review_text: I love this lip mask! Very hydrating, smells yummy, and isn’t sticky when you fall asleep with it on. You can definitely tell you lips softer the next morning.
PERFECT i love mangos so the scent is perfect and i put this on at night and wake up in the morning with it still there and my lips feel so hydrated
It might be basic and viral but it’s good! Not too overpowering of a scent in vanilla.
I didn’t see good enough results for the price.  just feels like a normal lip balm, nothing super special

Great lip balm, however I’m not sure it lives up to the cult-ish hype it gets. It feels amazing going on but I don’t feel it does much in the way of leaving my lips moisturized any more so than say aquaphor would.
I was experiencing unusual lip dryness, I already felt and seen a difference after using for one night.
this product was amazing I use it every single night definitely 10 out of 10 and I would buy again
I am in love with this lip mask. Best one I have ever used and I have super dry lips, especially in the winter.

review_title: The lip sleeping mask of your dreams!
review_text: This lip sleeping mask has become a staple in my nighttime routine. The texture is soft and velvety, and it smells phenomenal. When I wake up, my lips feel plump, supple, and refreshed - a great product to add to the roster!

I really wanted to love this. I’ve heard such good things about it from others and for the week I used it I thought it would be the same. When I put it on it’s very soft but when I wake up in the morning my lips are drier than they were before. I didn’t realize the product was the thing doing it until I read other reviews saying the same thing. Very disappointed but glad I got it as part of my birthday gift and not purchasing the whole thing. I know it works for others so I say if you can get a sample, try it because you never know! Not for me but that’s ok.
I love this lip sleeping mask. It smells great and leaves my lips feeling moisturized and silky all night and into the morning! I recommend it to everyone!

I received the mini laneige set for my birthday gift and was very excited to try this out, I was originally going to pick this up when it first came out but people I knew personally had nothing but bad reviews about it so I changed my mind. I’ll never do that again, this is the best lip product I’ve ever used. I struggle with very dry and chapped lips, dr bronners lip balm, A&D ointment, aquaphor, medicated lip balm, you name it I’ve tried it, nothing really seemed to truly moisturize my lips quite the way I was looking for, even with drinking a crap ton of water to stay hydrated and continuously having something in my lips throughout the day. I tried the mini version of this mask after I had a cold that entailed a lot of most blowing and my lips were just cracked and sore from all of the friction from the tissues against my nose and lip area. This healed my chapped lips in 2 days, I kid you not. I seriously thought it was too good to be true so I went a few days without it just to see what would happen. A little chapped but nothing like I would have experienced had I not used any lip product before bed for even one night. My lips have continuously never felt this soft or hydrated since I’ve been using this product, ended up getting the holiday set so I have a few smaller sizes to carry in my purse with me and leave at my parents house when I visit them. If you’re on the fence about getting this PLEASE BUY IT I promise you won’t be disappointed!!!!

This product is pretty good. I used it if I don’t have anymore Ordinary products. I find if I use the Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 & Ordinary 100% Plant-Derived Squalane during night it actually works amazing!!!! No joke. I have tried a lot of lip balms and honestly I have found that those two Ordinary products help the most. Just put the hyaluronic first and then the 100% plant serum over and you’re good to go! TRY IT

I like the product but not this color/scent. I much prefer the original berry one. I like that it comes with an applicator. It’s very moisturizing. As mentioned by another reviewer, I need to be careful not to over-apply it because I did breakout around my mouth.
Everything’s a “mask” these days! I use this at night, and it does feel amazing. I never have any left to wipe away in the morning. Def just a lip gloss but a good one!
Love this product. I received it as a birthday gift. Will definitely purchase the full size.
Love this! i used to use chapstick ALL day long. Now that I use this every night, i have drastically cut down on using chapstick! Makes my lips smooth and soft

Love this product! Smells great not too strong.Lasts awhile Keeps my lips very moisturized. I bite my lips when I am anxious ( horrible habit), but I put this on at night and my lips feel and look great in the AM.

Haven’t had a whole lot of lip masks but love this one. Doesn’t give any irritation, love the smell (I got vanilla) and makes my lips soooooo soft. After I put it on, I love rubbing my lips together...they feel smooth as glass

First time trying the Laneige brand and I absolutely fell in love with this lip mask! I use it every day morning and night (even though it’s a sleeping mask) and it keeps my lips from drying out. This product also lasts a long time, I’ve been using it since last Spring and still have plenty of product left.
Love it. Makes lips super super soft and supple. I love that it comes with a tool to get the product out instead of using your nails

I know lipcare, and this does NOT hydrate your lips. I go through tubes and tubes of lipchap all the time, every month I buy a lot lets say. This is probably one of the most expensive masks that you put on your lips and doesn’t do anything but look nice. 100% looks juicy, the product lasts almost forever, as it doesn’t sink into your skin, so no need to reapply, unless you’ve wiped it off, as it just sits on top. It definitely will wipe off if you happen to roll over or take a sip of water on your glass, so realistically I doubt it lasts all night to keep hydration in, or any moisture. I absolutely hate this mask, but it looks nice. Smell is nice as well, but doesn’t have a lasting effect. Will not repurchase, I get 100% more lasting nightly hydration by using a blistex balm or something similar that will hydrate and moisten. If you want the novelty, go ahead, I just put on blistex and the balm on top because I’ve bought it and don’t mind the gloss because I paid for it, so I might as well use it and look cute for a maximum of 5 minutes. oh well. I do not recommend.

review_title: Leaves lips dry and wears off quickly
review_text: I first tried the original formulation a couple of times through samples and fell in love with the product. I expected the same results from the Gummy Bear color, but instead wake up every morning with lips that are more dry than before putting the product on at bedtime as other reviewers have noted. I don’t experience the same dryness when I skip a night and use an alternative product. I have also experienced the product wearing off quickly as other reviewers have written.

Extremely hydrating and plumping as well as soothing and tasteful! When you apply it at night and then wake up it looks like you just put it on. Last all night long. Been using this all winter and it’s almost a necessity for my lips at this point. A little goes a long way, but I use a lot obviously! It tastes and smells very good too.
my friend recommended me this product because she loves it so much, and so far I really like it! its last long on my lips and feels great. great product
I am obsessed with the lip sleeping mask but the gummy bear ones stains clothes and gets everywhere. Terrible color

I absolutely love this product, I cannot live without it. I have very dry lips and I smother it on with the plastic applicator included in the box every night. I have also put this stuff on with my pinky finger, but since you need a good amount to really make a “mask“ the applicator is prime. The scent is amazing and the product is tasteless. It also creates a stunning 90’s vibe look if you use a smaller amount as chapstick during the day. For 22$ you honestly cannot go wrong!

This is amazing. I use it every night. My lips look so plump in the morning and the hydration lasts all day. My daughter is a mouth breather when she sleeps haha, so her lips were perpetually chapped but not since she started using this at night. As an added bonus, I swear my lips look fuller since I started using it.

If you suffer from dry and cracked lips, especially during the winter months, do yourself a favour and buy this.  Not only does it smell amazing, but it works so well!  Last night my lips were cracked, dry, and in serious need of care, and I used this for the first time, and OMG.  I honestly don’t know why I’ve waited so long to try it out.  Get this, your lips will thank you!
I LOVE this lip mask. I put it on every night right before I go to sleep, I keep it on my bedside table. Nothing has ever saved my dry winter lips like this product has!

review_title: Love how soft my lips feel
review_text: I love putting this on at night before going to bed. It’s now a part of my daily routine. It. One switch a little silicone spatula to apply product to your lips. Goes on super lush and it’s not sticky at all. Just glides on and feels super hydrating. I wake up in the morning and my lips are soft.

1000% percent would recommend. I use it every night, it is my favorite part of my skincare routine. It feels so good on your lips, not too think and very moisturizing. It smells so good, too. It comes with a cute little applicator too so you get just enough product. You need this in your life!

This is called a sleeping mask but I use it during the day too for my chronically dry, chapped lips. I put a dab on and “ahh...“ as it sinks in immediately. My previous favorite was the Fresh treatment stick, but this is just a bit thicker and lasts longer. The flavor is light, barely noticeable.

I’ve been using this product for a few months already, and oh my god what an excellent product. I feel my lips so soft the next day. I don’t have to focus on my chapped lips every few hours when I wear my matte lipsticks. Will buy again when I finish!
love the barely there tint of the gummy bear scent. although it smells more like grape kool-aid which i’m not mad about! i loved the formula of the original and this is no different. love it.

Let me start by saying that I love this lip mask! It’s not too thick to where it feels like a goopy mess, but it is thick enough to provide moisture that stays on your lips and doesn’t wear off easily.However, the Gummy Bear scent is more like grape. (As other people have mentioned) The smell is still good, unless of course, you don’t like grape. Overall, if it came down to it, I would purchase again based on product effectiveness, not smell.
I love this!  The first night I used this and when I woke up, my lips were so soft!

At first I was excited and loved the smell and feel on my lips. Once morning came my lips were dry. I have extremely dry lips that flake and look disgusting. I finally started putting nothing but blistex on and they started getting soft then after two nights of using this my lips were dry and chapping all over again! I had high hopes and was disappointed.

I’ve been using this lip mask every night for 2 weeks and overall my lips are softer and more hydrated, but I can’t say it’s worth the price.  When I wake up in the morning my lips are okay. I’ve used other more affordable lip masks that have worked better. This product is good but not amazing. I am recommending because the product isn’t bad, but it isn’t anything revolutionary.
After 2 weeks of using this, my lips have never been more chapped! I’m not sure why people like this or how they use it...my lips are burning!

This immediately replaced by lip glosses, lipsticks, etc. because it is perfect. It accentuates the color my lips already have and leaves them feeling so hydrated. I wear it morning & night, & can’t recommend the product enough. Already bought another & will continue to do so.

I got this product in its mini/free sample version. Very impressive, I use it only when I have dry lips, overnight and I wake up super plump and nice. This makes wonders, much better than a carmex or whatever you’d find elsewhere.

I had a slice on my upper lip since end of December. I wore this for the first time last night and the cut feels healed already. It no longer stings, and I can see it closing. Plus it smells and feels amazing

I bought the Vanilla lip mask and am obsessed with it. I had the worst dry lips before using this. life changing and not to mention it smells amazing!! the amount you receive is enough to last you more then if you bought 4 smaller cheaper lip balms or lip masks. Worth the price and just over all love love love this. I have recommended this to many friends lots have bought it as well.
Best best product! This is the best Sephora purchase ever. I love the original flavor the most , super hydrating and it gives baby soft lips every single time!
Scent is yummy !!! Feels really nice on !  I have used a few times and so far so good !
Amazing product! Moisturizes very well and smells delicious! Definitely a holy grail for me :)
Love the smell and taste. It has helped my lips heal, as I tend to have very dry lips in the winter. It makes a beautiful color on the lips. Barely there but glows.

One of my favorite products. My lips get dry and flaky, and this immediately moisturizes. I not only wear this at night, but it’s one of my favorite daytime lip balms. It has a subtle bubblegum tone that’s universally flattering. Love the texture. Not too sticky.

Based on this products reviews, reputation, and price I was expecting that this would work better than it did for me. It does feel nice and smoothly greasy when you put it on at night. It doesn’t smell or taste bad. It just doesn’t do much for my dry peeling lips. It doesn’t work any better than most of the widely available cheap lip products that I already have. I won’t be repurchasing this.

review_title: I’ll stick with my regular chapstick over this
review_text: I was so excited about this and it felt nice going on but then I was like, umm...this doesn’t even feel like it stays on. My lips felt kind of gross after having it on every time I tried it. I’m not sure what the hype is? Maybe if someone has never used chap stick before they would like this?? I will stick with my Burt’s Bees original chapstick, thank you!
I have tried two flavors of this sleeping mask, this is the only lip product I’ve tried that has had lasting results. I went a few weeks without it to try a different lip balm but went back to this.

I really don’t think this did anything special for my lips. I feel like I have other balms that do better, particularly the one from Sol de Janeiro. It’s a decent moisturizer for the lips but it’s not really anything special.
Amazing lip product. I use it before bed as a “mask“ but also as a lipbalm whenever my lips are feeling extra dry. I can’t imagine anyone not liking this product.

As a forgetful daytime lip hydrator, I love that I can fall asleep with this mask on. I have troublesome dry lips during most seasons. I found this to be the perfect product to retain moisture and allow my lips to reset during the night. Using this product every night, I still have a lot of product left! Will definitely repurchase when I use the last of it.

Don’t think, just buy it! Provides incredible moisture without any weird texture. Goes on so smooth and the vanilla smells amazing! I love to use this during the day as well. I’ve been using for 3 weeks and it looks like I’ve barely touched it, should last a very long time.

This was a negative for me all around. I can’t wear at night if I want to kiss my BF, it doesn’t sink in at all, ever! After a night’s sleep it was the same gooey mess as when it was applied, except that it had gathered fuzz from the bedsheets. Seriously ughh! Not for me at all. Waaaay too high maintenance for this girl.

review_title: This rescued my poor chapped lips!
review_text: This lip mask got me through my first north east winter with ease. I’m from a hot humid climate originally, so my lips were in a panic in all the negative degree temperatures, wind, and snow. The cold dry air was absolutely assaulting my lips - until I found this gem! Used in combo with a sugar scrub, this product repairs, hydrates, and protects your lips in an instant. This product feels so luscious and smooth, and makes your lips so plump and pouty and soft. This is an absolute fall and winter essential! I can’t imagine a winter without it now. It’s a true necessity.
I’m 61...this stuff is great for smoothing my lips and even helps with those vertical lines us old people get around the lips.

The best lip mask ever! Lips dry, peeling... Apply mask generously and you will see and feel results the next morning!! The lip mask works and that I love!!! I love a product that lives up to it’s description! I am a fan of this product because I love my lips to be soft (if an emoji could be added... I would be blowing kisses)!!

The first day I bought it and I used it that night.  I woke up with my lips Sooo Soft!! ,but after the nights after that my lips weren’t as soft as the first time. I still give it 4 stars and it smells soo Bomb!
Literally a god sent- I live in Oregon and our winters are VERY dry were my lips are constantly dry- this saved me from fire-y lips. Highly recommend!

I get cracked lips from allergies or if my fan hits my face in my sleep. It can be really painful but normal chapstick doesn’t cut it, and definitely not over night. My sister got this for me. I was skeptical but a month later using 2 or 3 times a week has been phenomenal! I’ll be rebuying this for sure and highly recommend to those who tend to not react well to other types of lip moisturizers for sleeping.

Smells good, feels good on my lips and typically lasts all night but I’m not sure what the hype is about. If your looking for a fancy pants version of Aquaphor, go for it. It is fun to have simple luxuries (and this is one of them) but I’m not sure there is anything super life changing about it.

I am currently halfway through my course of accutane. A lot of people online rave about this for the extreme dry lip side effects. Tbh the difference has not been dramatic since swapping products. Was slathering on blistex lip medix and aquaphor before. Although, this does smell and look better on. For those not on accutane, I have friends with “normal lips” who love it. However; if you have heard it will dramatically moisturize your chapped lips- lower your expectations.
This product was very sticky. It was kind of hard to wash off in the morning, but did leave my lips feeling soft.
It is a lot like fancy Vaseline. Same consistency and feel, but with a nice tint and smell. Works great and lips wake up refreshed and plump.

I’m on month four of Accutane and I swear by this product. I use it every night before bed and when I fly, and it helps protect/heal my super chapped lips. It smells good, feels nice, and is a decent price
I love this product!! I got it for free in my voxbox and it’s my new go too! #ISleptWithLANEIGE #KissedbyLANEIGE #contest #complimentary @laneigeca @Influenster

Super hydrating! I’ve always tried out drugstore products and I would always have to reapply after hours. I’ve worn this including Kheils lip balm and it’s super hydrating. I don’t have to reapply. Super hydrating, leaves lips really smooth and shiny. Can be used as a night time routine or a daily lip balm mask
Love this! Amazing as a gloss as well.
This is a nice sleeping mask. I received a sample and liked the product so I ordered. Seems as tho the sample was better.

I will admit, I purchased this product because of all the YouTube hype behind it. Lucky for me it’s actually a solid product. My lips feel extra moisturized and plump. I’ve also used this as a balm during the day and it really has amazing lasting power. You get tons of product, so do not let the small jar full you (remember it’s going on your lips which is a small area). I would definitely recommend this to anyone, especially if you are a matte lip wearer or have dry cracking lips!

review_title: best lip product i’ve ever used
review_text: i have never used a product that was this moisturizing and perfect for my lips. if i have chapped lips, i put this on at night and it is gone the next day. i 10/10 recommend even for the price because it goes a long way and it is well worth it.

Absolutely obsessed. Went into Sephora to try the regular pink bottle of this but it was sold out so I got this one and I love it! Makes my lips look gorgeous when I have this on and makes them very smooth and hydrated. I live in a cold area so my lips are always chapped, this is a life saver!!
I use this during the day and at night! Love how this saves my Lips in winter. Very moisturizing and I will for sure keep one on hand always.

This product is AMAZING it makes your lips look so juicy but also moisturizes them so well. I honestly wear this to bed and of it public because it it the perfect mix between a lip balm and a gloss. I use it everyday and I still have barely made an indent. 10/10 WOULD RECOMEND

There’s a lot of ridiculous things that make me qualify for Rouge status year after year. $400 Dyson blow dryer, ridiculous. $70 Armani foundation, ridiculous. $100 Sunday Riley oil, ridiculous. All of the $100s spent on Dior, Tatcha, La Mer, Tata Harper lip balms? RIDICULOUS. However, Laneige $20 lip balm- NOT ridiculous. Do not take it lightly when I say this will be the best chapstick you ever use. Nasty winter lips? This will erase that in 2 nights. Cracked lips? 3 nights. Bad breakup leaving you crying with puffy undereyes and even puffier lips? 1 night. This stuff is magic and if this cost even $40 I would STILL buy it. I own both this and the vanilla one and love both. It lasts a super long time so cost per use is probably $0.0001 but maybe I’m just saying that to make me feel better about my spending habits. If there’s one thing at Sephora that you should purchase based on a cosmetic shopaholic’s opinion, it is this. Thank me later. Also don’t recommend this to your friends because when I tried to be godly and spread the word they looked at me with 5 heads for using $20 chapstick. Thank me on that one later too.
I have been through a million lip treatments in my life because my lips are always chapped.  This one is the best by far - other than plain old zinc oxide.

Great lip mask! I appreciate even more as it gets colder outside, it has healed the dryness and chaps my lips have developed. I don’t just use it at night I use it in the morning and during the day as well.

In love with this product.  My lips are always dry to the point they bleed a little sometimes and I have to carry everywhere a lipbalm.  Eversince I started using this mask my lips have been so moisturized that I didn’t even need balm so much.  First i received it as a free sample,  i loved it so much that I bought it

I was very skeptical trying out an overnight lip mask but it turned out well. My lips felt hydrated in the morning and surprisingly a bit of the mask was left to wipe off. Overall cool experience. I received this mask free for testing
I received this product to try from Influenster and I was surprised at how much it worked after one application!! My lips felt really soft and it was light!! I will definitely be purchasing more

I love love love this lip mask! The scent/taste is light but still lovely and not over powering for at night. It honestly leaves my lips feeling so refreshed, hydrated and soft! It repairs my lips after I constantly abuse them with matte lipsticks. (I received this product free for testing but all opinions are my own)
Omg.  This has your lips feeling super soft. It does remove dry skin(my daughter tried it and was amazed that her super dry lips were gone). Its glossy and smells good.
Leaves my lips soft and supple in the morning. Hydrated lips all winter long.
I wanted to like this. My lips feel the same as they did without using this product. It’s not worth the price.
Using it a few days now And so far so good. Has no smell or taste. Has been keeping my lips soft
I thought that this actually just sat on my lips and never penetrated them. I was disappointed and surprised by all the rave reviews.  Just not for me.

I bought this about a week ago and let me tell ya this was the best purchase!! After my first use My lips were so soft and moisturized! A little goes a long way, so the price for this is perfect considering this will definitely last you months. The soft berry scent is perfect because it’s not overpowering but it’s subtle so you get a light hint of it. Highly recommend this product!
THE BEST LIP SLEEPING MASK EVER!!!! Not sticky or heavy at all. Feels very smooth and light. Totally worth the money!!! Also comes with a brush so you don’t contaminate the product!!!!

Am I crazy or does this smell like banana split dippin dots? They are my favorite and I can’t get them out of my head when I use this lol. I got a small edition in a Sephora favorites and I adore this! It just melts into my lips. Lots of product, affordable, pleasant smell, color and texture and actually works. Can’t go wrong.

This! Yall need to listen here. I was wondering if the mask was a kind of scrub you leave over night. To my surprise, it was a smooth, butter cream mask to be applied to your lips before sleeping. I saw the incredible reviews and I said that I must get my hands on this product, especially in this harsh winter season which leaves cracked and dried lips. Just yesterday night, I applied it to my lips which makes it creamy and quite enjoyable. This morning, upon looking myself in the mirror, I saw some beautiful pinkish plumped lips! This is no lie, I promise! My lips looked incredibly healthy and it was as if i did a plumped session just the day before. I had different expectations but i swear this is beyond everything. My lips look super healthy. It is worth the splurge!

I’ve had chapped lips my whole life. In winter, summer, ALL THE TIME. Nothing I tried worked until this mask. It’s only my third night wearing it and my lips have never been this nice!! I woke up to soft lips and they stayed this way throughout the day. I can’t recommend it enough!!
Very nice product!  I use am under lipstick, pm, and sometimes during the day.  Keeps lips moisturized all night so I don’t wake up with cracked lips.  Definitely recommend!

review_title: Great lip mask, just did not work for me
review_text: I really wanted to like this after seeing and hearing all the rave reviews.  I would apply as directed before bed and wake up with dry, patchy lips.  My lips were in better shape before I applied the mask and went to bed than after I applied and woke up.  Tried several times but always woke up to a chapped lip.  In fairness to the product, I do have some sensitivities to lip products and there must be something in this that is irritating to my lips.  I don’t think it’s the fragrance, as I use Fresh lip products which also have fragrance but don’t have any bad reactions.  I think it’s a high quality product and even though it’s a little pricey you get a good amount.  Personally it just did not work for me and I’ll stick to Fresh or Sara Happ lip slip for heavy overnight treatments.

If you’re feeling any hesitation about buying this.... DON’T. This is probably the best lip purchase I’ve ever made. For $20 you get a lot of product that will last you at the very least a couple months to a year, depending on how much you use. It comes with this nice silicone applicator so you don’t have to dig your fingers into it, and as someone with long nails, it’s so much easier. It has a very nourishing, moisturizing feel, and quickly cleared up my chapped lips. It has a shine that isn’t too over the top, and it really does bring a nice, plump pinkness to the skin.  The berry scent isn’t too strong, either, it’s just right. I wish they made this is a chapstick form that was more travel friendly, because I love it so much I want one in my purse!

review_title: Very good mask but not very moisturizing!!!
review_text: It makes my lips so soft and give it a natural red color. But it’s not very moisturizing for me.
OH. MY. GOD. This is magic. Lips feel instantly nourished and supple. Still moisturized in the morning. The nude/pink color is so gorgeous that I’m going to start using it as a daily lip balm.
Lips feel and look amazing!! So soft. Product smells pleasant and no weird taste. I actually use at night and during day sometimes over lipstick. Lots of product - great price for the amount!

review_title: sits on top of skin!!!! bad!!!!

review_title: Okay Moisturizer, Not Worth the Price
review_text: I’ve been using this moisturizer for a few months now and it’s just okay. It’s not as moisturizing as I would like, it’s good for summer and daytime use but I definitely need something more moisturizing at night. It also spreads weird, it doesn’t sink into my skin right away so I have to rub it in for a good minute before it’s fully absorbed. If this was cheaper, I would buy it again but given the price, I’m not planning on repurchasing any time soon.

review_title: Size of container is not misleading
review_text: This product works very well I fell in love when I got a sample size and have been buying it ever since!! I’ve seen reviews where people say it’s not worth it Bc there’s very little product compared to the size of the container but if you take it apart when it’s finished and simply push down on the plastic thing that holds the product you will seen it move down then put it back together and press on the part that dispenses it multiple time and take it apart again you will see that the part that holds the product has moved back up towards the top of the container so no the size of the container isn’t misleading. In fact I bought a new one and took it apart and my theory was correct. I will continue to buy this product because it is the best moisturizer I’ve ever tried and help with those dry patches that seem to not go away it also doesn’t make your skin look oily! And is easy on sensitive skin.

It’s alright. I feel like it’s not moisturizing enough to use on its own and I have to use serums to help deliver hydration. As for delivering peptides and proteins, I didn’t really notice a difference in my skin and I’ve gone through a couple bottles.Also sometimes when you apply it and mix it with other DE products (or other lines) it creates this white sticky residue. The residue goes away in like 10 minutes and seems to be absorbed in the skin, but idk why that residue is there…

review_title: Best thing for my skin ever. In my life.
review_text: This is the BEST thing I’ve ever purchased for my face in my entire life. My skin is soft, supple and even-textured because of this product. It is an indulgence well worth it’s price tag. I live in a very dry climate (Utah) and my skin has always struggled with dryness and dullness. I’m also getting older (38, don’t even worry about it) and wanted something to get ahead of more gentle anti-aging regimes. This is the thing. Every night, every time. And it goes a long way.

Not worth the money! Definitely overhyped and this Doctor on YouTube mentioned it was good for the elasticity. Disappointed on this product especially charging customers so much for not so great of a product.

My first purchase of this product and I’m so delighted and happy with the consistency and effectiveness.  Kind of expensive for my budget, but I took a chance.   Took me a second to figure out the different dispensing system,  but now I really like it !

Was hesitant about getting this because I hate how expensive drunk elephant is but this product completely turned me onto this brand. It’s so smooth and refreshing on my skin I don’t feel oily after using it and it did not make me breakout. New favorite face moisturizer.

I used this for about a month and a half and my skin has never been healthier. It’s a little harsh on sensitive skin and it did cause break outs when I first started using, but it did clear up after a week.

I used this product with the protein serum, and I would highly recommend! They go very well together. I’m 30 weeks pregnant with picky skin, and this has helped to clear my face and balance my skin tone! It has a light aroma, and leaves my skin feeling fresh, not greasy.

This moisturizer did wonders for my skin. But I will likely never purchase it again simply due to the ridiculous packaging. I love drunk elephant and their products but more and more I’m recognizing that they are focused on the marketing rather than the quality of product. I’m not buying your skincare for the fancy boxes but the product itself and what a way to trick the consumer that they are getting this huge bottle of moisturizer meanwhile 3/4 of it is plastic. Clean makeup? Clean for who? As far as I’m concerned they’re a dirty brand as far as waste production goes. No thanks.

review_title: Not moisturizing enough and didn't provide results
review_text: I’ve been using this product for 3 months and did not see any difference in my skin as far as fine lines, wrinkles, loss of firmness or being moisturizing.    Skin needed to be wet before applying in order to absorb fully, but skin didn’t feel replenished and moist.   Great packaging.  If you are looking for a deep moisturizer that plumps and repairs, this may not be the one.

Um it works. I don’t know if it’s the combo with which I’m using it, but initially I used a sample. Loved it. Finished it. And went back to using another moisturizer and immediately noticed a difference, so went and bought this. It’s been worth it.
Love everything about this! The formula is lightweight, but a little goes a long way. Love how refreshed it makes my skin feel.

Very nice, thick cream! I’ve been using this nightly with the Protini Serum. I really like mixing the 2 together and I’ve notice such a nice change in my skin. Everything absorbs nicely and doesn’t feel sticky or gross like some creams do. I wish you got a little more for the price but it is nice.

I’ve used this moisturizer + the DE cleanser for more than 2 years now and I absolutely love it. A little goes a long way and it’s not too thick. It absorbs into my skin very well and hydrates me throughout the night. It has never made me appear oily throughout the day either. LOVE the fact that they got an even bigger size and purchased as soon as I saw! Definitely maintains my skins moisture and softness.

review_title: I want to open the container
review_text: What I like about this product is also what I don’t like, the container.  I appreciate that it doles out the amount I need, I can’t tell when I’m running low and since I can’t open the lid, I can’t get all that remains. I know there is more left!  This it too expensive a product to not get to it all!
I received this as my birthday reward last year and found it to be too heavy to my liking. Not much else to say about it. It didn’t wow me like I thought it would.
Has a greasy feel after application and feels like it just sits on top. It’s great for before bedtime but I don’t use it in the morning.

I got this as a sample size and I used it as a day moisturizer. I liked how it had no scent and didn’t feel heavy. I also had a lot of maskne that was dry and this helped it. I also layered it with a couple of other things and had no reaction to them being combined. I would buy this again.

Hands down the best moisturizer!! It feels and look thick in the jar but melts on your skin and when you apply to your face - it gives a very refreshing feel. Feels like you just watered you plant (skin)

I love a moisturizer that doesn’t cause my skin to feel oily/greasy after using it. I noticed a difference in how soft and revived my skin looked after the first use! It’s crazy how fast this works and how spot-on it is to the description.

This product was alright. In my opinion, after a while it makes my skin super oily. I’m not sure why. I have combination skin so i apply it every where except for my t-zone and i still get oily. i wouldn’t recommend it if you have combination skin. it’s too thick and doesn’t absorb well either.

I love this moisturizer so much! I’ve gone through almost 4 containers of it. My skin always feels very soft after I use it. It’s also lightweight on the skin and looks great under makeup. I love love love this moisturizer!

review_title: good, but cheaper alternatives out there
review_text: I’ve tried many other DE products and have always found them to be a home run for me, particularly their Vitamin C serum and their Glycolic night serum, as well as their Hydrating Serum. I have combo oily skin and had always heard good things about this cream so I finally went for it during a VIB sale. It’s good. I liked the consistency, not too tacky and sticky like alot of gel moisturizers, and I liked how it delivered just the right amount of hydration. It absorbed into my skin nicely and didn’t ever feel oily. However, this lasted just under 2 months, with me using it as a day cream. It seems like a lot of money for something where there are alot of good alternatives. Enjoyed this and might even repurchase it in the future at a heavy discount but will opt for cheaper alternatives.

I got this as part of the birthday gift and used it on my face/neck every night. At first the texture was very creamy and pleasant to apply. However, after about 2 weeks of use, this moisturizer started to sting when I used it and it made my skin feel very itchy. I did not switch to any new skincare products or hair products during that time, or change any other parts of my routine--so I suspect there was something in this moisturizer that was irritating my skin. I have combo/acne prone skin, and while this did not break me out, it irritated my skin. I ended up finishing the rest as hand cream. I know people who swear by this stuff, but it wasn’t the moisturizer for me--plus I think the price tag for a full tub of this is a little ridiculous.

I used the mini version of this the free birthday gift and i promise you it is a great consistency, feel light on the skin. I’d say like a lesser weight then CERVE cream but it wasn’t glorious.. CERVE is thicker and cheaper and much better price per OZ.
I love this moisturizer. I use it at night after I wash my face before bed. I have oily skin and this keeps it very hydrated. I highly recommend

I’m on my second month)The packaging is A+ ... all those good ingredients stay active and I don’t have to keep putting my fingers in the jar. This has made a change in my skin by looking fresher. I also use other Drunk Elephant products coincided with this, so I don’t know if that’s why it’s working well!Skin looks healthy and fresh!
Not a fan, this did nothing to help my dry skin. Also smelled very chemically. Not a fan of the container either because you have no clue how much product you have.

My Life is Complete! I have really dry skin and it looks old and wrinkly if i dont moisturize! Ever since I tried the Deluxe sample my skin literally fell in love! Minus the fact its soooo pricey, one pump goes a long way(i apply full face, full neck and behind ears)! I love the pump feature bcuz u never cross contaminate ur jar of moisturizer and it keeps my face soft and supple throughout the day. I will never switch to another!

This moisturizer definitely moisturized my skin. When I would use it at night, I’d wake up with plump and firm skin. It’s not the best that I’ve used compared to my other moisturizing creams. However, it does what its advertised to do. It didn’t do anything for my skin’s tone or texture though.
Love this moisturizer, I’ve been using it for almost a year now and it’s absolutely fantastic. It’s lightweight but doesn’t leave my skin feeling dry when I wake up in the morning.

I hate that I love this moisturizer so much (because $$$). I have dry skin that gets extra dry in winter, so I used to buy a light summer moisturizer and heavy-duty winter moisturizer — this is an all-in-one solution. It’s lightweight (aka not heavy and oily) yet extremely hydrating. There’s no cons with this product — a neutral, natural smell; layers well under make-up; absorbs well; effective. I like the unique packaging too. It gives you just enough product with every pump.

Don’t really understand the hype at all. This product smells like play dough and the moisturizer is so thick. If you are prone to blackheads BEWARE. I have never seen so many blackheads on my chin, nose and forehead after using this product for about a month. It does leave my skin fairly soft but that’s all I can say and many other products do that without clogging my pores this bad.

My friend raved about this moisturizer so I thought I should give it a try. Initially, I used it twice a day (morning and night). By the middle of the first week I noticed my face was kind of flakey... so I cut it down to just once a day (night) and used another moisturizer for the day. Within 2 weeks I noticed my skin cleared up (I’m prone to zits in the cheek, chin and upper lip area plus I have zit scars on my cheeks). I was so shocked! My skin felt so smooth, firm and supple, but after a month with continued use I’ve been noticing that it’s been making my skin flaky again... and I’m breaking out again.... maybe I’ll try it again after the flaking goes away? I really want this moisturizer to work!!!!!!!

I really wish I liked this product more but it broke me out. I had the sample size for a while from a birthday gift and it was great, not sure why this left my skin so oily. It’s a bummer too because I love sanitary packaging like this :( It’s tough to find moisturizers with airless pumps.

Hands down, best skin product I own. I got a sample size last year as a birthday gift and had to purchase when I ran out! I just purchased my second one yesterday! Lasted almost a full year and I use it almost every morning. It is super light weight, and doesn’t leave an oily residue on your skin like other moisturizers do. This has reduced the visibility of my pores and made my skin look and feel more radiant. Will continue to purchase again and again!

I was hesitant to write a review because I don’t want all of you causing this to go out of stock and leaving me without any. But I have to tell you how amazing this is! I bought it after a free sample completely cleared and healed my skin after just a couple days’ use. IT’S AMAZING. I’ve been using it for two months (that’s about how long a tub will last, using almost every morning AND evening) and I just ordered another. Two months has made the lines on my forehead almost disappear and I can hardly feel them anymore either, my embarrassing acne in my 30’s is almost gone, and this stuff heals a breakout quickly. The cream feels incredible, soaks in completely, is not greasy, works great under makeup (Urban Decay liquid foundation), and doesn’t have any strange scents. IT’S LITERALLY PERFECT. Im now replacing all of my skincare with Drunk Elephant!

This is fine. I like that its cruelty free and fragrance free. I like that it has peptides in it. The finish is nice for daytime wear (non-greasy on my combo skin) and it didn’t break me out. However, the price is just too high in my opinion. You can get peptides from The Ordinary for much less. It’s a solid choice if you can afford it. I don’t think its worth breaking the bank for though.

I was really excited to use this because it has so much hype, but I honestly thought it was just okay. I have combo skin and I was using it during the winter and I don’t think it helped moisturize my dry patches very much. I do like that it releases the perfect amount of product, but if your skin is on the drier side, I would use the Lala Retro Whipped Cream or one of the Tatcha moisturizers.

review_title: Nice product... but my mind isn't blown
review_text: I really do enjoy this product first of all! It has a nice texture, lovely ingredients, and leaves my skin feeling nice. I didn’t notice a dramatic difference in my skin while using this product however. I feel that my texture and fine lines are more or less the same. I’ve only been using it for about 4 months, so maybe that is a factor. However, I’m not sure I can justify the price. It more or less acts like a “nice“ moisturizer. It possible my skin just needs something more moisturizing in winter months. I wouldn’t write this product off completely, but for me it wasn’t the HG product I thought I might be based another reviews. Maybe I’ll give it another try in the future.

Little to no difference unfortunately! I got the same results as applying coconut oil and a little basic moisturizer on my face. I love Drunken Elephant mini facial but I haven’t had much luck purchasing and sampling her other products. But everything works differently for different ppl. I guess if your skin is really normal without any issues this is good.

review_title: Not the same as it used to be!
review_text: The formula changed. I’m so disappointed. I loved the original formula, but the last one I purchased is thicker and doesn’t give me the instant firming feeling that protini used to provide.

This is such a dreamy face cream! I love the lightweight texture and have been surprised at how moisturizing the formula is. It soaks into my skin locking in hydration and creating a smooth, bouncy complextion.The packing is ideal to keep the product sanitary and dispessses an ideal amount for application. The surface is also great for maxing DE smoothies, I like to pump out my moisturizer and then mix in my serum and oils before applying. It’s so quick and easy! Overall this is an amazing product that is great to splurge on if you can!
Made a notable difference in the hydration and smoothness of my skin in short period of time!

I love the way this feels when you put it on.  It’s so soothing, and calming.  I got this as a sample for my birthday, and I will definitely be buying it.  I have noticed when the air is dry you may need to use a bit more, which is why I’m only giving it four stars.

I didn’t want to love this but I do love it. I received this as part of my Sephora birthday gift this year and I’ve never used a moisturizer that made such a difference for my skin. My skin always felt so hydrated and plump, and it looked great under makeup or on its own. I highly recommend this product if you can afford the price.
Caused my normal to dry skin to break out after 2 weeks of use

I absolutely SWEAR by this cream as a moisturizer. I use it pretty much every day after the B-firma and C-hydra serums in the morning. Together they all make my skin so incredibly soft. My friends have told me that my pores look smaller and my skin looks more even. I personally don’t know much about that (save the pores, I stopped doing pore cleaning masks as often as I used to), but my skin has never felt softer. Definitely helps give you that soft baby skin touch that everyone is looking for if you stick to it. I ordered this in the summer and I’m not even a quarter through it yet.

I received this as one of my birthday gifts from Sephora. (Mini size, of course) I was hesitant to try it since I’m a tatcha water cream girl. But I have to say, after using this moisturizer, I have found my skin to be very moisturized and soft after cleansing, toning, adding a little bit of grape seed oil, and then the moisturizer. My face looks clean and healthy after applying the cream. On the days where I just use toner and the cream, I get the same results. I’m on the ropes of buying this in full size since I really enjoyed the experience. I did not have this kind of reaction to the Water Cream and I love Tatcha products. Also, I’m normal to oily skin around my T zone. I have not noticed any breakout issues other than the one’s I get on the norm.
NOT good for dry skin. Did absolutely nothing for me.

Drunk Elephant is quickly becoming my favorite skincare brand! After trying their products I see why they come with a hefty price tag. It’s worth every penny. This is the best moisturizer I’ve ever used period. Whenever I use this moisturizer I look so baby faced, fresh, and glowing. It leaves my skin feeling truly baby soft, supple, and plump like no other product I’ve tried. It’s not too sticky, it’s not too watery, it’s not too heavy - it’s just perfect. It has almost a pillowy texture, and leaves your skin with that same pillowy plumpness. It feels like it’s genuinely hydrating my skin so deeply. I’m in love - this is my forever favorite moisturizer! Can’t recommend this product enough.

I have been using this moisturizer morning and night for the last month and a half and am loving it. I was using tatcha water cream, which is also a great moisturizer, but I feel like it didn’t always moisturize at night as much as I would’ve liked it to, especially in the colder months. I use this underneath Anastasia luminous foundation and it works great! No smearing and lasts for a full work day.

review_title: I can’t say enough good things!!
review_text: Wow. Just wow! One of the best moisturizers I have ever used! A little goes a long way. The packaging is so cute and the little pump in the jar makes for easy, mess-free application. Would HIIIIGGHHLLYY recommend!!

Terrible product. I heard such great things about this product but it does not work for me. It made my skin worse. After the first use, my skin was red, itchy, dry, tight, and bumpy. I was using this with the drunk elephant jelly-c cleanser. I continued to use the products for a week because I thought maybe my skin just needed to get used to the products but it’s much worse now. I have dry and sensitive skin around my mouth but very oily skin on my forehead and there are bumps all over my face now.

I have dry skin and was excited to try this product. I received it in the birthday gift set, and also purchased the full-size. Thankfully I started with the mini before opening the full size because I didn’t enjoy it at all. It seemed to absorb into my skin, however, it left a heavy feeling on my face. Almost like I was sweating or overly oily all day. Definitely not with the money.

The product itself is amazing and my skin feels so replenished and renewed after using it. I also really love how the dispenser on this product is designed, its clever and saves me from having to reach into a container and get the product under finger nails so all in all a great product overall
This is my favourite moisturizer to use for spring, summer and fall. I love to mix it with C-Firma in the morning and TLC at night.

I tried the mini in this year’s BI birthday gift and I had to buy the full size. This stuff is amazing. I love it. Not to heavy. Not to light. It’s perfect! My skin is normally pretty balanced with the occasional breakout with sensitivity on my cheeks and this moisturizer works amazing! I’ve noticed firmer skin after ~2 months and softer, healthy looking skin. You’d have to pry this from my hands for me to give this up.

The first time I used Protini ny skin felt instantly protected, moisturized, and comfortable. A great nighttime moisturizer for dry to normal skin, might be too heavy for combo/oily. My skin feels stronger, great for winter everyday. Can do every few nights in summer, switch with lighter cream.

i received this as a sephora birthday gift. i’ve been using it for a couple of weeks now and i really like it! my skin is always VERY dry, and this moisturizer has really helped me. the only downside is that it’s pricey. i don’t know if i will buy this when my small jar runs out, but regardless of the price, it’s a good product.

I just received a trial size of this product for my birthday and I am IN LOVE. Not only do I love that it is a clean product, but I love how it feels on my skin. It’s pretty heavy, but I have DRY skin so it doesn’t feel heavy on my skin. I would 10/10 recommend this!

Perfect consistency for so many different kinds of skin types! Clean product great packaging & formula. Will be repurchasing for sure. Hydrating soothing plumping and moisturizing without being too heavy.

I am so happy with this purchase. I’m always a little worried spending so much for one product. Within two uses I started seeing a difference in the tautness of my skin. This is the first face cream ever that hasn’t clogged my pores and made me break out. Love love love.
I hit pan?!?! I go through so many products my family knows to come by and take what they want.  Not this made my face feel amazing.  Will definitely purchase again!
AMAZING!! Leaves my skin so soft

Thought this product would be an investment. I was done with the whole container in 6 weeks, using as suggested. Beginning to think I received a partially used product... very disappointed. Definitely not sustainable pricing for 6 weeks worth of use.
made me breakout :-(

I keep wanting to like it but... it just feels really greasy on my skin. To be honest I haven’t been using it long enough to be able to tell if it is doing much for my skin, but I definitely didn’t get any immediate crazy results. The ingredients and idea behind it sound great, so I’m still hopeful for long-term, but using it once a day so far hasn’t been doing a whole lot except make me think I need to wash my face again.

I really like this moisturizer. I received a trial size for my bday and lasted me about a week worths use with morning and night. It is kind of heavy like a body cream, and does make u feel waxy. I definitely would not use under makeup. But my skin is very dry and hydrated the heck out of me. I did not experience any breakouts either. Ive tried other moisturizers like embroylisse and mac or even oils like argan and Squalane but this takes the cake on instant hydration and relief.

Im in love everything about it have super  sensitive and a bit a redness near me nose and big pores and now my face is getting more youth appearance and smooth is so  moist  without that an  oilly feeling

Beautiful packaging with a dispensing mechanism that keeps product fresh and clean.  Delivers moisturization and smoothing properties without being greasy.  Soaks into skin nicely and works well with serums.  No overpowering or heavily fragranced scent and free of toxic ingredients.  A nourishing powerhouse.

review_title: LOVED & I HAVE OILY & ACNE PRONE SKIN
review_text: Probably the most AMAZING moisturizer I’ve found so far!!!! I have OILY & ACNE PRONE SKIN, so I needed one that didn’t leave me drenched in oily or broke me out. I love how it’s a water gel & 1 pump is all you need. It’s not sticky either & I’m evenly hydrated throughout the day. It even helped make my skin softer & I was hardly oily all day! Dosen’t sting, doesn’t smell weird, FEELS AMAZING!!!! It may be pricey, but trust & believe it’s WORTH IT. I’m also an Esthetician, so I’m picky about ingredients & I know everyone’s skin is different, but I’d DEFINITELY recommend anyone with the same issues as me to give this one a try!!!!
SO good. Just a little pricey. My face feels amazing with this on it, so smooth and luxurious.

This product is INSANE.  WRINKLE ERASER!  I should start by saying that I have ridiculously fair, sunburn-prone skin and I’ve got plenty of fine lines at age 35.  And I don’t skimp on my skincare routine-- La Mer, SKII, Murad Vit C, Tatcha Vit C, Caudalie-- I use them all daily in my futile quest to eradicate signs of early aging (and yes, I’m going to go broke trying).  Then three night ago I’m brushing my teeth and looking in the mirror and noticing that the lines around my mouth almost look like they’re disappearing.  And I realize that a week ago I started using a free sample of the Protini Polypeptide Cream.  I have NEVER had an anti-wrinkle cream work that fast and that EFFECTIVELY.  Sure, my expensive routine gets me brighter skin and (good god I hope) slower development of wrinkles, but this seemed to truly diminish my lines.  I’m in awe as I watch these wrinkles continue to fade.Obviously I ordered the full size immediately and am using it nightly.   Also using it when I need a little light moisturizer during the day, it’s a nice light texture.

I’ve been using this for about 10 days and my skin feels so toned and soft! It has evened out all of the texture I had on my forehead and around my nose. I usually opt for less expensive moisturizers but this has me second guessing that decision.

i finally bought this after eyeing it forever. the concept, the packaging and the ingredients really intrigued me! so, i bought it while on vacation at disney and am so pleased with it. very hydrating for my mostly dry combo skin, and SO SO brightening! i wake up every morning and my skin looks so soft, poreless and even. i’m only giving this four stars because the price is so steep. because of that i’m searching for its replacement, but, so far no luck. (part of me if happy though, because i do love this so much hehe).

I have really dry and relatively sensitive skin. I splurged and tried this cream and I noticed my skin was soft, and brighter almost immediately. I stopped using it for a few months to save $ and my skin went back to the desert, bumpy mess it had been. Never changing again!!

I purchased a small, essentially mini/sample size of this off of someone from Poshmark (I had also received a very small free sample in store, but it didn’t last long enough for me to feel confident in giving it a full review). After using for a couple of weeks now, I noticed that my skin feels smooth all day! I struggle with dry patches, especially in the colder months but so far this has been amazing. I notice the difference in my skin when I forget to use it. Definitely going to be purchasing the full size soon!

I love skincare even more than makeup and I first scooped this cram up the day it debuted on the Sephora app. It has a great texture and it moisturizes my normal to dry skin very well. It didn’t cause any breakouts and left my skin with a hydrated look.

I have very sensitive and finicky skin and have struggled with acne for years. This stuff is super gentle and doesn’t irritate my skin and seems to actually help it! I love everything that I have tried from this brand so far and they are one of the best skincare brands!! Great ingredients and worth the price tag! This moisturizer has become a staple in my collection and I will be repurchasing.

I really like this moisturizer, it’s part of my current routine. It was a bit spendy, but it’s cruelty free which was a big draw when I was looking to find something to replace my Algenist routine. I also REALLY like the container/pump system, but am curious as to how much goes to waste when it gets near the bottom?

review_title: Using it every day for three weeks, no change
review_text: It’s not worth the hype for me. This is my first DE product and I am not sure I am going to buy anything else from this brand. There is so much beauty products in K-cosmetics now for a fraction of this price. I wish I did more research before paying for it. It does nothing for me even with daily use. Would not recommend it for this price. It’s not a bad product either. I would get it again at around $20 price point.
Makes my skin hydrated while making it feel as if I’m not wearing anything!

review_title: Doesn’t moisturize or reduce fine lines
review_text: I am surprised this has rave reviews. I love DE products and have been using the TLC framboos serum, vitamin C serum and TLC baby facial 7 months. I’ve used Protini for 4 months and I can honestly say it has done nothing for my skin! I have normal skin with dryness around my nose. This product is NOT a moisturizer! It does not hydrate my skin at all, I still have to use a hydrating gel around my nose because this product does absolutely NOTHING for dryness! I’m 37 and have some fine lines around my eyes and on my forehead. After 4 months of use, I haven’t seen them diminish at all, no reduced appearance. I really dislike the texture this gives my skin—it leaves it feeling slightly sticky and not smooth & hydrated. It does not mix well with TLC framboos serum, it made a white cast on my face that was difficult to blend into my skin. The only positive things I can say about this is that it didn’t break out my skin and it has lasted around 4 months. But I definitely won’t buy this again.

I’m 46 yo. Oily nose area, dry cheeks.  Use retinol S and acids. This lotion works perfectly to hydrate my skin, but not make me greasy looking. It’s my first drunk elephant purchase, and I’m very very happy with it. Will purchase again. Btw - my hands and finger nails love this lotion also.

This is my new holy grail product. Got it as a tester and after trying it immediately ordered online (it was sold out at all 3 Sephoras near my house!). It is super hydrating, makes my face feel baby soft, and everyone has been complimenting me on how nice my skin has been looking lately! I seriously could not stop touching my face the first night and admiring how much healthier my skin looked. I love this product so much. There are a few drawbacks. I have been getting a few more whiteheads then normal (but they are not noticeable) and it is just okay for oily skin. (I have super oily T-zone and though this does not make it oilier, it does not keep my skin from being oily either.) But compared to how much better this makes my skin look, these small drawbacks are not a bother for me.
Just started exploring this line and so far it’s a Win-Win situation. My skin looks great!

This cream feels amazing on and I definitely think it has an almost instant plumping affect, BUT it’s definitely not for all skin types like the brand claims. I’ve been trying the DE skincare philosophy for two months (so the “suspicions 6” can’t be blamed) and after using a sample of this cream I had pimples forming within 5 hours. No joke. Be careful if you have sensitive, acne prone skin! I really wanted to love this cream, but I can’t.

review_title: Its better than average but not AMAZING!
review_text: I am always on the hunt for a great moisturizer. I guess we can say I’ve not found one I am in LOVE with. I do like the packaging and easy pump this offers. The price point is where I really struggle with this. I am noticing my skin feels hydrated and soft but not anything above and beyond. This hasn’t won me over. I just don’t feel like it is worth the price tag.
If you have a dry skin, this cream is not for you. I read so many good reviews about it, unfortunately for me, it drys out my skin.

I am in love with this product, I was in a battle with really dry and patch skin since I had my baby and it seemed like nothing was sticking to my skin. I tried so many remedies and natural skin care but nothing worked until this great find!! I love it and I’m happy it also battles anti-aging and wrinkles because as I am getting older I started thinking of working that into my skin care routine. Love this and will repurchase again!
Good every day moisturizer but can’t say that I notice anything amazing about my skin. Still, it doesn’t feel dry, so I guess this is fine.

I am absolutely obsessed with this moisturizer! I have very acne prone skin - one wrong move and I’ll have a huge breakout that takes months to get under control. I’ve been using a few DE products pretty successfully and after reading some reviews I decided to give this guy a shot. I am blown away at how amazing it makes my skin feel and look. Will purchase again and again!

Works so well on my oily-combo skin. It controls the oil on my face very well and I haven’t blotted that much throughout the day as I would with other lotions I’ve used. I got this in their trial size, but might do some investment and buy the full size when I’m done!

Been using this amazing stuff for almost a week! My dry skin has never felt better or looked better! I use this after my C-Firma with a pump of B-Hydra. I think it smells like fresh donuts and I am obsessed with how it leaves my skin feeling. I am looking into getting more from this skincare line!

This makes my skin feel so soft, hydrated and smooth! Lighter than their Lala Retro Creme but thicker than their B-Hydra Gel so it’s a perfect consistency for myself with combination skin. I put it on before bed after my TLC Serum and my skin is radiant and glowing by the morning. Also love the packaging! The pump is perfect for getting the right amount as to not waste any of the product. I like that it also keeps out any air or bacteria there would be from scooping it out of a jar with your hands or a spatula. Drunk Elephant products are a bit on the pricier side but as an aesthetician I can’t stress enough that your skin is worth the investment!

Loveeee this cream!!! I bought the Date Night set with the Lala Retro cream and I loved it but it was too heavy for my oily combination skin. This one is the perfect texture and gives me the perfect amount of moisture and plump before my makeup application!! The packaging and fragrance free is a plus for me also.
I received this as a sample at my local Sephora and fell Inlove instantly that I had to buy it! It really does take off all your makeup, love it so much

Gets the job done. It has a thinner oil consistency and spreads easily on the face. It emulsifies well. It didn’t irritate my skin. However, it didn’t leave my face feeling moisturized. Don’t recommend based on the price.

I’ve repurchased this product easily over 5 times. My favorite makeup removing method gentle on the skin and effective. Always start with DRY hands. I like to scoop 1-2 pea size pieces of product and work it into the skin in circular motions focussing on the eyeshadow/mascara to melt it all down. Once the makeup looks “melted” enough I then rinse with water, again focusing on my eyes to make sure the makeup and cleanser is rinsed off completely otherwise it will bother my eyes a bit. I then I use a facial cleanser to wash my face again because I like to double cleanse after wearing makeup but I’ve done a wipe test and the makeup balm does a great job on its own already. I will mention I tried the goodmolecules balm when I ran out of Farmacy Green clean thinking “hey its just a makeup remover balm it’ll work the same.” trying to save a few dollars and it didn’t remove any of my makeup

review_title: i was skeptical but now I am a believer
review_text: I didn’t believe the hype. I usually hate oil or oil based makeup remover because they either cause blurry vision and hard to remove completely, or they make my eyes sensitive or dry out my skin. For really stubborn eye makeup (like urban decay 24/7 eyeliner and Armani waterproof mascara)I’ve tried Lancôme eye biphase, channel eye makeup remover, bobbi brown’s, mary kay, Garnier micellar water, bioderma Michelle water, and tatcha makeup remover oil. Nothing worked as wonderfully as this one. No redness, no dryness, and makeup melts instantly so no too much rubbing. It goes away with water, or you can wipe it away. I will say make sure you really wash it off, which you can actually do that unlike cold cream… otherwise, you will have blurry vision. I only made that mistake the first time I used it. Now I only open my eyes if I feel complete clean when touching my eyelids. Trust me, this is The One. Look no further. Trust your friendly neighborhood perfectionist makeup maniac. P.S you don’t need double clean with this, but if you are ocd like me, double clean (follow up) with a regular face wash.Oh and I have combo acne prone fair skin.

Have bought this multiple times (along with the limited edition Christmas set) and it really does get everything off! I use a lot of sunscreen and I can def feel the difference between just using a foaming cleanser vs going in with this cleansing balm first. You honestly only need a tiny bit and it goes a long way.

My new favorite makeup remover! I used to use the Boscia cool cleansing oil and since Sephora doesn’t carry it anymore I decided to give this a go. I love oil based makeup removers for removing mascara and brows and this one is amazing. The scent is subtle and amazing and the texture is silky and smooth. You need just a little dot to remove a full face of makeup so this tub will last a long time. Definitely recommend it!
Never used makeup remover before until I used this beauty !! I always had left over makeup on my face but this removes everything leaving your skin hydrated

100% the best cleansing balm on the market. I’ve tried 6 or 7 but have never found one better than this one. Takes off all makeup incredibly easily. A little goes a long way so it is definitely worth the money.

review_title: I Iove it, BUT two things bother me!
review_text: Overall, this product does remove most of my make up and it did not burn or feel drying on my skin in any way. I had to scrub and add more balm in order to remove my waterproof my make-up but it did a good job for that. My thing was is that even though it does remove my make up I could still see plenty of residue from my foundation when I was done washing my face pretty heavy. So, I still had to use my cleanser to remove any residue that was left. I think for it stating to remove the residue and being a cleanser it is priced a little high so that was a “ehhhh” for me, but I can’t pretend that I don’t love the feel when I am removing my make-up. A Solid 4 for me!
Needed something that removed make up better than Neutrogena wipes.  This does the trick!! I do have to wash my face with mild sopa afterwards to fully remove balm.
I ordered this after seeing an influencer I follow on Instagram use it. This stuff definitely melts away makeup and smells amazing. A little goes a long way!

This product is a MUST for makeup removal. I got a small size of it in the Farmacy Value Set and as soon as it was done I purchased the full size of the Cleansing Balm without a second thought. One layer of this balm effortlessly removed a full face of makeup! This is honestly a much better alternative to makeup wipes especially if you have sensitive, textured skin with rosacea like myself and want to avoid any irritation that comes with using makeup wipes.
Amazing at removing waterproof makeup and does not burn eyes!
My absolute favourite way to remove make up. It feels so natural, the scent isn’t overwhelming and it does a great job cleaning my face. You don’t need a lot of product so the jar lasts long!

For that much money, one could find better product to remove their makeup
My absolute favorite make up remover!! Love the scent, breaks down make up easily, rinses off quickly, and leaves my face feeling clean but not stripped. What more could you want?!

i can’t talk enough about this product. i first got it as a sample at sephora and after i tried it i immediately bought the full size. i use it every night before my cleanser and it removes makeup in the EASIEST way possible. it doesn’t require any rubbing, it just melts the makeup away. it is a very gentle formula, i have sort of dry, sensitive skin, and it always leaves me feeling refreshed and hydrated. i used to be a makeup wipe girl, but i will never go back!
Great and melting my makeup and it smells so amazing! Just like cherry candy or cherry yogurt!

I don’t wear a full face but for my usual it removes it completely along with my sunscreen and pollution from my day.

review_title: I'm an oil cleanser believer now
review_text: I love skincare, but never felt the need to try the “double cleanse“. After hearing so many good things about oil cleansing, specifically with this product, I decided to try it. I even use this when I’m not wearing makeup as a first cleanse for an extra boost of hydration. I’m obsessed and convinced my skin looks softer. My eyes burned and turned bright red and some of the balm stuck inside my eyes even though they were closed. My micellar water is much more effective and I never have eye irritation with that, plus it’s much more affordable! If you don’t have sensitive eyes like me and don’t mind the price, I’d say it’s still amazing at removing makeup!

Best stuff I have ever used. I have always used makeup wipes before but my skin felt like it was aging every time I used them. This stuff is amazing and a little goes a long way. I’m now a lifetime customer for sure.
Love this face balm as my first step to cleansing my face, takes all traces of makeup off easy and waterproof mascara.

Great balm, I bought this one in limited edition cherry scent. I know it is sold out online but I seen it in stores. It is amazing, cleans makeup easily without rubbing, glides on the skin and melts everything away. Like it a lot, wish cherry scent would become constant option for this balm.

review_title: Can I get a gallon of this please?!
review_text: Literally my 3rd jar, tried another go-to brand, and while it was affective, the other brand just was not Farmacy Green Clean! I love the smell, the feeling, the process, and most importantly the result! Really do not see myself purchasing anything else to remove the day!

Doesn’t take off all of my eye makeup but nothing I’ve tried has.
This has to be the best makeup remover that I’ve used ever! It literally cleans everything including my water proof mascara and liners! Worth every penny!!!

If you like a solid make-up remover that smells like key lime pie, you’ll want to try this!  It is effective and a pleasure to use.

review_title: Not effective and hard to apply
review_text: Not a fan. Got this as a trial and didn’t use it all. I had to warm up the oils in it to get the product out of the container and then it spread very thin on my face. When I rinsed it off, it felt like I still had a thin film on my face.After several uses, it was already getting a dirty appearance from the warming and multiple application process each use. I was worried with it being all organic and in a tub container, it would be easily contaminated if stored long term.
I love this stuff. It works so much better than the oil-based makeup removers. I like that it’s a balm and easy to remove after use.

My first experience with this product was after I received it in my boxycharm and I loved it so much that I purchased it. It Melt away my makeup pretty fast. Does an amazing job getting every bit of makeup off of me. Non irritating to my sensitive skin. Smells great and makes my skin feel smooth after.

This product has saved my skin. I have very sensitive skin and I wear waterproof foundation since I’m a fitness instructor. One of the best makeup removers out there! Doesn’t dry out my skin and removes everything! It’s little pricey but I am 100% satisfied with this product.
The gentlest, most wonderful cleanser I’ve ever used. My skin feels so clean after use. Like the rest of Farmacy’s products, smells divine.

Part of my daily face care routine! It smells and feels wonderful. Melts makeup ( Yes Mascara too!) within seconds! Thank you so much Farmacy!

review_title: Pretty Good, but not for me.
review_text: This product is PRETTY good. I am a long time Eve Lom cleansing balm user and I really wanted to find something that was comparable and not so expensive. I also don’t particularly like the fact that Eve Lom has mineral oil in it. Anyways, I wanted to really like this product. My skin is super sensitive and really dry, and while this product didn’t irritate my skin, I did find slight tightness after cleansing. I know this isn’t the norm for everyone, most people probably don’t have as sensitive skin as I do. I also found that I had to use about twice the amount of product compared to EL, which kind of negates any perceived cost savings when comparing prices between the two brands. I hope to find a product that compares with Eve Lom, but until then I will have to keep going back to what I know works best for me.
Love it! Best face wash I’ve ever used.
I have very oily skin and this takes my makeup off without irritating my skin or adding to the oil.  Added to my list of loves.
I start to enjoy makeup removal because of this product! Very good cleaning power and great for skin
I start to enjoy makeup removal because of this product! Very good cleaning power and great for skin

This was fun to use but ultimately not for my skin. I like the transition from solid to oil. It made it more manageable than other cleansing oils. The smell is nice and subtle. I thought that I liked the gentle exfoliation but either that or the other ingredients caused several small breakouts on my forehead a place where I rarely breakout. My skin also felt slightly dry in spots. It did remove waterproof mascara better than a couple of the other cleansing oils I’ve tried.

I got a sample of this and tried it out not really thinking much of it. I had used the Clinique cleaning balm before, the one everyone raves about, and I had no strong feelings either way about it. But I quickly realized how much better this one is! Firstly, this one smells nice - the Clinique one has the typical Clinique skin care smell. The smell doesn’t even really matter though, because the thing I don’t really like about the Clinique one is how much it chunks up when you’re rubbing it on your face. This is so much smoother and creamier, which makes it easier to use! It’s got the same makeup removing power as the Clinique one, so Clinique is such a pass for me. I’ve already bought this three times!

I LIVE FOR THIS. I have sensitive and dry skin. This works amazingly for my skin. Isn’t oily, clean sent, powerful but not damaging. I have to say that a little goes a long way, really. Removed a lot of my makeup and I just use my cleanser afterwards to be 100% clean. I would absolutely buy this makeup meltaway again. Worth it.

I really wanted to love this product but I don’t. It does a pretty good job of removing face make up. Eye make up you have to work a little harder but it does get most of my mascara off. However, it has plastic in it (Polyethylene) and for a clean beauty item that just does not resonate with me.

Great cleanser, very gentle on sensitive skin, a little goes a long way. Doesn’t leave the skin super dry. First time trying a sample and I’m sold. I love how it took my makeup off so effortlessly and left my skin feeling sooo clean and soft!!! Definitely will be purchasing the full size!!

I’ve since used it 3 times, and it doesn’t do a thing to remove my face or my eye makeup. I even tried first using the Sephora eye makeup remover to take off the first layer of eye makeup the second time I tried the balm, and all of the residual makeup left after using the liquid eye makeup remover was still there - no difference from if I’d never used the balm in the first place. The other night I tried using the balm again, this time just to remove my face makeup, and when I applied toner to my face after washing, the cotton ball containing the toner was covered in makeup, making it obvious that the cleansing balm did nothing! I don’t think I wear very heavy makeup and my mascara isn’t waterproof, so either the claims about the cleansing balm are greatly exaggerated or it just doesn’t work on my face. I’ll be using my makeup removers and regular facial cleansers instead.
