review_title: i used to love this stuff
review_text: The first time I tried this moisterizer I was AMAZED. It felt wonderful and truly hydrating.  I had been using this since January, and recently quit using it when i started going without complexion makeup to let my acne heal. That’s when I realized, on day 4, how greasy it made me look. Turns out it has dimethicone in it, which creates a layer over the skin and traps sweat/oil/bacteria, which I also have a sensitivity to. Its much easier to notice when your skin isnt covered with makeup. This ingredient is disappointingly common in makeup and skincare products, especially primers. Since I stopped using it my skin has looked more balanced, has been less oily, and the redness has gone down tooons. I’m very sad to have just realized after months of adoration of this product that I’ve been wasting $38 every time I buy. I suggest investing in products without this ingredient, especially if you have oily, sensitive acneprone skin. I do still use the cleanser and toner from this line and love it.

Cleared up my acne in a matter of days. This is the holy grail product. Worth the price, especially for cruelty free.

I love this cleanser! I bought the mini size to try it out after hearing such good things and it definitely lives up to its reviews. I like that it doesn’t leave my skin feeling dry or tight after cleansing and it doesn’t break me out. I was looking for a face cleanser that was super low in chemicals and quite simple and I found just that. I like that it’s a gel cleanser because that helps with moisture and that it foams up because that helps me see exactly where I am cleaning on my face. A little bit goes a long way. It is really good for people with dry and sensitive skin, but that doesn’t mean it is not good for all skin types. I have oily, acne prone skin and this works for me. I will admit though you will not see dramatic changes in a day. Clean and simple ingredients are best for your skin, but only heavily processed and chemical filled products will show over night results. This cleanser does live up to the “clean” name. I did see one ingredient that scared me which was “natural fragrance.”  The word “natural” has no legal definition in the food/skincare industry and fragrance is a known skin irritant so to find out more I emailed them and they reassured me that the “fragrance” comes from the foods found within the cleanser and are not chemical. I also dug through several YouTube videos to make sure this was correct and it is. So if you are looking for a clean low chemical face cleanser I do recommend this. I believe in the long run of using this product it would benefit anyone’s skin
I love this product. My skin is combined and this product cleans without drying. This is my second bottle and will buy again. I recommend it 100%.

This cleanser turned completely turned my skin around. I had been having deep cystic acne out of no where for months and I bought countless new products and tried new routines but nothing seemed to help. I have oily skin so it usually does not leave my skin feeling stripped, but on some of those super dry winter days it can. I don’t see that being an issue at all in the summer months, but if you have dry skin I’d definitely recommend getting a small bottle to try first and using it once a day to start. Love this and am already planning to repurchase so I never run out!

I received this as sample from the Rewards...omg it is great. som cleaners make my face grease  but this one makes it smooth and leaving my face feel fresh.....I actually bought the bottle for this!!! love it alot

I had the pleasure of having a skin consultation with Danielle. Since high school I was under the assumption that my skin was combination; oily t-zone and normal/dry cheeks. It has always been my diagnosis when I talk to someone about my skin. However, after I told her about my daily skincare routine I learned that as we age our skin changes and with that the nourishment our skin needs changes as well. I had been drying my skin to the bone. So much so that it was thirst for moisture. I purchased this cleanser through her recommendation to use something more hydrating and less stripping of the nourishment my skin needs. I have been using this cleaner for a week and I feel less tightness in my skin and feel more hydrated. Thanks Danielle for taking the extra time to explain things to me and for the recommendation.

I have been using this cleanser for the past two months. However, I don’t blame this cleanser since it doesn’t say that it treats acne. So I started only using this in the morning and my usual acne cleanser at night. I really do love this cleanser! I absolutely love the smell and my skin feels so refreshed, awake, and glowing after using this. It leaves my skin feeling clean, but not tight and dry afterwards. My skin is oily and sensitive; this cleanser does not irritate my skin and my skin oils are the same. All in all, I  love this simple, gentle cleanser!

But this can definitely work as a stand-alone foundation. While it definitely wouldn’t be considered “full coverage”, with a little powder I get TONS of compliments on my skin when Im wearing this as my ‘foundation’. If you’re still not sure, go with the mini one! I bought the mini one first to be careful and went through the whole thing.

review_title: Not for dry or darker skin tones

review_title: Great one and done for light Olive skin

I deducted a star because I’m not a fan of the jar packaging, and a perfect world it would self-set and I wouldn’t need to powder over it to get it to stop feeling tacky. I wasn’t expecting too much based on the reviews but have suffered with redness forever and figured I would try the mini size. I am OBSESSED!!!! Con: non-universal color; not a corrector of color but rather a concealer; messy / difficult application; and leaves face feeling greasy.I’ll be honest, I don’t have severe enough redness in my face to feel like the product is truly Earth shattering for me... however, that doesn’t mean it wouldn’t be effective on the skin of someone who truly suffers from severe uneven skin tone or redness. review_title: Seems Gimmicky? It’s Not. They’re Amazing.
review_text: Y’all. Believe the hype. These are amazing. I know it seems gimmicky, like something you saw in Seventeen magazine in the aughts and tried and they were hilariously awful, but these are legit. I had used them here and there on smaller zits with great results, but the true test came last night. Over the last few days a cyst turned up just above my upper lip. You know, the kind that makes you look like you got a botched lip job? The best kind. Like an idiot, I picked at it, but this was one of those gifts that you knew would keep on giving. Like it wasn’t done yet. Normally, this would have led to a week of scabs and a month of red spots to enjoy covering up each day. But I used a dot last night (stayed put all night, even on a wonky area) and woke up and almost the whole thing was white with the stuff it had extracted. The cyst (a full on cyst you guys!) is flat and I almost can’t feel where it was anymore. I’m repurchasing right now.

review_title: Doesn't work on Papules, Nodules, Cyst.
review_text: Doesn’t work on Papules, Nodules, and Cysts. I used this in the morning and at night on 3 to 4 types of acne on my face including pustules. It reduced the swelling on pustules after 6 hrs of use. It sped up the “acne stage“ on larger acne that were in the beginning stage. The larger acne nodules became larger and more inflamed after 6 hrs of use. The swelling of smaller pustules were reduced the next day after using it overnight, but did not suck out the pus. After 2 weeks of usage, some of the smaller acne diminished, and some of the larger acne were aggravated and left my skin dry and flaky.

They don’t work on all types of acne (ie, cystic acne) but on whiteheads? BRUH. I won’t say they’ll disappear overnight, but they decrease in size so quickly as to be nearly overnight. I am a picker. Pop them on over the horribly, painfully stretch skin, and it’s significantly flatter when I wake up a few hours later. You can’t really wear them unobtrusively during the day or under makeup, but it’s not horrible if you feel compelled to wear them out and about.

review_title: I’d give this more than 5 stars if I could!!
review_text: Okay, first off, I received this full size product complimentary from Influenster and Peace Out skincare for an honest review. But that in no way influenced my decision for greatness that is this product! I’m very skeptical when it comes to skin care, even more so with acne products. So to be honest, after the first round of testing this product, I noticed a difference, but thought my feelings on it would be a little biased. So I tried it out again, this time on a holy mother of God zit! I left it on overnight, over the problem area, and when I woke up I felt the circle to see if I could still feel a lump underneath. Sure enough I could, so I was thinking maybe the first time was indeed a fluke. I took the dot off, and the lump was not a zit, but the dot itself that had whatever it pulled from the zit overnight. My zit was GONE! OVERNIGHT! No squeezing, no pain, just clear skin under the magic that are these acne dots!I will absolutely be purchasing these again, and recommending this product to all my fellow acne sufferers! The only thing I should note is, and I only discovered this after trying the first time, was that your skin cannot have anything else on it before applying these dots. No toner, no moisturizer, no cream of any kind or it won’t adhere properly. But that’s literally my only tip as these are seriously a no brained, set it and forget it type of treatment! Thank you soooo much Peace Out God’s!!Note: I attached a picture of the dot after use so that you can see visual proof of its greatness. Sorry, I know that’s TMI, because who wants to see anyone’s zit crap?! Sometimes you just have to see to believe!

The second night the patches drew all of the puss and gunk to the surface and drained several, but left a few tiny whiteheads on the rest. When I wore the patches for a third time during the day on the second day they fully drained the remaining stubborn ones and I walked into work today with what are barely little red dots left from what was, on Friday, a major red-alert breakout. I’m really impressed and am buying more now to have just in case. Thanks to these nifty little buggers I’m going to have fully healed skin within a matter of days and there’s really nothing more you can ask for from an acne spot treatment. Highly recommend.

review_title: Magic dots sent from the heavens
review_text: O...mg......? Guys. I spend literally thousands of dollars every year at Sephora and I’ve NEVER written a review. These things are wild. I have generally clear and acne free skin but its sensitive with mild rosacea.. I get cystic acne breakouts usually when I pms and am on my period, like only around my jaw and chin usually but enough to where it really upsets me.Each dot is a little angel in disguise. Holy crap honestly I’m blown away like I wanna tell everyone about these things. I use them repeatedly till whatever zit they were residing on is gone. You can sleep in them or wear them through the day, I do both. If I wear them out during the day, like you can see them obviously.. but I’d rather have a tiny circle stuck to me in public than a big a** painful zit lol. I keep them on around 6 hours, then I remove and put a new one on if needed, and I repeat this until the zit is gone. After the initial 6 hours, the zit is much much much flatter and less painful. Definitely red and mad at me but I have sensitive af skin.You can see the patch sucking the oil out of the zit.. lol sorry if that’s graphic. But like after an hour or so being on the zit, the patch has a white dot you can see, which gets bigger the longer you wear it. The white dot is the oil!! I think that’s why the zit is so much flatter and less painful or irritated when you take the patch off, cause the patch literally removes the oil quickly somehow?These things are amazing and I will never ever not have them on hand at all times. But they’re really expensive. Its essentially $1 per patch, and if you have multiple zits you’re treating and using a few patched a day you’ll run out fast. BUT they work literal magic so I think it’s worth it.

I have combination skin depending on how my hormones feel like acting on that particular day and I feel that the cream did help. The reason why I give it a 3/5 instead of a 5/5 is because I have purchased cheaper creams that do a similar job and I have purchased slightly more expensive creams that do a lot better job at moisturizing the skin. Also, not much product is given. I got the cream about three months ago and it’s almost already all gone. For example, I had Lancome Visionnaire cream that lasted me almost past its recommended shelf life (almost two years). So, it’s disheartening that this one is running out so quickly because of the consistency of the formula. Anyhow, that’s just my opinion which I have seen is basically an outlier at this point. Case and point, the cream is good but not $73 good.

And with my previous day cream I almost always had to use extra because my skin still felt dry, but with this cream, I don’t have to use extra (woohoo!). This is also works great with makeup, regardless if it’s a luminous primer alone, tinted moisturizer, or full coverage foundation with primer. it hasn’t irritated my skin whatsoever. I also liked that the serum was vegan, clean and cruelty-free.  Unlike my other serums, the  main difference  I noticed immediately was it said in order to see optimal results, you would have to use it twice daily for four weeks. The first time I used this serum was in the morning, during my normal skin care routine. I used it after cleansing like the instructions said. I liked the texture and smell of this serum. The milky white consistency was not too thick and not too watery. The serum blended into the skin easily. There was a very, very, LIGHT fragrance that disappeared immediately after I applied it which I liked  despite not  liking fragranced products on my face. The serum dried slightly  tacky which I also liked. After it was completely dry I did notice a slight glow to my skin which I  really liked as well .Because I have oily skin, I usually am not a fan of products that  leave a glow or sheen-like effect, however I liked the fact that this serum was completely dry and my skin looked glowy versus actually being glowy.  The second day  I used this serum  I decided instead to use it after cleansing and moisturizing my face and used it in place of primer due to the tackiness. Again, because of my skin texture and type, I prefer a primer  that has  more of a tacky  feel to the skin as I find that my foundation sticks better, however I didn’t notice much of a difference. In terms of using it at night it had the same effects as it did in my morning routine. I’m excited to see how this serum  holds up to its claims* and how it effects my skin within the next four weeks.

Been using this serum for about 4 weeks now. Love the light watery feel as it go onto the skin. Made sure to get it around the face and neck. Did not see any signs of anti-aging effect. Liquid is very hydrating though. The weather in California haven’t been the best, so I’m guessing this might be combating the bad weather to not further age me. For that, I do recommend this product to others

I received this complimentary through Influenster. While the smell is fantastic and the texture of the serum is really nice, I don’t know that I notice all the skin changes. It did make my skin feel super hydrated though and didn’t irritate it. When you have super sensitive skin that’s always a plus! The price may seem a little high, but, when you factor in how little you actually use and how long it lasts it’s actually wallet friendly in the long run. Overall, I would recommend.
Love this product! I put it on every night and some mornings. It feel so great and makes my skin feel soft and moisturized!
Not recommended for sensitive skin. If anything it broke me out and opened up my pores. Maybe I did it wrong? I applied it at night after my shower.

I’ve been using this product for a few weeks now and haven’t noticed a difference in my skin really. If anything I’ve seen more tiny breakouts so I will probably discontinue using. Texture is fine, not much of a scent. Product feels good on skin upon application but nothing special really. I received this product to test out from Influenster.

I like it but I think it’s a bit tacky it overall does feel soothing and I would reccomend especially for winter dry skin if you have oily skin you might not love this but I think it has good ingredients so I like it.

I love this serum so much! It’s so light and once it’s on, you don’t really feel it. They recommend you to dab it lightly onto your face and it give it a really refreshing feeling to your face. I use it everyday!!

I absolutely love the serum. My biggest takeaway is how soft my skin feels - this serum has smoothed my skin and it has honestly never been softer. I have been using for several weeks and have enjoyed it. It has a fresh scent that isn’t over powering and leaves my skins feeling refreshed. I don’t think it has necessarily helped my fine lines but time will tell.

I’ve been using this over a month now and really enjoy this product. It has a natural, clean scent but does not irritate my sensitive skin. Layers well with products/makeup over top and my dry skin soaks it up beautifully. Will continue to use.

I like this serum but I haven’t had any “wow” factor from it. I received this complimentary for review purchases and although I do enjoy it, I don’t love it enough to purchase it in the future. I wouldn’t say not to buy it though, some people may love it, I just prefer other serums over this one.

I have switched all my beauty products to clean beauty so I was excited for this serum! Long life herb sounds very intriguing.I used it every morning and night with my skincare routine, two pumps was enough to cover my face and neck. I’d say the bottle lasts about 5-6 weeks for me, I still have a quarter left.I love how refreshing and earthy citrusy it smells and how light and easily it glides over skin. It leaves my skin feeling moisturized and glowing. I have a combination skin so I imagine it would not be that moisturizing for dry skin because of how light it is and immediately sinks into skin.After 4 weeks of consistent use my skin is clear, soft and refreshed. This is a great product for summer time use I don’t think it enough moisture and firming for colder months. The best thing about the product is that is CLEAN, innovative ingredients and glowing skin! I highly recommend if your skin is in need of boost of energy!
I received this product complimentary from Influenster. I really love it! It makes my skin feel so hydrated and glowy! I usually have dry skin but when I used this I didn’t even need a moisturizer.

It’s great feels nice on my skin good under makeup and right before bed.  I have not broke out. I have sensitive skin but it’s been really well so far.  I have noticed a difference, I’ve been using it for about 4weeks now!

I really enjoy this serum!! It smells really good, like fresh herbs. I got this about a month and a half ago and I am about a little under 3/4’s done with the bottle. I use this morning and night and I have noticed the redness in my cheeks have gotten a bit lighter!! This does not leave me oily or dry I really like this product

Firstly, this is a great and elegant packaging. It’s been 4 weeks or so how I have been using this product and my skin feels soft and hydrated. It is very lightweight and after I apply it on my skin the product doesn’t feel heavy nor oily. I have some hyperpigmentation issues and I was hoping the serum might be a solution, I am at the fourth week and still have some product left, but so far I don’t see much improvement on that part. I enjoy the nice scent and easy application of the product. The only improvement so far is that my skin is brighter. This is not a miracle serum that will solve all the issues but it is a great and affordable serum that will tone your skin and make it brighter.

I’ve been using this serum for a little over a month and I have been absolutely loving it. I use it after my Drunk Elephant serums and it leaves my skin feel healthy and dewy. The scent is also very lovely and subtle and it reminds me of a spa scent. It also leaves a wonderful base for applying makeup smoothly!

I really really love this serum! It’s super lightweight and I love that it has niacinamide in it. I have been using it for about 2 months now and I’ve definitely seen an improvement in the overall look of my skin. I feel like my skin looks a lot tighter and healthier than before.
I’m not too fond of the herbal smell but this serum has prevented dry patches from forming on my face. It’s light and not oily at all. I would recommend.
I really enjoyed this at first but halfway through using it, it made my skin breakout. I still use it on my neck though and it does ok. My neck feels really smooth.
I wanted to love this product but it didn’t workout for me. It made me breakout around my chin and cheeks. Which never happens.

I received this #complimentary BareMinerals Skin Longevity Serum from Influenster to try out. I used this product for 3-1/2 - 4 weeks so I could give an honest and thorough review. This is a serum that’s a bit on the watery side but not unexpected since serums are notably thinner. Skin Longevity is cultivated with the Long Life Herb from Okinawa, Japan. The scent to me smells like a fresh lemon mixed with the scent of a spring rain. After a week and a half, I noticed how incredibly soft and smooth my skin felt. The texture of my skin continued to get better over the next two weeks. As far as wrinkles, I didn’t have any “wow” results but I wasn’t really expecting to see a huge difference. When I read the clinical studies, it showed a 23-25% improvement in wrinkles and fine lines. This to me is a realistic expectation and something I can believe. I appreciate any company that doesn’t inflate result findings to mislead the consumer especially when it comes to skincare products. Overall, I like this product and think it’s great if you want to improve the texture of your skin and minimize pores. One good push of the pump (great delivery system too) is all you need for your entire face and neck. This will definitely last you a while even with the 1 ounce bottle.

My initial thoughts was that it’s lightweight and that my texture is clearing up. It is great for upstate NY summer weather but I am not sure how it will do in the winter. So far I love this product and I will repurchase!
My initial thoughts on this are that its very light weight comfortably doesn’t seem to irritate my skin. Has a slight citrus smell. Packaging is in a nice glass bottle very sturdy.

Lovely scent! Amazing slip! Absorbs into my skin VERY well! However I’ve been using the product for a while and I’m seeing very minimal improvements. May have to use it for a month and a half or longer

Here is the scoop. Love the product and love the ingredients. My skin feels soft and I love how its absorbed into the skin. My only concern is I have been using this product for about 1 1/2 months and still have not noticed too much of a difference? Of course I’ll keep using it to find out if my skin does change. During the day I have noticed my T-zone gets oily which I don’t love but the humidity here on the East Coast is awful right now

The first thing I noticed with this product was the selection of ingredients! I loved how they used natural ingredients and harnessed the power of the longevity herb. This serum smells like lemon and thyme. It wasn’t a very strong smell, which I liked. The texture of this serum is silky and somewhat thick. I loved how quickly it absorbed and made my skin feel soft and hydrated. Though it takes 4 weeks to see full results, I immediately noticed how it plumped up skin and smoothed out some of my fine line and wrinkles. I don’t think this product is as powerful as a retinol product when it comes to anti-aging; however, I do believe it is a great preventative product or a great vegan alternative to a retinol. I was very impressed with it! I use it after my vitamin C serum and before my moisturizer. Compared to other serums, I appreciated how hydrated and luminous it made my skin feel. Overall, it makes me feel fabulous with dewy skin and I would recommend!

This product smells amazing! Smells very natural and similar to Tatcha products. The packaging is nice and heavy. Feels super luxury. The product has very thing watery consistency and spread and get absorbed in the skin beautifully. I apply this and layer of moisturizer to keep my skin hydrated. I felt this is a little costly.

I really love serums first of all. But this serum is really nice and hydrating as well. I love that it’s not sticky and that it doesn’t have an unpleasant scent. I am seeing my skin look more plump and clear. I can’t wait to see more results from continued use. I was sent this complimentary from Influenster.

I have been suffering from extremely dry skin patches on my T Zone and have rosacea. I have tried expensive face lotions that have not helped or made it worse. This product is lightweight and has resolved the dry skin issue. it leaves my skin hydrated throughout the day.

I’ve been using this serum for almost a month now and I LOVE it. I put it on morning and night before my other serums and moisturizer. I really see the benefits of this skin-strengthening serum after working a few night shifts in a row. The long, odd hours can leave my skin looking dull and tired. The mineral-rich Long Life Herb strengthens and smooths the texture of my skin and eliminates fine lines and wrinkles. I can also feel good about using this product because of it’s clean ingredients (free of SLS, parabens, and synthetic fragrance) and because it’s cruelty free/vegan. Give this serum a try you won’t regret it!

So far, I am absolutely loving this serum! From the first use, it made my skin feel very soft and it just made it look refreshed. I am excited to see the results after 4 weeks. Another thing I love about it is the smell. It’s a very clean, herbal scent that is light and fresh. The ingredients in this serum are different than any other I’ve tried before so I am eager to see how they perform!

review_title: Not sure it’s worth the price
review_text: Pretty good serum with niacinamide high on the ingredient list. Don’t love the anti aging or herb marketing because it looks like the niacinamide is the main brightening ingredient. The texture was more watery than I expected and sunk in quickly though. Has a slight smell from the fragrance which I don’t love. Even if I see great results from this, I’d be worried about the long term effects from the fragrance. Plus the price seems high for a hydrating niacinamide serum...

I have normal to dry skin and slight smile lines. When I add this product to my skincare routine it makes my skin look soft and glowy all day. The scent is also really nice. I would definitely recommend this to anyone with my skin type!

review_title: Vegan long life serum that works
review_text: I love products from Bareminerals, so I’m excited to add this new formula for their Skinlongevity serum to the other Bareminerals products I use daily.  I like that this formula features niacinamide in the first 3 ingredients.  I have dry skin with eczema, so this ingredient of niacinamide AKA B3 helps strengthen the barrier of my skin.  I’ve used this anti-aging serum for a week and love the watery texture that seems to instantly absorb and soothe my skin.  I noticed right away that it seems to make my fine lines on my forehead disappear.  I like that the long life herb claims to be sustainably sourced from Okinawa which is a known blue zone famous for its youthful looking population.  I’m also very happy that it’s vegan and cruelty-free, and I hope to see longer term benefits after using the serum for a month.

I recently began using this product and have a few observations: I love the lightweight aspect, it absorbs nicely. The smell is very nice, nothing overpowering. I liked and appreciated the clean ingredients. I wish it was in a dropper rather than pump so that product didn’t absorb into my fingers before face. I did not have any breakouts on my sensitive skin, however I did notice a little dryness. I use this product after cleansing 1-2 times a day and I am looking forward to seeing results.
Great product. Love the texture and way it makes my skin feel after applied. The smell is very light and the product is gentle.

I got this product sent to me from influencer. Love the high end packaging and great feeling on the skin. I have been using it on top of my makeup as suggested on the box to give a little extra float finish and have been loving the result.
I’m super excited to see results with this Long Life Herb Serum! My skin felt so moisturized within minutes of applying this serum! Oh and I am a sucker for packaging, I loved it! Thanks Influenster!

I’ve always been a fan of Bare Minerals makeup, but I had yet to give their skincare a try. I didn’t know what to expect, but was pleasantly  surprised by this face serum. I’ve been using it for about a week, so far, and my skin is looking great. It’s a little on the watery side, which is a little messy to apply, but other than that I love it. I recommend it.

I just received my bottle. There was no direction on how to use the pump. I ended up just opening the lid to get the product out. The serum smelled very fresh and clean. It was a rich and creamy texture.  I look forward to using it and seeing the results!

My initial thoughts on this serum is that it has a pleasant almost eucalyptus like smell. It also has a very light formula. It doesn’t make my skin feel fresh and clean after using. It is much more watery of a serum then I am used to. I have only been using for one week and have three more weeks to test this product to see if it’s claim of a younger skin is correct. I received this product free and complementary from Influenster for testing purposes.

I received this product complementary for testing purposes and I love it ! I have been using it for a few weeks now and my skin is so soft ! All the dryness and roughness disappeared from my face and it has never been so glowing :) the packaging is so nice and I don’t think the price is high for what you are getting !

I love this product! It sinks into my skin so quickly, is lightweight, and doesn’t have a strong scent like some serums do. My only gripe about this product is the packaging. The cap was stuck on so tightly that it took a good five minutes just to get off, and the product doesn’t lend itself well to a pump applicator--it came out so quickly and watery and ran all over my hands. I think this product would benefit strongly from a dropper applicator.
I received this from Influenster and so far I really like the serum! It takes about 4 weeks to see results but instantly I saw my skin was glowy and looks healthier. I can’t wait to see my results!

I just used this product for the first time tonight and I have to say I love the scent! I felt it had a very clean fresh subtle smell of lemon and mint. It made me want to breath it in. At first I thought it would be too thin but the consistency was just right. My skin absorbed it immediately and did have a more firm feel to it. I am very excited to use this for the next 4 weeks and see what the results will be. Bonus points for being cruelty-free and a clean formula.

so lightweight! I have been using this everyday and have noticed a total improvement of my skin texture. Love the bottle and the pump dispenses the perfect amount each time

INSANE how much I love this. The difference in texture and how it smells.. obsessed. I was hesitant with the price point because I have sensitive skin and didn’t know if I would react to it. So so worth it

review_title: Great acid treatment for sensitive skin
review_text: Gifted by Sunday RileyI use Good Genes for pretty long time and so far it’s one of the best acid treatments for my sensitive skin. I never get any redness or irritation, but smooth and radiant skin. I also notice some fading in my pigmentation areas. They became less prominent with the time.

This treatment has been such a good addition to my exfoliation routine. It applies smoothly and absorbs quickly. It leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth. I did notice it makes my skin slightly oilier, but if only used 2 times a week, it isn’t a major problem. Looking forward to extended use to see if it helps with hyperpigmentation. Gifted by Sunday Riley.

I bought this hoping it would improve some hyperpigmentation on the side of my face, but after getting halfway through the bottle, I’m not seeing any difference at all - no improvement in the hyperpigmentation, no improvement to fine lines, and no import cement in my skin overall. It’s very expensive for a product that doesn’t seem to be doing much, so I don’t think I’ll be purchasing it again after I run out.

I’m very happy with this treatment, although I feel it’s overpriced. There’s a little tingling upon application and it feels a bit heavy although it’s not oily and it does not appear to cause dryness or breakouts. There’s no discernible fragrance added but on the down side, there’s a hint of a medicinal odor to it. It’s only noticeable though because it’s literally right under your nose. It’s not detectable to others and it’s not so overpowering that it prevents me from using it. I just mentioned it because some people are sensitive to scents.

To be honest, this product is like magic on skin. You almost see the results instantly and its amazing.Only reason Im not giving 5 stars is I think its way too expensive. I want to try other products with the same ingredients but cheaper to compare.

I have no major issues with my skin so I don’t think I’ve ever really been wowed by a skincare product. My skin looks pretty good no matter what I use. I don’t have a massive blackhead issue, but I get pesky little clogged pores on my t-zone that Biore strips never solved for long. I have bought tons of products claiming to clear out my pores, but this one actually and obviously delivers. My pores are just absolutely clear. Empty. There is a vacancy. Pore gunk has moved out. Sometimes I’ll see one or two little sebum plugs - ones I would not have noticed before, but now I do because NOTHING ELSE IS THERE - and I eradicate them with my DermaFlash. Good Genes does everything other products claim to, combined. It would probably even raise my child if I had one, which I don’t, which is why I can afford this stuff.
I think this lactic acid treatment is worth the price, very nice and make my skin plump and soft

I received this as a free sample. maybe it was the one that I recieved, but the smell was horrible. I’ll go back to using the one from The Ordinary, didn’t notice anything remarkably different between the two products.

Holy grail - I’ve never seen any product have such an amazing impact on my skin. The cost may seem steep - but for reference, I’ve used the same bottle religiously for the last 11 months and I still have enough product left for at least another month. SO, SO worth it!!

The holy grail of gentle yet effective exfoliators! I love Good Genes SO much!!! There are so many things I can’t use because my skin is reactive but this is so great, my skin just loves it. It will always be part of my nightly routine.

I’ve been using this product for about 4 months now in the morning and it really gives me a glowy look. I have acne scars and I feel like it has helped but it took a while to even see a little bit of improvement. I also can’t even tell if this product is what’s helping my scars because they’ve been really small for a while now. I also did get a very small purge when I first started using it so I recommended starting with once every other day instead of everyday.
Great product, exfoliates my skin very nicely.  Very gentle.

review_title: Buy it. You won’t regret it.
review_text: I had always heard good things about this product but balked at the price. I saw that I could get a sample size with my rewards points, so I thought, why not?I’m so, so glad I tried the samples. I fell in love with this product and immediately bought a full-size. I have been using a lactic acid product from another brand and had been pleased with that, but Good Genes is in a class all by itself. The difference is immediate and noticeable. My usually overly-sensitive skin is smooth and glowing, and somehow is not only not irritated at all, but it seems to have cut out the red surface tones of my skin completely. My forehead wrinkles are much less noticeable as well. I don’t know what voodoo this is, but I will continue to buy it, even if I have to sell a kidney to do so.

This product works fine. It has improved my skin clarity, however, I can’t say that it did anything additional to what The Ordinary has done for my face. Overall I do not think it’s worth the high sticker price.
My favorite treatment! My skin is really beautiful when I wake up after was apply this magic product.

review_title: A little goes a long way
review_text: This is my favorite exfoliating treatment of all time. The lactic acid makes my skin feel so smooth and the licorice root extract really helps get rid of post-acne marks and hyperpigmentation. Also, it lasts a long time, I use it once or twice a week and 0.5  oz lasted me a whole year

I absolutely love the Sunday Riley Good Genes All in one lactic acid treatment. I actually received this complimentary from Sunday Riley in return for a review of my honest opinion. At first I wasn’t sure if it would be something that would work for me but I am so beyond pleased with it that it has became part of my daily routine. It’s so easy to use. All I have used is about two pumps of it and it covers my whole face perfectly. I absolutely love the scent of it as it smells really fresh and not to potent to be on your face! It’s great! I have noticed that my face isn’t looking as dull as it was before and it’s really brightened up and my pores are seeming to be smaller and less visible like before. I am so pleased and feel like I look so much better than before I began using it!

I was gifted by Sunday Riley Good Genes in exchange for my honest review. This product is definitely a game changer. I noticed a difference in the texture of my skin within a week! I have rough patches and large pores and I can definitely feel an improvement already. My fine lines are less noticeable and my skin is overall softer and smoother. Definitely a staple in my skin care routine now. If you are thinking of trying it, do it! You will not regret it.

I love this product I received Gifted by Sunday Riley.I have noticed I have had a change in my skin clarity and fullness. My skin feels more radiant. I put this on fresh clean and washed skin. It’s lovely. Makes my skin more noticeably brighter and my pores seem smaller. My wrinkles on my forehead don’t seem as pronounced anymore.  I really enjoy this product.

Gifted by Sunday Riley in exchange  for my honest review.  Wow! I always double wash my face and then follow up with this product and I’ve noticed ever since adding this to my routine my skin has cleared up immensely.. the texture is way smoother, I have a natural glow peeking through  that I didn’t have previously, my pores seem smaller.. it really does seem too good to be true but it isn’t.  I absolutely adore the smell of this product as well.  I have no idea what I will do when I run out because it is so pricey, but I can’t imagine not using it anymore.  I highly recommend!

When applying I’ve found that just two pumps is sufficient and absorbs nicely. My cheeks, nose, chin, and forehead are a tundra in winter and your greasiest pizza every other season. This works for all of them.

I was so happy to be gifted by Sunday Riley this heavily talked about serum.  I didn’t really have hopes going in because other Sunday Riley products haven’t really been the right fit with my skin.  This little bottle of glory on the other hand is a god send.  My skin feels smoother,  and my fine lines are not as noticeable.  I don’t have any breakouts, and I can hardly see my normally massive pores.  I really do recommend this for anyone dealing with large pores and uneven texture.

I received this product complimentary from Sunday Riley. I have a few other items from this brand and I love them. I already see a difference in my skin after only a few harms. My face feels really smooth, it helps diminish my fine lines and cleans my pores. I love them smell as well. The only downside for me is the price point.

I received this complimentary or oduct from Sunday Riley. I used this product as a mask because I didn’t like the smell of lemongrass. In just one use I can notice how smooth, clean and glowy my skin looks. With just one pump you’re ready to go! It came in a box, very fancy packaging and loving the pump system, very practical and preventing contaminating the rest of the product. I would recommend!!!

Absolutely LOVE this product. My super dry skin loves it. I am prone to clogged pores and I also get these under the skin little bumps that I hate. Good Genes is the only products that clears them up without sensetizing or drying out my skin. My skin feels smooth and over all brighter. I use almost 3 pumps since it absorbs into the skin pretty fast. Gifted by Sunday Riley.

This product was kindly gifted to me Sunday Riley and I’m so glad that I managed to try it. I did not know about this brand before and it might become my favorite brand. I love the citrus and very fresh smell and texture of the product. I also love how the skin feels after I applied it. It looks definitely smoother and it looks pumped. I’m looking forward to more long-term results.

I was gifted by Sunday Riley Good Genes. I really like how this product makes my skin feel.  I feel like my skin looks more vibrant and youthful.  I did not notice much change with my pores. Pro tip- the box says 1-2 pumps. Start with a half pump a lot product and go from there.

review_title: One of my holy grail products
review_text: I received this product complimentary from Sunday Riley for review but I am a huge Sunday Riley enthusiast. I was and have already been using Good Genes along with some of their other products in my every day skincare routine. Good Genes has dramatically made a difference in the texture of my skin. I have acne prone oily skin with big pores. After using GG for a month or so, I saw a huge improvement in how smooth my skin looked and how much smaller my pores looked. My skin looks brighter and healthier with this product. I don’t have many fine lines so I can’t speak about seeing an improvement in them but overall my skin has never looked better after starting GG and other Sunday Riley products. I highly recommend GG!

I’ve used good genes in the past and took a break for a while. I’ve recently rediscovered how much my skin loves lactic acid and couldn’t be happier. I feel more glowy, less dull, and more hydrated than ever. 10/10This was gifted to me by Sunday Riley but this is NOT sponsored.

I’ve been religiously using Good Genes since 2013. A friend who was working as a MUA had discovered it and gave me a few samples to try. She convinced me that I had to incorporate some sort of lactic acid into my routine while I was still in my mid-20s. Yes, it’s pricey. As a 23-year-old, it was, by far, the most expensive item in my routine. But it was (and still is) worth every penny. At 31, I can honestly say this product has saved my skin from years of abuse and damage. I have one pronounced wrinkle on my forehead and some sun damage that Good Genes has kept at bay for years. I introduced Luna into my routine a year or so ago, and the combination is seriously magic. Not once in 7 years has it caused me to break out, the smell is quite gentle, and you only need 2-3 pumps daily. It worked just as well when I had combination skin in my mid-20s as it does now with my normal/dry skin in my early-30s.

This was one of my first expensive skincare purchases and it is my holy grail for reducing fine lines. I recently got into a rather extensive skincare routine full of The Ordinary, Stratia, and drug store cleansers that I think have managed my oiliness and redness well. But nothing tops this product for reducing the fine lines I have on my forehead from being overly expressive in facial expressions! I tried the dupe for this product from The Ordinary and didn’t see the same results. The Ordinary lactic acid is watery and I prefer the moisturizing texture of the Sunday Riley product. The smell is great too! I see my lines filled in within 2 days of use all over my face. I am in my mid-20s so please keep that in mind, but you can see my forehead wrinkles when my face is relaxed for your reference. This is one of my only splurge skincare products that I cannot get enough of.
Literally game changer for my skin! Saw results in the first couple days of using. Worth every penny!
This dried me out so bad and was not brightening at all. I switched to Biossance Squalane and lactic acid serum and it was a completely different story. It was brightening and smoothing, not drying.

I’ve gotten this both as a sample or part of a mini kit several times before.  I love it because it feels good on your face and has this fresh scent that makes you feel super refreshed.  However, let’s be real: lactic acid is lactic acid and you can get it from much cheaper products.  If you’re really into packaging and the smell, I get it but, that price?  Mmm not sure about that.  It’s be a better investment to save up your money every time you want to buy this and get filler or some other noninvasive expensive treatment instead.
This product is gentle enough to use daily on my sensitive skin.  I apply and wait 15 minutes and then rinse.  The results are glowing skin and invisible pores.
This product has helped reduce redness in my face but has not helped with any wrinkles or bags underneath my eyes.

I never complain about smells of products but this was unbearable. Maybe I’m sensitive but I started to apply the sample to my skin and instantly started gagging lol had to wash it off and threw it out. No thanks stinky pete.

I ignored this product for years because I assumed it was over-hyped and I was under the impression that using a $6 lactic acid from TO was going to produce the same results. I’ve never felt so wrong about a skincare product. I found a sample size of this for $5 that I decided to purchase, because $5 is easier than $130 to drop on a product, and I immediately tested it out. Literally overnight it did more than using the $6 TO acid ever did, or any other serums I’ve used in the past year. My pores DISSAPEARED, my skin was noticeably more smooth and the texture was incredible. After only one use. God I hate that it works. And it works so well. It smells like some horrible sort of fertilizer but after reading the other reviews it seems like that issue is only concerning the little sample sizes, not the full sized pump bottle. RIP my bank account.

The only negative is that I can’t afford it AT ALL.  But every time I receive a sample I am so happy. I don’t know what it is about this lactic treatment but every night I use it, I wake up with better skin. My breakouts subside, my skin is brighter .... magic. I wish I could justify buying it but I *so far* cannot.

I wasn’t able to use this as directed because I have sensitive skin & woke up with sad swollen eyes.  Use as a mask & remove before sleeping if you have allergic responses to some products.  I didn’t notice a difference in my skin using it only sporadically.

Recieved this as a Birthday gift.I used it for several weeks and saw no difference in my skin. Then I read that this brand was fined by The Federal Goverment for having staff members writing positive reviews! Will never by anything from this brand!! BUYER BEWARE!
Amazing product. Skin was instantly softer and more refined

This stuff is the best! I’m 23 with combo and acne prone skin, and I’ve always struggled with large pores and discoloration. I’ve never found any type of resurfacing serum that didn’t irritate my skin, make me break out, or dry out my skin. Good Genes does NONE of that and makes my skin look amazing! review_title: They changed the formula for the worse
review_text: I have purchased this product many times. I actually thought that something happened to my bottle because it smelled like lemon pledge (it never did before), and literally makes ZERO difference on my skin. In the past, Good Genes was a game changer and made my skin look and feel amazing.. now, not so much. I literally get the same result when using a toner. I read the recent reviews and realized they changed their formulation to have THE FIRST INGREDIENT now be water. What??? For $158? I will never buy this again. The Ordinary offers a fantastic lactic acid treatment for around $10. I already didn’t feel like I should be supporting a brand who was caught forcing their employees to write fake reviews of products, but I liked Good Genes so much that I still supported their company. Now that they cheapened a product that was amazing so that it barely does anything... won’t be supporting them anymore.

I don’t want to say it’s a bad product but it’s not for me. It exfoliated but skin and made it super smooth but at the same time it was breaking me out. I think if you don’t have acne prone skin or are older, it’ll work for you.

Absolutely obsessed. Has completely transformed my skin. I have combo skin, but usually by the end of the day or when I wake up, my skin would be so oily. This product ACTUALLY moisturizes without making my oily. LOVE IT!

Fave product from Sunday Riley! I would recommend

The best serum ever! Pricey but worth every penny it’s sold for. I have tried so many different serums and nothing compares to this. It gives an immediate glow. I get so many compliments when I wear this.
Good genes is the best product the I’ve ever used. It made my skin brighter and more radiant. I strongly recommend this product.

I opted to get a mini set with the ceramic slip cleanser, which I’ve been using for about 1.5 yrs now. My mother’s skin visibly improved after using this product for a few weeks. Lines visibly decreased, skin became softer and move dewy without causing her to break out.
Can’t live without it! My skin is baby soft in the morning. The price might seem outrageous but it lasts a long time and the results are well worth it!

Fantastic produce!! I have sensitive skin and can still use this without any reactions.  Not a lot of this produce is needed so even tho the price may be high, I get a full 2 months worth with using is every day and night.  I have noticed smoother, more even/glowing skin.  HIGHLY recommended!!
Received this and “Luna“ as a gift and I have seen a huge difference in just TWO days. I can’t even believe it. Miracle product. Thank you Sunday Riley!
Absolute holy grail product! I won’t reveal my real age, but everyone thinks I’m ten years younger...thank you, Sunday Riley!

review_title: It works but it might be too expensive.
review_text: This product is great. I used it every night for around 6 months and found that it made my skin’s texture and colour look more even. That being said, I had to stop using it because I simply could not afford the $200.00 price. Since I stopped using it-- which was about a month ago-- my skin has pretty much stayed the same. If evening your skin tone/texture is a top priority for you and you’re willing to splurge for the results, then this is your product. However, if you’re like me and you like the way this makes your skin look but aren’t willing to routinely drop $200.00 every few months, then I would recommend researching cheaper products that have a high amount of lactic acid in it for similar (but maybe less noticeable) effects.
I habe been using this product for a year now and it’s completely changed my skin. It’s so hydrating and gets rid of all my red spots and any blemishes on my face.
The best for hydrated skin. I have acne prone combination skin and it suits me really well. Simple and effective.
Doesn’t work for me. Will look for other one. But anyway it’s better than nothing.

excellent product very similar to the hydrating B5 Gel from Skin Ceuticals the consistency is like a thicker gel.

I’ve been enjoying this product. It goes on smooth, dries nice to the touch and I can layer on top, no problem there.

makes my skin look so fresh, and also added an extra but of moisture - which i really need! works amazingly

review_title: GREAT PRODUCT BUT APPLY IT CORRECTLY!!!
review_text: I’ve tried so many brands of hyaluronic acid and this is my favorite. it’s affordable and works wonders on my skin, especially in the winter. my skin feels hydrated, soft and smooth, and looks youthful. PS: the correct way to apply it is on damp skin followed by a moisturizer. if it’s applied on dry skin, it’s going to draw moisture out of your skin and dehydrate your skin. that’s why apply it on a damp face or after toner, it’ll draw moisture from the water or product instead!

Great hydration and control of acne for a teenager

Love this serum! I have dehydrated, acne prone skin so I will take all the moisuture I can get, but I can’t use thick, creamy products as they tend to break me out. I pair this with my FAB ultra repair face moisturizer. Best combo!

Je l’applique deux fois par jour. Produit chouchou!

review_title: Excellent serum, especially for the price!

An amazing affordable serum. I paid much more for a similar product and see the same results.

The Ordinary is my favorite beauty brand, and is the first place I go to find products. When I first heard about HA, I thought it made sense and made the purchase. I applied it in the evening and morning and it gets absorbed right away. But in certain areas, especially where I have existing acne, it started to flake on the surface. My skin was a bit reddened and taught, but I didn’t necessarily break out. After using it for a few days, I saw that it didn’t change the nature of my dry skin like I thought it would. After deeper research, I found that HA in the lab doesn’t necessarily behave like the HA found in our cells. If anything, the “water it absorbs“ is not from the air, but from the surface of our skin, since it is in direct contact with it. That probably explains the tightness. There are other products I love, so this I will discontinue.
After my Skinceuticals ran out I thought I would give it a try and I will def not be going back. Hydrated and plumped my skin. Absolutely love! I am acne prone skin and didn’t break me out.

A couple of friends didn’t do very well with it though.
Très bon produit, comparable à une certaine marque vendue ici en pharmacie à un prix beaucoup plus élevé. J’ai adopté!

review_title: Moisturizes and keeps my skin zit free
review_text: I have purchased the Belif Moisturizing Bomb over and over. There is something in it that keeps my skin really clear. I have strayed a few times and always ended up with small zits. I don’t think other products cause breakouts, but I think something about Belief’s formulation is soothing to the skin and keeps inflammation down. It’s not the most moisturizing, it’s not the most luxe, I don’t love the packaging (huge package that’s deceptive about the amount inside; it’s also not super sanitary b/c it’s in a tub), it’s unfortunately not a “clean” brand but it smells lovely, works well and keeps me free of pimps. It’s my ride or die.

Absolutely THE best moisturizer I have ever used. I have been using it for 3 years and I continue to love it and actually look forward to wearing it. I found it in the dead of winter when I had the most painfully dry and rough skin. I confided in a girl at Sephora who told me I needed a moisturizing bomb and she was right and Belif is SO RIGHT - it IS a moisturizing bomb. I can’t believe how effective and intense it is for being so smooth and light (no greasy residue) My skin feels fresh and bright all day long. I received this product as sample at the first time. I’m so loving this after I tried. Really works on dry skin!!!! I can’t leave it now!!!!

I was out of this moisturizer for awhile but so glad to have it back in my life! Nice light scent, moisturizing but not greasy. A favourite daytime moisturizer for my combination-dry skin. Highly recommend.

review_title: LOVE!!!! Must buy if you have DRY SKIN

On my second jar right now and OMG this is my new favorite moisturizer at the moment. My skin feels hydrated from the inside out and it lasts!!!! Now I gotta get the bigger jar!

review_title: Bye Bye dryness! for the driest of skin!

Love these guys, great for summer. Clear for the most part, little tint on a few. Hydrating and glossy but not super sticky. Smell amazing and packaging is pretty as well. Only reason it’s not a 5 is because it’s not life changing. Good product and I enjoy it.

love it, it taste great and moisturizing

review_title: The only lip balm you need!!!

Love this lipgloss, it’s super hydrating and makes my lips super glossy. The smell is amazing and lasts quite awhile making my lips feel super hydrated!
Absolutely love this lip balm! It’s soft and not sticky. Gives you the perfect tint and hydration to your lips when you don’t feel like wearing lipstick. The scent is subtle and not over powering.

Love this product. It reminds me of a day version of the Laneige Lip Sleeping Mask. Best Balm I’ve ever tried!
this is similar to the lip mask but it comes in a tube and works really well. the taste is minimal and the moisture lasts. looking forward to trying the other colors

Not sure what people are talking about when they say this isn’t long lasting. I put it on late and then when I woke up, it was still there! Love the product. Wish the tube was bigger or that the price was lower

review_title: HG Lipgloss... finally the hunt is over
review_text: Wow wow wow wow. I’ve been on the hunt for a HG lipgloss for years.... nothing quite did the trick... until I bought this. Smells amazing, amazing long-lasting, non-sticky finish. I just find myself rubbing my lips together for hours.. and after it is absorbed, it leaves my lips a beautiful pink color.. looks like I got injections.. in obsessed and I highly doubt I’ll ever buy another lip gloss again. I want every color.

I really liked the color and smell but I wish the product hydrated my lips for longer. But, when it is on, it is super hydrating.I’m also not sure how pronounced the colors of the other balms are but the Peach was a very very light tint. If you’re looking for a balm with a nice color payoff, this might not be for you. If you’re looking for something natural and “glowy,“ this is for you! I would definitely purchase again when I run out!

I’m really not usually a lip gloss girl, but I got this complimentary from Influenster and I absolutely LOVE IT. My lips feel so moisturized and don’t dry out after extended use. If you like the original lip sleeping mask, you’ll like this too. Super convenient because you can carry it around with you. It’s so pretty and feels good on. I’m curious about the other shades.

review_title: Very nourishing on the lips, flavors not great.
review_text: I ordered this in Peach and Berry flavors and although it feels very nourishing on the lips, the flavor is nothing compared to the Lip Sleeping Mask. (I absolutely love the LSM but hate putting my finger into the jar to apply the product. ) Was  so hyped to see these come in a tube, but sadly, they do not live up to the Lip Sleeping Mask. Maybe it is just me expecting it to be the same thing just in a tube? Other than the flavor being very mild, it feels like heaven on the lips.

I realllyy love this flavor. Haven’t tried the others but I bet they are great too. The gloss is not too sticky, it’s the perfect little tint and shine to make me feel more put together! I’m someone who uses chapstick religiously so I always want something on my lips. This is long lasting, I don’t have to keep applying it over and over and it feel so good on my lips! So nice to have in my purse for dinner or catching drinks after work!
I LOVE the lip sleeping mask so I had to pick this up and I would definitely repurchase this lip balm I love it the sleeping mask and this makes my lips so soft smooth and plumped! My holy grails

Love this stuff! I’ve never tried the Laneige lip mask because the Bite Beauty agave lip mask has always been my go-to. However, sometimes the Bite Beauty mask is a little too thick and sticky for daytime wear, so I picked this up! My lips are so soft and the berry smells amazing. Laneige should make a vanilla scent like in the lip sleeping mask. All in all I’m obsessed with this product!
Makes my lips super soft and holds in the moisture all day.
I really thought that this was going to be your typical sticky gloss but girl I was wrong. It’s so smooth almost like butter, super hydrating
It actually mositurizes your lips but does not really repair them. It smells good but pretty average compared to other products.

review_title: Dry lipped gloss lovers—this is for you!
review_text: (I tried the Grapefruit, not the Berry—Sephora keeps automatically selecting Berry, sorry!) Overall, I’m surprisingly impressed by this gloss. I have really sensitive lips and am a huge fan of lip gloss myself because matte/lipstick dries my lips super quick. Im always on the lookout for the next best gloss and if you’re looking for a basic, clear coat gloss for already pinkish lips—this is a winner. The flavor is super mild and not overpowering. And most importantly, it actually hydrates your lips without feeling sticky! This is huge. All gloss feels a little sticky but this is the most light weight gloss I’ve tried in a long time. I use it alone and it’s a beautiful natural color. I gave it a 4 because the size is a little small and you do need to reapply relatively often—but it’s worth it to not have that sticky Pst feeling on your lips. Plus, it’s a LITTLE spendy. I received this product for complimentary for testing purposes. But, I would consider buying once this runs out!

I’ve been using this for a few days now (berry flavor) and I’m really enjoying the product/results! It’s not too sticky, phew! And it’s the perfect amount of color when your on the go (I use on lipstick free lips.) my lips feel super soft and hydrated although i do feel like i have to reapply a few times thoughout the day but that’s okay because it tates/smells delicious! I do wish this product had SPF in it, then it would be 5 stars for me. I received this complimentary but would buy it again!

review_title: Lip Sleeping Mask in a tube
review_text: For the longest time I have been looking for something like the lip sleeping mask but in a tube version to make it easier to carry in purses and just use on the go. I love the lip sleeping mask in the jar but I hate applying it with my fingers while Im out and about. Now I can keep the Glowy balm in my bag and the sleeping mask on my bathroom counter!

My skin is combination and during weather changes it gets very dry and irritated. For example spring to summer and fall and then when we transition to winter. So for years This is my go to because it calms and soothes my skin, does not leave it dry, removes makeup, and smells refreshing/ feels refreshing too!

review_title: my go to face cleanser for over a year

My favourite cleanser! Skin always feels great after using it, and I love that I can use it around my eyes without irritation. I have a bunch of other cleanser samples I need to go through, but always find myself reaching for this one instead just because it’s so quick and easy to use!

review_title: Best Cleanser. Amazing for Sensitive Skin
review_text: Best cleanser I have ever tried. I have been using it for years and it’s so good I never even have a desire to try another product! I used to have severe cystic acne and took Accutane. Four years later and completely acne free, I still use the product and love how soothing and gentle it feels.

Received a sample of this and absolutely love it - it does a great job cleansing the skin and the cucumber is very soothing to the eye area - definitely noticed a difference from other cleansers and would purchase

It doesn’t leave me feeling dry or tight after washing my face, but I’m now wowed by it. It feels fairly clean but I will say that it’s not the best at getting any remnants of makeup off like most cleansers do in a double cleanse. Also, the smell is not something I’m a big fan of. This cleanser removes my makeup even better than miceller waters. This cleanser has combined all these steps in one. After washing my face just with this cleanser, my face is squeaky clean.

gel like with nice cucumber smell, gentle on the skin and wash off with minimal residue.

This is my all time favorite cleanser -  it is great for gentle skin and removes light makeup. Smells amazing and cleans without stripping.

I received this item from Influenster and Charlotte Tilbury, in exchange for my honest (very honest) review. Full disclosure, I am mostly a La Mer girlie who enjoys a lot of moisturizing power in my creams. I have a lot of dryness especially around my eyes that I treat with good moisturizers that pack a punch in terms of hydration.I got a sample of the CT eye cream once and loved it enough to buy the full size. I’ve tried the CT magic night cream and the regular CT magic cream and both are good but not miraculous, in my opinion. But as the CT eye cream has become a staple for me, I was curious to see what this CT magic cream with hyaluronic acid felt like. When I first placed it on my skin, it felt luxurious. Definitely creamy. The consistency is almost as thick as La Mer. It also has a heavenly smell. The payoff in terms of hydration for the next day was great. I used the cream for 4 days straight and was super impressed by the way my skin felt. I think it does work on reducing wrinkles because my face looked really good and smooth! I was really in shock by the result after so few days. As far as working as a primer, I’m sure it’d be amazing. But I like it more for just sitting on the face alone to moisturize overnight. To me, in order to add a cream to my routine, it has to (1) serve a function like anti-aging or  moisturize and make my skin hydrated (2) smell good and (3) have resourceful packaging. This cream ticks all those boxes. At the price point, it is extremely valuable. This cream could easily go for $98 and still be worth it. I recommend. 8/10.

The gold cap and glass container feel luxe. Fantastic smell. It was a bit heavy on my oily areas, so I concentrate this stuff on my dry, wrinkle-prone areas (forehead, neck etc). Hours later, my skim still felt soft and moisturized, even in the dry Colorado winter.
I love this cream but let’s not pretend there aren’t cheaper comparable options that work just as well. It’s actually shameful how much this costs.

Charlotte’s magic cream has lived up to its name for me and has exceeded my expectations. I has helped me with my goal of glowing skin. I love that it has hyaluronic acid, vitamin C and E. These ingredients combined help brighten and even out my skin tone and helps hydrate and plump my mature skin. I’ve been using the Charlotte magic massage technique when using this cream and have had been happy with the way my skin looks and feels. I love that it helps provide  a smooth canvas for makeup application. I’ve been loving bringing the product down my neck and on my décolleté. I enjoy the experience using this product as part of my skincare routine.

This moisturizer feels thick coming out of the jar but it absorbs well and doesn’t feel heavy. It has a nice light fragrance and makes my skin feel smooth. I have sensitive skin so the ingredients in my skin care are important and I can use this product without without any problems. I like the ’Tilbury Tap’ Facial Technique (facial massage instructions) that’s written on the box for a great application. Overall I found this to be a great product and I would add it to my daily beauty routine.

review_title: Save your money bc this ain’t it folks.
review_text: I received this moisturizer from Influenster complimentary in exchange for my honest review of the product. So here goes…I hated this moisturizer! It made my face feel absolutely disgusting. I had such high hopes for it bc obvs Charlotte Tilbury is such a high end skincare brand, but I was disappointed. The rose scent is so noxious and overpowering. It’s way too strong for a skincare product IMO. The cream is thick and has a nice consistency until I started working it into my skin. Then it turns into a slippery and greasy disaster. My pores immediately felt clogged and it felt so heavy on my skin. It never fully penetrated and just sat on the surface all night. The next morning I washed my face immediately upon waking and to my surprise…it broke me out! I am 39 and have never had acne or issues with breakouts of any kind. One night using this moisturizer and I was broke out on both cheeks, my chin; the crease and tip of my nose and along my jawline. Save your money and buy something else bc this ain’t it folks. The only reason I’m giving it 2 stars instead of 1 is for the heavy, beautiful jar/packaging and the massage technique to apply it.

This has to be the most hydrating moisturizer ive ever used, my face is baby smooth my fine lines have eased up my face looks more youthful. The smell is light and the cream is thick  and a little goes a long way, im beyond  happy to be using this product, this is absolutely  worth it!

I live in Hawaii where the sun is intense and swimming is done in the ocean. The preservation of our islands is very important to us, and chemical sunscreens are polluting our beautiful beaches and snorkeling spots. For this reason, the state has banned the sale of oxybenzone and octinoxate, ingredients found in conventional chemical sunscreens that lead to coral bleaching. So naturally, I was in search of a reef safe sunscreen with a light weight formula for daily use. I soon learned that this is NOT the product I was looking for. While Supergoop’s formulas do not contain oxybenzone or octinoxate, they still contain chemicals such as avobenzone and octocrylene that have been found to be harmful to marine eco health as well. Plus, chemical sunscreens work by absorbing into the skin and have been linked to endocrine disruption and skin sensitivity. The gel went on light and matte upon first application, but there was a distinct acrid chemical smell that followed. The next day my skin, though not burnt, was rough dry and scaly. Mineral sunscreens that contain non-nano zinc oxide or non-nano titanium dioxide are generally recognized as the only safe and effective UVA / UVB protection that do no harm marine ecosystems. I’ve since discovered there are many non-nano mineral sunscreens on the market with excellent light weight formulas that leave no white cast, are safe for your skin, and kind to our oceans. I wanted to share my findings, since this seems to be a popular sunscreen choice amongst Sephora shoppers. Great reviews, labeled clean and reef safe, reasons why you may consider purchasing this product and reasons that convinced me to give it a try as well. But upon further research, I realized Supergoop’s marketing is an example of greenwashing. Please be aware of buzzwords like “reef safe” and “clean” as there are no regulations for these labels, and they are often used to mislead consumers. A good reminder to research ingredients and shop mindfully.
