review_title: EXPENSIVE but wonderful moisturizer for dry skin!
review_text: I bought this a few weeks ago mainly because I had seen celebrities raving about it. I have dry skin and this moisturizer makes my skin look and feel amazing. It is pricy and I definitely don’t think you should have to spend this amount of money on a moisturizer but if you want something luxurious it is amazing and I would highly recommend it for anyone with dry skin.

Smells amazing and perfect for hot summer months when I need a lighter formula that still contains enough emollience to keep my skin supple and hydrated all day. The spatula and lid are super cute and fancy, yet utilitarian. I’ve purchased several jars throughout the years and have even given this as gifts.
I was disappointed in this cream. It makes my face very oily.

I wanted to love this but it caused so much redness and acne, it looked like I had hives! I have dry/sensitive skin and found this too rich. I would definitely recommend the water cream over this any day.

I had very dry, flaky skin around my nose for the past 2-3 years.   I tried numerous products, including prescription cream. Nothing helped. My skin texture changed and looked red.    After using this cream for one week my skin is no longer flaking. Dry skin is gone. No longer looks inflamed.  I think my skin texture overall has improved as well. So grateful to have found this product.  Worth every penny Packaging is beautiful too.  Sephora employee was extremely pleasant and helpful.

review_title: Dry or Dry Combo. NOT FOR OILY SKIN!!!
review_text: I only removed a star because of the dimethicone and gold that are ingredients in this. Other than that it’s deeply nourishing and you just need a little bit to feel moisture. Too much can leave you greasy. I’m not a fan of dimethicone because it stops the product from penetrating the skin and that’s good with makeup but with my skincare I want every ingredient that can protect my skin barrier. The gold can be sensitizing to the skin so beware of that if you have sensitive skin and the minor fragrance that is added but it’s nothing too bad it’s far on the ingredients list so it does not cause sever irritation or any for myself. I have dry skin so this actually really saved me during these winter nights and the dry patches I get are always a problem but with this in my collection I feel saved. I recommend this for dry skin to dry combo. Definitely not friendly to oily skin types.

Bon produit pour les peaux sèches. Je l’ai trouvé crémeuse et riche. tu vois une différence des les premiers jours d’utilisation. Ne commencez pas le même erreur que moi  j’avais pas remarque qu’elle est pour les peaux mixtes sèches, ce qui ne convient pas a ma peaux mixte grasse (ca peut etre trompeur) ;)

Product seems to be mosturizing but the smell is overbearing. I suffer from dry skin, especially on my jawline. This cream slightly burns my face on the dryer sensitive areas. All in all, it’s a decent product but not worth the price to me. If you have sensitive skin this product probably will be too fragrant for you. Will not repurchase.

Love this moisturizer more than anything, but the packaging is so wasteful. It’s such thick plastic meant to make it look like you get more than you do, but it really is just an environmental waste. Regular users know it doesn’t come with that much, so I hate seeing such careless packaging. Further, the box includes so many layers to create a feel of luxury, but it’s wasteful.

review_title: Loving this now that it’s cold and dry out
review_text: Bought this at the wrong time of year and made my summer skin look greasy no matter what makeup I used. Now that it’s winter and dry I have pulled this back out and I am loving it. It gives my dry skin a healthy dose of hydration in the morning and looks great under the more matte foundations making them a little more skin like.

Yes, it’s a very luxurious cream and it feels beautiful on the skin BUT I experienced what others have described as “pilling“ when I used it in the morning under makeup. Even giving it time to soak in (like, LOTS of time) my makeup still “pilled“, rolled off when I used this AND it affected the shade of my makeup as well. If you want a REALLY rich cream with a light, pleasant smell, this is lovely BUT I’d only recommend using it at night AND washing your face well in the morning to remove the residue. I will not be repurchasing.
This cream is very moisturizing ..!!! I always put this cream at night and my skin feels hydrated even after a day. It makes my skin dewy as well. It also reused redness around my nose
been searching for a product to really hydrate myself for so long. this product is truly worth the price. love it.

review_title: I break out and my face becomes oily with this.
review_text: Everytime I use this cream I break out and my skin has an oily film after a few hours. I wanted to love this cream but at this point I only use it sparingly when my skin is drier than usual. I don’t recommend for combination skin like mine.

My skin is somewhat dry with a ruddy complexion, some lines, and large pores. I wanted to love this cream but it has a very greasy texture on my face and the “dewy“ look just makes it look shiny and sweaty like I smeared baby oil on it or something. I will be returning this for something that can moisturize with a more matte finish. It’s such a bummer but understandable that we can no longer try products on in the store or get samples to take home and try before buying. If I had a chance to try first I wouldn’t have purchased this. Very beautiful packaging though and a light pleasant fragrance.
Wonderful moisturizer!  Love the rich creamy texture.  I have dry skin and really enjoyed this product

I absolutely love this moisturizer. I previously used an Estee Lauder product and wanted to switch to a cleaner product and I was not disappointed by the Dewy Skin Cream. It is thick and rich, but does not feel greasy on the skin. It smells like a spa, and a little goes a long way, so the product lasts long. I will definitely be restocking once I run out!

review_title: Texture freak ! nice balanced texture for dry skin
review_text: Love the texture & what it does to my skin by keeping it moist and nourished

I love everything about this cream. It smells great, spreads really nicely on the skin. I definitely notice a difference in my complexion the after morning after I put it on and my face feels smooth and my pores look smaller. I love it, definitely would purchase again.
I have really dry and sensitive skin so I bought this in hopes that it would be as good as people say it is. It just didn’t work for my skin, I felt like it made it dryer than it was before.

This is my Holy Grail. I started using this stuff after I majorly over exfoliated off my skin’s barrier and had rough, bumpy bumpy skin that wouldn’t return to normal. I tried everything and no face mask, serum, or moisturizer I tied was working. I bought this on a whim after having sandpaper skin for a week and I was shocked. My skin texture returned to normal in two days. I have a friend who sells high end makeup and skincare at Dillard and even she was shocked.I literally make all my friends try this stuff. Feels amazing, spreads amazingly, smells amazing, little goes a long way, and most importantly, my skin actually feels hydrated properly.. for the whole day. If you’re reading reviews because you’re hesitant, I’m writing this for you because I obsessively read reviews too. Buy it. I tried other mostuizers after this one because it’s expensive and only lasts me two months.. but I keep coming back. Love of my life maybe? I think everyone with dry skin should at least try this stuff once.

Absolutely AMAZING cream. And the most stunning expensive looking packaging. I have been using this for less than two weeks and I can say all my dry spots, bumps, and other issues. I will not live without this. If I could give it more stars I would

You know I dont know what it is about this product but my face has been glowing since I started using her products. its only been 2 days since I started using this specific cream, I have the water cream sample that I used my rewards for to try it out and have used that for 2 weeks and I think from using the water cream or this afterwards my skin has become super dewy, it even glows without the cream. I always wash my face after work and cleanse it well. I dont even apply anything on my face after cleansing and honestly this has made my skin very very dewy, I love it. I do have very dry skin as well as sensitive.

There’s not much else to say other than you’re going to love it if you love a plump, dewy look and want hydrated feeling skin. This is exceptional at creating an “I just worked out“ or “just had a perfect facial“ glow should you want to rock a no MU look. For a year I’ve been rotating this moisturizer with Kate Somerville’s ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer depending on what my skin feels like and if I had to choose between the two...so tough, but I ran out of this and am missing it (hence re-order jar #3). ExfoliKate’s Glow absorbs quicker and is a little lighter. This is a little heavier/denser of a moisturizer BUT I LOVE IT. A little goes a long, long way hence you can be generous with it and let your neck drink it up, too. Still good to wear under MU, just give yourself a few minutes if you can pre MU application. If you have to rush and can’t wait the few minutes (brush your teeth), not a big deal. My IT Cosmetics CC cream layers and wears really well on top of this. Also to note, I just got Tatcha’s Water Cream using my rouge points not long ago and it’s no comparison to this. Too light for my oily yet dry/thirsty skin. The Dewy Skin Cream hasn’t clogged my pores (coming from someone who used to have cystic acne at one point) and it’s just pure heaven. Packaging is beautiful. Smell is lovely, too. Enjoy!

I recently got very dry skin because I moved to a new home and nothing was working. It’s only been four days using this cream and my skin has drastically improved. I am in love and feel so at ease that my face is back to normal.

This product is ok but expensive...It will give u kind of glow u can avoid wearing foundation for daily but not on special event.. i Bought this coz of my dry skin it’s just help for few hours it’s not actually heal ur dry skin in fews hours ur will start seeing ur dry skin...I’m not sure if I’m going to buy again ☹️

I have to say, I’m pretty “moisturizer obsessed” because I have dry skin and it can be difficult finding a moisturizer that packs enough punch, especially in winter. I’d heard great things about this but kept putting it off because the hefty price tag - I’m SO GLAD I finally gave it a shot because it really is that good. It’s a nice, thick cream and it’s one of those moisturizers that immediately makes your skin feel smooth and plump, plus the moisturized feeling LASTS. Even better, you don’t need much of this product because it’s so thick - so the jar lasts! I got the smaller $22 size first and was surprised it lasted a few weeks - the container was so tiny I didn’t think I’d get more then 3-4 uses out of it so that was really nice! If you have dry skin, or just love the dewy look, I highly recommend giving this a shot!
Absolutely love this cream! It definitely leaves my face feeling silky and smooth!

Made my makeup and blush looks flawless and soft. As far as price goes it is very high. But if you times .34 by 5 it equals 70 dollars so if you get the smaller one, it is still a good deal for your money’s worth.
If you have dry skin, this is worth a try. I’m not a fan of the heavy bottle though.
It makes my skin feel so refreshed. You only have to use such a tiny amount for your entire face. I’m so happy I gave this a try!
super hydrating cream for very dry aging skin!  Great price and quality.  I used to use Darphin exquisage cream but its not hydrating enough.  This change makes a big difference to my skin.

For the price, I wish I loved this more. But overall it’s pretty good and I would purchase again. A little goes a long way, and it keeps my skin moisturized. I appreciate that I can trust the ingredients, too. The only issue is that the dewy look really only looks good if you have unblemished skin, which is not true for me.

UMM... I’m so disappointed in this cream! It left me feeling tacky and sticky and overall heavy and didn’t have a nice look on the face. It has a weird smell not unpleasant but not wonderful. Overall I will not be purchasing again :|....

If I could give this 100 stars I definitely would. I am in love with this moisturizer it is amazing and makes my skin smooth it just gives me what I need for the type of scan I have. I am so happy I tried this and give this a shot because I absolutely love this product. I can already see my fine lines becoming less visible my skin becoming more Dewey more moisturized and tighten. If you haven’t tried this cream do yourself a favor and try it for at least a week I guarantee you will absolutely love this.

I have the worst dry skin. It’s dry all year round. I’ve tried so many other moisturizers and nothing else has worked as good as this!! ITS A GAME CHANGER. If you haven’t tried it yet.... get it! You won’t regret it.

Absolute best thing I ever bought (face routine wise).  I only use this cream at night and have seen such a difference in my skin.  It does not break you out just gives you the perfect “plump“ to your skin.  Makes me feel like I would be confident seeing anyone without makeup on. A little goes a long way so it will last me months.  Highly recommend.

review_title: Probably best for a younger crowd
review_text: Not for me. It seemed to sit on my skin instead of moisturize. My sensitive / acne prone skin didn’t like it and I always felt greasy. I feel like this would be great for someone with young, clear skin but not for my 31 year old scarred skin.

This stuff is amazing. I have very dry skin & had been using Zo (medical grade) and I was consistently broken out. I tried this and my face is so much more hydrated, glowy, and most importantly CLEAR. The smell is stronger than the water cream, for some reason it reminded me of onions at first and I was going to return. But I got used to it and now I love it.
Worst cream ever I broke out in under skin blisters. Not for delicate skin or acne prone skin
The bomb dot com. Skin feels nice and hydrated will be my go to skin care once winter rolls around!!

As a moisturizing cream its better then everything else I have tried from low to high. But I hate the smell, the colour of the cream and the price! It smells like the cheap purple hued skin polishes/bleach creams from back home. That smell is even stronger in the olehenriksen retin-alt night cream, although I like the smells of their orange line alot. Just slashing one star for that otherwise it would be a perfect product.If you dont mind those factors then I highly recommend it, especially for dry skin. You dont need a lot and it goes on very evenly, feel like my foundations go better on top of it, doesnt feel heavy, sticky, wet but well moisturized and skin prepped for makeup. Smoothes out the skin very well, the smell doesnt bother me and fades while applying so thats good otherwise I wouldnt be able to tolerate it and end up hating a lovely cream. It hurts a lot on a student budget though.

Okay so I first bought this because I had seen a review from a person with normal skin and the review stated they are happy they switched from the water cream to this because it is so much better. Well, once I tried it my skin was so oily!!! Even my forehead was oily and usually my forehead is sort of dry! And the weird thing is that I only used like half the amount that I would use with the water cream, it was way less than dime size! The only reason I gave it two stars is the packaging. It is so luxurious and the little golden spoon is so cute. I could see this being a good product for dry skin but for oily, normal, or even combination, I would try a sample before buying. Thank God for Sephora’s return policy or I would be stuck with this greasy stuff!

I will start by saying that I have very dehydrated/dry skin. This is my first purchase from Tatcha and I bought it after reading so many positive reviews for it stating that it lived up to its name. I’m afraid that I cannot agree. It ended up breaking me out and I don’t typically have acne prone skin. It also added to the texture I already have and seemed to emphasize my pores. Sadly, it just isn’t the moisturizer for me.
It is hydrating and leaves a beautiful glow but the product does not completely absorb. If you rub your face a few minutes after applying, it will ball up and come off.
only 4 stars because it’s expensiveee. however it does a good job! thick watery cream. makes my face glow! havent had any breakouts yet from it

I have been debating this purchase forever. I finally just did it and it’s so much better than I could’ve imagined. I have dry/normal skin and this feels unlike any other moisturizer. It’s thick and creamy, feels luxurious going on and makes my skin glow. I will never be without this.

Love this !!! Leaves your face with a beautiful natural shine with a natural dewy look. I use this every night and in the mornings before I apply my sunscreen and makeup a must buy and it smells amazing!!

I really enjoy this dewy cream. It’s heavier than the Tatcha water cream so works great for my dry skin. It takes a while to set in but overall a nice take on a dewy cream, not comparable to any moisturizer I’ve used before. It also has a very light smell, similar to the Tatcha radiance c mask. New favourite Tatcha product.
Leaves my skin hydrated throughout the day while giving it a beautiful glow.

I loved this cream, but unfortunately it did not work for me. The cream is very hydrating, making the skin soft and supple. Smells luxurious too. Unfortunately dimethicone is one of the top 5 ingredients, and due to its comedogenic properties it broke me out. Once I stopped using this cream, the breakouts stopped. If you are sensitive to dimethicone I would not recommend.
I actually like this more than the water cream! I use this after the essence! Skin is really nice

I typically use the water cream but was curious when this product launched . I wanted something a little more rich for use at night time . WOW ! My skin is brighter , hydrated and radiant by morning . I pair this with the Kyoto cleanse ( oil /rice enzyme ) plus the essence and violet c serum for optimal results , but I’ve even used it alone on lazier nights and it still works phenomenally . I am an oilier gal and am usually fearful of breaking out with rich textured products , but I have had no issues with this . I definitely recommend it !

review_title: Can't use as a day cream
review_text: I’ve been using this product for a few weeks and I’m torn on it (and I’m usually a huge tatcha fan). It smells lovely and it feels amazing when you put it on, however I don’t feel like it ever fully absorbs. I definitely could not use it as a day cream because even after waiting 10+ minutes before applying sunscreen on top, it still pilled up and caused foundation to look oily and slide off the face within an hour. I also broke out more in the last few weeks and this was the only thing I changed. It’s better as a night cream but even then I feel like more got on my pillow than into my skin. Still giving it three stars because it smells so good and it does feel amazing when you first put it on. Maybe its best use is a lazy day when your skin is feeling dry and you have a while to let it try to absorb.

You do not need much, use the spoon (great when you have nails) to grab a pea size amount.  Smells great. Thicker unlike the Water Cream. It has more benefits for someone who wants more anti aging products. I compared a lot of brands because I wasn’t sure if the price was justifiable. For me it was. I’ve had for a month and use once to twice daily and have so much to still use. My coworkers have mentioned my skin glowing more. Sweet!
This has got to be the most delicious cream In life . Love love love it !!
I have terribly dry skin and this stuff is perfect. I have never found a cream that helps my skin like this does.

review_title: Disappointing and jar only half full
review_text: First of all my jar was only half full and at $65 a pop that is not cool.  Secondly where is the dew?  Dies not leave my skin dewey at all instead it clogs my pores and I have ultra dry skin.  so something is “off“ in the formula.  Will stick with Indigo soothing cream

I couldn’t wait to try this. I already use the water cream and does wonders for my super dry skin. For a more emollient cream I used to use Kiehls also but after sometime it started irritating my skin which is odd because the Kiehls ultra facial cleanser is fantastic and I often used together. But when Mario Dedivanovic premiered the Tatcha Dewy skin Cream in his recent Masterclass and Sephora released it early, I immediately purchased one and let me say it is as EXCELLENT as they say it is. It’s emollient, moisturizing, and has a beautiful scent. No irritations and goes on beautifully under makeup. Tatcha once again doesn’t disappoint. I’ve seen such a difference on my skin since using their products and have already seen a difference using this product only after two days. It’s worth every penny. I will continue to be loyal to the Tatcha brand.

Omg this beats every moisturizer I have ever tried! I attended Mario Dedivanovic’s Masterclass LA not to long ago and we received this cream in our goodie bag. This moisturizer is inspired by Mario’s dewy skin prep technique that he uses on Kim K and other celebrities. This cream is GOLD and I mean GOLD!!! If you have dry skin & uneven texture! I little bit goes a very long way, it’s been only three days since I have been using this cream and I notice my skin is a lot softer and I don’t have as much texture on my face as I used to. Love Love Love must have cream !

I received a jar in my Mario Dedivanovic Masterclass gift bag just a few days ago and was so excited to try it! It feels amazing on the skin. I use it both day and night, my skin feels super plump and moisturized and has a natural looking glow! Will definitely be purchasing once my jar is out!

I bought the rose wipes to use when I’m out of town so I don’t have to pack my face wash and face cloths. The package says there is “No need to rinse.” 10 minutes later I’m still wondering if this sticky feeling is going to go away on its own. I’m thinking the no rinse claim is not true. It’s hard to feel like it did the job of cleaning my face when it’s still sticky. Next time I will try rinsing the cloth out to use as a regular face cloth at the end.The fragrance is alright. I would prefer no fragrance but I wanted the hydrating wipes.

Please bring back the old exfoliating wipes! The new ones don’t do anything! These were a staple for me for years and now I’m so dissatisfied. Your makeup wipes were the reason for me ordering through Sephora over ulta!
These are great smelling wipes and remove all my makeup! But they are not exfoliating like the charcoal wipes are!

review_title: BRING BACK THE OLD EXFOLIATING WIPES
review_text: BRING THE OLD WIPES BACK! The new exfoliating wipes compared to the old ones are awful, the don’t do anything. They’re too gentle to exfoliate anything. Will be returning and not repurchasing

Sephora repackaged and rebranded this product, and I didn’t know! The old exfoliating wipes were literally microdermabrasion in wipe form... these...No.  My face is clean... sure, but I can get a clean face with the cleansing wipes (which ARE great!).  I bought 4 packs total, and will return the unused... SAD!

I don’t know why it won’t let me correct it for this review, but anyway... It’s alright. I wouldn’t solely rely on these to remove make up fully, but with a little scrubbing (using the soft side!) you can get off quite a bit. The cucumber smell is also alright, reminds me of something from Bath and Bodyworks. Not my favorite, so I’d probably repurchase in a different scent, when there is a sale again.I would not use these to exfoliate however. Probably wouldn’t be good for your skin in the long run. Contrary to popular belief, scratching the surface of your skin over and over is not beneficial. So, make up remover aide, okay. Exfoliant, no.

review_title: NOT for glittery or waterproof makeup!
review_text: I personally do not see a difference between the exfoliating side and non-exfoliating side.If your makeup routine does not contain glitter or waterproof makeup, this works fine for you.However, it does not remove waterproof mascara completely, nor does it remove glitter well (I don’t use glitters that require adhesives - I use glittery eyeshadow/glittery blush/glittery highlight).
used it all weekend while i was at the cottage. did its job, also smells so good
This is my second time purchasing this product. It’s a little rough on my skin but it takes off all my makeup. It’s small and compact so it’s very worth the price.

I picked the small watermelon package and it smells amazing! The size is perfect for travel. I prefer to use a towel to wash my makeup and face because it’s less wasteful but it’s a nice treat when you go camping or have nothing else on hand! It gets the job done.
I love the scent, so delicious. However my sensitive hand skin dose not like it all all. Would not recommended.
Love this product. The one side is soft and the other is bumpy (exfoliating) great for taking off stubborn lip stains etc
i use them every morning to take off the night sweat. works great and smells good too. they dont dry out my skin either. with other wipes ill have to use a moisturizer after but not with these

review_title: They are my lazy skincare go to!
review_text: This is my holy grail for crazy morning & late nights! The wipes don’t smell the best but what do you expect from Hemp wipes.

One of my favourite make up removing wipes! I have sensitive and dry skin, like extremely sensitive! I find the coconut wipes are nourishing and amazing at removing make up easily!!! Highly recommend!
Over all good! But it does make my skin a bit irritated but I still use them! Do recommend

out of all the SC wipes, these are my favorite.  the cloth itself actually feels like a better quality to me. some of the other wipes can feel a bit thin. I enjoy the smell, nice and fresh. the only issue is that these leave my skin feeling a bit sticky aoni have to either rinse with water or use a toner afterwards. I actually started using these to wipe off my cleansing oil/balm and then I rinse.
I’ve used the wipes in the past and loved them. However the last package I purchased dries out and burns my face
I am lazy to was my face, especially after a long day. These wipes do the job and smell so good.
Ces serviettes font des merveilles par temps chaud et humide. J’adore leur parfum. C’est un must!
my new fav!!! i love the coconut water one. i find the exfoliating pinapple one a lil too scratchy for my skin, but they are good too.
I love these wipes!!!! I got the coconut wipes. My face felt refreshed after a long day at Disney World. No after film left on my face. Smell is great.
Love them for making sure that my face is properly cleansed. They are handy for my purse.

review_title: Love these wipes, really miss the Green Tea wipes
review_text: Really great! takes off makeup, doesnt leave a film behind! favorites are, coconut,  charcoal, Bamboo, Green Tea!
These are surprisingly fabulous for the price. Just brought 3 mini packs ;)
Best Makeup wipes for removing ALL makeupHighly recommend
Love these wipes, they smell amazing. The only issue I have is how tiny they are. That’s my only complaint.

The best cleansing wipes I’ve ever used. They make my skin feel and look so clean and have such a great scent. It doesn’t feel chemically at all; it feels like the freshest clean I’ve ever gotten. Removes all my makeup (I wear natural, light makeup,so not sure about high glam looks). I think these wipes are a bit expensive, so I cut them in half to make the package last longer. Still works just as well. Highly recommend. I have dry, sensitive skin. I’m allergic to a lot of clearasil and neutrogenia products. I’ve had zero problems with these wipes.
Perfect for travel. I have the large pack in my work bag, for use after a long shift. I also keep the small pack in my travel bag. My skin feels so great, clean and refreshed after each use.
Was gentle enough on my skin but forget it being good at removing eye makeup without rubbing hard on your eyes.
The coconut water wipes are all I use now. It soothes and cleanses the best out of all wipes I have used. The scent is light and fresh.
Love the textured side for exfoliating & it smells amazing!

I love all of these wipes. I love the charcoal for a quick exfoliating and to really clean my ears. I use the rose to freshen up and remove my makeup (works amazingly on mascara). I also always keep the minis in my purse. They smell great and do a good job. I highly recommend these.

these cleaning wipes you were fine for taking off make up but it was very irritating when it was used around my eyes so much that it burned will no longer use this.  I wanted something that I can take with me traveling to remove make up without taking my whole make up remover bottle but this burned my eyes too much
Great scent, not too heavy. Removes all makeup, and leaves a clean feeling. Easy to carry and use anywhere.
these make-up removal wipes are just as good, if not better than Neutrogena.  For years I paid extra for that product that this is economical and leaves my face feeling great!
Recommend using the soft side because the exfoliating side was too rough for my face! Overall not too bad!
Love these wipes for taking off makeup and the end of a long day. The Sephora wipes make my face feel refreshed and relaxed.
Love the smell and ease of use
A little too rough for my face but they get the job done
Love! For late nights when i’m too lazy to wash the makeup off...I just wipe it off. Doesnt leave my face feeling yuck, sticky, or greasy...just fresh

review_title: Super soft (not scratchy!) and smell amazing!!
review_text: These wipes are sooo soft and not scratchy like some I’ve purchased from drug stores. I always get the coconut ones and they smell amazing. Going back to drug store make up wipes is impossible after using these!
After I take off my make up with a wipe, my skin always feels irritated. This is amazing!!! My skin feels sooooo hydrated after using this. ❤️

I got the mini watermelon size for travel and was disappointed. I didn’t realize the actual wipes were mini, I thought it was just going to be less wipes in the package. I wanted to love these but they were way too dry and I needed to use more than one.

I have a pack of these rose wipes everywhere! I always keep a pack on my bathroom counter, in my gym bag, and in my travel kit. I use them to remove makeup or just freshen up my face. I feel like they work pretty well and I usually only need one to remove all my makeup, unless I have a lot of heavy eye makeup on. They are so convenient to use and smell amazing! I tried the other scents by Sephora and many other less expensive wipes. But, I just keep coming back to these! Nothing compares. I only wish they cost a little less.

I bought the coconut face wipes to refresh my makeup/skin on a hot day and was very surprised they didn’t make my face sting. I never use face wipes daily bc they always irritate my skin but I’m so happy I found these
Perfect for on the go, fits right into my makeup bag and gets all my makeup off with one wipe
Works very well for removing the makeup (BUT not the mascara). Might need 2 wipes for a full makeup face. Smells like heaven. Super soft on the skin. Doesn’t cause breakouts.
I bought a small size and the wipes were dry when i opened them. I couldn’t get any makeup off.

review_title: Love it! I'm sure you will too :)
review_text: To be honest, I’ve never really had “skin care routine“ per se, I’ve always been kind of just winging it. That being said, I’ve always assumed that washing my face and moisturizing was enough and that for the most part, all the other steps in between were just filler. However, as I am reaching the end of my 20’s, naturally I am noticing some things like the formation of lines, changes in my skin’s texture, etc. So I was thrilled to receive a complimentary toner to try out-- and from a company I’ve been hearing a lot of positive things about nonetheless. The toner has a lemony/vanilla scent that isn’t too strong and feels a bit tingly (as expected) upon application. For the record, I have a combination face with an oily T zone, especially on my nose. This blue bottle has been a game changer! Not only do I FEEL the change in my skin’s overall texture but the appearance of certain large pores/imperfections seems to have faded as well. There is nothing more frustrating than trying to apply a full canvas of face for a big night out, only to find inconsistencies like dry patches, flakiness, or an overly oily/porous ruining your application. As I am learning, toner is as vital a part in your skin care regime as a primer to your foundation or even a setting spray after everything is done. Overall I plan to keep using this product as I haven’t seen any irritation in my skin, and I can’t wait to see what a consistent month’s worth of use leaves me glowing like!

So I used a very gentle cleanser, the toner, then Differin, followed by a thick moisturizer. The last 2 weeks my skin HAS NEVER LOOKED BETTER. Now I have more issues to fix, thanks to this cream. I would suggest to avoid, or at least use a very small amount to test it. I am planning on complaining to the company for not warning about this side effect - with other reviews, it should be taken seriously. I never give bad, or any, reviews, but I feel so strongly about this because of the damage it has caused under my eyes.

review_title: This one is not for me
review_text: I am in my mid 40s and I am suffering the consequences of not wearing sunscreen in my younger years (so please always wear sunscreen!) Now I use it every day, sunny or rainy, outdoors or indoors, all the time.I tried this sunscreen and I didn’t like it for me. I consider it a beautiful sunscreen, don’t get me wrong, but it is not good for what I want/need from a sunscreen.PROS:- Lightweight formula: it is so easy to spread- It is a translucent formula that doesn’t leave a white cast.- It has a beautiful scent: if you don’t like perfumed products, stay away from this one.- The brand claims that it offers more protection with water and heat, which activates the formula increasing the protection.CONS:- It is a pure chemical sunscreen. I don’t have sensitivity so I can use it on my face but not around my eyes. I prefer physical sunscreens but that’s only my preference.- It has a lot of silicon in the formula. While it makes it very pleasant to apply, it feels wet and slippery all day long. - To get the SPF the brand claims on this product, you need to apply a considerable amount (a nickel-size amount on your face at a minimum is the brand’s suggestion) and applying that, you end up with a shiny slippery face that doesn’t set. If you just apply a very thin layer, it looks really beautiful, but you won’t be getting SPF50 (maybe a 15…, not more)- It didn’t work with my makeup: it is not a good base for my foundations, not even the more matte ones. In the pictures you can see a drop of the product not spread together with the product spread after one hour (still super shiny) The other picture shows the sunscreen completely spread between both hands leaving a beautiful finish, feeling still slippery, but too thin to provide enough protection for me.I will probably use it just on my neck and chest.I am sharing my honest and authentic opinion as a Sephora Beauty Insider Community Ambassador

review_title: GREAT SPF, NO WHITE CAST, PRIMER LIKE, SMELLS GOOD
review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster and I was stoked because I had just ran out of the sunscreen I’d been using every day (Neutrogena’s Hydro Boost Water Gel Lotion with broad spectrum SPF 50). My skin is pretty sensitive to sunscreens (for instance the Purito brand everyone loves broke me out really bad) so I’m always a bit cautious when I try a new sunscreen on my face. I love using this product. I use it as the last step in my AM routine as my SPF and moisturizer. I am an essential worker and wear a mask every day to work and wearing this under my mask hasn’t broken me out or irritated my skin at all. The consistency reminds me of a make up primer it goes on really smooth, and wears well under make up. I also don’t smell sunscreen at all, just a nice citrus scent. It also gives my face a really nice glow it’s a light pink shiny color when it comes out. There is no white cast what so ever, it also absorbs nicely. A little can cover your whole face and whatever excess I have I put on my shoulders. I will say the method of applying 3 fingers would probably be too much for oily skin. I have given this 4/5 stars because the one time I did use this and went for a walk with no make up on (few hours in direct sun) it did pill, but I did not reapply nor did I get sunburnt so it works, but if you’re very active or sweat you’d want to reapply often or possibly bring something to wipe your face. Overall I really love this sunscreen it has worked for my skin, the scent is nice, it protects my skin for a long period of time without reapplication (I know I need to reapply but still!), it is a beautiful color and leaves no white cast. Also just want to add the packaging reminds me of the L’Oréal shampoo for kids the one that looks like a little fish with the eye which I love as well. Oh! & I did take this to the beach and dropped it in the ocean (whoops!) and nothing got in the product so the cap is good and secure as well.

The Shiseido Protector Lotion goes the extra mile when providing a ocean-friendly and Hawaii solution therefore you can have a worry free vacation at the beach.

This is a wonderful sun screen! It feels great and smells very nice.  I like the idea of the HeatForce and Wet Force Tech.  I have been using it at the park as much as I can before winter.  I have used it on my face and arms and will continue!
The texture is so light and feels almost like a primer, with very high spf coverage

review_title: Smooth like a primer + slight glow
review_text: This sunscreen goes on incredibly smooth and leaves a light glow. I’d compare the feeling on my skin to that of a really nice makeup primer, with a touch of glistening. It’s easy to layer and use with other skincare. There is a sweet scent but it’s not overpowering and quickly dissipates. This also sat nice and dry underneath a cloth mask, unlike others I’ve tried that felt more oily and moist. My only hesitation with giving it a full five stars is that I’ve not yet had the chance to try it all over in the hot summer sun — I think is a must-test when determining your holy grail sunscreen.

This sunscreen feels very silky on the skin. A very similar texture to a blurring primer. It’s a little hydrating but you definitely still need moisturizer. Without moisturizer it made my dry spots more noticeable. I used this on my face and put make up over it. It actually worked really well as a base there was no pilling. On the body it left a nice silky radiant finish. The Wetforce and Heatforce technology is a super cool concept! I only applied once in the morning and was outside for a lot of the day I didn’t burn at all. Perfect for a beach vacation you don’t have to worry about the ocean!! It’s ocean-friendly and Hawaii compliant! I took 1 star away because I prefer sunscreen fragrance free and it was not as hydrating as expected.

I was very pleasantly surprised by this sunscreen! It sinks in beautifully, even with multiple serums having already absorbed. It does leave shine, but applying Hylamide’s HA Blur corrected that. The scent is not my favorite, but it’s not terrible, either. The texture is very thin without being watery, easy to spread around. I have done an hour of Vinyasa quick flow yoga for the past three days with this sunscreen on. It is truly moisture resistant, as far as I could tell, it didn’t budge at all.I’ll continue to use this bottle, and am very likely to repurchase when needed

I received this product complimentary from Influenster. I just recently started using sunscreen daily as part of my skincare routine, and finding the right one that fits all of my needs can be difficult. This one is nearly perfect. Non-greasy, works great under makeup, mild scent and doesn’t leave a white cast. The size you get for $49 is also impressive. I was visiting family in Florida and went to the beach and wasn’t afraid to also use this on the rest of my body. After an hour of being in the heat and sweating quite a bit, the next day I had no issues with redness. It also didn’t leave any residue on my clothing. The only reason I am giving this four stars is the price. I will definitely use the entire bottle, but I can’t see myself buying it when I run out. There is plenty of Asian sunscreen at a much lower price point that helps my skincare routine.
Since I got this in October I haven’t been able to test it like I would like, but it smells great and goes on clear.

I was really nervous about this product I’m super picky about anything going on my face but I need something to protect my face from the sun so I tried and it and loved it! The scent is light and tropical it’s not overwhelming at all, it goes on a little wet but not like really watery but it blends into your skin and drys immediately which is really important to me because I like to just do it quick through out the day I’m really happy with this product and it’s heat water and sweat proof for uo to 80 mins so it lasts through my end of the day workout perfectly!
Just used this for an outdoor workout and it passed the test! This went on smoothly and absorbed quickly! No issues at all!!

I’ve been looking for a face sunscreen that has high SPF protection and that doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy. This one does not! The texture of this is lightweight and the skin absorbs quickly not leaving a white cast on my skin. It also leaves my skin smooth and it’s great as a primer under makeup as well. It feels more like a moisturizer than a sunscreen. I will definitely be repurchasing this!
A strong product with a light scent. Stays on during my longest bike rides and beach days! Helps my fair, freckled skin stay safe.

I use this every day and keep it in my purse.  It does have a light fragrance but it doesn’t bother me that bad (sunscreen will always have a smell).  I like that gives me a dewy glow (not greasy).  The lotion is tinted and does not give any white cast.

I have skin that is super prone to sunburn. And I hate the sticky feeling with a white trace. But this sunscreen solves the problem perfectly. It smells fresh, it’s smooth, it protects my skin and it doesn’t feel sticky at all. I tacked VC underneath and for hours of direct outdoor sunshine and 1 reapplication, my skin doesn’t even change tone that much. (Use to be red and would swell up and peel) The only disadvantage is it makes my black bag a little white. But i can wipe it off with damp tissue.

I recieved this as a sample and really liked this sunscreen. Unfortunately, this brand is not cruelty free though. The product has a great smell and overall protection, but just not for me for that one very important reason.

Overall great sunscreen. I have oily skin so I tend to have problems with a lot of sunscreens making my skin feel even more oily. I don’t have that problem with this one. It absorbs super quickly, doesn’t leave a white cast, & never leaves my skin feeling sticky or oily. Love it!

So easy to carry and is 2 in 1 as I can use in my face and also in my body. My skin feel so well and smells very good. No color change. I use to have a feel problems to stay in the sun for more than an hour and with shiseido I had no problem. I’ll definitely continue using it.

I really like using this sunscreen! It felt nice on my skin and not too heavy. It has great texture (wasn’t sticky) and has a very pleasant smell. Just make sure you fully rub it in fully and you’re good to go!
I really like this product. I received it for free but I do not like how it leaves a tint of purple on the skin. It is very lightweight and protective.

This is my favorite sunscreen! I spend a lot of time on boats for work so my skin gets a lot of exposure. I need a great sun protection product and this is the one! I have sensitive, acne prone skin and I can use this on my face without breaking out. It also doesn’t have the heavy, greasy texture that a lot of sunscreens have. Highly recommend!

Great body sunscreen! It fully protects my skin and it’s great that it’s ocean friendly. For the price, it’s not bad as far as higher end sunscreens go. There’s a decent amount of product. The only con is that it does leave a small white color on your skin.

I love this product because it’s ocean friendly, considering I love the ocean life! Love how it melts into my skin without making me appear ashy, it instantly soaks in my skin on contact! Loving this sunscreen & so happy that it’s SPF 50+ & great overall sunscreen!

I received this product for free to test and review and I am completely obsessed with it. I usually don’t like many sunscreens but this sunscreen is so light and I have not had an breakouts with this sunscreen either it’s amazing.

review_title: Not as good as the face sunscreen
review_text: Pros: this stuff smells amazing and doesn’t make my skin feel greasy. Cons: it’s super liquidy, which makes it hard to rub in—this also makes application take double the time it should. I feel like I have to use significantly more than if I were just using normal grocery story sunscreen. Because it’s not a creamy texture, it’s also hard to visualize which parts of my body I missed. This caused a lot of random burn marks when I was on the beach in Florida. Their face sunscreen is significantly better!

I received this product complimentary for testing purposes and I admittedly was never a big sunscreen person. I used a little here and there, or if it was in a skincare product I was already using. After using this product I am now an avid sunscreen user! I love how it melts into my skin and i absolutely LOVE the smell! Definitely a must have especially if you’re looking to incorporate sunscreen into your skincare routine! And it doesn’t leave that weird white cast!
Light weight and doesn’t feel greasy! Perfect to protect my tattoos from fun in the sun :)
I like this sunscreen because it doesn’t apply on greasy. Definitely very thick at first but it feels nice once it’s rubbed in. I also like that it doesn’t irritate my skin.

I love this sunscreen! I got complimentary from Influenster! I love how it is not sticky and heavy on the skin like other sun screens! I hasn’t blogged my pores! It leaves my skin glowing and it was very good with other skin products! I will definitely be buying the product and recommend it to all my friends and family.

This is probably my favorite sunscreen so far and I am like the sunscreen queen as I get sun allergies, I’ve tried so many different ones. This one doesn’t stay white on your skin, its super light and absorbing and makes my skin glowy. Very nice scent as well and it came with a reusable bag, perfect to protect it from the sand on the beach. I received this product complimentary and i am glad I did!

I love this sunscreen. It is a lightweight, peach colored sunscreen with a slightly gel texture that is so easy to apply and blend. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

This stuff is awesome! I LOVE that it goes on clear and smells so good! This stuff feels slightly greasy but dries down so it won’t leave you feeling that way all day. However, this product is not pregnancy friendly so unfortunately I cannot use it currently but I will pick it back up once I can!

This is a great product and I feel I am getting true protection when it is used. It blended super easily into the skin and does not leave a white residue. Star off because the smell is a bit strong and can linger on clothes, but does seem to dissipate from skin throughout the day. Also, I feel there could be more product for the price. Looking forward to more sunny days with Shiseido!
I was honestly impressed by the application of this product. It applied super smooth making it great for the summer months under makeup.
Using for last month . I haven’t see any improvements.
My favorite moisturizer so far: it smells great, moisturizes and softens skin, and makes the appearance brighter. Also, it never caused any breakouts, neither made my skin oily/sticky.

I loved it at first but it made my foundation peel, I was so sad about it because this cream really helped me out with my dullness and acne scars. I realized that I was using an silicone base primer with this gel cream so I switched to an water base one…That was the solution. There’s no other problem just pure happiness I really love this moisturizer, so refreshing!
One of my favorite moisturizers. It goes on nicely on the skin and absorbs well without making the skin look greasy. Perfect for underneath makeup.

It’s a gel, so it’s very light on the skin and not too thick or heavy. It has a great orange citrus fragrances that makes me feel clean. It also produces a bit of “glow”. A little bit goes a long way. I love this moisturizer and the whole vitamin C line!

This is my first time trying an Ole Henriksen product. After using a full bottle, I have now purchased a second one. One of my favorites! The smell is amazing and it makes my combination skin look fantastic. A bit pricey, but in my mind worth it.

I’ve been using this gel for a few weeks now and I’ve noticed much healthier and hydrated skin. I just love it! The smell and the texture are great! I highly recommend this product. I’ve also been enjoying other Olehenriksen products!

I loved it. I’m almost 50 years old with dry skin and it made my foundation go on so smooth. This, along with the primer, were the key to a flawless foundation. My foundation lasted all day. It begins looking a bit shiny but by mid-day it is perfect.

My skin always seemed to feel greasy after a few hours and it definitely made my acne worse. Liked the smell, but had to stop using it from the amount of breakouts i had.

i like this product a lot. a little goes a long way for me as i have oily prone skin. i definitely feel like it makes my skin brighter and gives my skin a nice glow. it also makes my skin feel very smooth! i do wish it was also an SPF but that’s asking a lot out of a product. i do have to be careful not to extend this to my under eye as i’m not sure why but it gives me an allergic reaction in that area and makes my under itch like crazy. other than that i love this product and will continue using!

I like the result of this, it is too thin but it spreads well and smells amazing too
Excellent day moisturizer! Light and plays well under makeup! Just be sure to top with sunscreen!

Very refreshing and hydrating

review_title: Great actives, bad addition of perfume/coloring.
review_text: This has multiple forms of vitamin c, including both the pure form and various stable vitamin c derivatives. That is great and their active ingredients are the best feature of this product. The gel crème texture is great for easy application in the morning. Aside from glycerin, there are a few good hydrating additions, but most are too small in quantity to make it a great moisturizer. What’s up with all those plant extracts? They are quite unnecessary, but the use of artificial fragrance and coloring is what really knocks the stars off this rating. Ole, make a cleaner version of this product (more humectants/emollients and less perfume

Got this as a sample and I love it. it smells so good. it feels good on my skin (not sticky and doesn’t pill if I rub) Will definitely buy a bigger jar after I finish my other moisturizers.

review_title: Decent Product That Offers Some Benefits
review_text: I received this product as a free sample from Influenster to test out, but all opinions are my own. This product has a citrus scent that is very pleasing to the nose. It is great for people who like their products to smell nice. I was not a fan of the fragrance, because fragrance has potential to irritate skin. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin so I was a bit hesitant with it. I did not notice any new breakouts for the three weeks that I used this product. Moving forward, it has a good gel consistency for oily/combo skin. I think it is hydrating enough for dry skin, and it would work well with normal skin types unless people are allergic to some ingredients in it. I haven’t tried it under foundation although the texture and consistency makes me think it would work fine underneath foundations. I didn’t notice a brightening effect in my skin, but that’s probably due to the fact that I did not use it for that long. My pigmentation from breakouts did not diminish or anything although I noticed my skin was a bit more hydrated which may or may not have been this product alone. 3 weeks itself is not a sufficient amount of time to see long term results from a product. In the future, I would not repurchase the product since there are other products that fit my needs more than this one does. For people who like nicely scented products, this is one they should consider buying.

I have oily/normal skin but it is very dull and I have a lot of old acne scars and within a week or two of using this, it has lessened my scars and brightened up my skin immediately!! Im obsessed with it and it smells like a sweet orange

I love this product. I have dry acne prone skin and it has helped tremendously with my dry patches. I love the smell and the refreshing feeling when I use it in the morning. Absolutely amazing. It’s nourishing, doesnt leave sticky residue, absorbs quickly, and smells like an orange creamsicle. Literally couldn’t ask for a better face cream.

I absolutely love Ole Henriksen,  so I was so happy to have received this product courtesy of Influenster, in exchange for my honest review!  Right away, I noticed the lovely, delicious smell of orange creamsicle.  It’s not a strong fragrance, just a nice, light smell. review_title: Stick through the purge, it is so worth it!
review_text: Amazing amazing amazing product! I’ve been using it for a month now (3 times a week) and my skin has never been so glowy, smooth, bright and even. This does wonders for skin texture from tiny under-skin “pimple“ bumps. That being said, you have to use it consistently for a while to see results. And at first, you’ll likely experiencing purging. This is when you seem to “break out“ from typically a product that speeds skin cell turnover (exfoliators, retinols etc). However the difference is that while breakouts (from makeup etc) tend to happen in areas where you wouldn’t normally get pimples, purging brings already existing pimples to the surface which is why purging happens in areas where you do normally breakout. Anyway, all of that is to say if you are experiencing purging with this product, it should go away after about a month (maybe more, maybe less). Stick with it because the results are so worth it! And for the price, it can’t be beat! A tiny splash goes a long, long way.I took off one star because of 2 things. First, I find the drip nozzle to be kind of leaky, even after I’ve screw it back up as tightly as possible. Product always ends up seeping out and causing the lid area to be sticky. To combat this, I’ve transferred some product into a dropper bottle and I use it that way. Secondly, I find this product to be a bit sticky. More sticky than I was expecting. However, I have oily skin, which is why this bothers me a bit. But if you have dry skin, this may be a plus for you. It’s fairly moisturizing because of the glycerin.

Wow, this toner helped tighten my pores. I love acids. Lactic, glycolic, salicylic, azelaic, mandelic, gimme all the acids. None of my other products containing acids that are meant to shrink pores have made such a difference so quickly. I know pores are supposed to be visible on your face, especially your nose, but I still use a lot of products that are supposed to tighten them. I never do a review this early on (less than a full month of use, usually at least 6 weeks), but the results are already there. The pores on my nose are very noticeably smaller since I added this toner to my routine. Reading the reviews, I thought there had to be some exaggeration going on. But, I still had very high hopes for this toner. I’m so impressed that it actually surpassed my expectations. The pores on my nose were the most noticeable to me. Within a week with consistent use, they are barely visible. The thing that surprised me the most about this toner is actually how non-drying it is. I expected it to feel harsher on my skin. After thorough cleansing and exfoliation, you definitely feel a tingle. However, it actually leaves your skin feeling supple instead of stripped. I expected my pores to shrink, but I definitely didn’t expect to be able to skip on a moisturizer. For someone with dry skin, I wouldn’t recommend this. But, for someone with combination skin that gets easily oily (especially in the warmer months), I do. Using this toner in combination with a hydrating serum, (plus a few other products, I customize my routine every time) has become my perfect routine for healthy, glowing skin.
