Bought this after doing a lot of research. I can say I was afraid after applying it on because it tingled and made it a bit sensitive, but ohhhh boy do you see results! I say slowly transition into any active skin products so your skin gets used to it. I have ultra dry, sensitive, rosacrea skin and I love this.
Very good!!!! Nice with my skin!  I recommend using morning and night

If you’re a beginner for a glycolic toner then this is the product to start with. the amount of product for the price point is unbeatable. I used the entire bottle and applied it nightly but, it’s blah. I need something stronger. I found the pixi glow tonic stronger than this. My next purchase will actually be the youth to the people glycolic toner.

Love this toner! I’m on my second bottle. It dries down quickly and does not leave my skin filling like I have product on my face. Since using it, I have noticed that I go without needing foundation to even out my skin tone more often than before.
Love this toner! Great results without having to overpay for toner!

review_title: Changes skin type from oily to normal
review_text: I bought this product in mid august and use it every night and it’s still looks like it’ll last me a few more months. I find that this helps a lot with brightening my dark spots in a way that no other product can. It also helps with acne and pores but I have noticed that it doesn’t help much with whiteheads, and it can be super drying, I used to have oily skins and since using this my skin has completely changed to combo dry. Giving it 4 stars because even though it’s a great price it doesn’t fully deliver the exfoliation that it says it does.
I used this twice, and it left a very oily film on my face and made me break out! Will be tossing sadly
Do a patch test first! I didn’t and it broke me out horribly :(

This did exactly nothing for my skin. I used an entire bottle over the course of months. I saw no improvements in pore size whatsoever which was my initial reason for purchase. Back to Ole Henriksen I go.

I only use this twice a week or when I’m wearing more on my face than usually. I remove my makeup (with the ordinary cleanser) then I use a clarifying cleanser, rinse and dry. Then I get my cotton pad ready for some toning! NOTHING is left after I swipe my face with this stuff! Any makeup that may have been left behind, including dirt and oil just runs away from this stuff! I moisturize throughly and I’m off to bed happy, knowing my face is clean.
Great product at an amazing price. This toner has certainly helped to even my skin tone and texture. It’s very gentle which is perfect for my sensitive skin. A little goes a long way.
Amazing product at the fraction of price.As an esthetician I can clearly say that this brand is anything but ordinary.Will definitely purchase more from this brand.

This stuff is great. I’ve been using it for about a year now and my skin has NEVER looked better. This product did take some getting used to. I tried using it every day but my dry skin did not like that at all. Instead I use it every other day and I use a witch hazel toner on the days I don’t use this. Really helps with scarring, unclogging pores, and exfoliates dry skin away.

This keeps my acne to a minimum and doesn’t dry out my skin. To me it has a strange ‘texture’ because it’s thicker than most toners I use. I like to switch off between this and Olehenrickson oil control toner and my face has been looking great.

I love this toner, it’s a great exfoliant, gets rid of extra makeup left behind after washing my face, and has improved my acne after using it for a few weeks. I’m waiting to see more noticeable results with this and my other products I purchased from The Ordinary, but so far am pleased overall!
This product has no scent, does not irritate my skin, but I’m not sure that it is benefiting my skin. I’ll keep using it in hopes that it will make my face softer.

I was thoroughly impressed with this toner, especially for the price. It has reduced a lot of redness and unevenness in my skin, and has made my skin significantly smoother overall. I have really sensitive skin, but I have been using this toner daily for over a month now and I have yet to encounter any dryness or irritation. It hasn’t completely eliminated breakouts for me, but I do notice that they tend to fade more quickly, and the discolouration afterward is definitely reduced. If you’re on the fence about buying it, I’d recommend giving it a shot!
I read all the great reviews and really wanted to love it. But it just doesn’t work for my skin. Makes my face feel sticky. I gave it multiple try’s and it’s just not doing it for me

This toner works absolute wonders!! All the ingredients are amazing with no added fragrant. It does what it says it does. I’ve been using this for around two months now and my skin looks brighter and clearer. Acne scars on my face have been less noticeable. My absolute go to in skincare!! And all of this for less than $10. Would definitely recommend

Love this stuff . Use only at night time. I have really oily skin and huge pores and kept getting little white heads. I started using this a few weeks ago along with with salicylic acid serum from ordinary and my skin is glowing. It has also helped me with the little hormonal acne i would get once a month. I also have very sensitive skin and have tried numerous things for my acne with nothing really working. So happy i read the other reviews and brought this.

JUG O’ TONER! It will last you forever if you use it correctly. And it works. It shrinks pore visibly. It clears plucky stuff outta your pores.  It doesn’t dry but removes oil along with dirt.  And it will burn any open cut, sore, pimple, blemish you have so be sure to apply the first layer light handed - so you don’t scream and the neighbors call the cops for your abuse of Toner. LOVE it.  Go buy it . . . like NOW.

Have definitely noticed a difference. It has helped my skin glow. I updated many things in my skincare routine but I feel like this has helped!! And for the price?! I mean you really can’t beat that...
Makes my skin feel so clean. I have sensitive skin, but this product did not affect that. It also has not caused me to break out when most new products that I try, do.

I don’t understand the hype with this product. I used up my Tarte Knockout Tingling Treatment, but decided to buy this as a cheaper alternative. I had high hopes because of all the positive reviews. Although this did not irritate my skin in any way, I did not see any improvements in my skin the way Tarte’s does. It maybe gives a very very subtle glow, but my texture isn’t improved, my skin is not brighter, and my pores are not even the slightest bit less visible. Definitely going back to Tarte Knockout.
I have an oily skin, acne prone, I felt like this toner does works well on me.

This is an excellent product, at an excellent price, with the primary ingredients to perform the exfoliation.  Equal, if not, better performance than Biologique R. P50, which I was using and could not tolerate the vinegar smell. Plus, it is at a fraction of the price. Please do note that you have to use it consistently. For sensitive skin you can dilute further with rose water, witch hazel, etc.
I like this a lot. The price point and effectiveness of this toner is great.  This is a definite repurchase.
Just got this toning solution & I’m already loving it. I wouldn’t recommend for people with very sensitive skin though. My skin is softer & brighter!

Didn’t work for me. I have sensitive skin and this made me itch. It also didn’t do much for my skin. Most toners I can tell the next day that it’s doing something but this did not. I wanted to like it but couldn’t since I was scared my sensitivity for this product would increase.

I have been using this stuff every night for 2 weeks and I honestly didn’t expect too notice such a difference so quickly. My skin was looking so dull and uneven this winter and this product has done exactly what I wanted it to! The price is just spot on and I look forward too trying out more from The Ordinary in the future!
I purchased this and gave a try. I noticed my skin looks healthier using 2 times a day. No cooling feeling using but you notice over time of using it’s value.

This really didn’t do much for my skin. It leaves a sticky film on my skin so I only use it at night and even then it’s still annoying because it gets on my arm as I sleep and it’s just sticky. It made me breakout so I stopped using it but I might try to add it to my routine again. I just don’t find it necessary to use on a regular basis over a toner that doesn’t have an acid in it.

I have super dry and sensitive skin. I use this a few times a week after cleansing my skin, and it really helps to keep my skin bright and glowing with no dry flakes. I’ve had no irritation (it does make my skin red for about 10 seconds when applied, it quickly fades) and this bottle is seriously HUGE for the price! I’m so excited to have this in my routine.

This has changed my skin for the better. My skin looks brighter and my sun spots have faded. This sounds so cheesey but one day I looked in the mirror and was like “omg I love how my skin looks, what foundation did I put on today??“ Then I realized I didn’t put on foundation that morning - that was just my bare skin. I now no longer even wear foundation on a daily basis because this toner has made such a difference in my skin.

I usually stop using a toner after a few weeks because it tends to dry out my skin too much. This stuff doesn’t do that to me.  Instead I have less breakouts and I feel that my skin looks way better.  I also believe it’s helping to minimize blackheads, but I have to use it longer to be sure

I was so excited to see sephora carrying this product. I have been wanting to try this line since I hear such great things about it, not just on the quality but the affordability. My skin type is an over all mess. to the point I don’t feel confident to go do my groceries without foundation on. its extremely oily, acne prone, i have huge pores,  dry patches, hyperpigmentation & its red a splotchy... so AKA a dermatologists niiightmare!!! this product has helped me lighten my dark spots, calm down the redness and smooth out my pores. I also use the salicylic acids solution on my break out to help treat that. I actually went to work today with just a little under eye concealer without feeling ashamed... I can’t wait to see if it will just keep improving the situation.

I will not be purchasing any other toner for a long time! This stuff is amazing! It has helped with my breakouts more than any spot treatment I’ve ever used. I use this at night and wash it off in the morning, and it leaves my skin feeling so smooth and hydrated even if I don’t moisturize after use.
I have oily, acne prone skin, open pores. Been using it for 3 weeks now at night time,  no changes in my skin at all, not even a little. like i was putting water on my face, not effective.

review_title: So good for such a great price !!
review_text: Bought this with the Salicylic Acid 2% solution from The Ordinary and the two together work wonders!! They cleared my skin within a week after trying many other pricy products!!

Super great at removing any leftover traces of makeup and helps brighten my skin! Not to mention the price is unbeatable!! This is a better version of the Pixi glow tonic at 1/4 of the price and triple the size! Must have staple for your beauty routine!

Stock up when you can get your hands on it! Excellent product and an acceptable dupe for Pixi Glow Tonic. Recommended for pm use only, but I’ve been using twice a day with no irritation. If you’re used to acids, this won’t be a problem for you. Another win from The Ordinary!

Amazing, I love acids and toners, this is great to remove dead skin and to gently exfoliate, the price of this product is almost a joke, it’s soooo worth it. I use it on my neck, chest, shoulders and back as well. I haven’t had any pimples since I started using this in conjunction with the aha 10% serum from the Ordinary, which is a miracle, especially during the time of the month. I even forgot to remove my makeup 2 times before bed during the holidays and I think this Saved me. Usually falling asleep before I remove my makeup ruins my skin for a least a week. I have sensitive skin and this does not make my skin burn or react. My pores look better. The packaging is so nice as well, very simplistic yet doesn’t look cheap and you don’t waste product because the cap is perfectly designed. On top of it, a Canadian brand, what else can I love more about this brand.
Visible difference after one use! Just don’t forget to wash your hands after application like me!

I used it for one month mixed with my moisturizer and saw zero tanning! It simply did not work. I tried a test putting it on one leg and not the other for one week - no difference! I used max amount of drops in each handful of lotion.
Used these glow drops and they gave such a fake orange hue. Had to exfoliate three times before attempting to leave the house because I looked like am Oompa Loompa.

The best at home tan you can buy in a jar. It works OK with any moisturizer. However, it works very well when you use this with the tanning butter, same brand. I have also used them with cheaper self tan lotions, but they do not compare!!

Love love love! I was hesitant at first because of the negative reviews, but seriously this is the easiest product to use every few days to get that tan look on your face. I exfoliate a lot because I have acne prone skin, so my face is usually quite paler than my tan body. This product not only tans my face to match the rest of my body, but I can also wear it under makeup. The smell isn’t nearly as bad as self tanner (which tends to make me nauseous after awhile), and I don’t notice any oily residue. So easy to use! I’m so happy I bought this!

I have used every brand of self tan drops out there from st tropez to tanologist and this one is by far the worst. You can mix it into your moisturizer for hours and you will still end up with dark patches and it gave my skin a red tint and stuck to the hair follicles on my legs so now it looks like I have KP when I don’t.

These drops were gifted by Isle of Paradise and are amazing and give a very natural glow! They’re gentle on my skin and didn’t dry it out. I love mixing it with my moisturizer and watching the color develop over time. I would recommend!

review_title: Best face tanning product out there!
review_text: I do not tan and this makes me looked tanned and sunkissed
irritated my skin & had a terrible lingering scent. it is not worth it the tanning drops!

The color came out subtle and nice. I would not try this product again as it made my legs super hot. Not sure what was about its ingredients but something might’ve clogged my pores. I hard a hard time sleeping at night (I applied it 3-4 hours before bed) because the areas that I applied the product to got super heated.
works well and fast. no orangy colour. used 3 drops 3 days in a row with my regular moisturizer  and looked like I had a deep tan .

review_title: No more Casper the Friendly Ghost
review_text: I do enjoy these drops. Depending on how many drops I mix in with my moisturizer, I notice the subtle or obvious tan tint in my paleness. I’ve seen reviews saying that these drops leave orange streaks on their skin. I had unappealing orange stains on my hand when I first tested the drops out and it is something that can easily be avoided by evenly distributing the drops with your moisturizer. I will say though, after applying the drops, the next couple days I can smell the tanning solution on my skin quite heavily. It’s not something that puts me off personally, but if you’re bothered by the smell of tanning solution then you probably won’t enjoy this product after a couple of days.
As a self tan novice, this is super easy to use and doesn’t have that gross self tan scent. You can apply it during the day or do it at night and it won’t again your clothes.
Use this stuff everyday! I love to mix it with my morning serum. Only 1-2 drops is all you need. Keeps my pale skin looking glowy all winter long

I used 10 drops and I look yellow orange. I will try the light shade and see if that is better. The directions aren’t very clear. It says you can use up to 12 drops. I would start with 2-3 drops and see how that goes.
This is my favorite self tanner!! I love it because you can add any amount of drops depending on how tanned you want to be and mix it with any lotion!

I’m surprised that there are so many negative reviews of this product, I love it! I am very fair skinned and live in a cold place so I thought I’d try this out to avoid looking like a ghost all winter. I mix it in with first aid beauty lotion for face and body and it’s come out even and a nice color every time. My palms haven’t turned orange at all with washing my hands after using. Even with the light option, just three drops in my face/neck lotion gives me a nice subtle color, even my husband complimented it! Will definitely be purchasing again.
very natural color, i usually put about 2 drops in my normal lotion per leg/torso/arm

review_title: Best self tanning product if used properly!
review_text: Pricing is not A selling point whatsoever however, this is by far the best self tanner on the market at the moment. The key is to use a very particular lotion and mix it in let it dry and then go for a second coat. I have no problem answering any questions, I started with medium, then went dark. If you are unsure, go and buy the starter kit in medium. In just a few hours I can go from pale to bronze. It’s better than a bohemian bronze. Secret: Australian gold Lotion. I will add photo. -1 star bc of price for little bottle. I tried to add lotion to my old bottle. I’ve had my new bottle for over a month and use it every night. And once you get your face glow you can use other self Tanners.

Mixed 6 drops in my favorite body moisturizer after bathing and exfoliating. And by mixed I mean mixed like swirling and blending for a minute at least then mixing again in my palms just before application. Ended up with greenish gold splotches on one leg and no color difference anywhere else on my body. Product feels creamy and hydrating, but didn’t blend well and color was green cast.
Awesome way to get a natural  tan!! I only needed 3 drops for my body and 1 drop in my facial moisturizer to achieve an awesome tan!!

My coloring is very fair but I wanted a little tint to my legs. I read other reviews and chose Medium - Golden Glow as others indicated that the Light was too light. I’ve had to experiment to find the right tint and now I know that 3 drops is perfect for me and 4 is a bit too dark. Regardless, I like that I add it to my own lotion and use it only once a week. It has taken the ghostly look off of my legs and I’m confident in its “natural“ look going into the summer. This will be my go-to product!

I tried the dark version of this first and it was a little too orange for me, but the medium works much better for my skin tone. I mix 3 drops of this with 4 drops of oil at night (usually rosehip oil or the B oil from the ordinary) and I find that this combination gives me much more even coverage than when I mix it with a moisturizer. This gives me a nice glow and isn’t too intense!

I was really nervous about this product when I first got it and went real light on the drops. But it actually works great!  Now I feel safe to put in a lot of drops for a deeper tan. I put my body lotion in a bowl and then mix the drops in really good and apply lotion like normal then wash my hands!  Tan is a good color, not streaky and I am very impressed!  It still smells like self tanner, but not nearly as bad as a normal spray tan!

i love this product! i was hesitant to purchase in case it wouldn’t work, and it’s a bit pricy but my goodness it gave me such a pretty glow with only 3-4 drops so far. and because i haven’t been able to tan yet i didn’t want to go too dark. my skin is on the lighter side, not pale, but it gets darker through the summer. very pleased with this product, whenever i run out (it’ll be a long time) i’ll definitely buy again
Excellent. Follow the directions as it works well.

review_title: Strong smell, use sparingly, decent tan
review_text: I’m still on the fence about this product.  I’m a fair-skinned red head with a lot of experience using self-tanning lotions, mousses, sprays, etc.  While this gives a decent tan and easy to apply, the recommended number of drops to use is way too high.  1 or 2 drops per section -- such as calves, thighs, tummy, arms -- is plenty.  Do not use 5-12 as instructed.  Unfortunately, the musty self-tanner smell is tenacious and lasts for days.  In the past 3 days since I used this product, I’ve washed my hands several times each day, showered, shampooed and still my hands smell like fake tan.  It honestly is interferring with my sleep since the smell is overpowering with my hands up by my face how I like to sleep.  I’ll keep working with it and using different lotions.  I used CeraVe lotion so far, with is just a nice basic moisturizer.  I have not put this on my face, as I want a thorough test first!  Like others, the color comes off noticeably on my white bathing scrunchy.  I also had to clean around my toenails and heels thoroughly as they looked caked with brownish-orange dirt after applying the drop-enhanced lotion.  And this is all with the “light“ tanning drops!  Very strong in both color and scent.

Works really well if looking for a natural tanned look. After about 4 hours you will notice it more. I used about 2 small drops and noticed a different. Could even go with about 1 drop. Will stay on your hand if you used your fingers to mix with moisturizer. Very impressed with the product.
Love this.  Does not turn Orange and leaves a great natural tan

Amazing! The best way to build a totally natural tan with low risk of streaking and minimal effort. I mix 10+ drops with my body lotion every few days to slowly build up a tan that I can maintain all summer. By applying smaller amounts more gradually, I haven’t had to worry about problems with lines/streaking/splotches like many self tanners (and I’m not patient enough to do a good job with many of them). I used to apply with bare hands and wash them immediately after, but it can sometimes get under nails or in dry skin, so now I use gloves.

I am a self tan addict and I love this product. It feels so nice on my face and doesn’t rub off onto my pillowcase. A little goes a LONG way, make sure you use a moisturizer and really blend it down into the neck. I only use two drops and it got very dark!

The tan is lovely. The best part is that it doesn’t have a self Tanner smell!! Any tanning product I have used (being from Canada- half the year I use ALOT of different products) have had very strong smells. It’s so nice to put this on before bed and not be bothered by the smell. And as mentioned, the tan results are beautiful! Highly recommend.

I like how you can mix this with any moisturizer for the application. However, it takes a LOT of product to receive any color payoff. I used approximately 4 droppers worth of product mixed with 4 pumps of body lotion on my body. The tan did show up nicely the next morning, but it only lasted for 2 days. Not worth the $29  in my opinion.

I got a sample of this product and loved it so I bought the full size. I think the company should put a plastic seal around the lid because quite a bit of product leaked out onto the rest of my order in the box and there was quite a bit of product missing :( :( :(

I apply 3 drops into my lotion (about 2 pumps of lotion) and apply to my body. I definitely think less is more, take your time- if you feel like you missed and area go back over it again. I left it on for 5 hours, I had a beautiful bronze tan!! I also apply it to my face (jet lag mask by summer fridays pairing) with 3 drops. It did not break me out. It does smell like self-tanner, but what do you expect? That’s what it is. Overall, amazing, barley used the bottle. Worth the money for how many uses you’ll get out of it.

This works really well. I am fair-skinned and used the medium. Mixed a few drops with lotion (per area of my body), rubbed it in, and had a light natural glow. Even did my face by adding it to clinique moisturizer. No streaks. Looks natural.So much cheaper than getting a spray tan. :) It does have a scent on top of the normal tanning-product smell. I wish they left that out. It’s not necessary. I have a hunch that the people who turn orange or have a skin reaction forgot to mix it with lotion. ???Going to buy the bigger bottle now.

I got a sample of this and was super excited to try it since I’ve never self-tanned before. I have a medium skin tone and was curious to see how to Medium shade would look on me.I mixed 4-5 drops with my Vaseline cocoa butter lotion and made sure to thoroughly mix it in my palms before applying. I applied it to just one leg so I could compare the next day and see the difference. Also, I did my leg in 3 sections and added 4-5 drops for each section.I noticed only a small difference the next day, but I was happy to see that the color came out with no streaks other than a small one on the bottom of my foot. I was also relieved that my white sheets were not stained and that the self tanner smell is minimal.I think I need to try the dark shade so I don’t have to use as many drops, but overall I’m really happy with this product!
Works great! First time tanner user and this is foolproof. Immediate results after one use and no mess. Super easy to control darkness with how many drops you use.
I have super fair skin, and this is the first tanner that hasn’t turned me orange. I add two drops to my daily moisturizer in the morning. It gave me a nice glow, without looking like a fake tan.

Ordered this online and it arrived leaking so I lost a bit of product, but I was still able to use it. I mixed 4 drops with my face moisturizer before going to bed. I did appear a little orange in the morning, but after washing my face it looked much more natural! I will probably repurchase in the future, but recommend picking it up in store to avoid potential leakage.
Love this self tanner! Super natural looking and last well. I’ve tried a bunch and this one is my favourite for my face. Doesn’t make me breakout and smells nice.

review_title: fades away and leaves face looking patchy
review_text: Really good on the first day but when it starts coming off it leaves my face looking patchy &Doesn’t fade away smoothly. Color is nice though but you have to reapply frequently if u don’t want the patchiness

I LOVE this stuff! As a natural red head, I’m always super pale and I hate it lol. But this stuff lets me turn any one of my moisturizers into a nice tan and it looks so nice and natural. I don’t think I’ll ever go back to anything else. It’s not the best photo of me but you can definitely see the difference between my skin tones lol

If I could give this product NO stars, I would! It is the worst self-tanner I have ever used! I had seen it demonstrated on QVC about 2 years ago and considered buying it then, but put it off. I am an older woman who does not wear shorts or tank tops, but I do like to have “color“ on my face and arms in the summer; and I normally get a good amount working in the yard. But using self-tanner keeps me from using makeup. I have tried several, and most do end up turning a bit orange. This one promised it would not, so I finally broke down and ordered it. After the much anticipated wait, I was thrilled to try it out the very first evening I had it. It was such a disappointment! After following all of the instructions, I literally had NO color change with the first application. So, the next day, I doubled the amount of drops to my moisturizer and went about my day. When I caught a glimpse of myself in the mirror, I was horrified. My whole face was a bright orange color, and the rest of my body (arms, neck, chest, etc.) were my natural tan color! On top of that, even though I had thoroughly washed my hands after each application, a couple of my fingers were dark brown! Embarrassed by my appearance, I proceeded to try to remove some of the coloring and was shocked when it quite easily came off - at least it seemed like the top layer did! Whatever might have soaked into my skin was there to stay until it could fade away! Fortunately, it was a bearable color and in a few days - or less - I could go back to my usual self-tanner and happily forget about this disastrous product. It is a waste of money and definitely NOT what I had expected.

Some of you are having issues with this, bc you’re simply using too much, or the wrong color! THAT is why you look orange! If you have FAIR skin, and buy DARK, what did you think was going to happen? You’re light, buy light, start with a couple drops and go from there. It may not be as dark as you want it, but you can build up the drops as you learn. Far better to do that, then go all in and be orange. If you’ have an olive skin tone, use Med, and so on. The colors are there for a reason. If you decide you want to look like you’ve been laying out for months, in 1 go, NO self tanner is for you. Sorry. Also, after the given time frame, shower! It washes off a lot of the excess and you will typically not have the oompa loompa look, afterwards. Ankles, knees and elbows will ALWAYS look darker if you apply the same amount as the rest of your body, regardless of how much you exfoliate, bc they are the areas that are drier. When applying, take it past your hairline or you will definitely look weird. Its not going to damage your hair. Self tanners are not for those who dont follow directions or who are expecting a MASSIVE change in 1 application... does the sun give you the EXACT tan you want in 3hrs? No... and neither does anything else. Afterwards, wash your hands and use coconut oil or some baking soda and lemon juice mixed together to create a paste, rub it all over your hands, then wash again. Both also work on your body, not just hands. Happy tanning!

The first time I used these drops, I only mixed 3 drops in my moisturizer and my tan looked okay. 5 days later, I used the product again but this time only using 5 drops of the product in my moisturizer. It took only 3 hours before my entire face looked ORANGE. I would say, if you don’t tan outside with the sun, use the drops. Beware after tanning outside and then using the drops.

Love this! This is my first time using a self tanner. I have super fair skin so I’ve always been a bit afraid. Being able to control how much I put in my moisturizer is perfect. I get a beautiful glow that looks completely natural!

I was skeptical to buy this, but I’m so glad I did.  I never use tanning products on my face because it tends to stick to problem spots or dryness and make my skin look worse, but this gave me great color.  Dark is a good color to choose if you always have a tan and not to dark.  I put one or two drops in my face lotion at night and wake up tan!

Like a lot of others, my bottle had spilled during delivery, but costumer service took care of this! I love the color this gives, especially on my face. It might like a tad orange, but I find that other self tanners on my face just look thick and fake. This looks really natural. It also lasts a while and doesn’t take long to apply. But it’s so easy to get an uneven tan since it goes on clear. I’ve definitely woken up in the morning and noticed i missed spots. And I’m going through the bottle so quickly since I use it all over my body. For now i’m gonna stick with this, but might see what other self tanners are out there.
I hate giving bad reviews but this product stinks. It literally stinks and the color is blotchy. Once it starts to fade its even more blotcy and just looks really bad.

i was so excited to try this from all the reviews but was so disappointed! i’ve used self tanner for 15 years and this was one of the streakiest most uneven results i’ve had. i switched which lotions i put it in and watched numerous youtube tutorials. do NOT recommend.

First time using a self tanner, but it works great! Doesn’t leave your face orange and gives off a nice healthy glow. Took off a star because my bottle (like a bunch of other reviews) also leaked in shipping.

First off the product needs to have a plastic seal or something, half my bottle was spilt in the shipping package which seems to be the case for many people. Smells good in the bottle, but once you apply it you smell the typical self tanner smell. I used about 6 drops per body part, it’s been on all day and I barely look tan. My skin tone is pretty light. The bottle says apply 1-12 drops, if I used 12 drops per body part this would be gone in one use. I was super excited for this to come but I’m pretty underwhelmed. Probably will not repurchase if my bottle is going to leak every time, don’t want to waste my money.

Fun and effective! You can add to any moisturizer and add to your face and body. I find it’s easier to blend with a gel or lotion rather than a thicker hydrating cream or body butter. It’s not orange and you can really control the tan. I used three drops and put on before bed and woke up with a great glow. But like any self tanner remember to blend blend blend.

Great drops! Goes perfectly with a moisturizer at the end of your skincare routine. I started with 2 drops in the morning and then added another 2 in the evening once the colour set in. Be careful of your neck though.
Obsessed with these drops, gives such an even glow can use two drops for subtle everyday color. Goes really well with the Drunk Elephant D-Bronzi drops for Summer

I’ve been using this product for about 3 weeks now and it works well. I mix about 5 drops with Aveeno daily moisturizer after a shower and it takes roughly 10 minutes for my skin to get darker. Like going for a spray tan in the salon: shower, exfoliate your skin, choose a thinner moisturizer and really make sure you’re running it in evenly and you’ll have good results. It doesn’t look orange on me at all and I’m fair skinned.Good luck
Be sure to wash your hands and finger nails when your finished. Bit of a sticky feeling at first, but I love the color this gives me!! (I use mainly on my face)

review_title: natural looking tan & no clogged pores!
review_text: These are awesome. I put two drops in with my face moisturizer this morning and a few hours later have the most natural looking tan ever. I was worried I’d notice a weird texture, greasiness, or it would emphasize my pores but nope!

review_title: Nice tan, but avoid putting on your face
review_text: Great product in terms of the even tan. Really wanted this to work on my face but unfortunately it broke me out so bad. If you’re even mildly sensitive to breakouts, stay away from this on your face. I’ll continue to use on my legs.

Not my favorite self tanner. Followed directions for mixing product into moisturizer and I was very patchy and orange the following morning. The color was all wrong and product clung and processed in patches.

I read many reviews and finally decided to try. Only used 1-2 drops and it really evened out my skin tone and made me look nicely tanned! My legs are so white so they are a bit harder to get evened out but my face and arms look awesome!

Such a beautiful and natural glow and tan. I’m pretty pale, so I was a bit nervous to try. 6 drops and I woke up this morning with such a natural tan as if I’ve been on the beach for weeks. So so happy with this product!

I love this so much I am ordering another bottle!  Also, several coworkers are wanting to try this!  I work in a warehouse,  and everyone asks me what I used, so your company might run out soon (sorry). Unfortunately,  I did not take pictures of the tan.  But I have nit been this dark, since using tanning beds.  Everyone at work thought I used a tanning bed.  I used alot of drops ( one squirt lotion, two dropper fulls of tanning drops).

review_title: natural looking tan on medium olive skin
review_text: I rarely expose my face to the sun so I always have a different color neck/face than the rest of my body. I got these with the hopes that I could blend in my face/neck to my chest a bit and so far so good! I have medium olive skin and added about 3 drops into my face and 4-5 drops into my neck area moisturizers and woke up the next morning with a natural looking tan. I had a little bit of a darker spot on my chin but that seems to have gone away after I wiped it down a bit with a damp washcloth. TBD on how long the tan lasts, but so far very pleased!

Love it. I used 3 drops the first time for just my face and I was so dark ( in comparison to my stark white skin) now I add 1-2 drops to my usual amount of  face cream and wash it off in a couple hours. It’s a perfect bronze glow.

I love these tanning drops. I mix a few drops with lotion before I go to bed and by the time I wake up I have a nice glow. It also last a couple of days. If I don’t mix then it can look somewhat blotchy. There is a distinct tanning smell but it does not come off to my clothing or my bedding. This bottle will last you a long time which is nice! I highly recommend this for your face as for a long time I looked for a self tanner that gave me the color I was looking for and didn’t look blotchy. I love it!

I am super pale but I self-tan, I was looking for a better way to get my face to have a nice glow to it as well. I decided to purchase the light shade but easily could have done medium as well. Even with the lightest shade, I thought I had a nice sunny glow that was not streaky at all! I highly recommend!

I was super pleasantly surprised by this, especially after reading some of the negative reviews. For the past few years I’ve used the st. tropez express self tan mousse but I fly a lot to and from college so this seems more convenient/less messy to pack. I was pretty conservative with how much I put on my first time (2 drops into moisturizer for face+neck, about 2 for each arm and about 6 for each leg/butt all mixed into a LOT of lotion). I put it on in the middle of the day yesterday and didn’t notice a huge difference until this morning. I have a nice bronzy glow that looks about the same as leaving on the st tropez express mousse for 2 hours. I’m not noticing any self-tanner smell today but it was pretty strong yesterday. I really like that it’s meant to be mixed into moisturizer because I hate feeling of how dry my skin is when I have to skip lotion and put on a mousse. Overall, I’ll probably switch to buying just this unless using it on my whole body makes the bottle run out super quickly!

I tried to like this product and make it work because I’ve been looking for something to give me a glow without wearing makeup. Pro: - it was easy to blend and did not break me out Cons: - very uneven around the nose and mouth - more orange than expected

review_title: Dont use the water then the drops.
review_text: I used the tanning water and then these the next day. The water worked well for me but the drops irrigated my skin amd were way more spotty. They do tan. It’s just not as clean as the water is. Also for my personally the skin irritation is not worth it.. I have showered multiple times to get ride of the drops so my skin can go back to normal. My arms legs stomach and even face and neck have these small bumps. It’s horrible. I used the drops with my lotion and moisturizer. The tan does fade after a few showers. Although I washed my hands they look like oompa orangey. Again this wasn’t until I did the drops. The water didnt have that effect. Maybe it was because I did both. But because of the skin irritation I dont think I’ll use the drops again.

Not the best self tanner out there. However, pretty easy to apply. Didn’t transfer onto white bed sheets but after I showered the next day it got all over my towel. I would say about 4/10 on the orange scale. Used about 4 drops on each body part (including face) and definitely saw a difference but wouldn’t do any more as it already looks a BIT orange.

I am VERY fair skinned so some self tanners are too harsh for me. I love that I can mix this with my own lotion and can customize how much I want to use. I have also used this on my face without breaking out.

Love these drops! I use 1-2 with my night cream every night and it adds a nice subtle glow (which is great especially in the winter!) I’ve also had it for about 4-5 months and not even half way through the bottle!
Turned my face orange with 4 drops mixed into my moisturizer.
This is exactly what is says it will be, a perfect shade of golden glow! For your face, 4-5 drops into your moisturizer. For the rest of your body, I would recommend making a more concentrated ratio

AMAZING!! And great for sensitive/acne-prone skin. I originally tried the COOLA face tanner which made me breakout, but these drops have done wonders. I like that this is a tan that builds day-over-day instead of something that washes off each night. I was originally skeptical since a lot of influencers were promoting these drops, but they actually work. The tan actually shows, lasts through hot showers and workouts, and no breakouts whatsoever. These drops brought my confidence back!
Works amazingly well. Not streaky but you need to apply with the mitt and let the lotion dry and sink into the skin before putting on clothes or else it does move around and will leave streaks.

THIS PRODUCT IS AMAZING. I love a good fake tan and when I saw that you can put these in any lotion/moisturizer I was sold. I bought the dark but then was immediately super nervous to try it bc I am PALE. When I say pale I mean I am the color of boiled chicken breasts pale. I normally get the “dark” shade for every other self tanner so I said yolo. I put 2 drops on my face and then mixed about 9 for my whole body. It was perfect! I’ve never had a self tanner fade so naturally as this one. I used to be obsessed with Loving Tan (which is still A+) but that would dry my skin out and not fade as smoothly. This is amazing and my new holy grail! LOVE LOVE LOVE

I don’t know if I’m doing something wrong but no matter how much lotion, time spent blending, and exfoliating I tried, this self tanner always turned out patchy and streaky. Deteriorates very quickly and fades in the most horrible way, with pieces flaking off making it look like I had some sort of skin condition. For reference, I used about 10 drops per 2 body parts with a quarter size amount of lotion. The bottle was finished within a month after using once weekly. Also very orange! I hope other people have found this helpful, this tanner just isn’t for me.

review_title: Ughh so was excited to try this product! FAIL!
review_text: Ughh so was excited to try this product! FAIL! I bought this product during the rouge sale. After purchasing I ran home showered and applied. I thought the concept was neat. Adding drops into your moisturizer. After waking up the next morning I looked like a fresh carved pumpkin, mind you I was already tan to begin with. My hands were blotchy and stained it’s almost like the product didn’t like my hands because I did moisturizer them prior to. I had mixed feelings about the colour it gave on my chest. Unfortunately I did end up returning and purchased the st tropez.

I really wanted these drops to work. I am an avid self tanner, but I won’t ever put any on my face because I always end up breaking out. I got these drops thinking these would be okay but nope. I tried it 3 times and all 3 times I broke out bad. I’m not talking like 1 or 2 pimples, I mean like full on break out with crazy texture that took over a week to calm down. I gave the product 3 stars because if your skin is tougher than mine, the color is perfect and goes on evenly. I use it on my neck and chest to enhance my regular tanner (Loving Tan Ultra Dark Foam).
Best self tanning product I have ever used.  I add a few drops to my daily exfoliating moisturizer, so I stay soft, and glowy.  No smell, no hassle...love it.

review_title: Easy to use and last just the right amount of time
review_text: I never self tanned this is my first experience and it worked amazing. The tan is just right and very way to use. The smell is very light.

review_title: Would only use for face and décolletage
review_text: For your face, these self-tanning drops are the best. They don’t break me out, and they leave you with a lovely looking color that develops in a few hours. I wouldn’t recommend using this as night as I have had an issue with unevenness because it’s rubbed off on my pillow, but my friend doesn’t seem to have a problem with this and uses it at night. I add this to my moisturizer in the morning after washing, toning and acne treatment. I mix 1-2 drops of this with my moisturizer. I typically lightly run a towel over my eyebrows and hairline as I have blonde hair and have noticed it can VERY slightly (probably only noticeable to me) change the color a bit. Since doing this with the towel, I haven’t noticed the staining. I then use foundation directly after and go about my normal make-up routine. One thing I will say that I’d use a lighter hand with make up on the day you apply this, so cut back on the bronzer or blush a bit more as the color will develop throughout the day. I have tried this on my body and don’t love it. I sometimes do it on my décolletage and that hasn’t been okay, but be sure to use a tanning mitt and moisturizer. For your body, I’d definitely recommend the Isle of Paradise foam. For me, these drops just don’t have enough “oomph” for the body but they are incredible for the face. Be sure to start off with a small amount of drops as it’s easier to add color than remove.

These leave a very natural tan to the face. It is extremely easy to use, I just mix it into my moisturizer at night and wake up bronzed! If you do this every few days you’ll stay tan. Mine does tend to fade faster than it would if I were not using a chemical exfoliate.

This is a GREAT self tanner!!  DO NOT FORGET TO SCRUB YOUR HANDS AND IN BETWEEN YOUR FINGERS IMMEDIATELY AFTER APPLYING!! Its easy to forget because you add the drops to your moisturizer, or to your HA or retinol at night. If you continue through your normal regime, it will be too late and your WILL HAVE orange palms that even scrubbing with Comet cleanser won’t take off!!  It doesn’t have too bad of a “self-tanner” scent which is refreshing! I do also recommend that you continue into hairline and down past the décolleté so you do not have streaks, AND USE A DARK PILLOWCASE AFTER APPLYING!

Patch tested on my arm, everything was fine, after application on my face ( mixed with moisturizer as directed) by the end of the day my face broke out in tiny red  bumps, this product is definitely not for everyone.

Honestly, I didn’t buy these and I didn’t put them in moisturizer. In the store, I searched the light and medium directly on my arm to test colors. Yes, I am brave. I am very pale with cool-neutral undertones. The light was red. Very red. It was darker than I had expected but it was such a reddish-orange that it would look awful on me. The medium, once fully developed (the light developed faster), was pretty dark but more of a natural tan color. I think I’ll stick to St. Tropez.  They did fade with lemon juice and some scrubbing but took about two days to fully eliminate.

review_title: Beautiful golden glow for your face!!
review_text: This product is amazing! I have fair skin but can get a nice golden glow when I spend lots of time in the sun. I hate sunning my face so when I discovered this product, I was was so happy I could finally get a tan on my face too, to match! The tanning drops give a beautiful natural bronze glow. I have sensitive skin and I have not broken out once. It lasts between 2-3 days, without exfoliating. Highly recommend!!!
Love this product! So easy to use and looks natural. I’ve recommended to at least 10 people!
Works so well! I’ve used it around 10 times and I’m just now half way through the bottle. Gives a good color without a really harsh smell of self tanner.

I like it but I don’t. The smell of self tanner follows you wherever you go and it isn’t covetable. I like the glow it gives and the color when layered buuuut it’s so hard to know where you put it. I found myself looking a bit patchy and streaky cause you can’t tell after application if everything was covered and where more needs to be applied. I really like the concept for making tans last but as a stand alone tanning product I would reach for my mouse instead.
This stuff works miracles. I love how easy it is to mix in with your everyday moisturizer. I have pretty fair skin and I bought the light and it gives me a great, natural glow. Would buy again!

review_title: mix it well and test first. works well!
review_text: These work well, add a light shade within a few hours of putting them on. There is still that self tanner smell after a while, but it’s definitely not as bad as in other self-tanning products. You need to figure out the right proportion for yourself (how many drops and for what quantity of lotion). Been using it for a while now, and today was the first time I had any reaction. I think there was a portion that didn’t mix well with the lotion and when i put it on, rash showed up instantly! I’ve never seen it appear so quickly, right in front of my eyes. I then put some Vaseline on and the rash started going away. Nothing major but now i know to really be careful when checking how well it mixed with the lotion. Thought I’d share!

I have yet to find a flaw with this product--absolutely 10/10. The color develops fully and quickly but hasn’t made me orange, no streaks, no weird smell. Mixes easily with my face and body moisturizers. Cheap. Lasts a long time. Seriously, a great product worth trying. And ’clean’!

These really work as promised! It took about 8 hours for the tan to develop after application, but boy did it develop.Pretty much never able to spend much time in the sun I decided to try a self tanning solution for the first time in my life. These drops were super easy to use! And the results lasted about two weeks

Love this product for the face. Due to retinols and acid exfoliating I never want my face to be in the sun, and I’m left with my body 3-4 shades darker! I used 2 drops mixed with my moisturizer the first night and 2 drops the next morning as I wanted a deeper tan. I wouldn’t buy this for my body and it would run out super fast. Looks very natural and the DHA smell is pretty much nonexistent and I’m sensitive - never wear perfume or scented products. Gives a nice golden glow! Agree with other reviewers that there seems to be no reason to go with a lighter shade, just use less drops and it would be more economical.

I had no idea this product existed. I was just browsing the New Arrivals section and saw this. I liked that you have to mix it with your moisturizer, and that it’s not something that adds another layer to my face. It looks so natural. It’s so easy to control how much or how little you want with the dropper applicator. I use it on my face and body and never get any weird looking patches or streaks.

Amazing product! I’m so impressed by the color of the isle of paradise tanning products. I’ve used both this and the mousse in medium and the color matches (I was worried they’d be different). I use this just on my face - I mixed 3 drops with PTR water drench moisturizer and got a nice even tan. I have light skin (Lancôme 090, Estée Lauder 1N1) so I didn’t want to go too heavy with the drops, the recommended 1-12 is a huge range. I didn’t notice a smell at all. Definitely wash your hands right after applying.

So my mom had recently bought this product and I decided to use it and see if it was good. I used it to get off my makeup and it was a total game changer. It felt so smooth on my face and melted my makeup right off! I love this product! I will definetely be purchasing myself :)

Honrstly, I really liked this product, I got to try it for free. A little goes a long way with this product, it doesnt sud up or anything so that is something to get use to. It does have a scent to it, its not strong more of a sweet oaty smell. When you use it it does feel oily on your skin, and you feel like your have to rinse your face really good to get that feeling to go away. When your done and dry your face, your face feels really soft. Its not a bad product.

Influenster sent me this product for free to try it, I have a quick review because I had already bought it months ago, so its texture seems perfect to me because it is not liquid at all but like a balm. It seems to me that if it cleans the skin very well but it leaves it very dry, and another thing that didn’t work for my skin is that in my opinion it is a comedogenic  so a week after using it, I started to get acne outbreaks on my skin

review_title: Newest must have in my routine
review_text: After adding this product into my daily skincare, I was a bit worried about the texture of it but this product is the bees knees, gets all makeup off with out leaving a greasy film on your face! My new go-to!

This is my holy grail for makeup remover. It works, it’s inexpensive, and it doesn’t break my face out. It takes everything off, even stubborn mascara. My only thing I don’t like is that it’s very very greasy. It comes off but it’s greasy when it comes out.

review_title: Does the job for a low price!
review_text: I use this as a pre cleanse to remove makeup and it works well even with mascara. It doesn’t burn or leave my skin feeling dry/tight. I have sensitive skin and this didn’t break me out either, I love it!
i tried to make this work, but it didn’t feel like it cleansed my skin at all! it left almost a greasy film and i wasn’t a fan of the grittiness

This product was a no-go for me. The cleanser was very hard for me to dispense, I literally had to squeeze the bottle so hard for just a tiny bit to come out! It felt like an ointment and I hated how it felt on my face. The product didn’t clean off any makeup off my face, if anything it sealed it in on my face lol. I do not recommend.

review_title: Not an expert but this product is BOMB
review_text: I wouldn’t use this product alone because it leaves my face feeling greasy af (expected with an oil cleanser, I assume), but it is the PERFECT first step in a double cleanse! I use the Cerave moisturizing cleanser after, and my face feels squeaky clean. I really started breaking out less after using this combination too! But I’m not an expert, so I don’t really know what I’m talking about lol.

Ive been using this for over a year as my first cleanse. I have no complaints except for one thing - it leaves an oily residue. Doesn’t matter how long you rinse, it’s there. But that doesn’t really matter because it’s gone after my second cleanse. Im rating this a 3 star + 1 star because it’s hella cheap and does what a first cleanse does and doesn’t break you out.
This stuff is so good! I got the mini to try out- it’s amazing for first cleanse! Love the texture! Super good if you wear a lot of makeup and sunscreen like myself!

Okay this stuff is amazing!!! I wear a lot of eye makeup and it’s always hard to take off no matter what I’m using. Seen this on tiktok and I have no regrets! It took my make up off so easily! I was surprised. It did take a little bit more product but that’s fine. I have combination skin and tend to break out easily but this was soooo hydrating and it definitely calmed my skin down. No breakout in sight since using this. I thought it would leave my skin oily or dry since it has a thick consistency but after wiping my face off it felt so soft. It’s a game changer!!!! My skin has never looked this great. I love that it’s two in one. It takes my make up off and cleanses my skin. Usually that takes about 10-15 minutes but now it’s less than 4 minutes. I know everyone’s skin is different but this has definitely improved the texture on my skin and it’s helped with any acne I had. LOVE IT. It’s now my HOLY GRAIL!!!!

It’s consistency was more like an oil than a balm once you rub it between your palms. I didn’t notice a smell. Don’t get it in your mouth it taste terrible. I had to go back for a second wash around the eyes to get all my Lancôme mascara off but it did the job and didn’t leave my skin feeling tight or dry. For the price range I would give it a try!
Hated this! Felt impossible to wash off even when double cleansing. If you’re looking for a similar budget make-up removing product, try the Elf Melting Balm.

At first it was great, but then the formula became compromised within a week despite being stored in a cool, dark place which was very disappointing. I’m not sure if I would repurchase if it’s only going to be enjoyable for a week and then go bad, but maybe I just got a defective one.

This is such a bummer of a product because the price and formulation seem amazing. It doesn’t loosen makeup and SPF as effectively as a cleansing balm should. But then, it also needs basically its own cleanse to come off. To make this work, you need to really rub and then follow with two “second” cleanses. So, in the end, you are really not saving money. I gave it two stars because it is soothing when you first apply.

review_title: Great for breaking down heavy makeup, gentle
review_text: This is a great product! I have really oily skin and while I don’t use it daily, I love it for heavy makeup days, or days when my skin is feeling extra sensitive or dry. It’s also awesome for getting rid of stubborn lash glue!It breaks makeup down so well, and really gently. I follow it with the ordinary’s salicylic cleanser, or another soap-based cleanser, because I don’t want any oily residue left on my skin. I’ll definitely buy it again!

review_title: One of my fave makeup removers
review_text: I love using this to take off make-up within my double cleanse routine that I have when it comes to make-up. I find that it help to break down the makeup and makes it easier to take it off.

I do enjoy the Inkey list so i was expecting this product to be really great, was severely disappointed. Getting the product out of the bottle is a struggle, the formula is thick like fat and does not spread well. I found it left my skin feeling even more dirty then when i started, even when i doubled cleanse.

I used this cleansing balm for over a year and it worked well at removing my makeup, including waterproof mascara and eyeliner. It rinses fairly well but I do feel like I needed to be extra thorough in my second cleanse to remove all of it.  I love how affordable this is and it was great for my sensitive skin. I recently switched to a different brand and I probably won’t come back to the oat cleaning balm for a few reasons. The packaging is not good and the formula seems to separate or melt in the bottle sometimes. I think a tub would be better because it’s so thick. It can be either be really difficult to squeeze out or it will be melted. Because it can be so thick (most of the time), it can feel like quite heavy on the face. Overall it’s a great place to start if you need an affordable cleansing balm. It’s gentle and effective but just not the best one out there for me. It might be for you! :)
This cleansing balm is nothing like what I expected. It’s texture is like a filmy oil that leaves a thick film on the skin.
Life changing for someone who suffers from acnea rosacea. I use this as one step in my double cleanse. Applies great as a hydrating mask.

I wanted to like this product so much, but it just didn’t do me any favours. It doesn’t lather up at all and felt like it left a thick film on my face after. I have combination/sensitive skin and it made me breakout.

I know you’re suppose to give skin products at least a month but I used it 2 days and both days I kept on getting pimples not purging, pimples. I tried it alone one night and as a 1st cleanse the next night because I thought I had used product wrong and both times I broke out. I know it was this product because it’s the only new thing I added to my skin routine. It helped with dry patches made my skin soft. But I wasn’t willing to try it longer because My skin is just recovering fromBad acne and I didn’t want to take a chance. I have sensitive combo acne prone skin.
This broke me out so bad and has a really weird texture
This broke me out so bad and has a really weird texture
gets face clean without stripping worth the price and has a lot of product

review_title: gentle & affordable but doesn't feel great
review_text: i like that it’s gentle and very affordable but honestly it feels awful :/ with other balms you can feel the makeup / residue of the day melting off but with this product it feels like it just mixes with what’s on your face and then stays on your skin no matter how hard you scrub. Definitely only tolerable if you double cleanse because that second product will actually make your skin feel clean, I can’t imagine just using this to cleanse. Cheap is great but sometimes it’s worth it to spend more. I’m using this until my glow recipe papaya sorbet balm arrives

I bought this specifically to wash off my makeup but when you put it on it feels very wax like and doesn’t feel like it’s washing off your face. I will use another cleaner right after and I’ll still see makeup coming off my face. I will not be repurchasing.

Yikes. This felt like straight tar I was slathering on my face. Doesn’t spread/emulsify. It did actually did a really good job taking makeup off as I had no residue on my face towel but I didnt have that clean feeling after since this is so heavy. I only bought this to travel with and definitely not a product I’d buy again.

this isn’t a make up balm, is probably one of the worse ones I’ve used.  It removed little make up, the eye make up stayed there after and leaves your face VERY greasy afterwards.  I would not recommend unless you like a layer of grease on your skin after cleansing.
Solid product. Great first step in a double cleanse. Can’t beat the price.

It does the job as a makeup remover/ first cleanse. The consistency is quite thick so a double cleanse is very necessary to get rid of the greasy film. I took off a star because I don’t like the smell and I wish it came off more easily.

It does the job as a makeup remover/ first cleanse. The consistency is quite thick so a double cleanse is very necessary to get rid of the greasy film. I took off a star because I don’t like the smell and I wish it came off more easily.

review_title: If you buy this, double cleanse
review_text: you NEED to wash it off with a different cleanser!!! this is more of a make up remover greasy balm.

Is very gentle and soothing to the skin, turns from a vaseline texture to a milky oil when washing. Theres a nice consistency to it, its fairly good at removing makeup. Would recommend as a first cleanse or a mask.
Amazing to take makeup off without irritating the skin. I always follow up with a foaming cleanser. Perfect combination for clean skin.
Amazing to take makeup off. I always follow up with a foaming cleanser. Great combination to clean skin.
Super gentle in my skin, and removes my waterproof mascara with no problems!! Only con is that it’s sometimes hard to find in stock.

review_title: Lovely experience once you get the hang of it
review_text: This was the first oil-based/balm cleanser and I decided to incorporate it as a first cleanse before my water-based cleanser for two reasons: 1) the sunscreen I switched to is a little trickier to get off with just the single cleanser, and 2) I do get some dryness and redness on my cheeks (borderline rosacea I think) and thought this might help. The first time I used it, I followed the directions and used it on a damp face, however, I found I didn’t love cleansing my face with it because it emulsifies and becomes milky when mixed with water (typical of oil cleansers). So I started just using it on dry skin and it works much better. It will be an oily experience, because of the nature of the product, but I found it very soothing and a lovely process to just massage it in for a minute or two before rinsing it off.It might be because of how I start on dry skin, but I do find it leaves a bit of an film even after emulsifying with water and rinsing it off. However, since this is the first of two cleanses, I don’t really mind because my second cleanser (CeraVe Hydrating Cream-to-Foaming) takes any residue right off. I love that it calms my redness, its a nice experience, and the price is great. I was a little worried about the oat kernel pieces some people have mentioned in other reviews, since I almost exclusively chemically exfoliate and didn’t want to be over exfoliating, but I really don’t think the pieces are big enough to cause issue - in fact I enjoy the very, very slight gritty texture.I will say, I keep all of my skincare in the bathroom cabinet, and find sometimes after a particularly hot shower, the product can come out a little melted, with the more solid oil liquified, but this isn’t a big deal for me, just rub it between your hands to get the rest of the product to a similar consistency, the separation doesn’t really cause me concern.I think it has helped my dry skin and redness tremendously and will be repurchasing!

review_title: Smells rancid, but there are things I like

The texture is smooth on the face and emulsifies quickly with some water, but fully rinsing this product off with water is impossible. I would not recommend this for a single cleanse routine because even a washcloth won’t completely remove the oily residue. It works great in a double cleanse routine though! Waterproof mascara and eyeliner removes very easily.The amount required to clean the face is about the same as other cleansing balms, so in terms of dollar per mL this is worth a try if you want a hydrating cleanser with simple ingredients. But for the price, you would be making some sacrifices in terms of product experience. Personally I will continue looking for the best no-fuss cleanser.

review_title: Removes makeup   cleans skin, all I need!!

I was really happy to see that because there’s nothing worse than when your skin feels stripped. I’m so glad to have this cleanser and highly recommend. It’s also a larger size so it’s a great amount of product. Paired with my other Drunk Elephant products, this is a HIT! You won’t regret it.

As alot of reviewers mentioned this product definitely deep cleans and takes off all your make up with ease.  It does dry your face out a little however that is when you use other nighttime hydrating skin improving products right after as it allows them to soak in nicely to allow full benefit of its purpose which I love.

Overall this cleanser is nice. It removed my makeup pretty well without being too harsh. However I have VERY dry skin, especially in the colder months, so it did dry my skin out a bit and make it feel tight. I think I could use this in the Summer months and love it, but for a daily cleanser in the Winter with my skin type it just won’t work as well as a hydrating cleanser does for me. I think if you have normal to oily skin this would be great for you. Even if you have mildly dry skin this would probably be fine for you.

Ok so I wasn’t planning on liking this cleanser but I have to say I really do. It definitely deep cleans but doesn’t dry out my skin, which is huge. I have very combo skin and so when it gets too dry it is very uncomfortable. The only thing that i feel I still have to do is double cleanse when I have a full face of makeup.

This is very gentle and gets my face pretty clean. I find I don’t have to scrub hard at all to get any dirt/makeup off and that’s a huge plus. Also the packaging is great and fun.

Well worth trying this out.

review_title: BESTe face wash I’ve ever used
review_text: Initially tried this thanks to the birthday gift set (genius idea Sephora, get everyone addicted to a pricey - but unbeatable cleanser). I definitely experienced a noticeable difference immediately after each wash, never had a cleanser that leaves my skin feeling completely clean but silky and not tight and dry at the same time. Always struggled with bad acne and acne scars since I was about 12 (25 now) and was not expecting to be beyond impressed by an unremarkably plain, bland face wash. I’ve purchased 2 more since and now that I’ve been using this product a consistent basis as my morning and night cleanser (when I had the birthday set I alternated bet this and my usual Body Shop tea tree set), I really notice an incredible difference in my skin and truly believe this product is infinitely better and therefore well worth the price, for my situation (if you have troubled skin and have struggled to find products that actually WORK)

review_title: IF YOU'RE SICK AND YOUR NOSE HURTS - USE THIS!
review_text: i am writing this simply based on the birthday sample. i had recently used a lot of products with actives in them and then got sick, so i needed something gentle and decided to whip this out. this cleanser is nice, but the SOLE REASON i’m even writing a review is to say that when i’m sick my nose gets SO DRY and irritated that ALL cleansers make it burn when i wash my face. i even bought the cerave cream cleanser for dry skin that has no scent and even it burned!  beste doesn’t sting, burn, or ANYTHING and my nose feels exactly the way i left it (that is to say, this cleanser does not dry it out further even if it doesn’t add moisture). my skin has been pretty balanced lately aside from my cold, so i think that makes it hard to speak on this product for someone who has consistently problematic skin. but i just had to share that i expected this to be irritating, and i didn’t feel a thing! i want to keep a mini on hand just for when i’m sick! i’m only docking a star because it’s expensive for a “plain“ cleanser (as opposed to ones with actives/additives) and isn’t sold in a mini so i don’t know if i’ll ever repurchase it.

review_title: My Skin Has Never Been So Smooth
review_text: When I got this product, it was originally a free sample birthday gift from Sephora. I’ve been using it for about 2 weeks, and despite only having used it for a short time, my skin has been extremely soft lately, which is kind of rare for me, considering I’ve always had rough and patchy skin. Although this product hasn’t cleared up my acne much, I have found that I’ve become less prone to blackheads. They haven’t disappeared completely, but no new ones have showed up (even when I use products that are specifically anti-blackhead, they rarely ever disappear, so this doesn’t come as a surprise to me). It’s also helped heal some of my acne scabs from when I used to have a bad habit of popping pimples and picking my skin. I have somewhat sensitive skin, and it has a tendency to get irritated easily, but that most definitely doesn’t happen with this product. It makes me feel refreshed when I apply it, and the cool sensation of the actual jelly is pretty nice. Also, it doesn’t interfere with any of the other skin products I use (I mostly use exfoliants and they often react poorly with jellies and moisturizers for some reason) apart from my toner, but that’s perfectly fine and easy to fix by just finding a different brand that does work (it’s only one product to replace, after all). Overall, I haven’t run into any problems with this jelly and it makes my skin feel wonderful. It’s an amazing product.

I’m happy with the overall effects this has on my skin, my face doesn’t feel dry after using, and it doesn’t give me any breakouts. However I feel like I need to precast before using the product to fully remove any makeup or sweat(after workouts) to have this product fully work. Hence the 4 instead of 5 stars.

Great product, just that when I used it 3 days in a row it dried out my skin, maybe its just too harsh on my skin, but if you wear a lot make up or have oily skin will work really good on you. Now I use only at nights, leaves skin feeling really clean and really soft tho.

I decided it might be this cleanser so I stopped and literally within like 2-3 days my skin was completely back to normal. Long story short, If you have acne prone skin—I DO NOT recommend!

I have very dry, sensitive skin, but, dryness is a bigger concern for me than sensitivity. I found the bars way too drying, so I switched to the cleanser. I also like the ease of having a jelly cleanser to travel with or take to the gym. However, those things are secondary to me, as long as the product works. I’ve been using the jelly cleanser for several months now, and find it pretty drying, especially on my cheek area. The back of the cleanser says to only cleanse your skin once a day with it and not twice. They recommend washing your face with water in the morning and then using the cleanser at night. This makes it tricky for me because I go to the gym every morning, so I want to wash the sweat off, but I also wear sunscreen everyday and want to wash that off at night. I tried washing my face twice a day with the cleanser once and my skin almost fell off. I have yet to find a routine with this cleanser, where my skin feels clean, but doesn’t feel overly dry. I still get peeling and rough patches on my cheeks, mouth area and neck (which improved a little with the night serum). I use the entire DE line and nothing else, and have noticed a huge improvement in my skin. I recommend DE to all my friends or people who compliment my skin. I truly do love their products and I’m a firm believer that their products really work. With that being said, I do have my “favorite” and “not so favorite“ products in the line. This cleanser is a not so favorite of mine and I do wish they would improve it. The thing with the other not so favorites in the line, is that when combined with other DE products, they truly do work. I will continue to repurchase all DE products, including my not so favorites because all of the products strengthen each other when used together— all of them besides the jelly cleanser. I will continue to use the jelly cleanser only because I have found nothing else that works quite as well. But, I will continue to search for a better cleanser in the meantime.

review_title: Did not work for me - continually broke me out
review_text: I hate to give a one star review, but I’d also hate for someone like me to waste money like I did.My skin: large pores, uneven skintone (lots of redness due to being incredibly fair skinned), “normal“ skin type, the beginnings of smile lines around my mouth (I’m 29.)This was my first BIG skincare purchase in terms of price and I couldn’t have been more disappointed. My initial issue with the product was that no matter HOW little I used, no matter whether I used toner before or after, it never, ever, ever sunk into my skin. So applying my moisturizer over top felt like smearing cream over gel always. My second and biggest issue was the breakouts. The product DOES say that if you are prone to acne, you might break out for the first few days, but then your skin will get used to it. What didn’t occur to me was that this process will happen *every* time you miss an application. So let’s say I use the product every night for 2 weeks straight, but have a night where I’m doing good to merely wash my face, much less do all 6 steps. Guess what! The breaking out process starts all over again. It’s like starting back at 0. It happened every. single. time. After 4 months of owning the product, I finally gave it to my mom. She’s 70 and has the wrinkles of a 70 year old, and this product has made her skin look *slightly* tighter. So I guess that’s a plus! But for the price point, I couldn’t believe that all the “results“ I saw from continued use were negative. :(
I really don’t understand what the point of this product is. It didn’t do anything for me.

I had oily and acne-prone skin since puberty and my face always had SOME acne, which easily worsened with stress, bad diet, etc. (It wasn’t severe scarring cystic acne, but I was permanently breaking out somewhere.) I used to rely on salicylic acid or tea tree oil toners and gels, which reduces breakouts, helps with recovery but can’t really clear my skin. Moisturizers with active ingredients like benzoyl peroxide are too harsh. These products dry out my skin, which over-produces oil. I started the Pitera Essence (a 30ml bottle from a Sephora Faves set) not expecting much. I slapped it on one night when I had dozens of tiny red bumps on my forehead -- the kind that typically develops into whiteheads by the morning -- and woke up to find them much reduced! Then I started using this product regularly and saw the baseline condition of my skin change from “always some acne“ to “maybe one or two“. My “really good skin days“ turned into regular days.  Even my mom noticed that my face looked better when I went home for Christmas that year. Half-a-year later I swapped out the alcohol-based salicylic acid acne toner in my routine for the Pitera toner (which also contains salicylic acid, but not so heavy on alcohol) and the acne stayed under control. Now, the default condition of my skin is CLEAR, with the occasional tiny whiteheads that heal super quickly with a bit of topical gel.I apply the essence with Shiseido’s cotton pads (known for not absorbing too much product) and 150 ml lasts me a bit over a year. Meanwhile, I save time and effort applying makeup on a better base, uses waaaay less topical acne gel/treatments, and saved the money I usually spent on trying new acne products. My skin also felt better now that I use less targeted acne- and oil-control products, which tend to be drying. The smell of the pitera essence is not great, but it doesn’t linger. The unit price is expensive but it’s worth it for me for how much it improved my skin.

Only reason I wouldn’t repurchase is because of the price point.

I love this product. My face feels youthful and glowing. It seemed to have tightened my face up. The serum was easy to use. The smell was not that great but doable. I received this product for free in return for my honest opinion.
Loved the way my skin felt and looked after using this product. It has a good texture and feels good when applying.
I honestly really liked this product i liked how it hydrated the skin

Thanks to Influenster for this complimentary opportunity to try it out. If only it was more affordable...

Made my skin so soft and firm, I really would recommend it
