review_title: Nice serum for my hyper-pigmented & sensitive skin
review_text: I received a free sample of this product, however that does not change my view on the product. I really enjoyed the sample I received. My face s suppler and smooth. I did not have any allergic reactions on my sensitive skin which was awesome. I do have lines on my forehead but those did not go away, however, my sample was extremely small so I didn’t use it long enough to see those type of results. My skin looked softer and smoother

Estée Lauder is a classic, and I know why my moms and aunts love it now that I’m almost 40. It does the job, no frills, no fancy packaging. Estée Lauder knows how to help us combat aging. I love the way it absorbs in my skin, a little goes a long way. I like that I didn’t break out as well.
Made my skin so soft and firm, I really would recommend it

I got a complimentary sample from Influenster. I was super excited to try this out because I have never tried anything from this brand. I was honestly super disappointed. Apart from hyaluronic acid, I did not see any other ingredients that would considerably improve my skin. Also, the consistency was kind of sticky and too oily, which made me breakout. I will not buy this again. It did not work on my face but I have been using it on my cuticles and it is really nice
Great product! nice texture and good results. However, the price tag imo is heafty for the product.**i got this for free in exchange for an honest review**

The texture is nice and it is not sticky or greasy which are positives but there wasn’t much of a noticeable difference after usage. I like to see more of a brightening effect in my serums.

It smelled nice and had a good texture and it really helped moisturize the parts of my face that weren’t already oily... those got a little too much moisture and began to break out, its definitely not the product but my skin in this case.

Pricey for the amount that you get and it is slightly more watery than some budget friendly options. It does hydrate well and improve luminosity of the skin. Great to ha e on hand for winter months and as part of a night-time skin routine

Received this item from Influenster. It was okay but feel like there are other serums that works just as well if not better for a better price.

received free sample! I liked this product! It made my skin feel very soft instantly after use!

I received this product compliments of Influenster in exchange for my honest review. It has a light citrusy scent that dissipates relatively quickly. The serum applies easily and a little goes a long way. For me, my skin remained tacky for a couple seconds as the product soaked in. Afterwards, my skin felt supple and moisturized. Usually I need to apply a thick night cream before bed but this surprisingly provided more than enough moisture for me. My skin looks healthy and a bit dewy, but most importantly it looks healthy! The biggest downside to this product is the price. Would reccomend if price is no issue.
I really loved this night serum! The formula is fantastic, and my skin felt better. I would recommend this product. I received it for free in exchange for my honest review from. Influencer.

I’ve used this product for about a week and noticed that my skin feels hydrated and plump in the morning. The texture of my skin is definitely smoother after using it. The texture is really nice, it’s not tacky for me.

I received this courtesy of Influenster and I really loved it! It has a nice citrusy smell to it. I put it on before my moisturizer at night and I’ve really noticed a difference!

This product made my skin look so wonderful. I received a sample of it via Influenster and I am so happy that I did. My skin looks and feels so wonderful. It has made such a massive difference in the appearance of my skin.

I received this product for free from Influenster for testing and reviewing purposes only. I havent noticed any difference since I started to use it. A little seems to go a long way. There wasn’t anything special and my skin seems softer.

I received this complimentary in a vox box. i’m  big serum user so I was excited to receive it. I like the consistency, it’s pretty viscous and feels smooth going on. not a huge fan of the smell but I do think my skin looks and feels softer after using it. definitely on the expensive side but worth trying if you can swing it!
I love this i got it frree from Influensterrr for testing purposes i tried it out for like a week and i loved it
I got this complimentary to try out. I have to say it left my skin feeling rather smooth. I have fine line and wrinkles and I felt like it helped blur them a tad.

I received this product complimentary of Influenster. personally, for my skin type (dry, combo) I didn’t see many results after my week long sample. after applying it to my skin initially it left it dewy and moisturized, after drying I could feel it on my skin and it didn’t leave lasting results, for the price of the product I would not personally add this to my skincare routine.
I really like this serum. I use it before bed and my skin feels so nice afterwards.  Definitely worth every penny

I am in my early 30’s and have always been very interested in skincare and bettering my skin from an early age. I loved this product! It made my skin feel so hydrated, soft and young. It has an interesting smell, not bad but not amazing either. It smells like herbal skincare to me. Scent aside it has changed my skin for the better. I didn’t want to think it would. I didn’t want to believe it would make a difference. But it really did. Is it worth the price I can’t honestly say since I got it for free but I can honestly say in the days I have used it I have seen firsthand results that have me hooked.

I tried this for one week. It definitely helped keep my skin firm and there were less fine lines, but I did notice a blemish or two pop up. It could have just been because it was a new product and my skin decided to be sensitive. Regardless, I’d probably have to use it longer than 7 days to see true results, but it was a decent product during the time I tried it out.

I received a week sample to try and overall I like the product. Makes my skin feel firm and moisturized. Doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin, cause excess breakouts, or increase redness. Scent is fresh but not overpowering or perfumey. My only complaint is no dropper but I believe the larger bottles do come with one! If it was a little cheaper i would probably buy to include in my routine but I’m admittedly a bargain hunter.

I received a week’s worth of this serum to sample.  It has a very faint natural smell which might be off putting to some.  It made my skin smoother and felt nice when I applied it.  I’m not sure it’s worth the cost as I haven’t noticed any significant change in the overall look of my skin but I may just need to continue using it constantly to see real results.  I like that it’s free of parable a and sulfates.

So I received this item compliments of Influenster. Over the last 8 days I have used the Advanced Night Repair recovery serum. It seems to make my fave glow more and seems to retain moisture very well. It feels fairly light on your face as well. You can use during the daytime as well. However, I only used at night after my face was washed. I will say though that I found it to be a bit tacky for the first several minutes. It did have a slight smell to it that I was not fond of as well.  Overall, I would recommend to friends.

I received a complimentary trial sized bottle from Influenster in exchange for a review. Although this product left my skin feeling hydrated and not tacky, as I was expecting, I really didn’t notice a change. I think it would be worth trying it out for a longer time though. It’s pretty pricey, but sometimes it’s worth it just for the self care aspect of things, ya know?

I recieved a 7 day sample to review, which while I don’t think that’s enough time to see results I think it’s a nice serum. It’s not sticky or too thick and it sinks into the skin really nicely. I don’t think it’s perfumed but it definitely has sort of an herbaceous scent. It’s not offensive and it doesn’t linger, but if you’re sensitive to scents just be aware of it. I also have pretty sensitive skin, but it hasn’t made me break out at all! I do feel like my skin is lovely and hydrated when I wake up the few times I’ve used it so overall I would recommend it, but I can’t vouch for lasting or dramatic results.

I am in love!!!! I tried this product for a week and even though it claims you can start seeing results after 3 weeks, I can definitely see and improvement on my face! It feels extra hydrated and soft. I will definitely be purchasing a full size bottle. Can’t wait for 3 weeks results!

I received this product complimentary from Influenster. I used the ANR serum for the first time a couple of years ago and loved the luxurious feel, it’s unlike anything I have ever used. It’s even better now, with the Chronolux™ Power Signal Technology, which helps increase the skin’s natural ability for visible self-repair, with in vitro testing showing it promotes skin’s natural renewal of vital new cells and boosts its natural production of collagen.I definitely noticed an improvement in my skin after three weeks of use. I have been battling with uneven skin tone around my upper cheekbones area and it is finally evening out:) I also noticed my skin looks more radiant, like a nice glow from within look. I will definitely love to purchase the serum but it’s too expensive so I will have to save up before I make a purchase (Ladies, we’ve to glow up responsibly). Overall, it does what it claims so I give it a strong 4 (it would be a 5 if the bottle was bigger and affordably priced).

This serum is an all time best. Anything that is wrong with your face this will fix like a miracle. I definitely recommend. This item was sent to me for free for testing purposes.

I’ve been using this every night for the past week and I really like the way it makes my skin feel. I’m already starting to see a small difference in my skin.  I will definitely purchase when this sample runs out.

Truly the best selling serum in the world! Easy to apply, absorbs fast, and no stickiness left on my oily skin. This serum brightens, smoothens, strengthens, and plumps skin. I use this along with my tretinoin and there is no irritation. I’m sure it’s because of the Bifida Ferment Lysate (an ingredient proven to improve skin sensitivity and help maintain healthy skin barrier) which this serum has a lot of. I really feel that this aids in the repair process of skin when I sleep. I have tried so many serums and I’m a firm believer that not all skincare products are equal. Some are just really, really good compared to others with the same ingredients. It’s not the ingredients that make the product, it’s the formulation. Many brands have tried to dupe the ANR and people may say that a few came close but for me, this remains better than the rest. The ANR has excellent formulation and Estee Lauder still keeps on bettering it. I was gifted a free 7ml sample of the new (2020) ANR and have been using it for more than a week. The new one has glycerin and some changes in preservatives. Both the old and new formulas feel and smell the same to me. Both seem to work the same as well. Well, the new one is maybe a bit more hydrating. I like it, so I bought two full-sized bottles for me and my sister. This serum is worth it!

I didn’t have high expectations for this serum. I e tried it before and it irritated my skin. This formula is better. First, the scent- it is a bit herbal but I also smell something like alcohol. It isn’t totally unpleasant or offensive. The serum is a good consistency and I find a small amount covers the face and neck easily. I layer it with my usual moisturizer. Ive used it for about a week and I can’t say that I notice much of a difference. I haven’t added or taken any other products away from my regimen. I’m not expecting miracles but Ive used other products that have shown some results in a small period of time.

I loved this product! I did a 7 day review of product sample from Influenster and I’m hooked. I’ve tried other serums and they may feel sticky or smelly, this was great. I felt like I had a better glow the following day and feels so smooth. I have a photo of the progress, maybe you can’t see w huge difference but I do and I feel a difference. The price point is a bit high for me but my birthday is coming up so maybe I’ll get lucky and get a bottle from someone !

I’ve been having an allergic reaction to something (I don’t know if it was a skincare product, laundry soap, environmental thing) but after adding this serum to my routine, my skin seemed to calm down. Love love love!! This primer keeps my makeup on all day and keeps my skin feeling super hydrated. It has definitely changed my makeup application. I feel like my skin looks smoother and airbrushed after i use this primer.

The vitamin-enriched face base from Bobbi Brown is a light, bouncy moisturizing cream that creates a smooth foundation for makeup. It has a rich texture but absorbs quickly, leaving behind a slight pore-blurring effect. It has the characteristic citrusy Bobbi Brown scent and works just as well alone as under makeup!

I just love this product! I love how it moisturises and maintains moisture throughout the day, even with heavy application make up looks! I have very dry sensitive skin especially on the winter and when I put on my makeup it shows dry patches but this product has improved my skin and makeup a lot. It definitely says what it does, gives a flawless look and the make up seems to stay on all day. I recommend this product!

Rarely will I ever try a product and immediately be like, “YUP this will now forever be in my routine“ but WOW this product I knew right away! It is buttery soft and feels so silky on my skin. Truly just blends right in. I have extremely dry skin, especially in the winter, and this has helped so much. 10/10!!

When it comes to cosmetic brands selling skincare, I get skeptical. However, Bobbi Brown is one of those exceptions as I love their development and research that go into their skincare launches. One major feat about this cream is that it’s a perfect match to wear underneath makeup like foundation. So if you’re a heavy makeup user, you might really like this. It’s a simple and straightforward moisturizer that creates a perfect canvas!

Bobbi Brown Vitamin Enriched Base Face Priming Moisturizer : I have been using this primer, it’s really fabulous, it’s great as a moisturizer and makes skin look younger and smoother. It has an exquisite soft and fresh fragrance, I apply it before makeup, it fades quickly, the skin looks healthier and more luminous. It is the best primer I have used and I definitely recommend it! You will love it.

Loved this face base a lot to use with my foundation. It makes it look so good and so natural, blends really well. Easy to apply, and it makes such a difference in overall look, that I cannot even imagine using the foundation without the base.

I received this face cream and instantly look the packaging, it is sleek modern and has a-lot packed into a tiny bottle. The product states you can use it as a face cream or a primer. honestly it is better used as a primer . I used it as a cream and it left my face dry all day. IT has a slight fragrance to it so it might not be good to use for sensitive skin.

This was awesome to use under my makeup as a good base! It was very moisturizing and my makeup went on effortlessly! Would definitely recommend this to anyone who has not got to try this out yet! 10/10

Living in the Midwest, this priming moisturizer has saved my sensitive skin. But it did take me a while to get used to the smell, smells like citrus to me but everyone that comes near me seems to like it. Does not leave my skin oily.

I’ve heard about this product for years and just wasn’t every that interested in buying/trying it but I happened to get a sample of it recently and NOW I understand why everyone’s been raving about it for years.  This is definitely a thick moisturizing base and right now--in the winter months--this feels amazing and definitely makes my makeup wear nicely.  I love the hydration that it gives and it really feels incredibly nourishing.  For those that dislike fragrance, this DOES have a subtle fragrance and I don’t think that those with oily skin are going to appreciate the ultra-creamy formula but I’m currently really enjoying it and I’ll probably end up repurchasing it.

From the first seconds I loved it’s fresh scent, it’s not strong - just right so start your make up routine. It’s honestly a hight quality base because it’s more of a moisturizer and antioxidant and your skin actually loves it. Also, I think it’s pretty gentle even for my sensitive skin during the winter months. Try it!

I have been wanting to try the famous face base for a while after hearing so many good things about it. Especially that it works well with oily skin. And I can confirm after using it; everything you hear is true! The consistency of this moisturizer primer is super silky and feels amazing on the skin as you apply it. It absorbs very quickly into the skin, which I thought especially impressive due to how thick it is. It does have a scent to it, but upon application that goes away. I prefer this for a “pre-base” moisturizer over a primer, as I do like my primers mattifying in certain areas of my face. But my makeup performed with no issues where I hadn’t used the mattifier, and sat really beautifully on top.

review_title: A little bit goes a long way!
review_text: This is a must have if you can never seem to get your makeup to look right no matter what you do. This transforms my dull and lifeless skin to beautiful glowing skin! It’s the perfect base for makeup if you want everything you put on to have the smoothest application possible and healthy glow that stays all day. I tried this primer with many different products and every single look was flawless and was very hydrated. I definitely recommend if you have dry skin and texture!

This product arrived to me right in time for winter when my skin is the driest. It helped me prepare and moisturize my face before applying both dry and liquid foundation. The best part - it is good for all skin types which makes it universal. Overall I’m very happy with this product and will keep using and recommending it.

This moisturizer/face base is an absolute life-saver during these cold, crisp days. It is thick but non comedogenic. Feels very hydrating but not greasy at all,  perfect for my combination skin. An amazing skin prep before makeup! I especially love how foundation layers on it, makes the skin look very smooth. Can also use it alone as a day or night time moisturizer. Smells decadent and the packaging is very luxurious.

This Bobbi Brown vitamin enriched face base is amazing! A little bit goes a long way. This a thick moisturizer but when applied on the skin it feels so lightweight. This is very hydrating and my face feels so smooth! I love how this face base makes my skin and makeup look. I highly recommend this product!

Gifted by Bobbi Brown for free! I absolutely love this primer/moisturizer and have been enjoying using it right before I put my foundation on! it seems to keep my face moisturized and my makeup stays put throughout the day! I couldn’t ask for more!

The Bobby Brown Vitamin Enriched Moisturizer is thick and absorbes easily. My skin was hydrated after using and worked great as a primer for my makeup.  Would definitely recommend, also the size was larger than anticipated!

Such a luxurious product to use ! First off the smell is beautiful, not to obnoxious but the perfect scent that makes you want to keep using it ! Packaging is super high quality & love the way it feels on my skin. I use daily morning and night !

It is a great multi-use product! It is so perfect for my dry skin! It really does moisturize my skin and it makes my makeup last longer and so smooth to apply! It also gives me a nice glow every time I’m using it, i don’t need to use my moisturizer anymore! It doesn’t feel heavy and it makes my skin look so plump! I also love that it gives vitamins for my skin! I definitely recommend this

This is a beautiful, thick, and luxurious primer and moisturizer. It preps the face perfectly for makeup or can be used alone as a hydrating moisturizer. It has a really nice citrusy scent to it which hasn’t ever irritated my sensitive skin. A little bit of this goes a long way as well and just feels so good on the skin. I especially love this during the winter time but can use it all year long because I have dry skin!

I’ve been looking for the perfect base and love this base from Bobbi Brown. It feels very hydating without taking and looks natural on my skin. I highly recommend this product for others looking for a good base!

This product was pretty good. It was very moisturizing and made my skin feel so soft and look smooth. The only thing I didn’t love was the scent. It’s not a bad scent, but I could still smell it even after applying my makeup and I’m not a fan of fragrance in my face products due to my sensitive skin and allergies. Regardless, my makeup applied very nicely over this base and looked great too.

This product was sent to me for review purposes only. I really like the packaging of this product! It also does a good job of keeping my skin hydrated under my makeup. It creates a really nice primer.

I received this complimentary product from BOBBI BROWN in exchanging for my feedback.I really loved this beautiful vitamin enriched face base primer or moisturizer that helps skin from dehydration, nourished and instantly firming the skin in preparation for makeup.The cream has a beautiful scent that’s quite refreshing, pleasant. The texture is silky smooth, soft and easy to smooth on the skin. It feels very lightweight and sinks into the skin nicely, gently without pilling or clogging pores. The product contains a handful of amazing ingredients: Vitamin C and E, Geranium Extract, Sodium Hyaluronate, Yeast Extract and Shea Butter. These are keys ingredients that helps provide oxygen, moisture, antioxidant protection for the skin. They’re making the skin look smoother and firmer in texture. This cream doesn’t make my skin look greasy or oily but a nice soft, smooth and supple skin. This has such a great benefits as a first step in preparation for makeup. The end result is very rewarding: a natural looking skin that looks soft, smooth and glowing beautifully.

I really love this moisturizer - texture is really nice, not sticky at all, absorbs pretty quickly into the skin and it is such a good base for your make up - my foundation glides on and melts so nicely without leaving any patchiness. Definitely recommend!

So I feel like there’s a little bit of a misconception with this product, it’s actually a primer + moisturizer hybrid with Shea butter base, not just a primer! This stuff has this awesome cushiony finish’s new it comes in a recyclable packaging, this guy’s a little expensive though so I would recommend weighting out your pros and cons!

This is THE perfect makeup base!! Wow. I have oily skin and I love matte foundations so prepping my skin for a drying foundation is important. This gives a glowing radiance look to the skin which peeks through my foundation. It also keeps my makeup in place all day.

This is the perfect light primer/moisturizer, it’s not thick or greasy and it absorbs quickly. It keeps my skin hydrated all day long and doesn’t break me out! I like that it has vitamins in the formula, it works very well for my combination skin

review_title: It does lightly matte down as the scent fades.
review_text: The product has a light lemon scent and it is highly hydrating as well as medium thickness making it easy to mix in while still having vitamins to nourish. It does lightly matte down as the scent fades.

bobbi brown is one of the best makeup brands so i was looking forward to trying this. it did not disappoint!! it’s especially perfect for days when you’re in a rush because it’s a primer and moisturizer in one. it makes for a great base and it doesn’t leave my skin feeling or looking oily.

This is a really nice base and primer for makeup. I have an oily t-zone and am usually skeptical about cream primers because the can make me oilier but I did not get that with this.  Would recommend as a splurge

Love this product. Works amazing as is or under makeup as a base. Makes makeup application so easy and smooth. I also noticed it makes my makeup last longer without getting oily. Highly recommend giving this one a try.

Love that this is both a primer and moisturizer because sometimes my face can just feel so cakey/heavy with so many products on. My skin feels moisturized and prepped and my makeup goes on so smoothly! I would highly recommend for anyone to try this.

This is such an amazing product! My favorite aspect about it is how creamy and hydrating it is. I can tell that it is very rich and needed on my skin. My mom uses this products too and her skin if different than mine. I completely recommend

This is my first Bobbi Brown skincare product and I’m impressed! So rich and hydrating. I don’t like skincare products with any scents but this has a very light fragrance. It didn’t bothered me at all.

I absolutely love using this face base. I typically use it under makeup, but even using it alone on my skin feels amazing. It feels so moisturizing but not heavy at all. It helps create the most perfect surface for applying my makeup!

I purchased this on my own before receiving for free to try. It’s an essential in my routine. Very moisturizing and creates a great base for makeup. I absolutely love the texture as it isn’t too tacky, oily, or drying.

I bought the duo in store (2 for the price of 1, yay holiday shopping!).  I was actually wary of buying it due to some negative reviews.  I used it one time and after applying my makeup I had some dry and dark spots on my skin and it was a little irritated.  I wasn’t sure if it was this or the weather, but I was pretty uncomfortable.  I tried it again the next day, and I had no issues with my skin; my skin and makeup looked GORGEOUS.  It really did look like some sort of photo finish.  It did exactly what I hoped it would do; SO glad I go two!

review_title: I viewed primer so wrong until now!
review_text: I always thought primer was primarily to enhance the appearance and wear of makeup- apply better, keep it fresh, prevent fade, etc. I recently learned that primer should also serve as a barrier to protect your skin from your makeup. And wow does this product do that!  My skin has never been healthier after incorporating this product. It serves as a moisturizer and barrier to prevent clogging and break outs (haven’t had a single one since using this over the last 5 weeks!) AND it makes my makeup look flawless, long lasting, and fresh all day. I’m so impressed
Great moisturizing primer. I use this on days I want my skin to just feel great. So far it has paired nicely with my other makeup!
I have very dry skin and using this stuff makes my skin so shiny and I love it.
Love this moisturizer but hate the smell! Smells lemony, but like a household cleaning product.
this is honestly amazing! Makes my skin look amazing!

review_title: 10/10 for dry skin, beautiful under makeup
review_text: I got a mini trail size and i love it so so much! it reminds me of the sunday riley’s vitamin c moisturizer, but thicker. Which is a plus for my dry skin, it especially helps under makeup, whether natural or a full matte glam look.
Has an amazing smell and texture. Love the way my face feels after. However, it does not keep my makeup in place all day. Would definitely use as a moisturizer, not a primer

god this stuff is so good. i have normal/combination skin (depends on the day) but this stuff has consistently made my skin feel amazing all day long. my dry cheeks don’t feel tight at the end of the day and my oily t-zone is not overly oily. right now i’ve had it on for four to five hours and my skin still feels soft, moisturized, and plump and you can still feel the existence of the product on my skin. it sits so well under makeup and it smells divine! really sinks into your skin. i regularly go without face makeup, and this stuff is thick enough that i dont feel exposed/dry throughout the day, but it has sunken in enough that its not just sitting on top. fantastic product
Great product. Best purchase from Sephora . Smells good , soft texture

The texture of this product is so bouncy and cushiony and I haven’t tried another product like it. It sinks into my skin really well and works great under makeup. The scent is okay, but not great. It’s fresh and citrusy, but almost smells like a surface cleanser. You can’t smell it after it is applied though. I’m not sure if I’ll repurchase because of its price point.
Way too much money for what it is. I’d say it’s an average primer. Not really a moisturizer.

It’s an amazing product. My skin feels soft and my blemishes are much lighter now. I find that my skin has improved so much with changing my  routine and products, and this cream is part of this new routine.
This product is amazing. I have dry skin generally and it is worse in the winter months. This makes my shin feel like silk. Perfect base for make-up products that follow.

I received a sample in store at the recommendation of one if the sales girls. The product worked great, my skin felt soft and my foundation applies effortlessly.  However, I asked for Cruelty free and she must have assumed vegan automatically meant cruelty free, it does not, so I only used the one time.

I’ve been using this for a couple weeks now and I’m really enjoying it. I usually apply it with a damp beauty blender and applies wonderfully. it works great under bb creams, cc creams and foundation. I love the smell and the texture, makes my face feel and look amazing. 4 stars for price, but it is Bobbi Brown so what can you do.most likely will buy this again.

Overall I enjoyed this primer! It’s a nice consistency and felt very moisturizing. I prefer a dewy finish and it definitely helped with that. I stick with tinted moisturizer most of the time, so I’m not sure how it does with a heavy foundation, but it made my skin look nice! I would recommend.

I enjoyed this product. I likes the thickness of the cream and how moisturizing it was on my skin. I used it as a primer though, and was not that impressed. I feel like it didn’t give me that poreless look I seek in a primer. However, I was pleased with its performance as a moisturizer. I enjoyed the product and will continue to use it, but the price seems a bit steep for just a moisturizer. Overall, I would recommend to a friend if they weren’t concerned about price.

review_title: Smells nice but didn’t wow me
review_text: This primer/ moisturizer smells really awesome and I like the texture but I didn’t think it did much for my dry skin nor did it make my makeup look any better. The ingredients seem pretty clean though and I appreciate that. For the price point I think that there are better primer options.

I’m not a big foundation user but I tried this for a week. This product has a good moisturizing effect - my face is quite dry so I appreciate products that have a deeply moisturizing element to them. This product runs thick so I ended up using more of it each time. It has a creamy white consistency with maybe a slight tint of yellow but it does not discolor your skin. The foundation sat over this primer smoothly - no flaky texture, it was nice and consistent!I received this product as a free sample
Wore this alone. It was hydrating and not greasy for my combination skin. Helped fill and mask my pores for a smooth finish. Great citrus smell. I received this product for free for testing purposes.

This is the perfect primer and moisturizer.  Hands down the best I’ve ever used.  However, I will not purchase until/unless Bobbi Brown goes Cruelty Free.  The bend overall have stunning products, but I’ve had to subtle them out, sadly.

I have combination skin and this product works perfectly on my skin. I feel highly moisturized before I put on my other makeup! It also makes my foundation look way better than it usually does. The only thing I’d say that could be better is that the packaging should come with something to take the product out of the jar so that you don’t have to use your fingers!!! Overall a great product.

This is hands down the best primer I’ve ever used - it’s not too thick or thin and applies so smooth. With most primers I’ve tried you can feel the thickness of the primer on your skin and that’s just not true for this primer. I’ve worn this both with makeup and without and I love it either way. The scent is also wonderful which is a huge plus. Had I not tried this product, the price would have scared me away, but it’s totally worth the money!I received this product complimentary to test and review.

I love this stuff! I kill 2 birds with one stone in the morning rush, and that’s always a plus! It sat amazing with my huda foundation! And my skin looked great all day! I’ll def be purchasing a full sized one in the future! I got this product for free in exchange for my honest review
These days I have been trying bobbi brown vitamin enriched face base I love the skin is very hydrated I use it with my usual makeup and it complemented well, I will continue using this product

I received this as a sample from influencer and I think overall it’s okay. I personally would not pay 60 dollars for this product because there are so many others that can do the same. My foundation didn’t stay on as long as I expected and my foundation came off my nose after 4 hours. This usually doesn’t happen with any of my other primers that are half the price. I do however like how it makes my skin feel on it own without any makeup on top.

I’ve got Bobbi Brown Vitamin Enriched Face Base as a complementary from Influenster and I love it! I have dry skin and this primer works phenomenally- it moisturizes and instantly softens my skin and gives it natural glow not in a greasy way. I don’t use foundation a lot , but still using it under my powder and it holds it very well! It’s very lightweight and  would be perfect for all skin types. I will definitely buy a full size.
I love the Vitamin Enriched Fase Base it makes my skin feel wonderful. It’s not greasy or thick , it goes in to my skin and make it feel clean

This product works great in the winter time when my skin is pretty dry. The thickness of this product helps my foundation to lay well on my skin as how a moisturizer would. Although this product works great, I don’t see a big improvement on how my skin looks compared to when I do not use this product. I have received this product for free for testing purposes.

I like the consistency of this product. I have dry skin so it works well with my skin type. I wouldn’t recommend for oily skin since it’s a pretty greasy consistency. Helped keep my makeup on all day and my skin felt soft and smooth !
This feels great on my skin, I love this and will be purchasing the full size , I wore this under my makeup, and this really made a huge difference. I love  this, def a staple.

I recieved my complimentary (for testing purposes) Bobbi Brown vox box! it was a total surprise, I had no clue I was getting one!! this is my 2nd Vox Box from Influenster!! I’m so excited.I tried it and it feels nice! Its smooth. I like that it’s a moisturizer and a primer in one. Instead of having to put moisturizer on then a primer. I wear it with makeup. I dont know that I would pay $60 for it though
Hands down the greatest thing to ever happen for dry skin

This moisturizer is everything. It works so well with almost any foundation. It instantly moisturizes my skin and gives such a healthy glow. I feel so hydrated and beautiful when I wear this. Worth the price tag in my opinion.

I tried this out and I completely loved it. A small amount goes a long way for sure. Also it’s somewhat sticky and I was doubtful about how it would look. But it made my foundation look so beautiful and last long. I am adding this to my permanent go-to staple.

Wow! Didn’t have high hopes for this, even hearing good things. Was afraid it would be to thick and smell perfumy. Was totally wrong! Has a nice citrus scent and while thick, a little goes a long way and it doesn’t feel heavy on the skin. Very moisturizing, gives skin a glow and makes it smooth for foundation. I will be repurchasing for sure!

I had received this product as a free sample to review the most honest I can. Without a doubt this primer really is the GOAT! Before trying this primer I didn’t understand the hype surrounding the product. Now I do. Its so lightweight and the fragrance is minimal. Once on your face it glides on softly and doesn’t make your face feel heavy. I used it as a primer for my matte foundation and it make my skin look flawless. I noticed that I didn’t get as oily so fast with other primers. When applying a little does go a long way. Overall I would recommend it to anyone and if you are unsure, getting the mini size doesn’t hurt.

I am new to the Bobbi brown products and they just keep impressing me every time. I just tried this product and it was thick so I instantly knew it would be moisturizing but I was scared since I have oily skin. As soon as it dried up and I followed it with the Bobbi brown foundation it felt so weightless on my skin and honestly kept the oil away from my face. I’m in love!

Love this product! It’s so versatile and a new staple in my makeup routine. It’s very hydrating which is great for my dry skin. I love that it can also be used as a primer so it cuts down on time in my daily makeup routine. I just started using it so I can’t vouch for a noticeable change in my skin just yet (but it’s looking really great). I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review.

I received this sample from Influenster and I’ve tried it out a couple of times and really like it. It smells great and has a wonderful texture. I tend to have oily combo skin and this worked well with it. I think finding the right foundation to pair with it is what’s tricky for me. I liked it with one and hated it with another. Overall, I think it’s a great product and I wouldn’t mind trying out the full size product even though it is on the more expensive side.

I received the bobbi brown moisturizer complimentary from Influencer for an honest review. I have been using the product for about a week. Its a thick moisturizer so it does take a minute for it to spread evenly as well as to taken in by your skin. I do love the feel the product as a primer and have used it during my make up days. I feel that the product leaves my skin looking hydrated throughout the day!

I received this from Influenster to review. So far I have only used it a few times. It has a pleasant scent, but could be too much if you are sensitive to that. I goes on smooth and feels weightless. I don’t find it very moisturizing though, which is disappointing since I have dry skin. I don’t think it makes my makeup last longer than any other primer would do. I don’t know if I was purchase this, for the price it’s just not WOWing me.

This product is amazing! I was skeptical at first because I don’t really see the point in a primer. This primer is definitely well worth it...It goes on thick like a moisturizer but once it dries- it feels very light. Smells great too. I’ve noticed my makeup stays in place all day and may skin feels amazingly smooth. A co worker told me I looked flawless the other day and the only thing I changed was using this primer. Definitely will be buying again! I was gifted this product for testing purposes.

This priming moisturizer exceeded all expectations I had by far. It’s a bit thick in consistency but it’s goes on your face very smoothly and instantly my face looked better, moisturized and glowy. I’m a big primer person and I did not need to use a primer with this which I loved, it was already a great base for my foundation. So it made my morning routine way faster, can’t beat that! The smell was refreshing, not over powering in any way. I received this complimentary from Influenster for my honest review .
I received this complimentary from Influenster! It is a great hydration primer! Keeps the makeup on all day. Can definitely be used as both a moisturizer and primer if your skin isn’t too dry!
Love this stuff it literally made my makeup look flawless, the only down side is it’s a little pricey.

No improvement to my skin and not enough moisture for me.  Very expensive for doing nothing. I thought it would be nice to use one product for both primer and moisturizer. It’s not terrible, just average and not worth the money.
Sooo good, super moisturizing I can tell a difference in my skin too!
The BEST primer EVER. Thank you Jeffree Star

review_title: WISH THEY’D MAKE A TRAVEL SIZE ONE
review_text: Soooo good and moisturizing ❤️❤️❤️❤️

I have had this on my loves list for SO long before I finally spent the $$$ on it.  This is the first Bobbi Brown product I’ve purchased and I don’t know how I lived without it!  I definitely think my makeup applies better over this face base.

magnificent for oily skin... although it’s not a miracle worker and you will have oily skin again eventually throughout the day, it slows and tames my oil production very well. i’m allergic to most fragrances, but since this is made with essential oils and not chemicals, its strong citrus scent does not bother me at all! its a great product that I will use again and again.

I rotate between this and my Tatcha silk canvas.  Two of my favorite primers.  This leaves your skin feeling hydrated without feeling oily or sticky.  Makeup also applies evenly on top.  Love this stuff!  I’m on my second jar.

I have oily skin so I always have to moisturise before I put on makeup especially if I’m going to be outside for a long time. This is the first moisturiser that I’ve used that works from my oily skin and I like it. It smells good and it makes my skin feel nourished!

I bought into the Tati hype. Plus, some of my really trusted makeup guru friends swore by this. So, I finally made the plunge during the spring sale. As a primer, it’s fine. It has that nice tacky finish that helps makeup cling to it. The scent is exactly like a freshly baked lemon cookie. It does absolutely nothing to conceal or fill pores, but I don’t think that’s the purpose of this product. I will update my review after using the full jar to see if any actual skin benefits remain to be seen.

I really love this moisturizer that doubles as a primer. It feels like gel, applies like cream, absorbs quickly into your skin and keeps it hydrated.Foundation stays on flawless. Doesn’t irritate or make acne worse.This product is worth its price.
This is my fav moisturizer because it makes my skin nice and smooth without making me oily and break out

Love the moisture this gives my skin. Love the smell (oranges). Love how it looks under makeup. This product is seriously a must have if you wear foundation because it makes your skin underneath look so hydrated and healthy!

I was using the Bobbi Brown Hydrating Face Cream and loved it. The Sephora employee recommended this to me since it has extra vitamins. I couldn’t get past the smell. It smells floral-y and I don’t want my skincare products/ makeup to have a scent. Scents don’t do anything to help improve my skin. It works just the same as the hydrating face cream.

I have bought so many moisterizers and none of them worked for my dry skin. this one is incredible. Put it on at night and let it sink in while you sleep and wake up with super soft and moisturized skin.

Love this face wash.  Disappointed with the Sephora support when the  packaging broke.  Have used this product for quite some time and love it.  In fact, I stock up buying it before I need it since I travel for work to areas where I can not buy Sephora.  The last full size tube I got, the lid broke after a few uses.  I see in the Q & A I am not the only one who experienced this flaw in packaging.  Rendered it useless for travel, which , I do every 2 weeks.  Because I stock up, the period of return IF I wanted to lie and say it broke me out was over.  I tried being honest and  asked for a new lid only and an exemption for the date of purchase due to faulty packaging.  Sephora could not help.  So, I had to squeeze all the product out into a small jar for use which leaked all over in my luggage. Great face wash!  I won’t stop using it since it is the only one I like for my sensitive skin .  It is expensive and  I would have expected more support from Sephora.  Buy this but be prepared to have the lid break.  Tape it or put it in another jar that seals really really well.  This will add more to the cost!

review_title: Listen!!!! You will NOT be disappointed!
review_text: I purchased this product about 5 days ago and when-i - say!  Upon placing the product on your hand, you can immediately feel the quality of the product. I add a very small amount of water and rubbed the product on my face and I have no complaints. I appreciate when I invest in quality body care and I can feel and see the positive affects. Your face will feel soft as cashmere. I pair this with the olhenriksen facial oil and I am in love!!!!!

review_title: The Jury is Out on this....for now
review_text: So I got this as part of the birthday gift from Sephora and I’m not sure if it’s this or the moisturizer that broke me out though I do feel it is this. I do like it I feel there are better cleansers out there (la roche posay) So I’d save this for maybe once a week definitely NOT a daily thing. Also, I would use at night as maybe part of a double cleanse to help rid yourself of the day’s gunk/funk/junk.
I really like how smooth my face looks and feel after cleansing with this product.

Pros: The facial cleanser feels luxurious on your face as you wash your face with it. It smells good as well.Cons: This cleanser dried out my skin! It literally zapped the oil and moisture out of my skin leaving it parched and very dry!

When I tried the sample in the birthday gift it left my skin feeling supple after washing so I decided to buy the full size. My skin feels drier than it did with the birthday size but I still like the wash & it’s consistency. I have dry skin so I need creamy washes. I like the texture, it’s like a light exfoliant. A little goes a long way.

When I tried the sample in the birthday gift it left my skin feeling supple after washing so I decided to buy the full size. My skin feels drier than it did with the birthday size but I still like the wash & it’s consistency. I have dry skin so I need creamy washes. I like the texture, it’s like a light exfoliant. A little goes a long way.
Wasn’t a fan. When washing it feels very think and makes my face feel heavy and unclean
Holy Grail cleanser. Its perfect for my super dry skin. I love how foamy this gets and how luxe it feels. The smell is perfect and not too over-powering. 10/10
Really a strong smell and texture. I wouldn’t say this is bad but I wouldn’t use it for dry skin. Although it doesn’t dry out my skin , it leaves a weird film over it and a very strong lavender smell
Really a strong smell and texture. I wouldn’t say this is bad but I wouldn’t use it for dry skin. Although it doesn’t dry out my skin , it leaves a weird film over it and a very strong lavender smell

I love this cleanser. I was hesitant because of the price vs size of bottle but a friend recommend it to me so I gave it a try. I have such dry skin and washing my skin with this (plus oils to moisturize after) left my skin more hydrated then it has been in a while. Plus a little goes a long way- it’s quite concentrated so you can use a little bit and just add water and it really lasts a while. I’ve tried many face washes and this has been the best so far!
Just lovely!  Very, very impressed with this cleanser.

I love this stuff! I have been using this in addition to the texture tonic and the skin soothing repair indigo cream. I have rosacea and this, in combination with the others, has cleared it up almost immediately! I was skeptical about trying a new brand, but this is definitely my new go-to.
Got this off a friend for $15 and I’m HOOKED. Best cleanser I’ve used so far.

This product is amazing! I got the mini version and I almost finish it I am definitely buying the full size. Perfect for my sensitive skin, very gentle but still exfoliates. I love it! I have tried multiple brands like LaMer, Drunk Elephant and I like this one a lot

Love Love Love Love this facial wash!!! Thank you Tatcha for coming up with this product. Saved me from irritation, redness, dryness and dullness. Being in my late 40s, I need a facial wash that maintains the healthy glow keeps the moisture and this is definitely one that I will keep buying. Love the smell, really mild. Doesn’t flake or strip your face after use. This size lasted me 6 months using twice a day.

review_title: not out of this world but I’d buy again
review_text: I have very dry skin, and if used after an oil cleanse- I think this does a great job at getting the remaining impurities off of your face without stripping away at the skin. A little goes a VERY long way, so price wise I think this is worth it. Only thing is that I don’t love the little rice beads in there but it doesn’t affect much
Hard to find a good face wash, this one is everything you want & need. Will be repurchasing.

This is the best face wash I have ever used. This give a spa like vibe everyday! Moisture moisture moisture.. Very high quality.. you only need a little because its so rich. I am more than impressed. No breakouts no irritation!

As long as you follow the directions to add water to the cream before applying to face, you will have the best cleanser! Makes a great lather, not foamy, no bubbles, still creamy. Smells nice, and leaves skin soft, smooth and firm! A treat-yo-self splurge!

My favorite face was of all time. The micro grain is the most gentle yet effective physical exfoliant that I have ever experienced in a face wash. Gets the job done. I feel super clean but not stripped. The pH balanced formula is great for when I need to apply a retinoid or retinol directly after. I have oily, acne prone skin and this doesn’t bother me at all. It may even help. Alittle goes a long way, so the price is reasonable in my opinion.

review_title: I wouldn’t buy if I were you...
review_text: Made me break out like crazy. I wanted to love this, I really did. :( now I have half a bottle that I basically have to throw away because it’s that bad for my skin!
I have always liked Tatcha products and this one I have to say is my favorite.  It leaves my skin so soft, plumped & clean.  I love this product.

I had the Tatcha Silk primer that they have, that was the first product from the brand that I used. I thought it was incredibly over priced but heard great things. I’m unbelievably picky about how products feel on my face. I hate the feeling of makeup and will use whatever I need to to use as little makeup as possible. The primer was incredible, I didn’t mind the price (as much) after I tried it. I needed a great wash that didn’t leave my skin feeling filmy, or tight and dry. This feels incredible when using it, and my skin actually feels and looks clean, and soft. I use this with my dewy Tatcha moisturizer and it’s like heavens gates are opening and little charobs are flying around me, I love it. My skin feels clean, actually clean. Definitely recommend anything they make.

review_title: Really like it...works great, leaves skin clean
review_text: As a first time user I really do like this cleanser. Has a nice subtle smell and its consistency is great, with bits of exfoliant that leave your skin feeling extra clean. My skin feels hydrated and smooth right after the wash. Perfect preparation for a moisture routine. I really like it and will buy again.

review_title: this is the only softener I will ever use
review_text: I am not been a huge softener fan, nor have I understood its effects. However... since I started using this product 3 DAYS ago, I have seen a noticeable difference in my skin. I struggle with redness and uneven skin tone. My skin type is oily/combo, so I can also struggle with balancing hydrating and shine. In combo with the dewy cream, my skin has looked even more clear (even when I didn’t struggle with blemishes before so I didn’t know this was possible), bright, and most importantly - even skin tone. I definitely think this product and the dewy cream have helped reduce my redness. My skin has been looking soooo good lately, and it has only been 3 days. I am a total fan of THIS softener now, and I understand the impact of using a softener. Applying this product with a cotton pad felt sooooo good too. It feels like a clean, hydrating, fresh swipe on my face. I have tried a lot of toners/liquid exfoliators and my skin often feels bone dry and uncomfortable after. My skin feels refreshed after using this softener. I highly highly highly recommend.

This is the one skincare product I can’t go without! I have dry sensitive skin and this doesn’t irritate my skin and makes it feel so hydrated and plump. I tried to stop using this product because it’s so expensive but immediately I felt a difference in my skin! I’ve tried to find replacements for it as well and nothing comes close. I have repurchased 3 times already. I know it’s expensive but one bottle last me about 12 months and I use it twice a day! Will keep repurchasing this no matter what!

This essence is very similar to the SK-II that’s been out forever: watery, not very moisturizing and I can’t tell if it’s doing much or not. I’m only using it up because it was so expensive; there are Tatcha products I love (gentle exfoliators and vitamin C serum) and some I dislike (Kissu lip mask.) This falls somewhere in the middle.

I just finished my first bottle and I have to say it’s one of the best decisions I’ve ever made to my daily skin care routine. At first, I was hesitant about splurging so much money on a “skin essence” something that I have not used before but after researching I started practicing the 7 step Korean skin care routine religiously and will have to say it’s been a game changer. My older sister just saw me for the first time since we’ve been in quarantine and she said “Did you get Botox done? Your face looks different. Good different!” I couldn’t have been more happy especially since I’ve dealt with adult acne and skin issues for over 10 years! Once Sephora opens their doors again this Friday I will be purchasing my 2nd bottle! YAY to TATCHA! I love you!
Didn’t see any difference with this product. As if I was using just water.

review_title: Easy to use and noticeably plumper skin!
review_text: Sleek and easy to dispense product from packaging.One of the better essences I’ve used. No strong scent, watery texture, fast absorption and so gentle. I have sensitive skin and felt no irritation or saw redness after applying this. Noticed plumper and more supple skin, even though I’m oily and acne prone ... my skin felt softer and more calm compared to before use of this product.Would recommend layering this with your favorite hydration product before bed to wake up to plump, fresh and brighter looking skin!

This product is very liquidy and takes a minute to set into the skin, but once it does you can feel it working. There’s a definite tingle to your skin. I love how light and smooth this feels, but I HATE how you have to apply it. I tried applying with a cotton pad, splashing a little on my fingers, and pouring it straight on my face, but applying with a palm full and pressing it in like they recommend IS the best method. It’s just messy and you always use a bit more than you need. I have noticed my pores are smaller, and my skin overall is more moisturized and dewy; however I have also been breaking out a lot more, and in places I don’t normally break out. This is a great product, just not suited for my sensitive skin. I would recommend to people with less temperamental skin. I received this product from Influenster to review with the Tatcha Violet-C serum, and I have only used the products together. I will keep trying them separately.

I really liked this essence! My skin felt soft and hydrated after every use, and I like that it seemed to absorb very quickly. The bottle is very pretty as well. The only thing I wish they would improve is the cosistency because I found it slightly difficult to apply as it was so runny and sometimes ran through/between my fingers. Overall I am happy with this complimentary product that I received for testing from Influenster.

I used the Tatcha Vitamin C brightening serum immediately after, and I definitely see results.  My skin  is now consistently moisturized and noticeably brighter. I recommend this essence!

review_title: Better than a toner (in my experience.)
review_text: I am new to using an “essence” of any kind, but I am very happy with this product. This used in conjunction with the Violet-C Brightening Serum have changed my face for the better, as my skin is now more even toned, smoother, softer, and noticeably more hydrated than it was before. It is a little pricey, but a little goes a loooong way (I end up using only a drop or so twice a day.) I received this and the Violet-C Brightening Serum complimentary for testing purposes, and I’m so happy that I did. I’ll definitely be buying this product when it runs out!

review_text: I received this product as a free sample to test and review for the app Influenster. I loved its product texture and the feeling of application. The smell is just okay. The screw-top packaging was really annoying. As far as results go, I have very dry skin and I had hoped for improvement, but I saw no difference. My favorite effect has been that makeup and foundation has appeared so much more natural and smooth since using this product. I feel that a pump or dropper would allow for a much simpler application process. I haven’t spilled the bottle yet, but could see that as a potential scenario with the current “pour” bottle topper.

I received this product complimentary from an Influenster Vox Box. I am really pleasantly surprised by how moisturizing this serum is - I expected it to be more like a toner (like The Ordinary’s 7% Glycolic Acid). It goes on slightly thinner than a gel moisturizer. The packaging is really cool; the lid prevents you from dumping out a bunch of liquid into your hand and provides an easily measured amount. First impressions in using the product for a few days: really did a good job of balancing my combination skin and helped reduce the appearance of my textured skin (primarily acne scars and sub-surface blemishes). Overall really pleased with the product! I would recommend it to someone with combination skin as a moisturizer/toner, with the option to add a heavier-duty moisturizer on top for especially dry days.
Really enjoy this product! You can instantly feel your skin get softer after applying the product. Also, has a very lightweight consistency. I received this product for free.
Highly recommend! This product left my face feeling hydrated and smooth without feeling clogged or greasy! Beautiful smooth base to start the make up routine with

Alright...I took the bullet and invested my money into Tatcha just to see what the whole hype was about. I finished the whole bottle and I felt like I need to write a review on what my initial thoughts were about this essence. For anybody wondering Tatcha is a US brand. The ingredients are from Japan but Tatcha is most definitely a Western skincare brand. Is this essence worth the price point? Absolutely NOT!! The ingredients are very nice and the packaging is really great. However, I will not be repurchasing this product. The reason I say this because you can you find affordable dupes like this all over the “k-beauty” world that are just as effective if not even better than this. The beauty industry is always changing and the skincare industry is always thriving and looking for the new “IT” factor. If you want to splurge and have the money to afford this then by all means get it but I think I will save my money.
Makes my skincare penetrate quickly! Love that it isn’t filled with water like a lot of other essences. Noticing a huge difference in fine lines!
i really love this. first time use my skin was so plump and soft. It helps with other products go into skin deeper. I would repurchase. A little pricey. But worth the money for results.

review_title: Necessary for the rest of your skin care routine
review_text: I was unconvinced about essences until I tried this one. Helps my vitamin c serum sink in better — and therefore helps knock out my Melasma. MAKE A TRAVEL SIZE TATCHA!!!!

Genuinely love this, amazing first step that leaves your face baby soft and over time I’ve notice my skin is brighter. I like it so much more than the SK II essence, and it doesnt hurt that it’s significantly cheaper!
Absolutely love this product! I am a tatcha junkie and this doesn’t disappoint. I apply 2 a day and it leaves my skin so soft and my makeup goes on flawlessly.

review_title: DID NOT WORK ON MY SOUTH ASIAN INDIAN SKIN :(
review_text: I really wanted this Tatcha Essence to work on me especially considering the price and how other reviewers are raving about it. I was so disappointed that I did not see even a tiny flash of difference even after using it 2 weeks straight. I wasn’t expecting miracles but perhaps even a tiny glow would have been a warm welcome for me. But at least it did not break out my extremely sensitive skin. For that I have to be greatful. Oh well......I’ll keep looking for that HG essence which will work for me I guess.
Lovely face wash, not too aggressive, and didn’t leave me with nasty break outs!

I’ve used both the Deep Cleanse and the Rice Wash and I was expecting to live this one more than the Rice Wash since I have oily combo skin but I tend to reach for the Rice one instead. Don’t get me wrong it’s a good cleanser but the texture is too thin and runny and I went through it quickly within a month of using it twice a day. Overall, a good cleanser but I will purchase the Rice Wash next time!
Deepest clean my skin has had in a long time! Clearing my acne and taking all my makeup off in one go! Definitely recommend if you don’t like products that are overly scented.
Saved my skin!! Paired with the dewy skin cream by tatcha my skin has never looked better. 10/10 recommend

review_title: think this is causing my breakouts
review_text: I give this 2 stars bc I’m honestly still unsure about it but i’m thinking it’s definitely gonna be a no for me at least. at first i really liked it and it feels nice on my face. i feel like the exfoliating part doesn’t do too much but i also don’t see any difference in my pores. before this i only had some hormonal acne on my chin, but now i have bumps & black heads all over my chin & cheeks. there’s even bumps coming up on my forehead now (the don’t have a head but they’re still red bumps) so definitely think i’m gonna stop using this for a bit and see if anything changes. i’ve been using the moisturizer with it but it was a small kind of sample sized one & so i’ll probably just use the rest of it. but even the moisturizer is too watery for me i thought it would be perfect but if i don’t put it over my serums and use an oil after it just feels like wet but dry it’s weird. and at first they both seemed to be doing okay i think i even gave a good review on the moisturizer i can’t remember but after using both for a straight month i think it’s just making my face worse. those were the only things i changed up. i still have some of the face wash i’ve been using plus another sample sized one also that came in the pack with the small moisturizer so i may see if i can go back to it later but if i see one bump after use i won’t be using it again. right now i’ll have to find something that can clear up my face now because i do believe it’s the face wash doing it

Leaves quite an amount of product behind, so yes, it is definitely gentle. Truly can’t rave nor complain about this product here but I will mention, I will be looking to try a cleansing product from Farmacy once this bottle is done.

This cleanser is my absolute favorite! I can’t wait to get home from work and wash my face :). It smells really refreshing and my skin feels so soft after. The exfoliation is super light, so you can use it daily.

Wow! This product is the definition of recovering what you pay! Simply the best! It’s reach! You can feel how it takes all the bad very gently! It’s milky, it’s not bulky. I just simply adore this product! And it’s huge!!Finally a premium product that it’s actually in a good size!
I LOVE everything about this cleanser!!  I highly recommend especially if you have oily skin like I do.  It makes my face feel wonderful.

Second time purchasing, LOVE this face wash!  After a couple uses I noticed my skin was so much more balances and a lot of my previous issues started clearing up. I still have some small breakouts occasionally, but nothing compared to what it was before!

review_title: not a great selection for oily skin
review_text: I was looking forward to try Tatcha, sephora rep. suggested this cleanser along with my regular Farmacy cleanser as kinda change.I am sorry but it didn’t meet my expectations at all, I feel oils build up just after 15 min of rinsing the foam it didn’t do the job it is supposed to.it may be a better choice for dry skin but not for oil/combined skins

review_title: great when you want a gentle scrub
review_text: Whenever I feel like I need a deep cleaning without the feeling of being to rough this is the cleanser I use. It’s a soft scrub.

Nice cleanser, didn’t make me dry or irritate my skin. My biggest complaint it the packaging. You have to squeeze the plastic which then cracks over time and get little pieces of the plastic onto your hand,and if you are paying attention, you could scratch your face. I would repurchase but only if they figure out a better system

One of my favourite cleansers. Leaves my face so clean, bright, smooth and shrinks my pores.Only thing I hated it is the bottle doesn’t come full, for the price I’m paying I’m expecting a full bottle of product

Love this product. I got a sample of it from ipsy during one of the worst breakouts of my life. Not only did it help to clear up my skin, it did so with extremely little rebound breakouts. With 98% of other cleansers I’ve tried, both drugstore and higher end, I’ve always suffered severe rebound breakout. This is super gentle, even when accidentally applied to the eyeball and leaves your skin feeling fresh and soft.
I received a sample of this product and absolutely fell in love! Trying to preserve it as much as possible as it is a little on the pricer side...

I love Tatcha products! First, I can’t get passed the smell of this, it is awful smelling. Then it doesn’t make my skin feel clean and I double cleanse with this as my second cleanse. I would happily pay the price but I’m very disappointed in this product.

The product is ok, but the packaging flakes. Since the first time using this product, that sea foam green packaging has continued to flake off and get all over my hands and sink. I grab the bottle with dry hands and still it comes off, causing me to wash my hands again before rubbing the litter on my face. The cleanser itself feels nice, but I doubt I’ll buy again due to the mess it makes.
Leaves my face feeling clean, nice clear complexion.

review_title: Average, I’m going to try the rice cleanser next
review_text: I do like this cleanser since it really does clean well. However, it cleans a bit TOO well to the point of over drying. I have to moisturize very thoroughly following the use of the cleanser since my face gets super tight and dry. The packaging also sucks, it’s literally impossible to get the right amount of product out and the top of my bottle broke off during my second use.
This is the only cleanser that has worked for my face!! It is quite pricey but personally I think it’s worth it. Love it.

Love this gentle cleanser.  I have sensitive skin and this isn’t irritating it.  Foamy enough, makes the skin feel clean, does not leave it feeling tight or dry.  I use it with a foreo sometimes as well.

Has helped minimize my pores as I have combo skin and this has always been my issue. I also use the water cream as a day moisturizer and absolutely love these products together. My skin looks amazing under makeup AND when I go natural. Worth every penny- just buy it and don’t think twice.
Love this! Gentle on the face and cleans my pores well. My skin feels soft after using this product.

review_title: Welcome to break out pimple city
review_text: I thought it was possibly just me but after reading many other reviews, this product really makes you break out. I had really high hopes for this cleanser but its a very tough scrub and wasn’t what I hoped for. I have to finish it because of its pricing and I would feel bad not finishing. Luckily masks are mandatory and these pimples won’t appear. Also, I tried not using the product for a while to solidify my suspicion and my skin cleared. As soon as I used it again, I broke out.
Works well and isn’t drying.  Really good for combo skin.

Love this cleanser, I have combination skin and this cleans my skin without leaving it dry. I also notice how smooth my face has become since I’ve started using it. Love the product dont like the price.

Loved using this product! I only needed a pea size of the cleanser & it felt very nourishing on my skin. I normally break out when using any sort of cleanser or exfoliant but I had no reaction which was amazing! I would definitely recommend this to my friends. I don’t mind spending the extra money on this product.

I received a deluxe trial size of this. My skin is a normal type with certain areas on the dryer side, and while the instructions say it can be used everyday, I found it a little much. It’s more of a ‘gentle’ exfoliant, but still very much an exfoliant, so I would not use it more than three times a week. Maybe for those with oilier skin, it would be okay to use it often, but I wouldn’t suggest it for anyone else. Otherwise, I did find it left my skin feeling soft, nothing crazy, it’s a good cleanser, but a little too much on the expensive side for what it does.

oh Tatcha, no no no no. I got the mini set with the water cream after redeeming some insider points and this was such a bad choice. There are granules in the cleanser that’s comparable to a harsh physical exfoliant. My skin is oily and I need a deep cleans, but dang!! This was way too harsh! It was also difficult to squeeze out and left a film on my face that was so hard to wash off. How this product won an allure award completely makes no sense to me. Threw it out after 1 use.

review_title: The One & Only Cleanser for this Gal!!
review_text: This is the very first Tatcha product I ever purchased and I’ve never gone back. This is truly the only cleanser I’ve repurchased over and over in my 40 years on this Earth. The description states this is for Normal to Oily skin but I have Normal to Dry, reactive aging skin. I deal with hormonal acne (minor) and milia when using products that are too thick in consistency. This cleanser works wonderfully for all my issues!The texture can be described as a light milky gel with small, non-irritating beads which mildly exfoliate the skin. My skin never feels dry, parched, or stripped after using. I wear waterproof mascara, long wear Milk or Marc Jacobs gel eyeliner, and this removes every last speck. I have never experienced irritation or burning of my eyes. My skin feels clean, soft, and looks radiant and clear. The price is the only issue I have with this product. $38 for only 5oz is quite steep but I’m afraid to try anything else and have my skin react poorly. I love this cleanser in combination with the Tatcha Dewy Skin Cream. The combo is perfection. I would, with 100% confidence, encourage someone with my skin type and issues to try this cleanser. :)
My favorite cleanser so far. Little exfoliating particles are not harsh like many other exfoliating creams. Doesn’t leave my skin feel stretchy. My skin feels bouncy and smooth after using this.

So gentle and yet so powerful. After start using it in the morning and before bed, my blackheads mostly vanished. This little wonder removes makeup and everything else but your natural moisture. A little goes a long way - I only use the smallest dollop. It took me a long time to find the perfect cleanser but this is it.

review_title: Amazing product with not so amazing bottle
review_text: I love this product! It does wonders for my skin (brightens, evens out my texture, lifts impurities/scars). The only thing that drives me crazy about this product is the bottle. You have to squeeze it and either too much comes out or when you are running low, none comes out and you have to add water to the bottle. Packaging is a bit of a deal breaker; I am hoping Tatcha changes it because this product is seriously great.

I received this as a sample and was excited to try it but rather disappointed overall. It was very difficult to get the product out of the bottle. The texture is light and milky with little beads and the scent was fresh and light. Unfortunately it left my skin too dry. I have very oily skin but even so this just seemed to strip my skin a bit too much.
I try on sample but I love it right away after I used it, it left my skin feel smooth and moisture, i literally buy one from Sephora online.
Love the product but the packaging was defective. The blue packaging started to peel off whenever it got wet - leaving little plastic slivers on my hands and face.
Best face wash ever! Don’t hesitate... just buy it

I love Tatcha water cream, and I like foam cleanser, but this cleanser is just not the one for me. When some red rashes started to show on my cheeks, I didn’t expect it would have been this cleanser; however, after I stopped using other products, the rashes were still there, I realized it was due to this cleaner. I immediately stopped using this cleanser, rashes went away, and my cheeks slowly became smoothy and shiny again.  I just don’t understand how a clean skincare product will irritate my skin...now the whole bottle is sitting there, making me feel very disappointed...

love this stuff and am on maybe my third bottle. you only need a pea sized amount to lather your entire face and it gives a decent scrub without stripping your skin too much. having said that i think this wouldn’t be good for dry or even normal skin types, this is really meant for oil/combo skin. the only downside and why i give it 4 stars is the PACKAGING. that opening will splurt out so much product when you only need a little and its impossible to put it back in. very wasteful for something that’s on the pricier side. Tatcha PLEASE get a pump for this or something.

love this stuff and am on maybe my third bottle. you only need a pea sized amount to lather your entire face and it gives a decent scrub without stripping your skin too much. having said that i think this wouldn’t be good for dry or even normal skin types, this is really meant for oil/combo skin. the only downside and why i give it 4 stars is the PACKAGING. that opening will splurt out so much product when you only need a little and its impossible to put it back in. very wasteful for something that’s on the pricier side. Tatcha PLEASE get a pump for this or something.
Terrible package, makes it difficult to get the product. Overall good cleanser, however not for sensitive or dry skin.

Smells great, but left my face feeling sticky. The lather wasn’t as much as I expected from a product that claims to lather. I understood this product to be more of a “chemical” exfoliating cleanser if that even exists, as opposed to a cleanser with a few exfoliating beads mixed in. Not horrible, just okay. Glad I purchased the mini instead of the full size. Definitely will not purchase again. I have historically oily skin that turns dry in winter, and has been normal/combination as of late, for reference.

I have always heard a lot about tatcha from influencers, so I decided to give it a try. I bought this along with the tatcha water cream moisturizer. To be honest I didn’t find any difference using this although it didn’t irritate my skin or cause any breakouts. I think its just ok. For the price I don’t think its worth it because you can honestly get a way cheaper cleanser somewhere else. I didn’t have any problems with it but I didn’t love it either since I didn’t notice any improvements in my skin. Tatcha is overrated in my opinion. If you feel like splurging then you should buy this, but if you have a budget I’d say look for another brand!

review_title: THE BEST FOR OILY ACNE PRONE SKIN
review_text: Been using this cleanser for over a year now in combination with the Water Cream. It is the best cleanser I’ve come across for oily acne prone skin! It’s not too thin of a formula and it smells great. The natural fruit exfoliation is great for everyday use. Your skin doesn’t feel dried out either. I have the entire tatcha line and haven’t found anything else that works on my skin. 100% recommend
Love this cleanser. So refreshing and keeps my skin looking and feeling healthy.
I got the mini version of the bottle and it lasted almost 2 months. My face looks more clear and soft too.

I have always believed that drugstore cleansers did the job & that costly cleansers were not necessary. BUT I was lucky enough to find this on FB market place for $5! The full size. I’ve been using it consistently for 4 weeks, day & night, after oil cleansing. It’s been the only new product that I’ve incorporated since then. Trust me, I have a large collection of ingredients/products that have changed my skin for the better BUT I believe that this cleanser has truly taken my skin to another level due to the formulation/ingredients and how it deey cleans and preps my skin to receive my treatments. My skin is brighter, smoother, less oily during the day. The fine lines have somehow smoothed over and my tone is noticsbly brighter. And My make up has been sitting so wonderfully! Its as if I have done an exfoliating or hydrating mask everyday! I watched the QVC promo on this and the before/after results were amazing. I can fully attest to this product’s claims because I am amazingly experiencing them! I believe it’s the amino acids that are aiding in fading my fine lines. I keep reminding myself that products don’t make Allure Reader’s Choice for no reason, there’s a reason! TRY THIS consistently for more than 2 weeks! You have to make sure you’ve washed off all make up & then go in w this cleanser. I even leave it on while I brush my teeth before rinsing, that way I can really absorb all the nutrients.
