By far the worst packaging ever for women. It’s a very hard shell. Extremely difficult to squeeze to get the cleanser to come out. Especially if you have nails. If it falls in the shower and hits you, you definitely will be in major pain from the container. It’s that hard. The product itself was nice but if you can’t get it out of the tube without hurting yourself, then what’s the point?
Shockingly this made me break out. I LOVE Tatcha. Since they’re “clean” and nothing else in their line has made me react before, I was disappointed. I have very acne prone and sensitive skin.
If you want your makeup to come off in a millisecond buy it. It also makes my skin look so glowy I love it so much.
Love this cleanser, but not as a daily option for me. Once a week for a deep cleanse with this has definitely helped my skin.
i first heard of this product through the beauty guru Huda Kattan and I’m so glad I purchased this product it is amazing! Exactly what my huge pores were in need of.
i first heard of this product through the beauty guru Huda Kattan and I’m so glad I purchased this product it is amazing! Exactly what my huge pores were in need of.
This is a nice for exfoliating but honestly I’ve found much better products for much less

I use this product right before the Tatcha Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder (Deep). I gotta say I am really impressed. I have sensitive skin and the two products together leave my skin clean, soft and luminous. The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because I noticed my skin tends to get dry after use, and I need to apply moisturizer right away. Other than that, I strongly recommend.

A lot of people are using this incorrectly and not seeing good results... you must take your make up off first with a make up wipe or cleansing oil AND THEN you go in with this cleanser and massage in to the skin! And wash off with water and there you go, you’re welcome. By the way this cleanser keeps me away from clogged pores everyday!!! Don’t sleep on this.

I tried the mini set with the water cream before purchasing the full size and I’m in love! You can’t go wrong with this product! My skin has never been softer and pores and blemishes are fading so my skin is an even tone. I love this stuff and will definitely be purchasing more Tatcha products.

Overall, I really love this cleanser. I use it at night and it removes all my makeup in one go, including mascara, which a lot of other cleansers don’t do. My skin does not feel dry or tight afterwards, just clean and refreshed. There are two downsides to this cleanser which are more preference based and not related to the performance of the cleanser itself. First, I am not a huge fan of the tiny fruit pieces in the cleanser because they are firm and may cause micro tears on the skin (so be super gentle when massaging the cleanser onto your skin). Second, there’s no pump because the formula is too thick so it’s easy to dispense too much product. The best way to control this is turn the bottle upside down before opening it so all the product comes to the front and is easier to control and dispense. I didn’t knock a star off for these downsides because they’re personal preferences and the product itself is phenomenal.

I saw all of the reviews on the bad packaging and still decided to try it out for myself anyways. Unfortunately I have to agree with all of the negative packaging reviews, I feel like I am wasting a lot of product in the little time that I have had this cleanser. The one thing I do like about this product is the fragrance, it does smell really good.

This cleanser is what I’ve been searching for. I use at night as my second cleanser, after using an oil cleanser to remove my face/eye makeup. And I’ll use most days as my cleanser in the morning. I’ve found the exfoliation is gentle enough to use twice daily without any irritation. I’m notorious for picking at small blemishes at my face (eeek!) which causes immediate redness. Using this cleanser greatly reduces any redness from the (forbidden) picking and my skin is left with a nice glow. Admittedly since using this product on a regular basis, I’m noticing less surface-level breakouts to pick at. Apart from how it leaves my skin feeling, it has a mild, relaxing scent. And as far as difficulty of the packaging - this is not a problem I’ve faced. Shaking the bottle upside down one time to get the product at the opening and gently squeezing works for me. This has become an integral part of my skincare routine, and I will continue to repurchase!
A good cleanser but the fragrance was too strong for me. I tend to like fragrance free things for my face. Exfoliant part was very gentle as well. Expected more for it being a “deep cleanse”.

I don’t wear make-up regularly, so I don’t typically need to double-cleanse, but I do like some light exfoliation in my cleanser and this really ticks all of the boxes for me. With sensitive skin that tends towards being dehydrated, I prefer an oil based cleanser and find that this is easy to use in the shower and rinses clean leaving my skin soft and soothed. Makes a great daily cleanser with the option of adding in additional exfoliation or cleansing steps on days when you need it.

Really really love this cleanser! I tried the 100 point perk and I already added it to my loves list so I can purchase the full size once my current cleanser runs out. I truly love how it leaves my skin. I know some people don’t like the design of the bottle, I have not encountered any issues with getting the product out of the bottle.
Mmmm, LOVE this stuff! It smells amazing and cleans really well without completely drying out my face!!
Mmmm, LOVE this stuff! It smells amazing and cleans really well without completely drying out my face!!

review_title: Caused BAD breakouts on my combination skin :(
review_text: I was so excited to try this product as I had heard so many great things about it. I was really disappointed when I ended up breaking out badly with both cystic and white head pimples within a couple of days of using the cleanser. I understand that switching products can clean out your pores or cause a flare up, however even if this were true, I still am not satisfied with the way my skin felt. To me, it also had a funny smell. I have combination skin that I take very good care of and rarely ever break out, so I was shocked when I got those cystic, painful pimples that actually left scarring and lasted for way longer than they should have no matter what I did to try and calm them. I switched to Dr. Dennis Gross Alpha Beta pore cleanser and after one use my cystic pimple scars look better and my face feels cleaner (plus it’s the same price!). Glad I made the switch but I do hope this product works for others!
Mon nettoyant pour le visage favori! J’ai l’impression que ma peau est propre et fraiche après usage. Il contient des petits morceaux qui aide à exfolier en douceur.
Smells good, feels good on my skin.

I was searching for a cleanser that would help with my horrible postpartum acne. I have combo but dehydrated skin. I tried so many different cleansers from high end to drugstore brands. This is the only one that has helped clear my acne (still get occasional breakouts) without irritating and drying out my face. It feels good on my face and I enjoy the smell. I will continue to buy!

This product is great!! It’s smells like lemons and doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin! Only down side is that it doesn’t have a pump so it’s easy to use too much if you don’t know what you’re doing. 4/5 I will buy it again!!!
Nothing fully gets rid of pores but this for sure eliminates the visibility of them!

I started this a while ago and started seeing my skin, and it’s texture thereof, improve. Doesn’t dry your skin out, which is good because I have dry skin and hasn’t caused my skin to get itchy ! Love this product and I will be purchasing again, along with trying more products from Tatcha. ⭐️

I have been trying to find a good skin care regime I stick too and so far this one worked for me in terms of doing a good job at exfoliating my face. I have combination skin where I’m only oily on my T-zone and this product does not dry my face at all. I use this product every day only once either morning or night depending if I use makeup. I originally purchased the travel size (which I do for most products to test out first) and consumed it in 3 weeks and I just fell in love! The smell is very pleasant and not too citrusy smelling. So since I loved this product very much I decided to get the full size product. I do want to mention I follow with the cleansing oil and rose enzyme powder from tatcha as well and it works wonders! Now here comes my cons and why I decided to give it a 3-star. When I purchased the full size bottle and came home I noticed the bottle was not full. And I can understand products won’t always be full but a good 1/5 of the product was gone. Now the bottle didn’t seem as if it was tampered with but for $38 I expect it to have a lot of product. Another thing is the way it dispenses. I noticed when finishing the travel size it became a bit difficult to extract the product therefore some of it will stay in the bottle and go to waste. I will follow up with Sephora to confirm that I didn’t get a defect bottle but other than that the product has worked for me. Clearer skin, it clears out my pores and doesn’t dry out my face!

Great healthy smell. First time using a sample I was so impressed I bought a full bottle. I have dry combo skin, usually have to pack on the moisturizer after I wash my face but this is so good I barely need any after! Not gritty at all but still exfoliates my skin perfectly. Ive used it every other day for a month and have had no problems and great smooth skin.
So amazing my skin is always oily in the T zone but dry around my nose and this cleanser is just right for my skin definitely worth it.

I am obsessed this face wash! However I must of been drunk when I bought because- Wow now that’s a price point! I switched to something else and can already see my skin reverting.... will go back once I save a few extra $$’s.

If you want a ‘deep cleanser’ and have sensitive skin this is a great product for you. BUT if you have oily/comb tough skin like me this product is too gentle. I don’t feel it removed dead skin and I could barely feel the granules.

Summary: Get this cleanser if you have dry-combo to oily-combo skin, it has been worth the splurge for me! Lots of people complain about the bottle and having trouble with getting the product out, but I just take the cap off and tap it lightly but rapidly upside down against my fingers to get product to the top, then squeeze out a bean-sized amount (which really is enough).I first got The Deep Cleanse as a mini size from Sephora in July. I bought the full size in September. I have decided that I really am in love with the scent, texture, and effectiveness of this cleanser — it’s gentle but thorough, and the light exfoliation from the luffa (think bits of lemon peel) means that I only have to use my exfoliating scrub once a week now. I live in a humid but temperate climate, and I have been using this every morning and most evenings over the summer. Right now, in mid-October as it’s starting to cool down, I can tell it will be too drying for winter use here — but I’m looking forward to putting it back in my routine this spring!!P.S. originally I got this along with a mini Tatcha Water Cream, which I am still trying to figure out if I like or not. Stay tuned!

This cleanser is a godsend for me, because having rosacea and a very oily t-zone AND acne my whole life (I’m 48) I seventeen ale to find anything that has worked for me till now.  I also have large pores/black heads in my nose,which even a charcoal cleanser couldn’t get rid of... anyway, I’ve wanted to try this for a long time but the price left me cold so when I saw they had a mini set I went for it. I was very skeptical, but I used it and first time I did all the black heads from my nose disappeared! Talk about shock, this stuff is amazing. The feel of this is like water,one drop was used and goes along way,it foams up easily. You need very little. It left my skin feeling very clean and fresh and dewy feeling, not tight or stripped. It was wonderful ,it’s such an elegant cleanser. I love this,and will keep using this for as long as they make it! Even my Clairasonic didn’t clear out my blackheads,but this did......
I love everything from Tatcha and this is no expectation. I have acne-prone sensitive skin and this does not irritate my skin or makes it feel dehydrated.

obsessed! it is a mellow exfoliate and smells AMAZING. The scrubs are very small so its not over-powering and good for every day use compared to a full exfoliate once a week. love love love. ive been using it for a week and my face has already cleared up. A great option if you dont want to break the bank and have medium breakouts. i have an oily T zone dry skin everywhere else so it is good for both.

I like this cleanser, it gently exfoliates & cleanses. Smells good. It doesn’t break out my oily, acne prone skin BUT the packaging....is ridiculous. You can’t control how much comes out so you end up wasting product. I think they had to have it this way due to it being thick with large exfoliating particles in it but it really stinks. I have alot of deluxe samples of this so I think I’m going to go thru them while I wait for them to improve packaging. Fingers crossed.

I have oily but slightly sensitive skin so I needed something that really cleans without irritating. This fit the bill pretty good. It does exfoliate but not too harshly. If this is too harsh for your skin, the Tatcha oil cleanser (step 1) might be a good option; if you want to get a more deep clean Tatcha has exfoliating powders you can use as needed.
Love this cleanser! just purchased my second bottle. I use it nightly and it has helped with closing out pigmentation while exfoliating. Gentle enough for my sensitive skin and doesnt overly dry.
Love love love.  It’s really gentle on my skin and makes it feel really soft.  Love the microbeads.

review_title: A little goes a long way
review_text: Since receiving a sample of this product, I have since purchased the larger option.  I use this product only at night as a deep cleanse from the days pollutants.  It leaves my skin feeling smooth and looking clean.  Smells really good.  A little goes a long way.  It his micro beads in it to give an exfoliant feel.   I have sensitive combination acne prone skin.
Love the product, not a fan of the packaging. overall though my skin has cleared up even after just a few uses and doesn’t dry it out. great product, just change the packaging!

review_title: State of the art worth the price

It wasn’t until I randomly bought the eczema body cream that my sores(from scratching) cleared up. So I bought the face balm and wash- which I love. Now I’m ordering pretty much the whole line. I had red ‘lizard skin’ in my elbows and flakey skin to my scalp. To the point that it bled. It was bad and I used steroid cream (triamcinolone acetonide) to help temporarily. As I started using these products as part of my nightly routine, as well as stretches and 10 mins of peaceful stretching (full disclosure) my eczema is gone. GONE (exhale). After over 2 years. Give it a try.

Great product. Very thick and hydrating, ideal for winter. Worked wonders for my eczema-prone skin. The ingredients are very impressive, this is one of the only creams that has delivered long term improvement to my skin’s hydration overall.

this mask is absolutely amazing!! i put it on after my moisturizer at night because i wake up with dry patches and this has helped SO MUCH with that

review_title: Not for me, but good for dry skin
review_text: This product did not work well for me, but still giving it 4 stars because I believe it would work really well with dry skin. The good: after applying this the night before, my skin in the morning was supple and glowing. The bad: the product is too rich and oily for combo skin. It does not absorb well into my skin which causes an oily feel and residue (but considering this is a sleep mask, I guess it’s not so huge a deal). The dealbreaker, however, was because it was so rich, it was causing congestion with more small bumps and texture. Oily and combo steer clear, but dry and very dry this one’s for you!
This is a great overnight mask and has helped my dry skin so much!

I tried this back a year or two ago and remembered loving it. Well, I wanted to buy another trial size before spending the money on a full-size, just to be safe. I can honestly say I LOVE this mask. Makes my face so soft and smooth the next morning. Very pleased

I absolutely love this product!! I use it to remove my makeup at night. It uses moisture to remove makeup rather than strip moisture away like a regular cleanser. It takes off even the most stubborn waterproof makeup, no problem. It is a staple in my nightly routine. My skin feels so soft and supple after using. Highly recommend!

I have found that if I use it under my eyes lately that it can sometimes sting, and it might be the fragrance doing that, or maybe the actives, but this makes my skin so soft, pulls in hydration, helps with my hyperpigmentation, and keeps my skin moisturized. When I’m in places with more humidity, I can use this by itself. I just wish they had a fragrance free version because:A) I don’t want to have to eventually stop using this due to my skin growing more sensitive to fragrance as I have noticed my skin doing. B) So I can finally reccomend this to my friends with fragrance allergies because I love it so much. I have combination skin that leans more in the side of dry by the way.

I’m shocked at how perfect it is for me, it’s like sorcery?? I avoid fragranced products because they irritate my skin, but this one doesn’t. The scent is lovely and pleasant. Again, sorcery. The effects are also very good, brightens and smooths my skin!! I’m only bummed about the price, but overall I’m willing to make the investment for my skin to be as happy as it is.

review_title: In love with the Dream Mask
review_text: This is my first review on Sephora ... I just had to share my experience with this product!  I literally used it one night - just one night and I woke up with an amazing complexion. I’ve never really had a product work so quickly and produce such a quick results!  I’m in love with this stuff and will be purchasing the bigger size.  Also, I love that I could get the smaller one to try it first.  Pretty sure they just secured a lifelong customer here :)

However, I do add vitamin C to the AHA and BHA serums that I use in the morning. It makes my skin super clear.

Although it absorbed relatively quickly, it left a a moisturizing residue on my skin that wasn’t overly greasy. I also had no problem with pilling, even though I used a generous amount. The product also smells AMAZING and the fragrance didn’t irritate my skin. If you have dry skin, I highly suggest to give this a shot!

review_title: Best thing for my C section scar!
review_text: I like this on my face - I have very dry skin and few products can help that. But with this I wake up in the morning feeling almost kind of oily. It’s probably not for everyone but I like the super moisturized feeling. I don’t use it more than 3 times a week. But I found an alternative use for this which is a life saver. I apply it to my (itching) C section scar (completely healed, but still itches pretty bad once in a while) and the itch goes away! This stuff is powerful. I have tried all sorts of things on my scar - coconut oil, lush lotions, Vaseline, etc.. everything out there. This is the best thing for it. It is kind of wasteful to use such an expensive product as body care BUT if it works it’s worth it for me. Will be repurchasing!!

This mask was all right. Didn’t notice too much of a difference in my skin after using for a few weeks, so I don’t think it’s worth the price. Also I noticed that my face would stick to my silk pillow case unless I let the mask set for well over an hour.
The ingredients and the formula seem super good to me!  My skin looks very pretty and soft, if I would recommend it.
i have been using this item too as well 5 days in a row and i love this heavy moisture feeling. i use this at work since i work as night shift nurse and my skin loves it.
Love it you wake up and your skin is so amazing bright and soft

When this company unveiled this product, I was beyond extatic. Ive been using YTTP products for a little while now and also have been looking for the perfect overnight mask. So when I saw this I knew I had to immediately get it. First Impressions, I fell in love with this product. I have oily/ combination and acne prone skin, the texture is super dreamy, its very lightweight on the skin and also does not transfer to your pillow case, which was a huge worry point for me. I woke up the next morning with almost immediate results, my skin was soft, glowy and supple. After a week of use I also noticed that it was starting to even ou my skin tone, which is an incredible need for me since I suffer from acne scarring and post acne pigmentation. I full heartedly recommend this product if you deal with the same skin issues that I do. You will not regret the purchase.

review_title: great texture and absorption for a leave-on mask
review_text: A little goes a long way. Feels great on your skin and doesn’t rub off like some overnight masks do. Skin looks noticeable softer and hydrated in the morning.

review_title: great texture and absorption for a leave-on mask
review_text: A little goes a long way. Feels great on your skin and doesn’t rub off like some overnight masks do. Skin looks noticeable softer and hydrated in the morning.
This product is so amazing- extremely hydrating and my face feels so soft when I wake up in the morning!

I love this product!!! It’s become a staple in my nighttime routine. I switched to this line of products about 3 weeks ago - didn’t experience any kind of break out or skin scream from adjusting my routine abruptly. I could see a vast improvement after only a week. My morning moisturizer is the Saturday Skin (also amazing). I also use a lip mask, the YTP serum and the YTP eye cream at night. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

This is a really great product. I received a deluxe sample of this with a recent order and have used it about a week. I use it as my last step and I feel like it “seals” in my skincare, but it does not feel like a coating. It soaks in and feels protective. Love it and will be purchasing a full size!

I looovvvee this mask! Ive been using it for over a month now, and I held off on writing a review because it too me a bit to figure out how to use it in a way that was best for my skin. When you wake up after wearing it you are seriously glowing! But unfortunately for me, I can easily overdue it. I have semi sensitive skin, so if I use it too frequently or put on too much at a time, I feel like it might cause a zit or two. So I love to use this mask once a week or so, or even add a bit of it to my regular moisturize. The smell is great and for reals...you wake up and can tell the difference immediately! Dry girls dream.

This product deserves all the positive reviews it received. I wasn’t looking to add to my skincare regimen, but bc I’m a skincare heaux, I found this and immediately loved it. Rich cream, very moisturizing, a little goes a long way, wake up with very hydrated skin. Leaves no stickiness, works well for oily skin. Def a product you didn’t realize you needed until you try it.

review_title: It really is a dream come true...
review_text: For the past few months I have been on the search for the perfect night moisturizer. I have tried several other brands all of which were either too sticky to sleep with, aggravated my redness, stung, itched, or smelled awful. However, I finally struck gold with this mask. It smells divine, is super (and I mean super) hydrating, goes on like a dream (pun intended), is not sticky and does not aggravate my skin at all. I hope this make this product forever because I use it every night and within the first few days started to enjoy less dry, patchy skin, fewer breakouts (probably caused by other night masks), and smoother skin for makeup application in the morning. I cannot praise this product enough.
I have been using this product for a month now, I have noticed my face is more hydrated and seems to have a healthy glow . I love it

This has amazing moisturizing and brightening ingredients, smells like a fruit pie combined with a Lush store, and sinks in (pillow safe!) within a few minutes. It’s a joy to put on, but also gives real results! I’m certain any skin type would truly enjoy this.

What I love the most about YTTP is that all their products work for any skin type and can easily be incorporated in your existing skin care routine or it’s a great brand to start if you’re looking to start a skin routine.  I’ve been using this instead of a sheet mask and I like that I am not dripping in goop and I am not throwing out a lot of garbage. This mask is better than any sheet mask! It’s great for once a week or daily use.  I love their updated formulas of vitamin C and hyaluronic acid used in this. Heart eyed emoji’s all around!

This product has been a lifesaver during Winter. I’ve been really struggling with dry skin for the first time and this mask is a must in my nightly routine now. The texture of the mask is super creamy and absorbs into my skin so nicely - You really don’t need much to get the full effect. By the time I wake up in the morning, my face feels hydrated and fresh. I’m obsessed!!

LOVE! Let me start off by saying I worked in cosmetics for 12 years and have tried pretty much everything and YTTP has won as my absolute fave skin brand. So it was a no brainer wanting to try their newest product. When I first received this mask my skin was looking rough. I had some little breakout bumps and redness so I was hesitant to start using it, but I just went for it. The product goes on thick - it’s a mask not a normal face cream but absorbs perfectly through the night. When I woke up the first day my skin was plump and sooo soft! I used it for 2 weeks and my skin is so soft, redness is gone, bumps gone, and any little flaky spots are fully hydrated. My one heads up would be the product smells so delicious, but if your sensitive to smell then use just a little. It’s fragrance free but the natural ingredients smell like berry happiness.  I will for sure keep using this product! It makes me feel like I can not wear makeup again on the weekend and still have a really even bright complection! Love this super product!
Loving this new mask! Very light and buttery- great for hydrating skin especially in the middle of winter. Also love how clean all of YTTP’s products are!

review_title: Best winter moisturizer for dehydrated skin
review_text: Love love love this mask! it makes my skin so smooth and works well over any oil or moisturizer. i’ve started using this during the day because of how plush is feels on my skin. It’s still too early to tell if there are any long term improvements for hyper pigmentation but i’m excited to keep using it because of how nice my skin looks and feels. i’ve tried other sleeping masks and none of them give the same result as this one. my apartment is very dry and hot and even though i’m oily this really helps to balance and sooth the effects of winter and bad sleeping environments does on my skin. makeup also sits nicely over this!

Thisnis basically the only mask I’ve ever used that actually produced a visible result. Skin smooth as butter after and actually less red. Result fades fast though unfortunately. Haven’t seen any long term benefit

This looked and does work the same as The Ordinary AHA 30% + BHA 2% Peeling Solution. But this is an expensive price What is confusing on the box of “how to use“ didn’t add new users never used anything peeling solution should use for 10 mins, but in the package it said. With The Ordinary AHA 30% + BHA 2% Peeling Solution it said “Leave on for no more than 10 minutes.“ and for this “Leave on for 20 minutes“ which is quite long for a mask/peeling solution.
This burned my skin and smelled horrible - would definitely not recommend

review_title: really amazing; don’t leave on for very long
review_text: This makes my skin look absolutely incredible. I use this once a week and leave on for 10 minutes. In my opinion 15-20 minutes is way too long. I did that once (and I’m used to chemical exfoliation) and my skin peeled for a solid week. Even with 10 minutes, my skin is bit flaky the next day but I just buff my face with a towel the following night and my skin looks incredible the following morning. Kind of a tricky product to get right, but for me it’s worth it. I bought this myself.

my skin has no particular concerns. but when a friend gave this to me as an x mas present, I decided to try it. well, it stung horribly. I know that that’s normal, and I kept it on for half the recommended time as a result. I tried this a few times over a few weeks, and my skin keeps getting worse. dry and textured. I’m going to stop using this and hope my skin goes back to normal.
I was nervous to try this but a friend talked my through it. I was not prepared for the feeling of the mask but I adjusted to it and feel so rejuvenated when I use the oil. Worth the money!

I have never broken out so bad in my entire life. I have normal to dry skin that is generally pretty clear. I am currently covered in red itchy and painful pimples all over my face, in places I have never had acne before like my cheeks and chin. Severely disappointed as I love my moisturizer from this brand but this was the worst reaction I’ve ever had to skincare.

I got this product in a sample size using my Sephora points and I LOVED it! I use a product with similar active ingredients from the ordinary which I really like. However, with this one the next morning I woke up to flawless skin and I praise this product for it. I’m not sure I will actually buy the full size as the price tag is too much for my budget but I’m going to keep a look out for samples and rewards.

I’ve been wanting to try this mask for a long time and decided to make the $80 purchase. I’m a fan of the polypeptide Protini moisturizer as well as the C-Firma.I regularly use retinol, vitamin c and AHAs/BHAs so don’t consider my skin to be sensitive. Upon application there was definitely a  strong tingling that lasted about a minute and then dissipated. I washed off after 20 minutes then used Tula moisturizer along with the Marula oil that was included. My skin felt so soft and looked clear and bright. I didn’t like the TLC framboos but really enjoyed this mask and will continue to use. You really only need a small amount, I applied with a brush.

This is my 2nd purchase of this mask.  I’m 59 & my face is smooth, brighter & softer than ever!!  I highly recommend!!  It is one skin care product that I can’t live without!!  I did begin slow.  First week 5 minutes, etc. & worked up to 20 minutes just to be safe.  It did slightly feel like it was burning at first, but went away quickly.  Your skin will love you!!
Wonderful product, does tingle slightly at first but leaves skin feeling nice.
It actually works! Worth the splurge! I have been using it for more than a year on and off and love it!

review_title: Good Product but the packaging is defective!
review_text: I’ve brought this masks twice and both times the pump has broken off inside the bottle; making it impossible to get the product out. I thought it only had two uses in it until I open it and saw the bottom part of the pump broken inside. It’s hard to beat the product out. So it basically end up being a waste of $80. Please change the packaging!

2.5 stars, for the Marula oil which is a nice, really pure, clear as glass consistency oil that soaks in like a dream... and the pinky size bottle seems to never run out. The baby facial though is so not worth the hype. I have normal type skin and am South Asian by background - I’ve been doing chickpea flour masks for a long time. You don’t need this facial to get the same effect you can get by just simple using a bag of $6 chickpea flour. It also burns more than I’d prefer, the glycolic acid content is way to high to be good for normal 30year old skin. I can see this potentially working for people with combo and oily skin as it is very purifying. Then again, since before my grandma’s my family has been using the chickpea face mask trick and it doesn’t come with this price tag. I do applaud DE for using generation tested ingredients and techniques and will try some of their other products.

review_title: Lovely Mini Set but not enough product to Trial
review_text: Lovely packaging but not enough product to get real results. This particular mini set is overpriced for such a small amount. Better to go for a set with larger items or just get the full sizes and give it a real longer term trial.

OBSESSED!!! I noticed how powerful this mask is after just one use. I have dull skin, and feel like I am losing elasticity. After literally my first use with this my skin was GLOWING and I woke up the next day with cheeks feeling like a baby’s bottom. This is the best aha/bha mask I’ve used and I use it religiously (every Sunday night LOL). Worth the money for sure!
I love this mask.  It makes my skin feel amazing Skin is so so soft after using. adding some  marula oil after just tops it off! I think this is one of the best products they make
I do like this product. Besides being expensive. It does work good. Be careful if you have sensitive or reactive skin, which it does warn about. But overall it’s a good one.

I really wanted to love this product and contemplated for months about buying it only to be disappointed. DE claims to be gentle enough to cause no skin irritation but this is not the case. I used this product alone for quite some time and still experienced REALLY bad facial burns. However, it does make my skin baby soft and smooth so...two stars.

Babyfacial was my second DE purchase and it is easily my favorite product! It’s definitely my Sunday routine. Exfoliates my skin and makes my fave look and feel as smooth as a baby’s butt. I put on some DE Marula oil after for that nice dewy glow!

This stuff is the best! I’ve tried the version from The Ordinary and like that one, too, but this is my favorite. It’s expensive but you definitely can tell a difference. Because of the cost I tend to rotate every other week with The Ordinary, but if cost weren’t an issue I’d buy this exclusively. It’s my Sunday night weekly ritual to do my facial and I love how my skin looks and feels after I use this.
Incredibly smooth skin!  Cleared acne almost overnight. Ordering more and trying the serums daily in between next.  Probably the best product we ever tried!
Baby soft skin! Slight burn when first put on so I only left it on for 10 mins to test but I love this product & will do the full 20 next week. Def worth the coins! Splurge sis, you deserve it ;)

review_title: Love the results, hate the bottle
review_text: I love/hate this product. Why I love it -I love the results it gives, it definitely leaves your skin feeling baby smooth like you just had a facial. It tingles a little at first as expected with a peel, so I recommend to just fan your face to cool it down and it will feel better after a few minutes. Why I hate it (and the reason for the three stars)- I cant tell if I got a defected container or it’s just how it is. I read multiple reviews of how the push bottle is broken easily or won’t push out more product after a couple uses and I agree it’s hard to know if it’s broken or just out of product. I’ve only used Thai product twice, the first time I was able to get three pumps of product just fine. The second time, I had to pump it like 15 times and barely got anything out of it. For the price, it’s not worth it if you can only use it 2-3 times. I don’t think it’s empty since the bottle says it contains 1.69 oz, but it’s very difficult to pump out the product, and impossible to open the bottle to get it out manually. I’m on the fence of returning this item since I love the results but I’m afraid of wasting almost $80 on unused product I can’t use.

I’ve used this once and I already have noticed such an improvement in my skin. I have very oily sensitive/acne prone skin and this has been such a help in clearing up the bumps on my forehead, improving my skin texture, bringing brightness back into my skin, and evening out my skin. I found the tingling sensation to be very minor and barely noticeable. Left my skin feeling incredibly smooth!

I was so wanting this to work after seeing all the great reviews, but it did basically nothing for my skin. My skin feels nice after but it did not help bring down breakouts or help resurface my scarred skin. NOT worth the money. For context: I use a lot of peels and a strong face wash on my skin for my acne and acne scarring and I think my skin may be too used to these treatments and this wasn’t strong enough or something.Farmacy’s Honeymoon Glow is a better investment and you can see results the next day after using it.

I love DE and I’m really gluten sensitive with my Celiac so I switched all products to this line. My mom got me this mask as a gift and it’s probably my favorite in the collection. Never have I used a product that gave me results so quickly! It burns and itches a bit the first time you use it but after that, the burn was either minimal or gone all together. I’m assuming it’s due to the active shedding of dead skin. I can literally see my skin tighten after a few minutes with it on and once rinsed, the firmness sticks and my skin is brighter. My skin is a smidge irritable right after removal and I highly recommend SPF moisturizer (DE Umbra is amazing) because it’s like a mini skin peel. Seriously, the sensitivity part is really only prominent the first time or 2 and I promise you will absolutely love the results. If you are on the fence about this product, just do it. You won’t be disappointed!

This product is amazing, but i give it four stars because its soooo freakin pricey! It definitely gets the job done but my sensitive skin can only stand about 3 minutes before it becomes unbearable. Do yourself a favor and SERIOUSLY research AHAs, BHAs, and PHAs before purchasing such strong products and use at your estheticians, dermatologists, or favorite skincare youtuber’s recommendation. These chemicals are great but super powerful and can potentially harm you if not handled under advisement and serious research.
I seem to be in minority in that I did not like this mask. Didn’t seem to do much

I love this so much! I use it once a week before bed, and it gives me the smoothest face. Great if you feel that your skin is clogged or dull and needs a pick me up! It does tingle a little bit for a few seconds after application, but nothing crazy. Have recommended this to several friends.

Loved the mask but after couple of use the pump broke. There is lot left in bottle but you cant put your fingers in to scoop it as opening is too narrow. 2 star is just for packaging but I like the product. Its 80$ product after all. Could come up with better packaging.
Works!  This plows through dead skin cells and renews a fresh layer of glowing skin.  Stings briefly then stops

This mask is POTENT. I only leave it on for 20m per application (set a timer), and the next day my face looks brand new. I apply once a week on Sundays, one time I tried twice a week and my skin came out looking waxy and strange, but switching to once a week has been ideal. I also, strangely, love the smell. This is an essential for me.

This is a pretty good mask, I think. I can’t say that it’s done wonders for my skin, but it did seem to make my skin look nice after each use. I think if I used it more consistently, maybe at least once a week, it’d probably have better lasting results. I’d consider rebuying this.

I was so hesitant to buy this product because of the price point and I was unsure of its effectiveness because I have pretty good skin with no acne problems. This product is a miracle product. Truly! My face hasn’t felt this soft since I was a baby. I cannot stop touching it! I am absolutely blown away after just one use. I never write reviews. Ever. But this product is too good to not rave about! I texted my friends immediately and 3 ordered on the spot!
Amazing. Used weekly it will change the texture of your skin. Holy grail mask!

review_title: Years of acne scars slowly disappearing!!!
review_text: As a teenager I didn’t do the right things for the skin. Didn’t use sunscreen, removed my makeup every night, or ate a good diet. So I had pretty bad acne. And when I did caked it with more make up. Then as an adult the damage has already been done no matter much water I drank or how much I washed my face. Just using this once a week  or two weeks now. I can see a HUGE difference in the acne scars on my face. Still have some on my cheeks but their much better that I just use light powdered foundation. I love this product. I’m addicted to all of the Drunk Elephant products!!! A forever costumer out of me!!

review_title: Can’t wait to buy full size!
review_text: I got a little baby tube sample of this stuff a while ago and was excited to use it because I loved Drunk Elephant’s lala cream so much. I put it on generously all over my face and it started to BURN a couple minutes in. I have sensitive skin so I washed the product off immediately and threw the tube in a drawer thinking I’d most likely never use it again. Months later, I got curious and decided to try it again. I’ve recently moved to a different state and my skin is not used to the environment so it hasn’t been at its best. I applied a thinner layer of this all over my face and SECONDS after applying, I felt the burn of the product again. I got a little scared but decided to wait the 20 minutes (the burning stopped after 3 min) and washed it off. My skin has never felt smoother!  I usually have VERY LARGE pores on my nose and around  my nose but hours after using this mask, they had vanished! I can’t wait to keep using this product and keep seeing the result.

Adding this to my skincare routine has been a game changer to my face’s texture and complexion! It definitely tingled for the first couple of wears, but my skin in noticeably smoother and more even. I followed up with the recommended marula oil and I have had no sensitivity issues or reactions. Love this stuff! I definitely only use it once a week or every 2 weeks- I feel like it would be a bit harsh any more than that on my sensitive skin
My skin gets better every time I use it! I use once per week.

this stuff lives up to all the hype. my skin is so soft as the tingle feeling was not nearly as bad as anticipated. definitely worth the results given. the marula oil is merely a bonus. buy now!! you won’t regret it!! promise.....

Yes, this is pricey, but I will be buying again. I’ve used it twice; first time I left on for one hour and the second time I left it on over night. I have a lot of red on my nose where it is broken and sticks out. After the first use the redness was noticably better!! My skin was super soft, looked more clear/even and my pores shrunk substantially!! I’m not sure if the people who didn’t notice a difference had nearly perfect skin already, this has done so much for me in two uses!

So I absolutely love Drunk Elephant and their products have changed my skin game. I think it’s really important to highlight though to use this product EXACTLY as directed. The formula is super powerful and you will more than likely feel some tingling when you apply. My skin is always brighter and clearer after my once a week use. I like to follow with a overnight mask and I wake up to glowing skin.

I’ve been using Sukari Baby Facial for 2 years. This is one of three products that I cannot live without. It feels like a professional enzyme mask/peel. It tingles for a reason, it is working. After, the results are visible - my skin looks smoother, glowing.

Exactly what other rewievs are saying, destroyd my skin with stubborn horrible breakouts everytime I used it in the areas I have never broke out before,  uggh gotta spend 10 times more money now to rescue my skin ;(

I got a free sample of this and have only used twice but am impressed. Probably gonna purchase the full size. I love masks - the whole experience is fun, relaxing and feels more special than just the chore of washing my face. This one got my attention straight away: upon opening the little sample tube a blob just forcefully quirted out onto my marble countertop. I wiped it up immediately but it still managed to etch the surface. While I’m am not happy about the etching, it’s not in a noticeable place so I’m over it. After seeing how strong it was, I was a little scared (but also kinda excited) to put it on my face. It only tingled, no burning. Results were pretty instant - skin was super soft, bright and glowy. My goal is to get rid of some sun damage/dark spots and I think this might do the trick.

Like all of the DE products that I use, this one is top shelf. It did not irritate my skin at all.  It DID leave my 50-something skin bright and happy--what more can I ask for?  I only use it a couple times per week, as my skin is sensitive.

I was very skeptical to try this product due to my sensitive skin, but the lady convinced me to try it. After purchasing this product I had a horrible reaction to a new serum, which caused me to break out in sooo many little white heads all over face. (Was so bad) I waited about 2 days to try this so my skin wouldn’t be so sensitive and wow!!! It really does leave your skin baby soft! I have never felt my skin so smooth before and the next morning all my little zits are close to gone!! Really amazing product, just wish it didn’t break the bank, but it should last a while !

my skin has never felt so good! i have combination to oily skin. it worked really well for me.i thought a lot before buying this, since it’s very expensive. but now i can see what the hype is all about. this works! does tingle a bit so people with very sensitive skin my feel it more, but for me it wasn’t something my skin couldn’t handle so am happy! bp

This works really well as a once or twice a week facial to get rid of dead skin. Doesn’t dry out or have irritating result. It also adds a tangy taste to my food when I try to eat with this mask on. Would not recommend to be consumed in large quantities though.

I used an entire bottle of this and then switched to a different chemical exfoliant mask. I just finished that one and am DEFINITELY switching back to this!! This one helped with smoothness, acne scarring, general acne, it’s a TRUE miracle worker!! BUY THIS! You won’t regret it!

review_title: wanted to love, but was too harsh
review_text: I really wanted to love this product, because I really like most products from this line, but it was just too harsh for my sensitive skin. My skin is oily and has a lot of redness. I tried this once a month for several months, and every time, it would cause me to break out and my skin would be irritated for days afterwards. Just not for me I guess.

smooth as a baby’s bottom... the strongest exfoliating mask I have ever tried. A blend of AHAs and BHAs. As recommended, I used once a week. Definitely helped with texture and clarity and brightening! When i first used this mask, there was a very strong tingling sensation, almost borderline burning. If you don’t use exfoliating acids, I wouldn’t start off with this. The concentrations are too high. Almost professional grade. That being said, it is a favorite of mine! And it does what it says! My go-to once a week “professional“ chemical exfoliation mask.

Awesome mask! Each time I use it I notice an immediate improvement in my skin. It can sting a little sometimes but it’s not bad. It really attacks acne blemishes immediately, drying them out then flaking away after rinsing the mask off. It’s smoothing and leaves such a softness and glow.
I don’t know if I had a bad product but I felt absolutely nothing when I put this on my face. After reading the reviews, I thought for sure I was going to feel some tingling.

I finally purchased this and I have no regrets! This really has made a difference in my skin! This and practically all the DE products have transformed my skin - less breakouts, glowy skin, smoother skin. I waited a while to buy this because the DE products are pricey, but once I tried this for the first time, I was hooked. So glad I invested in this product and all DE products!

review_title: Most incredible mask I’ve ever used!!
review_text: I’ve honestly never tried a mask as good as this. This is the third time I’ve used it and every single time it has taken away all unevenness/roughness (especially on my nose) and redness throughout my skin. I’m so incredibly impressed. I’ve never take  a mask off and my skin immediately felt such a HUGE difference in my skin. It feels like a baby’s butt I swear. YOU. NEED. THIS. I promise it’s worth the money

This product really works!! I got a sample of this with enough to use for two different times, and all I can say is WOW, did I see a difference after just one use. It looked as if I just had a peel done..outstanding results leaving your skin phenomenally smooth!  I definitely plan on purchasing.
I really like this product. I do feel like my skin tends to break out a few days after use. besides the breakouts I love how this makes my skin super soft and refreshed.
I like it but it makes my skin red for about 1h after use it. Now I only keep it 10-13 mins and redness is less but still present. Maybe it s just not for my skin.
Love it!!!!  Skin is super smooth

I have the entire DE line and this is one of my favorites. I use it every Sunday like most DE junkies and it is helping huge with my sun damage and uneven skin tone. The morning after my skin is glowing and baby soft. I’ll never stray from this line as long as they stick to being clean and produce beautiful formulas.

I had never tried a product like this before. After the second week of me using this, my acne scars were diminishing completely. It feels like tiny needles are stabbing my skin, but the results are worth it.

I bought this because of the stellar reviews on here and from Sephora employees, but I don’t think I’ve noticed one change. It tingles immediately so i assumed it was going something, but nothing noticeable. Maybe it’s broken me out more, but my skin is so back and forth, it is hard to tell, but looking back, it could be the catalyst. I expected it (I had super high expectations for the same reasons y’all did) to wipe out my really bad and stubborn blackheads, but naw. I feel like maybe it’s helped with cleaning out the small ones. It is super thick so you have to use quite a bit for it to spread evenly. Thankfully, I bought the mini that was sold briefly for $28.

Ok I was nervous at first buying this product my skin is hella sensitive and I get really bad acne I mean the cystic kind and the small hormonal kind. And I have really bad pores and blackheads. The first time I used this I was shocked how soft my skin felt. I didn’t use this on my chin area because of my bad acne. The second time I used it I decided what the heck let’s try it on my entire face. I only had 2 bad cystic pimples. My face was so red after BUT after putting on the Marula oil like they suggest the next morning I woke up and holy shizz my skin looked amazing and my pores had reduced! now when Sunday’s come I can’t wait to use this!! Thank you drunk elephant!

review_title: Nice product, but not a miracle.
review_text: With all of the glowing reviews, I guess that I was expecting this to be more of a miracle product. It definitely has nice features. My skin looks very clean and is very smooth the morning after I use it. I don’t feel like it’s doing very much to shrink my pore size, though, and I haven’t seen a huge difference in lightening my dark spots. It’s helped, yes. I guess I expected more for the price. It takes 3 pumps for me for 1 use (1 pump each for my cheeks and forehead), and I hope I get enough uses to make the price worth it. There is no way to estimate how much product is left. I probably won’t re-buy, but I have been enjoying it.

There’s powerful acids at work here to do the magic. Ladies, respect the instructions! I had to slather on heavy duty ointment and cream after my overzealous 2-days-in-a-row applications. It healed and now I’m happily back on the Babyfacial bandwagon. Yes it’s expensive. But it works. I’m buying it during the Appreciation Sale.

review_title: This has taken 20 years off of my face.
review_text: This is my first review despite the fact that I order from Sephora constantly. OMG, this stuff is amazing. I tend to use really high quality skin care stuff (skin medica, rx tretinoids, skinbetter, etc). This stuff is AMAZING. It has taken 20 years off my skin in just a few days. I am 44 but I have the skin of a 25 year old. I have no visible pores, my skin is smooth, dewy and glowy. It’s crazy. It says to only use it a few times a week and not with retinols. However I have pretty thick and non sensitive skin so I’ve been using it morning and night and with retinols with no ill effects. This is worth the price, definitely!

Honestly at first I was a little disappointed. I have done the Dr Dennis Gross peels and those you see results immediately and definitely the morning after. Especially on blemishes. The first time I used this, my face felt a little softer - nothing major - and not really any other difference on blemishes or my skin in general. I was afraid that since I have used a fair amount of acid exfoliants that I had too much of a tolerance and that all the good reviews were from more acid inexperienced people. But then in the next 12-48 hours my skin just kept getting better. Texture, clarity, brightness. Most importantly, it started budging some of the small numerous bumps on my forehead that I have thrown every treatment at. That was huge for me and made me so happy! So in short, if you need a quick result for a burgeoning pimple go with something else (I’ve had good luck with the Dr DG extra strength daily peels) but if you want long term total improvement of your skin, go for this.
This has been great for me.  My pores are more refined after using and my skin is clearer.

review_title: The only facial you’ll ever need !!!!
review_text: I love how thick and creamy this product goes on initially. Within the first three minutes after application I could feel a slight tingle. Within the next five minutes the tingling went away. As the mask started to dry I could feel it start to tighten. After twenty minutes I washed it off and my skin instantly felt smoother and looked brighter ! This is my new holy grail !!!

It washes off easily, and it gives my complexion a glow. It seems to even out my skin tone, and my pores/dark spots have minimized and lightened up. I would highly recommend this product, although if you truly have very sensitive skin, i would suggest trying out a sample first. My skin is slightly sensitive, and while the burn is a bit uncomfortable, it still subsides fast enough that i don’t mind. But for someone with very sensitive skin, that burn my be too uncomfortable to bear.

I have access to a wide array of skincare products such as SkinCeuticals, Revision Skincare, Babor, etc. Although I love those products, this stuff surpasses any product that I have used from either of those expensive brands. I think what I love the most about this product is the fact that it doesn’t irritate my skin. Usually, anything with glycolic acid causes me to peel significantly. This stuff does not. When first putting it on I will feel a bit tingly in certain spots on my face, but it doesn’t last for more than a few seconds. I got this stuff because the reviews for it are very good and thus I felt the impulse to buy it. (oops). I am glad I did! I have a lot of hyper pigmentation(caused by acne spots that refuse to take their color with them after clearing up) and this stuff has dramatically reduced those spots. I notice that it has also brightened my skin FAST. I notice the brightening effect immediately. I have used it only 3 times and having noticed such significant effects this quickly, I can’t imagine what my skin will look like in one month. Says you can use it up to twice a week. I did that and my skin handled it, but I was a bit red after using it for the second time in a week. Thankfully, the redness cleared up by morning. A little side note: I mainly wanted to try this to get rid of my stubborn areas where I am clogged. I don’t have blackheads, but I have these clogged small pimples on my forehead and around my mouth. This stuff has seriously helped so much. My skin is much much smoother since using this. Also, it helps to get rid of my occasional cystic acne quickly.Sometimes I will end up with a white head, or sometimes the pimple shrinks and disappears. Either way it helps get rid of it!  Don’t fret about the price tag, you get what you pay for! This stuff is worth it, and you don’t need to use a lot.

review_text: I’m middle-aged with middle-aged skin, so I am always on the hunt for products that will plump up and hydrate my skin. Enter B-Hydra - a very light cream-textured serum that layers perfectly with my other nighttime skincare to give just that little more oomph of hydration. Love it!!
This product works, but it feels sticky to me. I have combo skin, so it’s not a necessary step for me— but it is nice for dry patches in the winter.

review_title: product wouldn’t come out after minutes of pumping
review_text: I’m not able to accurately review this product efficacy I received to try because after 10 minutes of pumping, no product came out. I tried everything, opening and closing and wasn’t even able to pry the top off easily to bypass the pump mechanism. Very disappointed in the package design.

This B-Hydra product is my favorite from the Influenster box that I received. The serum has a great texture and leaves my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed. The consistency makes it so I don’t have to use too much product to spread across my entire face and neck. It doesn’t have much of a scent, which I appreciate.The packaging is adorable and keeps me from overdispensing the product. I do wish there was some kind of indicator to show when you’re almost finished with the product.

I. Love. This. Serum! This serum is on thicker side than I’m used to and I was not sure how hydrating it would be. Boy, was I wrong! I used this two different ways (it’s been 4 days since I started). One was to use this after I apply C-Firma and the other way was to mix C-Firma and B-Hydra together before I apply. I was not super crazy about “mixing” them but did it anyway because that’s what DE suggested. I found mixing them together works a little better. It allows me to apply both product evenly because there is more to spread! It does leave residue but I see that as a good thing because it makes me feel like my skin is hydrated and makes my makeup application easier. Oh, and smell is very subtle, almost undetectable if any which is a plus. It is pricy for how much it has but I feel like I don’t have to use as much because I mix it with C-Firma now. I need to see the result when I finish the bottle but I’m leaning towards to purchasing a bottle in the future.

review_title: a love letter to good hydration
review_text: Absolutely adore this product! I mix it in the mornings with my c-firma to give me a little extra hydration without turning my face into an oilfield. It’s perfect! I haven’t even grabbed for my Kiehl’s moisturizer after my routine since I started using this. I use half of the recommended amount, I’ve never had a product go so far, they definitely give you value for the price. I noticed an almost immediate improvement in hydration. My skin is so lush it minimized my pores, and together with the c-firma it makes the perfect one-two punch to fight sun damage and pores. I love this product!

I have been using this product for about a week now, every morning along with the C-firma, umbra sheer and shada serum. The packaging is really cute and fun to use. My skin feels really soft, moisturized and looks plump and bright. The only reason I haven’t given it 5 stars is because of the scent-I don’t like it while applying but once it is on it doesn’t bother me. Still recommend! For reference, my skin is dry now in the winter when I am trying it (and oily in summertime)

review_title: Great, IF you use a moisturizer with it!
review_text: I made sure to read many of the reviews before using this. I have again skin that is somewhat dry and am always looking for a serum to work as hard as a moisturizer on my “makeup days“. This , however, really needs a moisturizer over it. It soaks in quickly and then I can apply a moisturizer that I will need (depending on the day, season, etc). On its own, my skin does not feel hydrated and plump during the day. I wouldn’t repurchase for the above reasons and the price is way too much.  I received this free from Influenster for testing purposes but the  options expressed are my own.

A moisturizer that feeds my skin, while easing any concerns with product ingredients. Used daily under my serum, it absorbs immediately, requiring no wait-time for makeup application. While lightweight and refreshing. Despite being free of perfumes, it smells lovely. Appreciate the Drunk Elephant’s mission of skin health! Thanks Influenster

B-Hyrda is great for oily skin, which is what I have. Love using the product in my morning skincare routine.  My skin feels hydrated and not greasy underneath my makeup. Would highly recommend to anyone with oily skin, and I have got many friends and family using B-Hydra as well.

My very dry skin has been so much better since incorporating this serum into my everyday skincare routine! It adds a boost of hydration that really helps keep my face supple. I notice that when I focus on keeping my skin hydrated, it looks less dull and my fine lines are also less noticeable. I use B-hydra as part of my morning routine, I like to use it before applying Lala or Umbra, and also find that D-Bronzi mixes very nicely with it.  I definitely recommend this to everyone without a doubt.

I’m combination skin so I am dry and oily so for me this product works. it goes on very nicely it is a little sticky but once I mix it or layer it with protini or even the ashwagandha from youth to the people it keeps my skin soft and really hydrated for most of the day. I don’t like sprays too much because of how your face is left wet for a while (although it does feel refreshing on a hot day). compared to a serum where you have to massage the product into the skin. I highly reccomend this for ALL skin types. hydration is what’s going to help with balancing your sebum production so that way you can appear less oily and/or dry.

I used to have pretty acne prone skin, but after tons of Sunday Riley, Herbivore (lapis oil), and other amazing items I switched from the C.E.O brightening serum... I’m disappointed to say the least. The C.E.O is much more of a velvet feel, as opposed to a gel?

This is a nice serum. A bit overpriced, but you get a fair amount of product and it does last a while. I don’t like that you can’t see how much you have left to gauge when you need to restock though. I have sensitive skin and this helps provide some hydration without any irritation. I like that there isn’t fragrance or a bunch or unnecessary ingredients. It isn’t life changing but it’s a good product for what it is. I’ll definitely be repurchasing once I run out.

Like a splash of water for your skin. Really helps with dehydrated skin whether you are oily, dry, or acne prone. I find this actually helps soothe breakouts as well.I recommend topping this off with a moisturizer as it is very hydrating but a moisturizer will seal it in.

I’ve come back to this after not using it for a while. The description that its a ’cool drink of water’ is accurate! I just feel like its hydratiion that my skin is drinking up. It dries really fast and is a nice way to get some hydration without using anything heavy. It’s one of my favorites for summertime, and is great to use over other serums to lock them in, especially since it dries so nicely. I’m not sure if this would totally replace a moisturizer, especially depending on what other products you are using and your skin type.

review_title: So hydrating, Your dry skin will thank you
review_text: This was a surprising product. I got it as a mini and then went ahead and purchased the full size and I loveeeeee it. I have dry skin and this along with any cream works so beautifully. it instantly feels hydrating. I think this is my favorite so far from drunk elephant.  I wish the prices were a little more affordable. My skin loves the Dunk elephant line, but because of the prices I have to keep waiting for the Sale to purchase and even then its pricey
I use this morning and night and I love it! It’s not heavy and it’s really helpful because I use a topical retinoids for acne and doesn’t block my pores!
I mix it with all their products

This is perfect on it’s own but spectacular when combined with other products, especially DE products. I mix it with a-passioni DE retinol at night  and d-bronzi  in the mornings (both of which are too much on their own for my sensitive, fair skin). Hydrating, lightweight, multi-purposed. It’s a staple in my routine.
I love this product! I have oily skin but this gives me the hydration I need without making me oilier or disrupting my makeup once I applied, and I’ve noticed my skin looks more plump and healthier.

I wouldn’t say it’s ultra hydrating. I have normal to dry skin and I def can’t use this product by itself like other serums I’ve used in the past. For sure this needs to be paired with other products.

Worth every penny. I’m someone with incredibly acne prone sensitive pale skin. Using hydrating anti-aging products would break me out, but not this serum! My skin texture went from rough and bumpy to smooth with tight pores!

Moisturizing without being heavy. Having combination skin means I have to be particular with what products I use in the day. This was not only moisturizing but also didn’t cause any excess oil production. Skin feels amazing after use, and absorbs great!
Honestly not bad but could be better. I find that it does add hydration but I feel like it’s not intensive. I still need to put a layer of oil in order to feel moisturizing enough.

I’ve become such a DE fan in the last month. Everything I have tried has blown me away and this B-Hydra is no different! I use it in the mornings mixed with the Ole Henrikson Vitamin C serum and I find it adds that perfect boost of hydration to my dry, sensitive skin. I only use one pump and feel this will last me quite a while. Drunk Elephant can take all my money, not only do the products work how they say they will, the packaging is adorable too!
Not a bad product for moisture, but in the winter I would consider something a little heavier such as the Protini or Lala Retro. I will be giving this another go in the summer time!
Received in a Play by Sephora box. Awesome, was a wonderful addition to my skincare routine.
Have been using for 2 days and can tell a difference in my skin already!! Very supply and smooth af

review_title: feels so good on my. face
review_text: Love this as a face lotion. My face feels so fresh and clean after use.

Absorbs fast and non sticky. Works very well under makeup. I usually put it right after copper peptides or vitamin c and before moisturizers in the morning. This and NIOD’s MMHC2 are my favorite hydration serums

review_title: The best mosturizer I have ever used.
review_text: I never write reviews for products but for this, I had to. This is the best moisturizer I have ever used. I mix it with the drunk elephant face oil. I have very dry, itchy skin and this product gets the job done perfectly. I am so happy that I found this product.
I mix this in to my day and night moisturizer. it is light but very hydrating. Very clean and effective.

review_title: A little goes a long way with this powerhouse!
review_text: Hello, hydration!  This might possibly be my favorite from Drunk Elephant-- I use B-Hydra with everything!  It definitely keeps my skin looking nice and soft and even.  I tend to get very oily, but my skin seems more balanced these days.  When I use B-Hydra, I swear it really does lock in the benefits of whichever serum or oil I might be using.  Once I apply, within moments, everything seems to sink in -- I don’t feel greasy at all.  I tend to use B-Hydra most with Drunk Elephant’s C-Firma and a few small drops of oil.  I originally purchased the small size and recently graduated to the larger size-- worth every penny.   They tiniest bit goes a long way.  LOVE IT!
This is a great moisturizer. Lightweight.

Skin always feels a bit dry after putting this on, although I like how quickly it is absorbed and doesn’t leave skin feeling greasy. But isn’t as hydrating as the name suggests, and I have noticed the odd break out anytime I use this product.

review_title: A lot goes a little way.
review_text: You have to use so much of this to really feel hydrated. Drunk Elephant products are always such a disappointment.
Don’t believe that hype. Your buying great marketing and cute packaging. There is nothing hydrating about this product. NOTHING. TRied their protini cream and that broke me out. Over it.

I had been battling dry, flaky skin for months. I had tried every remedy possible, but my skin was still just flaking off which was gross and annoying. Finally, I went into Sephora and was purchasing another product, and this was left by someone at the checkout. I asked the cashier about it (I really just loved the elephant logo), and she said, ’It’s magical.’ Well, it really is. After just a few days, my skin completely improved. It effectively moisturized and the dry skin completely went away. I will purchase again.

Mediocre at best. I tried using this alone in the summer heat in NYC, and I’ve also mixed this with DE’s Protini. Either way, I didn’t see any additional benefits to using Protini alone. review_title: Great for oily and sensitive skin
review_text: I read multiple reviews that said ’not recommended for sensitive skin’ but i have had no redness or irritation at all. I have extremely sensitive skin and cannot use multiple products. I get burns and hives from skin cares products BUT THIS IS AMAZING. Because it is a gel, it works well for oily skin (it is very light) and hydrates beautifully. I uploaded a picture to show my skin but have a colored filter. I don’t take pictures so this is the only one i have (sorry).Everyone’s skin is different so what works for me might not work well for someone with a similar skin type. I will say that i did try mixing it with the C- Firma Day Serum and felt sticky. If you have oily skin and are looking to mix this duo keep in mind that serums are thick and can feel too heavy for your skin unlike with dry skin. I hope this helps give a different review for those with sensitive, oily skin.

So far so good! My skin was going through a dry spell even after I had gotten a rehydrating facial. My skin was peeling because it was that dry so I decided to give this product a try. So far, I like the results. My skin is hydrated, it doesn’t feel dry anymore. I recommend this product.

When I travel to dry climates, my skin drinks this up like no one’s business and feels glorious. A little goes a long way with all serums, and this bottle usually lasts me 6 months. Pricey, for sure, but better than any other moisturizer I have tried.

The product itself makes my pores look smaller and brings moisture to my face. I love it and will repurchase.
It is slightly moisturizing but a bit sticky. It was okay. I can’t see myself buying this for $50 .

I use this product as a lightweight moisturizer, or if my skin is feeling a little dry I will use it under my moisturizer. I like the gel texture and it is really easy to apply and spread evenly on your face. My skin feels really refreshed after I use it.

I tried love this product because of the brand but it felt so sticky I wanted to wash it off immediately. It was better once it dried but I don’t have the patience. The results weren’t worth the time.

I liked it a lot when I tried it in the store and so I bought it. I’m not very happy with it. It doesn’t hydrate that much. Too expensive for what it is. Ok fine I just liked it for the bottle and the cute elephant. Don’t recommend it, sorry

Probably my favorite product from the DE line. Adds some moisture to the line but I can see using this solo during summer. My skin soaks it up. I have dry skin during the winter and oily in the spring/summer. It gives a cooling effect. It just seems to go so fast - not sure what is up with that? Maybe because I am dry. That is why it didn’t get 5 stars.
Great moisturizer, definitely helps keep my skin hydrated.

I purchased this at the beginning of fall to give my skin a bit of a boost going into the colder months. At first, I honestly didn’t care for it much. I didn’t see an instant increase in hydration so I stopped using it for a while. After sitting in my makeup bag for a few weeks I picked it up again and decided to give it a really good go. I used it every day (morning only) for a week and HOLY COW did I notice a difference in my skin! My skin looks so much plumper and I can actually see the light reflecting off my skin as if I’m wearing a really nice foundation. I actually want to go out without makeup so people can see my skin now! This is an amazing layering product and will boost up all your other skin care, highly recommend!
Best hydration for me. Not too light or thick for my oily skin and it does not break me out. It is like a glass of water for my skin. Will always repurchase!

As far as exfoliators go, this one is pretty thorough. The texture is very gritty and satisfying. It has a pretty neutral smell, and a little goes a long way. I usually only use it a few times a week, and it does take a while to start noticing a difference. I like it! One of the best I’ve tried.

Not my ultimate favorite thing to put on my face. It doesn’t quite feel gritty enough to do any actual exfoliation and there’s no smell or feel to indicate it has cleaned anything. I only used it twice because I began breaking out around my house both times that I tried to use it. Maybe for someone else it will work, but for my sensitive skin it wasn’t the best.
Amazing product. This exfoliator is great, it gets rid of dull skin without over drying your face. My skin looked glowy and smooth afterward.
Ok, this product is the bomb! I received it as a sample and definitely need to repurchase. It made my skin feel so smooth even after the first use. Must try

review_title: Both exfoliates and is gentle on skin
review_text: I have sensitive skin and this product manages to still be gentle while sloughing off all my dead skin to make my skin feel soft and smooth again. I received this product for free for testing purposes from Goop and Influenster, but I will be repurchasing when I run out. Great product!

I was pleasantly surprised by this product. It was easy to use and my skin felt so smooth afterwards. It was noticeably smoother and glowy. I received this product for free to try and I will definitely repurchase!
I love this little product for those days when I feel my skin is feeling like it has too much texture. I little goes a long way with it and it doesn’t have an over powering scent.

Definitely loved it. My new go to!

I’ve been using this exfoliator 3 times a week for the last 2 weeks and im certainly impressed! What I’ve noticed is that my skin is really smooth, feels cleansed, and my skin is brighter. I would purchase this after I run out and I would recommend this to anyone who is looking for a great exfoliator that gives instant results!

This product really smoothed out my face. It is soft and feels good on your face. I recommend trying it. I received it for free to try from Influenster

review_title: Try it, you will love it!

review_title: An effective physical and chemical exfoliant
review_text: This is a chemical and physical exfoliant that comes in the form of a rich, thick cream. The packaging is very luxe on this, and it really does feel like a luxury product. You only need a little bit for your entire face, I gently rub this on and very gently massage for about 30 seconds to a minute. It’s important not to overdo the physical exfoliation because there are lots of particles and you really don’t need to. Then, I let the product sit on my face for another 2-5 minutes for the chemical exfoliation to do its job. Then, I wash off with water. I am really impressed by this product, it left me with bright and very soft skin. I did not experience any irritation during and after use of this product (or the day after). Using this 1-2 times a week is enough to maintain the results. It pairs well with my serums and moisturizer, prepping the skin well. There is no fragrance, and no chunky particles. It’s a pricey product, so you will have to evaluate whether you find value, but undoubtedly this is a high quality formula that delivers results. Goop for gifted me this product for my honest review.

review_title: Read this if you have oily skin!
review_text: I found that the trick to apply this moisturizer is to make sure your skin is damp. I have oily skin and so usually heavy products have trouble soaking into it, so I only squeeze out a pea-sized amount (not more) and gently rub it between my fingers so it’s easier to apply on my skin. You’ll notice white streaks on your face as you’re working it in, but that’s because your skin is still damp, which means as it dries down, the moisturizer will penetrate the skin faster. I hope this helps anyone with oily skin, who’s had trouble with this moisturizer. The overall performance of this I would say is great. It hasn’t broken me out, and it is gentle.
