This moisturizer is amazing! With all of the ingredients is has and at it’s price point! I mix this with Cerave’s PM moisturizer. With those two combined you have every item your stratum corneum needs to be healthy! Which are ceramides, cholesterol, fatty acids, amino acids, sodium PCA, glycerin and urea. With my stratum corneum healthy now my skin doesn’t get dehydrated and I don’t have to worry about TEWL (Trans epidermal water loss). I’ve found by really studying what your skin needs and finding those ingredients you don’t always have to buy expensive skin care products. Truly skin hasn’t been this hydrated in years!!!

review_title: Soft Skin. No more flakes. Very Impressed!
review_text: I have very dry, sensitive skin, with occasional hormonal acne breakouts (jawline and chin). This moisturizer has been nothing but excellent. It feels very moisturizing but then quickly sinks into the skin. I love that it provides a lot of moisture without a heavy greasy feel so it’s good for my daytime routine. Works on its own or under makeup. I can feel my skin is soft, no more flakes, and doesn’t aggravate my acne and doesn’t cause new breakouts. I’m SUPER impressed.

I’m a huge ordinary fan, I love all their products, however this moisturizer isn’t my favourite.. I’m not sure if it just doesn’t work with my skin, but I personally don’t find that it absorbs into my skin nicely. It tends to just sit awkwardly on the top of my face, even after blending & just has a weird texture/consistency overall. I’ve also found that it runs out SUPER quickly, which kind of balances out the lower price point. The ordinary cleanser, toner and serums are my HOLY GRAILS but I don’t think I’ll purchase this moisturizer again.

review_title: simple. works well. good print point
review_text: Simple and non irritating. Great for layering. Comparable to drunk elephant protini.
terrible!!!! I put this on as a mousturizer and immediately my skin got extremely red all over and itchy. don’t recommend

Like others are saying, this moisturizer is very waxy and thick. The pro to the matte effect is that it helps reduce shine after I apply other the Ordinary products (I’m looking at you, Niacinimide & Zinc). The down side is that it feels pretty heavy. Not my favourite, but will keep trying with other products for the price.

This moisturizer has a very thick creamy texture but applies beautifully. It doesn’t break me out which is great. The only problem I have with it is it’s not for oily skin. It does nothing to control oil and leaves me looking shiny by mid day. I stopped using it during the day and now only use it as a night cream after applying the glycolic acid toner.
overall good product, but it is more for oily skin not combination

I bought this on a whim because I was looking for a new moisturizer. I have combination skin with dry patches around my mouth whereas my t zone gets super oily. Using this before makeup is a dream it dries down almost matte and lasts really well throughout the day. I’d def get the larger size

This moisturizer may be a hit or miss depending on your skin type and the type of cleanser that you use. For me it was partially a hit. It appears to be of a thick, creamy consistency but it literally glides onto my skin when I apply it. Its scent-free and it is also non-greasy upon application which is a plus and I realized a little bit goes a long way if your skin is hydrated. I tried applying it after using a clay-based bar soap (which left my skin super tight and dry) and found that I was applying way more moisturizer as opposed to when I used a hydrating/moisturizing cleanser. I gave 4 stars because  overall my face honestly does not look super oily as it would when I tried other moisturizers. My face stays matte for the first half of the day but it tends to get a teeny-bit oily in my t-zone by the time mid-day comes around. I’ve been using it for about 2 months now and experienced no breakouts so I will keep using this until I can find my holy grail moisturizer

This is the best moisturizer I have ever used. It’s thick and rich and deeply moisturizing without leaving any kind of residue or making me oily. I have very dry skin and this product has taken care of my dryness and dullness entirely. I won’t ever stop using this product! I use the matching cleanser and they’re a power couple.

I was pleasantly surprised! I’m 40 and my skin needed a big pick me up. I was missing the plump youthful look I once had and my skin was dull with fine lines growing more deeper. I use the buffet serum day and night and this moisturizer for about 1 week now and I noticed a big difference in my skin. My skin tone was clearer, skin more plump and moist.Reduced my forehead lines.  I have combo skin and it did not make my face greasy or dry. I’m so happy with this product! And what a great company. I will buy again.

review_title: It does what it says it does
review_text: I have acne prone, combination skin, which means moisturizers are a pain to buy, since they are either too thick and break me out, or are too light to moisturize the dry parts of my skin.  I recently purchased this moisturizer since my skin was extremely dry due to change in weather.  To say I was nervous to try it based on how thick it was is an understatement.  BUT I have really noticed how moisturized my skin has become, AND there aren’t any significant breakouts (other than my regular hormonal ones) from using it.  I also do not end up with an oily t-zone at the end of the day, which is honestly a miracle. I use it in combination with the HA serum by The Ordinary and makes my skin super moisturized.  It also looks fine after applying makeup.
I use this moisturizer twice a day along with The Buffet serum and my dry skin has stopped flaking! I use these together as a primer under my makeup and it works great.

I have sensitive combo skin, and for me this product worked decently. I wouldn’t say it’s amazing, and like it says on the bottle it’s really only for surface hydration. It does the job but I don’t feel as though it changed my skin for the better. Good for people on a budget and a moisturizer before a makeup look.

review_title: You pay for what you get here
review_text: A great price point but I find that it doesn’t do a whole lot for my skin. To preface my review, I have combination skin but in the winter I tend to be more dry. It didn’t break me out at all, which is great since i have sensitive skin. I found that it didn’t do a good enough job moisturizing my skin especially since we are moving into the winter months. There are some amazing products by The Ordinary but I don’t think this is one of them.

review_title: Add this to your skincare regimen!
review_text: Used alone, it’s just ok, but use it as part of your skin care routine after TO serums and it’s amazing. I’ve started using TO serums and vitamin c as part of my night time routine and I finish off with this moisturizer and it’s the perfect top off. I have pretty dry skin, especially with the winter season coming and I’m in love with their products. Excellent value and an even better price. I’ve seen a difference after just a few nights of using this product.
A nice moisturizer but it feels greasy and doesn’t leave skin soft like others. Doesn’t stay very moist for long. You’re begging what you pay for with this.

i have normal skin and this has worked adequately to keep my face hydrated during the cooler season, without making me look oily/greasy. it does need to be rubbed in a bit to absorb the white cast, but that’s not really a big deal. if you’re on the drier side, you’ll probably want to layer an oil underneath (or go for something richer). all in all, i’m really happy with this moisturizer and will definitely repurchase! ✨

I really enjoyed this product. It was one of the first moisturizers I ever used that wasn’t some cheap dollar store one. It worked great for my oily/combination skin. However, it does feel like it just kind of sits on the surface of your skin. I never felt it sink in, which some people like, I’m not a big fan of. Because of this, I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone with super dry skin. The texture is somewhat thick, and takes a bit to rub in, which is why I don’t use it as much, but it does leave your skin feeling hydrated and soft.
This is hands down the best moisturizer I’ve ever used. It leaves my face nourished and supple! I’m never touching cetaphil again

Fair skin and on the mend after cystic acne.I had a bad year last year and suffered from cystic acne, after many trials with prescription meds my doctor put me on Accutane. As most on accutane know you cannot use and do a lot of things most beauty addicts love, like waxing and using most anti aging/ beauty products. This moisturizer saved my life. It was gentle enough but strong enough to keep my skin hydrated and from peeling for the most part. I had a small adjustment period but only due to the meds not the product. This moisturizer kept me sane and moisturized during my recovery. I am at the tail end of my dosage and I will be using this moisturizer for life. Best part is the price tag.I have tried many moisturizers in the past, some good some bad but this one fits just right.I urge anyone else who suffers from acne, life long or sudden, to try this tooo.
Glowing hydrated skin love it !

I have to say this is one of the best moisturizers I’ve used. I tend to have drier skin bc I live in the mountains in Colorado so it’s pretty dry here on top of me using retin-A every night. This works wonderfully on top of the retin A and keeps me from getting dry patches/flaky skin When I wake up. I also use this after my face serums and before I put my makeup on in the mornings. The consistency is more creamy which I like more then the thin watery or gel like, bc I feel as the hydration last longer. This comes in a decent size container for a price you can’t beat especially compared to tarte h2o gel and first aid beauty repair moisturizer I was using.
You only need a tiny bit, it spreads really easily.  I keep forgetting this and end up with lotion everywhere...not the worst thing I suppose since I use the extra on my neck and chest.

review_title: Great for price, but not necessary imo.
review_text: Pros: nice texture in my opinion, and it did hydrate my skin nicely when applied with my other skincare (rn using Biologique Recherche cleanser, ordinary eye serum, and supergoop sunscreen for morning routine). Can’t complain with the price and it’s also vegan and fragrance free (you’d be surprised how much skincare has fragrance or essential oils, it’s kind of disturbing really).Cons: I bought this when you could only buy the 1 fluid ounce (if it’s even that much) and it’s way too small to last a decent amount of time. I will buy the 3.3 fluid ounces next time. The only real con with this product is that it’s pretty useless unless you use another moisturizing product like a serum or a creamy sunscreen, or just have very oily skin to begin with. The brand labels this as a “surface moisturizer“ so I guess this means it’s supposed to be an extra secondary moisturizer to help lock in other products.

This comes out of the bottle like a whipped cream, not liquidy, not creamy thick, but in between. No real fragrance that is strong or off putting, smells like skincare. The actual product itself goes onto the skin like a subtle sunblock would, very easily glides over skin so there’s no tugging or immediate absorption into the skin, so you’re able to work it into all areas of the face, not hard to blend it into skin to remove residue. After applying this and another product from this brand my skin feels like the best, most smooth, non-tacky, non-oily, but very dewy protected and plump. For $<7 I will definitely be repurchasing.
This moisturizer is a must.  Just need a bit so it lasts a while. Makes your face feel extremely smooth.

I absolutely love the price. A little goes a long way. I use it along with the serum from the same company. I have super sensitive skin and this does not irritate me at all. I have already purchased my second bottle.
Put this on before I go to bed, amazing price and makes my skin feel really soft in the morning!
This moisturizer has been the best moisturizer I have ever purchased! I love it so much! My skin is extremely sensitive and this has been perfect for it!

Super duper simple moisturizer. Nothing special but actually amazing. It’s great for sensitive skin. I struggle with severe acne and this doesn’t irritate it at all but really helps with my dryness. Overall really great.

I LOVE this as a finishing “moisturizer“ after using my an oil on my skin at night. It seems to seal everything in and I wake up with soft, smooth looking skin. Doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin; a must have for me.

This moisturizer is mediocre. The reason for the low ratings is because there is so little product in the container that I only used it for a couple of weeks before it was gone. This is a sample sized amount inside of a decent sized package. I am very disappointed.

review_title: You get what you pay for
review_text: I would say this product was disappointing, but given the extremely low price point, I didn’t have super high expectations. This did not hydrate my skin at all. If anything, it gave my skin a weird gritty texture. I would skip this. Stick to The Ordinary serums and other treatments to save bank, and splurge on a better moisturizer.
An ok moisturerizer. At first it felt hydrating, then flat. Wouldn’t buy it again.

review_title: like a drink of water for your face
review_text: This thing is some weird science-y magic.The texture makes you think it’ll be a buttery, oily cream — but, upon application, it absorbs into your skin almost so quickly that you think you haven’t put enough on. I have combination skin (oily forehead   t-zone, dry cheeks and chin) and it balances me out so perfectly. On an ultra-dry day, I’ll mix in a little Herbivore Lapis Oil or The Ordinary Squalane Oil. But 9 times out of 10 it’s lovely, light and hydrating all on its own.Also— the price is insane. 10/10 recommend.

LOVE this moisturizer. No weird smell, not greasy or irritating in any way. Cloud like texture that sinks in to your skin. I usually have to moisturize 2 or 3 times in the winter, but with this one application and I can start my makeup. My only complaint is the small size - would love to see a double or triple size available!

This was not for me. I quite like the Buffet serum and was hoping this would be a nice complement to that. However, it feels heavy on my skin, and not moisturizing enough. The sensation after putting this on is like there’s a film on my face. Unfortunately, it does not do anything for my sensitive/delicate skin.

Great Moisturizer I am so prone to milia, and that you have to have them extracted. Most heavy creams cause me to get these. This cream does not. It went on well, it absorbed well and my skin feels really soft and smooth. I have ordered other products but I’m having to get them directly from the company. I do wish the bottle was bigger.
This is the only thing I don’t like from the ordinary products. I found the moisturizer to drying, I have combination skin and it did not work for me nor does the product last long.

Last night I had to dig out from the blizzard. Three hours of shoveling in the cold and wind. The only thing I had on my face was this moisturizer. Normally my skin would be dry and wind burned but not last night. My skin felt soft and smooth and totally hydrated. Can’t recommend this enough!

review_title: Fabulous moisturizer at a great price.
review_text: Do yourself a favor and give The Ordinary a shot. I have been using Natural Moisturizing Factors   HA for a few months now (was ordering through their website direct) and am glad that Sephora has picked up on them. Their products are exactly what they claim to be and the cost is amazing. I do use a serum under this moisturizer. It probably would be okay without it, but it is amazing with it. I have used the hyaluronic acid from The Ordinary before with it and probably will go back to it once i’m done with the bottle of other stuff I’m trying runs out. The cost and the functionality is everything they claim.

I falsely reviewed this product because I thought it had silicones, but it doesn’t! It’s very lightweight and hydrating, I would recommend it. The alcohol in it is the good kind that is safe to use on skin. I like using this on my hands more than anything though
An amazing moisturizer, I have extremely dry skin. Giving it 4/5 simply because I feel like it’s missing that extra boost. Would recommend using this with rose water
Bought this online when I read how amazing it was and words do it no justice. So happy to find something that works with my combination skin that’s so inexpensive. Love it!!

This is hands down the best affordable daily cream. I have combination skin and it’s amazing. I recommend this to everyone I know. I use it year round in addition to skin fix in the winter.  It gets rid of redness, rashes and razor bumps.
Love it! Keeps my skin so soft and plump. I use prescription retinoids and this has been critical in keeping my skin barrier resilient. A little goes a long way, it only pils if I used too much.
Forever obsessed have used this for years on years and when I can get it on sale even better.

My skin gets super dry in the winter and this helps to keep it hydrated. I originally bought the mini size to try it out and now got the jumbo pack. I also use it on my hands and feet for when they are feeling extra dry in the winter:)

This is truly the best moisturizer I’ve ever used. I have super dry skin and have tried so many different moisturizers and this is the only one that has made a difference. The bottle will last me MONTHS and I have never ever found a product that worked this well.
So thick and creamy, yet it doesn’t feel heavy and doesn’t leave you looking like a greasy mess.
Literally the best moisturizer I’ve ever used. Helps soothe my acne and moisturizes me without feeling heavy. Perfect for your hands as well. Couldn’t recommend this enough!
Love this profuct! Got on sale for Black Friday, better products for price, but if you can get on sale definitely recommend!

Bought this moisturizer for my boyfriend to start his first simple skincare routine with a toner. He was using cerave moisturizing cream but said he loves this fab moisturizing cream way better because it’s not sticky like the cerave. I also have sensitive skin and when my skin feels dry, I would steal his moisturizer cream and use in replacement of my night cream as it’s more hydrating. Love it! Will continue to purchase!

I tried really hard to like this, it’s just not hydrating at all my skin feels so dry after using. I use this in the morning before using a hydrating sunscreen that’s about it. Farmacy Halo Honey and Dewy Skin by Tatcha is soooo much better if you have combo skin!
I am someone who has year round dry skin & is VERY sensitive to products. This was one of the only moisturizers that I’ve tried that hasn’t made me blotchy red or burn.

Thick, making my skin clog. Use very lightly. Also pills if you try and put any makeup over top of it, flaking everything off. I only use it midday while working from home if I need a little pick me up. Such a specific use case, I won’t repurchase.

I have dry, sensitive, and rosacea prone skin this moisturizer helps with all of that! When I first started using this moisturizer I had flakey spots and dry patches and within a week my skin was alot less dry and smooth. 6 months later I know I’m never going to use a different moisturizer ever again.

So bummed that I didn’t like this moisturizer because the tub is huge and it seems like a good value. But unfortunately there is an ingredient in this product that my face HATES. After about a week of using, I broke out badly which is very unlike my skin. I have clear skin 95% of the time, only get an occasional spot here and there. I have quite dry skin and not sensitive to products typically. I do like the formula and how it absorbs into the skin quickly. But I will be going back to my Clinique moisturizer.

Got this with points based on the reviews to try before purchasing a full size. It was just ok, the hype was so huge that i expected it to be a game changer. At first it does feel very hydrating and soft but it dries up so quickly that my morning it the area i apply it to is so dry that it feels like i washed my hands and didnt apply lotion. Lots of other products out there that do what this claims
The product is just okay. I have dry skin and I thought this would be great but it didn’t do much. For me that moisturizer should get absorbed and this just didn’t do it for me.

review_title: perfect face cream for the winter months
review_text: I have sensitive combination skin and am closer to 50 than 40. I was looking for something to wear as a day cream in the winter months when my skin tends to be dry. I’ve been using this for a week in the mornings and absolutely love it. It’s thick and rich and has a luxurious feel, but doesn’t feel at all greasy.  Extra points for not causing my skin to break out.

review_title: the new reformulation broke me out
review_text: I used to use this alot and then stopped to try other products. I went back to this moisturizer because it was effective and affordable but with the reformulated one I started noticing every time I used it I would get more and more pimples appearing on my face. it’s still really moisturizing but whatever is in it is not making the skin on my face happy so this will now be foot cream.

I seriously can’t say enough amazing things about this product. I have very dry skin, and it has helped moisturize my skin so well! My friends who have oily skin use this product as well, and it has never caused them to break out. It’s so moisturizing, soothing, and also great for sensitive skin! It also works great under makeup, I’ve never had a problem wearing it under makeup!

Life changing! I have super sensitive and extremely dry skin. Almost every skin care I have ever tried made my skin bright red and itchy, but this ultra repair night cream with the oat toner is a life saver. In 3 months, I have gone from skin that looked like scales to smooth, plump, soft skin.  If I get lazy and don’t wash my face one day, I feel the dryness returning. So, I have to be consistent. But, I’m so thankful to finally find something for my nightmare skin! I also put this on my son’s eczema prone skin on his face. No dry patches for him either.

Sad they changed the formula - with eucalyptus oil, no peptides, and moving beneficial ingredients to the bottom. But better than other creams at Sephora so I still recommend but it’s not for me anymore.
It’s definitely a moisturizer. It keeps my skin hydrated overnight until the next morning. That’s all. Does what it claims but I also have cheaper moisturizers that do the same.
I purchased this based on the reviews and I’m so glad I did! It was great during the winter. I might switch back to CeraVe Moisturizing Cream for the summer because this one is a bit thick.

I have been using Ultra Repair Cream for 2 years now and I don’t know how I lived without it before. I have eczema patches around my elbows and the ultra repair cream gives me so much relief and visibly improves my patches. The cream really hydrates my skin and keeps it feeling soft and smooth!

I recently got on Accutane and started using this. It works as a moisturizer BUT once it dries to the skin it gets really flaky and clumpy. Sometimes after putting it on it looks like it is peeling off of my face and I look like I’m flaking dry skin everywhere. When I wake up or towards the end of the day, my skin looks dry because the product is flaking off. It works but I’m sure there are better options that don’t make you look flaky.

review_title: Cleared my dry skin/eczema in 1-2 days
review_text: I’ve been struggling with dry skin and breakouts during the winter. I continued to get very small pimples on my cheeks and no moisturizer or acne cream helped. This cleared it up in 3 days and continually works every time I use it. I used to get eczema as a child- maybe that’s what this is. If you have exhausted other options definitely give this a try! There is a tingling sensation the first few times you use it- I have VERY sensitive skin and whatever in the formula that caused this didn’t aggravate my skin in any way.

I’ve been using this cream for about 2 months now and I really like it. I first received it in a Sephora sample and the minute I put it on my face I knew I had to buy a full size. It is very soothing on the skin and feels very luxurious when applying. It is not greasy and doesn’t really have a smell. My only complaint is that for a few minutes (20-40) after applying this moisturizer after my hydrating cleanser and niacinamide serum, my skin feels tight or like it still needs moisture but then after about an hour it feels very hydrated and happy. I am not sure if this is due to the moisturizer itself or the current season (perhaps this may be better for summer rather than winter). While I do really like this product, I am not sure if I would repurchase because I am now having to double up on moisturizers (I use Cerave PM and then the FAB moisturizer on top) to avoid that tight uncomfortable feeling and I feel like if this were “intensely hydrating“ that I wouldn’t need to do that.

This cream is amazing but it’s not for everyone!I have very dry sensitive skin, to the point it gets flaky and red around my nose and mouth and forehead. I’ve always had horrible experiences buying any products because as soon as I apply it it feels like my face is on fire. What has worked for me is cocoa oil w vitamin e right after the shower and waiting 5 min for my skin to soak up the oil and then I apply a thick layer of aveeno eczema therapy and it works but not 100%. So I decided to give this new cream a try. The first day I was 100% shocked, my skin felt amazing, after so many years of feeling super dry skin the first and second day made my skin feel so soft, it looked hydrated without looking oily, it felt stretchy and It blew my mind. By the third day I started noticing irritation around my cheeks and nose. My skin started looking burnt, literally! Then when I applied the cream it started to burn. I stop using it at day 5 because my skin was getting worse within each day of use. So my conclusion is if I use this product it’s probably gonna have to be once a week or every other week only when I have to “repair “ any flaky skin or severe dryness. I think for people like me this product cannot be used every day or it’ll make the symptoms worsen. It’s an amazing cream but if you have sensitive skin I would recommend using it once a week or every other week. If I had normal skin I would use it every day no questions asked.

AMAZING. I have very dry skin in the winter and this magical repair cream works wonders. It creates a nice shield that locks in moisture and keeps my skin hydrated all day. My boyfriend even uses it! He gets a rash on the back of his neck that gets irritated and red and when he puts this cream on all the redness goes away. I will use this product for the rest of my life! My favorite first aid beauty product hands down.

This product is probably a great casual summer moisturizer, but isn’t something I’ll plan to buy anytime soon. I received a 1oz sample product when I purchased the Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer. The instructions on the back say to “apply as needed from head to toe“ so I decided to try it on my hands since I’ve been experiencing severe dryness this winter. I like that the product is light, there isn’t any strong or aggressive scents, and it absorbs quickly. However, I was disappointed to find that the product didn’t do a good job of hydrating my hands. I tried it consistently for a few days, to see if longer use would help – but unlike the product description mentions about immediate results, I didn’t see the results I anticipated. Eventually, I switched to the Sol de Janeiro Brazilian Bum Bum Cream and I noticed a much bigger improvement in my skin after a few applications. I was hopeful that, with a name like “Ultra Repair Cream“ that this product would be able to refresh my ultra dried skin, but in this case, the name seems to overhype the effectiveness of the product. I can see this as a good summer moisturizer to keep on hand, just in case, but overall, I won’t be switching to this product for everyday use.

This cream quite literally saved my skin.  I had overused my retinol gel because I stupidly didn’t look into how to use it properly, and my skin, which is normally oily, became so parched and dehydrated that it was peeling.  My whole face became incredibly sensitive, so much so that my typical gel moisturizer was making my face sting.  The skin on my eyelids were red, irritated and peeling, and my undereyes could not even tolerate concealer.This cream truly provides “Intense Hydration“, but is also super lightweight and doesn’t leave you feeling greasy.  The colloidal oatmeal really is soothing to my hypersensitivity.After I purchased it (and had stopped using the retinol for 2 days), I applied a thick layer all over my face and continued to reapply every two hours.  It has been less than 24 hours and my skin is no longer stinging, my eyelids have stopped peeling and turning red, and my undereyes are plump.I am excited to use it on the rest of my body, and can imagine that it is great for fake tan!
I initially bought this for myself but ended up giving to my husband. He has dry sun damaged skin and likes it because it has no scent and keeps his skin from looking like a dried out reptile ;)

review_title: CAN BURN FROM TIME TO TIME
review_text: Been using this lotion for years, very hydrating to the skin. Unfortunately though, if I over rub my face while cleaning either with my clarisonic or my hands, it can burn very bad. Other than that it is very hydrating.

Love this product it feels so good when it goes on my skin and within a week my skin looked more hydrated than ever and it absorbs into the skin fast and leaves no residue on the skin I use this on my hands too when they are dry and they feel better within an hour definitely recommend this product.

I always want to try new skincare and especially moisturizers but I always find myself coming back to this one. It’s so hydrating and gentle. The ingredients are bomb for my sensitive skin. I use at night after cleansing and again in the am and my skin just looks so much healthier than when I use other moisturizers. I love the texture and it’s a pretty great value as well

Purchased for my daughter who had this eczema Spot on one side of her cheek.   I decided to try this based on product description and helpful reviews.  It’s working—that dry patch is fading!   I’m so happy because my daughter has also had beautiful skin even during her pre-teen and teen years!   I have her applying in am and pm.  So hopefully this will continue keep to keep the eczema at bay.  I also changed her facial cleanser from Cetaphil for Sensitive and Dry Skin to CeraVe Facial Cleanser for Dry Skin.

It was a fine moisturizer but nothing special. I have combination skin and I didn’t feel like the moisturizing effects lasted that long. If it sold for $15 I’d give it 5 stars but for $34 I was expecting better

I use this as a moisturizer for my face and neck and it does the trick. I don’t wake up with a greasy face, and I don’t get super oily during the day. Only thing is that it takes a while for my skin to absorb it, but other than that I love it so far!
I love this. It works, its that simple. I can not get over how much I like this brand

I LOVE this stuff. I’ve been using it for 1 year. I have combination skin so I need to be careful to hydrate well but with something that absorbs quickly so I don’t get excess oil production. I use this as a 2x a day moisturizer in the winter but I only use it at night in the summer. It absorbs quickly and I love how emollient it is. It’s also great as a spot treatment for dry patches on the body. I get some flaky skin in the winter and this fixes it immediately. I used to use the Drunk Elephant Lala Retro ($$$) and switched to this to save money. Honestly, they work the same!

My only issue is I wish they would package this in a tube and it is pricey, but it works.

This cream is lightweight and absorbs into my skin quickly; skin doesn’t feel oily or tacky after, just hydrated. Can wear it under makeup and it doesn’t pill. Would give it 5 stars but it smells absolutely rancid; I hold my breath when applying and the smell doesn’t linger on my face after it absorbs, but the smell makes applying the product really unpleasant
This is a perfect moisturizer for my dry skin in winter. I originally got a mini size to try it out, and bought the full size because I liked it so much. I use this as part of my PM skincare routine.

I bought this as part of the unstoppable glow set. Like many recent reviewers, this moisturizer had a disgusting feet smell, which only developed after a couple weeks. This makes me believe this product had a bad batch. It’s unusable to use on my face due to the smell so I’m finishing the container by using it on my hands

I purchased the value size on Biossance’s website and am unfortunately not a fan of this moisturizer at all. I just cannot get over/used to the god awful smell no matter how many times I’ve used this now. It smells like feet/body odor or something, I literally have to hold my breath to use it. I’m just trying to get through and finish the jar because of the $$ tag. This moisturizer unfortunately is not moisturizing at all either. My skin feels really dry when I wake up in the morning after using this before bed time.

review_title: great for sensitive dry winter skin
review_text: I am pleasantly surprised with how beautiful this moisturizer is. It also leave a such a nice glow and is so amazing for dry sensitive skin. I would 100% recommended.

review_title: Not for me but could be for you.
review_text: If you aren’t from South Florida and have normal to dry skin I’d recommend this product. But if you are and you have normal to oily skin, then I’d recommend it’s sister the squalene + probiotic gel moisturizer. This one i found to be too rich and creamy and would leave my skin too oily especially if I’m running errands. Also I’m not keen on the smell, it’s fragrance free but it has a strange smell at first but wears away.
i tried this moisturizer as part of the whole kit. i love it. it os gentle, redness on my skin is disappearing and it does not feel heavy. sticking to this one now.

I really love Biossance! This is one of my favorite face cream for winter season and the gel version is good for summer season. The cream is very moisturizing. The ingredients are safe to use. Even I was pregnant and I was using this brand!
This is such a nice moisturizer! I love squalane and how good it works for my skin. This cream makes my skin very hydrated and soft. It doesn’t have any scent and made of clean ingredients.
Hydrating. Perfect for overnight. Great on my sensitive skin. I don’t think it smells like anything and if it does, it’s not strong.

I have pretty dry skin, so the fact that this is a heavier moisturizer reallllly helps me. It smells amazing, melts right into my skin, and is the only moisturizer I’ve ever used for more than 6 months. I ove this!

I got this as part of a Biossance kit and I can’t stand the scent of this. Every time I open the jar to use it I just get and overwhelming scent of rotten eggs! I do not recommend this at all. Sticking with the gel instead.

review_title: Nice cream but doesn't smell great
review_text: I just finished a sample of this product, and I thought it was a decent face cream. A bit too thick for daytime in the summer, but it’s great at night. I admit that it doesn’t smell nice, but the scent doesn’t linger. It absorbed into my skin quickly and didn’t feel greasy.

This cream smells so bad if I knew that it smelled this bad,  I probably would’ve not bought it. It works well it’s a good cream it just smells so bad. But the smell is only there when I’m putting it on my face after that I can’t smell it thank goodness. I wouldn’t get it again, there are other creams that work just as good at smell amazing and don’t smell like wet dog

This is my favourite moisturizer; it’s lightweight but still deeply hydrating which is perfect for my combination skin. There is one small “flaw“ (not even really a flaw): the smell of this drives my cats CRAZY and they will stop at nothing to lick the moisturizer off of my face. So cat owners...maybe don’t cuddle your kitties until the moisturizer is totally absorbed.

This stuff is a lovely rich cream formula, but unfortunately smells so bad I can’t finish the jar. Customer service told me it’s just the fatty acids in the product, but it’s a dealbreaker for me. It smells rancid and you can smell it as you apply it to your face. The gel cream doesn’t have this issue!
I got the sample in this, it worked really well on acne and it is very hydrating. It reduced blemishing and redness on the face. Definitely will be buying!

Well worth the price! I smooth this on my face, neck, and décolletage areas every night after toner and serums. Skin is plumper, smoother, and wrinkles are lessening, too. Instant gratification plus long-term results—win win!
I gave this cream a 3/5 because it was smooth and gentle on my skin but it smells like cardboard.

This face cream smells terrible- like rancid wax. I hated putting something that smelled so bad on my face. It goes on thick but left my face very greasy. I felt like I needed to wash my face after a few hours. Will not finish this product. If you want a “clean” moisturizer, I recommend the CeraVe night cream.

review_title: not hydrating enough and caused breakouts
review_text: Not for acne-prone skin or oily skin Not hydrating enough, skin became greasy only after a few hours and I had some breakouts at the end of the day, I didn’t see any other benefits either, not sure why there’s so much hype around this product

Got this as a prepackaged sample. Biggest con is the smell. Smells like protein and farts. However the scent doesn’t last long. On the skin, it feels moisturizing, slightly oily. But not moisturizing/life changing enough for me to buy this. Better off with Cerave Night cream. Appreciate its clean formula though, so i know why they wouldn’t mask the smell of it.

Lovely moisturizer. Skin feels hydrated and calm after use. That said, it says it’s unscented but there definitely is a smell. Unfortunately to me it smells like your fingers after eating Cheetos. No other way to describe it lol. Not sure if I’ll rebuy this product for that reason alone.
Love, to expensive, but feels so worth it, will ask for every Christmas and birthday.

Folks, this stuff is amazing!! I got a trial size last week and I’m loving it so far. It’s not greasy at all but it’s moisturizing enough for the dry parts of my face. My combo skin is very happy. :) Also, it’s like silk under makeup. So far no breakouts using it, and I’ll come back to update on more long-term benefits.As for the smell, you guys had me almost not buy the stuff, thinking it would smell like feet from across the room! It is absolutely not an issue. You have to really stick your nose in the jar to smell it, and even then it’s just a little play-doughy. This is just what un-scented cosmetics smell like - the ingredients that are in them, without being masked by horrible perfumes. Definitely recommend, even if I do find the price a little high.

I have extremely dry (eczema) and sensitive skin. I love this cream! Rx steroid creams can’t be placed around your eyes, but it’s where my eczema is the worst. This cream is quite thick and only a little is needed. It greatly reduced the redness of my eczema after one day! I’ve always used fragrance-free lotions and creams because of my extreme sensitivity and the smell of this is just fine.
I got this product from a sample set. The texture is good so I give it credit for that. But it has a terrible smell, smells like saliva

I have never written a review on here but felt the need bc I have been looking for a moisturizer that not only helps the skin long term but shoes immediate effects. I live in FL so it’s perfect for the more humid weather, not too heavy and sinks right into the skin. I didn’t purchase from Sephora, I stole it from my mom who did. Will definitely be purchasing again!

I received this product as a sample from a Sephora purchase. This was the first Biossance product I ever tried and I really wanted to like the brand and the cream.However, this cream did not work well for my skin. I have dry and oily combination skin. I tried the cream once in the morning on my clean face and it gave me a few acne on my cheeks on the same day. I guess the cream was a little heavy for me. It felt tacky during application and took a long time to be absorbed. The smell was also distinct and very medicine-like, which I liked, but some people may find it unpleasant.So, I would recommend to try it as a sample first if possible before purchasing the product.

This moisturizer is my go to for my skin. It smells a little funky but it is extremely moisturizing for my combination skin, which gets a little more dry in some seasons. It’s my go to! Really helps it hydrate.

It has a smell but not overwhelming it’s bearable.  It has like a medium thickness consistency to it.  So I find you can wear it on its own and makes the skin soft or pack your skin with other products like serum, other hydrating cream and use biossance as the last step as a barrier.  Help maintain all the good stuff in your skin.

I decided to buy the trial size before investing in the big jar. I’ve heard amazing things about biossance and was so excited to try! I have very dry skin and have been looking for a moisturizer that provides me hydration without feeling greasy. Unfortunately this was just not it. It did make my skin feel soft, but I felt as if the product just sat on my face afterwards and didn’t fully absorb into my skin. My skin felt greasy and cakey. I would only use as a night time moisturizer. I prefer the squalene + probiotic gel moisturizer from biossance. I really like that one so far!

review_title: Good for Oily skin in winter!
review_text: I really like this moisturizer. I have oily and dehydrated skin and I bought a sample with my points. It’s a very thick moisturizer, but not as thick as a night cream. Even though it is thick, I really feel it absorb into my skin and I don’t feel like it’s sitting on top of my skin. It’s GREAT as a pre-makeup moisturizer. I don’t know what fragrance people are talking about. It smells like the ingredients that are in it, just like all the Elemis products smell like the plants they put in it. I’ve never had a problem with either.

This is a rich but not greasy formula, it absorbs very fast into the skin and the 2nd day I woke up, my skin feels very plumped. Ingredients are extremely well-chosen, but I would not say it helps with fine-lines or anti-aging. Overall, it’s a great moisturizer that I would recommend for normal to dry skin, or combo skin for winder time

I have normal/slightly combo skin.  I only took one star away because it’s too moisturizing for my face.  So it sits on my skin a tad and makes me oily.  But the product is great.  So if you need some moisture in your life this is the moisturizer for you.  I now use their gel moisturizer everyday and I’m never switching!

They recommended this moisturizer to me in store so I got a sample to take home before I bought anything for my dry skin especially since it’s so high priced. The moment I put it on my skin it was so soft, refreshed and glowy. I was in love and decided to finish using the sample for the next couple of days and then go buy the jar. THANK GOD I DIDNT. I broke out after the 3-4th day of using it on my cheeks and I never break out on those areas so that’s how I knew this product was not for me. A great moisturizer but I’m sad it broke me out especially since my skin doesn’t normally do that to begin with except on my nose (which also broke out even more)
I don’t recommend this product because of the smell and my skin did not feel like it was moisturized.
Attempted to use product but I could not stand the smell!

AMAZING!!! I live in Colorado and this winter has been brutal on my skin. I’m sensitive/dry/red and this is doing a wonderful job of evening out skin tone with a great amount of hydration and NO BREAK OUTS!!!! Even my husband is stealing this from me, if you are thinking about it go for it. The price is worth it!

Love this cream. SWapped out my DE Protini for this one. Makes my skin super soft and the moisture levels are increased. Only complaint is the packaging: I wish all moisturizers came in the airless pump like Drunk Elephant. Hate dipping my fingers into a jar! Otherwise lovely.

Love the texture and moisturizing properties of this product. Absorbs quickly into my dry skin and leaves no greasy residue. But, UGH, the smell is atrocious! I honestly thought my cat had an accident in my bathroom, the smell was so strong and unpleasant. Maybe I received an expired jar? For the price, I can’t risk buying because this.

review_title: My most favorite and effective product!
review_text: This cream lives up to its claims! It is sooo rich and nourishing all without being greasy. It is absolutely perfect for my dry skin or when I’ve been overzealous with actives. I swear my skin looked noticeably better the next day after using! My face looked overall more healthy and plump. It almost feels like it sinks in and then moisturizes from the inside out. I don’t really find it to a have smell, but I guess compared to some fragranced options some people may think it smells “bad”. I personally prefer no fragrance so this is perfect. I’ve already repurchased and will forever. HG.
Hands down the best moisturizer I have ever used in my entire life. It soaks in fast, smells amazing, and leaves your skin feeling plump and healthy looking.

review_title: DON’T be scared of the thick appearance of this!!
review_text: Since my skin is combo, acne-prone, and sensitive, I usually steer clear of using any creams that seem heavy/rich.BUT, since I’d never tried a Biossance product that clogged my pores or broke me out, I decided to get a sample anyways and give it a go.WOW is this product an exception to that!!When you first feel this cream, it will seem thick, but when you smooth it onto your skin, (little goes a long way) it absorbs so quickly and doesn’t feel like you have this layer on your skin. It’s also calming and makes my skin instantly feel comfortable (even when it’s angry at me). NEVER broke me out or clogged pores and had no problems using it over existing blemishes (which is rare). When you wake up and look in the mirror, it’s almost shocking how much this evens skin tone, almost completely takes away any redness (coming from someone with Rosacea nonetheless!), and even somehow takes away any bumpy texture or inflammation I had (which I NEVER thought a cream could do)!Seriously, if you have combo, dry, or oily yet dehydrated skin (ESPECIALLY if your natural moisture barrier has been damaged from winter or too much cleansing/exfoliation), this is a MUST try!!! It balances out my oily and dry areas and repairs my moisture barrier faster than any of the dozens of products I’ve tried (from cheap to very expensive).

For about a month, I have been using this moisturizer after receiving it complimentary for sampling and it has really been a dream. My skin gets a little more dry during the winter months. This has really helped keeping my skin not only feel moisturized but I also have noticed that my skin feels softer. I like that it’s a more rich formula and you only need a small amount for your entire face. I find this to be comparable to Tatcha and I am alsoa user of Murad. All opinions here are my own.
I absolutely love this product that I received Complimentary from Influenster. I have always had dry skin and hate the amount of wrinkles I am seeing. This cream helped rehydrate my skin!

I absolutely love this face cream! I use a lot of different creams and have found it’s been hard to find a good one for my combination skin. I’ve finally found it! It doesn’t sit heavily on the surface of my face and instead completely absorbs into my skin. I use it both in the morning and at night. It’s so creamy in texture, feels like butter.Disclaimer: I recieved this complimentary product in exchange for my honest review

Wow! Can I just say this is exactly what I needed for my dry winter skin. I received this as a complimentary sample and I can’t Say enough about how good this cream makes my skin feel. Even on the coldest winter days my skin feels refreshed and renewed to its original softness!
I received the PERFECT winter cream courtesy of  @biossance and @influenster.  I used this cream at night after a harsh winter day. It gives me an instant plump

I love that you can feel it working right after it is applied. This product left my skin bright and moisturized without feeling greasy. I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest opinion. I would definitely purchase this product.

I love the texture and the light delicate scent it has. I love the fact it has natural ingredients other moisturizers make me break out and cause me to have black heads. While using this I had no reactions

Absolutely love this moisturizer! My skin tends to be on the  drier during the colder months and this moisturizer delivers on every level. I love that there is NO FRANGRANCE too! My skin is brighter, healthier and definitely well hydrated. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are my own.
I used a sample of this and I really loved it! Feels very softening and moisturizing for my skin. I love the ingredients in it also. This will be on my list of things to purchase once I’m able to!

I fell in love with it! I have dry sensitive skin and this cream fit me perfectly: it’s quickly absorbed, doesn’t leave a greasy shine and the skin becomes velvet after the first use. This is a must-have!

Clarins double serum is a holy grail. You need this in your skincare routine. I wake up to a glowing clarifies skin every morning after using this at night. My skin loves it and it helps to regenerate my dead skin cells and refresh my face the next day. This was complimentary from Clarins
As soon as I applied the serum I could feel it working immediately. I just love it

I got a 7day sample for this product to try for free and I really love it. It has a mild scent to it that I like. I noticed how moisturized my skin feels after a week of use. I would definitely recommend this product as there was noticeable improvement in my skin within a week.

I can’t say that I’ve noticed much difference in 7 days, so I wish I had the chance to try it longer before reviewing it, especially to see the effet on wrinkles. Overall, I was quite happy with it, just wish I could have fully tested its advertized benefits!

I tried the Clarins Double Serum 7 day system and found that it went on smoothly and gave my skin a nice glow and hydrated it well. It works wonders for me. Keeps my skin so smooth and hydrated. It’s fast absorbing and easy to use. I would definitely recommend this product. Must Try!

I like the way both parts feel, I also very much like that you can custom adjust the full sized one.  My skin felt nice every time I used it and reacted well to it. I am not sure if 7 days really showed any anti-aging effects, but it seems promising

I received this sample from butterly to try for seven days. I am very impressed with the Clarins double serum. The scent is amazing and the texture is as well. It goes on so soft and easily into the skin without needing to rub too much. There is no piling and the serum penetrates into the skin so there is no oily or sticky after feel. Cracking it in half made it difficult to take out all the product especially the clear serum.

But once I got it out and applied it, I was super happy.  I would totally consider buying the whole bottle if it weren’t so expensive. But maybe I will one day, who knows.@thisisbutterly @chickadvisor @clarinscanada @thisisbutterly @chickadvisor @clarinscanada

I got this 7 day kit which is packed with 21 plant extracts and also has some great ingredients like turmeric which is known to be used in beauty products. I was recently sent a free 7 day trial of the Clarins Double Serum from Clarins and Butterly to try in exchange for my honest review.The product  claims that it is able to boost the skin’s function to provide younger looking sign as well as reduce the appearance of wrinkles, fine lines, enlarged pores and to tighten and firm up the skin. The Claris double serum is very luxurious. It makes your skin smooth, and radiant. I love that it doesn’t leave your skin oily like some serums. Very light scent, I always prefer skin care that isn’t overwhelmingly scented. #gotitfree # double serum #clarinsskincare

This anti-aging treatment was a real treat to use. In only 7 days of use, my skin looked more supple, firm, and the fine lines around my eyes and on my forehead also looked less visible. I got to try #ClarinsSkinCare #DoubleSerum thanks to #Butterly #gotitfree.  @thisisbutterly @chickadvisor @clarinscanada.  The sample I was given was for 7 days.  You only need a little bit to spread across your face.  It made my skins feel soft and moisturized and smelled so good.  I love that it did not leave my face greasy and was good for layering other products.  My skin is sensitive, and it did not irritate me at all.  I love this product.

I got this product complimentary from butterfly/ chick advisor. This product I have used multiple times before in the past. You will notice a difference in your skin with consistant use of this serum. Day & night. I noticed within a week my skin was smoother, more radiant and hydrated! It also leaves the skin feeling so soft.

review_title: Feels great with a pleasant scent
review_text: I received this as a 7-day sample trial so I don’t know if that’s long enough to really see results. However, from the week that  I have used it, I can tell you that it feels very nice going on, has a very pleasant scent and it did leave my skin feeling soft and hydrated.  It was a bit messy mixing the two products together prior to applying, but I think that has more to do with the sample packs than the product.  I thought it would be a bit oily, but it really didn’t feel that way when applying and it absorbed well.  I love that this product is made up of plant extracts, without any sulphates or mineral oil, but I’m not sure if the benefits are enough to justify the price versus other products.

I received some free samples to try this product from Butterly and I was surprised by the hydration. I like how it’s a double formula that mixes together. You really don’t need a lot and it doesn’t dry so fast that you don’t have time to apply it. Although it’s an oil, I find it doesn’t leave a greasy feel at all. The hydration is a quick effect, but I’d be curious about the long term advantages

I really enjoyed the smell of this item and did my best to stretch it out before reviewing it. Overall, I feel like it gave me a good glow but I broke out a lot because of which. It was super sheer and nice! It was interesting mixing the product together and overall I enjoyed the sample.

I tried a seven day trial of this Clarins’ double serum in exchange for my honest opinion from @thisisbutterly and @clarinscanada. It is the #1 selling Prestige serum in Canada and I love Clarins products, especially their restorative night creams. This serum has a unique presentation as there are two separate formulations that are mixed together just before applying the serum on your skin. The point of this is to provide maximum benefits to combat the signs of aging in your skin. The serum has a pleasant scent. Over my 7 day trial period, I felt my skin was revitalized and renewed; I would recommend this product to others interested in looking after their skin and not affected by scented products.

really like this serum. It feels lightweight and hydrating. After using it for a few days, I noticed my pores seemed smaller and my skin looked brighter and healthier in general. It also seemed to smooth and soften texture when applying it as part of my usual skin routine before makeup. I don’t have major issues with wrinkles and fine lines so I’m not sure if this will help in terms of anti-aging, although I could see this plumping and brightening skin over time for a more youthful appearance overall. Definitely a must try for anyone who enjoys luxury serums

I was sent a seven day sample for free to try in exchange for my honest opinion. I have used it daily for the past week after I washed my face but before I applied my moisturizer. I can see it helping with anti-aging with continuous use.

This wasn’t a good match for me, the scent was overwhelming for me and the product wasn’t great for my skin. It probably is extremely effective for some skin types, but it just wasn’t a match for me. Overall I think it would be something to try and see, as reactions vary and my skin didn’t like something in it.

I’m loving the glow this gives me! The serums are easy to mix in my hands and absorb into my skin quickly. It has a light floral scent that I actually really enjoy but it goes away quickly for those who don’t like scented products. I also love that I can choose the amount that pumps out!
I would say this product works but I would do a test on your skin. Like your arm , before applying it to your face..

This serum is so light, it literally feels like water. It feels very hydrating as soon as you apply it, and it works well layered under moisturizer. I’ve been using in the AM and PM and my skin looks overall more supple and glowy. It’s only been a couple of weeks but I’m excited to track results after using for a bit longer.

This serum is very hydrating which my dry skin really enjoys. I also really enjoy the light scent of the product. My skin is feeling a bit smoother and more radiant after using this for about a week. I love that my skin feels healthier and more nourished.

This is two power serums in one product that works like magic. I use it daily on my face and neck area. It has visibly minimized pores and reduced wrinkles. This serum works great my skin type, to smooth and hydrate it.
I love this serum. It gives my skin a beautiful glow and I have noticed a move even skin tone/less redness. It does have a scent, but I find it pleasant.

I was really impressed with this product. It made my skin feel hydrated when used as part of my skincare routine and it didn’t irritate at all. I can’t speak for any real anti-aging benefits but it’s a nice serum to be sure.

review_title: Formula is different from my beloved older version
review_text: I recently received a 7 day Clarins anti-aging duo sample from Influenster- the Double Serum & Extra-Firming Energy Day Cream. As a former Clarins employee, I have used the Double Serum & a previous version of the Extra Firming Day cream with phenomenal results in the past, so I was excited to put the new variant to work!One of the reasons I went to work for #Clarins was because their plant-based skincare completely transformed my tight, dry, itchy, sensitive skin after I lost weight. Clarins did what no other brand could for my skin, so I was hooked. Needless to say I was thrilled to give this #VoxBox my undivided attention for a week to test the Double Serum & Extra-Firming Energy Day Cream.DOUBLE SERUM* Two-phase formula that’s oil & water based. * 21  potent plant extracts {many of them organic}— including Banana, Oat, Teasal, Kiwi, Avocado, Goji Berry, Leaf of Life, Huang Qi, Turmeric, & such— to attack visible signs of aging.* Visibly firms, reduces wrinkles, smooths, hydrates, tightens pores, & boosts radiance in 7 days.* Eco-friendly bottle made from PCR & uses less packaging.* Serum boosts the performance of Clarins’ moisturizers.Seven days is not that long to test anti-aging skincare, but these are 2 that provide appreciable results in the short term, but even bigger, better ones 30+ days later. They feel silky smooth, give the nicest finish, & work beautifully under makeup. The drawbacks for me are price & that the Double Serum is not the same formula as the one I used & loved several years ago. The older version seemed to give a deeper hydration & more overall brightening, but maybe I should not compare my past history to just a 7 day trial. It is also important to note that very little product is required, so these may last longer than your typical serum + moisturizer, making them more cost effective. Overall I would recommend this if it’s in your budget or if you could take advantage of a sale.

However I do wear it as a nice last stop and it just gives me such a special glow.  Not in a chalky highlighter kind of way but in a very healthy just sprayed a beautiful mist way. Also it just really helps with any redness I have on the skin.  Not sure how well this will do with make up as I don’t wear it but as a last step on your skincare routine this is GOLD! Pink gold but gold.

review_title: Light and not sticky, but prepare for fragrance!
review_text: I use a lot of different serums, and haven’t found a single one with this unique combination. I have dry/combo skin that gets so flaky and uncomfortable in the winter but is still prone to breakouts, and this combo of niacinimide and hyaluronic is IDEAL. the best part is that it is not sticky at ALL — something that is hard to find with a hyaluronic serum. Packaging and color is gorgeous. It feels like a premium product, but is still youthful and fun. It reminds me a bit of my Y2K beauty days, but all grown up. I will need a few weeks to see how this really sits with my skin, but so far so good. TBH I am not thrilled w the fragrance (I don’t want my face to smell like a watermelon jolly rancher lip smacker, lol) but it fades rather quickly. However if you’re allergic to fragrance, this may not be the formula for you. For this reason it loses a half point, but Sephora won’t let me do 4.5!The last thing I love is the versatility. You can blend this with your makeup to create a lighter, fresh, more dewy glow. Because matte skin is so 2004. Thank you for this complimentary from Glow Recipe product for my honest review.

The way it makes my skin look is amazing. I love the dewyness. It’s such a healthy glow. It absorbs fast on the skin and makeup looks beautiful combined with it. When I use it on its own, it makes my skin look so glowy. This product was gifted by Glow Recipe.

review_title: Love it for brightening the skin!
review_text: Like all of Glow Recipe’s products, their new Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Drops smell heavenly. Their products always smell like delicious candy and have beautiful packaging.Their new product claims to lighten hyperpigmentation due to the niacinamide ingredient. While I generally have issues with niacinamide breaking me out, this product luckily didn’t do that. I also appreciate that this product layers well under makeup, but you need to make sure that it’s completely dry before applying any primers or foundations. This product is mildly tacky so it will allow your products to adhere better as well.Overall, their product is fantastic and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to reduce their dark spots and brighten their skin for a more even and radiant complexion. This product was gifted by Glow Recipe, but that does not change or persuade my opinions of this product.

I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe when it launched. I think it has a really beautiful texture,  between a lightweight moisturizer and a primer! While I don’t use a niacinamide serum in my everyday routine, I do like using this before makeup to give me a really beautiful glow! I am all about dewy makeup and a “honey skin” look and I definitely think this helps with that since so many foundations are meant to be mattifying!

(gifted by Glow Recipe) I’ve been a fan of the Glow Recipe line for a while, and their Watermelon Glow sleeping mask and toner are right up there in terms of my favorite skincare products ever. While these Niacinamide Dew Drops don’t quite blow me away in the same way, here’s what I think:* Great texture that’s a similar silky dewy serum to the rest of their watermelon line* No pilling and great for layering * Adds dewinessHere’s where I think it can be improved:* Not dewy enough to rival a makeup highlighter in my opinion * Hence, a bit overpriced for just a niacinamide serum

#glowrecipegiftedme —>I have been absolutely loving the Glow Recipe Dew Drops. The texture feels super hydrating and glowy on the skin. I found that the product absorbed super quick into the skin and played well with other products. I absolutely love to use it as a part of my skincare routine versus over makeup. I would absolutely recommend this product!

Been loving this niacinamide serum, gifted by glow recipe! I like to mix this in with foundation for a lighter coverage/glow. It also wears super nicely under makeup, the radiance is beautiful. It has a thick moisturizing texture that isn’t heavy and has the classic watermelon scent, it’s not overbearing but something to keep in mind if you’re sensitive to fragrances.

I was gifted this new niacinamide serum complimentary from Glow Recioe and it’s one of their more innovative products. It has a nice, serum like texture that’s not too heavy. This product can be easily applied to the skin and sits well under makeup. If you want an extra glow dab a little above your makeup. It absorb nicely and didn’t feel overly sticky or tacky on the skin.

review_title: OBSESSED: perfect for dry or dull skin!
review_text: I’m absolutely obsessed Watermelon Glow Dew Drops! The product is the perfect lightweight and silky texture. I love using it before my makeup and mixed in with my foundation. It absorbs so fast and leaves no sticky residue which is a major PLUS! Also looks perfect for an added glowy highlighter as my finishing touch to my makeup look. I have very dry skin and it makes me look so radiant and bright! I absolutely recommend this product and so happy it was gifted by Glow Recipe!

I received these Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew drops complimentary from Glow Recipe. I’m absolutely in love with the glow that they give me. They have a nice light scent but it’s not overpowering. It makes my skin feel plump and gives and instant shine. I feel it also helps my makeup last longer. I like to use these in the morning under my BB cream!

This product was gifted to me by glow recipe for free in return for my review. I was super excited to receive the product, because of the ingredients. I love Niacinamide and I love combining my skincare and makeup when applicable. The texture is lightweight and absorbs into the skin nicely. I will say that I prefer to use this alone underneath makeup, not mixed in with a foundation. It gives a very youthful glow to the skin, and overall I really enjoyed this product.

This product is perfect for anyone who wants that natural glow. I find that a little goes a long way with this product because it does a have a tacky finish, which I am not a fan of. I have used it both as a serum on non-makeup days and mixed in with my foundation, which I prefer because it helps combat the stickiness. As for the glow aspect, it does a great job! I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe.

The dew drops gifted by Glow Recipe are lovely! I love the slippy, gel texture - it’s moisturizing without being too heavy or leaving behind a film. It took me a while to figure out the right amount to use, because too much and I found that it sat on the skin, but too little didn’t give me the glow I wanted. But with the right amount it gives such a beautifulhealthy glow. Under makeup it works like a charm as a primer. I found that my makeup went on so smoothly, but didn’t notice too much change in the longevity compared to my other primers. There was a bit of a learning curve figuring out how to best apply over makeup, but just a little bit on my fingertips and patting it in works best for me. It gives such a natural dewy glow and I like using it on top of powder highlighters to melt them into the skin. My favorite way too apply is as a serum when I’mnot wearing makeup, it makes my skin looks so healthy!

review_title: glow up this holiday season with this holy grail
review_text: Glow Recipe gifted me the newly launched Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops and I’ve found my new holy grail product! & it’s super user friendly and easy to use ⁣Y’all this stuff is so versatile you will definitely want to add it to your routine. I used it in 3 ways in the look above which is my current favorite way to use this product. I used it under my makeup, mixed in with my foundation, and then to finish the look off with a dab on my cheekbones!⁣⁣This stuff legit made my skin look and feel younger after just one use. When wearing it you get a dewy glow & after you take it off you see the benefits from the niacinamide. The texture is hydrating, goes on smooth, and doesn’t leave the face feeling sticky. It helped my makeup stay on longer as well, making it a great primer underneath makeup or finishing touch at the end. ⁣Oh and it smells like candy

glow recipe is a brand that continually releases new & intriguing products that push the limits and show just how creative this brand truly is. when I got the email about a product that could be used as a serum OR a highlighter I was instantly intrigued and instantly sold, and there was no disappointment here! the scent is like giving your skin a sweet candy treat which i LOVE, the texture is wonderfully done & works into the skin effortlessly. the glow is prominent yet subtle enough to be seen as natural, yet you can build upon it to enhance if using as a highlighter! bottom line I AM IN LOOOOOVE! this was gifted by Glow Recipe.

I’ve been using @glowrecipe niacinamide every morning this week and I’m loving the dewy look it’s giving me without my makeup! I think this is a wonderful product for your AM routine that adds more plump to your skin and leaves it looking brighter without adding any cakey looking makeup!! This is definitely a fave niacinamide - gifted by glow recipe

Glow recipe gifted me this dew drops and I am in love. First of all the scent is AMAZING! I cannot stress this enough, it seriously smells just like watermelon you want to eat it. The texture is gorgeous. It is very lightweight and has the perfect amount of glow. You can easily wear this in order to give your skin a no-makeup look and you seriously look like you have a filter on your face naturally! You can also use it under and above makeup for a highlighter that also has skincare benefits. This was great to use prior to my foundation and it gives a great dewy base and my makeup lasted longer with this on. It also makes my makeup look more natural. Over my makeup was great because it gives a subtle glow and I feel better knowing I am using a highlighter that is good for my skin! I personally do not like highlighters that feel to glittery as I don’t feel that is too good for my skin so having a liquid one that is also skincare is the best option for me. This absorbs very quickly onto the skin and makes my skin feel smooth. You seriously end up with filter-like skin! My favorite way to use this product is when doing a no-makeup look as it looks like you put makeup on but in reality it is just great skincare!

I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe. Smells like delicious watermelon and love the healthy glow it gives to the skin. Subtle but definetly there. Just the right amount in my opinion. Especially during winter when my skin tends to be a bit more dry and a nice glow is always a plus. The consistency is light and liquidy, sinks in beautifully.

I received the “Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops“ complimentary from Glow Recipe and Influenster for the purposes of a review.This serum contains niacinamide, watermelon, hyaluronic acid, and moringa seed oil which help in giving a healthy and dewy glow to the skin while also delivering skincare benefits. Niacinamide helps with skin texture, watermelon is packed with antioxidants and HA and Moringa Seed help with skin hydration.Personally, I’m not a fan of very dewy products. I live in a warm climate so dewy equals greasy in my book. However, this serum is lovely. I don’t usually wear foundation and this serum does give my skin a more even and glow from within look. I think it would work well with makeup settles on the skin since your skin wouldn’t show any dry patches.I add the serum as my last step before SPF and although I wear SPFs with a matte finish, this serum helps my skin not to look completely flat.   It looks like my skin is glowing from within which I love. It doesn’t get oily throughout the day and during the winter my skin feels moisturized. There’s also the Watermelon scent that’s lovely when you apply it but doesn’t linger. I honestly didn’t expect to like it as much as I did. I will continue using and would 100% repurchase.

Glow in a bottle! It’s a skincare-makeup hybrid that helps visibly brighten skin and deliver an effortless glow instantly and over time. The package is beautiful and feminine. Love the scent, it just become my new favorite product! Complimentary from Glow Recipe.

This glow serum (which I was gifted by Glow Recipe) has a glossy, slightly sticky texture upon application, however it absorbs quickly and does not leave any residue on the skin. It gives my skin a nice glow and has a light sweet fragrance. I wear it on days I am not wearing any makeup for an extra glow in my complexion. It also works well under makeup. I recommend!

I was given this serum complimentary from glow recipe to review. I love these watermelon dew drops. They give your face a beautiful glow without having a sticky texture. They are also super hydrating. I would definitely purchase these again especially to try in the summer.

I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe! I’ve tried some of their previous Watermelon products and loved this one just as much. It has the same sweet scent without being overpowering. The serum also sunk into the skin nicely and could be definitely be worn under makeup without being too heavy.

The Glow Recipe Watermelon Dew Drops has a gel/serum like texture. The smell is also amazing, it smells like fresh watermelon. When I applied it with clean skin (no makeup day) it gave my skin a hydrated appearance and felt moisturizing. When I wore it under makeup my skin felt nicely prepped for my complexion products. I really liked it for no makeup days and also as a base in my make prep! This was gifted by Glow Recipe for my review.

This is such a great multitasking product. I love that I can use it as a moisturizer or a highlighter. This adds such a nice glow to the face. Glow recipe gifted me this watermelon glow niacinamide dew drops that have been absolutely amazing on my skin. The instant moment I apply my skin looks glowy and hydrated. They not only smell amazing but do such an amazing job.

I received this complimentary from the brand and it came right when I ran out of my current niacinamide serum. The universe heard me ✨. ...I have to admit, right off the bat I was swept away by the packaging. I mean, look at how beautifully shimmery and pearl-esque this looks. So naturally, I was like PLEASE don’t break me out, pleeease don’t break me out. My inner dialogue was screaming for it to work well with my combo/dry New York skin. ...So far so good! It has such a beautiful feel/glowy finish. I enjoy using it before applying makeup-it allows my face to feel more brighter and nourished. I enjoy how it sets and sits on my face. I feel like it worked magically well under my makeup and didn’t disrupt the flow or act of putting on any makeup products on my face. Also, uhmmm hello gorgeous texture-gives me ASMR vibes. Well done glowrecipe, this is by far one of my favorites from you. To be fair, I have only used it a total of three times in the past week, so it’s hard to give a real review and see real results. I have super high hopes that this little baby will give me amazing results as the weeks pass by. As always, I attempt to be as authentic with my reviews.

Glow Recipe gifted me their Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops. This is Glow Recipe’s take on skincare and makeup in ONE. love mixing this with my primers! give you the most beautiful glow and doesn’t make you look orange!
