review_title: PERFECT GLOW ON NO MAKEUP DAYS!!
review_text: I seriously love this product so much! have been using for over two years now and tried with many different moisturizers and sunscreens. You can mix it with DE’s B Hydra as well. The only moisturizer I have tried with d bronzi that I don’t recommend is tatcha’s the water cream. If you use the water cream, you will understand what I mean when I say the the cream spreads out too easily on your face to mix well with d bronzi. The texture of the water cream and how it kind of melts across your skin is not compatible with d bronzi and will just cause patches of bronzy glow all over your face. Out of all the moisturizers/sunscreens I have tried with these drops (Purito, Krave, DE, Acure, Tatcha, Summer Fridays, and more) I think the best mixture I have found is with DE’s LaLa Retro. The two products blend together seamlessly and create such a natural look on my face. For those of you who don’t know, d bronzi requires mixing with some kind of other product (moisturizer, serum, sunscreen) because it is CONCENTRATED. Sometimes when you apply it, it looks a little scary at first but after working it into your skin a little you will get a beautiful flawless glow. I have fairer skin (but tan easily in summer), blue eyes, and blonde hair, and it works wonderfully for me, but I’m guessing it will probably not be as effective on tanner/darker skinned beauties just because it is not super dark. However if you do have a deeper skin tone and white moisturizers leave a cast on you, this may work well to hide the white cast!

I love this product. It is a little expensive but for me it’s worth it because I don’t end up using every day so it’s lasted me awhile. It’s especially helpful in the colder months when my skin is kind of lack luster, I add this in with my moisturizer and it makes me look a lot more alive lol

This is a shimmery tan bronzer with a consistency that similar to a thin gel lotion that is not too thin or too thick. It does lean quite orange. I had it for awhile before I really fell in love with it. I now use it either mixed into my sunscreen before I apply my tinted moisturizer or mixed into my tinted moisturizer or foundation. I have like yellow toned skin and I find adding this into my base makes me look alive! I have tried some of the other tan/bronzer drops and I definitely prefer this one as it is not too intense. It is a staple product for me and I will always repurchase. That said, I will say, I don’t wear it without mixing with a base or applying something over top as it is quite fake compared to my skin tone and makes me too orange on its own.
Great product. Gives me super pale face a nice summer glow. Will repurchase unless I find something similar at the drugstore! Cause this is expensive! Haha

I have sensitive/acne prone skin, and this product doesn’t break me out! It’s super pretty - and perfect for a bronzed no-makeup look. On the packaging it suggests mixing with the DE vitamin C - so I mixed with the one I have from Ole Henriksen - DO NOT DO THIS. MADE ME BREAK OUT. For best results (with sensitive skin) I either put on AFTER my moisturizer (harder to mix in, but doable), or with my sunscreen, which comes out really nice!

I love this sunshine in a bottle! A tube lasts nearly a year and I mix it daily with my moisturizer in the morning. Gives a nice glow- just use a light hand for a natural look.

review_text: Love this product. I’m fair skinned and this gives me the perfect healthy looking glow. I also have oily skin, and this doesn’t make me more oily! I purchased D Bronzi, C Firma, B Hydra and Protoni Polypetide Moisturizer as a DE newbie. With fair skin, I was very impressed with the nice glow-y and stream-free color this gave me, but I cannot figure out how to appropriately mix this for effect unless I don’t wear makeup. I tried mixing with the Protini (DE recommends you blend with other DE products), but the effect is completely lost if you add makeup after. Mixing with sunscreen after makeup also showed little to no bronzing benefit, so I am at a loss here for how this is practical unless you plan to go out without makeup. I will return or run it out but I do t plan to repurchase unless I figure out how to make this product work for me.

A tiny bit goes a really long way!! If you don’t want to use self tanner but want to add a bit of natural color to your face this product does the trick. You mix a tiny and I mean tiny dot into you face lotion, oil, foundation, etc. and it gives you amazing natural color. Good if you are tan and need to darken your normal foundation too!

I’m really enjoying this product! I mix it with my bb cream and blend all over my face as my daily go-to and I like the subtle glow, without looking orange. A little goes a LONG way. I sometimes put one single dot on the apple of each cheek and blend in as a blush/bronzer and that works pretty well too

review_title: Brings Out Spots And Any Breakouts
review_text: Purchased this and have tried it with serums and moisturizers. Definitely adds colour to my face, however, it sometimes looks a little muddy and not like a nice “glow“ that is advertised. Also, note that if you have any small breakouts or spots on your face this will make them look darker and more enhanced.
just the right amount of glow and  a light bronze color.  would love a deeper color too

Really enjoy this for a summer glow! Not a necessity though. I’ll finish the product, not sure if I’ll repurchase or not. But if this is the type of product you’re looking for then go for it! It’s great.
Not the greatest. These leave more of an “orange“ look. Make sure you don’t get this in your eyebrows, it looked super orange on the skin around & under my brows.

Just got this in the mail today and I can already say I love this product. I have debated purchasing this product because I was scared that it would come off orange on my ghostly white skin color. However, i was super pleased about the results. I mixed one drop of the product with my daily moisturizer and it gave my skin just a nice subtle bronze. A little goes a long way. I would  definitely repurchase this.
Favourite product since it first dropped!  I mix it with my tinted moisturizer or spf! In the summer, I like to mix it with my foundation since I get darker and more tanned in the summer.

I bought this product back in December and I fell in love. I mix it with my Drunk Elephant Protini moisturizer. It gives me such an even glow to the point that I feel like Im wearing makeup when I’m not. I even put it on before putting on my foundation as well! Such a verstile product. I love! And doesn’t make me commit to using a self tanner or tanning drops on my face because it will come off at the end of the day when I cleanse. Amazing product.
Does all that it claims and would last you forever considering the pea size amount that you need! Love this product ! Definitely a summer must have for me !

review_title: Add a tan glow, blend with your daily moisturizer
review_text: You’ll definitely get a tan glow and skin boost from this product, but it is very concentrated and easy to overdue. I add a dot or two to my daily moisturizer or my Vitamin B5 gel. I live in a sunny climate and tan easily but keep my face out of the sun, so in pictures, my face looked oddly paler than the rest of me. I blend this in my lotion down to my neck.

I mix this with sunscreen or moisturizer. I am extremely pale and this is the only liquid all-over bronzer that doesn’t get patchy or orange. It gives a reasonable, natural glow which is what I want.  Still a bit expensive but I will probably repurchase. Honestly, it makes me put on sunscreen most days which is a plus.
Love this product! Give such vacation glow . I get so many compliments when I use this product.

I want this to work for me soooooo bad. I love the idea and the color looks really nice on my skin. But this just isn’t it for me. At first it looks really nice and is perfect for just giving your skin color and a no makeup look but it gets super splotchy and makes my skin oily. I’ve tried it with moisturizers, matte primes and my itself and nothing helps it stay in my skin. With all the good reviews it makes me so sad that it was a flop for me ):

I love this serum!!! I mix it with my spf and don’t need to wear foundation only concealer on spots and under eyes.  I dust my face with a setting powder and I love that it covers my imperfections but still shows my skin.  My face is lighter than my body so this adds just the right amount of color so that everything blends well.  Since I’ve gotten this I don’t wear foundation anymore!!!  Plus this is skincare not makeup so I known I’m not clogging my pores.  It’s a must in my daily routine for a fresh face!

Love this. Gives a beautiful sun kissed glow. I have reactive skin prone to breakouts and redness. I pump in winter warms up my pale complexion... 2 pumps in summer to match my face to the rest of my sun kissed body. Love this.
Lightweight. Gorgeous bronze tone. Easy to use. Highly recommend
I’m really loving this product.  I add a little of it to my moisturizer or sunscreen for an everyday little hint of glow/color.  I don’t wear foundation anymore.

I’ve received two samples of this , and had to get the full size. I use this under makeup and mixed with the Drunk Elephant Sheer Umbra on barefaced days. This is amazing, if you’re thinking about getting it - you won’t regret it. I’m a black girl (Fenty shade 390) and it gives us the most perfect glow.

review_title: Oily and shiny after each use :(
review_text: Was really hoping for that sunny glow without the damage as purported in the description. This poor little tube left me super greasy no matter how little I used, and the color was not complementary to my skin. I’m not even light so I thought it would at least blend into my medium/tan skin, but no. I ended up returning it. :(  BTW I’m an oily gal and had initially been assured by the beauty adviser in the store that this wouldn’t be slick or glittery on my face. She was wrong. lol
Mixed this with my day cream and love the natural tanned look of my skin.  Nice alternative to wearing make up.

I have nothing negative to say about this product. It hasn’t caused any adverse effects to my skin since using it and I mix it with Tatcha Water Gel moisturizer for a nice, healthy and glowy base prior to my make up application. It doesn’t make me orange as I feared it would (I’m sure if you just used it on its own, it would be too much) It gives me a boost of happiness everytime I apply it because it just gives me such a nice wash of subtle colour. I can’t say much about whether it really prevents pollutants from getting into my pores but I would recommend it just for the fact that it gives your skin such a nice glow up.
I love the bronzy color this adds. My skin looks so amazing while using this, highly recommend.

This is my first review because I never care to write them. However this is prob one of my favourite bronzing products I have ever tried. I tried the trial size in the “out of office” kit, and it blew me away. I mix it with my face cream and the fact that I don’t feel like I am wearing anything extra is what sold me. It’s blends so well unlike other “drop” products I have tried, that have separated on my face or still looked like tinted moisturizer. So this product to me is a must buy. It’s the perfect amount of bronzing glow!

This product really is sunshine in a bottle and add such a beautiful soul glow highly recommend mixing it with a moisturizer or sunscreen definitely not on its own because it is very highly pigmented great ingredients and makes my skin Glowy and soft

Finally!! Something that gives me a natural and healthy glow and doesn’t cause breakouts.  I have super sensitive skin and this product does not disappoint.  I mix a little pump with my Cetaphil moisturizer (necessary due to sensitive skin) and I was so shocked that I had no reaction to the product other than a healthy glow.  Went from pale to glowing!! So pleased!

Loved this for a subtle glow and summer basic.  I can mix this with sunscreen or moisturizer for easy summer coverage.  Just a drop will do for a light glow, but this can be easily adjusted by using more product.  It is hard sometimes to control the amount of product that comes out, but that’s likely more just me getting used to the right amount of pressure to apply.

I’ve had my tube of D-Bronzi for months and I seriously can’t figure out how to best use it on my medium skin-tone.  I’ve tried to mix it with B-Hydra, sunscreens, foundations, used it alone, mixed with oil, used various amounts of the product, and I can’t seem to find a great way to use it.  It always ends up looking a little ruddy and orange on me.  I love the lit-from-within glow it gives, and I’m sure it would look great in the summer when I’m 3 shades darker.  But for most of the year, it’s been a challenge to make this work.  I do tan easily, and I have a warm undertone.  For some reason, I’m still determined to find a way to make this work!  For now, an OKAY 3 stars.

This is such a genius product! Add a little bit of this stuff to your existing moisturizer and it gives such a healthy, natural glow- no orange tones at all. I also find that it evens skin tone and smoothes my pores which is perfect for summer when I don’t want to wear a heavy foundation. Absolutely worth the investment!

I bought this during the VIB sale because Allana Davison raves about it! It’s not supposed to be used on it’s own so I mix it in with either my sunscreen or primer and it blends out nicely. A little goes a long way so I think this will last me a long time. I’d say it’s not like a “omg life changing“ product, but it’s definitely nice to have. It gives you a nice, healthy bronzy glow underneath makeup (or even just for your bare face) and I like the anti-pollution/skincare components it has. I’ve only used it for a few weeks now, but liking it so far!

review_title: Mix with Cicapair Color correct for perfect ltwt f
review_text: I mix this with my Cicapair Color correcting SPF cream: I love the natural finish and no-makeup feel on my skin. Wayyy better than wearing even a lightweight foundation in the summer. No breakouts on my breakout-prone skin when I use this :)

Love it. Iconic status. The shade is wonderful, and gives me light coverage and evens out my skintone when i mix it with moisturizer or sunscreen.I hope DE comes out with a few more shades to play with.

This looks so pretty coming out of the bottle but even if I applied it straight from the bottle (you’re supposed to mix it) it still didn’t show up on my skin. I have medium/brown olive skin so unless you’re very pale or only want it for the anti-pollution, definitely not worth your money.

Had to experiment with application a bit but I ended up loving it! If it’s mixed in with moisturizer or spf it gives a nice subtle glow. I’ll also use it sometimes alone as a liquid bronzer/contour. Love that it’s ‘clean’.

I tried this as a sample and I was just blown away by how well it works. I am very fair and currently in the midst of a bad cold. After mixing a drop of this into my serum I instantly looked more alive and had a natural glow. It doesnt seem to be irritating to my skin either. As someone with very sensitive skin I usually become flushed or my skin will tingle if the product doesn’t agree with it. Will adjust my review if anything changes.

At first it’s super orange and hard to blend I add it to my youth to the people açaí oil and I blend it into my face and then I take a brush and really work it in. It takes a while to work it in and make it really not streaky but I wear just this all over my face and I love love love the finish I don’t wear any makeup with it. It covers my blemishes and gives my skin this tan and glow like I just came back from a week in Miami
Love the nice color it gives your skin and that it has great ingredients for your skin too
Could not make this product work. Color looked unnatural no matter what I mixed it with. Looked splotchy and uneven. Extra star for ingredients.

I have never used a drunken elephant product before and this had been recommended by every sephora member when I went in. My skin has never looked so good and healthy before I started using this. It helped give a healthy glow to my skin that will help me stay looking golden and dewy all through the winter months. I am now not only switching myself over to more of their products but getting my sister some as well. Highly recommend
I love just about all of Drunk Elephant’s products and this one is on that list! I love that you can decide the amount of tan you want to be and it looks very natural!

I am super pale with redness and self tanners never looks even and bronzing powders can look dirty or too harsh on my skintone (i have tried countless different ones). I was very skeptical about how well this would work but let me tell you-after mixing just a little in with my face serum and applying all over my face-my skin had a subtle but noticeable bronze glow and looked completely natural! It was super easy to blend! LOVE this stuff!!
Amazing! Do yourself a favor (if you have pale skin especially) and try this!! It’s been wonderful this summer I have used it every day!!!

What a fun product! This might seem exorbitant, and frankly, that’s why the 4 stars, but this is a great product for me. I’m getting older, and avoiding the sun more, but the bottom half of my legs don’t really match the upper part. I use 1 pump, along with 5-8 drops of Marula oil (I’m very dry!) and blend onto my legs. This looks great on me! It’s just a hint of color, and the sheen of this product, coupled with the marula oil, gives me a nice, smooth look. I use this on my shoulders, too, if I’m wearing sleeveless. I do wear shorts a lot, so for me, this is a great product. Just remember to wipe off before bed. I just use a moist cloth, and so far, no stained sheets, though I’m not sure if it would be an issue anyway.
Not orange at all. Doesn’t oxidize. Stays put all day.
I love this!! Perfect glow, and I only need about half a pump (mixed into Belif Aqua Bomb). Looks great on its own and under makeup.
Amazing product to add your summer glow !

I am surprised by how much I love this product. I’ve been mixing it into my moisturizer or sunscreen most days and it provides a really lovely all over glow and a light bronzing effect. It’s beautiful and I have really stopped wearing foundation most days because of it.

HG product! I rarely say that. I’ve used this every day since I bought it, shortly after release. Gives a beautiful warm glow to my light-toned skin. I mix about a pump with moisturizer, let it set, then add sunscreen. Sometimes, I’ll stipple a little bit on my cheeks for a more bronzed look. A beautiful glow plus good-for-your-skin peptides and antioxidants; what more could you ask for?

I went on a “vacation,” that involved less sleep than usual and very little suntanning. I returned and everyone commented on how “refreshed” I looked. The only thing I switched up was my bronzer! This stuff is incredibly natural looking, like you just got a little tan on your lunch hour. D-Bronzi Plays well with my other makeup, it’s buildable and can be used for subtle contouring as well. I usually just use it after I apply my cover FX drops + moisturizer and use a kabuki or foundation brush to blend it in the hollows of my cheeks and slightly above for a sun kissed effect. Perfect for my gals who don’t sun their face. I may never go back to powder bronzer again. As you can tell, I love it so much, I don’t even know or care what good it’s doing to my face because it stays on and is just a great bronzing product.

Best Product I have ever used!!! It doesn’t break me out and makes me look so naturally tan. I wear this with concealer and powder and looks beautiful. I’m going to stock up on more bottles. I cannot get enough of this product.

I got the full size of this and returned it because I thought the color came out orange and horrible on me. Then I got a sample from another online order. Instead of trying to mix it into a moisturizer I tried doing all of my skincare routine and then at the end, I dotted it on each cheek and blended it out. Came out very natural and warm looking. You might need to play with this to see what works best for you, if at all, and I admit it’s a bit of work. I like it more now but not sure I’d purchase instead of continuing to use powder bronzer

Everything you could ever want in....any product. Seriously. I mix it half and half with DE’s Protini moisturizer for a beautiful glow that lasts all day without primer, foundation or concealer needed. This will live in my daily rotation forever (DE, please never take it away!) I am so white that I’m almost see through and this does not look unnatural or orange when applied. It’s life. End of story.

This is one of my favorite products on the market. I was so unsure about it but I bought it before my trip to Mexico. I don’t like to get sun so I always need a little bronzer (I am a pale, auburn, brown eyed girl in my late 20’s). I used this the whole vacation. I did one pump with a mineral sunscreen and it was beyond amazing. Looked flawless and no burns. Now that I am back I mix one pump in my bb cream and it’s perfect. I will def buy this again. Best product they have!
Mixed with the ’Rise   Glow’ due not only makes your skin feel amazing but gives you a sunkissed glow.  I wear it alone and with make-up, win win either way!
LOVE!!! I mix it with my rose cream from herbivore !
Love this!!  I apply it with my tinted moisturizer and/or serum.
Obsessed. I mix with one pump of foundation and it gives a natural glow!

Day 3 of using this product. I have very fair skin, and terrible facial rosacea. My whole face is nothing but red 24/7. I thought this would be my new fav. Adding this in with my moisturizer is not doing much for my skin. I have been adding two pumps and although from a distance some parts of my face appear tan, my complexion looks uneven and almost more red/pink. I wanted to love this, I’m going to continue for another week or so and see if it will improve my skin overtime.
I absolutely love using D-Bronzi on my minimal makeup days. Gives my skin some bronze and glow with alil concealer and mascara and I’m good to go.

Ce produit est génial! Je le mélange à ma crème pour le visage et celle pour le corps. Le résultat est super beau! En plus, il ne me cause pas d’éruption d’acné et il ne fait pas orange (sur moi en tout cas, je ne sais pas pour les peaux très pâles). J’espère que je vais réussir à m’en racheter un tube avant qu’il soit encore en rupture de stock. J’enlève une étoile à cause du prix. Mais je l’aime tellement que je ne vais pas hésiter à me racheter.

I can’t rave about this product enough! I can actually feel comfortable going to work or anywhere without having to wear any kind of foundation! It’s so light and mixes beautifully with any moisturizer and/or oil and leaves a natural, sun kissed glow. I just wear this with some concealer, blush, and throw on some mascara and I’m good to go!

I admit it - I fell for the hype that was all over social media about this product. The ingredients are great, can’t argue that one. I’m yellow-toned/pale skinned, and it didn’t quite work for me in terms of texture and color. I tried to mix it in other DE products (Virgin Marula Oil, then the B-hydra) but didn’t quite look natural (too oily with the oil and color/texture didn’t work great with B-hydra). If you don’t mix it with other products, you need too much to be able to spread it and it’s way too concentrated. Will be returning this, sadly. Seemed too great to pass up but will have to.

I’m 29, fair-skinned, and normal/dry skin type. I’ve used self-tanners but I don’t like using them on my face since I’m trying to lighten my sun spots. This is SO WONDERFUL! I don’t wear foundation, so I add one pump to my sunscreen for my chest & neck, and a little pump mixed with sunscreen for my face & ears. It’s not too orange for my fair skin, definitely a brown/bronzed shade that doesn’t streak, transfer, or smell like fake tan! I love it and I’m sure I’ll buy it again when I run out(which should take a while because all I need is one pump)!
I wanted to love this product but I couldn’t. It pilled off my face immediately after application, and maximized my pores. I have pretty clear skin with minimal breakouts, so I am not sure.

Supergoop gifted me their new shade of the glowscreen and i am so in love!! It leaves such a pretty glow and sparkle to the skin. I’m pretty tan and this doesn’t leave any white cast or anythign which i love!

Complimentary from Supergoop I love this sunscreen it makes my skin look so soft it does not leave a white cast The formula is lightweight and gives a beautiful glow it gives my skin a healthy glow. Also includes SPF 40 which is a huge plus for protecting my skin from harmful raysThis sunscreen is so perfect under makeupAdds the perfect glow that is subtle and doesn’t make me look greasyGreat sunscreen! It doesn’t irritate me at all and I like that it doesn’t have a strong smell.

The Supergoop Glow Screen is one of my favorite skincare / makeup products ever. The new dawn shade gives a beautiful, rose toned glow that is perfect for the upcoming summer months. I love using this as my base and everyday makeup because it gives me a luminous glow from within while protecting my skin from sun damage.

I’ve used this for years. I rarely use it alone, though, because it is very shimmery. If you like a lot of glow, use it alone. I usually mix this with moisturizer, self tanner, and sometimes my face oil. I customize it to get what I want. you can apply this under make up or wear it solo if you just want a glow a but protected affect. It’s a good product to have in your make up bag. I will continue to buy this.

love this product!! i’m in my teens and wear this everyday. i got the small bottle in my sephora advent calendar around christmas time and have worn it everyday since and there is still some left! i’ll definitely be repurchasing!

Looking for a sunscreen that protects your skin and let’s you look great doing it? Give this a try. It’s lightweight enough to let your skin breathe, yet strong enough to protect you from the sun. Its gentle coverage gives your skin a clean, naturally smooth appearance. Love it!

review_title: A must have in my routine
review_text: I love the product so much, gives you that little glow that every girl loves! Not greasy at all and easy to apply can’t wait to try the golden one
i will forever repurchase this i love that it gives me a little bit of a tan and such a amazing glow and no white and protects my skin from the sun
i will forever repurchase this i love that it gives me a little bit of a tan and such a amazing glow and no white and protects my skin from the sun
I received this in a sample box and liked it so much I bought the full size. I use it as a primer and spf. It leaves a nice glow to your skin.
i love this sunscreen it makes me look glowy and i receive many many compliments!! i recommend to get the bigger one since the smaller one tends to run out quicker and has way less product.

review_title: Not for me, maybe for you
review_text: I wanted to like this sunscreen because I heard so much about it and I love to get the natural dewy glow. However, this one is just not for me. I put in on after my moisturizer and I usually don’t wear makeup on top of that. After a couple of hours, I felt like my face looked so oily and greasy. :(When I was putting in on, I waited to let it absorb and pat it on, but I feel like I started to get a little bit of piling. I feel like under foundation it does give an ok glow, but without makeup it’s too much for my skin. I have dry cheeks and oily T-zone, but I feel like this still make me look so greasy all over my face.I am going to try the summer friday sunscreen drops, hopefully that will work better for me.

I’m actually a little surprised to see so much love for this item.  I was hoping to use this for a “no makeup“ look but it’s not what I thought it would be.  1) The shimmer actually makes my skin look really greasy, like immediately turned made my skin look as oily as it gets at the end of the humid summer day.  However, WITH foundation the shine is reduced and creates a nice underglow.  2)  The texture is not the same as the Unseen Sunscreen, which is like a primer.  It’s more liquidy and doesn’t have that softness.  Overall I will finish the bottle but it was not the ultra light coverage “foundation“ I was hoping for.  I may try the bronze version, but as a sample first!

My favorite thing everIt’s makes my skin glow, the glow helps hide under eye circles a bit too, and my skin looks even better the next day! If I could get a lifetime supply of anything ever it’d be thisI’ve recommended it to everyone I know

review_title: Good as a makeup base, weird on its own
review_text: This sunscreen works decently as a base under makeup. It’s important to me to have adequate sun protection every day, but I also wear makeup most days and want the products I layer to be compatible. I have combo/oily skin and use a prescription retinoid at night, so it’s hard to find a routine that keeps my oils under control but doesn’t exacerbate my dry patches and make me look flat. Glow screen is pretty good for this. My soft matte foundation goes on smoothly over it and a bit of the glow carries through. I do get pretty oily later in the day and my makeup doesn’t last as long as if I use my usual primers, but it’s much better than the results I get with most sunscreens.I would not, however, wear this sunscreen on its own without makeup. For one thing, the lighter shade Champagne is too dark for my fair-light skin tone. It also has a very strange finish, almost metallic. It definitely doesn’t look natural by itself, at least not if you use enough to be properly protected from the sun.

I love this product! It doesn’t give my tan skin a white cast which is a major thing for me. This sunscreen is my absolute new favorite. The glow from within is a bonus! It’s so easy to apply and beautiful under makeup!

Obsessed with this! It gives me such a lovely bronzer glow. I’m naturally very pale but this made my skin glow and gave it a hit of a bronze. It not dark whatsoever but it definitely has a tint more so than the champagne one. Highly recommend.

Absolutely obsessed! I’ve worn it everyday since getting it & it’s now become apart of my daily routine. Very sheer with the tad bit of sheen. Love wearing under my makeup or on days when I want my skin to look a little refreshed.

I wasn’t expecting it to have color but it did, at first I was like uhmmmmm but then I was like WOW! It gave my skin some color & glow which now the name makes sense! This is perfect for summer when you want some coverage but not makeup! It’s super moisturizing and gives my skin that sunkissed glow!

Supergoop is hands-down the best sunscreen on the market!! I absolutely love the Glow Screen for that ‘no-makeup’ makeup look, giving you a bit of color and a gorgeous glowy sheen. I find that my makeup sits well on top of this sunscreen, and even without a full face, this product is perfect with a touch of cream blush and concealer for a natural finish. I also have the Unseen Sunscreen, and I find that I reach for this one more instead! Definitely recommend this for anyone looking to try a new sunscreen, it is worth every penny!

This sunscreen is awesome. It has a sheer wash of tint that looks great on my pale skin. It just evens my complexion out a bit. It does not oxidize during the day and I feel hydrated without being oily. It is easy to apply and sets kinda quickly. Looks great with a bit of gel blush on top too.

I love multi-tasking beauty products and Glowscreen SPF 40 is not the only one of them, but its performance is quite impressive! This product is easy to apply, it absorbs quickly and leaves my skin glowing and moisturized. I use it as a primer or alone. I received Glowscreen SPF 40 complimentary by Supergoop!

I was very excited to try the glow screen from Supergoop just due to the sheer amount of good reviews from social media. It did not disappoint in the slightest. An amazing base for light makeup that makes your face glow from within. Even alone, this product was great. I however wouldn’t recommend for oily consumers as it may be too glowy. Overall, great experience and absolutely lived up to the reviews!

I use SPF daily whether I am inside or outside. The packaging is perfect for throwing in your bag to travel so you don’t forget to reapply! I have combination skin and I do not need to use moisturizer. It applies and absorbs seamlessly into my skin. It feels really hydrating on my skin and did not make my skin feel or look greasy. I usually wear this alone for a bone makeup glow, yet when I have worn makeup over this and it does not pill. This SPF shields from UV rays AND blue light! I am a teacher so I have been on the computer everyday. I am enthusiastic to continue using this in my skincare regimen. I genuinely recommend this if you are looking for a sheer, smooth finish while preventing signs of aging.

The sunscreen is definitely dewy finish. And I found it’s a little greasy for me since I’m the combination skin type especially in summer. But I found it’s goes well with my cosmetic products and the ingredients are relatively “clean”. So I’m still gone repurchase.

I will incorporate this sunscreen into my every day routine. I am very picky about sunscreens, but this one blends in easily and does not leave a white residue. I like that the sunscreen makes my skin look dewey and also has a slight tint that makes my skin tone look even.

Listennnnn I love the way this sunscreen made me glow I looked so beautiful ALLLLL day and it’s perfect underneath makeup to give you that glow from within look, please check it out you ain’t be dissatisfied.

I love this product and definitely recommend it for anyone who wants a glowing base. I love to use SPF everyday and I also love the glow/dewy look and this product accomplishes both. It also is very light on the skin.

I really love this sunscreen! I’m super picky with sunscreen because I’m a POC and a lot give me a white cast but this does not and instead, makes me look glowy and moisturized! I never get white cast and I use this multiple times a day!

This is a new holy grail SPF. I have gotten so many compliments while wearing this. It has the prettiest glow and is perfect for a no makeup day to give your skin a little color.  No greasy texture like some sunscreens. I’ll always have this in my makeup bag!

This product i wanted to love because of the glow but man it was so disappointing! My skin color is more on the medium to medium dark now that it is sunny. It left my skin looking weird like white cast but glowy! The glow was beautiful but the way it blended on my skin was horrible. I tried it on my mom who is much lighter than I am and it blended beautifully on her! There should definitely be more color range since this can and can’t work on certain skin colors.

My first SPF holy grail! It’s gives a great glow-y base for foundation, non-greasy, and doesn’t leave my skin feeling dry! I love that it also blurs imperfections for me (post-breakout marks) and gives enough coverage alone for those days I want to go without foundation.

My first SPF holy grail! It’s gives a great glow-y base for foundation, non-greasy, and doesn’t leave my skin feeling dry! I love that it also blurs imperfections for me (post-breakout marks) and gives enough coverage alone for those days I want to go without foundation.

I wanted to love this after hearing so many people rave about it. I do like how pigmented it is and the bit of shimmer. BUT it is sooooo oily and the pigment ends up looking weirdly cakey after a few hours.

I like the glow that comes with this but I wish the tint came in different colors because I felt it made my medium deep skin look a light lighter than it usulaly is. I’m not sure if I’m a huge fan of it on its own, but I like it under makeup so that the look goes from sweaty/greesy to glow. Wearing makeup also covered the “lighter skin“ experience I mentioned earlier.

I loved the way it made my skin look, but unfortunately I had an allergic reaction to it. It’s probably the octocrylene which is known to be problematic for people with sensitive skin. The smell is also pretty awful, a very strong sunscreen smell. If my skin could tolerate the formula I’d probably suffer through the smell. Here’s to hoping they reformulate it for sensitive skin.
This is so easy to use, effective, and integrates perfectly into my routine. Can’t live without!

I wanted to like this so bad but it just didn’t work for me. I tried it with different moisturizers and even waited a few minutes between applying products. Yet it caused SO my piling. Also, instead of making me glowing, it makes me look pale like in a weird way. Not with it
Love this. My skin looks so good. I’ve gotten compliments that I look like I’m glowing. Wojkd be happy with the dewy effect alone but I really love that’s its a decent SPF too.

One of my favorite sunscreens specifically for underneath makeup! It gives my skin a golden glow which I find preps beautifully for makeup. My skin type is acne/ combo leaning more on the dry side. I tend to love a dewy complexion and this gives just that! It never looks too oily on me or breaks me out but if you lean more on my oily side this might not be for you! Great sunscreen and just started my 3rd bottle!

This sun screen is awesome. It definitely gives a glow. I will say it’s very hydrating so I think it’s better for dry skin. When it’s first applied it looks greasy but it dries in seconds and gives a great glow. For those saying it causes dry patches, I think it’s best to put on a moisturizer before hand regardless of the fact that it’s already hydrating. 10/10 recommend this sunscreen!
I mix this with a pump of Double Wear foundation and a liquid bronzer and it looks BEAUTIFUL!  It also looks great alone or under makeup.  I will definitely be repurchasing.
Love how this looks and feels but it pills :( idk how to get it to stop?
Love the sunscreen coverage it provides, light feel of it, no stickiness, and a subtle, sun-kissed glow! Highly recommend!
My favorite!!! So glowey. I even use it at night as a primer before my make up
It works, it goes on smooth… but omg it’s poison on the eyes lol I’ve never had a worse experience. I did find that it kinda piled a bit, but not bad. But if you have sensitive eyes I’d stay clear.
very glowy, looks great under makeup. soaks in relatively quick, doesnt feel like anything on the face after a minute
very glowy, looks great under makeup. soaks in relatively quick, doesnt feel like anything on the face after a minute
I wanted to love it, but it feels pretty greasy on my dry, sensitive skin. It’s fun to sparkle, though!

I purchased this product for under my makeup (and touch up with the Tarte Sea Set & Protect mineral powder). I definitely would not wear this product alone because of how much it shines and accentuates skin texture. But under my foundation, this product looks nice. Not a huge chemical sunscreen smell, but I think they sit better under makeup than mineral. I typically wear tinted mineral sunscreen daily, but like this for makeup days. It doesn’t have a strong smell which I like. It also dries down and absorbs quickly. I’d say the cons of the product are the price and that it can pill if you use too much, so less it definitely more with this product. That being said, I love the concept of SuperGoop and other companies that create innovative suncare products.
Feels fine on skin, a little irritating near eyes. Unfortunately, if you have visible pores or any texture to your skin, this really accentuates that. Appears to have a tiny, but offers no coverage.
Pills under makeup and makes the makeup look very bad, I don’t recommend it.

I tried this as a sample and wanted to love it, but it makes me look silver. The silver even comes through after I’ve layered other products over it. It’s very subtle, but still. Shouldn’t have to worry about things like that in this day and age. Sucks when a brand just doesn’t make something for an entire group of people and I have only heard great things about this product so I thought I should say something. I’m Syracuse in NARS foundation, so I’m not even the darkest person out there and when I’m even darker in the summer months, this is just….. not happening.

Ok. I wanted to love this item because one of the derms I follow on YouTube recommended it. However, it is extremely shiny, and glowy for my taste. You have to use a small amount for it to look normal and such small amount will not protect my skin from the Florida sun. I applied the recommended amount and I looked like a shiny orange mess. I will use for my neck and chest only. I expected a better product for the price. Back to my eltamd or australian botanical.
I returned this. It pills which is a bummer because the color and sheen is beautiful. I will stick with my unseen sunscreen with a makeup highlighter. I still love the brand

I was immensely disappointed with this sunscreen. Since it is a chemical formulation, you’d think that it would give a seamless glow along with sun protection—it doesn’t do that for me at all. It pills, clings to dry patches, and settles in shiny brown patches along my cheeks and nose. The mineral sheerscreen did the same too. Don’t waste your money on Supergoop when there’s more effective options out there for less.

Definitely has more than just a “glow”. It is too much for me in its own, has a metallic like finish. I like the idea of the product so I started adding a little bit to my regular sunscreen and it works great! Decided to keep it and use it that way. I do like the texture and the way it feels on my skin too. Works great under makeup.
Great product that provides a gorgeous glow under makeup and actually helps with longevity
Sat through my college grad in 90 degree weather and no shade and did not burn even with fair skin, looks glowy under make up. 10/10

I’d use this on my arms or décolletage but it’s way too shimmery for face. Even with makeup over it, my whole face looks greasy and sparkly, I wish it were more subtle. I also expected the consistency to be more similar to unseen sunscreen but found it very oily and slick.
feels nice, doesn’t leave a white cast or anything. i thought it would be more glowy though. doesn’t feel greasy, is a bit tacky though so it might be good under makeup. like it so far.

To be honest, sunblock has never been part of my skin care. I never realize how important it is to use until now. So I wanted to give this brand a try because i heard so many good things about it. And WOW , absolutely LOVE!!!! No white cast, leaves my face hydrated and glowing. 100% recommend!

I don’t like this. I have fair skin and the tint to this is too dark and I end up looking orange. This doesn’t sit well on top of the Supergoop spf40 moisturizer, I get pilling and it doesn’t really set in. I’m able to touch my face and it comes off easily. I don’t like the texture, it feels like a physical sunscreen. I usually use the Supergoop Unseen sunscreen so I decided to try this for the glow. If it wasn’t tinted I think I’d like this formula because the glow is nice in natural lighting.

Had to return this product sadly. I loved the way it made my very dry skin look. The formula is so pretty and glowy but it broke me out with little red bumps. Really sad about it but if you have super sensitive skin be careful. If not I think you would really enjoy this for a dewy hydrating base underneath makeup or alone!

review_title: A bit too Oompa Loompa but DEF worth it
review_text: I love the finish this has on the skin, but I am rather light skinned and this is by no means a universal shade. It leaves me a bit orangey around my eyebrows and hairline, but I kind of don’t care because the glow looks pretty enough. I definitely would not call this a dewy sunscreen though. It’s more similar to a shimmery glow, but not glittery!!! I wish Supergoop would expand the shade range because I think it would be great for some of the darker skin tones to have a more custom finish as well, perhaps similar to the L’Oreal Lumi Glotion has.
Beautiful glow, doesn’t leave a white cast. Doesn’t clog my pores or feel sticky. Looks beautiful under makeup. I will repurchase

I’m not big on makeup. At most I was consistently using BareMinerals’ Complexion Rescue on a daily basis, but that was years ago. I’ve never been good about using sunscreen, but Supergoop’s Glowscreen has changed it for me! This is definitely one that I’m happily consistent about ending my morning skincare routine with.

I think if you have a deeper skin tone than me, you might be able to wear this on its own, but I really can’t. I’m not particularly pale (in a shade range that includes fair and fair-light, I’m usually a light or even a light-medium) but the tint in this makes it look like I’ve smeared a liquid highlighter all over my face. I do like it under makeup, though. Good texture
The best sunscreen I’ve ever used! I’m on my third bottle already
I love the subtle glow this gives my skin. The consistency is very lightweight. I’ve just been adding a bit of concealer and mascara, and I’m good to go.

Really comfortable and lightweight, spreads easily and wears well under other products BUT there is a large part of me that thinks this is way too highlighty. I have stopped wearing it alone if I am not wearing foundation on top because I think it is simply way too reflective and it looks a bit ridiculous. I do still like the product a lot though and maybe I will wear it more in the winter months when I feel my skin looks a little more dull. But for summertime it just got to be way too much.
Beautiful finish and works well to protect against sunburn but seems to break me out.

Best sunscreen I’ve tried! So lightweight. Has a nice sheer tint that leaves the skin glowing (not shiny)!! I will repurchase forever! Looks good under makeup or alone! Doesn’t leave a residue or break me out!
Love the way this makes my skin look and feel! Adds a great glow without being too shiny, and protects against the sun. It’s a win-win!

This is hands down the best sunscreen I’ve ever used on my face! I love that it has a slight shimmer and slight tint but still acts as a good primer for foundation. In the summer, I’ve just been using this in place of a light coverage foundation and I plan to switch to the matte sunscreen for the winter months.

review_title: Tinted! Great sheen and look IF it matches you
review_text: I can see why other reviewers mentioned an ashy cast from this sunscreen -- I don’t think it says anywhere on the listing, but it’s tinted. I have light skin, so it matches me pretty well. I’ve started wearing it instead of BB cream most days. It’s very light coverage, and it makes your skin look like you’ve put highlight all over it. Works great for me, but just be aware before you buy it!
I loved unseen and now seeing the moisturizing benefits and dewy finish I had to try. After my skincare routine just put this on and go. My skin looks plump and dewy/radiant. Would highly recommend.
I loved unseen and now seeing the moisturizing benefits and dewy finish I had to try. After my skincare routine just put this on and go. My skin looks plump and dewy/radiant. Would highly recommend.
This stuff is great for summer, it’s light and evens out my skin enough that I feel comfortable going makeup free. It’s not the best for priming, but it’s not terrible either.

Great sunscreen that provides dewiness hue to the skin.  Product stands on its own, but can be layered.  For my combo skin the glow can be a bit intense at times; therefore, I don’t wear this under foundation because it can make me look oily or greasy.

review_title: Terrible Taste in mouth after using this Product!
review_text: I do like to use as a primer and as a sunscreen, but when I put it all over my face I get a terrible taste in my mouth. I thought it was me, then I had my friend try it and she has the same disgusting taste, it’s so bad that I have to go and brush my teeth and use a rinse. Has anyone found that this happens to them when using this product? Thanks Stacey H. Long Island, NY
Absolutely love this product. It is great for my sensitive skin, works well and doesn’t break me out! Definitely recommend!
This product will make your skin look amazing!! Super glowy and natural, while also protective!!

I bought this because the reviews for the unseen sunscreen seemed soo good, but I wanted something that would give me that lit within beach glow & let me tell y’all, this did just that!!! It does have a slight sunscreen sent, but it is not strong & the results are to die for!!  PS. You could literally only put this on & some concealer & people will tell you you’re glowing!!

I bought this because the reviews for the unseen sunscreen seemed soo good, but I wanted something that would give me that lit within beach glow & let me tell y’all, this did just that!!! It does have a slight sunscreen sent, but it is not strong & the results are to die for!!  PS. You could literally only put this on & some concealer & people will tell you you’re glowing!!

I’ve been a die-hard Supergoop! fan for about 10 years now, so when this came out recently, I knew I just had to get my hands on it. I loved my originals I’ve been using for awhile, but the main thing that caught my eye was that it had a pearlescent finish that helped make skin glow and look natural. I do everything to have glowy skin daily but also love keeping things on the natural side, so this seemed perfect. When I finally received it, I was happy to see it wasn’t super shimmery or glittery, that the pearlescent finish was incredibly light and it definitely did give my skin an all over glow. Like all their other products, it’s lightweight, not oily or greasy feeling and can be used alone or as a makeup primer, which is a win-win. The other thing that drew me to this was that this also has ingredients which help with blue light protection, which is something I’ve been becoming more aware about as of late and do what I can to protect my eyes/skin. I’ve been using this daily and it’s incredibly comfortable; Supergoop! did a fantastic job with this. I definitely recommend this to any Supergoop! fan and anyone who wants a natural looking glow.

I really wanted to love this, but after using this for a solid 2 weeks, I just don’t. I have normal skin, not dry, not oily. Once I started using this daily, my skin became oily and blemishes sprouted. I also have pretty fair skin and this brought out redness in my cheeks which took away from the nice dewy effect. Definitely only use this on a freshly cleaned face or it will start to ball up and flake off. Also, do not get it in your eyes (or sweat so it runs) because you will regret that immensely. I suppose it was good as a sunscreen, but nowadays that’s not too hard to find.
Love love love! Sits beautifully under my makeup and works great as a primer. The glow is gorgeous! Doesn’t break me out! Just wish it was mineral

Love it so much came to read other reviews and was shocked at negative feedback. I have extremely sensitive skin and have not had any breakouts with this. I would say my skin type is dry and I am extremely fair. This would work best for that type in my opinion. Do not need to wear any foundation and makes you glow. Love it. Taking off a star because it does make my forehead a tad bit shiny.
This sunscreen left me looking greasy and shiny from all the glitter! This was really disappointing compared to other Supergoop products.
Love this alone or underneath makeup! I have super dry, sensitive skin and haven’t experienced any issues and keeps my skin hydrated and my makeup looking good all day!

I saw a review saying it has shimmer in the sunscreen, but it really doesn’t have it. It has an amazing glow to it, doesn’t leave my, very oily skin, more oily, for the first time it looks beautiful! Doesn’t have strong perfume, I didn’t notice it at least. And it goes great under my foundation (make upForever reboot).

This is better than expected. I use the matte style sunscreen and like it but this replaces my foundation most days. It goes on even and stays. I can see how it seems shiny but I use a touch of powder over and sometimes touch that powder up throughout day but I like it. It goes on easy, even and not weird smell. It’ll be a repeat buy for sure.

My fav sunscreen I’ve ever used! It’s like your skin but better. The consistency is a little thick but it really blurs the skin and gives you that glow from within look. Perfect for those no makeup days when you need a little protection and boost

This has definitely become my new favorite sunscreen! It’s got the right amount of glow and it wears beautifully under my makeup. I often wear it alone and so far I’ve had no breakouts. Definitely a keeper!

This is the product I was searching for for ages!!!! Finally it is here! It gives me all aspects, I was looking for. First thing when it says ‘glow’ it gives you that! And it last all day, this beautiful, healthy glow. The lightweight formula also works well, if you would like to put make on top (be aware, you will not need primer anymore, it works perfectly for me as primer as well) and lastly I don’t even feel like putting foundation anymore, it makes my skin looks perfect, glowy, healthy,  especially in the summer time when you don’t want to wear heavy make ups. Definitely will be re-buying. My next ‘MUST’ in my beauty routines.

This was an ok sunscreen. It has pretty glow when you put it on and felt light. It didn’t pill under my makeup which was a plus! However.. when I got sweaty while running errands, this started to sting my eyes!! I wanted so badly to rub them because they hurt but I had eye makeup on and had to hold back tears because the chemicals were burning my eyes. When I looked at the ingredients, it has avobenzone in it which is a chemical that you don’t want in your eyes! So if you use this, be careful not to apply near your eyes because it really hurt and was not fun at all! Other than that it was a nice sunscreen that didn’t make me look like a ghost!

I received this product as a deluxe sample with my last order. I like it so much, I plan to purchase the full size. I have large pores on my nose and this blurs them enough that they aren’t noticeable, even without foundation. Makes an excellent foundation primer.
I did not get sunburned but this SPF had a ton of silicone and although it’s not greasy it’s slip is too much. Unsure if it clogged any pores (yet) but I will not purchase. It was a sample.
Have been using these lip balms for YEARS! They never disappoint. Have tried many flavours and will continue to re-purchase when I finish my containers! A daily use must have for me!

review_title: Nice and balmy - but sticky to apply
review_text: This smells awesome and even kind of tastes good… the consistency is on the thicker side and has a decent amount of shine. Lips feel hydrated while it’s on but didn’t notice much lasting hydration benefits. Enjoyed using this on its own and also loved wearing this on top of matte lip colors. Giving this 4 stars as it was a bit goopy/sticky having to apply with the finger, would prefer it in a tube.
Love this product, just wish it was a little bigger. If you use it everyday, you end up repurchasing often. I use this more as a going out balm. It does hydrate well and smells delicious.
Don’t buy it. It dries out your lips and doesn’t do anything, but I guess it smells good. Go buy Kiehls #1 lip balm in mint.
Smells like a caramel cookie. Very smooth and luxurious so I use before bed
These are great for dry lips. Smooth with a wonderful light fragrance.

I say it is very comparable to the Laneige Lip Sleeping Mask product. I love the scent which brings me back to using those Lip Smacker lip balms. Advantage is Fresh seems to have a larger variety of scents compared to Laneige. I still prefer Laneige’s Lip Sleeping mask balm to this. I have smoother lips for a longer time when I use Laneige. I find myself with dry lips after 4-5 hours of using Fresh.
Hydrating! I have the Lychee and Mango flavors. I love how it’s not sticky and is keeps my lips hydrated all day long.

review_title: I use these over night & they're the best!
review_text: I’ve tried almost every flavor of this product and of all the ones I’ve tried, Lemon stays my favorite one!This lip balm is so hydrating without being sticky or heavy. I usually apply it at night and by morning my lips are no longer struggle for hydration! The only thing I don’t like is that it’s in a pot that requires me to swirl my finger in it.Other flavors I like: Caramel and Lychee.Flavors I don’t recommend: Coconut (the flavor is BARELY there, it’s the least flavored one imo)

review_title: Smells good, does nothing for my dry lips though
review_text: I was really looking forward to the product as I love a good lip balm and a clean product. I’m on accutane at the moment so I’m on the hunt for a lip balm that hydrates my lips. Although this lip balm smells good, why I’m giving it two stars, after application it dried out really fast leaving my lips even more dry. I honestly prefer the Laneige lip sleeping mask.
I’m loving the new flavor lip balms! This Passionfruit balm is so hydrating , I have been using it non stop .

I’m not the biggest fan of lip balms in a pot but Fresh’s Advanced Therapy balm is my holy grail so I decided to try this one.  What I love most is the watermelon scent/flavor as it’s not overly sweet or artificial.  The formula is not too thin or too heavy and has a smooth texture but I do find myself needing to reapply quite often so I went through it very quickly.  It didn’t dehydrate my lips but just doesn’t provide as much moisture as I need, especially in the winter.  I’m glad I tried it and I do recommend it for those looking for a great smelling, basic balm but it won’t replace my Advanced Therapy balm.
My faaaavorite luxury lip balm. Caramel isn’t too candy like or sweet as one might imagine. It’s a beautiful natural color that smells good and works even better for plush lips!
I received this lip balm as a sample and fell in love. I bought the full size in this flavor and all the others. It’s addicting.
I have dry lips, been using Fresh lip products for years, tried so many of their products and this one is my favorite sleeping lip mask. Keep hydrated all night. Keep coming back to purchase it.
This is one of my favorite lip balms. My daughter steals this from me every time I get it, so this one was for her. We love the way it moisturizes the lips and smells amazing.

Really love this! Its not like it does anything spectacular, but it feels really great. It doesn’t leave a tint like I thought it would, but the consistency is really great. Kind of like the oily(?) consistency of SunBum chapstick but a little thicker. Also, the blood orange smells like the Capri Blue(?) candles from Anthropologie.
Amazing product my favorite lip balm worth the cost
Great lip balm.  It leaves my lips soft and moisturized.  The peach does not have any scent.  My favorite is the Lemon which I will order the next time.
My go-to, all time favorite lip balm! Don’t use anything else. I love how it feels and smells, not to mention how it hydrates my lips!

The Lime Mint smells fresh (haha) and sweet but not sickly. The consistency is much the same as the other flavours - creamy, not dense, and soft but not so soft that it melts. I find that I get somewhat inconsistent results though. Sometimes  it’s hydrating, while other times I find it dries my lips out. I think this is more of a summer lip balm for me than a winter one. The other thing is the price point - it’s high for the amount of product you get.
I love this lip balm so much. It is so buttery and hydrating. The caramel & coconut both smell AMAZING.
This is my new favorite lip balm. I thought spending $18 on lip balm was crazy but this is worth it. If u don’t have the money I wouldn’t say to get it, but if u have $18 to spare, this is a must !!!

This is by far my favourite product I use. It smells amazing and is so soft, which makes my lips super soft. I use it overnight and in the morning some of it is still there. I will re-buy this always.
I love the smell of this and how soft it makes my lips. My lips looks so juicy after using this.

I was so excited to use this, but it dried out my lips! All winter I had no chapped lips. As some as I started to use this my lips chapped terribly. Am so disappointed. Smells great but tastes a bit weird
Horrible did nothing for my lips other than leave them sticky my lips get dry 20 mind after having it on horrible.

this is my favorite lip balm or lip treatment ever!!! I have all of the different balms. It smells delicious and feels luxurious. It’s not too thin or too thick. Feels like thE Goldie locks of lip balms. Absolutely recommend to anyone. Love love love!!!!❤️❤️❤️

review_title: Pretty and tastes like gummy bears
review_text: This is beautiful, moisturizing and delicious. It reminds me of gummy bears. The color has a nice almost ombre affect on my lips since it is a dark shade but clear and glossy. However, I do wish it was in a tube because the texture is on the sticky side and it would be easier to reapply.
Love it. Does everything it says it will do. However I don’t carry it around with me because I wouldn’t keep dipping my finger in it all day. I use it while I get ready in the morning.
Tastes like a mojito and is super hydrating for the lips! What more could you ask for?

This is thick and stays on.  It is my “winter“ balm.  If you love the smell of coconut and the thick texture, then this is the one for you.  Also, you must have clean fingers.  Thats the only thing wrong with the item.....you have to touch it to use it.
Love this just as much as the rest of the fresh sugar products!
Love the smell, love the texture, hate the unhygienic packaging.Pairs nicely with hand sanitizer. Also doesn’t really moisturize my lips as well as most drug store brands.
Bought this for my daughter, but I secretly steal it when she’s not around. Smells amazing.

This is the best lip balm I’ve probably ever tried. It doesn’t have nasty ingredients like Chapstick or Nivea, and it’s so nourishing that my lips immediately look amazing, not to mention it stays on for a few hours. I like the size of the pot because I can put it on my lips instead of having to use my fingers. Lastly, the smell is divine - delicious, and not cheap or sickly sweet, assuming you like caramel smells to begin with.

I love everything about this balm! I have the worst chapped lips in the winter and NOTHING ever works. A girl at my local Sephora recommended this and wow it is so hydrating! Lasts quite a while too. My fiancé likes to use it too! $25 bucks well spent!
Keeps your lip moisturized for quite sometime. Does not dry out my lips and keeps them pretty soft. I’ve been using this product for quite some time and will continue to use it.

I received this in a sample box and fell in love with it. I use this at night before bedtime and lips are not at all dry in the morning and I am a huge snorer so I used to use Vaseline but not anymore. I can even afford to use this for life it’s wonderful stuff and priced for us 50  that have limited funds.
I love this lip balm!  I put it on before I workout because it has just a hint of color and keeps my lips hydrated throughout my whole workout.

I like the smell and texture but there’s something in it that makes my lips so dry my lower lip line started cracking and bleeding. I keep putting it on to moisturize and I noticed it was getting drier so I kept putting more on. Eventually I had to put on an ointment to stop the stinging. This must have some weird chemical in it because I’ve tried a ton of different lip balms and this is the only one that actually messed up my lips. Which is too bad because I was really excited about the caramel part

review_title: LEMON SEE'S CANDY TRUFFLE or LEMON MERINGUE PIE
review_text: This is a total WINNER! Smooth and hydrating.  I am a lemon lover and they nailed this formula.  The lemon reminds me of See’s Candy Lemon Truffle Chocolates or Lemon Meringue Pie.  I am stocking up because whenever I love a product this much it always gets discontinued.  Please keep this LEMON in permanent stock.  My only wish is that it came in a stick form.  I don’t enjoy putting my finger in the jar but I will do anything for this lip balm.  So worth it the price.  I highly recommend this.  I love it so much I created this account so I could leave my first review.

My lips get so dry during the winter dryer months. I’ve tried a number of different hydrating lip balm, but none of them seem to work. Saw this on one of the YT channels and decided to try it. It is one of the best hydrating lip balms that I’ve discovered so far. Definitely recommend.

pretty good and hydrating. it has a strong smell, but it doesn’t linger and it smells good. however, im giving it 4 stars because its kind of pricey and its not as hydrating as other balms like aquaphor

I love the coconut version of this lip balm. Truthfully, I like the scent more than I like the formulation. However, when I saw the great reviews for the Sugar Lemon, I immediately ordered it. I often love citrus scented beauty products as long as they aren’t too sweet.This one just didn’t cut it at all! The lemon isn’t fresh, but more of a dull, dusty variety - and too sweet. Almost like a bad pastry filling.Sad, ’cause I really wanted to like this one! I’ll stick with the coconut.
It smells great! It’s not especially moisturizing, wears off quickly. It’s a little pricy for what you get.

I love anything Lemon scented and this did not disappoint. I have a issue with a lot of lip balms that they make me break out around my mouth when I use them, but I didn’t have any issues with this one. Love it and will definitely repurchase!
it’s really thick like a salve and you’re gonna have to keep reapplying it. So I did this test where instead of putting on chapstick I drank water when my lips got dry and they looked so much better

i’ve tried a ton of different lip balms - glossier, milk’s kush lip balm, dior lip glow (which i also love but i don’t think they make a colorless version?) and i use the laniege lip mask at night but i don’t like to carry it around with me - this is an absolute DREAM. super hydrating and the smell is addictive. it’s the perfect consistency and makes your lips look so soft and plump.

If I could give this product two reviews, it would be 5 stars for scent and 2 stars for quality. I purchased this product based on high-starred reviews, and I think most of those stars are for scent alone - it’s amazing, out of this world and my happy place. But the quality of the balm is lacking. I find it sticky and needing to be reapplied often, and to be honest, once the balm fades, my lips become dry quickly, which isn’t the norm for me. Disappointing, and I certainly think this product is overpriced for the quality.
I really like the smell and feel of this but I do wish it lasted longer. I feel like it wears off within 30 minutes even without drinking or eating.

I wanted to love this. It smells like lemon cookie dreams. But I don’t find it moisturizing, and actually leaves my lips dry. I’ve tried it both during the day and overnight. There are other, better products.
I love this scent, the lip balm is ok but I’ve purchased better product for the same price.

Gone are the days when I have to suffer through matte lipstick. I can put this over it and it looks brand new again. It extends the life of my expensive lipstick and I’m thrilled. Refreshes dry cracked lips even over lipstick and heals my dry lips! This is perfect and it’s tasty! So glad I’m packing up on this. It sold out quickly in stores so if you find one, get it! You’ll love it!!!

review_title: A Little Goes A Long Way
review_text: This is my go to night time lip balm. Does a great job of moisturizing my lips overnight. Love the subtle peach scent.

I’m obsessed with this product and can’t stop putting it on. It’s not that it doesn’t last, it’s just the smell is so good I can’t resist. It’s perfect for summer and is good enough to use as a lip mask. You’ve got to try it to understand how great it is.

review_title: Lemon Chess Pie on a Summery Day!  Yum!
review_text: Best and most lucious hydrating lip balm EVER!  FRESH needs to continue this delicious, fruity line.  I’m in love with all of them - coconut, peach - but sugar lemon is my favorite!  Lemon chess pie on a romantic, summery day ... exquisite!  Je t’aime ...

I prefer this balm to the coconut and caramel balms, it seems to be more moisturizing than the others. The peach scent is subtle, and I find the texture smooth and soothing on my lips. If you’re a fan of peach, this balm is a great addition!!

I bought this six months ago, use nightly, and still have a little left.  The coconut fragrance is amazing, but I was surprised and disappointed that the main lubricant is apricot seed oil, NOT coconut or any ingredient derived from coconut.  Correct me if I’m wrong, but I studied the ingredients list, looking for any sign of a coconut essence or ingredient.  Ruins it for me when the smell is obviously manufactured, not real.  It goes on creamy and hydrating, but I don’t notice any extra moisture in my lips in the morning.  Will try other Fresh products, but will def check the list of what it’s made of, first.
Not hydrating at all! It’s smells good and the packaging looks good on your hand but it doesn’t do what it claims to do at all, $18 wasted

Received this in my play box and once I finished it I had to get more! Usually in the winter I have one good round of chapped lips and peeling but using this daily has prevented that from occurring. Also when it does wear off it doesn’t leave residue on your lips.

I love ALL Fresh lip balms. I saw this new coconut flavor and bought it. I love it. Very moisturizing and stays on the lips for hours. This is the only lip balm I use and my lips feel so smooth. A little goes a long way.

I didn’t want to like this because I feel that that amount you get is not worth the $18 but the moment I tried it I totally understand the price point. You don’t need very much to cover your lips and the moisture it locks in is ahfreakingmazing. I usually like to put it on before I go to bed and when I wake up my lips are soft and moisturized. Not to mention the coconut flavor is out of this world.

review_title: Nice but probably won't purchase again
review_text: It was okay, but it’s not long lasting. I would have to reapply pretty soon after. The smell was a bit overwhelming at first but okay.

Love that this feels so rich on the lips even if applying a thin layer. It’s so moisturizing I put it on under my matte lipsticks and it keeps my lips feeling hydrated. To top it off it smells like paradise and I always get compliments on it ;)
Super Hydrating! I love the smell. Hit pan on it already so I just got a new one for Christmas!
Loved the texture and smell and taste of this lip balm! I love this sugar line, the lip line has yet to be anything but beautiful. I love the sheer plums most of all!

INGREDIENTS: majority safe ingredients besides a few (according to EWG, some plant oil/extracts, fragranced. PACKAGING: I don’t like the pot because it’s not sanitary, hoping Fresh will make a squeezy tube packaging! FORMULA: very nourishing and hydrating, pleasant scent!

review_title: One of the best lip balms I have!
review_text: I bought this on a whim because I needed lip balm for my school bag and I really love it! It makes my lips look so pretty and it smells sooo good! It’s great for cold seasons because it keeps your lips so hydrated. It’s not sticky at all, it’s smooth and feels great. All my friends who have borrowed it love it too!
Best lip balm ever! Smells amazing, my lips are hydrated and soft. You can’t go wrong with fresh products and this one is definitely worth the splurge.

I love this lip balm. It smells so good. I use it at night before I go to sleep so I can wake up with soft hydrated lips. I just wish it came in a tube with a applicator which is why I didn’t give it 5 stars.

This is a great product for moisturizing and has a beautiful coconut scent to it. However, it’s a lip balm that leaves a white-ish film on your lips and is rather thick. I love it because it feels like a quality product that lasts you forever but I can’t see myself spending $18 on it again.
I love this lip balm. My lips feel luscious and super soft.
This product is nostalgic for me. It reminds me of Brachs caramel candy I ate as a kid. The balm is hydrating and applies smooth. No flavor. Non sticky.
The best tasting lip product you will ever buy in your whole life. Literally tastes like a tub of caramel. Shiny but not sticky, hydrating, doesn’t slide right off. An absolute GEM
I love it, the smell, it does it’s job really well. The only reason why I didn’t give it 5 stars is because it didn’t wow me. Although I love the smell, I think the rosebud balm works just as well.
I got this as a GWP sample and I love it! It’s not sticky at all and leaves lips extremely soft. The caramel scent is delicious!
I love it! Best lip balm ever!

I have very dry lips and this helps keep them moisturized all day. I was out in the sun at Disneyland for 12+hours, and my lips were very hydrated with this. I am in love with the scent which is why I purchased it and I don’t regret it.

Love these! I have the chocolate one and the coconut flavor, and I couldn’t be more pleased with these lip balms. Especially since I was so disappointed with the Fresh Sugar Lip Treatment Sunscreen lip balms, which gave no moisture to my lips so I returned it. Then I decided to purchase this and give a try. I liked it so much I got another flavor. This really hydrate your lips and left my lips feeling smooth, and soft.
Love it !! It has a great light smell and hydrates your lips perfectly
Pros: Smells good, keeps my lips moisturized (and I normally have super dry lips)Cons: Pricey
If you don’t like the smell of coconuts, this is not for you (obviously). This seriously smells like heaven. It’s amazing
This is one of the best lip balms out. It wonderful and it hydrates the lips. It’s a little greasy a must have. The only con beside the price it you have to use your finger to apply to your lips.

This product is amazinggg! I initially tried the Caramel hydrating balm and liked it, although it didn’t keep my lips super hydrated as I had to keep applying but the smell was great! So I thought I would try the coconut out and honestly, it’s better than the caramel! The smell and taste are equally yummy like the caramel but the coconut keeps your lips hydrated for so much longer! Only reason I didn’t give 5 stars is because the price for amount of product is a little far fetched, but all Fresh lip products are pretty high
I’m a huge fan of Fresh and their caramel hydrating lip balm and this is the exact same formula except for the coconut. Definitely reminds me of summertime.
Will definitely buy few more of this product again .

Overall it is a very pleasant taste and feel! I had tried it once in store and was “Wow’d!” But after purchasing and over a months use, unfortunately I can’t same the same. I so wanted to love this product! It feels good and the tastes isn’t too over powerful by any means. But for me, the hydration just wasn’t there. For $20.... I have gotten better results from a drug store product. My lips are still dry and I find myself reapplying all the time. I’m almost through a full container... I’ve had other brands last longer and with better results unfortunately!
I love this so much! I got a trial and got the full version too because it was so good! I love the how soft it makes my lips!
smells amazing feels amazing and so rich without the sticky feeling

I’m giving this balm 3 stars because it is nice and smooth on the lips, but the smell/taste is awful.  It really does taste like caramel, but is that what you want to put on your lips right after you brush your teeth?  Like sticky toffee pudding?!  I will finish it up, but will not buy it again.  Very odd.  And I absolutely adore Fresh lip products!!
This smells so good!  However, the lip balm itself is a little thick/oily and hasn’t done much for my lips beyond a few minutes.  You can get better lip balms for a lower price.

I received this as a free sample and I was excited to try it out because the Sugar Lip Treatments are so amazing. Unfortunately, this product did not deliver. Not long after using it, my lips felt more dehydrated than they did before I applied the product. My lips felt very tight, rough and flakey after applying.
Absolute trash. Doesn’t keep lips moisturized have to keep reapplying. Will never purchase again.

I first received a trial size of this product in a sample bag, but I soon came back and purchased the full size.  It’s not quite an instant miracle-worker, but if I apply a couple times early in the day, I find that my lips are not only hydrated, but also significantly smoother by late afternoon/evening.  I’ll soon be swapping this out for my overnight treatment.  And it smells great.
Not sticky at all, makes my lips feel super smooth! I love it but not sure why it’s so expensive ..

This product really did not impress me. i have dehydrated lips, i usually ise more than one lip product-one for moisture and one as a block to seal in the moisture. This did nothing at all...I was constantly re-applying and my lips never truly felt relieved when I applied it. so glad I got a sample first! All I can say is that is smells really nice, just doesnt provide any moisture for really dry lips.

This had been on my wishlist for quite awhile and during the VIB Rouge sale for Sephora, I jumped on the sale and also had a gift card so I only ended up paying 4$! I feel like this is an okay lip balm. I absolutely love the Fresh brand and their skincare line, however I do feel this was a little pricey for the amount given in the container. I understand it’s more of a luxury item, so I’m glad I got it on sale with a gift card rather than purchasing it out right. The scent wasn’t overly sweet, but it doesn’t taste like caramel to me. It is a nice tasting sweetness, but it’s not terrible for those who are maybe worried about the flavor. It leaves my lips feeling very moisturized and I don’t have to reapply too often. Overall it’s a good balm, just not my favorite.
It’s not what I expected. Not a must but it’s alright. Save your coins!
Not too sure where they got caramel from. This does smell like candy however and no it doesn’t have a sweet taste. Not sticky or tacky and hydrates well. Great balm to throw in your purse.

This is a wonderful lip mask! I’ve been using it as my overnight mark for about 2 weeks now and my lips are soft as silk. My only gripe would be with the packaging - is huge! The pot is as large as some of my face creams. Is amazing otherwise

I got this product free from influenster for my honest opinion. I have been using this for a few months and I really enjoy it! I don’t like how sticky it is so I only use it as part of my bedtime routine.
