Personally there are other lip marks that I enjoy better,  but this does a great job at helping with my chapped lips from the winter! It’s a good product but I wouldn’t repurchase.

review_title: Good, but not cruelty free. Sorry!
review_text: I received this product for free from Influenster and belif in exchange for my honest review.I’ve been using this lip mask for weeks, and it definitely helps the lips to stay hydrated the next day. It barely has scent, so not an inconvenient at all. If this brand was cruelty free, I’d buy the product again.
This product was a no for me. Reason one being I didn’t see much change in the two weeks I used it
I really love this, but can’t get past the price. For me, it has the consistency of petrolatum jelly, and that is much cheaper.
love this  lip mask. really moisturizes and has taken over the chapstick role

Wow…I thought nothing would top the Laniege lip mask. Got this as a sample and dare I say it might be better…more rich, moisturizing and has less of a scent. Will buy the full size which is crazy to me because I have been using the same lip mask for 3 years!
I am obsessed with ChapStick, I need my lips moisturized at all times. This  does just that! My lips are so hydrated. They look and feel great because of it. I highly recommend it!

Bought this lip mask because I’m on accutane (causing dry peeling lips!) and this has SAVED my lips! I feel like the second I put it on the dead skin comes off and my lips are completely plump and moisturized. I use this before bed but also when I feel I need the extra moisture during the day when I’m just at home. It doesn’t have a scent to me and doesn’t sting or anything. A little goes a long way as well! Amazing product I will be buying more when needed!

I received my belif aqua bomb lip mask in the mail and was so happy it came right in time for winter when my skin tends to dry out. Also, I found that wearing a face mask as frequently as I do has sucked out the moisture from my lips recently, causing extreme dryness.Even though the sample was quite small, you really don’t need a lot of product to cover your lips. I applied just a dab of it by just slightly dipping my finger into the container. My advice would be not to apply to much pressure or scrape the product hard as you will find that will give you an excess of product that you’ll end up wasting. I applied a layer over my lips and felt protected instantly. The product looks like Vaseline in color but definitely is thinner in texture (it’s not sticky, actually it feels quite smooth and your lips don’t stick together when you smack them together), and doesn’t have much of a scent. There are subtle notes of some cocoa (I think) but nothing extremely noticeable if you’re not a fan of that. Honestly, I had to smell the product quite a few times to even pinpoint what scent I was getting, because I was almost leaning to saying it was unscented, but then learned it may be the shea butter that was giving the subtle scent. I use it more than just overnight, which has been a great addition to my lip balms. I don’t think using it in this way has had any negative effect, my lips just feel more moisturized and nourished. I felt this was really great as a unisex product. My husband doesn’t like my other lip mask, which has more of a fruity essence, but did love this. I felt the quality was nice, offering a simple solution to balance your lip skins’ moisture. Comparing it to other lip mask products, it was on par and was a great substitution to my other lip mask as this small size is easier to travel with. I was pleased with the ingredients, since they have natural ingredients that are known to moisturize (such as cica and madecassoide). I am satisfied overall!
Worked like any other balm. No scent or taste. I like laniege better just because of the different scents. If you don’t like scent, you’ll probably like this one better.
I love it!!! I didn’t expect my lips to get so dry this winter but this brought them back to life in two days!

Very impressed at how rich and hydrating this overnight lip mask is! Honestly, I was a bit skeptical about this product to start out with - in my personal experience, most lip products actually end up drying out my lips, requiring me to reapply the product over and over again just to keep my lips hydrated. This lip mask actually works- not only did it actually last all night, but when I woke up my lips felt really smooth and hydrated! Very impressed! Thank you to Sephora and influenster for sending me a sample to try and provide my honest opinions! I will be purchasing this product again!
Love it! Feels super light on but is definitely hydrating, which is great coming in to winter

This seems to be a quality product, and it feels nice on the lips. So nice, in fact, that I was using it as a regular balm, opposed to just a night mask. However, while it feels moist when applied, once it wears off, it doesn’t have lasting effects. This is sad, because I was hoping it would help heal and moisturize my lips. Sadly, that didn’t happen.

I have been using this product for about a month and although it took time, I do notice more smoothness in my lips after wearing this monthly. My house is very dry with the head on and they feel hydrated. Cons are it took a while to notice a difference and I don’t think the difference is groundbreaking.
This lip mask works wonders! My lips get super chapped over night and this mask prevents any cracking I would normally see. The scent is amazing. I will definitely be purchasing more.

This is a nice enough lip moisturizer. That being said I have tried better that last longer. I also am not a huge fan of the container. I do not enjoy having to dig my finger into the product as it isn’t very sanitary and leaves a residue on your finger.

review_title: One of the best on the market
review_text: I live somwhere where it gets very cold in the winter and since its mid December you can guess how cold and harsh the weather is. During these months my lips can get so chapped, they peel and can even feel raw and burn sometimes if im not consistent on moisturizing them properly. Since I’ve received this product I have used it every single night before bed and I honestly can say it works so well I don’t have to use any other product throughout the day if I don’t want to. It leaves your lips feeling so smooth and soft while looking very hydrated and just an overall healthy look. It’s a very thick formula but not to thick where you feel like you have a layer sitting on top of your lips. It blends in perfectly and feels so silky soft when applying. I also love that there’s a very minimal smell to it as well. I would highly recommend this product to anyone not just people who are prone to dry lips. I feel this is a product that would be good for anyone to have to keep there lips looking and feeling juicy and healthy. The trial size I have is almost gone and I will definitely be purchasing the full size asap!

I have always had dry lips and sometimes at night I accidentally break my lips with my teeth.  I was surprised and happy when I received this free product from Influenster.  I have used it every night for almost 1 month and I really like the result it leaves in the morning.  It is not a super incredible product or it doesnt do miracles but it is a good product and I recommend it.

review_title: Highly recommended from the Wisconsin artic
review_text: I absolutely love how this stuff goes on. Light and smooth but it also lasts long. My lips were super dry and chapped when I received this and after one night and a few uses during the day, my lips were brand new. I’ll definitely be recommending this as well as buying a new jar once this one is done. Highly recommended from a cold Midwestern girl, no chapped cracked lips this cold season for me!
Product is nicely packaged. Leaves my lips feeling soft and hydrated.  I would reccomend this product and the price point is okay feel like $15 would be a bit better for it though.

review_title: Worked the first time to restore moisture!
review_text: I received this product for free from influencer. I used it right away. Were we live it is very dry in the winter, so our skin and lips are always dry. I used this on me and my daughter and the next day our lips were way better and not as dry. I continued to use it in the day and I could see a big difference in my daughters normal dry and cracked lips.

review_title: Smell is very subtle and refreshing
review_text: Smell is very subtle and refreshing. It really helps knock out any dryness or chappedness overnight. It has the slightest fruity taste and smell. Really gets the job done.

Living in a dry climate, this is a great pick. It delivers quick moisture without the stickiness or fuss of too many artificial scents. I wouldn’t say it provides long lasting moisturizing benefits, but it gives you a good kick of moisture in a pinch.

I’m not new to overnight lip masks. This one is a nice consistency, very similar to a standard lip balm being not too thick or thin. It applied easily and lasted well on the lips. I found in both overnight and same day applications it definitely added moisture and improved my lips. That said I didn’t find it to be more impactful than using a standard balm or compared to other overnight masks I’ve used. I would consider purchasing in future but perhaps waiting for a sale.
Really like this product. The only thing I didn’t like is that it wasn’t in stick form. I hate having to use my finger to apply.

I really like this lip mask, it’s not too thick to put on but it does have a slight sticky feeling at first. have been using on and off for a few weeks and definitely notice my lips aren’t as dry in the morning when i remember to use it

I received this product complimentary and it came at the perfect time. My lips were starting to peel from the change in weather and I put it on that night. I woke up the next morning and my lips were no longer peeling and super smooth and soft

Anyone who has the pleasure of interacting of me knows I be struggling with my lips. Was happy to try yet another lip mask. I like that this one is more occlusive than other high end lip masks- this really feels like a good ointment for struggly lips. Also no discernible fragrance/flavor, which I appreciate cuz I usually can’t stand most flavors in lip products. This also comes in an adorable tiny jar for those who loves tiny things.

I received this product from Influenster to try and I absolutely love it! It doesn’t feel sticky when on. When I wake up my lips feel so soft and hydrated. I know this will be a staple in my skincare routine and will perfect for the winter months coming up!

review_title: One of the best lip masks I have tried
review_text: Recived this from influenster I gave it a try for 1 week before giving my feedback this lip mask has really been a game changer for my lips they are soft and smooth great for these winter months my lips usally are dry and cracked but not since using this product .

Moisture galore! Seriously. The first time I applied this my lips felt instantly smoother! I feel that the formula lasts a long time on your lips, and when it goes away, you are left with smooth lips for days. I am so glad that I got to review this product for free. It really is an amazing product and it will definitely leave you addicted to its healing magic!
I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review.  I really enjoyed this lip mask. I put it on after I brush my teeth at night and wake up with soft, hydrated lips.

I received this product for free from Influenster for reviewing purposes. I love this product! It’s so hydrating and makes my lips feel so soft. The only con for me is that it’s in a pot vs a tube, I’d prefer a tube it’s a little less messy and hygienic. But overall, great product.

I received a sample of the Aqua Bomb Overnight Lip Mask free from Influenster and Belif in exchange for my honest review . This lip mask was lovely to use, though I worry about possible air, light, and bacteria exposure of dipping into an open jar. It’s a thick balm that melts with your body heat into a hydrating but sealing thick jelly on your lips. It feels like a cross between petroleum jelly and a moisturizing lip gloss or oil, and felt very comfortable upon application. The top ingredients I recognize are Shea butter and waxes, along with many I can’t pronounce. The second half of the ingredients list worries me since it has so many fragrant essential oils, something that might irritate lips, though some may soothe them as well. The actual formula has no discernable scent though. The morning after using this, I notice my lips aren’t dry, but also aren’t very hydrated either. After a few uses, there seems to be no noticeable difference, but that may be because I don’t currently have dry winter chapped lips to try it on. Unfortunately however, a thin layer of petroleum jelly leaves me with more moisturized lips when used as an overnight mask. Overall though, for a very thick lip balm, it’s enjoyable while it’s on . #nofilter #gotitfree #complimentary #free #influenstervoxbox @Influenster #contest #skincare #review @belifusa #belifsmoothtalker #FallFavesVoxBox

I’ve been using glossier balm as a lip mask for years. It’s always been so good I never bothered even trying something else. Then I received this from Influenster to try out and wow. Literally overnight my lips became so plump and hydrated. I woke up amazed. I’ve tried so many complimentary products and this is the first time I think I will be purchasing after. The scent is very soft and it feels really nice.
I received this product from Influenster and I enjoyed it! I like the minty smell to it but it’s a little sticky. It felt good going on but it didn’t stay on all night.

I tried this overnight lip mask at the perfect time! My lips were so dry and just about to crack when this item came to my rescue. It has a petroleum jelly type texture with a soothing smell. I loaded it on right at bed time, as the directions instructed and when I woke my lips were so smooth!

review_title: I like it but it’s inconsistent
review_text: I like this overnight lip mask because it doesn’t feel too overly goopy like some of the ones that I have tried, however I don’t know that it does a whole lot for me. One day I woke up with moisturized lips and the next I woke up with dry flaked lips.
Best lip mask. I applied a generous amount at night and by the morning my lips felt soooo much more hydrated. My lips get really dry in the winter so this product will be my go to.
Really enjoying this lip mask! Just want I needed for these cold months when my lips are more chapped. Keeps my lips super soft and hydrated!

I usually have pretty dry lips and hate putting on lip products. Putting this at night before bed works wonders. I wake up with softer lips and not having to apply any in the daytime. It might be a little heavy for daytime use unless you have super dry lips but for nighttime this is perfect.

Great lip mask for dry lips. I have extremely dry lips and sometimes I could even peel a layer of skin off especially in the colder months. I started using this and in 3 weeks I was able to start seeing a major difference. My lip no longer peels and the lines have started to smooth out. The mask is rich with a little bit of a waxy feeling. It has no sent which I love.

This lip mask is really nice. It made my lips feel hydrated right away and they felt nice in the morning too. I took one star off because I like my lip products a bit thicker to stay on all night and this has a thinner consistency. It still worked great and the price is fair. I did receive this product complimentary but all opinions are my own.

I think this product worked really well. It provides a nice layer of hydration on the lips. It’s fairly thick and goes well with the rest of the Belif range. I do wish it came in a tube though or maybe came with some kind of applicator. I’m just not the biggest fan of having to put my finger in containers.

I’m one of those people who carry lip balm everywhere. What I love about this is the texture - it is similar to Vaseline in terms of how it looks and feels, but there’s a richness to it that makes your lips feel nourished. It gives a nice shine but not so much that it looks like lip gloss. The size is perfect to carry around in your purse and although I kept it home it’s great for keeping your lips soft under your mask!

I received Belif aqua bomb overnight lip mask complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I’m so in love with this balm.bomb! My lips are no longer chapped and works wonders! I will definitely be purchasing this lip mask in the near future!!
Looove this one so much! I get dry lips so every time I use this at night it helps so much

This stuff is the “balm” (sorry I’ll excuse myself out now.) But really, it’s super awesome and makes your lips so soft. Scentless and doesn’t have a taste either for those who are sensitive to products with smells. I got this for free in my Vox Box and I loooove it.

I have to say I really like this is the bomb. I put it on and I instantly felt my lips react to the hydration. I have fairly chap lips often because I lick them or they just dry out pretty fast. So this product is honestly perfect for me and definitely going to be a part of my normal routine. I feel like my lips are very satiny and smooth and I feel very hydrated throughout the day now.

I received this product complementary for my honest opinion. I like this overnight lip mask. It keeps my lips pretty hydrated through the night but isn’t the best I’ve used. I will continue to use it and do recommend it!
Nice Texture. Feels like a Vaseline texture. My lips feel moisturized and hydrated.
My first time trying a lip mask and It feels like Vaseline. I would purchase this. I would just use basic lip balm if I need to extra hydration

review_title: Perfect if you don't like a tingle
review_text: (I received the product free for my honest review.)I am a big, BIG fan of overnight lip masks. I love the conditioning of a thick lip product, but I need to wear thick ones at night where i can’t talk, lick, or eat them off.This one performs, as it says. Not really any taste to it, so if you’re wanting something without a flavor, this is your pick. It also is missing any mentholy/minty tingle, that I generally like in a heavy-duty lip balm. It helps me feel like it’s working, and I know that it also helps it penetrate.That’s really my only con, besides the price. If I’d not been given this, I’d stick with my $4 O’Keefe’s.
This is a great product to use specially for dry and cracked lips. Leaves lips feeling hydrated and smooth, the lips mask is not scented and doesn’t leaves a bad taste.

I received this through Influenster for review and I did really like this product. It made my lips feel really soft and I love the scent. My only criticism is that you need to dip your finger in to use- I wish there was a more hygienic application, but otherwise I do really enjoy this!

Loved this product!  I got it for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. This lip mask packs a punch!  It’s creamy yet light feeling.  It doesn’t feel goopy or thick but it leaves a nice sheen on the lips. I will definitely buy it when I run out!

When I received this product was a perfect time! My lips was asking for help and I always struggled with that. Finally my lips can be hydrated with the Lip Mask. I use one day yes another no and it keeps a great results for me! Happy for having this product!

As someone who’s uses chapstick 24/7, I was exited to receive this product in hopes that it would moisturize my lips enough, that I wouldn’t need to apply chapstick as often throughout the day. That was not the case.

I have tried different sleep mask and so far this one is so good , love how lightweight feels on my lips and how hydrated gets , on top of that my lips gets very smooth . I usually apply this when I go to bed and if I’m gonna wear a matte lipstick. Very nice product
I loveee this lip mask. It’s not super sticky like other lip masks that I’ve tried before. It works better than any lip-mask I’ve tried before also, it lasted me about 24hrs

I really enjoyed using this lip mask. I’m always feeling dry and chapped. It works great overnight but I actually used it more as a daytime lip balm. There’s no scent or bad taste on it. I received this product complimentary to review from Influenster. I’m honestly not a huge fan. It feels nice initially but there is no moisture provided. My lips feels more dry after using it. I wouldn’t buy it or recommend it to anyone unfortunately.
Yas! what a great product I loved how this mask made my lips feel and there was no residue
There is nothing wrong with this product. It is a good choice if you’re looking for a basic lip mask. No bells or whistles, but gets the job done without being too expensive.
very moisturizing, it’s like Vaseline but way better! it lasts for a good while. it’s going to be perfect for when it gets colder and my lips are chapping!

This does exactly what it says it will. It is very hydrating. It feels thick but guides on perfectly. I definitely saw results like instantly. I don’t like that it doesn’t have a scent. If you don’t care about scents then this is perfect. It’s a little pricey for what it is. I honestly prefer the wet and wild overnight lip mask and it’s under 5$ plus it’s scented. But this works if you’re into this type of thing. I got it for free in exchange for my honest review.
I love how soft this makes my lips feel! I also love the consistency of this product.  A little bit goes a long way!

I really like this product, my lips become very dry when it becomes colder out and they start cracking a lot more. I started using this product at night and it has made my lips feel soft and restored in the morning ! Would definitely buy a bigger size
I used this overnight during a time when I had a cold. It def helped with moisture and stopped my lips from chapping
Save your money and purchase the Lanege lip mask instead. I really noticed no difference using the product and don’t like the consistency as much either.
Amazing product!  I love it. Super recommend. I can have soft skin and amazing results.

I have tried other overnight lip masks and they do not match up to this!  It does not break me out like others do, which I am so glad about!  It is very nourishing and comfortable.  Not too greasy either.  I wake up to soft lips.  Great job, Belif!
This made my lips extremely soft and smooth! A lot bit  really does go a long way! Even long into the next day I could still feel the difference on my lips love it!
I really like this lips treatment because is very smooth and hydrate keeps my lips soft all days and night.
I love how soft it is, and it doesn’t smell like anything which is a plus. The first time I used it, I could tell a difference on the texture of my lips the next morning.

I am obsessed with this product! My lips tend to get dry often so it’s my nightly routine to put some good lip balm on before bed and after receiving this to try, I am officially going to stick to this one. It makes your lips so nice and smooth and it’s also great to put on top of lipstick for some extra gloss

I received this product for free from Influenster. This lip mask is comparable to the Laneige Lip Mask, very thick and a little goes a long way. Lips are hydrated in the morning when I wear it as an overnight mask. Great for trips to dry places.

I received this item complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I use several different lip masks and this one has become one of my favorites. Leaves my lips nice and soft when I wake up. No complaints other than it’s a little pricey.
I am really impressed with the texture of the lip mask and how my lips was so soft on the next day... I love it

I love lip masks, especially more so now that fall is here. This lip mask is not slippery like most are. This really grips to your lips and truly inserts itself where it’s needed most leaving no oily residue behind. I personally own this in the much larger size and I can honestly say it has helped improved keeping moisture within my lips in any type of weather. 10/10

A little goes a long way. I absolutely love this and will most likely continue buying this. My lips have never felt so soft and smooth before. I love love love it. Highly recommend especially during with the cold weather coming in.
Love love love the BELIF Aqua Bomb Lippy mask. Following my normal nightly routine, I simply lamb basted my lips for their overnight moisture soak. It will be wonderful in the colder months ahead!

I really enjoyed using this over night lip mask! It has a lovely thick creamy texture & is not sticky. It glides on with ease & leaves my lips feeling incredibly hydrated. It has no scent or taste which is perfect because it is stays on overnight. My lips feel soo soft in the mornings.

Super hydrating lip mask!! It has no scent or taste which I prefer before bed anyway. I love how soft it makes my lips feel and the hydration is so intense they appear to almost plump up after it’s been applied. I would definitely recommend this for those wintery chapped lips and also for those who can be sensitive to scented items.

I received this product to test for free and I couldn’t be happier! The texture is spot on. Some lip masks it is too thick or oily but this is perfect. There is a faint scent but nothing overpowering to wear at night (apparently I’m sensitive)!
It’s fine. Nothing super special but it worked. Doesn’t feel really heavy.

I love the belif products. I tested a free sample of the blam and i cant wait for the winter when my lips dry out really badly. It didnt cause any break out and by morning my lips were so soft. Love love love it

I received a complimentary trial size sample of the lip mask from Influenster and I have been applying this lip mask every night before bed for the past two weeks and my lips have never looked better! My lips tend to become chapped as the nights start getting cooler this time of year but this lip mask moisturizes my lips when they need it the most and I wake up with plump, hydrated lips.
Great lip mask!Rich in texture and really hydrates the lips!Much richer in texture in comparison to the Laneige lip mask, which I like!Received it free from Influenster
Overall great lip mask, I put it on after my nightly skin routine and I woke up with my lip actually smooth and looking hydrated. Its not as sticky when applied and super light weight
I really love this product! I usually wake up with dry lips, but when I applied this at night, I woke up to plus lips which was a nice change. Thanks to Influenster for sending this to me!

The lip mask is a nice and light balm that isn’t too thick. It hydrates the lips very well and helps keep the lips soft. Although it is a very good lip mask, I don’t find it to be any better or anything more special than other lip masks I have used in the past

The lip mask is actually pretty moisturizing but I do find I have to put on quite a bit or else it dries up too quickly! I find it doesn’t really have a smell which I don’t mind at all, I’ve been using it both day and night to really test it I would repurchase the full size. Also it leaves such a nice glossy finish on the lips.

I received this complimentary from Influenster. Clear creamy gel lip mask with beliefs subtle lime fragrance yet no distinct flavour.  Melts onto lips and feels lightweight and slippery.  No waxiness at all.  This is very emollient.  My lips feel more hydrated after just a couple minutes as though I’ve applied a lip oil.  This lasts about four hours.   It doesn’t last the night but would be more a good lip treatment than an overnight mask.
Softer lips in the morning, this will be really nice in the coming fall months :)

Absolutely obsessed with this product. I was pleasantly surprised. Although the texture was a big thicker than expected, it turned out to help my lips like no other lip mask before. It felt soft, hydrated and PLUMPED!!??Highly recommend it to everyone!

This product is really hydrating for the lips and it is really good for overnight because it is extremely hydrating and I wake up with fully plump and hydrated lips. It s also not sticky and also feels weightless on the lips.
LOVE! Love this lip mask so mask!! It’s now a staple in my skin care routine!
I recently repurchased this product again after not using it for a while. I used to LOVE it, but I don’t remember it smelling so bad?! I won’t repurchase it for that reason only.

review_title: A must have if it works with your skin
review_text: After using this product for the past few weeks, I love it. It keeps my face feeling hydrated all the time and it’s now a part of my skin care routine
i love this product, i use it everyday in my routine and it moisturizes my skin so well!

I love the applicator and it is very think and moisturizing! It have never had a problem with it smelling bad but maybe that’s just me. I do think it is a bit too expensive for what it is but over great!
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I enjoyed the whipped texture of the moisturizer and felt it easily. I mostly use it at night as it keeps my skin hydrated throughout.
This moisturizer feels so smooth on my skin. I like how lightweight it feels. I received this complimentary for testing purposes. I would definitely buy this moisturizer.

This is now a must have in my routine. I always love a good moisturizer! This one in particular is a little thick so I use it at night but it works very very well and makes my skin super soft ahydhydrated￼

review_title: a little goes a long way!
review_text: Works well! Leaves my skin feeling refreshed and clean and the packaging is adorable. As someone who has dry skin, I appreciate that a little product goes a long way and I don’t feel the need to reapply it through the night!

The Lala Retro Whipped Cream was the perfect pairing with the serum. It was extremely hydrating and I felt like it locked in the moisture (which is important when you’re using a chemical exfoliant).The texture felt very luxurious and sunk right in, but I felt the smell was a little odd. I’m assuming that’s because this thing is packed full of so many skin-helping ingredients. It’s for that reason alone that I’m giving this 4 stars.

Got as sample from influenster to try. It doesn’t smell bad but I wish it had more of a ‘fresh/clean’ scent. The texture is really nice and goes on smoothly. It moisturizes well but not the best I had, and honestly at the price it is, I would never buy.
In love with this moisturizer. It is so hydrating. I apply as the last step of my morning and night skincare routine and my skin feels amazing! I highly recommend!
I feel neutral about the product; it’s not bad by any means, but I also don’t see myself spending the money on this product based on this travel size one.

What I like about this product is that it’s very moisturizing perfect for those who have dry skin. A good thing is that it is 100% free of essential oils, silicones, and fragrance. Including Vegan and cruelty-free perfect for those who looks for these type of ingredients. It definitely makes my skin moisturizing through the whole day. Overall I recommend this product.
It does make your skin instantly hydrated but for me, it felt thick and heavy and my skin felt greasy after applying.  Not good for summer in hot and humid areas.  Skin looks great though!

This moisturizer is the best for sensitive and acne prone skin. I love how it glides smoothly without making skin look oily. A little amount goes a long way! Also love that it does not have any fragrance, makes it the best night time skin care routine product! My skin feel really soft and plump in the mornings. I use this along with the Drunk Elephant night serum.
I loved the texture and feel that this gave my skin after using the product. Seemed to diminish some of my redness present as well
Pillowy and thick moisturizer that is great for dry or dehydrated skin. Non-scented and non-irritating formula that plays nicely with actives and other skincare products.

I was very excited to receive a Drunk Elephant promo box from Influenster (in exchange for my honest opinion) & was super lucky to receive two products that I actually had a need for.  I have used this moisturizer for about a week now & love it so much.  I suffer from dry patches on my skin & this product has been amazing.  Some nights I mix it in with the new night serum they sent & they work nicely together.  I plan to replace this product when I’ve used the entire sample.

I have super sensitive skin so I was nervous buying this but I love it so much! It hydrates my skin and makes my skin feel so soft! It also clears up my acne (along w other DE products). My skin didn’t love this product the first 10 days but now it’s amazing!

I received this as a mini in a Sephora favorites that I purchased, I used this every day until it was finished; I have dry skin and this did absolutely nothing for my skin. It still left my face dry. In my opinion not worth the money. Very thick consistency which was misleading, I was hoping that since it was a thick cream that I would be moisturizing for dry skin. I would not recommend this product.

My skin drinks this stuff right up. My skin is dry and eczema prone, and this moisturizer combined with the marula oil is absolutely wonderful on my skin. My skin feels soothed, soft, supple, and smooth. Works beautifully with the glycolic serum and the F-Balm.

I have oily/combo skin. I stay away from rich creams because everything breaks me out (from large pimples to small millia around the eyes). I always stuck to skin products for acne prone skin and only used super light gel creams but I’m not a teenager anymore and at 35 I do need anti aging ingredients. Plus too much acne fighting products does give me dry patches here and there. The la la retro cream came as part of a DE sample pack I bought. I have been using the whole DE line and use this cream in the morning and the protini cream at night. I was afraid it would make me shiny or break me out but it has been the opposite. My skin drinks it up and the finish is very velvety and smooth. Since switching to DE I get so many compliments on my skin and I barely wear foundation anymore. And when I do wear makeup it doesn’t pill or turn super greasy. No problems whatsoever. I will continue to purchase.
My absolute favorite moisturizer!! I use it every single day and it’s amazing for all skin types! I’m dry in the winter and oily in the summer and it works incredibly well all throughout the year.

review_title: Only Moisturizer That Fixed Ny Dry Skin
review_text: I am a die hard Lala Retro fan- my skin is typically dry and dehydrated and I’ve tried a ton of different moisturizers that did not work for me (including Protini- plus my skin has some weird reaction to gel consistencies) but Lala has changed my skin, I don’t get dry flaky patches anymore and overall my skin is brighter and softer, I HIGHLY recommend for my dry girls, I don’t even consider my skin to be dry or dehydrated anymore since using Lala (this is with infrequent use, a couple of times a week max!). People always compliment on my skin after I put on too even if I don’t have anything else on my face, it’s just one of those BFF products for me that doesn’t have any down sides (beyond the price point lol but thankfully I don’t need to purchase it that often)

Fantastic product, but knocked a star off for ridiculous packaging. The amount of plastic waste just to have “fun“ dispenser is really ridiculous. This moisturizer is wonderful but I will not buy it again until the packaging changes. Like a few other reviewers, I also took it apart to get every last vestige out because it’s not cheap. A good amount of product waste. Probably four to five more uses left in the bottom.
All time favorite moisturizer! Super hydrating but never feels sticky or greasy!
I like that there is no strong smell, it keeps my face hydrated and works well with my sensitive skin... no breakouts so I keep reordering it I just wish it wasn’t so expensive!
I loooove this. Whenever I breakout, I use this cream and it helps to rebuild my skin barrier ! I recommand it for people with dry skin with occasional acne

I don’t get the hype around DE. Who is their target audience? Young adults that cannot afford their products or more mature people that are put off by their juvenile packaging? This is an okay moisturizer, absolutely nothing outstanding, for the price I expected much, much more. I’m going back to Tatcha and Estee Lauder.

A winter must-have! I have sensitive skin and this has been a lifesaver for those harsh winters and my mild patches of ecemza I have on my face. This is a really thick cream, so if you’re not into heavy creams, then this will not be the right match for you.

i can honestly say this is probably my favourite moisturizer. i have really sensitive and acne prone skin, and i have spent so much money on so many products that have ruined my skin and made me breakout. this is my holy grail now!! i’m so happy i finally found something that is so nice and gentle on my skin!! my skin tends to be really really DRY and flaky especially during the winter and this has SAVED IT

After struggling to find a great hydrating moisturizer I found one that works for my sensitive skin! I had an allergic reaction to about every moisturizer but this one didn’t give me a allergic reaction. So happy with how this hydrates my skin and stays hydrated all day long.

Didn’t like it at all. Even if I have dry skin in the winter, this cream didn’t do much. I did not penetrate my skin and it left a greasy film! I read a lot of good reviews on that cream and was excited to use Drunk elephant but I was really disappointed.

I have bought this product numerous times, but for some reason, this container I got has an AWFUL smell - almost can’t even wear it because of this. Normally it has a fresh, mild smell to it. Really bummed with this product this time, but it really works.
Something in drunk elephant products makes me break out. Something to keep in mind in my review. Immediately made me break out overnight
I love the entire Drunk Elephant line! This moisturizer hydrates my skin without leaving a thick heavy layer of cream on my face.

I live way up North and it gets very dry during the winter times, so I knew I had to splurge to keep my skin moisturized without greasiness. This product does just that! I would only recommend if you have dry skin or you might think it’s too heavy. Drunk Elephant did it once again!

It was alright. I tried both this one and the protini. Protini was better by far. This one broke me out when I first used it but after a while I guess my skin got used to it. It is pretty expensive for what it is.

The old formulation of Lala was a miracle worker and the only moisturizer I could use for my sensitive combo skin. I’d repurchased it 4+ times and I’ve never tried anything like it. This new formula just isn’t for sensitive or acne prone skin. It makes me flare up and I start getting little bumps all over my forehead.I don’t understand why DE changed such an amazing product. I’ve read so many reviews similar to mine- they really didn’t listen to their customers or do enough testing.

I love this product. It makes my skin so hydrated and moisturized. Even In the middle of winter it does an amazing job keeping me moisturized. I love the thickness of the lotion and it goes on smooth.  I would definitely recommend this product!

I want to give this product 5 stars, because a little goes such a long way. I put such a small amount on my face, and it feels so nourished and moisturized, without feeling greasy. However, there’s really no excuse for this product being $60. That’s absurd, and I would be too embarrassed to recommend it to anyone because of this.

Lala - you make my skin sigh with pleasure!!!  This is a light cream but very rich.  The great part - even though it is rich...it does not over-moisturize my skin or cause breakouts.  I am on my third container... this is in my daily routine, as well as Protini.  Drunk Elephant is the ticket!!!
Good hydration but made my pores huge - and I don’t normally mind my pores - it’s the first time I noticed a product just visibly enhancing my pores.

Sure why not. I have been using this moisturizer for over a year and a half. It’s definitely rich in texture but I can’t say I’ve noticed that much of a difference or that it does a great job penetrating my skin. Throughout the day I have noticed that it sits on top of my face, which makes it difficult to apply any type of foundation or makeup (but we’re in a pandemic now so it’s not like that matters). It seems to do it’s job rather well but is by no means essential.

Will be purchasing this for the fourth time soon. I have dry skin, rosacea and mild eczema and this is the PERFECT light weight, hydrating moisturizer that keeps all those issues from flaring up. No scent (yes!) and fantastic, hygienic packaging.

I was recommended this as I have normal-dry skin. It was a pretty small amount for the price and didn’t quench my skin at all. I would recommend Cerave or First Aid’s super moisturizing cream instead, if you are looking for ceramides + hydration.
Like even better than proteini.  Leave my skin baby soft and my skin has definitely become more moisturized since I switched to this.

review_title: This cream IS as light yet rich as it claims.
review_text: I have an extremely oily T-zone, but really dry cheeks. This cream is perfect for going on as my last step for added moisture on the dry parts of my face and neck. I’m male and after I shave my face and neck I need a moisturizer that is rich in moisture and easy on sensitive skin. This really works perfectly in my everyday routine.

I love this cream. I have dry skin and have been using it nightly for a month. My skin is not nearly as dry. I absolutely love the pump. It has no scent and does not irritate my skin. Totally worth the price and I will continue to buy it! If you don’t like a thick face cream, then this isn’t for you.

review_title: reformulation stings my under eye area
review_text: Reformulation now causes eye irritation. I have used this in the past specifically as a heavy duty under eye night moisturizer. It was non irritating and provided great hydration. But this new formula stings my sensitive under eye skin now for some reason. No clue what ingredient might be causing it but I will not be repurchasing.

Call me crazy but I don’t see the hype. This is the first Drunk Elephant product I’ve bought. I got a tiny tiny sample for my birthday or maybe points and I liked it so I went and ordered the full size in Jan during VIB sale. I probably didn’t really start using it until mid/end of Feb and I feel like it’s almost in empty. I use 1 pump nightly only and I feel like my skin feels dry in the morning. I would say however that thicker products tend to clog my pores but this doesn’t do that and I love the pump. Most moisturizer are just open jars and so unsanitary to me even though I only moisturize with clean hands and a clean face. With that said for the price tag it’s a little odd how much product you actually get. I’m all for spending money on something that works well but having that feeling of not getting my money’s worth is sucky. I won’t be repurchasing and I’m hesitant in buying other overly priced drunk elephant products.

review_title: Good for dryness, but not acne prone skin!
review_text: Prefer their protini cream! This is super moisturizing and if I have an intense dry patch I will use this there. Also love under my eyes, however I realized when I put it all over my face it was breaking me out! So just beware if that’s an issue for you. I will continue to use mine for the reasons listed and would repurchase only if I could get it in a smaller size jar.
This is the smoothest moisturizer I have ever tried. It makes my skin feel so soft.
there isn’t anything special about this cream. I also disliked the texture

I love this stuff. It’s moisturizing without being too heavy. I recommend waiting a good 10 minutes if you’re going to apply makeup following this product. The only downside is you really can’t tell when you’re going to run out, but the packaging does help with germs/contamination. I reached out to DE and they gave me an idea of how long each product should last you. The employee said this one should last 100-110 pumps. So if you use this twice per day, it would last you about 2 months.

Unfortunately, it’s overpriced for just 50mL. I went through 2-3 little tubs of this and used it primarily at night. It helped my wrinkles, not gonna lie. I would use it heavily around my eyes and forehead. I’m 25, had started forming wrinkles but this moisturizer just absorbed right up, left a lovely velvety feeling on my skin. I’m looking for a cheaper alternative but so far nothing.

I wanted to love this so much when it came in my March 2020 Playbox, I wanted to SO HARD! But I have combination skin and this just made my face feel super oily. It did help with some dry spots on my arms that I get every now and then but that was it. The scent wasn’t overwhelming but maybe a little too soft. I used very small amounts on my face, just enough to cover it and it just made my face oily and break out. I wont be buying this product in the future.

I adored the original Lala. I hadn’t been in a monogamous relationship with a moisturizer for a loooooong time prior to being introduced. I guess DE didn’t like riding the gravy train? Now we have this paltry reformulation in cheaper packaging. The flimsy lid is apt to fall off if you sneeze on it, let alone try to pack it. The formula is lighter and will barely moisturize dry skin for an hour after applying. It does nothing for my skin any more. Back to the dating game.

review_title: dries skin on me and my family who tried it
review_text: This moisturizer dries my skin. You read that right. I thought it was just me but I gave it to my mom and without me telling her why I don’t want it, she told me it dries her skin too. Very chalky and matte feeling. Hate it. If you have dry skin, don’t get it.
I have reordered this moisturizer 4 times and a still loving it! It’s perfect for dry winter skin
I just got it couple weeks ago so far so good very hydrating A small size goes a long way I love the packaging all drunk Elephante products they are very well protected from the sunlight

Great for very dry skin and works really well.  I mix a drop of marula oil during winter months for a  extra boost.  Been using this for 2 years.  It’s expensive so I try to use sparingly.  Love the packaging.

I genuinely really like this product. It’s perfect for the winter season. I have combo skin and this feels awesome to have on and my skin feels nourished and glowy after I use it. I really recommend this product, even though it is verrrryy expensive.

this is my latest repurchase. this cream is expensive but my skin appreciates it so much. I had switched over to some other creams like the tatcha dewy cream and Sunday riley good Genes and caudalie, but none quench my dry skin like this LaLa Retro cream. this one is a must stay.
It does not take much of this product to work. I even use it on my hands.

Love it! Wow it just is wonderful on my face. My face feels hydrated after putting it on. I definitely know when I’m wearing it versus when I forgot just by how my face feels. It is hard to forget to put on though because of the drastic difference I feel. I wish the price point was lower but it is better then other moisturizers I’ve tried!
This stuff is beyond moisturizing!  If you have dry skin this will become your bff
Great moisturizer to mix with serum- I like the dispenser. Leaves my skin hydrated but not greasy. Iight enough for under makeup and formula leaves my skin feeling soft
It’s moisturizing but almost too much for my face. It better for my elbows and other dry patches.

Love it. I was skeptical at first because the moisturizer feels a bit on the heavier side but it drank beautifully into my skin. My face is brighter and my facial redness has improved. The only downside is that the packaging is unconventional and I’ve had problems pumping product out.
Love this cleanser! Drunk elephant is quickly becoming a favorite brand and my skin is thanking them!

This Lala Retro Whipped Moisturizer is my absolute favorite. It’s very light and instantly soaks into my dry skin. Areas where I have noticed the most benefit is around my nose (which is very dry from my seasonal cold nose blowing) and around my chin. I can see that my makeup blends easier due to my skin being better hydrated thanks to this lovely cream. The container is perfect and dispenses the exact amount needed. I received this product free for testing purposes but will purchase in the future as should you.

I absolutely love the whipped moisturizer, it has done wonders for my skin. I received this product complimentary from Influenster and I absolutely love it. It’s so creamy and plush. It’s a must have. My only complaint is that the scent is very bland and boring. The product itself is very nice!! I know the price is a little steep but after using the cream it is well worth it. It’s so nice and the product goes a long way. You only need one pump for your whole face.

review_title: Luxurious whipped Cream in unique packaging!
review_text: Another genius packaging idea from DRUNK ELEPHANT. A measured pump on the jar, means the right amount and the bonus of keeping dirty fingers and bacteria out of the container. Easily absorbed, this soft souffléd night cream hydrates, calms, and moisturizes face, but with no greasy residue! A lovely evening cream especially when layered with their other products! Love the clean white jar with the Lavender lid that complements the other color coded products in the line. Wish it had an SPF as it would also make a nice day cream!

I am always weary of new moisturizers because my face is super sensitive and will break out easily.  I have been using this moisturizer paired with the framboise night serum for a few weeks now ans truly love it.  Not only has my not not broken out once, but this product has actually helped calm my chronic rosacea.  I will definitely buy this again when I run out!

Lala Retro is one of many Drunk Elephant products that I’ve used and enjoyed.  The texture is very nice and I can actually FEEL it working.  Not a fan of the packaging necessarily.... it’s not the easiest to completely empty, so I feel product probably gets wasted.  Still, a good product that I would purchase again!

review_title: DE Protini lover finally tried Lala Retro.
review_text: I have sensitive, combination skin so ever since DE released the Protini moisturizer a few years ago, I switched my skincare routine from Tatcha to predominantly Drunk Elephant skincare products.  But the Lala Retro moisturizer was one I always steered clear of (besides using the tester in store on my hands). I assumed that since Lala Retro has a blend of oils and seems to be more moisturizing than Protini is, I was worried that it would make my combination skin go out of control (especially in my T-zone). I do know that the current version of Lala Retro is a slightly different formula and has a lighter consistency than original Lala Retro formula. I have been using Lala Retro twice a day for the past few weeks and my skin is actually much more balanced. I do think that this moisturizer would be a bit too much for me to use in the summer time here in Arizona, but I will definitely use this as my autumn/winter moisturizer moving forward. I do have different hues of foundation for the different times of year (depending how tan or pasty I am), but I hadn’t considered changing up some of skincare routine products seasonally until I tried this moisturizer. My skin tone and texture has evened out, I don’t have dry and oily portions of face and no traces of redness. If you are struggling with winter skin (thanks to cold weather outside and dry, warm central air heating your home inside), this moisturizer has really helped my skin feel and look as good as it does during the warmer months.

I’ve been using this for a few weeks now and keep hoping that it’s not contributing to the whiteheads I’ve been getting since using Drunk Elephant products. Even though the company says their products work for all skin types, it’s not for mine. Good quality and great packaging, but I don’t need white heads at this time in my life.

This is a great facial cream product from Drunk Elephant. I liked the  Lala Retro whipped moisturizer with ceramides especially because it has the ceramides. I’m not sure if the container is the best because it might be hard to get all of the cream out but the cream itself feels nice.

Upon first impression, I thought nothing could beat the PACKAGING on this product. Turns out the actual product inside is even better!! It’s unscented, light, a little goes a long way (I need less than 1 pump), and it never leaves me oily or clogged. Love!!

I love this moisturizer. I have been using it for about two weeks with the TLC night serum and have noticed a difference - my overall skin tone has evened out and some trouble spots I usually break out in have become non-existent. I love the DE products are scent and dye free because this really makes a great nighttime mask that leaves my skin glowing and fresh in the morning. If you’re looking for a new moisturizer that will help your skin retain or regain its youthful bounce - this is for you!

This moisturizer keeps my skin feeling supple and velvety! It absorbs well into the skin and is lightweight. It does not leave an oily texture on the skin. It does it’s job in keeping my face moisturized even overnight.
This moisturizer is so lightweight and easily absorbs. With my combo skin I can get very oily, but this moisturizer doesn’t cause my skin to produce extra oil. Very very happy!

This moisturizer is perfect for the winter! I love how hydrating and creamy this product is. This moisturizer gives my face luminosity. I’m glad that Drunk Elephant added ceramides to this moisturizer which makes the product more helpful in hydrating and maintaining a healthy skin barrier.

This product is okay! I mean it worked like an average moisturizer but for $60, I wanted better results. Honesty in my opinion you can find a way better moisturizer for half of the price. I felt like it hydrated my skin that’s all! I know what some are thinking that’s what it’s supposed to do, ya but $60 I wanted it to more. I honestly don’t understand why she puts her average moisturizer on the market for $60 really!

This is such a good moisturizer! It is a bit too heavy for my skin type though. Many raving reviews say that this moisturizer saved their Sahara desert skin but my skin isn’t dry so I can’t use this everyday

This is one of my favorite moisturizers on the market.  It’s great for extra dry skin or a winter moisturizer as it’s heavier than most moisturizers.  It has a really clean scent, with no added fragrance, and feels like it’s rich with oils and other moisturizing ingredients that really make my skin feel hydrated and supple after applying.  I use this moisturizer primarily as my nighttime moisturizer and use a lighter one for daytime under make up.  Since it’s thicker, I like to mix with the Drunk Elephant Maraula oil when applying, but only in my nighttime routine as it can look a bit oily on the face.  In the morning, my face feels well hydrated and extremely soft.  Depending on your skin type, I highly recommend this moisturizer for dry skin and the Drunk Elephant Protini one for normal or oily skin.

Love the design of this! This pump is amazing, I don’t have to dip my fingers in or even continuously open and get air into my moisturizer. I love the thickness of this and how it’s super hydrating without feeling heavy. It’s pretty expensive so I’m not sure I’d be able to keep buying this multiple times but it’s definitely a little splurge for myself.

review_title: Wintertime moisturizer for the driest skin!
review_text: This moisturizer is a very thick cream. If you struggle with cold-weather dryness, this may be the right choice for you. Lala Retro might be overkill for those who don’t need that extra boost to their moisture barrier, though. And I can’t imagine using it in the summer. I do find it gentle and effective, though, after it’s had a chance to absorb. It doesn’t break out or irritate my sensitive combo skin.

This is a great moisturizer for winter for me.  I have combination skin and it takes care of any dryness on my cheeks immediately.  I prefer to use it at night as it’s a little heavy for the oily areas of my skin.  I love the pump packaging and ingredients!
Huge fan of anything drunk elephant! This cream did not disappoint :)
This moisturizer smells like play dough to me so I’m returning the product.

I originally received this moisturizer in a special 40+ skin care box I purchased. I now keep this moisturizer in my everyday stock! I have sensitive skin but have had no problems with irritation. This feels like it moisturizers on a cellular level, my skin stays happy all day! I also love that this is a “clean“ product!

I have been using this moisturizer for about a year. I use as a day time moisturizer and it keeps my usually dry skin feeling great! It doesn’t just sit on top of the skin or look greasy. Doesn’t break me out. Doesn’t smell funky or perfumes. I like the packaging but it’s annoying to have no warning before it runs out (one star off)!
Very rich dense moisturizer! Love the instant hydration!

It really is a nice gentle cream. Its not heavy.   I needed something to put on right after swimming, or layer so help my face not be in trouble due to the pool water.  It seems to be doing ok. For the price you would think its better. Its average if that.  I have dry skin,  and It is not making it worse, or breaking me out. Its just nothing special to write home about.

I like this product. It’s thick and similar to the texture of the First Aid Beauty cream but the packaging/dispenser on this one is much more sanitary. It sinks into my dry skin well. However, I feel like the size of the container leads you to believe that there is a lot more product than there actually is. It takes more than one pump to moisturize my face. Price is also a bit high.
This face cream is great for those with dry skin. Very thick and works great!

I don’t have horrible skin, but I have minor instances of many different problems such as fine lines, large pores, hormonal acne, acne scars, uneven texture, and redness. My biggest problem is that my skin is extremely dry. My whole life my only skincare routine was cleanser

review_title: May not be for you if you have acne-prone skin
review_text: I really wanted to love the Drunk Elephant line, but as I’m going through each of their products, I’m finding a few pore-clogging ingredients that I need to cut out of my regimen. This one has a few: Isopropyl Isostearate, Glyceryl Stearate SE, Stearic Acid﻿. Not for me as someone who’s acne prone. Clean is not always the best - check the ingredients to make sure there’s not something in there that doesn’t work for you and your skin.
I received this as a sample. I went to put a bit on my face and nearly gagged. It smells like mustard. I immediately washed it off.

I love love love this product! Everytime I notice that my skin is trying to act up, I use this overnight. The next morning it looks fabulous and all spots or acne is gone. It was quite potent for my skin so I use moisturizer before putting directly on my skin or else it burns. So just make sure you test it out.

Waooohh! Waoohh! Honestly, I had never noticed as good results with a serum before. This thing made my skin look flawless even when I was recovering from acne. Helped my scars so much and literally disappeared pores. My soin still looks like skin, but it is so brilliant and glowy without any product on it. It is strong so I alternate it between nights with other products that would also help me minimize acne. I feel the price point is good and on par with what the products does for your skin. Im waiting for another sale to get stock up.
I love honey as a skincare product and this is hydrating, gentle, yet effective.

review_title: better than the drunk elephant TLC glycolic serum
review_text: This smooth my skin and gave it a glow within 2 weeks of daily use. It also absorbs quickly and isn’t tacky so works well with other serums and a moisturizer

This serum was gifted by Farmacy Beauty. One of my absolute favorite serums! The first time I used it I was blown away. It absorbs really quickly into the skin and doesn’t leave any unwanted residue. Farmacy never disappoints!

This was gifted by Farmacy beauty in exchange for my honest review. I love this serum so much! It feels so nice on my skin and absorbs in quickly without any sticky feeling afterwards too. I received this complimentary from Farmacy Beauty for reviewing purposes. I’ve been using this for a few weeks now, after taking a bit of a break from acids and I’m really liking it. I love all Farmacy products, and this one was a missing element in my skincare routine! I love to use it because I wake up and my skin is glowing and smooth! And my morning serum and moisturizer seem to absorb much better! This product was fitted to me for my honest review

I love this product! Gives me skin such a nice dewy glow without irritating my sensitive skin. I love that this serum exfoliates but also adds some moisture to my skin. Highly recommend! This was gifted to me by farmacy beauty.

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. The packaging is very practical and cute. I would highly recommend this product to my friends. Very nice discovery, I’m glad I tried this one!

This product was gifted by Farmacy. I’ve also purchased this product in the past as well, it’s seriously so good!!! It’s a little on the stronger side so I’ll use it about once a week and my skin feels soooo smooth after it. Definitely a holy grail product!!!

I wanted this product to work so badly. But It didn’t deliver. Instead of my face glowing it became tired and dull over time. You have to mix it with other products and even then it takes a toll on the skin. Won’t be purchasing again. I gave it two stars for the week it worked.

I love this product and I am nearly finished my second full size bottle of it. I was using it every night but will be following its 3-4 night/week recommendation as I’m beginning to feel “stripped”. Very effective night serum.

I received this as a sample and I immediately loved it. After just one use, I saw a difference on the surface of my skin. My skin looked beautiful.  I am 49 years old with dry, acne-prone, sensitive skin and my skin loved this serum. I’ve already used it 3 times and I just purchased my first bottle.
This is an amazing skin treatment! When used with the right serum and moisturizer it creates such a balanced glow that you don’t even need foundation etc. Can be used daily. I love it!

I have very dry sensitive skin, so I wasn’t surprised that it burned for a few seconds after application the first few weeks. I’m 35 and use it on my hands and they look younger than they looked in my 20s.

I didnt find this hydrated me and since smell matters to me (and the smell isn’t great), I rate this as just ok. Performance wise, I cannot say that it did anything, but it didn’t break me out or irritate my skin either.

Aka: means it’s doing “something “ but, the finish is great, skin is smooth , glows, exfoliated and just looks great!!! Absolutely highly recommend!!!

Pricey but totally worth it. Been using it for a month now and I can say that this product is really is something. It’s amazing. My face appears to be super glowy and clearer now. Love it!

I’ve never written a review about a product before, but this product is AMAZING. It has become a staple in my beauty routine. I got it as a free sample and ended up purchasing. I have very sensitive skin and it doesn’t irritate it one bit. HIGHLY recommend.

This product is unbelievable, it has been absolutely changing my skin. I look forward to my nighttime skin care routine so much now. I use this every other night with a retinol in between. AMAZING!!! Really looking forward to trying more products from this brand, everything so far has been 10/10!

I have oily breakout-prone skin and this has really helped me clear up a previous breakout. When I use it, I wake up with more beautiful skin in the morning! Good stuff!!

This product is honestly one of my favorites. It leaves my face SUPER soft and I feel so hydrated in the morning. My face can be sensitive at times, so I only use it 2-3 times a week.

Decided to try this serum as I saw many good reviews and recommends. This product will give you beautiful angel skin. It doesn’t irritate my skin, smoothes out and cleans out my pores and makes my skin look so fresh and clear. i ordered this a few weeks ago, and i’m obsessed. since quarantine started i’ve been eating really poorly so i’ve had a few more breakouts than i’d like to admit. i have sensitive skin and i am acne-prone. once i received this product, my face cleared up within a week! i cant believe it. my skin is the clearest it’s been in a really long time and i couldn’t recommend this product enough.

review_title: Do not use unless you have real skin issues

review_title: Helps with acne, doesn't help with uneven texture
review_text: Warning: this product stings a lot if you have open wounds. As someone who has struggled with adult acne, I found this product to be very helpful. I changed my skincare routine when I realized my old routine wasn’t working for me. This product helped a lot in reducing the number of pimples, but it doesn’t help with uneven texture (still trying to find a product that will help with this). My skin in general is not sensitive, but it is slightly sensitive to this product. So, for those of you with sensitive skin, I would probably steer clear! At the time of application, it does make my pimples look worse and inflamed, but when I wake up, my skin looks a lot better--not “glowly“ but definitely better. Since my main concern was my acne, I give it 4 stars!

I got this product as a sample, and am I glad I never bought the full size! This product made my skin BURN, really burn. I’m used to using DE T.L.C Framboos and wanted to try something new, more budget friendly, but this product was a mistake. I have never had such a horrible experience with a skincare product before. If you have sensitive skin do not buy this product.

this stuff is magic. put it on and the next morning my skin is glowing, more even, and it does wonders for the skin texture. I have recommended this to everyone I know. it’s absolutely worth the price.

review_title: If I could give 0 stars, I would.

review_title: Don't use on broken skin - otherwise, it's great!
review_text: I’ll preface this by saying that I’ve only used the product once, and it was last night. So I may edit this after a few more uses!   I love Farmacy as a brand, and I saw this in the little gift box with the honey mask and decided to get it to try. I read a bunch of reviews that said it was fantastic, and I was in need of a good exfoliant type of product that wasn’t an aggressive St Ives type of BS.   The mini size I got is super ineffective at getting product out; the eye dropper is too small and the product too thick, so I end up just kind of scooping it out. It smells delightful, so I was excited to use it (plus it’s branded as ’clean’ which is a huge bonus for me). My forehead has had eczema issues previously, and my chin is currently full of acne scars and pimples that are just starting to dissipate, so when I put the serum on both of those areas they BUUURRRRNNNEEEDDDDD. Like, turned bright red and felt as if on fire. I was pretty sure it was because of the previous concerns, so I left it on and put moisturizer on top in hopes it would subside. After about an hour the redness was down to a very dull pink and didn’t burn anymore. I woke up and my skin felt so soft and really well exfoliated, no redness at all. My chin area was extra dry unfortunately (but that one is my own fault for using a towel to physically scrub off dead skin I had), HOWEVER, this product drastically helped it loosen some of the dead skin that had arisen, so I gently rubbed it off. I feel like if I use this maybe 2x a week I’ll see great results. Forehead and cheeks feel really soft and look clear as well. Chin has always been my biggest problem area, so I’ll give this a few chances and see if it helps.
Even the first time using this my skin was glowing in the morning and it reduced the size of my blemishes as well. Excited to see the results as I keep using it.

Wow. I honestly just got a sample of this to try, and I’m in a sure fire hurry to get back to sephora and puts chase this. The second I feel like my skin looks slightly too congested/clogged I use this over night and the results are astounding. I wake up clear, glowy, and evened out. I’m obsessed! It does tingle/burn slightly when you first put it on but if you’ve used chemical exfoliants before I’m sure you’ll do alright with it. If not your skin may be sensitive to the sensation, and I would suggest if you typically use a physical exfoliant to not use it for a week or two before using this.

So good I can’t live without it now, makes my skin amazing skin like in the movies except with out the whole team, love thats it’s made from plants and shows what the earth gifts still have for us if we don’t kill her.

A do-it-all type of product. Personally, this brightens my skin, evens my skin tone, smooths my skin texture, and greatly diminishes my acne scars. This stuff is liquid gold to me lol. This is the one product I can’t do without in my routine.
Very moisturizing and glowing, I’m glad I purchased.

I picked this up after Stephanie Nicole mentioned it in a recent video. I love this line and trust her recommendations as she does a lot of research. After only a few uses, my skin texture feels better and it is very gentle.

I got this in one of my beauty box subscriptions. It’s very similar in feel and consistency to Sunset Riley’s Lactic Acid Good Genes, which is why I didn’t like it. I prefer my acids to work without burning.

This is so light weight and not greasy I love it.  Sometimes I use serums and I wake up in the morning with such an oily face, but with this I just wake up glowing and plump looking and so so soft.  I have combination skin so it scares me to try new products because I don’t know how it will react on my skin, but so far love it love it love it ! Not one break out from it

I highly recommend this product, you will get a lot of compliments on your skin, even from guys (which is saying a lot lol).

I have had acne since I was a teenager. I’m 24 now. Needless to say, I still struggle with it. I’ve found a routine that works well and I probably only get about one to two small pimples a week, which is just fine by me compared to what I used to deal with. But then I was faced with the next problem: scars. Luckily I didn’t end up with any pock marks or deep scars, but I have a lot of discoloration and dark marks. Every fading or exfoliating product I ever used broke me out again, defeating the purpose and leaving me with more marks. But THIS. This product is amazing. It has DRASTICALLY faded my PIH and dark marks. (I attached a photo of one month’s difference after use) And it keeps my skin clear. I use two pumps every night because my skin isn’t sensitive to acids. I follow with a hyaluronic acid moisturizer. It has done wonders for my skin. Recently I’ve actually been getting compliments on my skin, which I promise you has never happened to me. This product is worth every penny and I will continue to repurchase. If you’re on the fence, try this!

I received this in my boxycharm lux box. I usually don’t try skincare products because they all break me out. I have oily/combination skin. After using this a few nights, I was already getting compliments on my glowing skin. I use a vitamin C serum (which I get on Amazon for $20) underneath and this on top. Overall, I love it! So happy I tried it. Repurchasing for sure.
I usually am not sensitive to skincare products, but this made my skin burn. I also didn’t care for the way it smelled, but I do like the container it came in.

Started with a sample (some of the reviewers mentioned tingling and redness) so I could see how my skin reacted. I guess I’m used to acids since I experienced no tingling, burning or redness. WOW! Within 15 minutes of my first use, my skin felt smoother & was actually glowing. Love the Farmacy honey scent and it left my skin feeling moisturized and soft. Got the full size and my skin is still happy with the product and is actually glowing. I use it 2-3x/ week and I’ve seen an improvement in my texture.

I love this serum so much that I’ve repurchased it. It truly defines my skin and keeps it clear and smooth. The morning after using this I can see such a difference in my skin. I will continue to buy this product because the results it produces are amazing.

Not impressed:( wanted to love this so bad as a replacement for more expensive AHA’s. I noticed upon application and after soaking in, my face felt really sticky and a bit itchy. Not the typical baby smooth feeling I expect from acids. Woke up the next day with a mix of hives and cystic acne on my cheeks. I continued use of this since I figured it could be the result of a purge phase. No luck! Just a consistent flow of hives and breakouts. Ive used prescription retinoids, peels, acids, etc all with no negative effects even close to this. I don’t have sensitive skin and am used to chemical exfoliation, so I’m not sure what ingredients in this are causing so much irritation:/ 2 stars because despite the breakouts and sticky-itchiness, there was a nice glow on some parts of my face that are typically dull and textured.Please do a patch test first even if you are experienced with chemical exfoliants!

review_title: BIG NO NO for sensitive skin
review_text: Wanted to love based on the reviews but I have very sensitive skin. Because of this I patch tested it on my neck and I’m glad I did. I broke out with small red bumps and a dry patch within minutes. It’s too harsh for my skin. It may work for others but if you have sensitive skin BE CAREFUL, the ingredients are very strong.
Ok yeah I LOVE this product. I love the products that make a difference from the first application! Glow check...hydration check...nourishing a big check! I definitely recommend it!

This is one of the few facial products I’ve used and actually got visible results.  It goes on smoothly, little tingly, no particular scent, feels light and a little seems to go a long way. What it has done is clear up a patch of dry skin above my lip that I’ve had for 8 months and tried a zillion things on.  It’s also vastly improved some acne scars.  This product is well worth the price and I will continue to purchase.  Wow!

Very nice formula with just enough sting so that you know it’s working. If you’re choosing between this and a pricier competitor product, I recommend this one ;). I don’t get a glow but I do have nice resurfacing with this product.
Best serum I’ve tried! And I try them all. My skin loves it. You can see results after only one use. I’m in my second bottle. 1 bottle last me 4 months.
magic in a bottle. I used to use drunk elephant’s night serum, but this stuff is cheaper and works wonders on my skin.

It does give a sight tingle and if you aren’t used to using acids you should take it slow and integrate it into your routine slowly.  Helps keep my acne under control and keep my texture at a reasonable amount.  Skin is softer and nicely exfoliated.

I finished a bottle in November. Found it amazing, no acne breakout and soft skin. Bought it when it came out at 64$CA. Then I tried the Drunk Elephant Framboos and disappointed, so many breakouts... I’m going back to honey glow but the price went up to 77$CA. Is it because of its popularity?

Best Exfoliator hands down! Makes my dry and sensitive skin soft, supple and glowy. I can’t help but touch my face constantly to feel how smooth and re-texturized it is. Highly recommend this product.
