This stuff works wonders. After only 3 uses my texture has definitely improved. A little goes a long way, and I love that it has clean ingredients. Will be a staple for me from now on!

review_title: The only AHA my skin can handle
review_text: I have used this for about 3 months, and it has really helped the texture of my skin! It didn’t clear my acne (I have cystic acne) but I do feel like individual spots went away faster and it helped heal my scarring. Usually AHAs are super drying for me and make my skin flake off, but I felt like this one was just nourishing enough that it didn’t irritate my (moderately sensitive) skin. Also, the morning after using this, I would always notice the most beautiful glow to my cheeks. The only problem for me is that I recently started a prescription topical cream for my acne, and this really doesn’t combine well with that. So I wouldn’t recommend this if you’re on accutane or use retinols or any other strong acne product.

I’ve been using this every other night for a couple of weeks. I’ve also been trying out new tinted moisturizers/BB creams at the same time and unfortunately had extra bumps/emerging whiteheads yesterday on my forehead and jawline from one of the BB creams. I put this on last night and when I woke up, the bumps were LITERALLY GONE. It blew my mind. I’ve been following this with face oil and a night moisturizer and love how my skin looks and feels the next morning. It does make my skin feel a little tight, but it helps my skin handle the moisture from those two products, and honestly, my skin could probably handle working up to using every night. With the sting, I could see how it would be a little harsh on sensitive skin, but I love how it feels.
This is a holy grail find for me. I noticed results after two uses. The pores beside my nose were significantly less noticeable. I love it and will be buying again and again.

This is a holy grail product for me! It works with one use along with being in Sephora’s “clean“ product line up. I look forward to more releases like this from Farmacy. This is by far the best product they have created!!!

I recently purchased this as an alternative to DE Framboos.  It is stronger than Framboos so I’ve been using 3 times a week.  I must say it does do what it says it will do.  My skin is clear, bright, and glowing.  I apply before bed and wake up, splash some cold water on my face and my I’m definitely glowing.

Love this night seryum, cleared up my skin. I don’t have acne but a few bumps here and there. It is very tingly when applied but you get used to it. Definitely love it and would recommend. A little bit goes a long way with this product so price isn’t too bad.

This product gently exfoliated my skin, and while I did not see a major reduction in pore size, it did smooth my skin and make it feel softer and more radiant. I received this product complimentary to review.

review_title: i have no words. but i do.only the good ones
review_text: This is a phenomenal product. I heard about it from a youtube skincare guru and I had never even heard of this brand so I decided, hey why not. Well, I am so surprised. It made my skin GLOW. More importantly I don’t think my skin has looked and felt so even before. It is an amazing product and this is becoming a staple in my skincare routine. It says to do it 2-3 times a week and I only used one full pump instead of the two and it still worked like a charm. If you have sensitive skin try the one pump first. My skin looks so healthy, radiant, and a natural glow. Im inlove!! Most likely will be looking more closely at this brand as well and finding more gems in their line.

Over all the years of being a Sephora product Junk is, this is the best product I’ve ever purchased. I used chemical peel pads for years until they just stopped doing the job. I used to use retinols too.  I decided to kind of quit all products and give my face a rest. Now all I literally use is 3 skincare products: 1.) Korres yogurt face wash. 2.) Farmacy Honeymoon Glow 3.) LaLa Retro Whipped Cream moisturized. It’s like my skin is completely new again. I was doing too much before and never imagined that doing less could make me have perfectly clear skin again. It was like the dry skin I had before from all the other products gave me more acne. I can go makeup free now. It’s incredible.

I was hesitant to try this product due the tingling feeling that I was warned about on the back of the bottle. After giving it a go, there was definitely a stingy/tingly feeling that made me feel uncomfortable at first. The product is thick and sticky which isn’t ideal. If you go into trying it with an open mind, you will be pleasantly surprised... the results are amazing and truest make your face glow!

I honestly don’t like the smell (it’s not that bad) and the price for me is too high.  What I like really like, you have to use this serum not every night, just 2-3 times per week, so it would last you for at least 3 month or so. I still going to use it and I’ll write new review after I finish a bottle. Thank you Influenster for opportunity to test this product!

Though I would say Tata harper resurfacing serum is still my favorite, this one is also excellent. I use this one only at night and definitely helps to even out my skin tone. I do find it a touch bit dryer compared to the Tata Harper one however would certainly recommend.
They weren’t kidding when they said this product will leave your skin GLOWING. I love waking up to the subtle scent of honey with bright, refreshed skin. Also, I think the packaging is super cute.

Wow.. I have been using this product for only a week and can already see a difference in my skin. This product has reduced general redness in my complexion and also moisturized. I’m pretty impressed, I just wish the price was lower.

I use this every morning for the past 2 months. My skin has never been better and I think this is a part of that!

changed my skin for the better and makes it super plump and glowy. i have gotten many compliments since use of it

I probably would not repurchase this product. For reference I have dry skin, age early forties.

This is the only glow recipe product I’ve ever given a negative review about! It made me sad I had high hopes for this product. I didn’t see plumping results at all, I’m almost done with the bottle and I probably will just go back to the Ordinary again. Don’t waste your money!

Sometimes you get a squirt of product but most of the time you get dribbles down the bottle and you have to pump a ton to get what you need. I was dying for it to be done so I can get something w a dropper. For $40+ it’s just not worth it.
This has been a game changer for me! I use it under my moisturizer and SPF during the day and it has definitely improved my skin texture and fullness! Also a little goes a long way!

It is very hydrating and does take a little time to absorb, it has a light scent that goes away quickly. I use this with the pineapple brightening serum and my skin has been looking great! I will be repurchasing this serum.

I can see a difference if I don’t use it but I’m not sure if it’s crazy better than other HA serums for the price. But if it’s on your list or searching for a sure thing, get it.
Love this serum! Layers really well with their toner and amplifies the glow!

The only reason I give this 4/5 is the bottle/nozzle. This product would be better suited in a dropper style bottle/applicator. I find that the nozzle/lid, where the product comes from, clogs SO easily. I store this with the lid upright, and the product can kind of form a seal/glue over the opening (I find this starts to happen about 1/3 through the bottle), and the lid clogs. Although I have become “used to” this, it doesn’t make it any less annoying. So many times I will be trying to gently get product out, and the nozzle will be clogged, so I try with slightly more pressure, and (more often than not), a massive amount of product comes out.  Of course I can make use of this product by extending it onto my neck or perhaps applying to the tops of my hands, but I know how much of this product I need at a time, and don’t appreciate “wasting” product on areas I don’t intend to use the product (however great it may be).

I have combination skin - oily forehead, dry around my mouth area. It’s a struggle. This product (especially for the price), works great on my dry areas. I got this product to review through Influenster!

I’m going through this product faster than most because of this, so I won’t be buying this again. I would recommend others to try it for themselves though.

This cleanser has almost completely cleared up my forehead acne and does not dry my skin out! Just wish it didn’t run out so quick and was more affordable.

This cleanser is AMAZING.  I have used it for years and years.  Started with it because it is clean.  Stayed with it because my extremely sensitive skin (break out prone, dry, etc) was happy with it.  And it does a good job of cleansing without drying out.  This is scent free but it does get slightly foamy/sudsy if that is a thing for you.  Tip -- buy the mini.  The large lasts so long (even with using on my face, neck, decolletage and back) that by the time I reach the end of the big tube mildew starts to form around the cap.... ew.  No such issues with the smaller size.  Value per ounce is about the same so I just buy 2 mini tubes at a time instead.  Due to the sudsiness, I have now switched mainly to the YTP Superfood Cleanser.

I bought a set of a bunch of First Aide beauty products with this face wash in it. My skin has been so dry because of the cold weather and I really wanted good products that were safe for sensitive skin. I did alot of research and I thought this was the safest route. Now I’m not sure 100% if this is what’s breaking me out. But two days I used this at night and the moisturizer and serum. The first day I noticed small bumps where I normally don’t have them. I figured I had a little breakout nothing serious. But the second day they were EVERYWHERE and very irritated itchy/burny. And I rarely get pimples. Maybe 1 on that time of month. But I thought it was the moisturizer that was breaking me out so the third day I only used the face wash and the whole day my face is tingly and burny. I assumed that because you wash off a cleanser it probably won’t break you out compared to a moisturizer that stays on your skin. But I’m pretty sure this is it. Because why else would my face be burning? If it didn’t have anything irritating on it. I hope its not all of the products because these are expensive and I bought this as a birthday present to myself and this is the first time I have bought such expensive skincare products. I was so excited to get this in the mail and now I feel ugly with all of these tiny bumps everywhere. I don’t like it anyhow even if it didn’t break me out its gentle but so gentle that it feels like it doesn’t take anything off. Maybe it would be good for a teenager but not for someone who wears alot of makeup. If you have sensitive skin STAY AWAY

If you’re main focus is getting rid of acne I’d go for something else or use this as apart of a double cleanse. This product is amazing. I’d still use it if it was good with acne. I would still highly recommend for those who’s skin concern isn’t acne.

In short, this is in my top three favorite cleansers and it will continue to be my cleanser of choice!

review_title: Reduced scarring / no wrinkles in sight
review_text: I am one of those people who rarely writes reviews, and I focus most of my attention/wallet toward skin care than anything else. I gotta say, this stuff works. I have been using it for about 3 months and for starters, have noticed that the area under my eyes are noticeable brighter. I put it on nightly under my serum and moisturizer, and literally see a “glowy“ difference, and wake up with brighter eyes. I have used less expensive products in the past, and this has made a noticeable difference in comparison. Second, my esthetician noted that she cannot identify any wrinkles under my eyes (I am 30), and voiced that she is impressed with whatever I am using. Self high five. Third, and biggest effect I’ve seen, is the visible reduction in dark spots and acne scarring. When I layer this, I usually hit the very top of where my pores are and have noticed that in the past 3 months of use, the few scars and dark spots I had are literally gone. This might be ignorant to say, but if it took away scarring, I feel like it must be doing wonders for my eyes and wrinkles. I have sensitive skin, and does not irritate. Sure, the little spoon thing can be annoying, but we’re paying for a good product, not packaging.

The new TEA ELIXIR SKIN RESILIENCE ACTIVATING SERUM by Fresh works miracles. My face feels so smooth and hydrated. Only after few uses I could see a difference in my skin’s texture and visible glow ! I loved adding it to my night routine.

I think this might be magic in a bottle! I love the packaging too. The scent reminds me of a really good black tea which makes sense! This leaves my fine lines and wrinkles so plumped and my skin texture overall looking incredible! This might just be my new favorite Fresh product!!

I absolutely love this serum and the way my skin looks and feels after starting to use it.  I just use a few drops AM & PM and follow with a hydrating moisturizer.  I wake up with soft, glowy skin.  I think the tone and overall appearance of my skin has changed and I love that I can take it all the way down the neck.  I really nice serum.
this serum has been giving me the prettiest glow, & smooth texture! definitely makes my skin look plump & supple! i have been using this as part of my day and night time skin routine & i am in love!

Love this serum smells like freshly brewed tea.The texture is lovely and milky it really sinks into the skin without feeling greasy. Really great ingredients like ocean kelp for refining skin texture call Ronek acid to help hydrate niacinamide for enlarged pores and then ceramide three to help strengthen the skin barrier this is going to be one of my favorite serum’s and I’m loving it so far.

I love other Fresh products I have and buy carefully cuz they’re pricey.  What I usually love are the hedonic (texture, scent, feel etc) but this formula goes on tacky and makes my skin feel sticky.  I use it at night on neck only because the feel on my face is kind of gross. Shame.

This night moisturizer is everything. It smells so good. I love FRESH products so I knew I would love this one. This is the only moisturizer that doesn’t break me out. (Which is saying something because my skin has a problem with everything lol super sensitive). Can’t wait to purchase this again but in a bigger size. I do wish that this product was more affordable.

review_title: The best night cream for moisture
review_text: If you’re goal is to lock in moisture and suppleness, this is the one! It’s not an aggressive anti aging product and I wouldn’t expect to see drastic results outside of moisture but the texture is amazing and it feels great!
I bought this mini size for my trip to hawaii this summer. Soooooo great at keeping my skin plump and hydrated after being in the sun all day. I think I’ll definitely buy the regular size.

I’ve been using this cream 3 jars ago, however long that works out to be, but I absolutely love it. It leaves my skin moisturized throughout the night. My skin is brighter, cleared and I have received many compliments!
Unlike some of the overnight creams I’ve tried, this makes my skin feel soft not sticky.  When I wake up my skin feels hydrates and smooth and ready for the next day.
I LOVE this nighttime moisturizer. It smells divine and works really well over other stronger products (retinol and AHA/BHA) I wake up with glowy and hydrated skin!

review_title: Not very moisturizing for dry skin
review_text: I have very dry mature skin. I only have small hormonal breakouts usually. I didn’t find this was moisturizing enough for me and it made me breakout really bad on my cheeks and chin. I’m not sure what it was that did it but I don’t ever breakout like that so it really surprised me. I gave it two stars because the texture was nice and the smell was pleasant. I took three off for not being moisturizing enough for my dry skin and the breakout.

I have been using this for years without incident; but lately it has caused my face to feel prickly & discomfort. I don’t know if they changed ingredients I will have to check / find an old box but just beware. I make sure I don’t use an aha & bha / Latic acid when I use this.. I have before and it has caused discomfort. I use herbivore orchid facial oil on the nights I use those treatments and the nights I just wash; I use a face wash, toner then this. I gave it three stars because i always thought it was a wonderful nightly cream but lately it’s just not working for me. I use the lotus day cream without incident. I recommend you try a smaller jar first and go from there. I honestly don’t know if I am going to keep buying this or try a different night cream. When I use this I do wake up to no redness, my skin looks healthier and toned. There is a fine line that has always been there; I haven’t noticed a change in that for a year. I probably need to use an actual retinol  cream for that but it has kept the aging process at a bay otherwise.

review_title: Fragrance, smells great but burns greater
review_text: I really wanted to love this but the fragrance in it makes my face burn. I do use actives so I know my skin has become more sensitive to these things. It smells heavenly and moisturizes very nicely. It feels luxurious but if you’re sensitive to fragrance please avoid.

I have been using this face cream every evening for a few months now. I was a bit worried about it being too thick and oily, but I was proven wrong! the face cream goes on smoothly and my face feels perfectly moisturized. One of my favorite things about this face cream is also the pleasant smell! It doesn’t have that baby-powder/chemical lotion smell, but a really beautiful, refreshing, peach-like smell. My face has seen significantly less acne since using this face cream as well. I will be purchasing this face cream again!
This is a really great night cream with powerhouse lotus plant extract, I woke up with much firmer skin! I only wish it didn’t have fragrance because it just isn’t necessary!

review_title: Good but I don't like the smell
review_text: Don’t really like the smell, but it’s really moisturizing. It’s  good cream but for the price I think I would buy an other one.

I love love love this moisturizer! I truly feels like it goes into my skin and hydrates without causing me to break out. It gives me an amazing glow and makes my skin so soft! Plus, it smells amazing!
Such a lovely night cream. This night cream is lightly scented and not overpowering. It is light going on and absorbs quickly without residue or an oily layer. This is part of my new routine!
Didn’t like it and strong smell. Used it for a short while but started to break out.
Feels super light which is nice for a night cream!
I’ve been testing this night moisturizer for about two weeks and have seen no real results. The scent is strong and off-putting. Seems to go on kind of tacky. I’ll finish this mini and move on.
After 1 week use, I see the glow in my face. Highly recommended for dry skin. I use it with the fresh rose moisturizer
Super moisturizing and love the scent it has a refreshing cucumber scent that’s not overwhelming. A little goes a long way with this moisturizer so I’d say it’s worth the price.
Not seeing a difference in my skin still looking for a product that works for me
This is really hydrating.. or rather soothing. really feels luscious. I use this at night. But I usually don’t use oils if I use this because it’s thicker, dense to begin with.
I like everything about this product. Smells pleasant (the scent doesn’t stick around) it’s a nice consistency,I like how my skin feels and looks.
I’ve been using this night cream for a few weeks and I absolutely love it. I love the smell and texture of it. my skin feels so soft and supple after using this.

When I wake up, I know my skin will be glowing after a good night of Fresh refreshment sleep. :) Just like the other items from this product line, you are welcome with the same refreshing cucumber send when you open the bottle.  I love layering these products on top of each other to create a spa-like experience.  Not to mention, the packaging is very neutral and modern so it looks amazing on top of my nightstand! I keep it right by my bed so I do not forget to use it.  I’m trying to look 30 forever so I shall let this cream do it’s iob while I do mine! :)

I have battled with severe acne for about the past year and after finally finding a solution to that, I’ve been left with scarring. After using this night cream I noticed a significant difference in the appearance of my scarring, looking lighter and less red than before. It does feel a little heavy and greasy on my face, but being a night cream, I think that’s to be expected. My skin feels so healthy and nourished after using this!

I was so excited to try the fresh lotus dream cream. I had been looking for a new night one so this was perfect when I received it in exchange for my review. The scent is light with floral notes - not too strong for something I am putting on my face. The texture is thicker than the daytime one which is nice especially for winter time. I apply it after I wash my face right before I go to bed. It doesn’t take too long to soak into my skin before I lay down on my pillow. When I wake up in the morning my skin feels soft and dewy. I also love the little jars these come in! They are great to repurpose once the cream runs out!

Omg, usually I am not a night cream user, but this cream has changed my mind! I have normal to oily skin so most night creams are too heavy. But this fresh lotus line smells light and fresh, applies very smooth and absorbs well. I don’t wake up oily, and my skin is glowing. I received a few items from this lien complimentary from Influenster but I am hooked!

I’ve honestly never used a night cream before and I don’t know what I’ve been missing! I can definitely tell the difference between using it and not using it just by the hydration of my skin. As I’m only 26, wrinkles aren’t a concern (thankfully yet) but I can tell this will keep my skin plump and hydrated. For those of you picky about smells, it is noticble but it a great way. It reminds me of like cucumber water. It was delicious. I did receive this free as a promotional product to try but won’t hesitate buying in the future.

Before receiving this from influenster, I’ve had mixed feelings about fresh products. The first product I used was the rose water and it burned me so badly. I love the lipstick with spf but thats about it. In order to really test out the effects, i swap most of my products in my daily routine out and only stick with my own toner. This night cream is very light weight, smells fresh, and really moisturizing. However, I didn’t see a big difference on my face. In addition, there is perfum (fragrance) and limonene in the product that im not really a fan of. Overall, I would not purchase this product had it been my own choice.
Great moisturizer, very hydrating. Perfect for someone in their 20s-30s. Not the most hydrating I’ve tried, but still good! I received this complimentary from Influenster

I received this product free to try from influenster. This is a dream product. Yes, pun intended. But, this cream has such a luxurious feel when applying before bed. My skin look and feels refreshed in the morning! I would definitely recommend this product!

I really enjoyed using this night cream, it is so soothing and cool, it feels so nice when applied before going to bed, you wake up the next morning with your skin feeling so soft and the scent is really good as well.

I received this complimentary from Influenster. It is think but not over bearing. I love the way it smells! It’s fresh and clean smelling... Cucumber? Very light scent, which is also what I love.  My skin feels great in the morning.
Super moisturizing,  the scent is a little heavy but dissipates quickly. It absorbs easily and my skin feels great in the morning.  It has been a great addition to my nighttime routine.

review_title: scent is amazing and really hydrates skin
review_text: I’ve been looking for a good moisturizer for a while now, and I’m so glad I found this one! I have oily skin, but I found that this product keeps my skin hydrated enough to where my skin doesn’t over produce oil! loving it so far! and the scent is amazing

I love this night face cream! I love how hydrating this made my skin feel right after application. The formula was thicker which I really liked. I woke up each morning with smooth feeling and hydrated skin. I would definitely recommend this to everyone.

review_title: Feels like a sleep mask dream
review_text: This night cream is my favorite of the lotus Youth lone. It’s rich without feeling to heavy but your skin def feels like it’s getting the moisture it needs to restore at night. I was wake up with glowing plump skin. The product has a cucumber scent like all the products in this line that I could honestly do without but it isn’t too annoying and doesn’t effect the over results. I would def recommend this to anyone who wants a nice night cream

I especially love this fresh Lotus Youth Preserve Dream night cream. As a 33 year old woman who is starting to get concerned with my skin this cream more then surpassed my expectations. Goes on smooth and feels great on my skin.

review_title: Fresh night cream leaves skin radiant
review_text: This night cream is very lightweight and the skin absorbs it very nicely. I wake up in the morning and my skin is very soft and velvety. My skin looks refreshed and radiant. It has a very strong scent at the beginning but it fades with time. I’m very happy using it because it truly is a great night time cream with good ingredients.

This has a very similar texture as the moisturizer - not too thick, not too thin. Using the Youth Preserve Moisturizer each morning and this face cream at night has definitely helped hydrate my skin so I don’t need to use as much moisturizer in the morning. Also, I do have mild acne, but haven’t had any breakouts since using their products, so that’s always a plus! This is definitely a great nightly moisturizer/face cream! Oh, and it smells AMAZING!
So far so good ! I recently received this item and haven’t been using it too long but my skin feels very hydrated and soft after applying the cream,
I haven’t been using this very long but so far I really like it. The consistency is perfect and feels wonderful on my skin. Can’t wait to see future results!
This nighttime moisturizer gives the perfect amount of moisture to my face without feeling heavy or greasy. I love the fresh smell and the packaging is super nice too!

review_title: I’d fight someone who would take this from me
review_text: I received a free sample of this from Influenster, but I would say that I love it regardless. It has actually replaced my Peter Thomas Roth Green Releaf moisturizer, partly because it’s lighter and it has a delight smell. It smells like plain frozen yogurt, which I think is amazing because frozen yogurt is delicious. I would strongly recommend for you to not eat it though.It doesn’t make my face feel heavy, even though I have a pretty long skincare routine. I wake up every morning feeling smooth as a baby’s bottom. It might even be a holy grail product for me.

I have really been loving this night cream lately. I received this complimentary for reviewing purposes but all opinions are my own. This cream is literally like a dream. I need very little product and I wake up with soft, moisturizer skin. I use to have tiny dry patches around my forehead and now they are completely gone. I highly recommend this for all skin types.

I LOVE THIS PRODUCT!  I have really bad dry skin in my t-zone and this product helps out so much with it.  My makeup no longer looks cakey since using this!  This product works miracles.   So glad I found it.  It also has a really good scent.  If you dont have this product already, GO BUY IT!!!

This stuff is awesome! The scent is very minimal. It’s non greasy and it only takes the smallest amount to cover your entire face! My face feels soft immediately but in the morning it looked and felt amazing! Highly recommended this stuff.
This is a great night cream for someone with dry skin. I love how hydrated my skin feels the next morning, however it is a bit heavy on the skin.

I am absolutely loving this product!!! It leaves my sensitive skin feeling so amazing when I wake up, no irritation at all even with the light fragrance. Its definitely becoming a regular in my skincare routine. It’s such a great price for the quality!

I got these a week or so before Christmas and I was in need of a new night cream. I absolutely love this stuff. It’s heavy enough for you to wear at night and feel like you’re getting moisture, but not heavy enough to clog your pores. I also love that this brand using glass and opens the container to use your hands, so that you’re not squeezing out of the bottle. Smells great as well.

Love love love this night cream! I noticed a difference the very first night I used this. Most moisturizers cause me to break out, and this one did not. I have been using this consistently for awhile now, and can’t go without it! It’s so smooth and creamy and SO moisturizing!!! I would recommend this to friends and family!
I loved the fragrance, the texture and how soft it made my skin feel. During the winter months I have to take special care of my skin and this product has become my new favorite cream.
I like this product! I like the smell and noticed that when I wake up in the morning my skin is soft. I haven’t used it long enough to notice any other differences though!
I absolutely love this product. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed after using it. I also love the light scent.
I instantly fell in love with this product! It’s so moisturizing for my dry skin. I love that it sinks into my skin

I have weird skin, weird because it is kinda combined, but kind of dry. So, finding a product to fully satisfy me is HARD. It must be thick enough to give sufficient moisture, but thin enough to not get oily. This product made me happy because it fits all my crazy requirements.Also, I am a true believer that a cream/moisturizer is actually meant to cover your liquid products and conceal the moisture, rather than provide the moisture itself. I tried this product as a stand alone product (just on toner), and I tried this product in combination with my toner, essence, serum and night mask.I found this product to work EXCELLENT in the multiple step Korean method of skin care. And it worked well as a stand alone product. As a stand alone product I did feel like I needed just a little more moisture though.I think the formula is great, the smell is preferential. It is a little sticky at first, but if you do your routine at least 1h before bed you should be fine. I like the texture because it is right in the middle. You can use a little less, or a little more depending on your skin’s needs. I also love that it does not clog my pores, as I have a major issue with pore clogging.I found my skin to be glowing in the morning, after using this product. I would highly recommend this product. Also, the 1.6 oz is a huge amount. I have been using this for a couple of weeks now, and I still feel like I have not used any yet.I received this product complimentary, to test from Influenster.

The cream is a bit intense on the cucumber or mint not entirely sure. My face tingled for a bit. The dryness after was not comfortable and it seems almost as there was a film. I wasn’t a fan but that may have been because of my sensitive skin. Yes, I would still recommend the product because although it didn’t work for me it could be a good product for someone else. I also have used other Fresh products and they have been good.
Overall ok product. It feels lightweight and not greasy and the scent is very pleasant and light. It moisturizes ok but not well enough to solve my dry winter skin so I was a little disappointed
Leaves my skin feeling super smooth and hydrated in the morning. Has not made me break out. Purchased the small size to test it out. Will be buying the larger size.

review_title: A DREAM come true for your skin!!!!
review_text: “Ahhhhhh!” The sound I make when applying this to my face at night!! Seriously!!! This cream is amazing!! I use it at night and boy have I noticed a huge difference! It Has a pleasant scent and is very moisturizing without feeling greasy. I wake up with bright, smooth, glowing and refreshed skin. What more could a gal ask for?? Love that it is paraben and SLS free. Definitely recommend!!! (I am so grateful to receive this complimentary for testing purposes :)

*I received this Item complimentary*I hadn’t tried Fresh products before, truthfully because of the cost. I always tend to lean towards simple affordable products that work (cerave, cetaphil). That being said, I have enjoyed this so far. I don’t usually use a night cream, regular moisturizer is my go to. This product is nice and light, but rich enough to do its job. It has a light cucumber like scent which is nice. I don’t wake up in the morning feeling greasy, but definitely can tell that I used it the night before. I gave it 4 stars mostly because I can’t see myself actually purchasing it because of the price point, when I could get a similar experience with a cheaper product.
I have enjoyed using this product. It has a light clean smell hardly noticeable. My skin feels nice and smooth after using over night!

This is a great light weight, pleasant smelling night cream. I have been using for about 2 weeks every night and this has not broke out my acne prone skin- yay! It is very calming on my skin. I wake up with no redness or dry spots and no new bumps like some night creams cause.
This moisturizer is perfect for an overnight mask! It is thick without being TOO thick, and it’s not oily either. My skin feels good and is soft! Highly recommend!

I love this cream! It makes my skin feel so soft right after I apply..it also gives me a glow without being greasy.  I have very dry skin and I can see improvement after using this product. I also feel like it’s evening out my skin texture..I think I may have found a beauty routine that I want to stick to! I received this product for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review

After using this product for a week, it appears to have smoothed a bit of my inconsistency as I have combination skin. The consistency is decently thick, which is perfect for a night cream to rehydrate. It leaves my skin feeling smooth, hydrated, and healthy. There is a slight floral/natural scent to the cream, which can be refreshing compared to the typical lotion scent.

Super smooth and hydrating. I didn’t wake up with a greasy face like I do with other products. When I woke up my face was sooooo soft and smooth! And it looked like I drank water regularly. The smell is so fresh and light, it smells like cucumbers. It did pill with my other skincare, but I just changed up the order and it was fine. Love love love it!
I love this product!! it gets rid of those nasty dry patches and doesn’t cause any breakouts. Wake up glowing and hydrated! Definitely recommend it!!
Extremely hydrating and great light cucumber smell. Absorbs well into the skin and the next morning I do feel hydrated.

I love this cream so far! I have been using it for about 2 weeks, and I have had great results. The only reason I gave it 4 instead of 5 stars is that it took a while to soak in and left me feeling a little oily, but when I woke up the next morning my face was super soft and bright.

First off fresh is one of my favorite skin care lines! I love all the rose products, so to get all the threw new full size products to try i was ecstatic! The night recovery cream smells lil like cucumbers to me which is refreshing! I cant recommend it any more as my skin feels amazing!
It’s absolutely perfect for me. I love this brand, they’re always the best with skin care

review_title: A little goes a long way!
review_text: A little goes a long way which is awesome considering the price point. It smells amazing! It isn’t heavy like other night creams I have tried! My face and neck were so smooth when I woke up! I paired it with the eye cream and the combo is amazing! I even notice since using my face is just so smooth and my makeup sits so much better! I received this product complimentary in exchange for an honest review. I would definitely recommend.

Wow! My new night time moisturizer is splendid. The smell is delightful, cucumber with a light peachy sent. It is not an overwhelming fragrance trying to cover up a cheap cream. This cream is worth the price as you need very little to cover the entire face/neck area. I have been using it for 3 nights now and every morning I look refreshed. I tend to have very oily skin and this did not add any extra oils which is a bonus.

This moisturizer is great! So far I’ve used it for 1 week every night and it’s the perfect consistency. The only complaint I have is the scent, only because I prefer facial products that do not have a scent. Otherwise, it’s great on my sensitive skin and I can tell my skin is more moisturized than normal for winter! Overall, I would recommend this night cream.

As someone with dry to extremely dry skin, this cream is wonderful! Being in the cold winter months right now, this cream has been one of the few products that provides enough hydration without having to use multiple moisturizers. I love a cream that has a thick consistency but unfortunately they often have trouble sinking into my skin and leave me feeling greasy. This cream feels super lightweight and sinks into the skin nicely. It does leave a little slick feeling but that goes away after a minute or two of patting in. I’m pretty suprised with how much I liked this product as I tend to be picky with my moisturizers because of how hard it can be to get hyrdation for my skin type.

This night cream had my face feeling so soft in the morning. The smell is a little strong and it is a little thick but once you wake up your face is smooth and soft feeling. All of the cream is gone after waking up.

I love how my face looks bright the next morning.  the consistency is not thick but not thin.  I have a mixed skin and I love how it does not leave my greasy face and the smell super nice like cucumber and melon.  Yes, I recommend this product.
I’ll start off by saying that my skin is one of the driest yet oily skin on the planet. I got this as a complimentary sample from Influenster to try
This product smells nice and I can feel my skin getting moisturized from the moment I apply it to my face. I’ve been using daily and it feels great on my skin

It smells so good and my face instantly felt so soft and smooth. It was gentle on the skin and smelled like peaches. The packaging is nice as well. I’ve only used it once but I could feel a difference right away. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.
Soft, smooth night cream. I started using it almost a year ago, its soft goes on well and my skin wakes up glowing. Just wish it wasnt so expensive

Tried this based on a recommendation. I love Fresh products and they usually don’t disappoint. The smell was strong but not bad. I have dry skin and this just wasn’t thick enough for winter night cream. bummer.

Wow, I love it! I was apprehensive because I bought it online without seeing or smelling it in the store.. and no free samples.. but I love it! Doesn’t have much of a smell at all (bonus) and when I woke up my face was still soft and moisturized, even with the heater running in my room (its cold at the moment so I need more help with my combo skin). Highly recommend!

review_title: Actually makes skin look smoother and improved
review_text: I rarely write reviews, but this cream, along with the regular version (that smells like cucumber), really makes a difference in how my skin looks overall. I got this regular version as a small version in a set and I was wondering if I had eaten something different that made my skin look better. I bought a full jar of that and loved it. I wanted a night cream, so I bought this version and it’s slightly heavier for night and I found it’s also better for winter. The results are just as good as with the regular version. There are only 4 skin products that I have found that make any noticeable improvements: this cream, the lurid regular cream from Fresh, the Ole Hendricksen vitamin C serum, and the Kiehl’s anti-aging serum. Everything else is an over-priced moisturizer.

review_title: Love the smell. Caused red bumps though
review_text: I really, really wanted to love this because it smell so so so good!! However it didn’t seem as moisturizing as the original lotus cream and also it caused me little red bumps the next day. I had to use it for my legs afterwards but the good thing is it didn’t cause any irritation to my legs (my legs are very sensitive and prone to eczema. So it’s very unfortunate.. Wonder if it’s the heavy fragrance or oil that caused the red bumps.

I bought the travel size to try the product out and my only regret was not getting the full size.  This night cream does everything that it’s says it does.  After the my first try I really did wake up to smooth supple skin and it has only gotten better from here.
This cream smells sooo divine  and effectively moisturizes skin. it’s  very gentle and not sticky, like many other moisturizers out there. you will not regret this purchase !

I purchased this based on reviews and was not let down in the least. I have tried many hydrating products and nothing has made my face feel this smooth. My skin is combination and it gets super dry during the winter months. I always have dry patchy areas and have just learned to live with it. First off, when I opened this luxurious jar. It smells heavenly! I wish I had a candle that smelled this beautiful. The moisturizer itself is a very light creamy consistency and doesn’t feel greasy at all but very moisturizing. In the morning though! Your skin will feel baby smooth, I kid you not! I’m trying to use it sparingly because it’s a bit expensive and I want it to last forever! I feel like a queen with this little jar! Definitely something I recommend trying! Love it ❤
Love this product! Creamy, thick, luxurious cream. I feel refreshed and plum in the morning. The scent is fresh, light and perfect for a dreamy nights sleep!

This night cream is rich yet lightweight, smells amazing, and gives you a “I just had an expensive spa facial” glow every morning. It’s my holy grail nighttime cream and would highly recommend it! A little also goes a long way - worth every penny.

As I am a big fan of Fresh products, I was eagerly awaiting this cream to be released. (I actually had a Sephora customer service rep find it for me in their stockroom, as it was not yet on the shelves!) I have been using this cream nightly since the winter and it does not disappoint! Both the texture and peachy scent are nice, and it absorbs well into my skin. My face feels soft and hydrated when I wake up in the morning. Does not cause breakouts. A little goes a long way...I just finished my first container, which lasted me 4-5 months. Have already repurchased and will continue to do so. I love Fresh products!

This stuff is amazing. The smell has a pleasant peach smell and I normally don’t like peach scents.  The texture is perfect for a night cream it absorbs beautifully but doesn’t feel too thin on its own and when i go heavier with serums and oils it doesn’t leave me feeling like a oily mess. The best thing about this night cream is the way your face looks in the morning. I look refreshed and have a glow I have never noticed with my skin routine before this came into my life. Will repurchase forever.
Feeling Soft skin every morning
Hydrating, improves the look of lines and wrinkles, smells like fresh peaches, and doesn’t break my skin out. What else matters in a face cream?
This night cream is the best thing that has ever happened to my skin. I have acne prone skin but with this cream they diminish and my skin looks great the next day I’m even more confident. I love it.
Really really wanted to love this because it left me really moisturized...however after using it, it broke out my face in 3 different areas!! Super unfortunate, returned it.
Leaves skin very supple and soft. Lightweight and smells peachy.

This moisturizer is worth every single penny spent on it. My skin has been dry and flaky lately because of winter, and my regular moisturizer wasn’t cutting it. I’d wake up with dry, flaky skin and it would persist through out the day. I’ve been using this every night for a week and it’s made a dramatic difference. My skin is so soft, and looks way better in the morning after using this at night. Plus, my skin doesn’t get flaky throughout the day. The soft peach fragrance is also really nice.

I would not say this is an instant fix, but it’s definitely showing results. It has the feel of Vaseline and is kind of like a peach matte version of that. But I can definitely see that it feels smooth and moisturized after application. I’ve been using for almost a month and I do t want to not use it…

I received a sample of this and really loved how nourishing and hydrating it is. It leaves a very dewy finish on my skin. I would recommend this product in winter or transitional months.

My skin is very dry and I have been searching for a deep hydration product.I am so impressed with Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer from Fresh. I’ve been using it for 2 weeks straight and I’m in love with it. It made my skin feel oh, so soft, smooth and hydrated.  On top of it it smells amazing! This is my new favorite moisturizer.
Sadly going to stop using this. Smells good, but pills and slightly caused me to breakout after use

I liked it at first. Stopped using it for a while and just brought it back out for summer… I instantly remembered why I stopped using it. It pills so bad and just sits on the skin. Don’t waste your money!!

I am in my mid 30’s normal/dry skin type (normally) and bought this product because I was looking for something gentle and hydrating for my hormonal skin. I was pregnant at the time and everything was making my skin red. This product instantly soothed my skin and made it baby soft! I continued to use this postpartum and have bought it 3 times since! This is perfect for summer because it is a light cream but you may need a serum to go with it if you have drier skin, especially in the winter.

I have oily skin, but this winter I’ve been getting the worst dryness & adult acne of my life. This moisturizer has helped soooo much. It’s very hydrating but absorbs really nicely into my skin and has helped so much in getting my skin back on track. I don’t think I can use it over the summer months but it’s perfect to combat the extremely dry environment in my apartment over the winter.

I got the mini because I’ve never tried this edition from Fresh, but am familiar with the brand. I have to say coming from someone with sensitive skin, this hydrated my skin without feeling like there was a layer of cream on my face.
Not for me. Sat on top of my skin, created a film and would ball up and come off.

review_title: I really wanted to love this!
review_text: I really wanted to love this. I have super dry skin now that it’s winter… And I am also trying out new products to find what is right for my skin care routine…. However, this one will not be one that will be apart of that. It pills so bad. I have tried everything and it will not stop pilling. What’s the point of a moisturizer, especially a deep one if it just pills off? I’m so sad.

Used this today for the first time and I am in love. If you are someone who suffers with dry skin this will absolutely change your life!! I’m also glad the scent isn’t too strong, it’s just right! 10/10 would buy again

If you use this moisturizer at night, it’s pretty good. But it cannot be used of a morning if you plan to put makeup over top of it. Pills like crazy! I even waited a couple hours to let it dry, same result. The only way I’ve found to keep it from pilling is to put it on at night and not touch my face until morning.

I got a little jar sample of this, and while it blends in nicely, this does not absorb into my skin at all. I have been using it at night and every morning when I rinse my face I feel it wash off...but oddly tis does not moisture my skin enough to last the night at all. My skin is getting drier and drier using this. If only my holiday order would ship out so I can use different cream!!
My skin feels very dry and patchy after applying this moisturizer.

I used this over the span of a year and I honestly think that this was meh. I heard a lot of good things about this product, but I think there are better products out there. I am a sucker for the rose smell, but that can cause a lot of irritation for people. For what it is, I don’t think it added much to my routine and I have since then found more affordable and more nourishing products.

I received this product for free from Fresh. I was very excited when I received this moisturizer because I’ve heard so many people talking about this brand. I really liked the scent and that the product was not irritating to my skin. It wasn’t drying and it didn’t cause me to break out. My face felt hydrated for hours, and a little goes a long way.

Not only does the rose and hyloranic acid deep hydration make your skin feel super soft but it has made a difference in this super dry heat we are having. I’m new to skin care routines and this has easily become a favorite product out of the 15 I have tried so far.

This cream is great for dry skin. It has light texture that absorbs pretty fast. I use it in summer. I don’t like the smell, that why 4starts. Over all my skin feels soft and moisturized through the whole day. I got it for free for my honest review.

This moisturizer is really moisturizing and soothing. It has a strong rose scent. I would not recommend this if you don’t like strong scents. It’s much slipperier than I expected, but it still very moisturizing. I enjoy it, but the scent turns me off.

I received this as a gift in exchange for my review.  This cream is really nice and thicker than I expected. It has a pretty strong rose scent which I don’t mind at all. I think it’s a great cream but there are others out there that I prefer for a lower price.

I really like Fresh Rose Deep Hydration Face Cream. It not too heavy for my skin. My skin is a little bit dry during spring and summer. If I use too heavy cream during summer, the acne will come out. This product will not cause the acne. And I also like the smelling, just little bit rose scent. Not like some products have very strong smelling.

Loving my daily moisturizer as it is smooth, light and creamy onto my skin. It doesn’t make my skin greasy or blocks pores. It has hyaluronic acid which acts as an anti aging property and enriches my skin from within. It makes my skin plump and glowy.

I loved the way this product made my face feel so smooth I don’t even need to use a lot and it get the job done, I have never heard of this brand before this product so I was able scores to try and it did not fail, loved that it’s not such a strong smell too just the right amount

This face cream applies silky smooth to the skin and has a very light fresh scent to it. It’s extremely hydrating without feeling too heavy or sticky. It leaves your face plump, dewy, and cool feeling. I love that it has the hyaluronic acid in the ingredients because it allows me to skip the step of applying that separately. It feels very luxurious and is the perfect night cream to apply before bed.

This was gifted by Fresh. I love this rose scent. The cream is super! Very gentle. My skin is hydrated all day long (I use this cream day and night). Wrinkles and flaking on the face are much less when using this face cream. I recommend to everyone.

This moisturizer cream was gifted by fresh. This cream is lightweight and it doesn’t feel sticky making my skin softer and looking fresh. I love the amazing scent of roses is a light scent that is pleasent to the smell.

I received this  commentary  product of Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer Reformulation for my review. Oh wow. Leaves your skin feeling absolutely amazing.  I use it day and night. Has a very nice scent. Doesnt leave the skin feeling sticky which is awesome. I highly recommend this brand and product.

I think Fresh beauty has some great products but not all of them have worked for me in the past. This moisturizer however is great! I really enjoy the light refreshing rose scent it has. I’m pregnant and my skin is not in the best condition right now, but this keeps my skin hydrated and refreshed. It gives me a sight glow which I love.  The consistency is perfect too-not to thick, not too runny.

This really hydrates my skin and makes my face looking healthy. It also looks good under makeup. It doesn’t have a sticky feeling. It feels good on the skin and it also smells good. I’ve used this product for two weeks now and I do see a difference on my skin.

I was thrilled to receive this product to try for free! It feels so luxurious and does exactly what it claims. I have been using it only at night to give my skin some extra hydration while I sleep and I have noticed an overall improvement in the smoothness and softness of my skin! I am dry/combo skin and I am so happy to report that this has given my skin exactly what it needs to feel hydrated and not greasy.

I have been using this product for a few days now. I like that the texture is lightweight. It leaves my skin hydrated. It made my skin feel soft and smooth . I use this product at night. It smells amazing.

I loved this moisturizer! It’s rich one that’s great for a nighttime routine and has the great smell of rose like the rest of the fresh products and super hydrating! Perfect size too and would purchase another one

I like this cream a lot; it absorbs well in my skin; it also feels good on my face, it smells so good; my favorite way to use this cream is: before I put my foundation on; it makes my makeup looks really great.

I received this product complimentary from Fresh. Great moisturizer that although thick, sinks quickly into the skin and smells like a rose field. I use it in the am and pm on my combination skin and I love it.

review_title: I love this product and the scent is amazing
review_text: I feel blessed to have received the product “fresh Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer“ free from fresh. First I want to mention that I love the container it comes in with the pretty pink lid.  This looks lovely on my vanity since my room is pink!  I have to say that the lovely rose scent is mesmerizing.  I like applying it at night and enjoying the scent when I fall asleep and also it’s the first scent I smell when I wake up. This product is highly moisturizing and the moisturizing effect lasts and lasts. I am quickly growing to appreciate the ingredient “hyaluronic acid“. I will continue to purchase this product.  I love it.

I love fresh products! This heat has been drying up my skin so bad. I’ve been using this every night and my skin feels and looks so good! I definitely recommend this cream. I bought one for mom recently and she loves it as well.

review_title: Good Daily Moisturizer for Sensitive Skin
review_text: I am a fan of Fresh and this product did not disappoint. I was afraid that the scent was going to be strong and irritate my skin but it has been almost a week and no skin irritation so far. I started small and tried it on one area of my face and after some days of no reaction, I used it on my entire face. I use this moisturizer in the mornings only and it is the last part of my daily routine.

I received this complimentary from Fresh. This cream is amazing it leaves your skin so soft and good. I love how it has Hyaluronic Acid because it leaves my skin hydrated. And the scent is so good it smells fresh and not to overwhelming. Overall, this cream is amazing.

Really soothing after a long day of skin wear. I use a retinol so a good moisturizer is a must. This moisturizer exceeded my expectations. My skin felt and looked better it smelled nice. I had never heard of this brand previously but I’m definitely a fan.

I’ve had really good luck with Fresh skincare and this new reformulated Rose hydration moisturizer that was gifted to me is no exception. I like the original and I like this one just as much. It does have a subtle rose fragrance which could potentially be a downside for some people but I find that it’s very light and dissipates quickly.  I prefer this as a nighttime moisturizer rather than for daytime although it does wear fine under makeup - - it’s just a little bit richer than I tend to need during the day.  It has a rich feeling yet a lightweight consistency and absorbs easily into the skin. I’m enjoying using it and feel like it adds the right amount of hydration that I need.

Loving this cream so far, during my pregnancy my skin change a lot, but one of the most radical things I’ve been seeing it’s that my skin turn dry and start to have patches in certain areas of my face. This cream absolutely help to maintain my skin hydrated and feel so soft. You can see the dewy skin instantly. The packaging is beautiful and the scent that it has, reminds me to one cream that my grandma had.

This is a very lightweight moisturizer almost like a gel. It’s definitely a summertime essential. My combination skin loves it. It absorbs nicely and keeps me hydrated all day. And it smells lovely too !

I love this face cream so much! First of all it has such a light rose scent that smells amazing. I also really like how it has hyaluronic acid in it which is always a must for dry skin. It is great to put on in morning and night. It works great under makeup as well.

I love the rich creamy texture of this moisturizer.  it’s a medium weight moisturizer that takes a little bit longer to sink in compared to other moisturizers. A lovely and refreshing rose scent. It helps to soothe my face when it is feeling irritated.

I’m in love with this moisturizer. It smells amazing and js not too strong. It delivered intense hydration to my sensitive dry skin as well. I really enjoy the subtle glow it leaves behind on my skin as well!

This is an awesome product ! It feels so good on my face ! I love how it is made from rose from Europe. I don’t think I could use any other brand of face cream now. This is my new favorite hands down !

Gifted by Rose, my skin is dry and need some extra moisturizer every time, when I tried this product, I automatically loved it because it lefts my skin feeling very hydrated and my skin feeling less dry than usual. It is very light weight and love how it has a light smell to it.

I received the Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer Reformulation as a gift by Fresh.  It is a lightweight moisturizer to wear in the summer, and it absorbs very well on my skin. Good for people who don’t like the sticky feeling but need to hydrate skin.

This moisturizer is very nice. It’s soothing and smells very nice and like flowers. My skin feels much softer afterwards. The formula is not greasy and soaks into the skin quickly. It works well under foundation. I would recommend this!

I have been hooked on Fresh since getting a set as a gift a few years back. I have the old formulation and love it as a night moisturizer. It is a heavier cream that I use with retinol but not too greasy for my combination face. The new formulation is just as amazing as the old one and I will continue to purchase this product!

Fresh gifted me their Rose Deep Hydration face cream in exchange for my honest review. This is an iconic face cream that is formulated with damask rose extract from Rose Valley, Bulgaria and a duo of hyaluronic acids to intensely moisturize. This cream is scientifically proven to deliver up to 72 hours of moisture.I really like the glass packaging that it comes in. When you open it you can immediately get a scent of the damask rose. The cream has a thick texture that spreads easily and absorbs pretty quickly into your skin. The face cream is meant to be used both day and night however I find that I prefer it more as a night cream. It leaves your face feeling silky smooth and ultra hydrated.

I was pleasantly surprised this face cream. Although I’m not a huge fan of floral smells, this was light and delicate, without being overpowering. It’s a slightly thicker gel texture that blends in smooth, leaving skin feeling instantly hydrated and soft. It dries down quickly and works well as a day or night moisturizer. Big win in my book and I have a feeling I’ll be coming back for more!

Rose and Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer Reformulation is just amazing. It smells so great. It has a soft smell of rose and has perfect consistency when applied. Its not sticky like the other creams. Its just perfect. Would definitely recommend it.

Fresh gifted me free this new Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer that is lightweight texture gives me plump and dewy skin. The moisture is long lasting which is a plus for those long night out.

I liked this product but it could be better. It leaves a sticky feeling on my face. Where I’m at is very humid so it didn’t help at all. Very strong rose scent so I can see where some people could get a headache. However the smell is very nice and it does its job very well. My face was super hydrated after one use and a little bit of this stuff goes a long way.

This Fresh Rose Deep Hydration Face Cream was gifted. I love everything related to rose, this cream smells so good and so rose. It is not lightweight, but absorted fast. It keeps my skin moisturized so well.

I have been gifted by Fresh in exchange for my honest opinion, this cream smells delicious of fresh roses, it keeps my face moisturized, it has hyaluronic acid and pink what I like the most is the softness with which my face is after putting it on and it lasts all the day its freshness to roses, the skin looks more radiant and soft, I definitely love it very much, you have to try it

I’m a huge fan of Fresh rose products. This is my second Rose Deep Hydration Face Cream. It feels hydrating and love that it also has hyaluronic acid. I apply this throughout my face and neck. Highly recommend!

I truly like the rose and hyaluronic acid deep hydration moisturizer. The scent is fairly light and pleasant. The consistency is on the thicker side, however it leaves your skin glowing. I think it’s perfect cream for your night time routine.

The texture is really light and smells amazing just like roses. I have dry skin and this is a prefect moisturizer that I can use everyday for summertime. This is my first time trying fresh and I love it so much . I received this complimentary from fresh

This is a really great moisturizer and it really does what it says it’s going to do,  which is deeply moisturize and hydrate the skin.  Like some of you say it is very fragrance but I personally love the smell. I always wake up with this softest skin and would recommend this for the driest skin.

I love this moisturizer!!! It smells amazing and feels extremely fresh on the skin. The texture is rich, I have dry skin and I mainly use this at night time to wake up with a hydrated skin. It doesn’t make you feel greasy at all.

I like how this face cream hydrates my skin! It’s light and absorbs nicely . It leaves my face smooth , hydrated and healthy looking.I love the scent too.I received this product from Fresh in exchange for my honest review

Oh my goodness this face cream is amazing. Fresh gifted me the Fresh Rose Deep Hydration Face Cream to test and review. I have really dry sensitive skin and this cream is so unbelievably moisturizing. It feels super lightweight on the skin and sinks into the skin when applied. Ever since I’ve been using this cream my face no longer has any dry patches. I no longer experience any dry areas on my face. This cream gives my skin so much hydration and moisturization. My skin would feel so dry and tight and now it feels soft and smooth. I usually apply this cream at night and in the morning my skin would look more plumped and youthful. This is definitely my go to face cream now. I will be purchasing this cream as soon as I run out.

This stuff is SO nice and luxurious! Smells very rosey. But I expected that and really do like that. Feels incredible on my skin as well. Not oily at all and doesn’t dry out my skin either. Definitely worth the price. Will for sure purchase once I run out!

Gifted by fresh I think this moisturizer is pretty amazing. I am just in love with this smell what woman doesn’t love the smell of roses specially on their face lol but anyways I definitely noticed how soft and hydrated it has left my skin feeling I am truly blessed to have found this moisturizer
I’ve been using Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration moisturizer and absolutely love this face cream. It leaves my skin smooth and fresh. I received it as a gift and would recommend trying it out.

This product.. I.. am.. in love it’s so so good for my dry and dehydrated skin. No matter how much water I take in it still doesn’t cut it but this stuff.. MAGIC. I saw amazing changes in my skin just overnight. Idk what kind of witchcraft it took to make this but im not complaining.
Very Lightweight moisturizer. My Skin felt soft and there is no overpowering scent. There is only a slight natural scent. It Looked great under makeup and did not pill even after a layer of sunscreen

I received this product from the brand in exchange for my honest review. I’ve used Fresh products off and on over the years and have had no complaints. This is no different. This leaves me hydrated and glowy and I love that it contains hyaluronic acid. The rose smell was really strong but as soon as I rubbed it in the scent was gone. Love this!

If I would have to describe this item in one word it would be AMAZING. The smell worn too strong. It feels amazing on my skin and left some skin so soft . I’ve never used a product like this in my life !!

This is my first time trying a product from fresh. I’m so glad that I was able to get my hands on this, it’s pretty great. I have dry sensitive skin so this was like the perfect moisturizer for me I highly recommend it!

I have acne prone dry skin so before I completely apply something new to my face I only test a small spot first. After I saw that I didn’t get a reaction to it I applied it to my face and I absolutely loved it. It left my face so hydrated and soft. The texture is very thick so a little goes a long way.  The scent is very soft light and it smells amazing. I think this product would be great for someone who has sensitive skin or dry skin struggles because it left my skin so hydrated and plumped my foundation went on so  smooth! I will definitely be buying one after I finish this one!

I was excited to receive this product as a complimentary gift from Fresh in exchange for my honest opinion/review. It is very moisturizing for combination skin. I have been on the hunt for months to find a moisturizer that would work for me. I look for cleaner ingredients that work with my skin type. Fresh uses such premium ingredients for a reasonable price point. I put it on in the morning and evening after cleansing. It feels hydrating and leaves my skin feeling silky smooth. I’m in a really warm climate and this moisturizer helps keep my skin feeling fresh and moisturized all day. I also love roses so much. The rose scent is beautiful, but not overpowering, which is appreciated. I believe the search is over for the perfect moisturizer. I will be purchasing this product once I run out. Could not be happier with this product.

I had heard the good name of Fresh but never tried their products. The most reviews I’ve read of this brand are positive. After I tried this rose face cream I would agree to them. It smells really good and perfect for the dry skin. I don’t feel it greasy but hydrated when I put it on. I really like it.

I love how lightweight this is, I can put it on and only allow a small window of time until I can put makeup on. Is super easy to apply and is quick sinking in. Formulated with Damask Rose extract, it smells very light and fresh. Contains Angelica, Rose Water & Hyaluronic for; deep hydration, strengthening the skins barrier and providing 72 hour hydration. Overall I enjoy it and notice that my skin looks and feels more hydrated!

Thank to fresh for gifting me this moisturizer, I’m truly thankful. This moisturizer is very thick and is great for dry skin. If you love the smell of rose you are going to fall in love with this moisturizer.

This was so AMAZING! it smelled so wonderful ! It made your skin look so smooth and your face feels so refreshed ! I will totally buy this out of pocket. The smell is not so overbearing it’s the perfect amount of scent!

As excited as I was to try a Fresh product as I love all things rose, I was nervous that it may irritate my sensitive acne prone skin when reading the ingredients and  when I opened it and was greeted with the sweet smell of petals. However I am happy to say that it felt so light and comforting to my face and a little goes a lonnnng way! My skin felt hydrated and supple and calmed. I’m happy with the product so far and can’t wait to try more products by Fresh now. Only reason for 4 stars is I prefer cleaner products.

I revieved this product to try and review. My face has been very dry and I’ve been looking for a product that works. This makes my skin very soft, and it smells amazing. I would recommend it to anyone.

It is a little thick and creamy but goes on smoothly and absorbs quickly. It hydrates my skin very deeply. I have really enjoyed this cream and how much softer my skin is. The scent is good too and not too overpowering and the package is gorgeous!

Fresh gifted me this Rose & hyaluronic acid deep hydration moisturizer to try for free. Thank you so much Fresh! This moisturizer has a nice rose scent. I love this moisturizer, it keeps my skin soft and hydrated without grease. I will recommend it to anyone who wants a good moisturizer.

I really love this face cream is very rich and make my face supper smooth. I have combo skin and is perfect for me doesn’t make me brake out and the scent is very delicious but at the same time not over powering

Fresh gifted me the Rose and hyaluronic acid deep hydration moisturizer cream, My skin is dry and sensitive and sometimes I get a worried when it comes to products that have some scent on them if using it on my face but this product is wonderful, the rose scent is not overwhelming and it didn’t irritate my skin, at the first use it left my skin soft and looking very hydrated, it’s one of my new favorite moisturizers from now on

It’s creamy and moisturizing. Fresh rose smell which is floral and not too much. I have sensitive/dry skin on checks and oil t-zone, this cream worked great on both. I applied it generously at night before sleep, it did a great job keep my skin hydrated and it was not greasy in the morning. Love it so far.

I’m very pleased with this moisturizer! I love the texture it’s so hydrating but also absorbs into skin.It layers well in top of serums and is great for day and night time hydration. In the day my spf layers over great with no piling. And as an added plus the damask rose scent is a lovely subtle touch.The packaging is beautiful too!

This is hands down on of my favorite fresh products ; It’s very moisturizing the rose scent is not too strong the whole fresh aesthetic is such a vibe it feels so luxurious without losing the integrity in the product

This moisturizer has great texture and thin enough for hotter days. I have dry cheeks and this was very comfortable on my skin.  It didn’t leave my skin oily. It has a    slight smell but definitely overpowering.

Amazing love the smell and texture of the cream! Love the package and I’m very excited because of the hyaluronic acid! It keeps your face super fresh and super hydrated not oily! So if you have sensitive skin don’t be afraid to use it!

This moisturizer is super moisturizing and smells so good! Not only was this super lightweight it also made my skin look super radiant and healthy. I have sensitive skin and this honestly was perfect for me.

I was in need of a new daily moisturizer and I am more than happy about this one! I absolutely love that this one includes hyaluronic acid with a new clean formula. My skin always feels so plump and dewy with this on. It’s part of my daily routine now!

Thanks so much to send me this gift. It smells like a garden in spring, so elegant fresh and romantic. The texture is soft and easy to apply on face. As a moisturizer, it’s excellent and friendly to sensitive skin.

I am obsessed with this product!!! I love all the products of this line and this one definitely exceeds my expectations. The smell is amazing and it is so hydrating on my skin and I have oily skin and haven’t noticed a breakout.

I am the biggest Fresh fan ever so I was super excited to try out the new formulation of the Rose deep hydration face cream. It smells so divine just like the previous version and has a clean formula that gives you 72 hours of hydration. The texture is super lightweight, the product melts into your skin and it left my skin feeling really hydrated and dewy. I personally felt immediate hydration and when I woke up the next day my skin still felt very soft and moisturized. I definitely recommend you should try this out if you’re looking for a new moisturizer that’s clean, gluten free, hydrating, and is actually effective.

Another amazing product by this brand. I love the packing. I use it everyday in my daytime routine and my skin feels so hydrated and moisturized. Thanks to the hyaluronic acid I can feel how I get immediate hydration. Loving this product

This face cream is so incredibly hydrating and it sinks deep into your skin & lasts all day long! I love the natural rose floral scent - it definitely adds to the experience and makes it a touch more luxurious. As hydrating as this is, I appreciate that the formula is not heavy and doesn’t clog my pores. I definitely recommend this for those with dry skin, but it is also suitable for combo and normal skin. This is the perfect skin pick me up for when your skin is feeling & looking dry, dull, and flat. My skin appears more youthful, radiant and fresh when I use this product. My skin appears more plump and bouncy.

Fresh’s hyaluronic acid moisturizer features a new clean formula with 72-hour hydration and a lightweight texture for plump, dewy skin. It’s wonderful and the essence is amazing. My sling looks moist and not oily. Gifted by Fresh.

I received the new formulated rose moisturizer complimentary from fresh in exchange for my honest review and I absolutely adore it! I love fresh as is but this moisturizer is so much more hydrating than the last, and I’m super dry so I can attest to it! Highly recommend! It even smells better!

This was gifted to me by Fresh. This moisturizer smells great, is not greasy and absorbs quickly. Leaves my skin very soft and moisturized for a long period of time, its not sticky either. I love this brands products.

I really enjoy this mask! My skin looks plumper and feels SO much softer after use. I will warn that if you have sensitive skin, don’t leave on as long during your first few uses as my skin became really dry. My only complaint is the pump on the product has been underwhelming each time I purchase.

Got this product in my FabFitFun box and I was quite excited because I had just run out of my holy grail Drunk Elephant Baby Facial. With the different price points I was hyped to try this one out. After about a half a bottle of usage, I will say I’ll keep splurging for Drunk Elephant. The thickness and smell of the mask is something I can’t get over and it just isn’t as strong as the Baby Facial. I didn’t notice much of a different in my skin as far as texture, plumpness or glow and I can’t stand the tacky/sticking feeling after washing the mask off. This product would be good for those trying to ease themselves into this kind of mask, but it just didn’t hold a candle to the Drunk Elephant Baby Facial.

So, I live in Alberta Canada, where it gets extremely cold and in the winter I have suuuper dry skin with rough patches all over which is no bueno. In the summer, however, my skin is not bad. The first time I tried this was in the summer and I didn’t find it made much of a difference. Today I tried it again (it’s -20 outside and my skin is in full winter mode) and my goodness I was not disappointed.. noticed a huge difference afterwards! My skin felt baby soft and the rough patches on my cheeks and forehead are gone. I normally have to work extremely hard to get my skin feeling like this. I’m hooked and will be using this regularly going forward. $66 is a lot for a face mask but if you struggle with really dry skin like I do, its definitely worth it.

This is a good mask! Very gentle, and feels nice on the skin. Kind of sticky. The one problem that I have with it, is that the fragrance is VERY potent. If they removed it, this would be a near perfect product. Provides gentle exfoliation and doesn’t leave skin feeling stripped.

I got a smaller size of this product from Ole’s “Pre-Makeup Babies Skincare Prep Set. It’s no longer available from Sephora but it is still available directly on the Ole website. I highly highly recommend the set! It comes with other great products to try too, like the primer, eye cream, and toner. And like the other Ole products, the Phat mask comes in a pretty color and enjoyable sweet smell. Using this mask feels like a fun skincare spa experience at home, as you rub in the mask, the color changes to white and then eventually translucent. However, PHAs are really gentle, so if you’re looking for real long-term or quicker results from exfoliation, this might not be the product for you. It is going to be awesome though for someone just getting into skincare, or those with sensitive skin. The product is very enjoyable to use. The smell is addicting. The face feels smooth and skin does look great after use, but the effects seem temporary. For something stronger, I’m extremely interested in trying Ole’s Power Peel next. It must be amazing, since it’s always “out of stock“ too! But if you’re new to Ole products, you could always start here and work up to the Peel.
It almost felt like I got a sunburn on my face from this product. I really wanted to love this but my skin is just way too sensitive for this product.
It’s expensive but you definitely see a difference in your skin!

Received this from influenster. Such a good mask!! Leaves my skin feeling refreshed and clean. Doesn’t dry out my face which is something I look for. Leaves skin glowing and smooth! A little pricey but it’s worth it !

review_title: I love the PHAT glow facial benefits
review_text: I love this facial mask, I’ve been using it for a couple weeks now and can honestly say I’m seeing a reduction in my pores and dark circles.
