It washes off nicely and makeup can be applied right after.

review_title: Good mask - would recommend for newbies and pros
review_text: This is a reliable PHA mask - my skin is smoother, and softer after the first two weeks. PHAs are a larger molecule which is often safer for sensitive skin, so this would be a great mask if you wanted to dip a toe into the acid game. As an older gal in the acid game, I use it every other night. It helps keep my dry skin spots smooth, and a fresh soft look to my skin.

I was actually pleasantly surprised with this mask! I usually tend to be pickier with face masks so I didn’t expect much out of it, but it’s hydrating and makes your skin feel great! I do however find it a bit pricey for what you get but it’s a pretty decent mask. I got this product complimentary for testing purposes.

This product surprised me with how much I enjoyed it!  Maybe I’m a snob but I normally wouldn’t buy something called Phat Glow Facial.  My first thought was how good the product smelled!  The scent is amazing and light.  The mask went on smooth and didn’t feel heavy on the skin.  The results were immediate, I felt glowy and refreshed!

After using this mask, my skin felt softer and a lot more plump. It definitely exfoliated my skin. The idea behind the mask is fun - massage the mask till it turns from pink to white. However, I don’t know how good this facial is at brightening and didn’t see lasting results for this claim. My only other complaint is that I am not a fan of strong fragrances in my products because they irritate me and this product was very strong. It does subside after putting it on but the initial scent is too much for me.

This is the first Ole Henriksen product I’ve ever used, and it set won’t be the last. As the title reads, my face loves this mask. I use it right out of the shower  with a dry clean face. It has a pump top, which is awesome, so take just one pump and spread it all over your face. Let it sit  for 15 minutes, and then wipe off with a wet wash cloth. It will leave your face feeling tighter and plump, while oddly hydrated. Highly recommend. I recieved this product complimentary for testing purposes.
Was so excited to try it. I certainly didn’t see results it promised.

This product has a slight citrus scent and feels a little sticky when you start to work into your face. I have oily skin, acne scars and break outs. I found that my acne scars faded after using this product. My skin looks bright the next day, or should I say glowy?! I think it’s a nice product for those with dull skin and acne scars. The price is fair for this brand and type of product. I received this product complimentary for reviewing purposes.

Its a creamy yet exfoliating and leaves my skin calm and bright! The biggest noticeable result it how bright/glowy my skin looks right after. i gave it four stars bc if i do this mask more than twice a week it will deff make my face feel a bit dry (a bit of moisturizing cream fixes this though). I was so glad i got to try this product out complimentary of Influenster.

So I love the scent and I was so excited to try this product I got for free for testing purposes but I was really disappointed. I have dry sensitive skin and I truly believe this dried it out more. However unlike my other exfoliants, this one actually makes my skin peel off in large chunks without brightening my skin. It is the weirdest reaction cause I was hoping for an amped up brightness that simply isn’t there. Save your money and buy Pixi Glow Tonic or Paula’s Choice AHAs. I received this product complimentary for testing from Ole Henriksen, I was so excited to try a brand new product from my favourite brand! I recently got into skin care because I felt like I wasn’t taking care of my skin as well as I should, and this was the first brand I fell for. I wasn’t sure how well PHAs would be for my skin, but I had been using AHAs and BHAs religiously. I used this mask before bed time to make sure I got the full benefit. The pump is so nice and product comes out so well. The soft pink colour of the product changes to white when you massage it into your skin, and it smells so good too. After rinsing it off, my skin felt so soft and had such a nice subtle glow. The nice thing is that this mask is suitable for all skin types, so my friends with sensitive skin can try it too.(:

I received this product as a free sample. I am really picking when it comes to what goes on my face. I don’t like things that make my skin feel dry. When I tried this I used my regular face wash first. Then I used this mask. I love that the mask starts pink, but when activated it turns white. I also loved how I could see and feel a difference in my face right away, my face was very soft, less bumpy the following day and some acne went away. I will defy be adding this product to my face wash routine. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

The first impression I had of this product is the packaging is very useful and it has a great smell. The pump style container makes getting the product easy and less messy. The product is thicker than most mask in which I have used. This is convenient because a little goes a long way. I did have slight tingling under my eyes that lasted about an hour. The product made my fast look brighter with an over all clean and shiny appearance. I did notice that the tone of my face became more even. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

Oh my goodness this new PHAT product by Ole Henrikson for one smells sooooo good! I LOVE the smell of birch and just by pumping the cream out I can smell the botanical products in this! Packaging: With first getting the package I can say they did a great job with the package and an even better job with the bottle! I love the pump method! It really helps save product from spilling over! It’s quick and easy also!Clear instructions: Literally just massage the product into your face, wait 15 minutes, wash and then you’re ready for your day- whether it means you can go right into putting on a full face of makeup or leave your skin bare.Final thoughts: I liked how this product didn’t get extremely drying as others masks do. I have extremely dry skin that flakes so my first thoughts when putting on the mask was, “please don’t dry my skin out even more”...... waited 20 min and washed my face aaaaanddddd oh my gosh I wasn’t dry! My face felt nice and supple and plump. Didn’t see much of the glow that the packaging says but also, I’ve only tried it on once! I don’t feel like it did anything to tighten my skin but I’m just happy it didn’t dry me out nor did my sensitive skin breakout! That’s a huge win for me! I’m hoping after a few uses I’ll see more of a difference. I received this product complimentary to test #PhatGlow
I loved this mask! Love the color, shimmer, smell and the way it made my face feel afterwards! I received this as a complimentary gift, but as soon as I’m out will be purchasing another one!

This product is everything I’ve been looking for this summer! The glow it gives my skin, especially on those hot days that I can’t fathom wearing making up, gives me the ~no makeup~ look we all strive for. It goes on so seamlessly and makes my skin feel so great afterward. I’ve beeb recommending to everyone i know. I received this product complimentary from Influenster as part of their OleHenriksen Vox Box.

I received this product as a free sample from Ole Henriksen and Influenster in August. And have already used this product twice this week. So far I am liking how it feels on my face. It has a light and pleasant fragrance. The product comes out in a pinkish colour. To use, apply an even layer to clean, dry face. Massage until it transforms from pink to white. Leave on for 15 minutes and remove with a damp wash cloth. During the fifteen minutes, you will see the product being absorbed by your skin, creating a nice little glow. My skin didn’t feel tight as the product gets dry and absorbed by my skin which is nice and comfortable.After I washed the product off, my skin felt very smooth and soft. Slight glow but not too dramatic. I believe the glow may be more significant If I continue to use it on a weekly basis. Product also helps reduce the appearance of enlarged pores. I have pretty small pores to begin with so I didn’t notice the change. Would recommend this product if you are looking for a gentle exfoliant that smooths and softens skin without causing any redness.
This mask is great and it makes my face glow! Exfoliates, brightens, reduces pores, fine lines and wrinkles
I definitely needed this in my life! I struggle with pores and fine lines and after using this I definitely noticed my skin smoother and had more glow! I will definitely be using again!

I had to try this twice before I could write a truly honest review and I have to say - I enjoyed BOTH experiences.. Instructions say to apply in an even layer but didn’t say how thick. The first time, I was definitely more generous than I needed to be. Still, it was wonderful. The second time, I applied less and it is true what they say: with good quality products, less is more! A single pump went very far on my face and my face felt smooth, rejuvenated and moisturizer afterward. I have noticed that it has brightened my complexion and given me a nice glow.The scent is also really nice. Almost like butterscotch, yet not sickly sweet smelling.. it smelled and felt of terrific quality and I can easily see this becoming one of my favourite treatments.. I normally like to share my face masks with family and friends when I love it, but I may love this too much. I may be greedy with this one ;)I received this product for free from Influenster and even the product packaging was an excellent experience. With reflective decoration and cute insta tags on the inside of the box, super enjoyable experience all around!

Seriously, this mask is magic! It smells amazing, and you can seriously see it’s affects after just one use. Not only does it exfoliate your skin leaving it baby soft, it visibly makes your skin plumper and brighter while simultaneously tightening your skin. It helped the appearance of my fine lines immensely! I love using this mask before applying makeup as well, it leaves you with a flawless application. Overall, I highly recommend this mask to anyone and everyone! I’m so glad I received this from Influenster, complimentary for testing purposes.
I received a sample from beauty Influencer. I loved how it absorbed really fast on my skin. I probably going to buy a full size

To start with I have extremely dry skin and was excited to receive this product for free in exchange of honest review since I’m always up for a good moisturizer. To summarize, the texture felt similar to the Laneige water mask but the effect was not as long lasting. I did not like how it didn’t get absorbed into my skin. Although my skin temporarily felt moisturized it was only for a short period of time. I would not recommend it to others and definitely wouldn’t buy it in the future. The Clinique Moisturizing lotion in the yellow bottle is a much better product than this and I highly recommend that one over this.
It was a very light weight, smooth feeling and light if any smell at all. Very moisturizing. It’s very nice . Easy to use.

I received a 2 week supply to test out. I’m not 100% sold on this product but it did a good job. My skin is fairly oily and I found that later it the day it would start to feel sticky. It applied very smoothly and I didn’t find that it had a smell. I really enjoy Clinique products and would likely purchase a full size of this.
I have normal to dry skin and I really loved how long my skin felt hydrated. The texture felt smooth and cool and applied easily. A little goes a long way. 10 out of 10 for hydration.
The moisturizer had gel like texture which was good for my combination skin. It didn’t feel heavy on my face and was hydrating.

I received a sample of this product from Influenster for reviewing purposes. This moisturizer is lightweight, refreshing and mild scented. I used this in the mornings and it absorbs quickly and leaves my skin moisturized for the whole day. It wears great under makeup and doesn’t pill or separate my products. I would purchase this to incorporate into my summer routine!

I have been on the hunt for a moisturizer that can help my poor dry skin regain moisture, especially through the cold winters here in Canada. I believe I have found that holy grail product. I have always been fond of Clinique’s products, and they do quite well with my skin, and this product wasn’t any different. It’s a light, creamy texture with a subtle hint of scent, and my skin soaked up every bit of moisture this product offered. I actually got compliments from friends asking what new foundation I was using because the glow my skin had after 3 days of using this was that comparable to wearing foundation. When I said that I wasn’t wearing any foundation, and that my moisturizer did this, my friends ran out and bought some for themselves to try. It does say that it’s 100 hour coverage, but I had to apply it every day as my skin is THAT dry. I definitely recommend this product and I will for sure be purchasing it again in the future!!

I have dry skin.Before applying, my skin felt and looked dry and dull. After applying, my skin felt smooth and less dull but under the surface the skin was still dry. The effect lasts all day or until you wash your face.It’s a very light weight gel moisturizer. A little goes a long way. I would recommend using this on top of an actual hydrating moisturizer. I would not buy this. It’s not worth this price.

I absolutely love this product! It feels so lightweight on my skin, but moisturizes so well. I love the gel formula as it doesn’t feel like it’s clogging my pores. I’ve always trusted Clinique as a skin care brand and this product really lives up to the brands name.  The price point is really great as a little product goes a long way. I would definitely recommend to anyone struggling with dry skin in need of a rescue!
I love this product. It gives my skin the extra hydration boost it needs without making my face look greasy or feeling sticky#freeproduct#influenster

I received this product from Influenster for my honest review. I really like this moisturizer. I think it’s great for summer since it’s not too thick. My skin definitely felt more moisturized and soft after using it.

I received a sample from Influenster for my honest review of this product.  I was only able to try this product 2-3 times due to the size. However, the gel texture didn’t leave my face feeling greasy or sticky. My skin felt plump and I had a dewy glow the next day.  There isn’t any scent to the product which I appreciate and I didn’t break out after using the product.

I received a complimentary sample of this product for testing purposes, however I will be purchasing it in the regular size! It is a gel like moisturizer, that has very little scent and works great for day to day. I have oily skin and I find this does not increase that feeling at all, in fact smoothes and softens skin quickly. I only gave 4 stars due to the fact it doesn’t seem overly moisturizing as I said , but is great for day use under makeup. I would recommend this product.
I received this as a sample from Influenster. I love Clinique overall. It is great for oily skin and is easy to apply. I would definitely recommend this product for the summer.

I use to use Clinique moisturizers all the time when I was younger. It’s been a few years since I’ve used them and they’re just as good as I remember. I especially love the moisture surge for when I’ve had a long day in the sun and my skin is a little burnt or irritated. It’s soothing and hydrating. Nothing more that I would want. Overall, I recommend this to anyone with any kind of skin type.

I received this product from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I have oily skin and found this to work really well for me. Didn’t add any excess oil and I find a lot of moisturizer does. I used this mainly on no makeup days but it does preform well under makeup also. Left my skin feeling supple and hydrated all day. No stickiness, little goes along way and absorbs quickly. Definitely recommend. I will be purchasing the full size for myself.

I have sensitive, combination skin, and I found that this product added moisture to my skin nicely without any poor reactions or breakouts. I really do like that this product is fragrance free. This is a slightly thicker moisturizer, which spreads nicely on the face and leaves the skin feeling soft for at least a day.

First off thanks to Influenster for the opportunity to test out this moisturizer for free in exchange for my honest review. I really liked this moisturizer because it was super lightweight. Little goes a long way with this one! So easy to apply and it dries quickly. It left my skin feeling so smooth and hydrated. Would definitely recommend!

I received this product from Influencer for a trial. I was alittle disappointed at the size sent because you can only test for 2-3 times. That being said the 2-3 times I did apply this product I did enjoy it. It is a very light cream. Easy to apply and blends in well with little work. I still need to wear a mask to work for my job, this under my mask did not create a bunch of grease or oil. I would definitely add this into my skin care routine!

I received this item to review and it was sample sized. I used the entire sample, even cut it open to get all the product out. That how much I love it. Definitely switching from my current product to this one. My face was left feeling so soft and didn’t dry out at all. I also haven’t noticed any breakouts which have happened before in the past with other products. I can’t wait to purchase the full size product!

review_title: would buy this after using a trial size!
review_text: Lightweight on my skin. Makes it feel like a smooth silicone finish without the silicone.  My face was dry in spots and breaking out after one too many face masks and this cream seemed to heal my skin barrier!  I received this as a free sample but wouldConsider buying when my regular moisturizer (Peter Thomas Roth cloud drench) is finished!

I received this as a complimentary sample from Influenster. I have a normal skin type. I used this moisturizer for two days during my morning and night routine. After using the Clinique Moisture Surge moisturizer, my skin felt soft, smooth, and plump. My skin looked healthier and hydrated. My skin also looks flawless and glowing. The texture of this moisturizer is a thick gel and has no scent or colour. The effects of the moisturizer lasted all day. I felt my skin on my face hydrated and looking beautiful. I would recommend this moisturizer to anyone who has sensitive skin or anyone who wants beautifully hydrated and glowing skin. I would buy it in the future as l can see lasting results with Clinique Moisture Surge moisturizer.

This product was very hydrating for my skin. I have tried and used the original moisture surge in the past and I didn’t notice a significant difference with the 100H. It had a nice gel texture, which I prefer and didn’t have a sticky finish. I have oily skin and this did not make me shiny. It’s not a bad moisturizer, however there are better options out there!

Let’s start with the basics; I’m a combo/oily skinned gal with sometimes reactive skin that will beam red if it doesn’t like a product. I received a 5ml sample of this product from Influester (complimentary) to give my thoughts. All-in-all I really enjoyed this moisturizer. It has a gel like consistency and a little goes a long way. I thought 5ml was going to barely be enough product for one use but it has lasted me about a week! I think if you had dry skin this product would be a show stopper and I plan on getting it for my husband. With my skin type, I do quite like it but I tend to use something to help keep my oils at bay (like Clinique) or something I know for sure won’t  exacerbate my oiliness (Nudeskin moisturizer). If I had been able to test this a bit longer, I might have had a better idea on that aspect. Hope this helps!!!
I received a sample of this product and loved it. It has a gel consistency which is very refreshing. It gives your skin a nice dewy look and I find it to be perfect to prep your skin before makeup.

I recieved a sample size of this product and really enjoyed it. The texture was great and it sunk in very quickly. It’s very light so I think it would be a great summer moisturizer but I would need something heavier in winter when my skin is dryer.

It’s a bit difficult to give a full review based on a sample, so I’ll go with my thoughts regarding what I did observe! I really loved the gel texture and the feeling it left my skin after applying it. I have sensitive skin and this wasn’t drying. My makeup applied nicely right after.  Now, I wouldn’t know the full term effect of this product, but from thw 2-3 times I used it, I liked it.

Nice clean refreshing feel with a lightweight finish for a quick moisture boost. Feel that it’s better to put on at night so I don’t risk rubbing it off bit under sunscreen during the day is good too, although it does make my sunscreen move a bit.
Clinique Moisturizer surge is a gel cream that is lightweight, non-greasy, and very hydrating. It absorbs quickly and I love the softness and hydration it gives my skin.

The gel felt nice on my dry skin. I didn’t find it moisturezed too much and I don’t think for the price point it would be something I’d try again. I didn’t find it overly moisturizing based on my combination skin type, but I’m sure it would work for others.

I received this product from Influenster for an honest review. With this item claiming to be very hydrating, I expected more from it. It did moisturizer my face, but didn’t give it that plump, almost “bouncy” look which my usual Belif products do. Also, it isn’t a lasting feeling, the moisturizer is pretty lightweight.

I received a small sample from Influenster for my honest opinion. I have dry, sensitive skin and I enjoyed the moisturizer. It absorbed quickly and didnt leave a an oily residue. My skin still felt moisturized when I woke up the next morning. I would definitely recommend this product.

My skin is combination of dry and oily. After using it my skin felt very hydrated! I love that it doesn’t have a strong smell. I received this product as a sample gift, so it is quite small. I was only able to use it about 3 times. Everytime i did use it, it did moisturized my skin!
While I only trialed a sample I have to say this feels amazing. My skin felt like it was being softened/smoothed out to the touch, but without a thick cream feeling.

I received a sample of this moisturizer for free from Influenster provided I test and review the product. This moisturizer is very light and absorbs fairly quickly into the skin, which I like. There is no heavy scent either and it paired well with my foundation (mufe) there will no pilling at all. I liked that my skin was hydrated throughout the day.

This moisturizer is a gel consistently (which I prefer) that absorbs very quickly into the skin (which I love). It has no scent and leaves my face very soft with no shine, so I have ben using it on no makeup days. I really like it and was happy that influencer sent me a sample to try.

I recieved a 5mL sample from Influenster for testing. If I had oily skin, I’m sure it would be wonderful. But since this is an oil free gel cream, my skin was unbalanced and started over producing oil in the three days I used this product. Also, like when I formally used Clinique’s classic yellow cream, my face became instantly red. Other than that, my skin was soft but I cannot speak of long term or if my skin were to adjust since I was asked to review from 5mL.
I tried this cream 2 times, I have dry skin and this works great to keep my skin hydrated without the oily feeling . It’s really good for daily use .

I received this product for free from Influenster. I like the consistency of the moisturizer however I don’t think it’ll work for someone with very dry skin. Perhaps a good product to use in the summer

So nice !!!! I was so impressed, the texture is really light and like gel, when you put it it absorb so fast but let your skin glowing like crazy, but in a good way. I have oily skin and it wasn’t shiny or anything just a nice healthy glow. I have redness sometimes because of the retinol i use at night but with this gel it calmed everything and my skin was confortable and without any redness! Will definitely get the full size

I have combination skin.  I received this sample and I used in the am. It makes my skin feel soft and hydrated without feeling greasy. It is definitely more of a day cream than night cream with my skin.

I received a small sample of this cream to try. I have fairly dry skin and this cream did help with hydration. My face felt soft after application and it lasted most of the day. I like that it is not oily and does not leave your skin looking greasy. I do wish some of the ingredients were a bit cleaner. Overall I enjoyed using this cream but did not have enough to see if it has positive long term effect’s from using. I only had enough for about a week! It is a thin cream so if you’re looking for a thicker cream you might not like this one. It is very lightweight which I prefer. I would purchase this face cream!

I tried a small sample of this in exchange for my honest review. I liked the feel of this a lot. I have oily skin and generally avoid gel creams because they go on like silk and then just turn to grease after a few hours. This one stayed soft with a satin finish. It’s lightweight but you can feel the hydration it gives. I think it balanced out the moisture for my skin. Because of the pink colour, I thought this would smell like grapefruit but it didn’t actually have much of a scent. I think this is supposed to give 100 hours of moisture but I’m far too oily to know if that’s true. I just washed it off in the morning and went on with my skincare but there were no dry flakes.

I can’t really give a HONEST review based on only 4 applications from a very small trial size but, I did like the very subtle to almost unnoticeable smell of this moisturizer. If you are sensitive to strong smells then this is a great option to try. I have oily/combination/hormonal acne prone skin… this moisturizer did not disturb my skin. It has a little sticky texture which I’m not crazy about but it wasn’t too bad. I can’t give a review on results as I only tried it for 4 applications lol.

I got a sample size of this product to review, and while it’s not my favourite, it’s pretty good. I’m generally not a fan of the gel water moisturizers, but this definitely feels nicer than other gel ones I’ve used. It immediately dried on my face without drying my face, and doesn’t have a strong scent or oily lingering residue (on my face or fingers).

I tried my sample out after showering and it’s a decent moisturizer. Not scented if this is a preference of yours, and I also appreciate the recyclable packaging. The texture of the product is smooth and not oily, and you do not need much of it to do the job.

I received a sample size of this product from #influenster and fell in love with it. In the winter my face gets dry and flakey and since using this my face has felt very hydrated and not dry. I apply this before putting on my makeup because it helps moisturize, dries fast and hasn’t made my skin break out. It’s definitely a product that I will purchase a full size of.

I received this product to review through Influenster and I was surprised by how moisturizing it was. It went on smooth and felt light on my skin but I was shocked by how long my face felt hydrated and looked dewy! During the change of season my skin gets so dry and this product seemed to protect against any dryness I usually experience. The only thing I would change would be the scent. I was hoping for a wonderful scent to accompany the aloe vera and other natural ingredients.

I received the clinique moisture surge from Influenster for my honest review.  I really liked this auto replenishing hydrator. It made my skin super soft. It was only 5ml therefore was able to apply just a few times but I will definitely buy it again.

review_title: I really really like this moisturizer!!
review_text: I received this as a free sample with an order. I really liked it and was a bit sad when it was gone. I will order a full size of this when I use up the jar of my usual moisturizer
Deja la piel súper suave, es especial para el invierno que la piel suele ponerse seca.

I really like this moisturizer under makeup which is how I mostly use it. My skin can be both normal and slightly oily at different times and this moisturizer works well for me at any time. It’s light and preps my skin nicely for makeup without feeling heavy or adding any shine. Although I like it for my skin type I’m not sure this will be enough for drier skin types.
Love this! This is the only moisturizer that does not break me out. It also doesn’t feel so heavy! It leaves my skin feeling very hydrated and not sticky, which is my biggest pet peeve!
I expected this product to be super hydrating and it wasn’t. I’ve used their other moisture surge products but this one missed the mark. It does leave your skin feeling smooth, but not hydrated.

I received this for free to try and review from influenster. Im really happy with it. It feels light on my skin but is super moisturizing. Ive been using it at night and my face looks and feels refreshed in the morning

I love a good face lotion, however, this “hydrator“ was not for me. It has a gel-like consistency, so it left my skin feeling a bit tacky after rubbing it in. I also noticed dry patches around my mouth after using this, which does not normally happen with my normal moisturizer. I am giving this product 3 stars because I have sensitive skin and think this may work for someone else!

All over I am not mad at this! I just expected more! More because of the price and more because it is Clinique! I couldn’t tell the difference between this moisturizer and a cheaper drugstore brand! Yes, it does all the things it claims to do (at least for my skin) but it did not make me go WOW

Love the original and definitely prefer that to this one. This feels great on the skin but the moisture disappears pretty quickly. That makes this great under makeup though if you don’t want everything slipping. I think if you have oily or combo skin, you would really like this, but as someone with dry skin, this just doesn’t do enough. It might work for dry skin types in the summer, just not the winter. If you liked the other versions of this line, get a sample before buying the full size because there is a noticeable difference.

I love Clinque’s moisture surge 100H. This truly was hydrating for my skin. I applied it everyday for a couple of weeks and noticed a difference with my skin and feeling replenished. I love that the packaging is Clinique  clean -sustainable packaging. I can’t wait to purchase this product and use daily.

I liked the old stuff, from the first iteration of this “pink gel” as my family calls it. I use the pink gel every winter, and yellow gel (now clear jelly) every summer. Fall and spring it depends on my skin and the weather. I love this stuff. One jar per winter. And well, this new formula is just as good. I don’t plan to test the 100 hour claim though. I’ve used Clinique over a decade, no plan to stop anytime soon.

I received a sample for free from Influenster in exchange for my review. The sample was .17oz so this is really just my first impressions. I love the moisture surge and actually own the 72HR version. This one immediately felt great on my skin- smooth and almost like satin.  But the moisture didn’t last as long as I’d like. I feel like I was in need of more moisture and I have combination oily skin. In my opinion, the other was better.

I received a sample complimentary of influenster. I honestly dont really have a true formed opinion of this product because it wasn’t enough to really test it. The only thing I can say is it feels nice and doesn’t dry tacky.

I received a free sample of Clinique’s Moisture Surge™ 100-Hour Auto-Replenishing Hydrator. I like that Clinique has made an effort to use 30% post-consumer recycled material for their sample packaging. The sample tube was small, only 0.17 fl. oz. / 5mL, but I was able to use the product for a full week applying this gel cream each morning and night after cleanisng my face. On first use, I didn’t really notice any scent in the product, but it does have a very light clean fragrance that I think comes naturally from the aloe based ingredients. This hydrator has a very light, gel like consistency that applies smoothly and absorbs quickly without feeling heavy or sticky on my skin. I have combination skin with areas on my cheeks prone to dryness and sensitivity, while my t-zone is more oily. This hydrator worked well for me in that it moisturized my dry areas without irritation and it’s quick absorption didn’t cause any clogged pores or breakouts around my nose, which I’ve sometimes experienced with heavier creams. Other than it’s beneficial moistuzing qualities, I didn’t notice any improvement to my skin’s overall texture or radiance while using this product... but I’m not sure that would happen after only one weeks use. I feel like overall this is a good product if you are just looking for a moisturizer that doesn’t irritate or cause breakouts, but for the price I would like to see some additional benefits such as wrinkle reduction or general improvements to skin’s texture.

I really liked how my skin felt after using the clinique moisture Surge 100 Hour Auto-Replenishing Hydrator. Even tho the free sample I received was just a little bit, I loved it a lot. My skin felt really soft after I used it. My skin didn’t feel sticky after I applied. Also what I loved is how quickly it absorbed onto my skin. Definitely recommend and would buy this in the future.
I really like the Clinique moisture surge 100 hour hydrator. I was amazed at how it made my skin feel. Left my skin feeling soft and looking great.

I was very excited about this product but I after trying it I am very disappointed. I have combination skin and love light weight products that hydrate my skin but when I used this product my skin feels really dry. This product is not hydrating at all.  I would not recommend this product at all. There are better light weight moisturizers out there than this.

I’m combo/oily skin so I normally don’t use moisturizer unless I’m really dry, or to use as a primer under makeup. I tried this at night by lightly patting it on, and upon putting it on I felt a refreshing sensation. It was almost cooling, but perhaps it’s the gel consistency. I didn’t mind it. There was also very little scent which I appreciate, as someone who can be quite sensitive to heavily scented products. By morning, my skin seem normal so I must say it does not make me glow or feel like I’m well moisturized but at least there are no breakouts which is always a plus in my book!

It was a small sample size that I tried so I don’t know if it’s a “fair” review, it had a light scent to it. The product was more of a gel than cream, I was surprised by the color and consistency. It did feel very hydrating.

It has a water gel type texture that absorbs quickly and leaves a nice feeling without greasy. Idk It is just is something I would use everyday, it is not really hydrating my skin. It may work for others though so I would say try it out for yourself.

its lightweight and absorbs quickly.  it feels good on the skin.  I like that it has hyaluronic acid and aloe.  but the sample that I got for texting purpose was small so I only got to use it 3 times sparingly.  so its hard to critique based on that.
You can feel your face refreshed and hydrated instantly after applying. I apply it at night and in the morning my face still feels moist.

I love the gel formula and how light weight and non greasy feel it has. I will say my makeup went on super smooth. It was like applying my makeup on silk. As far as it to be long lasting I can’t say I really noticed a huge difference. After I applied it and then my makeup my face felt like any other moisturizer. So for the reason of not noticing it lasting long term I only gave it 4 stars instead of 5. I just can’t justify 100 hours.  I would recommend this product and might give it another try since the sample size only gave me a few uses. It would be nice to try it a little longer.

This moisturizer is a great hydrating product that works well in the morning and at night. It sets your skin up nicely in the morning before putting on make up. It also absorbs well at night to really hydrate your skin. Overall, a great moisturizer for many skin types.
