It absorbs quickly without any greasy or sticky feelings. Products Shown:@SundayRiley~ 5 Stars Retinol Eye Serum

I absolutely loved the applicator for this product! The ceramic was cooling and I found it even better if I stored the product in the fridge. The formula itself was was easily absorbed by my skin and made my under eyes look less tired. Loved how the product didn’t apply oily or greasy but was more of a light weight formula. As a person who has not developed an signs of aging yet, I’d say this is a great clean product to prevent aging.

I absolutely love this eye cream. I’ve been trying multiple different eye creams over the past 2 years and can never find one with a good creamy consistency that is easy to spread. Happy to say this one is finally THE eye cream! Perfect creamy consistency, easy to apply, and keep my under eyes super hydrated. I’ve also noticed a huge improvement in the lines on my crows feet using this eye cream!

Sunday Riley’s newly launched Eye Serum that has a lovely lightweight creamy texture.  It has no discernible scent which I appreciated for an eye product.  The applicator had a cooling feeling which helped work the product in while depuffing.

I received this product for free from Sunday Friday in exchange for my honest review. I love this product because of some great  ingredients (retinoid and niacinamide); however, the olive oil is little bit heavy for me. I will keep using this product

The application of this feels so good under my eyes because the applicator has a cooling effect which is great for inflammation & soothing. This was gifted to me and exchange for my honest opinion.I apply this nightly and wake up with hydrated and smooth under eyes. I would give this a 9/10.  The packaging is so cute but I did find that the cap doesn’t twist off, you just need to pull it off and push it close.

review_title: Eye Spy A Super Star Eye Serum
review_text: I am always on the hunt for a good eye cream! As a huge fan of Sunday Riley products in the past, I was excited to try Sunday Riley’s brand new 5 Stars Retinol Eye Serum. I love how it comes with an applicator tip, so you don’t have to use your fingers. All you need is a pearl sized drop and then use the applicator to gently smooth the cooling serum around your eyes. At $65, it’s quite pricey but the 0.5oz goes a long ways!This eye serum’s got 6% Retinoid + Niacinamide, so def save this one for your night time skincare routine. While it won’t get rid of them, I’m counting on this wonderful eye serum to help minimize the fine lines & wrinkles around my eyes.Will definitely by when I run out and recommend to others.

This is probably my favorite eye cream I have ever tried. The texture is thick but applies so smooth, which I love around my eye area. I can tell that it also brightens up my under eyes immediately after I’ve applied it. My combination skin can be sensitive to retinoids, but with this product, I find that I can use it every day and my skin isn’t too sensitive to it. My under eyes are incredibly smooth and bright from using this!

Hello! I just want to say this product is amazing! The product stays cold and I feel like this was made for me. Highly recommend. I feel like this will be essential for everyone in their daily routine.

Amé este nuevo lanzamiento de Sunday, para empezar amé el concepto del empaque, la textura del producto es ligera lo cual es ideal para la zona del contorno de los ojos, el olor es suave y elegante, realmente la recomiendo me encantó!

Amazing serum for the eye area! Good texture keeps my skin stay hydrated and moisturized. I’m in love with the applicator with a little cooling effect, it helps to apply the required amount of cream! Convenient for everyday use, I recommend it!

I honestly really like this product! The application is easy to use and mess free. I never feel like I’m wasting product. My eyes feel refreshed in the morning which is a major plus. I would definitely recommend this product!

I really love the smooth, creamy texture of 5 Stars eye cream! It glides on beautifully with the ceramic tip and absorbs quickly, making it perfect for under my concealer. While I’ve only had a handful of uses, this hasn’t caused milia, which a lot of eye creams typically do. I am so excited to see results!

I love a good eye serum and this Sunday Riley product is a must try. I love the applicator so you don’t have to stick your finger in a jar and feel like you contaminated the product. It’s very moisturizing and gives the cooling effect you want after a long day. It’s been a part of my night time routine and I enjoy having a new eye serum to try out.

This product was gifted in exchange for an honest review. I love it so far! The skin under my eyes is slightly sensitive, but it didn’t irritate it at all. I’ve used it for two weeks so far, and I can see a slight difference, looking less tired.

I’ve been using this eye cream for the past week, and so far I’ve found it to be very gentle! I’ve experienced reactions and irritation towards retinol products in the past, but I’ve found this to be very delicate for the sensitive eye area. It’s a very creamy, almost silky consistency that feels really hydrating and soothing on application. It’s too soon for me to evaluate if it’s making a difference on fine lines, but so far, I’m impressed!

I’ve been using the 5 Stars eye serum from Sunday Riley for a week now and I’m really enjoying it so far. It has a smooth and creamy texture that absorbs quickly and leaves the eye area feeling soft and moisturized. The cooling applicator feels nice when applying and the cream is also gentle and non irritating for everyday use.

I have recently started using this product on my nighttime routine and I’m very excited about it. The texture of the product is creamy and feels very soft on the skin. The applicator has a very cooling effect and feels very nice. The product is very gentle with the skin knowing that the under eye area is very delicate. The only thing is that i think the price is a bit too much.

This eye cream has some really lovely ingredients! The retinoid is a pretty gentle one which is good for the eye area. It’s a creamy product that offers a good amount of moisture. I like that it sinks in quick and layers well under makeup without pilling. The packaging does look a little off brand for Sunday Riley, but it is cute and maybe they’re planning to rebrand!

I love Sunday riley’s products and this eye cream especially because it has retinol and Niacinamide my expression lines have improved a lot, I wear it every night and it has fascinated me I highly recommend, it I will continue to use it.

One of the best eye creams I have used! It makes my under eyes look so fresh and it makes me look so awake! I love how it just turns up the skin under my eyes in the mornings and at night and it just feels great!

Now that I’m almost 30, I’ve realized the importance of anti aging products. And though I hate to admit it, my eye area is the one area I tend to neglect. This eye cream is great! I love the application process and I love the ease that it brings into my routine. It’s essentially a no brainer. The packaging is cute as well. I have been using this for a week and I do notice a subtle difference. I’m using this more as a prophylactic step so I’m excited to see how this pans out!

This retinol & niacinamide eye cream is everything. It has a ceramic tip that stays cold and it truly feels so good at night! I have seen results since incorporating this product. Less fine lines and more hydration! Spa: olive oil is an ingredient so don’t over apply! Possible breakout sitch!

Big fan of sunday Riley and this did not disappoint. I love the applicator and cute packaging design. It goes on smoothly and absorbs fairly quickly.  I didn’t notice any skin irritation or tingling. Love that it has retinol!

Amazing! I am a newbie when it comes to using retinoids so I was hesitant to try it out, but nevertheless, Sunday Riley never falls short! I love how simple the application is, and how smooth the product goes on. I find it extremely easy to squeeze into my nighttime routine because of how little time it takes to apply. I am beyond happy that I found this product and will be continuing to use it! 5 Stars, for 5 stars! (;

I absolutely loved this retinol eye serum! It was so hydrating while also firming up my under eye lines. Usually I have an issue with retinals being to drying as I have extremely dry skin but with this product that wasn’t a concern!

This eye cream was surprisingly thick and creamy compared to other eye creams I’ve tried recently. This layered well with my other skin care products, and my eye area felt very hydrated when I woke up!

this is the first sunday riley product i’ve tried and i was not disappointed!! my undereyes have always been a problem area so i’m hoping i see more results in the long run. but so far, i like that this keeps my undereyes feeling hydrated.

This is a really nice eye cream. I like that it has a thicker consistency without leaving my eye area feeling greasy. It was very easy to apply and the applicator has a nice cooling effect - nice for warm desert nights! The ingredients works really well in my skin, it loves niacinamide and ceramides! I’ve been able to use it every night, so it seems fairly gentle. I am looking forward to see how the retinol works on my skin over the next few weeks!

I’ve always been scared to use retinol so I’m always stayed away from it even with good reviews and people saying good things! But I’ve heard so many good things about Sunday Riley and they asked if I could try this product so I said why not and I’m so glad I tried it! Definitely a must for me and it’s staying in my skincare routine!

This serum is one of my new favorite products and I’m so excited to continue using this! I love how this brightens, hydrates and makes my under eyes look smoother. I’ve been using this for about a week now and I have noticed a difference in the fine lines and my dark circles! The packaging is gorgeous and I love the applicator.

Oh what a glorious eye serum! This product is sooooo incredibly hydrating and high quality. It melts straight into your skin, extremely effective yet gentle on the skin. I love how compact the packaging is, easy to bring on the go and the ingredients are powerful!

I absolutely love the packaging. It’s beautiful. Texture of this serum is very nice and thick. I feel it’s very hydrating despite retinol it’s not drying formula. I like cooling ceramic tip applicator to apply the serum. It helps to depuff. After few days of use I noticed my under eye area looks brighter.

The packaging for this eye serum is really pretty. It has a bult in applicator that feel nice to apply. This contains a blend of retinols to help smooth fine lines and wrinkles and is packed with niacinamide to brighten ceramide to support the skin barrier. This will take some to see an effect so I can’t speak on that yet. However this feels lightweight and nourishing to the eye area and is super gentle & non irritating. The texture doesn’t feel heavy at all.  Overall this is a great eye serum! It is a bit on the pricier side though for 15mL.

haven’t really used many types of eye cream but I loved this one! it’s very moisturizing, great for sensitive skin, and has a good smell (that isn’t too harsh/filled with chemicals) also love the packaging!

I am in love with this eye serum. My under eyes are brightening up and the skin around my eyes overall looks more plump. I am excited to see what this will do for the deeper lines and wrinkles over the next couple of months. It also hasn’t caused any irritation whatsoever.  Overall, i’m really enjoying this eye serum and can’t wait to see what it will do for me in the next couple of months.

I recently got this product from Sunday Riley and have been loving it so far. The texture feels amazing on my skin and I love the packaging. I would highly recommend this product to my friends and family.

This Sunday Riley 5 Stars Retinol Eye Serum is my new favorite. It works nicely under the eye area. It helps to reduce the dark circle and the wrinkles. It has a smooth texture, and quick to absorb into the skin. I love this product because it doesn’t feel greasy at all. I highly recommend this product.
Honestly by far the best moisturizer I’ve ever tried! Especially under makeup

I enjoy other Milk products (melatonin serum forever!) but I cannot recommend this moisturizer. I bought the full size on a recommendation from an associate in-store. The moisturizer is the texture and thickness of elmer’s white school glue. I am not kidding! It is too thick to gently spread across your delicate face, and I always felt like I Was doing more harm than good putting this on. Furthermore, I never felt particularly hydrated or moisturized, although it did absorb and my skin was softer. It just left my skin feeling just as dry as before. Skip this particular product from Milk.

I have not tried this product yet on my face so cannot speak directly for the product itself, however, this is basically a sample size of the product that is insanely expensive. I have no idea why this is even sold as a legit product and not given as a sample. Even Lancôme gives away bigger sample sizes for free along with other products. Pretty ridiculous.

I am obsessed with the MILK cleanser, can’t recommend it enough, so I impulse bought this mini....I think it might be bad, it’s a mostly empty jar with a substance that is more like a greasy oil cleansing balm than a moisturizer. Nothing  like the creamy whipped photos some people posted. For the price, the amount, and the nasty greasy finish I can’t even deal with on my face this one’s a return. Hoping Milk skincare comes out with more bangers like the cleanser in the future tho!
I loved this moisture it’s light the smell isn’t strong can wear and not even worry about it

So thick and never sank in! I felt like I was dragging my skin/rubbing so hard to get it spread around. Once it was spread, it took forever to soak in some, but never fully did. I mean, mediocre at best
HANDS DOWN FAVOURITE MOISTURIZER. So thick and really noticeable once you have it on your skin. I really really love this product

I really wanted to give this a try and like it but I just couldn’t rock with it! It’s toooo thick, I tried to use to with oil but it just wouldn’t work. Took forever for me rub into my face. It also made little white heads on my forehead. If this was free would I still use it NO! Its so many better moisturizers out their ladies. Please do your skin a favor and do it settle. And if you think your face is doing wonders with this just think what it will do if you find a moisturizer with much better reviews. Please please do not settle!

This has instantly become my favorite moisturizer. I have really dry skin, especially in the colder months. This moisturizer is very thick and a little goes a long way. It keeps me hydrated all day long and it makes my foundation go on so smoothly. I definitely recommend if you have dry skin! You will love it!

I work at Sephora and I have tried all kinds of expensive and fancy moisturizers and surprisingly this is the best one I have ever tried!! $38 for this product is amazing for how well it works. This blows tatcha out of the water for sure. I love how thick and healing this product feels, and I swear it makes my skin smoother as well. Will be purchasing again and again
I wanted to love this, but unfortunately the packaging color bleeds and has stained so many items of mine.
My sensitive, oily skin absolutely loves this moisturizer!
It was moisturizing for my dry skin but my skin felt like it had a layer on it and it was sticky. I didn’t like the feeling so I returned it.

I really love the vegan milk cleanser of this brand so I had high hopes for this moisturizer. Unfortunately, I found it exremely disappointing. It has an insanely, oddly thick, texture-- to the point that I feel confused about the positive reviews as I am unsure how someone could possibly feel comfort with this moisturizer on their face. I would suggest trying a sample of this, if possible, prior to buying if you’re curious about it.
This cream is absolutely amazing. I have combo skin and this doesn’t dry or make my face oily. It has to be the best cream I have every owned.

I think this moisturizer is a bit too thick and greasy. I was hoping it would be more lightweight so I could use it under makeup during the day. I would say this is better for nighttime due to its consistency. It also takes a bit of effort to rub it in until it is fully absorbed and it also has somewhat of an odd smell (not a scent).
I love this product. It feels so good on my skin. It’s very moisturizing. Once again I just can’t afford this product.

It is a really thick moisturizer that locks the hydration in. I like that it doesn’t have a smell. I like to use it after a hydrating serum. I got it on sales and you don’t need much to cover your face and neck so it’s an amazing deal! Right now in summer it’s a bit too heavy for my skin but I feel it will be perfect in the dry winter’s day. It feels so nourishing!
Nice thick cream. I look for the thickest creams I can find. This is a really good one and it’s not too expensive. Leaves my skin looking and feeling great.

I feel like this is best for oily or normal skin, because it feels tacky almost when applied. I think it works for my dry skin during the summer when I’m often sweaty, but definitely not a deep hydration for me. It didn’t leave my skin with that super moisturized and dewy feeling, which is ok for daytime for me, but I need something more for night and my dry patches.
I’ve been struggling for years trying to find a good moisturizer, I have extremely dry skin because I take Accutane. This also works AMAZING as a primer!
Not heavy or greasy and leaves my sensitive skin feeling hydrated all day. Absolutely love and will be repurchasing.

I love Milk products, but this one didn’t cut it for me. I love that there is minimal scent. But this was thick and hard to rub in. It didn’t moisturize any better than the others out there. It didn’t live up to my expectations of Milk. I returned it.

I really thought I was gonna love this moisturizer bc I LOVE their other products, but it broke me out badly and I never break out. I stopped using it so I can see if the moisturizer was the problem and it was. As soon as I started using it again it broke me out again!

I love that it’s clean and vegan, and my edges love that it’s silicone-free! My hair is silicone-sensitive, so I am limiting the amount of silicone that touches my hair and edges. It is thick and very hydrating, so a little bit goes a long way. My skin is soft, moisturized, and smooth all day when I use this.

Love this moisturizer! It’s creamy and thick, but just melts right into your skin. Very hydrating and nourishing. Would be great for sensitive skin types too, as it barely has a scent. Leaves my combo oily skin super soft and smooth, it’s not greasy at all.

I have dry, textured / acne-prone, sensitive skin. So far, this product has not broken me out and has added good moisture. However, it tends to emphasize my texture and it has a weird white film? It also irritates my sensitive areas a little. Make sure you don’t use a lot — I barely use a pea-sized amount for my cheeks and about the same for my forehead.

Super épais et hydratant, parfait pour une crème de nuit. Apaise ma peau parfaitement. J’adore le produit spécialement l’hiver quand ma peau est particulièrement sèche. Par contre, le produit prend du temps à pénétrer dans la peau.

I was in need of a thick, unscented moisturizer that would not leave a heavy film behind nor feel greasy going on and this checked all the boxes! you need very little of this (you will know if you used to much because it will take a long time to sink in if you over apply.) I mix a little bit with two drops of rosehip seed oil at night and i wake up to skin thats still moisturized, balanced and soft. this did not break me out either which most heavy moisturizers do. since I began using this, I no longer have dry spots around my nose or corners of my mouth. very pleased and it doesnt break the bank either- cant beat that!
I really like this, it’s thick and dries a little shiny on my face so I use it before I go to sleep. Moisturizes my face very well.

This is such a hydrating moisturizer and the smallest bit truly goes a long long way! Even tho it has different oils it does not feel oily on the skin. Almost like butter and deeply moisturizing. Has no scent and love that it’s vegan! I wake up with no dry patches and glowy, bouncy looking skin.

Love this! I have super dry skin and this did the trick. I originally received as a bonus sample, was disappointed because the sample was smaller than a quarter. The sample jar lasted me almost an entire week! I just ordered the full size excited to see what results I will have. I have noticed a big difference in hydration level just using the mini. Switching to this from Clinique Moisture Surge Intense.

I’m always looking for products that are more natural, but often times I’m left feeling oily or I have allergic reactions to the amount of glycerin the products contain. Milk Makeup’s Vegan Milk Moisturizer is a life saver. I have very sensitive skin around my eyes and lips. I tested this product in the mini version a few months ago and i can’t get over how soft my skin feels and how well my lips and eyes responded to it and i DON’T feel oily. The glycerin content is so low that I haven’t reacted to it. I said goodbye to peeling lips and VERY dry eyelids weeks ago and I won’t be seeing them again. 10 out of 10 I would recommend to anyone dealing with dry skin on his or her face/neck.

This Is a very thick, heavy weight moisturizer it is light enough to be worn during the day if you have dry to normal skin but especially good for the evening. The Milk moisturizer doesn’t seem to have any added fragrance which is a nice alternative to all the heavily fragranced skin and cosmetic products on the market. I do not recommend this moisturizer for anyone with combination or oily skin.
I love how thick and rich this cream is! Soaks into the skin quickly and doesn’t feel greasy!

Left my skin super moisturized it is super gentle on skin. This product also has a very gentle smell, not overpowering or artificial! I received this product free from influenster and would definitely recommend! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

I tried this for the first time yesterday! And I actually liked it! The only thing was that it was a little difficult to rub it in but I found that if I pat in it works best :) I only gave it 3 stars because I still have to test it out! But I think it’s definitely worth a shot!

I was too skeptical to buy, so I got a free sample. I have bad acne and was worried I would break out after using this moisturizer, but I didn’t!! I have dry/normal skin and it did not leave me feeling greasy or oily. It does take a little bit to set in, but once it does it feels great. It almost feels like a primer at first but once you work it in enough it changes texture. My only complaint is the price, there are plenty of drugstore moisturizers that are non-comedogenic that will work just as well.
No harsh chemicals, very creamy and not sticky! I’m in love!!!
Extremely thick and does not feel really hydrating at all. I got it thinking it would be a good night cream but I woke up each time feeling more dry than using my normal moisturizer.

This is definitely hydrating for sure, but if you have very sensitive skin...forget it. My skin broke out like crazy. I gave it time to mellow out but it never did. It’s a very thick cream, it doesn’t really spread out on the skin well.
Love love love, a little goes a long way! If you use too much it will give you a greasy feel. I love the very clean feel it gives you.

My skin is normally dry because of winter. So I was pretty excited to receive a moisturizer to test out from Influenster. It is great for my dry skin. The product is thick so it takes a minute to rub in but you don’t need much at all, just a scoop on your finger tip. I only need to use it in the morning because it’s very hydrating and it doesn’t make you oily at the end of the day. I love bright colors, so the packaging was perfect!

I love this moisturizer. It does its job! It feels pretty heavy on my skin at first but quickly absorbs. Also have to mention that the packaging is so cute! I’m a fan and will continue to use this product!

This moisturizer is definitely super moisturizing but I didn’t like the greasy feel that stuck around after I put it on. It didn’t absorb into my skin and is very thick. It would probably be great for someone with very dry skin but it wasn’t great for my normal skin. I do love that it’s unscented and vegan though!
Great moisturizer for dry skin . The moisturizer was much thicker than I thought it would be, but it did a great job of soothing my dry skin!

Obsessed with this moisturizer!! It is so thick that I use it in my nightly routine. It has a very gentle scent. It has honestly made my skin GLOW. I’ll definitely be purchasing the full size product once I run out of complimentary one!

Wow! This was perfect to have in the winter and saved my skin from looking dull and dry in the cold weather. When I first received this product I thought it looked super thick and was worried because I don’t like anything too tacky on my skin. This however literally felt like it just melted into my skin. I started out just using it as my night cream and I woke up with my face thanking me with a nice glow! I decided to try it in the AM even though it is so thick and I was impressed that my makeup managed to stay on and it didn’t make my face super oily at the end of the day. I am a big fan that it contains clean products and also that it lacks a strong scent. That can be so hard to find these days. I also wanted to mention I usually have combo skin and am acne prone and this did not break me out!! Definitely worth trying if you haven’t already. I did receive this product complimentary for testing purposes but all opinions are my own.
I received this from Influenster and it’s just ok. It’s a very thick moisturizer and it has to warm up on my skin in order to rub it in and I just prefer other moisturizers

review_title: Feels so great on my skin!
review_text: I have been raving about this moisturizer and recommending it to friends who are looking for a clean product! Really has my skin feeling smooth and moisturized. So glad I got to try this in my vox box because this is my new daily moisturizer.

Love. I am usually more drawn to gel based moisturizers because i feel like others just sit on my skin, but this one is different. I love how this moisturizer is so thick but still you can feel it working without just sitting on your face. After an hour I just feel like my face is fresh soft and glowy!

Just like everyone else, I bought this to combat the cold Midwest months. My skin is so dry right now so I wanted something thick to help get my skin back on track. After a few days of using though I noticed tiny pimples all over my forehead, nose, and jaw line. My skin was also not any more moisturized than before I started using it. So disappointed! I’ve never had a product break me out like that before! I’ll still recommend this product for those that don’t have such sensitive skin

review_title: wish I could give it 4.5 stars
review_text: I’ve been really enjoying this moisturizer. My skin is sensitive dry/combo and gets very dry during the winter. Most popular moisturizers don’t moisturize enough so I’m always searching for a thicker cream. The consistency of this is really thick and it spreads almost like lotion. It didn’t give me any irritation or allergic reactions which is a big plus, most products can. I also appreciate how unlike other thicker creams it doesn’t leave me looking greasy or too wet- it dries down almost matte and smooth. I wish it was a little more intense but I can supplement with a hyaluronic acid serum. Excited to see how this works under makeup!

I received this product from Influenster to review, and I have to say i really enjoy it so far. It’s only been a week of use and I really enjoy this moisturizer! It’s very thick and heavy feeling, so I’d only use it at night before bed because this would definitely be oily if I applied this in the morning. It sits well with my other nighttime skincare routine products and only has minimal fragrance which I really enjoy.

This is a great moisturizer! The smell isn’t too overbearing which is always a huge plus. The consistency of it makes it great to use at night, or in the morning on dry, cold days. It’s great if you’re seeking that extra hydration for your skin in the Winter months. I love that it’s Vegan as well, so I can be sure of what I’m putting on my skin.
Great! Pretty standard for a moisturizer but I like that it’s chemical free

This product was one of the best. I have really bad sensitive skin which is why it makes my face dry. This product on the other hand made my face feel clean and wonderful. I also love the package makes you excited to see what’s inside. But overall I would prefer you to try it, I received this product free with influenster. So go try it out, I hope it works for you like it did me!
This product is perfect with the cleanser. Feels really nice. And has no fragrance. This was a complimentary product.

review_title: I have no choice but to LOVE IT
review_text: I got this mini moisturizer in my Influenster box. They didn’t require me to write this review but it is a “bonus”— that doesn’t matter. The vegan milk facial wash?? Sooo stripping to my dry, sensitive skin. I did not leave the best review but THIS CREAM. ugh, it is truly nourishing without being overly greasy. It may be a little too much for oily skin (but a great winter option for oily skin). My dry, sensitive skin loved this cream, and while it has several moisturizing ingredients— specifically I love the the jojoba and aloe vera— it doesn’t clog your pores and therefore cause acne like some super heavy creams. Also god bless that it is fragrance free, cruelty free, and vegan
This moisturizer spread soooooo nicely. You only need a little bit! I used the same amount i use for my other moisturizer and it spread all the way down past my boobs lol (i usually moisturize face
This moisturizer is frangrance free which is my favorite part of this product. This is good for my sensitive skin! Helps with dry skin also. I have received this product for free to review.

I found this moisturizer to be of good quality and really loved he packaging. I have clear skin, but can’t use anything too heavy. I liked this moisturizer but it was just a tad heavy for me, but for people who don’t hace sensitive skin it would be great
Thank you Milk! Great vegan moisturizer for winter. I got this just in time to use it during winter. It is creamy without having a heavy weight and exactly what my super dry skin needs.

review_title: Love this product especially for night time use!
review_text: Great moisturizer; I feel that it does exactly what it is supposed to do and gives my skin a really healthy glow. My skin is acne prone and although the consistency is a little on the thicker side, so far I haven’t had any issues with my pores getting clogged. I also like that it has no scent and therefore great for sensitive skin. This moisturizer is especially great for night time use!

This is one of the best moisturizers I’ve ever used. It’s thick and rich, but doesn’t leave a sticky or oily residue which is great for my combination skin. It creates a great base for my foundation and makeup and it looks great! The moisture lasts a long time, and it mixes well with additional oils for days when my skin is extra dry.
Loving this moisturizer. I traveled to Brazil which was super hot and this moisturizer wasn’t too heavy on my face, used it twice a day.

First of all-cutest packaging! This has been so great for my dry skin. I have very sensitive skin and so far it has not been irritated and I have not experienced any breakouts. I did receive this for free to review.

Feels kinda heavy until it soaks in but feels great after. I use it very heavily at night and lightly with another moisturizer in the morning. Smells weird, but I’m sure it’s bc there’s not an actual fragrance. I received this product for free from Influenster to review but that doesn’t change my opinion.
I received this product complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes. However, I would purchase this product on my own. The packaging is sleek.  This product works great!

I received this product as a part of an Influenster campaign and I was super excited as I’m a huge fan of the brand. Overall, I liked this product, however I wouldn’t recommend using it during the day time as it is VERY thick and it takes a bit of time to sink in. It’s very moisturizing which is great for my skin as it’s dry normally, but it’s chapped and flakey dry during the winter. I use it at nighttime and it has been saving my skin from the cold dry winter weather.

This moisturizer is absolutely AMAZING! Hands down the best one I honestly think I have ever used. I have extremely sensitive skin and this did not irritate me at all and in fact, healed my skin more than any other has in a very long time (if not ever). I cannot recommend this enough and, i also want to add, if you have normal- dry skin you will probably like this best. Others, I would simply use at night. It is not sticky at all and sinks right into the skin (won’t even get on your pillow at night). Amazing amazing product!!

This is a very hydrating moisturizer! I love the way my skin feels after using it.  However, it is on the THICKER side and doesn’t glide on the face smoothly. It feels heavy and a bit oily at first. This is why I have to give 4 stars. It does get the job done and leaves your skin hydrated. Just keep in mind that you will feel this on your face! It can also make you look too oily at times. I can rub the shine off my face after several hours so the absorption isn’t the best. I received this product from influenster for free to review!

review_title: Rich Texture, but not a dewy finish
review_text: I thought this moisturizer would have a dewy finish since it’s tailored for dry skin, but to my surprise it leaves a non greasy satin finish. It gives my skin enough moisture where my skin feels hydrated, but not overly greasy where it feels like oil is sitting on my skin. It absorbs fairly quickly when you rub into the skin, but does leave a slight film. I think this is great for normal skin. It has a really rich texture almost like a hybrid between a balm and moisturizer. Jars are not my favorite since you have to dip in and sanitary reasons, but I think it is the right component as it might be too thick for a pump. Overall I love this moisturizer, but think if you have dry skin you might not like the satin finish and want a dewier one like the tatcha luminous dewy cream.
Love this product! Doesn’t have a scent and it does not clog my pokes or make me break out.

To start off, putting this moisturizer on feels like putting on cold cream. It’s too heavy And thick for me everyday but I live in a super mild climate. When I went up north to visit family over the holidays, this was super handy for my dry skin that was not used to be abused by the cold weather.

This moisturizer was too heavy for my skin. It has a thick texture that would provide amazing coverage for someone with dry skin. It made me breakout but my skin is rarely happy when trying new products. I have used the moisturizer on my hands Or patches of really dry skin and have had wonderful results!

review_title: Great moisturizer for the winter time
review_text: To start off, I have combination skin but it turns extremely dry in the wintertime cause I live in Chicago. The packaging is so beautiful and really stands out alongside my other skincare bottles. The only thing I personally don’t like is the consistency.. it reminds me of a body butter and I prefer my creams to be moisturizing but more on the lightweight side. It’s fragrance-free which is amazing for my sensitive skin and really is hydrating, but I think I have yet to see any other mindblowing results. I use it in the morning on days where I’m not wearing make up and my face only starts to feel a tad dry when it hits the 5-6 hour mark. Overall it’s a great daily moisturizer, and I think the formula would help ladies who have really dry and sensitive skin. I received this product as a free sample.

I received this complimentary from Influenster and it is amazing!! So lightweight and does not have a scent. Portable so you can carry it on the go with you and does the job. Also amazing that it is made with vegan products so it is clean and good for your skin. Highly recommend!!

I received this for free through Influenster to try and let me just say THICC. I kind of like it though because so little goes such a long way. I tried it and the next day i had really dry skin and flaky ness. It could just be me because I’ve been traveling a lot but it was just strange. The product may work, but I have weird skin

A nice consistency - not too heavy and not too slimy. I have been using it for over a week now and would recommend. I love the way it feels going on my face and how it makes my face feel afterwards. My skin gets dry in the winter and this soaks into my skin perfectly and gives it a nice finish. I will keep using this product!

The formula is creamy and absorbs well. I have yet to decide how moisturizing it really is because its winter and my skin tends to stay on the dryer side. When i use the moisturizer at night, my skin gets incredibly oily so i have avoided using it during the day. The formula itself spreads well, its not super thick, which i like a lot. A little goes a long way.

I received this product for free through the Influenster app, it does the job, I like that it’s vegan/cruelty free, however my skin has been EXTREMELY dry in the recent months so it hasn’t been too hydrating for me personally. But I think it may work well for others!

This product is very moisturizing and calming to my skin. I have combination skin and this product moisturizes the dry areas and does not cause the oily areas to be greasy. My face felt fresh all day using this product and after about a week of using my skin felt really soft and velvety.
10/10 would recommend. I was so surprised that this rich, creamy formula was not too heavy for my combo/oily skin. It’s incredibly pleasant, not greasy, and leaves my skin so smooth.
If I could leave a 10 star I would. New favorite moisturizer and I use a lot of different skin care. I’m obsessed. It’s actually incredible

Love this product. It does come on thick so If you are looking for something lighter this is not the product for you. I love this for nighttime moisturizing — my skin feels amazing the next morning. After using it for a week I can definitely say this will become a standard part of my nighttime routine moving forward.

This moisturizer is super thick and a little really goes a long way! However, it takes a little to soak in and has a greasy feeling when applying if you do not have dry skin that really needs the hydration. Doesn’t make me oily but the feeling of it when applying is enough for me to dislike this product. Good for those with dry skin!

This lotion is great, it hydrates really well and has a lovely creamy texture. It soaks in quickly and left skin feeling refreshed. Living in midwest in the winter, I will say I need an even more hydrating lotion, so I think this would be better for less dry climates/seasons.

I was super stoked when I received this product as a free gift because I love Milk products, this did not disappoint. I know a lot of the other reviewers say it’s really thick, I would disagree. It is much lighter than many other facial moisturizers that are marketed as ultra moisturizing. Before receiving this product I was using Skin Drink by Lush, I would say this product is comparable, if not better. It applies really smooth and absorbs into thirsty skin quickly without leaving much of a residue. I would absolutely recommend this product, especially for the winter months.

I absolutely ADORE this moisturizer! I use it at night with my Drunk Elephant TLC night serum and my skin is smoother and softer than it’s ever been. The moisturizer is super thick and creamy and doesn’t leave any weird residue the next morning. It definitely soaks into my skin and leaves me feeling super hydrated, especially during the winter time when my skin needs a little extra love. It’s also unscented and has amazing ingredients. This has become a new staple in my everyday routine! I love it!
I am absolutely in love with this moisturizer! If you have super dry skin you would absolutely love this. It is more of a thicker cream and its extremely hydrating.

I absolutely love this moisturizer! The product is packaged in the cutest lime green container. The moisturizer consistency is very thick when you first apply it, but in good way. It is perfect for the winter months, especially if your skin gets dry or flaky. The moisturizer melts into the skin and doesn’t leave it feeling oily or sticky. It’s also great that it is unscented, made of natural ingredients, and is super delicate for the skin. I definitely recommend this product for everyone to try!

I received this product free for testing purposes and to be honest, I was very skeptical at first. However, I fell in love with it the very first time I used it and I continue to love it more and more every day. It has an amazing texture and my face doesn’t feel sticky/weird like it usually does after any sort of moisturizer. My skin looks brighter and feels so soft after using it. I have never been big into face moisturizers but this one is absolutely amazing. I highly recommend it.

I love this moisturizer! At first I used a thin layer when applying it but after a few minutes my skin was getting tight and dry in a few areas. then i applied another layer and it was perfect. Its not oily at all and skin feels so hydrated especially when i wake up in the mornings. I totally recommend this.

AMAZING. Can’t rave about this product enough. I have used Clinique moisturizer for years and this now be my new go to. Thick consistency but lightweight upon application. Also has the cutest packaging!

This is a lovely vegan moisturizer that DOES NOT skimp on the moisture! This is fabulous for dry skin and feels rich and thick when applied. It isn’t super light-weight which can be rough on the oilier parts of my skin, but I’ve been mixing this with a lighter moisturizer and it’s been doing the job. n.b. I was given this product in exchange for my review.

I received this product free to test out and i actually really like it! I have very sensitive skin and have been searching for a moisturizer that suits my skin type. With the weather being very cold and dry this product helps and hydrates well. It does leave a bit of a greasy feel around my nose and forehead areas but doesn’t last long. Over all really like this product.

So I noticed this doesn’t have any reviews yet so I’ll be the first to write one... I LOOOOVEEEE THISSSSS!!!! I have dry skin and this is it y’all; you dont need a lot of product and I normally use caudalie vinosource SOS hydration but this will get me through when i dont wanna spend $42 on a moisturizer, LOVE THISSSS!!

Love it so much! I struggle with acne, redness, and texture. After less than a week, my skin is smoother and less red, and no new pimples have come up. It’s thick and creamy in texture, so you don’t have to use much at all. It still soaks in really nicely which is hard to find with thick moisturizers. Bonus that it’s natural! Highly recommend.

This moisturizer leaves your skin baby soft! It feels kind of thick but it soaks into your skin really well! It doesn’t leave your face oily or sticky just SOFT! It is very gentle. It doesn’t have a scent to it at all and the packaging is super cute. The fact that it’s vegan makes it even better! I will definitely be repurchasing.

I honestly can’t yet comment on the effectiveness of the product having just used it for one day, but I will say the fragrance in this serum is really off putting. I dislike it so much I don’t know if I can continue use. It’s a strong floral scent, so heads up for those who don’t love strong fragrance in their skincare.

this hydrates my skin very well. I am not 100% sure about the dark spot because I have not seen any changes. The Ordinary products are definitely more effective than this when it comes to dark spot correction but Caudalie is so gentle on my skin so I go with this.
No result. It smells good and your skin is smooth after applying it. But your blemishes are still there after so many usage.

I received thus product as a complimentary from topboxcircle  in exchange for my honest feedback. I have been using this product for a few weeks now and I absolutely love it! I have old acne dark spots on my face and I am so pleased with how bright and radiant this has made my skin. This serum is silky and goes on so smoothly. I am all for paying for the quality of products and this is definitely worth the treat.

#trywithtopbox sent me this #freeproduct to try. I have been using this serum for almost a month now. It leaves my skin super soft I use it 2 a day every day. Im just starting to notice my dark spots are getting lighter. I would definitely buy this serum again!

Totally in love with this brand. I have received this product complimentary from topbox and would say this is worth it if you are facing discoloration.My skin has small discoloration which gets more pronounced in summer but using this product helped me lighten my skin tone and make sure its balanced throughout. Totally worth it.

I received this #freeproduct from #trywithtopbox about 2 weeks ago and it’s working for me. I’m using it with night cream and very happy with the results. Lightweight and quickly absorbs into skin. My skin is more glowy and dark spots are less visible. One can clearly feel a difference. So happy to find a solution which actually targeting the problem areas.

This is my first time trying this brand and I love it. The serum comes in sturdy glass bottle and is white in color. The dropper design is nice to get product in right amount. The serum is milk like texture and has unique smell that reminds me of herbs everytime I apply it. The smell fades after applying though so people who do not like fragranced products don’t need to worry. I have added this serum in my morning routine. I use it after cleanser and before moisturizer. I have oily/combination skin and did not find any heavy or sticky feeling after applying. It did cause redness and irritation around my nose area after applying so I avoid using it in that area and results are good. It gives matte look to skin without overdrying it. Skin looks clean and even after use. I would recommend it to all and really happy to have tried this.

I received #freeproduct from #trywithtopbox to give my honest review. I have been using Caudalie Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum for about 2 weeks and have seen a noticeable change in my skin. Especially the dark spots left by acne have faded, the skin is brighter and more moisturized. I would use this serum first and then use a moisturizer to lock in the moisture. It doesn’t feel greasy and absorbs quickly into the skin. I have known Caudalie and trust its skin care products very much, so I am very pleased to try this product, and will buy it again next time. I will recommend to my relatives and friends to buy and try it.

This serum has a light, watery texture that spreads over my face easily and absorbs quickly. That lightweight consistency so it’s perfect for dry to normal skin without being too much. It features a signature scent, with notes of fresh citron blossom, orange leaves, watermelon and crushed mint that makes application even more pleasant. Once settled, my skin feels super smooth and soft with no trace of sticky or greasy feel. I apply this once in the morning and at night, and the included hygienic dropper provides some much-appreciated precision, because you don’t need much for full coverage. I have some concerning dark spots around my face, mainly my cheek and eye area, so I am hoping to see results with more continued use, but even in this short time my skin feels softer, with a texture that’s smooth and brighter. #freeproduct #trywithtopbox

Literally love this, makes my skin feel so soft and plump, also really good for dark spots I got a sample version of the free gift I wish it wasn’t so expensive so I could buy it. Also doesn’t make me break out i have sensitive skin and it calms my skin down and prevents breakouts and shrinks my pimples if I have hormonal break outs
Very nice, non greasy, texture quite light. But quite expensive almost $100 for only 30ml
Visibly brighter skin. Repeat purchase for me, even stocked up at Duty Free at the airport.
Received it as a sample - liked the product. Didn’t make my face shiny.

review_title: They changed the formula, not for the better : ((
review_text: This used to be my holy grail hydrating serum. I’m not sure if it ever helped with my melasma patches, but was unique and worth every penny for its dewy, non-sticky formula.. Suddenly the bottle design looked different, and the serum felt like it had something slippery or siliconey added, and has lost the non-slippery hydration I loved.  It’s still good, but I’m not a fan of slick siliconey feeling serums, so I likely won’t repurcchase.

I’m not sure this is doing anything for the spots I was trying to rid myself of, I don’t think 2~3 weeks is long enough to tell. But the small sample I had lasted a while, and for the duration of use my overall skin tone was much more evened out. I also like that this product seems very gentle. I am likely to return and purchase the full-sized version and put it into the regular rotation when I’ve finished trying out all the other products I’m curious about.
Meh. I didn’t notice a difference in my skin. Super disappointing for something this expensive. It smells and feels nice though, which is why I gave it 2 stars.
Good product. Works for some wrinkles ( not going to remove wrinkles, if this is your goal then don’t spend your money) For sure gives your skin fresher look.

Love this product! Using this and the night time cream for my acne scarring dark spots and it has done wonders. I have struggled with dark spots and finally found something that works! I have tried everything!!!

I have been using this product for over a month and I am super pleased with the results!  As I roll into my mid-30s, I am definitely seeing the beginning signs of aging. Significant problem areas include sun spots under my eyes and newly enlarged pores on my nose/cheek area. My pores look soooo much better after incorporating this serum into my routine. There is a noticeable improvement in the evenness of my skin tone. I use one dropper-full, once a day (morning or night depending on mood) and that covers my face, neck, and upper chest. I should also mention that I use this product in tandem with the Caudalie Vinoperfect Instant Brightening Moisturizer with Niacinamide or with the Caudalie Vinoperfect Brightening Glycolic Overnight Cream. The ingredients list gets a big thumbs up- vine sap that’s more than 60x effective at brightening than vitamin c? Crazy good. I have been using a serum with L-ascorbic acid for years and it’s nice to switch things up, while feeling confident that I’m still feeding my skin. Yes, there is a scent to this serum but it’s truly inoffensive. I have had the best experience with this serum!! #freeproduct #trywithtopbox

#freeproduct I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I love this serum! My skin looking brighter and glowy after using, and I love that this is a brightening serum that doesn’t contain vitamin c (my skin is sensitive to it). It has a really earthy scent, which I love. If you’re looking for a serum that helps with the texture and look of your skin, but isn’t necessarily hydrating, this would be a great serum to try

Caudalie Radiance Serum is amazing for my skin. It’s smooth and smells light and pleasant. My skin looks radiant, from day one this product has worked for my skin. I recommend this product, a little goes a long way. I like the packaging and glass bottle with the dropper. It’s so clean smooth, and worth the price.

I couldn’t wait to use this every day! In one week my skin seemed more even toned and I loved the slight citrus smell! Even a friend of mine asked me what I was using. Best compliments! Will keep using hoping for even more improvement over time.#freeproduct

I’ve used this product for at least 3 years now and I truly cannot find a better serum for my acne scars! After several uses, I noticed that my spots were getting lighter and my redness was reduced. I don’t think it claims to help with pimples, but when I do end up with hormonal acne or pimples by trying out a new face product, it always helps make the pimples go away that much faster and reduced the overall appearance. The times that I have ran out of this and hadn’t repurchased it, my complexion was uneven and I could tell I needed to buy this serum again. This has a very very faint scent but goes away and I will say that the 1oz bottle only lasts for a few months when used every night (I only use this at night after a regular wash, exfoliating wash or mask). Highly recommend making the investment over other serums!

Okay...so I wanted to love this product. I had been purchasing the small sizes with my points every time I saw it, and finally but the bullet and bought the full size. It sits only 1/4 used on my product shelf for months now. I gave it a fair shake and used it daily as instructed for nearly two months. Did my skin feel softer? Yes. Did I notice better evenness? No. Did I like the smell and feel? Yes. Was it worth nearly $80? Mehhhh. I could take it or leave it.

I don’t usually write product reviews, but I really wanted to give a shoutout to this one. I’ve been using this product since 2019 to get rid of a dark sun spot on my left cheek—mainly caused by every day commute and all the UV exposure to the left side of my face as I drive. This patch has lightened considerably, to the point that I don’t need to use this serum as much as I did at the beginning. Like every good social scientist/researcher, I believe more in the effects of longitudinal studies, and I’d say over a year’s time of observation is sufficient proof of this product’s effectiveness. (The one confounding variable is I don’t need to drive as much as I used to since March of this year, so arguably, that side of my face has not been exposed as much as it used to be, but even before March of this year, I had noticed significant improvement, so I still give much credit to this product.)

I initially received this as a birthday gift several years ago and it really worked on my melasma.  When I tell you, this review should have been written years ago.  I love this product.  It actually worked and help to fade my melasma.  It makes me sad when I say it stopped working after a year of using it.  I don’t think it the product but my melasma getting worse and more difficult to handle.  But this my fact look beautiful. I am thinking of repurchasing since I am going through so many different products that are not working.  Hoping it will work again.  We will see. but I still love the product.

This is my favorite skincare product of all time. I’ve always had acne, and although this is not specifically an acne product, it has helped so much clearing and smoothing my skin. After i started using this i was actually able to not wear makeup on my face. I’ve been using for a couple years and will continue to buy it!

I have received multiple samples of this over the years, but never used them.  I received some samples in a recent order and thought I’d give it a try.  Wow!  I used it twice a day for a week and even my husband said how nice my skin was looking.  I have some discoloration that popped up during chemo treatments and this is helping to even everything out.  I bit the bullet and bought the bottle.  It’s pricey but it works.

This is a nice product but not worth the price. I got a 2 weeks trial of this and used it every night and saw little to no difference in my skin. I do not usually use products with added fragrance but took the chance anyways. Thankfully it did not break out my sensitive skin and was not over powering. But for the price I would not purchase this because I saw no changes. Save your money and try something else.

This is always in my skincare routine! It helps with texture and make my skin glow. I’ve noticed it even out my skintone, with other products that I also use for hyperpigmentation. You have to be consistent with it to get the results. Just ordered my 4th bottle.
This serum is amazing!!! This is the only product that helped remove my dark spots from acne and overall made my skin beautiful and plump!

review_title: This is the serum of all serums ✧・ﾟ:*
review_text: This product deserves its price point and its rave reviews.I remember putting it on once per day for a week, and noticed that my skin felt like a new baby’s butt!For reference, I have had eczema and KP and generally allergy-prone irritable skin my whole life, and KP on my face around my jaw (let me know otherwise if it sounds like something else). My face never felt soft, no matter what moisturizers, oils, or natural whatever I put on my face.This serum completely improved the texture, and with minimal use. I was so pleasantly surprised because I wasn’t expecting it.The price is a little steep, but they keep offering the full-size sets for the same price with extra products, which is really awesome. And for the fact that it actually creates a noticeable difference, I’d rather buy this every so often then go through other stuff that don’t make much of a difference.

This product was the holy grail for my hormonal acne! As a sophomore in high school, my skin was the worst it had ever been and so was my self esteem. My mom walked into Sephora and asked a worker there for recommendations for dark spots from picking at acne (which is that I did daily). She recommended this product, and after a few weeks, I could see all my dark spots start to disappear. I had never felt more beautiful, honestly.I also used Caudalie’s moisturizer, essence, and beauty elixir. All products worked nicely with this serum as well. The only reason why I did not give this 5 stars is because of the price. This truly changed my life because I gained confidence in myself after my face cleared up.

review_title: ONLY Product That Removes Dark Spots - MAGICAL
review_text: It is the ONLY thing that gets rid of my blemish spots after a pimple has healed. It clears up everything and lets my real skin show through! SO SO SO worth the money!!

I used Caudalie as a sample size at first and saw a visible improvement in my skin. Definitely brightened my complexion and lightened up my dark spots. It’s helped a ton with my deep acne scars as well. Well worth the price and I’ve made it a staple in my skincare routine.

I purchased the set, which included this serum. A store employee suggested this to me for my hyperpigmentation. She said it really helped her so I bought into it. When I first started using it, I was using too much and it made my skin very oily. I cut down the amount I was using and that remedied the oiliness. I finished the bottle and did not notice much of a difference on my hyperpigmentation. It did make my pores appear small, and have some sort of glow. I repurchased the kit because my mom liked the glow it gave her skin. We have both moved on from this product now and will not be repurchasing it.

This is a forever product. I have been using it for 2 months now since I developed adult acne. Be patient with your skin and trial and error ladies. It is easy to overdue it but believe me less is more. Find the products that work for your skin and stick to it.  Listen to your skin it will tell you if you are overdoing g it...back off. Anyway this product is amazing for treating post inflammatory acne hyperpigmentation ( those dark spots). No result immediately but over 2 wk I noticed some improvement now if you combine it with Caudalie glycolic acid overnight treatment , Wow! It enhances the effect definitely a winner and yes expensive but believe me well worth. Once I am rid of the dark spot I will continue to use this alone.

After almost two months of using this product, it really didn’t do anything for my skin, I will say it gave my skin overall radiance  but as far as the dark spots/areas which is what I got this for and then do anything for them. Really sad that didn’t work out due to the price but yeah,will not be repurchasing.

review_title: Not so good for oily skin
review_text: Didn’t work for my combo/oily skin. Left sticky, greasy residue. My face felt sticky for more then 1 hour. Used it for a week, not sure if it is effective for dark spots since stopped using due to greasiness.

I have used this off and on for several years. Every time I start using it again, I wonder why I stopped. This serum is amazing it really help to even out my skin and leaves it feeling moist and soft. I used it when I was younger and had more oily/combination skin and acne. Now I’m older and my skin is dry, less acne but I have rosacea now. The serum worked great then and great now. Caudalie has amazing products that leave your skin feeling amazing. This serum works slowly though. You’ll notice a gradual change in your skin, so don’t get upset if it’s not an overnight fix. The wait is worth it.
This does a beautiful job at brightening the skin and making it look younger and healthier. And it smells like grapes!

Hands down one of the best serums I’ve ever used! This helps with my dark marks and texture while leaving my sensitive skin hydrated, refreshed and glowing. I’ll continue using this and will most definitely be repurchasing when I run out of it!

i was so excited to try this product and i assumed it would be great for my skin due to the price and it’s label as “clean.” i am sure it is a good product for more mature skin but i still get clogged pores and can breakout from certain things and this was the only thing i could link it to. i wish i didn’t spend 75 for it.

I’ve seen a lot of bloggers recommend it, but It didn’t work on me. The serum is so sticky and you have to use a moisturizer after applying it. Didn’t give me the glow or radiance I was hoping to see. It smelled like rose water which I don’t like. It didn’t work for me but it could work for you.
I have very very sensitive skin and this is one of the rare products that really work for me. So good, but so expensive.

I absolutely love this product and will continue rebuying every time I run out, even though it’s pricy. I feel like it gives my skin a beautiful texture and really does help minimize dark spots and pores. Obviously not every dark spot, but I feel like it just helps the overall look and feel of my skin. You only need a few drops at a time so it lasts for a while.

To be honest it’s taking a little longer for compliments on my face but on my neck and even my decollete I have been compliment on after two weeks of use.
