With this serum being light and able use with other products with no issue I’m willing to try it longer.

I love this serum so much! I got a sample and when I was finished I could definitely tell my skin looked supple and reduction in dark spots. I’m 25 with sensitive and dry skin. I have a couple really small darkish spots around my cheeks and this serum helps makes them less noticeable. I will usually wear it every morning and most nights. I purchased the full size!

I have a tan Latina skin. Dark spots are always a problem for me. This is my holy grail!! It works, smells amazing and leaves my skin super pretty. Got the face cream sample and not work perfect together if I use cream only at night.

Liquid foundation of youth and vitality. Love this serum. Lightweight and absorbs easily. I initially got this as a sample and couldn’t believe how well it worked. Loved it so much that I go the full size. But even the tiny sample size lasted a while. Get this for smooth radiant skin.
Have been using this for the past 6 months. Helps skin look more radiant and lighten dark spots. Love it! It’s pricey but will last 3-4 months. Worth the price
beautifully moisturizing
Horrible product and horrible brand. I never see or feel any results. This particular serum made me break out. I do not have sensitive skin.
I’ve tried ALL the serums that supposedly lighten age spots, and this is the one that works. Within a week, I noticed lightening. Can’t live without this one.
• perfect component as a part of your skin routine • refreshing, hydrating, light, soft
I saw no results from this product. in my opinion it is not worth the money.
LOVE this product! Leaves my skin feeling moisturized and maes it look glory and healthy! Would buy again!

This product isn’t worth the price tag. The ingredients mean this is a very basic skincare product that doesn’t deliver on multiple skin needs or concerns. Maybe you’ll see results on your unique face! But I do love the bottle, the dropper, and the fragrance!

review_title: In Love with this Natural Oil Free Serum
review_text: I love how bright and firm my skin feels when using this serum. I have sensitive skin that breaks out easily but this product is gentle and calming. I have less redness and a more even skin tone while using this serum. I feel good about the ingredients and the smell is very light. I will consider purchasing again as it lasts a long time for the price.
I am in absolute love with this product! It truly makes my skin feel so good and makes it glowy! I have to have more.
first time ever using a seruma little goes along ways smooth finish
I like this serum so much! The smell is strong. The serum feels good in the face. I definitely recommend it! I received this product for free from Influenster’s.

First received as a deluxe sample and liked it enough to purchase the full-size when the sample ran out. Very calming and helps to lighten red areas from past breakouts. Hydrating but not so much that it makes my moisturizer (La Mer Moisturizing Soft Cream) overkill. And it smells amazing.

I was very skeptical about getting the serum because it is very expensive but decided to give it a shot anyways just because I wanted to get some of my acne scars to go away. I’m already halfway through the bottle and They are disappearing! I really want to re-purchase this but I’m gonna wait until I am almost done with the bottle! I also will say this though this did last me a very long time so that’s really good!

Been using this product for 2 weeks now and I already can see the difference. My acne scars have faded a little. My skin is glowing and people have been noticing it too. I have combination skin and it works perfectly for me. It did not break me out and it made my skin care routine so much better.

I bought this in the Vinoperfect Serum Set that was sold a few months earlier. I love this serum because it smells great and does an amazing job of healing my acne scars or just the occasional blemish. I decided to finally write a review because it helped heal my skin from some acne bumps and mosquito bites that scabbed over. I try to use it sparingly because it’s quite pricey, but would say that it’s worth the money for what it does.

Didn’t notice a difference. I did peels, exfoliations and used this serum and also followed up with another Caudalie serum once I finished this. I have pasty and sallow skin with under eye circles and it didn’t do anything. I had also hydrated a lot, ate and drank juice, tea and foods rich in nutrients that promote radiant skin.
Fantastic serum!! Leaves skin smooth and bright.  Apply before your moisturizer or in place of one.
The best radiance serum I’ve ever tried. I’ve received so many compliments on my skin. Two of my friends have bought this product because they love my skin so much ❤️

I really love Caudlie products however I feel like this serum did not really live up to its name. It moisturized my skin very well however it didn’t brighten my dark spots or show any visible improvements to my skin. I was disappointed because I love Caudlie and this was pricey.

This is a ok product. I would say it does help me a little bit with the acne scars (only the new scars), my skin is more even skin tone and dewy (about 40%), but the thing is it’s super pricey and the result comes kinda slow. I would try to find something else that work faster. Will come back until I try all of my serum list.
This is a good light moisturizer but I didn’t see much of a difference with fine lines. I purchased a serum from juice beauty which I saw better results with.

Ive been using this for about a week now and it has taken away my redness and i can already see some sun spots fading away and some old acne scars. Its so light and smells lovely. I use the essence then this serum then the overnight cream. Im obsessed with this line!!

I have struggled with cystic acne and horrible scarring for years along both of my cheeks. I have really sensitive skin, so trying new products is hard for me because I often break out or react poorly to new products. After lots of research and looking at reviews, I decided to give this product a chance. I use about four drops, day and night, following toner and I follow up with a moisturizer afterwards. After a few uses, my skin started to feel healthier, softer, and hydrated. It wasn’t until a month or so in that I started to notice my dark spots lightening up and healing. It helps keep my skin hydrated throughout the day. It’s been a few years now and I have lost count of how many bottles I’ve gone through. It’s one of my holy grails and when I don’t use it, I visibly see a difference in my skin (more dull, doesn’t heal well, no glow). My skin has become more radiant, healthy, and many of my scars have lightened up/disappeared.This is not a stand alone product. It’s something to add to a skincare routine. It doesn’t solve for breakouts, but heals them better and maintains balance in your skin. I love this and would recommend to anyone looking for something to soothe, hydrate, and brighten.

I love this serum, it’s amazing.  The one thing I’m not a huge fan of is the price (it’s 39,20 euros in France, which is around 50 USD) but other than that, the serum is magical.  I really love the product a lot, I just with that in the States it was more affordable.

Mediocre product. Was using a sample for almost 2 months. Honestly didn’t do anything earth shattering to my skin. Especially for $80. I gave stars cause it smells amazing and feels nice on the skin. Did it make my skin radiant? Ha, not really. Really nothing noteable from this product....very average.

My skin is very sensitive so i try not to use serums just good moisturizer.This one is the only one that does not clog my pores.Ingridients are fantastic no harsh chemicals.Smells wonderful very light and skin looks great!

I got this as a birthday sample. I use it at night, layering it with other serums. I’ve definitely seem an improvement over the last couple of weeks. Today, my skin was glowy and dewy, which never happens. I’m not sure if I’ll purchase the full size. It’s so expensive.
This product in combination with the matching moisturizer will make your skin feel like silk. Perfect to be used night and day.  Worth the price

When I first got my skincare birthday gift set from Sephora I was super excited to try this out! I’d heard really good things about it, plus I absolutely love caudalie products. Let me just say it didn’t disappoint! You start to see results after using the serum for a couple of weeks – brighter, glowing skin! I ended up getting the full size during the VIB sale; while I do believe it’s a bit overpriced, like many people say: naturally beautiful looking skin is worth it. I’d highly recommend this product and others by Caudalie!
Now I can see why there is only a few left, people love this serum.  I hope I can get the full size! Thank you Sephora for the birthday present as my face shows it! Younger, brighter and so smooth!

I used this in conjunction with the Vinoperfect Brightening Essence. It absorbs fairly well, though it feels a little sticky (but in a moisturizing way). Others reported fantastic results that I just haven’t seen. In the end, for me the Resveratrol Lift Serum works much better. I do think this product is high-quality; building a good skincare regimen involves finding the product that works best for you, and I suspect this would work well for others.

31 Jul 2017the perfect serumI received this as my birthday gift from Sephora, along with the Moisturizing Sorbet, and I absolutely love it! My skin is softer and brighter. It adds a nice pretty glow. It absorbs into the skin quickly, never any oily type residue. Just soft, smooth, glowing skin. It has a very suttle but appealing citrus smell. This is definitely worth the money!

I received this for my Sephora birthday gift and right away I was amazed. Light weight and silky smooth. I put this on before my moisturizer and with Caudalie crème sorbet hydratante that also came in the birthday gift. My skin is glowing and looks healthier even after I’ve washed my face after a long day the glow stays. This is a product I will definitely be purchasing in the near future.  (It beats my normal serums price point and will save me $10) I am reviewing this as a part of a contest

review_title: Great for anyone with combo or dry skin
review_text: Super light weight formula. Smells like sweetness and blends in easy. I use it at night in my trouble spots and hope to decrease some spots from sun damage. I wouldn’t want to wear under makeup being an oil. Nice birthday sample!

After receiving a sample from Sephora’s Birthday gift. I fell in love with this serum. Very nice and lightweight, I applied right after toning my skin and it spreads and absorbs evenly. It has little to no smell and my skin always felt great and soft after using. I will definitely add this serum to my skincare routine.
It really does leave my skin feeli g radiant and clean. It has a nice smell. It doesn’t make my skin feel icky or greasy.  I love this produce so much. I got it free for my birthday gift.

I get this product as a Sample gift for my birthday. I took my time to try it before make any review and I love this Serum. After a week using it morning and night I feel my skin so radiance and glow also very moisturize and soft. the best thing of all is that I really see a difference in unify my skin tone specially under the eyes area. the essence is so Natural herbal/ Chamomile smell. The only inconvenient is the price is a little bit spensive.

I usually don’t get anything from caudalie because it tends to be a pricier high end brand and I’m a college student on a budget lol but this was given to me as a gift. I love this serum! It makes my face so smooth and moisturized! The smell is ok but overall I like this. I am writing this review for a contest.
A bit pricey but a little goes a long way !
Has an amazing texture and scent. Makes my skin feel incredible. After just a few uses I can already see the radiance! I am reviewing this as part of a contest.
I like this on my skin because I feel like it soothes it and it also helps hydrate my skin. I’ve only been using it for a couple days now and it helps make my face look brighter.

I’ve enjoyed using this serum so far! I’ve been using it for about two weeks now, and while I haven’t seen a dramatic improvement in my complexion, I have noticed some improvements. From the other reviewers experience, results are coming after further use. The consistency of the serum is very nice, and I enjoy the clean smell as well. My face feels incredibly soft after use, so even if I don’t notice results for several more months, I will continue to use this serum! I am reviewing this as part of a contest :)

Absolutely amazing! I’ve only used the serine for a week and i already see the difference in my skin. Not only is my skin more radiant my blemishes have been slowly disappearing too. I also love the perfume smell that it has. I’m excited to see how much more my skin will improve as time goes on
light on the skin, perfect for making your complexion glow and look much more clear. fragrance is light and nice as well; not overpowering.

I have really dry skin and after using this product for only 3 days so far, my skin is so soft and looks moisturized!I apply it after I thoroughly wash my face with an exfoliant, benzyl peroxide cleanser and then a salicylic acid face wash. I got this product to review as part of a contest so this is my first Caudalie product I’m using and I’m so happy with it!

I got this as a birthday gift from Sephora and I will be getting this again. The serum feels light on my face. It has a light scent to it. I have an uneven skin, and i’vr started to notice the difference, it’s starting to even out. It really smooths and hydrates my skin.

I received this as part of the birthday gift and must have received a product that was old. The serum was watery and sticky once applied to the skin.  I did not like the way it felt and don’t really want to continue using to find out if it does everything that is is supposed to do.  I’ll look for something else that feels better on my skin.

I got this as a birthday gift, and it made my skin soooooo soft and glowy, i loved it so much. the natural brightness and highlight it gave the high points of my face was stunning. only downside is the price... kinda pricy.

LOVE LOVE LOVE this balm. it feels like you’re applying butter. it adds a shimmer/glossy look to your lips. also hydrates them really well. only thing is that its a small amount for 18 USD, and you need to apply it pretty often.
Feels nice on lips while wearing it, however it did not help heal my chapped lips at all. It might have made them worse

First off you only get 1/2 an inch of product. Which is crazy for what you pay for it. It doesn’t stay on your lips long at all. I’m being generous giving it two stars. At least it doesn’t stink. But there are many other long lasting lip products that work better and last longer.
Great lip balm, little fragrance, long lasting.  And here is a tip I use it around my eyes....

review_title: Quantity of product Vs Money = Not fair
review_text: Good product. However, the amount of lip balm you get is not much.It is also worth to point that once you hit the bottom; you will need a tool or something to extract what’s left inside.In my opinion is not worth all the extra work.

I absolutely love. In my collection of lip balms this is not the most expensive but the one that performed the best for me - my lips drys in 10seconds if I don’t apply lip balm on it. Out of (dior lip balm&gloss / kiehls butterstick / glow receipe/ Bite) I really found this work for me the best. Appreciate the scent-free part too.
I love this product. It is super moisturizing! There was not as much product in the tube as I thought there would be. Otherwise, I really do enjoy using it!
Does NOT hydrate or  nourish dry chapped lips. This is the worst product from Drunk Elephant. Do not buy.
Nice balm but doesn’t do anything long term and you don’t get much product for the price. I’m still looking for a decent reasonably priced balm that keeps my lips hydrated.

To start, this lip balm is TINY. The balm itself doesnt last nearly as long as it should for the price. The lip plumping that is promised is extremely minimal, and the balm lasts about 3 weeks. Additionally, there was a quarter inch of product left in the tube that I wouldn’t be able to use unless I scraped it out
My new go to - super moisturizing and easy to find!
This product is small but amazing! Makes my lips feel like butter and surprisingly lasts a long time! My favorite lip balm! I love It so much I have Yet to lose it like all my others
Super nice as a everyday chapstick but it does run out really fast, I hope they make a bigger size.
I’m not sure if the formula has changed. But, it didn’t work nearly as well as it did when I used it about two years ago. It’s too pricey for minimal to no results. I will not be repurchasing.

I’ve never tried anything from DE before, but I like/trust the research they put into their formulas. This lip balm is incredibly expensive, but worth every dollar. I had high expectations for it, and even still I’m blown away. I use it 2-3 times a day, usually after I brush my teeth or if I notice they’re feeling dry through the course of the day. I noticed results almost immediately. Overall, its made my lips more supple, plump, soft/smooth. Of course it doesn’t magically stop lips from getting dry, but I’ve noticed that my lips are considerably less dry and never cracked like they used to (even compared to when I was using other chapsticks regularly). My biggest concern for my lips is them getting wrinkly lips as I age (I don’t know why I bothered about it because I’m only 21, but its probably my biggest worry for my appearance as I get older), and although this balm didn’t make my lips less lined than they are today, I think over time it will be preventative against more wrinkles/lines setting in as I get older. I don’t usually write reviews, but this balm really impressed me. I think its probably the best single skincare product I’ve ever tried in terms of results. I plan on also buying another when this runs out, and buying a second for under my eyes. Because it can also be used as an eye cream, the amazing results, and the confidence boost, I think this lip balm is beyond worth the money.
So hydrating and applies well. Don’t need to reapply often

This is a very hydrating & soothing balm for your lips, I`ll give it that. However, the product finished within 2 weeks of using it, which is unreasonable when considering the price. Would not purchase it again solely for that reason.

I rate this product 2 stars for many reason. 1) the price. $18 for a chapstick. Just no. 2) when I first purchased this product (a month ago) I thought it worked really well. The diameter of the tube was great because it coated my top and bottom lip at the same time, which was convenient, and it made them feel so smooth instantly. However, every 5 minutes I had to reapply and I thought that was because the product was so good and hydrating and my lips were just so dehydrated. Then I started to notice my lips and the skin around it got chapped and was peeling way more often the more I applied it, but I couldn’t just not apply it because the whole point was to counter dryness... that made me realize the product itself over drys my lips way too much and makes them peel too much as well. I shouldn’t be applying chapstick every 5-10 mins every single day. Upon reading some reviews today before I made my own, to see if anyone else had this problem, I realized they did. Will not be purchasing again.
Cute packaging, but this lip balm made my lips dry and peel.
Best lip balm ever! My lips are super dry especially in the winter and this really does the job plus it’s a clean product which I really enjoy.
Too expensive for the quality of the product. It really doesn’t do much. I usually love DE but not this product.
Did not work for my dry lips. In fact, it made my lips even drier with more cracks.

I wasn’t impressed with this product when I first received it but now after having it for 6 months I have to say first impressions aren’t always the best.  This is my go to product for dry chapped or cracked lips, within 1 day my lips are soft and kissable.  I have also started using around my eyes as recommended by manufacture and I love how it feels, time will tell the outcome.  Long story short, if you have dry chapped lips, this works likes a charm
Grabbed this as an impulse purchase at checkout. Feels nice going on, but quickly wears off. The large applicator is awkward. Not worth the money.

I collect the Fresh lip balms but I’ve switched over to DE for my skincare and thought I would try this. I like it better than the Fresh; it lasts longer and it doesn’t get sticky or greasy as it absorbs in. It’s expensive but the Fresh balms are $6 more and imo this product is better. Will buy again.

first off I want to say that I absolutely LOVE THIS PRODUCT....However, for the price and the size I would never buy it again.  VERY, VERY OVER PRICED.  This product should be closer to $15 not $25.  There is actually more packaging then product.  Very disappointed in the DE balm.  A better choice is definitely L’Occitane Organic Shea Butter in the small tin for $12 for 10ml.  That stuff is heaven!!!

review_title: Nice but not worth the absurd amount of money.
review_text: This feels very nice but there is a ridiculously small amount of product. $18 for about 2 weeks of use. Using it lightly once morning and night and it just might last a little longer. Yes, it’s nice but I will never spend $20 on a balm that costs pennies to make just because of the branding. Ridiculous!!
Works well, but for the price it should blow my mind.

Love this product!! My lips are normally so dry in the winter and this has been keeping them soft and supple. Love the packaging - I just throw in my purse and have had zero issues with the cap coming loose. My fav lip product!
I loved this balm but the size is meh. It’s too big for the lips and the packaging  feels cheap. The results are great for someone like me who has mature lips.

This lip balm doesn’t slip and slide under lipstick and it’s able to keep my lips moisturized all night, so it’s perfect to use for both day and night. The formula is not bad but it doesn’t stand out among my other fave lip balms. The stick itself is super chubby (very cute), but it takes some time for me to get used to.

This balm is such a lifesaver!  It is so nourishing, perfect for a dry winter rescue or after a full day of a liquid lip.  This is a new staple in my nighttime skincare routine.  I love applying it as the last step before I jump into bed.  Of course the lips, plus a couple pats in the under eye area leave me with perfectly moisturized skin in the morning. The formula reminds me of the Brazilian Kiss lip butter but without all the fragrance.  If you are in love with BK but the fragrance is too much for you, this is definitely a great replacement!  Grab a couple because you will definitely want one on your nightstand and one for your purse to keep on you at all times!

This is a good lip balm if you don’t mind having to reapply often. This just absorbed so quickly I felt the need for more in 20 minutes. Which would be fine if it softened and moisturised my lips to the point I didn’t need anymore but that wasn’t the case.

I love that this lip balm covers both my lips in only one swipe. It is completely scentless and clear, but has a bit of an oily sheen, which is a perfect base for applying lipstick on top, especially a formula that is matte and more drying. I was drawn to the size of the balm and its clean ingredients — I highly recommend!
I actually really like this lip balm--it moisturizes well, it is mildly plumping, and I do love the size and neutral/subtle scent! There is just not much of it relative to the cost

The product is fine as a lip balm. But didn’t find it works any better than lip balms that cost a fraction of the price. The packaging is an awkward size and difficult to apply without getting it all over your mouth area and not on just your lips. I’d skip this.

This is some gooooood lip balm! Pricey? Yes. Does it work? Oh heck yes! It’s rich in moisture and makes my (thin-ish) lips look plump and amazing. A new staple product for my handbag! Also, a little product goes a long way, so that makes it less of a splurge.
This is as nice options of chapstick for hydrate the lips! Ot doesn’t have fragrances or flavor but makes fells your lips so soft when you use it evenThe first time
Super Moisturizing! I love it more than my burts bees

I think this lip balm is pretty fancy, it has some nice ingredients. My lips do feel silky when I apply it as compared to cheaper waxy lip balms. I think it is cool that this balm can be used around the eye area, i did try it. I don’t know that I would spend $18 on this Lippe Balm, but I wouldn’t say that it is not a good product, it just could have  a slightly lower price point.
Love the smell and very moisturizing on the lips. A bit too expensive for the product though

I really like this lip balm. No fragrance is important to me. I love the width of it.  It goes on so smooth and silky and is great alone or under lipstick. I really like how it smooths my lines around the edge of my lip line. My lips definitely looked healthy and younger.

review_title: Does the job- a bit pricey for little product
review_text: This lip balm is very moisturizing although you don’t get as much product as I think you should for the price. I use this as a finishing touch in my morning and night skincare routine. There is no fragrance which I love! I received this product complimentary for testing purposes

While this product feels great on your lips, it doesn’t seem to have any long lasting results, requiring you to reapply often. I’m also wishing the packaging was a little different-it’s a wide tube and is awkward applying.

I love this lip balm! It feels great on my lips...not thick or sticky, yet it is mousturizing... I did take one star off because it says you can use it on the eye area and when I tried that it really dried out my under eyes...will continue to use this on my lips...I did receive this product for free for testing purposes from influenster.

Bringing lip balm to another level! This is extremely moisturizing. It feels really good on the lips and made my lips super soft and smooth. I also leave this in my purse in case I’m in need of a moisturizer for my hands and skin! Love that it’s multi purpose :)

This lip balm is very moisturizing but not greasy. It goes on smooth and has a soft formula so it’s not super hard like burts bees. It also seems to last for quite a while. The only downside is the price, since $18 is a bit steep for a lip balm that might end up getting lost. A good product but nothing extraordinary.

I received this product as a free sample. So I had not heard of this brand prior to receiving the items but when I looked around I heard great things about the product line. The balm is honestly okay it’s not revolutionary as I had thought it will be. It’s a simple balm and the ones that are medicated off the shelf do better in my opinion during winters than this but it’s good to use as a base underneath liquid lipsticks.

This is hands-down the best lip balm I have ever used! I have tried just about every brand for my extremely dry lips and this one adds instant moisture without feeling tacky or sticky. It feels so smooth on the lips and I actually use it as a base for lipstick quite often! I can’t recommend this lip balm enough! I will buy it again and again and again that’s how much I love it.

I don’t really have any complaints but the price point for this is really high and I don’t find it to be particularly special. I appreciate how it’s not super scented. Keeps my lips hydrated but seems like a normal average chapstick.

Drunk Elephant Lippe is a regular lip balm th it’s fragrance free. I’ve tried this out a few times and it’s definitely not enough moisture to put it on before bed. It feels moisturizing initially but doesn’t last very long on the lips. It’s ok for prepping lips for makeup. But I don’t think I would recommend this for the $18 price tag. There are better products for your money. I received this product complimentary from Influenster.
This lip balm is really nourishing and hydrating! I kind of like that the stick is so chubby and you get a decent amount of product. I definitely think it helped smooth my dry lips.

I love drunk elephant brand because of their clean ingredients, but it is a bonus when something works as well as this Lippie balm. My lips have been dry and peeling this winter, and as soon as I started using this balm, they started to turn around. Now my lips are flak free, soft and hydrated. I highly recommend this lip balm. Also the circumference is very large so it’s more of a one swipe instead of each lip.  Very impressive lip balm. Better than other hyped up brands that are trendy right now

review_title: Very small and pretty average for the price
review_text: This is a decent product. Very moisturizing. But, it’s tiny. Not sure it is that much different fromother lip balms to make it worth the price. My teen daughter is big on lip balms and borrowed this. She is also known for losing her lip balms. Not a big deal when it’s a cheap one. But I wouldn’t buy this for her for that price, and risk having it get lost. Doesn’t seem all that different from lip balms that are half the price, although I do like the wide top.

I like this ok for added lip moisture, but where this product really shines is for under eye balm. You can apply it all around the eye for moisture, really helps with that crepe under eye skin before applying concealer.

This product is pricey for a lip balm. But I like that it isn’t scented and works super fast to hydrate my lips. It does leave a greasy film for a little bit until it fully sinks in. Highly recommend though if you don’t mind splurging on lip balm.

I’m always looking for a new lip balm since myLips are chronically chapped! I was excited to try this product! It works well but it’s not super special and not something I would pay $18 for! I am always losing lip balms so spending that much on a product that does the same as a $5 one isn’t really my thing!

I actually really like this product. I use chapstick daily once it gets cold out but I never had one that leaves my lips moisturized without being greasy. I definitely see a difference once I started using the Drunk Elephant lip balm. It makes my lips feel hydrated and actually helps the dry spots recover. It also doesn’t have a strong scent which I really like.

I love DE products, but this one I would not repurchase. My lips get pretty dry in the winter and I thought this would be a game changer. Sadly it is not. It reminds me of portable Vaseline without the mess. I will finish what I have but would not recommend. Not worth the price.

Not worth the extra money. I had high hopes for this lip balm because of the brand name. I was looking for a nighttime lip treatment and this came up in my Sephora search. Once applied, it is light and sits on top of my lips instead of sinking in. It does not last long. It is better for daytime if lips need a light moisture. My search continues...

review_title: save your money, buy carmex instead for $1
review_text: I have chronically dry lips. I have been on accutane in the past (twice) and I live in a dry climate. I crave hydration and was hopeful this would repair and rejuvenate my poor dry lips, but it did not. Honestly, the carmex brand (yes the kind you get for $1 at target/walmart) was a lot better. Save your money and get that instead if you looking for rejuvenation/repair.
Was super pumped to try this, but it tastes really weird and leaves a weird residue on your lips. Not cute. :(

This product provides decent hydration, but for someone with incredibly sensitive and dry lips, I’ve found it doesn’t last too long and I’m often reapplying every 10 minutes when I wear this. For the price, I expected more but it feels like it just sits on top of my lips as opposed to hydrating. I’ll probably just stick to vaseline at this point - more effective and less expensive!

There were things about the formula that I liked -- it felt think and oily. It’s also a wide opening which is nice. But I didn’t get much softness out of it. That being said, I also had a cold at some point, and I scraped off some of the formula for my red, raw nose, and not only did my skin stop hurting but it made it so soft! So, I like it, but not for its intended use. If you’re part of a niche market for lip balms that can double up as a skin-saving salve then sure, it was pretty good. ;)

I’ve purchased so many different lip balms. From drugstore brands to the very expensive brands but this by far is the best! It not just moisturizes your lips temporarily, it improves the look and feel of your lips long after the product has worn off. I wear it every night before bed and in the morning my lips are amazingly soft.

Really like this product. I’ve gone through two of them already. Yes, you can find a lip balm for much cheaper - but this product is clean and the packaging is super cute. If you want to try something new with cute packaging, i recommend this product! Also, of course, does a good job at moisturizing the lips. It says you can use it around your eyes, i personally never tried it but thats a plus too!

I love this lippe balm. Is perfect. I only wish it was not so expensive. Tastes great, feels great, and works great. Cute packaging. Good ingredients that I do not mind wearing. Always on my Christmas wish list because i go through so many each year and feel horrible about the cost! But nothing compares that I found...Lost 1 star for price. LOVE the product. Is luxury (cute) and health conscious.

This is a fantastic lip balm. I absolutely love it and I have tried a million of them. BUT it is so expensive and runs out very fast. Not worth it to keep purchasing if I need a new one every two to four weeks.

review_title: It’s not that hard to apply!
review_text: I fell for this lippe after my sister let me try hers. It’s delightful. I like the texture & consistency. It’s true that it’s wider than a typical lipstick but is not too tricky to apply.
I did not know a lip balm could be so amazing. My lips are never dry after using this.
My lips love this in the winter!!!! It’s so smooth and hydrating!
I wish I didn’t love this so much because it is on the pricey side for a lip balm - but it works better than anything else I’ve tried and I have dry lips from working in a hospital with very dry air
Smells good. Feels good and keep lips hydrated!

This Balm is ok.  Pretty good.  I like it.  But for the price.... naw.   I’m a huge Drunk Elephant fan and do not mind paying a higher price for a great product.  This doesn’t make the cut for the price.  Too many other amazing options.
Super moisturizing lip balm for sure! But unfortunately won’t be buying again, just can’t justify the price.

review_title: fantastic as eye cream, barrier cream!
review_text: I love this product.  I originally recieved it as part of a DE set.  I had put this in my pocket on a snowy day outside and was using it as a lip balm.  As a lip product, it was good, but nothing remarkable.  Where this product shines is in its ability to multi-task.  My under eye area can get very dry and sore when I’m outside in the winter at 40 below at extended periods.  I found that using this both under my eyes, as well as on my cheeks that were freezing and dried out.  This something fantastic to have in your pocket if you’re outdoors a lot.  It moisturized as well as acted as a barrier cream.

Wish there were more stars to give this product. This is the best best lip balm ever... I live in Canada and it is very cold and hard on your skin. I purchased other pricey lip products and there were ok but I wanted something better, after researching I came across Drunk Elephant. I purchased in not expecting to love it so much.  It glides on your lips and has a subtle flavour that is pleasant. It isn’t sticky at all.  I fell in love with it immediately,  this has kept my lips soft and full. It actually plumps your lips and to be honest, I have felt there are times I don’t wear anything other than the lip balm because it’s THAT GOOD!  I am on to my second one and am completely hooked. I would recommend it over and over again... Happy Lips!
Feels okay for maybe 20 minutes but then wears off... Also it ran out way too quickly for the high price tag
Pretty good doesn’t make my lips peel but price wise eh

Positive - I liked the scentNegative - Broke me out around my mouth. Did nothing for my lips I couldnt already get from other cheaper brands. I was very disappointed as i had not tried anything from drunk elephant before.
I bought one for me and another for my daughter. We agree that it makes your lips softer than other “solutions” for chapped lips and the smell is not intrusive. It’s a win.

Moisturizing at first but then it started drying my lips to the point they were flacking. And the size of it is a little too big and weird to apply on the lips. I’m a DE fan! I’ve been using their serums and moisturizers for years but this product I don’t like a d don’t recommend.
this is my new fav! it keeps my lips hydrated and so soft. when you think about how much product you get and how long it will last, the price isn’t high. its well worth every cent.

Packaging they nailed.  Smooth as butter.  Taste is incredible. Most definitely the best lip chap I have ever used.   Got this in a kit which made it pretty much “free”.  Despite how much I love this, I would never spend $22 on it.  My $5 natural Rocky Mountain soap one is also top notch
Okay but nothing to write home about. I love the drunk elephant line, so this particular product was disappointing. Wouldn’t purchase again.
This practically contains the same amount of product as a chapstick. The tube is shorter and more round. Moisturizing. Lips feel supple.
love this balm!! it cured my chronically chapped lips

LOVE THIS! After buying one I bought another so one is in my house and the other is in my purse. It doesn’t sit on the lips, it actually soaks in and moisturize the lips. I feel like some lip balms/chapsticks can sometimes look messy and oily and this one does not at all, my lips have never been this soft! I will definitely keep repurchasing this product.
This stuff is pretty much the perfect balm.  It goes on smoothly, moisturizes well, isn’t greasy, and doesn’t leave any buildup.  If you’re looking for a good basic lip balm, go to town on this one!
Best lip balm I’ve used. I’m a lip balm junkie and this one is worth the price tag! It keeps my lips soft and hydrated so I don’t need to reapply often.

Love this! It keeps my lips moisturized for a few hours and I know I won’t have to reapply often like other balms. The product is in the perfect container where I can carry it on me and also not small enough where I can lose it.
this is a good lip balm but not amazing or worth the money. i keep it by my bed and enjoy using it but i probably won’t buy it again.

It’s okay. I wanted something good for my lips after microneedling and this just felt like crumbly, grainy chapstick that sat on my lips and didn’t absorb. No additional benefits. Drug store stuff would be cheaper and more effective.
super duper moisturizing!! Gives your lips a natural, glowy, sheen.

One of the best lip balms on the market. I wasn’t looking for anything glossy or specifically lip plumping but this makes my lips feel hydrated and full every single time I apply it. Really happy with the results and feel of this product.
this has such great hydration. its perfect for those who experience a lot of chapped lips.

I’ve tried many lip balms- from korres, to Dior & now drunk elephant. It’s good, nourishing and light weight on the lips. I do not find it completely nourishing to the point where it has heeled my lips. Also, my lips aren’t even that chapped to begin with. I feel like there is better out there.
Best balm I’ve ever used!! Those out all my others after using this for two weeks, hydrating without being greasy with no obnoxious scent or flavor.
Depends on what you’re looking for. If you want just a chapstick, this is nice. If you’re looking for something to nourish your lips that are dry, this is not nice.
I absolutely adore this product!! It’s on but not too thick or greasy. My lips were instantly hydrated and stayed that way! I love using it at night
I really wanted to like this product, but it didn’t work on my skin type. I have a bit of sensitive skin and it gave me a bit of a burning sensation.

review_title: love the product, price is steep though
review_text: I love this product. I have sensitive skin and use it in the morning and at night. It has helped reduce my hyperpigmentation and makes my skin look plump and hydrated. The price is steep but I have not found another vitamins C serum that compares to this.

This is the best skin care product that I use. It helped me get rid of my acne for good and gave my dull skin a brighter completion. Best of all, it is great on my sensitive skin. I have been using this product for over 2 years and it’s never failed me.
Love this product, I use it with the Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer and the Silky Peony Melting Eye Cream.

Maybe I need to use another full size bottle of this to provide a more thorough opinion, but given I’ve only gone through using one full size at this point (and I’m sharing this because you have to use serums for a good 4-6 months to really see a difference), I can’t say I was impressed with this product. I’ve seen better improvement from another vitamin C serum I purchased after using this and that was over $50 less expensive. This might be one of the few products from Tatcha that just didn’t work so well for me. Don’t let it deter you from giving it a try if you’ve been curious though because everyone’s skin is different. I am still on the search for a vitamin C serum I want to use over and over again.

MY GO TO VITAMIN C SERUM. HOLY GRAIL. this is great for my morning routine after washing my face, it’s the first product i look forward to using every morning. it makes your face feel so fresh & hydrated throughout the day, spurge on this one forsure!! :)

review_title: sample size made me switch brands
review_text: I got this as a sample size and took it with me on vacation for two weeks. I have oily skin and am very picky about what I put on under my makeup because most skincare has a way of helping it slide off my face in the Florida sun. This serum was a welcome exception! It brightened and smoothed my skin while absorbing quickly and effectively. I will be purchasing a full-size version as soon as I run out of my current vitamin C serum.

I’ve used this for about two months and I can see a difference in the texture and tone of my skin. My pores look smaller, my face looks firmer and I actually GLOW without needing makeup! It isn’t sticky, greasy, or smelly, and it doesn’t irritate my skin.
I’ve used every vitamin c out there. This was the only one where I saw an obvious difference. So expensive but I keep buying it because it works.
Not a fan of Tatcha products and this was no exception. Didn’t really make much difference while using for over 3 months.

review_title: way too watery for a vitamin c serum
review_text: This product feels more like an essence as far as how watery it is. I usually use the Murad original vitamin c serum and that one is more gel like and really absorbs into the skin quickly.. and smells better. With this one I haven’t really noticed a difference in the fading of my acne scars either.

I wanted to love this stuff. The bottle is really pretty, and the promised results were intriguing. The serum itself is really watery, which is strange for a serum. In the end, I just didn’t see any results after using a full bottle. I’m always happy to pay any price if a product works, but I won’t be repurchasing this.
I used the serum for more then a year and didn’t see any improvement of my skin.

This review is purely based on my first 5 days using this product. Beautiful, quality packaging. Japanese packaging is always top tier, and this is no exception. I did ding this product one star (I would have given 3.5 stars if possible) bc its consistency. It’s very watery. Sliiiiightly thicker than water, but when you pump it, you must take care to not let it just drip down your finger/hand and waste your pricey serum. At first, I thought it could be just watery from withstanding the Texas summer shipping process, but it never thickened back up. Might be weird, but I probably would not buy again for this reason.

I was chosen by Sephora to participate in their #sephoraskinwins campaign and I wanted to share my before and after pictures with you guys after trying out the tatcha violet c brightening serum for about a month now.I have to say overall I’m happy with the way my skin is looking. I haven’t noticed a huge difference with brightening but overall my skin feels more smooth and glowy!#sephorapartner #beautyinsidercommunity
Works well. Kids said they saw a difference on my skin after 2 weeks of use.

I’m probably 6-8 weeks into using this product and I’m just not in love. My skin was definitely not pleased when I first started using, which was surprising to me — my skin is usually very receptive to AHAs and Vitamin C products. I laid off using it nightly and built my skin up to using it nightly. I put it on over a hyaluronic acid serum and my skin eats it right up. It seems to be helping a pretty intense acne scar I had lighten up — but given that is a one time issue for me, and my skin isn’t appearing as bright as I expected... the product is just “meh” to me.

WOW. When I first got the sample for this serum I set it to the side because I didn’t think it would be worth the price. So a few weeks later I finally used the sample in my nighttime routine and I woke up the next morning and my skin looked amazing! I purchased the full size and have been using it for a few weeks and I’m still in love with it! I will definitely continue to repurchase!!
This did nothing for my skin , literally nothing . It has a sticky texture too

Very lightweight. Great for oily skin types like myself and good for Summer. It DOES brighten and clarify my overall skintone, I just didnt think this worked as intensely as well as some other AHAs serums. That’s ok, I dont need to strip and scald my skin everyday. This is perfect to use daily with zero irritation.  Very gentle. However, i recommend once or twice a week using something stronger like retinol or maybe a BHA in combination with this. This is a great product if you are sensitive and or new to acids in skincare.

This is my first product from this line and so far I’m very happy with it. My skin has been smoother and brighter and I love that it doesn’t have any smells or residue. It is very liquid-y so sometimes I feel like I waste a lot of product if it runs all over my hand, but knowing that I have gotten better at using it so I don’t waste a lot anymore. I hope to continue seeing improvements and benefits from using this. I really wanted a good vitamin c product and so far I am happy with this (especially for the price). I also enjoy that it is vegan and all natural products. I’ve been using it a few weeks so far.

For my anniversary, I picked out my own gift (skincare). I was torn between a few things but ultimately chose this guy. It’s a nice serum. I found that it was gentle and it softly brightened and improved my skin texture. The effects were just too minimal, however. It’s very viscous which made it hard to work with & I ended up using more than I wanted to. I bought the drunk elephant night serum instead and I feel very great about my choices. This is a good serum, but maybe not good ENOUGH, per say

I was a little sceptical about this serum at first, simply because of the price. You don’t always get what you pay for, but with this serum you do! Over the course of time while using the serum, my face had gotten to be pretty bright and clear. A lot of my small bumps had gone away too. Since I ran out of my first bottle, over time I’ve noticed my skin doesn’t look as vibrant or even. I’ve even tried a different serum and my skin isn’t happy or look nearly as good. Definitely a investment!
I went through 2 bottles of this, I run out so fast! This is one of the best Vitamin C serums out there! Too pricy for the amount you receive! It’s like $90 bucks every 2 months!!

I have religiously been using this product every night for a month and I can say that I have been able to see a big difference on my skin. The tone is my skin is even and my skin looks smoother. Definitely worth every penny!
I’m 38 yrs old I have dry combo skin . This product broke me out. this product didn’t do anything to brighten my skin . Was a waste of my money

This is the best Vitamin C serum. I have dry to very dry and sensitive skin. Honestly the first time I used, this product left a tingly feeling on my skin. I was made aware of this by the Sephora associate as well. So for the first week,l used this product every other day. But from the second week I have been using this everyday in the PM. Being in week 6 now, it has gradually reduced hyper pigmentations and stubborn acne scars on my skin. Also, unlike other Vit-Cs, this product has more like a essence consistency, so one pump of this product is suffice and it’s also a little bit hydrating. If you are tolerant enough for the 20% concentrate, this will work great for you. I follow this up with eye cream and moisturizer.

After reading all the great reviews I thought I’d have better luck with this product, but nope. I gave this product a concerted effort and after using it for about 60 days, I keep breaking out. Wanting to make sure it’s the product and not something else, I went back to it 3 times and each time I would breakout. Perhaps this is for younger skin; I just turned 40 with pretty flawless skin already, but wanted something to maintain my glow. Few products out there make me breakout, unfortunately, this is one of them.

My skin does appear more even after using this product for a month. However, I’m not sure if I would pay this amount again for this product when there are  cheaper items who will do the same thing for less money.

This serum is super thin, so be careful when dispensing. Having said that, one pump is enough for my whole face! It lives up to its hype as far as keeping skin smooth and reducing the little bumps on my face. However, I don’t notice my skin being any brighter and I’ve been using it for a couple months now. Overall great product, it will last practically forever, so I’ll use it until it’s gone!

I have tried this several times in the past few weeks. First I just got a sample and I loved it. I would apply it at night after with the dewy skin cream and loved how my skin looked on the morning so I went and bought the full size. I really like the liquidy consistency of it and it doesn’t leave my skin tacky at all like other vitamin c serums I have tried. Plus, a little goes a long way. However, I usually take my showers at night and when I put it on after, my skin feels hot and gets red so I took off one star. I don’t really have sensitive skin and the Herbivore Emerald+CBD oil does help calm the redness/burning, but that’s something to consider. Otherwise, it is really nice! I would just try a sample first if you have more sensitive skin.

I was a little skeptical when it came to making such a pricey purchase, however I think it was worth it in the end. My skin is much brighter and glowy, and it even smoother out some pesky bumps I had on my forehead. The discolouration in my skin is slowly being smoothed and blended together, thank goodness! I will definitely buy more Tatcha products after this, I’m hooked!

I’ve been using Tatcha Violet-C Brightening Serum for 3 months. My skin has not looked this great in over a decade. I’m getting compliments left and right. I have dry skin with rosacea and sometimes acne. Sun-damage and ageing skin are my biggest skin problems. Here is what I’ve noticed. My skin tone is completely even. No dry patches or texture. No flakey skin interfering with my foundation. It’s like the canvas is clean and perfect. My skin is radiant and glowing. No other product has given me this brightness before. I had fewer breakouts. I attribute this to faster cell turnover (thx, AHAs) and less gunk clogging my pores. I did not have any sensitivity reactions as I do to some ingredients like fragrances. I appreciate that it is unscented. It is very slightly sticky, like most vitamin c serums. Since it’s worn at night, a little stickiness is ok for me. I did not notice for certain if it has done anything for my fine lines. I do know that it did not fade my sun-damage hyperpigmentation. But, still, I will happily re-purchase. This is an awesome P.M. serum.
In the past, I used both Vitamin C serums

I have very very sensitive skin, and this product didn’t irritate me or break it out at all. This serum faded all my dark spots, evened my skin tone, it softened and smoothed my skin, and made it glowy. It’s made it so my skin tone is so even that I feel comfortable not wearing foundation. I also noticed a lot less breakouts after I started using it too. i’ve been using it for over two months now. This is a holy grail and must have product for me now. I highly highly recommend

I saw the few negative reviews on here, and told myself that it wouldn’t be me and I’d most likely be okay since this is a clean product. I don’t typically have averse skin reactions, however this product makes me break out every single time I try using it. I’ve tried using it daily, every other day and twice a week and even still. I never get acne unless its the odd one during my time of the month. I love Vitamin C products and really wanted to love it, but it was a miss for me. AHAs can make your skin purge. Try testing this product out with a sample before purchasing.
This is step 4 in my skincare routine. I apply it right after The Essence. I think it’s very light and smells great and sets up the skin for the day.

Such a beautiful serum. I love Tatcha products as a whole but this is amazing. My skin has honestly never been so soft and my breakouts have been kept at bay. I originally got it as a sample and within 4 days of use knew I needed the full size so I went out and got it. If you have textured rough skin or breakout prone skin, you will not be disappointed. And the best thing is you see results really fast and though it’s pricey, a little goes a long way! Highly recommend :)

Very good for acne/redness/dullness. I was able to replace my retinoid with this and get much better results. It also is very brightening and I wake up with my face looking bright and clear! I also have sensitive skin and it does not irritate at all.

This was the first serum I ever purchased, part of upping my skincare game in 2019. I love that it has the two functions of the AHA and the vitamin C. I have used it just over a month and have already noticed a big difference in my skin. It has a very nice consistency and absorbs into my skin very quickly!! The packaging it also very luxurious. I am very happy with this purchase!

I brought this product with me when I went on vacation to Dubai and it really helped keep my skin moisturized and soft despite the heat and sand in the air! This serum really brightened my skin and helped keep breakouts at a minimum I totally recommend this product! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.
I’m very pleased with the Violet-C Brightening Serum. I used it before bed for a week and my face was as smooth as a baby’s butt!

made me break out badly in milia bumps all over my face after 2 days of using this. It was pretty hydrating, and made my face look dewy. but sadly made me break out badly. Wouldn’t recommend for sensitive skin

I’m hoping that winter is why I am only giving three stars! I was given this product as a complimentary gift from Influenster. I was very hopeful that it was keep my face from feeling chapped during these cold winter weeks. I do believe I’m beginning to tell it is working after 6 weeks of use. Will update review if that is the case. It goes on nicely and is easy to apply. Would currently not recommend for the price or length of time it is taking to see a difference.

I loved this product!  In under a week I saw an increase of vibrancy in my complexion.  My skin seemed more plump and hydrated.    This product goes on easily and absorbs into the skin in no time!  This makes it a nice addition to a morning routine that needs to be done quickly.

I am a big fan of this serum by tatcha! It’s light and absorbs quickly, but helped my skin feel more hydrated, plump, and vibrant. It was easy to produce an extra half pump on those days my face needed a little more attention, which is always a plus in my book since I hate wasting product!

review_title: find something better at tj maxx
review_text: Sorry, I just don’t see much of an effect. Also, for a serum, it is a very watery texture. very runny.

This serum comes in a gorgeous bottle and feels really lovely on the skin, but I’m not sure how effective it is. I didn’t notice much brightening or a more even skin tone. I do appreciate that there are clean ingredients. I received this product free for review purposes.

Got this in my Influenster VoxBox! I’m normally someone who can’t be bothered with spending money on what I consider at least to be high end products, I’m a drug store kind of girl (thanks student loans lol). But this is something I could see myself actually purchasing after I run out of it! I have really bad acne scarring, so I know it’ll take some time to see major results. But so far, I see some lightening on a new scar! I have faith that over time it’ll help even more! I like that it doesn’t feel heavy on my skin, didn’t break me out, and doesn’t have a scent really (which is great, a lot of acne scarring products do not smell good)!

This was the very first face serum I’ve ever tried and I was expecting/wanting it to be life-changing. I do like it and think it goes on smoothly and adds hydration but I haven’t seen crazy results. My skin tone is somewhat even already so I was expecting it to even me out completely. Not a bad product by any means I will still keep using for the hydration at night but nothing crazy special to make it worth the price in my opinion.

This serum is amazing. I started using it while I was in the middle of a horrible breakout, and noticed almost immediate results—not necessarily in getting rid of acne, but in calming, smoothing, and evening out my skin. I do believe it assisted in clearing my skin, because I stopped using it for a week as a test and found my skin back to its former oily and pimply self. I have used it in both cold, dry climates and hot, tropical climates, and found it was effective in keeping my skin soft, smooth, and bright in both. It also seems to balance the oil on my face without drying out my skin. It’s a little pricey, but a little goes a long way (I end up using about 2 drops a day.) Also, it smells so nice! I received this and The Essence complimentary for testing purposes, and I’m so happy that I did! I’ll definitely be buying it when it runs out.
The bottle is super cute and the ingredients are very natural. The product is on the pricey side
Smells good and feels really smooth on your skin! My skin was brighter after a couple of uses too! This product was given to me to sample by Influenster - this is my honest review ❤️
good for acne prone skin. lightweight and absorb easily. awesome ingredient

review_title: Not oily, But worth the value?
review_text: My favorite thing about this product was that it did not leave my naturally oily skin feeling even more oily. I also loved that you only needed one to two pumps of product per day. I used this product in my nightly routine, paired with the essence. If I was to choose between the two products, I would buy the essence. But together, the products are great! The packaging is also amazing, so many serums come in glass bottles that make me so nervous!

My first vitamin C product and I am in love! At first I didn’t notice too much change but after a month in, I can definitely say this product has helped making my dark spots from acne scars less noticeable. Ultimately, using this in tandem with The Essence, I noticed more even skin texture but I was hoping to see more brightening results. This could be possible because my skin is more temperamental in the winter but I hope to continue to see results. Only knocked down a star because it does leave a sticky residue that I’m not used to applying moisturizer after helps. Also makes me sad that I can’t easily afford this right now as a student but hoping to repurchase in the future!I received this complimentary product for testing purposes.
Love the silky-feel of this formula, but just didn’t see any visible results. Will give it a try for another couple of weeks though, because I like the brand.

This wasn’t the greatest product to me. I used it everyday for about two-three weeks and I didn’t see much of a difference. I have combo skin. I didn’t notice my skin to be any brighter than it was before. I received this product for free to test out and review!

This is an amazing serum! I have dark spots from cystic acne and this has really helped them. It also makes my skin brighter and plumper. I use with the Tatch essence. I received this product complimentary.

This product was ok. I used it with tatcha the essence and I didn’t really see a difference on my skin. It did make it feel soft but nothing that made me go “Wow” I’m not sure if it’s because I have used Vitamin C from Ole Henriksen and Kiehl’s. They had instant results on my skin and this product I feel is very overrated. Beautiful packaging and bottle but I won’t be purchasing in the future with my money. I will give it 3 stars because it made my skin feel soft but it has a very watery and light feel to it also.

I received this item complimentary to try out and review and within a week of using it I could tell my skin tone was a lot more even and brighter. I saw my best results when using this right after a shower. I definitely reccommend.

Okay... so I absolutely love Tatcha and totally credit my recent skin transformation to their line so I 100% wanted to love this product... however this just isn’t doing much for me. The plus is I have sensitive skin and this kind of serum would usually cause breakouts and lots of redness and this doesn’t. Unfortunately I haven’t seen any visible improvement in my skin either. I got this as a freebie so will definitely finish it off, but will not repurchase. For the price there are better out there.
I received this product complimentary from influencers. This product is wonderful my skin looks amazing. Hydrates not heavy or greasy I love it.

This product was amazing!! The only reason it gets 4 stars instead of 5 is I wasn’t a huge fan of the leftover feeling on my hands an face felt kinda sticky. Other than that I loved this product. I used it for a week  and started noticing a difference in my skin tone and How soft my face was. Will be purchasing again!! I also received this product free to test out!

I waited a full month to review this product because it takes time to see the full results. I can honestly say that my skin tone is much more even (much less redness in my cheeks) and so much brighter. I started to really notice after 2 weeks of straight use.  I haven’t noticed any breakouts either which is a huge plus! I revived this as a complimentary sample :)

The Tatcha Violet-C Brightening Serum comes in a gorgeous bottle that I love to leave out on my dresser. The serum pumps out in the perfect amount. It doesn’t feel greasy and isn’t too watery. It absorbs right into my skin and feels refreshing. I feel like my skin looks bright right after I use it. I received this product as a free sample.
Thus serum is a game-changer! My skin has never felt more nourished and healthy. It has a natural glow and appears brighter than ever

I received this in a Vox box from Influenster and I’m absolutely in love. This makes my skin feel so plump and healthy. I’ve also always had extremely textured skin and this has almost completely rid my skin of it. I will be purchasing this when I run out. I’m giving it four stars because the first one I received the cap was glued on and we had to break it to get it off, luckily tatcha sent me a new one.

The first few uses with this product plus the essence is outstanding! It brightens my skin and evens out skin tone making me feel more confident and making me have radiant skin! I received this along with essence in a voxbox and they are truly life changing products!

I am absolutely in love with all their products, but specifically, this Violet-C Brightening Serum has made a huge HUGE difference for my skin. I have been using it for about 3 weeks now in combination with the Essence, and my skin is a lot smoother and softer, more even-toned skin, it looks healthier overall and has made applying makeup SO much easier and BETTER! I use to have bad acne and had spots on my face but I noticed it’s fading away (not sure if this products is suppose to help with it, but I noticed the marks fading! and they’ve been there for months!) I’m impressed with Tatcha products. I’ll definitely be continuing using this. Thank you to Influenster and Tatcha for sending me this complimentary to try!

This brightening serum has been a true life saver. My skin took a bit of time to get used to the moisture (about a week with a few minimal breakouts) but after the adjustment, my skin LOVED the impact the serum had. I’ve had dark acne scars for a few years and these have diminished the appearance drastically. The formula is Very nice and glides on the face swimmingly.
