I have sensitive but T-zone oily skin and this oil works wonders on my skin!! Very light scent, if any, and it gives me gorgeous

I’m not sure what to add that people haven’t already said in all of these raving reviews, but I was sceptical about putting oil on my already oily/combination skin, but have absolutely NO REGRETS. This stuff is awesome! I’ll buy it until the end of days

This really irritated my skin and caused severe redness and blotchyness all over my face. It is odd because i use rose water all the time, i thought this would be really hydrating but it just didn’t work for me

I have very sensitive skin (face only), so I was nervous about trying this. This stuff is AMAZINGGGG! I have very bad dry skin in the winter, and no matter how many times I applied my moisturizer, my skin was still flaky. I apply this once, at night after washing my face and my skin is bouncy and moisturized when I wake up, it is amazing! Def recommend!

I’ve been using this every night for a week now, layering it on top of their 10% Lactic Acid or Retinoid Emulsion (alternatingly). My acne scars have already lightened up and my skin has been so smooth and plump. I don’t even need to put any moisturizer anymore because it is so hydrating. I have a normal type of skin but oily on my forehead, so a combination I guess? Anyhow, it’s only been a week but I’m excited to see the results when I finish the entire bottle!

I’m an oil junkie, however I have to be careful as my skin is acne prone. I can’t use this one every day as it is a little heavy, so I used it every few days and I use maybe 3 drops and rub it on my hands and gently pat it on my dry spots, not everywhere.  It is a little heavier oil that I’m used to, but it’s good.
I use this all the time and love it. Its a must have.

review_title: Holy Grail! Constant Compliments On My Skin!
review_text: This oil cures all! I have hormonal breakouts and with this oil I don’t even experience them anymore. Recently I had stopped using this oil and I had a pimple on my cheek that I popped. It bled and it crusted over but still had a nasty scab and was poking out on my face but when I put this oil on my skin at night, I woke up with NO bump and no dry, crusted scab. I had a very small mark where the pimple had been which is unusual for me because I am dark skinned and I usually scar immediately when I get pimples. My sister asked me what I had been using on my skin because my skin looked so smooth and I said just some rose hip oil from The Ordinary! Every woman needs this in her skin care routine. I apply just 2-3 drops and it immediately absorbs into my skin. It doesn’t really have a smell at all and it’s not greasy at all. I even got my boyfriend to use this to help improve the surface of his skin and reduce his breakouts. He loved that it didn’t make his skin shine. I don’t use any other moisturizers on my skin anymore and many other rose hip oils out there aren’t organic, cold pressed and 100% rose hip oil and might I add CHEAP! I LOVE this oil!
This oil is a must have! Almost instant results on my skin’s discoloration and texture. This will be a part of my routine always going forward!
This product is a great addition to my AM skincare routine. The oil is pure but gentle on my sensitive, oily skin.
Smells wonderful. Makes my skin soft.

This product is amazing.  I think I have genetic acne, no matter what I eat, my stress levels, what medicine I am on, nothing changes it.  My brother has the same problem.  As a result, I always have scarring on my face.  Over the past 3 weeks, this product has reduced the scarring so much.  Any new acne I get goes away much quicker with this. Makes my skin feel so smooth and nourished.  The affordable price makes it a real lifesaver too. I wish that Sephora would stock these products better.
I have the worst dry skin imaginable. This product is soothing and smells great. Still blown away that it’s only $10.

review_title: Not the best the Ordinary has to offer
review_text: Skin did not react well to this product. Broke me out, did not absorb well into the skin even just with using the tiniest amount and does not have the most pleasant smell (think leaves rotting). Have enjoyed other ordinary products and was hoping this would help with fading of my acne scarring. For reference I have fair, acne prone, combo to oily skin. Only saving grace is the price.

review_title: hydrating and great for red-irritated skin
review_text: Best product in the line. I’ve tried several ordinary products and this is by far my favorite. I use this alone at tonight before going to bed and the rose hip oil hydrates and also calms my red skin. I’m in my mid 40s and starting to show rosacea and this product calms my redness so by morning, I’m pleasantly surprised.  It’s worth the price and a little bit will cover my entire face and neck.
Great oil! This really calms down my skin and just makes my skin look so healthy, however the oil somehow crystallized on the seal and it makes it harder to open and close.

Very good primrose oil, not the best but good and the price is great. I have been using oils for years as moisturizers because they don’t irritate my skin. I mix this in with other oils and I like it a lot. Highly recommend.
Very nice! I love how this feels and makes me glow from within! Fantastic for acne prone skin and a great added moisturizer with foundation! Only regret that I didn’t buy more as it’s been sold out!

After a week of using I definitely noticed my acne scars fade. I put it on under my makeup and at night time, skin doesnt feel oily and hasn’t broken me out. Only dislike: the dropper, the oil drips off the dropper wasting the product and gets messy. But product is amazing, definitely an essential for me!!

I have acne scarring as well as dry, acne-prone skin. I used to use a different rose hip seed oil but it smelled like soy sauce and was expensive. I switched to this brand when I found out it’s a better product and a better price. Scarring has gone down with routine use!!

review_title: Fades acne scars; can cause breakouts though
review_text: This is a phenomenal oil for fading hyperpigmentation, for example acne scars. It brightens skin and blurs fine lines because it is a natural retinol. However, it is comedogenic meaning it can clog pores and cause new acne to appear. I recommend for mature skin that is not prone to acne. I do not recommend for acneic skin or the acne prone because it did break me out. I purchased this item from Deciem before Sephora carried it.

review_title: Magic. Literally Harry Potter style youth serum.
review_text: Wow. This stuff is simply amazing. I am getting older and have long neglected my skin care. Like always forget to do basic moisturising and taking make up off. Yes. Bad!! Started afresh in the new year and literally within 3 weeks of using it with 2 other Ordinary products. It’s taken 10!years off me. Seriously. Magic!!
broke me out on my face. mixed with my body moisturizer to repurpose with no problems

I have been using this for 3 weeks now in the morning and evening after cleansing. I have noticed an improvement in my skin. It looks more hydrated, plump and clear. This is a serum that will continue to be a staple in my skincare routine. I am going to try the other buffet with copper and report back!
I found that while this product is hydrating and applies nicely on my skin, it did nothing for fine lines. I’ve been using it for around 3 months and will not be repurchasing.

review_title: I wanted to love it… but couldn’t :(
review_text: I’ve notice that it’s clogged my pores. I’ve had a few white heads but my black heads seem to multiply after just four or five days of continuous use. I wanted to like this because of the anti-aging benefits but not at the cost of clear skin. I usually don’t get broken out unless it’s around that time of month and it’s definitely not that time. I have dry skin so it did work well for that. Other than it being hydrating, I didn’t care for the clogging of pores. So I’ll pass.
This is my third time buying Buffet and I love it. You can’t beat the price point and I see noticable results.
Such great value for the price. I have repurchased many times.

I started using Differin and Caudalie Vinoperfect Serum in March of this year, and I’ve definitely noticed some positive changes in my skin, but it was subtle, and my pores still looked huge. Then I added The Buffet to my skincare routine maybe about 2 weeks ago, and I’m astonished. My pores look so much tighter and my skin feels incredible! This was apparently the missing piece that I wish I’d started using sooner. I don’t usually write reviews, but I’m shoooook.

Nice but I could live without it.    Nice base before makeup that has a little of everything if you don’t want to buy a ton of different products.    Easy application.  Little bit goes a long way.   Try the smaller size first. Large one is big.

absolutely love this stuff. have used this and the salicylic acid from the ordinary for 2 years and it’s changed my skin. it evened out the textured. controls the breakouts and keeps the moisture locked in. I’ve gotten several comments about how good and healthy my skin looks.
This is a good serum. Didn’t dry out my skin or make me break out. I didn’t like that I couldn’t use it with some of my other products.
I use this with “niacinamide + zinc” and the combo works great for me and has reduced fine lines.

I have almost used a whole bottle of this up and have been enjoying it. It is nice and hydrating and leaves your skin feeling plump. I love that it has peptides, although I haven’t noticed much difference in fine lines. Maybe that’s something you have to keep using to notice more of a difference. I’m impressed that while this has HA it hasn’t dried me out in this dry climate. That’s something I have experienced with other HA. Overall, it’s great and would recommend and repurchase.

review_title: I will literally never stop buying this
review_text: My sensitive, combination skin can actually handle this moisturizing serum. It combats the flaky skin I get around my nose and between my brows without activating my acne. Oh, and the price is FANTASTIC for the quality.

I buy this for my mom. She just uses this and body soap and body lotion with no sunblock day and night . She is in her 60s and people are shocked when they hear her age. Just faint laugh lines around her mouth and nothing else. She also gets pimples so rarely that she calls me in a panic when it happens. While genetics play a huge part she finds this to be an essential and is easily on her 6th bottle. When she finishes it she bugs me until I get her a new one. Personally I didn’t like the texture and I think it broke me out a bit I’m in my 30s and I don’t uses body soap. While I think it’s her genes (that I hope she has passed down thou I did not get her no fuss skin) she is evangelical about it and she looks amazing so I give it the full five stars

This was the first serum I ever consistently used in my routine! The  results aren’t out of this world, but I did notice a more even complexion and less texture, as well more radiant/supple skin. I would totally recommend this as a beginner serum since its not intimidating at all for a skincare newbie like myself. It’s a gel like consistency but gets thinner and more liquidy as you spread. It leaves a sliiightly sticky residue but that goes away after applying moisturizer. Overall, I’ll probably purchase this again!

This product quenches my thirsty skin! Even Dr Dray praises it. When I apply it, I can just feel my skin is happy. Absorbs rapidly without any sticky / greasy feeling. My complexion is better and glowier ever since I started using this product. Love it!
Good serum, gives good hydration for my combination skin, doesn’t feel too greasy

I really like the product however I haven’t had it long enough to give a full review. So far I have not had any breakouts from it, it goes on nice and seems to have diminished some of my fine lines. I’d like to give a more thorough revive after I’ve used it for 3 months.
Cannot beat the price! This stuff is great. Super hydrating! Soaks in quick   Sometimes I even use alone
This serum has worked wonders on my skin. Since using this product, my skin has been blemish free and radiant. Amazing price too! Would absolutely purchase this product again.

I love Buffet. My skin has always been prone to dry flaky weirdness with still oily skin? and it now feels hydrated, I don’t even need a moisturizer but gotta love a double moisturizer lol. I look forward to putting it on. I love love the ordinary products.
I’ve been using this day and night, and now I’m about 1/2 way through the product. I don’t notice any difference to my skin.
using this for a long time, helps keep skin well moisturized and for a great price

After just 3 days of use along with the “Hydrating Factors“ face cream, my skin has never been so soft. I didn’t expect results so fast and never thought my rough dry flaking skin would disappear. Very hydrating and smoothing without the greasy feeling. Love.
I love this. It feels amazing on my skin. I just started using peel pads and this helps to soothe my skin afterwards.

I really wanted to love this product for its simplicity and price product. After using it for about 2 months I started noticing white heads all over my forehead and around my eyes. I had changed a few skin care products because my skin gets a bit more sensitive in the colder months, so I wasn’t sure if this product was the issue. Turns out, it was. Not sure why it took 2 months for a nasty breakout, but this is not the stuff for me.

This serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly into my normal to dry skin. I gave it 4 stars because I prefer a slightly thicker serum with more glycerin or aloe that feels like it packs in more hydration and moisture but I’m super happy with Buffet. I’m on my 2nd bottle because when I ran out my skin felt the lack of water in my skin- moisturizer, hydrating toner, facial oil, and SPF during the day weren’t cutting it. As soon as I added this back in my skin felt more bouncy and plump. It’s so nice I’ll continue to use and recommend, just also look for another serum to pair with it for an even deeper hydration. It also slightly improved the look of my skin after finishing my 1st bottle m- hyperpigmentation and small fine lines beginning to smooth!
Oh how I love you so. This product has done so much for my face, I’ll probably never stop purchasing it. My only pet peeve- it can get a little foamy upon application.

review_title: Moisturizing boost for over a year
review_text: I’ve been using this daily for a year+ and I can’t say for sure if it does the anti-wrinkle part but it definitely gives me a moisturizing boost. I use it in the morning with a little bit of The Ordinary’s vitamin C powder to add a brightening boost.

If I only could give zero, I would give. I applied Buffet before going to bed and next morning I woke up with zits all over my forehead. I’ve NEVER had so much zits and pimples on my face. I always had a good experience with the ordinary, so of course I couldn’t believe that buffet gave me zits and I thought that the reason why I got zits was different. So next evening I again applied buffet all over my face before going to sleep and next morning I got even more zits. So it was definitely the ordinary. I returned it to the store. I read so many positive reviews about this product but I don’t understand why it didn’t work for me
I was really worried this would break me out but it didn’t.

As someone who’s used buffet for well over a year, I can confidently say that I’ve notice a drastic improvement of surface hydration, barrier function, and overall smoothing of superficial textures. For the what, $30 you’ll pay for the full size, it has to be one of the best bangs for your buck on the market. If you’re unsure which ordinary product to start with, give this one a try. It’s got everything nailed into one bottle.
It was good, used the whole bottle but not sure if it did anything

I swear by this! It’s my anti-aging élixir in a bottle! It’s affordable and the brand The ordinary is non toxic as far I know so I really value their products. My main concern is prevent wrinkles, and lost of elasticity/sagging so this is everything I need! Love the affordable price too. No scent no irritation either.

I’ve started using this a week ago, it made my skin so soft and supple that I keep touching face to reaffirm that, yup, it still feels great. The product is a great value and a little goes a long way.

I have really liked this product. My skin has looked the best it ever has since I have started using this, other ppl have even said so. The only thing is I find it stays a little sticky on the face but really not enough of an issue to make me stop using it.

review_title: cleared acne and left dry burn
review_text: My tween has been breaking out in tiny pimples all over her cheeks and the derm didn’t offer much help. I’ve been trying everything (fancy silver pillowcases, changing haircare, probiotics, and a million cleansers, products with zinc). This product actually cleared them up—but created a new problem. Her cheeks are rough like sandpaper and super dry like a chemical burn.
broke me out a lot even though i have pretty clear skin and i don’t have sensitivity problems. the breakouts went away after i stopped using the serum.
This brand is just WoW ! Love the effect of the product on my skin after only 1 try!
I have been using this product religiously twice a day for the last five months. I love it and would repurchase it. I notice my aging skin is more glowy with reduced fine lines.
I like this serum, it hydrates nicely and I find my skin tone is more even! Also can’t beat the price, I usually use this in the morning and use a stronger serum at night.
This is honestly amazing for the cost. My fine lines are disappearing and it’s helping hold in hydration! Can’t wait to try other products from The Ordinary
Anything from this brand is a 10/10 and this really helped heal some of my acne scars and overall make my skin look more healthy. Great for all skin types and would highly recommend
Anything from this brand is a 10/10 and this really helped heal some of my acne scars and overall make my skin look more healthy. Great for all skin types and would highly recommend
I LOVE buffet. I’ve been using it daily for months and I definitely notice an improvement in the texture and appearance of my skin. A great daily serum.

I’m so happy I started using this product! When I learned about The Ordinary I was immediately intrigued and started doing my research. Buffet continuously came up as a recommended product for all skin types for anti-aging. It was also what I could get from The Ordinary - they have some other products that have been out of stock for so long :’(. Luckily this has been in stock. First off, it absorbs quickly, but not in a drying type of way. The serum is pretty clear and a super light gel consistency. It feels great on my skin and I enjoy putting it on. Secondly, I do think it’s helping with anti-aging. I feel my skin a bit tighter, but even better is the brightening effect it had. I feel like my skin is becoming that coveted word: “radiant.“ I’m really happy I bought it and have frankly bought even more than I need because I am so scared of it being out of stock like the others and I love it too much!

review_title: dried my skin like the dessert!!
review_text: awful! i’m an esthetician and so badly wanted to love this product but it dried my skin out AWFULLY. i literally thought it could have been eczema! i don’t even have dry skin regularly so it’s very stripping. not worth the low price

I noticed a difference within 2 days of using this stuff! Even more so now it’s been a few weeks of daily use. It smells and feels great on the skin, I personally don’t mind the tackiness. I typically wait 1-2 mins in between serums. I use this in conjunction with their Niacinamide/zinc (AM) and Alpha arbutin & HA (PM) serums and I’m a happy lady with glowing, supple and happy skin. :)
I unfortunately was another victim of breakouts from this product.

Used for two weeks before writing a review. I noticed effects after the first use. I have sensitive skin and have broken out in the past when trying a new serum. This serum cleared up any break outs I originally had and soothes my skin. I can even say it’s helped minimize the appearance of my forehead wrinkles. Amazing product!
Very moisturizing and calming. Works well with other serums. Evens out skin tone and adds a glow!

review_title: I'm in it for the long-term maintenance
review_text: Great for easy full-spectrum maintenance when you need just one serum.  The Ordinary serums are my go-to and this one is perfect for travel.  Aging gracefully is my go-to-game. Love that Sephora stocks The Ordinary products.
Lightweight, and smooth application,  doesn’t feel heavy and doesn’t make my makeup look cakey.
This product is hydrating but I found that it did leave a sticky feeling to my skin
A very valuable skincare to try. Gentle and moderate texture.

It’s great for its value. I finished the entire bottle before writing this review. I have dry skin, it really helps with that. I have some fine lines on my forehead and it seems to fill them up when I use this product. However, I don’t think it does much to actually get rid of fine lines. I mostly got this for hydration so I’m not disappointed. I bought the buffet with copper peptides to try it (it’s also more expensive) and I think I prefer that one. If you’re looking for to treat yourself, buy the buffet + copper peptides. If you’re looking for a very good value, buy this one.

While I do enjoy this serum, I have stopped using The Ordinary HA serum so I can give this on a shot after reading great reviews. Needless to say, after this bottle, I will go back to my HA serum. I prefer the tackiness of the HA acid and feel like it absorbs into my skin so much better than this one. I also find that I can not use this serum in the mornings, just evenings. Good serum I don’t see myself re-purchasing.
I’m not sure if this serum made a difference in my skin.

review_title: So far I'm really enjoying it.
review_text: I’ve been using it for about a week and it’s lovely! I’ve noticed an improvement in my forehead wrinkles and it reduced the dryness of my skin leaving me looking dewy. I really like it.

Honestly I can’t really review the product because it travels so poorly. It felt a bit sticky when I first put it on but quickly dried and then didn’t feel sticky. For a holiday trip I checked it and it managed to open and spill half the contents all over my clothes - also happened on the return trip when it was in my overhead. The bottle just didn’t travel well and as a result I can’t vouch for the product since it’s treated my sweaters more than it has my skin.

I love the skincare products from The Ordinary.  They are reasonably priced and very effective.  I have noticed visible improvements in my skin over the past several weeks since I started using them.  I’m using Buffet, the Hyarulonic Acid, the Ferulic Acid and the retinol, as well as the Vitamin C and moisturizer.  Happy with all of them!

Don’t feel like it does much for my skin hydration wise. For some reason any product (moisturizer, oil) I put on top ends up pilling off because of this product under. I’ve tested my moisturizer and oil without this and no pilling. For the price, i don’t feel like I lost much so its okay.

Admittedly, I’m only about ten days into using this, but I can already see a difference in my skin. I have incredibly sensitive, red-prone skin — Drunk Elephant’s B-Hydra sent my face into an absolute meltdown — but using this has really brightened and softened my skin with absolutely no issue. I’m currently using it only at night, but amazingly still see the results in the morning. Only reason for a less than five star review — this is a solid 4.5 out of 5 product — is because the feel is tacky and ever so slightly tightening on the face, so you know it’s there, which I don’t love. But you can’t beat the price or the results, especially if you have skin sensitivities. Really, really pleased with this purchase.

I’m on my second bottle! although this product targets for anti-ageing and I’m just in my early 20s, I’m very happy that I added the Buffet into my skincare routine! My DRY skin never feels softer and looks smoother! I used to have so many little pumps/ or under-skin pimples on my forehead, flaky skin on my nose and this product help clear and smooth them all. You can clearly see the result instantly as well: after one night your skin feels a lot softer and after a week your skin appears so plump, hydrated, smoothly and youthfully.  A thin layer is enough to do the magic, so 30ml bottle lasts a little over a month for me, and I used it twice every day. Only one CON is that this product does NOT look good under foundation or concealer, it makes your makeup base look patchy and cakey. However I don’t wear foundation or concealer daily so this is not a big deal for me, I just use a normal moisturizer whenever I wear makeup. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

This product should be a staple in every over-40 person’s arsenal to treat uneven tone and texture.  I’ve seen a HUGE change in the tone and texture of my skin AND my pores seem so much less noticeable.  I’m on my 3rd bottle and I will be getting more.

I tried this after seeing the price and science behind it, and I’m SO GLAD I DID. I went from wearing foundation every day to not having to wear any in two weeks. I use it during the day with Embroylisse, and at night with The Ordinary Granactive Retinoid serum and Weleda Skin Food. My skin went from so-so to incredible. Definitely try it!
Nothing happened. I really wanted to love this more than I did. I noticed no major differences in my skin, even after going through the entire bottle. Fortunately, it didn’t make my skin worse.

Great product, I use it twice a day under my other three serums. I alternate the ones I use daily and this is my last one I put on. You just have to be careful with your amount of product that you use as if you use to much it tends to get kinda sticky and dry down takes awhile. I’m 40 years old and started out with a few fine lines and sun damage, have been using this for over a month and now both are barely visible. It’s a very good product and I would definitely recommend it to anyone!
Love this whole range of products! Very effective and a little goes a long way.  Lightweight and good texture and feel. Noticed a noticeable difference in about 2 weeks!

I really enjoy this serum. I can’t give you good feedback on how it works long term, because I have been inconsistent in my use. However, I did notice it impart a plumpness, firmness and overall youthfulness to my skin that I hadn’t even realized I was losing. I would definitely recommend, and at the price point it’s hard to complain. However, I did find that Isometimes experienced tingling when I went to apply my next product. I couldn’t figure out if I wasn’t letting it absorb long enough, or something else. It seemed to be random. I also did notice the tackiness that others have mentioned, but I put on another oil based serum after, or moisturizer and the tackiness wasn’t a problem after those layers.

Best face product I’ve ever used. First thing that has ever gotten rid of the redness by my nose. Also got rid of the try patches on my face. I have very fair acne prone skin and this is the most even my skin has ever looked. I used in combination with The Ordinary Glycolic toner.

I started using this and the Tata Harper Hydrating Floral Essence at the same time, and the combo is pure magic. My skin is so soft, plump, and hydrated! I feel like I don’t use a lot of this serum, maybe 2-3 drops, yet it covers not only my face, but neck and chest too. While a little goes a long way, I still feel like I’m going through it quickly.. luckily it’s so affordable I’ll just order another bottle soon

I can’t explain how much I love this! At first I only used it at night because I used the Hyluronic acid for the morning, but I found I didn’t get any product pilling with this product like I did the HA, so I switched to this full time. I used to use the Estée Lauder serum and swore by it, but I needed to find another serum for a more affordable price. I’ve found my skin responds just as well to this, if not better. I have very sensitive skin, especially after dermarolling, and I’ve found this doesn’t irritate my skin at all. I prefer using this Ordinary serum over the others because of the combination of things, plus I don’t get product pilling when I overlay lotion. My first bottle lasted me a bit over 2 months with regular use.
I’ve noticed an improvement in the skins texture and brightness after using this for a week. A solid staple in my routine now!
My favorite serum ever!!! So affordable and perfect for my dry acne prone skin.

I can’t believe how nice this serum is. It doesn’t make your face feel sticky, and it absorbs quickly. I’ve been using it for about two weeks now with a couple other the ordinary products, and my skin has never looked better.

This product did NOTHING for my skin. I used it for a week, with my other usual products. BROKE OUT like crazy. Sure, the price is low.. but the results were just not there. I have normal/dry skin and i am in my 40s.

This serum works as well as my most expensive ones! If not much better! It moisturizes very well and leaves my face hydrated and I’ve noticed a huge difference in some fine lines as well. This product is a complete steal.

GREAT! This is the absolute easiest way to moisturize your skin for an amazing price. I have acne prone skin and this has not caused me to breakout since I began using it (about a month ago). I still use my regular cream moisturizer and serums, but I’ve added this for an extra “boost”, and I will definitely be trying other ordinary products, I’m curious if they’re all as amazing as this one!

review_title: Wonderful results and a wonderful price
review_text: I have been hunting for a serum to use both am and pm, that wasn’t too expensive. This one is perfect- and a killer price, which is handy. I am 35, and starting to notice some fine lines on my forehead and also starting around my eyes. I use this after cleansing, and before my regular and nighttime moisturizer. I have only used it for a week, and I can already see how much of a difference it is making with the fine lines. It’s a small bottle, but you only need one drop for your entire face. Any more, and yes, you will find it sticky. I let it soak in, and then apply my moisturizer, and then makeup, and it’s been just fine. One thing to note- I went to The Ordinary’s website, and it does have some very specific instructions on products and ingredients to not mix this with, including Vitamin C products. Worth a look if you want the best results, esp. since the details here don’t note that.

I was spending $100  on serums before and this product makes my skin look BETTER than before! I don’t find it sticky at all and a little goes a long way. My skin is sensitive and breaks out to everything but not this! If you’re on the fence, seriously buy it!

do yourself a favor and buy this. for me, it balances oil production and plumps up my skin, making it look much more even and glowy. on days i use it, my skin looks and feels nicer! idk about its anti-aging effects because i am 19 and don’t have any real visible signs of aging yet, but i can vouch that it has many extra benefits outside anti-aging.it’s easy to use more than you need, though. you don’t need a full dropper full, and you’ll run out quickly if you use that much. just a little dollop spread thinly over your skin will do, and will prevent pilling when you use spf or makeup on top. :)

I have super sensitive, combination, acne prone rosacea skin so with everything I read about this brand I was really hopeful. Unfortunately, the oil seems to have been too thick and after a couple of days use caused a small breakout and flakiness along my jaw. I thought the oil felt really nice though, but when I stopped using it the breakout cleared up. Luckily I just tried a sample, so thankful Sephora gives that option! I like my sample of the Lala whip so far, not ready to give up on trying this brand!

I NEVER thought someone like me, naturally very oily (hair and skin), would use and SWEAR BY an oil for a skincare product. To say that I’m obsessed is an understatement. For months, I was getting by with just purchasing the sample size duo (with the night time serum), but I just had to bite the bullet and go full size in everything. I am officially obsessed with this brand because nothing has transformed my skin more than DE products. This oil is light, melts right into your skin, does NOT make you look oily, and you wake up with buttery soft skin. I use this at night only after applying the glycolic night serum from their line. If you are someone with very dry skin you can definitely get away with using this oil during the day, too. But because I have oily skin, this stays in my nighttime routine only. I LOVE THIS SO MUCH!! Seriously, if you are able to save enough $$ to go full-size, I can’t recommend this enough.

Not recommended for acne prone skin! I broke out with white heads all over my face the next morning. Several days later, and I’m still trying to clear up the wreckage. I used the rest of the sample on my dryer legs and arms and it was just okay. I would not use again.
Not greasy, feels hydrating and my skin drinks it up. Love it! I have acne prone skin. The woodbark smell does not bother me - very faint.
Fantastic for moisturizing dry skin

I opted to buy the smaller size of this oil as I feel I could make it last a while. All I do is take the dropper out and let a few drops land on my finger tip, I don’t even squeeze down on the dropper. I apply this around my eyes, eyebrow area and on my lips. I love the feel this leaves on my lips in the morning and at night.  I have noticed my brows growing in the more sparse areas as well. I am a huge fan of DE products and even have my friends loving it!

review_title: Did not work for my sensitive skin :(
review_text: I purchased the night serum from D.E and love it! I received a mini bottle of murula oil and tried it out.  My skin felt hydrated the next day but after using it for about a week I noticed I was breaking out by my nose and jaw.  I stopped using it and it cleared up! Wanted to love it but did not work out for my sensitive skin!

This is a dream - after buying the full DE set to try it, my skin was transformed in only 3 days. This is the cornerstone product too. I mix this with the sunscsreen, DE face cream and even in my foundation to give some glow. I’m in love. The bottle will last you  VERY long time, a little dab will do ya!
Just okay for the price, i didnt see a diff in dark circles or anything other than helping w hydration. Consistency is nice tho it almost melts into ur skin.

I got this in a kit and was v excited bc to try it! I have dry and textured undereyes, and this visibly smoothed them. A little goes a very long way, but I am also very acne prone.This caused undereye acne for me so I had to repurpose it on my neck and hands.

I don’t know how but my under eye creases have gotten worse with this eye cream and it’s only been a month. I decided to upgrade to this from the RoC eye cream since I got such good results from using that one. This one has reversed all my progress. Disappointing.

This is my second time purchasing the Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream. I am not easily impressed when it comes to eye creams because I have sensitive skin and really dull/ dark under-eye circles, but I can safely say this eye cream is one of my all time favs! I’ve used it every morning for 3.5 months so far and I feel like it really helped make my under-eye area look so much more radiant and healthy. I don’t know if it specifically lightened my dark circles, but my whole under eye area just looks so much more refreshed and youthful. Highly recommend if you are struggling with dull looking under-eyes.

love this eye cream so much. i have super dry under eyes and a lot of eye creams don’t work for me or irritate my eyes. this one melts and becomes super soft and spreads really well so you only need a tiny bit. only thing that keeps me from buying it again is the price. probably will wait for a sale

review_title: I really enjoy this eye cream however..
review_text: This is very hydrating and I have dry skin so I personally enjoy it. You don’t need a lot of product to use on your under eyes, eyelids and your fine lines around your mouth if you have them like me. I can’t really tell you if it does much for fine lines or wrinkles.  I’m sure a cream won’t make fine lines or wrinkles go away however it could prevent them, we’ll see in the future. I think it does help the look of my dark circles a bit, not a ton as it isn’t a miracle worker but the skin around my eyes feels hydrated and more “plump“ if you will. This cream starts off thick and melts into the skin.  My under eyes and eyelids feel smooth and soft. I don’t think it is worth $60 that’s why I’d get it during a VIB sale. $35 is the max I would pay. The lid on my eye cream was loose which I didn’t like that but it didn’t look like it was tampered with. Also only has a six month shelf life.

It does feel nice applying and does feel moisturizing, but that’s it. The packaging is also pretty. There are much better products out there. It is not extra-ordinary in the least. It’s not bad, it’s just not good either. I would not recommend.

THE BEST!! I’ve tried many eye creams (I tend to get dry patches around my eyes) and this has been hands down the best eye cream I’ve ever tried. It’s incredibly creamy and blends in beautifully. It’s pricey, but a tiny bit goes a  VERY long way. The skin under my eyes also feels  fuller and more healthy!
It’s nice and luxurious. It melts into the under eye. I don’t notice a difference using it though.
Love this stuff. I had dryness under my eye during the winter and when I put this on, the dryness disappeared. It definitely helped this 37-year-old!
Very luxurious and worth the hype! Keeps your under eyes hydrated and bright.
Haven’t seen amazing results but I like the texture and it absorbs really fast.  Non-greasy and light but still gives good hydration.  One of the better eye creams I’ve tried.

My favorite eye cream by far! I am very rarely impressed with most eye creams. I usually tend to think that moisturizer achieves the same effect. But this one works some major magic! It almost has an iridescent, highlighting effect. It looks SO beautiful and feels deeply nourishing.

It’s okay. A silky, gentle, every-day eye cream. I’ve been using it regularly for a month. No change in crow’s feet or brightness. If you just need a bit of a hydration boost, this does the trick, but I will keep searching for something more potent for my crow’s feet.
Disappointed. The pictures show a cream/lotion, but I got a balm?

I redeemed the small size for points and was able to use it for about 3 weeks or so. It feels nice and smells good, but I’ve noticed no difference in my undereyes aside from them being moisturized. I wouldn’t purchase this.
This really melts into the skin. I’ve never tried anything quite like it. It’s amazing. My under eye stays hydrated all day.

I love this eye cream! I reach for this over my Bobbi brown eye cream which used to be my holy grail until I started using this one. I used This eye cream at night before bed and wake up looking hydrated. I also use it under my under eye concealer and it just adds so much hydration to the under eye area. Feels extremely smooth. Highly recommend.

Received this as a sample and I absolutely love it!  It is so incredibly luxurious, silky, smooth and hydrating.  I will definitely purchase a full size.  My lids as well as my under eye area love it.

review_title: NOT SO GOOD FOR CONTACT WEARERS!
review_text: this eye cream is nice but if you wear contacts or suffer from dry eye and easily get irritation, then this might not be for you. Otherwise if you none of that applies to you, this is a nice silky eye cream that feels soothing and smoothing.

I love this eye cream. Within a week of using it, I noticed a reduction on fine lines under my eyes. A little tiny bit goes a very long way. I love Tatcha products... very high quality and so far they seem to work!

review_title: Nice, For An Eye Watering Price
review_text: I received a sample of The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream with a Sephora order. I pressed the sample into a small jar and it lasted me about ten days applying morning and night, so a little goes a really long way! I like the delicate mousse texture, lack of oiliness and how swiftly this cream sinks in to the skin around my eyes. It didn’t irritate my skin and wore well under makeup. I will not be purchasing this product because for an eye cream in this price range, I expect a higher performance in terms of dark circle reduction and long term skincare benefits.

review_title: didn’t live up to the hype for me
review_text: I had wanted to try this eye cream for awhile so I splurged. I haven’t noticed any differences in fine lines, firming or anything like that and it’s been almost 2 months now and I am at least halfway through my jar. I just can’t justify rebuying this with how expensive it is. Yeah it moisturizes but so do less expensive eye creams. Idk. It didn’t do anything for my little bit of dark circles I have either. Maybe it will work if you have perfect eye skin already lol
Perfect for my under eye area. I was feeling my skin very dry even though I don’t have to many wrinkles. After first week of use the dryness disappear. I notes when I apply my concealer.
Hydrating and illuminating. It does it’s job! Scent is very minimal.

This was horrible!! It caused my eyes and the skin around it to burn so so so much, way more than normal. The next day came and my skin on my eyelids and under my eyebrows start to flake and the next day it continued! I wish I never used this! Not good for sensitive skin.
Absolutely love this product. Only been using for a week but can seriously already see a difference in puffy ness and dark circles.

Honestly? I really wanted to love this product. I just don’t feel like it does anything significant. I really like Tatcha as a brand and the packaging was too cute to resist (I mean how cute on your bathroom counter with the little flower on the lid, come on) but it just doesn’t make a difference in my skincare routine. I actually also purchased the Tatcha Serum Stick which contains squalene and lemon balm, and I feel like that’s worked better as an undereye treatment. I use it underneath, on the corners of my eyes, and on my eyelids to retain moisture and implement gentle anti-aging ingredients to my eye care. Honestly, get that instead and then use a simple fragrance-free moisturizer under your eyes instead of spending this much money on such a small product.

I was looking for an eye cream that would help with under eye dryness and fine lines from dehydration. This cream is incredibly hydrating and within a couple weeks I noticed the dry skin was gone and I had less fine lines. It is a great base for makeup, but if I put too much on or its especially humid outside, it can feel greasy. Still, highly recommend.
Incredibly hydrating for the eyes. I’ve only been using this a week but I can already tell a difference.

I liked this eye cream and would consider purchasing it. I didn’t see any noticeable results, however I am in my late 20’s and do not have drastic undereye needs. The consistency was very buttery, and a bit thicker than other eye creams. I had minor creasing under light bareminearls powder foundation. For reference, I had a deluxe sample from Sephora which lasted approximately 2-3 weeks.
Solid eye cream that will last a long time. Great for brightening under eyes and goes on smooth. A little goes a long way, I have been using it for 3 weeks and have not even made a dent in the jar.

I bought this and also ask for a sample so I could try it before I opened the purchased one. I am glad I did. I was hopeful of this but it’s not as good as Shiseido. I use Perricone serum and Shiseido eye cream. I will be returning.
This is a very hydrating when cream, but not too hydrating to the point that my makeup doesn’t apply correctly. This is another great Tatcha product!

review_title: Slow And Steady Wins The Race
review_text: This is a product which will be preventative. Beauty products do not erase what you have already done to your face. I’ve been using this for over a month and a little goes a LONG way. It goes on so smooth and my makeup goes on top with no issues or funky streaks. I’ll for sure buy again! And this will be a product I will stick with for years. This will be the true test. I’ll let ya know when I hit 40! Dont be afraid to invest in your skin... it’s a long term investment with rewards you wont notice for years to come. Stop being impatient with your skin care!

Some products don’t work for everyone - this eye cream is exactly that for me. I don’t see a difference in my eyes save for the now pronounced undereye puffiness this product gives me every morning. Not a fan!

This dried out my under eyes. It didn’t even feel moisturizing when I first applied it, it just felt thick, when it dried down it was flakey. Not only was I not able to apply makeup over top of it, it made my under eyes more dry than when I skip moisturizer. I developed two lines under my eyes from it dehydrating my skin. I am so disappointed by this product.

I really wanted this product to work, but it did nothing for my dry eyes. The balm feels amazing upon application but that’s about it. It doesn’t hydrate, help with puffiness, dark circles or fine lines. I gave 2 stars because it looks okay under makeup. If you are not treating serious under-eye issues (dark circles, puffiness, etc.) this may be a great preventive treatment for you. I love Tatcha products, so pretty disappointed in the eye cream.

While this eye cream has a lovely slip/feel when applied, and does not irritate my sensitive eyes, I have been using it consistently for 2 months and have not seen any difference in the appearance of fine lines around my eyes. Back to the hunt.
I really like this cream so far, very tight weight and a little goes a very long way! It is unseated which I love. So far its my favourite eye cream

I received this product for free to test out and I am in love. This eye cream is very nice and creamy without feeling heavy or greasy and the packaging is so beautiful! I have been using this for about 3 weeks now and I have noticed a significant decrease in my eye wrinkles and fine lines so this product definitely works if you’re consistent in using it. My only issue would be the size of the item and it’s price point, I don’t feel like you get enough for the price even with a little going a long way but other than that I would definitely purchase this item.

Love this eye cream! I always get super dry and flakey under eyes and especially eyelids, it’s hard for me to wear makeup because it’s so dry. Yes, this is on the pricy side but I personally think it’s worth it because a little goes such a long way. It’s very thick so for me I don’t even take a little chunk out I just swirl my finger around and that’s usually enough for my entire eye. It is slightly scented so if your not into scents you probably wouldn’t like it however it’s not overbearing. Packaging is nice and it’s sturdy yet small so it’s great for traveling. Overall my skin quality on my eyes has definitely changed and my eyes aren’t flaky or dry at all. My under eyes are very smooth and foundation/concealer looks great over it now!

I absolutely love this product. I have a powder concealer and I put this over it to smooth it out and I’ve noticed my fine lines smoothing already. I had been wearing my makeup for about 12 hours in the picture and was outside in the hot Arizona sun for most of the day. #complimentary

review_title: My first and best eye cream experience!!
review_text: I received this product about 2 weeks ago, since when I have applied it ritualistically to my under-eyes morning and night. This is the first eye product I have ever used and it did not cease to amaze me!! My dark circles have gotten lighter/brighter, in the morning it instantly de-puffs me, and wakes me up. It is creamy yet very light product when applied to the skin (which I loved). I struggle with acne so I dont like the feeling of too much product built up on my face. I would recommend to anyone looking for a great cream!
Just started using this product  but I like so far how it hydrated my eye area

review_title: Texture is nice, but that’s about it
review_text: Texture is nice, but I havent noticed any wow results.  It’s ok, probably not worth $60.

The texture of this eye cream is amazing. I only need to use a little to get the benefits in my opinion. Are all my lines gone? No, but it does reduce them and every eye has lines. It also hydrates my under eye. Honestly my only complaint is the price, its a bit higher than I normally feel comfortable paying.

I received this product free to sample and review. I was excited to receive this product because I had already been thinking about purchasing an eye cream (for the first time), and what better way to start than with a Tatcha product!? I was super impressed with the packaging (it’s important for something that you look at everyday), and the product itself is a delight to use. It smells good and it’s very smooth. I have noticed that my makeup goes on a lot smoother in the under eye area and I’ve started to notice that the area is overall more moisturized. My only complaint is that it’s a little thick, so I feel like I have to put a bit more pressure when rubbing it in causing me to tug on the skin. Not ideal, but not enough to prevent me from purchasing in the future!

Ok so as soon as I opened the package I was so into the packaging it’s so freaking cute. It looks small but it will definitely last I use it around my eyes and smile lines and love it . I love how it really does feel like it’s melting right into my skin and helps my makeup look so much better . It has a light fragrance but nothing crazy it’s smells nice and expensive. The texture is amazing it’s cream when you look at it but melts and feels kinda watery it’s super hydrating. I would definitely buy again. I did get it complimentary for testing purposes

This eye cream feels so smooth and luxurious and even better when it is applied. I instantly feel like I am doing my sensitive under eye area a hydration favor. The price could be a little better but you do get what you pay for!

While I didn’t use this product daily, I used it frequently enough to get a feel for it. It’s thick and creamy. Which is what I feel an cream should be. Tatcha has a great reputation. I did receive a sample of this from Influenster. Would I buy this for myself? Probably not, because of the price point. I feel like there are other more cost effective creams on the market

I enjoy this eye cream. I don’t have super dry skin, so it works for me. I can’t stand greasy products on my face, so I appreciate this formula. A little goes a long way. It’s so smooth and melts right into my skin. I like to use this at night and under my makeup and I feel like it gives me a more hydrated and awake appearance. I did notice the other night that it made my eyes water some at night. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.
It’s an ok product. It smells nice and is very smooth and hydrating, but I used for over a month and didn’t see any difference.

I like the way this product feels on my skin. It’s very lightweight, but still feels hydrating and I like how I can really feel it soak into my skin. It has a slight fragrance to it, but it’s almost not noticeable in my opinion and I value that as well.I would recommend this product! I received this product complimentary to review, but all statements and opinions are my own.

review_title: Adding this to my daily beauty routine!
review_text: This product gives your eye area all day moisture. This light weight formula delivers results and does not interfere with my make up application. I visibly saw less puffiness and brighter complexion under eye area.

Must say that I was impressed by the Tacha silk peony melting eye cream been my eyes were looking as tired as I felt and the cream just perked them up like a flower with fresh water not to heavy or oily there’s a nice smooth consistency I would recommend for a quick fix saw results in about 3or4 days #complementary #influenster

I’ve been using this eye cream now for about a month and can say I’ve used it enough to give a sufficient review.The texture itself is really smooth and does have a scent but it doesn’t bother me. I use a really light layer under my eyes and bring it up to my temples. As far as preventing any fine lines, wrinkles, and helping with puffiness, I want to say it does its job. When it comes to brightening up dark circles, it’s a different story though. I haven’t noticed too much of a difference in that department. Overall, nice eye cream but nothing too too special. I do like it better than the popular Ole Henriksen Banana Brightening Eye Cream. I received this product complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes.
Received as free sample. Really love this brand. Worth the money. This eye cream was really light and didn’t feel to heavy when applying. Will have to use for longer term to truly see results.

This eye cream is great! It is a little thicker than I’m used to but in true Tatcha fashion, it completely melts and absorbs so nicely into the skin. Feel hydrating and smooth. The packaging is absolutely gorgeous but the only down side is the amount of product given. I was sent this product for free in exchange for my honest review.
I love this product. Glided on very smoothly and it was light and refreshing on my skin. I prefer it to the Kiehls under-eye cream I was using prior.

First off, the product itself is very nice. It has a lovely light consistency that is not too heavy or oily. It is an ideal eye cream. But the best part are the transparent ingredients on the label, and the fact that the product is free of pthalates among other harmful chemicals, so I feel good about using it!

review_title: Smooths under eyes with light but rich moisture
review_text: Really nice under makeup, it hydrates and blurs. My only complaint is that it doesn’t do much for puffiness or dark circles. I would have loved a little bit of brightening. The packaging is beautiful and the consistency of the crime is really light almost whipped, which I love!

I have been using Tatcha Silk Peopy for almost a month now and I have never been so happy about my results from an eye cream!!  I highly recommend this product to anyone looking to brighten and smooth their eye area.  This will become an item I purchase often.

Just like the name, this cream literally melts into your face! I love it. I’ve always dealt with dryness and creasing under my eyes, and this totally takes that away! It’s so silky, and goes on like butter. I love that I can use it as a base for literally any makeup, and it doesn’t leave any weird residue. It’s the first thing I apply after washing my face both morning and night.

I’ve been using this product twice a day for a couple weeks now. The packaging is beautiful, like most Tatcha products. The consistently was a surprise to me at first, as it is almost balm-like but melts into the skin. This is actually a good thing because I feel like I need less product and it may last longer than the average eye cream. I notice a mild brightening effect when I use it and only notice a slight scent. It is lovely under makeup and for day use.I prefer a heavier product for evening, but I am enjoying this under my makeup for day wear.I received this product for an Influenster campaign for testing purposes.

Eye skin concern: darkness, tired, wrinkles, fine linesPros: The product doesn’t have a strong smell, good amount of product in 15 ml container (I’ve used it over a month and I still have a lot left), smooth texture and moisturizing. It’s essentially good for dry skin under your eyes.Cons: my eyes are not “brighter” or “radiant” as it claims and no overall appearance of the eye. Now I’m not sure maybe results take up to 6 months, but considering the use for a little over a 1 month, no improvement.Luckily, I got this as a tester through influenster (thank you!), but I would never purchase this especially for $60, that’s absurd.

This eye cream is amazing. It’s very hydrating and a little goes a long way. It is a little more scented than you would expect an eye cream to be, but it didn’t irritate my (very sensitive) skin at all. 12/10 would recommend.

I love this product and the design is super cute! I use it day and night and it makes my skin feel so silky smooth. I use it on my eyes and around my lips because it gets dry around my mouth. Would 100% recommend!!

This is such a rich creamy hydrating cream, I saw a positive difference in my skin around the eyes in just a couple of weeks. Its expensive, I received this product complimentary, but after trying it, I would buy it again! The packaging is also beautiful!

I got this product complimentary of influenster for testing purposes. I love the packaging it is cute and small easy to store with my other products or sit out to display. when first opening it to use it does have a nice fragrance to it. I dont notice the scent once the product is applied. my first thought was that the price was crazy for the small amount of cream that is in the container but after using the product it is solid and does melt on to my finger and under my eye. I hardly have to use any at all so this is going to last me forever so 60 is a fair price since it is going to last longer then 6 months. after using this it is a nice product I put a little on in the morning before my make up and it does not effect the application of any of it.i also use a little at night. over all this is a good product and worth the price 60 that’s basically 10 a month for 6 months and this will last longer then 6 months...and the smell is nice to.

I received this item compliments of Influenster. The packaging of this eye cream is very lovely. There’s the famous light Tatcha scent in the cream. I started using this for a week to see what the results were and I’m pretty pleased with it. The formula is light weight and non greasy. I did not give it 5 stars because I felt that it didn’t 100% hydrate my skin as much as I wanted it to. Overall, it’s a nice eye cream.

I’ve been using this for about 3 weeks now, day and night. This eye cream is not bad but I didn’t see much of a difference either. It feels good and is hydrating but that’s about all. I didn’t really notice any brightening or radiance as it claims. Also, the fragrance makes my eyes water, but I also have sensitive eyes. It was nice to try it out since I got it for free through a campaign from Influenster but I don’t think I would purchase it on my own.

review_title: Great price for a wonderful product
review_text: Love this eye cream and everything about it!I used to spend a lot of money on La Mer and La Prairie products, but ever since I’ve tried this cream, I’m not going back. Better results for a fraction of a price.
It truly does melt on to your skin and feels great. So far I haven’t noticed the same firming and highlighting others have, but maybe with time.

WOW! I am loving this eye cream, it definitely lives up to its name of “melting” because it literally melts when you warm up in your fingers on to your skin. Although the price pint is high, I find myself not needing much product so it seems like it will last quite a while. This wears well under makeup too and gives me a nice hydrated base. I did receive this product complimentary for testing purposes, BUT I will likely repurchase on my own!

I’ve been using this for about 2 weeks and the skin around my eyes is definitely softer and more hydrated then before. I love the feel of it- very creamy but not greasy- and i love how quickly it absorbs into my skin. Will definitely continue use!

*FREE COMPLIMENTARY SAMPLE PROVIDED*I got this product to try in the latest Tatcha Voxbox from Influenster. I have been using for a week and I am absolutely in love with it. It leaves my under eyes feel moisturized and hydrated. It’s super smooth like butter and not heavy feeling. Cannot wait to continue using! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

Such an incredible , hydrating eye cream. I love the formula . The packaging is exquisite! Works for all skin types. I use this morning and night. If you want more radiance for your concealer, you can always mix a tiny bit of the eye cream with it.

So I got this item about a week ago as free sample and I think the texture is just fabulous. The cream just melts into your skin like butter. You can put makeup on top of it without it starting to pill or have weird lines. I have normal skin and it didn’t feel greasy or anything.
I love this eye cream so far. It’s so soft and moisturizing. It leaves my eyes soft and even brighter. A little goes a long way and it will last you a while. Would totally reccomend.

I received this product for free to test and I am shocked how much I love it! I have been using it for 2 weeks now and it moisturizes so well and I don’t have nearly has many issues with dry creases in my under eye!!

I already have a daytime eye cream but i was looking for a good nighttime eye cream. The texture of this cream is amazing! Its solid and melts as you glide your finger across it, so product isn’t wasted. I’ve been using this for a week and i can already see that my undereyes look more hydrated and aren’t as dark. i hope to see my lines get less noticeable over time, but for now i like it! this is my 4th tatcha product, i love this brand! i received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

Got this as a gift from Influenster. Really pretty packaging right on brand for tacha. The product is thick like a body butter and melts when you rub with your finger. Doesn’t take much to cover under eye. I think it’s going to last a really long time. Very light scent. Doesn’t irritate my sensitive eyes!!! I’m not seeing any difference in the lines. I do usually use very high end eye creams and it seems to be about the same. But maybe longer time will?
I love love love this eye cream! Here recently I’ve been obsessed with eye creams and this one top them! It’s so creamy and silky and the packaging is amazing!

This anti-aging eye cream is amazing! The container is super cute, and it smells really good. It applies nicely, leaves skin around eyes feeling soft, and refreshed. I love that it helps with early signs of aging!!

I’ve started using this twice a day and I am sooo impressed by this product. I’ve tried a lot of eye creams but right off the bat, the texture and quality of this felt way different. It goes on your skin soooo smooth I get why they call it “melting” eye cream. It feels great. Other products I’ve tried (many) have been thin, watery, or even sticky. This is completely different. It comes in pretty small container but it’s a thicker consistency, a little goes a long way so I think it will last me a while. I’ve used it consistently for the last 4 days and I do think I see a difference so far! I looked much more refreshed with no make up on this morning, despite getting little sleep all week. Less dark circles, bags, and under eyes less puffy. Looking forward to hopefully even more results!Full disclosure I just signed up for Influenster and received this product for free but so far I loveeeee it and would recommend it to any of my friends. Great quality. So lucky they sent it to me.

My first time using a Tatcha product and I must say I am impressed! I have dry skin under my eyes and this definitely helped improve it, I did notice dark circles under my eyes slowly disappear. The smell is so soft and smells clean which I love, I highly recommend this! I did receive this product for free

I have eyelid dermatitis that gets absolutely horrible in the fall and winter: my upper eyelids and under eyes become extremely red, dry and flakey, almost like a burn on the skin. It is so painful and causes horrible wrinkles/ Absolutely NOTHING has worked to combat this issue except for this magical cream. I am sure that the negative reviews for this cream are indicative of the fact that this cream is so incredibly rich. I imagine that the use of this cream on normal skin would cause milia and acne because it is SO moisturizing. I would NOT use this cream on my cheeks or forehead, for example, because I generally don’t have dryness in these areas. But, on skin dealing with ultra dryness, this stuff is extremely effective! After two days of applying the cream, my dry eyes (which had been flaking and horrible for 3 weeks prior!) were perfectly hydrated and back to normal. I finally look my own age again. I am so happy I found this stuff!

This eye cream has been a game changer for me. I have a tendency to get a lot of wrinkles under my eyes & this eye cream has drastically minimized that. review_title: It Actually Works? Oh ok lol
review_text: So I’m always shocked when a product works. Lol. I know y’all feel me. I received this product for free in exchange for a review - it’s not the kind of thing I ever would have purchased because I am extremely skeptical and picky with eye products in particular - most just don’t do anything. Sadly, I am at the age where my under eyes are kinda...puffy a lot. And haggard looking in general. So. I kind of do have need of such a product lol.This worked pretty immediately to smooth out texture and tighten/de-puff my under eye area. I was shocked. I had someone else confirm that it wasn’t just in my head - “oh yeah, you do look smoother and tighter.” Lol. Gee thanks. The effect is temporary of course - this isn’t really a treatment product as much as a cosmetic one. It has a polymer which is essentially forms a tightening and smoothing film over the skin. I am oily of skin and the texture remained a *little* greasy/sticky/tacky for me - presumably that is the cocoa butter content. But, it’s something I can put off with for a temporarily more youthful and rejuvenated appearance.I knocked off a star because I would prefer a lighter/less greasy texture, and because Sunday Riley’s prices are just nuts. The bottle *is* very pretty though, and it did work lol. For something to be used occasionally the price may be worth it.  Included before and after pics - it’s prob hard to tell much a difference given the poor lighting in my crib, but it was very noticeable IRL. At least my eyes look nice in them!

I don’t wake up feeling oily and seems to work well underneath my makeup. Overall, I think this is a great eye cream that combines moisturizing, brightening, and depuffing when used day and night!

DRUNK ELEPHANT slaai makeup-melting butter cleanseri use as my step 1 of a double/triple cleanse to remove makeup—MAC studio radiance face and body waterproof base which is sheer but it has staying power. after rinsing DE slaai, i use bioderma  sensibo H2O soaked cotton rounds to remove any leftover mascara and residue. DE slaai is also my 1st step to clean Sephora Pro synthetic makeup brushes. i start w DE slaai and then Bioderma sensibo H2O to remove makeup. then i use Dawn dish detergent to clean followed by quick dip in 70% isopropyl alcohol/rubbing alcohol to disinfect.

review_title: Goodbye makeup wipes, hello cleansing balm!
review_text: I try to avoid drunk elephant products because I don’t like how the company is run; however, this makeup balm is one that I have yet to find a good alternative for. I no longer have to use makeup wipes to remove my makeup, I just slab this on my face and follow up with cleanser and all my makeup comes off smoothly. The container is also really large making this a good value product. Deducting one star because it does leave skin greasy after application, so following with a normal cleanser is a must!
Bought this because the Sephora employer recommended it over the farmacy cleanser. It works just as well and has better ingredients apparently. Worth it, little goes a long way!

Honestly I was excited to buy this. But it leaves so much oil residue in my face I have to triple cleanse. And I went to the store to return and they only want to give me half the money. This is ridiculous. It also made me break out. Don’t buy if you have acne prone skin. Not worth the money!

This is my favorite makeup remover! It does a great job at dissolving waterproof mascara and hydrating my skin. It does not burn my sensitive, dry eyes. I remove the makeup and product with a soft facial cloth and warm water. I follow-up with my regular facial routine. I do not use the booster but it can provide a nice exfoliation.

I think some of the fruit oils they have chosen to use may be more fragile than would be ideal for a mass produced product. Mine may have been sitting for a while or not air tight so the oils were not as fresh. I don’t know if I got a bad one or if this is just how it smells. I’m going for something with more stable oils next time.

review_text: So there was a solid top, but after breaking into it, there was liquid underneath.  Mixing it all together just made it all liquid.
