I tried to use the drunk elephant bars for a while as a change and i felt like my forehead was much more congested. I have combination skin. As soon as I went back to this cleanser my skin was smoother and less congested. I  never double cleanse with it and my skin is the clearest when I use this product!

I got this as a sample from my points and I initially loved it, so I decided to buy it. When I got the full size, the butter cleanse does not fully wash off my skin. I have to wipe it with a towel and do a double cleanse afterwards. The sample I originally got would fully rinse off without needing the second cleanse. It does an effective enough of a job at removing make up and it has zero scent, along with no irritation to my skin. So that’s good. I was just disappointed that the full size didn’t wash off completely with warm water as the mini sample I got did. It must be a production issue on some batches.
This cleansing balm does a great job removing all my makeup at the end of the day. I use it as the first step in my double cleanse and it works better than other oil or balm cleansers I’ve tried.

This is possibly the worst cleansing balm I have ever used. It leaves such a thick film on  my face even after I used my clarisonic to wash after. I still felt slimy and dirty when I used this.  I have quite I few more that I like 1000x better than this. The packaging is nice though.
Probably the worst makeup melter I have tried. It did not remove my makeup and took forever to rinse the residue off my face.
I have gone threw 2 of these and I love them it gets all my makeup off and does not leave my face feeling tight!

I love this balm , it’s soft and gentle on the skin It melts the makeup away.  My skin feels clean without it being completely stripped from moisture. I use it with the beste no.9 jelly cleanser and it has worked miracle on my face. I seen a lot of people leaving reviews saying that It left your skin feeling greasy but I don’t have that problem. I take a soft washcloth , wet it and remove it. It does feel different from a water based cleaser but it’s definitely not greasy in my opinion. When I run out I will definitely repurchase. It’s a big yes for me.
I use this as the first step of my double cleanse routine.  My eye makeup (mascara, liquid liner, waterline eyeliner) melts right off.  I’m on my 4th jar.

I would start by saying I really like Drunk Elephant products, and there is nothing wrong with this product - it is just nothing special. There are so many better options at the same price point or cheaper that i really like, i wouldn’t buy this again. Also i hate the smell.. I understand this is made with natural ingredients and no perfume which i do like, but other brands have found a way to do the same without smelling like this one does. I’ll use it until it’s gone, but i am counting down the days until I can start using the Farmacy cleansing balm again.

review_title: Doesn't rinse clean, but did I get a bad batch?
review_text: I don’t like to place a bad review but I really don’t get the hype for this product. I’ve used many oil based make up removers as my first cleansing step. This cleanser is so thick and greasy even using the smallest amount I have to wash twice to remove it and I still feel it is coating my skin. It also has a smell of old oil, slightly rancid. I know Drunk Elephant does not use fragrance which, of course, is a good thing but still this, to my nose, smells like it is past its expiration date. I have used the Farmacy cleanser and much prefer that. Its lighter, smells nice, and rinses clean.

I love cleansing balms and wanted to love this one, but it was a miss for me. It applies like a typical balm and mixes around your makeup like you’d expect, but when applying water doesn’t melt away. You’re left with an oily film on your skin, and I’m not sure how much makeup it even took off. I also have naturally breakout-free skin (I’m lucky), but after one use (and not changing any other skincare) it completely broke me out over my entire face! Unfortunately, strong pass for me.

Really love this cleanser. It takes off a full face of makeup without feeling drying. I see many reviews stating that it leaves ‘a film’ behind-I get what they mean but personally I don’t mind the feeling; my skin feels hydrated as opposed to being stripped of its natural oils. I love that the smell is bland and doesn’t feel like a bunch of unnecessary ingredients were added. This is now an everyday, makeup-removing cleanser for me that leaves my skin feeling silky and hydrated, especially impressive in the cold winter dryness.
I’m so happy I found this cleanser. It’s perfect for removing eye makeup at the end of the day and doesn’t leave your skin feeling like it stripped all the moisture out of it.

I could not live with out this. This takes my make up off so easily and quickly. No left over residue. Mascara and black eyeliner, gone. I will say I exclusively use this as a make up remover, so I follow up with another gentle cleanser after. But this is the only thing that takes eye make up off without it an absolute struggle. And drink elephant does it again with the packaging! I love the magnetic wand on the lid!!
Removes makeup, oil, and dirt so easily, but is gentle on my skin.  Love love love this!
my favorite cleansing balm! so buttery and takes off make up easily!
This is the only cleanser I’ve tried that takes off my makeup completely and leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated.

This is a really great price for how long this lasts me—approx. 3-4 months. and for how tiny the exfoliant looks, it reeeally lasts a long time as well. It has been the best face cleanser I have ever used—it takes all my makeup off (EVEN MY MASCARA!), it doesn’t leave my dry skin feeling tight, and it lasts quite a while. I have repurchased this once.

Best cleansing balm I’ve ever tried. I love how a little goes a long way! Usually cleansing balms last me about a month, but this one lasted me almost three months! Also, the booster is a really nice addition so I can have my exfoliation process at the same time before cleansing.

review_title: Waterproof mascaras and fake tattoos beware!
review_text: Let me tell ya! I put on a fake tattoo the other day and that sucker would NOT come off my skin. In desperation, I thought, “okay the melting butter cleanser removes some hardcore waterproof mascara so let’s give it a try on my Ana, Elsa, and Olaf tat!” I put a dime size of this cleanser and it melted off in seconds- sorry Olaf. I have really dry skin and this is a great way for me to remove my makeup. I prefer to follow up with DE’s Pekee bar of soap to remove any residue.

I absolutely love this product. I have very dry skin and this takes my makeup right off without having to scrub my skin and it doesn’t dry it out. I rub this on my skin then wet my hands and rub it some more before rinsing it off. My skin has never looked better.

I think this product is worth the money and its a good alternative to makeup wipes and the Farmacy oil based makeup melter. (that has polyethylene in it, basically just plastic) I honestly just use this as a makeup melter and not so much a cleanser. I use this on my dry skin and then once i wash it off, I wash my face with a gentle exfoliator and my skin is perfect. You can’t expect all of the makeup to come off if you have a full face of makeup and youre not exfoliating/ using a face scrub brush in my opinion. I love this product, it feels nice on my face and doesnt leave any residue. Also people complaining about the oil making thier eyes filmy, its because the oil is stuck in your lashes. Just wash them gently with a cleanser.
I only wish it smelled better, but it makes my skin feel like butter. I LOVE this product.

I was originally looking for the Bobbi Brown Cleansing Oil but the store I went to didn’t have a BB counter. A sales associate recommended this to me -- oh dear i wish i still have the box to return!!! It’s the thickest oil that that’s effort to emulsify and the smell is on the unpleasant side as well. Out of all the cleansing balms / oils I have tried this is one of the least favorites due to the texture! Yes it removes makeup well, but the whole experience doesn’t bring me joy like many others. WILL NEVER REPURCHASE! I don’t get along with any DE product i’ve tried so far....sign...

I’m so glad I got to try a small size of this in Midi Committee because I hate it! I usually use Clinique’s makeup remover balm and the DE one has made me realize how much I really love the Clinique. Slaai has a funky smell that reminds me of plastic or something unpleasant and just doesn’t wash off! It does remove my makeup but as another reviewer said, it feels like I rubbed butter all over my face after rinsing with water. The residue is thick and disgusting and I have to wash twice after to get this stuff off my skin. Usually I will try to finish up products even if I don’t love them but I don’t know if I can finish this one. I hate it so much.

This product does it’s job of breaking down all makeup. BUT. it is extremely greasy and SUPER hard to get off your skin. It leaves a rubbery film on your face, as if you used coconut oil. Both this, and coconut oil clog pores and cause breakouts. I would not recommend this.

I NEVER thought I would be writing a 1 star review for a drunk elephant product. But this cleansing balm is TERRIBLE. The smell is terrible, smells like old olive oil or something and the performance is so lackluster I have the same results using a rag and warm water. I bought this in the “midi“ kit, and i’m not sure if it was an old container, or that is just the natural smell, but  I can’t get over it and it smells disgusting to me. The texture is horrid, it leaves a nasty residue, does not perform, has left a waxy residue in my sink, just everything about this product is a flop IMO. I will gladly continue to use  Farmacy green clean.

I’ve been using this for months trying to make myself love it but...this product misses the mark. It all but doesn’t emulsify. In fact when I add water I find that it makes it harder to wash off as the water just rolls off my face. It emulsifies a bit better if I use hot water BUT that is TERRIBLE for skin. It also is notorious for leaving makeup behind. This works better using a washcloth to remove..but that defeats a good balm in my mind.

review_title: Don't knock it till you try it.
review_text: This product is really good. I use the most long lasting mascara and eyeshadows and it takes them off. This is also better for your wallet. buy this instead of the pharmacy one. you get more.

I just don’t know about this cleanser. I have been using this for about 3 weeks now. I am loyal to the DE line so of course I needed to try this. I have tried using varying amounts of the product to see what results I can get out of this cleanser. If you use too much you seem to have this thick layer of product left over on your face like a film. And too much as in maybe a full sized spoon of the product. I just recently started using a very small sampling of the product and rub it really well in my hands to warm it up and turn it into an oil before I apply it to my face and that has seemed to work best. This product definitely requires a double cleanse to make your face feel clean. It does remove make up but something is just off with this.
I received this in my Play box and it’s horrible. It leaves an oily film all over your face and doesn’t come off! I used my Philosophy purity face wash to get my skin feeling clean.

I LOVE this balm cleanser as my first cleanse. It doesn’t feel stripping at all, in fact it feels very moisturizing and I don’t notice any residue, although i immediately follow up with a second cleanse. I have acne-prone skin and this hasn’t broken me out at all. I only wear sunscreen on most days, and sometimes just a light amount of concealer so I can’t say how well it takes off makeup. It lathers up well, feels great on dry skin before you add the little bit of water necessary to lather it up. Plus, you get a lot of product for the price. I’ll definitely be repurchasing.

I’m a skincare snob, DE has great products but this one was just your average melt on your face oil cleanser/makeup remover double cleanse. It didn’t even take all of my eye makeup off without rubbing.

After reading the reviews I was nervous to try this product but now I’m so happy I did. I had no issues with odor or greasiness like other people mentioned. As a makeup remover. It worked perfectly for me, but I also don’t wear waterproof or hard to remove makeup so make of that what you will. As a cleanser, it is amazing on my dry skin. I  was using GlamGlow face wash with Mario Badescu moisturizer before. I changed to DE cleansing balm with DE moisturizer in the morning with a combo of DE cleaning  balm,  glamglow cleanser,  and DE moisturizer at night and my skin is noticeably more glowy and hydrated. Worth the money. Just a tip,  after you massage into dry skin, massage it again with wet hands. The balm will get a soapy look and then it rinses off much more cleanly.
I love it! it takes all of the make  off! and doesnt leave your face feeling dry.  its amazing product

This is a pretty disappointing product from DE. This doesn’t remove makeup well, and on top of that it is very difficult to wash off, leaving you an oily/waxy face instead of a hydrated face. There are a lot of products in the market that works better than this. The only reason I give 2 stars is because of the packaging.
Leaves greasy almost waxy residue and does not remove all makeup, FAIL

More about my skin: I have all over dry skin, very rarely oily even after 12+ hours in foundation, but my skin is textured and flakey. I also have moderate eczema that happens between by brows and on my cheeks. I’ve loved this product! In college I used coconut oil to remove my make up and this product is what you WISH coconut oil could achieve. It’s luscious once it warms up on your hands/face and leaves the slime feeling soft and not greasy. All of my make up comes off completely with this product, waterproof and all! I’ve had several other high-end makeup removers that do this, but this product breaks down the tough makeup so quickly and gently I don’t even worry about wearing it anymore!I usually follow this product with a very gentle + clean cleanser, just so I have a less saturated face to apply my nightly moisturizer onto.

Love this stuff!! Removes even my eye makeup without having to scrub my eyes very hard. This is the perfect first step in any double cleanse routine. Will be keeping this product in my routine for a very long time!

I am actually so impressed with this stuff! I never want to run out. I have acne prone skin and have completely switched from washing my face morning and night to using this instead. It has made the biggest difference in my skin! In love!

I like oils that remove makeup but this one was incredibly waxy. No matter how much water I used I felt like my face was left with a layer of wax on it. I went in with another gel cleanser and then after that makeup wipes... I will not be using this product again

review_title: Not the best, still not the worst
review_text: I was excited to try this when I received a mini in my play box this month - however, I wasn’t impressed. The consistency feels more greasy than smooth, and I felt as though I couldn’t get it all off with water... it doesn’t emulsify well. Waterproof eye makeup was also a challenge, but it got the job done. For the price point, I’d just go with a more tried & true product.

This is one of my first cleansing balm’s that I have tried and I love the drunk elephant line all around it. Great ingredients my skin feels conditions and ultra soft and takes away any trace of make up and doesn’t irritate skin great even for oily skin

review_title: Not a holy grail, but not a holy fail
review_text: I like this balm, but I don’t love it. It does its job, but I’ve tried others that do it better. I found that it didn’t completely dissolve my eye makeup and left some smudged that I had to remove with a different cleanser. You’ll need to use a washcloth to rinse because it leaves a really greasy residue. I’ll keep using it for now because I like the moisture it adds and I like the ingredients and the fact that there are no added fragrances. Also, I LOVE the magnetic spoon!!!!

I’ve never used a cleansing balm but like most other drunk elephant products I enjoy this. It removed my full face of make up without a trace. I used a wash cloth to wipe it off (a step I always do regardless of the product I use). It did exactly what it claimed and I like the mini physical exfoliator that’s included.

This takes off makeup easily and does not dry my skin out like a lot of cleansers out there. This is great for drier skin / those who wear foundation daily. Finished my first tub and will be repurchasing.

Can’t say enough good things about this. I use this every night to remove makeup and absolutely love how gentle it is around the eyes. I decided to ditch makeup wipes because I hated how much pulling I was doing around my eyes with the wipes (hello wrinkles). Right before starting using this I had a forehead full of little bumps from clogged pores but this helped to clear them up right away. This is an amazing product that I will definitely be repurchasing . The bamboo exfoliant is an awesome bonus too I thought it was so nice that they include that with the cleanser. Side note I double cleanse and think that if using this to remove makeup a second step of toner or another cleanser would be needed.

It’s a good makeup remover, gets everything off. Efficient—end of story. I wasn’t really moved off my rocker for this makeup remover, it got the job done. Didn’t know what I was expecting, it lasts about as long as you think it would.

Of course its good. Its Drunk Elephant! Can’t say enough good about the packaging. The magnet attached scoop that adheres to the top is amazing! Why doesn’t everyone do that!  And the washing balm is my second favorite balm ever. Sorry but I do love Farmacy just a tiny bit better. Much better than Cliniques’. Not sure what the small tube is in the picture, don’t think I received that. But this is great, and you only need a tiny bit to wash your face.

review_title: too thick and heavy - doesn’t feel clean
review_text: I love balm cleansers, but I HATED this. It’s hella thick and heavy, doesn’t emulsify, and left a thick film on my face that required a second AND a third cleanse before I felt like I didn’t have a layer of Vaseline on my face. Seriously it was like cleansing with Crisco. I’m bummed, because that magnetized scoop is genius, but the product inside the packaging was awful. Plus I get that DE is all virtuous about no added fragrance, but I hated the smell of this. Very medicinal. I returned this for the Farmacy balm, which smells so much better.

review_title: I finally found a cleansing oil I love!
review_text: Being a flight attendant that works international flights this particular cleanser butter is a big winner in two major ways. First, it isn’t a liquid. It has the consistency of coconut oil but is hard at higher temps. Because of this I can bring this to places that I normally would not be able to if it was a regular liquid form cleansing oil. It also is one less thing I have to worry about exploding in my bag. Second, this stuff busts through my makeup like nothing else I’ve ever had. Being how I use long wear makeup that has to last for at least 12 hours, being in multiple environments, as well as being slept on during break in bunks, it usually takes MULTIPLE washings to effectively remove it. Even with using clinique’s Take Off The Day, I still had to wash my face several times. With the Butter, I have literally cut my removal time in half. First I have to mention how little you need to get the full effect. At the rate that I’m going, I can see this lasting most of the year. While using it, my eye makeup and mascara, (which was always the hardest to remove) practically melts away. The result is a face that is manageable with a regular cleanser. I have fairly sensitive skin and so far I haven’t had any issues. In the end I completely recommend it to anyone who is removing some heavy duty makeup.
This butter cleanser is good, takes off makeup as stated.
Love it. Works better than most cleansers & makeup remover wipes combined.

This was an impulse purchase from the Rouge Sale and buy was I thrilled with it. I usually use Trader Joe’s oil facial cleanser and do a double cleanse with the juju bar to remove makeup. But this melted off my makeup and didn’t leave a trace of mascara without damaging my lashes. I felt like it did leave a bit of an oily residue, which might be great for dry skin. This wasn’t a problem because I am sticking to the double cleanse with the juju or peeke bar. I also love the magnetic spatula. This brand never disappoints!

I was really excited about trying this cleanser. However, I was slightly disappointed. It doesn’t take all your makeup off. So I can’t skip that step. It is a nice cleanser. It leaves my skin silky or buttery. But i will revert back to my standby cleanser.
I have really dry skin and I have great results with product!

I’ve read all the reviews about it leaving a greasy film, but to be fair, the product description does say it’s supposed to moisturize and leave a dewy glow.. I double cleanse, so it doesn’t bother me as much. I mean, it does its job :) takes off ALL da makeup. The bamboo charcoal thing is meh...I’d rather use my normal exfoliator.

I love cleansing balms it’s always the first step in my makeup removal routine.  My go 2 has been the Green clean by Farmacy. When I saw DE was coming out with one I wanted to give it a try. I got a sample size of this in the current promo that’s happening and when I tried it for the first time I was seriously underwhelmed. It’s thick and really oily and I found it hard to rub into the skin. I felt like I was rubbing for a minute before it started to melt. Furthermore, it felt like it was sitting on top of my skin and makeup  as an oily mess rather than dissolving the makeup. I had to cleanse two more times with deep cleanser and my Foreo brush to get all the makeup off. I gave it one more try just to see if it was my own user error and got the same results; frustrating. I’m glad I got this as a sample if I had purchased it I would definitely be returning it.

Yuuuuuck!!! I use a pea sized amount every time and every time I literally can’t get it off my face!!! It leaves a nasty, chapstick feeling all over your face that you can’t get off unless you wash your face with something else. Oh yeah and it doesn’t even remove my makeup!! Yuck, no thanks!!

I love this cleansing balm. I’ve previously tried Farmacy Green Clean and Physician’s Formula Matcha Cleansing Balm. This is my favorite out of them all (I do not recommend the Physician’s Formula one. It’s significantly cheaper but does not take my eye makeup off any better than just regular face wash). The Farmacy one is great, but with this one you get a little more product for the same cost, and you get the Bamboo Booster for exfoliating. I will say that this one isn’t as smooth as Farmacy’s, but it’s easy enough to massage out the little clumps. The packaging is also 10/10.

LOVE! This cleanser has changed everything. I had a bout of dryness/redness and I thought my usual cleansing routine might be the culprit and wanted to go with a balm/oil cleanser. I tried this after talking with the DE rep at Sephora and WOW...skin is soft, smooth, even... Dark mascara needs some additional effort for removal, but I’m okay with that because my skin has never looked better.
MY FAVORITE THING EVER! Removing make-up has never been for peaceful. I will never use any other product!
LOVE it as a makeup remover/first cleanser in my routine. It’s nourishing without being too heavy for my oily acne prone skin
Washed off completely fine for me. Took off eye makeup better than the Clinique one or the Farmacy one. Packaging is brilliant!

I wasn’t really in the market for a new cleanser, but then DE dropped this item and I had to try it! It’s not my favourite smell, kind of smells like playdough but I know DE doesn’t add fragrances which is fine. It removes all my makeup and leaves my skin feeling super hydrated and soft. It does leave a waxy feeing on the skin but DE said this is to soothe and nourish the skin barrier (??). It doesn’t bother me though, just makes my skin feel extra silky. This product doesn’t make me break out and doesn’t irritate my skin (my skin is v sensitive). And the packaging is bomb.

review_title: Left Me With Greasy Skin and Burning Eyes!!
review_text: I’ve tried so many balm cleansers and this is by far the worst! I usually love DE products and use several of them in my daily routines. I tried using this with different variables, ie. with and without mascara, with and without eyeshadow, and with and without lip color. My eyes burned every time I even got the product close to my eyes. And the burning sensation lasted almost an hour. Plus it leaves a greasy feeling on the face which is not pleasant.With Slaai containing 22+ ingredients, I’m most likely reacting to one of the ingredients. Just because DE doesn’t use the “suspicious 6“ doesn’t mean that a person can’t have a reaction to one of their ingredients. I will be returning asap.

This might be the only cleansing balm to leave my eyes irritation free! Normally I have red, blurry eyes after a balm but this one was great! I used half a scoop and melted it in my hands and it removed virtually every bit of makeup with minimal effort- even my lash glue! I really didn’t mind removing it with a washcloth because that’s how u normally remove oil cleansers anyway so it’s not that much of a bother. It didn’t dry out my skin, and left me feeling really clean and soft!

I am literally in love with this cleanser. I was recently using Farmacy’s Green Clean (which I really do like), but this beats it hands down. I love that it doesn’t irritate my eyes/make them blurry at all when I use it and it takes off my makeup like a dream. Full disclosure I don’t wear a ton of makeup, usually just mascara, eyeliner and concealer. My skin feels so soft after using it. And I didn’t think I would but I also really like the little bamboo booster it came with. The packaging is great and really like the magnetic spoon—I can’t tell you how many spatulas I’ve lost from products like this. Overall it’s just great! Wouldn’t change a thing and would 100% repurchase.

This cleansing balm is AMAZING. The first night I used it, I didn’t use the grains with it. Initial thoughts: it took off my eye makeup, foundation, etc. I always like to check a cleansing balm to see how much it didn’t get off my face by following with a micellar water. I did this and literally nothing came off on my cotton pad. Tonight I tried it with the exfoliating grains and it was a game changer! It left my skin so soft and it felt like a deep clean. This is hands down one of my favorite cleansing balms now.

I suddenly developed rosacea 5 years ago, including the type that affects the eyes. I had to give up wearing eye makeup and struggled with my skin for years before finding Drunk Elephant. I eventually gave up on foundation as well since it all made my skin angry, partly because nothing could ever get it all off without causing more irritation. Well, since using Slaai, I’ve been able to wear makeup again (only stuff that’s safe for my reactive skin) because I actually have a product that will remove it all without irritating my eyes or face. I’ve been using it every night and am so so happy! It is the first oil/balm cleanser I’ve ever used that doesn’t blur my vision or burn my eyes and it’s also the only one I’ve used that rinses clean without oily residue and the need for a second cleanse. It removes all makeup effortlessly and I have had no issues with breakouts or extra oiliness. It smells pretty waxy/oily but that’s because DE doesn’t use fragrance so if you’re into things that smell pretty you probably won’t like this one but the performance is so worth it. (For reference, Farmacy Green Clean is garbage compared to this and I sent it back after it burned my whole face and didn’t even remove all of my makeup).

No great smell but Been using this product for the past few days. It definitely feels like the consistency of butter and when rubbing it on feels like your lathering butter on your face. I wear mascara and concealer and this product definitely makes it easy to get it off. I have to rinse more then I would with other balms. But this balm leaves my face feeling smooth and refreshed. I love the feeling of my skin after using the product and love the magnetic spoon! Great idea. I also have rosacea and this didn’t irritate it at all

Best balm I have used so far.  Removes all of my waterproof masara with some work. Clinique balm will still leave some behind but not a problem with this.  It does feel a bit heavier after rinising off but I personally don’t mind if since I double cleanse.  Pleasantly surprised and will repurchase.

review_title: A little bit goes a long way!
review_text: I was SO excited to see DE came out with a cleanser specifically for removing makeup! I like the Beste cleanser, but it didn’t remove makeup (specifically eye makeup) very well. This product is AMAZING. I used way too much the first time and it took a while to wash it off- a little bit goes a LONG way. This tub is going to last forever!

i have combination dry/oily acne prone skin and this is by far my favorite mask! the cooling effect feels amazing and does a great job helping with inflammation. it controls my oil without stripping moisture like other clay masks do
I use this mask maybe once a month. The cold and Monty feeling works well and my face feels so clean after. I do see my pores minimize after use.

OMG I AM OBSESSED!!! I asked my friend for a good recommendation for a clay mask because my blackheads and pores were getting bad. She suggested I try this one and I’m so glad I did! I wasusing samples of it and now I’m gonna buy the.bottle.
I try a lot of masks, this one made a visible difference in leaving my large pores in the T zone noticeably cleaner

This is the only Olehenriksen product I use and it’s also the only mask I genuinely love. It’s such a treat. Usually doing a mask feels like a chore, but I actually look forward to this because it’s so easy to apply, wash off and it feels like a drink of peppermint tea for your pores. It doesn’t dry out my face, but I always use a moisturizing serum and then finish with squalane oil from the ordinary afterwards. Next morning my face feels like a house organized by Marie Condo—only bringing me joy.
This is a very “meh“ clay mask. It’s not extraordinary by any means.If I am going to spend the money on a clay mask, I think I’d rather go with GG supermud.

This applies so nicely and washes off easily too which is key, no scrubbing! It feels cool and leaves me skin feeling so soft. I don’t have big pores so I can’t speak to those properties but my skin looked and felt great after using it.
Calms my acne flare ups and overall provides a soothing feeling.
Love everything about this mask! The colour, the smell, and the tingling. Works well and skin feels so refreshed after washing off.
This mask is such a fun colour and works amazingly. It makes my skin feel SO clean and soft, and it is very cooling and refreshing!

I’ve been using this mask for about 3 weeks now and have notice a significant decrease in redness around my nose area, and on breakouts. When I am starting to get a pimple, I use the mask and I have found that redness and swelling have gone down. I don’t believe I’ve used it long enough to notice a shrinkage of my pores yet. It definitely has a strong peppermint smell and cools down your face. Be careful when rinsing because it definitely does not feel good in the eyes. Overall great mask, is fun to use and helps with redness and swelling.

review_title: Effective and fun, but not an essential
review_text: I have naturally large pores that tend to get bumpy with sebaceous filaments, so that is what this review is focused on, not blackheads or whiteheads. I noticed that after I removed the strip, there was a noticeable blurring of my normally VERY visible pores, and this effect lasted all day. By evening my pores looked their usual (genetic) size, but visibly clean. When I run my finger along the top of my nose, I no longer feel rough bumps, even a day later. I would recommend this product to anyone with sebaceous filaments who wants a temporary pore minimizing effect or rapid smoothing. I’m not sure how this would compare to drugstore versions, but obviously it does have added beneficial ingredients that those products do not have.Downsides to this product: There are only four nose strips per package, and since I didn’t need the rectangular strips, this was very expensive per unit. Like many other customers, I wish they would sell these two varieties separately. The nose strip must be placed carefully to avoid tugging at the under eye area, and removed slowly and carefully to not irritate the skin. Since it does pull at the skin when you remove it, I am not sure whether it would be safe to use daily to achieve the pore blurring effect, and at any rate it is too expensive for me to use daily. Using a retinol serum or exfoliating acids could probably smooth and minimize pores just as effectively and you would get more uses out of that kind of product.  Note that this product does not PULL blackheads or filaments out like a traditional pore strip, so do not expect this. Don’t get the strip wet! I sprayed it with a mist last night unthinkingly and this made it hard to remove and irritated my skin.Overall I am not sure whether this is a product I would want to incorporate into my routine, because while I love the way it produces results immediately, I’m not sure it’s necessary except for special occasions or other rare days when I want to rapidly unclog my pores.

The next night, I tried again but showered before and put them on right after - big difference! I think these work the best when you put them on when your skin is warm, freshly washed, and all the gunk in your pores is loosened up. Now when I shower at night before bed, I dry my face and put one of these on my nose and use the pore strip either on my chin or cheeks. I have also cut the pore strip one into different sizes so it fits my face/the areas I want to draw gunk out of my pore better and it still worked great! Does this product magically make all your pores disappear? absolutely not. But does it help and have I seen a reduction in blemishes from clogged pores? yes. For anyone with sensitive skin who may be worried to try these, my skin reacts to everything (fragrance allergy, environmental allergies, easily irritated, etc.) and it has been totally fine with these! review_title: Decent, but not the best I've tried before
review_text: I wasn’t disappointed, but have experienced others being top dog.

I have been using this stuff religiously for a little over 10 years and I swear it’s the one product in my skin care routine that actually keeps my cystic acne under control. My mom first introduced me to this product when I was in the 8th grade (because that’s when I started getting forehead acne), and it’s been a game changer ever since. As I went through my hormonal teens and stressful college years, this mask stayed by my side. It wasn’t until I started my Accutane treatment that I stopped using it, but only because I didn’t need its help anymore. But before Accutane, this mask reduced my redness, kept my cysts at bay, and helped prevent those pesky whiteheads and black heads from reappearing every day. I also would only apply this mask to my problem areas rather than my whole face. And because the mask dries down matte, I would use it to spot treat any difficult pimples and go to sleep with it on. By the morning, the bump would be practically half the size. Another perk about this mask is that it has this cooling effect that helped reduce my skin irritation and soothed the bumps that I couldn’t help but pick. I also have super sensitive skin and suffer from eczema patches that will occasionally appear on my face. But this mask was sensitive enough that when applied over my eczema, it didn’t sting nor cause further irritation. Maybe it was placebo, but I think it helped the eczema on my face go away? Although I love this mask, I wouldn’t recommend it to those who are looking for something hydrating. It doesn’t dry out nor strip your skin, but it doesn’t deliver any form of added hydration.

review_title: Gentle, light scent and good for combination skin
review_text: This is a “just come back to it” kind of face wash. It’s one of my old reliables. I’ve used it on and off since I was a teenager. I’m now in my 30s, so that longevity tells you this is tried and true for lots of people! It’s just a well rounded cleanser. The smell isn’t over the top, it’s creamy, not too hard on my dry spots but still cleanses my oilier forehead. My acne has mostly faded away as I’ve gotten older, but when I had moderately bad acne this was still gentle, didn’t make breakouts worse (it also won’t clear them though, so if you have acne or very oily skin, I’d maybe look for something more specific to that need). Highly recommend for combination/dry skin.

The Origins Check and Balances Face Wash is a great face wash for any skin type, especially sensitive. I have oily skin and was able to use this to wash away the oiliness as well as it’s great for taking off makeup. I love that I can use a very small amount and it’s enough for the entire face and gives a very good froth amount. The texture is very soft, I would say it feels almost like a soft paste. It has a very slight minty smell but doesn’t leave any lingering smells. It hasn’t caused any breakouts nor left any other sensations. I love this face wash because compared to other face washes, this one doesn’t leave my face feeling dry. Instead leaves my skin soft, smooth, and can tell that it leaves it clean without leaving it dry. I recommend this for any skin type!

I have combination skin, and I’ve really enjoyed getting using the Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash as part of my daily skin care routine. I use it as my second cleanser in a two-step double cleansing method, where I use this product after an oil-based cleanser. I have really liked the results I am seeing. I know and trust Origins as a brand as well.

review_text: I’ve tried this cleanser on two seperate occasions (months apart) really wanting to love it as I had gotten it in a gift set both times. the first couple of days to a week would be fine and then all of a sudden my cheeks would start to get small/medium sized bumps and become very red. it goes away almost immediately when I would stop using it so it had to be the culprit. I have a love-hate relationship with pretty much every face wash I have ever used.  I either love the scent, the way it feels, the way it works or the way it makes my skin feel afterward, but never more than one at a time.  I really love this face wash.  I love the scent, it smells subtly minty and clean, almost spa-like; I love the way it froths up and it feels velvety on my skin; it make my face feel clean and I cleans my face thoroughly; and it doesn’t make my face feel dry or tight afterward.  You only need a little bit of this, maybe a pea-sized amount, in the palm of your hand, then add water froth it up and massage on your wet skin. (Don’t add it to your skin before adding water to make it frothy.)  It washes off easily, which is a bonus for me as some are harder to rinse off completely without leaving a weird residue or scrubbing my face too hard to remove it. I have combination skin and this cleanses my face well.  I don’t notice it has made any difference in the overall oiliness or dryness, but it doesn’t dry out my skin or make it feel tight nor does it cause my skin to produce excess oil. I’ve tested how well it cleanses by taking a makeup remover wipe after and I’ve washed my face and there was no makeup that appeared on the wipe, so I can confidently say this is good as a cleanser and makeup remover.  I’m fortunate to not have problem skin and I don’t have any adverse reactions to any product, but I’m surprised at how many reviewers complained about breakouts.  This is a pretty gentle cleanser, so I wouldn’t have guessed it to cause any breakouts. Everyone has different skin, though, and not all products work for everyone, I guess.  For me, this pretty much hits the mark on every level for what I want out of a cleanser.

The only thing that helps my hormonal acne on sensitive skin. This nightly in combination with a retinol after a gentle cleanser is a god send. Just make sure to hydrate after! 10/10 saved my skin.
I didn’t see any results from this product. I’m not sure if my skin really liked face oil, so take into consideration if you haven’t tried face oils before.

I so wanted this to be a holy grail product but it just wasn’t. I do think it helped clear my chest and back, but it did very little for my hormonal acne on my face. So be warned, if you have hormonal acne this won’t touch it. Also, the smell is AWFUL and so strong so if you are using it on your face it is literally hard to sleep at night because of the smell.

Be prepared for an INTENSE purge. If you struggle with acne you might consider purchasing this like I did. Overall I don’t regret it but I must say that I think it contributed to the WORST acne flair up I’ve had in my life. I’m 26 and suddenly one day found myself struggling with breakouts that would just not quit. This definitely made them worse but I stuck with it questioning the purge my skin may be doing after years of working in a dirty mechanic shop. I can safely say my skin is definitely clearer and healthier now and I’ve seen a reduction in my pores. My advice is to be prepared and use something like a baking soda tonic (please do your research as this comes with risks too!) and follow it up with this. My pores are so clean and my fine lines are substantially lessened. Keep with it. Be patient. Don’t beat yourself up over having acne. And don’t mind the smell— honestly if it works for you are you really going to let a natural odor bother you? It’s not synthetic smelling. Just earthy!

Truly an amazing well rounded product! I’ve had mine for a over a year now. Skin type: Dry/combination sensitive. Whenever I feel a breakout or bumps coming on I would use this as the last step in my regiment. It smells herbal and very strong and pungent. However, if you can get pass the smell it does tremendously help your skin texture and get rid of acne. I find that if I use this in conjunction with with tatcha vitamin c it helps fades old acne scars. Be patient with it and I hope you have amazinggg skin!!

The improvements I saw in only one night of use were really really impressive. Texture on my forehead that nothing had worked on before was noticeably smoother. Unfortunately I cannot get past the smell. I am not exaggerating when I say it made me gag nearly every time I smelled it. I’m the person who will use up a product no matter what, especially if it’s expensive like this one, and I couldn’t force myself to use this. I used for three nights — I tried not breathing through my nose, I tried smearing Vick’s vaporub under my nose to counteract it. Nothing worked. Unusable for me. However, some people don’t mind the smell at all; if you can get your hands on a sample of this to see whether or not you can stand it, I would — it’s truly a great product otherwise
I love this stuff. Literally tones down acne overnight and completely got rid of all my acne scars in 2-3 weeks. I am so glad this exists! I am repurchasing this for sure.
Works well and quickly to treat hormonal breakouts, but it smells terrible. My husband hates that I wear it to bed. I’ll still do it because it works so well, but just be prepared.

This is literally my favorite skin product ever. I have struggled with moderate acne for years and this is the first thing I’ve tried that really works for me. I have combination, acne prone skin. This oil does not make my skin dry, and for me, keeps my breakouts almost completely at bay. (Hormones, am I right?!) I will say, I haven’t noticed any difference in terms of older acne scarring, or uneven skin tone/dullness, but at stopping breakouts A+ Highly recommend, but try the small bottle to start because this product is real expensive! Also, a little goes a long way!

I’ve been using for a month and it has made wonders to my skin! I’ve had acne issues for the last 15 yrs and this is the first time that im confident to go without makeup. My acne is down about 95%, my skin looks glory, and smooth. Life changing product. Whoever invented this, thank you!

I’ve been using this product for a year now and my skin has never looked better. I’ve struggled with hormonal and stress related acne, but this did the trick. I found that for the first month of use it did not clear up my acne. If anything it looked worse. But after a month of allowing my skin to get used to this product it has never looked better. In the beginning this really dried out my combination skin, but I realized all those dry flakes were just dead skin cells and texture that this oil was removing. Now this oil is extremely nourishing for my combo skin. I wake up with smooth skin, minimized pores, lightened dark spots, and smoothed wrinkles. If you can stick out the month where your skin looks like a wreck, then this product will do amazing things.
It works. Takes 3 days to see the result for me. If I used it more regularly it may prevent the breakout but when I do use it when I have a breakout then the blemish heals faster.

If i ever wake up with troubled skin, within minutes my redness and irritation is eased, and within hours my breakouts and texture have started to go down. the scent is very earthy/mossy and it is pricey (only .5 oz) but It’s worth it for the amount of product you have to use and for the incredible results.

I originally purchased this oil because I have been suffering from some acne and clogged pores. This oil served as an excellent moisturizer, keeping my skin hydrated and glowy. A couple of drops are enough to cover the entire face. However, it did not address  my issue about acne or scarring. Not too impressed.

I really wanted to like this. The concept is great but it caused massive cystic blemishes. I tried it twice, with over a month in between to be sure and this was the cause. It also does not dry completely non-greasy, but that wasn’t a deal breaker. The breakout season were.
I wanted to love this product so much but it made me break out like crazy. I guess this isn’t great for my skin type.

I got a sample of this and I was super hopeful that it would work. It did even my complexion but It smells terrible! Besides that it made me get all these bumps on my chin/jaw line area. Definitely test it out on a part of your skin before applying it to your whole face

This is seriously the most amazingly smell ever. it’s exactly like the Tom Ford jasmine rouge, which is $500 a bottle or something close. I would buy this just for the perfume all day. It’s so good. Product is effective, texture super nice and fast absorbing. All around awesome.

I bought this product on a whim (completely forgetting about the drama surrounding reviews and Sunday Riley). I have to say its a very nice product. I’m half way done with the half size bottle, I’m 3 days short of using it a month exactly. I only use it at night because I have oily skin, so daytime use under foundation is not option for me. It doesn’t dry out my skin at all, which has been my problem with anything that has salicylic acid in it. Did I think this was going to clear out my skin and give the most perfect skin in the world? I hoped it would but it did not. What it did was stop my pimples from growing into mountains on my face. I use this with my Eradikate acne treatment at night and when I wake up my skin is less red and every single pimple i have reduces in size by over half. Even though it didn’t give me perfect skin, I would recommend it because it works well. Def not a miracle product for me, but that doesn’t mean it can’t be for someone else.

The young lady at Sephora recommended this for my super-oily skin and I’m so glad I gave it a try.  With their return policy you almost have nothing to lose. I mix 2 drops with my moisturizer and I like the way it makes my skin look and feel “dewy“. I still get shiny after a few hours but this is so far the best product that “holds off“ the shine.  (BTW, I have tried mattifying products but they make me feel overly dry,  like the smile lines get more pronounced so that was a no for me)I’ve had 2 pimples within the past 2 weeks when i started using it, but I ate something I know breaks me out AND one day lathered sunscreen on my face at a water park.  I don’t think this product caused the breakouts which goes against what I thought I knew about oil. I purchased the $40 bottle but I’m thinking this could last a year because I use it very sparingly. Note*in this picture I’m also wearing a light layer of cc cream

I began using this product about 6 months ago and wish I had found it sooner! I have struggled with hormonal acne for about 2 years or so and as a twenty-something woman it has been something I have been extremely self-conscious about. Slowly through additions of oral medication (not accutane) and holy grail cleanser (tata harper clarifying cleanser), I began seeing some improvement in my skin, but it wasn’t completely clear yet. I added this to my regimen of: cleanse with tata harper’s clarifying cleanser, tone, moisturize (belif true cream aqua bomb), and lastly U.F.O oil. Within days I saw immediate improvement in the overall texture of my skin. Those pesky clogged pores and texture had improved/ disappeared and over the next few weeks I experienced fewer cysts. Have repurchased twice so far (it has lasted me about 3 months/bottle) and will continue to repurchase again and again.

THIS IS IT!! I don’t write reviews, but I had to write one for this. I’ve been using this consistently every night for about 2 month and I’ve noticed a huge difference! Background on my skin, I have oily-combination skin and suffer from painful cystic acne. Since this is a CLARIFYING face oil, you will notice some breakouts when you first start using it. I have a lot of congested pores with lots of little bumps all over my forehead and cheek area, during this “purge” stage it has completely pulled all the gunk from underneath my skin and after a few weeks my skin was SMOOTH. Every night I was my face with a gel based cleanser, use a toner (haven’t found the right toner so I’m still in the trial and error stage) and then I take about 5-6 drops of the oil and I massage this into my skin. When massaging my skin I concentrate in the areas where I have the most congested pores and where I have active breakouts. I massage my face with my fingertips going in little circular motions for about a minute. I wake up the next morning to smooth, radiant skin! I highly recommend this product to anyone that suffers from acne. When trying this you just need to keep in mind that it will take time for you to see real results. Be patient!!
Overrated. Did not help shrink my adult zits. My Burt’s bees works better

review_title: So glad I found this stuff!
review_text: I have oily skin and never thought an oil would ever help clear my acne... but this stuff changed the game.  I knocked it down a star because I do still get occasional breakouts during my period, but it’s not nearly as bad as it used to be.  It’s helped lighten up my acne scars and even out my skin.  Hate the price (and the smell,) but it goes a long way.  After getting the small size in a kit, I splurged on the big one.  I’ve used it at night for about 2 months and it’s not even close to being half empty.  Until I find a dupe that compares to this stuff,  I’ll continue to shove out the money for it!

i really wanted to love this oil the first time i used it i noticed the strong smell and still decided to try it, after noticing skin getting worse by getting bumps i stopped. Tried it again and same thing. This smells really disgusting and did not work for my skin.
I believe my skin is a repellant to facial oils. Even as a spot treatment it only seemed to flare up my skin.

Love this product! actually I don’t use it all the time, but when I do have breakouts I put this *under* my moisturizer at night and the next morning most of it is gone. If I have more I would use it for 2-3 night more. What i love the most about this product, is that it really handle breakouts amazingly, but because it’s an oil it’s not drying your face. I personally got the small size because I don’t use it everyday and it lasts forever.

I never leave reviews on products but I just had to say that this stuff is amazing. My skin has always been so dry but I get painful cystic acne around my chin. Nothing seemed to help my breakouts and anything I tried would just dry my face out more. One day I was suffering through a particularly bad breakout and became so desperate that I drove all the way to the mall on the Wednesday before Christmas during rush hour traffic to spend almost $100 on this. SO WORTH IT. That day my skin had never looked worse, and now my skin has never looked better. There was some purging, but now my skin feels hydrated, my pores are smaller, my previous acne scars are fading, and I have yet to get one of those huge painful under the surface bumps. I could cry. I will buy this product forever.

review_title: Great for small bumps on my forehead
review_text: This is the only thing that worked on these small bumps (closed comedones?) I had all over my forehead. It got rid of them while also not over-drying out my face. Doesn’t do too much for the regular acne on my face.

I have acne prone skin and I was scared to use an oil but this didn’t break me out. I didn’t give it five stars because I’m not sure it “treats“ my acne like it says it does but it definitely doesn’t make anything worse.

I have very sensitive combination skin that is pretty acne prone and just all around stubborn to treat. At first, I really wasn’t noticing any changes in my skin and I had been using it for a month or so. Then I was realizing that I had more blackheads than usually and my pores looked MASSIVE. I was thinking about all the skincare products I used that might’ve been causing this issue. After reading some other reviews of people who have had the same issue, I realized it was this serum that was causing my problems! Now I’m basically back to square one with my skin and have to fix it all over again. Very disappointed

I bought this because one of the girls in Sephora said it would help clear up my acne. However, this only created blackheads. I am giving it two stars because I do feel like it hydrated by skin but filled my nose with blackheads. It also has a very strange scent.

This is my very first time writing a review, and i just HAVE to come on here and say THIS IS THE BEST!!! i had clear skin for a long time but then i started getting acne on my cheeks and chin. i found this and after about a weeks use, it cleared up!!! i would still get an occasional pimple but it cleared my big acne patched on my cheeks and chin!! i ran out and didn’t buy a new one for about three months. my acne then cane back and i bought it again and BOOM it cleared up!!! I’ve never experienced anything like this and i would definitely recommend!!
Love this product! Has really helped minimize my blemishes.

review_title: oily acne prone and sensitive skin
review_text: I have oily and very acne prone skin. I usually use the Josie Maran argan oil bc I find oils make my skin produce less of it’s own and keep it bump and breakout free. After using an spf that broke me out horribly, I purchased this oil. It’s a miracle! My skin had already started clearing in just a few days. The only reason I didn’t give it five stars is bc I don’t line the smell at all. It’s tolerable for how well it works though.

I’m not in the “breakout age” anymore, but I get clogged pores and whatnot due to slowing cell turnover. This stuff is great! Keeps my skin hydrated and comfortable, but works on the pores and makes everything look great! Awesome addition to my routine!

Love this product!!!! In my 30s and developed some adult acne, got really bad on my vacation to Orlando.  Went to Sephora in Disney Sorings and asked an associate for her recommendation for adult acne. This is what she told me about, she new all the ingredients and everything!  She was amazing!! I wish I remembered her name. Anyway, my skin has calmed down and new pimples have stopped appearing!!!  I noticed small results after the first day, no lie.  Now my skin looks better than it has in a long time.  Love the scent now, at first I didn’t really like it.  Now that I know it’s such a blessing for my skin, I love it!!!  I will forever buy this product.  I am also so thankful to the associate who told me about this product!!

Based on other reviews here and on YouTube, I had really hoped this product would help clear up my adult acne. It did not work at all for me!! It did not clear up my acne or prevent other breakouts. I have much cheaper drug store brands that work better than this product.
It didn’t help clear my skin and just made me feel gross and oily

review_title: My go to face oil for acne primed skin!
review_text: I started using this oil in an attempt to clear my acne for my wedding. I get a lot of hormonal cystic acne around my jaw line. I love this oil! I was reluctant to use it at first because I have combo/oily skin, so I thought it would make things worse for me but it didn’t. It has really helped clear my acne and I have had many people compliment me on my skin since using this product! I buy the smaller bottle and it lasts me 6 months and I use 3 drops each application. Totally worth the price!

I expected to like this since I am a big fan of Good Genes and figured this product would perform well.  It did NOT.  I was left with clogged pores which was the opposite of what I was expecting.  I have tried other SR products and all have been good so this one is the outlier.

This product is amazing! It took about a week or two for me to really see the results starting to show. When I ran out my skin went right back to how it was before. This is a definite holy grail product for me.

If you’re struggling with acne, this is a MUST try. I struggled with acne all throughout my teen years and then as I went into my late teens to early 20s it slowly went away. However, I turned 24 and my acne came back at full force. I was trying every product under the sun to get rid of my hormonal/cystic acne that was destroying my face and nothing was making a difference. Finally I tried out this product after watching a YouTuber blog about this product and how it changed her face. THIS IS A GAME CHANGER. Around the same time I found this product I was also put on medicine from the doctor (which definitely played a roll in my face clearing) but without this product I don’t think I would have seen the same results. On nights when I don’t use this oil I’ll see a change in my skin and the next morning have a small break out starting to appear. But It has been a few months of consistency and my acne is for the most part completely cleared up and I’m now just dealing with scaring. I use this at night and in the morning along with Sunday Riley’s good genes lactic acid and I finally feel good enough about my skin again to go out into public without makeup on (only on my lazy days of course)! The price may be a little steep for both products but I will never go without either one again.

Bought this oil a few months ago and my skin has never looked better. I use this at night after toner and it has helped so much with redness, breakouts and texture. My skin looks so clear and feels so smooth the next day.

I am in my late 30s, and ever since having kids, I break out, especially before my period and especially on my T-zone.  I have tried so many products to try to avoid pimples, and none have worked until this one.  I use this along with the Martian Mattifying Melting Water-Gel Toner.  The smell is strange at first, but I quickly learned to like it.  I am so pleased to finally find skincare that I love.  I am now a Sunday Riley devotee!
This product is amazing !! It has helped my face sooo much I rarely break out anymore and has helped fade my scars. Pricey but definitely worth it !

After reading all the reviews talking about this as a solution to hormonal acne I was sold! I went in immediately to pick some up, I was having the worst breakout around my mouth and jaw I was so embarrassed at the store. But a sweet employee told me it help her tremendously so I gave it a shot. After using this for only 7 days- day and night, this has helped my skin SO MUCH. The existing breakouts have since gone down in swelling, all the annoying under the skin bumps I had turned into white heads which, for a day or two was kinda gross but now everything is clearing up and I don’t have any new breakouts forming.. which hasn’t happened in a long time! Will keep using religiously and adding more Sunday Riley products to fade these after acne marks.

This has truly been a miracle product for me! I have had acne constantly for 10 years now and NOTHING has been able to keep my skin this clear. Whenever I run out of this product my skin has not been happy with me. I have gone through 2 smaller bottles and finally bought the larger size during the VIB sale and I will continue to repurchase! I use this mostly at night after cleansing with no moisturizer on top and my skin is never dry! 3-4 drops cover my whole face and I use a little extra on any big pimples or problem areas. If you struggle with acne, you need this!

I got a sample of this stuff about a year ago and absolutely fell in love with it and have since recommended it to many people as my holy grail acne product. My skin is so sensitive and dry, and I am very prone to hormonal acne these days. My chin and forehead constantly have little bumps all over them, which aren’t noticeable unless I pick at them, but they give me such an uneven texture. I used my bottle sparingly and every time, the bumps were gone and prevented for about a week per two to three uses. I picked up a bottle of this recently because I finally committed to the full-size, and once again, my face is clear in a matter of four days, and it is not at all irritated, red, or peeling. The color is also a fun bonus, as with the Luna oil. Just as a completely irrelevant side note which makes me love the oil more, the theme of the UFO oil (the title and color) remind me so much of Futaba from Persona 5, who I’m also very partial to!

I got a deluxe sample of this and it’s been sitting on my vanity the whole time then one day I grew out a pimple on my left bro -wasn’t able to do my brows for a week! I saw it and decided to give it a try. After 2 days it’s all gone, thanks to UFO!!
This works but smells terrible, I might even say not everyone can tolerate this old grandma flower scent.

I’ve had acne for 7 years. Haven’t left the house without make up in 7 years. I was on accutane. Went through dermatology for 5 years. NOTHING WORKED. This along with the sulfur mask and good genes saved my skin and my confidence. BUY IT!
Excellent product! :) Its the best product I’ve used to help my acne.

review_title: YOU NEED THIS IN YOUR LIFE
review_text: This stuff is amazing!! I have super oily skin and acne prone skin. This stuff cleared my breakouts and acne in less than a week. I am amazing I love this so much. Never going back!!!! It is worth every penny!!! I got the small size, which is really all you need. You dog need barely any when you use it!

I’ve been using this for about a month, and the difference to my skin is astonishing. Decreased acne, redness, and discoloration... And the results were almost immediate. The smell takes some getting used to - it kept me awake the first night but after about a week I adjusted. I use this serum with the rest of my products morning and night. A holy grail product!

I have generally clear and dry skin but occasionally get small pimples, mostly on my forehead where I’m the most acne prone. I was excited to try this product but was disappointed with the results! The consistency is nice, it’s definitely a dry oil and I personally like the strong and forest like scent. However after using a couple drops on my forehead for a few nights, I broke out in pimples! My whole forehead is filled with tiny white and red bumps. Not sure if this is purging or not but I definitely would not splurge on the full price version.

review_title: UFO for My Old Skin That Still Breaks Out
review_text: I am a mature woman who still gets plagued by breakouts. I need moisture and to block the occasional breakout. This does it all. It keeps my skin from breaking out and plumps up my skin. A little goes a long way, so even though this is pricey, it lasts a long time.
I like this product! I even like the smell! It has helped with my acne when used regularly. I also use it as a spot treatment when something pops up.

I’ve been dealing with stubborn breakouts around my chin and mouth and none of my usual regime has been able to even make a dent. I got a sample of this when I bought Sunday Riley’s Tidal and I’m stunned-- this literally cleared up the breakout overnight. Definitely try this out if you have the opportunity!

So far so good!!! *knock on wood*This seems to be working for me.  I was dealing with hormonal acne and tried this since there were so many good reviews.  Got multiple samples since my skin was so sensitive and reactive.  Not sure if it was stopping the RMS items I was putting on my face which may have caused acne OR adding this to my routine....but now, my face seems to be clear!  So psyched for this product.  Well worth the price in order to keep acne at bay.  I did purge a little for like 3 weeks but that’s since passed.  I do love the scent and the bottle looks so cool.  A little goes along way so I think it’s worth it for clear skin.  Try it, return it if it doesn’t work for you.  Can’t go wrong.

This product helped my skin sooooooo much. I’ve never been so thankful for a product. I’ve struggled with acne since I was 10 and have been insecure about my skin since. For 10 years it felt like no matter what I did to get rid of my acne it wouldn’t go away until I found this product. Honestly I have never been so thankful for an oil. Instantly I saw my skin start to improve and the bumps slowly started to disappear. I’m not a huge fan of the smell but it does fade pretty quickly so it doesn’t bother me that much. 100% would recommend.

I am so hooked on this face oil. Got it as a sample and now it’s a regular part of my nightly skin routine. Takes care of basically all of my acne issues - if any acne is beginning to form, it is either gone or barely noticeable when I wake up because I put this oil on the night before. I had what I thought were basically permanent acne scars on my jawline that have totally disappeared! This oil is game-changing.

After having my baby 16 months ago my skin has completely changed. Adult acne and dry skin galore. After getting this as a sample and using for 2 days my skin is looking better than ever. I tried other acne products, even ones that worked pre-baby, but Sunday Riley is a life saver. I was incredibly hesitant because of the oil, but it’s luscious and you omg need 2-3 drops for your whole face. I’m obsessed. I will be purchasing the full size after my sample runs out!

So I was super skeptical about this product at first because I have SUPER oily, acne prone skin, and being that this is an oil, I was afraid it would make it much worse. At first, my skin looked a little bit more oily than usual, and I broke out a little bit (which is normal for me, it happens every time I start a new product) but after about 2.5 weeks of using this product every night and every morning my skin looks AMAZING. I still break out here and there but not nearly as bad as before I used this. My complexion looks so much better, scars are much less noticeable which I LOVE. I used to wear a bunch of foundation to cover the scaring and breakouts and red marks and now I wear close to none because it’s all gone, and what’s left is hardly noticeable. I LOVE THIS PRODUCT.

Want to love this oil as Sunday Riley is a miracle worker, but the oil makes my skin break out in ways and areas that I never had issues with before. This is a side effect of the product but created an unfortunate situation on my normally clear skin. Not worth it for the price.
The best oil I have ever tried! It WORKS. I had few pimples that would sometimes appear on my chin and since I have been using this product, no pimples AT ALL! My skin looks amazing!
Love the dry oil, absorbs fast and doesn’t leave oily feeling

I purchased this in the Space set with the toner and sulfur mask and found it to be ineffective for me. I ultimately gave away the toner as a stocking stuffer because I don’t like to use toners with alcohol on my skin. As for the sulfur mask, I’ve since repurchased it. Mask-wise, I apply a small amount onto my entire face for about 10 minutes a couple of times a week and it has done wonders to combat my active acne. Alas, I can’t say the same for the UFO oil. I had tried the Luna and found it too harsh for me. Even though my skin is mature, I’m not quite at the retinol stage or I’m just too sensitive to use it. Anyway, while I wanted to love this UFO treatment oil, as I’ve been experimenting with oils to help with my oily, acne-prone skin, this just didn’t do it for me. If anything, it promoted congestion around my jawline vs fighting it. And no, I am familiar with the concept of purging. I’ve used actives before and this was not what I would have considered a purging effect. This was oil getting trapped in my pores, creating fleshy bumps along my jaw like gravel over a two month period. Shortly after I stopped using this oil, the clusters of gravel along my jawline improved. Not sure what is in this that would promote these weird blackheads/small bumps but it just wasn’t suitable for my skin (sensitive, acne, mature, oily/combo). Price vs size: With consistent daily use, 1oz will likely last you a year unless you are slathering it on. Smell: I actually liked the smell as I found it earthy. Color: The color is not as “natural“ as you think. There is no way you would get this consistent green color in every batch if they used all natural colorants and no preservatives. The green would vary.pH: I have no clue what the pH of the SA is, and pH in beauty products is important.
amazing oil! Clear up your face in weeks

Honestly, my favorite thing about this oil is the scent. I love it. But I wouldn’t pay this much just for the smell; I like the way it works, too. I use it at night, it works for my occasional hormonal breakouts but doesn’t dry my skin out at all.

Hate the smell, love the results. I’ve had this product for a little over a month now, and my blemishes have gone way down. I still have some small bumps here and there, but no big guys in sight. I would recommend keeping this as far away from your eyes as possible- it dried out my under eyes pretty badly.

Every other product I have tried either doesn’t work at all or just kind of works. I have been having issues with breaking out around my ears and high up on my cheek bones. After a week of using this in the morning(very small amount) and a larger amount at night, the breakouts cleared,  it’s even helping fade the discoloration from previous breakouts and it’s keeping the natural oils on my face under control. I even had my teenage brother using this to help with his acne and just after a few days there was improvement.

I received a sample for this product and let me tell you it’s a miracle worker. Gets rid is pimples fast!!! The smell is a little weird but can’t complain about the how good it works. I use it very night, and it works good for me. I know some people use it with their makeup but personally it’s oil and foundation and oil would not be a great mixture! Give it a try, it can help out with acne!
Really, really like this product. Goes on smooth and absorbs quickly. Does not leave a residue and did not break out!!!

review_text: I am loving the way this cream reduces fine lines and hydrates without greasiness. So many eye creams are too heavy for me, but this one works well without the heaviness. I received a sample size of this from influenster in exchange for my honest opinion.

Clinique Smart Clinical RepairTM Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream does what it promises. It comes in modestly-sized, twist-top container, and is intended to be massaged into the area around the eye twice a day. The cream is thick enough to properly moisturize, but not suffocating or difficult to absorb. This product did not cause any irritation to my eye or skin. There is no fragrance. The eye cream contains Sigesbeckia orientalis extract, CL1870 Peptide Complex, and Hyaluronic acid – one of which I had heard of. The functions these ingredients accomplish include minimizing wrinkles, hydrating, maintaining skin density, and boosting collagen. After using, I do not see crow’s feet wrinkles, dark circles, puffiness, or any other unsightly issues in the area I applied the product. My skin felt smooth and hydrated. I would recommend to my friends, as it works for all skin types, and purchase it for myself. The cream does not contain parabens or phthalates, and comes in recyclable packaging.

Not worth the money. It is a decent eye cream but you can find better for a lower cost. I got this from the Littles bag and this product was probably the most underwhelming.
Love it! Definitely noticed a difference with puffyness and lines under my eyes. They dark circles have improved as well! Has helped me out for sure as I generally don’t sleep good

I H8 writing reviews but I HAVE to for this. I have genetically puffy under eyes/bad dark circles. I’ve only had this for a week and the puffiness is not as bad and magically my dark circles have lessened. My family has noticed a difference and I can now apply my concealer without looking like I have the worst allergies ever. I will always rec this and purchase!! 4 stars because the packaging feels cheap.

1 pump is enough for both eyes - I use my ring finger to pat it along my orbital bone around my whole eye, even into my eyebrows. It has lifted the entire area and softened my crows feet so much they are nearly gone. I recommend this to all of my friends, it’s worth the price tag
I keep this eye cream in the refrigerator and it feels so good in the morning or evening. It will wake up tired eyes!
I’ve given this eye cream so many chances. Every single time it gives me milia. Never again!

I just bought my second bottle of this product.  My fine lines are minimized, the undereye area feels really soft, but the darkness is still there.  Im gonna give it a second chance because the Sephora representative speaked so good of Drunk elephant but I was ready to try a different one.

review_title: Just turned 40 and this is my dream cream
review_text: Makes you look bright eyed and bushy tailed like a vacation in a bottle. Really smooths the skin around your eyes. Application is key remember to lightly pat w/ring finger.
Used this for 6 months, there are better eye creams. Noticed no difference and it is rather pricey to not see any change.

review_title: Great moisture and diminishes crows feet!
review_text: I really like this eye cream. This has kept my under eye area fairly moisturized and I feel like crows feet diminished.  My skin is also very sensitive and what I love about this cream is it doesn’t irritate the eye area.  I will definitely purchase again!
Great eye cream. One of the few I have tried that I have actually noticed a difference from using. Hydrating and brightening. Have repurchased multiple times.

I have almost every product by DE, but found this one to be my least favorite. I don’t feel that it smoothes fine lines in the eye area as well as less expensive professional brands, and I always wake up with redness in the outer edges of my eye area, which Ive never had before. Pretty much just using it up to somewhat feel like I didn’t waste my money :/
Kept it in the fridge and my dark circles improved within a week. It’s refreshing to put on and I wake up with bright eyes. Worth the extra money for me.

I really like how light this cream is! The biggest issue I’ve found with past eye creams is how heavy they feel once applied and I’m not finding that with this cream. That being said, a little goes a long way and you don’t have to use a ton to fully apply to your eye area. My eyes looked brighter after a full week of using both in the AM and PM.

review_title: THE BEST EYE CREAM IVE USED SO FAR
review_text: I got a sample of this product and I was amazed. I have really fine lines and dark circles. My under eyes were so bright only using this for a week. High recommend!
This product is very potent! It does help reduce the appearance of the fine lines under my eyes. It’s not as deep as it used to be. Absolutely worth every penny!

I have loved all of the Drunk Elephant products so far. This is the only one I didn’t see any difference with my under eye circles or darkness. I will continue using to see if it does improve later down the road. Feels good going on but no results.
Really like how this product feels around my eyes. I see a slight difference after using it. I prefer using it in the morning before applying my makeup
I like this eye cream- formula dies not irritate my sensitive eyes. Haven’t seen any immediate brightening effects but my eyelid and fine lines feel moisturized at night.
Feels great on my under eyes but I’m not noticing any real differences. I’ll continue to use it and update my review if something changes.

This eye cream is amazing and the packaging is truly awesome!! It’s powerful and I only use it at night. I’ve noticed a great improvement in my under eye area with regards to dryness and puffiness. The first time I used it I woke up with puffy eyes but it hasn’t happened since. I love it and will continue using!

I have been on the hunt for a good eye cream for ages. Nothing I have tried has really made a lasting difference where I felt like I needed it in my skin care regimen. This one is no different. The texture is nice and applies smoothly, but I don’t notice any difference using it vs not using it.
Great eye cream and amazing packaging. It goes on smoothly and clear. It works best when used twice a day and with other drunk elephant products. I really enjoy using this and would recommend.
This eye cream is great. I find myself forgetting to put concealer on because I don’t have dark circles anymore. I received this as a sample but will be repurchasing when I run out.
This is a nice eye cream and it makes your eye area feel very smooth and soft.
