My under eyes have never looked BETTER. After using this product ONE TIME, I could tell a difference in my skin under my eyes. Normally I have either bags, or dark circles, and this has removed everything leaving my skin looking AMAZING!!

Love this eye cream especially when it’s stored in the fridge. I am not big on eye creams in general but this is light and does not cause clogged pores. Keeps under eyes hydrated and works great cold.

I really love this product. It is rich and creamy and unscented. It really ups my eye care game. I noticed a difference on the first day of use. The area around my eyes look rejuvenated. I also love the dispenser!

This eye cream is very thick. It is definitely moisturizing but I see no difference in fine lines or dark circles. I have only used it for 2 weeks but hope to see a difference with the continuous use.

Very soft and smooth. Keeps my under eyes hydrated. Excellent packaging for easy application! I’ve definitely noticed a difference after using it regularly for a few weeks now. I would definitely recommend!

I received this complimentary but the review due date is too soon to tell whether or not it actually works. in general as packaging of st. As all of the other fabulous drunk elephant products. Product comes out as a white cream that spreads easily. I appreciate the clean ingredients. So far I seem to be getting milia from this so it might not work for more sensitive skin around the eyes. I have not noticed any difference in my under eye appearance but again, it might be too soon to tell.
Very moisturizing. Haven’t used it too much to see a difference.

I’ve been using this for about 6 months and I enjoy it. I am 41 and have combo skin, and I find this keeps my under eyes hydrated and smooth under the normal environmental conditions that I live in. (If it’s  really dry, or I’m traveling and my skin is stressed, I might need additional moisture and will reach for something a bit thicker.) I don’t have dark circles, so I can’t speak to the brightening abilities of this product. I definitely appreciate that it has no fragrance, and I like that it absorbs quickly and doesn’t run into my eyes or cause any irritation. Overall I like this and I my eye area is looking great for my age, so I would definitely consider repurchasing.

So do any eye creams actually work? I haven’t seen the evidence.I will say, this feels nice, doesn’t sting and I’m quiet sensitive and you really need like 1/4 of a pump. 1/2 of a pump was way too much I put it on my neck lol. I was lucky enough to get this sent to me for testing. I love DE, but I’m not sure about this products benefits..feels nice tho and is a cool night time routine that makes me feel special
This eye cream is okay. I love the consistency, but honestly I don’t see any results. But it feels good.

So far so good! I have had this product in my routine for about a week and my skin has responded well. I have been searching for a good eye cream and this seems to be it! A little product goes a long way which is nice! Love the pump/packaging, keeps product clean without having a cap to loose or break. Will continue to use and love!

This is such a great eye cream! I apply it every night as part of my nighttime facial routine. When I wake up it helps so much with puffiness and redness. Make my under eyes feel tightened and refreshed.
I really enjoyed this it did great things for my eyes and compares pretty well to other brands I have used in the past sometimes even better than them.

I really like this eye cream. I am starting to see fine lines and this really helps keep them plumped up and at bay really. I like that it’s not a super heavy cream, because I’m prone to milia as well but haven’t gotten any with this product. I like that it’s light enough to wear under makeup too without making makeup crease. Definitely will repurchase, it makes my eyes feel nice and I keep it in the fridge for extra morning chill!

I’m not much of an eye cream person. I can barely deal with all the multiple steps for skin care. I figure I’m still young for this. Let me tell you, after running after kids all day and enrolling back in school. I have bags and puffy eyes. This has been my safe haven toMake me look youthful again. I don’tHave to color correct my bags anymore. A little of product goes a long way. One of the best eye creams out there.

This is a really fantastic eye cream!!! First off I love that there’s no scent because my eyes are super sensitive and the added scents in other products really irritate them!!! Also this doesn’t leave my eye area feeling greasy or anything!!! In less than a week I can already notice a huuuuge improvement!!!

I love this eye cream. Out of all the eye creams I have used this was the most hydrating, non clogging, non greasy eye cream ever. It stays on for hours. I would put it on at night before bed and the next morning when I wash my face I can still feel the hydration of the eye cream, I have mild dark circles, sometimes puffiness around the eyes, some fine lines. I think it’s more dryness under my eye then anything else. Very good primer for concealer. I have repurchased this twice already. I do find it pricey and switched to another brand, but always end up coming back to this one.
This product has greatly improved the darkness under my eyes.  My co workers noted that I looked refreshed the other morning.  I really think it’s improving my eye skin. Thank you!

A little goes a long way with this product, which is what I would hope so for paying so much. I’ve seen a bit of improvement in terms of tightness, but unfortunately it hasn’t done too for my dark circles. My puffiness has never been too intense, but I can’t say for sure whether it has gone down a little from the eye cream. The cream itself is not heavy and it’s an easy pump applicator. I’m hoping after continued use I can see more of an improvement.
Definitely love the consistency of this eye cream. Helps moisture my dryness under my eyes. Love that it’s has Vitamin C for brightening.
love. moisturises my eyes. does not irritate. would not stop using
Would not absorb into my skin. Had to be peeled off in crumbly pieces. Very weird texture and smell, so not recommend.

I have only been using it for about a week. I’m 34 with dry skin, And I can see my self starting to age. This eye cream has been a life changer. noticed a big different. So far ive tried about the 3-4 different eye cream. This is my favorite one. dipping into this skin care more. They have a tester bag that’s a good buy. You can try a bunch of there main skin care with out committing to the full size. Then when you love it as much as I do you can buy the full size one.

I was not a believer in eye creams until I tried this product. I’m one of those girls that gets half way through an eye cream and then stops using it because I never see results. Don’t ask me what drew me to it, but during the April VIB sale I picked this up. I saw results IN ONE WEEK. I honestly couldn’t believe it! The dark circles under my eyes began to retreat right away. My eye area felt hydrated, plumped and brightened. I find that this plays well with my other products (I use a mixture of Farmacy, Drunk Elephant and Tatcha products) and doesn’t pill up when you try to apply makeup on top of it. If you were like me and hopped around from eye cream to eye cream, you should really try this out!
Not really effective. Have been using this for almost a month after the sales representative suggested this for dark circles. Not worth a purchase

review_title: A little goes a long way!
review_text: This eye cream has a nice hydrating formula with a thicker consistency than some other creams. I feel like the hydration was what made the most changes in fine lines and puffiness.

review_title: Burns and make my eyes swollen and itchy
review_text: This makes my eyes swollen and itchy. I did not know what made my eyes swollen at first, thought it was my sleep. And then one night I put two pumps, the stingy feeling tells me suddenly it is this that made my eyes so swollen and itchy these days.I have bought the baby facial (BHA/AHA) of drunk elephant, and it burns my face like fire. I have tried the VC face serum, it also burns the minutes I applied and after I diluted it. This brand is insane. All three products 1 start.

This is a good quality eye cream.  I definitely feel that it hydrates the sensitive skin around my eyes and while I don’t see significant difference in my dark circles, I will keep using it to see if it improves with time.  A bit pricey and the packaging is deceptive, lots of bulk but not a lot of product.

I am always nervous with wearing an eye cream during the day/under makeup due to excess oil. You do not have to worry about that with C-Tango! Applying twice daily and loving the results! Skin around the eyes feels moisturized, plump and tight. 10/10

review_title: Irritated my eyes like no other
review_text: Glad I only got this in a sample-size using my points. This eye cream was way too strong for my sensitive eye-area. My skin was inflamed and tingling for days after using this once. No other eye cream has had that reaction before. I’m a fan of many other DE products but this was a miss!
i have used this every night since i bought it. No difference in dark circles. Waste of money
This cream is amazing I noticed a difference in brightness within a week. PUT IT IN YOUR FRIDGE - that way in the morning it depuffs AND brightens. Amazing.

Really disappointed!! The store had ran out of my typical eye cream and so an employee recommended this product and said it was her favorite and numerous others agreed with her too. I used the whole bottle and was really disappointed as I didn’t see any impact as I normally would with my other eye cream. Don’t know if it’s just me or if I used it wrong (which I find hard to believe as it’s an eye cream how could you possibly go wrong with applying it) but I was really disappointed as I really wanted to like it as people seem to love it!
Some ingredient in this product triggers my eczema and causes the skin under my eyes to dry up and flake. I switched to a different eye cream and the eczema cleared up.

Had a really bad reaction to this eye cream, my under eye became really dry and flaky, and was really irritated. Had to use just the drunk elephant marula oil for a week just to get it back to normal.
I like a lot.  My dark circles are much less visible

I’ve tried to love alot of DE products, but they all fall flat for me. This eye cream starting giving me milia, the little clogged pores around the eye area that you cant just squeeze out. I stopped using it after about 3 weeks to really give it a good shot despite what I saw.  It also pills (rolls off the skin), no matter how little I used. Not for me!

I think this is a good eye cream overall. It lasted a long time, 6 months of daily use both morning and night. The price is a little high and I don’t think it did anything too different than my other eye creams. I do think it’s hydrating but I didn’t love it to buy it again.

This is one of the better eye creams I’ve tried.  It goes on smoothly around my undereyes (which have fine lines) and isn’t greasy so it sits very well under makeup.  However, for its price, I don’t find that it does much more than a primer.  I did not see much in terms of improvement to my undereyes following a few months of use.
Love love love this! I have problems with dark circles and this has helped more than anything else I have tried.
I wanted to love it. It’s so highly recommended. It sits on my eyelids and makes a kind of waxy film. Cannot put makeup over it, because it pills. Bummer.
Love this product! Super moisturizing, no residue, absorbs quickly and the pump is a god sent because you know exactly how much to apply! In my opinion its worth the money!
I’m pretty new to eye creams but I really love this. You don’t need to use a lot and it’s so hydrating and feels wonderful.

I have rosacea, sensitive, dry skin, and dry under eyes. I have been using this cream for a month and I’ve noticed a big difference in how smooth my undereyes look, especially when I put makeup on. I’m a fan.

At first I was hesitant to indulge in a pricey under eye cream - I had been using a little less expensive product made my a makeup brand I really like, but decided once turning 30 it was worth the investment. I do think this cream makes a difference, but with any product it’s not over night. It goes on super smooth, it lasts a long time if you use it correctly and it has been my most favorite eye cream I’ve tried.

I got this product as a mini (in a set) and am not a fan at all. I like to put eye cream on before makeup and this one does not work that way at all. Makes my concealer bunch up. Also makes my eyes irritated/watery throughout the day.
This is mainly my daytime eye cream. I feel it brightens, and tightens. I love that it has clean ingredients.

At first I didn’t like this cream, thought it did nothing, but kept using it. First it smells good and you just need one pump for each eye and pat it in. About 3 weeks later, saw a difference with texture and color. My eyes did look brighter. One star knocked down because of the price.

I do not use a full pump of product. I use a small amount split between both eyes and smooth it on with my ring finger. At first it stung but it doesn’t anymore. It is very soothing and goes on easily. I do feel that my under eyes look brighter since I have been using (about a month).

I literally just joined the site to write this review. I love DE I have the C firma and Protini and I mix the two with avocado oil and the results are amazing. HOWEVER, after using this for a couple days I realized my makeup was looking really weird over it; it made my concealer clump, look patchy and actually aged me. I’ve never had that issue. For the remainder of the bottle I’ll use it for nighttime only but won’t repurchase and am now looking for a new one for the day!
I love the “feel“ of this product, but it made my eyes water.  I like the other eye gel much better.

I wanted to love this eye cream because of all the positivity behind the brand. I was very disappointed to find that it significantly dried out my under eye area, to the point where my concealer was clumping up around dry skin. My creases get so clumped up with concealer, it’s disheartening. I did not have this issue prior to using this eye cream. I also found that my skin’s pigmentation was slightly changing. Makeup didn’t look the same anymore. I gave two stars instead of one because I did notice that my eyes were less puffy, and my dark circles did lessen. Because of this, I continued use of the product, hoping that my skin would adapt and it would get better. I also tried supplementing with serums and oils, but that did not help at all. Given the price of this eye cream, I was disappointed that the brand’s solution to the drying would be to supplement with another one of their expensive products.
I have never found a miracle eye cream...however, this does hydrate around the eyes, which helps my makeup/concealer lay more smoothly.
It made no difference to fine lines and wrinkles, but it did hydrate the area.

I really wanted to love this item , for I am OBSESSED with DE products. However, I was let down :( I used it all up and did not notice any difference whatsoever. Not only did I not see any improvements, this made my eyes SO DRY! I had to buy a very heavy, moisturizing eye cream just so my eyes wouldn’t be dry anymore.

So I bought this because I bought the littles collection and the eye cream in that didn’t do much for me.  This however....I can actually feel the skin around my eyes tightening and the bags under my eyes are disappearing.

Wow. It’s been a search looking and trying various expensive to inexpensive to European to Korean skin care eye creams. I was visiting a friend and she said to try it. I could notice the difference the next day! Darkness and the lines seemed to have softened! I decided to go ahead and purchase. Yes, expensive price point but you get what you pay for. I’ve noticed the difference and sometimes pop it in the freezer while brushing my teeth and promptly remove and apply. Feels amazing.

This is a richer eye cream than the Shaba. I like this better. It’s absorbs well and my eye area seems well cared for. My fine lines seem less and my eyes have a bit more of a youthful look. I use the tiniest amount. Not a full pump.
I really enjoy this cream! I haven’t seen a dramatic change in my under eye circles yet, but it’s definitely quenched any dryness I’ve been dealing with!

Having seen great results from their C-Firma Day Serum I had to ive this a try and have to say I’m liking it. Def does nothing for dark circles because let’s face it - only make up works for those but it keeps the skin around my eyes well moisturized and I’ve noticed the skin is looking plumper. I will prob buy again.

review_title: Actually working on my fine lines!
review_text: This is great for fine lines! I’ve never reviewed a product on Sephora before but feel like I need to review this one. I usually use higher end eye creams because my eye area is dryer but now that I’m 41 I’m noticing fine lines. Ive been using this product for a month (morning and evening) and have totally noticed my fine lines are disappearing/lessening! Even my husband agreed when I showed him. I’ve never had such success from an eye cream so I’m super excited about it! I also am not having a problem with milia, which I’ve gotten before from several other eye creams. I highly recommend this eye cream.

I so wanted to love, or even like this, but not the case. I have other DE products that I love, so I had high expectations. The texture is great and absorbs well. However, I noticed on the days that I used it that I looked tired and makeup would settle into the lines under my eyes. Not a great look. I ended up returning it because it is too much money to not use.

I use this eye cream af night only due to the high price. With that out of the way, this product is worth it. My dark circles have never been this light (I’ve had under eye bags since age 6-7) and the skin around my eyes feels hydrated and smooth. Definitely recommend this to people with dark circles. It does not de-puff eye bags.

Loving this eye cream, the sales associate took his time and helped me find something that would target the puffiness and fine lines.  He offered me 3 different choices in different price points and so glad I went with this one.  Next I am going to try the serum.  I have been using for 3 weeks now and I truly see a difference.

This is the warrior for dark circles. I have had hereditary dark circles since I was like, eight. This is the only cream which makes me look like I am awake and I don’t really have to put on concealer afterwards if I use twice a day. I wake up and feel beautiful! I have had no problems with irritation and I have dry, itchy skin. I get allergy eyes and this makes me appear less puffy. Very expensive, but I use sparingly, so it should last ages. I also layer another thicker cream afterwards for more moisture since my skin is very dry. 10 out of 10!
Does it make a difference on my eye bags? Not really but they can’t be helped. It doesn’t make anything worse, my eyes are hydrated. It’ll do.

I’m a huge DE fan. Ur wasn’t impressed with this eye cream. Honestly, since starting DE I haven’t really needed an extra cram just for eyes - marula, protium and lala work great already. This eye cream didn’t give me any noticeable hydration/brightening, and using one pump morning and night it didn’t last even 6 weeks. Save your money and skip this one!

review_title: I still can't find a DE product that works for me!
review_text: I did not find this product to be hydrating. it did not sink into the skin. it even flaked off and pilled up about 10 minutes later when I went in with my primer. at the end of the day, it made my makeup/ concealer look like absolute garbage. I would not purchase this eye cream.

I’m a huge fan of drunk elephants products but this was a huge miss for me. I love how easily it sunk in and how lightweight it felt. But after using it only for a couple of days my under eyes began feeling tight and they got so dry that the skin actually started peeling a tiny bit around the edges. Also whenever I applied my concealer my under eyes look so dry and like I aged 10 years. I switched back to my usual eye cream and all of those problems immediately went away. Love drunk elephant but I wish they came out with a super hydrating eye cream like their la la retro moisturizer.
I love this product!!! It has already made a huge difference in my under eyes! They are deff brighter and more awake looking!

DE does it again! Dark circles and wrinkles have been a concern of mine for yeeeears, but Ctango   Shaba have worked WONDERS for me. I’m the type of girl that typically doesn’t leave the house without concealer, and I’ve actually ventured out sans concealer lately since I started using this. I love love loooove it! Also, of note, I have SUPER sensitive skin and eczema. For those who have had unwanted reactions from this cream, it actually may be the other skincare products they are using that have caused their skin to be sensitized. Ever since I went on a clean cleanse from the “suspicious 6“ products found in various skincare products, I haven’t had any issues at all.

I tried the Shaba for a month (for comparison to this). I liked the texture, didnt notice any changes, and if I applied before bed, it had a tendency of making its way into my eyes. C tango is thicker, and I can apply it day or night. It doesnt seep into my eyes at night. I did notice a little tingling/warmth when I first started using it, but its been doing well on my under-eye area. No redness or irritation and its been a week so far.
Love this product. It gives a healthy glow to my skin
This is everything to me!!!! The dewyness wowwwww!
I love this stuff!  I use it to spray on my back.  Makes my faire wings tattoo hydrated.
Always keeps my skin dewy and smooth! Awesome addition to my skincare routine.

This is my 3rd bottle of the Mini Dewy Mist, I’m 75 years old and on hot days I use it a couple of times a day, it refreshes your face and I also use a couple of squirts at night so my face feels amazing in the morning. My face almost feels a bit tighter in the morning and thin lines and large open pores are so much better, I wish I could describe it better, I just know I get lots of compliments on my skin since using this and I can actually feel it doing my skin good, I will never be without this, my skin type is combination/oily on the T zone and I love the aroma and the feel it gives me. I can see the difference myself, this is my honest opinion!

Yes my makeup looks like it has a golden glow but it made my pores look big. It also feels a bit greasy when you put it on. The directions say only 1-2 pumps but it took me about 10 to see any difference. The spray is minimal so I wasn’t able to tell if it was coming out of the bottle. When I blotted after has I felt a lot better.

I had bought a few products from Tatcha and got a mystery bag and this was included in it. Now normally I dont like sprays that are supposed to be for several uses because I have really dry skin and feel like they aren’t hydrating enough but since I received it free I tried it.  This mist is everything!! First off the spray is perfect. It spray lightly but consistently. The smell is like heaven. Its not overwhelming at all as I dont like heavily fragranced products and it really actually hydrates. I dont use it as a primer or setting spray but I carry it with me and when my face starts feeling dry I use it. Never thought I’d love this type of product but its amazing!!

review_title: Best finishing spray for dry skin
review_text: This is the best finishing spray for dry, flaky, winter skin. My skin is horribly sensitive and flaky during winter and when I add this on top of my makeup it really helps control the flaky appearance of my skin I sometime get after a few hours. My dry skin loves it, but this is definitely not for people with oily skin.

review_title: Worth it if you have DRY skin
review_text: I absolutely LOVE this spray but more for a spritz of hydration (skin care) vs a setting spray.  I use it before moisturizer and throughout the day.  I have super dry skin and throughout the day my face just gets drier and drier... this is great for rehydration.  I know it is expensive but I have not found anything remotely close to what this product does for my skin.  I literally am on my 4th bottle and will continue            repurchasing it.  I feel this product is specifically for dry skin and if you have oily/combination it’ll be too dewy for you and won’t get the full-effect of what it does for your skin ;)
Good product, not best for my type of skin, someone with dry skin could benefit more from this.
It is really good! Best for makeup application as well as hydrating the face too.
I received this product on a trendmood box, and my mom loves it! She’s an essential worker and every 3 hours or so, she sprays this and feels very refreshed and not too dewy
I received this mist in a Trendmood box. It works beautifully as a makeup setting spray. It leaves a very dewy finish.
This a nice hydrating and dewy mist. Good to use on bare skin. I received this on my trendmood box! Definitely recommend!
I finally got this in the trend mode Box it leaves your skin so do I the packaging so Allegan and beautiful it is a little expensive for what it is but if you like high end you will enjoy this
I received this product through Trendmood box, I have to say it is very nice giving my skin a dewy look rather than having my face looking oily.
Feels nice on the skin, wish the spray was stronger felt like I was over spraying but maybe it’s just me
Heavenly scent & fine mist! Really enjoy the sensation when sprayed on. Always love to bring with me on travel to stay hydrated on the plane.
I recieved this on my trendmood box this product here is my favorite product. does not feel sticky and its so refreshing.
Got this from TRENDMOOD! Very nice and refreshing, would recommend.
This has actually made my face a lot less oily. Got this in my trendmood box.

Received in my Trendmood Tatcha Takeover box and I loved the whole box! I’ve had my eye on this for awhile and I love it. I have dry/oily (combo) skin and it’s so hard to find something to hydrate without looking oily and this is great even after my makeup is all done. Gonna buy again thank you Tatcha and thank you Trendmood!
Great skin mist for nighttime skincare or fall/winter for my oily skin. It’s so hydrating and rejuvenating. Love it!! Received it in my Trendmood Tatcha takeover box!
I received this in The Trendmood Box! I love it at first I thought it would be sticky but it’s so fresh and it gives me a subtle glow
bought this unsure if it would work for me, but I use it on my beauty blender when I’m putting on foundation and it turns out beautifully!
Obsessed. For someone with dry skin, this is a godsend. It literally gives you a glow like you just left hot yoga. Best skin mist I have tried.
i wanted to love this, but it fell short. definitely makes you look dewy, but it feels like it just sits on your skin without doing much.

I simply love it so so much! It makes my makeup look flawless all day! I apply it after my serum and my Water Cream moisturizer but before my Tatcha Silk Canvas primer, I do my make up and then y apply it again as a setting spray. It’s pure magic! ♥️

This product does exactly what it claims! My skin is very combination and sometimes the powder step of my makeup makes me look less natural. This mist is perfect for a skin like finish on normal makeup or an added boost for a glowy look. The smell is skin carey but took me by surprise a bit.
Just 3 sprays and your skin instantly looks so dewy and glowing. If you like the dewey look, this is for you!

review_title: It’s nice, but I won’t repurchase
review_text: This was just ok for me. Thankfully it didn’t break me out or anything (dry/combo acne-prone skin) but it didn’t give me the dewy look I was hoping for. It definitely gives some moisture, but for the price you can find others much cheaper that give the same or better results. Cute packaging, though!

this like... doesn’t do anything. i’m dry/combo and on a bare face it makes me look shiny for a few minutes then it’s no noticeable difference. it does even less to my makeup. literally doesn’t make my makeup look any different whether i spritz it before or after. also, two spritzes for your whole face? i need at least four/five to cover everything, especially if i’m wearing foundation, and it’s tiny as if it’s some gold in the bottle... so i’m halfway finished with it and have used it maybe 5/6 times. i wanna love tatcha and this packaging is to die for but the actual product? hard pass. i see better results with a jumbo 7 dollar bottle of evian face mist from tj maxx.

everyone raves about this so I decided to give this a try myself. honestly I didnt like how fine the .its was and with the mini size I had to spray alot to cover my whole face. so much so that I went through this bottle rather quickly. which didn’t say well with me because I paid 20 bucks for it. not dissing the product at all it just wasn’t for me. the must did feel good on the skin and the smell is really nice. i wish i couldve liked it more.

I use this after my moisturizer because it helps it STAY moisturized i LOVE ITI cant use it as a “throughout the day“ mist though because city air is dirty ): and I feel like this mist is a little on the thicc side

I do like this product but it doesn’t last long by the time you spray it but I do really like it! I would probable buy if more often if it was a little cheaper.  I use it Mostly on days I don’t wear a lot of make up it gives me a nice glow and keeps my feeling fresh!!

i love the mist, love the smell, and i love the dewy look it gives me. i don’t know if it’s the bottle i have or if its all the bottles but i feel like the product does not come out as well as it should, spending $50 i would like to think the sprayer would work well.
I have normal skin but because I need all the hydration I can get being in my 40’s. This spray is exactly what gives me hydration and that amazing glow that I love! Can’t do without!!
Prime. Set with powder. Use a powder foundation. And this. Seriously could not find a better every day make up routine. I have dry/combo skin and it looks dewy and healthy with make up on !

The only downside to this product is the price point. Everything else about it I love however if you have sensitive skin I wouldn’t use it if you’re irritated at all due to the fragrance however other than that mid day when you don’t want to put more moisturizer on but you want a little dew and moisture and glow to your face it’s perfect it makes you so glowy and luminous I wish it was less expensive I have the trial size from the tatcha best sellers set which id definitely recommend for those curious about tatcha but I don’t know if I’ll be repurchasing because of the price I can’t see myself spending 50 dollars on a spray but If you got the coin I definitely would recommend!

It works OK to dry and sensitive skin. But i don’t think it worth the price. I used it when i was dehydrated. However, the spry didn’t good enough.  This one do has the shine but i don’t like the feeling and not hydro enough after suncream.For a really dry skin I would say the “Shu Uemura Sublime Beauty oil in lotion “is better even after you apply sun cream with it in a spry bottleAnd it is a lotion.

I do love this product, can’t go anywhere without it. But the price is not lovable, and the packaging is heavy. I wish they bring out a bigger, more light-weighted version than this. It happened that I ran out of it during my two months trip to another country, and it’s very difficult to find a replacement. I suppose the packaging makes it what it is, but I’m only in for what’s inside

I had really high hopes for this because Kim Kardashian’s make up artist swears by this. The spray feels very light, very wet. I like the scent. It doesn’t cover much area when I spray so I find myself using 4-5 sprays per use. This is nice to have when I’m running too late to pull out the tatcha lotion but still want some moisture but I’m not sure yet if I like this enough to reorder. Will continue using it though.

It’s amazing when you finally get it out. You can’t tell if it’s going on your face or not and if you keep spraying bc you think nothing is coming out, you end up looking like a grease ball. I under the fine mist is good thing but if you apply too much, it’s not good.
Tried it. Did not see the hype. Face did not feel fresh nor dewy. Returned it.

Yes it smells wonderful and the packaging is luxurious, as all the Tatcha products are. While I do like it as an indulgence, the price point is a little high for my personal results. I did not like the sprayer as much as my go to Claudalie grape water.
My all time fav setting spray ever!!!!!

This is my holy grail! This mist makes your skin glowy and airbrushed, your makeup just melts together in the best way. However, for the price it only lasts me a month or two which is not cute. But definitely worth the splurge in every way.

I bought this wanting to use it as a setting spray over my make up, it wasn’t so great. It was as effective as just using plain water. So I started using it on my minimalist days, when I would wear only mascara and lip balm. It looks great on my skin!

Not a fan on the way the mist sprays ..  I felt like I had to press a million times to get an even amount on my skin ... also didn’t make my skin look dewy at all... I didn’t like how the mist sprayed .. I had to pump it quite a bit before there was an even amount in my skin.. also didn’t make my skin dewy at all

Very disappointed with this one :(The mist feels amazing on my skin pre or post make up- however, post make up makes my skin extremely oily and no amount of setting powder will fix it. Before makeup I found works much better, but I’d really like something that is versatile.

The mister on this is everything. It definitely does what it says. It leaves my skin looking healthy and glowy. I have woren this alone and with makeup. It also sets my makeup in place and gives your skin a dewy finish thats really pretty. I do wish that it came in a bottle that wasn’t exposed to light. I keep mine on a drawer so it doesn’t bother me but this one has to be in a dark place.

I’m so sad to give this, but I have dry skin and me thinking it would do wonders. Initially I tired it as just a plain and my skin began popping red bumps and small pimples, so I tired it again a week later and it still did the same thing. I do have dry skin but it didn’t work for me.

I don’t quite get the hype surrounding this product. It’s not horrible, but it’s definitely not worth the hype. It’s not a dewy as I thought it would be and the spray on it is a bit annoying and cheap in comparison to the rest of the packaging. I’m happy I got the trial size, but I doubt I would repurchase. It’s just an OK product.

Love this product. It has helped my skin feel and look healthy, it improves a lot. It does make you looks dewy... so if you aren’t into that, this is not for you. One star down due to the price - the bottle doesn’t last that long, especially with daily use.

review_title: skip it - you don’t need this
review_text: This doesn’t give the dewy skin everyone thinks or says it does. I have very dry skin and it just made me look kind of shiny. It didn’t give me any kind of glow at all. For the price it’s just not worth it.

I got this in a kit with he radiance mask and silk primer. This spray is nice, smell is mild (smells like the rice polish) which I don’t mind. It does give a dewy glow but nothing crazy. I wouldn’t have bought it as I have combination skin and this is a no for oily areas. If you have dry skin you might like it. I use it on no makeup days for a bit of extra moisture.

I like Urban Decay All Nighter but for mature skin this is the best.  The mist is super fine and sprays on evenly leaving my skin soft but not too dewy or oily.  The fragrance is light and smells of herbs and incense.

This setting spray truly does what it says. It makes my face very dewy and glowy.I use this product on after my base - so my complexion products ie foundation, blush, bronzer - and before my brows eyeshadow and mascara to create a nice canvas for my eye products.

Highly recommend! This is the best mist I have ever used. I apply it during lunch break and it is able to moisture and give my skin a dewy look for the whole afternoon. For the price, it is not cheap, but it worths it.

I absolutely let this product. I wear it over my BB cream and it is so light weight, I really appreciate  that it has a comforting smell to it. this is my second time purchasing TATCHA  products.  I will say that it is money well spent

very pricey product. happy I didn’t get the full size, and happy I didnt pay the full price for a mini! I don’t understand the benefits it has? As well as the dewy look? I have way cheaper setting sprays that achieve a higher payoff. Other people might like this product, however it is not for you if you can find an alternative or already own the alternative. If you’re trying to save up, dont buy this product.

I absolutely LOVE this spray! Every time I use this spray through out the day it leaves my skin glowing and feeling well moisturized without making me feel greasy! This spray has a fine beautiful mist and a wonderful clean smell! I will being by this many times over and will recommend it to everyone I know! It is well worth every penny you spend on it!
Love the tatcha recommended by Jeanne. Love it  Thanks Jeanne

I received this as a gift from a friend. After hearing about all the hype I was excited to try it. I wanted to love this so much but I really found it to be lackluster compared to other Tatcha products. I usually used it after applying my makeup and had a travel size in my purse to refresh during the day. I honestly did not see a big difference between this and other cheaper setting sprays meant for a dewy finish. With that being said it did give my skin a luminous look after makeup so the product itself is fine, but definitely won’t be a staple in my beauty routine considering the price compared to other setting sprays and moisturizers. There is also a strong fragrance that I liked, but other consumers may not. I feel like the travel size in your purse may be worth it if you live in a dry environment and need extra moisture during the day, but for me living in Florida this is just going to sit on the shelf.

review_title: I really wanted to like this product
review_text: I really wanted to like this product, but sadly I breakout really bad every time I use it. I would not recommend this to anyone.
Love the product itself but mists our so finely I want to feel soaked in it lol.
I like this product, definitely gives me the look I want, BUT I cannot get passed the smell of this, I think it smells awful. Another reason for 3 stars is the price, it’s definitely expensive.
It feels good on skin but I don’t think it worth the money.  3 stars for thewell made bottle. For the product you can mix any toner with argan oil that you like to achieve the same result.
Holy grail of setting mists!!
Love this spray, sets your makeup, gives you a dewy glow.
Wonderful, I’m addicted to this product!
Did absolutely nothing for my skin. I have dry skin and this didn’t hydrate or make my skin dewy whatsoever. It’s just like spraying water on my face.

This product is my holy grail like I love this stuff I use it every time I go out it gives you that beautiful natural glow and I do have complements for my skin all the time... definitely recommend it .
Made my skin dewy all day
Saved me all winter! I have combination skin but in the winter my skin gets to be very dry. This honestly changed everything!

This product doesn’t work for me. I had hoped it would make my makeup look more skin-like but it just broke apart my foundation. Might work for extremely dry skin but I have regular to oily skin and it’s a definite no for me.

In love! So delicate and moisturizing without feeling greasy or slick. The mist is so fine, almost like a perfume, that you won’t end up with drops all over your face... instead you will get even distribution and feel fabulous!!

5 stars for how it looks spritzed on my shoulders and collarbone. Gives me a healthy summer glow with my maxi dresses and off the shoulder rompers. Absolutely love how easy it is to use. Lasts all night too.
When my foundation is cakey, I spray this my face. It brings a good finish look, but I feel it make my foundation getting sticky. Not really love it.
No better spray than the Tatcha Dewy Skin Mist

Love! I love in dry COLORADO and use retin a so my skin gets super dry in the winter. This sets my makeup beautifully and gives me this amazing glow. I’ve tried many and this is the best. HG, hope it never goes away.

I received this in a value pack that I bought for myself. I wanted to try out Tatcha without committing myself to full sized products. I was very excited about this spray since I love hydrating products; however, I find that it makes me look quite sweaty. It is nice and hydrating, but the “glow“ can be mistaken for sweat. I’ve had people ask me if I’m okay and why I’m sweating so much. It’s rather embarrassing. I don’t know what to do with the spray now. I guess I’ll use it at home where no one will see me or ask me why I’m sweating so much. It is hydrating, but I don’t think I will purchase this product. There are other sprays out there that are hydrating and don’t give a sweaty look. Plus this spray is quite small given the price. I don’t love it.

Loved this! made my makeup look so soft. It instantly takes away any look of “powderyness” and dryness. I love this. It kind of smells like curry hahah, but the smell goes away instantly. Would give the full 5 stars but I don’t think it increased the wear time of my makeup. But it did make it look beautiful

review_title: Not worth the the hype, barely lasts
review_text: I like to use a lot of product, but I use skin mists sparingly, because a little goes a long way. The 1.34 oz bottle last me about a week before it finished... More importantly, I didn’t notice a huge difference on my skin compared to other mists, even though it came highly recommended. So I’m not convinced I would buy in full size, instead shop around and check out other mists.

This product is... okay. I bought it after seeing it everywhere and assumed it had to be worth it. It’s definitely good for refreshing your make up during a long day, but I would not say my skin looks “luminous“ or “dewy“ afterwards.

review_title: Too little product for the price
review_text: I absolutely love the look this product gives me, my only issue is that it doesn’t last very long. I use 3-4 sprays. I’ve had it for 3 months but i only use it 2 times a week, sometimes less. I basically finished the bottle already ... for this much money i would expect it to last longer. Other mists i’ve used i can spray them on multiple times a day and they will lasts months. for that reason i don’t plan to repurchase. get yourself a very subtle highlighter and set your makeup with it for the same results lol.
This was a great spray for  dewy finish. I loved it

I really like this product, I use it under my makeup and under my primer.  I feel like it give me an extra glow.  I have yet to use it as a refresher for my makeup.  But I suspect it will give me a glowy complexion over makeup.  Will probably buy again!
Don’t really see the point of this product, got it in a bento box set. Mainly use it to cool face down after being out on a hot day.

I’m not sure if I’m qualified to review this particular item because I’m 47 and new to all this “primer“ and “setting spray“ thing. I saw a video here on Sephora where an artist was applying makeup based on skin that is blemished with acne. I have very problematic skin that is extremely dry. I have developed hormonal adult acne as well as, a reoccurring Staph infection of the face that I have yet to beat after a year. I’m left with a lot of spots without skin. I have scars, holes, and some actual sores from my chin on up. This is why I watched the video and Tatcha was one of the products that the artist recommended. It left me with a dewy finish that looked fresh and natural not to mention it felt great and my makeup didn’t budge over a 6 hour period. It seems as though primer and finishing products are now being used by everyone so, as far as I can tell this one got great ratings and some people even got a little passionate about how much they loved it. Hope this helps?

Not at all thrilled with this product, I finally splurged during the holidays and after many applications I do not see a difference in it making my skin glowy or luminous. It does set my make up well, but it does not give me a glow or dewy finish even after spraying multiple sprays.Also, the scent is like a gingerale/sprite stale scent, not a fan.
I wanted to love this, but it’s just not it for me. It does nothing for me at all... I didn’t notice a good set on my makeup. And I definitely didn’t get that “glow”. Wouldn’t buy again.

review_title: A must have for dry skin
review_text: Love this! Leaves you looking super glowy and dewy without looking greasy! I have extremely dry skin and despite having a full skincare routine before putting my makeup on, my foundation always looks cakey. I do all of my makeup EXCEPT my mascara, spray this on my face, then finish with my mascara so it doesn’t run and immediately my makeup melts into my skin and looks flawless. This is definitely NOT for oily skin, as the product description does say for dry, combo and sensitive skin.

For me, this product is best when used in the winter time either directly on your skin or after makeup. I have very sensitive skin (cannot use any cream except for Tatcha sensitive triple recovery cream) and when it’s below 0 degree this mist saves my skin. I spray this after my serum. I only find it a little sticky when used in the warmer weather and I have combination skin.

To borrow a line from Tom Hanks in the movie BIG...I don’t get it. Is this a refreshing frippery, a preparatory base, a uniquely formulated setter? I’ve tried it every which way and I still don’t get it. It has no impact. It smells nice, the packaging is pretty, but I don’t understand its purpose. Tatcha is a great brand. LDSM is out of sync with their other products—all of which are carefully thought-out and highly effective, with a clearly defined purpose. This mist lacks intention but, if Tatcha returns to the proverbial drawing board, they’ll innovate a superior new product.

I was expecting a lot more from this product. I found that if I used it as a setting spray it made my face sticky and tacky..something I prefer BEFORE doing my makeup not after. Besides the skin texture I found that it didn’t do much to extend my makeup life or improve it in anyway. It does has an amazing sprayer on it, I will give it that. Overall, not worth the price.
Doesn’t dry out my skin. What I use before foundation.

I thought I would love this because I have dry skin but it actually made my skin look greasy instead of luminous, especially when I used it while wearing makeup. Its not bad on bare skin but for the price point I could find something better.

I love using this product after I am finished applying my makeup. The mister is great and I love the nice dewy finish it leaves on my skin. Love the smell too :)I’m if sure if it helps my makeup stay in place but it definitely does give me a nice glow.
trash product! makes your makeup splotchy & only worse throughout the day. i got it because of all the hype & hated every time i tried to give it another chance

this is a moisturizer for people who hate moisturizer. it goes on and absorbs and dries immediately. I don’t mean that as a negative, I think some people would prefer this. I do think calling it a moisture cream is slightly misleading as it feels more gel-like than creamy. Probably great for teens or anyone suffering from light dehydration with oily skin.

After a week of use I started getting very dry patches around my mouth, chin, nose, and forehead. I don’t normally have sensitive skin when it comes to trying new products, so this was a very bizarre reaction for me. For being advertised as a “moisture cream“, the result was the complete opposite. It sucked every bit of moisture out of my skin, regardless how much of the product I used. Immediately after applying, my skin felt tight and dry. Returning this!!

Amazing product! Bought it for my mom and she loves it. It is amazing product for you to gift your loved ones as well, does not have any issues and my hair feel relatively healthy after using this product. Definitely recommend!

I love the ingredients in this moisturizer. I have sensitive oily acne prone skin and this did not make me break out. The smell is not overwhelming but I did feel like my skin would be become really oily as the day went on.
Ehhh. I dont know about this cream. It smells really  good my face is so clear but it does not hydrate. I like it but the product does not hydrate me at all. In fact my face looks more dry ….

This moisturizer is the best on the market. It isn’t heavy, the scent is nice, and it absolutely melts into my skin and leaves it feeling so hydrated. I am obsessed!! It’s the only daytime moisturizer I will use.

This is a nice product but would only recommend for VERY OILY skin. If your combo i would not recommend because it is not hydrating enough. My skin feels tight and dry. Not matter how many layers I put on. Disappointed. I found out really how dry it was after the first week of trying this out with the standard one layer and tried to out on makeup and my skin was just awfully dry. The texture and look of makeup was just horrendous. Even now trying to finish the tub, putting on multiple layers my skin still feel tight! It smells great, cool to the touch, and isn’t sensitizing so it does have that going for it. Doesn’t clog the pores. I really wanted to like this but have now bought the other moisturizer apparently for dry skin albeit the mini version due to this experience.

New favorite every day and night moisturizer!! Somehow is both light and deeply moisturizing, and smells so fresh! I used in both very dry air in colorado and high humidity in PNW and it’s just the best.

review_title: Didn’t think it did much until I ran out
review_text: I got this moisturizer as part of the YTTP skin routine set. At first I was underwhelmed - it didn’t seem to make much difference in my skin. Then I ran out, and now I can tell a huge difference in my skin’s moisture level even though I’m still using a moisturizer. I have a fairly deep line in my forehead that had smoothed out quite a bit but is now back in full force. I will be getting more when my current moisturizer runs out!

review_title: Not as moisturizing as I thought it would be
review_text: I really wanted to like this moisturizer but it wasn’t moisturizing enough for my skin :( I have oily skin and after I put it on my skin felt tight and not moisturized at all.
After using, my skin feels so soft and moisturized. I would 100% recommend. My skin is on the oily side and this worked wonderfully!

This is a really good moisturizer. I’ve been using for almost two years now. I love that the ingredients are clean and there isn’t anything in there that really clogs pores. I like it because it is lightweight and hasn’t caused me any breakouts. My issue with it is I don’t feel like it’s doing anything fantastic for my skin moisture wise in the winter. It seems like a basic cream and for the price it’s tiny that’s why I took a star off. I will continue to repurchase because I feel like it’s not adding any issues to my face. Over all of you need a cream and are scared of breaking out this one is great! YTTP please, come out with a bigger size.
Amazing product. Keeps my skin moisturized all day

I am honestly a huge fan of this cream. I have combination but mostly oily skin, and prone to breakouts. It’s the perfect day moisturizer, and I would’ve given it a 5 star but honestly the price is too much. If you’re using it every day, the jar goes very quickly, and $63 for this tiny jar just seems absurd. Although it is a staple in my skin care routine, it would be great for the company to recognize that this might be too expensive for their buyers and potentially mark it down in the future.

had gotten a sample and loved it. decided to splurge & buy the 50$ bottle and did not disappoint! immediately left my face feeling full and hydrated like the sample packet did. usually have combo skin, but it becomes very dry in the winter & that’s when I bought this product. 10/10
Wanted to love this because I love this brand. Was disappointed! It’s not moisturizing and broke me out! :(

Ingredients of this moisturizer looks perfect, that was the reason I got it, I have acne prone oily skin. But! It made my skin super dry, especially around mouth. Even layering it up felt like nothing. Unfortunately will have to return it.
severely dried out my skin even after applying it many times throughout the day

review_title: Not enough moisture for dry skin
review_text: I wouldn’t recommend this for dry skinned boys and girls. It’s certainly light and airy and sits on the skin that way. For me though it doesn’t alleviate dry patches, nor does it give my face a plump, hydrated feel.

Prior to purchasing I saw reviews saying this was drying but wanted to try it out for myself, I wanted to love this SO bad because of the recommendations and the beautiful texture but my combination skin was so dry after every use. Not worth it :(

I love how it just melts on my skin…leaving a air light smooth finish and the quantity omg I’ve using it for 2 months regularly and trust me I’ve not even used 1/4th of a jar ..this thing is gonna last me another 6 months I believe ..so extreme value for money and it does the job it’s made for

Purchased recently and it just arrived today to use for AM/PM.  Love the packaging and scent, it is very light and cool to the touch.  My skin drank it right up so I put on a bit more but then went for another moisturizer, as lots of others noted here.  Pricey, fine for every day use but not hydrating enough for my skin to be the only moisturizer for AM/PM.

I am really surprised about the bad reviews here. This has made a HUGE difference in my skin to where when I am not using this I start to see fine lines and wrinkles again vs when I am using this my skin is GLOWING and super plump. I have spent thousands of dollars on microneedling and lasers for old acne scars and this is the only face cream that I can use that’s super gentle and doesn’t break me out. Highly recommend this stuff if you have oily skin and it’s a perfect moisturizer under makeup.

This is an okay product. I appreciate that it doesn’t feel greasy and it hasn’t broken me out however,at times it feels slightly waxy and doesn’t feel super moisturizing. Also not a fan of the fragrance.

This is definitely a great moisturizer! I’ve been using this in the morning and at night I use the YTTP dream mask. I find it gives good hydration on the face BUT it is lightweight so if you have eczema and dry skin like me then you’ll notice that your skin is still stiff and dry after this cream. But I’ve learned that when I put a thicker layer of dream mask at night, my face in the morning is much more hydrated and this cream is sufficient. Also use this after the Vitamin C serum and it works really great as well in combination with the serum! I’ve been falling in love with the whole YTTP line in the past few months starting with their cleanser! Such great products
Very lightweight, hydrating moisturizer...not to mention that it also has bomb AF ingredients!

The smell was so amazing I wanted to love it. But it really isn’t enough moisture for my dry skin. I have to apply it multiple times a day to have any moisture on my face. I’m sure it works for other people, but for me this is a no.

my acne-prone combo skin loves this moisturizer. Lightweight but still hydrates my skin. Works great under makeup, and best of all, doesn’t break me out! I’ve already repurchased.only con- the lid is sort of flimsy and mine cracked. However, the ingredients and the way this makes my skin look and feel make up for the packaging!

I had the sample packet and it worked really well on me. Kept me hydrated without being too heavy or oily. Then I bought a full size and didn’t get the same results. It left me extra greasy which is unfortunate. For reference, I have combination skin.
great moisturizer for someone with oily skin and a decent one for dry skin, my husband and I love it!

This moisture cream is exactly what I have been looking for! It isn’t very heavy and hydrates my dry skin. You don’t need to use that much of it for it to cover and do it’s job. I initially tried this product in a trial pack and fell in love with it.
I love this product! It feels so light and fluffy on my face and my skin always feels so great afterwards.
Did not work for me and made my skin very sore.  I used after the Superberry mask and between the two my skin became very inflamed.

This is my 3rd time buying this! I love the smell so much and the texture is so light and whipped as the name suggests. It sinks in beautifully too! This might be a new holy grail for me. Only drawback is the high price!

review_title: Not for oily, acne prone skin
review_text: This is a wonderful product but not for Spring and Summer if you have very oily, acne prone/ blemish skin or large pores. The texture is lovely and it didn’t break me out but, it felt a little too drenching/ heavy on the skin. I would try it again in winter.  This would be best for normal or combination skin

I love this product. It smells so good, and it’s not a heavy cream. This really moisturizes my face and a little goes along way! It’s been so hard for me to find a moisturizer that won’t make my face feel greasy! My face feels super soft !
I loooove this moisturizer!! It’s so lightweight and doesn’t make me feel oily. I apply it before my makeup and also sometimes before bed.

There’s always an “ah ha” moment when you find a product that works for your skin. This was mine! I have tried many other moisturizers, and most tend to leave my dry skin feeling too sticky. This is the only one I have tried that gives me a soft, baby-face feel. For reference, my skin is pretty dry and flaky, and can be sensitive to many products.

I have combination skin and this moisturizer did not work for me. It feels nice upon initial application, but after a few moments of wear my face felt dried up. It didn’t matter how much I put on, within a few minutes it felt like the moisturizer had left and taken the moisture from my skin with it.I tried to make it work for a month to see if my skin would adjust, but my skin kept itching slightly and breaking out in random spots. After a month of my skin acting up, I wanted to look at the ingredients to see if there was something I missed that was causing my skin irritation. So, I flipped the glass moisturizer jar over to inspect it closer. The ingredients weren’t listed there as I expected, but I saw black specks sitting inside the bottom of the jar. At this point, I realized I may have recieved a faulty product. The seal was removed when I had first opened it, but I just assumed it had come off into the lid as I unscrewed it. I ended up returning the product.Despite my overall experience with the product not going well, I am still giving the product two stars because of the two redeeming qualities:1. I love the brand philosophy of Youth to the People and I would still happily try their other products.2. I think this product could possibly work well for people with super oily skin. I don’t think it’s a bad product; I think that it just didn’t work well for me.

Love YTTP, it’s the majority of my skin care routine. I was super excited for this moisturizer but it doesn’t help my super dry skin. It’s not the worst but it’s not the moist moisturizing. My under eyes are always very dry, this just kind of keeps them from going haywire. Prefer their other moisturizer.
I was excited to try this but after applying 1 layer, my skin seemed dry. I put 2nd layer on. Half hour later,i literally have dry white skinon my face. Zero moisturization.  Very disappointed.
Amazing for oily skin. Doesn’t leave a film and absorbs quickly. Keeps me hydrated all day. Great under makeup.
Great for the summer months, or for people with oily/combo skin. Very lightweight and I felt my skin looked great when using it. If you have dry skin I don’t think it would be hydrating enough.
I wanted to love this product but it did not work for me. Left my skin feeling dry and tight. I would not suggest if you have dry or combination skin.

Didn’t notice much of a difference in my skin. Overall nice moisturizer though! One thing that is rough is the packaging - the black letters have worn off and are all over the other items in my skincare bag :(

I’ve been using this for years! It is an amazing moisturizer that doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy, is a great make up base and I don’t get cystic acne with those product like I do with heavier creams.It’s also a great base for adding serums if you want a little extra during the day. Highly recommend!

It was too light for me. I have normal to dry skin, and it made me so dry even in the summer time. I had to mix with face oil. Might work for oily skin. I wouldn’t buy it again. But I liked the smell, very refreshing!

review_title: where have you been all my life ???
review_text: Better than coconut oil. I love this my skin literally drinks it up. I feel great my skin feels great. Will be buying this again. I am 55 and so grateful for this product
Absorbs quickly. No grease residues, kept my skin clear and hydrated
Absolutely amazing love it Would recommend to people with cystic acne prone skin
First moisturizer that I will repurchase for ever !! Love it for my very greasy skin
Meh. It was too lightweight for my dry skin. Probably best for oily skin that already has enough moisture.

My favorite moisturizer of all time. For those of you who don’t like heavy, thick products, this is a dream cream. It has a beautiful, mild, clean fragrance. It’s light, and cool on the skin, spreads easily, and absorbs beautifully after a minute or two. It’s absolutely refreshing, and brings to mind summer cucumbers - even though I know it’s got kale and green tea as its ingredients. It’s a wonderful product if you tend to layer with serums, because it helps to keep things nice and light.  Love YTTP products in general, and this lovely moisturizer will always be part of my regular skin care routine.

review_title: Love it! Not so much the packaging
review_text: 1 star off for the jar packaging, but other than that I love this! My skin is sensitive, breakout prone, combo. This doesn’t irritate or clog my skin at all and it is an amazing base for makeup for whatever reason. On days I wear it my makeup sits really well, I guess bc my skin is balanced- it doesn’t get oily/cakey, and also doesn’t get dry and flake or separate. I just have great skin days. I love the smell, love it, so it’s something I look forward to putting on in the morning. I use it every day daily, sometimes at night, but I usually use something heavier and more moisturizing at night. Fwiw the adaptogen cream and superberry mask both broke me out so I don’t use either of those. The adaptogen even gave my 6 year old a breakout. Would not recommend those if you are clog prone. But this kale stuff=HG!

review_title: Very drying causing oiliness and acne
review_text: I couldn’t be more angry about this product! Over many years of having oily, acne prone skin, i have learned that the key to clear skin is to wash your face and then use a good moisturizer, the more hydrated my skin is the less oily it gets throughout the day and the less acne i have. This worked for me and i was pretty much acne free for many years while using La Roche Posay’s effacer moisturizer which was amazing, but i wanted to switch to a clean brand. This moisturizer was recommended to me and feels very good on the skin, it is very light and i used it for a few weeks and liked it but i started breaking out more then usual. At first i thought it was my period or hormones or stress, but then i realized how dry my skin was with this moisturizer. I had never before had any dry patches on my face but now i did, my skin was flaky and as my skin was so dry i was getting oily skin again. I switched my moisturized to Tatcha’s water cream and within one day my skin started to clear up. I don’t recommend this cream to anyone it is not moisturizing enough and leads to breakouts!
Hydrating and lightweight. Use it every morning before sunscreen. That way I don’t look oily and nor break out. Gives my skin a dewey look.

I was so confused. I heard great things and was recommended this product. I have really dry skin and redness. I loved the feeling and smell of this, but I felt like it really didn’t do much for my skin. I still felt dry and if I didn’t put on oils, etc. my skin would feel like I never put on moisturizer in the first place. Really wanted to like it but will not purchase again.

I have trouble with my skin actually absorbing products. This works really well.  Anything with citrus/citric acid causes acne for me, this is the best citrus free moisturizer I’ve found. Skin feels and looks visibly smoother. Improved dark discoloration also. Make up looks better.

I really enjoy this cream. I am 31, have hereditary dark under eye circle and some fine lines. I have been using about a month now. My combination skin also can’t have vitamin C and most moisturizers break me out so I have to resort to water creams. The consistency is a little thick with the whip but my skin soaks it up like water, is not irritated or breaking out and a little goes a long way. My lines on my forehead and laugh area are pretty much gone, my lips are extra plump even though I have not applied any cream to them.The aloe, hyaluronic acid, being a clean cosmetic and family business peaked my interest. Definetly going to buy again.

I have very sensitive skin and have been looking for a moisturizer that doesn’t leave me oily or trigger  my rosacea .  This stuff is fantastic.  I’m not saying this is right for everyone.  But, I can honestly say that I love this and I plan on using this for a long time.  I am 49 years old and I can finally say that I love the way my skin looks and feels.  Give it a try and see what you think.  Just ask an associate to make samples for you to try.  No money is spent so you don’t lose out on anything.  I also use the cleanser and I simply love it.

My oily skin loves this! I find it’s great to put on over my tretinoin in the evenings as it isn’t at all irritating, just a soothing layer. Tip - spritz your face with rose water before and/or after applying to increase the hyaluronic acid efficacy.
perfect summer skin product! both super light and super hydrating. traveled all over Southeast Asia (10  flights) and i absolutely vouch for this level of hydration.

I’ve been looking for a product to really soak into my skin and hydrate it. At first, this seemed to do the job. It felt nice and refreshing, but then I noticed the moisture sits on top of my skin more than it sinks it. I enjoy the texture of the product and the light, refreshing smell, but I won’t be repurchasing this one.

I have combo (on the more oily side) skin and this is the perfect moisturizer, especially in warmer weather months. The smell is great and I love the gel texture. It’s super cooling on my skin and it relaxes me before bed. Has not broken me out or irritated my skin at all.

This is the first moisturizer I’ve ever tried and I wish I did it before. I started using it because I saw dehydrated skin, showing small wrinkles (I drink a lot of water and do sports intensively every day). Even though I do not have a lot of comparison material, it doesn’t irritate, is full of known and good ingredients, smells nice, and is just leaving my feeling fresh every morning and night without any tightness. 1 Star less because it runs out quickly (every month) and is not cheap.
I absolutely LOVE this- it feels light, the smell is nice and not strong-  I put this on at night and see a difference in my skin the next morning. It is moisturizing but not oily.

A light moisturizer that sinks into the skin. I love it because it doesn’t sit on top of my skin. It smells good and makes my skin look amazing. I’m on the drier side, so it’s not moisturizing enough for me at night, but it’s perfect during the day.

This is my all-time favorite moisturizer. It’s super light weight, smells great and does the trick! I alternate back and forth with this one and the adaptogen moisturizer. Big fan of this brand and how it effects my skin.
My new favorite. I have sensitive skin. This moisturizer is soothing hydrates and sinks in leaving skin ready for foundation or for me my Urban Decay One and Done
This has an amazing texture and absorbs instantly. This has not triggered my sensitive skin and it has a light pleasant scent.
Best thing that ever happened to my skin. I use every morning and after shower. My face is super soft and this moisturizer isn’t heavy/greasy. I love love love it!

I did so much research on the ingredients on this and decided to try it because it is one of the cleanest products I’ve been able to find. The texture is great and I love the smell even though it has no artificial fragrance. It sinks into the skin right away but the minute I started using it my skin got even more dry. Right when . I put it on I got dry patches almost everywhere and my skin got flakey in spots where I usually don’t have dry skin at all. As the day went on I noticed my nose getting more oily than usual. I don’t think this is a bad product it just didn’t work for my skin.

I received a sample of this product and put it on at night. It left my skin feeling so soft in the morning! I didn’t wear it during the day as I wear an anti-wrinkle day cream instead. But this product leaves your skin so soft and moisturized!

I started using this product on Thanksgiving 2018, I just finished my first jar and wow. This moisturizer is so light and soothing for my annoying combination skin. My nose will be so greasy it shines, but also have dry flaky patches. This moisturizer was the cure. My acne has significantly improved, so has the texture on my cheeks. I will never go back to the Lush moisturizer that I had previously used for two years. Hooked on this stuff.
Super light weight but it’s also really moisturizing, I have dry skin but this works really good as a day moisturizer

This is an awesome 3 season moisturizer! My skin gets a bit too dry in the winter for this to be my daily go to during winter. It’s very refreshing and light for the rest of the year and I will for sure be going back to it when the weather warms up.

For the price of this it is not worth it. I didn’t notice a significant difference in my skin. I wouldn’t say it helps with fine lines and plumping. It’s an «okay» moisturizer, but that’s about it. The scent was nice and very very light though, good for anyone who is sensitive to scents.

This is a great moisturizer for oily skin, has a nice fresh scent and sinks in quickly.  My skin has been leaning more combo-oily instead of combo-dry and while I need to add MUFE Skin Booster in the winter under makeup, it is perfect by itself the rest of the year.
I got a sample of this product and it is horrible. My face broke out. This brand does not agree with my skin at all.

Love this moisturizer! A great smooth texture - a hybrid of a gel and cream formula. Skin perfectly moisturizer every time. I only buy vegan and cruelty free products and this line is such a fantastic  find!

I have combo skin with hormonal/adult/utter BS acne and my previous day moisturizer was the Origins Ginzing. I would say that this cream is comparable in that it is very lightweight and fast absorbing which were both things I loved about that moisturizer, I just decided to try this in the hopes it might help clear up my skin.After a couple weeks I will say that some of the scars I have are clearing up a little faster, but I am otherwise not seeing any dramatic improvement. Time will tell I suppose if this is something amazing vs just a good product. I saw someone in the comments mention they had sensitive skin and didn’t like their results and my guess there is that using the product in the day with exposure to sunlight might have irritated their skin because of the hyaluronic acid, so it might still work as a night cream for them.Overall, it gets 4 stars because it is a great product, just not enough of an improvement over my old moisturizer to justify the additional cost IMO.

I’m always afraid to try new moisturizers, especially  those with oils, due my acne-prone skin, but I received a sample in my Play bag and tried it out. This cream is gel-like and kept my skin moisturized in the dead of winter without clogging my pores. It has a light, fresh scent, and I would love to purchase in full-size.

I’m not a 48-dollars-for-lotion kind of person, or at least I wasn’t until now. I got a sample of this and had to buy the full size. I’ve struggled with acne, redness, and just overall skin inbalance for all of my adulthood and have never been happy with any face lotions, high or low end. Somehow this stuff lessens the appearance of my pores and redness, and makes me look like I have foundation or primer on my face. (I dont wear foundation or powder.) My skin feels baby-smooth and I look younger. Literally. I don’t like the container since it’s open to the air and I worry that since it’s natural it might not stay stable, but we’ll see when this jar runs out. It’s too amazing not to use.
I loved this product. Sensitive and very hydrating. I give it 4 starts because it is a little expensive.

If you want good hydration and aim to have better skin texture, then this is a must have. I use this as part of my night time routine.  When I wake up in the morning, my skin is so hydrated and smooth. I love the smell of this product!

I absolutely LOVE this product!! I typically only use oils/serums because I feel like cream moisturizers are quick to make my skin feel congested, but this product is so lightweight and absorbs beautifully. I’m using it morning and night, and my face has taken on a smoother and more even texture. I usually have a little morning redness, but am now waking up to happy, hydrated skin. LOVE it!!

review_title: This is not for dry skin
review_text: This cream is very lightweight. It feels and smells nice but it’s very light texture and doesn’t feel like it’s moisturing my face that well especially at the dryer part of my face. I have to use another cream on top to help moisturizing. I almost finish it and still doesn’t show any result. Would not buy again as it doesn’t suit my dry skin and doesn’t do anything for my face.

Let me start by saying that this is the most AMAZING moisturizer I have ever tried! From the moment this magical cream touched my skin I knew I was in love. I have tried multiple moisturizers in all price ranges and have never been fully satisfied until I tried Youth to the people’s super food air whipped moisturizer. I literally would buy a moisturizer use it for a week or two and never open the container or bottle again. When I got my hands on this product I instantly was in love, and have successfully used the WHOLE container down to the last drop! My skin has never felt soo good! I don’t think I will ever change moisturizers, as this one has changed my life!

I initially bought this product because I wanted something hydrating but not heavy that did not contain silicone and I have not been disappointed. It is hydrating without being heavy and doesn’t cause my acne prone skin to break out.

Received a sample and loved the way this left my skin soft and moisturized, so I purchased the full sized. It smells good, almost like nothing. It comes with a little paddle to apply, which is nice. I was using the latest Drunk Elephant and this is more moisturizing.

I absolutely love this product!! I was looking for a moisturizer without dimethicone and I tried several but this one was the one that stole my heart. I have combo skin but mostly dry (oily on my t zone), and this worked wonders, it absorbed into my skin beautifully and left it hydrated. Works great underneath makeup too. After my second pregnancy, my skin changed and I had a lot of discoloration, dryness, etc. and this has given my skin a total makeover. I give it 4 starts because price is a little up there for the amount of product

Okay, first of all, I just finished a sample I’d gotten in my allure box & loved it so much that I just bought the full size. It’s amazing. So here’s my review:I love the kind of whipped like texture of this stuff. It went on smooth, & it made my face feel super smooth & soft immediately after application. It originally went on looking kind of shiny but once it absorbed, my face wasn’t shiny or greasy at all. It feels super moisturizing but light and not heavy & my skin feels like it could still breathe. It smells very light and fresh, but it’s not overwhelming at all. It calmed my irritation & soothed my redness. It didn’t break my skin out & it actually helped clear up the couple of breakouts I already had. I have a frown line on my forehead that has started to look softer & is less noticeable now (whaaaat?!). My skin looks clearer & more even, & it feels softer & smoother now. This stuff is 10/10, seriously. A little pricey, but I wouldn’t have bought the full size for this price if I hadn’t been so impressed with the sample size I’d gotten. I only used it for a week and a half before I ran out (used it 2x/day; also a little went a long way with this in my case) and it already did everything I described above; I can’t imagine what wonders it’ll do after a month of use!

I was looking for a morning face lotion or cream that wouldn’t make my makeup slide and I finally found it! This cream is great! It feels light on the skin, smells great, has diminished my fine lines, and is perfect for use under makeup. Highly recommend!

Received a sample with my last purchase and I’m really enjoying this moisturizer. Feel fresh and lightweight while tackling my dry skin issues. I’ll have to purchase the full size when my current moisturizer runs out.

review_title: It's a great cream for the summer!
review_text: Absolutely love this cream, it’s very light weight. I went through it very quickly. It’s the perfect summer cream because of how light it feels on your skin. However, if you have dry skin like me I would suggest to use an oil base serum before to keep your skin moistures.
Love it it’s very smooth and supply’s well doesn’t leave my face greasy smells wonderful

Light-but effective moisture!  nourishing but not greasy feeling. My skin looks and feels amazing, and for being 36 and an esthetician I’m really picky about skincare. I love this brand, it’s message and it’s results! You will too!
