I promised myself I would never be the person who pays this much for moisturizer, but it’s totally worth it to have a product which is fulling moisturizing but also doesn’t leave you skin feeling tacky.
amazing product - plumps and hydrates - non greasy smells amazing too

I love this product. I have oily skin and have been looking for a moisturizer that works and doesn’t leave me feeling more oily. I use it along with the cleanser and mask daily, and since I have had less breakouts, and my skin has improved overall.

Dewtooia easily just became my favorite product. My skin I literally look like a glazed donut after using it SUPER DEWY I love it . I love to use it in the morning and at night. It really does give me this natural dewy look gifted by ole henriksen

I got this as a free sample and just gave it a try the other night. Yowza! It banished my dry, uneven skin and brought back the glow I thought I’d finally lost to age. I’m 59, a rehead with sensitive skin and spotty, fading freckles. Dewtopia smoothed and refreshed and brightened as soon as I put it on, with lasting effects throughout the following day. My husband was an instant fan the next morning. He thought I’d just gotten a good night’s sleep, LOL! I immediately ordered a full bottle.

Bamboozled once again! I got a few uses out of the sample of this and it worked like a DREAM, visibly softer, healthier, clearer looking skin the mornings after. Was SOLD and bought the full size only to swear the potency is significantly less than the sample’s. No difference seen after multiple uses, the way I noticed when previously trying the product. Maybe it’s just too mild for my skin (I’ve endured a ton of facial treatments/acids). I loved the chocolately lemon scent which reminded me of past chemical peels I’ve had which made me assume it was actually useful. But, I’m disappointed. Maybe it’s just too gentle for me and would work better on sensitive, innocent skin.

LOVE it. Makes me skin so soft the next day and it’s helping with rough texture I had from a dry skin patch. It can sting a little but it goes away in a few minutes. Also dries pretty fast, I normally only wait a couple minutes until I put on my moisturizer. I have super sensitive, reactive skin and it’s not too bad.
Sticky! And who knows if it works bc Sephora won’t take a return if you used any more than a teeny bit, in Staten Island.  Returned, bc don’t know if it is worth enduring the stickiness.

Yessss. This works hardcore, at least for me. I do not have sensitive skin, so right now using every night. I personally love the smell and don’t find it toooo sticky, just a little. I am on a small dose of spironolactone to help stop new acne, and this helped TREMENDOUSLY clear up the absolutely horrible cystic breakout I had. I got a sample with one of my orders a couple weeks ago, and not sure if I’ll need to buy a full size or not, but won’t hesitate if I do! I definitely feel like my skin looks more radiant.
I had never used an acid treatment before this one but this one made my face feel smooth and even toned after using.

I was a little hesitant about using an acid product on my face. However, I was very surprised and have loved my results. The first night I did have a slight tingling sensation after application, nothing major. My skin was a little sticky feeling upon waking up though. Not a huge deal to me. I have noticed a reduction in my pores, acne marks, and uneven skin texture. It has a nice light lemon scent, not overpowering. I’m excited to see how my skin improves with continued use. I received this product free in exchange for my honest opinion.

When I first tried the product I thought I wasn’t going to like it since I had a tingly sensation on my face at first. But when I woke up, I definitely felt my skin smooth. After continuous uses, I really felt my skin becoming smoother.I recommend to do a skin patch test before you try it on your face. Also minimize your sun exposure after using it. I felt more tanned after using this the night before. I would definitely recommend trying it out.

I received this complimentary from influencester to review. I really enjoy using this product. It seems to be helping my skin and is becoming a staple in my nightly skincare routine. Feels great on my skin and easy to use.
I LOVE this product. It helped smooth my skin’s texture and reduce congestion across my nose and cheeks. I would highly recommend.
I like this, however I’m not sure I love the tingle. They say that’s how you know it’s working. I dont feel I’ve used it long enough to see results.

Love love love!!! I got this in an Influenster vox box and is hands down my favorite products I’ve received yet. I worked at Estée Lauder and it reminds me a lot of Fruition from Estée Lauder except with a boost. It retexurizes the skin and leaves it really smooth. It makes my makeup look more flawless too.

First off, I love the light lemon scent of this product! It does tingle a bit when applied, but the effects are completely worth it. After using this product for several weeks, I love how rejuvenated and dewy my skin looks. I plan to use this bottle until it runs out, and even at this price point, want to repurchase to continue getting beautiful skin!
I loved this product was really great addition to my night routine. My skin looked really great dewy and my pores looked smaller after a week of using it everyday.

I was unsure of this when I first got it but after several weeks of use I can honestly say this this has improved the overall look and feel of my skin. It tingles when you put it on, but not so much that it’s too distracting. The scent isn’t strong but does last a little while so if you are sensitive to scents this may not be the product for you. Overall I really do enjoy the product and will be purchasing again in the future.

Dewtopia made my skin feel really great and smooth. And omg, it smells like lemon cake! The ONLY downside was when I used it right before bed, it left my skin a tad sticky and didn’t feel great against my pillow. Allow it to dry well and your skin will feel amazing.

I have been using this product for about 1 month now. I have to say i am loving it! My skin feels so plump and supple after using it. I prefer a chemical exfoliant to a physical one and my skin is loving this.

I loveeeeeeee this smell! Smells like those orange / vanilla soft serve ice cream when you pay them onto your skin. I love that a little goes a long way with this product and I would definitely buy it again. For its price, it’s not bad for a serum. It gives my skin a dewy glow the following day and I just love how my skin feels! Give it a try, would recommend.

review_title: Not Too Much For Oily Skin
review_text: I was sent this by Influenster to test and I’ve enjoyed it! I definitely notice my skin feeling more hydrated when I wake up. I have oily skin but it does not feel greasy at all. My face feels nice and smooth. I would definitely recommend if it’s in your budget and you have dryer skin.

This product smells like lemon cake batter which is great. I’ve been using this for about a month now and I think I do see a difference when it comes to evenness and brightening in complexion. I especially feel a tingly sensation on where I have a few freckles/sun damage so this kind of makes me believe that it’s doing it’s job!? I started off using it twice a week - skipping one day and then gradually started it using 3/4 times a week since this was my first time using an acid in my skincare. Nothing happened to me except that my face did get a little flushed the very first time I used it. In the mornings after I’ve used it, I feel like my face is very plump and moisturized. This might become a new staple in my skincare routine from now on!

review_title: Buy it - You wont regret it
review_text: I’m a huge review reader and hate to see reviews from folks who have received the product for free, I just think the review is bias. So for anyone looking to read a review from someone who actually paid and isn’t a fan of Ole Henriksen - this is it. I purchased this on a whim and do not regret it. I saw changes in my skin overnight and was actually mind blown. The acid was gentle on the skin with very little tingling. I have used the product for about 2 weeks and truly see a clarify to my skin that I haven’t seen in a long time. The overall texture is smoother and the darks marks are fading rather quickly. I have sensitive, acne prone, eczema skin and this did not cause any flare up or breakouts. Again, not a fan of Ole’s generally  but this products does exactly what it claims.

I’ve had fairly good skin with some breakouts, but after Covid and the masks - I’ve had maskacne bad.  This is helping to clear my skin after going through a bit a purge I see the light!!!  Thank you.  My pores are smaller and skin is looking clearer.  It has a pleasant smell and for me just a slight tingle no burn acid.  I started with every other night and moved to most night. I would recommend! And keep it in my Arsenal.

I have been using this product for a couple of weeks now and I feel like my skin has improved with each use.  I love how bright my skin looks each morning after I’ve used Dewtopia. It does sting a little the first time you use it, so if you have sensitive skin I would be careful with the more tender areas. Other than that, I believe this is great to use on a regular or semi-regular basis.

I received this product free from Influenster for an honest review. I have dark spots, I’m getting old and I have had years of sun exposure without wearing sunscreen, particularly from where my glasses cause some more concentrated areas of dark spots. I was deeply in need of a treatment for dark spots when I received this. I can’t stress this enough, it works. I still have spots, but they have begun to fade and are less noticeable. I plan to continue to use this product until the bottle is gone, and I am fairly confident that this will replace other staples of my skincare routine.

I recently received Dewtopia complimentary to try out in exchange for my honest review. Since turning 40, I have been looking for great products to keep my skin from showing signs of aging. I am really loving Dewtopia. I use it before bed. It has a nice lemony clean scent that I like. I think my skin had been looking dull, and Dewtopia makes it look fresh and dewy. It helps make my pores look smaller and it reduces age spots. I am excited to see what my skin will look like after I continue to use Dewtopia.

I absolutely love this product! I have fair skin which is easily damaged by the sun. As a result my skin gets dry and I have sun spots. This product not only hydrated my skin but actually lightened the dark pigmented spots. I highly recommend this product!

I’m a big Olehenriksen fan and I was excited to try his newest product! I have pretty oily skin and I felt like this complimented my skin very well. The texture is lightweight and has a nice, light scent to it. I read a lot of reviews saying it felt sticky but I didn’t feel like it was sticky whatsoever. I did use the dark spot blue toner of his prior to applying this so maybe that’s the secret!
This product made my skin feel amazing. I definitely saw a difference in my skin texture.

I was so excited when I found out I was receiving this product to try from influenster. It went above and beyond my expectations. The lemony smell is so good, the slight tingly feeling upon application feels like something is actually happening and I’ve been getting nonstop compliments on my skin! It really smooths texture and just improves overall appearance of skin. It is definitely pretty pricey but I will repurchase because it’s worth it! This is going to become a staple in my skincare routine.

review_title: Well hello there, even skin texture.
review_text: I love being a mom but it sure did to a number on my hair and skin. My beautiful even skin and long, thick hair disappeared. While this obviously cannot help my hair issues, it did enormous help with my uneven skin texture. My skin looks healthier and I attribute that to this product.

review_title: Love how smooth and soft this has made my skin.
review_text: Love how smooth and soft this has made my skin. It tingles a bit when you put it on, has a nice light citrus smell. If you are going to be in the sun all day I wouldn’t use it the night before. I worked up to about 3 nights a week and could probably use it every day if needed.

Also I have not had an issues with sun sensitivity, and I’m a girl who is out if it’s sunny all day long! I highly recommend this product and hope it works as great for you as it has for me!

I have not noticed a change in a couple of pigmentation spots, but like I said it’s only been a few weeks. I recommend this product.

review_title: Great addition to your night routine
review_text: My skin looks and feels so much softer and a MUCH more even texture after using this. So far I feel like it has helped to minimize the appearance fine lines and wrinkles. This is perfect for those who use peels or acid products. Even if I mix it with my moisturizor and toss it on over my toner, essence and serum, it leaves my skin so smooth and soft. I like the texture of it and since I use it at night before bed, I can’t say whether makeup goes on over it well or not but this is meant more for a before bedtime overnight treatment and not to be worn under other products. It can be a little sticky but if you throw a moisturizor over it the stickiness goes away. I’d definitely recommend this product. I can’t say how well it works for lines and dark spots as those things take consistency to see results and I haven’t used it long enough yet, but I do have high hopes for it. I have noticed an improvement in the texture and softness of my skin. For reference I have normal, leaning more towards dry skin that is not very sensitive.

I’ve tried many high end products in this arena over the years, so I believe it’s fair to consider myself of “advanced” level expertise. In a nutshell, this formula is smooth, satisfying to apply, and effective. I waited many weeks before reviewing so that I could give the product a fair amount of time to “work.” So many people are too quick to judge skincare products; give them time to do their thing! As far as packaging is concerned, Dior is expert level; the soft pink and silver design just screams luxury, and honestly looks stunning even just sitting on my shelf! Beginning with the first actual application, I was immediately impressed with this product. The formula is luxuriously soft, easy (and satisfying) to spread over delicate skin, and has a lovely, dainty floral fragrance. There is a slight tint that effectively blurs my pores and offers a subtle radiance that reflects light beautifully. I mostly wear it as a primer under foundation, for the blurring and smoothing benefits, but I also wear it alone on days I want a very natural look. I think it is so flattering, even on my “seasoned” skin. After about two weeks of daily use, I could tell a slight but noticeable improvement in the texture of my skin, especially around my cheeks and nose. These areas continue to improve as I continue to use the perfect skin creator every day. I believe that the fine wrinkles around my mouth, nose and eyes are becoming less and less noticeable as time passes as well. Thus far, my results have been encouraging and impressive, and I will continue to use and recommend the product with confidence!

There is fragrance, in case you’re sensitive to that, but it did not irritate my skin. It’s a good product but given the price point, it’s not a life-changing product.

Received complimentary for review.Leaves a great base layer and much more than a primer. I’ve been using regular and really like the difference it has made in my skins appearance.

I received this product for free to try it out ! I can feel how nourishes my skin, well hydrated and leaves a nice scent ! I wish this product would have mire natural ingredients and less chemicals !

review_title: Very pretty bottle, not huge impact for price.
review_text: I received this product as complimentary from influenster for testing purposes. This is my first time trying or using Dior so I was beyond excited when I received it.  The bottle is beautiful and reminds me of something my grandmother would have used when life was about being glamorous. The smell is a little bit overly perfumey for me. I didn’t see any huge difference using this product. Leaves a slight oily feel. I can’t see spending the amount for this product, I think mainly the price is because of the name.

I’m 35 and have normal to dry skin with some mild dark spots and fine lines. I’m always looking for something that can help brighten my skin and lighten my dark spots, and this product actually helps do just that. I apply the product on a freshly washed face. The product is has a pearlescent base that helps brighten the complexion. It applies to the skin like a primer, and helps blur pores and imperfections. It makes the skin feel very smooth and leaves a good base for makeup. I notice that it helps my makeup look better, and last longer. The packaging is very luxe and heavy, which I love because it makes me feel fancy. As far as if the product helps to actually lighten she spots, I didn’t really notice, but it could be because I haven’t used the whole bottle yet.

review_title: Good Primer but not worth the price tag
review_text: I did receive this product complimentary from Influenster but I am always 100% honest with mh reviews. This product is pretty much a primer. I see alot of ppl getting confused on how to use this product. It is a primer with added skincare benefits. It performs great as a primer. It both smoothing and blurring. It gives the skin a radiant finish without being greasy or emollient. You can wear it without makeup too to help blur pores and smooth skin. Ive been using this now for a month and I cant really say anything as far as skincare benefits goes. It is very scented as most Dior skincare is. If u want to splurge on a luxury primer with added skincare benefits then great, i Definitely recommend this product. But i dont think this primer is a game changer and worth the price tag.

I’ve been using this daily in the mornings combined with their super potent serum. A little goes a long way. Just two pumps and I can cover my entire face and leave it with a blurred and dewy look. My skin feels and looks great after application. I don’t wear foundation or anything so this compliments a nice fresh face look for me. This is a tinted product with a light scent and does not cause any irritation. The price point in quite high which may deter you from buying. Also, not sure if it’s related but since using this product I’ve gotten an increase of milia on my face (3-4 white bumps) so I stopped using daily.

I’m in my early 40s, have normal skin in the summer and combo skin in the winter. My concerns are hydration, plumping, and smoothing acne scarring. My routine and go-to serum includes Sunday Riley Good Genes and AHC Aqualuronic Hydrating Emulsion (am). My goals are natural beauty and makeup. First things first: the packaging. I get that Dior is a luxury brand, but I hate the fussiness of such a bulky bottle. I’ve read that when you’re nearing the end of use (as in the pump won’t release any more product), that there still may be quite a bit of product left in the bottle that you’ll have to break in order to collect and put into another container. This is super wasteful especially for such a pricey serum (despite that I received it complimentary!). The pump emits just enough that I think you get enough coverage for your entire face. The serum is a pale pink/super light beige in color and feels like a very liquid like lotion. This texture allows it to be gently applied onto your skin by gently pressing until absorbed. I’d prefer no fragrance, but since it’s Dior I was actually shocked that the fragrance wasn’t overpowering and intolerable. It is definitely something you notice throughout the day, but my sensitive nose didn’t hate it. As for the efficacy, this product delivers. It feels moisturizing and smoothing without stickiness or tightness. The mica in the product is what add the very subtle “blurring” shimmer. Know that this does not make your wrinkles go away permanently. The niacinamide in the product is the key ingredient for boosting collagen production and reducing redness. So, yes, if you use it consistently the niacinamide will benefit your skin long-term. I was pretty happy with it!

It’s good, just not great! The scent and texture is amazing but I just don’t feel like there has been a dramatic improvement in my skin. I received this as a free sample and really was hoping to love it.

This product is even better than I imagined. The packaging is GORGEOUS and makes for a beautiful counter piece. As for the product it’s a great skincare item, with only one down side, the fragrance is alittle strong. When using, it only takes one pump.. just one pump and my skin looks smooth instantly. I gave four stars because I did not see any permanent changes in my skin. However, as a skin care item to help improve the appearance of my skin upon application, this product works miracles. It blurs my imperfections like no other before. Dior did not disappoint. #influenster #Dior #Dreamskin **pro tip for my sensitive skin twins : Always do a spot test 24 hours before full application. I always test my products either on the inside of my wrist or below my earlobe on my neck prior to use to ensure i dont have a reaction.

I tried this product out for a full month and a half so I could really give an honest review. I used it as skincare and as a makeup prep as it states it can be used for both. As far as skincare goes I honestly didn’t see a difference in my skin after a month and a half. Using it as a makeup prep it worked rather well. It definitely gives a blurring effect and smooths out the skin. My skin feels very velvety and soft when this is on and my foundation applies very smooth. I love the scent it has it smells very clean and lovely. Overall I can’t say I would spent the $120 on this product though. It’s a glorified primer at most and you can definitely find a cheaper one that does the same thing this does. I received this product free from Influenster to try out and give a review.

This product is amazing the way it melts into my skin. It’s not heavy or oily & provides a smooth matt finish. It smoothed and blurs light blemishes, dark spots, overcomes dryness and leaves a uniform slightly glowing texture.It can also double as a primer or a base make-up & the product is so versatile that it can be worn by itself or underneath sunscreen. All in all it’s an incredibly good and sophisticated product. The product comes in a classy rose gold packaging and looks incredibly more expensive than it is & brightens up my whole vanity. Almost looks like a high-end perfume. The bottle is sturdy and refillable so it’s better for our pockets and for the environment too!! Overall this is an incredible product that l’m probably going to be using forever. I received this product as a part on an influenster campaign.
Great product. i’m in my late 20s and i feel like my skin is hydrated. it goes on light and isn’t too thick or oily. I didn’t notice much difference in fine lines however

This was what my skincare regimen was missing! I have used this Dior Skin Perfector for almost a month and I can definitely say the texture of my skin has improved, which is amazing in a primer product. I have mature (I’m 51) dry skin and this product seems like it was made for me. I use a light moisturizer and apply this in place of a primer. It goes on beautifully and sinks right into my skin. Next I apply a Lancôme stick foundation and it glides over my skin beautifully thanks to this Dior Skin Perfector. With the Dior Skin Perfector underneath my Foundation I get a slightly glowy finish, which at my age I love. I lost my glow many years ago so something that helps bring it back is a WIN in my book! I do see that my skin stays hydrated throughout the day (dewy - not oily) and make-up lasts the whole day with this Skin Perfector. There is a light scent (roses?) but I don’t mind it at all and it fades pretty quickly. All in all, I will be adding this to my morning regimen for many years to come!

I really liked using this primer. It felt silky smooth when applied to the face and created a perfect canvas for my makeup. I used this on my face and eyes and feel like it enhanced the color of my makeup.

I was so excited to receive this product from Influenster to try out for free and give my opinion on. First off, the packaging is gorgeous... you really feel like you are purchasing quality. And the pump bottle is nice and heavy too, which adds to the quality feel. I have been using this in my AM routine after my hydrating essence toner, and at first I have to admit I didn’t like it much because I didn’t think it was really doing anything for me. But then I changed things up a bit, and now I actually do see a difference in my skin after application. I now make sure to wait until my skin is completely dry from my essence toner...I think I was just hurrying through my routine a bit too fast. I also don’t think I was applying enough product at first. You definitely don’t need a lot, but I apply a partial pump to cheeks, forehead and chin and that seems to do it. It rubs into the skin nicely, and definitely does smooth out pores and makes my skin look more radiant. I don’t feel like this is very moisturizing, though, so if I were wearing this under makeup I would have to use a moisturizer too. I also love the fact that you can buy refills for this to save on packaging. I wish more companies did that. Really the only thing I don’t like about this product is how heavily scented it is. It is very strong and over the top in my opinion, and fragrances are known to be problematic for sensitive skin. Because of the scent, and because of the high price point, I probably won’t purchase this in the future. I will continue using my bottle, though, to see if I notice more long-term changes in my skin. If you have the money to spend and scents don’t bother you,  I say definitely give this a try... it does make the skin look beautiful.

I received this from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I had actually tried this like 7 years ago as I am obsessed with all things Dior. They have apparently reformulated it since then and I like it better now. It really made my skin look smoother and brighter under my makeup but didn’t leave it greasy like it did years ago. I seem to be able to use less foundation also. I was skeptical that this would have any effect on my skin since it’s supposed to be used as the last step in morning routine but my skin is brighter and some of my acne marks have lightened. This has niacinimide as the 6th ingredient which is a proven skin brightener and I think it works. I used this for 3 weeks before reviewing. When I applied this over sunscreen I also found it got rid of that greasy sunscreen look that always makes my pores look huge.  I would purchase this again. A little goes a long way and the packaging is lovely as well.

review_title: Wow, I even went barefaced with this product!
review_text: I received my full-size bottle of Dior Dreamskin Skin Perfector to review through Influenster. I have used this product for a few weeks now and I tested it out for a few weeks on days that I went basically bare faced & with multiple types and brands of foundation. This product was great for my sensitive skin that has patches of dryness. I have redness in my T-zone and it evened my skin tone out and hydrated my skin. I am 46 year old so I was pleased that it corrected blemishes, sun spots and corrected my crows feet/wrinkles. The price point on this product isn’t cheap, but I don’t mind the price when the product actually works. I appreciate that it doesn’t take a lot of this to do the job. It’s is also pretty cool that this product is refillable I would definitely recommend this product and will be buying my own refill.

I am currently using the product as my last step to my nightly routine and will start using it as my primer before getting my makeup on. Its creamy and smooth. It also has a scent that fades away through the day. The scent isn’t bad or strong sits nothing to worry about.

I’ve used this product for the past 10 days twice a day and I can 100% say my skin loves it. It’s not sticky, makes my skin feel softer and smells amazing. I like the pore minimizing aspect and the light tint. It doubles as a makeup primer and it’s probably my favorite so far. I have combination skin and this doesn’t add any additional oil or shine. Would definitely recommend!
Love this product! It’s so smooth and goes on so soft. Works as a great primer or used alone. Doesn’t make my face oily or sticky like some primers I’ve used before.

Not sure how I feel about this product yet. I feel the label is a tad misleading but that may just be me. I was expecting more of a serum like product to be used during my skincare routine but it’s more like a makeup primer. It smells good but it feels greasy and it’s tinted. I used it after cleansing my face and I didn’t notice any improvement in the look or feel of my skin. It didn’t blur or cover up any imperfections. Mostly it just gave my skin a mild shimmery appearance.  I wouldn’t recommend if you have acne prone skin.

I have been wearing this product alone, I am an Rn and have to wear a mask all day so I haven’t been wearing makeup and wanted something to smooth out the skin. I worry a little about the fragrance in this product as it may break my skin out. So far when I apply the product it goes on smooth it has a nice texture my skin looks smoother. I can’t say it is making long lasting effect but it does slightly blur when applied. I will continue to use to see if the fragrance causes an issue.

I was given this product to test and it’s really nice! I would highly recommend using this alone in the morning or before makeup. it leaves the skin nice and smooth and lightly dewy without being overly shiny or greasy feeling. it’s perfect for the summer!

I started using Dior Dreamskin Skin Perfector about 10 days ago. The first day I used it, I loved the hydrating & silky feeling it left on my skin, although 1 experience doesn’t speak to it’s quality & performance. A couple days following, I experimented using it as a primer then as the last step in my skincare routine prior to applying makeup. I quickly learned my preference as primer would be for my no makeup days & I preferred it as the last step in my skincare routine if I would be applying makeup. Not to sound confusing but it makes a difference to me how it works best and looks best. When using as the last step in your skincare routine prior to makeup. I liked the outcome best when I made sure all previously applied skincare (including SPF) had about 3 mins to be absorbed into my skin prior to applying Dreamskin. I love it most before makeup for its blurring effect & subtle glow even under makeup. I admit I didn’t notice it until my daughter first told me how good my skin looked as well as my husband a couple days later. I’m really liking, almost loving this product although it’s too soon for me to speak to the long-term benefits to my skin. I will keep using & will purchase again if current performance continues. On the plus side, it didn’t cause me to break out. So far so great with Dior’s new Dreamskin. I’m tempted to explore more of Dior’s skincare but will wait a bit to make sure this one stays consistent. I was sent this product in a Voxbox by Influenster at no charge in exchange for my own honest thoughts & review of this product. Thank you!

I have been trying the Dior Dreamskin Perfector for a little while. It goes on smoothly and blurs the look of pores and imperfections. Makeup goes on smoothly over top, no pilling. It feels nice going on and sinks in quickly. Packaging is beautiful! I’m enjoying it so far but can’t attest to long term results. I’m happy with initial use and looking forward to using more in the future.

Absolutely love this product! I received complimentary from Influenster, but i would definitely repurchase! The texture is silky and velvety, gives skin a very nice glow whilediminishing dark spots and my melasama. The packaging is luxurious and to die for!

When I got this bottle, it felt so “extra“, however now I can’t imagine living without it! I use it as a final step in my skin care regime, and it has totally changed both my skin and makeup game. I’ve noticed more luminous, even skin, with incredible results in texture. And the best part is it doubles as a luxurious primer. My makeup goes on evenly, it blurs pores and lines and the smell is heavenly. It’s my new favorite product!

I received this product for free to try from Influenster. The first thing I noticed when I opened it was the heavy fragrance which is why I gave it 4 stars. It’s very typical of the brand so if you are used to it or like it then it may not be a problem but for me it does make it a bit unpleasant to use. I was confused at first whether this is supposed to be a skincare step or a primer but from what I can gather it can be both. Personally I feel it works better as an illuminating primer. The glow it gives is soft but still a little much to wear on its own without foundation or at least a BB/CC cream. I have dry skin and I don’t notice any moisturizing effects from it, just illumination. I do like the packaging as it has a refillable container which makes it a bit more cost effective for the consumer (not really ecological though as there is still a large amount of plastic that gets thrown away). Personally I don’t see myself using this too much because of how strong the fragrance is but if that doesn’t bother you and you are looking for a high end illuminating primer then this isn’t bad one.

This product is AMAZING. I know its expensive but man.... it’s something I dont want at this point. I NEED it. I go in spurts of how heavy I want my makeup to be. I use this as a primer every day and I’ve been finding myself wanting to just use this instead of foundation. It makes my skin so beautiful. Its lightweight. It has a light scent which i dont mind but some people might. It blurs and hydrates. My skin looks amazing with this on. It’s a light liquidy substance that soaks into the skin nicely and quickly. I highly recommend. I wont be without it now.

I want to thank Influenster for picking me as a candidate for this campaign! I never knew I needed this baby in my skincare routine! I’m 4 months away from turning the big 3 0 & I’m going to be honest.. I AINT READY FAM! I’m on week 3 & I hardly even see any wrinkles!! I’m SHOOK! The texture ain’t super slimey nor does it clog my pores. The smell is light & not overwhelming. I’m beyond impressed & I’m going to purchase one for my Momma!! Dreamskin Skin Perfector is a must for my beauty babes! I put it as a primer or by itself. Get this it’s worth every penny!!

From the first use I began to notice a beautiful softness on my skin, but as I spent the days using the product without a doubt my skin looked much better.  a more beautiful skin and with the makeup it was like a mixture that goes well makes the makeup an incredible combination

The results speak for themselves. So much so that I can look past the strong scent. After a week this product has faded minor sunspots and given my skin an even tone. This product goes on smooth. Remember a little goes a long way - usually I don’t need a full pump to have coverage for my entire face. The only reason it isn’t 5 stars for me is the strong scent. If I don’t put this on as soon as I wash my face and give it time for the scent to fade, it doesn’t mix well with my usual perfume scent. I also noticed if I don’t go light in application then I have slight breakouts.

review_title: Dream Skin Primer gives you dreamy skin!
review_text: I’ve been using this amazing primer for a few weeks now, & I’m loving how it makes my skin feel. It is extremely gentle, smells great, and feels like velvet on your skin. It does not clump up with your makeup and provides adequate coverage for pore minimization even with just a couple pumps. It is a little pricier compared to most primers, but I would say it’s worth the investment since the quality is more result-driven.

This product could not be better! There’s literally no way it could ever improve because it works PERFECTLY! I noticed a difference after the very first use (something that can’t honestly be said about the majority of products). It plumps and softens your skin, making it look and feel almost baby like. It has a nice light fragrance that isn’t too much. It doesn’t make me break out or cause irritation of any kind.

review_title: This pale pink bottle of goodness is a win!
review_text: Where has this pale pink bottle of goodness been all my life? I’m loving this!!The Perfect Skin Creator means business because, well, just look at its product name. True to its title, the product boasts a wealth of benefits. In addition to minimizing wrinkles, pores and spots, it also combats redness and dull complexion. The silky formula produces a “soft-focus” effect that basically gives my skin the impression of an airbrush finish. I found that despite its lightweight composition (which smells subtly floral, by the way, but notoverpowering at all in case you’re wary), the product actually provides delicately balanced medium coverage. Not only that, but it creates an incredibly glow that is perfect for any look. I’ve been using the new Dreamskin for 10 days now and, I’m truly noticing  a difference in my skin. Here are a few reasons why I am loving this product: * Moisturizing; even more so than the old formula if you’ve used this product in the past. * Feels velvety and makes my skin smooth, which is why it’s also great as primer.* Removes redness and blemishes (quicker than when I still had vitamin C in my routine).* Minimizes the appearance of my pores. * Gives a natural radiance that addresses my dull complexionI can’t wait to see how my skin looks after finishing this bottle. One thing I left out in my review is that this bottle is refillable. Love being able to refill my products. So glad Dior is doing this. Lastly,   I received this product for free for my honest and unbiased review.

I received this item for free in exchange for a review. I absolutely love how my face looks and feels when I use this product! Whenever I use it, I don’t even feel like putting foundation on, because my skin looks so good! The only reason I give it a 4 star is because the perfume smell. It’s not too strong, but you can tell it’s there. So, keep that in mind if you are sensitive to that. Other than that, this product is impeccable.

I recently received this product from Influenster for review, I have had this for about 3 weeks now and have tryed this under my makeup and without makeup, as my final step in my skincare routine. Something I noticed immediately was that there was not much of a scent with this which I really appreciate, most higher end skin care products seem to always have slot of frangance and this did not. I enjoyed using this as a primer before makeup and it gave my skin a healthy glow from within nothing shimmery or glittery and after using for a few days I did notice that my skin seemed to look more naturally glowy hours after I had applied any type of product. I can’t say if this really made much of a difference with fine lines since I would have to use It for a longer period of time which I do plan on doing Its a really nice product and I’m so happy I received it.

I like this product, but I feel like it needs to be marketed better. The bottle or box does not say what this product really is. It seems like skincare, but after googling, it’s actually more like a primer. If it was described more clearly I would rate it higher.All that being said, I do like this as a primer. I have redness in my face and this easily calmed that better than any of the color correcting primers I use. My face feels smooth after applying. The price point seems pretty steep. I like that the packaging is reusable and you can just buy refills. I’ll probably repurchase just because I struggle so much to cover redness and this really worked for me.

review_title: Dewy, smooth finish, high price point
review_text: So I really like this product. It applies really well and evenly, no clumping. It leaves a really dewy, beautiful finish and your skin feels so moisturized. As a primer I think it does the job but I do prefer it alone because it does even out your skin tone and perfect it! However I think this price point is a bit high for what it is and I think there are more affordable options for the same product.

review_title: Decent primer, but not worth the $
review_text: I received Dior Dreamskin complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I received the 1.6 oz bottle which retails for $120. The first thing that made an impression on me was the beautiful packaging. It comes in a pretty light pink and silver refillable bottle. The next thing I noticed was its smell. It has a light fragrance but it reminded me of an older lady’s perfume. I didn’t care for it. As far as the application, it went on smoothly and I felt like it hydrated my skin. It blurred all my imperfections and helped my tinted moisturizer and foundation to go on smoothly. I’ve only used it for a week so I can’t really tell if it reduces fine lines over time or reduced my dark spots. So far it hasn’t. Although it did a nice job as a primer, there are many other primers out there that do the same job for a fraction of the cost. I do not feel like this is worth the price tag and I will not be repurchasing this product. Thanks for the opportunity Influenster and Dior!

Been using this under my makeup after washing my face. It does have a heavy perfumed scent that goes away after application. It seems watery after you pump it out (it is tinted) but once you apply it on the skin, it feels like thick silicone but then it sinks in thin and nicely. It’s hard to describe it, but it makes your skin feel very moisturized. I haven’t noticed any dark spots fading or brightening yet. Makeup base after this looks very smooth and blurred. If it wasn’t for the heavy perfumed Dior scent, I would purchase this definitely.

Product is beautiful, silky and luxurious! If you have dry and dull skin then I would really recommend this.. if you have oily skin then I would probably stay away from it, it feels almost like a primer and seems like it might trap sebum in the skin. There is a fragrance but it’s faint and smells good

I’ve been using this product for a week today. I received the product as a sample to try via Influenster. My before and after photos do show a slight difference in my pores and the “beauty” of my skin. I’m excited to see what the difference will be after using the complete bottle and will decide from that point if it’s worth purchasing another! Overall the product to me seems worth the cost, it has become a part of my nightly face routine. Smell isn’t my favorite BUT is not overbearing or “bad”... doesn’t leave my face feeling oily but instead smooth and soft.

I tried Care and Protect for 7 days. I noticed immediate results. It blurred and soften my skin, as well as leaving a soft smooth finish. My t zone stayed matte ALL DAY. I applied on its own after cleansing my face, but this would also be an awesome primer! I personally like the smell. It is easy to apply and dispensing the product from the bottle is easy and controlled as well. It did not irritate my skin or acne. I think it actually helped clear up my skin a bit! My only issue is cost, but it’s good a few pumps go a long way.

I received a This from Influenster for reviewing purposes. What I love most about Dior DreamSkin is that it’s basically a hybrid between skincare and a makeup primer. It has the benefits of skincare and gives makeup a flawless application while making my makeup look flawless and it also wears longer ask well. It gives the skin an “airbrushed” look and plumps fine lines and wrinkles. Most primers make my already dehydrated skin feel drier and/tight but this one doesn’t. The packaging is beautiful, as always when it comes Dior. I think they did a beautiful job on this product. And even though it’s a little pricey, I think this bottle will last me quite a while so the price is justified because the performance is great!

I tried this moisturizer for a week. It does help hydrate your skin. It is refillable, so that’s a plus. It’s thick and I felt I needed more to cover my face than some other moisturizer s. It does have a fragrance which I don’t care for in skin care products. It’s not a terrible scent and does dissipate but if you are sensitive to fragrances, you may not like this product. I have normal-dry, mature skin. I don’t typically break out but I did have a few blemishes with this product.

This is an amazing moisturizer. My skin felt soft and silky smooth after a single use. There weren’t any visible benifits until about a week after i started using it. After a week my skin looked noticibly more hydrated and some of my summer skin damage was starting to fade. While it has the same scent i associate with almost all french skin care the scent was light and not overly floral. I love that i can get a refill with less waste and when i do finish this i will be getting a refill
This product is so nice! This leaves your skin feeling soft and refreshed. Has a great scent and a little goes a long way.

This moisturizer is meant to be the last layer of your skincare before makeup and it provides a very luxurious experience as a primer. I notice, upon immediate application, it smooths over my skin providing a soft blurring effect with a natural skin finish. As a primer it provides a layer of smooth protection for your skin, but it does not absorb into your skin. It lives up to the name of “Care and Perfect“ because it provides skin softening and perfecting while acting as a barrier to protecting your skin from any damage your makeup could be causing (or other environmental damage). The product is a light milky consistancy, smells great and has a silky feeling on the skin but doesn’t cause my makeup to slide around. I would repurchase this product and I recommend this product for any skin type that is looking for a smoothing and skin protecting makeup primer. I received this product complimentary to test and review from Influencer and Dior but this review is my personal opinion.

I received this full size Dior Capture Totale Dream skin - care and perfect skincare from Influenster to try and review at no cost to me!  All I can say is wow!  Dream skin is right!  ❤️ I have used this everyday for two weeks now.  My skin looks refreshed, dewy,  softens the appearance of my fine lines.  I have been applying a small amount on my clean skin morning and night.  I typically don’t wear a ton of makeup this gives me that no makeup, makeup look! I am 48 years old with sensitive, breakout prone, aging and Rosacea flare up kinda of woman.  So far I have had no issues.  The smell is light and wonderful.   Some scents irritate me, especially when applying before bed.  This scent did not cause any irritation.  My personal favorite thing about this product is that my skin seems incredibly DEWY!  But also soft focused, I look several years younger!  Even my husband noticed a difference.  Highly recommended!

I have received my product thanks to Dior and influenster, I have used it and the first thing I appreciate is the delicate aroma, when applying it I felt my skin silky and smooth, it absorbs quickly, incredible product, it will definitely continue in my beauty routine

review_title: Exactly what you're missing in your makeup routine
review_text: What an amazing product. I recieved Dior’s Dream Skin Care & Perfect for free in exchange for my fair and honest review. I am so in love with this product. Before using I read a couple of different reviews online and wanted to know how other women were using it. You can use it by itself as a moisturizer. It’s advised to use it twice daily for maximum benefits. You can also use it before applying primer as an addition to your makeup routine. With everything going on and since my lower face makeup is pretty much removed from a mask, I’ve been skipping the foundation and just using this moisturizer instead. My face looks so bright and rejuvenated. My skin has honestly never looked better. It has a beautiful luminess, flawless appearance. I’ve been searching for a product like this one for so long.

I love Dior products! They make your skin so smooth. Never oily, and they absorb into the skin quickly. I can always see a difference in my skin after only just 1 week of use. My skin is bright and smooth, wrinkles minimize, dull skin is bright and revived. I can’t say enough about how wonderful this product is. I feel so youthful and refreshed. I put mine on right before bed and sleep so when I wake up I get the ultimate results.

Super cute packaging that looks really luxurious on your vanity. If you have normal to oily skin this is probably moisturizing enough for you, but since I’m on the dry side I use a moisturizer as well. Definitely notice my foundation applying more smoothly and it blurs some of my dark spots allowing them to be covered more easily. On days I don’t wear makeup, it makes my skin look more soft and velvety. The only con to me is the fragrance. While I didn’t personally have a reaction, I know some people are sensitive. The scent doesn’t stick to the skin, and I can’t smell it while on.

review_title: Great addition to my skincare routine
review_text: I used this product over the last few days and it made my skin feel soft and hydrated. I have dark spots and some dryness in my T zone area and it helped improve both of those problems. It really helped keep my skin moisturized all day. I don’t wear make-up, so this was the last step in my skin care routine after cleansing and using a toner and moisturizer. I think with prolonged use I will see even better results. I did receive a complimentary product to test and offer an honest review.

I got this product in a VoxBox for me to review and have been using it for a few days now. This is my first time using a product from Dior, and I had high expectations. It did not live up to my expectations at all.. the product feels nice but it is basically a primer and I would not reccomend using this for skincare/moisturizer. It has an extremely strong perfume scent and it does not go away after application. I also did not know until after using this product that it has Niacinamide in it, which I prefer not to use because my skin has been sensitive to in the past. It actually made my skin feel tighter after use, not moisturized. I think this is a very good primer, does a good job of blurring and smoothing the skin, however the scent is a deal breaker, it smells expensive however I would appreciate a non scented version. I am very happy to have had the opportunity to give this product a try, however I will not be purchasing in the future, especially since the price point is over $100.

Omg! I am in LOVE with this product! The first thing I noticed is that is absolutely smells so freaking Amazing, It makes me want to rub it all over. It makes my skin feel so soft and smooth and works wonderful as a primer used before your foundation and also works well when used alone. HIGHLY Recommend! It is a little pricey but it’s not more than what I’d expect to pay for a Dior product. I feel so lucky to have received this to test and try out. Even though I didnt purchase this myself, my opinions are my own and are honest and will definitely purchase this when I run out!
This felt nice on the skin but it was so heavily fragranced that I get worried about it on the long term aspect. Otherwise it’s nice but is very pricey.

This product was nice. When applied it worked into my skin quickly. Did not sit on top or leave any weird film. It has a light fragrance that dissipated as soon as it was applied. I wouldn’t say it left any luminosity, but it appeared to leave my skin looking softly blurred. Since the pandemic started, I’ve resorted to wearing little to no face makeup. So I can not tell the wear with foundation on, but can definitely wear by itself. As for long term benefits, I can not tell; I have only used this product for a few days. Price point wise , it seems to be expensive for what it does. Although, if this product does work as a skin care product and helps improve the appearance, it might be worth the price. I did receive this product complimentary to test.

Im in love with this product, Dior Dream Skin is AWESOME! I only using this for a weeks, but I can notice the difference already. It makes your skin feel soft and smooth. Definitely recommend. #influenster #dior #complimentary @influenster @dior

I’m definitely making this a part of my skin routine from now on! It felt so luxurious on my skin and immediately made my skin feel smooth, hydrated and alive. I used this as a primer and my makeup went on flawlessly, it even smoothed out my fine lines. I have combination skin that can tolerate oils without breaking out so I love to hydrate my skin with products that last. This product is slightly greasy when applying so it was perfect for me. I find that if I apply oils to my skin it not only preventsy drier areas from drying out but it also stops my skin producing excess oil. If this isn’t how your skin works then this may not be the right product for you but if it is give this a try because it’s an amazing product. As with most Dior skincare this does have a fresh scent to it so those with very sensitive skin may want to test this in store before buying.

First off, this is a beautifully packaged product. I wasn’t sure if it was for morning or night but after using it I think it’s better for morning routine. It’s a pretty thin texture and absorbs quickly. I was surprised by how smooth my face felt after. It is great for a primer before foundation or sunscreen.

I received this as complimentary for testing. I am not a fan of the scent,  It is very strong and perfumy. But other than that I really enjoyed this product. I used at morning and night. It works great under make up. It made my skin Glowy without adding shimmer or glitter. I was very please with how this feels on my skin.

review_title: Feels amazing, my bank account hates it
review_text: I received this size primer from Influenster for free in exchange for an honest review.Im in my mid thirties with cystic acne prone skin. Im well aware cystic acne is hormonal but the level of fragrance in this product is not something I would use during an active breakout for fear of irritation. I started using this product right away and its a lotion type texture which does absorb beautifully and make makeup application flawless so while I will absolutely work this into my daily routine (unless im nursing a breakout) the price point is jaw dropping.
I’m obsessed with this stuff. It smells incredible, feels super light on the skin and shows why expensive skincare is a must.

This product is hands down amazing. The packaging is awesome, the quality of the product is smooth, and the scent is amazing. I will be purchasing this again in the future because I have yet to be disappointed by a Dior product. The texture is light, but yet the coverage is amazing. I received this product “complimentary” for testing purposes through Influenster :)

The container is gorgeous.  The product smells wonderful!  It is a very light fragrance,  not at all heavy. The texture is light and absorbs quickly.  I could feel a difference in the texture of my skin right away.

I typically use very little primer since I don’t wear a ton of foundation but I love this Dior Dreamskin primer because it also perfects my skin! It works well as a primer and as a nice base for my nighttime skincare routine. The packaging is elegant and gorgeous which is to b expected from Dior. I absolutely love how dewy and fresh my face looks after applying. Only one pump is required for full coverage which makes the value of the product the best part! It smells so pleasant and I’ve seen the smile lines start to lessen already. My dark spots have started lightening up and my skin is feeling smoother than ever. I am now absolutely obsessed with Dior skincare and plan to be purchasing more! Could not recommend this product enough, Dior has another winner here!

This skin perfector by Dior is amazing. It makes my skin feel so smooth and does not makeup my makeup look cakey or peel up. I am obsessed with this product. THe price might be a little steep for some people but it is definitely worth it. To me at least. I have combo skin but I feel this would work for just about any skin type. if your looking for a new skin perfector/primer I would say give it a try! Thank you Influenster for sending me this amazing product for my honest review!

There are tons of people who write reviews on their “holy grail” products whether it be makeup or skin care and I have yet to try or come across such a product for me, until now. I’m a skin care junkie who’s suffered from acne, acne scarring, and huge enlarged pores. I’ve tried every mask/serum/peel/treatment on the market in an attempt to correct these issues; while I very much enjoy wearing a full face of makeup, there are days when I want to go bare faced or wear light/sheer coverage and still feel confident, which I haven’t been able to do until I tried this product. This doubles as a skin care item and a makeup primer which shrinks my pores and reveals a flawless makeup application, but also allows me to use it on its own without a full beat and still glow. 10/10 would recommend. Is the price point a bit high? Yes. BUT, 1) it’s Dior, so what did you expect? And 2) you definitely get what you pay for with this product. There are so many beauty brands that jack up the price of the product because of the name, packaging, etc. and because they know people will buy it, yet the product doesn’t deliver results. I can honestly say that is not the case here. I have no problem spending the money on something if I know it’s going to work, and this product is definitely an investment but it exceeds expectations. I look like I’m wearing an Instagram filter. Cannot live without!!

This stuff is like crack for your face!!! oh my, yes its expensive but you will not be disappointed!! I go to wk at 4:30 am so I don’t have time to do full face I slap this on and add lipstick, BAM! DONE!! everyone asks me what is different about my face, like did I switch makeup. Skin is baby butt smooth and evens out your skin tones. LOVE IT!

I love this product!! I use it as primer and sometimes I use this as a light moisturizer, I use capture total creme and the lift sculptor serum that matches the moisturizer as well and it’s a great triple threat combo.
I love this product! It makes your skin so luminous and smooth, it looks as if you’ve already applied foundation and highlighter! It comes at a steep price, but definitely worth it!

It goes on nicely but then pills up under any foundation, I feel like my skin is peeling off after a few days in the sun. Gathers in pores and needs to be smoothed out, brushed off after makeup application. For the price and performance it’s disappointing.

Love this product and I mean Love!Smooths our my poores, gives a glow.   I have had so many compliments about my skin.  The only negative thing is that it’s pricey , I also found that my t zone gets a bit greasy so I just avoid applying that area.  I love this product and would be nice if they sold a travel size also.

I’m 48 and I thought I had pretty good skin for my age -- and I do.  I had no idea however, how much better it could be.  I got a sample of this and started using it around my eyes and nose and mouth.  Immediately I could see fine lines were softened, and skin was smoothed, and the texture was evened out a bit.  Then over time I started using it all over the face and I saw changes in brightness, evenness, and along with the other changes I mentioned before.  With continued use I was excited that my skin was looking better and better.  In fact because it has a slight tint to it, I found I could just wear it and nothing else on my “off work“ days.  It is creamy but light.  It has a delicate fragrance that doesn’t linger.  It is not greasy at all, and it leaves the skin  moisturized but not tacky.  Pop on some eyebrows and mascara and you are good to go.  I’m hoping that Sephora will start carrying the foundation!

I will always have this mask in stock! I have bad, hormonal acne flare ups & this mask keeps those breakouts at bay. Look forward to using this mask every week.

Probably the best mask I’ve ever tried. You see immediate results. Smooths out my skin, definitely gets rid of surface gunk and helps with pimples over time too. It’s a steep price but so so worth the investment. Fair warning tho, kinda smelly.

review_title: Good product but recently watered down
review_text: This product is effective, in that it noticeably exfoliates the skin such that it is smoother and glows the next day. Importantly, it doesn’t irritate my highly sensitive skin (and basically everything irritates my skin). However, over the past year or so, the company has started to water down the products -- I guess to save money. This makes the product extremely runny and difficult to apply without spilling it all over the sink counter. Not to mention the fact that the little spatula they include for scooping is rendered completely useless. Just charge us slightly more for the real product, rather than forcing us to use an inferior product. Very disappointing.
Love this product. It smoothed over all my redness and acne and really cleaned out my skin to make it look a lot less res.

I was looking for something to refresh my skin. Unfortunately, I am not a fan of the smell or consistency. It didn’t make me break out, and immediately after my skin feels clean, so I will give this a 2.

I received a sample pack ,I had enough to use for two days and while the smell is not flowery or very nice smelling I found the product did work for me .After a minute I can’t really even smell it anymore but I only had mine on for five minutes due to my skin sensitivity. It made my skin feel smooth and I will be buying a full size

I’ve been using it since the beginning of June.

review_title: Color change is normal!!!  Stop throwing it away!
review_text: I love this mask!  My mask did turn green, but this is normal and the product is still effective.  It even states this in their website.  “Mask may be dark blue to missy green in color, a change in color does not effect the efficacy of the product”.  I can attest to this as my mask arrived a nice blue, then changed to missy green.  I still used it (it’s expensive!), it worked perfectly and I had no adverse reaction.  People, you’re throwing away an amazing $50 mask for no reason.  If you still don’t trust it, do a patch test, which you should do anyway.That being said, it’s not worth the price.  I get a custom formulated prescription trentinoin from Curology for $19.95 per month. I have mature, acne prone skin, so my custom formula is Retin A, clindamycin (antibiotic) and azelaic acid.  This product has been a game changer.  No more breakouts, my lines are lessening and my pores are clean and have reduced in size.  Spend your money on Curology instead!

My skin is very acne-prone, and this mask has not only kept my new acne to a minimum but has also helped smoothen out my skin and brighten some of my pigment scarring from past acne. Although the smell might take some getting used to, this is the only mask I am using at the moment and am not regretting it one bit! I have been using this mask for four nights in a row and with typically sensitive skin that reacts easily to products, I can leave this mask on for 20 minutes with no bad reactions. So if you have sensitive, combination, and/or acne-prone skin, I highly recommend the spend!

I’ve heard such good things about this product so I really wanted to try it. However, it stung, made my skin red, made me break out and dried out my skin. I’m sure this works better for other people but it just wasn’t for me.

I took a look in two boxes as i was going to purchase, and they were also green! For reference, i have used this product before and loved it, so i know what the consistency and colour should look like!  There are no preservatives in this mask, therefore the shelf life isn’t as long as other products. My concern is that maybe Sephora has too many old blue Tansy masks in inventory that they are trying to offload. Fantastic mask for congested acne prone skin. Hoping Sephora is able to resolve this apparent issue soon!
