I was very cautious about this product, but i put it on my face, then washed an oohh, how lovely my skin was, even for oily skin it feels so gooood. it has a little bit tingle but that’s fine, I have sensitive oily skin and for me worked perfect!. minus one point for price :( I wish i could buy it, but for now, zero chances.  :( therefore, love it!!

review_title: best mask for red, sensitive, acne prone skin
review_text: if you are looking for a mask to gently exfoliate, completely clear up breakouts and help with redness and texture, DO NOT HESITATE TO BUY THIS. you only need a very small amount so this jar will last a long time. after having second degree burns on my entire face about a year ago, my skin has become EXTREMELY sensitive. it breaks out from any little thing, and nothing could ever make them go away. i was already acne prone before the burns, but it’s amped up significantly following. i’ve used this mask 3-4 times and my skin is almost 100% clear. i have 2-3 blemishes left on my entire face and i’d definitely say it’s my skin purging from the mask pulling everything out of my pores. it is very tingly/cool on my skin, but does not have a burning feeling. i’ve been using this mask paired with the Lapis oil, rose+witch hazel toner from boscia and some different products from the ordinary. i have never gotten so many compliments on my skin before. i have hardly even been wearing foundation. do your skin a favor and BUY THIS MASK.

I wanted to love this mask. I really did. I read all the amazing reviews, loved the herbivore backstory. But as soon as I opened the jar, I dry heaved. I have never smelled something so strange, probably ever. Nevertheless, she persisted - I put the goop on my face (holding my breath the entire time). I waited the allotted 20 minutes and washed it off. My skin felt soft, but it was only my first time using the mask. Two days later I went to put it on again, but as soon as I unscrewed the cap, I wanted to vomit once more. It smells like rotten spearmint, if that makes any sense. I have never had such a visceral reaction to a smell, especially in a cosmetic/skin product. I couldn’t bring myself to use this mask again, so, sadly, it had to be returned. So, I haven’t been able to see if this delivered on skincare results. Since then, I’ve read other reviews and everyone mentions the smell being earthy and fresh and clean. I’m wondering if maybe I got a bad jar? Unfortunate, but for the best. Now i am phantom smelling blue tansy mask...
This mask is my secret to clear skin. I use this once or twice a week and constantly am getting compliments on how clear my skin is. A must for anyone with combo/oily skin.
Good face gel mask. Help reduslce redness and clean skin.

After reading all of the great reviews about this product, I was extremely excited to try it. However, it did absolutely nothing to my skin. I continued to use it in hopes of seeing results but after finishing the product completely, I was left super disappointed. Will not be repurchasing
I cannot live without this mask!!!! It has cleared my blemishes completely and makes my skin look flawless!!!!

I wa really excited to try this product because I heard so many good things about it. However, I’ve been using it for a few weeks now and I’m not noticing any improvements in my skin. It might work for some people but I will not be repurchasing this product.

The best mask I have ever used.  I followed the recommendation and used it once a day for the first 4 days and the once a week for a few weeks now. It has made my skin smooth and clear.  Hands down the best results I have had from any mask.  It does what it says it’s going to.

I love the smell and feel of this mask on the skin. It feels cold when you apply it but I actually love that! A lot of people have complained about the smell but personally, I love it! It smells like candy or something. I found that this helped my active pimples to shrink and go away much faster! It isn’t uncomfortable on the skin and doesn’t burn, it’s soothing. Overall, I actually enjoy this mask and found that it helps clear my skin. I will repurchase!

I absolutely LOVE this mask!!!! I do it at night so my skin isn’t sensitized in the am. I have bad hormonal acne and redness. I did the 5 days in a row and WOW!!!!!! My skin pinks a little when I put it on but when I wash it off and wake up the next morning holy crap my acne is calm and the size of my acne are reduced and my face is GLOWING!!!!!! You don’t need much at all either!!!!!! Will definitely purchase again

I’ve tried this out for a month now, about once or twice a week. The first time, I rinsed it off with warm water and didn’t notice any results. I really recommend adhering to their advice suggesting that you should wipe it off with a wet wash cloth. I think leaving a little on your skin will help the product work on it for longer. I don’t find that it helped with any existing breakouts or prevented any others, but eventually it does help make the rest of my skin feel fairly smooth and seems to be helping with my PIH marks.

Seriously beyond amazing! I love the smell somewhat sweet earthy smell ! I have combo sensitive skin that can also be dry but oily a weird combo depending on the weathers. I’m medium skintone so I can blemishes can leave dark spots at times . This work no matter what’s going on with my skin . It exfoliates but gently leaving me super smooth. I recommend after silly finishing with a the lapis or Phoenix oil .. then a moisturizer to put some moisture back into the face. I use this 1 to two times a week especially after a week of heavy makeup wear! You won’t be disappointed!!

I LOVE this mask. I used it for the first time this morning. My skin is pretty sensitive so I removed it after slightly less than 20 mins. My skin was instantly smoother and more glowy! I have some larger pores around my nose and cheek area that had significantly minimized. This product is magic. I’m obsessed!
Amazing. WATCH OUT, it is still an EXFOLIATOR. Repeated use more than just once every other week WILL PREMATURELY AGE YOUR SKIN. Be careful and be gentle.

Stop reading and buy this. I’ve tried a lot of masks. I have skin that is sensitive (I react to strong things and get red very easily), but also combination (oily in the t-zone, but can be parched on my cheeks and even on my forehead sometimes) and also suffering from 30’s acne (particularly on the chin through nose areas). This really works. If you think you might benefit from a little bit of a ’peel’ sort of thing, try this first. Even with sensitive skin, I don’t get that horrible burning feeling that a lot of ’resurfacing’ products give me. At the same time, it seriously works. Put on a thin layer, let it stay on until it dries, and then take it off with a wet cloth. Follow it with something moisturizing if you are dry.

This is a great mask for sensitive skin - I leave it on between 10-15 minutes depending on how fast it dries. The results are obvious. This is one of the first face masks that didnt make me super splotchy and irritate my skin.

I have porcelain, acne prone sensitive skin. I haven’t used this product enough to get the full effect, but from the first use my skin looked brighter. The mask itself is very thin and a little goes a looong way! People who complain about the smell are obviously ignorant, the smell isn’t overpowering or overwhelming. Overall, great first impression and I can’t wait to see results in a couple weeks.

review_title: Thank you for clearing my acne!
review_text: This really helped to calm down my acne big time. About 15 minutes after applying the mask, I already notice the red inflammation and the acne bump decreasing. There is no burn, tingling or skin peeling. I often leave this one as an overnight mask. I used this mask almost on a daily basis and it lasted for over 6 weeks. An absolute life-saver for acne prone skin. I am re-purchasing this product.

I love the smell of this product! I know some have said it’s off putting but I love the herbaceous smell. It makes your skin feel super smooth and helps with some break outs. It is a bit smaller than I was expecting too. I didn’t give this 5 Stars because I’ve noticed after the first few uses I don’t notice a difference afterwards with helping clear up my breakouts. But it is nice and cooling/refreshing so I will keep this and use till it’s finished. I don’t think (as of writing this) that I will repurchase but will update if I do.

I didn’t see any difference until i started using this daily. i have combo skin and moderate to severe acne. after using this 3 days in a row i can finally see a big difference on my skin. It doesn’t dry my skin out either.

I love this mask! While it doesn’t give instant results, like some people have had, I noticed a little difference after each time I used it. It has started to even out my skin tone and kept away those annoying under the skin blemishes. So excited to see further results! The best part is the mask doesn’t burn; it feels nice on my face. I highly recommend for anyone with congested skin.

Honestly, I’ve always felt like masks make seem to make my skin nice but ultimately lead to me breaking out eventually, and so for years I would try different masks, and then stop. When I tried this mask, my skin looked brighter, and clearing up my blemishes. I love it. I’ve been using it for about a week now, and I’m so glad to have finally found a product that works for me. I’m looking forward to having clearer, brighter skin, and this will definitely become a staple in my skin care routine.The smell is strong when you open the container, but it does not actually smell that strong when applied to your face. I make sure to apply my serum right after before applying my eye cream and moisturizers.

I originally received this in a sephora play box, and it’s been life changing. I’ve always had acne since I was young, starting around 12/13, some of it cystic. I’m now in my mid 30s and still get it, though not as bad. Since I started using this 2-3 times a week, it’s been life changing. I feel so much more confident in my skin, and while I do still have some acne, the ones I do get are much smaller, less painful and go away much faster without scarring. I couldn’t do without this product!
Overrated. I think people get overly excited bc it’s organic but it’s not that great.
seemed to tint my skin blue and I saw no difference in my skin. The odour didn’t bother me.

review_title: Calms down my complexion and clears redness!
review_text: When I was a Sephora Play! subscriber I got this in one of my boxes back in fall of 2017. I really wasn’t expecting much, but I ended up absolutely loving it and used up the entire little jar. Then I bought the full version because this is my new favorite mask. I feel like every time I use this it helps so much with my acne. It calms down the redness on my face (because I have red cheeks with acne scars) and overall makes my complexion look so much better. I am acne prone and I definitely feel like it helps when I have breakouts. I use it a few times a week but wouldn’t mind using it more. Some people either love the smell or hate it. I really really like the earthy herby smell but my husband absolutely hates it. Hah, it’s great when I want him to leave me alone. :)

I use this in combination with the lapis oil and really like the changes I’ve seen in my skin. I didn’t give it five stars because it is hard to remove unless you use a brush or cloth. When I only use water it’s pretty stubborn and takes a lot of scrubbing. There is some tingle but nothing like burning. I don’t love the smell but don’t find it unpleasant. I’ve overall noticed clearer, smoother skin after using it as directed (every other day for first week and then 2-3 times per week).
This mask is well worth the price! It not only helped clear my blemishes, but left my skin feeling smooth and feeling great. I do recommend using it with the Lapis oil for the full effect.

Received a large sample of this. Used it a few times and threw away the rest so as not to waste space in my cabinet. This didn’t do much for me and I didn’t really care for the smell and texture. It is gentle - but that’s also because it’s not effective. When I spend time with a mask on my face - it better do something. This so underwhelming.
Amazing !!!! It is worth the money

I decided to wait a month and a half before I reviewed this mask because I wanted to give it a fair shot. To be honest, at first it wasn’t really doing much for me. After hearing such great things, I was a little disappointed and a little skeptical. Then about 2 weeks into using it, I broke out with some hormonal cystic acne. I used this mask in tandem with the Ordinary’s salicylic acid treatment and it was the fastest I’ve ever seen a cyst disappear. I was “lucky“ enough (trying to see the silver lining here) to break out with another cyst the following week, and rather than using my blue tansy/ordinary combo, I used Glossier’s Solution and it did Nothing to clear my cyst. It felt like it was just sitting there on my face-- no improvement whatsoever until I gave in and tried my blue tansy/ordinary combo one night. The next morning I woke up and it looked so much better. Not gone, by any means, but vastly improved, smaller in size, and less red. In general I find that it gives me a nice glow and makes my skin feel soft.I’m sold. Will definitely repurchase.

Typically I have oily/combo skin, but lately I have been having extremely horrible breakouts as well as a lot of redness. I heard this was good to reduce breakouts as well as calm the skin so I tried this out. Here are my thoughts: 1. Love the smell (smells like blueberries to me) 2. Gave my skin a cooling sensation while it was on. 3. Calmed my skin (reduced redness, breakouts were slightly less irritated and did not dry out my skin). The only downside I see is that since this mask is pretty much all natural it does tend to expire quite quickly. I will say it does start turning a sort of greenish color after a few weeks upon opening. I am not sure if that is just because it is exposed to oxygen or what. However, I have continued to use it and it works just the same. Just something to keep in mind. Also since it does not last as long as other face masks that are not all natural, it is quite pricey in my opinion. I wish they would sell a mini sized.
Used this for clogged pores and oily skin. Very clarifying and very nice.
I’ve used this prob 10 times and have only used 1/4 of a jar. It helps with softening and making my skin more radiant. I use it twice a week and really am happy with it.
This mask is awesome! It’s powerful, gentle, and smells great. It really helped clear up a patch of bumpy/rough skin on my chin.

I never write reviews but this mask deserves one! Everything this mask states it will do it does! I have combo/oily tzone midday and have been slowly transitioning to cleaner products. I have fairly clear skin and don’t typically experience breakouts, however I do have a dullness to my skin and my forehead has under the skin little bumps and cheeks have slightly larger pores. This mask clears my pores, my skin is more even toned, radiant and clear. This is comparable to drunk elephants Sukari facial, yet this one is hands down better and cheaper!

This product, plus the lapis oil, are probably the BEST two skin care items I have ever purchased in my lifetime. I’ve been using these products for about two months, and I have seen some dramatic improvements on my skin. I have acne prone, super sensitive skin, and uneven skin tone. I started using this product by recommendation from a Sephora staff member. At the time, I had a break out, and was about to go away on vacation and needed a quick fix. This mask fixed my skin in about 4 days and I was good to go for my trip! If you are trying to decide if this is worth a try or not, please pull the trigger. You won’t be disappointed! The ONLY thing I would say is that the smell is not for everyone. It’s very different. I really like the smell myself!

review_title: Get over the smell and give it a chance
review_text: After a few uses, the texture and softness of my skin has vastly improved. My skin is usually broken out in 5 spots at any given time; 4 that are small and manageable and one that is deep and painful. This, along with hydrocolloid patches for the more aggressive breakouts, are keeping my skin soft, radiant and smooth. I agree that some of these reviews seem a little too good to be true, but based on my experience I think this mask is worth it. The smell is no joke. It’s kinda earthy, kinda floral, kinda astringent. Definitely not pleasant but it does fade. This mask doesn’t give you that luxurious experience that some other masks offer - it’s no frills, straight to the point, and effective.

As much as I like this mask, I can’t get over how quickly it turns bad. There is no preservatives in this mask. This allows for bacteria to grow once you open the container. It will turn green within a month or two. If this mask came in a more hygienic container, I would be buying it again as it did do a good job for clearing up my skin.

So I use this on a daily basis and it helped me A TON with my hyperpigmentation. I wash and tone my face first and then I go ahead and use this product and leave it on for about 30 minutes. After washing it off I apply my serum and moisturizer. Once I got into the habit of using it every night, my redness gradually went away.

I really wish I could say this is my holy grail but it just isn’t for me. However, I definitely think it’s worth having on hand. There isn’t a HUGE noticeable difference in my skin, but it does help with some slight texture I experience along my jaw line. I am extremely combo skin (oily T-zone, normal cheeks) but I do tend to use this when I have breakouts just because I know it will clear out any bacteria. That being said, if you have textured skin or suffer from break outs, I think you would love this product.

I have bad texture issues on my forehead. Not scarring, just these...bumps...all over. I don’t use this stuff as often as I should, but dang! When I use it, my forehead goes from feeling like Braille to smoother than a baby’s butt! I do little extras, like lightly scrubbing my face dry after rinsing to add a sort of physical exfoliant, but ice never had skin like this! I think it’s even helping with the Mariana’s Trench sized wrinkle in my forehead, too.

I struggle with acne on my chin and when I use this mask my face is clear 3 days later. The smell doesn’t bother me too much either, it only lasts a few minutes. I would definitely recommend, I’ve repurchased twice!!

I bought this to help with my cystic acne. I didn’t notice a huge reduction in acne itself but I did notice my scars fade much faster when I use it regularly. My expectations for this may have been too high after seeing the reviews but overall I’m happy with it. I love the smell even though it’s weird and it’s also not irritating but it has a gentle burn like any good AHA product.

I have acne prone skin and I have tried many different masks. This is the first one that has really worked for me and it’s not messy like a charcoal mask is. I absolutely love the smell of it and it washes off easily. My skin always looks glowing after and if I get a bad break out I just use this mask for a few days and it clears right up. Will definitely buy again!

I received this in this month’s Playbox, and WOW! I was a bit hesitant to put this on my face because of the smell, but I’m so glad I did. I have sensitive, combination/dry, always red skin, and the benefits were instantaneous. I didn’t even recognize myself in the mirror because I’ve never seen my face that calm before. Will definitely purchase full size, this is a dream.

I wanted to love this mask due to the skin concerns it claims to address, but I honestly could not get past the HORRIBLE smell. The smell as so strong that it was actually nauseating. The results of the mask were pretty good, but I think there are other masks/treatments out there that are just as good with a much more pleasant smell!

This is one of my favorite enzyme masks.  A little goes a long way and I love the smell.  It’s a bit medicinal but that’s what I like about it.  There is sometimes a slight tingle if I’ve been being harsh to my skin, but it dissipates as it dries.  I notice very smooth and soft skin after using this. I recommend it for sure!
very nice and gentle exfoliator, soo good soo good

I like the texture of the granules in the wash, they don’t feel very rough. On the other hand I hate the strawberry smell, it smells off, that’s the best way I can put it. It also leaves behind a weird filmy feel. Ended up finishing the bottle with using it on my body instead. Would not repurchase.
smells absolutely amazing but doesn’t do a lot for my skin, it leaves my skin feeling fresh but hasn’t helped with blackheads or acne like it’s supposed too.

This smells ok but not like strawberries. The Sugar dissolves fast so it does not exfoliate. Worst of all, I developed 3-4 huge painful zits within a day of using and I never breakout. One is smack dab in the middle of my forehead. Avoid this.
I was hesitated when seeing exfoliating, as I have sensitive skin. But it is quite gentle that didn’t cause problems on my skin.

review_title: Best facewash for my neutral red skin
review_text: I love this face wash and have been using it exclusively since it came out. I use it pretty much every day. The smell is so fresh without being overpowering and has the perfect amount of exfoliating beads. it doesn’t leave my skin very dry either
I love the scent of this scrub! And like all FRESH products, it’s gentle on my temperamental skin. I pair this with the soy cleansing gel.

review_title: it’s okay, looking for a better option!
review_text: It’s okay, nothing amazing about it. Feel like it’s a really light exfoliation. Sugar melts quickly so I don’t really know if it’s exfoliating. I do get little breakout from it, could be the vitamin c. I’m Sensitive. I won’t repurchase.
Love this exfoliator! I bought this last year in September and just finished the bottle! That’s me washing my face everyday with this.
Makes my skin feel nice & clean without making my skin tight. Leaves it feeling replenished and smooth despite my textured skin

This product smells good and isn’t aggressive... However it’s not aggressive enough of a scrub for me. I feel like the scrub dissolves too fast before I’m able to actually get a good exfoliation in. Also after 3 weeks the cap wouldn’t close shut completely, then I noticed it started to leak. So now I gotta lay it on its side to avoid having having it spill everywhere.

review_title: A tasty treat for your skin!
review_text: It isn’t really a cleanser I think, it’s just a thick scrub that melts into your face and makes your skin SO SOFT. I have the mini size one, since I wanted to sample it and I use it after my normal cleanser in the morning and I gotta say it really leaves my skin feeling supple and smooth. Depending on how much you use, the sugar either melts almost instantly when rubbed on the skin or it takes a little bit to melt. The full size is expensive for a scrub, but I think the small size is great if you use it a few times a week in the morning after your normal cleanser. I also use an AHA serum during the PM a few times a week, so I also don’t use this scrub as often. I give it five stars because it really leaves your skin feeling amazing afterwards, and I kinda like the taste haha. It’s an expensive treat that is worth the money, in my opinion.
Meilleur exfoliant : l’odeur, la texture, la délicatesse, tout est parfait pour ma peau. Je suis en amour avec le parfum fruité de cet exfoliant et il laisse ma peau nette et lisse.
I have just started using this product a couple weeks ago and my skin feels so clean and smooth! I do reccomend
Love how they came out with a value size, it’s definitely worth it! A perfect gentle exfoliate!
Strawberry scent is really nice, not overpowering. Gentle on my sensitive skin. Definitely would purchase the full size.
Bought this yesterday and love it! The smell is amazing. It’s a great exfoliator yet gentle at the same time. I bought the 6 oz. tube and I know I’ll be repurchasing.
Absolutely love. Amazing smell and super gentle. Does not irritate my skin but still does the job. I love it and will buy again

review_title: Sweet addition to the summer skin care routine!
review_text: As a long-time Fresh customer, I wanted to try this sugar exfoliator for a boost to my weekly skin care during the exhausting summer season. This product has a slight grainy quality to it with a subtle sweet scent which makes the experience more enjoyable. I use this once or twice a week to not over agitate my sensitive skin especially after hours of sun exposure. The face wash gently clears the oil and redness from the skin while leaving the face feel refreshed and looking healthy. Only crit is the price.

I have been using this product for almost a year now. I was looking for a product to help brighten and tone my skin during the summer months. Highly recommend this product for someone with sensitive skin. It has become a staple in my skincare routine. SO happy it comes in a value size now (400mL I believe.)
This product gets a lot of praise but I don’t see why. I love other products from Fresh but this one was a miss for me. It didn’t improve my skin texture at all.
My favorite exfoliating face wash. My skin feels smooth and refresh
Smells sooo good! This is my favorite exfoliating face wash by far!
I absolutely adore this product, I saw a difference very quickly. My face was noticeably brighter and more clear!

What can I say I am in love with this stuff. It is reminiscent of my childhood. Reminding of the sweet smell of my strawberry shortcake dolls. I use it a couple times a week to cleanse remove dead skin as if I were a lizard. I feel just like the berry princess after use.

Fresh is a consistently quality brand, so I was so excited to try this new product. It’s fantastic and worth shelling out for the larger size. First off it smells AMAZING. It’s just like those little strawberry candies. I have sensitive combination skin, and it is super gentle and doesn’t dry you out. However, it still leaves your skin feeling smooth and soft. I love it and highly recommend.

I love the fresh soy face wash, but this wasn’t for me.  The smell was kind of weird, exfoliant beads were pretty weak and it left a sort of sticky feeling on my skin.  Just wasn’t my favorite and won’t repurchase.

I’m not one to leave a review. However, I think this product was a waste of $33 plus tax dollars. It was sticky and I did not feel like it did much for my face. I expected exfoliation from it, it ended up being pretty smooth. Bottom line the product isn’t that special and not worth the price tag.
Absolutely love this exfoliating face wash!! I have re-bought it 3 times now!! It’s great for really replenishing the skin and is very good for sensitive skin!! Cannot recommend this product enough!
This is not as scrubby as their mattifying exfoliator; definitely more gentle, but still like it.
I feel this does not work for oily skin. It is not strong enough.
my skin is dry and sensitive after one use: leaves your skin soft, smells great. definitely recommend.

I love this brand but so far this is my least favorite product I’ve tried. The sugar scrub dissolves immediately before scrubbing off much dead skin. It’s also a really thin product so I find myself using a lot of it. It works alright as a cleanser to get my makeup off but I wouldn’t necessarily recommend as an amazing exfoliant.
Love this stuff. I’m acne prone and have to be careful what I use. This is gentle and effective, totally recommend!

My friend gave me her full sized tube of this deliciousness because it was too hydrating for her oily skin.  My DRY, sensitive, eczema prone skin loves it!  I use a chemical exfoliant, so I use this once a week and after eczema flares to get rid of the visible dry flakes.  It’s very gentle, smells and tastes (lol) amazing and leaves my skin smooth, soft and very hydrated.  It’s one of the best cleansers I’ve tried.
Smell amazing, gentle with the skin. I have sensitive skin and it worked on my without being to strong. Love it.
I absolutely LOVE this face wash. It is gentle yet effective, and it smells amazing. It leaves my face glowing, smooth, and baby soft.
I actually enjoyed this. Something I noticed is if you chose to do it in the shower it’s less exfoliating compared to just wetting your face. Smells like REAL strawberries.
Not super effective as a cleanser and exfoliater. But oh my god does it smell amazing. And curiously doesn’t smell like strawberries. 3 stars for smell alone. Please use it for everything.
Smells weird, needs a large amount to actually exfoliate and my skin didn’t feel clean after using. I wouldn’t recommend.

I want to love this product but I just don’t. I was looking forward to the strawberry smell but it’s very very light. It doesn’t lather. I needed something for exfoliating so I use this alternatively with my regular cleanser and absolutely cannot use this to remove eye makeup like my ole henriksen facial cleanser, it burns my eyes so badly! Disappointed! I will use for the morning wash as an exfoliator and to make my discontinued ole cleanser last longer.

I do love this product but the smell........ it is strong and very off putting. It is a strawberry scent but it is not the smell I expected. I do love the product so I ignore the smell and it does not last. I love that it is not too harsh but works well. I find that I use a lot of the product each time but I will continue to use and consider repurchasing.

After lengthy testing, I’ve discovered this product to be responsible for the worst acne (by far) of my life. My friend literally gasped when she saw my face. I’m 23 and have never dealt with acne even remotely close to what this did. I have a theory that these exfoliating crystals are sharp, so they leave actual cuts that are more accessible to bacteria. That’s just a theory! All I know is that out of the hundreds products I’ve put on my face, this one affected my combo skin the worst and I’m throwing it away.

I loved the Peter Thomas Ross strawberry scrub so when they discontinued it, I have been on the hunt for a replacement ever since. This is definitely different than the Peter Thomas Ross one, it is more of a gel like consistency, but it performs just as well. I feel like it really does clean my face without harming it. I still use a cleanser before going in with this but more pores get clogged easily and I enjoy how this seems to be the extra step to really make my skin feel clean. I can’t say I notice a strawberry smell but as long as that is not a big deal to you, I think you’ll love this scrub.
I did not like the strong strawberry scent and felt like it left my face with a coating on it, instead of feeling exfoliated and smooth it was more slippery
Really enjoy this. Smells fabulous and gently exfoliates without drying out my skin.

It’s just ok. Doesn’t irritate my skin, and the smell is nice. I don’t think this product exfoliates at all, and I think it is worse than my other cleaners at reducing breakout potential.I am usually a huge fan of fresh products (anything moisturizing, serum, or toner), but I would not recommend this product. There are cheaper versions that are better. Try a Korean brand like skin 79.

I was so happy to see another fresh exfoliating face wash .... for 2 days.  All fave covered with small spots , not pimples but allergy like.  Strawberries ??  I never had that allergy but obviously they are not meant to go  not on the face    Horrible look.  I went back to Origins modern friction and it took me over a week to get my face back.  So disappointed and very careful with this company from now on.

I have a heck of a time with exfoliators. Too rough--I break out, too weak-I get nothing. The fact that you can adjust the texture just by adding water is wonderful. I use the Soy cleanser daily but when I feel a little rough this comes out. I have had skin struggles my whole life. I have never had this level of balance and satisfaction with my skin. Fresh has got it goin on

I absolutely love this stuff, and it’s got to be good for me to write a review.  It smells so so good and I love the gentle scrub. I look forward to using this scrub everyday. It also leaves my skin feeling soft and fresh.
Great exfoliating wash. Cleansed great without over drying.
Leaves your skin feeling very smooth and soft. Since i started using this product my breakouts have been to a minimum, and it doesn’t dry out your face.

This is my first time introducing an exfoliator into my skincare routine and this has helped with my spots, redness and just my overall complexion. 10/10 would recommend.

review_title: Does not do enough for its price
review_text: Claims to be a face wash and an exfoliator. Does a poor job at both. There are better products out there that cleanse and exfoliate your face more for much less. I would only recommend this if you want something really gentle. My face does not feel clean after I use this that I have to use a foam cleanser before and then use this after for added exfoliation. The sugar grains are also very small and they dissolve before they can even properly exfoliate you. I think you’re much better off using a chemical exfoliant like AHAs or BHAs instead of physical exfoliants like this. If you want a good sugar scrub kinda product I would recommend the moment of truth 3 in 1 sugar scrub from ole henriksen.

This face wash smells amazing and leaves your face feeling squeaky clean. It’s very gentle on my acne prone skin and have noticed a difference on the texture of my skin. So glad I got to try it out. Thanks to Influenster for sending this product complimentary.

A great exfoliating face wash! When I opened this product, I was expecting to smell strawberries but it doesn’t smell like that to me. It smells great but it just doesn’t smell like strawberries, but not a big deal. This product provides physical exfoliation while cleansing the skin. I personally stay away from physical exfoliants so I only use this twice a week. Although it is a physical exfoliator, it’s really gentle. You can also control the graininess by adding in more water to dissolve the sugar granules. It’s also great at cleansing the skin without overdrying it. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes from Influenster.
Love this! Smells amazing. I have super oily and sensitive skin, so after I used this my face felt so soft and smooth. I was worried about using an exfoliate but I had no irritation at all!

my first thought of this product was that it smells amazing and it almost had a strawberry lemonade type scent but you can tell it’s natural from the ingredients and dissipates quickly. I have somewhat sensitive skin and it’s hard for me to find something to exfoliate my skin without irritating it. This is perfect the sugar granules aren’t to aggressive and you can thin it out depending on how much water you cleanse with. Perfect to leave my face feeling smooth and clean. I did receive this product complementary for testing purposes.

After oil cleansing, once or twice a week depending on how my face feels I use this! It’s not overly gritty and the sugar is very fine. This face wash doesn’t leave my face feeling stripped. It does have a scent, but it’s very light and I don’t notice it after I rinse. I love using this! It keeps my pores clean. On myself, I feel like it gives a brightening/ glow effect. I would recommend this to someone who doesn’t want a harsh scrub!!

I received this product from Influenster to test and review and I can honestly say I love it! I have been using this exfoliating face wash for about a month now and I have definitely noticed a difference in my skin! My pores are smaller, my skin tone is more even, and my skin is clear! I use this product everyday and will definitely continue to use it in the future

Its a very gentle exfoliating face wash. Feels fresh after use. Not drying at all. It smells like strawberry jam. Personally I think its too gentle me but I would recommend this product for people who have sensitive skin.
I only got a sample because it was sold out! (For good reason) after the first use I loved how the product worked as well as the delightful experience.

I’ve recently been using the Fresh Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash! Over the winter, I was experiencing dry, flaky skin, and was on the search for an exfoliator that was efficient enough to do the job without damaging my skin. Luckily Influenster sent me this face wash, along with the Fresh Soy Face Cleanser to test and review, complimentary; however all opinions are my own. I like the fresh, fruity scent of the Strawberry, and the gentle grains of exfoliating sugar. I’ve used Fresh’s sugar scrubs in other forms in the past and they’ve never disappointed! I love this face wash, and will to the very last drop!
Great for sensitive skin, the scent is divine makes me want to eat it. Product works well and its not harsh on skin

First off this product smells amazing. I was super excited just based on the smell lol. It feels good on my skin and hasn’t broken me out yet. I have super sensitive skin and break out really easily. So I am really happy this hasn’t caused any breakouts. However I feel like it doesn’t have the strength to keep my pimples at bay. Overall I’m happy with this product I just don’t feel like it’s an every day face wash for me

This scrub smells AMAZING. It truly looks/smells like strawberry jam. I love how the beads dissolve as I smooth the product around on my face. It leaves my skin feeling SO soft & definitely exfoliated! The only downside is that if doesn’t seem to improve acne, which is doesn’t claim to do, but that’s what I need in a face wash. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

This smells like heaven and leaves the skin feeling refreshed - it was a bit more harsh than I had anticipated - but not so much that I wouldn’t use it again. It’s really nice paired with their rose mask afterwards to calm the skin a bit! I’m sensitive, oily and acne prone and I would use it again. Received complimentary from influenster to review.
This stuff is SO BALLER. It leaves my skin Dewey LOOKING, but matte FEELING. It’s amazing.  On top of that is smells amazing ( duh)

I like the way that this product makes my face feel, I am not the biggest fan of the smell of it but I like the outcome and the texture. I received this free from Influenster and have enjoyed trying it.

I have to say I am pleasantly surprised. The scrub is extremely gentle. The scrubby fruit particles in it barely stay on the skin for a few seconds before melting into the skin. I doubt there is any possibility of any “micro-tears” happening in the skin. PROS: It’s extremely gentle, washes off perfectly and the oils in it leave the face very hydrated. I love that about it. CONS: I don’t think this does that great a job of cleansing the skin. I find that when I go over my skin with some micellar water after this, there is still a ton of dirt and residue (and that’s without me wearing a shred of makeup). And for me personally, if I am manually exfoliating, I would like a tooouch more scrubby action happening than this provides. All in all, I am kinda halfway torn. I love how this makes my skin look after, all supple and hydrated, but it’s also not very good at its job of properly cleansing. I’m happy I got to try for free courtesy of @influenster. And I will definitely continue to use it all the way to the last drop. Whether I will repurchase it with my own money, remains to be seen.

This is a nice product but I’d say it’s more of a polish than a scrub. The granular pieces (sugar I believe) creates a very fine polish on the skin, but is less effective than a coffee scrub for example. It does leave the skin smooth, but not as smooth as it could. I would compare it the the Laura nervier skin polish. I like the light fresh scent, but I don’t like the packaging. Companies need to be more conscious of the impact they have on the environment.

review_title: Love everything but the Strawberry smell
review_text: I was super excited to try this product but unlike most other reviewers, I’m not in love with the strawberry smell. I wish they would make it a cleaner smell like their other products. Besides the smell the product is great and does a great job of leaving my skin soft and hydrated! Probably won’t use these every day but a few times a week to give my skin a little refresh! I did receive it complimentary for testing purposes.

I love this face wash! Immediately after the first use I knew Fresh’s Sugar Strawberry would become a staple in my everyday routine. The sugar crystal exfoliant leaves my face super smooth and so clean. The texture gets deep in your pores and the smell is heavenly, like candy!! Pro tip - I like using it in the shower with the hot water for a full spa effect. I received this product complimentary from Influenster, but with my every day use, I know I’ll be purchasing it the next time around!

I have very sensitive, oily, acne proned skin so I use a prescription acne medicination daily. It causes my skin to get really dry and to peel. I received this complimentary from Influenster to test and was very leary about it as exfoliatiors tend to make my skin worse. I opened it and it smells soooo good! Like good enough to eat you guys. My skin was peeling really badly and I had a couple small breakouts before I used it. I used it at night before going to bed and it immediately made my skin soft and smooth. I applied a moisturizer afterwards and went to bed. When I woke up the next morning, my skin was clear and no signs of peeling! I definitely recommend this product!

However this is a great physical exfoliant for 1-2 time use a week!
This is a good exfoliating scrub. However, not one that I reach for during my nightly routine.
Love love love this product. I like to use sugar scrubs since they’re gentle, smell great, and don’t dry me put like some good chemical exfoliants can sometimes.

I received this product complimentary from Fresh in my influenster box and it’s been great thus far. The only slight downside is the strong smell so if you’re sensitive to that I’d be careful.

I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

this face wash is amazing! it gently exfoliates your skin without leaving it raw. also it smells great too! i received this complimentary from Influenster and this is by far my favorite item yet! i will definitely be repurchasing!!!!!

Smells wonderful but if you have very sensitive or reactive skin I recommend grabbing a sample and patch testing first. Can be used to remove makeup but I prefer as a second cleanse. My only complaint is the price. If price is no issue that one is a 5 star winner
This is the holy grail of exfoliators. It’s so gentle but effective. My skin looks so polished and smooth but isn’t tight and dry after I use it. I will definitely be repurchasing!

It reminded me more of cleaning products instead of a fruity beauty product. When the word strawberry is in the name of the product, I’m expecting a much sweeter and fruity scent. I received this product for complimentary testing purposes.
I exfoliate my face once a week and omg this was perfect it’s not harsh but gives you an amazing glow I recommend this to everyone

I just wish it had a lower price tag which is why I knocked off a star. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

I got sent this product to test out and it literally smells like a strawberry daiquiri!! It works really well and scrubbed away any dead skin. I have sensitive skin and it was gentle enough that there was no irritation after using this product. Def one of my new favs.

I did not like that the product arrived wrapped in plastic wrap unnecessarily. I received this product via influenster and am happy to add this exfoliator to my routine!

This wash is UNREAL. The consistency is so luxurious, it smells divine and the glow you’re left with is incredible. No harsh grit here - the sugar melts into your skin as you massage leaving a silky, smooth, supple feel. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

I do agree with some people on the strange strawberry smell but it wasn’t too bad. Will keep using in my routine! I received this product as a free sample.

It also said to use this product after a cleansing face wash, which I thought was interesting because I usually use something exfoliating first and then I go in with a cleansing face wash. Either way, I’ve been loving it so far. It’s so gentle and my face feels so clean and fresh after using it. I totally recommend if anyone is debating getting this.
Such an amazing product!! it’s so gentle on the skin and it leaves my skin so soft and hydrated and it smells like strawberry like come on you can’t beat that , definitely recommend giving it a try .

i received this product for free for reviewing purposes but this opinion is my own. this scrub is so good! this is my first fresh experience and I was not let down. my face felt smooth and looked less dull immediately after using this.

I received this complimentary from Sunday Riley for my honest review. I’ve used this for a solid month & am seeing clear results; there is an immediate glowing effect from first use, but after a few weeks, you can see a brighter skin tone & dark spots lightening. I had old sun damage spots that just would not lighten even through 3 bottles of other Vitamin C serums, & I am seeing them fade after 4 weeks of this one. It does take some getting used to: instead of a runny/gel serum, it’s like a thin cream (see picture) with some texture to it. I use it after cleansing & toning, but I can usually skip other hydrating products after using this & sometimes go straight to SPF because it’s moisturizing enough for my combo skin. It has a protective feel to it like a moisturizer, but is not greasy or sticky. I love that it has helped simplify my routine. I also tried it with the Good Genes lactic acid treatment & it was amazing - the two combined give such a dewy glow! And, I’ve used it in the evening before the CEO Glow facial oil for a super rich night treatment. I would definitely repurchase this even though it’s expensive, because it feels luxurious & works better than more basic serums.
