Makes my skin bright, dewy and glow.  Sunday Riley C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum was gifted by Sunday Riley and i so thankful for this)

I’ve used this a few days this week and my skin already appears brighter and it reduced the texture I have in my tzone. What I also love about this product is that it doesn’t make my skin sensitive. I have used products like this in the past that have tore up my skin because they were just too harsh, but this is definitely more gentle. I feel like this formula will work for most people and definitely pair it with a sunscreen!  Gifted by Sunday Riley

I didn’t expect the texture to be more like a regular lotion type of moisturizer. I expected clear gel. But I like this a lot. There is a citrus scent and very easy to spread on the skin. It sinks in really well shortly after. I would continue to use to get the full benefits! It is gifted by Sunday Riley.

I’m so glad I get this amazing Vitamin C serum was gifted by Sunday Riley. I used it in my day time routine. It works perfectly with my other skincare products. After I use it for a week I feel my skin brighter and softer. I’ll keep using it and recommend to everyone

Wow this such a great serum! I really feel like this is one of the best vitamin c serums! The dispenser is great for protecting the active ingredients in this serum. I love how clear and bright this makes my skin look. I recieved this complimentary from Sunday Riley.

Pricey but worth the expense.  This product has done a phenomenal job of lightening and removing  dark spots on my cheeks that were primarily caused by long term sun damage.  Smoothed on this light non-greasy lotion morning and night for about 4 weeks and the results have been amazing.  Light citrus fragrance and absorbs super quickly.

I got it as a sample size. The product feels like a lightweight lotion and has a very fainted scent which I admire about this product. It sits well under any sunscreen, tinted or not. I did see some difference on my PIH, and it also brightened my overall complexion. However, the product is not budget-friendly for me. There are other vitamin C products in the market that are as good as this one but not overly expensive. If I want to use it again, I would buy it during a sale or as a free sample size again.

Product is best used at night because it leaves a sticky feel and shiny look to the skin after application but I didn’t hate it. I don’t think I will purchase it without trying others first though. I do believe it was beginning to fade some spots on my face but I didn’t feel it gave me an overall brightening effect personally. Perhaps you need to use it longer but I only got the trial size in an offer.

I received this sample using my beauty rewards points. It is very sticky and heavily scented. I prefer to use unscented products on my face as my skin gets irritated easily. Drunk Elephants vitamin C serum is much more effective and comfortable on my skin.

review_title: lLove a product but not the Price
review_text: I love the product! To be honest, everything is great except the price. I got it on sale for a very good price. I will by it again when a prize dropped.

This is a lovely serum in lieu of an oil based one. It feels like a light cream when applied, but absorbs immediately leaving a hydrated glow all over. The scent is lovely. Like peeling a clementine. It smells natural not synthetic.

review_title: If your skin likes vitamin C, this is for you!!
review_text: I find that with some actives, certain types agree with different people’s skin. I tend to have less than favorable reactions with niacinimide, retinol, some AHAs, etc. but I always see great results in reduction of redness/hyperpigmentation when I apply Vitamin C. For that reason, I absolutely love this product- I honestly see a difference when I use it regularly! This is my second purchase of this serum and I always come back to it. Two of my friends absolutely hated this product, so I think it really comes down to knowing if 15% Vitamin C is going to work for you or not. Also, I do like the smell but it has a distinct “Froot Loops” type scent to it, so that may be another reason to stay away from it, if that is your personal preference.

review_title: perfect serum for humid weather or oily skin
review_text: I love this serum, I purchased in store and was hesitant to try a different serum from my usual power strength kheils, but I’m so happy with the results, its really lightweight, soaks into my skin really quickly and living in Florida I found other serums to feel sticky on my skin, this one doesn’t at all. I can defiantly see a brightness, healthy glow and tighter pores since using the product after 1 month.

I’ve been using this sample for 3 days now and I’m so super impressed. I have a stubborn area of melasma, sun spot on my left cheek. this stuff has really helped it already!!! it has lightened and my face looks luminous. I have also been using prime miracle oil which I believe enhances the serum. I’m really on the fence as to spend 85.00 on it but, if my spot continues to lighten, I’ll be investing in this!

Smells great, but hasn’t done much for my skin. I’m about half-way though, using it every morning after my morning routine. It only leaves my face sticky for the rest of the day. Haven’t seen any brightening effects.

review_title: Doesn’t exaggerate wrinkles and pores with makeup!
review_text: Vitamin C serum/cream is tricky, but thaere are many good Vitmin C skincare products. I tried many, and I know a few good Vitamin C products, but this C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum stands out not only for the effectiveness but also for the texture and feel of the product. It looks beautiful on my skin by itself but also works great with most of the liquid foundations I have (Marc Jacobs, Fenty, tarte, Revlon, and M.A.C) .When applied on my face, it has a little sticky, gummy, syrup like texture, which I liked. I think this texture helped a little to keep the makeup in place?It is moisturizing, so for example, Korres Vitamin C Oil is very drying by itself and always has to be paid with additional moisturizing product. With C.E.O. Vitamin C serum, you can just wear this after washing face and wear makeup right after if you want to. PROS:- Effective- Delivers Vitamin C into a deeper layer of skin than water soluble Vitamin C- Nice subtle sent- Very Stable- Skin looks pretty after application- Works great with liquid foundation- Doesn’t exaggerate wrinkles and pores after applying makeup (great for mature skin)- Wonderful feel and textureCON:- Price (very expensive!)

review_title: Whoa! If I was a rich girl...
review_text: ....this is how my skin would look like! Wow! This serum man..! I had only a sample (.17 fl oz./5 ml) but I managed to squeeze about a week of use from it (the sample was from Sephora as one of those you pick when you shop online). The consistency is like a light lotion, milky and easy to apply, and little goes a long way. It does have some discreet scent, but I can’t really figure out what it is.. It does not smell like lemon or orange to me, which is what I expected based on the package and vitamin C that it contains. I am OK with this scent, as I said, it is very discreet, and it does not linger. Now the effect that it has on the skin is quite amazing! After using it my face is literally like silk! It gives this beautiful glow and moisturizes so well. It makes my skin so soft and gives the impression of the skin well-taken-care-of. When I tried it on my hand I could immediately see where on my hand I applied it - the skin immediately looked glowy and luxurious (if you know what I mean). I don’t know if there are any long-term effects on the skin from using this lotion - does it improve my skin over time, or provides remedy/illusion of it only when applied - but even if it is only a short term effect, if I could afford it, I would use it gladly. I am not sure if this serum might create some unwanted shine for the people with very oily skin (I think that mine is normal to oily, although my sister says it is just normal), so I would recommend they try it first before spending a bunch of money (then ending up shiny and angry). Also, my skin is prone to cystic acne, but I have not experienced any lately, and this product had no negative effect.

Great for night time use, otherwise a little heavy for me to wear under makeup (I have oily skin). I have been using a sample I picked up with my points and even with the small bottle you get so many uses out of it. I’ve used it a few times and the next day my skin feels and looks smooth and clear! I suffer from acne scars as I had very bad skin when I was younger. I hope overtime to see a lot of reduction in the appearance of it, but as for making skin look great it does instantly.

I really liked the consistency. It’s creamy and I noticed a difference in my skin when I Added this product. It began to lighten My dark spots and my skin was brighter. I would buy this again. I think a second bottle is needed to see a greater difference.
Overpriced, only lasted me about two months, and didn’t see any changes in my skin.

review_title: new addition to my skincare regiment
review_text: i wasn’t sure i needed a vitamin c product in my routine (already a fan of Good Genes in the morning, A+ at night). But i got this when i splurged on a kit of Sunday Riley products so I gave it a shot. after just three weeks i am seeing some lightening of dark spots on my face. now using this daily and alternating between my other products at night. This is sticky, yes, but less so than the Drunk Elephant product. and it smells WAY better.

I have literally never had such a bad reaction to a product in my life. I do not have sensitive skin. I’ve used many vitamin C serums, retinols, etc. After one day of using this my face and neck started itching. I didn’t think it was from this so I used it again the next day. On the second day of using this my husband asked if I was ok because my face was so red. Again, I didn’t think it was from this serum. On the third day I put on my makeup and realized I had a zillion pimples under my skin. Literally everywhere. And I still couldn’t stop itching my face and neck. Then I finally put two and two together. I wondered if I should keep using it - maybe my face was purging? - but the itching and redness is insane! I have to stop using it.

I’ve tried so many Vitamin-C products from serums to creams. This is by far the best, the texture and smell of this product is amazing. It’s super hydrating and gives your skin a beautiful glow. I took 1 star away due to the price, for how expensive it is you don’t get enough product. Packaging is much bigger than how much product you’re actually getting.

I bought this serum because I saw that Karla Deras has recommended it in an interview and her skin is amazing so I gave it a shot and I really love this product. It is a light serum with a slight citrus scent that I add to my morning and night routine after washing and toning my face. I think my skin looks so good when I use it, brighter and clear, which is great since it is a bit of a splurge but definitely an investment in your skin!

review_title: Look Ready for the Day, Even if You're Not
review_text: This is part of my daily skin care routine.  I apply this every morning after toner, and it does an amazing job of perking up my skin.  I feel like it creates a great texture and plumpness.  Definitely helps me look ready for the day, even if I’m not.  The price point on Sunday Riley products is definitely high, but their products deliver real visible results.

This uses tetrahexyldecyl ascorbate and not ascorbic acid. Not all Vitamin C’s are equal.  This is not nearly as effective as ascorbic acid and it shows. After finishing the bottle I saw no change in my skin tone. For this product to be effective it may take several bottles and that’s not worth the price. I’ll be returning to ascorbic acid products.
Love, Love, Love this stuff! I use it in the mornings before make-up. It brings on the glow & lightens dark spots.

I have dry skin and this vitamin C serum is wonderful for both hydrating and improving my skin. I love the dewy glow I get from using the serum. Also I just love how it feels on my skin. I’ve tried other serums and this is my favorite. It works and gives the most noticeable results.

While this serum went on smoothly and temporarily brightened the skin, it did not have the effect L-ascorbic acid has on my skin. I used two bottles before leaving a review. It is a pleasant serum, with a refreshing fragrance and it brings some glow to the skin for the day. However, I will stick with Obagi when it comes to vitamin C serums. If you are in your 20s, with no sun spots for example, this serum will most likely be a lovely addition to your routine.
Love this product! Brightens my skin ! I’ve seen my skin change within a week of using it , my skin tone is better looking I’m really enjoying it

review_title: Good, but not a great value for money
review_text: I purchased this after a brief and failed relationship with a Drunk Elephant serum that broke me out and made my skin dull. I really saw a difference in my skin tone and brightness within a few days, and it worked well under my CC cream. However, the price for what you get is nuts, and I’m not shy about spending money on skin care. With morning and night use (1 pump, which is not even the max they recommend!), this bottle lasted me about 6 weeks. There is still some product in the bottom, but it’s impossible to get to.

This product. WOW!! I have never loved a product so much in my life. I truly cannot live without this. I’ve tried to find other products that cost less to use instead and keep coming back to this. Nothing can beat it. It is 100% worth the price. This will change your skin. I have honestly never felt so beautiful since discovering this product. Buy this. Your skin will thank you. I seen results from day 1!

Brightens overall appearance of skin, smells great. My skin looks more hydrated and dark(age, freckles and acne) spots look leas noticeable. Will make me break out if I use too often, and can be a bit oily feeling under foundation and/or other face cream. This product works best when you learn how your skin likes it best - mine every other night with a few dabs of evening facial moisturizer on top, on nights I’m not using Retinoids. Also works on scrapes and scabs to promote healing and leveling of scab surface. Use with salve and scabs will heal faster. Pricey, but worth it. Buy mini size to try and play around with application, you’ll love it.
Didn’t do anything for me. Was expecting to see a difference in my dark spots but I didn’t. Really expensive for something that didn’t work for me and my skin type.

This is honestly the best brightening serum that I have used. I use to use a medical grade product and this did a way better job. I use to ride horses as a teen, and never thought about wearing sunscreen during the summers. Now I have some sun spots on my cheeks. In less than 2 weeks I started noticing a difference. My skin was glowing, and I’m able to wear little to no makeup. Even the front desk girl at my pilates class said my skin was glowing! I like the way the product feels. It’s really creamy almost like a lotion. Other ones I have tried are liquidy, and seem to soak in your skin instantly. It is hydrating to my dry and sensitive skin.
I broke out so badly I had to see my dermatologist. Contacted the company thru their website and got ZERO response. Actually, they get zero stars but that’s not an option here.

This has quickly become a staple of my skincare routine. I had a deluxe sample that I used every morning for a month, and all dark spots and acne scars that had been getting darker over the past year had lightened up noticeably in only a week or two. I brought it on a 2-week road trip where I was in the dry heat all day and night, and this calmed my skin and looks super flattering on it’s own in the morning before heading out. It gives an immediately brighter glow, has a beautiful dewy finish, looks great with no makeup or only B.B. cream, and it’s a great consistency under a full makeup look. I bought the full size right away when my 1-month sample was finished. It really calms irritation for me, and I’ve started using it at night too—I’m addicted! I do layer a thicker moisturizer over it at night, but only in areas that are dry for me this winter. You can layer other Sunday Riley oils over this at night too, just wait a few minutes for this one to sink in.

Has changed my skin a lot in just a couple of weeks.. I have really had dark under eyes and a lot of freckles and they both have faded. It’s pretty heavy so I prefer to use at night alone and in the morning just a little of this and normal face lotion

I got a sample of this and couldn’t even get past using it more than a few days to see the long term results.  It has a weird plastic greasy feeling  that feels like it just sits on top of the skin and never really soaks in. There’s no way I could use this in the morning  under makeup. Wanted to love this but I just can’t do it.

This product smells great and does give my skin a really nice glow but the one thing I don’t like that it does is that it makes me break out jus when my face was all cleared. My skin is combination skin and occasional break out when it’s my time of the month I get a pimple or two. So honestly this product is like a 50/50 gives an amazing skin glow but the break out isn’t fun
Good product but very expensive

I live in Texas and I’m 28 yrs old. I purchased this for the first time and have been using it during the winter. My skin is combination but want to say more in the oily side. Anyway it’s worked great for me in the winter and my skin has been clearer and healthy looking. Will definitely keep trying in the winter months as I feel it’s a bit thicker than most serums.

I love good genes and Luna, and I’d love to try out other products from Sunday Riley. But this one... it doesn’t really work, and the CEO cream doesn’t work either. But as a brightening serum, it’s much cheaper than good genes...

I was skeptical about vitamin C serums, but received a sample of this and dang if it didn’t make a difference! My skin looks smoother, less splotchy, and maybe even a little younger. It’s pricey, but I think it’s worth the cost - I actually took advantage of the various sales Sephora had around the holidays and bought two bottles. I use it once a day and I think a bottle will last ~3-4 months.
I used it for a month but didn’t see any results. What a disappointment.

I got a sample of this product and used it for about a month. This was one of the first products I’ve used that has actually worked to lighten my dark spots from acne. I started seeing them lighten in only a week or 2. It smells great and made my skin super moisturized even in the cold weather. The only downside was I started breaking out from it but I do I have very sensitive and acne prone skin so I doubt that would happen for most people. If you don’t usually break out from products and want to get rid or dark spots and scars I would say try this!

My newest obsession! I have rosacea and this has helped to make my skin a more even color and less red. I was quite surprised! I use it every night before my moisturizer and I can tell a complete difference when I forget. Some people are not fond of the scent but I think its great. It smells so fresh. It’s like going into an orange field :-)

This product is good if you DON’T have a 5-10 step skincare routine (like a Korean routine, for example). This is a cream. Vitamin C is an active, and is supposed to be one of the first things you put on your face, after you wash. Considering that this is a (somewhat thick) cream, you can’t put any watery essences, etc after it. This is one and done. I don’t even put moisturizer after this (but i do have oily skin). It seems to work. Some dermatologists say a cream is a better way to use Vitamin C, so decide what is best for you. This is how I use it (in the morning): Wash Face; Hydrating Toner; C.E.O., Sunscreen.

I bought this because it’s an allure award winner and I thought I’d give another vitamin C type serum a try.  It worked fine, but it didn’t last long for the price.  It only lasted me about 2 months and it’s difficult to get the last of the product out of the bottom.  I switched back to my DE C-firma which is also expensive, but lasts me twice as long, I get better results from, and I don’t have any issue getting to the last drop.
After using it, my acne issue got worse! When I stop using it, acne slowly went away. Such an expensive stuff but does not work for me, so I’m going to return it.

I purchased this after going through another vitamin c serum from a clean brand...also sold at Sephora and about the same price. The serum I used before this was amazing and completely got rid of the few sun spots I had on my cheeks. It also improved the texture of my skin, especially on my forehead which tends to be dry, and dull. When I ran out I decided to try something that’s more stable because vitamin c products expire super rapidly. This claims to be “highly stable.” I also dislike the metallic smell of the other product. This smells lovely; HOWEVER, I’ve finished half of the bottle and all of the benefits I saw from the last serum are gone. Sun spots are back and more visible than ever using this. The texture of my skin is worse using this. C.E.O. is ineffective and overpriced. I don’t mind paying for good skincare but this ain’t it.

I absolutely love this product. I got it as a sample first and fell in love. I add a pea size amount to my moisturizer at night and my dark skin spots have lightened drastically. I’m giving this only 4 stars because of the price. If it was 40$ I would give 5/5.

I used this every morning for three weeks and have noticed no difference in my skin at all. It smells lovely, and absorbs quickly, but the formulation is difficult to distribute, so you need to use quite a lot....  which makes it expensive for a cream that doesn’t appear to do anything.
yes. good stuff. works great, feels great.

I’ve only tried samples from Sunday Riley, same with this product, but everything I’ve tried from them is amazing. I saw an improvement the first time using it. My complexion was more even and bright. It’s too bad I cannot afford their products. I feel like they would make a huge difference on my skin.
I love this product but the price is getting out of control. It’s really too bad, I have to look for another serum now.

I went thru a full bottle and I’m dying for another. It faded my dark spots/acne scars and now I have more that I need to get rid of. Love love love this and will not stop using again. Can’t wait to try more from Sunday Riley.

I have had a red spot from a cut on my face for over a month now and knew I needed to take action to help dull the red spot.  I have been using this product each night for two weeks and the spot has dramatically dulled!  I am so impressed with how fast this has worked and how well!

review_title: Great addition to your routine for skin that glows
review_text: In love with this serum! I have a very expensive skin care routine with top of the line products, but was looking for something to add a little extra glow to my skin. This has given incredible results. It makes your skin look dewy and luminous. I’ve received even more compliments on my skin tone since using it. (Side not: do not forget to wear your sunscreen everyday as using powerful serum can increase skin photosensitivity.)

I have not wanted to try a different vitamin C serum after I found this. I have repurchased my second bottle and will continue doing so. I just wish the price was better. The lotion like texture makes it feel creamy and not irritating. It has a yummy citrus smell that I look forward to while applying. I like how it’s packaged in a glass jar to help preserve the vitamin C stability. This product can tingle slightly especially when used with retinol products. It doesn’t hurt or irritate. The form of vitamin C is the least irritating than the other cheaper ones such as l-ascot if acid. I’ve had other vitamin c oil type serums turn my fingers and my face red and orangey. This doesn’t make my skin smell strange like self tanner like other vitamin C “serums”. I don’t think there’s a better vitamin C product out there.

i have been using this every morning for about a month. my skin has never looked so bright and radiant. When people compliment your skin when you’re not wearing make up tells me that this product is a winner! ( im 46 y.o. those are the compliments i love to hear!)

review_title: Let light shine out of darkness!
review_text: This WORKS for dark spots. My honey is using the sample I received from a previous Sephora order. He puts it under his eyes for his hereditary dark circles and lower where he has MAJOR sun damage from years of playing basketball outside. He is ex-pro and has Caucasian skin and doesn’t wear any serums or creams or anything like that. He thinks putting sunscreen on once a day, even if he’s out in the sun ALL DAY, is enough. UGH he just doesn’t get it. Anyway, as soon as he puts this on, there is an immediate brightness and blurring effect. From using it nightly for the past 2 weeks there has been significant lightness. I swear he looks younger. I’m impressed and I’m happy for him because he notices it too and feels better. We are waiting for the April Rouge sale to purchase (and then I’ll try it too)!

review_title: A product you didn’t think you would need.
review_text: Amazing! I had no idea I Needed this until I had it. I was sent a full size of this in my Allure Beauty box and I have never been so satisfied about a product.

review_title: I am in shock with how good my skin looks!
review_text: I have been using this every night for almost a week and I immediately see that I have smoother , brighter skin. This product did not make me break out. I did too receive this with my Allure Beauty Box! Which is crazy I only spend 15/ month and I get five-six  beauty samples sent to my house monthly, one being a full-sized product. This happened to be the full-size product. I’m glad it was in there because my skin needed it! I will definitely purchase this once I’ve polished off my first bottle!
Only seems to brighten when I’m wearing it. Smells great and thin consistency. It caused me to breakout every time so I won’t be repurchasing.

I got this serum specifically to lighten my acne marks, and I noticed it working in just a few uses. Over time, my acne marks have lightened considerably and there’s a general overall lift in the evenness of my skin tone. It has a lovely lightweight texture, and it even seems to create a great base for layering makeup or other skincare on top. My skin is smoother and brighter but it’s still super gentle. Plus it smells very lightly of oranges in a pleasant way. The price is steep but I’ve been using it once a day on my entire face for a while now and I don’t seem to have made a dent in the amount left. Highly recommend!

review_title: OK Product not worth the Price Tag
review_text: Received this in my Play Beauty box. While the product was light, and very refreshing when putting it on my face.... It did not keep my dry skin moisturized, and did not assist in skin tone or pore visibility. Giving it 2 stars, because it felt good on my skin when applying, had a nice faint smell, and did not cause my skin to react negatively.

review_title: Might be a good product but it’s a NO! For me.
review_text: Received a deluxe sample in my Sephora play box. I was super excited because I’ve heard such good things. I didn’t even read the reviews I was so excited to try. SO I used it the same day I got it, added it to my skincare routine. The next day I noticed some small pimples. But I refused to give up. SO I gave it another try, repeated it in my skincare routine. & My skin broke out SO BAD! Wasn’t about to use it again because the breakouts were so bad, I couldn’t risk it! SO I wouldn’t recommend if you have sensitive skin. I also have combination skin, currently on the dry side because of the winter. It just did NOT work FOR ME & my skin!!!

I always come back to this. I started noticing my expression lines starting to set in and I know they are inevitable but as soon as I started using this, I can notice a significant difference - my lines of course are still there but my skin around the eyes are more plump so the creases don’t set in as deep. I live in fairly dry climate so I’m always looking for something that will truly moisturize. I am someone that doesn’t mind a heavy cream. If you don’t like heavy stuff, this may not be for you ccourse are st
Pros: Creamy, non-migrating cream. Eye area felt smooth and moisturized. Cons: Was only a sample. I will add this to my must-try list.

Trying and looking for cream that works, finally found this one. Age 33, using cosmetics only professional for about 15 years, I know what works for my wrinkles and what is not. This one works. It is rich and last long. No smell, no allergy(but I do have sensitive skin). It is to oily tho, but it works, so I don’t care.

I’ve been using this eye cream on and off for years. I take a break, try something different and it is NEVER as good as Shiseido’s eye cream. I use Bioscience (Squalane + Marine Algae Eye Cream) in the morning and this stuff at night. It’s super moisturizing and combats the dryness I started experiencing since being prescribed Tretinoin.

review_title: An Eye Cream That Truly Works
review_text: I have genetic under-eye dark circles and bags, and with aging (57) I am now adding lines to the mix. Go me! I got a sample of this and was surprised to see how much better my under-eye area looked when I used it. Concealer and makeup go on over it great, too. Believe me, I have tried soooo many eye creams over the past 3+ decades, from drugstore brands to $125+ luxury brands. While not cheap, this works and falls in the middle price wise. I’m convert. The skin around my eyes looks so much better when I use it.

Omg! I’ve used many products. Olay products are constantly touted as amazing. I’ve never noticed any difference. I used Algenist blue Vitamin C serum to clear up patches of sun damage and Sunday Riley’s Good Genes to help with my forehead wrinkles. This product worked SHOCKINGLY WELL!!! Looking at the dates, before was 10/7. After was 10/20. 13 days!
The only thing that works for my parched sensitive  eye area, absorbs quickly but keeps area moisturizes for the whole day

Not a fan. Would not absorb into my skin. Normally I don’t mind fragrance but this one has a surprisingly strong scent, especially for an eye cream of all things. It also did not play well with any of my other products. Glad I only had a sample and didn’t spend money on this.

review_title: Does not absorb into the skin
review_text: This does not absorb into your skin. It feels like a thick oil/cream is under your eye and it’s noticeably shiny too. I have been using it for two months and there has not been a noticeable change. I love Shiseido but this is not worth the price at all.

Thankfully I applied this to my hand first after noticing the smell. It’s so perfumy I had to wash it off even my hand. It may smooth wrinkles, but I’m not putting anything this strongly scented under my eyes. I would probably make my eyes burn if I did.

review_title: Six Months Later and I’m still hyped
review_text: I’ve been using this for about 6 months. A little goes a long way. I can always and I mean always tell a difference in the morning when I have used this night before. I don’t have bad black circles under my eyes like some people do but still a girl needs a little help. When I wake up I feel as though I don’t need to put on as much concealer when I use this. I’ve tried samples of countless eye creams and I never see any difference which is why I waited so long to write this review. I will re purchase and will probably re purchase after that. This is the real deal.
I finally found an amazing eye cream. This is great for wrinkles and dry skin. I can’t tell you enough. Buy it. You won’t regret it

This is my Third Jar. The last time I purchased this, it was the end of January. A little goes a long way. I love my results. And although they didn’t come over night or even in a week when I noticed them I was impressed. Right around week 2 is when I began to notice my fine lines less noticeable. Even texture and tone. This eye cream is very hydrating. Again a little goes a long way. And it is worth the price point.

I received a sample of this and it lasted for about 5 days. I used it twice a day. I feel like my fine lines/wrinkles under my eyes were less noticeable. They did not look as deep as they normally do. I am in my late 20s and I am about to use this product religiously for the rest of my life. I also applied it to my forehead lines and on my dimples. It does feel oily/heavy. But that depends on how much you use and a little goes a long way with this! You want it to feel a like that because it is locking all that wonderful moisture in.

review_title: best eye cream at this price
review_text: This product is amazing!! I used Lancôme and other big name eye creams and they all caused serious allergy problem around my eyes. Until I started using a sample of shisedo eye cream. I got to see result overnight! My fine lines around eyes are smoothed out and the skin very hydrated - drastic change from the allergy red and dry the night before. I’ve been using the sample for two weeks now and I can really see the improvement. Didn’t hesitate to buy the full size during the sale! It’s seriously the best eye cream at this price level.

The Shiseido Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream has helped diminish the appearance of fine lines on my eyes. I was born with already puffy eyes so I really don’t expect for anything to happen with just a month of use. I definitely saw the difference on the fine lines as I begin to see that it makes the skin mousturized and supple. Hence, avoiding fine lines to get deeper. I love the luxurious smell and feel of ths cream. It is easily gets absorbed in the skin so I can use it with or without a concealer. It makes my eyes look a little bit more awake. I love it and highly reccommend!

I love the brand so I was very excited to try this out. It is pricey but a little goes a long way and the packaging feels very high end with its weighted container and little spoon. I do think it is very good at moisturizing and I did notice the difference in the morning after applying. You will have to use consistently for several weeks to see results but I did notice slight smoothing over time with the product. I like that it is not greasy and does not leave residue behind but instead absorbs well Into the skin.

I really like this eye cream! It’s even better when you place it in the fridge for a few hours and then have that cooling feel under your eyes. I definitely feel like this is an amazing product. It helped reduce some of my under eye bags though not all, but something is better than nothing.

I really like this eye cream. I’m in my early 40s, and I’ve noticed my skin has changed from being oily to dry. I have been using this eye cream for about a month day and night I find it super emollient but not greasy. In the mornings I have applied it after washing my face and it absorbs pretty quickly. After about 15-20 minutes I am ready to prime my face and put on my makeup. I find that it does smooth out my under eyes by moisturising and tightening. The tightening feel is strange because it’s not drying, it’s the opposite. I received a free sample, which is what I am basing my review on, however I am considering buying a jar after aim done with it. Another thing, a little goes a very long way. I do 1 tap of the cream with my ring finger and I can use that tap under both my eyes. I love this eye cream. If I were to have 1 con, it would be that I wish it smelled less. I do not like applying fragrances products on my face.

review_title: Took years off the appearance of my eyes!!
review_text: New Holy Grail eye cream! When I say I have tried every eye cream on the market I really do mean it. From drugstore all the way up to la Mer, even prescription creams. Nothing has ever wowed me like this one. It goes on cool and you can immediately feel the intense hydration. It’s not thick or sticky like some eye creams, just silky and hydrating. I wear this at night because even an hour later, my under eye area is still moist! I wake up and my eyes are refreshed and hydrated. Now for the amazing part- I have used this cream for 3 weeks straight at night, not only do my eyes feel hydrated and amazing - but they look that way too. Seriously, In three weeks I have noticed a significant reduction in fine lines and wrinkles! It seems to have taken years off my eyes. I just turned 51 and I swear my eyes look younger than when I was in my 40’s. I just bought a back-up in the Sephora sale because I never want to be without this eye cream.

I’ve tried my fair share of eye creams and this wasn’t my favorite, like other reviewers shared~ this cream is extremely thick and heavily scented (which I can’t use many products w/ scent). Smelling that on my face all day really bothers me! You need less than a pea size for both eyes and the it’ll still be there in the morning for you to cleanse off. Aside from the awful texture/formula I did like that it covered my dark circles with a sheer glimmer~ at least giving the illusion that they’re hidden ;) I used this for about 14 days and can’t say I noticed much of a difference with my fine lines OR younger looking “eye-area.” All in all for the price there’s definitely better products at Sephora that work magic! Some of my favs: Clinique, Drunk Elephant, and Glow Recipe’s Retinol Avocado Melt—> this is a WINNER!!

I’ve been using this product for a few weeks and have noticed minimal improvement, but my under eye dies appear a little smoother overall.  I don’t care for the fragrance and the product is greasier than I prefer.

review_title: Youthful instantly takes off three children
review_text: Oh my gosh this eye cream just blew every youknowthebrand eye cream out of the water! I normally have to layer on the brightening coverup to make my eyes look less tired and “mom”- I had to dal everyone I knew on FaceTime asap to show them as soon as I put this on! Look at my eyes dang it, Karen! I will be seen and hey, do I have any kids stressing me out at home? Can’t tell anymore from looking at my eye circles puffy dragon wrinkled self- boom, magic, gone. Looooove! Received via Influenster Voxbox

I received this product complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes. This product is an extremely thick and emollient eye cream which feels very soothing under your eyes. This product claims to smooth wrinkles and lines around the eye with a noticeable difference in a week. I have been using this product every night for approximately 4 weeks and I have noticed the finer lines around my eyes have drastically diminished and the the more pronounced under eye wrinkles have softened. In addition, my under eye area also appears brighter. The cream has a strong scent when it is first applied but it dissipates quickly. I really do like this product and hopefully with consistent use it will continue to show results.

review_title: Great for under eye wrinkles and dryness
review_text: This cream helped with the wrinkles and dryness around my eyes. In one week, I could see a slight difference in my under eye wrinkles. In two weeks, I could notice a difference in my under eye wrinkles. They weren’t as pronounced and deep as before I started using this cream. The cream is also very hydrating, a little goes a long way, which helped with some dryness I had around my eyes. Overall, I would recommend this eye cream.

I love this Shiseido Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream! I found it very easy to add into my skincare routine. It absorbs well into the skin so you don’t feel it there shortly after application.  I am 42 years old and starting to show some wrinkles around my eyes. This cream helped smooth those out. I look and feel younger.  The cream really doesn’t have much of a fragrance to it, so perfect for those that prefer unscented items. Overall I think this item is great for your anti-aging skincare routine.

Shiseido Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream is a dream to apply! It has light whipped texture and leaves you’re under eyes soft and smooth. I received this product a month ago and wanted to give it a good month before writing this review.  My finale thoughts after using this every night are....I’m pleasantly surprised. To date this is the most moisturized my eyes have ever been! If you have dry under eyes trust me you’re going to want this stuff! I have sensitive skin as well and didn’t have one problem. I would definitely repurchase.  It’s a win!!!

This product worked great under my eyes! My eyes are very tired and show early signs of aging due to life as I a busy mother, wife and full-time employee. I use this cream before bed every night, and in the morning after washing my face. It is a bit oily at first but your skin absorbs it after a few minutes. I really also like the spatula that is included with the product so that I am not putting my fingers into the cream. I have noticed reduce fine lines under my eyes and my eyes don’t look tired after using this product! I definitely recommend this I cream!

The jar is beautiful, the cream is very moisturizing and feels refreshing. I love using it, but sadly don’t see any difference in my fine lines and wrinkles despite applying it liberally twice per day. I will finish the jar but I don’t think I’d spend $70 on this particular product. Before photo without mask. Photo with mask is after using product 2x per day for 3 weeks.

I recieved this item free for my honest review. This is very hydrating and smells nice. I have been using it for three weeks now Nd have noticed some subtle changes in the fine lines on my face, but nothing to write home about. It goes on smooth and silky. It does moisturize my skin and makes it feel smooth and supple. I hope that with continued use it will make more of a difference over time.

i recieved this oroduct in exchange for my Honest opinion. That being said I find the cream to be extremely hydrating and soft. I have sensitive skin and this product did not irritate.  i have a hard time finding eye creams that i like and id say this has to be one of my favorites.  ive been using this about two weeks but think is need to test a full jar before giving it 5 stars

This is one of my favorite eye creams. It leaves my under eyes feeling moisturized. I used this on my under eye area, crows feet and eyelids that left all those areas feeling hydrated. I used it both morning and evening. It is a thick formula  but did not irritate my eyes which are usually sensitive. I did notice that it did brighten my under eye area and will highly recommend this product. I did receive this free from influenstar which made me happy because it was on my list to buy. This did not influence my thoughts on this   Product.

It is a very very rich cream.  I have a combination skin with some dry spots.  This cream definitely goes into heavy cream.  The direction says use pearl size amount, it will be too much.  When I use pearl size of amount, I feel like my skin was covered by some kind of film.  I feel like the skin cannot breath.  So I reduced to use 1/3 of the recommended amount.  It is little draggy, so I was not able to massage my eye area.  I feel like the cream is not absorbing into my skin.  It feels like the cream is just sitting on the top of my skin.  I recommend if your skin is super dry, use this cream.  I was not able to use day time.  Since it is too rich, I cannot layer my other skincare routine or eyeshadows.  It caused crease on my eyelid.  I always check the ingredients.  It contains parabens.  I am not a super clean beauty person, but that bothered me a little.

I honestly had never tried this brand before but was excited to try it out. It immediately decreases the look of my fine line in between my brows and plumps the skin around my eyes. A little goes a very long way and the spatula it comes with is super useful!

review_title: Nice feeling but questioning the investment
review_text: This eye cream is very luxurious. You can tell that a lot of thought went into this product. This cream is very hydrating. You need less than you normally would for an eye cream. I can’t tell if my very faint fine lines are gone due to the product or the hydration but I do like the way it feels on the skin.

I got this product free from Influenster. I am a fan of eye creams, they have been apart of my skin care routine since I was 24 and noticed fine lines around my eyes. I have really used anything by Shiseido but I hear nothing but good things from the brand. This eye cream is lovely. It comes with a small applicator. The campaign said results in 7 days and to use the eye cream day and night as the last step of your routine.  The eye cream is really hydrating and a bit greasy. It would probably not work for someone with oily skin or underneath concealer. I will keep this, and use it mainly at night. My eyes get really itchy, so this actually helps the area that I made even worse with my scratching.

Received this eye cream for free in exchange for my honest review, and I’m so happy I did! I’ve tried SEVERAL eye creams, and most I’ve tried are on the high-end side because I do believe in investing in high-quality eye creams.  This is truly a thick, hydrating formula in the form of a cream. I mention that because it is not light-weight in any way, as gel eye creams are.  That being said, it is very moisturizing and concentrated, and as a result does a great job of combatting wrinkles and lines. Creams are what I’d recommend if you are trying to get rid of lines whereas gels are better when combatting dark circles. I can honestly say this cream has helped my crow’s feet around my eyes and made my eyes appear more youthful and vibrant. Besides the high price tag, I do love everything about this cream!!!

Very hydrating and gives somewhat of a glow. I don’t think I saw a huge improvement in lines. It’s a nice texture but, a little heavy for under makeup, I thought. I wasn’t able to use it but a week before my eyes started itching from it. The itching was pretty intense and stopped shortly after I discontinued use. I don’t think I would recommend this product.
This product is hydrating which is great. I haven’t noticed much of a difference in the 2 weeks I’ve been using it. I can only use it at night as it’s too greasy to use under makeup for me.

I have always loved the shiseido line of products. This Beneficiance anti wrinkle eye cream is no exception. I like that the texture is creamy and very moisturizing. My eyes feel and look refreshed after using it. I can’t say as to the efficacy of the product because I’ve only used it a couple of weeks but so far so good! I did receive this as part of Influenster’s vox campaign but I would have purchased this on my own regardless. I have used shiseido for years and always end up picking up products as I cycle through my skincare routines.
This is not any more efficient than any over the counter affordable cream. I wouldn’t spend 70.00 or even 20.00 on this product.

I received this product complimentary to review. This eye cream feels very luxurious and does moisturize. I did not notice any real drastic improvement on my under eyes though. I probably would not purchase this for $70.

This eye cream is a miracle worker. Within days of using I started to see a difference to the small crows feet and after a couple of weeks, my eyes looked more youthful and less tired. I have tried many eye creams, including La Mer’s and I gave that high remarks, but I had never used this product as a tool for measurement.  I am so happy that I received this product to try. A little goes a very long way, when I finally run out, I will definitely be purchasing this. It is worth every penny they charge for it.  The pictures were taken four days apart.

I really like this eye cream!! I haven’t been using it long but from what I can see it does a great job. It is very thick so a little goes a long way and I like that about it!! The packaging is beautiful too!

I’ve been using this for 3 weeks now and it’s an absolute game changer! My crows feet are definitely diminished. The price is high, but a little bit is all that’s needed for good coverage. After 3 weeks I still have 3/4 of the container left. I will be repurchasing!

I have been searching for a good eye cream that actually works. The only thing I don’t like is the floral smell. I received this in a Vox Box from Influenster to try a little over a week ago and I have seen a huge improvement in my dark circles and bags.  Would recommend.

This eye cream is very hydrating and soothing. I have quite sensitive skin, but I had no trouble with this eye cream. It is pretty heavy and would be visibly moist for hours despite using a small amount, so I used it at bedtime mainly. The puffiness under my eyes showed a significant improvement- I really love this eye cream.

Since I’m in quarantine, what better time than now to try out the sample products! I am on a kick to find a good trusted eye cream that will work for me and this is definitely not it. Felt too heavy and greasy under my eyes and I don’t know if I just put too much but it was still noticeably greasy five hours later. This is irritated my skin and made my under eyes itch. Just threw the rest of it away.

This cream is so luxurious! I love how it feels on my very easily irritated skin. It doesn’t break me out nor does it irritate my skin. I have deep wrinkles and this cream seems to be softening them up a bit. I love this and think it’s worth the price point. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a good eye cream.

I’ve been using the Shiseido Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream for 3 weeks and so far I am very pleased. In the beginning I was unsatisfied with how greasy it made my face look until I learned I was using too much. A very small amount goes a long way! Which makes this a great value. Once I got the amount right, I started loving it! It instantly makes my under eye area look nourished and luminous. Although I don’t have crows feet or major wrinkles around my eyes, I do notice an improvement in tone and appearance around my eyes. The cream itself feels very luxurious. No harsh scent. No irritation to my contact lenses or eyes. I’m very pleased.

I received my Shiseido eye cream just in time! I have been battling puffiness & dark circles under my eyes. I use a serum plus cream for puffiness and concealer for the dark circles. Every concealer I tried ended up getting texturized under my eyes highlighting my wrinkles and making my under eye area look worse! It turns out that the concealers were not the problem, it was the products I was using prior to the concealer. Since switching to Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream, every concealer I own goes on smooth. This cream is rather heavy and oily so a little goes a very long way. After topping it with concealer, I lightly press setting powder under my eyes and have no problem with texture or fine lines. Since I’ve been using this eye cream, I’ve noticed a reduction in my fine lines. I use the cream every morning and night and absolutely love it!

I received this product as a free sample in a Vox Box from Influenster. I was so excited to try this product because I heard that it had great results in only one week. I must say, I did see results after one week! I used this product for one week on one eye to see the difference and you can totally tell which eye I had been using it on! My first impression was the packaging was beautiful. When I opened it, the smell was a bit floral but not overwhelming. I liked the little applicator it came with. When I put it on the first night, it did feel really thick and I didn’t know if I’d be able to wear it morning and night like it said on the packaging. However, when I tried it the next morning, it worked well under my makeup and didn’t make it wear any differently. The first thing I noticed with the use of this was that my eyes seemed much more moisturized. By the end of the week, my fine lines had lessened in number and depth. I don’t have any real wrinkles but if it works that fast on fine lines I would imagine that it would work on wrinkles too, although it would probably take longer to notice a difference. I like the amount you get in the container because you don’t really need that much for each application. $70 is more on the expensive side, but it definitely works better than other eye creams or serums I’ve used. Now that I’ve been using it on both eyes for a few weeks, I’ve decided to only use it at night but I am still seeing results!

I’m pushing 50 and have fairly dark circles as well as wrinkles along my upper and lower lashline.  I’ve tried numerous products with little success but this one is promising.  I have noticed in my three weeks of use that my lines have softened and my dark circles have lightened.  The product is very creamy but slightly greasy.  I can only use it at night because it sits on the skin.  I don’t mind this because it keeps the skin around and my eyes and on eyelids extremely moisturized.  A pro tip is to use the small application blade that is provided to get directly below the lash line.  The only downside to the product is that  I can’t use it during the day.   The product is just too heavy and doesn’t play well with my concealer.

It’s a really great product. Shiseido has actually been a favorite of mine for an eye cream for a long time. I’ve been using one of their other products I won’t mention it here because this one’s actually really good for probably about five or six years. And it’s typically at the top of the Allure listings for a list for being one of the best eye creams. What I do like about this is that I like to put my finger in a pot versus squeezing something out I feel like it makes it that I’m actually controlling the amount that’s going around my eyes. I do love massaging around my area I absolutely love the way it feels. Typically  my eyes are not good with a cream,  I need more of like a lighter weight gel or lighter weight cream but this one is actually a really good consistency good texture and a good weight. I say that because sometimes some of the eye creams give me those little white bumps around my eyes because they’re too heavy.This one’s awesome I like it I’ve been using it for three weeks I’ve definitely seen results I found that my eyes just look better brighter healthier and some of the little fine lines are starting to just fade away. I love it I recommend it.

Love everything about this product. A little goes a long way and it stays for all night long!! I love that it smells so pleasant and luxurious. I have been using this product for last 2 weeks and I already see huge improvement on my dark circles.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review or opinion of it. Overall, I’d say it’s extremely hydrating. It does a great job plumping up the eye area and limiting the visibility of wrinkles. It does not get rid of wrinkles per say. Overall, I would definitely continue pur Co asking because it has been by far the most eye hydrating product I’ve tried to date!

I really like this eye cream. It’s smooth, creamy, and very hydrating. It feels great going on! There is no residue or residual oily feeling.  I’m a contact wearer and sometimes eye creams will bother my eyes if my contact lenses are in, but I’ve had no issues using this eye cream. I only gave 4 stars because I’ve been using it for a couple weeks now and only see a moderate difference in the lines around my eyes, but the area is so perfectly hydrated and I do see some improvement so I’d still recommend it.

I enjoy this cream it feels very moisturizing under my eye. I have Ben using it for a week and have not yet seen any improvement but it’s likely that it’s just ok short of a time. I will update after I finish the jar

review_title: Actual results from an eye cream!
review_text: Thanks Influenster for giving me the opportunity to try Shiseido’s Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream. I own what I think may be the previous version of this product, the Benefiance WrinkleResist24 Eye Contour Cream. That was my eye cream HG before, but this new product tops it! First, a tiny amount goes a long way with this cream. My biggest issue with the WrinkleResist24 cream is that I had to wait a while for the product to sink into my skin as it was a bit heavy. The Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream remedies that problem as it is much lighter! To me, it is the perfect balance of rich hydration without heaviness. My eye area felt immediately softer and hydrated, but almost any eye cream can do that. To me, the proof is in continued use. I’ve used this product twice a day since I’ve received it, and I can truly tell a difference in my under eye area and minor crow’s feet. My fine lines are reduced and smoothed out, and although I didn’t think I needed anything for dark circles, my under eye skin looks brighter somehow. Do I look like I’m 18 again? No. I’m instantly suspicious of claims that a product can completely erase all effects of time. Is it the best eye product I’ve tried? Yes, definitely. Not miracles, but real results!

Amazing! This is more hydrating than I anticipated. I use less than a pea size amount under both eyes before applying my full face of makeup and it STAYS hydrated under my concealer and lasts ALL day long. I wore it a little heavier at night but it wasn’t necessary, in fact, I applied too much so the next morning, it hadn’t all sunk in. So it will last me a long time. I have used this for about two weeks and noticed it does help plump and hydrate around the eyes. Whether it reduces fine lines, I don’t yet know, but it will definitely prevent them from getting worse. I did receive this complimentary from Influencer, but I will, without a doubt, repurchase on my own, likely during the VIB sale. I love this eye cream better than Glamglow and Tatcha’s eye cream. I have dry skin and am near 40. I use it ritually day and night, so if you can get a weeks sample worth, you’ll fall in love! The spatula it comes with will have you scooping too much, but it’s a nice addition.

review_title: Honest Review: My two week trial  and counting.
review_text: I received Shiseido Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream Complimentary From Influenster to review. I’m Two weeks in. I feel obligated to you all too really use this- not for 1-3 days and say “my wrinkles are gone. It’s a Christmas miracle“..  PROS: some truly amazing ingredients I’ll  mention a few-lots of GLYCERIN-Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract ( green tea) KOMBU-Bounce Complex: Formulated with green, brown, and red algae which helps address the look of wrinkle formation-one of my favorite ingredients.Squalene, tri-peptide complex to name a few. this is extremely thick in texture appears It’s intended for night. Offers the “spa like”- light scent ( I am highly allergic- no problems with the scent ) sits In a beautiful glass jar w a scooper ( I’ll get to  that) packaging is easy to read, well thought out. CONS: the essentials!!  Linalool- Limonene- Citronellol  The Horror! IMO they should’ve went with “Coffea arabica (coffee) fruit extract” instead of caffeine.. I say this because it is $70+. Caffeine?- it appears to tighten ( tho temporary) as it restricts the blood vessels. Some hv no issues. I just do. My absolute worst and unfortunate .. CINNAMOMUM CASSIA BARK EXTRACT— this is a huge no for myself. I am highly hypersensitive to Cinnamon in my facial anything. Total waste!! The world is ready for All pumps pls. No more jars/scoopers.. they are dirty- little fingers- tired fingers get in the jars. Who knows? Mom in law fingers ?!?! I mean..sure have a Scoop? This needs Retinol or Vitamin A derivative to offer signs of Wrinkle reduction. I have loved  every moment of this -but will not be purchasing the Benefiance Wrinkle Eye.. I would love to try some with Retinol or a derivative. Wonderful experience! I would recommend to someone with combination/normal skin that wants to shy aaa was y from Retinol bc the Algae’s are phenomenal!! Superb!!

I love this eye cream! Its very moisturizing! I have used it for a couple of weeks once a day, at night. It is a bit oily, so I can’t use it during the day with makeup. I have seen results in fine lines around my eyes. It does a fantastic job of delivering moisture and pumping the skin. Although it is pricey, you only need a tiny bit. I would use this product again.

I truly like this eye cream. It is thick which is perfect at night and smells really nice.The packaging is simple and pretty and the lid is lovely.A little goes a loooooooooong way. No need to go overboard as this is a thick cream.

This is a very rich hydrating cream that really leaves skin hydrated and plumped. You only need to use the tiniest amount to cover the entire eye area. The cream leaves a very greasy residue on the skin. However, the payoff is that it will leave your skin plumped and very moisturized. I don’t believe that there are ingredients, such as retinol, that will actually help to repair fine lines and wrinkles. If you are looking for a highly hydrating eye cream that will leave your skin moisturized and supple this is it.

As other reviews note, this is a rich, emollient cream. It does give a somewhat greasy look to the skin, but I usually wear makeup and haven’t had any issues with how concealer looks over it. I have dry skin, so it actually helps with blending. I don’t have a lot of fine lines and wrinkles, so it’s hard to say how well it works for that, but I’m pleased with it overall. It has a very mild scent, which I appreciate.

I’ve used this product consistently for the past 5 days; both day and night, and I’m seeing the benefits already! Noticeable improvements for reducing my puffy eyes and lessening the appearance of the fine lines/crows feet. I use this as my last step in my routine and my fresh face is so happy with this abundance of hydration after I’ve cleansed & toned. A helpful tip I recently learned: following application in the morning, before applying makeup, I set translucent powder on my face while it’s still dewy from my lotions applied. Then, I set it all using a setting spray... only after the spray has dried so I apply foundation. Wow! The results- Fresh, dewy glow all day long and my makeup doesn’t budge. I usually see creases by mid-day around my eyes but this eye cream has elimated that problem. I’ll be looking for a sale just to be sure I have a spare on hand; pricey but great product with effective results!
This is one of the best eye creams I’ve tried. It is super creamy and smells really nice. I’ve noticed my under eye area feels smoother and silkier after using it. I use it at night.

This eye cream is so rich and hydrating! While it is very thick, it’s not greasy at all and absorbs amazingly well. It provides the smoothest, softest base for under my concealer in the morning. At night, after all my makeup has been removed, I feel like I am giving myself the creamiest eye treatment and I know that I will wake up in the morning with a wonderfully hydrated under eye area. I’ve only been using for a week or so now so I can’t really comment on how it works on fine lines (lucky me, I also don’t really have a problem with those) but I have been super impressed with this eye cream!

I received this product complimentary from Influenster and I absolutely love it! I’m super picky about my skincare products. This cream is great — it’s light, not greasy. There is virtually no fragrance which I love. And I really believe it’s doing the job: my fine lines are not nearly as visible after only a few days of use. Bonus: a little goes a long way so this one jar will easily last for weeks!

review_title: Hello bright and smooth under eyes!
review_text: I didn’t want to like this because it is pricey but I fell in love instead. I’ve been using it for a week and already see a difference on my under eyes. They are brighter and smoother plus this cream works great under my makeup. No creasing! Totally worth the price!  Thank you so much Influenster for giving me the opportunity to try this amazing product!

Wow, what can I say? First, Shiseido is a well known brand in my family - aunties and grandma. So when I received this eye cream I was super excited to try this since I’ve been looking for an eye cream that will help with my fine line and dryness. Like with most of their products, it doesn’t have a harsh smell. It has a light smell, but you can tell the chemical is clean. The product does not have any alcohol in its ingredients! (Alcohol is bad for aging of the skin and dryness) When I apply to my eyes, it’s moisturizing enough for my dry skin but not too oily. I didn’t start to notice any changes for a couple of days. But after applying it for close to a week, my milia started to disappear from applying too much of my old products, and surprisingly, my eyelids started feeling super soft. I didn’t realize I had dark circles until they started disappearing with my eyes looking brighter! Been using this every night now. The price is a little high but the quality that you get from this shiseido eye cream is worth it! I’ve used mid range eye creams a little bit inexpensive than this, but your eyes will thank you with this formulation.

This eye cream cones in a sturdy container with a plastic spatula to help you apply it. I have used the cream for a week and have noticed that my eyes definitely feel more hydrated. I put this thick cream on at night and my eyes are still hydrated the next day. Since I have only been using it for a week it is hard to tell the long term benefits of this product. Currently I love that my eyes feel hydrated.

I am in my early 30’s with minor fine lines around my eyes and normal to dry skin. I absolutely LOVE this eye cream. It gives my skin a dewy look and natural glow. I really like the thick creamy texture but lightweight feel. I like applying day or night in my skin care routine.

review_text: After receiving this eye cream from Influenster and using for one week I’ve found that this unique eye cream is best suited to me as a nighttime eye mask. It does a very good job at keeping my eye area soft, plumped and hydrated! I really like how it truly keeps my 11’s frown lines hydrated creating a smoothed-out result. I use a substantial amount at night, mask style, so come morning it’s still there having not absorbed all the way. I was unable to use this product for daytime use, as it does leave a sticky film which did not play nice with my makeup.

I was not prepared to love this cream as much as I do! First off, the packaging is awesome. It feels sturdy and luxurious. Next, the scent is just amazing. It’s so fresh! But the most important point is IT WORKS SO WELL! I’ve been using this twice a day for just over a week now and I can’t believe the difference in the fine lines around my under eye it has made. Seriously, I’m hooked!

I’ll be 48 this year (yikes lol) I prefer to use skincare to help slow the process vs is fillers.    Shiseido Beneficance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream is truly a unique product.  Love the wand applicator, you don’t have to use your finger to apply the product, more companies should do that.  The product is nice and rich and soaks right in to your skin leaving your skin nice and silky.  It’s significantly reduced the puffiness under my eyes in such a short amount of time.  I’m looking forward to seeing the changes in my skin.

I’ve noticed a smoother looking skin after about a week.

New product excellence award for Shiseido Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream.  Smooth eyes and lessened wrinkles.  My eye area felt hydrated all day, and I noticed that my dark circles seemed brighter.

Skin defiantly feels smoother after a week.

Please lower the price and change back the old formula ASAP. Otherwise it’s no difference from other so called anti-wrinkle eye creams.

I feel this new formula is less rich and not as hydrating.  With the old product I saw results sooner too.  This new formula doesn’t have the same affect.  Please bring the old formula back.

I have very oily skin so when I use oils on my face I never put it all over I just use it as a spot treatment for my acne and let me tell you this oil is amazing. Despite other products with rose making my acne worse when I put this oil on any acne the results were so amazing. I put it on any pimples I had before I went to bed and when I woke up my face was so much clearer and almost all of the redness and inflammation from my acne was gone. Only one or two stubborn pimples remain but they definitely reduced in size. If you have oily skin but still want to try I definitely recommend using it as a spot treatment.

If I could give this 3 1/2 stars I would I love face oils. I have oily skin in some places but I love to use them at night before I go to bed or when my skin is a little dry in the day time, like in the winter. I would not recommend this product if you super oily skin though. I feel like this would be best for people who aren’t older, have dry skin, or suffer from a dull complexion. It left my skin feeling hydrated in the morning but I didn’t really notice it made my skin Moreno luminous or less red. If I hadn’t recieved this as a complimentary sample from Influenster I wouldn’t purchase it again because of the price and minimal results. But I do enjoy it and plan to finish out my sample. It was a good facial oil but just didn’t do everything it claimed and I can see how it might clog your pores if you’re using it too often or too much of it.

review_title: It's not the same as before
review_text: I’m not sure if they changed the formula or if the one I got from sephora was different from when I bought directly from Biossance; but this gave me huge sebum break out; It was strange, I thought it was my time of the month but I stopped using it and returned it. I got towards the end of the old bottle and couldn’t get all the products out

I received this in my Influenster package last week. I love face oils so was excited that this one smelled like rose and was packed with vitamin C. I suffer from dry skin so this was incredible for my face, it absorbs it nicely and leaves a beautiful glow with a hint of roses. I have been using it every night and when I wake up in the morning my skin looks great! I recommend this to anyone looking for a good face oil.

Not everyone is blessed with a skin that’ll react positively to this oil. I’m a 57 year old male spending 500$ annually upwards towards skin care but this oil wins hands down. Got this as a sample and will definitely buy tons! Holy grail? Yes for me but not for everyone.

I got this in my Influenster box with the Squalane + Vitamin C Rose mask. I didn’t think that an oil would give noticeable results like this one did, but I’ve been struggling with severely dry skin/dry patches around the nose and this completely fixed that. It’s absolutely amazing and seems to be helping keep my skin hydrated overnight while making my forehead lines seems less noticeable as well. The glow from this is unreal. My skin is so even, hydrated, and glowy! I did use it right after the mask, but they work amazingly together.
This oil is really nice and it smells good without being too overpoweringly rosy. I really like it!
Great coverage and a lovely smell. Doesn’t go on too thick or feel too greasy. Moisturizes great and a little goes a long way.
Okay, so, it’s not the best Vit C I’ve ever used. But I love the way it makes my skin feel! I’ve been using it as a moisturizer and haven’t needed anything else.

I absolutely LOVE this product. Completely transformed my skin for a more plump, bright, soft textured skin. I use it religiously and never skip a morning but the only thing about this product that leads me to reduce from five stars is that the dropper is short and it won’t pick up the end of the product a fourth of the oil from the bottom of the bottle! I choose this product not only because it was amazing but because it had a dropper and I was completely upset when I couldn’t reach the end. And the opening isn’t like normal bottles, the dropper is held straight so I won’t matter if I held it sideways or whatever to get the product, I’d literally have to pour it in my hands and that wasn’t what I wanted for hygienic purposes. I’ve contacted the brand but they haven’t really done much about it. Hopefully, they will soon

After using a sample size of this oil for a couple of months, I pulled the trigger on the full size. I have fair, reactive, oily skin with random dry spots, and this oil works so well for me. It doesn’t break me out, it helps fade discoloration, and it’s very moisturizing. Several oils I’ve tried, even the squalene oil from this line, feel like they sit on my skin and don’t absorb well. Not the case with this oil—I’ve even use 2-3 drops as my daytime moisturizer prior to SPF, and my foundation went on flawlessly over it. At night, I’ll wait half an hour after applying my nighttime moisturizer and finish with this. If I’ve exfoliated or my skin just feels tired, I’ll use a bit more of this as my only nighttime moisturizer. It just seems to work for me.

I got the cleansing oil, eye gel, gel moisturizer,  and rose oil and have been using them for a few weeks.  I see a noticeable difference in my skin which feels and smells amazing and is more even in skin tone, brighter, and smoother.

Great oil!! I have combo to sensitive skin so not a lot of oil works for me and this is the only oil that’s hasn’t broke me out yet. I’m giving it four starts cuz it’s not really a must have item but rather a good to have item because I realized that my skin got used to this very fast  that it took awhile to absorb unlike the first month of using it.

This is a perfectly fine product, and it worked to moisturize my skin (though I didn’t notice any brightening effect from the vitamin C), but I wouldn’t repurchase. I find that the formulation is needlessly fussy, and I’d prefer to use either pure squalane or a pure oil.

my friend introduced me to this, got a sample of it and now I can’t get enough. It’s worth the price; for any skin types and especially for my acne prone skin, it does not break me out and it helps with reducing redness!

Currently on my third bottle! This is one of my go-to’s, the last step to my skincare regimen. I alternate between this squalane oil and the oil from Kora Organics, both products make my skin glow. I use this during the morning (three drops for my face and neck) and at night (five drops for face and neck). I haven’t gotten any breakouts.

This product is my go-to daytime oil. I learned about it from a Sephora play box and I was hooked. It’s absolutely perfect!  I’ve been using this for over 6 months and my skin has never been or looked better. I usually splurge on face oils cause I think they’re so important, more so than a moisturizer, yet this one is super affordable and just the best!!! This is the first thing I put on after I use my son and park beauty water. I let the oil soak in then follow with Laura mercier tinted moisturizer.  I get compliments on my skin daily (no one thinks I’m my age!). I definitely recommend it. Oh and btw, the bottle lasts a realllly long time. And I don’t skimp!
Good for dry skin concerns with fine lines, spots of hyperpigmentation, and uneven texture

This oil is amazing.  I have extremely sensitive, acne-prone (to the point of cystic acne), and combination oily-and dry skin.  With this being an oil, I was extremely hesitant to try it out of fear of breakouts, but I am so glad I risked it.  It makes my skin feel great, reduced my old acne redness, and even reduced the number of my breakouts.

I really wanted this to work out. I love that the product is local, I loved that the product doesn’t test on animals and uses renewable resources as their main ingredients. Unfortunately what didn’t work out was my skin didn’t stay moisturized throughout the day. I also saw more lines appear on my skin once I changed over to Biossance products. I ended up switching back to my previous moisturizers. At least this made me realize how well they were working.

WORTH EVERY PENNY! I have combination skin and if you do put too much on your face it will make it feel Oiler than normal. I put 2 drops in my palms and press it in my skin and it has transformed my skin! My skin is healthy, glowy, radiant, overall I’m convinced this product is the key ingredient to giving me the skin I’ve always wanted! This product doesn’t break me out or give me black heads, it’s helped with my redness and keeps my pores clean and clear, I love that this product is truly a clean beauty product! I can’t recommend this enough!!

I really love this.  I recently tried Drunk Elephant C firma and didn’t care for it at all. this serum however is amazing. Has lessened my fine lines, especially in the forehead area and pores seem minimized. just perfect.

review_title: wanted to love it so bad
review_text: I wanted to love this. I tried using it several different times, under different circumstances for different periods of time and it never fails that I wake up with white heads every single time.

I am always looking for clean ways to take care of my face.  my skin type: I do have mild Rosacea on my cheeks and small sized pimples occasional  with combo skin.  this stuff is extremely oily and my skin does not absorb it well no matter how little I use.  while my Rosacea has show some improvement this product is not really adding anything to my overall routine.
Made me more dry? Almost felt like my face was more sensitive and red while using this for a few days. Went on to the next oil. Returned and do not regret it.

small but worth it!!! I have extremely dry and sensitive skin and it feels great no burning or oily feeling. just so hydrating and makes my skin so soft and dewy. Just 4 drops is enough for my entire face and neck, highly recommend this stuff!!!!

review_title: Did nothing for my skin concerns
review_text: I used just about the whole bottle and saw no difference in my skin tone or texture. Just did not work for me.

review_title: Every day use on rosacea-areas: happy skin!
review_text: Love this! My skin breaks out easily around nostrils and nose-- rosacea-- and this does not aggravate those areas even when I pat it directly on them, which is a breakthrough for me! The EWG rating is extra reassurance that this is good to slather all over :)
I am in love with this product!

Only started using this (with the moisturizer) 4 days ago. Morning & night. My complexion and firmness of skin have completely changed. I’ve never seen my skin have such a healthy glow! I literally touch my skin all day long it’s so soft!
Amazing product. My skin has looked and felt so wonderful since trying this. Definitely will be purchasing again as soon as I run out of it!

This product has SERIOUSLY changed my winter skincare game. I’ve been struggling to find an oil for sensitive skin that didn’t cause pores to clog.
