This is the holy grail product that hydrates while not clogging up your skin. It also removed all the redness I had on my cheeks!! I am a believer and will be a Biossance customer for life. Also trying the pro-biotic moisturizer and the pair is a God-send for the harsh DC winters.

review_title: Best for normal to dry skin
review_text: I am new to oils and got the sample size of this product. At first I hated it and it just left my combo oily skin way too greasy. I was applying it after serum and moisturizer as the last step like a beauty blogger suggested. Well then I tried applying it after cleansing and toning and the difference was like night and day. It sank into my skin and did not leave an oily finish and made it feel very soft. Do not listen to anyone who says to apply oil over moisturizer! Definitely going to use it every day now and not leave it sitting in my drawer like I was. That being said, I think the Sunday Riley Luna makes my skin feel better. This is a nice product but personally I don’t feel like I need it for my very oily combo skin. Just make sure you are using it correctly.

I like to pamper myself with faceoils at night before bed. And this is one of my fav. It absorbs nicely, doesn’t stain my pillow, wake up in the morning my skin is soft supple and feels like the oil has sunk in. I only use three drops for all over my face. So even though the price seems pricey, I only need 3 drops everynight. The oil also doesn’t give me breakouts, unlike other face oil I had. Overall, this is my holy grail face oil.

If you’re in the market for a beauty oil or want to try one because your fave “beauty guru“ uses one on their social media outlet; they haven’t experienced anything! I am a dry skin type but LOVE full coverage foundations. For the past two weeks I have been adding 2-3 drops to my KVD foundation and everyone has been complimenting my skin and wanting my foundation. The honest truth is that this oil has changed the game on my application of this foundation. Not only am I still very hydrated throughout the day with this beauty concoction, but my skin is brighter and my trouble area’s are smoother! This oil is top 2 for me to mix with my KVD foundation which by the way is made for an oily skin type. #skingoals
amazing my holy grail. this oil has completely changed how my skin looks an feel my redness had gone down. the over all texture of my face has softened. I will buy the full size

I wanted a moisturizing and brightening product that had no iffy ingredients. This meets those requirements. I used to use products Retinol/Vitamin A, but am trying to pause that for now. I liked that this oil has Vitamin C which I thought could help my dark spots. So far I like it, it feels luxurious (maybe because of the cost, but also the packaging is really nice). I admit that I don’t use it regularly enough where I think I have noticed a difference in my face. I like the scent, and that it absorbs quickly. I have oily skin so I also try to use it sparingly. I have gotten a few very small zits after applying the oil at night after my shower, but I don’t know if the oil caused the breakouts. Overall it makes me feel fancy and moisturizes without a greasy feeling.

I love love love this product !! It was a game changer on my beauty routine. I have a pretty dry skin and it absorbs all my moisturizers in like 2 seconds and usually my make up didn’t last long because my skin was so dry. Now I apply this oil 10 min before I start doing my make up and it lasts almost all day! I also apply it at night and I wake up with a very fresh skin!
My skin needed this spf but I add powder to get the airbrushed look Used this to do a photo shoot

For a long time I thought IT cosmetics foundations were overhyped but I love this. I use a pretty small amount, like half a pump and it spreads so nicely and looks so seamless and natural although it adds really good coverage. I can’t wait to get a bit tanner because this is my summer shade but I can’t get enough of it. I find that it doesn’t crease in my fine lines or accentuate pores either.

I am obsessed and choose this over all my other foundations. It is easy and does not clog pores. You can still see dark acne marks and it transfers if not set. I prefer this finish over the illuminating version.
Disappointed! My face looks very cakey. Doesn’t cover my dark spots too much but it’s also not great for layering, hence the cakeyness! I had to dab off with kleenex.  My pores & lines were showing.
Undertones for people of color are just awful. Do better IT cosmetics!!!!!

I LOVE this! This is my go to every day foundation and has been for a few months now. I don’t plan on changing it anytime soon and even bought a second bottle. It s easy to apply and sits nicely on the skin. It definitely helps with oil control for me and stays on pretty well throughout the day. Definitely a great buy!

I had high hopes for this CC cream because I use a couple other IT Cosmetics items as staples in my beauty routine, but found this product pretty disappointing. As another reviewer noted, the “oil-free/matte“ name may be misleading. The product may be formulated without oil, and may settle to a matte finish after application, but it does nothing to control or resist oily skin. I have to blot after two hours, and by the end of the day, this stuff is just... gone? It also leaves a residue/stain on my brushes and beauty sponges. This product might be better for someone with more advanced signs of aging and less oily skin than I have. It does look very nice and natural immediately after being applied, but for the price, I was expecting better. I won’t purchase this again.

I was using the Fenty foundation and an employee at my local store suggested this instead. I’ve always had my foundation become oily and slide off very quickly. This solved the issue. I love the SPF, too. This created a nice finish, and it’s super easy to apply more throughout the day. It’ll blend right into an already finished area.
Heavy, full coverage and moisturizing. NOT mattifying by any means. I have combo skin which is not incredibly oily and this product breaks down so quickly on my face.

I like the coverage and color of this product. However, it really did nothing at all for my oily skin. In fact, my skin got more oily more quickly using this than with my typical foundation (Lancôme). From this aspect, it was disappointing and I won’t buy it again.

LOVE. It’s so hard to find good coverage that is oil free AND has a high SPF! I’ve gotten so many compliments on my skin lately. Love that it not only makes my skin look great but it’s protecting me from UV.

i really enjoy this product. I would say it’s heavier than a normal CC cream though. Still gives an exceptional amount of coverage and it does hold up matte. Better to use with a sponge rather than a brush. It is quite expensive though so i find i run out quickly. The shade range is not great either. I wear Neutral Medium when i am at my least tan (winter) and it is a perfect match but as i get darker it is harder to find something that matches me. It is either too light or way too dark. If you find your perfect match i would strongly suggest this product. If you are in between then don’t even spend the money.
Love this so much! The face that it’s a CC cream makes the coverage very shocking. I would have never expected a coverage of a CC cream to be like this but I still love it. Feels very lightweight.

I was really excited when I came across this product, but was immediately disappointed. It does not blend as well as the original cc+ cream. The color match is also off from the original. I’d rather touch up my makeup throughout the day with the OG than use this one.
I love the coverage, satiny smooth, and love that it includes so much spf!
Great CC Cream, I really enjoy using this for everyday. I do have dry skin and prefer the illuminating version!

excellent coverage on my scars on my face and redness. top it off with toofaced powder and my skin looks amazing. i have very oily skin so unfortunately i do have to reapply powder to take away the shininess away. no complaints though. is it just me or does it leave an unpleasant odor on your face afterwards?

I really like this for my primary winter makeup. It’s not oily but moistures just enough so my skin looks normal. It also stays on decently well. I only use face lotion and then this product on my face and does a good job.

This foundation is great as far as coverage goes, but for whatever reason it really accentuates my texture. However, it’s one of the only foundations I can find that actually matches my skin’s undertones, so I remedy the texture problem by mixing it with some primer (I use the Olehenriksen’s banana bright face primer) or another more radiant foundation.

review_title: best mattifying product for my tzone
review_text: This is the only product I found that helps keep my tzone not oily throughout the day. No other foundation has the same mattifying power as this one. I have combination sensitive skin and it doesn’t cause any breakouts or other skin problems However this product is not hydrating enough for the rest of my face so I have to use this on my tzone and the original cc cream for the rest of my face, which can get pretty costly. I wish they would make the mini sized ones in all the shades!!!
This stuff is awesome! I actually really like it for my oily skin!! At the end of the day I do have a little shine but it’s a good shine.

I can’t say enough about this product! It’s great for my oily skin, and I only have to blot or add powder once a day, as a pose to other foundation products, where my face looked like a grease ball in a couple of hours. This definitely isn’t full coverage but more of a no makeup, makeup look (better for day to day.) I would suggest layering or caking this on because it tends to make you look orange. I absolutely love this stuff! A little goes a long way. I use this everyday and it last about 3 months. If you want a day to day foundation for oily skin, this stuff works great!
One of the better foundations I’ve tried! I love that it has such high spf but doesn’t feel too heavy. I would agree it’s not as full coverage as other foundations, but I prefer that.

New favorite! It blends so well with my skin and actually stays matte throughout the day. Love that it also has mineral SPF and anti-aging properties! I’m definitely going to replace this with the Milk I was using.
I like to thin it out with a moisturizer because it’s more coverage than I prefer, but I really like that thinned out version, it looks like nice skin. Wish they had more shades tho :/

I have really oily skin so its super hard to find foundations and CC creams that matte my face. Even though the coverage is amazing it made my face more oily than normal. I wish it didn’t because it is such a good CC cream other than that one issue.

I love this foundation! I had tried it out when it first came out, and I was the shade light, but after going on some vacations, and spending time in the sun, I got darker.. I just had to go buy this again in the shade that I am now! it applies so beautifully on the skin, and I love that it has SPF 40!

review_title: really wanted to like this product
review_text: I really wanted to love this product!!! I have regular skin, not dry, not oily. I bought this to cover up my acne scarring but it doesn’t cover anything. When I apply it to my face, my cheeks get super dry and peel. Really don’t like this product but I’m keeping it because of the spf in it which I really need and because supposedly it’s good for the skin
Love this!  Though I like the regular CC cream it was a bit too oily for my skin.  This gives the same great coverage without the excess oil.
I NEVER write reviews!! I’m almost 46 and this does it ALL!! It gives me coverage, lasts all day, looks NATURAL, is buildable when I want more coverage. You will NOT be disappointed

I really love this cc cream. Its not full coverage but it covers enough to make your skin look beautiful. It doesn’t set completely matte which is why I took a star off but if you set it, it definitely helps set it. It makes my skin feel really nice, breathable. It photographs very very well!
I like the product but, I have oily skin and it doesn’t perform well throughout the day. I end up having makeup sliding around

I received a free mini makeover at a Sephora and this is what matched my skin tone perfectly! It’s so nice and natural looking. I’m not a huge makeup person, but I love this with some bronzer, blush, and highlight!
very light coverage, im very surprised a like the finish, feels like nothing on the skin

review_title: MUCH better than the original version
review_text: SO MUCH better than the original version. Feels much more natural, not sticky like the other one, easy to blend. Just the perfect coverage. Use this everyday to work
I’ve always been a fan of this CC cream, and the matte version is my favorite of all! Love it

This Foundation is not too matte but i still really like it. I’ve noticed my face looks alot healthier since I’ve been using this. I have oily skin and I do have to powder my face after a couple hours but this is a good foundation.  I think people with dry skin could use this also because like I said it’s not too matte. It also has alot of good ingredients good for your skin. I like the fact it’s not overbearing matte because I have big pores and this doesn’t make my pores stand out. I bought this in the kit with the samples for 40$. I will definitely buy this again!
Product is great just wrong color

I was a big fan of the original formula so I was very excited when I saw that it came in matte. The first day I moisturized, applied the CC cream then set with powder. About an hour in my skin got very flaky, cakey, and dry. So the following day I tried to use it by itself (after moisturizing)   and about a couple hours in everything started to settle in all the lines and pores and made my skin look very dry and patchy. The third day I moisturized, primed, then applied the cream. After a few hours some parts of my face got very oily and the coverage was fading, in other parts it made my skin very dry and patchy looking. It also caked and intensified in all the fine lines. I really don’t have many lines or wrinkles on my face and it made me look like I did. So I decided to just give up and return this product and go back to the original formula which always had a very natural smooth finish.
Loving how it covers my redness

Been searching for the perfect foundation for years, tried this on a whim even though SPFs typically are super oily on me this one is perfect! The coverage is just what a need and it’s a very matte finish that keeps me shine free all day! I hate the feeling of thick suffocating foundation and this is the best I’ve ever used hands down.
Love this better than original CC cream especially since my skin can get a little oily as the day goes on

I really like this foundation. I have applied it with a sponge and after it is on it looks flawless! It covers all of my imperfections and dark marks, but YOU HAVE TO SET IT!!! If you do not, it will wipe off and will not stay matte throughout the day. The people that do not like this foundation do not set it and thats why they end up returning this product. The only downside I have is that even though my skin is light and I choose the ’light’ color, it ends up looking A LOT darker on my skin and I have to blend it all the way down my neck. I would purchase this again just in a different color.

I love this product! I have never written a review on Sephora because I’ve never liked a product enough to leave a review but I had to make an exception with this product. This has quickly become one of my favorite foundations! It controls my oils and last all day long. I never have to reapply this foundation and I love that cause my days are usualy pretty long so I’m so glad they made this foundation because the original one doesn’t last all day on me.
I might just use this as my foundation! It gives an awesome amount of coverage while looking natural and lively. I absolutely love it.
Is not full coverage, does not last more than 2 hours before cracking and wearing off.  I am oily and it was not matte, I was shiny after just a few hours.

Keeps my face matte but starts to settle into my fine lines and break down at the 5-6 hour mark.  It also transfers.  I’m older and I have more texture than younger women who this may work better for.  Love the anti-aging ingredients!

I randomly picked this up while at Sephora, and I’m so glad I did! I usually get Smashbox CC cream, and I like this even better. The price was a little better, and the coverage was a little more transparent. I have freckles, so I want them to shine through my foundation, but I need pore coverage because I was on a swim team my whole life, and now I’m in my thirties, so... pores. Anyway, I love the tube, and the pump nozzle. The creamy coverage is beautiful and bright on my skin, and it feels very moisturizing. Just, love this stuff!

I was very excited to switch from IT COSMETICSYour Skin But Better™ CC ™ Cream with SPF 50  because I have oily skin - and it felt like it slid off my face and even the best setting powder couldn’t tone it down.THIS version is perfect for me. It does not setlle into my lines if I use a good primer (No Poreblem over here!) and is truly MATTE. My skin looks perfect and truly looks like a Snapchat filter!The only reason I didn’t give this 5 stars is the shades are so whack. Light is NOT light and I feel like it got darker on my face througouht the day. There aren’t many options, either.

I was so excited to try this as the claims seemed amazing! Sunscreen and skincare in one seemed great! No matter the type of primer (used 3 different types of primers!), set and sprayed and did not matter if used a brush or beauty blender! This broke up within an hour and rubbed off easily. With Co. Bo skin this should have been perfect. Will be returning!
It’s amazing, I love it!!!!! My skin looks healthy and it feels really soft on the skin! I recommend it!
Nice all over coverage.  I’m used to a tinted moisturizer, so this feels a little drying on my skin.  So add a moisturizer first!

best cc cream i’ve ever used!! i’ve used the other it cosmetics original and highlighting cc cream and i gotta say this is the best one out of all three! one star off bc they expanded the shade ranges to 8? but i still couldn’t find a perfect match for my skin.

Love this! I have really oily skin but this makeup stayed matte all day for me without feeling heavy. It’s definitely thicker than the original but was still very easy to blend with my beauty blender.

I was really excited to try this because it promises so many things however, it melted off my face after a couple of hours. If you have oily skin this product is not for you! It lifts off your skin, especially around the nose area even if you set it and use a primer. Also be careful if you have sensitive skin because this gave me tiny little bumps all over my face.

I was so excited to try this since I’m such a huge fan of the  original CC cream... but it fell flat!  It’s thicker and doesn’t go on very smooth.  It really does nothing for my skin, and the matte look only lasts for about 2 hours.  I’ll continue using the OG version after I finish this tube.  It controls oil much better than this stuff!

review_title: Stay away if you have combination skin
review_text: I wanted to give this product a try since I have combination skin, but it was awful. My pores looked huge! my skin looked so dry and around my T area it was just HORRIBLE! Cakey and falling apart. If you have combination skin I don’t recommend this product!

I tested this for a week with different techniques, and unfortunately it just never sat well throughout the day for me. Such a bummer about this product. I highly recommend getting a sample made first if you’re interested in this item.
Love this. Have been getting compliments on my skin when I wear it. I was using the more translucent version but found my face to be too shiny. The matte version is “just enough” matte.

I tried using it cosmetics cc cream a few years ago while I was in high school. When it comes to my complexion, I am extremely picky on what goes on my skin. I have combination skin so I have to be very careful that nothing makes me too oily or too dry. The original cc cream did not work too well for me back then, also keep in mind that I wasn’t using the right skincare so that probably has a lot to do with it and now, it works better for me but I still wouldn’t say it’s my favorite. This version of it though is great! I don’t like heavy foundations. I prefer build able coverage and something that makes my skin still look like my skin just a little more even! This does that and even though it’s matte, I wouldn’t say it’s a flat or full matte...more of a natural matte finish or maybe velvet. The only thing I have to say though is even though it says full coverage, if you have redness or blemishes, you’re probably going to need something to cover that underneath. I have some breakthrough redness on my cheeks and chin if I don’t use concealer or a couple dots of bye bye redness underneath which I also really like but still..it does give a nice look and I’ve also found that my pores look cleaner and the gunk does get pulled out wearing this. It works for me in the hot and humid weather but come late fall/winter, we’re going to have to see.
Not impressed, it didn’t blend well and it made me break out.  Not matte, I was really hoping to love this but I didn’t and I returned it.

This product has way more coverage than I was expecting. Two pumps and it’s comparable to a medium-full coverage foundation for me. When I bought this product I wanted something lighter for the summer than what I typically wear for foundation. I do love that it has SPF in it and I like the skin-like finish it has after using one pump. With that being said, it does move around your face throughout the day even with powder applied. Also from what I experienced, if you use more than one pump there is some cracking around fine lines on your face. I’m glad I bought it for the summertime, but I probably won’t be buying it again when there are way better options out there for CC/BB creams and tinted moisturizers.
I have the oiliest skin ever . It did not work out for me , which I’m upset about because it is actually full coverage .
Love this. Does exactly what is says it’ll do.

With the original CC and the illuminating CC, my face would be a big greaseball within an hour or two. But using the new CC matte, my oil stays away for a good 6 hours. And around that time, I only have to blot my NOSE and T zone area! I used to have to blot my entire face. That’s a win in my book! It is very thick as others have said, but I think that’s due to the formula including 3 different clays. Clay is thick people! Just put a little extra time giving it a good blend and it’s perfect. I don’t find it to be full coverage, but I don’t have skin issues so light to medium coverage is just fine for my face.

Definitely not matte in my opinion. Lasted on me for 4 hours before I started to get shiny. First photo is before and next photo is after. For reference, I have an oily T-zone. As the day wore on, I could feel my face beginning to feel more and more caked, but I powered through the cakiness to see what this foundation would feel like in it’s final form. At the end of the day, I ended up looking like the attached photo. To fully test out the mattifying prowess of this new foundation, I tested it out with different versions of my morning skincare routine. Test 1: Toner, moisturizing gel, lotion and sunscreen underneath the foundation. First day I tried it with this routine I had much regrets and decided to go the next day forgoing the lotion. Now underneath I only had toner, gel and sunscreen. It was still a mess. Then I decided to skip the gel, and only use toner and sunscreen. I was still oily. No matter how much times I try to reduce my morning skin care routine, I would still end up oily at the end of the day. The foundation itself is kind of thick, so I tried my best to apply it thinly, as that is how I try to prevent it from caking. But alas, I could not prevent it from doing so. However I give the product 2 stars because it performed well and looked great on me in those 4 hours, and the product packaging is so pretty! Also as a warning, the SPF included in here is not enough if you were to stay outside for more than an hour in the sun, as the amount used when applying foundation is not enough to protect you from the sun. So although this foundation does include spf, please do not rely on this to be your sole source of protection from the sun.I received this product from Bzzcampaign to review.
Its amazing! Goes on really well, is a match for my skin, and its just flawless

I used this foundation on a very hot day, 109 degrees to be exact. I was a little hesitant since I had not used it before nor heard of it. I was pleasantly surprised when it stayed on my face and didn’t smear, even though I was sweating. It lasted through the day and the SPF40 was an added bonus. I received it for free from IT Cosmetics and will be definitely purchasing it once I finish it.

review_title: Love it - better than the OG one!!
review_text: I’m a formal lover of the OG CC cream until I tried this new matte one! I have combination skin and tend to get oily later in the day, especially in the heat. However, after wearing the matte cc cream all day - some being in the VA heat AND going to the gym, I did not experience any shine or transfer!! This cc cream still has a sheen to it (similar to the OG), but doesn’t get oily! This cc cream is now a must-have!!!
A little heavier than I’m used to.  But I still will wear it because of the high SPF.

review_title: A Snapchat filter for your face.
review_text: I loved it. It went on really smooth and lasted for a good 5-6 hours before I felt the need to take it off. After so long my face felt oily. I love the coverage and it instantly made my skin look so good, basically disappeared my pores and blemishes. My foundation doesn’t work that good so I have been using this cc cream in place of it. Only downside is it’s not really matte for very long after  applying but it does leave n almost satin-ish look which I liked more. Also the overall oil co trol was a bit lacing but the fact that it has spf and good coverage made up for it. I was able to try this for free thanks to BzzAgent and I’m glad I did because I definitely recommend this and I personally love it and will be using it from now on.
love love love it!! love all their products that I’ve tried..

I love the original CC cream so I was excited for this once since I can get oily at times. I felt like the color of this was darker than the regular one but it was okay. I’ll keep wearing it, I liked it.*I received the product for free from IT Cosmetics to try.

So I got this product for free for IT Cosmetics an exchange for a review. I have to say I’m disappointed. It goes on very thick and does not have good coverage. The color also is not true to what is says “light” it is definitely darker then I expected.

Not the color i expected. I got a free CC from IT cosmetics and i recieved the color i requested. It ended up being to light even though the picture showed it was darker. I did apply some to my face and it felt ok. Had good coverage which i like. I just wish it was my shade so i can rock it!

I was really excited when I found out that this was coming out since I’ve been using the original formula for years and love it. I first tried it using the primer that I’ve always used, and felt that, even with the matte translucent powder that I love and always works for me, the CC cream never set. Within 15 minutes I was looking oilier than normal. The cream never set on my skin and felt really heavy. I’ve tried it with primer, without primer, with moisturizer, without moisturizer... but it feels the same. I will finish it up probably mixing it, but will stick to the original formula that is WAY better

review_title: Love it but could be better
review_text: I received this product from IT Cosmetics to try and Let’s say it is good however could be better. The package is pretty. I love how it has the pump so one or two pump is sufficient for whole face. The shade did not match my skin tone perfectly but they do offer a variety of skin tones. It does come with Matt finish and provides proper coverage. However I did notice that it feels a bit dry and does not settle in well on my skin. So I have to put in a moisturizing primer under it. I would definitely love it better if it can be a one step process.

Let me start out by saying this was sent to me complementary to test and review. I am glad I got the opportunity to try this out. it is simply great. I love how it is matte and it feels light on the skin. The only reason it I did not give it 5 stars is because I’m currently tanned and it doesn’t fit me at the moment. I recommend it!

I received this product from Sephora and couldn’t wait to give it a try. I had heard good things from other people and am happy to say that this CC cream didn’t disappoint! I wore it to the zoo in the middle of a 95* day and then to a nighttime outdoor concert, and my skin stayed fully covered, no melting off! I definitely recommend this to others and will be adding this to my regular makeup routine!

This is a product that you MUST swatch in person. IT Cosmetics did an amazing job with this formula   the coverage, and you can’t beat the SPF. I encourage anyone and everyone to try this - no matter your skin type. I have combination skin :)

I wanted to try something new for my skin this summer and I came across this product on Sephora. I recently stopped using my regular foundation for getting in on new ‘bare skin’ trend. I have a very dry and oily skin at the same time  (combo)! This turned out to be a perfect product for me! Left my skin feeling soft and kept it moisturized all day long. Not to mention it served as a sunscreen lotion, too! Will re-order and recommend to my friends and family as well.

I’m surprised by all of the negative reviews. I purchased this myself and really enjoy it! It gives me full coverage, a matte finish, and hides my pores. When using this in conjunction with the Laura Mercier Foundation Primer and IT Cosmetics Pressed Bye Bye Pores Powder this lasted all day on me with no creasing or separating! This looks FAR better than the other two cc creams on my oily and acne prone skin. If you’ve wanted to love the original, but can’t get past the smell or shine - I think you’d really enjoy this.

review_title: Good CC Cream for Combo Skin
review_text: This is actually one of the better CC Creams I’ve used. I have combination skin, with extreme oiliness in my T zone. I found that this product actually kept me fairly oil-free which I haven’t experience with most CC Creams I’ve tried in the past. However, I will say that this product in particular doesn’t seem very matte as it claims. I would describe it more as dewy but it still looks good with my skin type.The color was a perfect match for my skin. I didn’t need to use much of the product to get full coverage either. Overall, good product. Would recommend to those with combination skin.I received this product free from IT Cosmetics for my review.

If you’re not a true oily skin girl, don’t buy this! I love the original and was excited to try this matte version for summer. But this stuff literally made me look dead with chalky skin. Oh and the fair light is the weirdest shade ever. It has a pink undertone but still is warm at the same time. Awful shade selection for us redheads. I’ll stick to the original in Fair even though that is still a bit dark. I’ll make it work because I do love that formula. Bottom line, their *step up* in shade range is still not cutting it. And I’m disappointed I couldn’t make this work for my combo skin. Sad. 3 stars because oily skin girls might love it.

I received a this product free from IT cosmetics to test and I have to say it does seem to be a good product. Sometimes it’s hard to choose a shade from pictures online, but the light medium matches daily well with my skin tone. There is a slight orange hue to it but that might just be due to the shade I chose being a little dark for my complexion. The product does apply smoothly and doesn’t appear shiny at all. Also, it covered some dark spots I have from previous acne outbreaks. All in all I would be willing to recommend this product to friends.

I was so excited and thought I had found something I could stick with year round.. the concept and ingredients are great! But this was a big let down for me. I applied several different ways, on different days. Each time, it broke up and moved around on my face, and only within a few hours. It transfers so bad I had to touch up after a quick phone call, due to smudging. I have normal, breakout prone skin and I am used to full coverage foundations. But this just feels so heavy on my face and creases pretty bad too. I was surprised when I saw how bad this separates on the face and settles into undereyes and fine lines. I will definitely be returning this.

review_title: Thick, but has great coverage, doesn't feel cakey
review_text: To be up front, I received this product for free from itcosmetics to review. I got the fair shade and started trying it immediately (it’s 110 in Texas, so perfect). I first tried a small pump on my hand and was a little turned off by how thick it is, but it promised to be matte, stay all day, and have SPF, so I gave it a go. The first try I wasn’t a huge fan due to the thickness still. However, the second day I used a damp beauty blender and spent a lot more time blending. I ended up using way less product and it looked SO much better. I have been using it for about a week and a half now and am very happy with it. It’s not something I would probably wear year round, but it’s beautiful for work and date nights!!!

Currently, it is over 100 degrees where I live, which is why I usually go without makeup during the summer. IT Cosmetics made a slam dunk with this CC  Cream! I am able to wear it without worry all day long. I have oily skin some days, dry skin other days, and always have some blemishes. This works any time and makes me feel like a million bucks! I have used this for a few days now and am confident that I will continue using it on a regular basis. It is a great product!!

review_title: Love the coverage, hate the feel.
review_text: I received Your Skin But Better CC  Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40 as part of a promotion from IT Cosmetics. I first was surprised by the color I received. I usually am a fair, but chose the light color due to the fact that I have quite a bit more tan from the summer sun. It is much darker than I would have thought or even than what is pictured on the box. I don’t wear a lot of makeup but even still this feels very heavy on my face. I love how much it is supposed to do (foundation, sunscreen, detoxify, anti-aging, etc), but it feels thick and oily on my face. I had to use a powder after application so it wouldn’t feel so tacky. I do love how well it covers and it hasn’t made me break out. I have very sensitive skin and it has not given me any bad reactions which is an A  for me.

I received a free product from a BzzAgent campaign to try out. I must say, I was weary at first to try it because i was so set in using my other favorite products. But once I got over that and finally used it I fell in love with this CC cream.I received this in Light, which matched my skin tone perfectly. Easy application, no greasy feeling or heaviness.
I absolutely loved this product! It was very creamy and thick which made it great for covering blemishes and freckles.

I bought the medium tan for my olive skin tone and unfortunately it has a pink undertone to it.  It doesn’t match my neck or my body.  The cream feels very heavy on the skin and looks like I’m wearing a lot of makeup.  It also smells and applies like glue and highlights my pores big time.  I was very disappointed in this product.

I received this product from IT Cosmetics for free in exchange for my honest review of the product. I was very excited to try this product. I loved the light weight feel of the product and it is very matte which is perfect for someone like me who seems to get oily only after an hour. However, the shade was a tad too light for me and gave me an ashy look. Aside from wishing there were more inclusive shades for people of color, i liked the product. I may try the deep shade to see if it would be a better match since i am a warm with a red undertone, not yellow.

I received this free from IT Cosmetics in exchange for my honest feedback. First I have to say that this color is not at all what I thought it would be, it’s way darker than the picture shows. Woo i wasn’t really able to test it outside of my home without looking like a fool. So I did try it inside my home, yup! Looked really crazy like I didn’t know how to apply makeup lol! But other than the fact I can’t ever wear it, I would say it seems to be a great product. Easy to dispense, a nice matte finish, smells nice....I hope they fix the color guide though...so if you are good my to buy it go 1-2 shades lighter.

review_title: Great finish and color match for me
review_text: I received this product at no cost from IT cosmetics to review. I love that ut has 40 spf and that it is so lightweight. It dries smoothly and is full coverage. A little bit goes a long ling way so dont have a hand hand when putting it on. It blends nicely! It was a perfect color match for me and I have light medium skin tone. It lasted throughout my 13 hr busy work shift while running around and staying active. never had to reapply and I have oily skin so I was surprised it lasted so long. It is a great amount of product so it will last you a long time. Very happy with the product and I will be purchasing again when I run out of product. I have been telling everyone about this because it is amazing!!

I love how this cc cream feels on my skin! I just put it on and had to write a review. My skin looks matte but still has a glow to it and feels moisturized. Super happy with the purchase. I have oily/combination skin hope it lasts all day.

I received this product from IT cosmetics and the color was a perfect match! My skin is very oily and prone to breakouts in the summer, so I wanted something with full coverage, yet light! This is now my go to! Blends right in and keeps my fave oil free for the 10 hours I wear my makeup!

Amazing product, I have purchased so many different foundations in the past and never found anything that works for my skin until now. This product has it all, it’s moisturizing, refreshing, oil free, long lasting formula plus sunblock. I have complexion skin and finding something that fit my skin is a plus. It only takes a small amount of product to get a full coverage. Blends in beautifully and provides a natural finish plus it conceals all of my blemishes, scars, and dark spots. I truly recommend this product, thanks to bzzagent for giving me the opportunity to try this product out.

This CC cream has a smooth coverage and lasts pretty well. It provides evening out of skin tones and a light amount of coverage. It didn’t settle under my eyes and I did not bake nor use a setting spray. The only downside is using the product without any additional finishing is it did sweat off.Note: I was sent this product to try all opinions are my own.

Thanks to It cosmetics I received my free trial of the Neutral Tan. I absolutely love the way the foundation feels. It has everything I look for in a foundation amazing coverage, get sunscreen, not to thick plus it lasted the entire time I was paddle boarding. I would definitely recommend this product.

review_title: Great for some, not so much for others
review_text: Cleanses face amazingly but mascara not so much. I recommend unless all you wear is mascara.

I have been using this religiously as a makeup remover and have felt a nearly instant difference in the texture of my skin. So smooth! I see a lot of other reviews saying things about a residue is leaves. I bet it would if I didn’t know I needed to remove the balm with a face wash… I’ll be purchasing again when I run out in a couple months.

It pains me to say that I love this. I normally use the INKEY list oat cleansing balm and have only ever used that for an oil makeup remover. It’s significantly cheaper and I never had problems with it but they were out of stock and I needed a makeup remover. So I went with this one despite the price and YES it is worth the money. It rubs on more nicely than the other and it comes off much easier/removes makeup cleaner than the INKEY list balm. My only concern is I wonder if this will last me a long enough time with the amount in the jar. But I have sensitive acne prone skin and it hasn’t caused me any new breakouts.

Wow! I have been a dedicated Clinique cleansing foam user for my daily double cleanse up until recently when a trip to a dermatologist a few months ago screwed up my skin to no end. After several months, I happened upon a sample of this product and gave it a whirl. After one use my skin was smoother, glowing and felt squeaky clean without any associated dryness. My skin just continued to heal each day I used this in my double cleanse. My fine lines have lessened and my skin is smooth while the breakouts have calmed. No allergic reaction or irritation either! The oils used here are low on the comedogenic rating too. It’s worth giving this balm a try if you’ve been struggling with your breakouts like I have.
I love this cleansing balm it melts all of my makeup in a second and washes off easily and doesn’t make me feel oily

review_title: very good product - doesn’t break you out
review_text: It’s a pretty good product for makeup removal. I would say it’s not the best I’ve used, but I’m not upset by it. The one thing it has going for it over my previously used cleansing balms/makeup melts is that it does not break out my skin. Drunk Elephant works better than this, but it destroys my skin. So I think it’s a good trade-off considering. I’ve also tried Farmacy’s balm and I still like this one over it.

As a flight attendant i am required to wear cosmetics for work. I use long wear products that soap or cream cleanser doesn’t completely remove. I can see it on my cleansing brush. Since I am a big fan of apricot oil decided to try this. Removes everything in one step and no more flaky, dry patches. I usually massage it in the leave for a couple of minutes to soften and allow the enzymes to work then massage again and rinse. Not a trace of mascara or long wear foundation. Best part is it’s cruelty-free!
So far my favorite cleansing balm. Doesn’t leave my face feeling greasy. Removes all the makeup.

my go to make up removing cleanser. it doesn’t sting my eyes and the way it takes off the makeup is so satisfying! also when added to water it does emulsify a little which is really nice! it also smells amazing!!
I’ve been using this for over a month and i love it! It really takes off ALL my makeup (mascara included) so easily! It is gentle on my eyes and smells sooo good!

I am obsessed with this product. Feels so lovely when applied to the skin, smells nice without being overly fragranced or irritating. Removes make up beautifully too! Cannot stop recommending this to friends. Skin looks and feel clean and refreshed after each use.

review_title: Got a try this one, it’s better than most.
review_text: I have tried many many bombs and this is definitely the best. I love that it has papaya enzymes in it and it does not leave a greasy feel on my face.

Did an alright job as I don’t wear a ton of face makeup to actually wash off, but it doesn’t rinse off very well and leaves a film on your face. Was horrible for getting off mascara as well. Wouldn’t buy again and repurchased the pharmacy green balm after this was done.
I love the luxury feeling of using this. It really melts my makeup, but it leaves a little bit of a hydrating film on the skin when washed off. The packaging is also adorable

LOVE. LOVE. LOVE. I’ve tried several different kinds of makeup removers and this IS. MY. FAVORITE. When I ran out of this I tried two other cleansing balms and neither worked like this one. No problem taking off my waterproof mascara! I threw the others away and repurchased this one!

HATE this product. It gets your makeup off... but leaves a thick residue that requires multiple rinses and a double use of face wash. If I wear heavy mascara there’s usually a bit left over too. Not a fan at all. Much prefer the farmacy cleansing balm.
Really disappointed. Was difficult to wash off, even using only a pea sized amount. It did NOT remove makeup, I only wear waterproof eyeliner and TINTED MOISTURIZER.
Doesn’t really remove all the makeup - I usually use this as a first step cleanser. It smells nice, leaves a residue or film over the skin which I get rid of with a second cleanse.
Love!!! Quickly gets rid of makeup, smells amazing, and leaves my skin feeling SO hydrated. Definitely recommend for sensitive skin.
Super gentle cleanser/remover, hydrating and easy to use. I love the scent!! Definitely a must have.
I absolutely love this!!! It takes my makeup off right away like no other. A little goes a long way too! I will definitely be buying again and again!

Only cleansing balm I’ve ever tried that I’ve loved. A little pricey, but so worth it. Has a light smell and completely melts all makeup off my face. The product itself lasts for a while and the packaging is very good quality. It doesn’t leave a residue on your face, and it doesn’t clump like so many of the other cleansing balms I’ve tried do. Would recommend this brand and product to anyone.
Terrible as a makeup remover, but great as a skin softener. You’ll probably have to do a triple cleanse if you use this as a makeup remover. The only plus is it makes the skin super supple after.
Smells amazing, feels great, most effective makeup removing balm! And I like that the smell isn’t as potent as other cleaning balms but still is there. Definitely going to keep using this
omg i love it! smells so good, like a fruit smoothie. it emulsifies  so well and really melts all of my sunscreen off. i love it! so gentle.

This product is amazing for getting all of your makeup off. Everything seems to melt right off my face and not to mention how good it smells. I’ve completely stopped using makeup wipes and switched over to this for my nightly routine. It’s also really nice to do a double cleanse with as well.

Got this in Sephora’s clean makeup kit. First was disappointed that on the Think Dirty App this scored a 6, so not exactly the cleanest. I try to keep my products 3 and under. Second, I’ve never used a balm before but this left the weirdest residue on my face. I felt like I couldn’t really get it off. Maybe that’s normal, but I usually use a face wash to get makeup off and am just not used to that weird feeling. Also it didn’t remove all my eye makeup. Overall it’s cute packaging but would not be interested in buying the full sized product.

review_title: fun and works well?! sign me up!
review_text: Say hello to my new must have skin care product (there’s a lot but still) It’s a super fun texture and color that feels amazing on your face. I almost don’t want to wash it off, especially cuz it smells amazing. But when you do it really does MELT off your makeup, even eyeliner and mascara. The packaging is super nice also, like can’t find one thing I dislike. Started as a sample and now I’ve used half the jar
This is the best product i’ve found to remove waterproof mascara (even better than coconut oil)! It doesn’t leave your skin greasy and washes off easily with water.

I like this balm. It works well and doesn’t anger my skin. I switched to this one after drunk elephants slaai made my face explode.  For me the smell could either go away or be an actual smell but this halfway thing isn’t ideal because whatever smell that is in there doest totally cover up the waxy/oily smell that the balm just has normally so it just sorta smells like a slightly scented waxy crayon. Just the waxy smell would be fine honestly. I dismiss this because it works fine and gets off my mascara etc and its not on my face too long. I should also note i have rosacea and this was ok for my VERY fussy skin.

My favorite cleansing balm!! I don’t wear waterproof mascara so I’m not sure how this works on that but works great on regular mascara and the rest of my makeup. This is the 1st cleanse and then I follow up with a regular cleanser. After reading other reviews maybe the “film” they’re speaking about is because just the balm is being used alone?

It is indeed very rich, and can be a bit tough to get off with just water, but I always use a cloth to gently remove the first layer of any cleanser I use. It smells fantastic, leaves my skin feeling clean (not just “removed my sunscreen” clean), doesn’t sting my eyes if it gets in (I wear contacts and sometimes forget to take them out and still no stinging), and though it is indeed very rich and can be a bit difficult to just splash off your face, I find that it forces me to actually massage my face until EVERYTHING is gone which means I actually get all the oil and makeup off! If you’re getting peeved with how long it takes to get off, just use a gentle cloth or paper towel to gently swipe off the excess, then go ahead and wash with water. I didn’t think it could beat my clean it zero balm, but it did!! If you’re worried you won’t love it, glow recipe offers it as a sample on their website with any purchase!

My boyfriend walked in yesterday and the first thing he said to me was “WOW your skin is glowing!“I received this product for Christmas and have been using it every night as my first step cleanser. After having multiple dermatologists mistake my dehydrated skin as oily skin, and giving me the wrong products to use I now have a lot of blackheads as well as acne scarring and hyperpigmentation. I have been using exfoliating products for the last year in an effort to get rid of my blackheads and clogged pores. After hearing about this enzyme cleansing balm and reading reviews I decided I wanted to try it and add it to my routine.First off I love the fruity refreshing smell. It does dissipate so if you’re concerned about a strong fragrance I wouldn’t let that deter you. It’s a very creamy balm consistency. I haven’t had any issues with it being runny or needing to be mixed like some other reviews have said so maybe that is a storing issue. It spreads on the skin really nicely and does a good job of removing makeup as my step one cleanser. To be fair I do not use foundation and only do eye makeup and lipstick. It rinses off better than other balm cleansers that I have used and leaves my skin really smooth. My skin feels so nice after I almost don’t want to do my step two cleanser.Being as I have only been using it a couple weeks, it’s hard to tell if it’s impacting my blackheads since they are so old and deep. But it is worth noting that the last pore strip I used seemed to pull out a lot more debris from my skin so maybe that is because of this cleanser.It only takes a small amount of product to cleanse my face so this jar is going to last me quite a while.It’s a bit more expensive than the last balm that I used but smells better, works better and takes less product to cleanse so in the long run I think it will actually be cheaper. I highly recommend this product if you are looking for a step one cleanser.

This was alright. If im honest, the packaging is what did it for me, its orange! And quality too, sturdy glass jar and a scooper. I used the whole container and will say i was a little bummed the first time i tried it bc it left a bit of a film behind. Farmacy Green Clean and DE Slai didnt do that for me. Not a huge deal bc my 2nd cleanse would take care of it.The smell isnt the best, it smells like candy but its not bad. If youre in to smells the Farmacy one smells like lime sorbet and i love it. As far of exfoliation, i didnt notice very much. I use acids regularly so thats probably why - i think this would be a good exfoliating option for those with sensitive skin for sure. Overall i think its good but wont be repurchasing, im on the Deviant Cleansing Concentrate right now and loving it

This product worked well for cleansing. I thought it improved my skin over the couple of months I used it. Used with PMD clean. I didn’t like how strong the scent was, or how difficult it was to rinse off my face. I won’t be purchasing a second time, but good product and great value.

Overall, I really like this cleansing balm.  It has a subtle, fruity scent, and my face feels smoother and more hydrated.  The only minor downside is the texture.  When I rubbed it on my dry hands, it felt like a thicker/heavier oil compared to other cleansing balms I’ve tried.  However, I think it rinsed well.  I should note that I double cleanse, so I can’t tell if it leaves a residue.

It’s ok. Truthfully I am a bit disappointed, I love Glow Recipe skincare products—the blueberry bounce cleanse and watermelon toner are my holy grails & leave my skin so smooth. I just ran out of my Clinique makeup removing balm and decided to try Glow Recipe’s new balm. I am not impressed with it. It’s easy to remove, it doesn’t leave a film but it does a poor job removing mascara. I expected it to have a light fruity scent like every other Glow Recipe product but this one has no scent (maybe I got a bad one?). You definitely have to use a regular cleanser after this because it doesn’t remove all your makeup. I do like that it comes with a scoop so you don’t have to stick your fingers in the the jar. But overall, I haven’t noticed any changes in my skin & don’t know if I will buy this again. It’s not a bad product but there are better make up removing balms out there for the same price.

I feel like I’m alone in not really liking this product. I loved the smell but that was it. I didn’t like how waxy the balm was, or how it didn’t actually melt on my face. I also found it didn’t remove eye makeup as effectively as other balms. I’ll finish it up but wouldn’t buy again.

I really wanted to love this. It smells great. It just didn’t wow me for the price point. The jar should be much larger. It has an interesting almost waxy appearance but feels like Vaseline once it is on your skin. It removes face.makeup decently. I found I needed a bit more in some areas. I had to massage my lashes it  to remove my mascara (Milk CBD).  I found myself using it sparingly to make it last which kind of defeats the purpose. If the jar was larger, I would buy it again. I didn’t find value in the price point.
It removes my makeup like a charm every time, better than any other makeup remover I tried before. And it smells soooo good. Really recommend it!

This product is so hard to take off your skin. I followed the instructions, I followed the videos from the Instagram, I tried so many methods and it’s still so hard to take off! It feels like a thick wax on your face that is impossible to wash off. After rubbing in, it leaves a super white cast on your face. I try to use warm water to massage after and it doesn’t come off without wiping with a towel or removal wipe which kind of defeats the purpose of using this. Sometimes I will just double cleanse after to make sure it is completely off. I wish I saved the box to return it but this product did not agree with my skin at all.
smells amazing, wiped all of my makeup away and did not live my face dry.

I received this product as a free sample. I’m super honest when it comes to reviewing products. I’ve always had trouble finding the best makeup remover for my skin. I don’t break out or anything, I just have extremely sensitive skin when it comes to removing makeup. I stopped using wipes because they would just damage and make my skin irritated. After using this product I feel like I have found the BEST makeup remover. It’s so quick and easy and it literally melts ALL the makeup off of your skin. 10/10 for product and 10/10 for the packaging! The packaging is adorable!! When I run out of this I will definitely be purchasing another one!!!
This product is great for taking off your makeup, worked well on my waterproof mascara.Typically am not a fan of scented products but this felt great and didn’t seem too irritating.
I love the way this smells and how easily it goes on. The only reason I am not giving it 5 is because it really drys out my skin afterward so make sure you mosterize afterwards

This product did a great job of cleaning my skin with out making me feel dried out or turning my skin red. It didn’t leave any residue or greasy feeling behind either which can happen with cleansing balms. Great moisturizing cleaner!

I got this with some of my reward points. I really like this balm, it smells really good and takes off all face/eye makeup without any irration to the eyes. Some I noticed have reviewed it’s hard to get off but I just rinse off with water and muslin cloth and it comes off very easily. I’m going to purchase full size!

I surprisingly was not a fan of this product. It actually made my face severely breakout a week after use and my face is still not back to normal. If anyone has combination or oily skin I would not recommend trying this product.

Absolutely a must have product! Not only does it dissolve eyelash glue, but the cold tingly sorbet feeling is absolutely immaculate! This was the first product I had ever received and was actually shook!
got a sample to try it out. doesn’t emulsify well, and turned into a white cast sticking on my face, had to use a cloth to wipe it off!

I received this as a free rewards and thank goodness it was free cause it’s now in the garbage.This is the most terrible product I have ever used from beauty line. I’ve been an avid double cleanser for 5+ years and over that time have tried many cleansing oils, balms etc.. some amazing, some good, some not so good. I’m not quite sure how this even passed as a cleansing balm?This product was super waxy and smelt like crayons.As far as makeup removal... it barely took off my mascara and eyeliner. Which is all I wear on top of foundation. For any serious MUA or girls who wear a full makeup application - this will NOT be strong enough for you in my opinion.

I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.This cleansing balm is very soft and melts easily into the face. I also like that it has a light nice fragrant smell that is not so overpowering. I usually do not like fragrance in skincare products, but since this is a wash off, I do not mind it. My skin is very dry, and I loved how this cleansing balm made my skin feel nice and hydrated after using it. A few cons for this cleansing balm:  1) It is extremely hard to get of the face because it does not emulsify well with water. 2) It does not remove waterproof mascara as well as I have to use makeup remover afterwords.

Wasn’t sure what to expect, but LOvED this. Not only was the packaging beautiful but the smell is to die for. It was so easy to use and a little goes a long way! Left my skin feeling so soft amd hydrated.

I was blown away with this product! I tested it with a full face of stage makeup and after using the balm the makeup completely melted away. It was very gentle on my skin compared to other products I’ve used to remove heavy makeup, and it also smells fantastic!

I wanted to love this cleansing balm! I’ve been a dedicated user of Farmacy Green Clean and Very Cherry Clean for years, but was looking for a more natural alternative, and I LOVE Glow Recipe’s AHA toner and retinol/avocado eye cream. However, I didn’t love that you Have to double cleanse when using this product. I’ll normally use an oil based cleanser to remove makeup and SPF, and then use a micellar water or toner to get anything left behind. This leaves a slight film, so you have to follow up with a water based cleanser. I have normal to dry skin, so true double cleansing is something I try to avoid.Secondly, while I have zero issue with fragrance in products, natural or not, I had an issue with the fragrance of this. The first use, it smelled like any tropical scented product, very fruity. The next couple times I used it, the true papaya smell came through—which might be great to some, but I think real papaya fruit has an acrid scent note, which I don’t love. If double cleansing and true papaya scent don’t bother you, by all means, definitely try this!

review_title: Hard to rinse or wash off
review_text: Smells nice, melts on skin easy, takes makeup off. Does not rinse off well or even come off well with most cleansers. It feels waxy on skin instead of melting away with water or even cleanser. Was excited to try, but disappointed. I prefer the Farmacy cleansing balm and the drunk elephant one too. I’m glad I got it as a sample with purchase instead of paying for a large one.

This cleanser was ah-mazing!  My skin is oily but with dry patches due to using retin-a. I used the balm on dry skin (as recommended on the box)and  as I rubbed it gently in I noticed pieces of dead skin coming off as I continued to rub it in. I also used it on my neck and noticed the same. When I finally rinsed my face with a washcloth, my face and neck felt baby soft and very clean. I didn’t notice the fragrance really. I thought it was subtle and not over powering at all. Loved this.
It’s a good cleansing balm. I don’t think it’s worth the price but it is good as the first step in a double cleanse to help remove make up and sunscreen. It’s smells nice but not overwhelming.
Seriously love this stuff! So glad I got to try this complimentary or I would have never known how amazing this product is! My skin was soo soft and refreshed after using it!!

Does an amazing job at melting my waterproof makeup with very little effort and my skin does feel nice. However, it has a texture that’s hard to wash off. Unlike other balms that immediately washes off like milk, washing this balm just feels like heavy residue.
I am so glad I found this product! It easily takes my makeup off and leaves my skin feeling soft. I highly recommend as the first step of skincare.
I absolutely love this product! I’ve tried a few products similar to this one and they’ve all broke me out. This one hasn’t done anything close to that, and it makes my skin feel so lovely afterward

review_title: Go back to the drawing board Glow Recipe
review_text: I love cleansing balms and oils, so I really wanted to love this. I was so excited. And on application I was like yassss...gimme that smooth, buttery, goodness. But then I started to emulsify and it was unlike anything I’ve ever experienced with a cleansing balm. As I added water to emulsify, the texture got thicker and as I added more water the consistency was not thinning out, just getting thicker. I thought I maybe used too much, but it didn’t seem to make a difference the next night when I used a tiny bit. The water just made it thicker. It was so weird. I have never experienced this kind of thing with a balm and I’ve tried dozens of cleansing balms. I double cleanse every night. By the time I got this stuff off my eyes were bloodshot from all the water I had to splash on my face and I was exhausted. I had to dig deep to find the energy to continue on with the rest of my skincare routine...and that was just Step 1. I don’t see how anyone can like this cause there are far better cleansing balms out there. Not too fond of the scent either. It smells like those 2 for 1 fruity cocktails you get at Applebees. I feel like I can actually smell booze in it. IDK...It looks cute on my vanity...but I’m beyond just keeping a product I don’t like cause it has cute packaging. Can’t a girl have cute packaging and a bomb product?!

I have received this complimentary from Influenster, this balm truly takes off all your excess makeup that remover wipes don’t. The downside is that it is a greasy consistency that doesn’t mesh well with my oily skin and makes me feel really oily after. But other than that i really think it gets all the makeup off.

2 stars because the product looks nice and smells nice. Minus 3 stars because this product is terrible at actually taking off your makeup. It melts down nice in the hands but once you put it on your face and start trying to wash it, it turns into this weird layer of slippery gel that becomes really difficult to get off your face. After I took a towel over my face after washing it with this balm I had a ton of makeup still on. I am really surprised at the 5 start reviews. I would recommend farmacy green clean balm over this one.
Smells great! Removes makeup incredibly well including waterproof makeup and long wear lipsticks that can sometime stain. Is very hydrating as well

review_title: Works amazing and NO micro plastics!!
review_text: Amazing product! I don’t normally love cleansing balms buuutt!....this one does it for me! Removes all my makeup (and I am a *heavy* eyeshadow user) with zero residue left, smells amazing, AND has NO micro plastics!!!! I still cleanse with my normal cleanser, but this stuff comes off so easy and doesn’t feel greasy or leave residue at all!!! Definitely will become a regular purchase for me!!!

I have been transformed from makeup wipes to this product! I had never used a cleansing balm before and I was amazed that it melted all my makeup off. The scent was magnificent and it left my skin feeling buttery smooth. I will purchase this again!

This product was so smooth and got rid of all my makeup. I love how I was wearing so much eye makeup and it subtly cleansed it off in one swipe. I only giving 4 stars because you do really have to rinse it off quite good. And even after rinsing for a while I still had to take a cotton pad to some places to get the residue off. I recieved this product complementary.

Ok, this stuff definitely does its job! Cute packaging and container, smells nice, etc. IMO you only need to use a little bit to dissolve a full face, so go easily. I use this as the first step in my double cleansing method. I definitely think it stays on your skin more so than other balms which is why I’m giving it 4 stars, seems like it needs extra rinsing as opposed to other oil based cleansers I’ve used.

I like this product. It smells great and really melts my makeup away. I’m not sure if the price matches the value but it’s a great, environmentally conscious way to remove makeup. Note- I received this product for free to try.

When I tell you I am obsessed with this product..I am not lying! I tested it with my favorite waterproof makeups. The mascara and concealer melted off of my face without scrubbing or skin aggravation! It smells amazing and leaves your skin soft and free of impurities. I absolutely love it!

I love the fresh scent of this cleanser. It has a watery Vaseline like shine consistency when rubbed on the face but is not greasy feeling. It works well for taking off all makeup including mascara & eyeliner.

This says it melts makeup off. I was really skeptical at first but IT REALLY DOES. It’s so smooth and hydrating, but in a way I’ve never felt before. My skin is noticeably smoother after using this product.

Honestly pretty surprised with how well this product worked! I had never used something like this to remove my makeup but it worked fairly well it left a bit of mascara residue left over but overall it’s a good makeup remover left my skin feeling fresh and clean!

I’ve used other cleansing balms in the past, specifically the Clinique one which I liked. I’ve read reviews complaining about a “film” being left on the skin after rinsing. A cleansing balm isn’t going to be like a face wash at all. Like all the ones I’ve used before I’ll cleanse my face using the balm and rinse with warm water, using a rag gently after I’m done and patting dry with a towel before moving on. I’ve used this day and night since receiving it and haven’t noticed any clogged pores, and no breakouts. There’s an improvement in how I feel my skin is retaining moisture. You get ALOT of product and a scoop too. A little goes a very long way. I’m excited to continue using!

As soon as I saw this posted on Trendmood’s page on Instagram, I was instantly intrigued. I purchased this with my own money just a few days after it launched on Sephora’s website and this is my honest review: it has a nice, mild fragrance to it, which is pleasant as I rub it all over my dry face. It is definitely a balm, which turns into an oil and does not have any grittiness to it. I use this at night as a first step of my double cleanse method and remove it in the shower. I realized that the more water you add to it, the oilier it becomes. It feels like an oil slick on my face, which I don’t love but don’t hate. However, I find the oil very difficult to remove with just water and may have been luck taking it off with a washcloth. It leaves a significant film and you MUST use a cleanser afterwards. I will say in the directions, it suggests to use their Blueberry Bounce Cleanser (which apparently is good at also removing makeup) but I can’t use this right now because I am pregnant. So I used the Mad Hippie Cream Cleanser and it did remove the access oil. The good thing is because it is so emollient, it removes all traces of makeup, including my mascara (not waterproof). I’m not sure I would repurchase due to the amount of time it takes to remove the product, but it is nice and would be a good option for those who wear a full face of makeup, like myself.

WOW!! This takes EVERYTHING OFF!! It even took off my house of lashes eyelash glue from my lashes. This is amazing and so soft on the skin. It feels so much better then using a makeup wipe. Will never use anything else ever again.

I love this product so much. It leaves my skin feeling so soft, and clean, and makes my skin glow. It also takes off all of my makeup, including my mascara. It also smells amazing! I definitely recommend this for someone looking for a cleanser/makeup remover!
I was really surprised at how light weight it felt while taking off a full glam! For double cleansing I would recommend using this with a makeup wipe then going ahead with your favourite cleanser!

This was my first time using a cleanser and I was surprised! Usually it takes me a couple of swipes to take off my makeup especially my eye makeup with a makeup removing wipe. This cleanser melts all the makeup off almost instantly! It’s a very smooth and silky consistency. It’s safe to use on sensitive skin! I usually use it right before I take a shower so I have that refreshed clean skin. There’s no doubt this removes all your makeup because it leaves your skin soft and clean- it doesn’t have that lingering feeling like some makeup removers have. You no for a fact there’s no more makeup on your skin and it’s nice and clean. Definitely recommend!

I absolutely love this new way to take off my makeup! It worked well in dissolving my all day makeup. The smell is nice and light and it left my skin feeling smooth and bright! Absolutely In love with this product!

This is a really great cleansing balm. A small amount does a great job of melting off your makeup, and really sets the stage for a second cleanse. It has a light papaya smell that isn’t too overwhelming, but still smells good.

I received this item on an influencer boxI really liked how it took all of my makeup off without have to rub my face too hard. Has a great scent, not too strongI did need to wet my face a lot to take off the residue feeling

review_title: bought without knowing what it is...

This product takes off all makeup and leaves your skin feeling SOOOO SMOOTH. I was skeptical at first but this is a product I will keep buying. Absolutely worth the splurge.

OH-EM-GEEThis melted off my makeup after a very long day! And after cleansing my skin was so soft and glowing! This is now a staple in my skin care routine

Smells so good and feels amazing! It went on amazing and got all my makeup off my face!
Smells so great and really cleanses, despite being a balm. I will definitely be adding this to my nighttime routine and it melts off makeup.
Love this serum. Light, fresh, and easily absorbed.

review_title: Plumps and hydrates but breakout city
review_text: When Tatcha first came out I was interested in purchasing a lot of the products however when I talked to an employee (FYI with flawless skin) she told me that Tasha is fine but it has a lot of extra/unnecessary ingredients which is why she doesn’t use it. This is important because fast-forward a few years and I finally decided to buy some Tatcha products. For reference I have sensitive combination/oily skin. Its very rare that my skin breaks out and I don’t really have any skin issues, I mainly use products to prevent aging. So I purchased this treatment serum and for the first week all was fine and it did plump and hydrate my face, maybe a little too much because i started to notice my face did tend to feel a bit greasy by the end of the day. The following weeks my skin started to go south. I started to get pimples every so often then I started getting those deep under the skin pimples, I was noticing the pores on my nose and chin and my skin just started to look rough. I finally stopped using this product and all those issues started to disappear. So the product does deliver in terms of plumping and hydrating but I think the extra ingredients were clogging my pores so my skin was just fighting with this product. I think if you dry skin this likely won’t be an issues, but if you have sensitive combo/oily skin beware.
This, plus the Dewy moisturizer, have helped me keep my face looking healthy and not dull despite stress.  A little goes a long way, which is nice, and the scent is very subtle.

Holy cow! I have had this bottle for awhile but I was delaying using it because I was trying to use up my other serums I had on hand. I DON’T KNOW WHY I WAITED! This truly looks beautiful when applied. As others had mentioned, you really only need one pump for your whole face. It almost immediately softened my fine lines and gave me that juicy look on my skin. This reminds me a lot of my other favorite serum “Genifique” from Lancôme. 100% recommended!

Wow!! This serum is absolutely amazing no joke! My skin is so soft and feels very hydrated and smooth. Game changer for sure!! Only downfall is how expensive it is. But I have to say it’s totally worth it!

I have used the luminous hydration and firming one prior to trying this but I have to say after about a week of using it, I much prefer this one...texture is milky and one pump goes a long way for me...very light and airy for me and leaves my skin very soft...the other one had a sticky feeling so I would definitely repurchase this one for the other serum...

review_title: Made my skin very plump and glowy!!
review_text: I received a gift card to select a product of my choice to review, and I chose The Dewy Serum. I am oily skin already but I do tend to get dry quickly if I don’t stay hydrated or keep my skin moisturized. My skin has some early signs of aging with fine lines around my eyes. I did notice some improvement with the serum in the appearance of the wrinkles and also kept my skin glowy giving me that healthy skin look. ⁣⁣I personally would recommend this product to dry-normal skin types as they would benefit from this the most. This is the perfect gift if you’re trying to splurge while treating your skin with some extra love.
This is my new favorite serum! Leaves your skin feeling amazing.

review_title: love this product, Tatcha is worth it
review_text: I received this product for free in exchange for my fair and honest review. I’ve previously used other serums from Tatcha, and they are a cut above the rest. After the results I saw from the Violet C serum, I affirmed that despite the high price this brand is worth it, and I would be willing to buy Tatcha products again. I put it on before bed and in the morning my skin looks plump, dewy, and healthy, a godsend especially during the winter months.

I received this serum complimentary from influenster, I use It when I want a nice dewy glow! It works great and definitely plumps the skin, I do have oily combo skin so I notice my forehead gets very shiny when I use this. It has a nice fresh scent I would definitely recommend!

The cold weather has left my normally oily skin super dehydrated and tight. Using this serum at night has helped rehydrate my skin and even soothe dry patches under my nose. I feel like I get the most benefit by using it in the evening and sealing it in with a heavy cream.

recieved this serum from influenster. I love the way this makes my face feel and look. It has improved my daily glow so much. It is not greasy feeling. I love it and will deff be buying more once i run out!!
Been using for about a month. Love this product! Not sticky not gooey. Goes on smoothly and smells great!
Love this product! Got it to try for free and it’s amazing.

I received this for free from influenster. It says it’s plumping which I never noticed. I do see how it gives a light to my skin almost glowy due to  whatever is in it. I do like that it’s basically 2 ingredients with hyaluronic acid.  I just didnt notice a big difference to spend 30+ on this when you can get hyaluronic products cheaper.  I will say I’m mid 30s and I have a regular skin care routine, so maybe it’s just not helping with the skin care I already do..maybe it would help more for those who don’t already have one. I also have extremely dry skin.  I’m not saying I wouldn’t buy it, I like the way it smells and I always wanted to try tatcha products, I just don’t think this is for my skin.

There is little to no scent other than a fresh, clean smell.  It glides on smoothly and initially leaves my face feeling cool and super smooth, but the effect doesn’t last long.  I guess I also expected to see some extraordinary plumping results, since it’s in the name of the product, but that wasn’t the case.  After using for a month, there were no noticeable changes in my skin.  It’s nice enough, but not for the price.  I received this product to try through Influenster, and would’ve been super disappointed if I had shelled out full price for it.

I love the packaging! I love the texture and the smell! My skin is super DRY, did this make my skin dewy? No. But did I enjoy using it? Yes! Ultimately a gateway product, I will definitely be trying other products from this line soon!
I wanted to love this product so much. The texture is creamy but not oily and it is very hydrating. Also, it smells amazing. Unfortunately, it started to burn my skin after using it for a few weeks.

I received this product through Influenster, and am so excited I did! My skin is super dry in the winter. I use this serum every night and in the morning my face is noticeably plumper. I like this serum, my face looks plump and hydrated each morning. One pump is enough to cover my whole face, so it should last a while. It doesn’t clog pores and does help with overall texture. I will be repurchasing.

I was gifted this by Influenster and let me just say....it has been a skin changer. I have been using this for 3 weeks now as directed on bottle. It has changed my skin in so many ways.
