I promise you will not regret buying this product. 10 out of 10!!!

Was super hesitant to try because all of the reviews were  from comped products when I first saw this product, but I’m so glad I did. Super effective on fine lines and dryness, feels great, barely smells (like a nice light cucumber), no breakouts. I’ve been alternating with a vitamin c serum for brightening (wish this offered both but it’s still 5 stars on its own). Let me say start by saying, wow. I was so excited to recieve this product from Influenster for free and be able to give my feed back. In the winter time I get so dried out and this serum helps keep my face hydrated and plump ! LOVE LOVE LOVEEE <3

I got this product for free from influenster to give an honest review and let me tell you I love this product. I seriously couldn’t tell you how sad I am to have spent $34 for a face wash that just feels like I’m using a bar soap on my face when I could have spent $25 for origins and really get my face nice and clean. I will say that it doesn’t dry up your face so I’ll give it that. But if you have oily skin/normal skin or have to watch out for blackheads/pimples this ain’t it.

This is my favorite cleanser at the moment, it smells fresh and the scent is not too strong, and it makes my skin feel bouncy and hydrated. I also would recommend using slight wet hands when you rub it on your face, I found it easier to use that way.

This is my current favorite cleanser.  I’ve only ever bought the mini size, and it lasts me for months (using it one to two times per day).  It IS very gentle, so nothing fancy happens when you use it…it just lathers a little and cleans your skin.  The scent is very light, which I appreciate since my skin is pretty sensitive.  If I’m wearing makeup, I use this as the second step in my double cleanse, so I can’t vouch for how well it removes makeup on its own.  But my skin never feels too dry afterward, so I’m a big fan.
Favorite cleanser of all time! Cleans face without being too drying! I feel like it’s helped me with my acne. If you’re on the fence of trying it out I’d say go for it!

I have dry skin, but this didn’t strip my skin at all. It didn’t leave my face extremely dry and tight like most cleansers do. My skin is soft and has a clear complection. I use Innisfree Green Tea Serum after use and it leaves me with a dewy face

review_title: Gets All Makeup Off So Easily Without Drying
review_text: This gets all my makeup off without drying my already dry skin. I don’t think I’ve ever had a cleanser that makes my skin feel so clean without stripping it.

review_title: Stung my eyes a little bit
review_text: I love this brand and have many of their products, but this is not my favorite.  It stung my eyes slightly when using it.
Love this product! Leaves my face feeling clean and fresh!!
It made my skin super soft (I did use with other Glow Recipe products), but I didn’t foam a lot or make my skin feel super clean.

I love this stuff! Just bought two more mini size because the full size was sold out. Leaves my skin feeling clean, but not dry. Great for taking off my mascara with because it doesn’t irritate my eyes. Smells amazing. Clean ingredients. Amazing!
It was a little drying for me, once my skin was dry and felt very tight. Also wasn’t great at removing makeup. I really wanted to like it because I love so many of Glow Recipe’s products.

Just got this lovely cleanser in a little Sephora hull.. and wow I’m already obsessed! This left my skin SO soft, glowing and looking bright and refreshed dafter one use. I have combination skin and this didn’t over strip over over hydrate the Goldie locks of cleansers. Also the smell and texture of the lather is perfect. AND it can double as a little mask, can’t wait to continue to use this and see some nice long term results.

I love how foamy this face cleanser is and I don’t feel like my face has been stripped of all oils. Definitely works with the watermelon toner and moisturizer. Good scent that isn’t overwhelming and lingering.

I love everything from Glow Recipe I’ve tried except for this cleanser. I’ve tried over and over to make it work for me, but it severely dries out my skin to the point where I have to use multiple masks and serum to get my skin back to normal . I wish they would make a moisturizing cleanser for us dry skin folks!

Not the most gentle cleanser. My face felt tight when I used it twice a day. It can be hard to pump out of the bottle due to the texture. I did enjoy the texture of it and it foamed up well. The smell is light but refreshing.

i like it a lot! it’s so cute, smells very good, has a nice texture, cleanses well. however, it can be slightly drying. not for me personally, but i have normal to dry skin, not very dry. so be sure to patch test this product if you have more dry skin. other than that, it’s a great gentle cleanser!
My face got oilier and broke out within two days of using this cleanser. Excellent blueberry smell, though.

Love this product! I bought the mini one to try it out and instantly knew I was going to buy the full size. I’m very picky about skincare products but this hit the mark for sure. The ingredients are clean and the product itself smells SO NICE! Leaves my face feeling fresh especially when I use it with the watermelon toner.

I typically lean more towards a sudsy cleanser, so I love this! It won’t take off makeup completely, so I use this as a double cleanse. The fragrance is nice and light. I took one star off for the price, lol

It leaves my skin feeling nice and supple (as opposed to tight and dried out) and it also works great as a mask! However, I’m not a huge fan of fragrance in my skincare. Even though this cleanser smells delicious, it still has somewhat of a strong scent for my taste.

This cleanser is the only cleanser that suits my skin. It cleans my skin without it feeling dry afterward. I. make sure not to use it around my eyes, because they felt irritated when I did wash my whole face, including the eye area.

It smells “berry” amazing (haha) and you really only need one pump. It’s not super foamy (which is okay) but it does leave my skin feeling a little tight after use. I do like it for my oily/ normal skin type (my other cleaners have been mostly oil/ cream based so this is a different change).

I have been using this alongside the papaya balm. My face doesn’t feel very clean, and I’m noticing more congestion and blackheads than usual. There’s better products out there containing aha’s to get down into your pores.

This is definitely gentle! You can even rub it in your eyes. It’s a thinnish gel consistency, and it slightly foams up. It does dry your skin out a tad, especially if you use a lot, but if you put on moisturizer it’ll be fine. I don’t quite recommend it if you have dry skin though. I have combo/ normal. The scent is nice and didn’t make me break out. Overall great!

review_title: Blueberry Scent + Soft Skin = Happy Customer
review_text: I have purchased this facial wash now a few times and I will use this as long as I can. The smell is amazing. Clearly smells like blueberries but not heavily scented, its just right. I use this in the AM and sometimes the PM , just depends on the exfoliation depth I am going for. This product is great with my combo skin. Its an absolute staple in my skin care.

Smells light and pleasant. Mini size pumps worse than the regular size, but not too badly. Lathers up nicely and cleanses without irritation, but I don’t have sensitive skin, so take that with a grain of salt.

I’ve always struggled with the texture on my nose and using this just a couple times made it feel so smooth and soft! I do wish it was a little bigger for the price but I feel like it works incredibly well
i found this product to not only over strip my skin and smell like soap, but also leave a weird sticky film on my skin. this was a 100% a waste of money.

It’s a gentle AHA cleanser. Not a gentle cleanser. Even though it has fragrance I’m in love. My skin feels so smooth. Also I recommend every other day with this cleanser. The texture is my favorite. I start dry cleansing then add water as it foams up. Ps: oil cleans before.

Ok I have been using ivory dish soap as my face wash for about 15 years! It’s scent free and easy on my skin so I’ve never changed but recently I decided to try out an actual facial cleanser and I am beyond happy with my choice! This cleanser feels so incredibly nice after I wash my face, it feels genuinely clean and bright afterwards, I have really good skin to begin with but I feel like this has made it even better after using it for a few weeks. Also the smell is absolutely amazing, I love blueberry scent and they nailed it with this one for sure!
I love the way it makes my skin feel after using it. My skin never feels tight but nice a hydrated. I have dry skin and I love it. also it smells amazing! and not too fake smelling.

review_title: good price, good product, in my opinion
review_text: It smells great but isn’t too powerful. I like the texture, it’s a bit like jelly. It isn’t too stripping either. Since I don’t wash my face with soap every day, it lasts me at least 2 to 3 months to finish. I think the price isn’t bad.

dude. this is one of the best cleansers i’ve used. i’m on my third bottle of this, and it’s great. i don’t get breakouts too often, but i do get little skin-colored bumps on the sides of my face. this cleanser has helped so much with that. my skin is pretty sensitive, and if you do too, i recommend not leaving it on your face for too long.
I love the smell of it and the gel texture. It’s smooth and cleanses the skin well. I love how it lathers on the skin and foams up really nicely.

review_title: Surprisingly Drying, better for double cleanse
review_text: I bought this cleanser hoping that it would be gentle for every day use, especially using it conjunction with other treatments. The labelling is confusing, because it says gentle yet also says deep cleansing.  I found that my skin is tight immediately after cleansing and there isn’t really any moisture in it.I think it should be reccommended to be used as the second step after an oil cleanser. I don’t think I’d buy it again.

I bought this product a year ago. When using this product every day, my skin is so amazing. I have acne prone skin and my face is oily. So it was nice to finally find a product that works great with my skin. Plus it smells amazing. I followed with the pineapple brightening serum and watermelon pink moisturizer. My skin never look better. I recently bought the watermelon toner, Avocado retinol eye cream, and the banana soufflé moisturizer. Will do a review on those to see if those made a difference in my skin.
bad for dry skin, strips your face so bad & the fragrance caused me to get little red bumps so wouldn’t recommend for sensitive skin.

bought this for my son whose at the age of breakouts. tried different face wash before ordering this for him. he’s been using this for a few weeks now and his face is all cleared up. i was actually amazed.
This is my daily routine day and night I feel that it removes all of my makeup I loveee this cleanser  makes my face feel fully cleaned

review_title: My Go-To Face Cleanser for Night Time!
review_text: I actually really like this cleaner. It foams nicely, great for oily skin, and smells amazing. I love that it actually dries me out and makes it last. I have very sensitive skin and this doesn’t cause me to break out or flare up at all. I use it every day. :)

I love love this cleanser. Will be in my daily routine. This cleanser doesn’t make me break out and my skin has actually been clearer. I usually have little bumps on my skin and they are all gone! So glad I discovered this!

This is just an eh cleanser for me. It smells good, sweet but clean and that’s probably the biggest pro for me. On its own, it cleanses just fine but after rinsing my dry skin feels tight and overly cleansed. I like it best when used after a cleansing balm because the pair together don’t leave my skin feeling tight. Definitely wouldn’t go out of my way to use it again.
This product made my skin look and feel clean without stripping and causing me to break out!Bonus: Light smell that smells amazing

Firstly, I have very dry skin and NEVER get pimples! I was so excited to try this since it’s “clean” skincare. After using it a few times I had 3 huge pimples on my face along with small red bumps. My skin is normally smooth but now very textured and bumpy. I threw it in the trash and will go back to the YTTP cleanser. This was a total fail for me.
Not a fan was very irritating on my eyes and didn’t do much.

I absolutely love this product! My new favorite cleanser! Great for sensitive skin! It always makes my skin feel and look so much cleaner! I can definitely tell a difference in my skin since using it as well!
This cleanser completely dries out my face. I’ve had my fair share of products slightly drying my face but this one just strips my face so much it’s unreal.

This cleanser is amazing! I love the smell and after a month of using it I still get really excited to wash my face. It doesn’t take a lot of it to wash your face and feels very nice to wash with. I think the smell makes me very happy in general, and will literally help me if I’m not in a good mood. After washing, I definitely feel a difference on my face. It does not dry out my face and instead it leaves it feeling fresh and healthy. I haven’t run into any problems even when washing my face with this twice a day and I’ve never felt like it doesn’t clean my face well enough. Another amazing thing about this is that I haven’t had a single pimple since I’ve started using it. Before this I would get one or two pimples on my face each week and I haven’t had a single one after a few days of using this. I don’t really see myself using another cleanser in the near future and consider this cleanser my all time favorite.
Not my favorite cleanser . Didn’t get all my makeup off . wasn’t that hydrating either . Does smell amazing but that’s really it .

I’ve used this cleanser for over a year. I shower in the evening using another cleanser, using this cleanser in the AM. I have no clue if it removes makeup or not. I always felt it was a little drying, however this winter, which has been incredibly mild, my face after cleansing is very tight and dry. I’ve always had an issue with my toner (also bought from and when Glow Recipe had curated products) foamed up on me. I thought it was the toner. Twice I cleansed in the AM using a different cleanser, and the toner doesn’t foam up. I did an experiment, for a week I used the product in my shower to cleanse. At no point in the week did my toner ever foam up. In my opinion, the Blueberry Bounce cleanser is not completely rinsing off my face. I’m a 61 yr old woman who has been cleansing her face for a long time, I know how to completely rinse, I know how much product to use. I wont repurchase this. If your products are foaming, look to this cleanser. The foaming agent is too much.
It doesn’t do anything for the skin. It’s just a plain cleanser. It is really good at removing make up and that’s it.

I had really high hopes for this cleanser as I do enjoy the brand and the reviews were good, but it fell short. I have combination skin and still feel like this product stripped it! It smells like blueberry vodka - alcoholic stench. I don’t believe it caused me to breakout but it didn’t prevent further breakouts or improve my skin in anyway. Failed to remove basic mascara or create a froth, I never felt fully clean after using it. My sister also bought the cleanser and feels the same way (we both gave the product two months to properly form an opinion) sadly would pass on this purchase!

good at taking off makeup, and my skin feels super clean after use. however, after using this regularly for about a week, my skin became dry and flaky, even after using their Watermelon moisturizer. I had to use a heavy-duty moisturizer to help, and my skin is still dry even after I stopped using it. It broke me out a little when I was using it. I don’t consider my skin to be sensitive, but I think this cleanser is too harsh on my skin.

I love the smell, I don’t think it’s a gentle formula so I use it a couple times a week. I have combination skin and don’t like to use foaming washes on a daily basis. However when I do use it I love it.

So far so good! I have been using this for about a week. I thought the travel size would be a nice size to see if I liked it. It has this odd, yet nice foaming bubbly feeling on my face. I am unsure if I’ll get the larger size, I am going to give it the whole bottle. But, so far, so good.

overpriced for the amount in the bottle. Glow recipe has been slowly upping prices and reducing quantities of their products. I find this extremely tacky. I found a manmonde dupe for only $21 compared to the abysmal amount I got with this.

I love the watermelon moisturizer, so thought I would try this. It is very soapy and my face felt a little tight and dry afterwards. Did remove my makeup but stung my eyes a lot! I had red sore eyes for hours after :(

review_title: Doesn't Impress Me for the Money
review_text: I got a mini size of this from buying the Glass Skin set. As of writing this review, the Blueberry Bounce cleanser has an average rating of 4.0 out of 5, which I’d say is pretty fair. There’s nothing terribly wrong with this cleanser, it just doesn’t really wow me for how much it costs. I’ve used other gel cleansers in the past that I’ve liked, but this one just doesn’t do it for me. The most off-putting thing for me is the scent; the blueberry notes are nice but there’s also a “soapy“ scent, kind of like liquid hand soap or dish detergent. And quite honestly, this cleanser just doesn’t leave my skin feeling super clean - I’ve tried it both in the morning and at night, but just wasn’t impressed by it at either stage of my routine. (For reference, I have combination/oily skin and my current cleansing regimen is to use a milky cleanser in the morning and then to do a double-cleanse at night.) It’s nice that this product has a lot of natural

I love this cleanser! It removes all my make up without that tight feeling after. Scent is light and not overpowering. I do feel like I go through it fairly quickly because the cleanser itself is a pretty thick gel so I actually wish they had a larger size for the shower.
Great cleanser! Super gentle but cleans really well! scent is very light as well so it won’t irritated your skin, I definitely recommend this cleanser
I loveeeeee this product! It’s super gentle on my skin ( pretty sensitive skin ) and I haven’t had any issues since using this product! I actually love glow recipe products!

the original formula was a cleanser i swore by! this cleanser is very different right off the bat. it has a very strong fragrance closer to flowers than blueberries (which didn’t bother me too much, but wanted to note). after two days of using this cleanser day and night, i had breakouts in places that i don’t usually have those issues. i decided to go back to a different cleanser for a few days, and these breakouts went away really quickly. the original formula actually prevented me from breaking out for the full six months i used it, so this surprised me.if you do choose to buy this, a little definitely goes a long way. this bottle could last you months and months, even when used twice a day. a full pump gives more product than needed. i just wish they had kept the original

This product is 5 star-worthy. After a single use, my skin felt so refreshed and smooth. The smell is also very refreshing, and beautiful. I recommend this product to anyone who desires smooth, glowing skin :)
This really cleans my skin I love the way it smells and feels ❤️

I have a very large pores and super oily skin! I have been searching for years for a product that will clean my face without drying it out. This stuff is the bomb! I added make up on that micellar water and a black charcoal facemask couldn’t get rid of! But this cleanser pulled all the crap out and my skin feels clean and amazing! Definitely a product I will replenish when I run out!

If you have any kind of dry skin, you might want to skip this cleanser. I have truly combination skin, some parts are oily, some are dry, and some are normal. So I switch between this and a more hydrating cleanser depending on how my skin feels. Not too stripping and it really does leave your skin feeling nice and clean. Would definitely recommend to oily skin! Also, I love that it only has clean ingredients in it!

I love this cleanser! It has a light scent that is quite delightful and texture of the bubbles are very airy and unique compared other cleansers I’ve tried. It’s gentle, but does a great job at removing dirt, oils, light makeup, and makeup residue, but doesn’t strip my skin. I would definitely purchase again!

I really like this cleanser! It didn’t strip my oily skin or leave it feeling dry like some gel cleansers do. I use one pump for no makeup days and in the morning and two if I have makeup on. I really like the locking mechanism on the top which made it nice to travel with. It also didn’t irritate or break out my skin which was great. It has a nice light blueberry candy type of scent that’s pleasant and disappears quickly. It’s a good quantity for the price. It took me a little over 4 months to finish. Will be repurchasing!

It has a lovely blueberry scent right out of the bottle, but as you lather the scent turns sort of unpleasantly soapy. And as soon as I rinsed my face, my skin felt tight. I have dry skin, so I think this just isn’t for me. And especially with the weird soapy smell, this would be a pass for me.

Wanting to try a new face wash, I decided to go with Glow Recipe and was pleasantly surprised with this product. It’s a wonderful, gentle cleaning face wash that goes on soft and washes off well leaving my skin feeling super clean. I usually use a light wash after an exfoliant or scrub and this one was perfect. Love the scent.

I’m actually really concerned about how dry my face is after using this for one week. It’s like every last drop of moisture in my skin has been stripped away. It’s going to take some time to get back to where I was. Horrible cleanser and I’m sorry I ever tried it:(

I recently purchased this for a trip to Kenya. I had wanted to try the blueberry cleanser anyway but when I saw it came in the travel size I grabbed it. I LOVED IT! The scent isn’t overwhelming and oddly brought me joy while washing my face. The texture is a light jelly and it was light enough to use every day but also as a step in my makeup removal process. It didn’t try my skin out at all. I currently use Farmacy’s honey cleanser as my daily morning face wash but I’m gonna add this into the routine for the summer months.

I bought this product and finally received it. I just wanted to try it because so far I had already purchased the watermelon and avocado masks and love them. This face wash is just ok in my opinion. It doesn’t really lather at all... it smells nice but other then that I don’t know if it’s doing much. I will not be buying this again
Take off the make up! Smells nice, has a nice texture. Pump and half goes a long way for neck and face. Can be a tiny bit drying.

I love this cleanser so much! It’s a super unique jelly-like texture that lathers for a really good clean. I have dry/combo skin and it doesn’t feel like it strips my face at all so I’m not left with that uncomfortable tight feeling, but still does a thorough job of removing makeup as my second step of cleansing. I’m normally not a fan of scents but this has a really pleasant and not at all overwhelming fruity smell that’s super yummy. The bottle lasted me a good 4 months!

This cleanser is amazing. I have dry skin and this thoroughly cleans my skin without leaving it feeling dry. Takes off makeup like a dream. I’ve been using it with my Clarisonic every night and I’ve noticed a huge difference in my skin. The smell is also very pleasant but doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin.
Dryed me out smelled and felt like a cheap glycerin cleaner overall terrible

I have had a lifelong struggle with acne and textured skin and this cleanser has been a LIFE SAVER. I notice a difference almost immediately after washing in the overall health of my skin. It cleans impurities without leaving my face tight, and leaves an overall brighter appearance. It smells great and does not irritate. So happy I tried this on a whim after using the Fresh Soy cleanser, which would constantly leave my face with small bumps. Highly recommend.

I got this at least a month ago. The first few weeks my skin was adjusting to it and felt tight.  After a month my skin is beautiful, much improved, hydrated, soft and smooth.  I now realize how much I needed this kind of cleanser. My other products work better because my skin no longer has a dead layer.  I’ve just ordered the Glow Recipe Avocado night mask and can’t wait to use it, as well.

Honestly really disappointed. I have sensitive combination skin (oily nose and dry every where else) and this product claimed to be gentle and hydrating but it left me feeling too ‘squeaky’ and with dry patches galore. Really don’t think this is a gentle cleanser what so ever, it was far too harsh and did not make me ‘glow’ or feel hydrated in the slightest.

I’ve tried at least a hundred cleansers and nothing seemed to make any difference for my stubborn skin. I struggle with redness on my cheeks and dull uneven skin tone and this stuff is the only cleanser that I can see and feel a difference. It leaves my skin soft and smooth. I quite enjoy the scent, and it doesn’t create a huge lather which I actually appreciate. My skin can be sensitive and it did not react at all to the fragrance, which is very light and pleasant.

Really good cleanser! I normally would use it while I’m in the shower to scrub off all my make-up and it works well!!! I had on a matte lipstick (can’t remember if it was Kat Von D or Kylie) but I just rubbed a bit of this on it with no water or anything and left it for a few seconds and it wiped right off! Good stuff

My favorite new cleanser, hands down! For those that are curious, the consistency is gel-like and considerably thicker than it appears to be just from looking at the bottle. Leaves behind zero grimy residue yet still remains hydrating to the skin. Only a single pump is required to remove a full face of make up and is able to be worked into a rich lather. The easy-to-use locking mechanism on the dispenser is a godsend (considering how many cosmetic products are lacking in such a feature) and keep the bottle from accidentally dispensing when you’re travelling with it. It also has a light, clean scent and lovely packaging. Will buy again and again!

As far as face wash goes, as long as it actually soaps up and doesn’t leave a weird film or make me break out then I’m sold. This one definitely hit all the check boxes the only downside is it’s more on the basic side so if you’re looking for a face wash to help with radiance or aging it’s not up to par with some of the others I have.
This product is amazing. Makes your skin feel great and even removes waterproof makeup! You don’t need a full pump because it lathers up on your face.

I have super sensitive skin and find most cleansers too harsh.  This is hands down the best cleanser I’ve ever used!  It smells amazing and is super gentle but makes my skin feel extremely clean.  Absolutely love it.
Even when I wash two times, this face wash doesn’t do a good job of cleaning my skin. Smells great but look elsewhere if you want a good cleaning product.

review_title: So worth the hype...must try product
review_text: I’ve been looking forward for Glow Recipe to arrive in Canada for a long time.  Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser has a thick gel consistency so a little does go a long way. One little pump is enough to take off any leftover dirt that my oil cleaner couldn’t get.  My 56 year old face and neck are so smooth and moisturized after this step.  Definitely happy.

I have the older version of this cleanser and already loved it! Now that it is beautifully and conveniently packaged with a pump - it’s perfection! It removes makeup with ease and does not make my skin feel tight (stripping my face of oil) afterwords. Great job, Glow Recipe!!

I’ve used the original Blueberry Bounce Cleanser and there are some really great things about this new version.  As other reviewers have noted, the bottle is really nice.  I like the pump design as well as the increased quantity!  The new fragrance is floral but very subtle.  I started using this as my second step in my two-step cleanse but where it really shines is as a makeup removed.  I had a really late night and didn’t wash my face (!) so the next morning I tried using this as a makeup remover by massaging it into my face for a minute and rinsing.  It worked great!  Even though my skin wasn’t in great condition it felt soft and there wasn’t any makeup residue!

review_title: Not as great as it used to be ￼
review_text: I just bought my fourth or fifth jar of this and it’s now a new formula. Unscented which is fine but it’s also a different texture and definitely not as hydrating as before. What a disappointment. Not sure I will buy again.
Really good lightweight moisturizer works wonders for my oily skin! Purchased it for points at Bazaar. However will not buy a bigger version for money because it is pricey :(

I recieved this complimentary from Farmacy Beauty for my honest review. This is such a light weight yet hydrating moisturizer. It applies and absorbs into the skin so well. I didn’t notice any scent to it which is nice. This is one of my favorite Farmacy products now.

This was my daily moisturizer for about 6 months and it was perfect. Not too drying, kept my skin balanced, soaked in easily. This new formulation has caused the WORST acne I have ever experienced. I don’t have acne-prone skin at all, yet my cheeks and forehead have been covered in angry red breakouts for the last few days and I couldn’t figure out why. I suspected it was the moisturizer and sure enough there are dozens of recent reviews ranting about the new ingredients. So sad that I can’t use this anymore. Sensitive skin beware!

I had high hopes for this one because it’s clean but I’m not a huge fan. I have sensitive, combination type skin and it broke me out into a bunch of small little pimples and caused redness and itchiness on my cheeks. If you have rosacea, this may not be the one. It’s a bit too heavy for me

A few reasons for this rating: - Not typical of a gel moisturizer as it is sticky and cloying. A bit more of a cream with a “gel“ appearance.- Average at best in terms of moisturizing but it leaves skin oily feeling.- Subjective, but the scent is not pleasant at all.Overall: very disappointing moisturizer that has little to no redeeming qualities.

I love this stuff so much. I keep trying other brands but I come back to this because my skin loves it in the winter when it is dry and the summer when it is combination.  I have somewhat mature skin and I highly recommend it.

I received this product as a free sample and was very impressed. The scent is light but citrusy and smells delicious. It glides onto skin and instantly moisturizes. My skin both looked and felt great.
Just enough moisture for my skin without it being heavy! I love this moisturizer a lot and it’s one of my new favs!

review_title: Broke me out, but otherwise loved
review_text: I’m soo sad that this causes my very sensitive skin to break out. It’s really refreshing and cooling upon application and gives my skin a dewy glow. Sadly, if I apply at night I wake up to breakouts the next morning. I will not be repurchasing, but if you’re looking for a hydrating moisturizer that really makes you glow this is worth testing out.
Super disappointed, this made my skin oily and tacky after I used it and made me break out! I have oily sensitive skin that gets red easily.
I’ve been using this moisturizer for a couple of years now and I absolutely love it! it really helps control my oily skin. I use it daily and it will likely remain as a favorite!
Never found a moisturizer that keeps my face feeling fresh and hydrated. I have combination skin and doesn’t leave my face greasy, gives a nice glow.

I got this as a sample, the fragrance is strong, so I suggest going into stores to smell before you buy. Its not necessarily a bad smell but its not my favorite, kind of reminds me of those old soap bars that were used as decoration but more of a ’newer’ smell not old.. if that makes sense. It also felt tacky after absorbing into my skin.

Eek! I’ve never washed off a moisturizer before BUT...Pros: I’m a huge fan of the ingredients and everything it’s supposed to do for the skin...Cons: left my skin really really really sticky and it felt so heavy on. I wanted to love it, but ended up washing it off and putting on my PTR instead. I just couldn’t do it, it did not feel breathable at all and was starting to turn my skin red.

review_title: OK For Normal Skin That Doesn't Need Heavy Cream
review_text: I have “normal“ skin - not too oily and not too dry. If I don’t use any moisturizer, my skin really doesn’t mind. This is a nice moisturizer for those who don’t want to use a really heavy cream moisturizer. It does have a distinctive odor which is not unpleasant but seems to be in line with their earth mother type of branding - e.g. calling it Daily Greens. My main quibble is the shape of the jar because it has created nooks and crannies which make it difficult to access the product.

I LOVE this moisturizer! I have very sensitive skin, prone to breakouts. This does not have a bad smell to me and I find it so moisturizing without making me greasy since it is oil free. It is a gel so it goes into the skin and without any sticky residue and feels very nice. Its my night time cream, but I will even wear it under makeup during the day sometimes because it does not pill at all. Its gives your skin a great break from the silicones in other moisturizers. Highly recommend!

I got a sample of this with one of my purchases and even though I am committed to my own products, I decided to give it a try.IT IS SO STICKY. I felt like I had glue on my face and that my pores were suffocating. I thought it would feel better after 30 minutes, but it didn’t. Scrubbed it all off and used my normal products.
Made my skin unstable. Didn’t want to apply on my face any more.Used the left as body cream.

This moisturizer lasts a long time ! You need very little each use. It also leaves my sling feeling soft and glowing. My Pores are improved so much with this ! Using this and Farmacy Toner with Moringa and Papaya you get the best results !

UNDERRATED!I was actually surprised by this product! I wanted to try their other ones with the spatula BUT alcohol was listed WAY up in the ingredients list. and they were supposed to be super moisturizing ones.This has NO ALCOHOL and has moringa and niacinamide! I love moringa and its benefits! Papaya is brightening is in it as well!I used to be an avid user of cerave then the first aid beauty cream, but they were too thick that my skin developed milia. This did not react with my curology treatment and leaves my face so glowy, I use it for both morning and night.

review_title: very moisturizing and I have T-Zone oily skin
review_text: very moisturizing. they gave me a sample package in my skin felt good all day I will have to buy me a jar love this stuff.
The formula is great, however, smell is very very strong. I would purchase again, but the smell is really pungent and removes a star for me.
Sooo good. Sinks into the skin quickly and doesn’t leave a residue. New favourite for sure

I have combination skin and I used this during the summer (thats when I switch over to gel-based moisturizers cause my skin gets more on the oily side). Love everything about it BUT it just didn’t feel moisturizing to me. It wasn’t heavy which is great on oily skin but it just felt like i has used cool gel and nothing else. I would say try the mini before committing to the full one.

Got a sample for 100 points and I think this moisturizer is more targeted towards people with oily/combo skin, I have normal/dry and it was very hard to spread and work into my skin, just did not love this moisturizer. Not sure if I actually broke me out but I did notice a couple new pimples after using. Not my favorite, I really love the cleanser from this line of Farmacy I use it day and night and it works wonders. Just not a fan of this moisturizer!

Really not a good option for dry skin.  I ended up using a ton of this in a single use because I didn’t feel like my skin was getting any hydration.  The result was a thick, tacky layer of gel sitting on my face that provided very little moisture.  If you have very oily skin, this may work well for you, but it’s not the greatest for normal to dry skin.

Received this moisturizer as part of a Farmacy Gift/Value Set.  The odor is worse than my kid’s sneakers.  luckily the stench fades after a minute or so.  Absorbs quickly and leaves my aged skin hydrated & smooth
Amazing makeup removerIt’s literally removes EVERYTHING within seconds. Even Huda Beauty’s eyeliner!
smells like a balm you would use for headache, not unpleasant though. Super sticky though, my eye lids actually was sticking together after applying a pea size amount all over my face
I did not love the smell, and more importantly, I didn’t find it moisturizing. Won’t be buying again.

By far, the best gel moisturizer that is clean, silicon-free and moisturizes for the whole day and practically all night. Been using this about 2 weeks and my skin loves it. It has a cooling effect and my little bumps on my forehead are gone. I love this brand. My only complaint is that I hope it came with some form of scoop/spoon so I don’t have to dip my finger everytime I use it. I use Q-tips for now.

It’s a good moisturizer, but I wouldn’t buy it again. I like the gel consistency. It’s light weight, but hydrating. This is great for summer months.  My skin glows after using it. Make up applies well over it, but I always use a primer anyway.I do not like that it is scented. It’s a very STRONG citrus scent. My skin hasn’t reacted to it, but I don’t think skincare should have that many added smells to it. You can even see on the ingredients list there are about 3 added citrus scents. If you’re have sensitive skin, I would be careful.

review_title: light, non-greasy and great scent. great value!
review_text: Light cream with a fresh scent. Worth it for the price point. Very hydrating. Can be used day or night, easy to apply makeup afterwards. Not greasy and light!

I received this as a reward. My current full size moisturizer is Farmacy’s honey drop lightweight moisturizer but since I received this I’ve been using it everyday. I’m a nurse and normally by the end of my shift my face is so oily. This keeps me matte and hydrated all day. I feel like it tightens my skin and reduces visibility of my pores. There is a scent to this product but I find it clean and pleasant, almost medicinal. I logged on today to purchase the full size because I like it more than the the honey drop moisturizer.

Worked so hard to keep my face smooth and blackhead free just to have all of them show up in ONE day. Very disappointing. I don’t know why this would be recommended for oily skin, when everybody knows that one of the main struggles for people with oily skin is blackheads; this does absolutely nothing to help with that. I should have stuck to the true cream. For the price I expected more than I would from a cheap drugstore oil-free moisturizer. Only pro is that it absorbs somewhat well. This product peels off when applied after oily-skin-care staple: niacinamide.

I honestly love this moisturizer. This is one of the few products from the Farmacy skincare line i use regularly,  (next to the honey lip balm), and it does what it is supposed to do. It doesn’t feel sticky upon application and it works for sensitive skin like mine, and it doesn’t cause harsh breakouts. After using toner, I’ll apply a few dabs of it, and a little does go a long way.
My skin has been really oily recently. I tried this product and now my skin is not oily. I use it morning and night and it really controls the oil well.
I got the sample then I bought the full  size. And I honestly love it. It feels very fresh and love the smell.

I like to follow the Deep Sweep toner with this moisturizer. The two products make a power house combo for combo oily skin. My skin feels clean and moisturized after use. My only complaints about this product are that it does not play well with other moisturizing products like my Cream Skin toner from Laneige and the smell. It smells like artificial lemon lime candy. It is not offensive, but it is also not my favorite. I think this product has specific uses for specific skin types, like mine, but may not be a one size fits all. This will be a repurchase for me and would be a good moisturizer for those with skin that errs on the oily-er side of things.
I have oily skin and I love this as a daytime moisturizer. Super lightweight and it sinks right in to the skin but in a good way. Highly recommend!
it feels nice on the face and smells nice and all but it’s one of those ’dont really want to repurchase’ purchases

Gotta say, I really enjoy using this product! It smells amazing and I don’t normally use products with fragrance because I have more sensitive skin sometimes, but this didn’t irritate me at all. I love the texture and how my skin just drinks it all up. The only reason I’m not giving 5 stars is because I do feel a bit oily after using, but it leaves a beautiful glow. But then again, I do use serums beforehand so it could be feeling oily because of that... As I experiment more in finding my perfect daily routine, I will definitely buy again and see how it goes. I’ll try to return with an update once I’ve repurchased and mastered.  Farmacy’s products haven’t let me down yet!

This sits well under makeup and isn’t super rich so it’s great for daytime. My skin can be sensitive to dimethicone so I love that this is silicone free. I am not acne prone but I did have some minor breakouts the first couple of weeks I used it. I liked the consistency so much I kept with it anyway and my skin got used to it and hasn’t broken out since. A little goes a long way so this will last you a while!

I have oily skin and this moisturizer is great as my warm weather moisturizer. In the colder months the skin around my mouth and eyes tend to flake if the moisturizer isn’t moisturizing enough which I find will be the case with this moisturizer. This product is lightweight, doesn’t feel tacky/sticky, and provide just enough moisture... for the summer. But if you’re like me you won’t be able to use it for the colder months.I’m not a fan of the packaging. It’s made of glass and the top is narrower than the bottom so you’ll have to curl your finger to get the product  out from where the packaging gets wider.

I received a free sample of this product. I liked the smell, texture and the fact that most of the times my skin looked hydrated during morning. I said most of the times, because there were also days where I felt kind of dryness in my skin. I also had couple of breakouts during the time I was using it. The fact that it has been a stressful time makes me ambivalent about the cause of such breakouts. I also liked the fact that it’s vegan and cruelty free. But based on my own experience, most likely, I will not use it anymore.

First of all I can’t stand the smell. It smells like pop/coca cola gummy bears lol not sure what that comes from. Just feels like I’m pouring a fizzy drink on my face. It’s a bit too hydrating for my oily face. Face remains shiny after application.

I had high hope for this product but I really disliked it for 3 reasons 1. It was very greasy on the skin, it was like the moisturizer wouldn’t absorb into my skin, not only making my skin look, but also feel greasy.2. The small is weird, it almost smells like some type of warm spice or something you’d find in a fragrance, but it just smells off putting 3. It broke me out all over my forehead and jaw, It was so bad I washed it off the second time trying it.
Silky and rich gel that goes on light and hydrates beautifully. Smells every bit as good as it’s name and ingredients.

After the first application from this product I broke out instantly, not exactly sure why but it does claim to “purge“ out impurities so I like to think it’s that. I had a feeling that I should keep using it even if it broke me out and I’m glad I did. Personally it wasn’t a miracle worker but it did a really good job at hydrating my face for the most part, not breaking me out after the first application and just a good moisturizer.Cons: for some the smell might put them off a bit but it’s pretty subtle and it subsided, also this cream will only last like a month

This moisturizer has become one of my favorite travel staples. I live in the South but often travel out West for weeks at a time. The climate differences wreak absolute havoc on my skin texture. I am very dry, but less so in humid climates. It’s tricky because I think of myself as combo until I get out West and then I’m just as dry as the desert surrounding me. This formula is so perfect for going between both climates. Never too heavy in humidity, and glorious in the arid climate. I love the weight of it and the way it absorbs is excellent, even luxurious! I have noticed some brightening benefits as well and this moisturizer also cleanses away very easily. Layers well with my SPF and under full face of glam! Using this in combination with Hyaluronic Acid from The Ordinary has been transformative for daily use. Gah. Can’t say enough about this formula. Clean ingredients to boot!
Best moisturizer feels very light weight works great for all day .

As a self proclaimed heavy handed person, I cannot empathize enough how LITTLE you need to use of this product. If you use what you would normal do you will because a greaseball. This stuff smells, great, makes my skin look smooth and will last a long time for how small of an amount is needed daily. I’m really happy I bought it, I love Farmacy products.

Loving everything about this except that it leaves a tacky layer that eventually dries smooth in an hour or so. Definitely leave some time between applying this and then applying makeup. Other than that very happy.

I love this moisturizer ! I love the way it smells and the way it feels on my skin. I have combination skin w acne so a lot of moisturizers are too thick and cause breakouts but this one is light and leaves my skin feeling dewy and smooth. Will purchase again :)

This moisturizer is AMAZING for my combination skin. I’ve been using it in the morning and it does such a good job of keeping me hydrating without going overboard. The packaging is also so good. Highly recommend!
I really like this moisturizer in the morning for my oily skin but it smells like the puke cleaner used in elementary school! Just a warning

As someone who has both acne prone skin and horrible dry skin in the winter this has been great! It keeps my skin well hydrated without it being oily and incredibly smooth. Scent is very light - would recommend this for multiple skin types!

Extremely disappointed in this product, it made me break out in welts which has never happened with any beauty product I’ve ever used. Also I would not consider it a moisturizer it’s some sort of gel that leaves a film on the skin.

Normally I am not a fan of the oil free gel moisturizers. I feel they stay tacky all day and don’t fully absorb. This one however is perfect! I mix 1 pump of Drunk Elephant B-firma serum with roughly a pea sized amount of this moisturizer and it absorbs fully and doesn’t make my oily, dehydrated skin oily or dry throughout the day. I feel my skin is balanced and glowy (not oily). After 8 hrs I’m barely greasy! Not my go to for night time use but absolutely perfect for daytime! Not crazy about the smell either but it doesn’t linger and is pretty light. Doesn’t compete with or alter my Coco Cabana scent!

I actually purchased this item myself during the Beauty Insider Sale and just received it todayThis is a highly fragranced product. It smells intensely like a herbaceous lime, its extremely strong and doesnt dissipate quickly. Its a shame because otherwise i like this moisturizer. It feels really hydrating and almost soothing to my oily retinol-purging skin. However when it dries down, it does feel sticky.Ive been searching for a silicone free moisturizer for a long time and thought i found my HG, but i have to return it because of the scent. I think its strange that a company that focuses on making clean products would load this with fruit and citrus oils, which adds more ingredients and stabilizers, when customers often dislike and react to these scents

I really enjoy everything about this gel moisturizer. It was gifted by the brand for reviewing purposes. I have oily skin and I love how it feels on my skin—it moisturizes without adding any heaviness or oiliness. I also LOVE the clean, fresh scent. It smells so refreshing. I think the ingredients in this are great and it’s priced fairly. A really lovely moisturizer!

I had high hopes for this product, but was disappointed. Not a thin moisturizer as others claim. Took a long time to absorb and my face felt sticky all day. Still decided to keep and use, since I had already wasted the money. But now a week in and I have developed deep cystic acne. This is the only new product I have used in my face in the past 2 months. Will be getting rid of this. I’ll have to restock on my Tatcha Water Cream or Kiehl’s Ultra Facial Cream.

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. It’s a great product!!leaces my face feeling “awake” and rejuvenated when applied. It has a great texture and consistency and smells awesome! It doesn’t dry my skin out after application but actually makes it more radiant

Thank you Farmacy, for gifting me this lovely Daily Green oil-free gel moisturizer. This was my first time using a gel moisturizer and I was pleasantly surprised at how easily it drank into my skin.  I received this product complimentary from Farmacy.

This product was received complimentary from Farmacy Beauty.  Daily Greens has a really nice gel-cream formula that sinks into the skin nicely and isn’t sticky or thick. The composition renders it perfect for oily skin-types, and its ingredients target both lack of hydration and blemishes. I also think this would be a really great moisturizer for warmer weather since it is so lightweight! It does have a strange colour and is pretty fragranced which are the only two iffy things about this product

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. This is a thicker, green gel with a unique texture; It’s a bit less than a cream, it has the slip of an oil, without actually having any oil in it. It smells fresh and not overly fragranced. This is a great post-cleanser moisturizer, since when my face feels stripped, this seems to add hydration back to my face. Overall, a great mid-range moisturizer that seems to take the best trends from kbeauty and make it their own. It’s amazing

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. I like this Daily Greens oil-free gel moisturizer. It makes my skin feel hydrated and not greasy. It has a light, refreshing scent. My skin has never felt better.  Also, the packaging is very nice.  #GreensForAll This was a gift from FarmacyBeauty

review_title: Nice moisturizer for oily and combo skin
review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty for my honest review. This is one of my new favorite skincare brands so of course I was stoked to get this moisturizer out. Overall I have been liking this moisturizer! It’s been wonderful to my skin and doesn’t overwhelm my oiliness. A little goes a long way and makes my skin feel like I took a big gulp of water! The only thing I think could be improved a little is the scent, but it fades quickly so it doesn’t bother me too much. This is a great gel, oil-free moisturizer and I do recommend anyone with oily/combination skin to give it a try!

This is a great moisturizer for the summer time/warm months! I love that it doesn’t contain any oils or silicones, which is really ideal for my sensitive skin, and it provides hydration while being lightweight without feeling greasy or tacky. The only thing that bothers me just a little is the scent of this but it doesn’t linger, which is fine. The packaging is so cute and high quality and this jar looks amazing on my vanity! Another great release from Farmacy!

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. It is an amazing moisturizer that I use both day and night. It is so cool and refreshing once applied to the face. I love the way it seems to wake up my skin. My skin is typically dry in spots and this moisturizer has worked miracles.
I love the consistency of this product. It goes on very nicely. The smell is also amazing. I’ve used this for a few days, and it seems to be doing what it says it does.

Ahh this is gonna be my new fav moisturizer in the upcoming summertime. I have super oily skin, so in the summer I really need a super light moisturizer and THIS IS IT! The smell is very pleasant, kind of fuity without being overpowering. The texture is gel mixed with water. It gets absorbed in the skin right away and is great for under the makeup. I got this complimentary, but I would totally pay the full price for this! #greensforall @farmacybeauty I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty.

I received this complimentary from farmacy in exchange for my honest review. And let me just say this is a product I will be buying on my own again. From the sleek glass jar to the bouncy green moisturizer this product doesn’t disappoint! Such a clean refreshing smell. And so lightweight I look forward to using this everyday ! I have combination skin and I’m left feeling like I left the day spa after applying ! #greensforall @farmacybeauty

Farmacy Beauty gifted me the new Daily Greens Oil Free Gel Moisturizer and I couldn’t be more pleased. Hyaluronic acid is one of my favorite skincare ingredients as it works well with my combination skin. The texture is lightweight and absorbs easily without leaving a greasy feel plus it calmed my skin. My skin holds its hydration better and it helped to noticeably minimize my pores. I have rosacea and I have to say something about this formula really worked well for me. I’ll without a doubt be purchasing in the future.

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. This Daily Greens Oil-Free, Gel Moisturizer has become my new favorite moisturizer in my daily routine. I have combination skin. My t-zone tends to be very oily while I also have dry spots. It’s hard to find a moisturizer to balance my face out without being too greasy. This gel moisturizer does the job. It moisturizers without making my face feel oily an hour later. I use it in morning before applying my makeup and at night after I wash my face before bed. I also noticed my makeup seems to stay in place longer because my face doesn’t seem as oily. It has a light, pleasant scent. A little bit goes a long way. I highly recommend!

Farmacy gifted me this product. Let me start by saying I love this brand, what they stand for, and many of their products. The scent of this is just incredible. It’s similar to their make up removing balm. I have oily combo skin, a little dry in some spots and this has done wonders for me! It’s a great summer moisturizer, as it’s not too heavy and doesn’t sit on top of the skin. I also find it sits quite nicely under make up. Will definitely purchase this when I run out!

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. The Farmacy Daily Green Oil-free gel moisturizer with moringa and papaya is super moisturizing and is oil-free, silicone-free, formaldehyde donor free, synthetics fragrance-free, phthalate-free, mineral-free and cruelty-free for the skin. The moisturizer feels lightweight on my skin without feeling greasy or oily throughout the day. I like that the cream has a refreshing scent of papaya and herbs. This cream has phytonutrients that can help reduce shine on the face and clear the pores from dirt and impurities. The cream has hyaluronic acid that help provide moisture in the deep layers of the skin while holding in moisture so the skin doesn’t dry throughout the day.  I love the packaging of the box and jar which is easy to open and close.  I can tell after using it for weeks my skin isn’t as dry as it uses to be which sometimes when it dries it feels a little. This has helped a lot for my skin and is a cream I would buy or try other products from Farmacy.

This Daily Greens oil-free gel moisturizer is absolutely perfect for my oily/dry combination skin. It works magic in the areas that are dry, but doesn’t create extra oil in the areas that I get oily. I actually think it gives me an even moisture throughout my entire face. I love the scent, it’s so refreshing! I use it both morning and night. I’m not sure I can live without this product!! It’s definitely my new favorite!!I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. #greensforall @farmacybeauty

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. Very cool and unique moisturizer. It works well for my combination skin. It’s very creamy but it’s a gel. It’s thick but not heavy. It feels really good on my skin - it’s cooling and feels super smooth. It is very hydrating, doesn’t feel sticky or leave any residue. I didn’t notice much of a scent, just smells very clean. My skin feels soft and thoroughly moisturized. It’s great because it really penetrates the skin but it’s not greasy like some deep moisturizers can be. It’s the best of both worlds for those of us with combination skin - not too heavy but moisturizes well and deeply without leaving my face feeling oily. #greensforall @farmacybeauty

I love this product. I have combination skin and for me the most important thing when choosing a daily care is lightweight.  This cream is perfect for my skin type. Oil-free, silicon-free moister without feeling greasy. I like to use like a makeup base.

I received this complimentary from Farmacy in exchange for an honest review. I’ve really enjoyed using this! It’s hydrating enough but doesn’t make my skin feel greasy/oily. It smells so good too! I’ll definitely continue to use this. So far it’s great for my sensitive skin.

**I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty as a gift from the brand in exchange for my opinion** First impression was pretty great, the packaging is lovely and the claims the product/company make sound very promising! The product itself a very pretty sea foam green color with a light, pleasantscent. Instantly cooling on skin(will be wonderful for those nasty summer months) when applying and dissolvesbeautifully after a few seconds much like a serum. The majority of my face felt comfortably moisturized save for a few dry patches on my forehead, but considering that I have combination skin I’d prefer to be drier in those areas than oily in the slick spots. I’m definitely excited to see what else this brand has to offer! #greensforall@farmacybeauty

Complimentary from Farmacy Beauty! I absolutely adore this moisturizer! It is super lightweight and has the most amazing gel texture! It absorbs quickly into the skin and keeps it hydrated all day long! I have combination skin and it works wonders due to the lightweight gel consistency and the perfect amount of hydration it gives! Totally recommend!!!

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. I have used this everyday for the last week and my skin loves it! It smells so good and is perfect for my combination skin. I love the way it way it absorbs quickly and feels so lightweight. I have noticed fewer breakouts and a more even skin skintone. I will definitely be purchasing this in the future and I recommend this to anyone looking for an everyday great moisturizer.

There’s no product than can eliminate oil in our face right away but this moisturizer controls shine and adds moisture just right for sensitive skin like mine. I like that it has that refreshing feeling when you apply it has some kind of a soothing feeling.Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a lightweight yet hydrating moisturizer!

I received this complimentary from Farmacy. It has a very soft sweet scent (I think due to the fruit in it). The texture is like a mixture between gel and cream. It is a nice product but I believe it broke me out. I have oily acne prone skin and this says it’s oil free but it may have just been too heavy for my skin. It does moisturize the skin. For what it’s worth, I would not buy this.
I was so excited. The ingredients looked great up until the 3 citrus extracts and limonene fragrance. These will sensitize your skin over time. Sensitive skin people beware. Next.

This Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer is amazing! I love how my skin feels with it on. It hydrates without leaving me feeling greasy. It smells good. The packaging is also so cute! Definitely will be getting more of this product! I was gifted this product complimentary from Farmacy.

First, I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty, and I’m very thankful for that. I really like this moisturizer! It comes in a cute glass jar with a plastic lid, I quite like it. I just hope that there aren’t any photosensitive ingredients because it IS clear. Very aesthetically pleasing, though.It has a very pleasant scent, light and slightly fruity kind of like lemongrass. Not overwhelming, just a nice treat for your nose.It has a texture somewhere between creamy and jelly, feels good going on. The current state of my skin is a dehydrated combo, with slight sensitivity, this feels like the right moisturizer for me, but may not be rich enough for people with drier skin.It sank in pretty quickly despite using probably too much the first time. It left my skin feeling fairly soft and didn’t feel sticky- just VERY lightly tacky like a primer.Speaking of: it played really nicely with my makeup. I was using a liquid foundation and it actually looked better than my previous moisturizer.I used it in the AM following a rinse, hydrating toner and C serum. Also worked fine under sun screen.I used it in the PM after a double cleanse, glycolic serum (not every night), same toner, hydrating lotion and facial oil. It did seem to want to pill a little if I didn’t let the oil completely sink in.Overall, I would definitely keep using this.

#farmacybeautygifted me this lightweight gel moisturizer. This moisturizer feels so lovely on the skin. It has a light refreshing scent to it. I love the glass packaging it comes it. I think the price point is also really good compared to their other products.  #greensforall

complimentary from Farmacy.I have used this product a few times and I am loving it. It smells great, it’s lightweight, feels amazing on the skin. In addition, it has amazing ingredients. My oily skin is loving this product so much.

Farmacy gifted me this daily greens gel moisturizer in return if my honest review. First of all, I love the papaya and willow herb scent perfect combo! This moisturizer is so refreshing and feels good on skin. It’s very lightweight and dries up easily. I also love the fact that it has a hyaluronic acid and polyglutamic acids that are well known for their skin benefits. I use this moisturizer after I clean my face in the morning and evening before going to bed. This product is perfect for those who have combination to oily skin type like mine. My face feel so smooth and hydrated without having that greasy feeling. #greenforall @farmacybeauty

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty, and let me just say..it is AMAZING! I’ve been using it every day, and my skin looks and feels great! It is an oil free gel moisturizer, and it contains polyglutamic acid and hyaluronic acid, which optimizes skin hydration! It also contains moringa, papaya,  which reduces shine and clears pores, willow herb and niacinamide, which helps control oil! Farmacy has created another amazing product with good for you skin ingredients!

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. I love how this moisturizer smells and feels so refreshing on my skin. I keep it in my beauty fridge to keep the gel extra cool, and it’s like a spa day for my skin after a hot day.

I love everything Farmacy so I was so excited when I was asked to review this product. Much like everything else Farmacy the packaging is super high quality. It was a citrus almost green tea scent which makes it so refreshing. A little goes a FAR way, I’m talking a finger tip dip covered my entire face and neck. This is a great moisturizer so it’s a little thicker so I do prefer this for night time, but if you have enough time in your morning routine for this to fully set it would be great for AM too. I have dry skin have been extra dry because of our weather, this stuff worked absolute magic and my skin is the most hydrated it’s been in a long time. I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a high quality affordable moisturizer.

review_title: Great for oily skin or summertime!
review_text: I received this product complimentary from the brand! I think it’s a lightweight product, and it’s been good so far. Glow Recipe kindly gifted their new serum to me to try--which was very exciting--and I immediately started using it when I received it.  I don’t struggle with a lot of redness but I AM always interested in trying products to help strengthen my skin barrier and improve my overall skin health.   For the most part, the ingredients in this formula seem solid which made it more appealing.  I’ve used it both morning and evening and have found that using it at night before bed provides a light amount of overnight hydration that’s still noticeable by morning although I wouldn’t recommend this solely for hydration.  It also works great for me in the morning and doesn’t interfere with makeup application over it if I don’t use a primer and meshes problem-free with any primer that I’ve paired with it as well.  Unlike some serums that I’ve used, this one absorbs very quickly and doesn’t leave a tacky residue but rather my skin is left with just a soft, hydrated sensation.  The packaging is very on-trend with the brand--very cute and appealing--and I appreciate that it’s dispensed easily with a pump.  In terms of formula, the majority of the ingredients are beneficial with a couple of exceptions; I wouldn’t recommend this for those who particularly struggle with acne as it can potentially exacerbate especially fungal acne.  It does have a light scent which is derived from natural ingredients rather than added fragrance but this may also be problematic for some.  Overall, however, the serum contains a blend of ceramides, lipids, glycerin, niacinamide, and some other reputable elements that have proven to be beneficial.  I’m overall happy with the product so far and have had no negative reactions after having used it consistently; I would recommend at least trying it if the product claims are of interest and will continue to use it myself.

review_title: Must use in combination of a water spray
review_text: I’ve used the entire Water Drench range. And I just realized I had been using it wrong! As Hyaluronic works by binding water it draws from the atmosphere with the skin. Therefore you must use it in combination of a water spray, such as Avene, La Roche Posay or Evian. Spray before applying the serum, before the could cream, and spray very generously if your skin feels dry. Use your finger tips to massage in till fully absorbed. You can thank me later! (I took one star off as there should be clearer instructions as how to use the product properly.)

This stuff saved my face. More than a decade of harsh, drying acne treatments and a complete lack of other skincare had essentially turned my entire face into one giant scab. It was more like a thin layer of dried paint than skin. After a lot of research, I figured out what I’d been doing wrong all those years. My skin was lacking water, and the acne meds were stealing more, which was making my skin produce more oil to hang onto its water, which led to clogged pores and more acne, which I then slathered with drying treatments. Then I got this stuff. It’s like a long drink of water for your face. No more dryness and peeling, a lot less oil, and a lot less acne. It’s even gentle enough to use around my eyes, and I have quite sensitive eyes. It’s pricey, but for what it does, I’m willing to pay it. I have found that it works even better with an oil layered on top to help hold the moisture in. That routine has made my skin soft even on Accutane! It’s also great for chapped areas elsewhere. My one very slight caveat is that it makes makeup primers ball up, but that’s not really surprising. And you can continue to use all those nasty drying treatments on top of this stuff, only without the side effect of taking your face off. If this ever gets discontinued, I don’t know what I’ll do!

At first, this product was extremely satisfying. I love the hand of the product and how it is easily distributed onto the skin. Just a dab would cover the whole cheek, however, it leaves your skin shiny and oily. It also isn’t hydrating in humid and warm climates. Hyaluronic acid is honestly an ingredient that the beauty and cosmetic industry exploits. It already exists in our skin and all forms of hyaluronic acid, aside from hydrolyzed hyaluronic acid, is useless because it evaporates before it’s even absorbed in the skin. I wish this product was as effective and appealing as the packaging, but it isn’t all that moisturizing either. I used half of the 20 mL size before I gifted it to a friend. I won’t be incorporating this into my skin care regimen.

This moisturizer is so light weight and even the sample size lasts me months because it spreads really well. My skin was soft, supple and my make-up held so much better. I immediately went back and bought a full one. The difference in my skin is amazing - this is my go-to recommendation for everyone. I’m really pleased with how good it feels on my skin and how good my skin feels after using it!!
