I have sensitive skin, dry/oily skin in the winter and oily skin in the summer. Only a dime size is needed for each cheek area, a smidge for the T-zone and a nickel size for neck area. Works great under serums too. Hydrates very well and doesn’t make my skin more oily. Stays soft and light feeling all day, even with going outside. My very sensitive skin loves this too. Found my Holy  Grail moisturizer!!

The product is called a cream and I did not realize it’s oil-free. It goes on smooth but dries out my skin right after. I piled on the clouds and mists but nope, not drenching. It’s too bad since the packaging is so cute. Maybe for others.
Love it! lightweight

expensive not effective... i like scents and this cream has none.. may be a plus for others. When I put it on it feels great but after a couple minutes it feels like I didn’t put anything... I have combination skin and have tried many other moisterizers way less expensive that works better than this one

review_title: Got eczema? This might be your saving grace
review_text: I’ve had eczema for 18 years and get it around my eyes and mouth occasionally but last two winters it’s been persistent and awful. Nothing works, not even Elidel. I’ve tried literally every other moisturizer in existence. Finally this. I don’t care what this cream is called nor do I bother with “cloud like” consistency. It could smell bad too for all I care (it doesn’t though) as long as it does what it does which is moisturize my face nightly and keep it from getting those awful, flaky eczema blisters. High five!

I received a sample and immediately ordered the full size after trying it once. Super light as air smooth feel that absorbs and hydrated your skin with no sticky oily residue but not drying. My skin is very sensitive and combo of dry/t-zone oily and this is a magic potion! I am obsessed. I just ordered the cleanser and serum from same collection since this moisturizer is so amazing. The texture is the best out there in my opinion. Some face moisturizers that are too heavy make me breakout and this is lighter so have not have any issues.

I’ve only had this about four days. The east coast winter is making my aging skin age even faster so I went for help. This was recommended to me and the first evening I noticed my dry tight skin was much more moisturized and not feeling as dry. I have it 4 rather than 5 stars only because I want to reserve my judgement for a couple weeks and see what kind of improvements may be achieved. I still have dry patches. It’s not a ‘maracle’ but it may be heading my skin to a nicer more moisturized place in these cold weather conditions.
Love! With my dry skin in winter it really feels like instant moisture going into your skin. I don’t use this everyday either. Only when I don’t use vitamin C or retina.

I have really dry flaky skin with acne. I am using this product with Peter Thomas Roth acne clearing wash(also dying). My skin has never been so moisturized. I get occasionally flakiness over post acne marks that are healing. However, this product is the best I’ve used so far and doesn’t make me break out.

So I was really skeptical buying this product although I had heard many good reviews but decided to give it a shot. I later realized after I continued to use it that it was creating a lot of texture and small bumps all over my face. The cream itself was very moisturizing although I just know it wasn’t suitable for my skin type at all. I have combination oily/dry skin and quite a bit of redness on my cheek areas with few breakouts occasionally. I believe (correct me if I’m wrong) but after doing some research and talking to my new skincare specialist that Salicylic acid and Hyaluronic acid aren’t normally treated for young and immature skin. At least not until about 22  because our skin cells turn over faster than that of matured skin. So if you are a younger adult like me looking for a good moisturizer; this is not the route to go.

I love how this stuff feels. It’s lightweight but does amazing things for dehydrated skin. I use it in the morning over serum and under sunscreen and it layers like a dream. My only complaint is that I wish the packaging wasn’t a jar.
I’m really enjoying this. I first got it as a sample and got the full size the next day

I absolutely love love LOVE this moisturizer. It’s amazing!!!!! I was recommended this moisturizer by one of the consultants in the store, and I thought ok she’s definitely trying to sell me the most expensive stuff on the shelf but I ain’t buyin’!!! She was talking it up really well and she gave me a little sample on my hand. While she was talking I was like ok finish so I can say no thank you and leave but as she talked I massaged it in and OMG. I didn’t even let her finish when I said Ill buy it!!! she kinda looked at me funny like what??? but whatever I love it and now my sister is using it and so is my mom!!! Very very satisfied customer right here.

I love this product! It was suggested to me by an employee when I was at Sephora. When you put it on, it completely absorbs into your skin. I’m on my second one. It lasted me about two and a half months, using it at least twice a day.

This moisturizer feels very hydrating on the skin. I normally use Korres 24 hr moisturizer and this one feels very different. Korres leaves my skin supple. The Hydraulic Cloud leaves my skin hydrated as if I gave my skin a drink of water.
I have combination skin and was looking for a lighter end moisturizer w/ the benefits of hyaluronic acid but it just sat on top of my skin. Didn’t even absorb at all

This is my favorite moisturizer. I normally have oily/combination, and acne prone skin. Ever since I’ve used this regularly, my skin is now well balanced and does not produce excess oils. This moisturizer (alongside my other skincare) has single-handedly kept my acne at bay due to balancing my oil production and dehydrated skin, which can be a factor for breakouts. Personally, I believe this moisturizer is best for oily/ dehydrated skin, since it’s very light weight! I really recommend this product as it has been a staple in my skincare routine for months!

This moisturizer is absolutely amazing. I have super dry skin but this really hydrates it.You need very, very little of it to cover your whole face and it makes you feel like your face is wet and dewy.I would buy this again in a heartbeat.
This cream clogged my pores and I had lots of breakouts.  The Moreno you touch this product the waterier it became so yes it does hydrate. Better products out there.
I absolutely love this cream, it leaves my skin so smooth and soft!

I break out easily, but I need good moisture for my combination skin, which doesn’t like alcohol.  There are plenty of moisturizers in the same category as this one, but this is the one my skin has chosen to love.  It has a lot of great ingredients, so maybe I can make up for the price by deleting something redundant from my repertoire.

This has been my favorite thing from the play!box, received the deluxe sample which lasted me two weeks that I had to buy the full size. This moisturizer is so lightweight, but packs a punch with hydrating my skin, especially in the dry Utah climate. I hope PTR never discontinues it because it is my favorite moisturizer ever.
This product is fantastic! I apply so easily and drys quickly and last all day! Great product to apply before primer and makeup

I’ve been using this for 2 months now and I can’t tell you enough how amazing it is. Yes it’s a little pricier but the amount of money I’ve spent trying to find that one perfect sleeping moisturizer is ridiculous. It has made my skin more smooth, reduced texture. It’s calming and soothing, and there isn’t anything in there that I would put on my naughty list. Def recommend.

So far so good. No irritation and good formulation. I haven’t seen any miraculous transformation but happy that the first ingredient in here is collagen (makes me somewhat justify the cost). And while I have no irritation, I just wish this didn’t have fragrance, there’s just no need especially for a night cream.

I’ve been using both Genius Liquid Collagen & the Sleeping Collagen (& occasionally Genius daytime collagen moisturizer) for 3 years, I LOVE the Sleeping Collagen the most, & if I could only have one product l’d choose the Sleeping Collagen because it’s so unique; all the benefits of a nighttime facial oil for deep moisturizing + collagen AND it sinks in, not at all goopy. I use it 2 nights a week in summer & 3 nights a week in winter, when I’m in for the evening & after washing with an exfoliating scrub (Philosophy MicroDermabrasion) at least an hour before bed, pat dry & then dab on the Sleeping Collagen & gently smooth over my whole face (but NOT eyelids), letting it soak in before pillow time.  I’m almost 70 & people often comment on my youthful skin so I highly recommend both.

This moisturizer really saved my dry winter skin, but was not too heavy for summer. I bought it in February and it lasted until August. It really does have a texture like butter yet doesn’t make me break out. I feel like it’s reduced fine lines but making my skin hydrated and dewy. I just repurchased, it is expensive but it lasts 6+ months and I used more than the recommended pea sized amount.

So I’ve been using this cream for about 3 weeks now, and I am pretty happy with it. For reference I am 27 years old with combination sensitive skin. This cream is a rich buttery consistency that melts into your skin. Often I find rich hydration creams to leave a residue on my skin but this one absorbs well for me. The light vanilla scent is nice and not over powering. After my first use I woke up with plump hydrated skin. After 3 weeks my skin is well hydrated from this cream and my usual winter flaking around my nose is non existent. The only reason I’m not giving it 5 stars is because I haven’t noticed a difference in my fine lines mind you I don’t have many because of my age and also 3 weeks of use may not be enough time to allow the product to minimize fine lines. Over all happy!

I wanted this cream because of a recommendation from a favorite Youtuber. I didn’t think I would like it as much as I do. I have very oily combo skin, but more oily. I’m 31, and I’m seeing fine-lines developing on my forehead. This cream has helped with the lines. It applies very balmy. It feels great. Doesn’t feel oily in the least and my skin drinks it up (remember I’m oily). I love this stuff.

Delightfully buttery texture that has a calming effect upon application that doesn’t feel tacky or greasy. Skin feels sealed in, but not caked in - which, considering it smells like vanilla you’ll almost want it to be cake! I’ve been using about 6 months now and have barely put a dent in it, love that I don’t need much for each use. Fabulous for drier winter weather, but I also didn’t find the hot summer months to change how it felt either. Probably one of my most favorite additions to my nighttime regime!
Sooo good! Hands down the best night cream! This stuff has hydrated and plumped my skin like no other. It’s pricey but it lasts forever and it’s so worth it.

review_title: I will keep getting this based on scent alone!
review_text: This cream smells soooo nice! It’s a mild scent, imo, maybe a little like vanilla. (Vanillin is an ingredient.) And the texture is very thick and luxurious! It protects and moisturizes my face so well overnight. A little bit goes a long way!
I absolutely love this stuff! I got it it as a deluxe sample years ago and keep buying container after container of it now!

I am 30, dry skin, dull skin.I got this cream yesterday and used for the first time last night. I have already noticed the difference this morning!! My skin is dewy, pumped and bright. It feels very similar to my previous injectable beauty booster.  I am happy with it. Can’t wait to see what will happen after weeks

I’m not one to leave reviews normally, but this cream is so glorious it deserves to be spoken about! I have been dealing with smile lines around my mouth that have gotten fairly prominent as I smile constantly in my customer service world which is also set in the great outdoors - My skin takes a beating! I was looking for something to help “erase“ these crevasses as I am just too young for them yet! I do have acne prone skin and noticed that, if worn too often and/or not blended into skin well enough, this collagen cream did give small breakouts. However, I found that the best for me was to apply this two or three nights in a row about once or twice a week or so and, voila! My skin is youthful and supple upon waking! This has been the very best product I have used for filling in those deepening lines and stopping them from getting any worse. Just be sure to not use it every night and, seriously, a little goes a veeery long way! This has a slick consistency when applied that just melts and slides over skin - It is not only plumping but hydrating too! Rub it in thoroughly! This tub will last me probably two years, there is so much product for needing so little! This will remain a staple in my skin care routine.
Wanted to like this product but it stings my eyes(applied up to my cheeks only). Need to find another sleep product.

Got a sample, and tried it.  I couldn’t believe how soft it made my skin feel, it’s amazing.  I immediately ordered the full size which just came today.  It feels so good on your skin.  It’s pricey, but the jar is big and you only use a little do it will last a long time.

I have dry, sensitive skin. Not the “my skin is just dry in the winter“, my skin is dry year round. I received a sample of this product and when I read what it was for I thought I give it a try. It has a slight fragrance which is fine and the product did not break me out which is always a plus. But this product is not hydrating. When you first apply it goes on smooth and spreads nicely over the skin but after it absorbs my skin feels dry to the touch. I applied this product to damp skin because anyone with dry skin knows to apply moisturizer to damp skin. I’m sure this product works well if your skin is not truly dry, save your money and get a real moisturizer.

I’m so surprised by the number of bad reviews here. Algenist products aren’t usually my go-to line for skin care.But I used my Beauty Insider points to get the 10-packet deluxe sample. Let me tell you: After the very first night of use, my skin responded so well to this lovely cream. It is NOT heavy, greasy, or thick, and it has a nice, subtle scent.My aging skin (55) was exhausted from daily use of Vitamin C and Tretinoin (Rx version of retinol.)My face wasn’t glowy and it just looked and felt overworked. Using this Sleeping Collagen was like 10 spa days for my face! It feels fantastic going on, and the next morning, I could clearly see a rejuvenation of my skin—super smooth, nicely hydrated, smaller-looking pores, and relief of that overworked sensation in my skin.It even made my neck and chest incredibly smooth, and in about a week, the horizontal ‘tech-neck’ lines were noticeably smoothed.Like all Algenist products, it’s simply too expensive...yet I’m buying the full size today. When a night cream works this well on an aging, sun-damaged face & chest, you have to dig deep and pay a lot for it. But just a couple drops cover your face, which means the jar will last several months. If you have the budget for it, this is a beautiful product.

I love this so much. Thank goodness I received a sample so I knew how amazing it was. I am 39yo and have minimal forehead lines and wrinkles around my eyes. My mom is 70 and has deep eye lines. This has greatly helped us both not mention give our skin moisture. we use it every night before bed. Totally worth the money. It only takes a little product so it will last quite awhile.

After using this product for a couple days I had a horrible breakout on the left side of my face. Like 10+ bumps/pimples popped up out of no where. I did initially really like it, but unfortunately I will not continue using due to my skin’s reaction to it.
It is a think cream but doesnt feel clogging. My skin is super soft when i wake up in the AM. Dont see any fine line improvement yet . have been using consistently for 2 week

At first I was a bit skeptical about what this product could do. I saw the pictures and the price and read all the reviews and I thought, you know what? Let’s give it a shot!I have been using it every night for 2 weeks now and my skin is WAY SMOOTHER! My partner even noticed it! The tiny wrinkles I had on my forehead are basically gone and my deep wrinkle don’t seem as deep anymore. Will definitely keep using every night!

I’ve been struggling with dry skin and increasingly visible pores and fine lines, and I found that this product quickly refreshed my skin, making it soft and  firmer. The price tag was a bit intimidating, but I found that you only need a small amount and that the product has a long life.

I love Algenist products and was excited to try this based on the rave reviews. I was disappointed this did nothing to moisturize my skin. I woke up with my skin feeling much drier than when I would use the Algenist overnight restorative cream. I used a sample I received for about a week.

My latest skincare obsession is sleeping masks and night creams, so I’ve been testing a handful of them in search of greatness. I can honestly say that I’ve found it with this product. I use different products, depending on my skin’s needs each particular day. When my skin is feeling parched and in need of serious hydration, I reach for Sleeping Collagen night cream and it does not disappoint! This cream is very rich and thick, but it applies like silk. A little bit goes a long way and it melts into the skin like butter. The scent is very minimal and smells faintly like their Ultimate Anti-Aging Cream (which I love - the product & the scent). The first time I tried this, I was blown away! When I woke up the next morning, I couldn’t believe how soft and supple my skin was. It felt smooth, plump, hydrated and baby soft. I do not have flawless skin, but for the first time in a long time, I was in awe over how amazing my face looked and felt. I’ve been using this along with Liquid Collagen and my skin has never looked better. I’m looking forward to seeing the long term effects this has on my skin, but for now, I’d call it an overnight miracle.It’s definitely an investment, but now that I’ve tried it, I can’t live without Sleeping Collagen.

The texture of the cream is very nice. It’s thick and mosturizes really well. My skin absorbed it really well. The smell of the cream is neutral. It doesn’t have a strong scent. I liked it but I gave it 3 stars because I didn’t really see any difference in my skin appearance.
The texture of this product is very smooth and it doesn’t leave any residue. My face feels refreshed in the morning and it is helping to tighten the skin in my face.
**Received this complimentary from Influenster**I really ended up loving this stuff. It’s nice and buttery and really moisturizes my super dry checks.

Love this moisturizer so much! I received this as part of a complimentary Influenster VoxBox. This moisturizer is so creamy, so butter, it looks like it might be heavy but it goes on really light! I was scared it might be greasy because its a night cream but it was so light and perfect! I do not too many signs of aging, but at 29, I need to start making night creams and collagen part of my routine. Besides making my skin feel supple and moisturized, I did see my forehead line fill in! I would definitely recommend this if you want to spoil yourself, your mom, a girlfriend. At $98, this is the most expensive cream I have ever used but honestly, save your pennies because this cream is worth it!

I really liked this product! I received it free from Influenster. It’s very hydrating, so may not work well if you are on the oily side, but feels lightweight on the skin. Loved this as a night cream. Has a slight scent, but it’s not overwhelming.

I received this collagen in my VoxBox, and I was blown away. When I put this on before I go to sleep I wake up with moisturized (not greasy) skin, my skin is plumper, and my redness is lessened. My only problem is because the product is so thick and I have long nails it’s hard for me to get the product out unless I scrap it out with my nails and I end up taking too much out.

I received this product for free via influenster for reviewing purposes, and oh my, this is a gem, it smoothes my skin to perfection, leaves pores less visible and its very moisturizing but doesnt leave my face oily.

I received this product free through Influenster. I wanted to love this, especially living in Michigan in the winter. The cream was too thick/oily for my combination skin. A little goes a long way, and still ended up all over my bedding and clothes. I loved the serum, but the night cream was too thick for my liking.

Loved it! Very very hydrating. Doesn’t feel sticky. I paired it with the Liquid Collagen and I noticed a difference quickly! Definitely recommend. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are my own.

I have dry skin and am always looking for something hydrating. I was excited to try this cream as I assumed, it being a night time cream, that it would be even more hydrating. It’s become my daytime cream- it’s just not enough to get me though the night but I do really like it. The texture is great, it absorbs well, even with oil and products already on the skin. I also really like the scent. My skin has a nice glow to it and I am able to apply makeup over, though I use a minimal amount- I’m not sure how things this would do with foundation on top. While I did receive this from Influenster, it’s a product line I’ve wanted to try. For the price, in not sure I would repurpose even though I did like it. I think it’s better for someone with normal skin and I didn’t notice much of an anti-aging difference.

I received this product complimentary for testing purposes. My skin is always horrible in the winter. It’s dry which makes every wrinkle, blemish, and line stand out so much more. This collagen moisturizer has battled the cold winter air and left my skin feeling and looking amazing. I’ve noticed my skin is more hydrated, I feel like I look younger because my wrinkles are barely noticeable, and my skin is so soft. I will buy this product when I run out. I also use the liquid collagen serum- which is fantastic and pair so well.
This moisturizer is amazing! It hydrating, and does all the work for me while I am sleeping. It makes my skin feel soft and healthy without being oily. I recommend this product to everyone!

From the scent to the feel of this amazing night collagen cream...it screams luxury. Love how it makes my skin so silky soft with a healthy glow. I actually use it during the day (a few times a wk) now that the winter months are upon us and my skin needs just a little extra help along with my nightly regimen.

Love this product!!! My skin has improved drastically since I received it. I apply it at night after I cleanse it. Every morning I wake up with beautiful dewy supple skin. I received this product conplimentary from Influenster for sampling purposes but all opinions are my own.

When I began using this product I started to notice a change in my skin. It began looking more supple and smooth. I had heard about this product before and was always curious about it. It works so well!

First of all, this smells amazing! It goes on super smooth and very little goes along way! I put it on at night and it when I wake up in the morning my skin feels and looks amazing. Even tone and very plump. I highly recommend this product. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes and absolutely love it! My opinions are based on my very own personal experience

I like this product a lot! It has a nice consistency and it applies really easily. I have been using it for a little over a month and my skin feels more hydrated in the mornings and softer. It has a nice scent to it but it isn’t overwhelming. The only complaint I have is that on occasion when I put another product on top of this product or if I put on to much, it will pill on my skin.  Overall though, it’s a great moisturizer and I plan to keep using it. I received this product through influenster for sampling purposes.

I like that it is plant based skin care product. The texture of the cream is firm; you have to melt it down with your body heat. It is a thicker cream so definitely use it at night and wash face as usual in the morning. The price is on the high end side but most night creams are. mention that you received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are your own.

Finally I found a night treatment for my face, specially in this time of the year when my skin is more susceptible to the weather change. I have been using with the collagen liquid and the results is really amazing, if you skin is normal don’t be shy to use a butter cream like this, your skin will be grateful.  Finally I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are your own.

The first time I tried this product, I paired it with the GENIUS Liquid Collagen. The collagen was sticky and not pleasant. However, the cream had a wonderful velvety feel to it. Nice scent that was not strong which is important for me in a night cream. The second time I used it, I opted to try it alone. It was much better! No stickyness like with the liquid collagen. I woke up with nice rejuvenated skin the next morning. This is not to say that all my wrinkles went away or anything but it felt fresh and rested. I have worn the cream for about two weeks now and I can see the difference. However, I do wish that it was a little more hydrating. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are your own.

They aren’t lying when they say this cream is like butter! I was surprised to find just how thick it is. I’ve never used a night cream quite like this before. The scent is pleasant, not strong, but there. I’ve got acne prone skin so I was hesitant to put something so thick on it, but tried anyway and I was happy to wake up with the same skin I went to bed in. No extra break outs or problem areas, but I didn’t notice much of a difference either. After a few more days of use I haven’t seen much of a difference overall, but it does seem like the deeper wrinkles in my forehead are more smooth than they were when I started. I’m going to keep trying it and see if those continue to fade. The beauty of this cream is that it will last forever! It’s a generous jar and you’re not using very much each night because it’s so substantial. Would I pay $98 for it, probably not, but it is a quality product with quality ingredients.  I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are my own.

This is the product I was not expecting to be the way it ended up. Genius sleeping collagen by Algenist is a super creamy and very thick night cream.  It has very little in the way of smell or scent and when applied it feels similar to a smoother and buttery Noxema. The texture upon first glance and application is luxurious. Unfortunately, that, to me, is where the positive qualities of this cream ends. When massaged into the skin it is very oily and the residue is almost unsettling.  Nearly immediately I wanted to wash it off and instead chose to sleep in it overnight. After waking up in the morning the very first thought I had was to get it out of my skin. While there was no redness or irritation my skin felt very heavy. I’m not sure if this was just my experience or the experience of others but this is not a product I could recommend. I would not go out of my way to purchase this product again.

As the name suggests, this is a moisturizer to be used during your nighttime routine before bedtime. I, being a dumb-dumb, disregarded the “sleeping“ portion of the name and decided to start using this product day and night. I found out real quickly that this moisturizer is indeed too thick to be used that way. It feels too heavy under makeup and also causes some of my primers and foundations to pill. So I have been using this just at night for the last few weeks and in conjunction with the Liquid Collagen. The plant collagen, collagen amino acids and ceramides have definitely healed my skin. My dry patches are now gone! . Algenist claims that this product also releases natural, stress-relieving notes to help promote restful sleep, which I sadly can’t confirm. Working night-shift has messed up my sleep schedule and after using this product for about a month now, I still don’t sleep well. To be honest, I don’t think any beauty product is really going to help with that. How does this moisturizer compare to others? Well sure, there are plenty of thick moisturizers out there, but this one contains VEGAN plant collagen and Algenist’s patented Alguronic Acid! Furthermore, this formula doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin with heavy fragrances or make it feel congested. In the morning, my skin feels soft, hydrated and revived! Despite having a high price tag, a little goes a long way and the effects this has on my skin are outstanding! I highly recommend that y’all try it out! Head to your closest Sephora and just ask for a sample!(I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are your own. )

I really enjoy using this cream on my face overnight! It is super hydrating and left my skin feeling moisturized and plump in the morning.  This product has a very pleasant smell and feels amazing on the skin. I received this product in a Voxbox free from Influenster

The texture on this product is really nice. It’s buttery and smooth. I feels really good on the skin. It’s not too heavy so you don’t get a greasy feel but you still get a lot of hydration and moisture. I’ve just started using this product I received it complimentary from Influenster to review and I’m loving it so far.

review_title: Don't Sleep on this Beauty Secret
review_text: This product is amazing! The smell is soooo good. Reminds me of sweet almond oil and it is very smooth. I have been using this product for 3 weeks now and I have noticed my skin is soft and mosturized even through the day! I received this product complimentary for sampling Purposes but it is worth the buy.

I received this complimentary from Influenster. I have found that I am getting compliments that my skin is glowing and more plump than it was before. My skin is in good condition breakout wise, so I will continue to purchase when I run out! I’m so glad I found something that does not make me break out!

I really loved how luxurious the product felt. It feels like hydration all over your skin. The scent was a bit strong for my personal preference. I received this product complementary for sampling purposes but all opinions are my own.

I got this from vox box. I was super excited to get to review this. This review is honest , because I am a huge addict of face care. First the product is full to the top. So you’re getting your money’s worth. Second the first time I used it it didn’t take much to cover my face.  At first it felt like it sat on top of my skin, but it does melt into the skin . It is alittle oily. But from someone who has very dry skin I didn’t find that an issue. When I woke up my face feels moisturized still. I’ve been using it for two weeks and honestly I’m super happy with it. I feel like my fine lines are less noticeable . And it helps my skin feel more youthful. I would recommend this .

I have recently used this product for the past 3 - weeks. It really has a rich texture and is great for the winter season! I have combination skin so I only put it on nightly 2 days out of the week. It really helped moistured my skin but if I put it every night I would break out.

The Algenist Sleeping Collagen feels more like an OG body butter than anything else. To be honest, I was afraid it would break me out ... but it didn’t! Its definitely thicker than any night cream I’ve used before, but a little goes a long way. While it really enjoy it as a face cream, I love it for my face/chest area. I paired this product with the Algenist Liquid Collagen, putting that on a freshly washed face, waiting about a minute then warming up the Sleeping Collagen and applying that on top. I’m a sucker for serums since the penetrate deeper into the skin and these pair nicely. They both have a subtle, natural scent - reminds me of a mild white tea. While this is too thick to use during the day, after a nights sleep it has all absorbed well. No miracle Botox like affects after 2 weeks, but definite short term effects as an awesome moisturizing product (especially for the winter). While this cost more than I’d usually spend on a night cream (only reason for the -1 star), I do expect it to last much much longer since a tiny bit goes a long way. Yay for Collagen!I also tried mixing some of my self tanning serums into this product - both the Tan Luxe and Isle of Paradise drops blend very well. review_text: This stuff works wonders! If have hyperpigmentation especially if you’re a POC, give this a try! I have long suffered from adult acne as well as post-acne hyperpigmentation and scars. This product will fade scars and pigmentation and prevent new acne from forming.  This will also prevent aging and you definitely want to start using it early in your 20s for that purpose. Retinol is a strong product and you have to slowly introduce it to your skin care routine to avoid irritation. It will take months to see results, but it is worth it. You want to use retinol permanently as you never stop benefiting from it. I’m including before and after pics, and even though I don’t have perfect skin yet I’m doing a lot better than before! Pics were taken about three months apart.  PS: if you’re using this for hyperpigmentation it is crucial to use SPF religiously or else the sun will undo all your good work as it will darken your hyperpigmentation.

review_title: Worth the money if you look at the ingredients!
review_text: I’m a part of various online skincare communities, and any time this products comes up, I invariably see someone complain it’s way too expensive for a retinol. The problem, I think, is that one thing a lot of people don’t realize is that this cream isn’t *just* a retinol. If you look at the ingredient list, you see that this is actually a very well-formulated product that includes a lot of superstar ingredients, including niacinamide (great for regulating sebum production and actually making retinol more effective), peptides (excellent molecules for lessening the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles and encouraging further collagen production), and tetrahexyldecyl ascorbate (a form of fat-soluble vitamin C that helps brighten skin and protect against free radicals). So, if you’re looking for a straight retinol, there are cheaper options; however, if you’re looking for a well-formulated product that includes awesome actives and gives you serious “bang for your buck,“ this is the cream for you.

I’ve been using this once a week for eight weeks now and I have to say the results are real and very, very impressive. My black heads on my nose are almost invisible now. My crow’s feet look dramatically reduced. My dark spots are much lighter. I can’t believe the results while only using it once a week! I can’t wait to start using it twice a week. I had some major peeling during the last four weeks but don’t let that put you off. It’s absolutely worth the wait for that part of the adjustment to be over. I never had any redness. I never get acne, but this did cause a mild purge which was over quickly. I have tried every variation of retinol in The Ordinary line up and none of them ever did anything. Spend the money on this because you will see results. Just be patient and start slow! I wish I could give it ten stars!

review_title: If you can splurge on it, GET IT.
review_text: I need to start off by saying that I think we should be getting more product for the price point or at the very least more practical packaging for getting every last bit out of this very expensive cream- this is why I give 4 stars and not 5. That being said, I really whole heartedly believe in this product. I have used so many things to smooth out the texture of my skin, decrease the appearance of acne scars, and just overall improve my face. NOTHING has so effectively done this without stripping my skin and making me a scaly flaky mess. Until now. This has truly been a game changer for me in every way possible and I have actually waited until I was finished with my first bottle to write this review because I believe skin care is something you really need to try over time. It lasted me a couple of months, and I have already repurchased a new one because I just need this in my life. I’ve stopped buying little odds and ends here and there for my skin completely because I’ve found my answer. I use this after my toner and my skin has not been so lovely since the day I was born.

Let me start by saying I’m all in on D.E. products. I was terrified of retinol and only chose to try it after the brand released their own version. I have no other retinols to compare it to so this review is just about this product itself. Let me start by saying, I had a skin infection last year after a round of chemo that left my skin raw and scarred. To this day, my skin will get hives if it’s irritated so I was nervous to try an ingredient that is notoriously harsh but I’m SO glad I did. I mix 1 pea size amount with 2 pumps B-Hydra 2x per week and always layer lala whipped moisturizer over it. At first my skin was a little pink and angry but over the last month it’s adjusted. That was the worst of it. I haven’t experienced any peeling or angry red spots and it doesn’t cause my skin to blister or hive (which is an issue specific to my sensitive skin, not retinols in general). I’ve been taking before and after pictures each week and the changes are astonishing. The little bumps and clogged pores have cleared up, the scarring is becoming less noticeable and the overall texture and tone of my skin is improving.  I haven’t tried it without diluting it with B-Hydra or following up with a rich moisturizer and I don’t think I will... but my extremely sensitive skin has been tolerating this product well and after 4 weeks I saw improvements. I suggest taking weekly progress pictures so you can see the improvements, it’s very subtle on a day to day basis.

review_title: a little research gives it a chance
review_text: I’ve been using this product since release. So thats about 2 full months at this point. All the people on here complaining about how it makes their skin peal clearly didn’t do any research before slapping this on their face. That is a very common side effect to non retinoid/retinol tolerant skin. You have to build up tolerance over time. That being said my skin only lightly pealed twice with this. I used it every second day alternating with the framboos, sometimes I use the baby facial once a week but I’m lazy so it’s inconsistent.—Just for reference. Once your skin is tolerating this product it is nice. I have eczema on my face which has calmed down and the redness that comes with it has also faded. I would recommend this to anyone. Just everyone needs to understand it’s not an overnight thing.

I had major acne scarring and it’s definitely improved but I need to use the products more for it to completely get better. Be warned- there is a “purge” period if your skin is acne prone, I broke out so bad for a few weeks but it all went away with no additional scarring. It also made the skin on my nose and under my eyes horrendously dry. I don’t put it under my eyes but it probably spread there while I’m rolling around in my sleep. I need intense moisture while using, especially because I live in MN and we regularly have -30 degree weather. I LOVE Drunk elephant as a whole and can’t wait for more results.

I’ve been using every 3rd night and after this next application I’m going to every other.  I use a rich gentle cream after I apply it.  My skin looks great the morning after.  I’m a fan!
So far do good! I have been using for about 3 weeks and I can see a noticeable difference!

So far so good! I have been using this product on the backs of my hands for a couple weeks to make sure I’m not gonna break out into a monster, and today I tried this in a mix with one pump of Lala and one drop of Marula oil... my entire face feels like a dolphin! So smooth, such great texture. Can’t wait to buy the full size.

Woo. Woooooo. This stuff is legit. I’ve tried Retin-A before.. and this stuff is just as strong. Be careful... Read and follow the directions. Start by applying once a week and use a good moisturizer at all times. Do NOT, for the love of cheese, scrub on your face at all while using this stuff. I didn’t do it, I’m just speaking from past experience. Wash your face with hands only. Unless you just like that “scrubbing my sun burnt face with a Brillo pad” feel. And always use a skin loving sun screen. Enjoy! I think I will!

I have used this time and time again and it never fails me. I have dry combo skin and for me if I’m not exfoliating a few times a week I feel like I’m not letting my true glow shine through! This is the BEST
I love using this scrub after I remove the fuzz off my face. It makes me feel as if I removed the dead skin and makes my skin feeling refreshed and smooth. It’s not harsh and has a pleasant smell.

I love this product.  It is my only high end skin product right now.  I am on a tight budget, so I use mostly drugstore skincare.  I am glad I chose this one because it does one of the most important things which is to deep clean and exfoliate my face.  My face looks ten times better.  It is smooth.  There is less little break outs.  I just use it once or twice a week.  I was told how young I look the other day.  The person said I look 10 years younger.  Please keep selling this product.  Every time I find an exfoliator that I like, they discontinue it.  Also, I do this in the shower so that I can completely wash off the granules.  That is the easiest way.

I bought this a couple of weeks ago and used it several times. It does work (that is why I am giving this 3 stars); however, I don’t smell any lemon, which I love. I am disappointed. Would I buy this again, probably not.

I’ve used this scrub for couple of weeks and do not notice much difference. Though it smells nice, like lemon merengue. So I’d rather spend on dessert rather than this scrub. Will not buy again. At the same time, the scrub did not cause any issues for my skin, no breakouts, no sense of dryness after using it. So maybe this is the positives . I am sure I’ll be able to find similar product for fraction of the cost.
Great product but the small size of the tube shocked me! I would have given it five stars if the tube was twice as big for the price. I will say a little goes a long way, but really!

review_title: Recommended to use for overnight formula
review_text: This is my on the go product ( always buy an extra one in case they discontinue it) I have oily and sensitive skin due to which I really dont prefer using scrubs on my face. The tube is soft and easy to squeeze but it feels sturdy. This is a great one to keep in your shower because unlike a jar, water can’t get inside the packaging.
The texture buffs out any oil and dry patches, smooths skin easily. It does cause a bid of short term redness after use and dryness but if you use a good moisturizer you’ll be good to go.

Love this product!! It leaves my skin feeling smooth and supple. I use it in the shower and leave it on for about 5 mins as it gives the “AHA’s” a moment to absorb into my pore-opened, damp skin. I massage it in after and wow my skin is so soft and clear! Im impressed every single time I use it. It’s definitely a must try!

Completely underwhelmed with this product. I find it counterintuitive to have a scrub withAHA in it. I’m going back to using my old scrub: much better with a cleaner rinse. No bits get stuck in my eyelashes and no I don’t scrub my eyelids.

Hands down my favorite exfoliant facial scrub to date. Gentle and effective. Pleasant lemon fragrance. Skin feels smoother and looks brighter. Has even helped diminish acne and redness. Would definitely recommend.
Got this to help with my dry flakey skin, after one use saw major changes!!

Love! Gentle and effective for my sensitive skin. Love the smell and how my skin feels afterwards. I use it 3 times a week in the shower and I find it helps keep my skin and breakouts at bay. I used to use the walnut scrub but I find this to be gentler on my skin and less irritating. Will definitely repurchase.
Actually, I didn’t like it, the fragrance and I didn’t think it did the job, hard to rinse off.

review_title: Ole knocked it out of the park with this!
review_text: I have incredibly sensitive skin and have been suffering lately with texture but this scrub changed my life! My skin is so smooth after using this and I haven’t had any reactions with it which is so rare!

The grit is not very coarse yet has enough to feel that this product really is exfoliating. This product does have a lemon scent to it although it is not overwhelming at all. This exfoliater does feel like it works can’t wait to keep trying it out.

The lemon scent had me smiling from the first moment I opened the tube. I appreciate that the scent was not too overwhelming & just the right level of enjoyment. Also, I noticed a change in the overall texture of my skin & I like that it’s not too harsh on my skin.

I’ve been really enjoying this scrub! First of all I LOVE the smell of lemon, so this stuff smells great! The grain is pretty small so the scrub doesn’t seem too abrasive. For the quality and price, I really like it!

I got this product as a complementary sample from influencer! I was super excited to be chosen to test this product! This product smells super good. I got the opportunity to try this and I absolutely love it. It makes my skin soft and smell amazing! I would highly recommend this. It smells delicious like lemonade and does the job perfect!

I recently received this product free from Influenster to try out and I certainly have some conflicted feelings. First of all, I really enjoy the smell of this face scrub as it is refreshing while still being subtle. It definitely smells like lemon, therefore if someone is sensitive to citrus smells I would recommend just skipping this one but it is honestly not too overpowering! I also want to note that the packaging is very nice, easy to store, and very beautifully designed as well. I find the product extremely easy to use due to the packaging which is amazing. BUT, as much as I love the small things about this product, the product itself is only okay. I am not the biggest fan of scrubs, but I decided to use this one on my face initially. I noticed no change in my pores and I felt like the scrub was actually a little too rough for my face because I typically have sensitive skin. So, I started using the scrub for my body which works wonderfully but still not what it is intended for. Overall, this product is just OK and for the price I would definitely say that other products could be purchased that are more gentle and productive on the skin.

This product smells super good. I got the opportunity to try this and I absolutely love it. It makes my skin soft and smell devine. I would highly recommend this. It smells delicious like lemonade and does the job right.
This is a good product, I used it every other day after I shower and before I apply my face cream. I feel it made my skin smoother. The scent is a nice plus as well!
I was pleasantly surprised by this product.  The smell is intoxicating and reminds me of my mother’s lemon cake every time  I use it. It will now become a staple in my beauty routine.

I found this scrub too harsh on my skin. It says it has ingredients like chamomile to sooth the skin but I felt like it was irritating my skin too much after using it once that I was scared to continue to use it and cause damage to my skin. I’ve heard too many horror stories about the apricot scrub to trust this product further on my skin. I liked the slight lemony scent though. I received this product complementary from influenster for review purposes.

So far, I’m in love with the scrub! I have sensitive skin and am sensitive to scents. However, I found that this product didn’t irritate my skin and the smell wasn’t so strong that it gave me a headache. I love an exfoliant that I can feel working and I definitely can with this one.  My skin was sooo smooth after using it. It made my skin so smooth that even my boyfriend commented on the texture of my skin afterward. The scent smells just like lemonade and I love that!

The only reason I give this product 4 stars is because the lemon sugar scent was super overpowering. I prefer my products to be a little more subtle and this felt like a whole lemon cake batter was on my face (scent wise). My skin felt pretty good after use though! It felt really soft and I saw a difference in my skin. It had cleared up a little bit. The scrub itself was quite gentle and wasn’t too rough which was nice. Overall I would still recommend but wish the scent was a little less strong.

So first impression when I opened this, it smelled just like lemonade. Took me back to summertime drinking some ice cold lemonade. The scent is a super plus for me! First time I used it, I was impressed. It was gentle yet really got all of that dry, dead winter skin off without making me feel like I just scrubbed my face to bits. The little exfoliating bits are small so I think it helps really get the dry skin off. This scrub has become part of my weekly skincare routine
Smells super yummy!  I really like this scrub as it’s very gentle but does a great job exfoliating. Unfortunately, every time I use it I get a zit or two!

I love this product! I’m a very big fan of scented skincare to begin and I absolutely love citrus scents. It truly smells phenomenal and it works even better! After my first application, I noticed a difference. My skin felt softer, smoother and it looked brighter as well. My skin is quite dry (especially in the winter) so I have been using this twice per week and the results have been great. I highly recommend!!!

I swear, this scrub is literally summer in a squeeze tube :) Jokes aside, I really like it. The scrubbing parts are not too harsh, but at the same time you can feel them and they don’t melt down the moment you apply it on your skin. There are actually several ways you can use this scrub, but my favorite one is to massage into my skin for a minute or so and then leave it on for a couple more minutes as a mask. This way it has enough time to clear my pores and brighten my overall complection.
I love this scrub. It does a great job at exfoliating without feeling too harsh. And it’s smells delicious.

I have been using it 2-3 times a week and I really like it! It smells like fresh lemons and the texture is beautiful.  It has Glycolic & Lactic Acids that help to reduce the look of pores and also help to remove impurities in a delicate way.
Love the smell and texture. I also personally love lemons so this was the perfect scrub. Used 2x/week on my sensitive skin

I am so impressed with this . It feels great, smells great and works !! It makes my face feel smooth and I have incorporated it into my daily skincare routine . It wipes away all of the debris off of my face so my moisturizers can actually get to the skin and cleanse it too!!!
This product feels wonderful  on the skin. It is very soothing ! My main complaint  is that it didn’t  smell very lemony  to me. I wish it was Slightly  more sented.

I received this complimentary Lemonade Smoothing Scrub from Ole Henriksen thru VoxBox. This product smells very good. It’s a light Lemon smell. The scrub feels really good as you apply it on your face. My face felt smooth after wards. I did not want to give it 5 stars only because I haven’t used it long enough to feel comfortable rating it that.

Another winner from Ole Henriksen. I love all of their products and this one is no exception. The smell of the lemons is amazing, although I would suggest using this product at night due to the AHAs possibly causing sensitivity to the sun. It would have been a great refreshing smell to use in the mornings, but I still can’t complain. The scrub is gentle, I use it once or twice a week and it keeps my face smooth and exfoliates away the dead skin cells. I think the smell is amazing, but if you’re someone with a scent aversion, you may not like it. But it honestly smells fresh, not perfume-like. I would recommend this to anyone any day! It is comparable to the higher end brands with higher price tags.

This is a gentle scrub that leaves my skin super soft.  I have oily skin and I really like how it left my skin after using.  I have been using it 3-4x a week.  It smells amazing-if you like lemons you will love this.  This is the first time using this brand and I will definitely be purchasing more of their products.
I have used this cleaner only 3 times and i can feel the difference. My skin feels cleaner and smoother. I probably going to buy this product in the future.!

I recently got into face products and this is one of the consistent scrubs I kept. The smell is nice and I like the way it feels on my face. I use this 2 times a week to not over do it with the other face products I use . Also, this face scrub is vegan and cruelty free which is something I definitely look for .

I was really excited to use this because exfoliation is an important part of my skin care routine . I normally exfoliate three times a week, and I usually use chemical exfoliants rather than a physical exfoliants like a face scrub. I absolutely love this lemon scent of the scrub. It’s late and just a little sweet, Without being overwhelming. I also enjoyed the texture. It’s not abrasive it’s about the same texture as sugar, so I think it would work well for people who have more sensitive skin. I don’t have any sensitivities so I really liked it. I could see that my skin looked immediately writer and smoother after using it. My only issue with the scrub is that The little crystals get left behind on my face even after I’ve rinsed it several times. I found that using this describe over the sink became a little messy so I really only use this in the shower to make sure that I’ve gotten every last bit of the scrub off my face.

I typically don’t buy face scrubs so I don’t have much to compare this to, however I do really like it. I was very concerned when I read lemon that it would stink, but it smells more like lemon meringue pie. I don’t have overly problematic skin, but I do have dry skin right now. It felt really nice going on but I did find it burned a little if I let it set like the bottle said to do not sure if it’s supposed to lol. Overall I didn’t notice a bug difference in my skin long term but for a bit after my skin would be very soft. I did really like it, but not sure if I liked it enough for me personally to pay the price it cost!

Great scrub! It smells delicious. The texture is amazing. It is abrasive and really clears my skin of all the dead cells. After I rinse it off I feel so fresh. This is my new go to scrub. I can not reccokend it enough. Olehenriksen has out done themselves again! Did I mention it is vegan and cruelty free. Does not get better than this.

Such an awesome product!! I love the smell of this scrub, and the way it feels when I’m using it. It gently exfoliates your face and leaves it looking smooth and smelling delicious. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a great facial scrub or exfoliator. I received this free as part of a promotion with Influenster and LOVED IT.

I love this product so much! The smell is amazing and to me it is the perfect texture for an exfoliant - very fine grain but you still feel it working. I like when I can feel it. It broke me out a bit but that is normal for me when I exfoliate with a new product for the first time. I’ve been using it consistently and have seen an improvement. Bonus: the smell is incredible! I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

I have been using this product for a couple of weeks now and it is wonderful.  My skin feels amazing and smooth after using.   It smells so good that I can’t wait to use it again! I received this complimentary to test and review.

I’ve been using this for about a month now and it has made my skin feel and look so good! It exfoliates my skin well except the beads are a bit harsh. I prefer sugar scrubs usually, these feel like plastic micro beads....

This is a nice quality product the scrub is thorough but not rough. I did expect my skin to feel softer after use as it does leave a bit of a drying feel once rinsed but I do notice brighter looking skin

I’ve always loved Ole Henriksen products and this one is great as the other products. I’m completely in love with it, I love how it smells and how it exfoliates my skin without cutting my skin. It’s not harsh, and it’s perfect for all skin types.
Incredible smell, if you like lemons or lemonade, it has a wonderful smell but not too overpowering. Makes my skin feel very smooth and fully exfoliated!

I have dry skin so I didn’t expect to like this scrub but I am definitely a fan! My skin felt so soft and supple after, and the scrub itself is very gentle and not abrasive at all. I noticed my skin has less texture since I’ve incorporated this into my routine. I use this 2-3 times a week and I feel like it really makes a difference and doesn’t strip my skin. Compared to other scrubs I like how this one doesn’t had huge exfoliating beads and how it’s a lot more gentle. Taking a star off for the scent - it is a nice citrusy scent and not super overpowering but i’m just not a fan of scent in my skincare products. Definitely worth giving a try!!
I was very excited when I found out Influenster was sending me this product! This scrub gets the job done and my skin feels amazing afterwards. The scent is also great, smells just like fresh lemons.

I received this from influenster and was super excited to get it! The exfoliate is really nice and does the job but i’m not a huge fan of the scent. i love most okehenriksen products but this wouldn’t be one that i purchase myself.

review_title: Life gives you lemons you make lemonade scrub
review_text: I was given this product as a gift by the company and the reason I rated a 4 I do not really use scrubs. If I did though I would highly reccomend this one. This definitely washes the winter blues away.  It has the most amazing lemon smell and it is almost makes you want to eat it but don’t.  Honestly it leaves my skin softer and softer after each use. Do yourself a favor and get one.

review_title: Does the rough work without hurting you
review_text: I really love lemon for a scent so I love the smell of this scrub. It’s got rough exfoliating power with small little beads but sensitive enough for your skin. I really liked this!

I use it 1/week and its lightened my dark spots & fragrance is super fresh. I was gifted this by ole Henriksen. I was worried that this might be too much for my sensitive skin, but it worked wonders. My skin is baby soft and smooth.
Loved the way this made my skin feel the day of use and the day after!! The smell is refreshing and clean. I definitely recommend!

This product is wonderful. It has a light scent to it which is very nice. It exfoliates my skin but doesn’t make it feel stripped or tight. My skin feels smooth and moistened after I use this. It hasn’t caused any sensitivity to my skin either very gentle. Will definitely be buying more when I run out. I received this product as a gift from olehenriksen via Influenster.

First thing I noticed about this product is how great it smells! I am usually hesitant to use physical exfoliants on my face because I am quite sensitive. The granules in this scrub were not harsh at all which I was super happy about! I definitely noticed my skin felt baby soft after using, I used it more on my t zone because it was feeling rough and clogged. My pores also looked fresh and clean. The only thing I am not thrilled about it that there are essential oils in this product. It doesn’t concern me too much because it is a wash off product. I also like to use this for body exfoliation! * I received this product complimentary for testing purposes from influenster*
Exactly what I needed! I have dry skin especially around my  nose and needed a scrub that wasn’t as gentle as others. This is perfect with a very light scent. I love it!
Love this scrub. Its gentle enough you can use it more than once, but isn’t too harsh to cause damage. My face always feels so smooth and soft after!

I am in love with this product!!! I have oily skin and I found a noticeable difference after using it just a few times. Honestly the best smelling product I own. I will definitely be keeping this as a staple in my skincare routine!
This product smells so good! It may be too harsh for some but I enjoyed it before my self tanner! Keeps everything smooth and soft!

I am typically hesitant of facial scrubs as I have sensitive skin and they can be harsh. However, I was surprised at how gentle this exfoliant was in comparison to other products I’ve used. The sugar crystals make it a much more gentle product and leave the skin smoother to the touch. Due to my sensitive skin I don’t use the product on my face to often, however I find this is a great exfoliant to use in the shower on my legs either before or after shaving. It doesn’t leave my skin feeling dry and my legs feel much smoother afterwards.
Smells wonderful. It is light and makes your face feel amazing. I let my mom try it and she loved it so I got one her too! 10/10

review_title: Smells like a lemon pie - works well.
review_text: Wow! This product smells so amazing. I am a fan of lemon and so the scent does not bother me. It almost smells like a lemon dessert. I have sensitive skin and did not have any issues using this product. I’ve used it a few times and noticed my skin feeling softer. It did not irritate my skin at all. And washed off well, too. I also appreciate the back explaining the active ingredients will make you sensitive to the sun - so many people don’t realize that with skin care.

Looove everything Olehendrikson and this scrub is no different! It’s so soothing, so refreshing- smells amazing- fresh & lemony! I received this from Influenster but I will definitely be repurchasing. It’s great for sensitive skin too!!

Really love this scrub! The crystals are the perfect size and doesn’t feel too abrasive on the skin! It really does brighten my skin when it feels dull. My favourite way to use it is after scrubbing I leave it on for a few minutes as like a little mask. Also smells really nice and refreshing, totally recommend it!

This scrub leaves my skin noticeably smoother and more refreshed after using! It’s not too harsh, and has a nice (but not overpowering) citrus/lemon scent. I got this free to try and will certainly buy another!

I received this free from influenster to give my honest opinion. This is such a great scrub. It doesn’t irritate my skin (which is super sensitive) and leaves it feeling super smooth and soft. Great fresh scent and love using it.

I got this product to try out from influenster. Ive been using this product for a few days now & i really must say i love it. Ive used a few ofher scrubs in the past and felt they were harsh or dried out my skin, but i feel like this one doesnt do that at all! It leaves my skin feeling really soft and smooth and gets rid of all the dead skin. Ive been using it as a body scrub but i would love to try it out as a face scrub as im sure it would work just as great.

The best product I’ve received from Influenster so far. I was beyond excited when I learned I was getting the opportunity to try a new ole product and this one did not disappoint. My only con is the price for the amount you’re getting. I hope they come out with other scents but lemon is amazing!

Nothing special to be honest, the crystals of this scrub are kinda rough even when you gently rub it on your face. Yes you do get a fresh feeling after washing but sooo many products do that so it’s not unique. I’m not really a fan even though the scent is nice. I received this product complimentary from Influenster.

Love this for a weekly scrub, helps get that bit of extra skin off my nose and keeps it from looking dry and flaky. The scent is good and I don’t find the scrub to be too harsh! I had my sister try it and she loved it too!

I’ve used this twice this week and my Skin looks so good. It does sting a little bit but it’s not bad at all. My skin is really glowing. I’m def going to keep this in my routine. I’m glad that it doesn’t dry me out too. Very gentle.

This scrub is prefect. It’s the perfect texture to gently exfoliate without hurting your skin. It smells delicious and not too strong at all. You can also use it as a mask and leave it on for 5 mins before scrubbing and removing. It tingled on my skin a little which I liked. Highly recommend.

This is very fragrant but I love the scent. It is very thick which helps make it gentle. It’s too gentle for me because i like a more abrasive scrub. I leave it in for a few minutes for the chemical exfoliation and my pores look smaller and my skin looks brighter. It’s great product for the price point but may not be great if you are sensitive to fragrance or are looking for an abrasive scrub.

Number one, the scent of this product is light and fresh and reminds me of summertime! The formula is very smooth, there aren’t huge abrasive chunks in it. It makes my skin so smooth and soft! I was very pleased to receive this complimentary from Influenster to try and review. I will be a repeat purchaser!

Upon my first use of this scrub I fell in love. It smells amazing.  It isn’t too rough. It made my skin soft and smooth. Better yet after a couple uses my skin looked brighter and was less oily. The packaging is appealing too.

I am really enjoying this scrub! It smells amazing and my skin feels very smooth after using it. I notice all the dead skin is gone when I use it and it’s not overly drying my face out. I do wish the bottle was bigger but you don’t need to use a ton of it so it should last a while. I did receive this product for free for testing purposes from Influenster and it does not affect my true thoughts on the product.

Smells like fresh lemonade!! It’s the perfect summer scent! I was a little concerned about some of the ingredients because I have mildly sensitive skin, but so far it hasn’t bothered me. I’ve been using the scrub 1-2 times a week for a few weeks now and my skin is so soft and smooth. This product will be a staple in my skin care lineup for a long time to come.

Wonderful product! The smell is fresh and bright, the texture is effective for exfoliating and my skin was smooth afterwards. I think a resistance needs to be built up for the slight burn. Slowly but surely.

I like this scrub! The grains are finer than their walnut scrub, so it feels less intense but make my skin so smooth after using it. I love that it has basil and chamomile extracts in it to calm the skin. Exfoliators can sometimes be a harsh on sensitive skin, so I’m glad that this has calming ingredients. It does claim to brighten dull skin, but since I’ve only started using the scrub this week so I haven’t noticed a ton of difference there yet.

Love the smell of lemons! It smells natural. The scrub is perfect, not too corse but enough to scrub away any dead skin. I keep mine in the shower and it’s been an awakening wash I look forward to. I received this from Influenster.

review_title: Leaves Me With A ZEST For Life!
review_text: Terrific face scrub that leaves you with a ZEST for life (pun intended)! Terrific smell and an excellent addition to my skincare arsenal.

This Ole Henriksen Lemonade face wash leaves my face looking brighter and feeling softer. And it smells amazing! Truly smells like lemonade! I am a natural blogger so I tend to gravitate towards more natural products. I like that this facial scrub uses real sugarcane making the texture extremely gritty for maximum exfoliation. I also like seeing all of the natural fruit, leaf, flower, and root extracts used for fragrance instead of added artificial fragrance. I would love to see less alcohol, acids, and ingredients that I cannot pronounce. In my experience, if you can’t pronounce it, it’s usually bad for you.
Absolutely loved this! Used this while on vacation in the mountains, my face was super dry and this made my face feel so nice and refreshed! Also helps with the bumps left on my face with the mask!!

I have used this product twice so far and am overall happy with the results. Like other reviewers, ease into the use of this product if you have sensitive skin. The first time I used it I noticed some irritation and the second time I didn’t. I’m not a huge fan of fruity scents with skincare products and am satisfied with the scent of this one. It does the job and does make me feel like I’m getting a mini facial at home which is nice.
I really enjoyed this product! It smoothed my skin and left me feeling clean and fresh. Smells amazing!

I love this facial scrub! I use this scrub to wash my face and then I use a moisturizer right after and it leaves my skin feeling so soft! I also love how it is completely vegan and not tested on animals. The scent is amazing, it smells like fresh lemons. I would definitely recommend this product.

I like the versatility of this scrub. You can use it daily or as a quick mask. I also like the amount of scrub particles, I hate when scrubs feel like liquid with not enough grit to make a difference.

Absolutely loveeee this product!!! My skin felt so smooth and fresh! The scent is amazing too! Very calming and not overwhelming at all! It has this very welcoming lemon scent that is just perfect! The exfoliate is great! It’s not too hurst but does a great job! I love that it left my skin feeling fresh and even took some redness out in areas. It’s a huge bonus that their formula is  clean, vegan, cruelty-free and gluten-free!

its lemonade scent is really adorable.  I received this excellent product in my first #influenster voxbox, my God it is a delight, it does not irritate my sensitive skin, I left it for 8 minutes on my skin and I felt a pleasant sensation of freshness.  I used it before bathing, my skin deserved it.  without a doubt it is an excellent product.  I feel my skin softer and fresher, I hope it helps me to disappear the production of bait in my nose.  thanks for this gift olehenriksen team and influenster I am very grateful for sending me this product for free to know my opinion.

I’m such a big fan is this product. First of all, it smells AMAZING. Reminds me of lemonade shakeups at the fair. I left it on for two minutes after gently massaging, and felt a slight warm sensation. I did notice a more even tone to my skin, and my pores were not as clogged or big. I LOVE IT. I did receive this complimentary got a honest review.

This product is prettt amazing. The lemon scent is not over powering. The scrub is smooth and easy to apply. I used it with and without my brush and I prefer with the brush. Either way, you will be getting the result you want. I love the way my face feels after being exflorated. You will not regret this purchase.

I’ve only used this lemon scrub a few times but I’ve noticed an immediate difference in my skin! It really exfoliates well without aggravating the skin unlike other scrubs. It does have a mid to strong smell but immediately disappears after rinsing and isn’t too much for sensitive skin. I did receive this as a complimentary product for review purposes but I would gladly purchase it!

I really like this product! I use a chemical exfoliator twice a week, but an esthetician friend of mine suggested I also use a physical exfoliator twice a week as well. Since I started using this product my skin is more radiant. Dead skin is sloughed off, revealing smoother, brighter skin.

I received this product complimentary from Influenster. This scrub is amazing, I have sensitive skin and it was nice and calming on my face. The smell of this is Incredible. This is so refreshing . My face felt amazing after this scrub.
Amazing! I had no idea my skin could feel this smooth!! I received this product complimentary for testing purposes, but I will definitely be buying it again.

I really love this stuff! It made my skin feel so soft and it smells amazing. It says you can use it twice a week but I would only use it once a week of you have sensitive skin. To test it out, I wiped my face with a makeup remover soaked cotton pad after using the Belif Cleansing Balm, and found makeup residue still on my face. I have oily, acne prone skin and I was really worried that this oily cleanser would cause me to break out. I did notice I was breaking out but it is hard to pinpoint whether it was due to the cleanser or other dietary/lifestyle factors. My other complaint is silly, but I also found it really annoying to try and carry around the little spoon that comes with the Belif Cleansing Balm while travelling. For people who wear a lot of makeup/foundation I would recommend cleansing the face with another product first to ensure proper removal, and then following with the Belif Cleansing Balm for moisturizing and smoothing the skin.

I use a zinc based sunscreen at all times due to previous radiation and high risk for melanoma. But my sunscreen on my face is always sooooo thick and I worried about breaking out. I tried a sample of this in the mini travelers and decided to get the full size, from Drunk Elephant directly (same price). This does make you a bit pale due to the zinc but a little goes a long way. Sometimes I forget if I had put any on or not. It absorbs well, not thick and greasy like my other sunscreen. I will admit if I am going to be outside for a long time and active I will be using my normal sunscreen because it is thicker. It is for this reason why I have been very apprehensive about using mineral sunscreens because I had such a bad experience with this product. Anyways, I now have two bottles of this DE sunscreen since I’ve purchased the DE Trunk twice and it just sits in closet collecting dust. I really need to given in and just throw them away.
