It’s ok for a mineral sunscreen. It has a heavy texture that does eventually dry down and although it didn’t really leave a white cast on my skin, this wouldn’t work for people with darker skin. There are better options out there that are cheaper and more cosmetically elegant. You don’t have to tolerate sunscreens like this like I did lol.

I love this product!  I have dry skin, and this provides moisture for my skin.  I feel like it has a nice sheen, and overall am now loyal to this product.  I have tried so many face sunscreens, for sensitive skin, and can say this is now my go to product!I highly recommend it!
This is awful and not worth the money. It makes your face extremely white and is not of good quality. It does not match up to the rest of the drunk elephant products

Really can’t say anything nice about this product.1. The scent of it is very strong. Even after wearing it for a bit, I could smell it. People next to me could smell it. 2. It made my face very shiny. I have normal oily skin in my t-zone and this made my whole face appear oily. 3. It leaves a residue on the face. Even after a while, my face didn’t soak up the white from the cream.Wouldn’t recommend this to anyone.

I wanna save you some money, and time. If you decide to buy you must really dissolve it in the palm or your hand It produces a white flaky coat over the skin. It does its job but if you are in a hurry when you put this product on get ready to see white chunks in your face.

I really didn’t like this product. I don’t know if I got an expired one or something but the smell was not good and the weird consistency freak me out it was watery with some white dots. I bought it to wear under my makeup but because of the consistency the makeup don’t look good A waste of money very disappointed
I Love this sunscreen.  I have sensitive skin and with most other Sunscreen cause a breakout. This does not. I love that it goes on smooth I use on face, neck, hands.

I have very fair, combination skin and struggled for years finding a good sunscreen that didn’t exacerbate my oily areas, strip my dry areas, or break me out. This sunscreen is a dream. The formula is thick and creamy, and when initially applied, it’s a sheer white - but that’s the wonderful, protective 20% zinc at work! Other physical sunscreens have left me ashy and dry-looking, but this one sets with such a lovely dewy finish - not greasy, imo. The white dissipates quickly when rubbed/tapped in. My makeup sits so nice atop it, it’s almost primer-like. I always let it dry a few minutes before going into makeup. Lastly, I think the biggest reason I’m sold on this is because it helps neutralize the redness caused by my type 1 rosacea, so I especially recommend for those with fair skin or redness. Overall, I can’t recommend it enough, it’s a forever purchase!
I have dry skin and I usually like thick products, but this is suffocating. My skin fells clogged and gray after using it.
Left my skin super white and oily. There are a lot of other amazing sunscreens in the market, don’t settle for this.

So I got this as part of a value set of DE products and I can honestly say this is the only one is didn’t like. It relatively oily when you put it on and leaves a weird residue. It also has a weird smell that you literally cannot stop catching hints of the entire day. I did give it two stars because I didn’t get burnt while skiing when I had this on. However, I feel that if I used this every day my skin would be so clogged. If you’re looking for something light weight this is NOT IT.

Personally this sunscreen doesn’t work for me. It has a funny texture that is hard to rub in your face especially with the recommended amount of spf you’re supposed to be using. It also has an overwhelming smell and a terrible blue cast, and I’m super pale and I still notice it. The cast does get slightly better while worn but more often than not I regret using this sunscreen. Even though I tried hard to like it, I won’t repurchase.
You know what I mean? Bizarre texture and smells of spoiled coconut milk.

review_title: Horrible white cast, ended up sunburnt
review_text: I was excited to try this but it makes me look so white!! It was a little hard to blend out and gave me an awful white cast. I brought this with me on vacation and it didn’t photograph well at all even with my usual makeup on top. When I sat by the pool, I made sure to reapply this every 2 hours... but I still ended up sunburned with a red face. The rest of my body had a different sunscreen on and wasn’t sunburnt! So that tells me that this sunscreen on my face wasn’t working.. if you’re on the fence about it, don’t buy it

review_title: Wouldn't recommend for dark or dry skin
review_text: This left a white cast and really dried my skin out even when i used a hydrating serum and hydrating cream underneath. The texture also feels a bit grainy. It doesn’t even feel comfortable to use on my hands.
I love Drunk Elephant products and this sunscreen is good, but I highly dislike the packaging they used for it. I have to be so gentle when handling it otherwise it comes squirting out everywhere.

review_title: Finally a sunblock that doesn’t feel thick!
review_text: Despite the negative reviews of this product, for some reason Drunk Elephant works on my skin and so does this sunblock. I absolutely LOVE how it just glides on my face and feels so light. I have used cheaper brands for face sunblock, such as Neutrogena and Aveeno. This one is worth the money. It doesn’t feel as gunny and thick as the previous brands that I mentioned. Lastly, on my skin it doesn’t leave a white finish like some may do. It blends right in.

One of my favorite things about drunk elephant is that there is no scent, no extra frilly things... ifs just a good product and that’s all it needs to be. This sunscreen sits lovely underneath foundation and it adds an extra layer of protection. It does exactly what a sunscreen is suppose to do. I’m very pleased with this product.
This is what I’m looking for, It goes on very nicely and leaves no white residue. This is my everyday sunscreen. I love!!!

After all the negative press non-mineral based sunscreens have been receiving lately, I was excited to try Drunk Elephant’s Umbra Sheer Sunscreen.  The first thing I did when I received it was check out the active ingredients which only lists 20% Zinc Oxide so I believe the brand is committed to formulating clean products.  The sunscreen itself is thicker than I’m used to, but applies evenly and absorbs quickly without leaving a white residue.  Overall a great substitute for chemically based sunscreen.

review_title: It doesn’t make me more oily
review_text: I have oily skin and not a lot of sunscreens work for me. I am also 41. This sunscreen is goopy and a lil goes a long way. I work 12 hours and am hardly in the sun so I don’t use sunscreen all too often. This sunscreen doesn’t make my skin more oily than normal but I don’t feel it’s does create extra texture that I don’t need. I had a better results with the coola and almost $50 for sunscreen I don’t think so

Great sunscreen however I can’t use this on my face. When I tried to apply it to my face I found it pilled up my foundations and it was super hard to blend all the way in especially around my hairline. I plan to use the rest of it on my body in the summer but don’t plan to use it on my face unless I am not all that concerned with my appearance because it was just too much trouble to work with unfortunately.

This is a sunscreen - not a every day face moisturizer. There are other brands who have managed to put SPF into daily face moisturizers much more successfully. If that’s what you’re looking for - I would not recommend. If you want an overpriced sunscreen to wear to the pool/beach then this is the product for you!

I like to use this on my no-makeup days. I can’t figure out how to make my foundation look nice on top of this. I enjoy the product and the consistency but unfortunately I have other SPF’s that I will reach for before this one.

I have a bit of color in my skin so most sunscreens leave me looking pale or covered in a white sheen. Invisible is a bit misleading on some of these products but drunk elephant gives me the coverage that I need without the weird glaze left on my skin. After about 5 minutes it absorbs nicely into my combination skin

I have very oily skin, so I’m picky about what sunscreens I use, as they tend to make me look pretty slick pretty quickly, especially in conjunction with moisturizer.  This one did once or twice, but that was my own fault for using too much.  While I didn’t think this felt too heavy, I can absolutely see how this could feel like too much in conjunction with other products.  However, as someone who generally goes makeup free, it’s a decent option for me.

review_title: Love love love!Easy facial sunscreen   not oily
review_text: OKAY I wear foundation with SPF but use this as well and love it! It doesn’t overwhelmingly smell like spf at all and keep it in my bag when I travel (I’m a flight attendant) so use it before laying by the pool/beach etc on layovers. The fact that it stays in my bag means I love it!
I’m not a fan of this with makeup as it makes my face feel very oily. It might work better on a beach day when it’sPrimary use is sunscreen though. I’ll have to try it then.
Not for combination or oily skin, left me feeling way to oily. I may try to use this during different seasons to see if that helps any but so far I’m not feeling this product.
This product is great for my skin, lightweight, lightly greasy but still great product. I received this product complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes.

Amazing. Worth every penny. Does not disappoint. Very soft smelling and does not irritate skin. I recommend using a very small amount under morning skincare or foundation. I’d give this ten stars if I could.
It’s a good daily sunscreen. It is non-greasy and absorbs well. Do I think I’ll be spending $35 dollars on it in the future? No. But it’s a good sunscreen and works well under makeup.

I used this product on its own and with a moisturizer and have noticed that it settles to invisibility almost right away. I don’t wear a lot of makeup so this works just great for me ! “I got to try this product for for free as part of a promotion”

I really love this sunscreen because it is gentle and it wears very well under makeup. It doesn’t peel or leave a white cast. I love that it has zinc oxide in it. The tube is also very cute I love the aesthetic of this brand. I think it’s a great price for the quality and amount you are getting.

I’ve been looking for something light weight that still gives my face as well as the rest of my body protection from the sun and this is truly it. This product feels very light on my skin, as if I’m wearing nothing at all, but does the job right. I’ve also noticed a change in my skins texture and it is not super greasy or oily but rather very very smooth. I highly recommend this product.

I like this sunscreen, it’s not greasy, absorbs fast, and doesn’t have a scent. However, when I use this on my face it leaves behind some white specks. When I wear foundation, it sits beautifully on top and covers them completely. I do not get the white specks when I wear this sunscreen on my neck or body, so I think it might not be vibing well with my dry skin on my face. Overall I really like this sunscreen under makeup and on the body, but I don’t like how it looks on my face by itself.

This sunscreen is white when it comes out of the tube, but ends up being transparent after blended in the face and neck. I love how light this is, feels like a moisturizer, doesn’t leave a sticky or white residue. Doesn’t affect the makeup i put on top. I just wish they could make one with a higher spf next time.

I received this free from Influenster for a VoxBox campaign, but sadly, this was the worst product in the box. First of all, I don’t understand the word “sheer” in the title when it left a notable white cast on my already pale face; those darker skinned may have an even worse experience. It is sticky and pills very easily, which is a hard pass for me, since I usually wear makeup over sunscreen. It pilled even without makeup. Hard pass.

review_title: sheer but still has a slight sunscreen smell
review_text: I love a good sunscreen product and it was easy to blend in without leaving a residue, it does still have a sunscreen smell to it slightly, which doesn’t personally bother me. Nice to use in the winter where sunscreen is still important

review_title: Does what it is supposed to...
review_text: I was sent this product in exchange for my honest opinion. I have been using this along with the vitamin c serum, shada eye cream, and b hyrda. I apply this in the morning after cleaning my face with micellar water. I also add in olay daily sensitive skin lotion with spf 15 because the entire routine is not hydrating enough for my dry skin. This sunscreen is weird. It makes my face both oily and dry. It also has bad packaging and the product pours out as soon as you open the bottle and is very messy. I do like zinc sunscreen and will continue to use this though.

This worked well over the C-Firma and B-Hydra! I have never been big on wearing Broad Spectrum Sunscreen due to greasiness. This product settles nicely on the skin. Not greasy, or heavy. My skin has never felt better. I am definitely turned on to this brand! Give it a try, you will not be disappointed!

I am always on the hunt for the best physical sunscreen since I have  rosacea. This one does not disappoint. It went on light and clean without a hint of white or flashiness. My makeup went on over it really nicely and lasted all day. It’s a keeper

This stuff is pretty thick. I think I’ll let it in the summer but for now it doesn’t really sit well under my foundation and everything it feels like I have a ton of stuff on my face when I do. But if I have time to wait for it to really soak into my skin before I apply my foundation it’s fine!

My least fav DE product (unfortunately!!). I wanted to love this, but it was just so thick and did not absorb into my skin whatsoever. It took a lot of work to rub in, and left my skin so tacky/sticky and it has a significant white-cast, which I hate.

This is extremely lightweight and thin. It spreads easily and doesn’t leave any white cast. It gives a slight dewy finish  I would prefer a higher SPF coverage though. I was sent this product for review.

What a perfect product! I have a hard time finding a sunscreen that doesn’t make my face oily and this has made the mark. I love how light it feels on my face. I love the smell. I love the texture. I will be adding this to my daily skincare routine.

I typically prefer chemical spf. Physical/mineral spf tends to feel heavy and gross on the skin which I why I stay away from it. While this one isn’t nearly as bad as some of the other physical spf’s I’ve tried, it does still have those qualities that I’m not a fan of. However, if you do prefer physical spf I think you would like this one. -PROS: no scent, easy to apply, good ingredients, gentle, non-irritating, not greasy at all, satin finish. -CONS: slight white cast, pills and rolls off applied on top of other skincare (even other DE products), feels like a mask on the skin, slightly drying.

I’m a big sunscreen user. I’ve tried a bunch at all price points. This stung a bit on the first few uses and isn’t the best for under makeup as it bunches ever so slightly. A great product for no makeup days if you have dry skin. I’m ultra dry and haven’t gotten oily from this sunscreen. Worth a shot but nothing extraordinary!

I haven’t tried their SPF before so I’m not sure yet on the long term wear of it. Since it’s Fall and Winter here in N.America, I haven’t had to use SPF much since I’m mostly indoors. I did end up doing a few trail runs and found this to be non-greasy and doesn’t leave a white cast from the physical sunscreen (which I prefer over the chemical sunscreens). I did use it under makeup but I had light makeup on (as I do in the summer) and found that it didn’t effect it for the first half of the day. I didn’t reapply it though and my makeup did look worn down by the end of the day (12 hrs time). Can’t really attribute it to the sunscreen however. It’s pretty much the way my makeup breaks down after half a day. However, with any sunscreen, this would definitely come in handy on our sunny vacation when we go in January. Would recommend.
I like how Umbrasreen merges with the skin, although I would like the protection to be greater

I was specifically looking for an everyday mineral based sunscreen without silicone for my sensitive skin Yes the texture feels thick and suncreen-y when applying but it sinks in fast and I totally forget about it after a minute. My skin felt nice all day, and my makeup looked good

I was so hoping this was going to be my it sunscreen grab- instead it was more like a chalky face scrub that was watered down. Texture aside, it left my skin super dry and wanting moisture. I won’t grab this one in the future!

Honestly torn about this product because I hate the way it feels when you first put it on it’s sticky and thick I did not like it, but about 20 minutes after my skin absorbed it all and it left my skin hydrated and happy so I can’t complain too much
So for not a fan. It’s super thick on my skin and feels heavy. I’ll give it another go when we act have some sunny weather but for now it’s a pass

I really do love this sunscreen. I wanted to give it give stars, but the few points I had against it bothered me enough to bump it down to 4. I live in the sunny South and definitely felt like it protected my skin. I put it on after using the whole DE morning day routine. It was a bit tackier/gummier than I’d like while it was drying, but it absorbed quickly. It’s really important to only use a little though, especially if you’re on the oily side, I felt that because I used it in moderation (small chickpea sized drop) it left me looking dewy but not slick. The smell is soft, natural, and very pleasant. If you’re oily I’d be cautious but if you have dry skin I think this would be perfect. I’d love to try the tinted sunscreen next.

My eyes are extremely sensitive to sunscreen and I love that this product doesn’t make my eyes water and goes on smoothly. It’s on the thicker side so I usually apply and leave it on for 5 minutes before I apply my makeup.

I’ve been using this over my regular skincare routine as the final step it hasn’t broken me out which is a plus and makes me very happy because I’m prone to acne, I vent wait too try this though in the summer months on the beach I’m always looking for a good spf!

I’ve been using this product for sometime now and it works really well. The only issue I have with it is it is on the thicker side, especially the older it gets. I got to the bottom of it and I had it for months but it got a little dry. But it does last for a long time which is good. For the price you cant beat it. And it has a high concentration of zinc oxide which would account for its consistency.  If you want something that works I would say use this product. I would like to add that you have to make sure to really rub it in, if you do then you won’t see it. For darker skinned ladies, I would think it would present itself as a little more of a challenge. All in all, I plan to continue to use this sunscreen and I recommend it. A tip, make sure to moisturize before hand, it will help it to blend nicely.

tried a tiny bit on my hand in the store and it felt nice so i bought it. but when you put more than just a tiny drop, it becomes a really weird texture on your skin and pills up. it made my skin look drier than it is. i’ve tried many sunscreens as i try to wear it every day, but i would not recommend this.
Leaves a white cast. Very chunky. Very heavy smell. It’s just not pleasant to use.

I like it as much as you could possibly like a clean mineral sunscreen. It wears well under tinted moisturizer but not as well under foundation. On days where I’m wearing a lot of makeup I’ll skip this and opt for a foundation that contains SPF. I prefer it to REN clean screen. My one complaint is that the bottle is a bit leaky I feel like it would live up to the Drunk Elephant standard a bit more if it had a pump or something so it is less likely to spill.

Went to the store looking for the Clarins Milk SPF lotion, it was out of stock and I was recommended this one from Drunk Elephant.  It didn’t work for me.  Gave rash to everyone in the house and we got sun burn.

I honestly really like this. It’s pretty thick so I like using it in the winter when I don’t feel like I’m sweating it off. If you do sweat, it does not taste good. Overall, I’m a big fan, but definitely more so when my skin is dry and not oily

Works well for dry and sensitive.  It leaves my skin hydrated and does not irritate it.  It does have the slightest white cast, but it on me it almost appears like a soft glowy sheen.  For reference, I have medium skin tone.  Makeup applies well over it.  So far my favorite sunscreen I have found here.

I’m very happy with this sunscreen. Ive had it for 6 months and apply it 2-3 times daily to my face neck and hands and still have plenty of product left. Definitely my favorite I’ve ever used. I mix it with one pump of the drunk elephant bronzer and it completely cancels out the small amount of white cast this product leaves and gives a natural glow. Will repurchase
So disappointed with this one! I love DE products but this one was way off. The texture is very thick and greasy. It does not feel light and enjoyable on my face. Taking it back this week :(
A wonderful mineral sunscreen - does have a bit of a white cast, but it sinks in after 20 seconds or so. Feels a bit moisturizing, but is nice on my combo skin even in the spring
Literally the only sunscreen that doesn’t break out my extremely sensitive skin. will never use anything else.

I didn’t get a white cast and it didn’t melt off in the sun. it did break me out. I use all of the DE line so it’s not because of the suspicious 6 in my skin care. for whatever reason my skin does not like this

Loved the idea of the ingredients but tried this out after receiving a free sample to test with my usage of DE baby facial and the DE glycolic serum. Had a wonderful experience with the baby facial and felt like I noticed an immediate improvement with my skin. The next day I had no breakouts or visible purging from the baby facial, but after a day of wearing this to protect my skin as opposed to my previous eminence sunscreen I saw lots of small congestion bumps when I washed my face off later that evening. I’m pretty convinced it was this due to the obvious difference compared to how my skin looked following tlc. I think this is just way too oily and thick for my sensitive acne prone skin. Feels like it maybe suffocates skin and clogs pores. So disappointed, will continue to look for a better zinc sunscreen.

I’ve actually found this product to be fairly good. It does take a bit of rubbing in( I generally give it a little mixing in my hands first). I have found that despite the high zinc it is not overly drying. It hasn’t caused significant break out and comes off easily with cleanser ( probably an indication you need something different if you’re doing an activity and sweating). I don’t have significant issues with the white cast because of my skin tone, but can definitely see this being an issue( like most minerals). The other thing of note is I don’t generally wear it under or over makeup so that experience may be wildly different.

I have very fair skin and can easily get dark spots when I don’t have the right sun protection. This sunscreen applies smoothly and does not leave any greasiness on the skin. I let it absorb for about five minutes before beginning applying makeup. It is the perfect barrier throughout the day!

review_title: Good stuff, just a little greasy looking
review_text: Smooth application, feels great on my skin, but leaves it a little greasy looking. The shine factor is taken care of after I apply makeup and setting powder. If you like the dewy look, you’ll love this. Definitely the best natural sunscreen I’ve tried to date. Very little scent and something I smooth on every day. Would I buy it again? Probably.

I love this sunscreen! The texture is nice, and so is the smell. It’s goes on smooth and is quite moisturizing. I have combination skin which can be oily but tends to be dry due to the treatments I use. This feels very slightly “greasy” going on which worried me at first. However, after a few minutes it dries down to a beautiful finish and feels perfect on the skin. For 3 oz of product I also think this is a great value. It’s a very good quality sunscreen that I will definitely repurchase!

Perfect -- not too much slip, not too greasy. Feels like a moisturizer going on and leaves a natural finish.I tried this product a few years ago, but gave up because it was gritty and pasty. With the new formula, it’s the best sunscreen I’ve ever tried. Most sunscreens dry out my skin, but this one hasn’t.
I think there are far better sunscreens out there. I will admit that I liked the glow that this sunscreen provides

I am a lover of all things drunk elephant...except this product. It leaves a horrible white cast on my skin (especially since I don’t wear foundation) and the texture is so thick that it feels as though it’s sitting on your face forever. It also makes my face feel and look incredibly oily. This is the only drunk elephant product that I will not repurchase.

Maybe I have unreasonable expectations from a sunscreen... This one was greasy, heavy on the skin, and smelled questionable. I break out badly from most sun screens; I broke out from this one too but not as much as some. I don’t think I used it long enough to really know for sure. It was returned.And the quest for a truly noncomedogenic sunscreen continues...

I have very fair, sensitive skin and I was looking for a non-greasy everyday sunscreen to prevent skin damage and this product was suggested to my by a Sephora associate so I figured I would give it a try.I will be returning this product. It is very hard to rub in without having white streaks or a cast to your face. Once rubbed in it does leave a greasy fill on your face. Finally if you touch your face at all during the day while wearing it you will have white come off on your hand.Would not recommend this to anyone.

I wanted to love this sunscreen. It has the high zinc, which works for my combo and breakout-prone skin. I was extremely skeptical of the term “sheer“. I could get away with one very thin layer, but had a slight washed out look. Multiple layers, and I was tinted white. The ingredients in totality make me want to use it. I have other sunscreens that look better, though.  If chemical sunscreen isn’t an option, use this. It didnt dry out my skin or leave a thick heavy layer. It has no scent. My skin likes it. My eyes don’t.

I have oily skin. I was worried this would give me added shine that I didn’t want. I was wrong! It dries to a natural glow, not matte. My primer and foundation apply without pilling, which is a common occurrence with other physical SPF’s. It does have a white cast, but it doesn’t bother me since I apply D-Bronzi overtop on my no-makeup days. Would I buy this again? Yes. It’s definitely in my top 3 that I have in rotation.

I am super-pale (pretty much always the palest person in a room) in my late 30s with combination skin. I’ve been using Coola Mineral Face Tint SPF 30 - which I found a bit drying,  otherwise it was great - but decided to give this a try after seeing all the positive reviews. Are we using the same product? First of all, it’s super greasy and difficult to blend in. The product ends up having a stringy, pill-y quality on the skin. I use the term “blend“ loosely as it really never does blend in. I look like Helena Bonham Carter’s portrayal of the Queen in Alice in Wonderland (translation: like I smeared my face with white grease paint). The product also gets caught up in my eyebrows. I don’t mind a bit of greasiness and shine but it looks and feels like Crisco. I’m giving it two stars because it hasn’t made me break out and doesn’t smell offensive, but man, I wish I was using whatever product it is everyone else is reviewing.

if you plan to use this product in a HOT and HUMID weather, i would say it’s a big NO-NO. feel like having a coating on your face and make your face sweat a lot, and then sweat is in WHITE color! i have tried applying them while turning on a/c, much better, but have to wait for 2-3mins at least until it is set and then put on my foundation. however, if I use it in aussie winter/ or the US when it’s not so hot and humid, it’s totally fine. i will continue to use and finish it because it’s a physical sunscreen(cuz i am trying to stay away from chemical one), its price tag and i don’t want to waste the product. however i won’t re-purchase it ever again. there should be other better physical sunscreen out there regardless of pricefyr i’m a flight attendant based in HK (freaking hot and humid currently) and frequently fly to US and AUSSIE.

I love the texture, the feeling of it initially on my skin and the formulation (no silicones!). But this is HORRIBLE under makeup!! I have normal skin and don’t have major issues with dryness. But this makes my under-eye area look like I’m 80 years old within a few hours. I mix this with marula oil and there’s no difference. I know zinc oxide is drying, but this is just a no no with foundation and/or concealer. So sad :(

review_title: Mess up my primer and foundation every time
review_text: I was so exited about this sun screen lotion. However, it’s a terrible sub product. It’s super sticky, not easy to blend. It makes my primer and foundation move and my face look super pale. It’s a disaster.

They’ve changed the formula of the DE sunscreen to no longer pill and it’s been my favorite sunscreen since. It’s thick because it’s a physical sunscreen but there’s no odor and I don’t have any other issues with this sunscreen. You get quite a lot of product so I think it’s a really good investment for your skin.

review_title: This wasn't as amazing as I'd hoped
review_text: I think this  provides the appropriate sun protection, but it has a very white cast, and definitely changes the way foundation products sit on the skin. I found it clinging to dry patches, and causing foundation to pill. It may come across differently if worn alone, but I specifically purchased to wear under my makeup on a daily basis during Spring and Summer, and now I find myself not reaching for it. I’ll save it for the beach, where I’m sure it will go to good use.

This is my go to sunscreen! I mix it with a little tinted moisturizer, my favorite is JOSIE MARAN Argan Daily Moisturizer SPF 47 (tinted) it leaves no white pastey look like most sunscreens deliver. No scent, just clean! I love it!!
I love this daytime moisturizer. It’s my last step in my morning skincare routine (I use C-Firma
The key to this is to use a small amount. Enough to cover your face but not too much. I have not experienced any flashback or white patches with this.

I have the most sensitive skin and I am truly obsessed. Use this as all over my face, with the tinted on my forehead and cheekbones. I got so many compliments that my skin was radiant today—best it’s ever loooked. Didn’t even need foundation, and normally I need medium coverage. Best. Purchase. Ever.

I am always a bit hesitant to try new moisturizers because I tend to break out pretty bad when switching products, but this one was a smooth transition where I actually saw improvement in my skin. I think it might of made it less risen & sort of less irritated but it was still red & not going away just not as bad as I think it would of been. I do however have a lot of blackheads & white heads in my nose & chin & I will say I don’t see a huge difference but it does kind of make them a little less noticeable sometimes especially after exfoliating & using this moisturizer. review_title: good for keratosis pilaris (KP) on my arms!
review_text: I use this on my upper arms for keratosis pilaris, and I think it works really well in reducing the redness and bumps. I apply it to my upper arms after a shower and then, after it soaks in, apply skin fix’s glycolic acid cream for KP—or mix a few drops of the lactic acid into the lotion. The two together seem to work better than the skin fix-brand cream alone. I love that this is an inexpensive product, too. I haven’t tried using it on my face.

review_title: Not Sure, But Doesn't Seem Affective
review_text: Ordered this and was hoping for a change to my skin (I have very acne prone skin and my forehead & jawline have dark acne scar spots). I had been using it for a couple months (usually 3 to 5 times a week; at night when skin is repairing itself and is more receptive to skin care products). I thought I was seeing results and maybe there has been a slight change, but my old scars are still dark and some new acne came along. I don’t know if it’s just not working on aggressive scars or if it’s because I used this with others products (like after a charcoal facial scrub or after PanOxyl cleanser on other days and if that was messing with how affective the lactic acid is) but in any case it’s not really working. It doesn’t seem to do well for me, but might work for others.  I’ve stopped using it for now to see how well the stronger AHA 30% + BHA 2% Peeling Solution works. I just received that this week and will write a review later.
I have oily, acne prone skin and I haven’t seen any difference while using this. My skin just feels sticky and unclean.

This is an amazing leave on chemical exfoliant!  It has the perfect ph balance to penetrate, and exfoliate, the skin without causing severe burning or peeling.  I spent over $200 dollars on two other brands claiming the same the same benefits.  Unfortunately, their claims are a complete lie!  The ph in AHA’s should be 3-4, ideally 3.5-4 if you have sensitive skin.  The ordinary is a 3.5.  The two products I’m referring to are about a 7.  Meaning, you might as well put water, or a basic moisturizer on your skin. The first rhymes is a sleep mask that smells like water melon. The second, spelled differently Cate Summerville.  Save your money, and go for The Ordinary.

review_text: This is relief in a bottle for me. Long story short, I purchased this only 10 days ago and my stubborn hormonal acne has healed significantly & I haven’t had a new breakout since. Though this soaks into your skin almost instantaneously, I wouldn’t wear it under makeup with sun exposure as it will sensitize your skin. The Ordinary is really out here, y’all. Consider pairing this with some of their other products and customize your own skincare routine. For my nighttime routine I use this first as a “base” then layer The Ordinary’s vitamin C suspension 30% in silicone mixed with my favorite nighttime moisturizer and wake up with significantly less texture and redness - nearly baby soft skin. <3

This and the salicylic acid treatment - used in conjunction - have transformed my sensitive, dry, dull skin. Before I started using these, I had to manually exfoliate every second day, or else foundation would gather in my dry spots, and just look terrible. That caused my skin to be more sensitive, and get drier over time. I’d get hormonal acne sometimes, probably caused by dead skin cells blocking pores, because this stuff stopped that almost completely. If you have potentially sensitive skin, I’d recommend using lactic acid first, twice per week, and increase (and add in salicylic acid) if you have no negative side effects - dryness, irritation, etc. Your tolerance may allow you to use them every night. Again, use this only at night, because it can cause increased photosensitivity. Also, you can apply lactic acid and salicylic acid at the same time - but since they both require a pH between 3-4 to remain active, use them as your first step in your nighttime routine, and let them sit for at least 20 minutes before applying anything else. This will give them ample time to do their job before you dilute them and raise the pH out of the effective range.

review_title: Is Worth the Time It Takes
review_text: This product can be tricky, but you can have good coverage without pilling. The trick is time. Simple, I know. I do all my usual morning skincare, then walk away for at least five minutes before you come back to apply the sunscreen. The more hydrating my moisturizer the longer it needs time to absorb. After waiting 5-7 minutes, I apply the two fingers of sunscreen and walk away. I need to wait between 10 and 15 minutes before applying makeup. If I still see the cast, I know it’s not ready for makeup. I can say  it always makes my skin look great, but I’m not sure it’s worth the time it takes.

review_title: Not for my skin type/diagnosed issues
review_text: I received this product for free (sample size 17oz/5ml) from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I knew after checking the ingredient list that it would likely cause issues for my skin (I have been diagnosed by a dermatologist with seborrheic dermatitis/massezia issues in addition to hormonal/cystic and regular acne), but still chose to patch test it on the same 2 spots/areas (on jawline, one near chin, one near ear) to see how it worked out. It does not have a strong scent/fragrance, thankfully, and has a decent, lightweight texture. I personally wouldn’t consider it very moisturizing or hydrating.  Unfortunately it caused burning/tingling upon first application so I used a very small amount. My skin was mildly red/irritated in the 2 areas I put it on by the end of each day that I applied it, and also felt a bit more dry and tight than the rest of my face. I only used/patch tested it for 3 days. I discontinued the trial so as not to cause long-lasting irritation. I’m sure this would work well for the right person, but unfortunately it is not a good match for me. Aside from the diagnoses I listed previously, I have sensitive/reactive, mostly combo skin that leans more dry, sometimes scaly/flaky and red, around my nose/mouth and chin, and oily on forehead and cheeks.    I’m sorry if this review isn’t very helpful. I feel bad leaving a bad review since I knew it wouldn’t compatible with my skin, but hopefully it helps someone else with fungal issues avoid trying it just for the heck of it. Finding the right moisturizer is quite frustrating with seb derm/rosacea/etc.

review_title: Good night cream but I’d invest in serum
review_text: I have tried this entire line - first the serum then the eye cream and now this product. I will say this is my least favorite as I loved and repurchased the other two. For reference I have a normal skin type - not oily whatsoever but not dry either - just balanced for now. In winter I can become dehydrated. review_text: I’ve been using this serum daily for over a month and wanted to love it, but I still have mixed feelings about it. The product is a pretty lavender and creates a nice dewy glow upon application. It has a very pleasant smell and feels hydrating. It made my skin look brighter, but over time I found that my skin became more textured and it made me break out. I didn’t notice an improvement in my fine lines, but my pores actually became noticeably worse. Overall, I’ve never had much luck with Ole Henriksen products, and I personally don’t like this serum. I’ve been using this serum by Ole Henriksen for a few weeks now and I have to say I  like it. This was my first time ever using a product from the brand and have been enjoying using this product thus far. This serum says to apply serum to face and neck daily massaging in an upward circular motion. I applied one pump to the back of my hand ( one pump was enough product to cover my face and my neck generously) and then I massaged it in. After immediately applying the serum, there were no immediate results or signs of diminishing fine lines, dark spots or wrinkles but the purple tint did immediately brighten my skin which I did like. After applying the serum I did notice that it left my hands and face a bit tacky which I wasn’t a big fan of. After a few minutes of letting the serum absorb into my skin I did notice that it left my skin pretty smooth for the most part with a hint of tackiness, but nothing out of the ordinary. I like that this serum didn’t leave my skin looking or feeling greasy as some serums tend to do on my oily skin. It absorbed really nicely and didn’t feel heavy or like I had product on my face. I also liked that the consistency wasn’t too thick or pastey but had more of a milky consistency. I liked that the ingredients weren’t harsh or didn’t irritate my skin. review_title: Great for oily or combo skin
review_text: My skin is dry, not only due to living somewhere with so much sun but also because it was damaged during my radiation and chemotherapy treatments. So, when I get the chance to try a new moisturizer I am in! First thing I noticed when I opened this was that it smelled so good. Not super strong, that’s not good in skincare, but very subtly fresh and citrusy. It also is a gel like texture like the regular Aqua Bomb which makes it glide onto your skin. If you keep it in the fridge it’s so soothing and cooling. I’ve used this now for just about a month, added it to my nighttime routine, I stretched this sample as far as it would go and I am really enjoying it. It’s moisturizing without being too heavy. I’ve you have oily or combo skin this will be perfect for you. It works well to put over a serum.I love that it’s got vitamins C and E, and four types of hyaluronic acid. Hyaluronic acid is so beneficial and something our bodies naturally produce. It is really good at retaining water, helps with your skins elasticity, can reduce scarring, and even helps wounds heal faster. The vitamin C will help with aging and brightening of the skin. I always love when a product has hyaluronic acid because so far it’s been so helpful in getting my skin back to it’s pre C state.If you’re extra dry like me you may need to put another moisturizer on top, but if you don’t have desert dry skin, or even oily skin, this is the one for you! Regardless, with the benefits of this one I will definitely consider using it under one of my heavier creams. With the sample size it’s hard to say if the brightening works but my dark spots do look slightly better. It would definitely be worth it to purchase the full size to see what using it longer could do.

I feel my face is well-protected because I could tell that it’s already helped repairing my skin barrier. My skin feels so soft all day- love it!! Would recommend this to dry/problematic/sensitive skin (that’s me!). I would say this is a must-have hydrating/repairing/restoring the skin in high-end skincare product!

my skin feels really hydrated, the feeling is fresh and light. review_title: Definitely worth the price for me
review_text: This cream is the ONLY one that works on my extremely dry flaky skin. I’ve tried everything from Clinique, Claris, and Fresh to Olay and L’Oreal. The only reason I give it 4 stars is that it is VERY expensive. That being said, if anything is worth the money it’s my skin, especially when the product works as well this does for me.

My forever Holy Grail! I have been using Creme de la Mer for over 10 years and I have never found anything better. It hydrated, smooths, clears dark spots, and just makes my skin look so supple and healthy in a way no other cream can. People always think I’m 10 years younger than what I am and a contributing factor to that is due to how meticulous I am with my skincare. I wash twice a day, tone, moisturize with La Mer, use a facial steamer and follow up with high-quality masks. Yes, I know, La Mer is expensive, but in life you get what you pay for and the end justifies the means. If it is a value for you to maintain gorgeous skin then you won’t mind the price due to the value you place on yourself. Thank you La Mer for your amazing products. Literally going to keep using this until I’m like 90! Also, the mini is perfect for traveling!
I always come back to this. It’s the only moisturizer that I use that minimizes my pores. Too bad it’s so expensive.

I’ve been using the creme de la mer for about 3 weeks now and I have noticed a major difference, my skin is getting so smooth, my fine lines has improved noticeably. The price isn’t very appealing but you can’t find a cream like this. Truly the holy grail of creams!

review_title: Best skin product I've ever used
review_text: I treated myself to this about 2 months before my wedding. I have terrible skin and have seen several dermatologists for my cystic acne and excessively dry skin. All of those issues went away within 2 weeks of using this product daily. My dermatologist still can’t figure out why the acne went away...but it did! Sadly, I don’t have the finances to afford this product all the time :-( Maybe someday.

The absolute best!  I was a medical aesthetician and laser technician.   I have used everything... medical grade, department store, and this is my favorite.   The consistency of it will keep your skin younger longer.  It makes your skin look hydrated and luminous.   La Mer sunscreen is fantastic and goes on beautifully with it.  I am in my mid-40’s, and look years younger.  I plan on using this to keep the clock away.

Have used this off and on for over 25 years. The little mini jar is sufficient for a few months - I just dab a tiny bit on my cheeks. I think the large jar would dry out before I used it up!

But either way,  my skin reacts terribly to the cold and dry climate... more so than others.

I have very dry skin, and earlier this year I suffered from a horrible chemical burn from a popular (and much, much cheaper) face cream that I’d been using. I’ll spare you the horrific (and gross) details, but trust me, it was BAD. So that’s when I decided to splurge on this, and I do not regret it one bit. It literally saved my skin. After only a few days I noticed a complete hydration restoration. Pores are minimized and face looks and feels more firm, is ridiculously smooth and you just feel so refreshed after using it. My scars from the burn are healing nicely, and quickly, and they’re almost all gone. Without a doubt, this is definitely the BEST moisturizer on the market. A staple in my daily skincare regimen. MORE MEN NEED TO BE EDUCATED ON THE IMPORTANCE OF SKINCARE! It comes in a nice, heavy glass jar, with a little scooper to keep you from having to use your fingers, so there’s less of a chance for rest of the product to get contaminated, and it’s nicely scented, but not overwhelming. This stuff is magic, and worth the splurge!

For those two reasons, I seriously thought about purchasing this product.  However, a few things held me back.  I did some research and it looks like this contains potentially irritating ingredients like eucalyptus oil.  In addition, the jar packaging isn’t ideal for keeping the antioxidants stable.
