Man....I tried. I really tried. But this smells SO BAD. I read reviews stating this, but even going into it knowing it would stink did not prepare me for how awful it smelled. I had to remind myself of the price to stop from washing it off my face every night I tried it, which was 8 days. 8 days that I will not soon forget because it was truly truly awful. I don’t even know how to describe it. The only good news, hence 2 stars, is that the smell didn’t give me a headache, which can sometimes happen with strong smells. It’s a shame because I know people have good results with it, but I just couldn’t gut it out anymore. And if I’m paying this much for a product I shouldn’t have to literally dread using it every night. I have no idea why they haven’t corrected or improved this. It’s so so so awful. I would recommend getting a sample if you’re considering it, because I know there are some of you who will read this and think “It can’t be THAT bad” but I promise you it is.
Got a sample, and so far I love it. I’ve been very hesitant about retinol because my skin is so dry. I’m very happy to have tried this, definitely will be buying the full size!!
Ugh, did not like this and finally threw it out. The blue coloring stained my white sheets and duvet.

I can’t really comment on the long term effect the oil has as I’ve only used it once which was last night. I just got the oil so we’ll see how my skin reacts to it. I did wake up with very soft skin though. I have very mild rosacea and the oil didn’t seem to irritate it so far. I’ve only recently gotten into retinol with another retinol oil the Superstar night oil from Pestle & Mortar which is another very expensive retinol oil and that hasn’t irritated my sensitive skin either but I am very wary about using retinol because of the risks with that chemical. I am however surprised how many people here think that the blue color of the oil is some added dye they put in the oil! The blue color comes from the oil Blue Tansy, it is not something that’s put in the oil to give it a pretty blue color. It’s kinda weird that people think it is but that is how it’s supposed to look like. Just like the Blue Tansy Resurfacing Clarity Mask from Herbivore, that mask is blue because of the tansy oil and that company only uses clean products so no dye in this retinol oil. I’m going to continue using the Luna oil and hopefully it won’t give me any breakouts like other people have been saying it did to them but I’m not breakout prone so I’m not too worried about it. The only thing that worries me is the retinol and how sensitive it can make the skin to the sun and stuff like that, fortunately I live in a country where the sun doesn’t really shine constantly but I’m still gonna take it slow and see what happens. I’m only 30 but I still have some fine lines here and there so we’ll see if this oil actually does anything about that or if that’s just bull. Maybe I’ll write another review in a couple of months or so if I think it’s doing anything worth while. It is a bit expensive yes but compared to other retinol oils I’d say it’s a pretty standard price when it comes to products like these. I didn’t know how to rate the oil since I still don’t know exactly but hopefully it’s worth 4 stars!

review_title: Finally a retinol that works for me
review_text: I have extremely sensitive skin and in the past when I tried retinol products I always experienced a bad reaction, rash and terrible redness. But not with this oil. My skin does seem smoother. I only need to massage a tiny bit for my whole face. My only concern is does it need to be that blue? Wish there was no added coloring. But will continue to use most nights as part of my routine. I personally love the scent.

First off, I just received this in the mail yesterday. Used it last night and tonight. The redness in my cheeks, forehead, and just my skin all in general has IMPROVED. Like literally that quick?! This stuff is insane. I can’t tell if it’s also bc of the CEO vitamin C serum (which used only once as well) combined or this alone but I’m literally hooked. Drunk elephant products took at least 2 weeks to get not even this close. My first review btw, I would never even bother but I just had to.

I never write reviews, this stuff has changed my life. I have huge pores and no kidding I noticed a difference after the first time I used it. My skin glows and my pores are tight. I have never had anything work like this for me, and honesty I’m still skeptical, but I can’t deny the outcome. I got this on a huge sale, but I am willing to spend full price on something that actually works.

review_title: Love it, Love it, Love it
review_text: Omg !! This oil saved my skin. I have dry skin and rosacea on my cheek !! Redness was spreading all over my face but after using this oil my skin completely changed. I saw good results in 2 weeks. I know it is pricey but I think it worth to use this oil. I am going to buy this product again and again and again...
Love this oil! It definitely helped my acne prone skin calm down and even out the texture. I love Sunday Riley products and this is one of her top! The ingredients are amazing and really does the job

Not for me. It makes my skin really textured and irritated, especially on my forehead. I don’t believe it’s from purging as I’ve used a retinol regularly for almost 2 years now and haven’t had any issues with other products. I have just been using it on my neck and chest at night because it’s expensive and I feel like I have to use it. But I hate it. Also if it was good, I would look past the smell but I really don’t like that either. I’m happy it’s at least a natural scent but it projects and lasts after I’ve had the oil on for a while.

I bought this on a whim.  i love retinol, but hate how it can irritate, so much so thT I’ve sworn off it.  The product promised to be gentle and calm redness, so I decided to try.  i was very pleasantly surprised.   The next morning my skin was bright and clear.  Not only were my pores reduced , but my skin felt a bit firmer as well.  I have yet to see how well this works over time but I am impressed already.  As for redness that tends to accompany retinols there was no trace.  I have had no drying or flaking either.  The oil has a pleasant herbal smell to it and was easy to massage in.  So far I’m in love!
I really wanted to love this oil, but it broke me out every time I put this on my face. I tried for a good month, but sadly I’m going to have to stop using this oil.
I really like it. It is not strong retinol. In the morning my face looks glowing

review_title: the smell is terrible but my skin looks nice
review_text: I just started using this, this week. It is oily and doesn’t sink in. I am going to give it some time. Does it smell old to anyone else or is it just me?

So I have been using this product for about 8 weeks and I have to say I am in love. It absorbs so well into the skin, there’s no greasiness. I like this a lot better than the UFO oil which had an odd smell and made my face an oil slick. I credit this product with helping to even out my skin tone postpartum. A little goes a long way.

I really rarely write a view, way too lazy, but this product really has made such a difference in my skincare routine. I pair Luna with Good Genes, using Luna in the evening and so many benefits. Putting it on alone is relaxing, kind of cool with the blue color dissolving, and instantly makes skin feels nice. If I get a pimple (which has been so rare in the 2 yrs I’ve been using this) the redness will quickly calm down. It has smoothed out my skin, kept breakouts at bay, and I hope this is my forever product. Everyone’s skin is different but I encourage giving this a shot if you’re looking to try an effective evening oil.

review_title: a product I've purchased multiple times
review_text: I’ve purchased this product numerous times. when I first started using it I was totally in love! It made my skin feel very soft and smooth. However, I don’t believe I’ll be repurchasing it in the future because I find that the Paula’s Choice retinol works a bit better and is quite a bit cheaper.

I’ve heard about this a lot from youtubers I watched and got the travel size and I used it for 2 weeks and it changed my skin completely. It helps with my dark spots, pores,acne scaring,everything. A little goes along way as well I’ve had this big bottle for almost a year and I use it every night. And it’s almost gone, will continue to purchase this. It’s expensive I will admit but it’s truly worth it to me.

review_title: Love this despite disliking the brand
review_text: Ever since the fake-review scandal, I’ve wanted to dislike Sunday Riley so that I wouldn’t feel compelled to patronize them again. However, while I can live without “Good Genes“, I don’t see myself giving this up anytime soon. I noticed a difference after the first night I used it: my skin looked calmer and clearer, with noticeable fading around acne scars. I also don’t mind the smell or color; I’ve actually come to associate the smell with sleepy-time which I’d like to imagine helps me psychologically wind-down before bed. I currently use this every other night (I alternate between this and Drunk Elephant’s TLC framboos) and my skin tone is getting better and better. Rest assured this isn’t a fake review. However, the first ethical brand to make a comparable product without trying to defraud consumers with phony reviews about others will get my business.

The best night oil ever. This is my holy grail and my go to whenever I think my skin needs a little boost. I wake up feeling and looking amazing. My skin is glowing, redness is down, and my skin texture looks so smooth and flawless. Definitely recommend buying this, worth EVERY penny.

For reference my skin is normal to dry and gets extremely dehydrated verrrry easily but I’m prone to acne also and biggest struggle is rough texture. Basically I hit the skin type jackpot. I was v skeptical trying this after all the hype and glowing reviews saying it’ll transform your skin overnight but GURL when I woke up after the first use I was shook. My pores which are normally big enough to make anyone with trypophonia shudder we’re GONE. Idk where they went but they left my face and took the bumpy texture with them. My mom thought I had foundation on that’s how crazy it was overnight. It just keeps getting better and better and people are asking me what I’m using bc my skin looks so good. It’s gotten rid of any pimples that I had and hasn’t caused more, it’s gotten rid of the texture I struggle with especially on my cheek bones, it’s refined my pores to basically nonexistent, and my skin is so smooth even and glowing. I bought this with a sample of good genes so I don’t know if it’s just this or the combo but I don’t think I’ll ever be without either of them now and it has only been two weeks of use!

I have been using this about 5 months. This does exactly what it claims to do. Enough said. I highly recommend.  I could write a paragraph about what it has done for my skin, but the indications pretty much cover it.

I use this every night or wait a few days if I just got a facial. The smell is sooo relaxing and I love the blue color. I have combo skin that gets jawline little bumps and this has helped get rid of the serious stuff. Also doesn’t make me an oil slick by morning. I love retinol products but this takes the cake because it’s also hydrating my face with a glow

I do like how Luna makes my oily skin look gorgeous and radiant without feeling or looking overly oily. But, like another reviewer noted, it enlarged my pores. I tried this product twice and both times the same results and it’s pretty obvious. The oil itself may be too heavy for my skin. I don’t recall breakouts, but would not doubt the possibility.
Say goodbye to adult acne! I’ve never had better luck with cystic acne until this product. I’ve been using it for 3 years and my acne has stayed away. It’s worth the price!
I am in LOVE with this!! I use it nightly and definitely noticed a difference after a week. Worth every penny!
I got this as a sample and it’s done wonders.My skin looks bright and clear in the morning.

I received a sample of this in my Allure box. I use this as a part of my nightly skin care routine. After applying my prescription retin-A, I rotate this with the SR A+ High-Dose Retinol Serum. By adding this, I no longer have extreme sensitivity or dry flaky patches using the Retin-A alone. my hyperpigmentation patches definitely improved in texture. I’ll definitely buy this and the other serum!

I was desperate to improve my texture without having to get chemical peels once a month and struggle with blackheads, redness, and texture. I have very few products I will ever buy twice or even finish - this is absolutely one of them. Smaller pores. Smooth texture. Reduced redness. Glowy skin. Lasts forever and I use a generous amount every night. So impressed.

This has really helped with my skin tone, texture, lines, etc, but if I use a drop too much it gets very oily very fast. When you figure out the perfect amount it doesn’t leave skin feeling greasy, just moisturized. I use it with good genes and notice a big difference.

review_title: Love the product not the price tag!
review_text: I love Luna! I have been using this for a year or more now, have repurchased multiple bottles of this and saw significant improvement in my skin almost immediately after starting it’s use. I actually did a trial with my Botox to see if I would notice my skin care helping the aging process. I usually get Botox every 4-5 months and it has been 8 months. While I do have unwanted movement, I have no set lines which I normally would have one or so in my forehead when the Botox wears off. I love that this product is blue, I love the smell, and love the way it makes my skin look and feel... four stars instead of five because of the price tag- I do feel it is a bit pricey but obviously that hasn’t stopped me from purchasing. This is a great product and works wonderfully with Good Genes as instructed.

At first, I fell in love with this since it made the bumps on my forehead disappear. I was using it every night for about a week, but then my skin turned into a flakey desert. My eyelids were peeling and burning. I did not put it on my eyelids, but I must have rubbed my eyes at night after touching my face enough to dry the heck out of my eyelids. This stuff still did work, but you have to be careful in how often you wear it so that it doesn’t dry out your skin. I will have to cut back to only using this maybe once a week or so and right before bed so I am not tempted to touch my face and get it anywhere it’s not supposed to be. The smell is very herbal to me and I feel like a hippie in a candle store when wearing it, but oh well.
Has a strange smell to it.  It must be really rubbed on skin or it will leave a blue tint on face.  Ok

I am on bottle 3 of this product! First off- the lovely unchemicaled scent of retinol and botanicals. It’s an odd thing to have on your face- I promise it goes away before you even finish that first glass of wine on Bachelor night! Left in its place is smooth glowing skin with reduce fine lines and minimal pores visible. I haven’t had any issues with this product and the sun which is a mega retinol bonus!

I love how moisturizing this is and I do think it’s faded my freckles. But dear god it gave me the worst acne on my chin. I have NEVER had acne, not even as a teen. So to suddenly have my chin erupt is horrible. Even taking a break and then trying to use it only a few times a week results in the same issue. I’m hoping I can use it on the rest of my face and avoid my chin and things will be ok. The smell is odd - not unpleasant; it smells like a medicinal herbal tea.

I have no idea if it works or not because I cannot get past the smell. I used it once. It smelled horrible and the scent lasted on my face for over an hour (I do have a great sense of smell). I had to give it away.

I have used this product for over a year and always restock. I find that applying this at night I wake up to much clearer skin, with redness visibly reduced. It also heals acne scars quite quickly. And especially in the dry winter, the oil helps to provide that moisture. I can definitely notice the difference of my face when I am consistently using Luna Oil vs not.

Can’t say enough good things about this product. This and good genes together completely transform your skin. I love that it’s a retinol and an Oil because retinol can usually leave your skin dry and flakey but this one is actually hydrating! Also the blue tansy in it helps reduce redness and inflammation. Best retinol on the market and literally everyone can benefit from it

I’ve managed to have pretty good skin with the help of retin A, Clarisonic brush & an arsenal of great products. After my pregnancy my skin changed & this oil with Good Genes is the ONLY thing that got it back on track. It’s def $$$, but worth it! Must try !

I purchased one of the holiday sample kits. I’ve tried this oil consistently for 3 weeks. I still have breakouts, my skin tone is still uneven and it’s not making my skin feel any better. Going back to the  cheaper oil that gave me better results.

review_title: Changed my skin completely for the better
review_text: This changed my skin. It’s so soft and smooth and feels amazing.
This is the best night time product I have ever used and I have received so many great compliments about my skin since I started using it.  It leaves my skin hydrated, soft and dewy.
I’ve got it in my Allure Beaty box, it’s not bad face oil but I didn’t see any difference at all personally. I used it at night only and  a small bottle does last very very long.

One of the best skin care products I have used from Sephora. This Sephora employee recommended this to me when I mentioned to him that I was suffering from blemishes and break outs big time. It worked like wonder within a week. I finished one bottle and ordered another one. Thank you Sephora.

I really do love this product! I’ve been looking for a good before bed product and I just so happen to bump into this one. I was a bit unsure at first because of the price so I purchased the sample size and fell immediately in love.. after the 1st night I noticed a difference in my skin. It looks more even toned and smooth. I love that a little goes a long way. I have now purchased the larger size and it was totally worth it.

When I first bought this, my skin started breaking out, which I blamed on the product. Fast forward to 6 months later, when I decided to give it another try. This time around I cannot get enough. My skin feels incredibly soft in the morning. The signs of aging have decreased and my fine lines are not as prominent. I absolutely love this product and will continue to use it.

I bought this with the power couple duo. The active ingredient, Hydroxypinnacolone retinoate is my FAVORITE retinoid! It does not irritate me at all and I think it’s very effective. I don’t use this product as a night oil because I don’t love the smell (hence 4 stars) but I do use it frequently as a spot treatment, especially when I get tiny zits around my nose and chin. It keeps them from going crazy and it layers well with makeup if you let it dry for a few mins. I also use it on my chest to work on some lines I’m getting in my cleavage.

I’m a nurse that works 50-60 hr weeks and let me tell you my skin takes a beating. This is hands down the MOST AMAZING thing I have ever found for my skin. I put it on after long night shifts and wake up with hydrated, smooth, clear skin. It addresses any skin concern I could possibly have. I use it alternating days with a deep moisturizer on the opposite nights and I don’t think I will ever change up this routine. WELL worth the money!!!

review_title: Great for first time retinol users
review_text: This worked really well in the beginning, but my skin unfortunately got use to it. This was my first introduction into the retinol world and since it is a natural retinol it was a good first step because it’s more gentle. I have since graduated to more intense retinols. I wish this still worked for my skin as the initial results were great. Definitely give it a shot but don’t be surprised if you get use to it.

Amazing.  I was skeptical at first and tried a sample by the 2nd time I used it I went to the store and bought it.  My face tends to get “flakies“ and breaks out sometime, this has greatly improved my complexion.  There is a slight scent but it dissipates quickly as does the color.
i love the tea-tree smell it has. i yse it every night.  Wake up to my skin feel soft.

I’ve never written a review for a product, but I’ve never used a product that transformed my skin so much! And like anyone who struggles with acne, I have tried A LOT of products. I received a sample of this in my July Allure Box and have been using 3 drops every night since. I did purge a bit in the beginning, and it brought everything brewing to the surface. Then it cleared up all existing acne. I go totally makeup free to work, and after a few weeks of using this my coworkers asked if I was wearing foundation because my skin had gotten so much clearer. Since then it has slowly faded more and more of my acne scars and redness and made my tiny bumps go away. My indented acne scars have also started to improve so I’m excited to see more improvements in the months to come! Seriously, this stuff has totally transformed the look and feel of my skin. I do still get a few zits here and there, especially around my period, but it is nothing like what I used to. Plus they never stick around as long and the scarring isn’t as bad. As for the cost, yes this stuff is pricey, but it does last a long time since you only need a tiny bit. I’m still using my sample size, which is 1/4 of the full size, 3 months later. Plus I barely use spot treatments anymore so there are some indirect savings. If you’ve tried everything to clear your skin with no luck, I totally recommend giving this a try especially if you can get your hands on a sample!!

Love it, love it, love it.  The oil has a funny smell but I actually love the smell.  I’ve used other night oils before and this one doesn’t cause me to break out.  The oil helps to soften and smooth fine lines.  I love all the Sunday Riley products.  She really knows all her formulations and they’re not just gimmicks.
It literally improves my skin texture in just one night! I don’t use it on a daily bases. But my face is so soft in the next morning if I used it in the previous night. Repurchased already.

I absolutely adore the little pot. I love that it’s blue. I love the smell. I love that it’s a dropper. I love that it keeps me hydrated all night long and I wake up without that right feeling on my face—which I used to get if I didn’t use a strong enough moisturizer at night. I just love this little guy and will absolutely be repurchasing when I run out.

I love this product!! I have suffered from hormonal acne for years. The first time I used this I woke up the next morning and was speechless. My skin hasn’t ever looked so good. It really does help with discoloration and redness, it’s very calming and good for my dry skin!!
It’s extremely good oil.

Absolutely love this night oil! It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and conditioned without that greasy oil feel and the benefits in the morning are amazing! My redness is definitely calmed and my fine lines are minimized.

I got a sample of this, but I could only use it once. The smell is SO strong, like the strongest makeup/skincare product I’ve ever used.  And unlike some products, the smell doesn’t go away once you put it on your face. It’s really disappointing, because I had high hopes for this product because of the retinol. I don’t understand why luxury skin care brands like Sunday Riley continue to use fragrance, which can irritate skin, in their products, especially in this amount.

I bought this as part of the multivitamins set. I have combination skin and, to be fair, it was mid-Summer when I tried this. It was a little sticky to apply and left a light layer of film on my face. The morning after my first application of Luna, my skin was bumpy and I had teeny tiny breakouts all over my cheeks. I was horrified! Maybe this was my skin’s initial reaction to the product and I would look amazing after persisting for a couple of weeks. I don’t know, I don’t have that kind of patience!
Obsessed!!! This night oil makes my skin look amazing the next morning. I’ve not found any other product that gives me results anywhere remotely close. Love it!
This -- in combination with the Lactic Acid -- are making my skin more glowy and dewy than ever before! I will definitely be building this product again.

Not sure what the hype is and I regret buying this product. Very oily on the skin (just feels like it sits on top) and they add artificial color to the product. Not a fan. The ‘blue’ color isn’t natural which is disappointing. We shouldn’t be applying products with artificial color to our face. Would not purchase again.

I was SO eager to try this product after hearing so many people and friends rave about it! I used it for a week and my skin hasn’t looked this bad in years! it caused a flare up of horrible acne on my otherwise clear skin. I stopped using the product and the breakout ceased and started to heal. I’ve used Retin-A for years and I swear by it so I didn’t anticipate having this experience with a retnoid oil!

This product was a game changer for my skin! When I use it at night, my skin is smoother and more moisturized the next day. It has a strong smell that I love but if you’re sensitive to smells, you might have  I try a different serum. I’m on my third bottle of this product and I’m still addicted.

This oil has been a staple in my routine for a year and a half now. I love that the retinol isn’t so high that I feel like my skin is super sensitive from using it, but it’s enough to where my fine lines and pigmentation have lightened gradually over time. The overall quality and youthfulness of my skin has returned after years of dry, dull skin. While waiting for the retinol to show results, the carrier oils nourish and soothe skin. While this may not be a skincare necessity for next-day results, retinol is for sure a must for combating signs of aging — because yes, retinol (vitamin a) is the only ingredient proven to not only prevent signs of aging on the skin, but reverse them as well.If you’re looking for quick, instant results this isn’t for you. This is, in my mind, a long-term, preventative product that’ll keep your skin looking youthful with prolonged use... which for me, being in my 20s, is perfect (though all ages would absolutely benefit from this!).
Really like this. I use this with Retin-A with zero issues. It soaks into my combo skin and does not feel overly oily. I also use UFO in the morning and no issues with that either.

review_title: does everything it says it will
review_text: I’ve really noticed a change in my skin since I’ve started using this.  I began using it with good genes together and the combination is one I will not stray from.  These two led me to try more SR products.  My skin breaks out really bad with most oils, but this one does not at all.  Like many people when I first started using the lune/good genes combo it seemed to bring impurities to the surface, especially on my chin where I get the most breakouts, but after a week this was gone and super smooth clear skin was left.  This product actually does exactly what it says it does.  My skin texture is WAY better, it looks more plump and smooth.  I love this product.

Honestly, if I could I would give it a zero star. I have fairly normal skin. Just a little oily in tzone sometimes and sometimes dry cheeks but i still feel im not combination. my skin is not prone to breakout at all *knock on wood* BUT i decided to up my skincare game and add this as an anti aging product. BIGGEST MISTAKE of my life. really. tried using it for the past 4 months. in various ways. and i regret. i should have stopped in the beginning when it clogged my pores and broke me out. went back to sephora and the lady says sometimes it brings out impurities so it can happen. tried few more months and now i have several spots on my face from the break outs and my pores are larger than before. i did not use too much product ever but it managed to break me out every single time the next morning i woke up. i really tried to love it for all the hype and the price. probably i will end up using it on my foot as an oil.

Useless!I knew it was too good to be true, oil and retinol for my dry parched skin in winters! but it turned out to be a disappointment. Thankfully i just bought a small sample size when it was in stock, i have used almost 3/4th of it with no change whatsoever in my skin concerns. My skin is still dry and scaly, pores are the same size and pigmentation is still there. Infact what i noticed was that the skin over my nose got even drier and started to peel of, i switched using the oil to alternate night but its still there. So im going to use the remaining oil on my neck and stop using on the face.

I have textbook definition combo skin (oily and dry) and this product honestly saved my skin. I started using this with some hesitation because I have little experience with oils, but, within a couple of weeks, this product made a significant difference in minimizing pores, toning down my breakouts and honestly an overall improvement of my skin. I will say it dries fast yet somehow also keeps your skin feeling SO soft. And, now that i have used it for awhile, i have noticed my skin looking younger and fuller and because it’s so nourishing i don’t have as many dry patches on my skin either! This is honestly a game changer if you are looking to improve the overall look/feel of your combo skin. I will admit i HATE the smell, but, it fades quickly enough for me to not care that much, by the time I’m done with my nightly skin routine and head to bed you can’t smell it. If you are scared of the price - I will say, i only use 3 - 4 drops MAX at night on my face and neck so this product will last you a long time.

Here’s the thing.  I have been using this product for a couple of years now.   I love it.  But the most recent purchase had a horrible product inside.  I could not even squeeze the rubber cap, it was like hard inside.  Then I took apart the glass dropper and it also had dried up glue looking stuff inside of it, and it was extremely sticky.  I don’t know what happened to this bottle, but it could not be saved.  I hope this is just a fluke. I was heartbroken.
It makes my skin feel smooth and evens out my skin tone. Love this!
I use with Good Genes every night. I’ve NEVER seen my skin look so clear and smooth! Even with my oily skin, I get no breakouts! Will be repurchasing!

First of all the smell is unbearable. It’s like soy sauce. I literally had to hold my breath when applying this. I bought it due to the good comments, and the color looks so fancy, I didn’t expect it to smell so horrible. I had breakouts when using the clarins face oil, but this seems to not have causing any yet. I don’t see much improvement as in skin tone evening or moisturizing.

Started to include this in my nightly ritual and have definitely noticed a great change in my skin.  I’ve noticed a more youthful and smooth skin. My makeup looks so smooth n beautiful after using this at night.  obsessed!

review_title: great option to retinol for sensitive skin
review_text: My skin is very sensitive to retinol and thought the trans-retinoic acid ester in Luna Oil would be a more gentle option. It has been and my skin has had no issue with sensitivity to it and it does make my skin softer. It would be a definite repurchase for me except that an oil that is applied as a first step isn’t conducive to layering other skincare products. I’m using it on alternating nights and use Good Genes (along with all of my other usual night time steps) on the non Luna nights. I’ve layered Good Genes after Luna as recommended by Sunday Riley but I’d rather use actives on bare skin. It’s a good product and does what it says for me. A great option for a more minimalist skincare girl.

I first used this product when it was given to me as a sample, I was so impressed by it that I bought the bottle even though it was pricey. It is worth the price! not too greasy, feels light, and you wake up with beautiful skin. There’s a few things I want to touch base on in this review. First off, the packaging is great. I really like the new concept of a “refillable” outer packing where you just repurchase the product in a small cartridge instead of buying a whole new product that some brands are starting to do. Second of all, the texture of the moisturizer is absolutely incredible. It looks like it would be a thick cream but it’s not as thick as it looks and it melts right into the skin. It even looks good on the skin - it doesn’t look too oily or shiny like some moisturizers can make you look. Next, I feel like it pairs really well with other products. I used it alone and also with a vitamin C serum. It works great with both. Lately, I started using this product when I had super dry skin. I used it at night and woke up to beautifully moisturized skin that looked healthy all throughout the day.

This is a great product, especially for summer! It is lightweight, easy to apply, absorbs nicely into the skin and doesn’t leave it greasy. I have really enjoyed this cream and how much softer my skin is.

This is a great product, especially for summer! It is lightweight, easy to apply, absorbs nicely into the skin and doesn’t leave it greasy. I have really enjoyed this cream and how much softer my skin is.

Have been testing this moisturizer out over the last couple of days!  Very hydrating & plumping.  The texture is like a thicker gel consistency and my only concern is that I feel like it doesn’t absorb into my skin as much as I would want it to.  Definitely gives a glow and have been using in the morning before makeup!

I have dry and sensitive skin and I always need to moisturize it. I’m in love with light texture of Plum Plum Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer by Glow Recipe. It’s really hydrating. Skin looks plump and glowing. So, I highly recommend it.

I’ve tried a few products from Glow Recipe and they were all amazing, but this one really takes the cake. First of all, it smells amazing. I love how smooth it applies and it makes my skin feel amazing! It’s so hydrating. It’s not super thick but it’s not too thin, it’s literally perfect. I also love that it is refillable! I’m obsessed.

I love this cream so much!! It instantly brightens and plumps my skin and I love the scent of it. This is definitely my favorite product from this brand to date. It’s so lightweight but helps hydrate my dry skin!
My skin always looks and feels amazing when I use this products. 10/10 recommend… but it now

review_title: Do not really fit all skin tones
review_text: I received this product as a part of my May Boxycharm.While it is very hydrating and soothing, she is SHINY and I didn’t expect that at all! Also, the shine gives it a kind of beige color that I find, do not suit all skin tones at all. I am a tan/medium deep and this is way to pale for me! It shows on my skin and doesn’t blend well.They should have made different shades of this. Like a more bronze/golden one, like Saie, so it would fit all skin tones better.
Leaves my skin glowy, usually wear alone. My pores look good as well

Product has a nice smell and texture and did not cause any problems fir my sensitive skin, but I definitely won’t be using the rest of the tube. This is not a priming moisturizer - it leaves a greasy residue and does not wear well under makeup at all. Very disappointing
Favorite primer, especially for my skin that dries out from certain products. I love using it under makeup as well as alone for an extra glow when I don’t plan to wear makeup. Highly recommend!

I love this under makeup! Great level of moisturizing and adds a bit of a glow. On its own I find it a bit too glowy (shiny), but I love using it under makeup. It seems thick when it comes out but doesn’t feel thick or sticky on your skin. Wonderful coconut scent, not too strong.

I was looking for a glowy moisturizer since I usually don’t usually wear makeup and like my bare skin to have some glow... this stuff smells nice and does give a glow, but I found it left my face a little red and irritated at the end of a day’s wear. My skin is NOT sensitive usually so I’m surprised and will steer clear in the future.

LOVE this product. It gives such a subtle, luminous look to skin, and is the perfect base layer to my skin. My face tends to get oily, but this product doesn’t promote any excess oil which is usual the problem with moisturizers. I really recommend this product to all my friends.
Not what I expected!! It has a sheen to it so it makes your skin look super dewy. Its great for sensitive skin so if that’s something you like than this is a great product for that.
This primer was okay. It felt a bit oily and more like a sunscreen rather than a primer, which I wasn’t expecting.

review_title: This Will Become Your Go-To Primer
review_text: This is my go-to primer. It smells great, goes on smooth, and blends flawlessly. You can wear it with or without foundation, and I get compliments either way! It also helps with keeping my face hydrating - previously I had been using a Smash Box primer, but I had to quit using it due to drying my skin out. I can’t rave enough about the hydration and wonderful smell of this primer, as well as the creaminess of the primer. I would highly recommend!

Been using this moisturizer for years.  Have tried other ones but I always seem to come back to this one.  It is light and non-irritating and works as primer as well as moist. Gives you a little glow which is nice.  Will forever buy this!

I have to use this everytime before makeup now. It leaves the most natural, dewy, plump glow. It does not look sparkly or shimmery in the slightest, and it also doesn’t look greasy at all. It’s got a slight pink tone which is flattering. It wears so lovely over skincare and under makeup, it doesn’t pill with any of my products. I use Milk Hyrdo grip primer on top.

This is a lifesaver! I have awful combo skin, super oily in my T zone but also super dry. Literally I looked at my skin and I’ll get acne. This however is the first primer that hasn’t broken me out and is safe for my skin. It’s hydrating enough but also controls my oil. Leaves a subtle dewy finish, you can use it by itself or under your fav makeup. Highly recommend to anyone with sensitive acne prone skin!!
This is a great primer! It’s moisturizing, smells great and you can wear it alone. Works well with my other makeup products. Definitely recommend!

This is an excellent primer for my minimal make up routine. I do not like bulky foundations or cover ups- this primer is often the only coverage I opt for. It has a dewy effervescent glow and provides some blurring of pores. There is slight tan tint. Any bronzers and blush certainly have stronger pigmentation and are longer lasting when applied over this primer.  I can understand how this product would not be preferred for a full matte look, but if you are trying to achieve a “no-make up“ make-up look, or like dewiness, I highly recommend!
I absolutely love this primer! Love First Aid Beauty period.

If you’re looking for a light moisturizer with a shimmery sheen, this is a good product. Smells nice. But it’s NOT a primer as the name suggests. It doesn’t prep my skin to help makeup look smother and richer, which is what I expect a primer to do. And it looks too glitter-ish to put all over your face anyway. Way too much shimmer. And it ‘sits’ in creases accentuating any lines or imperfections.

I think it’s a good moisturizing primer, but I didn’t feel like my skin was looking necessary smoother and flawless. Also, don’t put to much because it will roll on your skin. I think this primer is perfect for dry skin.

I wanted to love this product. I actually love the hint of shimmer. However, my normally totally clear skin broke out insanely after a few days of using it. It is the only change in my beauty care, so I know this product is to blame. I haven’t broken out like this since I was a teenager, and I am almost 40!

I tried at least 5 different primers and I always come back to this one. This my all time fave and I don’t even wear makeup sometimes because of how great my skin looks with it! Smells amazing and even tho I have combination skin and it is sometimes oily, it just makes my skin so much better. I love it!!

This primer it’s amazing, not heavy, good for my skin, smells delicious! I am super happy with this purchase! Makes my foundation go on a lot better!! Great recommendation by Maria @Sephora PlazA Bonita!!! Thank you Maria, you rock!!!

Love this primer! it has worked well with any foundation I have used with it. It keeps my make up on all day and keeps my skin hydrated! I have liked this one better then higher priced one and ones that are more popular. I think this one is super underrated and is my FAV.

review_title: Great to add moisture to skin
review_text: This is a really nice moisturizer. The smell is very light and fresh and the texture is very smooth. I use it under my makeup everyday and I love it. The only reason I am giving it a 4 star review is because I think of this product as more of a moisturizer and not like a primer. It doesn’t do anything for texture and I don’t feel that it makes my foundation stay on any longer than usual. It is just a really great moisturizer for dry skin.

This is the best makeup primer for dry skin! I love that it is super moisturizing, and it preps the skin for foundation application. It helps make my foundation easier to apply. I have repurchased this a few times. It is very similar to the Too Faced Hangover primer but more affordable! Love this!

I recieved this as a sample, but I can assure you that I’ll be buying more shortly. It evens my skintone, it feels great on the skin, it helps my makeup stay where it should, but on top of all of that it smells a m a z i n g !

Loved that it was super hydrating and had a nice light coconut scent to it. It felt light and creamy but I don’t think it’s good to wear it everyday. For me it seemed it’d be best to use when you have a one of those long days/night you need that extra boost of moisture the next day.

review_title: Not a good product for me
review_text: I didn’t like this product at all. Feels like sunscreen and applies oddly. Made application of my foundation difficult and then it clumped in an hour. I tried it again and same results. Glad I got it as a free beauty insider sample and didn’t pay for it.

I feel like this breaks me out but I like the glowy look it gives. It gives a nice glow without looking oil! I find using it before foundation makes it grip the foundation from the stickiness, but I prefer using it with bbcream mixed in because the finish is beautiful. Just wish my skin wasn’t sensitive to it. Good thing I got the free sample to try.

This stuff is amazing!  I can’t get over how awesome my skin looks.  I use this in the morning as a moisturizer and the first time I put it on I was blown away, My skin looked so nice I didn’t even use my BB Cream.  It really toned down any redness I had from acne and made my skin look glowing.  Most days I only use this with no extra make up on my skin.  I’m really excited to see how it looks in the winter if it will be moisturizing enough!  I originally got this as a sample from the rewards bazaar but I bought a full size bottle. Only complaint is I wish it was packaged a little differently bc sometimes I get too much product.  I hate saying I wish a product had a pump bc of how wasteful it is but that would be the only thing that makes this better.

A consultant recommended it to me at a store... but for some reason it didn’t work out. It felt too oily and looked greasy on my skin. Maybe somebody who is going for that glossy look would like it. For me it was too much so I gave it away.

I bought this as a part of a kit first aid beauty has, I wasn’t going to plan on trying it considering I have oily skin (I didn’t like it for that exact reason as well) but also it broke me out very badly and was the only thing I didn’t differently in my makeup routine. It makes your skin look really good and feel soft but it broke me out so terribly. I’m bummed because I wanted to like it.
My absolute favorite primer. And I tried a bunch (tatcha, smashbox, fenty beauty) and I keep coming back to this. And it’s so much more affordable too.
I really love this. It feels really good on my skin and creates an illuminating effect while moisturizing. I have sensitive skin and this does not irritate it at all. Will definitely buy again.
It not only smells good, but it also provides a pretty smooth canvas for my makeup.

This is a nice lightweight moisturizer. The smell is interesting, don’t laugh but the best way I can describe it is it smells like a clean gas station bathroom. You know, one that was just sanitized and has that fresh sort of smell to it. It’s pleasant I guess, I’ve smelled much worse, but it’s not a smell I’d necessarily choose to have next to my nose on a regular basis. Would I buy it again? Probably not as I’ve had better moisturizers in other brands but I’d use it again if I had a sample or a freebie.
Smooths my skin and leaves my skin with less texture. Awesome product!
I love it!!! My skin is no longer dry

I live in desert dry heat and using this before applying my make up is a life saver from feeling and looking dry. I only had the sample size but this time I am definitely buying the biggest size available.

review_title: Nice lazy day primer and moisturizer
review_text: I have a large collection of highend primers, I like that this one is moisturizing and a primer but it doesn’t smooth very much in my opinion which is why I gave it 4 stars. I don’t use this every day either because the coconut in it seems to clog my pores with constant use which is why I only use this once in a while when I don’t feel like using a moisturizer separately from my primer. it is a good product though, I am just sensitive to coconut oil and derivatives.
It felt super oily and so heavy on the skin.

review_title: Good product that I use often
review_text: The smell reminded me of the fountain pen ink I used to have as a child. Perfume like and far from coconut. The texture itself is like a lotion that is easy to apply and absorbs well. As a moisturizer, I prefer to use it as my second moisturizer and love it. Not sure about the priming aspect as it has not done much for my pores. Works better with a little concealer. All in all its a good moisturizer. My skin looked glowy and not oily after a few hours of application.
I really don’t think this primer does anything other than makes the skin glow.

Thankfully I only had a sample size of this, as I didn’t care for it. As other reviewers noted it was coming off in weird “pill“ type flakes on my face. This was more noticeable under foundation. I had to wash my face and start again because it looked awful, and made a mess. I have never seen a moisturizer do this, so would be curious to see what ingredient is causing this. An easy pass for me.
Amazing for dry skin. I have dry flaky skin and my makeup goes on and stays so smooth after using this. I received this as a sample product and just purchased the full size
Great primer for dry skin! Looks great worn alone also
Doesn’t do much to help with skin texture and it has an “illuminating“ quality that just looks like unwanted shine on my face. I will use it up but will no repurchase.

Love this product! Can’t be used in place of moisturizer, you’ll still want to moisturize before applying, but it gives me a dewy glow without making my skin look greasy, and foundation layers really well over it. Also love the way it smells!
Made my face look very oily, and sometimes made my make-up kind of peel/roll off, which was weird, also made pores a lot more visible, smelt good though
This product smelt really gross to me. Too fake smelling maybe? Maybe too sugary smelling? I also didn’t feel like it helped my makeup go on very well. Disappointed.
Sadly, this left a gummy and shiny film on my skin, and I immediately wiped it off! It was sticky and makeup wouldn’t apply smoothly. Not for me :).

review_title: great for moisturizing not good for a primer
review_text: Great for use a moisturizer but not so great for a primer. I use it mostly as a moisturizer but I find that if i put my makeup on with  using this as a primer, it really dos not do the trick for me.

I received a sample of this product in my Allure Beauty Box and fell in love with it and had to buy the full size. Even though the name says “priming moisturizer“, I use it just as my day moisturizer. It absorbs quickly and gives me a “slept all night“ glow. The smell is fantastic!
I have the driest skin because of being on accutane and this is perfect to put on in the morning to make my skin feel alive again! Plus I love the smell!

I don’t often repurchase products because I’m always looking to try something new, but this is one of the products that I have repurchased 2 times now. It is very hydrating and comfortable under make up, it makes my foundation go on smoothly. It is very beautiful and gentle on the skin as I have very sensitive skin and this product has not irritated by skin. It does not leave the skin looking oily or greasy, it’s a very nice moisturizer/primer that gets absorbed into the skin.

review_title: Miracle moisturizer!! Hydrated without greasy skin
review_text: I received this product free for testing - and it was the moisturizer I’ve been waiting for!! For years I’ve been trying to find a moisturizer that doesn’t make my already oily skin look greasy and make me break out while moisturizing for hydrated skin. This may be the first moisturizer I’ve ever used that hasn’t left a greasy film on my skin!! I’m so happy I will absolutely be a returning customer and buy this product

I relived this complimentary from Influenster’s in the Sephora play box. Love this product, it gives me the perfect amount of hydration, and love the mild natural smell, plus I’m a big fan of everything coconut.
Found it pretty useless. It had neither priming nor moisturising effect on me.

I adore this primer.  I believe I initially received it as a deluxe sample.  I have since repurchased the full size multiple times.  Literally EVERY time I wear this someone compliments me and says that I am glowing and asks what I’m wearing. Wearing this under makeup gives me just enough of a glow! Love it! I have sensitive skin and this doesn’t irritate me in any way.

I got this in a allure beauty box, not something I would normally buy, nor was excited about. As the title says I never wear foundation, so I was a little leary of the tint in this but it’s amazing. At first it adds a little shimmer, but that dies down as the day goes on ( I have combo skin), and it really evens skin tone. It is also a bit sticky at first but once it sets it’s fine. Worked as a great primer for my eye shadow. Highly recommend, I will be buying the full size as soon as the sample is done!

this makes my skin look even better. this product is amazing! so perfect for dry, sensitive skin. leaves my skin looking so smooth, poreless, and glowy. i don’t know if this helps with the longevity of my makeup, but it definitely makes my makeup application look perfect. this primer also has a coconut scent which I love. it’s very calming in the morning. it also has a pearlescent tint which i think is why it looks so good on skin.  pros-- perfect for dry skin- makes makeup look better- leaves skin hydrated- blurs pores- smells amazingcons - longevity of makeup not helped

review_title: more moisturizer than primer but still a win
review_text: I enjoyed this product when I received it in one of the sampler sets released around the holidays and I recently repurchased. It is a nice moisturizer with a shimmer to it similar to a strobe cream.  I felt that it helped my liquid foundations perform a little better, but it did wear more like a shimmering moisturizer than a primer.   Although I used it regularly in the winter, I will not be using it in the summer because it lacks any sort of sun protection.
I have oily skin and this moisturizes my skin perfectly and keeps my foundation on amazing without letting me get too oily or greasy!! And smells amazing!!

My favourite thing!!! I do not wear make.. well very much anyway and this all I put on my face. It makes my skin look amazing, and it smells so good. Hands down one of my favourite beauty products I’ve ever bought

This is a great primer/moisturizer! I use it as the last step of my am routine. First it evens out your skin and moisturizes it - it has the smoothest texture even when its not a methicone based primer. Second, it gives you a dewy glow. AND it smells good (with no added fragrances!)Totally recommend this product for dry skin!

Before I bought this product I went into every Sephora and asked different workers what primer they would recommend for dryer skin but has a oily t zone and they all told me this one so I was convinced now I love this stuff! It smells amazing and feels really good on the skin! I don’t really notice it minimizing my pores which is fine since I have my mufe primer but I would definitely recommend!

OMG, my favorite primer!  Not only does it moisturize but it also has a slight “shimmer“ to it...  Not extreme but just enough to make you “shine“ when the light hits your face just right.  I, originally, received this as a sample and have been buying it ever since.  Amazing, amazing product!  I LOVE it!!!
I have severely dry skin due to acne medication, and this is the best moisturizer ever!! It also is an amazing primer. I would recommend this to E V E R Y O N E !

I use this every morning as part of my regular skin care routine now. I love that it brightens my skin and most times I just wear it over top of my moisturizer without anything else. Great product. Nice and light.

After starting a retinoid, my skin went from outrageously oily to drier than the Prohibition.  I needed a moisturizing primer in addition to my modified skincare so my foundation wouldn’t dry up and cake.  This was the solution!!  I layer this over the first few steps of my skincare routine and allow it to set, then apply my foundation over top of it.  It is sticky enough that it grabs the foundation tight, and holds all day.  My foundation doesn’t dry up or get patchy. It just stays gorgeous all day!  I’ve been reaching for this over many other products and I feel this is money well spent.  I did deduct a star because it pilled horribly when I tried this over a facial serum that is glycerin-heavy, so I cannot use that serum when I want to use this primer.  It’s also not moisturizing enough to use on its own if your skin is anything close to dry.  It does not do well under my eyes and caused uncontrollable creasing in my concealer.  Everywhere else, though, it’s fantastic.
This product feels so nice and refreshing on the skin. It also works well with every foundation I have worn it with. Gives the skin a nice glow.
honestly i love this so much, it hydrates my skin and my make up goes on so nice and lasts better.

I bought this from the recommendation of a Sephora employee when I told her I was looking for a hydrating primer to go with my Nars Sheer Glow (one of the only foundations that I have found a good match for my skin tone). I was a little skeptical because I haven’t really liked any of the FAB products I had tried before this, and I was slightly let down again at first when I used it as a primer under my foundation. I liked the slight cooling effect and the texture of the product, but I didn’t feel like it really did anything to help the application or longevity of my foundation.HOWEVER—I decided to try mixing it in with my Sheer Glow instead of putting it on under my foundation. GAME CHANGER! My skin looked so much better with just this little change. My dry skin looked so hydrated and glowing! (I will say I don’t really have a problem with pores or my makeup lasting, so I can’t say anything for those concerns!)I am taking 1 star off because I felt that I only truly loved this with the addition of another product, but the price for the amount you get is reasonable for me. It smells pretty good too!

Great for winter to add some glow. I have combo skin but tends to look full in winter time. When I apply this primer I actually mix it with my foundation to sheet it out as a tinted moisturizer to apply over my face and then lightly powder around T zone. The finish look is satin, and the finish lasted a long time. I am surprised how great the product works out for me and the price is not bad either. Will repurchase in winter time for sure!
Has a dewy look under makeup and doesn’t budge.

Makes my skin so glowy!! I received this as a sample but will buy the full size soon and get more accurate results on if this will make me break out or get oily during the day but so far, I really like how glowy it made me look under my foundation so I will purchase soon.

review_title: Really amazing primer for sensitive skin
review_text: I’m absolutely in love. EVERYTHING irritates my skin, but this doesn’t. On top of that, it really helps make my mineral makeup look great! I’m still working on some acne marks, but if I can get those down, I could totally see wearing just this and a little powder and walking out the door skin-wise. Note that the mica does make you slightly luminous. And I have noticed a bit of oil shine, but nothing drastic. For how this makes my skin look and makeup apply, I’m willing to take the slight oil shine in the afternoon. LOVE! <3

I have combination skin and I’m very dry on my cheeks and I find the need to use this cream in combination with a more hydrating one. This cream is still one of my favorites because of how aluminizing it is, it makes my face have a healthy glow.
I am in love with this primer! I have very dry, uneven skin and this is so soothing and moisturizing. When I put this on my skin is glowing even before I put my foundation on.
This is a very moisturizing primer, which is something I need. If you’re looking for a good moisturizing primer, you can’t go wrong with this.

Got this as a sample in one of the mini swag bag promos they had over the holidays and I must say I was pleasantly surprised by this. This truly matified my face and almost felt like a BB cream to me as well. I bought a smaller sized version as part of a limited edition sale set and have high hopes to use this as a grab and go product for those mornings when I don’t have time for makeup.

I really wanted to love this but it broke me out really badly. It gave my face a nice sheen but after using it for 3 days I started getting zits. The coconut smell is a bit overpowering and I don’t think this would work at all for oily skin, it’s super dewy. I gave it to my friend who also has dry skin (but not sensitive skin like I do) and she likes it.
Smells amazing and helps my dry skin in this winter weather

I initially received a sample of this. Liked the coconut summery smell. Saw the glow it leaves on the skin. Don’t use too much, it can make you look a little silver. Anyways it doesn’t do much for priming. But it does feel nice and looks nice with or without foundation.
This is an amazing product! It makes my skin glow in a dewy way. I actually stopped using powder and bb cream. Smells amazing too!

I haven’t used a lot of primer because this is the first primer I used and I just sticked to it. My foundation blends really really well with this primer and when I use it, i just tend to have less breakouts than wearing foundation alone. It also makes me skin glow, like natural-looking glowing. Only thing is it’s a bit oily for my skin type.

Great moisturizer! Smells amazing and definitely soothing and hydrating. I even felt comfortable applying this on my kid’s face before applying Halloween makeup! Only thing is I wouldn’t use this as a primer  more as a moisturizer. Only reason why I gave it 4/5 is makes me break out a little, yet for the harsh cold weather this is definitely a great skin saviour.

Looks lovely on my yellow undertone, light, combo skin.  Hydrating, doesn’t break my out, and provides a nice sheen for no-makeup/makeup days. I’ve been using this in the morning along with a light concealer and brow makeup. It’s a great go-to.

I redeemed points for this product. At first I didn’t have high expectations for it as it was just a priming moisturizer. To my surprise it gave me the most beautiful lit from within glow on my skin alone, and a flawless base and glow under my foundation. My skin feels and looks really smooth. I intend to order a full size and it check out more product in their range.  I love!

review_title: Wonder primer, especially for dry winter months!
review_text: Miracle primer for the dry winter months! Smells wonderful and leaves skin feeling creamy, hydrated, and dewy. Works well under a variety of foundations. Wouldn’t recommend for the summertime if you live in a humid climate. Only downfall is that it doesn’t have sunscreen so you should apply sunscreen before applying this product. Bonus is that it is oil free.

With sensitive skin, it is overbearingly difficult to find something that is gentle and effective. This does those things plus more. It also has a soft bubble gun scent. It is very light and breathable making it easy to apply.

It gives your skin this subtle sheen/glow. Smell is light and fresh. All other primers tended too pill under my make up but this primer sets in seconds and sometimes i wear it without make up on top! (on brave days.. or like working out when you wana be cool and not wear make up). Its also about the consistency of like a medium cream but still sits light and pretty.
Absolutely love this!  Leaves my face feeling and smelling great!  Even though I’m usually a cheapskate with most things,  I’ll make an exception with this product. Will definitely be buying again.
IM IN LOVE WITH IT. ITS MOISTURIZING AND LEAVES MY SKIN TRULY DEWY DEWY WITHOUT THE GREASY FEEL. 100% RECOMMENDED. MY FAVORITE PRIMER AND MOISTURIZER ALL IN ONE

At first I thought it was really great - good smell, felt nice going on, touch of shimmer - but after awhile I realized it was super heavy and greasy. When I see “primer“ I think oil-absorbing and smoothing, this is NOT that kind of primer. It’s basically a fairly heavy moisturizer with a little shimmer. If you have dry skin, go for this.

I figured I would try it and see, boy am I so glad I did! I’m on my 3rd bottle. My 2 teens both borrowed it and also fell in love. My oily girl uses it as a bb cream, dry-acne girl as daily moisturizer/primer and I use it daily, with or without makeup. All 3 of us have seen great improvement in our skin tone. I love what’s in this!!

After exploring many different primers. I came upon this one. it is AMAZING. it is lightweight and smells amazing. it also gives your skin a subtle glow. the price is great too and it has lasted me so long! I even mix a bit with my liquid highlight drops to give the glow a more natural look.

I’ll be honest, as a straight-up primer to keep makeup lasting all day, this may not be worth the 5 stars BUT it’s still a 5 star product for because of its use as a luminizer and moisturizer. As a last step moisturizer it’s great and gives my combination dry skin that hydration and softness my skin needs with the added bonus of luminosity. Though if you run oily, it might make you too shiny. for those with seriously dry skin it’s a great primer moisturizer because it makes skin look and feel great, is cheaper than most comparable luminizing primers and moisturizers and does both. Even if your skin is not that dry but if you veer towards powder makeup, then the moisture in this balances the powder to prevent over drying and cakiness. I usually use liquid base products and powder everything else, but I can get away with a powder foundation with this underneath or can even do this and juat concealer and a sheer powder because of its glowy evening out effect. I also love the smell. my only gripe is that since I have tan skin with a very yellow and slightly olive undertone, I wish it had a gold shimmer Laura Mercier’s Radiance primer,  instead of silver shimmer because it actually looks better on lighter skin with a neutral undertone. That said it’s still my holy grail must wear. I’ve even worn it to sleep in a pinch because it makes a great light moisturizer on its own and doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. And at $28, it’s a great value.
Love this primer. I got a sample with my points and when i used it all up,I went back to sephora and bought the full size. Only thing i don’t like about this primer is the glitter.
Smells amazing! And it has a touch of glow. Very confortable to wear. Plus it’s not full of chemichals like the other products on the market.
Leaves my skin glowing, healthy looking, and dare I say more youthful. It gives that touch of tackiness like after a great facial on the daily.

review_title: A holy-grail for a oily acne prone skin
review_text: I initially got this toner as a free sample and wasn’t fan of the smell. So I gave it  to my husband thinking it will not work for him. But I was very amazed how his skin got brighter and his acne scars started fading in just 3 days. We immediately purchased the larger size. The product is a bit stickey when applied to face but it will go away after a few seconds.

I’ve tried a few exfoliating toners on the market and continue to come back to this one, it’s exfoliates the dry skin off easily and leaves my skin glowing, plus you get much more product for the price than some of the others (for example- summer Fridays AHA exfoliating solution). Would definitely highly recommend for glowy, healthy, skin.

Amazing!!!!! I am a makeup artist of 25 years and my skin is constantly needing exfoliation and deep cleansing products because I wear makeup almost on a daily basis. This product does everything I need! It is an amazing toner and exfoliatior. It smells amazing and gives your skin a very refreshed citrus deep clean feeling. I cleansed my skin with my usual makeup melt balm and followed by a cleanser. I rinsed and dried my face and then followed with REN. I applied it with my hands and just pressed it into my skin. You can also use a cotton pad if you want but I liked the feeling of just pressing it directly into my skin with my hands. It is suggested to not use it on days that you have used another exfoliatior. It did tingle on certain spots of my skin but I liked that because it made me feel as if it was working it’s magic. My skin felt tight and bright after use and I followed with a moisturizer. I would rate this a 10/10
I got it as a sample and after it being on my skin for couple of hours. it caused pimples!!! If you have sensitive skin stay away!

which is not disclosed anywhere on the bottle.  I received this as a sample and used for several days before reading the fine print on the website.  I am PREGNANT and BHA is NOT SAFE to use.   I checked the bottle carefully and nowhere does it mention BHA, only AHA.
My dry skin LOVES this product. I use it at night after cleansing and before serums. This product has helped to even out my skin tone, reduce texture and give me a glow. Highly recommend.

What is this witchcraft? So I’m always skeptical to try new things with my sensitive skin but I had zero problems with this and apply it every night before I moisturize. You can literally feel it working (the micro bubbles) and my skin has never looked better, my sun spots and acne have all gone away and my skin just looks brighter and healthier. I think my pores look a bit smaller but I can’t be sure yet as it’s only been a week and a half I’ve been using this. Also it really preps your skin for whatever moisturizer you’re going to apply after. This is a new staple for me for sure!

review_title: A must have!!! I promise you!!!!
review_text: This is my second purchase of this product! It gives me a glow after only a few uses it’s amazing! I’ve recently tried ole henriksenglow2oh dark spot toner and it doesn’t even compare to the ren! Only thing I don’t like is that they changed the spout before you could press down with cotton swab and it dispersed product, but I think they may have changed it because some people don’t use cotton swab. That’s minor though.

I expected this toner to be more on the harsh side, but it is surprisingly gentle! The smell of this toner is subtle, it’s not too fragrant. The downside of this toner is that it is drying. I only noticed a slight difference in my skin (hyperpigmentation on my cheeks and chin), but nothing significant enough to repurchase this product again, especially for the price. I recommend this toner for those with minimal hyperpigmentation.

I received this product to try.  I was pleasantly surprised at how much I liked this.  It had a nice, light scent.  I used it twice a day and can tell the difference.  I will continue to use this product.

I’m really obsessing over this toner, it came right on time as I just finished one. Doesn’t sting when used on my sensitive combination skin. Really cleans out a lot of grime my cleansers leave behind. Will definitely pick this one up again.

I’m really obsessing over this toner, it came right on time as I just finished one. Doesn’t sting when used on my sensitive combination skin. Really cleans out a lot of grime my cleansers leave behind. Will definitely pick this one up again.

I received this product as a sample and it might be my new favorite toner. I’m starting to get into AHA and BHA products so I was really excited to receive this. This doesn’t dry out my skin at all, it makes it feel plump and it does look more radiant. I would try to avoid any active breakouts though since it does sting a little. I’ve been using it for about 2 weeks now and there’s definitely a difference.

First off, I love that this is a clean product. I love that it is good for your skin and The packaging is recyclable. It is also a cruelty free company so there is no testing on animals! The toner itself is also amazing. It has a citric scent and it really does make your skin glow. It exfoliated without drying out my skin and my face felt so good. I felt like I got the best results by using this daily.
Overall I don’t see too much of a difference just yet, my skin seems a bit brighter and clearer. I dont use much toners if ever, but I would recommend to friends.

I have been using this for the last few weeks now and I can definitely see a change in my skin.  It appears brighter and younger.  I also use in the bikini area to help lesson the dark spots. So far so good.

I have sensitive skin so I was a little cautious about this toner, but it works great. I use it about twice a week as part of my nighttime skincare routine. It is a little bit drying, so I follow it with a heavy moisturizer or sleeping mask (a regular moisturizer won’t do). The next morning, my skin is soft, smooth, and clear.

I have sensitive skin so I was a little cautious about this toner, but it works great. I use it about twice a week as part of my nighttime skincare routine. It is a little bit drying, so I follow it with a heavy moisturizer or sleeping mask (a regular moisturizer won’t do). The next morning, my skin is soft, smooth, and clear.

This is your great everyday toner. As someone who has dry skin, toners tend to dry me out even more so I did not think they were necessary in my skincare routine before this product. This tones me without being overly stripping. I also love that it is sustainable and a clean beauty product.

This toner has a light, refreshing citrus scent and is not sticky at all! It leaves your skin hydrated and clean, while others might dry you out more. I like that the company is very eco friendly! I got this product for free to review, but I would definitely purchase this in the future! I recommend this to all skin types. My skin is a combination and i have seen improvement in my glow and texture since using it!

I love this toner - I saw it on tik tok and decided to try it . I used to use physical exfoliation on my face until I learned how bad it was for aging - now I use chemical exfoliator as like this one . My skin feel super clean afterwards and it has helped with some of my hyperpigmentation- I’ll have to use longer to see how much. Most toners aren’t worth anything but this one actually exfoliates so it helps your other products work better.

I use toner as part of my daily skincare routine but don’t think toners have made much of a difference. I’ve been using the REN toner for a few weeks now and I am seeing positive results. I have normal sometimes oily skin and this toner is gentle and does not dry out my skin. I use it daily at night. I like that this is an all in one toner so that it gently exfoliates and brightens my skin. My large pours are minimized and it has helped with my skin texture and I see fading in my dark spots from the sun. It does feel a slightly sticky but once I add my serum and moisturizer my skin feels soft and smooth. I like the dispenser as I can squeeze out just the amount I need and don’t worry about waste. It has a light, citrusy smell which I really like. This is my new favorite toner.

I love this toner - I saw it on tik tok and decided to try it . I really like this toner!!!! It’s very hydrating which is nice because some toners can leave my skin feeling really tight and dry, and this is not the case here! It’s got a nice hint of citrus scent, but not overly fragranced. This can be irritating, especially if you have any open wounds on your face like a recently popped pimple, or if you are an aggressive face washer. But I’ve found if I don’t scrub my face too hard or have any open spots on my face it’s not irritating! I will definitely keep using this.

The first thing that stands out to me with this product is the clean/vegan ingredients & 100% recyclable plastic bottle.  I am all for clean beauty and a clean planet.  The REN tonic is easy to use; I squirt a little onto a cotton pad and swipe all over my face (avoiding my eye area as directed).  A plus, is you need very little of the product for a single use, so this bottle will really lost a long time.  Another plus is that after application, I can literally feel my skin getting tighter.  If you have any broken skin on your face, you may feel a little burn, but that subsides quickly.  You will literally glow because the tonic leaves a film on your face that makes you look shiny/glowing.  The downside to this product is it does feel sticky.  My fingers are a little sticky after application and so is my face, but what I have found is that applying your moisturizer afterwards helps make the sticky feel subside.  This product states to use nightly and I would never use it before leaving the house or under makeup.  I honestly do not like the shiny look, I prefer my skin to look matte, so I wouldn’t want to be in public with a shiny face (I don’t mind it while at home).  Plus, I am not so sure this would be too great underneath makeup (haven’t tried it).  I apply the tonic every night, after cleansing and always follow up with my eye cream and facial moisturizer.  After a couple weeks of use, I have noticed some positive changes in my skin overall during the day.  I do not mind being barefaced in public anymore and I feel like my skin is a little more youthful overall; clear, even and lighter dark spots/melasma.  See my no makeup selfie attached photo (I am 40 years old).  Overall I recommend this product if you do not mind a little stickiness (that subsides) and a shiny face (some call it a glow).  The tonic has made a positive, noticeable difference for me.

This REN Ready Steady Glow toner has a nice, light citrus scent. It’s very runny which is why it instructs you to put it on a cloth or something to apply it. It goes on smoothly, absorbs pretty well and works well. I can see a more even facial tone and I feel good about using it because it’s clean!

This is a lightweight liquid with a mild scent of citrus, this can be used daily. When applying to skin it goes on smooth and absorbs instantly. Works well to remove dead skin cells while also brightening and tightening my skin. My skin was hydrated, smooth, and had a clear complexion with a renewed look! I highly recommend buying!

I used this everyday for a few weeks and noticed little red bumps forming on my face. I thought that maybe I needed to give it more time, so I went from using it every day to once every other day. Long story short, it still continued to break me out. My friend suggested this to me but unfortunately it’s not for my skin type. My suggestion to anyone looking to buy any type of skin acid is to do a test patch, but also to really get to know your skin FIRST.My friend and I don’t actually have similar skin or similar issues and so I tried something that worked really well for her, but had a lower chance of working for me since my problems and skin are entirely different! Get to know your skin and always test patch! This product isn’t terrible, it just doesn’t work for ME but it will and obviously has worked for others.
I wanted to love this as it deff made my skin glow but after a week of using I can confidently say it made me break out all over my face and also left a sticky feeling :( maybe just my skin but fyi
This toner appears in so many Sephora Favourites kits...which is where I tried it. It’s okay, stings more than your average AHA toner.

I noticed brighter skin the day after using this before bed! I use it for chemical exfoliation only when I need it, so the bottle lasts me a long time. It helped my foundation go on smoother when moisturizing alone didn’t help.

I really like this stuff. I have been using the Olehenriksen Dark Spot Toner but I got this with my points and thought I’d try it out. This is more intense to me but it has been doing a good job of keeping my skin under control - I have less breakouts. I use it at night. I find that it almost gets foamy when applying it, which I love. It leaves a residue on your skin though and I find sometimes my face is a bit dry in the morning after I cleanse so I might not use this every night. Both are great but if you want something more gentle, I would suggest the Olehenriksen.
