My skin burns after using this. I would not recommend anyone buying this product. I bought the from the Sephora store after reading reviews online but was totally surprised after I used this product. I used the product for 3-4 days before writing this review. And the burn feeling has been the same since day 1.
It’s a good everyday toner. I would buy it again but I think there might be better toners out there. It’s better than most toners that I’ve tried.

I love this product. As a healthcare professional who wears a mask for the entire day, I found myself getting clogged pores, breakouts, and a significant amount of texture on my jawline and around my mouth area - all despite washing my face as soon as I take off my mask, not wearing makeup, and changing my mask half way through the day. I noticed that these breakouts were quite difficult to manage.I use this product morning and night (but I skip it if I plan on using my retinol in the evening), and within a week I noticed my skin texture improving and acne marks fading. This product has saved my skin! Also, if you use this product (as with other AHAs, BHAs, and retinoids) PLEASE wear sunscreen. It will definitely increase your skin’s sensitivity to the sun.

On my second bottle & one bottle last a long time. I can tell a difference when I don’t use this. I notice the glow in the morning after I wash my face. I only use this at night rub two pumps on with a cotton round. Helps my dry skin in the winter, no flaky bits around my nose. If you have oily or combo skin I would not recommend using this during the day, only at night.

I love this product! Yes, it is slightly sticky but it goes away especially if you’re using other products on top of this. Yes, it does sting a little bit the first time you’re using it because it’s an AHA. Start slow by using it once or twice a week, building up to more frequent usage. I alternate between this and a soothing toner. I used to have bumpy, acne-prone skin but my skin texture has improved so much within a month, I don’t break out as much anymore and my acne scars are fading. Of course, I do combine this toner with Vitamin C and Niacinamide which help a lot too :)
great AHA Toner. My face is brighter and clearer. I got it as a sample at first and an very impressed with the price of the 500 mL bottle

I really loved this toner for the first 2-3 weeks! And then suddenly when I used it my face would get bright red, sensitive, and sting all night! I discontinued it for about a week, then patch tested on my cheek and the exact same reaction happened. Not sure why it started to irritate my skin but it’s really unfortunate since it’s quite pricey and did a good job.

I LOVE this product. I bought it thanks to Milabu, my favorite beauty blogger. It’s now a staple. It stings a bit at first my my skin has gotten used to it. My skin is starting to look brighter and acne scars/blemishes healing faster. It leaves a slightly tacky residue on the skin but it doesn’t bother me. My skin looks so much brighter and more even toned in just a few weeks. I use in in the AM and PM without any irritation or sensitivity. Must have!
Had breakouts with it, it was recommended by a Sephora skin specialist but did not work for me
I really love this toner. My face looks exfoliated and clearer after each use.

This toner is definitely OK! But for this price I would expect way more.. it doesn’t make any harm to my skin, but I don’t have any visable changes as well. There is many cheaper and better toners on the market, for example Ordinary Glycolic Toner, after which I have way better results. Will finish my bottle, but won’t be re-buying it.
I love this toner. It resurfaces the skin and gives you a glow. I like the tingling feeling.

review_title: Great AHA Toner for Daily Used!
review_text: Love this toner. I have noticed a big improvement in my skin and I am in my 2nd bottle.  I will be buying this toner again in the future.

review_title: Stay away if you have sensitive skin
review_text: When I first applied this with a cotton pad, I enjoyed it, the product felt nice. I had no problems with it. However, about three days later my entire face was covered in small bumps and had a rough texture to it. Nothing else in my routine had changed, so I know it was the product. It took me a month in order to get my skin back to where it was. If you have sensitive skin, I would not go near this product.

Love love love this toner. It feel so good when applied and really has improved my skin tone and skin. Marks left behind from sun damage and skin issues are disappearing and I’ve only been using it for three weeks. Great product not sure how I lived without it
This works just fine on my oily skin but I can’t stand the stickiness afterwards. So I use it, wait a few minutes, rinse with warm water, then apply the rest of my skincare.

This is a really nice toner that does what it claims to do. I love the well-pump it has for application, you just place a cotton pad over it and press down, usually one to two pumps is enough for me. I have been using this every morning and night for 3 weeks and the bottle is still more than three quarters full. It does not have a fragrance as listed under the Ren Clean Skincare label along with other things it does not have. It offers very gentle exfoliation on my dry/combination aging skin and even completely got rid of some tiny flesh colored bumps I was starting to get under my eyes, which surprisingly did not irritate the surrounding eye area. My skin does feel a little bit sticky after application, but nothing too bothersome. It really gets rid of any remaining dirt and dead skin cells after washing my face. I have also noticed an actual glow with continued use of this product. I have a lot of little dark hyperpigmentation spots from a deep laser resurfacing treatment I had a year ago and am trying out everything to see what works on them. I think this does make my skin more even toned, but I’m also currently using Korres wild rose Vitamin C oil and their moisturizers that claim to lighten dark spots. Either way, I will continue to buy this toner as I find it does not dry out my skin like other toners I have tried before and it makes my skin feel nice and look healthier.

OH MY GOD! this has helped my breakout and makes my hyperpigmentation slowly go away. Honestly, I was very skeptical about it and I was blown away by it. I love it and I can see it becoming my favorite toner.
I absolutely love this product. I wake up with glowy skin. My pores are smaller (almost non existent) and not redness. I have acne prone skin and redness but this product is honestly my holy grail.

review_title: good for my oily and dull skin
review_text: I got a sample size of this product with my beauty insider points and ended up going back to buy a full size. I have an oily skin and this toner definitely controls my oiliness and also over time, I noticed my skin being brighter and having a more fresh appearance. I can totally see the difference in my skin on the days I forget to use this toner. Try getting a sample size first since everyone’s skin is different.

I could not stand the smell of this product. I used it over several days and would dread toning my face after cleansing it. It did make my skin look nice but nothing any other normal smelling toner hasent already done for me. Avoid if your sensitive to smells!

I originally got this in a deluxe sample and noticed my skin being more even-toned and pores reduced. Also great for getting any more residual makeup off your face after washing. I have had people comment on my skin looking better and this was the only addition/change I’ve made in my routine after buying the big size. Love the bottle it comes in, too, with the top pump that you put your cotton ball on. Super legit stuff.

Love this toner! Great value for the amount you get, and always leaves my skin prepped and primed for moisturizer. I use it daily and have noticed pore shrinkage and fewer​ problems overall with breakouts.

review_title: Effective AHA toner but it stings!
review_text: I’m writing this review after using this toner for about 2 weeks. First- love love the results. I notice immediate difference in my skin next day. The texture is smoother and, yes, there is that glow! HOWEVER, this product STINGS!! Every time I’ve used it, it would sting my skin for about a minute. It doesn’t irritate my skin beyond the stinging, so I’ve been continuing use bc of its efficacy. If you don’t have sensitive skin, I would recommend ditching those watery first-step treatment essences for this product. For me, I’m continuing my hunt for an AHA product that is equally effective but doesn’t sting my skin!

review_title: Generous sample turned into my fav toner
review_text: I received a generous sample of this toner. Never heard of the brand before but free is free so I gave it a try. The first and second use it burned a little and I thought I was going to have to stop using it but my face was really glowing afterwards. I use it with Claude serum and origins (orange moisturizer) to me that’s the magic trio for beautiful skin. I normally get facials once a quarter but my new regime allows me to go on a little linger without a facial. Definitely worth giving it a try, if you have super sensitive skin you definitely need to do a patch test or use only 3 times a week.

absolutely wrecked my skin :( I was so excited to try but after 3 uses (I test patched on my hand/wrist before using on my face) my skin is the worst it’s ever looked... there are little red bumps all over my face and my skin is super irritated right now. I really hope my skin heals fast but this has been the only new product in my skincare routine & my skin isn’t even that sensitive...
Great toner. It has a nice smell and does leave the skin with a glow. Only downside is how sticky it feels I’m after yu use it, first time that happens to me while using a toner.

This toner is a GAME CHANGER.  The surface of my skin has been transformed...it’s smooth, radiant, and blemish free!  I only deducted on star because they discontinued the larger size which was a much better value.
Great product!  I got it in the monthly beauty box and like it so much, I am buying the larger size.  Makes my skin clean and glowy.

I knew I needed to incorporate a toner into my skincare regimen of cleansing and applying moisturizer and rose water spray so I did some research and I have combination skin with very few breakouts, typically only around that time of the month. I wanted something to make me glow because I love the look of glowy skin but I also wanted something to lighten some dark spots I had due to pimples. I came across this product and the price is worth it for me because its a good size and the fact that it is clean at Sephora also were pros for me. I have been using this for a week and my skin is definitely more brighter and glowing and I can see my dark spots lightening a bit. It is a bit astringent so it does sting while it dries but I usually add a serum and moisturizer after and it goes away.

A rep from Ren CS suggested this for me when I asked what they would recommend for exfoliating sensitive skin. It is great. It tingles but in a good way and it doesn’t over irritate my sensitive skin. I use this at night every two days or so after cleansing and follow up with the Evercalm mask that I sleep in. My sensitive skin is happy.

I had never used toner before, then one of the ladies at Sephora showed it to me and I decided to give it a try. I love it, I have been only using it for a few weeks and I think it has definitely helped my skin. Also it doesn’t smell bad which is a plus.
I’m really happy with this, so far. I’ve been using it for about 3 weeks and my skin feels great! I have really sensitive skin so I am really apprehensive about new products especially exfoliating.
I am a HUGE believer in exfoliation, and this product is gentle enough to use every day.  It has become a permanent part of my daily skin care routine.

I usually do not use products like these, but I love this tonic!  It smells great it’s a fresh citrus type scent.  I used it after I cleanse and it still removes leftover residue.  I would recommend this to anyone looking for a fresh finish!

This product has done wonders for me. It was recommended to me by a sephora employee and she said this will go great with my skin and I tried it in store and I loved it. You really have to make sure you have a good moisturizer with this product because it takes out all of the oils in your face.

Super soft skin!!! This product soaked onto a cotton swab and gently swept onto my face and neck every other day is the key for me. I love pairing my origins matte cream the one in the pink jar, with this it makes my skin so silky and smooth. Can’t recommend this product enough. Worked for my skin and I will definitely be repurchasing.

I was really hoping to like this toner but unfortunately I had to return it after like 2 weeks! The lady at Sephora recommended this to me and mentioned that this is targeted towards those with sensitive skin which I don’t have but thought I’d give it a try anyway. Using it, I did notice a glow which it says it should do and it was not drying at all. However, I did notice that it stung a little on application but not anything that I couldn’t handle. After about 2 weeks of use, I noticed light patches appearing around the mouth area which made me stop using the product. I have used AHA toners in the past and never experienced such a reaction so I ruled that out. I also used my normal routine with this product. I’m thinking that the citric ingredient in this product is what triggered the light spots.

I am very pleased with the results usage from this toner has given me however application does come across a little sticky. That took some getting used to. My hyperpigmentation is less noticeable and my skin looks dewy and youthful. I have been using this toner for two months or so. I definitely recommend.

I was a little nervous trying this product because I have very sensitive skin. Although my cheeks are little red after first use I didn’t have any other reactions. This product is great! It has really helped with smoothing out my skin tone and I have seen an improvement in my pore size. It also leaves the skin feeling soft and my moisturizer goes on so smooth. My skin has improved in brightness, skin texture and tone since I started using this and it’s going to part of my skin routine from now.

What I hate most about skincare is the waiting game for many products. Consistently using something and not exactly seeing any difference even after weeks of using something is tiring. But this, this I could tell a difference the first time after I used it! I’ve never been one to really believe in toners but this just changed all that. I use it in the morning after cleansing and I use a glow recipe + kiehls serums after and my skin has never looked so glowy! Even hours after applying the rest of my routine I still feel like my skin is noticeably retaining the glow. Very happy and will continue to use and recommend!

review_title: burned my skin! not for sensitive skin.
review_text: I have dry, sensitive acne prone skin and I wanted a really good toner to help even my skin tone out and to plump it up for a more youthful looking skin. When I first used it it did tingle my skin which I knew was going to happen and I loved how my skin felt after my skin absorbed the product but with continued use it started to burn my skin and make my skin even more dry and worse around my acne prone areas. I then started to break out with little baby white heads all over my acne prone areas, (my chin, around my mouth) I stopped using the tonic and sadly had to return it to the store. It did not help my skin whatsoever but I think it is because of Glyceryl Caprylate that my skin did not agree with.
my mine is blown by this product I just bought my second bottle, it helps to fade dark spots and I have noticed my pores getting smaller in just 2 weeks of using this product.

I’m on my 3rd bottle of this toner and I’m so happy they have the 16.9 oz bottle for only $10 more! This is seriously the best toner ever. It’s taken away so much of the texture on my skin and leaves me glowing. When I’ve run out, I’ve tried other toners and nothing compares to the REN one. It just makes my skin look and feel so much younger looking, which is something I have to worry about as I approach my mid-30’s. Highly recommend!

I am so in love with this product. I went for a full make over and the MUA used this on me and OMG it was super good I had to buy it. I had the make over on 23 February and today it’s 12 March and I’m still loving it. I hope I knew about this earlier. This product is a gem.
Wow my skin looks so nice after only using this a few days. I gave it 4 stars because it does burn a little after use but I do have sensitive skin as well. My skin looks flawless and fresh!

While I do like this product due to it having healthier/cleaner ingredients and the smell of citrus is very upflifting. It does what it’s suppose to do. The only downside to this product is it’s very tacky! Feels nice going on, but afterwards my face feels like it has a brown sugar glaze mask on, and continued to feel like that even after a moisturizer.

This is probably my favourite skincare product. It tingles the first few times, but after that it’s no problem at all. I feel like this product has played a pretty big role in clearing up my skin. review_title: AHA daily tonic + NIGHTTIME Facial = Glowing Skin
review_text: Right now my favorite beauty product. Too heavy to wear in the morning but good to use after an evening face scrub followed by the REN nighttime facial. Wow this combo works miracles as you sleep! You wake up glowing. Can’t rave enough about them!
Game changing product for my face! Over the course of a month, with 3x week usage, my face was smoother, less red, and yes, I feel like it glows!

HOLY SHMOKES!!! THIS GLOW TONIC IS AMAZING!! I recommend it for sensitive skin too!! And the best part is that the “glow” part is  actually achievable with this toner!! I also love the packaging for the pump❤️totes recommend!!

I LOVE my Hourglass illuminating powder and unfortunately my skin is SO bright after just 2 days of using this toner that I can’t use my powder anymore! I can’t recommend this enough.

Skin glowed and makeup went on well AFTER I washed the product off. Unfortunately this left a sticky film all over my face and neck resulting in me having to wash my face again. I only saw one other review that mentioned the sticky feeling which is surprising. I will be returning the product.

I loved this toner when I first bought it. I have combination skin and I thought I had found the perfect toner. For the first few weeks I used it as the directions say to and everything was fine. But the longer I use it (my bottle is a little below half full) the more it stings. And the stinging takes FOREVER to go away. If your skin is sensitive, be easy with the product. Other than that, for the price you get a good amount of product. The little spout you have to push down is SO annoying, just bad design..It either doesn’t work or it sprays the product everywhere. Overall there are a few things to consider before spending your money but this product helped the texture of my skin, it also brings color and life to my skin as soon as I apply it. With a good serum on top the results are great ☺️

I definitely feel that this has been doing its’ job. I got a deluxe sample that I have been using. I do not have sensitive skin but this definitely can burn if I rub with a cotton pad or use twice a day. I’ve been using it in a gentler manner, patting my face with a cotton pad instead of rubbing it, which helps. I use this several times a week but daily or twice daily can be too much for my skin. I wanted to rate this 3 stars but I must say, I have seen improvement in my skin and it does warn that it can irritate. For me, it just can burn a little bit if I use it to often or harshly but I haven’t had lingering side effects after the fact. I would not recommend this at ALL if you have the slightest of sensitive skin or any blemishes or acne or have freshly gotten any part of your face waxed. THIS WILL BURN. Use with caution, and as another person commented, maybe try a patch test first. I will definitely continue to use the deluxe sample that I got but I’m not positive that this is something I would actually purchase as there is another toner I really like that that doesn’t feel so harsh on my skin...although I don’t think the other has made such a difference on improving the brightness and texture of my skin!
Great product! It made me glowy. Only thing I don’t like is, it has this sticky feel for the longest time until it fully absorbs and dry.
Works well but smells too strong with a fake citrus/orangey smell.

review_title: Sticky but still giving it a shot
review_text: I received a deluxe sample of this product with a promo code for my online order. I was really looking forward to trying it as I have textured cheeks and am always looking for products to help with that. I really like the REN brand (animal cruelty free) and have used some of their products in the past. I also really like the idea of an AHA toner that can be used both morning and night. With that being said, I have used the product in the morning for the past week with little results. The product definitely leaves my skin feeling sticky, even after applying my moisturizer on afterwards. My face feels heavy, as if the other products are just sitting on top of my skin, not sinking in because of the stickiness of the toner. Overall, I will continue using it to see if the results improve but I think I will try rinsing it off after a minute to get rid of the sticky feeling. I would suggest trying it for yourself to see if it works for you but only if you can get a sample. Not worth the money for me.

I am super obsessed with this toner!!! My skin is luminous and my pores have become nonexistent! I have never gotten so many compliments on my skin. I lead a very busy lifestyle so this fits into my routine with no problem. This is such an effortless way to exfoliate. I can’t wait to try more REN products to see what other magic I can find!

I’m so impressed, I never leave reviews for skincare cuz they’re either bad or nothing special but this is honestly a great toner. review_title: First Sleep Mask I have liked!!!
review_text: Just checked the price and it’s a seems on par as other masks for cost: However the results are more than on par effective and noticeable!! review_title: WISH I COULD BUY PRODUCTS SEPARATELY
review_text: Pros: I have very dry and flaky skin around my nose/chin area to the point I can’t wear foundation too long before it starts to separate and flake off around my nose/chin area. I have tried many different night moisturizers/masks with no luck. When I saw this product on Sephora with all the great reviews, I decided to give it a try and I’m happy I did. I can now wear foundation throughout the day and feel confident it will actually last. Cons: Now the ONLY con and reason I will probably never purchase again, is because they don’t make it available to purchase separately. When the product arrived, I received so much more of the water cream mask than the cooling gel. I tried so hard to be frugal with the gel and generous with the mask, but I still ended up with so much cream mask left over. For the price, I don’t think I can keep buying every couple of weeks just for the gel and wasting all the left over cream product. BTW: I noticed some people saying it doesn’t give them the hydration needed. Since my face is extremely dry/flaky/sensitive, I apply a layer of ’Aquaphor: Advanced Therapy’ before before this 2 step mask and every night time routine I’ve had the last year. It has helped my skin resist drying from a fan or a/c blowing at night, and helps me absorb this product slower throughout the night(my skin will literally inhale any product up within a couple hours). Hope this helps.
Just apply a thin layer overnight, and my skin becomes so smooth and hydrating in the morning!

review_title: Didn’t work for my acne prone / sensitive skin
review_text: Oh how I wanted to love this. Truthfully, I’ve never found a product from Fresh that works for my acne prone, sensitive skin. But I wanted this to work. review_title: Good if hydration is your goal
review_text: TLDR: good for hydration, but not much elseI love using sleep masks- I find them relaxing before bed and love my skin when I wake up the next day. That said, this sleep mask works if hydration is your only goal.I tried the Fresh Rose Deep Hydration Sleeping Mask multiple days over 3 weeks. The container and directions give no hint for how much to apply, so I varied the amounts to try to achieve a glowing complexion. Since I already use a hyaluronic serum, this mask felt similar. My skin felt “bouncy”, like in a super hydrated way, for over 24 hours after using the mask. However, I didn’t wake up with dewy/glowing skin, which was disappointing.Application: I applied the mask after cleansing. Sometimes that was actually washing my face and other times it was wiping micellar water. Unless I also physically exfoliated, this mask would feel sticky/tacky. Physical exfoliation immediately prior to applying helped it go on smoothly. Bonus: Since there is a lot of product and I wasn’t getting much beyond hydration on my face, I decided to test it out on other body parts. I tried it on some very cellulite-y areas and I feel like there is a small (albeit temporary) improvement in smoothing, perhaps due to the increased hydration. Your mileage may vary! Rating: 3/5, knocking a star off for price point/only improving hydration and one for container issues*I received this product complimentary for testing purposes in exchange for my honest review.

review_title: A true luxury in a bottle!
review_text: Not only is the packaging super luxurious but this is also a #cleanatsephora product! It’s made with 95% naturally-derived ingredients, such as Ouessant Island Black Honey and 3 new powerful honeys from protected islands and biospheres. The scent is heavenly and not overpowering. This has the richness of an oil, the freshness of a Toner and has the power of a serum. Achieving a radiant, hydrated and plumped skin is easy with this! No wonder this is sold every 26 seconds!

This is a lovely skincare product. The packaging is sturdy, beautiful, and the dropper is ideal for this type of serum. The product itself is a unique texture- it feels slippery like an oil but also watery. It absorbs very quickly into the skin and does not leave you feeling greasy or oily, but glowing and nourished. It can be used in the a.m. or p.m., though I find myself using it more at night, especially after applying retinol. My skin has had no negative reactions to this product. All of that said, I cannot give it 5/5 stars because I can’t help but feel that this product is overpriced. Of course, it’s marketed by a “luxury“ brand, but I can tell that some of this is just upselling to make money. The package is lovely but made to look like gold and look luxurious. The product itself is very highly fragranced and smells more like a perfume than a skincare product. I’m not sure if the little gold beads suspended in the product truly serve a purpose or if they exist mainly to look fancy. They make this seem like it’s a very special product because the honey comes from specific bee colonies in an exotic location (I mean, come on....and the honey is far down on the ingredient list. There is more alcohol in this product than honey or propolis). I’d purchase this product at a more modest price but wouldn’t repurchase at current full price.

review_title: Glow all summer long with Abeille Royale oil !!

It has a luxurious scent which may be too strong for some but I liked the spa like product scent it has as it is like aromatherapy. The product helped hydrate and give my skin a nice glow. After two weeks of use my skin felt more radiant and rejuvenated. My skin is dry so I needed a product like this , it also worked well as a base for my make up.The bottle is nicely designed to fit in your bag to take on the go and I liked that it is made of 95 percent naturally derived ingredients. It keeps up with Guerlain’s high quality products and brand.

I often try skincare products that I like (or even dislike). It’s rarer for me to find a product I love, never mind one that I love this much in every way. I don’t put much stock in the cost of an item or it’s advertising, the proof is in the pudding, as they say. The Guerlain Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil has a mighty tasty pudding.Putting aside the food analogy, this stuff is fantastic. I’ve always had combination skin with oilier areas on my nose and recently I discovered how amazing oil can be, but many brands get oil wrong. Youth Watery Oil is a fantastic option for those who don’t want an oily oil. It may sound weird, but the ‘Watery’ texture of this oil is just so pleasant to apply and doesn’t feel like an oil at all. It absorbs quickly, leaves behind no oily residue and immediately begins it’s work on skin. Because it absorbs basically flawlessly, it’s perfect for morning and night.I find many brands have cloying, overdone or very ‘fake’ scents, but this oil smells divine. It’s strong, but not overdone and really pleasant. I was worried it would smell like honey (a scent I don’t love), but it actually smells like a lovely expensive ladies perfume.Speaking of expensive, the branding is spot on here. Everything from the outer carton to the bottle itself feels super luxe and really involves you in the experience, telling you about their bees and where their ingredients come from.The most important thing for skincare is that it works. The Youth Watery Oil is fantastic. No breakouts when switching and I saw an immediate improvement in my skin. The texture tone and softness level was obviously improved from first application. It takes a while to see wrinkle reduction, but I’d use this oil regardless, as the improvement in the look of my skin was so intense.When it comes to Guerlain’s Abeille Royale Youth Watery Oil I can easily recommend it and I don’t hesitate to say that it’s probably my favourite skincare product of all time!

This product is very luxurious; from its sleek bottle with a faux gold pipette, to its extravagant price.I used this daily, consistently, both in the morning and nighttime and while it fails to deliver on its “plumping” promise, it does a great job as a rich and hydrating toner. It has a pleasant fragrance and is not sticky or difficult to work into the skin. It also boasts a 95% natural ingredient list, which also includes honey. The price point may not be accessible but all, but perhaps that’s the purpose of luxury beauty.

The beautiful packaging and subtle yet full-bodied  scent are definitely on brand with this luxury line. This oil comes in a glass bottle with a gold coated plastic top built with a pipette to dispense the product, so you are less likely to waste any of the oil by trying to pour it or contaminate the remaining oil with your hands by applying straight from the bottle. So overall very cute, luxe packaging.Now to the actual product… the Queen bee, itself. The good folks over Guerlain took a page from 2016 beauty obsession with honey and took it a step further. They claim to have taken a repairing black honey along with three unnamed island honeys to formulate the microdrops sitting at the bottom of the oil. So you shake the closed bottle to somewhat disperse them before applying the product. A shake or two will do but don’t be alarmed if you see bubbles when shaking vigorously. Of course you can read the ingredient list but the most recognizable ingredients of this oil to help describe its consistency are oil, water and alcohol. In my opinion, it feels as if the water is a “carrier” of the oil & microbeads of honey and the alcohol is included to dissipate the water. It’s a pretty cool concept which allows the oil mixture (which you assume to be heavier in consistency)to remain lightweight. The lightweight formula allows the product to really absorb into the skin and leave it feeling supple & moisturized.Now, the product claims to plump the skin. Be clear it doesn’t artificially “plump” the skin as most products usually advertised as “plumping”— it hydrates deeply instead & provides a luminous quality to the skinOver, I like this product. I’m interest to see how it effects/improves my skin long term to really determine if it’s worth that kind of Guerlain coin (no shadé, Guerlain)… but for a preliminary review I am very impressed with its lightweight hydrating capabilities & so far think it’s perfect for a moisturizing base to add to your regimen.

I’m going to be honest with y’all. I’m no stranger when it comes to applying acids on my face as I have been implementing it into my skincare regimen for years now. For some background: I have oily/combo skin, acne prone, and I struggle w/ hyperpigmentation. I was hesitant on applying this peel because not only is glycolic acid such a strong chemical exfoliant (AHA) itself, but it’s also in a high concentration to give you this “glow peel” effect. By saying this, glycolic acid has the capability of irritating your skin (especially sensitive skin) due to its small molecular size that allows it to deeply penetrate your skin. Here is my review:The product in the pad smelled quite strong, which is expected for a product like this. I love how easy and convient it was to apply this product on my face due to the way the pad is designed. This product did sting my face upon the initial touch but it went away after a few minutes. I went about my normal routine and made sure to apply  hydrating moisturizer on top to prevent irritation. When I woke up in the morning, my skin felt great and was smooth to the touch. However, the day after was a different story. My face was covered in acne and irritated pimples, which was something new to me considering I don’t have sensitive skin. I didn’t change any part of my skin routine besides this product and made sure I was meticulous about the compatibility of each product. I was hoping it would go away after a few days but to no avail. Now I have to repair my skin barrier due to the damage this has caused. So needless to say, everyone’s experience is going to be different so I definitely recommend spot checking first and gradually introduce gentler acids in your routine before using this to reap maximum benefits and prevent unnecessary breakouts.

First off, I’m giving this product five stars because it is exactly what it promises to be. It is very moisturizing and had a nearly immediate (noticeable the morning after the first use) calming effect on my skin. My skin is overall “normal“, but I have unfortunate patched of oiliness as well as red itchy dryness, so it can be difficult to find products that are gentle and effective for both issues. I was skeptical at first because an overnight moisturizing mask seemed a bit intense, and I was concerned that I’d wake up covered in greasy whiteheads. I was very pleasantly surprised when instead I awoke to very soft, supple, calm skin. The surprisingly lightweight formula left my usually patchy/red chin and cheeks smooth and even toned, while my typically oily “T-zone“ felt like it had been recently cleansed. I’m not sure which of the ingredients is responsible for this, but I suspect the combination of antioxidants and soothing honey  didn’t hurt. I do have a bit of advice for other people who sleep on their stomach or side like I do: I suggest applying the mask about half an hour before getting into bed so that it can really sink in before inevitably wiping your face on the pillow. This mask does not dry up like a traditional clay mask, but feels more like a very lightweight layer of lotion. Honestly, I was initially worried that the mask would feel heavy or “wet“ as I went about my nighttime routine and tried to fall asleep, but once it was applied, I couldn’t even tell it was there unless I touched my face. review_title: Looks & smells pretty but that’s about it
review_text: It smells great and looks pretty but as far as long lasting moisture for your lips I would say it’s not worth the money. I get more moisture for my lips from carmex. Also don’t lo e how sticky it is for a night treatment. Buy Laneige instead, a few bucks less and long lasting moisturizer.

I had really chapped and dry lips. I also live in a very cold and dry climate. I have been using this lip mask for over a month now. It’s been working so well. My lips are fully healed and no more chapping. I got a mini sized one and it lasts forever. Really feels like bottomless.

I looooooove this. It’s very soothing. I was skeptical about the lip plumping effect but it really works. I had dry lips so put a bunch on just because it felt nice, the next morning my lips were visibly plumper. Definitely going to buy again!

This lip mask is very glossy and long lasting Often my lip balms disappear on my lips quickly but this one lasts. It is nourishing and good to put on your lips before bed. A little also goes a long way you do not need a lot to get the job done which helps offset the price. Overall, I’m glad I have a deep nourishing mask to put on whenever I need a boost.

I’ll be honest...... I bought this solely for the packaging. The product itself is mediocre. It’s very sticky for a balm but I will say I lightly tap it with my finger once and it’s enough for my lips. Very little goes a long way in terms of covering your lips but I feel as far as hydration goes it’s not the best. Feels more like Vaseline doesn’t seem to absorb kind of just sits there. Probably really good in the winter I’d imagine as it would be a nice barrier from the wind I suppose

review_title: A wonderful and reasonable luxury before bedtime
review_text: While I don’t think anyone *needs* a pricey lip mask, since Vaseline/Aquaphor likely does just fine, I find lip masks to be a reasonable luxury just before bed. This one is my favorite so far, as compared to the Laneige one and the Nooni Apple Butter lip mask. The Laneige is a light, whipped texture and it’s my second place. The Nooni one is much more solid. The Kissu Lip Mask is a jelly, but it’s nice and thick and I wake up with plump and moisturized lips. I don’t think any lip mask is a cure-all, but it’s a nice, luxurious addition to lip care. In the evenings I apply my moisturizer to my lips and then seal it in with this mask. It’s a lovely indulgence that is also effective.
I love this stuff, before I started using this every night, I couldn’t get smooth lips no matter how much I used lip scrub and balm. Now this is the only lip product I use.
I am a lip mask fanatic, and this is hands down the most moisturizing lip mask out there. Putting it on every night feels like an indulgent treat.
This lip mask is everything! I use this every night, and it does wonders for my forever-dry lips. Everyone needs this!
Love it. It reminds me of this 90s lip balm. It’s thick and the smell. Yum.
Really lovely product. I have a bad habit of chewing my lips, especially when they are chapped (which as ALWAYS). I will apply this at night and the next day my lips will look much healthier.

Lip mask doesn’t really do anything dries out quick and not nourish or moisture lips.I love other products from the line but this one definitely did not do anything with my lips.I was looking for a good effect since brand has other good products.
This stuff changed my lips for the better. I use a little when I need it and more for over night. I wake up moisturized and plump. Love this stuff!

I’ve used the lip mask for a while now and I’m not disappointed after months of continuous use my lips look plumper and feel softer. I normally apply it overnight and use a decent amount I massage it into my lips I don’t just set it on top overall love the product and will continue to repurchase it along with my other Tatcha products
Does nothing basically.  Didn’t particularly moisturize, definitely didn’t plump, and the statement that this isn’t sticky is false.  The Laneige Lip Sleeping mask is WAY better by leaps and bounds.

At first I was like “I don’t need a lip mask“ but I was quarantine stress shopping, so I got this. turns out I love it! This has a luxurious texture, nice faint scent, and makes my lips feel all shiny and soft when I wake up in the morning! A little goes a LONG way so I know it will last a really long time.

review_title: Works wonders for dry and cracked lips!!
review_text: I put this on my lips with the little spatula 2-3 times a week before bed and in the morning they do feel a LOT softer and smoother! Along with using a lip scrub or lip scrubber it works magic. Besides being a lip mask, it’s very clear and shiny and could be worn alone as a gloss, not to mention the texture is very slick; like Vaseline or lip oil.
Not a fan. I love the smell and look of the jar. However every time I put it on my lips would dry out!  Waking up with flaking lips was not what I had in mind with this purchase
feels nice .I have used this item three times now .I am glad I purchased this item.i use another of their skincare

My lips were a MESS when I went in the store looking for something to fix them. Dry, flaking, cracked (from the cold weather, and I had just gotten filler). The cast member suggested this, I started using it and my lips were healed within 48 hours. Love this stuff!!

Product honestly does not work well. I’ve used it for about a month and even compared it with Laneige or regular vaseline and the Vaseline worked best among the 3... I was really sad about it tho because I actually wanted to like this product and find something that would help keep my lips feel hydrated the whole day after leaving it on the whole night... and as soon as it gets washed off in the morning when I shower... it only take about 2-3 hours before my lips literally feel flaky again. With that said I don’t think it’s worth the money or even trying...
Truly the best lip mask out there!  It softens your lips and gives them a fresh and hydrated look.  Love to use before bed or during my morning skin routine before putting on makeup.

review_title: I REALLY WANTED TO LIKE THIS
review_text: I LOVE tatcha. I have most of the tatcha products. I just really didn’t like this lip mask... It goes on very smooth and has a nice thick consistency but when it dries, it leaves the lips feeling cracked and dry too. Definitely won’t be purchasing again.
Returned. Horrible product. Did not moisturize at all :-(

review_title: Don’t buy unless you like dry lips
review_text: Totally drying! The longer I used it, the dryer my lips became! Not worth the money. Tatcha products are SO hit or miss. Fortunately Sephora has an awesone return policy!
I love his lip mask. I have dry lips and this is just what I needed. This can also be worn under the sephora lip stain.

It’s an ok product. NO scent although I kind of expecting it to have a peach scent since in their description it said it’s made from peach extract. It’s sticky but it’s moisturizing. You’d definitely want to use it before sleeping because I find it pretty sticky to have it under lipstick. LITTLE goes a long way.
I love it so much! Last so long on my lips, and it’s so hydrating!

review_title: Love this product, not the LANEIGE
review_text: I love this one 1000x better than the LANEIGE one, with this one my lips feel plump the next day. Doesn’t heal your lips if you have dry skin on them, I suggest a lip scrub first then this product.

If you need the ultimate hydration for your lips you need to buy this. You will notice a difference within the first 2-3 days of using it. My lips were so dry and burning before using this because, of the weather here. This was the only thing that would soothe them. It provides hydration and makes your lips look plump and healthy. I highly highly recommend if you want that extra hydration or just more fuller lips in general. You use such a small amount each night that I do believe it is worth the price. The scent is so settle and soothing. Love love love this product!
I am surprised by the negative reviews. It’s the best lip make available!
Feels so great!!!  I use it nightly as directed and I think it has helped improve the overall smoothness of my lips (they seem to have less lines)!  A little goes a long way.
I love this mask so much! I use this every night before bed but honestly you can use this throughout the day too and it will hydrate your lips all day!
i do not think this product was good or helpful. the consistency was weird and it was very sticky and not moisturizing. i threw it out in all honesty. would not recommend
This product is ok, didn’t notice anything special after use.

I love this product, ever since I was little I would pick at my lips till they bleed, and they get so dry and patchy but this helps sooo much. Gives them moisture and after just 2 nights of using is I see a noticeable difference

review_title: a must buy product, lifesaver for me!!
review_text: being a flight attendant while being constantly in recycled dry air in an airplane my skin & especially my lips suffer from dryness,cracking and flaking. I have tried every lip mask/balm/serum/treatment/gloss/scrub and honestly nothing works. this lip mask is the only thing that was able to keep my lips from going dry/chapped & flaky to moisturized and plump. I highly recommend for anyone who has a similar issue. a little goes a long way.

review_title: Super treat for lips at night!
review_text: Feels so good going on. Lasts overnight. My lips are much better this winter since using this product.
This product dried out my lips badly. I plan on returning.
This isn’t a bad product. It does moisturize your lips but an hour later you need it again.

Ahhhhhhh-maze-ing! This product was worth every cent. It’s super luxurious and a little goes a long way! I LOVE the mini spatula, it helps to conserve product by keeping it away from absorbing into fingers. There really seemed to be no scent. I imagined a stronger peach scent but wasn’t disappointed because the results were fantastic. I woke up to buttery soft lips. The condition of my lips have improved overall and I feel like I am applying less balm throughout the day. I consistently use matte lip paints so I need sometime to revitalize my lips daily. This does the trick. I must say that this product to me was much better than the competition, even though everybody swears by the “other” it pales in comparison to tatcha. This lip mask is very emoliente and luxurious. I highly recommend!

I love Tatcha products but this lip mask was a fail for me.  Left my lips dry and peeling for a few days.  At first I thought it was something else I waited a few days tried it again and realized it was this lip product. Not for me sadly I returned.
Cute package with little spoon but that’s about it.  Left my lips super dry!  It’s very gooey and I thought I would try it overnight.  Nope.  Dry lips.
Not my favorite it’s thick but doesn’t last or work for my lips

I’m unsure of how I feel about this product. The first dip in and application was lovely. Such a luxurious consistency and a beautiful feel on the lips. The issue I’m having is that I feel it left my lips dry and reapplying didn’t give them extra moisture. For the price I don’t think I would repurchase.

While I do like this new formula, it’s still nowhere near as good as the original, despite an added hydrating ingredient (peach extract). With this one, the moisturizing effect lasts only a few hours, whereas the original lasts all day for me. I had bought 2, this go-around, but sadly one of them went back. If you haven’t tried the original and find the Laneige one does nothing for you (like me), definitely give it a shot, though.

This product was nice but for the price and for how little I don’t think it is worth it, I feel using the spatula makes you pull out more product than needed. I returned it not a fan and probably won’t re purchase

This is the first lip mask that I honestly feel actually retains moisture. I’ve tried the Laneige mask, the caudalie mask, and many others. Most of them feel great while wearing but either don’t improve the lips post-wear or leave a film that dries down. I’ve been using this lip mask nightly for 5 nights now and I see a noticeable difference in hydration levels and lip texture. This is the only lip mask that I will recommend going forward. I wish it existed before I spent +$200.00 on other masks, but I will settle for it existing now.

not what I wanted...was hoping for a product that left my lips super moisturized the next morning.  I’d say they feel on the verge of  dehydrated and I immediately put more on so they don’t become dry and chapped. Seems like an expensive Vaseline

I purchased this item at the recommendation of a very knowledgeable Beauty Specialist at my local store. I was (I did say was) suffering from severe lip chapping due to a facial allergic reaction. He offered several products encouraging me to try on each before I decided on Tatcha. Tatcha was my product of choice given it didn’t irritate my lips, its smoothness going on, the fact it didn’t immediately dry out, the shine wasn’t overbearing and it is a clean item. The Kissu Lip Mask stayed in place - after leaving the store - until eating many hours later. While the product is a nightly mask I have worn it doing the day. As to cost, a little goes a long ways and as previously stated it does the job while staying on your lips. The packaging is very adorable. I especially appreciate the glass jaw opposed to a tube. I pray this review helps.

I first NEVER got a spoon with mine... I literally pucker my lips or finger it out. Its EXTREMELY sticky. Smells pretty decent, not as peachy as I expected I guess. I’m confused over people’s reviews, however I’m assuming they had an old formula and its changed therefore disappointed others. I hate things that make my lips look pinker than they are, so I only wear this at night. I put it on and it’s actually the only gloss that DOES stay on all night. I dont wake up with dry or cracked lips. Would I buy again? No...I found a better product to be honest. I also dont have issues opening the pot. To each their own I guess.
Really cute pacakging but for the price laneige is way more worth it ! Its an average lip gloss I use it day or night because its shiny it give you cute lips
I really wanted to add this product to my go-to’s but it was completely unjustified for the price. It does nothing for you. Laneige lip sleeping mask is 100x better at making my lips soft and full
Not happy with it, drys out my lips. Don’t waste your money

review_title: Not as good as they say ...
review_text: I am here to report that I am not a fan. I’ve recently been introduced to Tatcha and just love the products I do own but this is a flop. Packaging wise, I hate that the spatula is just loose. There’s no spot to hold it or magnet to keep it attached. The first few minutes this lip mask seemed great but now my lips are worse than ever. Back to the store it goes!
it’s amazing!! I used to use Laneige, but this is better. Would recommend.

The new formulation of this is terrible. It’s very sticky and tacky and doesn’t make my lips feel moisturized or nourished at all. The original formula was a dream so I was excited when I saw this pop up again. The new stuff is a no. I will be returning what I purchased.
this leaves my lips so soft and plump. worth every penny!
Not very moisturizing. My $5 lip balm is more moisturizing than this. Also, the lip mask made my lips peel and feel raw.

I gave this five stars for a few reasons. First reason being that it feels amazing and doesn’t burn my very chapped lips. Second, they feel a little fuller after sleeping with it on my first night trying it. Ill come add more info once I’ve been using it.

Not sure what everyone is complaining about? I think this is a really great lip treatment! I used my toothbrush to exfoliate my lips and then slapped this bad boy on and it feels so moisturizing! Its a winner for me.

This stuff is amazing!! I have HORRIBLE chapped lips, especially in the winter, and I have yet to find a chapstick that does anything for them. I use this stuff morning and night and within two days my lips were no longer chapped. Definitely worth it! Beware though- it has a somewhat heavy gel like texture so if that’s something that would be bothersome, definitely consider a different product.

Received in the mail today and excitedly slapped it on my very sad, dry lips. Very sad to report that this lip mask is so disappointing. It’s possibly my imagination, but lips are even more dry and are now peeling. I am going to give it another chance but I don’t think this is something I’ll be reaching for. Typical of Tatcha, packaging is gorgeous and the product is aesthetic appealing. I’ll likely stick to my Jouer lip enhancer.

Unfortunately when Tatcha decided to reintroduce this product they also messed with the formula, adding an oil to supposedly make it more moisturizing. Well, I had the opportunity to compare them side by side and all they did was make it stickier and LESS moisturizing. The old mask melted on contact with your liips; it was like a sheet mask for the lips. This new version is much thicker and sits on top of the lips rather than sinking in. It pains me to say it but Tatcha took an exquisite  product and turned it into an average lip mask.
Incredible formula, this product leaves your lips hydrated for hours on end. Just a little goes a long way and after contact you still have the formula stay in your lips. Worth every penny
i have combo skin & i got the whole combo pack of this like & it completely broke me out. v annoying cus i have a whole mini tube left. gonna use it as a spot treatment! fingers crossed

review_title: did not give me long lasting relief + broke me out
review_text: i had lots of inflammation and swelling on my face from allergies and eczema. Although this felt good - my face still felt dry after half an hour and it started to break me out quite a lot = La roche posey ended up fixing my face lolgood product but be careful if u have dry and sensitive pimple prone skin

I got a sample of this I’m one of the monthly sample bags they sometimes give out at sephora and this cream was too good, I had to get it even though I still have lots of my usual moisturizer. I use the barrier + from skin fix right now. This tiger grass cream is thicker and soothes my dry/sensitive skin. It is a small amount but you really don’t need much.

I had a sample size & This worked amazing for me, but i noticed I started breaking out and this is the only thing I changed in my skincare routine. Really sad cause I enjoyed this I have rosacea & this helped a lot! Idk why they have to have essential oils in here cause that’s probably the cause of breakouts, if they removed those I think the formula would be perfect.

This is a review for those who have extremely dry skin like me. I’m a long time Ceramidin user, but wanted to try this as it’s got niacinamide and could save me a serum step. I used it for 3 weeks - no problems with sensitivity from the lavender, and my skin liked it. It’s lovely to use. However my skin tends to flake if not heavily moisturized, and I found that I needed to use about 50% more of this than Ceramidin to get the same level of control over my dry skin. So it’s very nice and if my skin were less dry I’d definitely continue use, but since I’m going through this faster than Ceramidin it’s more cost effective to me to stick with that one.

I ordered a DrunkElephant moisturizer and this was a free sample with the purchase. I’m not going back to DE, this stuff is incredible! It feels so good on my skin, which has been prone to dry spots. It’s thick and rich and smells amazing. Ordering full tube.
Soothing for sensitive redness prone skin. This helped my skin more than stuff prescribed by my dermatologist. Worth a try!

I have an issue where I lick my lips too much. This in result made the corners of my mouth very dry, red, and would crack. It was painful sometimes. This is the only product I have used that actually healed the redness and keeps the area around my mouth hydrated! I’ve been using this for a little over 6 months and I won’t go back to any other product. For reference I use this every night around my lips.

Really good, skin felt soft, there was a bit of glow from this moisturizer but not a lot. I didn’t see any help with redness really. I used it for about 6 months. There is a scent but that doesn’t bother me at all, just to note for anyone who doesn’t like fragrance. I would repurchase but I love trying different moisturizers so I never stick with one.
Just finished a sample tube. I wanted to love it for my rosacea, put it on twice a day. Sadly no improvement in my redness after a week or two :( felt nice but that’s about it

Great cream to have on hand when your skin is going through something. I have very sensitive skin, and from time to time decide to get adventurous and try new products. Sometimes this works out fine, and other times is disastrous! This cream is my rescue cream for when things veer off into a ditch. Super calming and soothing, and very gentle. I highly recommend keeping some in your arsenal.
Dr. Jart, why do you do this to me?? I like the cream, but once I found out they test on animals, I knew I had to find an alternative.

I have sensitive and acne prone skin. Used at night and I had breakouts immediately the next morning. I stopped using for a few nights and breakouts cleared, tried it again and breakouts the next morning again. I was hoping there was an adjustment period for my skin but I fear this makes things worse for me. It feels nice on the skin but not worth the risk. Maybe I’ll try in combo with tretinoin

I ordered my hundredth tube during the Rouge sale and I can’t explain how happy I am about the new packaging!! The old one would chip off and I would have white paint specs all over my face. So annoying! It’s a great change and I’m thrilled! Oh and the product is the bee’s knees for sensitive red prone skin.

So I can’t even put into words what wonders this cream has done for my skin! The tiger grass cream has completely revitalized it in every sense. I have suffered from continual breakouts of facial psoriasis, and I can honestly say (without a doubt) out of the ~MANY~ products I’ve tried over the years, this cream by Dr. Jart is hands down the very best! Within a matter of just a couple weeks, my skin has totally healed where the breakout localized. I would also suffer from some occasional dry patches throughout my beard just below my mouth wherein using this cream worked awesome — it’s balm-like texture is easily distributed through even the coarsest of mains.Truly impressed and will never buy anything else to treat my skin going forward.

Thought this would be good since I have rosacea and sensitive skin but it’s certainly not for sensitive skin. Broke me out and actually caused redness, coming from a person who has used a lot of beauty products this is definitely a big no if your skin is even somewhat sensitive, it’s also pretty greasy and doesn’t absorb at all, skip it!!

I recently dabbled on retinol and had a bad reaction from it. I applied retinol 3 nights in a row and had the worst skin reaction. My skin was very dry, flaky, itchy. It looked like I had hives, thanks to this cream it relieved the dryness and calmed down the aftereffects of retinol. It’s worth splurging on. Skin saver this one!

review_title: not as moisturizing as I hoped
review_text: I was expecting this to be a nice thick nourishing cream that would really take care of all my dryness and irritation. Unfortunately I feel like it falls short. I have normal-combo skin so I don’t even need thaaaat much hydration but the occasional times that I have redness and dry patches around my mouth this doesn’t do much. I feel like I could possibly use it as a winter moisturizer but it certainly wasn’t what I expected.

I got a sample of this cream and never tried it until recently when I did a chemical peel. I experienced some purging and was so unhappy. I have a few bigger pimples that are red and a scar from one before the purge. Well, not only does this help with redness it also helps healing. I am blown away. I just ordered a larger tube!

I really liked this cream because it has a very clay like consistency. It is very hydrating yet it soaks up in the skin leaving no residue at all. I really like to use it under my makeup because it works perfectly as a primer. I received this product complimentary from Influenster to test out and would really recommend it.
I highly recommend this cream! I’ve been loving it on my face and knuckles haha! It’s added so much moisture back into my skin without making me feel oily/greasy.

This product is thicker than the gel cream. I feel more moisturized after using it, however I have used other products that leave me feeling better during the day. This product has a light scent. I received this product free for testing purposes.

I was really hopeful of this product! My skin without any breakouts tends to be red and certain triggers make it flare worse. I feel like this cream helped reduce the amount of redness in my skin but didn’t do anything to help with reducing flares of rosacea. If my skin is triggered it still gets insanely red. So, at least it helps with some aspects but I’m still on the hunt for something that gets down to the root of the problem, more so.
AMAZING!!!!!!!!!!!! I love this product. Definitely recommend. It really helps redness and leaves my skin hydrated.

this cream is my saving grace for my extremely sensitive skin!! I prefer this over the gel cream even though I’m not a fan of heavier creams. this is definitely a little bit on the denser side, and the smell is not for everyone (it’s refreshing but also gives off a medicated scent as if it’s healing my skin). I used this for 4 weeks along with the mist and serum in my night time skincare routine and it’s changed my skin. it is smoother, no breakouts, more glow and no more dullness. will be purchasing again and again! I received this as a complimentary product for testing purposes.

I can see why this project is designated for PM use as it’s very thick. Though I love the lightweight of the gel this is the perfect PM moisturizer. Love that ingredients helps repair, soothe, and refresh my skin. It will leave your skin feeling a little oily next day at least in my experience. I received this product for testing purposes.

I have extremely dry skin and get a lot of dry patches around my mouth and nose. Have been using it since last few weeks and it’s good on my skin. It helps a lot in reducing the dryness, but I need to keep applying multiple times. I like it’s texture and it blends well. Would work great on combination skin.

I have very dry skin and this cream has reallyhelped hydrate my face. My facial esthetician even noticed my skin is now healthier. I love the scent and feel of this cream!  I received this product for free for testing purposes.

review_title: TRY THIS NOW THANK ME LATER
review_text: Out of this whole collection this has to be myFavorite product! The cream is nice and rich yet not heavy or thick on the skin! All the products work well with on another and this one is no different. There is a scent to everything in the line so be weary of that if you are sensitive to scents, but my sensitive skin had no issues! I received this product for testing purposes fromInfluenster.

This cream is very very hydrating. I have dry/ eczema prone skin so this works wonders for me! It is very thick and a little goes a long way. I only use a little on my face when my skin is feeling really dry. I use it often for my elbows or any dry patches I have. It is extremely soothing and leaves my skin feeling refreshed! I received this complimentary from influenster. I highly recommend this product!

This product feels so good and hydrating. air is a bit heavy, but I kind of like that because my skin is always so dry. i feel like this really helps seal in all that moisture my skin needs!Why four stars and not five? It’s an absolutely DREADFUL lavender scent and a huge headache trigger for me. I hate that so many beauty products have it. I did receive this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

This cream has left my skin feeling and looking amazing! It does not say that it helps with fine lines and wrinkles, but the lines around my eyes and forehead have been less noticeable since starting to use this product. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

This product is fantastic for red skin. In combination with the gel and the serum it drastically changes redness and helps with sensitive skin. It is helps with dry skin and does not feel super thick on the skin. I would definitely recommend this product. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

One of my favorite creams. This one doesn’t feel too thick even though it seems like it will be. There is a slight green tint that doesn’t show up once applied. There is a herby smell that dissipates quickly but I personally like it. I like using this before makeup after the calming mist and serum. I use this before bed after cleansing. I did notice my aggravated skin calms a bit when I use this. It is very moisturizing as well. I love this product. I was given this product for review purposes by influenster. All opinions are my own.

I received this product free for review in my Influenster VoxBox. It feels clean and natural, wonderful as a cream for after taking my makeup off or even as an overnight cream. Not as fast absorbing as the gel water cream because it is a thicker consistency.
I received this product for free as a promotion and it was absolutely amazing what a game changer for real the best products I have used!

I am a person who has very sensitive skin and anything will itch and irritate my skin the minute I put it on. So when I tried this gel cream I was surprised to find it hydrated my skin and left me with an amazing base for my makeup routine. After a couple of weeks using it now, I found that my skin has been very soft, hydrated and I have had no breakouts what so ever. I recently traveled to Europe and after an 8 hour flight my skin wasn’t dry like it usually would be. I have been using this cream along with the serum and compared to other brands that I have been using in the past, this brand and products are well worth the money. I was gifted products from Dr. Jart  to review, and I can honestly say I would purchase these products myself when I run out. Don’t hesitate to buy. I have been using very expensive skincare products in the past and Dr.Jart  has really topped them all. Great price and does it’s job. A

I have the most sensitive and irritable skin. I always have breakouts and red skin. This product has helped soooo much w decreasing the redness and reducing my breakouts!! I’ve only been using it for a week, every morning, and I’ve seen such a big improvement!! Would definitely recommend!!

I love using this as the final step for my nighttime routine. It sinks right into my skin and seals in all the goodies that came before it so nicely! Might be a bit too heavy for daytime use. I recommend this moisturiser for sensitive skin. I received this product for free for testing purposes.

This product ls one of the beat moisturizers I’ve seen so far. I spent a lot of money on products to help with this spray of breakouts that I had and this definitely helped Remember a little goes a long way.  I received this product for free for testing purposes.

LOVE LOVE LOVE !!! I have very dry skin and a few dark spots on my cheeks. I’ve been using this for about a month and wow it has changed my skin so much. Not only does my skin look more dewy/hydrating, but it lasts all day. No need to reapply. This is perfect for those who want to wake up hydrated asf ! Definitely, purchasing it once I run out.  “I received this product as a free sample“ and I received this product for free or complimentary for testing purposes.

I received this product for testing purposes from Influenster. If you don’t have a sensitivity towards silicone then this cream is pure magic! Unfortunately the silicones in this cream cause me to breakout, which doesnt make it my go to cream. Please remove the silicones!

I have this and also the gel cream and I prefer using this one when my skin feels more dry. It’s a bit thicker than the gel cream but both work wonderfully. I feel like this one just packs a bit more of a punch in terms of moisturizing. I have combo skin and it didn’t make my oily spots feel super greasy.

I have very dry, sensitive,  easily irritated skin. This product is so soothing and hydrating it feels amazing on my face. A little goes a long way and it isn’t too greasy or heavy feeling.  I love it. I recieved this product complimentary of influenster for testing purposes :) I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

My skin can be supper dry (especially in the winter) but this cream locks in all the moister in my skin! It is thick so for the summer its been my night cream (if you have oily skin I don’t think this is for you). You don’t need a lot, it goes a long way.

Love this product. I use it every day. And once I use it I apply the color corrector and it makes my face look amazing. And so clear and natural. I like how thick it is and I love that a little goes a long way!

I like this moisturizer. It nourishes the skin well but I can’t differentiate it from most other moisturizers I use. I would recommend the other products in the Cicapair line before this one but it’s still a good product. I received this product free for review.

review_title: Moisturizing cream that helps with redness
review_text: I use this product over the Tiger Grass Serum. It doesn’t feel heavy at all, surprisingly. This product keeps moisture locked in for hours, and I would even say using this alone (without the serum) is adequate enough! It calms my redness and feels soothing.
wasn’t impressed. I didn’t notice any improvement in the redness or dryness of my skin.

I have been using this cream for about 1 week and I can already notice how good it is. It is really consistent so you will not need a big amount to have the benefits. I love how super hydrating and sensitive skin friendly it is. It is one of the best of the whole cicapair line. As soon as you use for the first time you will feel how your skin will be soothed and nurtured. I received this product for testing purpose and I am in love ❤️.
I received this product complimentary from influenster, i have very dry skin and this product makes my skin feel and look healthy!

review_title: An ok cream for dry skin
review_text: I love this cream a thousand times better than their gel cream. It’s more suitable for people with Dry skin. However it works better as a day cream for my dry skin rather than a night cream. The smell is nice but I do notice my skin gets a bit dull throughout the day so I don’t think it’s moisturizing enough.

I received this whole line for free. However, this product was my absolute favorite. I love how it makes my skin feel afterwards on how quickly it absorbs and how it gets rid of the redness.
