This product is great for moisturizing my skin after the skincare routine. Definitely using this for my nightly skin care routine! Great for my red skin at times!

This product has done wonders for my skin, even after just a few uses! My skin is very sensitive, but this cream didn’t give me any reaction whatsoever. In fact, it has helped immensely with irritation, dryness and redness. I received this product free for testing purposes. I would definitely purchase it for continued use.

I love this product! Been using it nightly for my dry acne prone skin for a week now and already noticed a significant difference. I also use it on my neck which get awful dry skin acne and it’s already clearing up. I highly recommend this product if you have dry/sensitive skin.

Great as a nighttime moisturizer! You should pick it up if you have issues with sensitivity. I don’t find it makes my face tingle or act up like I find in a lot of other products. I received this free for testing purposes and I love it!

review_title: Would highly recommend for dry skin.
review_text: I recently received this product as a free sample and asked to review it. It’s recommended for dry and sensitive skin, something that living in Nevada I am constantly struggling with. I’ve honestly tried so many different types of moisturizers, but most always seem to burn after application, leave my face red, and to top it off they normally dry out within an hour and I’d have to reapply it. After trying the entire Cicapair line, I can genuinely say that I am beyond happy with the results and will more than likely purchase in the future when my samples run out. I have not had any burning of the face, I don’t have to constantly reapply due to drying out, and my face has never felt so smooth and hydrated. Honestly the best free sample items I’ve ever received. I really can’t speak on how well it may or may not work for acne because I don’t really struggle with that, but as for sensitive dry skin, it’s definitely worth it. I enjoy using the cream before bedtime, although it’s a cream, it definitely feels like a nice lightweight lotion after you smooth it out, it doesn’t clog your pours like most creams might, it smells amazing, smooths over really easily, and definitely adds tons of hydration! I could go hours without having to refresh.

I was surprised by how thick this cream was! It was quite heavier than i expected. It does a lovely job hydrating and will be perfect in the winter. The scent is pleasant and it did help calm my skin a little bit. I received this item complimentary in exchange for an honest review.

This is my favorite moisturizer!! It’s so creamy and makes my skin smooth. It helps a lot with irritation and redness. Good for acne prone skin. I received this product as a free sample and to enter a contest.

my skin feels super moisturized when i use this. however, it’s pretty heavy and thick and i feel it on top of my skin for a while after applying it. this is just personal preference though! i received this product free for testing purposes.

Awesome product! I have sensitive skin and this doesn’t irritate it and just makes it so moisturized and plump. It’s not greasy at all and makes me skin so nice! I got this product for free from testing purposes.
I tried this product via Influenster. Love the calming cream. It was lightweight not too heavy and worked well with my makeup. Definitely would buy this product.

In the summer months I prefer the gel cream to this product because I am oily and this felt too heavy. I ended up giving this to my sister who has dry skin and she raved over it! Definitely noticed reduction in redness and provided the perfect amount of moisture.

Now! About this moisturizer. I love it! I’ve never used a moisturizer that leaves my skin so silky and smooth. I feel like it does help locked in the moisture and keep my skin from drying which I love since I do have dry skin. Also, last but not least I did received this as a complimentary so thank you!

Let me start off by saying I love this cream. Yes, it’s a little heavy but my dry skin loves it as a nightcream. I have dry skin that breaks out on my right side in a rash in the blink of an eye. When I woke up in the morning my redness had reduced and my cheek was smooth. My skin felt plump and hydrated. I prefer the gel cream for under makeup. I received this product complementary for testing purposes and I plan on purchasing it once my tube runs out. The tube is so convenient and lets you really get every last drop. I typically use tatcha but will switch to this in the evenings.

definitely the best moisturizer ive ever used in my life! definitely for someone who has sensitive skin, acne or even facial ezcema. I always use it as my last step in my routine, very moisturizing but still light on my skin. has definitely improved my facial skin overall, as i would have dry flakes by my lips and eyes and this keeps me looking more normal and less red! i would recommend for someone who is dry, needs that boost of moisture but needs something that will also soothe the itchness or irritation from ezcema! I received this product for free for testing purposes.

This is the best moisturizer, all year round. For someone who lives in New York, and experiences harsh winters and lots of weather changes, this is the only moisturizer that has protected my skin, leaving it glowing even in cold, dry, days while toning down the redness. It has also never made me break out, and reduces the appearance of my acne. It is a little heavy for a summer moisturizer, so I only use it at night durning the summer months. I wouldn’t recommend it for people with oily skin, since it does tend to clog my pores a little bit.  I love the texture, and it leaves my skin with a natural glow. The only reason I ducked away the star is that it only lasted me a couple months (I only used it as a night moisturizer) and for  $50, I would  expect it to last a little more. Also, the packaging could be better, I prefer the traditional jar than a toothpaste-like container.
I’m on my second tube now, and it’s made a HUGE difference in correcting the seemingly perpetual redness and irritation on my cheeks. I’m absolutely hooked and can’t recommend it enough.
I have oily skin and this product shoothes my sensitive skin without making it greasy.

This cream was a big help in calming my skin after a particularly bad hormonal breakout. The texture is thick and a little goes a long way. The formula definitely soothed my sensitive skin and helped tame irritation. I’m not a fan of the aluminum packaging though- sometimes you end up with way more product on your hands than you bargained for. Otherwise, great cream!

This is just a great product! It has really helped the redness in my skin from acne. It’s gentle and doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin and it layers really well with other products. I’m on my 4th tube!
I keep this is my travel kit it’s a lifesaver for dry irritated skin. You do need to warm product up in your hands first and gently pat on otherwise it’s too thick.
Super Moisturizing. Great Scent! Haven’t noticed any changes in redness. No breakouts.
If you have acne, eczema, irritated red skin, dark marks, this will heal it all. It’s a godsend, I wish I found this earlier.

Broke me out SO TERRIBLY. I’ve never written a review for a product because I’ve never had SUCH A HORRIBLE REACTION to anything in my life. Bought this in hopes of relieving some winter dryness and as the description states this is good for acne/blemish prone skin. I had a few small hormonal breakouts before using this. After a week my entire chin and cheek area was COVERED in whiteheads and clogged pores. Made an emergency visit to my esthetician who was so alarmed by the condition of my skin and immediately indicated the cause had to be something topical that was clogging my pores. This was the only new product I’d introduced to my routine. Never again will use any Dr. Jart  products. Absolute trash and did nothing for the dryness to boot.

This stuff is worth the hype, seriously. If you have combination or acne prone skin, but live in a climate that has cold or harsh winters, this is a must. Despite the price tag, I continue to repurchase this and my skin has never been better (I’ve gone through three and a half tubes now).

I never write reviews of anything but I feel I must! I have very fair, red undertoned sensitive skin and I wanted a heavier face cream for the winter, but nearly everything I try that’s too thick gives me a rash. I heard this cream is healing, and sometimes I am guilty of trying to pop a zit with too heavy of a hand, leading to raw spots, so when I heard this had “healing abilities” I thought it may be BS but I’ll give it a try, and WOW. Within using this for 2 days my raw skin has healed up, even scabing and coming off today! It calms redness in the process and makes your skin feel moisturized and comfortable. It really is worth the hype and the packaging is so fun with the turn key making sure you get all of the product out to get your money’s worth! A must have for sensitive skin for use morning or night.
This stuff does wonders for making my skin tone even and eliminating redness. When I run out of the sample, I will definitely purchase.
Really good underneath makeup actually, and it doesn’t break me out but at the same time very moisturizing.
My favorite Dr. Jart Cicapair product! I love that it is a cream. I put this on at night and by morning I feel like my face is more even toned. Will continue to buy.

Thick and rich! This certainly takes longer to work into the skin than the Ceramidin™ Cream and leaves a comfortable layer of protection over the skin. Great for night and under make up. The smell is a little medicinal but I don’t care for any kind of fragrance in skincare so I really don’t mind it. The smell doesn’t linger around.

There’s a reason why this stuff is always sold out, it is a magical cream!! I’ve suffered from bad facial eczema ever since I was pregnant (and still do 11 months postpartum) and this is the ONLY topical non-prescription cream that has cured my eczema. It also helps with redness/rosacea and general inflammation. Just amazing stuff. Stop what you are doing and buy this.

So i researched this tiger grass cream and decided to order it. First off, this product defiantly conceals blemishes/dark spots bery well. It goes on green and fades into a nice neutral base tone  color. I have pale, porcelain skin so it matches perfectly. I use it alone without make up while I’m at home...it covers that well. My daughter tried it, and it matches her darker skintone very well,  so I believe that through some miracle, it blends to match any skinrone. Overall, I love this product; it conceales, moisturises, soothes and heals irritated skin. I do have to say that this cream is HEAVY feeling, and slightly suffocating... I cannot wear it under make up or when it too hot outside. I do look forward to its benefits during our harsh, dry winters. Overall, I believe this is an awesome product. The pricetag is quite steep though...i feel $49 is a bit high for this type of product, however I purchased mine online for $15 no shipping (1/2 ounce). I can say, this tiny jar will likely last well over a year...yes it goes that far. Giving this product 4 stars, not 5 only because it’s pretty heavy feeling but overall awesome!@

I have dry skin that is easily irritated. After using some Vitamin C products that left my face with a burning, itchy like feeling I was desperate to calm my skin down. This cream went on like a velvety salve that calmed the itch and the redness. It also great on dry and cracking patches. I will continue to restock this product to always have it on hand!

I got burnt quite a lot during September this year at a lake. My skin is also mixed but sensitive and I need something to calm down all the irritation. I went to the Sephora at Prudential Centre in Boston and was evaluated by a nice employee for even evaluated my skin and gave me samples to try before I bought the full sample. Very helpful. Despite the cream being green in color, my skin does not turn green, lol. It does help calm down the redness slightly and over time helped my skin feel better.
I received a sample of this product and it was pretty good, it felt nice when applying it to my face. However, I wasn’t impressed enough to want to go buy the full sized product.

If you’re thinking about it, take the plunge! I had a freakish series of hormonal breakouts that left my skin itchy, peeling, and scab-like. I had tried the belief moisturizer and glam glow hydrating mask for a week and they couldn’t do what this product did in less than 24 hours. Redness has been significantly reduced and peeling/scabby texture is all gone. HOLY GRAIL.

Best year round moisturizer. Not too thick for summer, not too light for winter. I have rosacea and very dry skin and this moisturizer soothes and comforts to the max! I’ve been shopping for a perfect moisturizer for years- I have found it!!!!

I have oily, sensitive, acne prone skin. (I am a 17 year old girl, though.) I got this as a deluxe sample back in January and WOW - I noticed an immediate difference. It amazed me that one product could make such a difference overnight. I was hesitant to purchase because of the price, but I feel like if you sabed up to buy it, you would not be disappointed at all.

I have severely dry and red skin, and this comes out when my skin is misbehaving particularly bad. I love this cream, but a little goes a long way. It can also be quite greasy feeling, even with my really dry skin. I use it overnight occasionally to try to keep my skin extra hydrated, and I feel like it causes tiny small bumps/weird texture near temples sometimes. Overall, if you’re really dry, red, sensitive skin, this product will help!
Absolutely terrible, smells awful and made the skin bright red and even more dry! Hated this so much!

I have been using this for this winter with the Tiger Grass Serum and my redness has cleared up. My hormonal acne has too! This is a heavy cream, but absorbs and heals. My skin was a little dry in the autumn, but a month of using this fixed that. I love the way it soothes and heals any irritated spots. I also use this to protect my face when I go skiing. I imagine I will only use the Serum during the humid summer months, but will keep thus on hard for spot healing. I have never had such clear skin with no redness! I am very impressed and will be repurchasing as needed, probably next winter. A little goes a long way.

i like this cream. i like it, but i don’t love it. while it does improve a little bit of my redness and contains ingredients that reduce inflammation (ceramides, niacinamide), it also has some ingredients that i know irritate my skin. if this didn’t have the lavender and rosemary oils, i would give it five stars. i’m just really disappointed because i wanted to LOVE this, but it’s really just okay.

Wonder worker! It is very moisturizing for the face. I typically use it under my eyes to remove puffiness and redness. It works better than the many eye creams I have tried. Also, ideal for my sensitive skin.

I have very acne prone, red, combination skin and this is perfect. it’s the best thing I’ve used for my dry spots and it’s not oily so it’s still good to use on my oily areas. saw my redness and acne getting better after the first day.

I love Dr Jart products and was happy to see this one in my play bag! I have very dry sensitive skin and this went on smooth, wasn’t greasy and didn’t irritate my skin at all! Would definitely recommend.

i really wanted to like this. The reviews looked good and I’ve been sufferring from a lot of blemishes lately. I used this for a week as part of my skincare routine and it ended up breaking me out. This was the newest addition to my routine so I knew it had to have been this. I tried it on its own without anything else on my skin and it was too much for my skin.

I never planned on using this, as I have very oily skin and figured that something this thick and creamy would be a disaster for me! But I used it in desperation after getting sunburned and it was incredible. I’ve since gotten a second sample and purchased a full sized tube of it because nothing has ever made my skin so clear, even, and calm. I use it every night before bed and my skin has never looked better.
I have been using this cream for a few weeks now and I can see a big change in my skin! Less redness and very moisturized, and not greasy!

review_title: I’m sold - this stuff is AMAZING!
review_text: Best face cream I’ve ever used. I love in CO (very dry climate) & am 51.   This cream moisturizes better than any product I’ve ever used - I apply AM & PM. Is great under make-up too. Smells yummy. Best new skincare product I’ve found in a long time.

My favorite moisturizer by far! A little goes a very long way so it lasts for a really long time but as soon as I’m getting low on the product I have to make sure to go by another one so I don’t run out. It’s thick but light on the skin and has a pleasant smell. It’s literally my holy grail!

review_title: It goes on thick and moisturizes!
review_text: I love this moisturizer because it’s heavy and therefore, perfect for my dry skin. It leaves my skin feeling so soft and moisturized. The texture is very thick, think margarine but it is not really icky greasy and you shouldn’t put it on your toast. It does leave my face looking dewy but I prefer that glassy skin and hydrated look. I use it morning and night! The only con is it is pricey. There is scent but I don’t mind it at all and it doesn’t last.

“Dry“ is an understatement to describe my skin. That being said, this has been a god sent. I was hesitant after reading reviews stating this isn’t a good summer/morning moisturizer due to it being heavy (even for dry folks). However, I find it is perfect because of how dry I am. I admit it can feel heavy if you over apply, but I believe I’ve mastered applying just enough in the mornings where I’m hydrated but not sticky. At night, I apply SR Juno oil on top to seal it all in and my skin loves it-- I no longer wake up super dry!! Before buying this, my favorites were Tatcha’s Dewy Skin Cream and the Adapotgen Cream from YTTP. (I loved both of these products, but Ice is just better.) In addition, my foundation sits on top of this really well! All of this to say, if you have really dry skin, this is a must have that’s definitely worth the price tag. However, I would not recommend this to those with oily/combo/normal skintypes.

review_title: Bumps on my face after application
review_text: I received it as a sample. Only with single application I have bumps all over my face. I stopped using it but not too sure whether the bumps are because of the cream. I tested again after about 3 months and same as before, only after one time application I had the same problem. I didn’t have such problem with other brands. I don’t have sensitive skin.

Finally found a moisturizer I can honestly say I love. The cream is nice and thick. I have really dry skin and had been using shea butter, but I wanted something a little lighter. Got this as a sample and ended up buying full sized. I still have to use the shea butter at night, however I’m noticing that slowing there is no need for any other moisturizer. I do think the price is a little high, but its worth it in the end.

review_title: Hydrates, heavy, slow to absorb, breakouts.
review_text: At first application, I thought this was wonderful! My skin rejoicing at how well it hydrated. Then I noticed how heavy it was. It was very slow to absorb. I sleep with silk pillowcases because of my mess of hair, and it made a mess of my cases. Within 24 hours, it caused massive pimples. I’m 55, and haven’t had a breakout in decades. I have it a few days and tried again (but only in the morning!), mainly because it was so hydrating. Same result with only one application. I have found if I put nothing at all over it, the breakout is less, and I have to clean my gave half way through the day. Otherwise, it’s like, well, more than I had as a teenager. I don’t find the benefits to be worth all that.

I really like this moisturizer! It comes with a tool to scoop the cream out, so you are avoiding germs. I really like how it goes cooling on your skin. I have been using this for several weeks at night, and I really feel like it is helping my combination skin that is acne-prone during that time of the month. I will def purchase again!
I can definitely see a difference after using this nightly! Has a nice texture and easily blends with skin. No scent which I prefer for a under eye cream.

The Sunday Riley ICE Ceramide Moisturizing Cream has worked well for me. My skin has been extremely dry this winter, After using this, the dryness reduces and my skin more brighter and plump. It doesn’t irritate. It goes on smooth, absorbs quickly, and my makeup goes on well on top of it. This will definitely stay part of my daily regimens. The only downside, it has a slight scent to it.  My fine lines have reduced, and I’m happy with the results

Received this product for free for my honest review.  This moisturizer is great specially for overnight.  My skin gets really dry and this moisturizer helps so much.  I put it on at night and in the morning I can see the difference.  Love the product.

Okay this is so creamy yet so light, and the fragrance is super nice.Ceramides are supposed to be really good for our skin - especially our skin barrier. I really looked forward to trying this item for that reason as my eczema causes dry patches on my face which can be really itchy and annoying. This cut down on those inflamed patches by Moisturising my skin in a very lush way. 10/10 recommend this
I really loved this moisturizer I have combination skin and it did great on my dry patches but it didn’t cause other parts of my skin to be oily. It wasn’t heavy which I loved or greasy.

The packaging is lovely, I was taken aback by the smell. I trust Sunday Riley so I dipped my spatula on in, and dolloped the rich cream arpund my face and starting massaging it in. It feels like an aaah moment for my dry, dehydrated skin. I really like how my complexion looks so much fresher and almost dewy. The smell is string from the container but it dissipated quickly. My skin overall has seemed much less dry throughout the day and I’ve noticed and especial improvement around my nostrils that tend to get seasonal irritation In winter.

Such a great product! This is a thicker cream, it spreads beautifully. This leaves my skin so smooth and improves the texture of my skin. It absorbs into the skin and is not greasy. Love the way it makes my skin feel!

I felt like SR ICE Ceramide Moisturizing Cream was a bit heavy for me to use twice a day so I just use at night. Excellent for a winter cream. I can’t wear every night because it’s so thick because then I break out. The smell reminds me of maybe coco butter. Love the little “scoop” that helps get the cream out of the bottom of the jar.

Moisturizes great and doesn’t clog pores. I’ve noticed that it helps some of my 40 year old fine lines disappear. It doesn’t stink, but I wish it had a more pleasant scent. It smells like a regular cream.

Thos product is great during winter. My skin typically combination most of the year. But mid December I begin to get a bit more dry. This is a good hydrating moisturizer. Doesn’t take much effort to massage in. Dries quickly and doesn’t leave your face feeling greasy. The only thing I don’t enjoy is the scent. Something about it... I liked it at first but eventually found it off putting. If you’re wanting to splurge or treat yourself, this is a good item!

review_title: ICE CERAMIDE MOISTURIZING CREAM.  SUNDAY RILEY
review_text: I love the ICE ceramide moisturizing cream.  It made my skin feel revived.

This product is definitely moisturizing, but I found it very thick and it takes a really long time to absorb. I would not recommend for daytime use. It also has an almost medicinal scent that was quite unappealing.

I absolutely love my Sunday Riley ICE Ceramide Moisturizing Cream. It goes on nice and light and a little comes along way. The first thing I noticed when using this cream is it’s cool on your skin, which I absolutely love because it adds a nice firming effect along with superb moisturizing. This is definitely a five star product!

Let me start by saying I have extremely sensitive dry skin. I’ve been using the Sunday Riley ICE Ceramide Moisturizing cream for about a month now. The texture, consistency, and smell are nice. The product absorbs quickly. I did notice some redness without feelings of irritation in the forehead area a few minutes after application during the first week of use. The redness dissipated within a few minutes after application. By the second week of use I no longer experienced any redness with application. I would compare this to some of the OleHenriksen and Fresh moisturizers I have used in the past. I like the product, it moistuizes well, and I would recommend it to others with dry skin.
I really love this face cream, I have dry skin and this cream is thick, but doesn’t leave my face weighed down. It absorbs and leaves my skin moisturized and smooth!
I really enjoyed the feel and non greasiness, smoothness & how it made my face & neck look & feel.  It is truly a wonderful and fabulous product!

I have oily skin and usually don’t stray from my hydration moisturizer. At first use I felt this cream to be on the thick side but doesn’t cake on, it smells fine, but left white spots on my face unless I worked it in pretty hard. On day one, I didn’t have to blot my face as much as I normally do. After about 2 months of use it’s working amazingly, no complaints! I love that it doesn’t leave me oily and by skin remains clear and moisturized. I definitely recommend this moisturizer.

This cream has a lot of body to it. Nice and thick and heavy. But your skin absorbs it all and feels extremely soft to the touch. You can definitely feel the moisturization. Skin feels protected all day. I like to use it as a night cream too. Has a nice smell that is a mix of coconut or almond. I really like this because it feels different than most moisturizers because of the thickness.

Don’t be scared off by the negative reviews! This cream feels so good going on, and leaves my skin baby soft. There is a slight scent to it, but it’s not overpowering or off-putting, and I didn’t feel like it was particularly difficult to apply. You don’t need a lot so the big jar should last a long time, making it a good value for the price tag. Just a little dab will do ya, and RUB IT IN! It is think, but it’s supposed to be. I have sensitive combo perimenopausal skin and this is the thirst quencher. The smell is almond and it’s lovely, if you don’t like almond, it doesn’t stay long. Get this. Your skin will thank you.
This has been my saving grace this winter! I apply at night and my face is still glowing, and completely moisturized! My hubby even uses it!
Sunday riley Ice is my favorite moisturizer! It leaves my skin silky smooth and glowing! It has given me a better texture and tone. It leaves tour skin looking healthy and vibrant.

I recently tried this cream hoping to solve my winter dryness around my forehead and cheekbones. The packaging is fantastic and really feels high-end. Overall I’d say the cream was a bit too thick for my personal taste - I found it difficult to massage into the skin and it takes some time to soak in. It smells wonderful and does leave the skin feeling hydrated, but not my favorite texture.
I loved this product it really moisturizes your skin leaving it silky and smooth. I got mine as a sample form buzz agent. Will definitely be purchasing this product again.
Kept my skin hydrated all day long! Wasn’t a huge fan of the smell though.
