I got this product to try for free. I am in love on how my skin looks after using this moisturizer. My skin feels very soft and looks hydrated and radiant. I love the formula it goes very smooth on the skin and i alsonlove that has coconut in it that keeps the moisture in my skin, its perfect especially for winter thats when my skin gets very dry.

I love this cream. It is thick, so I mainly use it at night before bed! I look up with great looking skin! I love that it is gentle and without a strong scent. It definitely gives me the Moisture I need

I received this complimentary from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review.I love this cream and feel the quality in application to my neck! I will definitely recommend this. The packaging is superior and you feel pampered upon opening it.

review_title: super soft and great for sensitive skin
review_text: This is my go to moisturizer every night! I originally got this as a sample but it was so good that I ended up using this as my main moisturizer! It’s soft and smooth and doesn’t affect my sensitive skin negatively. I will say I give half a point off for the scent. I’m not really a fan. it doesn’t smell bad or anything, I just prefer floral scents. My friend who tried it said she liked it though, so it could just vary person to person. It doesn’t stop me from using it all the time though, which is why I didn’t take off a full star.

This moisturizer is very thick, but absorbs easily into skin. It has a pleasant smell and keeps skin well moisturized. It is a quality product, but it didn’t have quite the impact on my skin I would expect at its price point either.

The Sunday Riley ICE Ceramide Moisturizing Cream took getting used to for me. At first use, my face tingled and was a little red. I decided to give it another try another day and it worked like normal with no tingle or redness. Mine does look a little yellow and not white, but maybe that’s how it’s supposed to be. It does help firm skin which I like.

As it compares to other moisturizers, I thought this was heavier than I would generally prefer. Some benefits that I appreciated were that the ingredients helped skin stay soft and supple. Unfortunately, I don’t think I would buy this considering the moisturizer I already use. However, I would recommend this to friends who prefer a richer, heavier product.

It’s a really nice, moisturizing cream from a great brand. It was a little strong for my sensitive skin at first, but after using it once a week for a few weeks it’s really helped moisturize my skin in these dry winter months. It is pricey but considering how long it will last me, I would recommend it! The product isn’t too heavy or greasy which is great!

Wearing a mask has dried out my skin something fierce. I have never used moisturizer as I had oily skin, but that has changed in the last year and the Sunday Riley Moisturizing Cream seems to give the right amount of moisture without leading to pimples. Thanks!

This is a very hydrating moisturizer. I have oily combination skin, and I think that this is a great moisturizer for winter. It is very thick and a little tacky, so I don’t use this under makeup. It comes with a tiny spatula to scoop out product, which helps keep it sanitary. It has a light sweet scent that is not overpowering. If you are in need of a moisturizer to help dehydrated skin, this is a great choice.

I have sensitive, combination skin with visibly large pores and redness all over. This moisturizer was great for my skin. When I first opened the container to me it smelled like pistachios and I was in love. It reminded me of my childhood. The more I smelled it, it began to smell like spumoni. The product comes with a little spatula (to be honest I didn’t know which side to use because one side is a spatula the other is round lol). The cream is thick, but not heavy. It blended and absorbed beautiful into the skin. There was no irritation nor greasy feeling. The product played well with all my other skincare products and makeup products. My skin felt soft and hydrated all day. I would definitely purchase this on my own. Overall the product was lovely and worked well with my skin.
The ICE creamier cream was too thick for my liking. I had a hard time getting it to absorb in my skin and it felt really sticky. Also unpleasant smell.

I have combination skin so i usually have a hard time finding a product that’s not too thick or too thin. This one i really like. I use it as an overnight cream and the texture of my face looked different after - almost like a glowy look but not in the super shiny type of way. Only thing is if you over apply too much you will find it looks greasy. A little goes a long way!!! Absolutely love this cream.

The ICE moisturizer by Sunday Riley is a must for thr cold and dry winter air. This creamy moisturizer helps protect the skin from seasonal dryness. I’m so glad I found this brand of moisturizer - it’s now part of my daily skincare routine.
Another great product. Thick cream so use lightly during the day and at night at your own leisure. Gives a great feel and provides adequate moisture. Came with an application tool.
I love this face cream it’s thick but not too oily. This cream makes my skin looks wonderful.

review_title: So glad I gave this luxurious cream a chance!!
review_text: I have to admit, when I first tried this moisturizer, I was a little skeptical. I am blessed with normal skin, natural aging concerns with fine lines and wrinkles but overall good, not too dry and not too oily. This cream felt a bit thick and heavy the first time I tried it. I should not have worried, my skin just drank it up and I was left with baby soft skin. During my morning routine, it is the perfect canvas for my primer and foundation. Both go on smoothly and I seem to have a more natural glow all day. But my night routine really told the story. I love a good night serum but decided to try this cream on its on. Morning after morning, I am waking up with dewy soft skin that again, just glows. I’m noticing a much smoother texture after regular use and even my hands are enjoying the benefits. Sunday Riley is definitely a new favorite!!

This face cream is very nice. It feels super luxurious, and comes in really nice packaging if that’s your thing. It definitely keeps my skin hydrated during dry winter days. My one con is that it is VERY thick, so it’s kind of hard to spread around, but I like to use it as a night cream so it’s not an issue for me personally. The ceramides in this product are great.
very well formulated,  and smells great,  one of the best moisturizers.   the best product in the Sunday Riley line.

review_title: Instantly Helped My Dry Winter Skin!
review_text: A little goes a long way with this super moisturizing face cream!
I do feel this provides a nice level of moisture and helps even out my skin.  My only issue is the scent does take a bit of getting used to.
I love products with ceramide and this is no exception. It’s an excellent night cream and the texture is really creamy. It also smells great!

This is the best moisturizer I’ve used EVER. It has a thick consistency, great for my dry dehydrated skin. It doesn’t trigger my acne/eczema prone skin. It has a delicious vanilla fragrance. I Will definitely purchase or again.

I really disliked the smell of this product.  It smelled of bad coconut.  It was too strong to have near my noise.  It went on smooth and absorbed easily.  I would be cautious in recommending this product to my family and friends because of the aroma.  If this product did not have the strange smell, I would use it.

My experience with Sunday Riley’s Ice creamide moisturizing cream has been amazing.  I have incredibly dry skin. I’m not just talking dry irritated skin. My skin looks like it’s a good 30 years older than I am. I have been using Sunday Riley’s Ice creamide moisturizing cream for a while and I can’t begin to explain the drastic improvement it has made.  From the very first application it has immediately made a visible difference. Beyond that the itchiness, pain and paleness of my skin has improved as well. If you have dry skin, scaly looking skin, or skin that looks like crepe paper, I would say that you should give this a shot. It soothed, hydrated and got rid of that creepy looking skin and it  brightened my skin tone all without feeling greasy or heavy. Every day my skin gets more relief. I would recommend this product and I do intended to continue using it.
I received a sample of this wonderful cream from BzzAgent. It glides on and my face feels wonderful. My foundation smooths on after!
The thickness of this moisturizer is great. It leaves my face feeling really soft. It smells pretty good, too. I wasn’t super familiar with this brand before trying this but would buy.

Overall I am pretty impressed with my ICE Ceramide Moisturizing Cream. The cream is thick and rich. It has a light, pleasant scent. It is non-irritating to my skin. It does take a couple of minutes to fully absorb and rub it in due to its consistency. My skin looks fresh, youthful, and bright. I can really feel the hydration. This is an excellent, high quality moisturizer. After using it regularly for over a week, I can see a difference in my skin overall. It is firmer, smoother, and less rough. I definitely recommend it!

SUNDAY RILEY ICE Ceramide Moisturizing Cream blew my socks off, I’ve heard amazing things from the brand and hve tried their ceo cream. This ceramide moisturizer is thick ao i definitely started using it more as a night cream but it is qorth eveey penny even if i received this through reciew, i would def buys this over ans over again
Feels great! I absolutely love the formula and how hydrating it is. A little will go a long way leaving your skin feeling hydrated and smooth.
Not too heavy. I apply before my makeup and it absorbs nicely. Makes my skin feel soft and smooth.

When the cooler months come along I change my face cream to help my skin tackle the dryness that usually comes. This is definitely a heavier cream that is perfect for that. Because my skin is more combination than it is dry I find this a little too heavy for day use (at the moment. If it gets super cold that may change) but at night it gives me the super hydration I love...which means I wake up with perfectly hydrated skin so my day time moisturizer doesn’t have to work so hard. The smell is amazing (although that’s subjective) and unlike Tidal, this did not cause my skin to breakout.

With the cold weather and the stress that 2020 has caused, my skincare routine needed an overhaul! My niece even mentioned to me that my skin was looking a bumpy and not smooth and noticed my wrinkles :( I was excited to try out this moisturizer to address it and like others I loved the packaging and the fragrance when I opened it. It’s a bit thicker than my normal moisturizer so I was a bit worried it would be hard to absorb but I was impressed, a little goes a long way! The first time I tried it I accidentally put a bit too much on the wand, so the second time I was a bit more careful how much I scooped and loved how easily it spread across my face.I’ve been using this cream for a little over a week and really like it a lot as a night-time moisturizer. As a day-time moisturizer it feels a bit thick so I try and use less but could see this coming in handy as the weather gets colder.

I have liked using this skin cream. It feels thick and luxurious on my skin and doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. When I wake up, some remnants are visible in some white build up, but not much. I can’t say I’ve noticed any effects so likely wouldn’t but again, which is a bummer.
This cream is thick, but melts into my skin. It’s perfect for the winter months as my skin usually becomes very dry.

This cream is perfect for the winter months, it’s thick and hydrating. I wear it to sleep or during the day, it’s given my skin some of its moisture back! I’d definitely recommend to anyone in cold climates or looking for a thick moisturizer.

This is the best moisturizer I’ve used so far. It leaves my skin feeling nice and smooth. I will definitely buy this cream to add to my skin care routine. I recommended this to both my friend’s and family
Most moisturizers leave my skin feeling greasy and I end up breaking out but this one is a lot lighter and feels better.

The packaging deserves four stars. Very beautiful and high end. I’ve only used this a few times since receiving it. I love that it has no scent and feels like a midnight moisturizer. Non-irritating. I have not noticed any differences yet. The price point is a bit high in my opinion.
This product offers a nice aroma and it’s smooth to the skin, but I don’t see the benefits of using it.

This stuff is amaaazing for dry skin! Almost immediately I noticed a difference and I have really dry skin on my face. I used this at night and woke up with nice soft skin to apply makeup on. Usually I fight with my foundation and that flakey look, but not anymore! Yay!

review_title: Luxurious Cream Without the Price Tag
review_text: I am loving this cream. It is thick and luxurious, like some of my other creams that I paid double for. It leaves my skin feeling super moisturized and plump. I absolutely love it and wear it daily.

review_title: I wouldn't recommend for anyone with acne issues.
review_text: I got a small sample of this and decided to use it up. I found my forehead got bumpy which happens sometimes because I have comedones come up when I use a product my skin doesn’t like. I looked up the ingredients to see what could be triggering it and I found that these ingredients are irritating to acne like lanolin alcohol (which is pretty high up on the list), Cinnamomum Cassia Leaf Oil, and Stearic Acid. Especially for such a high price tag, you might not want to risk.
This product soaks into my skin and leaves in feeling super soft and “plump” it’s expensive but it’s worth it.

I’ve tried several samples of this (ipsy/insider points) and ...ehhhhh.This is a rich moisturizer (love that) but it doesn’t sink into the skin very well and feels kind of waxy. Despite that, it did not stop the moisture loss from the dry air/central air, which I desperately need.....worked fine on a nice day though! Might work for more normal skin (I’m dry/dehydrated in winter) but I personally wouldn’t bother for the price.

This is the absolute worst moisturizer I’ve ever tried. I received this product in my Allure beauty box and was excited to try it. I used it once and broke out but I didn’t think it was this expensive cream so I tried it again. Big mistake. Both times I broke out with tiny bumps all over my face and neck and dry red patches everywhere. Please beware.

I don’t know what these individuals are talking about regarding a foul smell from the Allure sample. I also received it in my Allure box. It is normal smelling and it’s also a WONDERFUL moisturizer!! A little goes a long way as a nighttime moisturizer. I use it as my top layer moisturizer to seal my serums & my Perricone MD cold plasma treatments in! It’s rich & creamy, ... and yes, it’s a light beige/yellow color, which is normal. I think the light fragrance smells quite lovely. It has a vanilla quality to it so I’m not sure how it could be described as rancid or smelling like paint?! I’m 50 and my skin loves it! I’m about to buy the full size after my sample is gone. I’m also trying their water cream to see if that will be a good day time moisturizer ;)
I love this moisturizer! It’s rich, without being too heavy.

My skin was breakout prone when I began using this (I’ve since had a baby and my skin changed completely, probably hormones), and it never caused me to breakout. Used in conjunction with Sunday Riley’s retinol it works really well as a rich night cream. Seems to help with fine lines a bit, not sure if I’ll use this in the summer though.

I cannot figure out why this product’s reviews on here are so mediocre. I tried multiple samples of this before pulling the trigger and I absolutely love this moisturizer. I have super dry, hormonal acne prone skin and live in the very dry climate of Colorado. When I put this on, it feels like my skins just drank 100 ounces of water. The best part- that feeling actually lasts. My skin has a nice dewy healthy glow. I used this after the CEO vitamin C serum. I also put this moisturizer in my makeup fridge to stay cold. I’ve tried a ton of moisturizers and I finally feel like I found the right one in this.
Moisturizer is perfect for dry skin, however, it cause me to break out.

This needs to be said. There are about 10-12 ingredients in skincare and makeup that cause cystic acne, and this product has roughly 7 of those ingredients. Please look it up. I didn’t prior to my purchase. Don’t buy this Moisturizer if you’re concerned with the possibility of breaking out. Period.

I have oily, acne prone, yet hyper sensitive skin, with an allergy to all chemical sunscreens and titanium dioxide. A recent series of events led me to a point where the bottom half of my face was burning, dry, irritated, and peeling, yet still breaking out at the same time. I didn’t even know that was possible. Every single thing I would put on my face to try and fix it, wound up stinging and irritating me even further, including Skinfix barrier , Dr. Jart Ceramidin, Caudalie SOS, Biossance Omega Repair, Korres Hydra Biome, Korres 24hr Moisturizer.  On a return trip to Sephora I saw this sitting on the shelf and requested a sample, which the Sephora employee tried hard to persuade me against. Evidently, they don’t think any better of it in store than the reviewers on here do. This cream quite literally saved my skin. It was the ONLY cream not to further sting and irritate me, it visibly improved the redness and dryness with each application, and over the course of a week and a half, has brought my skin to near perfection. I had backed off all my normal skin care and used Ice, exclusively, all over my face twice a day. The skin that wasn’t irritated looks healthier, more hydrated, brighter, smoother, and clearer.In my experience this cream:-absorbs very effectively, leaving skin plump and bouncy-doesn’t leave a trace of oiliness/greasiness behind, even on oily prone areas-smells kind of like cherries, which does not bother me one bit-does NOT cause any breakouts, even seems to improve existing onesI applied a slightly thicker layer to the irritated areas, and a thinner one to the rest of my skin. I found that pressing it in versus rubbing seemed to make it easier to spread. I will be purchasing the full sized version and making this a permanent addition to my routine. I’d give it 6 stars if I could.

Purchased my second container today. My skin gets very dry in the winter, and I also live in New England, it can get brutal. This cream has been a life saver. My skin drinks it immediately and I have not had any irritation or dry patches since I have started using it.

Unfortunately after starting to use this product my face broke out horribly. Tiny bumps were all over my face! I’ve never had this kind of reaction before with any skincare product, so I’m not sure what in it caused that reaction for me. I do have to say I love the other Sunday Riley products it’s just this one that my skin had a reaction to. Sad :(

After reading several of the reviews written I can now confirm that this product caused the tiny little bumps all over my face. I typically Always have clear skin and I love the Sunday Riley Tidal moisturizer, so I thought to give this new one a try and it was a huge mistake. I immediately returned it and it’s been a few days since using it and my skin still hasn’t recovered. I rarely ever write reviews but I felt very passionately about this and I felt like I had to share/warn the next person. This issue seems to be a very common theme with this product, I would highly suggest that Sunday Riley reconsider the formula to prevent any hindrance to their reputation. I think this one is made with coconut, and based on some research (not a dermatologist or anything) but coconut is too thick to apply onto the face. Nonetheless, I’m still a fan of their Tidal brightening moisturizer, so I exchanged this one for my usual.

This product was suggested by a Sephora employee for my dry skin. I bought it after we sampled several other products. I was leaning toward a different product but went with her suggestion. She was not wrong! This is an amazingly buttery cream. It goes on a bit thick but spreads easily once it is massaged into my face. No more dry skin! My face is soft and dewey fresh. Worth every penny as a little goes a really long way. It is probably too much for summer time but PERFECT for winter.

I received a sample in my allure box and have been a fan of Sunday Riley. BUT, I take care of my skin and consider myself to have nice skin, thanks to genes and good moisturizers. THIS MOISTURIZER MADE ME BREAK OUT SO BAD!!! I have bumps all over my neck and face and my nose pores are completely clogged. I’ve never experienced this and am super disappointed.

I really like this cream. It has a rich consistency but not as oily as the ceo rich hydration cream. It has an almond scent which doesn’t bother me. It’s best as a night cream but might be too much under makeup, maybe if you have very dry skin or you use it sparingly it will be fine. Overall, I’m satisfied with this cream.

review_title: Great for dry skin or wintertime.
review_text: Very rich. This is definitely a great winter moisturizer for the southern New England area I live in. It’s not something I would use in the summer for my normal to oily skin.
Broke my face out in a fine rash after just a few uses. My face has been quite dry, recently so I thought this would be a good option, but my sensitive skin couldn’t handle it.
Love. Recommended by one of the associates at Sephora. It’s thick but just warmed a little up in my hand and put it on and my skin looks and feels fantastic. Awesome product.
Better options out there for a better price. Not worth it.

Not sure if I like it or don’t but I didn’t love it so it’s going back. Very thick but magically doesn’t feel heavy on the skin. I layered it over Sunday Riley retinol and had a tingly sensation. I liked the scent but it is too strong and artificial for my liking when it comes to facial products (would have been a great body product). My skin was glowy and seemed plumped and worked well at night, when I used it diring the day my makeup didn’t layer nicely over it.

A winner. I have oily skin that gets dry patches and prone to dullness and discoloration.  This feels amazing. I am new to using it but like all other Sunday riley products. A winner right out the box

At first, the texture freaked me out because it is really thick but, as I massaged it in, it just melted into my skin. I will say that during the day, I’m not a huge fan unless I’m not wearing makeup. At night though, I absolutely love it! I don’t wake up dehydrated anymore and my skin looks smoother and has a more natural glow. My favorite thing to do is put a small layer of Tidal Moisturizer first and then put this on top. It makes a great sleeping mask that doesn’t get on my pillows, as long as I don’t use to much. I didn’t use it for a few days and let me just say, I noticed a difference. Hands down one of my favorite products ever!

This goes on like a dream, feels beautiful and makes your skin looks and feel so baby soft. I break out EASY and this does not clog my pores or break me out at all. Your skin will thank you, you will see results quick! Also you need so little this will last you a while!

I’ve been using this for a while — I absolutely love it, I put it on before bed every night and it’s so good, especially in winter. I will say it’s really thick, and it can make me break out if my skin is already feeling greasy. It really feels like it creates a barrier though — love it at night and I use it when I go out during winter so my skin doesn’t crack!
Great for dry skin albeit heavily scented. Moisturizing enough for harsh winters and negative temperatures.
The only moisturizer that works for me :) light weighted and doesnt cause breakouts. Its like a mini face spa

review_title: A must have in the routine
review_text: I love this moisturizer ♥️ absolutely amazing. The texture is so rich and soothing.

This product is this product is amazing and I think it’s great for gifts and it does a good job with your hair. I use it on a daily basis and I give some of it to my family and it has really helped keeping my hair healthy and I would definitely recommend it.

This product was gifted by Farmacy. First off the packaging on this is just awesome! It’s very heavy and feels premium plus I love the fact that a little metal scooper was included so that you don’t have to dig your fingers into it. The best part though is that the scooper actually sits on top of the lid magnetically so that you don’t have to worry about losing it. The actual cream is very thick but silky smooth and it rubs into the skin easily. Because of the thickness I did find it to take about 15 minutes or so to fully absorb into my skin to the point it wouldn’t feel like a residue when touched so I did have to make sure to apply it far enough ahead of time before putting on makeup or going to bed. It made my skin feel very hydrated and supple. I do have normal to combo skin that errs slightly on the side of being more dry in the winter months so for me this will be a good wintertime moisturizer and I would probably skip it in the warmer months because it would feel too heavy for my oilier periods. The one drawback to this is the scent for me. It does smell like honey, which I love, but it is a very heavy, cloying honey scent to my nose which I didn’t enjoy fully. If it had been a bit lighter honey scent I would’ve loved it more but it’s not a deal breaker. Just be aware if you are more sensitive to scents this one is quite strong. Overall this is a good moisturizer for when you need a lot of extra hydration either in the winter or if you have year round dry skin.

The honey halo is amazing! I have combination skin, but this has helped hydrate my skin so much. It absorbs quickly and also smells really good but not too strong of a honey scent. I apply in the morning and at night and my skin feels dewy all day.Gifted by Farmacy Beauty

I’ve always had issues with moisturizer either not giving me enough or giving too much and then breaking out but this moisturizer gives me ev-er-y-thing. I use is morning and night, at night I’ll sometimes add a little facial oil if i feel like i need it, otherwise this is my absolute go-to. I’m on my second jar

review_title: Good moisturizer but heavy for combination skin
review_text: Got this moisturizer in a sample kit, overall a really nice moisturizer. It’s a little bit too heavy for my combination skin so I got a few oily breakouts after daily use. The smell doesn’t bother me at all (other reviews I read complained about it). I would recommend it for dry skin types or even as an occasional moisturizer for cold seasons when my skin is a bit dryer.

review_title: one of the best moisturizers i’ve ever used
review_text: satisfying thick consistency- super moisturizing + didn’t irritate my dry/sensitive skin. natural fragrance which smells so good!!! ingredients list is 10/10
if this has 1 million fans i’m one of them, if this has 100 fans i’m there, if this has 1 fan it’s me, if it has 0 fans i’m dead. best. moisturizer. ever.

Love this moisturizer. I have been trying to find a good heavy night time moisturizer and this is it. I did not like the Skinfix and I used to use Olay, but even the fragrance free irritated my eyes. I use a lot of actives/serums so I’m really just looking for something to seal everything in. This has a heavy cream consistency but goes on the skin very light! It’s crazy. It’s also a nice way to include propolis in my routine.  You could use this day and night and it gives a nice glow without being greasy. Definitely would be good as skin prep under makeup. You only need a little bit so this jar will last you. Again moisturizing but light enough for summer. Think it is good for all skin types. Highly recommend, not hyped up at all. If it is as good in winter as summer then I will stop trying new products.

I love it so much and a little goes a long way. It’s so thick and creamy and sink into the skin so nicely. It doesn’t feel heavy on the skin which I really appreciate and the scent doesn’t bother me but if you really hate the scent of honey definitely avoid this product.
the best moisturizer i’ve ever used! perfect for dry and combo skin. it leaves your face feeling fresh and moisturized without any grease. in luvvvvv get this product!!!

I started using this moisturizer about 5 months ago and I absolutely love it! I have mature skin that tends to get tight and is very sensitive. The luxurious texture goes on thick but instantly absorbs into the skin so it doesn’t feel heavy or sit on top of skin. The fragrance is nice (not too heavy) and I love the little paddle that allows you to scoop out the moisturizer without having to put your fingers right in the product. A little pricey but a little goes a long way. Would definitely recommend.
Absolutely love this moisturizer. It does not pill which is a huge bonus. Honestly has changed the game for my skin! I love that it comes with the magnetic spatula too.

Disappointed. I love the Honeymoon Glow, but this moisturizer is very tacky on my normal skin. It doesn’t absorb and just feels heavy and gross. I am now going back to my Elemis, but I was hoping this would be good since the price is better and I do like some of Farmacy’s products.
This is the first moisturizer I’ve used that didn’t sting my sensitive skin. It’s smooth and actually pretty light.
Incredible moisturizer. Buttery and soft formula, sinks into the skin easily and leaves a healthy glow. It does have a strong honey scent, so be aware if you’re not necessarily into that.
I just bought this on a whim to try it and it moisturizes without feeling too heavy and oily. I’m acne prone/oily and this does well with my skin. Also..it smells like honey!!
My bf originally liked this product but over time it started to give him whiteheads. It’s pretty heavy! Mind you, he has dry skin :(

This is a lightweight moisturizer that worked well for my sensitive, dry skin. For the sensitive peeps out there, this is a good one. It just doesn’t give as much moisture as my stressed and parched skin needed. Works well for acne prone skin. I’m at the end of my jar, and it has become a pain in the butt to scoop out so just keep that in mind. Otherwise, definitely give it a try!

review_title: BEST moisturizer I have ever tried
review_text: I have tried more moisturizers that I can count and I’ve never been this impressed. I have combination, acne prone skin. This is extremely moisturizing and a bit heavy, so it’s perfect for nighttime use. I like to mix it with hyarulonic acid to make it a bit runnier. It keeps me hydrated and glowing throughout the night, minimizes my pores and doesn’t break me out. A little goes a long way, I got the sample size and it has lasted me a month. It’s truly a holy grail and I’ll recommend this product to all my friends!

I thought this would be too heavy for my oily/combo skin, but this is a LIFESAVER! I’ve always shied away from things that look like they’d make me a grease ball, but my skin has never looked better... Ever. A thin layer of this lasts all night, it’s not sticky, leaves your skin soft and plump, and smells like honey. I don’t think i can live without it!
it was alright it wasn’t moisturizing enough for my skin

I have semi-oily skin in my t-zone area and received this in my most recent FFF box. I typically only use primer in the morning before applying my makeup but decided to start using this, waiting about 5-10 minutes and then use primer. This stuff is amazing. I legit do not need to apply powder like I had to before I started using this. Some how the shine stays minimal. I love this stuff so much because it has brought balance to my skin. I have a healthy glow after using this.

I love that it smells like good quality honey, but if you are sensitive to scents then it might bother you. I dont notice it after its applied. Im very acne prone and this really nourishes my acne and dryness, it doesn’t make it worse which is a little rare for me. Definitely hydrating but not overly so, I can wear this night or day and I do. Its not greasy or thick its light and creamy but packs a hydrating punch. Its a really good versatile cream and I recommend it! I bought the largest size and Im so glad I did because i can tell it will last a while since you don’t need a lot! I think it helps my redness too and my angry acne is soothed.

review_title: The smell of honey is so pungent
review_text: Felt good on my face and did good job of hydrating my very dry skin. However the smell was so terrible I was dreading using it. I know honey is in the name, but didn’t think it would smell ... so bad. To anyone who is sensitive to the smell of honey, don’t buy this.

review_title: this is the one you’ve been looking for!
review_text: I am in love with this moisturizer. I have combination skin that leads more to the dry side. I’m not a fan of gel type or water based moisturizers. I prefer ones that are like a thick cream. I have used both of the drunk elephant ones because they have the texture that I desire and I honestly found that those did nothing and ran out rather fast. I love how this moisturizer comes with an applicator so that I can choose how much I want to use AND I don’t have to come into contact with the rest of it with my fingers. A little goes a LONG way with this moisturizer. Seriously. I use about the size of a pomegranate seed each time I apply. It fully blends into my face and absorbs beautifully. I’ve noticed an amazing difference in the softness and the plumpness of my face since using this. It has the slightest honey scent as well and it’s very comforting. I love this product and would totally recommended it.

Such a nice moisturizer, super hydrating and makes my skin feel super soft and gives a subtle glow. It’s definitely thick and creamy but it’s not so thick that it just sits on your skin and doesn’t sink in, actually sinks in pretty quick for how thick it is. No real fragrance, just smells like a skincare product, so it’s not gonna irritate your skin if you’re sensitive to that. And it lasts a pretty long time because a little goes a long way.

Finally found my perfect moisturizer! I’ve been on the hunt ever since the First Aid Beauty 5 in 1 face cream was discontinued. My skin isn’t bothered by anything in this cream and it has the perfect amount of moisture. My skin is left feeling calm, healthy, moisturized and even ready for makeup.

I really love this moisturizer. I have oily/ normal skin and while this seems thick in the pot it spreads so evenly and softly on the skin, soaks up fast and leaves my skin feeling incredible. Using this moisturizer after a face mask feels sooooo nice. It has a light smell of honey but not in the sweet way but the smell of beeswax candles! Only 4 stars purely because of the cost but will definitely repurchase
Very rich and moisturizing.  Unfortunately it made me break out so if you have sensitive skin or can be acne prone beware of this.  Will be returning for something else

Incredible. I’m about to purchase the jumbo size. I’m currently on tretinoin/retinol, & my skin is dry, peeling it’s been tough BUT this moisturizer really has made a difference. It’s lightweight but still is very hydrating! There is basically no scent. I just love this brand every product I’ve tried i love! I have combination, acne prone & extreme sensitive skin…
Wasn’t wowed by it but it does it’s job as a moisturizer and a little goes a long way. I have normal/dry skin and it works well for me.

The packaging is absolutely amazing..The applicator..Amazing. I just can’t get myself to like this moisturizer as much as I wanted to. My skin feels sensitized and warm after I use this, and not a huge fan of the smell, kind of like honey greek yogurt. I have combo skin so maybe that’s why I ran into issues, but I will  be returning.:(

I got this as a gift as a winter cream. I thought I would love this product since I really love their cleansing balms. This product gave me major breakout despites having a very dry, not prone to acne skin, after two uses and skin irritations. I don’t recommend this product to anyone with dry and very sensitive skin. Plus, the smell is non tolerable for me. Had to return the product.
It’s an amazing product.. my skin is so soft after using it

So I’m on my second jar, and this is a great moisturizer. Just the right amount of moisture not too much or too light . And the packaging is super nice , and I find the smell okay even though other reviewers complained about that. I only took off one star because for how much it costs , it’s not enough product . Usually when I buy a high end moisturizer it’ll last me like a year, this one last 7 1/2 months n that’s only using it at night soooo ya . But I have repurchased cuz I love the product .

If you have combination skin, I highly recommend this as a night cream. I’ve been using the ceramide treatment thing from The Ordinary and loved it but couldn’t really justify buying one every 2 weeks. The nice thing about this moisturizer is that a little bit of product goes a long way. So even though I have a freaking five-head and big face, this product usually lasts me about 1-2 months?It does have a strong honey smell initially, but I got used to it after a week.
Very moisturizing in the Fall and Winter for my dry skin. It’s too heavy of a cream to use in the summer so I will only use it during the cooler months.
This creme smells absolutely delicious!  A very moisturizing intense product that is not for oily skins However, I use it for deep tissue face massages and also with my  jade roller and Gua Sha.

I have sensitive dry skin with a bit of rosacea. I’m always looking for a good moisturizer that doesn’t irritate my skin. I love this product. Light on scent, great ingredients and it does an amazing job moisturizing. This product tends to be heavier, although I don’t find that it makes my face oily. Highly recommend

review_title: I am basically Winnie The Pooh
review_text: I LOVE anything with honey in it, so this whole line of honey products by Farmacy is in my cabinet. Honey is a natural humectant, which means that not only does it hydrate, it actually locks in moisture too. Add in the ceramides and this is a dream concoction! My skin is so bouncy, bright, and hydrated. I was having trouble with combo skin, this helped balance me out so much. The honey farmacy products were all I needed for perfect skin. This is my routine: Ultrabland Cleanser (honey & beeswax) from LUSH, La Roche-Posay cleanser for dry-normal skin, Lancôme Tonique Confort (acacia honey), Farmacy Honeymoon Glow, Honey Halo Mask (2x/ week), and ofc this god send moisturizer! I also rotate between the honeymoon glow serum and Sunday Riley UFO (salicylic acid) to fight off hormonal acne. I literally have not had a break out in 6 months since I started doing this routine. Everyone is different, so just give your skin what it actually *needs!!

Ill be honest I rarely write good reviews, but this one deserves it. I’ve tried many products that claim to make your skin “glow” but this is the only one that has worked for me. Admittedly my skin takes most things well so I haven’t gotten any breakouts. My face feels hydrated and so smooth.  Half a dime size works for my whole face so the bottle will last a while which makes the price worth it.

I wasn’t super impressed with this product. I got it because my combination skin was leaning more on the dryer side in the winter months and because I loved the honey drop (lightweight) moisturizer from Farmacy. However, I didn’t like the way this sat on my face. I would have to put it on hours before I went to bed because it would transfer to my sheets. I feel like it is incredibly hydrating but a little too much if you’re the littlest bit oily. Some pro’s tho: didn’t cause me any breakouts and I’m sure it’s amazing for super dry skin. Smells great and feels like butter.

review_title: Must Try for Dry, Acne-Prone skin
review_text: This moisturizer is amazing! I had been using the Cerave moisturizers (daily and the intense tub one) and though those were the best. However, this leaves my dry, acne-prone skin so hydrated and glowy. I also think it helps heal some of my scarring and acne because of the honey - it doesn’t get rid of my acne (I use a sulfur wash, the ordinary’s niacinimide and zinc, and pimple patches for that) but it does help speed along the healing when a pimple is in later stages. I use this as a night cream as it is very thick and sometimes I also add the cerave daily moisturizer to really lock this in.
My skin turned extremely dry after having a baby and this helped revive my skin.

review_title: recommend, few things to keep in mind...
review_text: I should start by saying that my skin is combination acne prone, so I don’t usually buy heavy moisturizers. This winter I needed something more substantial to follow up a lactic acid cleanser and another daily exfoliant as my skin was becoming flakey and had frequent reactionary breakouts. This has worked great and has been replenishing. My skin has recovered and I’m even noticing some improvement on discolouration due to acne scars. This being told I can see why other reviews mention it’s not hydrating enough - it’s feels more buttery. I’m applying a toner (spray) before and it helps locks in moisture and feels balanced. Would purchase again and also curious about trying out the lighter version of it available on the Farmacy moisturizers line.

Unfortunately this product made me breakout....I didn’t mind the sent (could really smell the honey) and it melted into my skin really well. But it gave me a small rash and bumps. Returned but i still like other farmacy products!

I was really excited for this moisturizer and had high hopes for it working with my skin type. It was bad from the second I opened it. The smell is strong and not at all pleasant. I decided to use it anyway. I’ve been using it for several weeks now thinking it will get better, but it leaves my skin so unbelievably oily. No matter how much or how little I use, my skin is greasy within 10 minutes, which is not the norm for me. It gets two stars because I like the jar.
Made me break out. I will have to return because I can’t use it. Lotion felt good. Strong honey scent

This is a rich, thick cream and a pleasure to apply. It seems to make my skin supple. However, this also makes my skin tingle even when it isn’t particularly sensitised. I have noticed that if I switch creams or only use an oil, my cheeks do not tingle so I think it might be the added fragrance in this product. Unfortunately, I don’t think I will be repurchasing even though the product itself is nice
Fantastic cream. You need so little & your skin stays supple without any additional products; personal preference obviously, but heavy hitter on my book
I absolutely love the smell and feel of this moisturizer.  I often use on its own or with a facial oil underneath for an extra boost of moisture especially in winter time or in a dry atmosphere.

Ive been trying to make more sustainable purchases when I can. I am so glad someone at Sephora brought me to this brand. Not only is it in glass, the lid is wood, the spatula is metal! And the best part the lid is magnetic so that you don’t lose it!!!  And it’s a great moisturizer!  Totally going to try more from this brand. I’m sold.
This is the best moisturizer ever -so hydrating and heavenly ! Writing this review to beg Farmacy to PLEASE make a travel size -the packaging is too bulky and awkward to travel with. Thanks xo

My experience with moisturizers have been truly a rollercoaster ride over my lifetime, with many needs fluctuating with the the seasons and budget, but this moisturizer right here y’all... Butter. The packaging - I never knew how much I needed a magnetic lid - not for the purposes of closing the product but of the steel spoon that comes with it to stick to the top lid that way it never goes missing and picking up product is simplified, life changer. The packaging aside (which I love it’s minimal woodsy vibe) is the formula, which I’m still not done processing how much I love it. I use a good pinkie’s worth every night, at first I wanted to test the dry down without other products and results are that it fully absorbs, you can’t see any product on your pillow or even finger if you rub your face, it might feel the slightest bit tacky but it just feels like your skin is hydrated and is still transferproof (which for someone like me with a love of sateen and silk is a must). My skin is rosacea prone, light to medium, and can be super dry and tight in the winter. I noticed that this not only fully absorbed but also calmed my red-orange spots and fine lines over time. Obviously it’s not a cure for those issues but if it’s soothing the agitation and inflammatory flush, it’s doing it’s job. The smell is like a subtle aged honey, not my fave but not at all a deterrence from daily use. I purchased this a month back and I suspect have a few weeks left before I need a repurchase, which could cost you a good couple hundred per year (I’d wait for the sales season to bundle up) but definitely mid range affordable and best of all EFFECTIVE for dry skin!

This is simply the best moisturizer I’ve used. I have dry, sensitive, and acne-prone skin, and have tried so many different products throughout the years. I went into Sephora knowing I wanted to try something new. I knew I wanted something thicker like my previous moisturizer and was recommended Honey Halo. It is a dream! The packaging is amazing, and I love the magnetic lid. Some may find the honey scent overwhelming, but I absolutely love it, and it does not linger, especially once on your face. It is a heavier cream so a little goes a long way. It does take a little longer to absorb, but doesn’t sit on your skin. I’ve been using it twice a day, but when incorporated into my evening routine, I wake up with soft, glowing skin. I’ve found that this product does not only calm and moisturize my skin, but my acne is noticeably disappearing. And a bonus that it is clean! I’ll definitely be buying this product again. Love the ingredients, and absolutely love how it takes care of my sensitive skin.

review_title: It was only a nice moisturizer...so I thought
review_text: I thought I already posted a review on this, but I can’t find it. I bought it on a recommendation from a girl I watch on Youtube and I wasn’t blown away. I did love the scent and the way it made my face feel, as I have pretty dry skin - but I didn’t feel like it was doing anything major. That is...until I stopped using it and switched to Keihl’s Super Multi-Corrective Cream. I could not use ANYTHING underneath the Kiehl’s without it pilling and I can’t stand that. I also noticed I was needing to exfoliate more often. I still had 1/4 of the Honey Halo left and started using it again. This is absolutely the best hydrating moisturizer I think I have ever used. I can use my serums and vitamin C beforehand and no pilling. It also works so well under makeup! Ordering again!

review_title: This is literally my ride or die
review_text: My holy grail. I switched over from the Kiehl’s Ultra facial cream to this because I needed something heavier for my skin. Don’t get me wrong, the Kiehl’s cream worked but this is even better!! I can almost instantly feel my skin getting the hydration it needs and it also does soak in fairly quick when I don’t use my other skincare products under it. It’s a little pricey considering the jar size but well worth for the quality of the product.I have sensitive eczema prone skin. It can get red and splotchy very easily. My face is dry 365 days out of the year, and I have easily reactive skin as well as easily irritable. This thing goes on like butter!! My skin has zero negative reactions to it. A little goes a long way with this product and I love the little magnetic spatula that comes with the jar. 10/10 would highly recommend to anyone that’s been struggling with dry and flaky winter skin.

I bought this moisturizer after Sephora Squad member Maddy Gutierrez recommended it in her highlights. I live in Colorado so our winter weather is dry and cold. This moisturizer has kept my skin soft and hydrated. Bonus, it smells amazing!

review_title: If you struggle with dry skin this is for you!
review_text: I struggle with dry skin, especially in the winter months. I enjoy a thick night time moisturizer but haven’t found one that I truly felt added moisture back into my skin until this one. I’ve only been using it for about 5 days but in less than I week I’ve noticed a huge difference. I wake up in the morning and my face feels incredibly soft and my makeup goes on so smoothly. I even think it reduced any texture I had. My face looks so smooth and glowy! Love this product and will continue using!

With quarantine keeping us indoors, I’ve had the chance to really focus on my skincare. Well my bf has observed my obsession and purchased this for me for xmas. I’m pretty picky with the products I put on my face but since he bought it, I decided to try it out. My go to lately has been the Biossance omega repair cream (which I LOVE) and right away I noticed how rich and creamier it was compared to Biossance. I live in the PNW So winters can get pretty cold so I love to layer my moisturizer pretty thick at night but this moisture PILLS. I first noticed it when I used it in the morning and layered my sunscreen on top. I go pretty light with moisturizer in the day so I figured I didn’t give it enough time to set before using my sunscreen. But a few days later during my nighttime routine, I gave myself a good 30mins after my serums and when applying it I immediately felt it pilling. I did notice people saying they press it on so I might try that otherwise I’m going to use it for my neck/décolletage area.I do LOVE the packaging. So innovating that the lid is magnetic!

I love Pharmacy products and got this based on all the rave reviews. It is honestly super average. It absorbs nicely and doesn’t feel heavy but I could layer the entire bottle on my face and I’m still dry and cracking through my whole T zone. Have to say I expected more.. Disappointing.

I am very impressed with this moisturizer. Firstly, the packing is cute. It is glass and the top is wooden and magnetized so the little metal spatula sticks to it. My normally fairly normal skin has been super dry because I blast the heat in the winter. It is awful and becomes a tad painful. I got relief the first night I used this. It is extremely silky and goes on very smooth. I didn’t need to use much. I planned to use as just a night moisturizer, but it absorbed so well that I am able use it during the day too (this won’t be the case in the summer). It smells faintly of honey. Very happy customer. Highly recommend.
I was shocked by how hydrating this is. If you have dry skin you need this! It’s perfect for winter and it smells like honey which is amazing. Just found my favorite new moisturizer for sure

review_title: Must have for ultra sensitive & dry skin!
review_text: This is the best moisturizer I’ve ever used, period. I have ultra sensitive skin, and sometimes it feels like everything I try sits on top and never soaks in, dries it out more, turns me red like a sunburn, or causes me to break out. I usually have to resort to using Aveeno Baby Eczema lotion as face moisturizer in the winter just to keep my face from cracking. I took a chance on this based on other reviews, the clean stamp, and the ingredients, and it’s changed my life. I felt it soak right in immediately, my skin felt soothed and soft, and looked hydrated but not at all shiny. Can confirm I’ve had no redness, hives, cracking, or break outs, and my skin has never felt so soft. I’m using it as my morning and night moisturizer and it keeps my face hydrated all day. It’s also unscented, which is a bonus. Invest in this moisturizer, it’s worth every penny.

Amazinggggg. Best moisturizer ever! I have sensitive skin that’s prone to breakouts but this moisturizer gives me no problems. It has my skin looking great. I pat the cream on kinda like the la me one is applied.  In fact, they’re very similar IMO & for a fraction of the price. I recommend to everyone.
I like to go light handed with this Uber hydrating moisturizer...my skin is dewy & naturally glowy!

In love with this moisturizer!! My skin gets really dry during the winter and I’ve decided to try this out & I’m really impressed! Definitely worth the money! The consistency is thick but once you apply it on your skin it melts on your skin and keeps your skin looking really hydrated and super smooth! My skin has improved! Every night I wash my face and then I use this moisturizer and I wake up with my skin feeling soft! The smell does not bother me at all. You should definitely invest on good skin care products like this one. Your skin will thank you later ^_*  . I also love how the lid has a magnet and the little spoon that comes with it sticks to it!

I received a deluxe sample to try from Farmacy as a bonus with my purchase from them during Black Friday. In my opinion, this cream stinks. It smells like baby’s breath flowers (that sour lightly pungent scent). It goes away after about 5-10 minutes but I absolutely hate it. As for the texture and feel, it is good for dehydrated skin but I still think Dr. Jart Ceramidin is much better (and less nauseating). This is a decent moisturizer and is actually quite light in the face though it is specifically formulated to be a thicker cream. For those who think Ceramidin is heavy, you’ll like this. For my dry skin, I wasn’t a fan. I didn’t see too many issues with my sensitive skin but I use this very sparingly due to the scent. Not sure if I used a thicker layer like I do with the Ceramidin, if it’ll change. Other than that, I don’t see any other bonuses from the other ingredients but for a simple moisturizer it’s nice. If you’re looking for a clean beauty product, I think this may fit the bill.

I had a small jar of this from a Farmacy set I bought and was secretly hoping I wouldn’t like this cream. The ingredients were kinda weird: vegetable oils and flavour? Who knows what this even means. However, on the first use, I was completely sold and bought a full sized jar the next day. The texture was like room temperature butter and felt very soft and silky on my skin. It took a few min to fully absorbed, but my skin didn’t feel itchy or tight at all. I use this only at night because it’s quite thick as a daytime cream. I’m not a huge fan of the scent, but because it doesn’t linger, I’ll tolerate it (it’s like a concentrated honey scent). I use about a pea to dime size amount and it’s enough to generously moisturize my face and my neck. I think this will be a great night cream to use as the days get colder in Canada.

While I am generally have pretty normal skin, aging and moving to the mountains changed me, and my skin has been thirsty for something like this moisturizer for so long. I tried a number of rich creams but really nothing worked until this, and my life has changed. I believe the ceramides are what make all the difference. I would recommend this moisturizer to anyone who is suffering to be quenched. Plus it is so buttery smooth, it is a welcome addition to a relaxing, self care, skin care routine. One million stars, absolutely recommend.
I’ve tried so many moisturizers and this truly has transformed my skin.

This is my absolute new holy grail. The scent is light and heavenly, the texture rich and buttery without feeling heavy, and it’s resolved every dry patch on my face. I’ve even started wearing this during the day despite it being on the thicker side as I feel it’s done wonders protecting my skin from the winter weather. Amazing product.

What can’t I say about this miracle moisturizer? Upon first glance, I found the container adorable. It’s made of glass and shaped like a honeycomb. The lid has a wood-like appearance and has an internal magnet for the metal spatula. The smell wasn’t overpowering at all; a simple, light, fragrance that doesn’t linger. The product itself is a light yellow butter-like cream. It melts into your skin for a moisturizing feel that doesn’t sit on your face. From the first use, my skin looked and felt different. I don’t wear foundation, but I do wear powder blush and it applies smoothly and stays all day. I’ve been looking for a miracle moisturizer for my year-round dry skin and this fits the bill. This moisturizer didn’t affect my sensitive skin; no breakouts, redness, or itchiness.

I have used and loved a couple of Farmacy products and have been incorporating ceramides into my skincare so I was super excited to try this product. I’ve been using the Lord Jones acid mantle repair cream and love it, but now that winter is here I wanted to find something a little more rich for my dry skin. Sadly I’ll be returning this product due to it causing skin irritation. It does have a heavy honey scent, which frankly I found a little off-putting and is probably the source of irritation for me, but the scent does dissipate very quickly. This is a really rich cream and I found that it did leave my skin feeling a bit tacky until it soaked in which took about 20 minutes. Another review complained that it just sat on top of your skin which to some extend it does, but that’s really what I was looking for in a winter moisturizer. I wouldn’t recommend this for someone who has oily skin or for warm weather, but if you’re looking for something to lock in moisture during harsh, dry, winters this would be a good option. I just wish the fragrance wasn’t so strong/irritating to my sensitive skin

This moisturizer is so heavily fragranced that when I used it my eyes burned and teared up. I even tried just putting it on my neck and the same thing happened. I don’t understand why this has 5 stars as it seems like a typical moisturizer and nothing special. One of the main ingredients is vegetable oil....I also didn’t like that the spatula it came with looked like a piece of scrap metal but that’s purely cosmetic. I’m returning this and still on the hunt for the perfect “clean” moisturizer.

This is one of the few thick moisturizers that actually work and does a great job. This does have a really rancid smell if that bothers you but otherwise this is an amazing moisturizer. It’s very occlusive but still hydrates well so your skin is moisturized and protected. Plus my skin loves honey so my skin has looked a lot clearer and calmer (although that might not happen for everyone). Would definitely recommend if you don’t mind the smell or price point.

review_title: Goodbye dry skin! Hello glowy skin!
review_text: Love this moisturizer! I’ve used for over a week and my skin looks bright, glowy, feels smooth and moisturized! It smells like all their other honey products....I personally don’t mind that at all!

review_title: great for super dry sensitive skin
review_text: Thick feeling cream that surprisingly seeps into extremely dry sensitive skin with ease and no greasy after effect. Love this product and their night cream version honeymoon. This product may turn me it to a farmacy follower but will see after I use the full bottle!
When farmacybeauty gifts you #HoneyHalo and your skin glows more than golden hour ✨✨Love how my skin glows and is hydrated. This was gifted by Farmacy Beauty and will definitely purchase.

Just WOW!  This products has the most amazing texture ever!  I have acne prone skin and this came just in time as we transition from summer to fall. It is not too heavy at all despite it looking as it may be. It blends in and sinks in to the skin beautifully!  This has not caused any breakouts at all. And has helped keep my skin hydrated and happy!

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. This new launch has been absolutely amazing! This moisturizer has helped with my dry skin! While the formula is pretty rich, it is not oily or greasy!
The greatest moisturizer in history. Literally feels like heaven no words I am AMAZED it’s exactly what I was looking for!!!

The Farmacy Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Moisturizer is excellent for those with dry skin types as this moisturizer provides intense hydration to keep skin looking smooth & dewy! The cream is on the thicker side but massages into skin nicely for immediate hydration. Standout ingredients include antioxidant-rich buckwheat honey, fig fruit extract to plump skin, shea butter, vitamin E & plant-based ceramides to protect skin’s moisture barrier. I really love how this moisturizer feels on skin, it’s especially needed with the super dry weather we’ve been having in SoCal & would be a great winter moisturizer as well. It has a slight sweet, honey scent but is not overpowering. This is considered a Sephora clean beauty product with good-for-skin ingredients and also features eco-friendly packaging & is cruelty-free. Highly recommend!

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. If you have normal to dry skin this is a must have! This moisturizer is a luxurious cream feeling, extremely hydrating and it helps with plumping your skin. This moisturizer is supposed to help with fine lines and wrinkles so I enjoy the fact that it helps with anti-aging. I have had no reactions to the moisturizer and I tend to have normal to dry skin all year around as well as sensitivity.

I’ve been using this Honey Halo Moisturizer for weeks now. This moisturizer is very thick to the touch, smells like pure honey and a little of this product goes a long way.The packaging is great for those who worry sanitization as this comes with a metal spatula you can use to scoop out your moisturizer. The metal spatula is magnet for easy storage after using honey halo. I’ve found Honey Halo to be very nourishing, moisturizing to my skin and it has worked perfectly for my oily skin. It has helped combat my skin irritation along with dryness as the ceramides have improved my skin’s barrier which locks in the moisture. I personally love to use Honey Halo Moisturize at night time considering the thickness of the product, I’ve found that this moisturizer is extremely beneficial when applied at night. Also thank you to Farmacy for gifting this product to me to try out!

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. I have combination oily skin and I wasn’t sure how my skin would respond to this product. After using the product I am quite pleased with the results and the finish it leaves my skin. It’s very hydrating without leaving a greasy finish which I really appreciate being on the oily side in the warmer season. The packaging is to die for, I love every detail Farmacy put into this product the matte glass jar and the wooden accents of the lid are beautiful and I love that the lid is magnetic for the metal spatula. As far as the scent goes it definitely has a honey scent but I also get slight floral notes of jasmine maybe, I really like the smell of this product. Would I recommend this product? I definitely would!

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty, and I could totally see this becoming my winter favorite. It’s a very creamy, buttery formula, moisturizing without it being heavy. Love the consistency, the packaging, everything!!!

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. The application was smooth and creamy- melts right into your skin. I suffer from dry skin and since we are transitioning into the Fall season, this is perfect for the colder weather. I thought the packaging was everything!! You can tell a lot of thought and intention was put into creating this product.

I was gifted their new  Honey Halo Ultra-Hydrating Ceramide Moisturizer.  This moisturizer has a rich texture (but not so rich that it sits on the surface of the skin all day) and is perfect for winter months when is your skin is thirsty. They use Buckwheat Honey and Propolis blended with Royal Jelly along with Plant Ceramides, Shea Butter, Vitamin E and Fig fruit extract, which work together as humectants to help skin retain its’ moisture.  I felt the effects well into the mornings (used at night).  .The smell is light and disappeared quickly. And the scooper to get product out is always easy to find since the lid is actually magnetized and the scoop clings to the top of the lid. No more digging around looking for your scooper!  (Brilliant!). I used this more at night but for very dry skin, think it would work well under makeup.  .It’s also very soothing to the skin and I think this would be ideal for anyone who is sensitive too.  I used retinol and this really helped offset the flakes and sensitivity from that.  I feel hydrated, plump, and soothed!   I’ve found my winter skin saver!

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. Farmacy always kills it, and this product does not disappoint. It has the sublet smell of honey and is so creamy and dreamy. It really soothes my skin and makes it soooo soft!

review_title: Use at night, wear SPF during the day!
review_text: I do like this product, but I think the instructions should be changed to encourage people to use these at nighttime and/or follow with SPF. This is an exfoliant and should be used at nighttime; “once or twice daily“, to me, sounds like something you can include in your morning routine. That’s how I was using them back in 2018 and I used them every day - I wasn’t using SPF every day though and I actually developed a skin cancer lesion (basal cell carcinoma). I’m NOT blaming this product for my skin cancer, but I also don’t think it’s a coincidence that it showed up at around the time I was going really hard on these during my daytime routine and not using SPF. You live and you learn - it’s not a critique of the product but I hope folks reading the reviews will see this and decide to use this product in their evening routines + follow with a good sunscreen in the morning! The bottle comes with a self-loading dropper dispenser. When you open the bottle, it draws product up into the dropper. Every time you open the bottle, the product is ready to be dispensed. Great idea for the packaging. The product is not sticky and sinks into the skin quite quickly which I really liked. It seemed to provide an instant moisture boost. I did not have a problem wearing this under makeup as I do with some serums. This one soaked in and did not cause me to be oily at all. This product also decreased the texture in my skin quite a bit. It made my skin look hydrated and more smooth. I think this product overall made my skin look more vibrant and health. The only downfall I found with this product was that when I used it at night, it seemed to cause a slight breakout along my jawline area. To me, the one or two pimples it caused still did not outweight how good it made the rest of my skin look. I stopped applying it to that area at night and I stopped having problems. Pros - great packaging, soft skin, decreased texture in skin, and made my skin healthy. Con - slight breakout when wearing at night. I would recommend this product. I was excited to try this serum when I got a free sample from Influenster, but my heart sank when I got it and saw that Dimethicone is the main ingredient. This is a serum that is pretty much liquid silicone. I have acne/oily skin even though I’m in my late 50s. Suffered from cystic acne most of my life. While Dimethicone on its own doesn’t cause breakouts—it holds in moisture for people with dry skin—but also locks in oil. That leads to oil plugs and cysts for me. I tried the serum and my T-zone felt like rubber when combined with my breakthrough oil. I have a few wrinkles which are deeper rather than fine lines, and I tried targeting the serum on the wrinkles but saw no real effect on them. The serum isn’t strong enough to brighten or do much of anything on my oily skin. If your skin is dry with very fine surface lines, it might help, but it’s just not doing anything on my oily skin. I see better results on my texture using acid toners combined with an oil-free, silicone-free moisturizer.

review_title: APPLY ONLY TO DAMP, MOIST SKIN FOR BEST RESULTS!
review_text: I have dry mature skin, and moisture is the key to a youthful texture and tone to one’s skin. I believe in serums as I’ve used them for years. I highly recommend this serum! After reading some reviews it is noted that the product leaves skin dry and tight feeling, also that it may have a “peeling” property. I do know that with any serum one must apply sparingly to moist and damp skin for optimal absorption and results. Preferably after a gentle wash. Allow the product to be absorbed entirely (even dry) then apply a light moisturizer made for your skin type. I would be willing to bet that this serum doesn’t work well with SPF, so if you’re protecting in the day try using this serum at night under other serums and night creams without SPF. Used correctly you too can get some pretty amazing results!

I did not notice a significant difference in the crows feet that I have it they are fine. I love Clinique Moisturizers and this product  just left a little short for me to consider adding to my long term regime but it was decent.

The consistency of this product was my favorite. It feels really emollient and moisturizing, which is nice for a retinoid product. It isn’t a runny serum, it feels nourishing. Love this! Made my face feel so smooth and am happy with it!

review_text: I really wanted to love this and was so excited try it however im really not understanding what all amazing reviews are about.. this didn’t remove my make up very well at all and I followed the directions exactly and I dont use water proof or wear that much makeup.. just foundation concealer and mascara... no eyeliner or eye shadows... (not sure if you need to have warm hands to make this work better or not)  then I started massaging it all over my face starting with my cheeks and forehead and finished off with my eyes and made sure I went over them numberouse times until I felt my mascara was starting to clump off my lashes and then i added warm water while still gently massaging and then rinsed off completley but I was left with tons of makeup and black mascara all around my eye area..I looked like a raccoon so I dried my face and did the process all over again.. that helped a bit but I was still left with lots of makeup residue and needed to use my normal cleanser to get the rest off.. Wow! I love this cleanser. My skin has never looked so good. Works great on my sensitive skin.

review_title: Great Oil but Packaging Leaks Everywhere
review_text: I love this cleanser so much, but I do have one complaint regarding the price and packaging. I used to buy the smaller size of this, which, even though I had to buy it more often, it was more affordable for me to spend less money at once. It seemed that they got rid of the smaller size, which was a disappointment, so I bought the large size. This large size, the 5.1 oz, does not have very good packaging. Unlike the smaller size, this bottle leaks constantly. The oil just seeps out and gets all over the place, and is almost impossible to travel with. Even though I keep it in a closed ziplock all it doesn’t ruin everything, it’s very disappointing that so much of this expensive product is wasted from all of the leaking. It really makes me consider getting a different brand, even though I love this actual oil so much. Tatcha really needs to fix this packaging and also start offering the smaller size again.

this oil is HEAVEN lathered on your face! My first experience with it was just so nourishing and revitalizing to my face.I just this product everyday and my pores have been diminishing day by day, I absolutely love this product! I will be using it for years!
I saw Jackie AINA using this on her stories and I said WHY NOT let me give it a try and yup I love it. So smooth and a nice pre step to cleansing and cleaning the face. I love it.
Amazing! Works so well In removing all my make-up! Best cleanser I have ever used!

Furthermore, the ingredients don’t actually do much as skincare, so there really is no reason for this to be so pricey.

review_title: Best Oil Cleanser I've Ever Used- worth the money
review_text: This is without a doubt the best oil cleanser I have used. I’ve been trying out others at lower price points because I do use this daily and it would be nice to have something a bit more economical but thus far I have found nothing that compares to this. If you want to be able to take off your makeup without pulling or rubbing on your skin, this is THE move. I follow up with a gentle cleanser with a Clarisonic and my skin feels completely clean and soft, but not dried out or agitated. With most other high end skincare, I would say there are usually cheaper alternatives that work just as well, but Tatcha cannot be beat. There are other oil cleansers, but this is the best one I have tried to date.
