I was apprehensive about replacing my Take the Day off until I got a sample of this Tatcha One Step Camellia Oil Cleanser. I was apprehensive of a cleanser with the word oil in the title because I have combination skin, but I’m a convert. It removes makeup so well that it really is a one step product. I use one pump if I’m not wearing much makeup, two if I have on mascara and eyeshadow. It is a very gentle cleanser and leaves skin soft and smells fantastic. I usually follow with Tatcha Rice Polish in Classic or Deep Clean depending on the season. I would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a good makeup remover and/or cleanser.

review_title: Love for my dry sensitive red head skin!
review_text: Let me tell you a secret, I never actively washed my face before this product, not consistently. The few times I attempted I would break out, have my skin stripped, wind up with chemical burns, or all of the above. This is the very first thing I have tried that actually takes off EVERY OUNCE of full glam makeup and keeps my skin clear and hydrated. My husband even commented within 3 days of use that my skin looked brighter than usual.

literally the best product for removing makeup and for daily cleansing. It’s so gentle and you can put it right in top of your eyes without them burning. My skin leans towards the sensitive side and this never irritates it. Also I feel like it lasts a long time. Other makeup removers claim to be gentle but they’re really not. I love it
I used to love this cleanser. It’s still great, but I now prefer the Farmacy solid cleanser. I feel like the Farmacy one takes everything off, while this oil leaves makeup on my skin after washing.

beautiful cleansing oil.  This is a luxurious feeling product.  But the price!! I just can’t justify it unless I’m ready for a splurge.  I found I had to use a fair amount of product for cleansing so the fact that it doesn’t last long also makes the price a little harder to take.  However it is one of the nicest first cleanse products I’ve tried.  I love oils and balms for removing makeup and this one works really well.

Love love love this oil cleanser! It takes off all makeup/residue without a problem. Doesn’t dry out my face! One pump is good for my whole face. I love how it also comes in a travel size which I take with me on trips!

The scent of this product is really natural, and I can’t imagine it really be strong enough to really bother anyone. It really does melt off any base makeup and even your eyeliner if you rub it in well, but it will not take off your mascara. It’ll try... but will not succeed. Other than that, no complaints. It really didn’t change anything immensely in terms of my skin texture, pores, acne, or any of that. But it doesn’t cause further breakouts, which is a plus.

Just gotta add to the amazing reviews of this product. I’ve never used an oil cleanser before but days after have gotten compliments on my skin. I bought this in a sampler package and will definitely be repurchasing.

I don’t often wear makeup (although when I do, this works like a dream) and it does a great job of keeping my face clean and clear. I don’t usually use oil based cleansers, but I decided to give this one a try and loved it. No harsh odors and no unnecessary dyes. This is a great, lightweight, clean product!
This has become my go to makeup remover! It’s very gentle and moisturizing on the skin. Also removed every stitch of makeup no problem!
I wear heavy makeup at LEAST 5 days a week and this completely melts all my makeup away from lash glue to a deep lipstick color. This is definitely one of my all time favorites!

I’m amazed at how easily and effectively this takes off makeup, even mascara. I just massage two or three pumps onto my face and once I wash it off, my face is absolutely clean and bright. Simple as that. Once again, tatcha delivers.
Easily removes makeup and cleanses my face! I have very dry and sensitive skin and this has never caused me any problems. Love the light scent!
Amazing makeup remover cleanser but too oily for my combination skin. My skin broke out after about 3 days of using product. But seriously a great makeup remover.

review_title: The only makeup remover you’ll ever need!
review_text: This product is amazing! Takes off all makeup, even waterproof makeup. Its so gentle, doesn’t burn eyes, and I even use it on my 8 year old to take off her dance makeup. It even removes eyelash glue easily. It’s the BEST!!!

so so good. i have super sensitive skin and i was afraid this was going to break me out but so far so good. ive been using for three months and my skin feels so great. i probably will never go back to a regular cleanser to be honest - i used to use cerave. love tatcha products and this one is another winner!

This is so good, probably the best and I’ve tried a lot of oil cleansers. I’ve probably repurchased this like 10 tomes, if not more. even when I go to try out a new cleanser I always end up coming back to this. I use it before the tatcha deep cleanse to help break up and remove my makeup and it does such a good job. you only need a couple pumps and it even breaks down my eye makeup without issue. has a nice scent, does irritate my skind and leaves it feeling soft. would recommend this to people who like double cleansing. or just oil cleansing in general
One of the best cleansers I have used.  It removes all types of makeup one can imagine.  Leaves my skin soft and glowing.  It costs more than I would like but it does go s long way.

review_title: Takes off EVERYTHING, leaves skin hydrated
review_text: Takes off ALL makeup and somehow leaves your skin feeling clean but soft and hydrated at the same time. Expensive, but it’s a large bottle that lasts a while if you just use one pump per use. Will never use another cleanser again. Completely hooked.

I never never usually write reviews for products, but this cleansing oil is AMAZING and is my new holy grail cleanser! I wear waterproof mascara and have a hard time finding a product that is gentle, takes it all off, is easy to use. Plus, it is made with natural ingredients – super bonus! Prior to finding this cleanser I was either scrubbing my eye area (ouch) with other different cleansers I had at the time or I was using an oil (like almond oil) to lift the waterproof mascara and then washing that off with my cleanser. The whole process was more time consuming than I like, I ended up using a lot of water, and was scrubbing my eyes more than I wanted to have to. With Tatcha Camellia oil cleanser I love that you start with a dry face and can just massage the oil in. It has a very light, pleasant smell. Then the best part is that is washes off really easily and quickly leaving your face feeling moisturized, but not greasy at all. I then usually just follow with a toner and a light moisturizer. It is perfection and makes my routine so much faster. And it literally gets every bit of makeup (waterproof mascara included) off without harsh scrubbing which feels like a miracle! Even though it is way pricier than I would ever normally pay for a cleanser a tiny bit goes a long way and it is seriously the best cleanser!
I got this as a deluxe sample. Very underwhelming. It’s ok for a morning cleanser when there is nothing on your face, but if you are wearing even a little makeup it does nothing to take that off.

I’ve been using this for over a week now and I love it. I do a 2 step cleanse and this oil is amazing for removing all my makeup but also for cleaning a naked face. It smells lovely, fresh, and natural, it rinses beautifully, and my skin is left soft and comfortable after. My skin is combo, and can be reactive to harsh or heavy products. This isn’t one of those. It’s gentle and effective and doesn’t bother my skin one bit.

review_title: Great but not the only option
review_text: I wish I could give this a 3.75. Better than 3 and not a 4. This is a really nice product, it has skin softening effects, and does not irritate my skin. However, I think you can find another quality oil cleanser for a lower price tag. The next oil cleanser I’ll try is Glow Recipe Blueberry Bounce.

I was skeptical about this at first, it is so different than any other face wash I have used before. But I am hooked. I especially love to use this after work when I am taking my makeup off. Before I started using this, I would wash my face and still have makeup left on my skin and dripping into my eye during a workout. But this stuff seriously cleans my face and leaves my skin so soft and bright. It’s amazing!

review_title: the ONLY cleanser you’ll ever need!
review_text: Honest to God the best cleanser I have ever used!! I was a bit weary of an oil cleanser because I have acne prone skin but this is amazing! I would always have residue of makeup left on my skin with other makeup removing cleansers but not this bad boy! It takes off waterproof mascara like a dream and it’s pricey but you’ll love it! Start with the mini and you’ll be amazed
Love this cleanser. It’s gentle and takes off makeup and leaves my skin soft. Make sure your skin is dry when you apply the oil.

One of my favorite things about all of Tatcha’s products are the scents in the products; nothing heavy and perfumey, but smells so delightful, luxurious and relaxing! this product is amazing, put it on a dry face with full make up and watch your makeup wipe away. This leaves my skin feeling clean, smooth, and fresh. My new cleanser!

i am OBSESSED - i have combination skin that veers slightly oily and this takes off all my makeup, leaves my skin super-soft, and also smells really good (similar to other tatcha products). i like to double cleanse with this followed by drunk elephant jelly cleanser, but i’ll even use it in the morning when i ~technically~ don’t have to because i love the way it makes my skin feel.

review_title: Look forward to using this at night
review_text: Soft silky oil that turns into a milky broth to remove makeup and sunscreen without pulling or tugging.

I adore this cleanser! Tatcha can do no wrong. I use it to remove my makeup. Not only does it melt away full coverage foundation, it works on waterproof eye products as well. It has helped to calm my skin and make it look great!

I tried this once, it was a free sample that came with my order. I was a little nervous because it’s really an oil and u dont do good with oils... but I just say..THIS STUFF IS AMAZING! seriously it was effortless taking off my makeup and stubborn eye make up. Like shiz biz man... it smells amazing to!
leaves your skin soft and silky

I think I might be the odd one out but I do not like this product. I find that the cleanser is breaking me out when I use it on its own. I have oil cleansed for years and this is just not as good as some traditional oils I have used for much cheaper.

This product is AMAZING! It’s the first make-up remover that I’ve ever used that completely removes my mascara. I also love the way my skin feels after I clean my face with this. It also shrinks the pores that I have on my nose. Totally worth the money.
Does what it’s supposed to do, gets all of my makeup off. ALL of it! I also enjoy using it if I’m having a day where my face just feels dirty from the environment without makeup on.

First off, I bought this cleanser in a time where my skin was an absolute mess. I had been in between products and had spent months trying everything. My skin was red, patchy, acne, and dry. I bought the discovery kit at Sephora and it was the best decision I ever made. I will never use another brand. My skin is very sensitive, dry, but also acne prone, so I struggle finding things that will be gentle enough and moisturizing enough for my skin type but that also won’t break me out. This cleanser is absolutely amazing. Within 2 days my skin was soft, no longer red and patchy and it even improved my acne!! I know oil cleanser sounds scary for acne prone types but this cleanser leaves no residue whatsoever and actually leaves your skin clean, unlike other gentle/sensitive cleansers. In addition, the smell of it is to die for and I am anxiously waiting for Tatcha to come out with a natural perfume based on camellia (hint hint). Moral of the story: You must try this cleanser! You won’t be disappointed!!!

I have normal skin. I use this to clean the makeup from my face  each night before using my exfoliating cleanser. It gets my skin nice and clean while soothing and hydrating. I have seen an improvement in my skin texture and brightness since using (about a month).
This is a great cleanser, I use it with the rice enzyme powder too. Great line of products!

TATCHA OIL CLEANSER REVIEW I have combo skin and I’ve been battling some dry flaky patch along my jaw line for a couple of months, I’ve exfoliated, moisturized, masked and nothing seemed to work. Then I picked this cleansing oil couple of days ago using my Rouge discount. When I used this oil to clean my face...low and behold my dry skin seemed to be gone, it feels soft & moisturized and it’s barely there. I’m so happy. I will sure be buying this over again when I ran out. Thank you Tacha for this amazing oil cleanser.
So refreshing and doesn’t hurt my eyes at all!!! Don’t need a rough cloth and it comes off like a dream with some water!!!
I thought this would be too oily but it leaves my skin clean. Not oily and not dry. Haven’t caused any breakouts either.
My skin looks better when I use this as part of a double cleanse. I love it.
Simply amazing. Must try for everyone!

I got this after hearing amazing things and my current cleansing oil was almost gone, I don’t regret buying it but I also won’t buy it again. It doesn’t remove make-up that well, I still have to go in with something else to remove my make-up (and I don’t where that much makeup)

This is the best makeup remover and cleanser EVERThis is my second bottle and omg It’s so good It’s great for those thick mascaras that don’t want to come off In general it’s greatYou don’t even need the wipes when you have this oil, I don’t recall when was the last time I used a makeup removal wipe after I started using this oil

I bought this based on the great reviews and was excited to use a natural cleanser.  Unfortunately it did not work for my combo/ dry skin.  It completely stripped my skin of any natural oils and it took me almost 2 weeks to get it back to normal.  I used it in conjunction with other TATCHA products, so I think the line isn’t fantastic for dry, winter skin.  I would definitely recommend for normal or oily skin because the consistency and ability to remove makeup is fantastic.

review_title: oil cleanser for the oily skin win!
review_text: I was skeptical about an oil cleanser as my face is oily but the Camellia Cleansing Oil has made a believer out of me. I’ve read several reviews that it doesn’t remove waterproof mascara but I must disagree. This works great for removing all my makeup, including my waterproof mascara.I use two pumps on dry hands and apply to my dry face and massage. At first my skepticism had me scrubbing pretty hard when it came to my eyes (waterproof mascara is typically AWFUL to try to remove) but gentle circular motions work great!! The oil washes off effortlessly, turning into a milk like liquid, and doesn’t leave a film or oily residue behind. This is great as I wear contacts and sometimes do not take them out prior. Should I get some on my lens it’s easily cleaned with contact solution.Finally, follow up with the cleansing rice powder and your skin will feel squeaky clean, without feeling dry, and ready for your skincare. ❤️
This is my favorite cleanser! Not only does it take every speck of makeup off my face, it also leaves my skin feeling clean and hydrated. Also it’s cruelty free!

I love the mild smell and it does remove all your foundation and makeup. I do use a micellar water beforehand to remove stubborn eye makeup. It’s a great cleansing oil and only need 2-3 pumps for the whole face.  I would definitely get again.

Absolutely love this to remove my makeup. It makes my skin feel so soft without leaving any residue behind. I’ve tried so many different oils to remove my makeup but this is by far the best. It’s says it’s a one step for everything however I still wash my face after if I’m wearing makeup. On the days I don’t wear makeup I only use this to wash my face. I will definitely be buying another bottle after this one is gone.

I first started using this cleansing oil a few years ago and I haven’t turned back sense. My skin is sensitive. It seems like everything makes my skin red. This tatcha oil cleanser has helped get my face clean and has helped calm my skin better than anything else. Plus, it doesnt leave my face feeling dry or tight. I have recommended this to everyone. I give it a four star because it doesn’t completely remove my mascara.

I ordered a trial size of the pure one step Camellia Cleansing oil. And It does such a good job at taking off my make up, and leaves my skin so soft, even when I’m not wearing make up i still use it in my nightly routine and it’s the holy grail really. I highly recommend it

Sensite, dry, ALL skin beware. I am an avid Sephora shopper and I have never felt such a way about a product that I had to take to the review section. I tried this during an age defying skin care class at Sephora and my skin has been covered with tiny bumps across my chin and cheeks. I have incredibly soft, smooth clear skin. I have tried a number of products throughout the years and I have never had this reaction to any product ever. I wish I would have read the other reviews of users having adverse reactions before trying this along with the violet mask. Honestly, what it does to your skin is depressing and the thought that this may take weeks to clear up is absolutely awful. I do hope that Sephora does not filter this review to the bottom. Hopefully this spares somebody.
This stuff is amazing and has done wonders for my skin. It’s so gentle yet so affective! Not a trace of makeup left no matter how much you may cake it on.

I purchased this after my dry skin was screaming for help (sub zero temps for a week). I use this as a morning cleanse and sometimes as a second evening cleanse. It leaves my skin feeling soft, not tight and my sensitive skin has not reacted. I absolutely love it
At first I was hesitant, but now I love this product and how it takes all the make up off!

Love love love it! I had been using Argan Oil for years but have been looking for something lighter. This cleansing oil blew me away! It takes off all makeup, my skin feels clean and doesn’t feel stripped or dry. This product line is amazing!

review_title: Nice oil, but it is hard to avoid the eyes
review_text: This came recommended from a YouTube channel, and at first I loved it, but using more than a couple of times, it burned my eyes, and was not a pleasant as when first using.

The cleansing oil removes my eye makeup very well, and does not leave an oily feeling on the my eyes.  I really like the Tatcha products but so expensive.  Would recommend if you wish to pay the price.  There must be a similar but cheaper product

review_title: feels like your spreading cooking oil on your face
review_text: Tried this in the store as well as a few samples. This product feels extremely weird and my skin does not do good with oil cleansers at all. It felt heavy and greasy on my skin and when I rinsed it off my skin felt weird and greasy.

Works, but it’s not the best, at least not for dry skin, it takes away the natural oils so you’ll fell like putting something inmeditaly after cleaning (which isn’t a good sign and means it dries even more) it smells strongly and not too good, but it’s not bad, it does the job, just doesn’t do wonders. Wouldn’t recommend it for the day, it’s too greasy and there are better oil cleansers for the same or less price.

I’m not sure how to describe the feeling I get when I use this product; it feels rich and luxe and like it should be more expensive than it is (and it’s relatively expensive as is). I typically use this as a second cleanse in the evening after my Clinique TTDO cleansing balm and it now takes me forever to get ready for bed because I just keep rubbing this stuff all over my face and don’t want to stop. If I’ve had a particularly sweaty workout, I’ll use this to wash my face in the morning instead of the Bioderma micellar water; I have dry, somewhat sensitive skin and this just makes it feel soothed and calm. It’s a clear oil, not thick or sticky but not too thin and watery either. The packaging is not as nice as the travel sized one, but it is sturdy and I have not had any issues with it breaking or malfunctioning. It just feels amazing and leaves my skin feeling amazing as well. It’s a no-brainer for me.

I swear by this product. I once got the small tester size and it cleaned my skin so well. I use it to take off my makeup and it has helped clear my skin so much. It works great and doesn’t burn your eyes if you’re sensitive to that.

Love love love this cleansing oil. It removes all traces of makeup without leaving your skin dry. I have used it for 6 months now, I constantly get compliments about how smooth my skin is when I wear and don’t wear makeup.

It’s good, not great. A little does not go a long way, although when I use up a lot it does seem to remove all my make-up and leave my face clean. It hasn’t done a whole lot to stop my face from dehydrating. It’s a good product, but I think I’ll be testing other options before re-purchasing. I appreciate the company philosophy though.
I don’t know why I took so long to try this.  My face is much clearer and not as dry.  Love it.

review_title: Don’t notice any difference but nice cream
review_text: This is very pricey and I’ve noticed no difference after weeks of use. I’ll keep using it… and make it last.

I got two of these as sample sizes/minis or whatever and I’ve been using for about 5 days now and wow. I notice a difference already! I’ve never seen results before especially this quick!! I’m going to sadly have to buy the full size even though it’s so expensive
I see zero improvement on my fine lines. I’ve used other eye creams that work great but they are on a pricier side. I guess I shouldn’t switch.
I really like the triple algae eye renewal balm with multi peptide complex

ALGENIST TRIPLE ALGAE EYE RENEWAL BALM helps with my dark circles and fine lines. It also gets rid of fine lines, wrinkles, and puffiness. It has a lightweight formula that hydrates my skin. I put this balm every morning as my normal skincare routine. My eyes looks smoother and brighter thanks to this product. I highly recommend it to everyone
I received this product as a free sample but it works great! I saw a difference in two days and I struggle really bad with under eyes bags and dark circles.

I received a sampler kit of Algenist Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm from PinchMe. It was a set of 20 single-use packets, so I can’t review the jar component. I used one packet each at day & night, per the instructions included in my kit. This is definitely a heavier balm, vs the eye creams I usually use. It didn’t interfere with any of my other skincare or makeup products, but if you heavily use product around the eye area, this balm might be too thick. It did feel very soothing on my skin. I did not notice any added fragrance in the product. I would consider purchasing this again, but I would probably want to use it solely as a night cream, using a lighter cream or gel for my day routine.
The texture of the product was amazing however even after using it for 10 days I did not notice a bit of difference it could be because my under eye issues are extremely serious.

review_title: Pricey but perhaps promising for long term use
review_text: Used the Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm with Multi-Peptide Complex for about 12 nights continuously under my eyes. I’m 30 and have one deep wrinkle under each eye. To me it seemed like by the end of my trail with the product, the lines looked a bit more blurry, but I’m not entirely sure. I wonder if the results would be more clear if I used it for a much longer period. I didn’t notice a scent, which was nice. The biggest con to me is the steep price point.

I’m really satisfied with the results I received since trying this Algenist Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm for 10 consecutive day’s! I had the best results with this product, out of all the eye balm products I have used thus far! The cream glides across my skin easily and soaks into my skin fairly quickly without leaving any greasy residues behind and leaves the eye area looking brightened, nourished, smoothed, and hydrated. A small amount goes a long ways, It’s really gentle without giving me any irritation, and doesn’t have a strong chemical or perfume scent. I have also noticed my concealer makeup aplies well after applying this eye balm with a smoother application. Overall, it’s an amazing luxurious eye balm that makes my eye area feel and look healthier and I would highly recommend it.

I love the way this product makes my eyes look!  It helped my skin look more refreshed and minimized my fine lines.   It was so smooth and makes my skin feel hydrated.  I think it made my dark circles less apparent too! My eyes feel better and I find I rub them less with this product.
I’ve been using this eye cream almost every night. I really love it! It is super moisturizing. It’s not sticky, either. I really think I’d buy this product.

The Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm with Multi-Peptide Complex has blown me away with its advanced formula. I’m showing a lot more aging, so I gave the Algenist Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm with Multi-Peptide Complex a whirl. I have been presently surprised by how much of an impact the Algenst eye balm has done on me. I love that it has a beautiful mix of Triple Algae (Red, Brown, and Green). The algae mix has helped my eyes to appear firmer and smoother. I’m looking and feeling much more confident, thanks to Algenist. I was fortunate enough to have received a free product from PINCHme
Triple Algenist Eye Renewal Balm works great! Noticed a firmer and less puffy eye area! Also fine lines were diminished!

I loved using the Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm. I have very thin skin with puffy bags under my eyes and sometime they are a purple color.  I seen a slight improvement  over the days using this product twice a day.  Morning and evening.  I will have to use it longer then the samples they sent me to see for sure if it will improve it but for as long as I used it I think it’s working.  It also feels amazing on.  You just use a little dap of it around your eyes.  It melts into your skin.

I’ve been trying different brands of eye creams and this Algenist Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm with Multi-Peptide Complex felt really nice but I couldn’t tell if it made a difference. I have dark under eyes from insomnia and lash growth serum so I was hoping this eye cream would make my dark bags disappear. It might be too early to tell yet since I haven’t been using it for that long. I’m going to keep using it because I like how it feels.

I received the Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm as a free sample, and I am so glad I did!!! This cream is incredible! Thick and indulgent, smells good, and it smooths on so easily. I used it under my eyes (bags area), below my brow bone, and where the crow’s feet start... I saw a difference in the Lil crow’s feet I am developing too! Plumped them up just right! I will be buying this cream, I am very happy with the results.

I received Algenist Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm with Multi-Peptide Complex as a free sample. The product truly delivered on what it was selling; it reduced the appearance of my lines/wrinkles, helped with my dark circles, and my skin appeared firmer and smoother. Worth the price!

review_title: ALGENIST TRIPLE ALGAE EYE RENEWAL BALM
review_text: I’ve used some other Algerian products and I really like the brand. I’ve been using the ALGENIST TRIPLE ALGAE EYE RENEWAL BALM for the last month and I definitely see a difference in the under eye wrinkles! My eyes were less puffy, well hydrated with less visible lines around the eyes. I can say this is a great product and I will continue to use it.

Overall this eye balm was outstanding!! I incorporated this into my nightly routine and favorite aspect was how hydrated my under eye area was in the morning! It wasn’t too heavy which is something I look for in an eye cream and there was a noticeable difference pretty early in.

I received this wonderful Algenist Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm, I liked its texture, it is creamy and absorbs quickly, it leaves a light, restful and fresh sensation almost immediately, it is not greasy, it spreads easily.
This produce was GREAT!! It went on smoothly and actually showed the results I was looking for!!

I’ve always been a fan of Algenist products and this was no different. It seemed to lighten the darker circles underneath and left me feeling smooth. It soaked in and didn’t leave a greasy feeling either. Smells great, works great, it’s a keeper!

I love the triple algae eye renewal balm with multipeptide complex by algenist! This is a fantastic eye cream brightening up my dark circles- not just under eye, smoothing and hydrating my fine lines and even lifting and tightening my sagging upper lid. I will be looking forward to purchasing this in the future.
I received ALGENIST TRIPLE ALGAE EYE RENEWAL BALM to sample and I love it!
I really like how this cream moisturizes the skin around the eyes, it is not greasy, it is quickly absorbed, it is ideal as a base for make-up.
I received this as a free sample from PinchMe. I liked the product as it was moisturizing and made my under eye area look fresh. I will probably buy in the future as I was satisfied with the results.

I have enjoyed using this product for the past month or so. I am not sure if I can tell an immediate difference in my fine lines around my eyes but it does feel luxurious and substantial while I am applying -- like it is locking in moisture and protecting my delicate eye skin. I have used morning and night, and I don’t find it to pill under makeup like some creams can. The smell is a bit odd but it kind of smells like it must work -- it is not perfumed and smells like useful ingredients. I do not have heavy bags or dark circles so I cannot speak to how this works for those concerns but if you are looking for something hydrating and balanced for delicate skin, this fits the bill. It was my first product from Algenist and I now trust the brand to provide what it claims to provide.

I received a couple of samples of this eye cream and I had honestly never tried anything from the brand and I must admit that I did like it. It seems a bit pricey personally for me but a little goes a long way and it would last a good while so I would say I can justify the price. It is a balmy texture and sinks right into the skin without feeling sticky or bothersome around the eye area. Keeps the area moisturized and has helped a bit with fine lines.

I received this as a free sample from pinch me. I was Very impressed! I absolutely love algenist triple algae eye renewal balm!!! I can already see a difference.  I also like the container. I love how easy it is to use and how it feels on my skin. It’s not nasty or “greasy” like a lot of products from other brands.
It’s wonderful.  Very nourishing but don’t leave any greasy feeling to skin after use.
This was brightened my eyes and helped with wrinkles and dark circles.

Received this eye cream complimentary from Algerian. I love it so much. I feel like my eyes aren’t as puffy and they are definitely hydrated. I also see a difference with my fine lines. I would recommend this product.

review_title: Improved the look of dark circles.
review_text: I tried Algenist Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm with high hopes. I’ve always had dark circle even as a child. I like the ingredients and the moisture this product provides. I think I noticed a slight improvement,  but I think it’s too soon to tell. I will keep using Algenist and hope to continue seeing even more improvement over time.

review_title: Very smooth and notice a difference
review_text: This balm is very hydrating and easy to use. I noticed a difference in the softness of my lines and my eyes felt hydrated in the morning.

I naturally have paler and thinner skin on my face; and I deal with higher levels on inflammation than your average person. So I often get a “redness stache“ that surrounds my nose, upper lip and chin area. And it can get very distinct and there are weird cut-off areas where my skin will be spared from the redness. It’s definitely due to how my capillaries are formed; my skin type & my inflammation. Even THAT calms down noticeably after using this; and I didn’t have to sit in a mirror and think hard about it to deduce that. It also will help calm the anger in any active breakouts & reduce the redness in healing inflamed acne scars. I have been using this along with some other great skin products so I can’t contribute my lack of active surface acne to just this- but it’s definitely played a huge part in adding a penetrating bounce to my skin and giving it even & ethereal “milky“ complexion. As someone who’s oil production naturally alternates from being on slight overdrive to super overdrive; I feel like this alone encourages my oil glands to back down a little bit as well. I LOVE how you don’t have to rinse it off and I love how the impact of the anti-inflammatory effects don’t just last an hour or 2 like some other products with a similar aim. If you give it enough time between waking up & makeup application; it won’t pill under your makeup- at least it hasn’t for me and I like to play with multiple different formulations of primers etc. It’s just thick enough to give dry skin instant relief yet it’s very emollient so a little goes a long way; even on skin I’ve just toned with a generous application of a powerful Glycolic & Lactic Citrus toner. review_title: First Face Oil That's Worked for Me
review_text: I have combination skin and have shied away from using face oils in the past. I received a sample of this product and used it up before I saw any results. The fragrance (and there is a fragrance) and the feel were so luxurious, however, that I decided to take the plunge on the full purchase. This is not as “slippery“ as many other oils (not for gua sha or face rolling IMHO), but when pressed into the skin, it really feels like it fills in every nook and cranny. I have also mixed it with moisturizers to save on time. My results have been positive. After several weeks of use, my skin texture is soft and glowing. Frankly, the best I look all day is when I first wake up in the morning. For those wanting to try this product, I highly recommend trying a sample first. The oils and fragrance could easily cause problems. I also once used this product after overexfoliating with chemicals and it caused severe irritation and redness. For anyone with damaged skin barriers or extremely sensitive skin, this may not be the product for you. For everyone else, I think it’s a lovely addition.

A little goes a long way with this one. Feels great on your neck and décolletage area as well. I wake up with soft, plump skin. After about a week of using it nightly I started receiving compliments on my skin.

I wouldn’t apply directly under the eyes or on eye bags. Age 59.

review_title: Smells DISGUSTING, But is a Miracle Product
review_text: The smell is horrible. And it took a while for me to be able to tolerate the smell. However, once you can get past the horrible lavender smell this stuff is a miracle oil. Everyone I know has raved about this product for years, and I received a free sample and I figured I would try it out, and I liked the results from the week the sample lasted so I decided to invest in a whole bottle of it. I have been using it for around 3 months now! I have an almost natural redness to my skin that I have always associated with having very sensitive skin. Like washing my face with just water will make my face red. Even with like the gentle dermatologist recommended CeraVe face wash, my face is red for like 15 minutes afterwards. I have noticed with continued use of this MRC that my face is much less red and irritated by other products. I love that when I wake up my face is even toned and glow-y. My skin is very dry in the winter, and this has helped prevent and get rid of all of my dry patches. I have used MNR for a few years and I do love it. It is packed with nourishing and hydrating ingredients (squalane, an oil known for its intense hydrating and anti aging benefits, it the top ingredient). That said, it is not a cure all. The reviews regarding breakout, I’d like to address. 1. You cannot claim breakout results from one day2. Yes, if sensitive you can breakout just by changing products - so it wouldn’t necessarily be the product but the change in your skin chemistry. 3. You absolutely must exfoliate! The beautiful lavender oil and other oils used in conjunction with squalane could clog pores if you are not cleansing properly and doing at the very least a mild scrub once a week. Breakouts tends to be an issue of an over production of oils and over production of your skin cell turnover (I.e new skin cells). Just a few things to keep in mind. If your looking for a nourishing, moisturizing serum to make you skin velvety soft - this is a great candidate.

This did nothing for my skin. I’ve used many retinol products.  This one was like putting nothing on my face.

review_title: Works for my oily, acne-prone, aging skin!
review_text: I have oily, acne-prone skin. Been battling acne and oil since I was 14. I’m in my early 40’s and only in recent years have I managed to keep my problematic skin somewhat manageable. After about a month of using this sorbet – enough time for me to know if it will react to my skin, I know this will work for my skin type. I have NOT broken out at all. No surprise purging, no breakouts or little pimples. My skin is liking this sorbet a lot. I know it is a good product for my skin type because my skin is looking much more balanced and has started to “heal.” Marked redness from my blemishes and acne scars are fading. My skin is looking much healthier in terms of clarity, my pores aren’t congested, I don’t have the usually expected breakouts, and there’s almost an inner glow happening.Because of my problem skin, I always needed to exfoliate chemically with glycolic acid almost every night to keep my skin smooth and cell turnover happening. But now, I especially notice that when I take off my makeup at the end of a long day, my face does not feel rough or congested anymore. It has started to feel smoother to the touch, the roughness isn’t there anymore, and overall my skin looks so much better. My last breakout was one small pimple on my chin during my time of the month. This is the only product I’ve changed in my routine, and my skin texture, redness, clarity and overall skin condition has improved significantly.Now that I’m older, I’m needing to battle the ongoing wars between hormonal changes, and finding skincare that addresses oily, acne and aging skin. I’m very careful of what I put on my face because I’ve tried everything. I tend to stay away from most moisturizers because my skin is already so oily and sensitive. There always might be a product that works better over another. BUT, though this sorbet might not work for everyone, it is working for me. This sorbet, quite surprisingly, has slowly won my skeptical heart over.

This toner completely changed my skin. I have oily skin and it reduced breakouts, noticeably reduced the size of my pores on my nose, and all over smoothed my complexion. I’m about to buy my third bottle in a row!
Like many others, I tried this toner after Desi Perkins raved about it and have liked the results. My skin isn’t as oily but it also doesn’t feel dried out.
Really great moisturizer for my oily t zone. It does dry out less oily areas like mouth area and under my eyes at night. Great for day time use though! Wasn’t dabbing my forehead throughout the day.

This truly helped transform my skin. I’ve always struggled with acne and this has helped clear so much of the uneven texture and discoloration. I wanted to give it a 5 star but it leaves a sticky residue. Other than that I sincerely recommend this to anyone who’s looking for a toner to clear and even out the texture of the skin!! (:
Seen a visible difference instantly and with continued use! This is a staple skin care product for me. Removes extra makeup, helps with oil control, refines, exfoliates! Love this!

review_title: my favorite and I’ve tried a lot
review_text: Ole Henriksen products were some of the first skincare products I bought at Sephora almost a decade ago. I’m a serial product hopper but recently have cycled back to the brand. And oh my gosh, after revisiting their toner this will be a staple of my skincare regimen. It has a refreshing cooling sensation and adequately preps my skin for my remaining skincare. I can’t credit all of my skin improvements to this product but it definitely works synergistically with my other products to give me the best skin I’ve had in years. Also if you like this you will love the sauna scrub in the green bottle from ole too!!

If you haven’t tried this, run to the store and get it ASAP. Clears breakouts, prevents oily skin but also works with my dry/combo skin. Removes so much excess dirt and makeup even after I use a remover and cleanser. It’s amazing, I had no idea I had so much leftover on my face. Feels super refreshing as well. Must have!

I have sensitive skin with some redness so I was kind of nervous purchasing this product as some reviewers said it caused breakouts for their sensitive skin.  Since it started getting humid and hot, my forehead, nose, and the area around nose became super, super, super oily.  I’ve been using it for a few days now, no breakouts and no oil!  I only apply the toner to the oily areas, not all over my entire face.  Def would purchase again !!

review_title: love this! and this product line!
review_text: I normally never used to use a Toner because I felt like they dried my skin or made it feel like it was burning for a bit until my face calmed down, but this stuff is truly amazing! I’m really enjoying it!

Let me start off by saying I was really really hoping I wouldn’t like this toner. I’ve been using The Ordinary’s Glycolic Acid toner for a while now and love it. It’s cheap, effective, and comes in a fairly large size. So, I didn’t want to love something that was 3-4 times more expensive.With that being said I gave into the hype and tried it out and man it’s amazing. I feel like it honestly controls my oils. I’m naturally really oily and have consistently moisturized and hydrated my skin while alternating between hydrating masks and clay masks. It’s a constant battle between cleaning my pores while strengthening my skins moisture barrier. I felt like I reached a plateau but I was wrong. I noticed my texture and oils were waaay better after incorporating this into my skincare routine. It was the only thing I switched up and I tried it for a few weeks.It leaves my face feeling super cool, like a minty feeling almost so there’s no prominent itchiness. At first it made me feel like that meant it wasn’t working and the chemical exfoliant wasn’t strong enough, but my skin has never been better. I still get acne during that time of the month (I don’t think anything can prevent that honestly) but I noticed that this time around my pimples are a lot smaller and don’t get as angry looking.
not impressed. really wanted to like this product because of all the positive reviews but i felt like it didn’t do anything for my face. i did like how the toner had a cooling effect on my skin

This stuff worked really well in the beginning but once I reached half of the bottle, I noticed this product dried my face. I started getting small red bumps and itchy irritation. I know it was this product because I skipped one night without it and my face was so plump and moist the next morning.

I love this! I’m almost 30 and I always have breakouts around the forehead embarrassingly enough. I was desperate to find something that could help me out and after hearing Desi Perkins gave about this multiple times, I decided to give this a try. My face feels clean & refreshed after I use this and I absolutely love the smell, reminds me of the spa.I feel like it does a nice job of my oilyness under control and I haven’t had one breakout since I’ve been using it (it’s been 3 weeks and I always use it before bed). 100% worth the money!

I have tried so many mattifying moisturizers, primers, foundations, powders, serums, i mean you NAME IT! This is the FIRST product that actually leaves my skin MATTE. I mean it is a toner and I never thought it could do that! I am blown away and praying that this products stays forever. My new holy grail! I need to buy backups on backups.

I definitely like this toner, it helped with my blemishes. I used it mornings and nights, I was disappointed that it did not help with my oiliness like it claimed it would. Definitely moving on to a different toner.
I have very oily sensative skin and acnee this Product have been so great for my skin love IT.

review_title: Stings a little but SMOOTHS skin
review_text: I originally purchased this because of Desi Perkins. She has combo skin and she swears by this. A lot of the claims are like “takes off excess dirt, excess makeup, shrinks pores“. On my cotton pad, I don’t see any dirt but it honestly must get out dirt because before I started using this, I had bumps under my skin probably from built up pore gunk. After just 3 days of using it, the built up gunk (white heads?) on my chin area left, around my face is gone. Like my skin is SO SMOOTH. The one thing I didn’t expect though was for this toner to smell like and feel (sting) like diluted tea tree oil. It literally feels like I put a drop of tea tree oil in water. But I honestly highly recommend this if you want your face to feel smoother.

In love with this toner.  I have combo-dry/normal skin and it really does what it says it says.  It removed excess oil, clarifies and freshens the skin without stripping it.  Keyword here is removes EXCESS oil.  It does not strip the skin whatsoever.  I am shocked when I wake up and my nose and forehead are not oily at all, but also feel normal like the rest of my face. I concentrate this mostly on my nose, forehead and temples and then lightly put it everywhere else to help with any breakouts.  I haven’t had any new breakouts or small bumps and my mild acne I had cleared up significantly after 1-2 uses.  I hope this continues to work for me.  I appreciate that there is no alcohol in this except for the 2 alcohol ingredients near the end of the ingredient list and is for a preservative of the formula and has vitamin E.  I am all good with that as it does not dry out the skin.  I also like that there is no added fragrance which is unnecessary in skincare.  Bottom line, I think this will help the appearance of mild acne but I don’t think it will magically clear severe acne.  I was on accutane a few years ago, but have slowly gotten more hormonal type breakouts that are mild and this helps quite a bit.  I am most impressed with its oil control and will use this in the day in the summer.
Great product,feels great on the skin.
Used this with the Oil Control Cleanser and my skin was mad at me every time I used it. Would get very red, irritated, and hot. I had to return it.

review_title: FAVOURITE DAYTIME TONER FOR OILY SKIN!
review_text: I’ve been using a bottle of this stuff since June and I still haven’t finished it yet (very close though) since a little goes a long way! I love the cooling sensation it leaves on my skin and the ingredients list is INCREDIBLE all ingredients that my acne, oily skin NEED. I just bought my second bottle of this stuff yesterday so I won’t be a day without it! I couldn’t recommend this more for oily skin types!

Was looking for a replacement for the Pixi Glow Tonic that I currently use and love but tired of running out after two weeks. I  looked online at Sephora and found this which also has Glycolic acid that the Pixi Glow Tonic has as well as other helpful ingredients for oily skin.  I’m so glad I chose this.  Love the tingly refreshing feeling after I use it on my face. It’s only been three days of use but for the price and 6.3 fl oz its a winner.

I love how my skin feels after I use this product. I love how it leaves my skin tingling for a few seconds after I use it. Really helpful that not only does it help with my pores, it also removes the last of the dirt or makeup left on my face. This product it great. I wouldn’t recommend to people with extremely sensitive skin, but it does work.

I have combination skin, and wear lots of makeup so pores tend to get easily clogged. I purchased this after trying other products from this brand and having great results. This one did not disappoint! I was worried it would over-dry my skin but it actually leaves my skin feeling very comfortable. I haven’t noticed as many clogged pores as I did before using this and it definitely helps keep the oil down during the day. It is also a really large bottle so it’s a great value! Definitely recommend this for combo/congested skin!

review_title: Leaves skin balanced and feeling comfortable
review_text: I love this stuff! I have oil control problems on my chin area and this toner really helped keep the oil down and in turn keep blemishes away. I used to get big painful spots deep under the skin that would last for weeks about once per month. Since I started using this toner a few months ago I haven’t had any! (hopefully I didn’t just jynx it.) It could be the sun and vitamin D  helping too but I think it’s this toner. It’s nourishing enough to use all over my face too. Even in my very dry areas. Its smells great, faintly of tea tree but mixed with other luxurious and soft scents. I want to try the moisturizer too!

I got this for Christmas and used it as my last step before bed. Maybe it’s the combination with the TLC glycolic night serum + lala retro, but my skin looks brighter and healthier overall. Will buy it again.

I wake up with baby soft skin when I use this product. It is not heavy on my skin as a masque. I like to use it with an exfoliator overnight. I’m slowly converting to using more and more DE products and it’s worth the expense -- I can feel a big difference on my skin.

I got the mini size for my birthday & instantly fell in love. It’s cooling, moisturizing, hydrating, plumping & leaves my skin so soft. Pure perfection. I would go as far to say that this may be the best skincare product I have tried. Finally purchased myself the full size.
I love this product because my skin looks amazing! I especially love it under makeup - I add one pump before makeup for amazing skin. The only downside is that it smells like play dough.

Love this product for double moisturizing at night, when I first tried this on my hand I was like… this feels like water lol but it really does hydrate and make your skin so smooth and healthy looking, love!! I’m also the kinda of shopper that wouldn’t buy something at this price if it didn’t absolutely blow my mind tehe

review_title: Wearing my skin care routine these days
review_text: A year ago I would never have written a product review, and certainly not about a skin care product.  I didn’t see the point, my skin seemed fine.  I was scrolling through pictures on my phone one day and in a side by side by side comparison I could no longer argue with the glow of my natural skin after using good products vs a full face of make up, or not being bothered with basic skin care at all.  I am converted, my skin care journey started on a whim with some travel sizes and now I find myself giddy like a kiddo at the holidays, opening up my next drunk elephant loot haul.  This is one of my many favorites from their line, the level of clean hydration on my face each morning makes me feel like I’m getting an actual thank you from my face.  Having beautiful skin makes me feel more confident than all the make up in the world.
The best hydrating mask. I use it more as a night time lotion. Way better than summer fridays jet lag mask. Would friendly repurchase.

I am baffled that this claims to hydrate parched dehydrated skin overnight. I have combination skin with your typical dry cheeks but oily t zone. This absolutely did not even remotely hydrate or moisturize my skin. I had to get up and apply moisturizer over it, every night I used, just so my skin wouldn’t feel dry. Saw no cooling or reduction in redness. Gave it 2 stars because it didn’t irritate skin.

I got this as a sample with a recent purchase and I used it two nights in a row as the last step in my overnight skincare. The first night I felt like it did a little to hydrate my skin and maybe calm a little redness but after the second use I realized it was beginning to cause a breakout which then lasted almost two weeks. It was a weird breakout all over my chin and up around my eyes and this was the only new thing I put on my face. I threw away the sample and definitely wouldn’t purchase.

I love this moisturizer!  I got a sample with the Baby Facial purchase, and really liked it.  I bought a full size one at the end of the year just for special treatments.  This winter was really hard on my skin--redness, irritation, and excessive dryness like I’d never had before.  So I stopped all my other skincare (serums, etc.) and started using this every night before I went to bed and that fixed everything.  I continue to use it nearly every day as the final step in my evening routine.  I only need two pumps (their suggestion of 4-5 pumps is bonkers--you’d look and feel like a frosted cake!) to seal in everything and my skin is baby soft the next morning.  I’ve used everything DE except their fermented spray and the new peptide serum, and this is by far my favorite.  I think it’s one of their more economical products too (so long as you use the amount you need, and not the amount they suggest).  I just purchased another full size bottle and will continue to repurchase as long as they make it.
I absolutely love this product! I switched all but my eye cream to DE products and I will never go back. This product is like a big glass of water for your face. Hydration at its finest.

review_title: Not sure if it’s worth the price
review_text: I’ve been using this more as a supplement to my night time moisturizer if I’m feeling like I want a little more oomph. I like to go to bed looking like a greased chicken so when I wake up my skin looks baby soft. This stuff definitely helps but I don’t think it’s worth the price. It’s got a nice texture and almost feels cooling, but its not magical by any means. Just a nice extra for anyone with drier skin who wants a little more moisture than a cream or an oil is giving.

I really wasn’t sure about a face mask that ‘only’ hydrates your skin at this price point. For me, this product is just perfect: it felt immediately soothing and all of my normal redness just disappeared while I was still in the bathroom. I have fairly sensitive and dry skin since I was born (neurodermatitis) and I didn’t break out or anything. I have literally nothing negative to say here.

I use this mask on top of my moisturizer because I have very dry skin. I always have flaky and dry skin around my mouth and after about a week of using this each night my skin was no longer flaky. I find it does take a while to sink in but it’s definitely worth it and super hydrating!

Huge DE user. Moisturizer, retinol, baby skin facial and pink top product (can’t think of the name right now) this has been my go to brand for over 3 years and I rarely switch out products due to my skin sensitivity and DE always works with no reaction/ breakouta. With that said...I was disappointed in this product. I didn’t feel like I had any visible difference with or without my whipped moisturizer. Won’t be re purchasing.
This is my favorite mask. I put this on my face at night once or twice a week and my skin just feel so plumped, soft and radiant in the morning. I can’t recommand it enough!

I don’t think I will ever be able to live without this product again. It leaves your skin feeling moisturized and honestly my skin looks clean and smooth as glass after applying and looks that way for hours after. If you use it as a night mask, you’ll wake up wi the most glowing skin the next day. BUY THIS

First leave on mask that actually keeps my face dewy throughout the night. Other than facial oils this is the only product I’ve tried that does that successfully. Definitely the extra drink needed for winter skin.

AMAZING product. I’ve been using the sample every night and the results the next morning are astonishing. My skin looks so smooth and even and less dull. I don’t normally write reviews but this product has quickly become my favourite.
Loving this mask! It feels very refreshing on the skin, I love to use this after my moisturizer on nights I exfoliate. I have very sensitive skin and this is also very non-irritating
I have combo/oily skin, this caused me to break out multiple times. Not crazy about the smell and overpriced for the amount you get.
This leaves my face so hydrated in the morning. I have chronic dry skin and this has worked wonders!

I tried this at night on its own, to see how it worked without the interference of any other products. First impression was that it had an oiler consistency than I expected and a slightly odd smell. Not super nice to apply, but nothing horrible. After I’d had it on for about 15-20 minutes, my skin started feeling irritated and itchy, especially around my nose and chin. It was very uncomfortable and I was worried about the state of my skin the next morning, so I washed it off and applied a gentle moisturizer that my skin was used to. After about 5 minutes my skin felt back to normal. I’m not sure what caused the irritation--my skin is pretty resilient and non-sensitive, and the reaction is particularly surprising in a product that’s meant to be hydrating (it actually felt like it was drying out patches on my face)....I would just advise people to proceed with caution, and check the ingredients carefully before using.

Fantastic product. I use it a few times a week as a last step in my regimen (wash, tone, two serums, moisturizer, F-balm). Two pumps and then pat it on. It absorbs with a tiny bit of stickiness but that fades. Excellent for use with la-la retro which is my moisturizer and also works great when I use the DE retinol a couple of times a week. I have very oily skin and this stuff balances that out. I wake up without an oil slick on my face. It’s also great to use when you’ve exfoliated and applied your toner, serum and cream. Will buy again.
I find this product is amazing for dry skin or sensitive skin. I like to use this after I’ve use a chemical exfoliant!!

I use F-Balm every night as my last layer (after AHA, extra niacinamide, and moisturizer). I don’t think this product is absolutely necessary. I do, however, think F-Balm is great if you use a retinoid. I use tretinoin once per week and the added hydration of F-Balm keeps my face from peeling. This always stings my face a little upon application but doesn’t turn me red or break me out. It smells clinical, like its base ingredients, mixed with a hint of crayon.

I love this stuff. I was surprised to bc I normally don’t like sleeping mask type stuff having oily skin. This makes my skin so soft and just what I need on nights I use a-passoni. I will absolutely repurchase.
Not my favorite DE moisturizer, Protini seems most moisturizing.  It is excellently formulated, though i wish it would have been more moisturizing.

review_title: love it....but can’t justify buying again
review_text: I really love this mask/moisturizer but will most likely not be repurchasing. While it feels amazing and super hydrating, leaves skin with an awesome smooth glow, soothes after my retinol and makes me feel better about using it when I have acne because of the niacinamide....it’s just way too expensive for what you really get. I loved it for the winter and can only imagine myself repurchasing for that time of year because it really did rescue me in some super dry times. But other than that, I can’t say I saw such a dramatic difference in my skin to justify the price.

I love this product...and I’m not the least bit surprised. I received F-Balm as part of a panel through Influenster and I could not be more pleased. It fit right in with my normal routine and added extra hydration I didn’t know I needed.

review_title: This turned out to be such a great product!
review_text: I was a little hesitant to use this product since I received it complimentary from Influenster, but I decided to give it a try and I was so shocked! I put it on at night hoping that in the morning my sensitive skin wouldn’t be covered with tons of pimples and I woke up to supple, plump, and glowing skin instead! I think this product was just what my skin needed and I’m so excited to keep using it!

This product was a great product for my skin. I have dry-combination skin and often wake up with an oily forehead. With this product, I noticed my forehead being less oily for sure. It’s applies softly and with a very cool sensation. Drunk Elephant packaging also never disappoints. I received this product from Influenster for my honest review.

I love this product! I do my normal skincare routine and I add this as my last step at night. I enjoy the feeling of it and it’s easy to apply. in the morning my skin feels nice, smooth and plump. I have oily skin but it does not leave my skin oily. I did receive this complimentary from Influenster and I’m so glad they did.

AMAZING!! I got this product complimentary and wow. I’m so lucky to have gotten to try this product. I’ve always been skeptical because of the pricing. But this product really pulled through on their promises! A half pump goes a long way. My skin was plump and well moisturized without being greasy. I would use this at night and wake up with fresh young looking skin! I hhighly recommend this. I’m definitely going to buy this product going forward!

I love this stuff! As a girl with oily skin, I usually avoid moisturizers cause I don’t want to feel greasy the next morning. With this one, I actually felt very refreshed and clean! I was very pleased with this product and plan to purchase more in the future

I love drunk elephant products! This particular mask really doesn’t feel like a normal mask. It’s more of just a cream. I liked it although I really didn’t see anything special about it. It smells fresh and nice however.

Impressed with the product. I have oily, sensitive skin and find this to be a great addition to my evening routine. I use this as the last step in my routine and it compliments my Caudalie essence and serums well. I find that a little goes a long way (only need two pumps instead of the suggested 4), and soaks immediately into the skin leaving a hydrated and smooth finish--no heaviness or stickiness at all. My sensitive skin has no issues with it so far!

I received this complimentary from Influenster. I’m very pleased with the product. Although i love most of drunk elephants products. It’s a little pricey but the container is quite large and a little product does go a long way. It definitely helps keep my skin hydrated. I probably wouldn’t purchase though because me myself i have more oily than dry skin. This is perfect for someone with dry skin. Especially in the winter months.

I’ve never used a product like this so I didn’t know what to expect. While I could feel the texture of the mask before bed, it wasn’t a nuisance and didn’t bother me at all. There wasn’t a distinctive smell either. I felt as though the tone in my face evened out and I didn’t have as many breakouts!!

I got this mask and started using it right away , it’s so wonderful. It leaves my skin feeling so soft and hydrated ! It also makes my skin look better as well . Definitely feel like it gives me a glow as well .
I just recently got this for my birthday! It’s AMAZING! I wear it every night over the other DE that I use. It’s made my skin so smooth and glowy!

I received this product for free for my honest review. I have pretty sensitive skin and the first time I used it it made my face really red and hot and uncomfortable but I gave it some time and that died down. I’ve used it a few times a week and I like it. It makes my skin feel very soft in the morning. I do feel the price point is a little high for the results. I don’t feel like it is a product I could live without but since I have it, I will definitely be using it.

This product is very hydrating and makes my skin feel very moist and plump. I wake up in the morning and feel like my face has a natural glow. I would recommend this product to anyone who wants a moisturizing night time mask that is not too thick.

It’s winter time and my skin is extra dry. I was really happy to received this from Influenster since I do love Drunk Elephant! I’m acne prone so I was a bit skeptical on being a gel texture on my face but it honestly did the opposite of what I thought it would do. I’m only giving it 4 stars because I thought it would hydrate my skin a little more than it actually does.

I think I like this sleeping mask without the glycolic acid. With the glycolic acid, my skin has a very weird texture the next morning after washing it off. My skin tends to get a little dry over the winter time and I think this product does a good job hydrating the skin. It does feel a little sticky but your skin feels plump and moisturized the next morning. The sleeping mask itself is very hydrating but I didn’t see any drastic changes in my skin (I used this for about 3 weeks). It’s decent for the price but overall not a bad sleeping mask.

review_title: Rough starts sometimes lead to happy endings
review_text: I received this product for free to give my honest review of. I personally thought the packaging choice made it look cheap. The consistency of the product seemed super watered down and I was initially not impressed. I looked drunk elephant on The think dirty App since they claim to be a clean company. Their scores weren’t as low as I was hoping. But after consistent use my fave declares a different story. It’s a lot less patchy and dry. Without the greasy feeling. I haven’t broken out any worse. And it has a healthier glow about it. I’m pretty darn happy with this product!
Great overnight moisturizer! It absorbs very quickly. I first use TLC framboos, then b hydra, then this mask, and followed by an oil when my skin is feeling pretty dry. I would repurchase!

This isn’t anything special. Really the only positive is that the beads feel nice bursting on my skin.My face definitely doesn’t feel more hydrated - I’d pick the Laneige sleeping mask 10x over if I’m looking for hydration. I tried it with and without the TLC Framboos mini (made no difference) as well as different amounts of the product (also no difference). I did have the *wonderful* experience of waking up with acne each time I used it, that took several days to disappear. The details claim that the product calms redness, but my skin is no less red than when I started using it. I’m definitely returning.

I received this product to try from Influenster and I was very excited after reading about it. However, after a couple weeks of use I would say that this is not moisturizing enough for me in the winter time, especially with my dry skin. It feels lovely when you put it on and very minimal scent which is nice but after applying this at night and waking up in the morning my skin still felt a bit dry and did not look any different after a few weeks of use. At it’s price point, I do not believe this product is worth it if you have dry skin as it is just not moisturizing enough.  I got a sample of the DE Protini cream for my birthday gift from Sephora this year and have to say that I have been enjoying that one much more.
The weather is extremely cold in the north.  This is a perfect addition to my Drunk Elephant.  My skin feels soft.
So far so good.  Absorbs nicely.  Not greasy. No fragrance - which is great.

This did absolutely nothing for my skin. It did not break me out though, so I’ll add a star for this. I was very excited to try something that was intended to help with super dry skin, and how perfect in the winter. I ordered it and began use right away--added this on top of my normal nightly skincare routine and saw no difference when I woke up. My skin felt soft, but if anything, it was dryer, rather than lush and hydrated. I wanted to love it, but I am still on the hunt for something super moisturizing to help me out in the winter.

review_title: Did nothing for my dry skin
review_text: I was super excited to try this but was very disappointed. This did nothing for my dry skin. I used it on top of my trusty caudalie products as the final step in my routine. The next morning I had dry patches. Even more dry than before I started using it. It’s pricey and did not work for me. I would not recommend

I was so excited to try out this Drunk Elephant hydrating mask!! My skin has been so dry this winter and I’ve been struggling to get that flow back. And let me tell you.... this did it! Honestly, this is the best hydrating mask I’ve ever tried!! I will definitely be repurchasing! **I received these products complimentary

I’m not sure about this product. The First time I used it, my skin almost felt as if it was burning. I kept trying it, giving it a fair chance. Honestly I don’t see a big change in my skin. Yes it moisturized my skin but I have MANY other night creams that are about a fourth of the price that work in hydrating and moisturizing. I was super excited to try out this brand I’ve never been able to afford before but this just wasn’t it for me. The product technically worked but not for the price point.

review_title: Best Clean Addition to my nightly routine!
review_text: Drunk Elephant continues to blow me out of the water with their products. I have severe acne, bad texture, and dry skin. This product was a miracle for me!!! It truly has changed my skin after just THREE, yes, THREE, uses! It keeps me hydrated, and my bumps go down over night! I even use it every other day as a daily moisturizer and it does not disappoint. You don’t even need 4-7 pumps of product! A must buy!! Worth every single penny!!

*this product was sent to me as PR from Influenster*F-Balm Electrolyte Waterfacial Masque Hydratant by @drunkelephant feels really great when used on it’s own. It isnt super greasy, but it does have a slight stickiness to it. Once it’s applied to the face and neck, it gives a very supple look and feel to the skin. I have noticed since using this product I’ve seen a change in how dry my skin can get during colder seasons or lack of proper hydration. So this really saves the day. I’m not a huge fan of the T.L.C. Framboos that’s included, as it makes my skin peel, which is the point, but I just find it doesn’t do a whole lot for my skin in a positive way. The Drunk Elephant product comes in a plastic pump dispenser that feels weighty, slightly expensive. We all like boujee! Their ingredients list looks to have a lot of natural ingredients, which makes it more beneficial to apply to the face. Best of all? The brand is cruelty free, however, not all products are vegan. If you don’t mind the price, get you some!

Pretty good product- feels nice on the skin and I’ve never used an overnight mask before so this was a pleasant change up to my routine! The first few days of use left my skin feeling a bit tingly, so those who have eczema be cautious. There was no redness or inflammation, and it was smooth and easy to use. So far, haven’t had any significant changes to my skin other than perhaps more hydration due to the extra moisture overnight.

I was excited to try this product as I’ve heard the hype around DE products, but could never afford them. I was surprised that this wasn’t super moisturize, but by no means did I hate this product. It did moisturize my skin and it felt plump, but it’s not most intensive hydrating product I’ve ever used. In combination with the Framboos serum, I liked the way it made my face feel before bed. If you have extremely dry skin, opt for something more intense. It was a good nightly moisturizer for me and I’m happy with it!

I received this product free from influencer and was very excited to use it as I’ve heard great things about drunk elephant. I like the sensation that it gives your face after application, although it does take a few minutes to dry. Very light feeling on the face and not oily. It did leave my face feeling hydrated as it is supposed to, but I do not think that I would be able to pay the price for future use.
I received this product complimentary from Influenster and I really liked it! I have dry skin and it was so hydrating. I even found that it helped moisturize dry patches on my arms.

I received this product from Influenster and I like it but I’m not blown away. I feel like it’s a really good moisturizer but I didn’t notice a change in my skin other than it was dewy looking after using it over night. It’s a good product but not sure I would purchase it myself as I feel there are less expensive products that provide the same results

I’ve been using this for about two weeks now with the glycolic acid—I wouldn’t say it’s life changing, but it does a good job of locking in products/moisture overnight. I’ve only used it as an overnight mask, I’m not sure how it would do under makeup. Overall I have red, dry, flakey skin and this didn’t irritate me at all!

I absolutely love this product!  I’ve been using this product for almost two weeks now and I can see a big difference in the redness of my skin!  It has evened out my skin tone and left my face feeling so hydrated in the dead of an Illinois winter! I would highly recommend and will definitely keep using this product!

I was expecting a lot more from this being that the price is so high and generally this brand is known to have good products. I feel like it did moisturize my face but I have used other products that are cheaper and better. Disclaimer: I received this product as a free sample. I did not purchase this product.
I absolutely recommend this product!!! My face looks amazing! I gave it a few days before posting the review and wow, I’m shook! It’s totally worth the price!!! My skin feels great, it’s glowing!!!
I am very happy with the way your skin looks like in the morning. Just apply it before you go to sleep and after you wake up, you look fresh and skin is soft!

review_title: the best overnight mask I've tried!
review_text: this mask is lightweight and absorbs so that you don’t have to worry about making a mess while you sleep if you’re a side sleeper, and when I woke up I was so moisturized I felt like I didn’t need any products!
Love this brand and all the products, this makes my face feel so smooth and refreshed
This product is so awesome !! I love it paired with the framboos serum. My skin is so dry

I was really looking forward to using this product as I have SUPER dry skin during the winter, but within minutes I was all splotchy and burning up on my face. I took it off immediately but I was swollen for hours on my face and neck. I’m really confused how this happened because I’ve used most of the DE lineup but one of the ingredients must not agree with me. Very disappointed.
This is so moisturizing on the skin. This paired with the TLC night serum is amazing! definitely worth the price!

My skin has been so severely dry. Hi! My name is Amy and I have dry-sensitive-eczema prone skin. I know. I know. I’m the lucky one! Lol. Moved to Florida for College- it’s as if my skin knows my Jersey relatives are freezing and my skin becomes Scaley-and parched. I could drop hyaluronic acid all Down my face w a dropper like  on Instagram ( psa : don’t ever) and I was at my wits end bc I cannot even wear concealer! I need that ! So I went in to Sephora asked for a sample -she filled the teeny plastic paint by numbers plastic thingy 4 pumps. Then she said ( sounded slow motion) TTHIISS ISSS ANNN OOVVERNNIGHHT MMAASK” sorry for the dramatics lol but I kid you not I said out loud are you kidding me. I thought of one thing. Rhymes w “Scwhatermelon” over night. She said ( we see each other too much my husband says) you’ll like it - she has oily- she said I promise. She knows I’m allergic to .. everything.. I slathered on 3 pumps worth to save some for a 2nd night - I went back an hour later probably added another 1/2  pump.  Skipped all my Actives -and Tretinoin after my GSR I added a drop of snail serum and Niacinamide 10%Zinc2% and went to bed. TBH .. at first, by my orbital bone.. it stung a little. But that’s my fault I knew that I was using too many Actives. I woke up and forgot. I looked in the mirror to start my morning routine and looked up. My face was glowing. I kid you not my skin looked the best it had looked in a long time. My eyes were still a little cringey around sides bit tonight I will focus more peri-orbital. I wore my full face and concealer today! Still needs work but I am convinced this is an Excellent product for extremely dry-sensitive-eczema prone skin. I used 3 1/2 pumps. I could used 4 no problem. Just to get started I probably would go through this in 3 weeks. Then taper to 3 months. This is a keeper. I will buy this 100%% thank you DE From one tired Momma!
Love this so far. I like that I can leave it overnight. The serum burned a bit but only on some healing skin .
These 2 products are perfect for extra hydration , especially if you have dry skin!  Thanks to influenster

I absolutely love this product. I am a huge fan of DE. I live in a climate that gets super dry and this has been the holy grail for my dry face. the instructions say 4-5 pumps but you really only need 2-3 in order to cover your face. don’t think twice, definitely purchase!
Basically a regular moisturizer. In no universe would I call this a mask! Tried it out for 3 days. Thoroughly unimpressed.

I’m not sure that I can give this product an honest and accurate review so far. I used it for a couple days and started to break out and wasn’t sure if it was from this product but then it stopped when I took a break from the product. I have very dry skin but didn’t feel it to be super moisturizing- will try again. Might work better for someone else!

review_title: Not hydrating enough for Dry Skin
review_text: I have dry skin (not super dry, just dry enough that there is a bit of texture, typically around my mouth area) and I have a few hydrating masks that I use that leave my skin feeling super smooth and perfectly prepped for makeup. I have a few Drunk Elephant products that I love but this unfortunately is not one of them.The instructions say that you need to apply 4-5 pumps onto your face which sounds a little excessive. I can get a generous layer on my face with just 2 pumps. I tested it out with only 2 pumps and it does NOTHING for my face. They make you do 4  pumps so that it’s more of a thicker “mask“. I used the serum it came with as well and let it absorb into my skin.It is quite cooling and has a light gel-like consistency.
