After applying 4 pumps and waiting a few minutes for it absorb into my face, I can feel that my face is a bit smoother. So it does hydrate. However, it is not hydrating as I’d like it to be. Like I would not feel confident putting my foundation on after using only this product. I would need to put on another moisturizer to hydrate my skin moreHowever I am giving it 2 stars because 4 pumps is so excessive. Drunk Elephant products are already expensive. If people have to use 4  pumps every time, they would run out of product so quickly. Also I have other products for about the same price that hydrates so much better with less product. This product may work better for people with oily skin but if you have dry skin this may not be as hydrating as you’d like.

I absolutely love this! It has a nice soothing texture that absorbs into my skin wonderfully. I have been layering this at nighttime over my moisturizer as my last step in my skincare routine and this locks in all the good moisture. In the morning my skin is hydrated and glowing! This has been given to me complimentary from Influenster my opinions are my own.

review_title: Drink of water for your face!
review_text: I used this product for the first time last night and WOW - already a difference! I have dehydrated skin which gets even dryer in the winter time and decided to give this a try. I paired it with the Night serum by DE like it was recommended but instead of the 4-5 pumps, I only need 1 and a half pumps. My skin hasn’t felt this good in a long time! Even people at work the next morning noticed a difference in my skin. I can’t wait to keep using this to see even more benefits!

review_title: Your dry skin will love you!
review_text: Highly recommend this if you have dry skin! Used this last night after applying the TLC serum. Went on very easily and my skin quickly absorbed it so there was no issues with it being greasy or coming off. Used it as an overnight mask and my skin looked great this morning! Very hydrated and glows!

I used this product as an overnight mask and LOVE it. It leaves my skin so hydrated, which is so helpful in the cold/dry winter. Instructions say to use 4-5 pumps, but even 4 pumps leaves far too much product on my face, so I only use 3. The full 4 pumps left my skin overly saturated and unable to lay down for bed, as it would all come off on my pillowcase. Overall, highly recommend!

Never in a million years did I think I could go to bed without drenching my face in thick cream to combat my dry skin, but I was wrong!! This product is amazing. In the winter my skin is so dry and sensitive and this completely puts life back into my skin overnight. I wake up with plump and hydrated skin. It’s also amazing to use on top of the drunk elephant gylocic serum for extra exfoliation. Seriously if you have dry skin give this a try!!

I’ve developed perioral dermatitis over the past several months which has made it difficult for me to find anything to calm my skin or prevent flare ups. The first night I used this product my skin looked and felt so much better. Since then I’ve been using it regularly in my routine. My skin is smoother and more even. I will add that their suggestion of 4-5 pumps seems excessive. I’ve been using 1-2 pumps and it had worked great.

After just a few uses of this product I’m in love. I’ve been dying to try this brand but was worried about the price. It’s well worth the price and I would purchase again! My skin is soft and glowing!
Without a doubt one of the best mask I’ve ever used it’s super easy to use and makes my skin feel so nice and hydrated im in love definitely a must have

So this is very sticky feeling, it sadly didn’t absorb for me. It feel like it just sat on top of my skin. Even after so many hours of it on.. I woke up and it was just very sticky feeling. I’ve seen a lot of reviews stating it’s not sticky at all after it absorbs.. unfortunately this wasn’t the case for me. I can’t stand the feeling. It’s going back to the store... I’m sure I’ll find a better mask out there that actually absorbs and doesn’t feel gross.

So I really liked how well it hydrated my skin overnight and I was breaking out so it helped tone down my acne. I wouldn’t give it 5 stars only because I have oily skin and when I used it two nights in a row, my face was very oily. Still was super soft though so i definitely recommend but just not every night, maybe every other night or once a week!
Refreshing and light, while still hydrating. Definitely pairs well with the framboos.

review_title: Not as hydrating, but still a good product.
review_text: I was sent this product for free from Influenster. This product is nice going on and feels so cooling and hydrating, but overnight it made my skin feel a little drying when waking up. That being said, it really did a great job of calming down my skin. I did use the Framboos serum as well, so I am not sure if my skin looked better in the morning because of that product or because of the F Balm, but it is a nice addiction to my skin care routine. I’ll continue use of this product.

I use most everything from drunk elephant but am horrible with putting on masks. This one was very easy to use and did everything it said it would without leaving a film or greasy texture on my face. It works great and simple to use for this busy mom.

I am skin care junkie.  I was so excited to try drunk elephant’s newest! I suffer from horrible eczema around my eyes when I use a product that doesn’t suit me or I go to aggressive with retin A.  I was in the middle of a bad bout of eczema when I purchased this.  I didn’t notice anything the first day but I noticed a significant improvement in my eczema by day 2.  After using it for 4 days now I honestly can say my skin is glowing.  The only thing I may have noticed is a slight increase in blackheads on my nose but this was quickly resolved after a few washes with my Clarisonic.
It’s just okay.  After a week’s use, I don’t notice any improvement.  I think I’ll be trying other products at this point to see if it helps.

I wanted to try this out since I got the jelly cleanser and the other moisturizer as a free b-day gift and enjoyed their other products but this F-balm I don’t fully feel is worth the price. It gives you a rubbery texture feel and I’ve been using it for over a week now and see no signs of change in my skin. I wouldn’t really recommend this one I think I’ll stick to my Tatcha Dewy skin where I actually felt it moisturized and hydrated my face/made a difference.

I will keep this short and simple and give you a little secret. I have combo VERY acne prone 32 yr old skin. I did not receive this for free and paid in full. This did not break me out although I discovered a wonderful way to use this and it’s not as a face mask. I apply this under my eyes every morning and it does what no eye cream (expensive and drugstore) has never been able to do...it seriously moisturizes, smooths and brightens. And the price isn’t so bad for how much you get and how much you use if you use as an eye cream. And their regular eye cream is 60 and you only get .5 oz. you get almost 2 oz of this and it absolutely blows it away.

...But I don’t. In fact I already returned it, after trying several nights to make it work. It feels LOVELY going on, but it just didn’t hydrate my skin enough, even using more than directed, and combining it with other things I know work for me. My skin is Sahara levels of dry AND dehydrated, though, so someone with even slightly less dry skin than I will almost certainly love this. I don’t remember the last time I woke up with my skin so obviously dehydrated--I could see the pores on my cheeks in the mirror from 18“ away. This happened even with an oil over top of this product. (I tried the Indie Lee squalane, DE marula, and Herbivore Emerald   CBD, none fixed the issue.)

review_title: My pockets really didn’t want to love this
review_text: I was all set to declare this a one time splurge but damn it this is amazing. It used it over my full DE night routine (Babyfacial, bhydra, Laila, then Marla oil). No pilling whatsoever and soaked in completely. I have dry skin but honestly I woke up expecting a greasy mess with all those layers of moisture but my skin looked INCREDIBLE. Like Jlo’s glow without a stitch of makeup and none of the redness that usually follows Babyfacial nights. I’m shook. This is coming on my next flight to combat cabin dryness. Hooked!
Loving this product so far.  It has a nice feel upon application.

I usually do not leave reviews after one use. However, I absolutely had to after using this product. I initially tried it on my hand in store and was really satisfied with the way it made the skin on my hand feel without all the extra grease or heaviness. Having combination skin I’m usually concerned about a product either over-saturating my face, or being too lightweight. I used it on my face after the Drunk Elephant TLC Night Serum, and I cannot day enough good things after one use. For starters I live in a cold area where the air is dry and harsh to the skin. The combination of this plus the TLC has visibly helped with the appearance of dry skin, and made the skin feel supple without all the extra shine and overly oily feel. Even as far as the texture I usually have on my chin and forehead, it has significantly helped improve that. I know that with time and continued usage of this product, I can bring my skin to an even happier place. My skin tends to lean towards the sensitive side from time to time so I’m very picky about products. I’ve had some hits and misses with this brand but this one is definitely a hit. If you do plan on using this with the TLC Night Serum, is suggest building up tolerance to chemical exfoliants if you’ve never used one before. Try it 1-2 nights a week before frequent usage.
Best self tanner with least self tanner smell!!  I am olive skin toned. I use the light. And it gives me plenty of color!!

As soon as I unwrapped the plastic, I noticed there were strange particles inside, it looks like it’s old & I definitely saw a couple black dust particles, and what seems like a piece of white string. I don’t feel safe using this, and hugely disappointed in this brand. I’ve used this exact spray in the past and never had this issue, but seems like it’s happened to several other people recently as well.

I received this a few days after purchasing and it was all milky and chunky, looked very gross. I contacted Sephora and they sent me a new one, and it was identical to the first one. I decided to reach out to isle of paradise and told them the condition of the product, sent pictures and ultimately wanted to know if it was safe to use. They finally got back to me and told me the product SHOULD be clear, not milky in colour and definitely no chunks. They indicated that the product was exposed to heat/higher temp causing the product to breakdown. However, the product is still safe to use and doesn’t pose as a health concern. I did use a small amount on the inside of my arm and it does give a subtle tan, however still looked a bit orange on my skin. I can’t get over the condition of the product so unfortunately these will be going in the garbage. I wanted to love it so bad.

I normally tan naturally to a medium level after a summer of leg exposure, but wanted to speed things up a bit avoid baking. Used self tanners in the past with good, natural results. Saw this in the store and decided to give it a try, looked easy to apply.What a mistake. This product turned my legs a horrible shade of dark orange over night. It smells awful, a cross beween graprfruit seed and bug spray. I’m desperately trying to exfoliate it and won’t be able to wear a dress to work until it fades, it’s that bizarre looking.Do not use it. You will regret it.

review_title: buy the drops & pass on this product.
review_text: Skip this & buy the drops! The drops are a revolutionary product. So low maintenance & never streaky & hardly has the self tanner smell. This stuff is a mess. My whole floor was covered in the mist. The soles of my feet were brown. And my tan was so streaky and uneven.

review_title: not as good as the oil drops
review_text: At this point I’ve tried both the tanning oil drops from isle of paradise and now the water. It just doesn’t give you as substantial and strong of a tan as the oil does. I would say the water is more of a light/medium and if you want more of an actual tan, get the drops instead.
I love this tanning water! Been using it for over a year and it’s always my go-to!
i used it once on my legs and i’m completely satisfied. the comparison is after 1 time and that’s my arm and my starting color. i’m quite pale.

I use this on my face and hands whenever I tan using the mouse, works great but very subtle colour compared to the extra dark mouse. Also I feel as though it does not last as long. Smells fine and does not stain clothes or sheets. The spray is also a bit leaky.

I am glow-in-the-dark white after a few days out of the sun. This product smells nice and works really fast and well. I was very skeptical when trying this and the nice even tone, as pale as I am, worked so well I used this for my brother wedding instead of getting a spray tan. I even helped fix a couple trouble areas of a few of the other girls tans.

I have been using the medium shade for 2 years and loved it. Something is different with these products now. This is supposed to be darker and instead I woke up the exact same shade. Very disappointed and no longer works. Will be returning and trying a new brand

awfully uneven tan and fades incredibly splotchy. Please refer to the photos other reviewers have provided. this tan is not worth it and ended up making me look ridiculous for a few weeks. I suppose its longevity is a pro but the con of the ridiculous looking tan far outweighs the pro.

I didn’t have issues with streakiness like others have reported. I used a tanning glove to rub it in. I’m really really pale, like when light bounces off my skin it’s nearly blinding. It definitely gave me colour but I just look orange, not tan. I also think I have an issue with body chemistry and tanning products bc this stuff started to smell really bad after 2 hours. Rinsed it off at 3 hours bc I couldn’t stand the smell. I wish I liked this but unfortunately I will be returning.

Love it! The color is stunning, not orange at all, gave me a really natural looking tan. Works well on pale skin btw I am super fair naturally. I used a mit to rub it in and it did a great job. Not streaky or patchy at all. The scent is also quite nice for a fake tan, they usually smell super strong but this one is more subtle. The only cons I have is that it is quite messy to apply since you spray it on your body, it leaked under my feet which did not look so good lol

The feeling of having it on for 4-6 hours sucks. It’s a gross feelings to wait it out. I couldn’t take it anymore and left it on for 3 hours and still got nice results. It’s a bit of an oily feeling.. overall it gives me a glow but it can be kind of spotty so be careful. But definitely one of the best self tanners I’ve tried yet. Will be buying again

I’ve been using this product on and off for a couple years now and I love it. I am very clumsy and don’t trust myself with other tanners but I ALWAYS get compliments on my tan when I use this. I am very pale naturally and whenever i use this I am told I have a natural glowing tan. Love it!

I don’t recommend this product at all. I use self tanner frequently and know how to apply well with the mitt, and very rarely am unhappy with my result (this goes for drug store, Sally Beauty options all the way up to St. Tropez). This is the worst product I have ever used. Because it goes on clear, it is difficult to ensure adequate coverage. My coverage was surprisingly good. The color is orange and unnatural. It is streaky, and blotchy. It looks awful as it fades, more blotchy than any other product I have used. It concentrated very heavily in my dry areas (which I always pre-treat, and pre-moisturize, to limit the uptake), and despite that the result was terrible. I haven’t been this unhappy with a result since my very first experience with the drugstore self tanning products of the early 00s. I wouldn’t use this product on anything but your face.

The first time I used it, the pump broke. I was only half way on application. Also, didn’t really tan as much as I expected. I’m super fair like Mac NC15. But the thing that bothers me the must is te pump. Not practical you know? Plus it was just leaking everywhere as I was trying to used it.

Maybe because it was my first time self-tanning but I did not have a good time with this. I thought I had good coverage but by the time it developed I had some very noticeable missed areas (probably me being a rookie though). I don’t like how you have to keep the bottle straight up and down for it to spray, made it awkward to apply. Also I really hated the smell and it sticks around for a while afterward. Some pros are that the colour is a nice deep tan (see photo) colour and that it lasts for a while.

review_title: Not for olive skin but beautiful product
review_text: This is not for my medium olive skin tone-turned me orangey!! If olive undertone beware...im going to be trying the sosu tanning mouse instead. HOWEVER I must say this product was so easy to apply and went on streak free...also was a subtle developing tan but buildable

I was very surprised to see that this product actually works. Before I used it all over my body, I did a patch test on my forearm and was shocked! I am fairly white so the difference was very clear, which I was so happy about! I do recommend a patch test first!!
I liked it! Until I didn’t... my bottle (which I always kept closed) got some weird yeast or bacteria in it. Disgusting.
Does it job. Not a huge fan of the smell. Im medium tanned skintone. Didnt make me orange.
streaks on my hands other than that love it! recommend it a bunch already to a few friends.

I was so looking forward to this product after many friends told me about it and how much they loved it. I will say that prior to this I have used St. Tropez mouse and went back to that immediately. I found the product to be very uneven and streaky, even after using the mitt to even out. On top of that it takes forever to dry and any kind of sweating or even just crossing your legs in the hours after application can mess up the color and cause spots :(((

I liked this product it looks very natural and the drops for your face didn’t break me out at all! (And I am very sensitive). The only negative thing is the nozzle is incredibly difficult to use. If this company could fix the nozzle it would get five stars.

I don’t see any cons when using this. Maybe only that I need someone else to spray me but thats okay. Takes about 6 hours for full development. It doesn’t stain, color is beautiful (just make sure you pick the right tone), and doesn’t smell that bad (air out the room). As long as you make sure to apply evenly and don’t skimp on product, it’ll look great.

I had high hopes for this product. Followed the instructions to a T and when I say it only developed on my left arm, I’m not kidding. The one arm was a beautiful glowy golden and the rest of my body was left looking pale.
Love this, but be careful where you step after spraying it. I tanned the bottoms of my feet because I walked through it afterwards!
Great color but you have to work quickly to prevent dark patches - even with the mitt. I much prefer the ease of the tanning drops.
Perfection in a bottle. Highly recommend. Make sure to use a mitt for even applications. Perfect for your face and body.

I was looking forward to getting this product...it does have an after odour which I’m not a fan of took some getting use to ... I usually put this on in the evening but just know that if it’s a hot day out it’s going to come off or melt off otherwise colour is nice I’m sorta stuck in the middle w this one
Best self tanner I’ve tried to date! No streaking, weird smell, or orange coating. You look like you’re golden from the sun, not the bottle

I like that this has the “clean” stamp but I will be going back to St Tropez now that my bottle is done. The spray comes out in uneven bursts and the bottle is not ergonomic so it doesn’t stay in your hand. I often have to use two hands to spray it (one to hold it steady, one to spray). As if putting self tanner on wasn’t awkward enough! Plus the liquid is clear so the first time I used it (and any time I wasn’t meticulous with the applicator mitt) I was super blotchy. The color and smell is good so I would buy if they redesigned the bottle. I also use this on my face and it works well for that (spray it into my hands first). The mitt disintegrated before my bottle was used up. I would recommend the St Tropez mitt.

review_title: make sure you're putting it on properly
review_text: the first time I applied this, I turned out so splotchy and looked horrible! I was about to return it before I gave it another go, carefully reading the directions and making sure to make sure my skin was VISIBLY WET and spray on a lot before rubbing it in. The first time I don’t think I sprayed enough, so it looked streaky. I’m OBSESSED. It looks so good, it’s such a natural color not orange AT ALL. I didn’t use a mitt, just used my hands and washed them well after. I’d just take the time to make sure you are applying it carefully and liberally, exfoliating before, and be careful around your knees, ankles, and wrists. the only thing that stinks about this product is the sprayer is hard to use and you need to use a lot to coat the whole body, so it’s kind of a steep price for the amount of uses you will get for it. However, I totally recommend!

review_title: BEST self-tanner I've used so far
review_text: This product is by far the best self-tanner I’ve used so far (Jergens, Loreal, Neutrogena, etc.) It smells great, not harsh or chemical-y like many other self-tanner sprays or lotions. It develops subtly and doesn’t look orange or streaky at all. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a gradual, healthy-looking glow.

This stuff is absolute magic! I don’t understand how it makes your skin so bronzed, but doesn’t get anywhere else. I use it along with the lotion after the shower and it does take a couple hours to develop but it’s so natural looking and works really well when you layer it so I just do a little bit every day. And I’m not a self-tan aficionado, I’ve had a couple disasters and gave up until this product. I like both the drops and the spray version.

I came across this product from a “Top 5 Sephora Must Haves” on Tik Tok, trusted their opinion without fully investigating myself.Don’t understand how this bottle can be encased in a plastic wrapper yet still leak through it’s protection. The bottle arrived with a greasy film on the outside, not a deal breaker, just an inconvenience. The spray nozzle is great actually, it produces a nice fine even mist. Moreover, I can see why people hate the fragrance; the scent doesn’t smell ‘clean’, it smells like my mom’s hairspray. The application is beyond terrible, it will inevitably get blotchy patches with even the most vigorous of blending. The color payoff does not live up to its hype. I have light to medium skin with a yellow undertone and the tan read orange on my skin. Unless you want to look like you just walked off the set of Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory, I wouldn’t recommend this self-tanner.

review_title: I look like a Picasso painting.
review_text: Really had high hopes for this. I will I was wrong. Woke up the next day to blotches, Dots and lines. I followed the directions and still had this result. Get a lotion, not this.

I am very pale and have very dry skin. I’ve used a lot of drug store brand moose and high end brand. This by far was the easiest and have the best overall color. Only 1 patch I’ve had so far on applications. It’s very easy to apply. Sometimes with moose if you don’t get enough in one spot or too much in another it gets patchy, with this one you’re able to move the liquid around. I really love it!

review_title: Wanted to love...fell short of expectations
review_text: Wanted to love this product because I love the self tanning drops from this brand for my face, but this product fell short. Seems impossible to get a seamless application with this product since it is clear and you can easily miss areas of your skin because of that. Tried to apply this in the bathtub so it didn’t make a sticky mess out my bathroom floor like last time, but then I could not see how well I was applying it without a mirror! Spray nozzle needs to be improved, can not spray this upside down when you are trying to spray your legs which is a huge downfall. Liked that this doesn’t smell quite as bad as some other self tanners initially, however after a few hours had the same self tan smell. Exfoliated before hand and still came out splotchy in some areas. Looks kinda orange. Getting returned, I would pass on this product. There is better self tanners out there that are easier to apply with better color payoff!

I finally tried this after using the IOP foam for a while, both in light and I feel the foam adds better color. It is also easier to apply. The spray does seem to blend better but probably only because it is lighter. I use the IOP glove to apply. Both also fade nicely and obviously still a great product I just personally had better results with the foam.

Splotchy, streaky, stinky - I bought this having high hopes because of the hype of the product and was super disappointed. I have used many self tanners but this was definitely the worst. Because it is a clear spray, you cannot easily tell where it was applied and where it wasn’t. Even using the mitt, it still is hard to spread evenly and make sure you get every spot. I slept overnight with this on, crossing my fingers I’d wake up looking good, but it was soo streaky and I missed those hard to reach spots on the back of my arm and leg and it was very noticeable (luckily I tried this during quarantine and nobody really saw me). My room also smelled terrible from this and the only plus is that it does not stain sheets and the color is relatively natural-looking in the places it showed up. Overall would not recommend at all - use a tanning mousse instead that goes on in color so you don’t end up with splotches from applying blindly.

Usually never leave reviews but this product deserves it. I absolutely love the color. I have tried all the self tanners out there and this one is the most hydrating and natural looking color you can get out of a tanner. The reasons why I’m giving 3 stars are first - it washes away so easily even if you take the proper steps before and after. Therefore you have to reapply a lot more often. Second reason is the nozzle it makes the whole process so much  harder.
Application is messy and the spray cap leaks making it hard to keep pressing on. Color looks good.

LOVE! I’m actually allergic to every other self tanner I’ve tried, my esthetician thinks it’s the instant bronzers. So when I saw this come out over a year ago I jumped on it! I’m careful to apply and never have issues with streaking, love the color and it’s long lasting! The smell isn’t crazy overpowering, but definitely there. Doesn’t stain my clothes or sheets, which is a HUGE plus! Overall SO happy with this product, I’ve tried several others from the brand and like them too.
Great product, doesn’t come out orange and just gives a light tan for those who are fair skinned. Easy to use.

review_title: I love it, I failed the process lol
review_text: DO NOT SPRAY A SECOND LAYER IN THE SAME DAY.... I put this just on my face since my body is still tan. Decided to add a second layer right before bed. Needless to say the first application was more than enough as I woke up with a bright orange face this morning. Nothing a makeup wipe cant fix. I got enough off to be comfortable going outside lol. Would definitely recommend this dark one if you have a base tan already.

review_title: wonderful tan - super weird smell after
review_text: Okay so I just bought this product in a combo pack with the self tanning drops in the same shade. I tried them out today and at first I was in love. Even now, the next day, the tan looks pretty even for the most part (I’m not an avid self-tanner at the moment but I’m working on it) and the smell at first was HEAVENLY. I loved the smell and it’s super straightforward. Now my only issue with this product is the fact that the smell lingers and creates a very strange smell as it wears on the body. I put this on straight out of the shower and I was super confused. I’ll defs still use because I loooove the tan it’s given me so far but the after-smell is kinda off putting

I cannot say enough good things about this tanning water.... & I have written maybe a handful of reviews in my entire life... but this I felt the need to. I am super pale and took a chance on getting the dark because the medium was sold out. I’m glad I did. My tan looks amazing. Natural and flawless. Literally ZERO streaks or orangey smudging. The only area that is slightly whiter is my armpits, but good thing I’m not an armpit model or anything. Lol. I did follow the manufacturers directions exactly. I exfoliated my entire body 24 hours before I applied this. Moisturized my drier areas before use. And let it sit for 6 hours before showering. I also used the mitt that Isle of paradise sells which probably helped a lot too. So just follow the directions and you’ll be fine. The people that are complaining probably didn’t do those things.. so go get you some girl, you won’t regret it.

Easy to apply! Loved the shade; very natural. I think I want to try to build this up (applying 2 days in a row). I used my bare hand to rub in the product-- I think a mitt would just soak it all up! You could probably use a rubber glove if you’d like. I just made sure to wash my hands well after!
Love this product! Totally buildable! Got great color from this

I’ve used this product several times and while I really like the tan that I get from it, I do not like the breakouts that are accompanied by it. I have pretty normal/regular skin and I am used to the occasional pimple but I have noticed the last couple of times after using this product my skin is a mess. Breakouts on my face, shoulders and chest-basically anywhere I put the tanner. It’s kind of a bummer because I want to love this product but my skin clearly does not. IF you are going to buy this product though I would 100% recommend buying the mitt.

Quick and easy way to get glowing skin! Best used on face and neck (compared to full body). I found the best way to evenly apply is to go through your normal night routine and finish by moisturizing. Let your moisturizer sit for a while, THEN spray the product all over your face. Rub in with your hands, evenly distributing. Sleep on it and when you wake up your skin will look beautifully tan!
This stuff is amazing! Make sure you don’t spray it too close to your face and it gives the most flawless tan

I enjoy the color of this product once developed, but I wish there was a little tint to it for application. It’s quite difficult to make sure you didn’t miss a spot because it’s clear.Also I find you need quite a bit of product to cover an area, it will be interesting to see how long a bottle lasts using it once a week.

Yes yes yes. I was pretty much fluorescent white and used this after a shower and a good exfoliation. It IS super dark but has a great bronze/brown time instead of orange. I feel like it isn’t sitting on top of my skin like a cakey lotion, instead it “stained” my skin (in a good way). Anxious to see how it fades over the next few days.
Worst. Goes on very splotchy, I look like a cheetah. And yes I used a mitt.

Please order more than one mitt.....I absolutely love this tanning water! My natural skin tone is equivalent to a cotton ball, and just two applications gave me a nice even glow!BUT!Don’t do what I did. During my first application I started with my arms and worked my way down to every limb and crevice. Damn right I blended this stuff into my butt crack. Then I realized, I still have to do my face!! And I wiped my butt with the mitt! So I closed my eyes and sucked in my lips and blended away at my face with the butt mitt. Please order more than one mitt.
my favorite self-tanner EVER! definitely would not recommend to beginners as getting an even spread can be tricky because it is clear upon application. super natural, smells great,   wears well.

I tried the foam first and absolutely LOVE it but I wanted to the water and see what the difference was. I feel like the water got me a little darker but was a lot streakier. The foam is amazing and not as streaky. The water makes it super easy to correct the streaks. If you’re going to get one I suggest the foam!! Either way they both work and I’m a tan queen

review_title: wanted to love it but no
review_text: I really wanted to love this but I don’t. The tan is pretty nice. The application is awful. The spray gets stuck all the time, is not a fine mist unless sprayed perfectly straight (which lets be honest, when you’re spraying yourself that’s nearly impossible) and doesn’t spray well upside down to get the legs. If you don’t seriously blend it’ll look super patchy. It’s nice that it goes on clear but at the same time it makes that you can’t see mistakes until it’s too late and you’re already tan. Love the idea of it but it’s a no on this product.

This is the best self tanner I’ve ever used! I have olive undertones and am pretty pale in the winter but get dark in the summer. I like this product for use in spring before I have some color. It is super easy to apply, doesn’t leave streaks, and doesn’t have a strong smell. I use it at night and then walk around for about 10 min undresses to let it dry, go to sleep and wake up beautifully tan! It doesn’t look fake, nor orange. I even use on my face with no problems. I got all the girls at the office to buy it as well, and medium worked for all of them, even the dark and very light completed. I do apply with a tanning mit just to save my hands. Will be buying again

I was expecting a lot more than what I reciped from this pricey tanner. I purchased the dark bronzer glow and it ended up looking like my skin Color but slightly and I mean slightly bronzed?  That’s not even the correct word. The next day when I touched my arm it was coming off in a weird film with just a slight touch. I would save your money and purchase a drug store tanner it will do a better job.

I read an awful lot of AMAZING reviews and bought this based on such, but three attempts later and I am just barely a shade darker, typical glowy orange, faux tan stinky, sticky tacky person. This isn’t a dark tan, it’s medium at best after trying to build it throughout the week (since first use was sooo light). I have used fake tanning products for over a decade and know what I’m doing. I also know when I am using a one star product for the last time.
This is a really gorgeous tanner that’s buildable and not streaky! I used a mitt and found the application very easy to do!

review_title: new favorite self tanner! beautiful tan result
review_text: Wow!! My new favorite self tanner. I was weary of it being in water form hence not being able to see where I am applying. Literally applied everywhere in 5 mins and woke up with a beautiful tan in the morning. The upside to this also it didnt get on my sheets like all the other self tanner have in the past.
I love this product! I naturally tan very quickly-- but I never wear shorts, so I have the half

review_title: Order Dark!! Do not order medium!!
review_text: DO NOT order the medium color unless you want to be orange as a carrot, if you have a tendency to go orange from self tans then go for the dark color for sure. The medium gives a ‘sun kissed glow’ but in an orange-red sunset kind of way. Dark tans are usually the way to go with fake tanners because the color builds up enough to be actually bronze and not some weird in between color...only ordered medium cause dark was sold out

I use the dark self tanning drops ( mixed with my favorite daytime moisturizer ) for my face, neck and décolleté area. I use the spray on the rest of my body after exfoliating the day before. I also use the tanning mitt to have an uniform tan and there’s no streaking ! I love the fact that it doesn’t have a guide color so my bed sheets don’t get stained. The color payoff is the same color that I used to get when I was tanning ( I haven’t tanned for about 7 years now and I wear mineral sunblock every day ). It doesn’t have the typical self tanner smell which is great! I will definitely repurchase the spray and the drops once I finish them! Love both!
Love it! You see results right away after first use.

This product is okay. I wanted to love it, but it didn’t live up to all the good reviews. I absolutely hate that you can’t see the product during application because that leads to being streaky. It smells just as awful as all other tanning products, and leaves you with that sticky feeling. I probably should have went with the ’light’ spray because the medium left my skin orange and sunk into my pores leaving little spots. I will stick to the St. Tropez tanning foam because that works best for me personally.

Super happy with the results of this! I should start by saying that I think a tanning mitt would definitely be good for this product. I didn’t use one, and I applied it a bit haphazardly, so I do notice some light patches because of that (not super noticeable though). I didn’t use nearly as much as other reviewers are claiming they had to use, and the results aren’t as deep as I’ve seen other pics, but the tan I got from this is perfect for what I wanted. Added a lot of glow in a more bronze tone instead of orangey. I naturally have fair skin, but I go tanning a couple times a week, and this is a really good supplement to tanning I think. Not sure the length of time it’ll last as I just applied it yesterday, but after I took my shower this morning it still lasted through it (normally the self tanners I’ve used lose a lot of the color after I shower). The pic of the bottle is how much I used for a decent glow. The second pic, you can see the difference in color around my wrist, where i didn’t blend it well enough lol. I will use this probably twice a week to deepen the color, I don’t think I’ll need it any more than that though.

I LOVE THIS STUFF!!!! I bought it on a whim when i decided that i wanted to get back into self tanning and it is SO EASY to just spritz, rub in and go! It dries down fast, has a very pleasant smell and not so aggressively chemically(mind you it does smell like fake tanner but in a way like some perfumes smell pleasantly like sunscreen would).The color is so soft and natural looking, mind you i am a hairstylist who never gets to go outside when the sun is out! I got SO many compliments from my coworkers and clients alike asking me if i had just got back home from vacation!Love this stuff, will totally repurchase!!!!

THIS IS MAGIC OMG this is the first time I use a self tanning water in my life... I never thought they would actually tan me! I live in the Caribbean but I’m of a Fair skin tone and this has tanned me in just ONE USE. I’m in awe. I barely review products but I just HAD to give a 5 stars to this one! I put 6 drops in my Mary Kay moisturized. Ma-gic. I’m telling you.

I have a love hate relationship with this product! The color is amaaazing! Seriously the best color I’ve ever gotten from a self tanner. I love the water formula. BUT a huge downfall is the pump. I absolutely hate the pump. It gets stuck after a couple sprays and you have to continuously stop to fix it. It’s hard to get the back side because you can’t spray upside down. They really need to work on the pump because the formula itself is amazing. I use the drops for my face and absolutely love them but would need to use a ton for my entire body so I think I’ll try the moose next.

This tanner gives good color, but I did find it difficult to apply evenly since it doesn’t have any bronzer in it. Also, the squirt bottle makes it very difficult to apply to your back if you don’t have someone to help you.

I bought this product because Sephora was sold out of the medium color and all the drops. I didn’t think this one would be dark enough for me. I did a test patch after I bought it and 4-6 hours later didn’t notice any darkness on the test patch. I thought I’d just wasted my money but decided to try it out on my whole body anyway. Put this on with a tanning glove before bed (after barely exfoliating) and woke up with the perfect tan. I didn’t have any streaks or uneven spots and I’m terrible at applying self tanner. I’m so happy I bought this. I may eventually switch to medium but for now the light gives me enough color that I can cancel my tanning salon membership. If you’re on the fence, just go for it. I can not recommend this magic water enough.

This product is really amazing! It leaves you super tan after using. I recommend using this after showering but before bed and sleeping in it for the best results. Though I do really love this product there are some downsides. Since it comes out clear you can’t tell which parts of your body you have and haven’t put tan on yet. It is easy to miss a spot and realize it once it’s too late. This can stain your hands and feet pretty dramatically too if you don’t use the right applicator and/or gloves. Overall, it’s a great product with really good results.

I bought it because I seen a few insta bloggers swear by it, and I couldn’t be any happier. I recommend applying with a tanning mit and for best result letting it sink it overnight. I am very pale and blonde and my results came out awesome (no streaking and not orange at all). I also use it with tanning drops for my face and neck.

I have tried maybe two or so self tanning lotions before and NONE compare to this. I always smell different lotions and I hate the scent of them. This one does smell, but very mildly so and it doesn’t smell chemically at all. The spray nozzle sort of sprays in a wide horizontal fashion so that it covers a lot of your body at once if you hold it further away. Getting the back of your body done might be a little difficult, but if you rub it in properly, it won’t leave any streaks. I did it with my bare hands and that was fine as long as you wash your hands after so that it doesn’t make them too dark or streaky. Beware of your feet and elbows. I made the mistake of forgetting to be more careful with them and ended up with blotchy feet but that’s my own fault. Anyway, it’s an amazing product and the tan looks amazing, especially for someone like me who happens to be the most pale shade of foundation usually.

Great color! Not orange at all, would caution if you’re not an advanced self tanner as it’s hard to blend since it’s a water based tanner and you can’t see where it is and isn’t on your skin. For those who self tan all the time and have their tips and tricks knowing how to blend evenly this is a great product!

review_title: Love the shade and smell. Spray needs improvement
review_text: I am a complete tanning newbie. I am Asian with light-medium skin. I only tried on my legs. I took a shower and put lotion on the tops of my feet and on my knees. I sprayed the bottle on the front of my legs and it was very easy but when I sprayed the back, it was very difficult to push the nozzle to spray and the tanning water started leaking down my legs. I didn’t know how much leaked on my feet until the next day when I was spotted like a Dalmatian. Going to try spraying directly on the tanning mitt and applying to see if I get better results. I do love the shade, not orange and doesn’t smell bad.

review_title: Best tanning product. Worst spray nozzle.
review_text: This is the best tanning product I’ve used! The easiest too. Knocked off a star because the spray nozzle isn’t the easiest to use and it leaks.

I truly wanted to love this product.  The color I left me was even, beautiful and truly TAN on my medium olive complexion. Now to the bad, the spray on applicator. BAD. No, HORRENDOUS. Doesn’t spray upside down, SOOOOOO much fall out on your feet (make sure you wipe the TOPS and BOTTOMS of you feet), and the pump get clogged easily. I would rate this so much better in a mist.

This product works well, it left me glowing and bronzed but i’m not sure how you can do your whole body without help. I like that it’s simple and there isn’t any risk of staining your clothes or furniture.

I’m a lover of the St. Tropez mousse normally, but my Sephora stopped carrying it, and we got this instead. I got the darkest shade, and I was extremely impressed with the color! I should’ve exfoliated/shaved my legs more than 8 hours before, though, because I was definitely left with little dots. Overall, I was pretty happy with the application! The only thing I wasn’t ecstatic about is the way this stuff fades. It fades really patchy, so I suggest using a gradual tanning lotion to clean it up!

I am fair skinned, and never liked tanning products because of their greasy and heavy feeling, and the horrible smell! (Even those who claimed to not have a smell, still did). When I saw this was a Water, I decided to try it.  The water gives it a light feeling that sinks into the skin, and has Absolutely No Order!  It gives me just the right amount of tan for my fair skin - enough to make me look healthy and natural, without the orange look!  And it lasts for days!

Formatting my reviews in pros and cons:- color is great. I used this just before a wedding and my very tan cousins kept asking me if I had been on vacation.  I did two applications the days leading up to wedding and was very happy with how it turned out- easy to remove for mishaps (the tan eraser is awesome I highly recommend) Cons:- because it is clear application is a little bit “Jesus take the wheel”.  You just can’t be sure. - the pump on this SUCKS.  Pro tip: buy a cheap spray bottle with one of those pumps/nozzles that you pull instead of pump/press down and use that.  It is SO much easier.  I wish they’d change the pump because it is a little unfortunate.  This would be a 5 star product for me but that pump knocks it down. Overall, great and healthy glow.  Not orange.  Smells nice.  I will totally buy this again over any other self tan products!

The first 24 hours of this product was amazing! The application was the most difficult with the formula being clear. However my skin was tan and was not orange. Here comes the down fall. 5 days after the tan was fading and becoming blotchy all over my body. It looked horrible and unreal. Very disappointed.

I mean... I’m honestly a little confused as to how aggressively bad this product was for me compared to other reviews, which are predominately VERY good. I use self tanners pretty often and have tried a number of brands and know how the system works- exfoliate 24h prior to use, rub product in with a mit, let develop. I did all of these things the way I normally would, a way in which I always get a normal looking fake tan. In this case though, I did all of these things and woke up to a scary looking, splotchy mess. I just don’t know what happened. The color is also all wrong and almost gave me a tan verging on sunburned look. This was not a user friendly product either because you can’t see where you’re actually applying the product because it goes on totally invisible. Maybe there needs to be a lighter shade in this range too because I’ve never used the fairest shade of a self tanner and been this dark. Overall, as I sit here scrubbing my body before work with baking soda, I would 10/10 NEVER recommend this product to anyone, ESPECIALLY if you’re fair. It also smells like any other tanner so... I call fake news on the “no fake tan smell” claim.

This is a great product! I have tried every self-tanner on the planet and this is the ONLY one that I used that applies evenly (NO streaks or uneven appearance), dries quickly, does not have a over-powering odor, and has a natural-looking color. This is less expensive than the competitors, and far superior, from my perspective.

Several years ago, I started having allergic reactions to every self-tanning product I tried. This is the first product I have used in close to 10 years that hasn’t caused any hives or itching. It’s a beautiful color and easy to use, but it does have the self-tanner smell.

I was very skeptical to try this out because it said ‘water’. After my first application I loved the results. I did a second application later that night and woke up very tan. The tan is extremely natural and not orange like other brands. This tan is buildable. After a few days (5 days for me) it does fade and become patchy but it does the job. To keep the tan up I apply lotion and have learned that self tanning lotion (Jergens natural glow) is a good upkeep. I didn’t buy the face drops either and I’m glad I didn’t spend the money. The ‘water’ worked just as well on my face.
Excellent product, no smell and noi orange streaking

I really like the color. I’m pretty fair skin. However it was messy due to the pump spray and the consistency of the product. I’ve used aerosol tanners before and they weee not half as messy. Even with a towel down on the floor it seemed to get all over the place. I returned it for that reason alone and I return very little.

review_title: BEST SELF TANNER IVE EVER USED.
review_text: BEST SELF TANNER IVE EVER USED! First time using a self tanner. Remember to use a mite (I used one from Josie Marian) no streaks, no problems applying in tough to reach area, and color is naturally looking and sunkissed-beautiful! Only one star off because a MILD self tanner smell comes out after about an hour. WILL PURCHASE AGAIN.

First off, this stuff smells WON.DER.FUL.- If they bottled this scent into a perfume, I woud wear it everyday! The mist is very fine/light and offers great range. However, because the mist range seems to be slightly wide, I would recommend spraying yourself away from carpet or the walls - I actually stepped in my shower to avoid any potential stains. I could already see color start to develop about 5 minutes after applying, and after about 4 hours I could definitely tell a difference in color - I was a bronzy-golden color, which is what I wanted. I will say though, it is kinda sticky at first and I felt like I needed to air dry before putting clothes back on, but once it dried, I felt totally fine and honesty forgot I just doused myself in self-tanner. I have been a dedicated fan of St. Tropez for years, but this may have just changed the game for me!

Love this product, the only reason I have it 4 stars instead of 5 is because it does leave the skin feeling a little sticky after application. This has a great smell, unlike most self tanning products and doesn’t make the skin orange.

Bought shade medium for my light-yellow undertone skin. Works perfectly, tan appears in about a day. I’m on day 2 and it looks like a natural tan. Didn’t use a mitt and I guess I missed a patch on my left knee, scrubbed at it with a body scrubber and it didn’t go away; so it appears to have good staying power. Post-spray it was tacky for about 20-30 minutes. Smell is light
Product didnt even add moisture to my skin!! A it did was make my face burn and make me break out even after several uses!! This is a no from me. Not even worth the discount price!
Works very well for me my skin feels amazing after can’t use anything other then this

It made my skin feel so smooth and hydrated! I use this every morning after doing my whole routine and I love it so far. I received the sample size as a gift and I’m definitely gonna buy the larger size
Product is easy to apply, however it gave me very bad acne on my cheeks and around the mouth.I rarely get acne on my cheeks.Going to return.
Love this product I use it right before bed and in the morning and it really locks in hydration and gives you this glowing look.

review_title: Left my skin always feeling sticky
review_text: The Texture is amazing, and it feels extremely hydrating. The only thing I don’t like about this product is when you rub it in your skin, your skin is left feeling sticky afterwards. For people with oily skin I do not recommend at all, maybe people with dry skin might not have the same feeling after applying it.

I am more in favor of gel moisturizer especially in the day time and during hot weather. I have been using the Tatcha Water cream but found this one the similar texture and the same result. The price is cheaper.

I love this but I think I know why it’s getting mixed reviews.  I loved to AZ recently and my skin became incredibly dry.  I couldn’t fix it with moisturizes and finally figured out that the amount of oil on my skin was still adequate (hence better moisturizing wasn’t helping) but my skins hydration was poor.  One night w this and my skin was looking good again in the morning!  So I think it’s a hydration boost and may not be the right thing for people wanting to add more oil to their skin.

I wanted to love this (big fan of gel moisturizers layered with my skincare) but it was so sticky, I found it pretty confusing tbh. I enjoy tackiness with a gel primer, for example, but if I’m just trying to put on a moisturizer, I don’t expect it to leave a straight up sticky layer on my skin that never seems to soak in. It just sits there like a residue, I couldn’t stand it. Tried it a handful of times and ended up washing it off the last 3 times because I just could not get it to work for me. Bummer! I do think if you’re a person with super oily skin and you want to skip primer before foundation, you could use this in place of a product like Milk Hydrogrip - it’s truly that sticky.
I have combination skin and this gel moisturizer just doesn’t work for me. it left it feeling more dried out. will not buy again

Received this product as a sample, and I’m glad I had the option to test it. I found the scent to be a bit chemically (not super strong, but would likely affect those with sensitive skin). It took too long to absorb into my skin for a gel, and left my skin feeling sticky for awhile. Not for me - will not be buying the full size.

Is this as good as Tatcha Water Cream? Not quite. Is this a great compromise at half the price?  Absolutely. Allows smooth application of make up, doesn’t smell all flowery, soaks in and leaves face and neck feeling great.

I was very surprised my this product. I didn’t expect to like it, I didn’t expect it to work. I have sensitive skin so I’ve been having a hard time finding things that work. I love it. It’s light, hydrating, refreshing! It smells a little off but I got over that pretty quickly.

I love this product! my skin is a combination but mostly dry and I feel like this has really helped my skin feel hydrated. During the day my skin feels amazing and does not feel dry or irritated. The only thing I would say about this is that it does not feel the best on burnt skin and rashes but everything else it really works for!
I have eczema, lets start by saying that and this is my favorite moisturizer ever. Honestly it makes me feel like My skin can breathe but at the same time I am not dry. That is very hard with eczema.

I’ve been on the hunt for a good facial moisturizer.  Prior to using Tarte’s Sea Drink H2O, I tried 5 different moisturizers. My skin is very sensitive and acne-prone. This moisturizer is amazing!  I’ve been using it for over a week and there is such a noticeable difference in my skin.  It’s so soft and smooth.  I usually break out or have allergic reactions to most products, but I’ve had no reactions to this one. Would highly recommend it!

It is WAY too scented for me, as well as it made my face sting when I put it on. It also left my face feelings sticky, and didn’t soak in well. I am very glad I had a sample to try before buying. Bummed because I love all of their other products, but oh well!

This is the best moisturizer on the market! I have oily skin and I am always afraid of moisturizers making my face greasy, but this doesn’t do that at all! It absorbs nicely and is cooling. It helps with sunburn, windburn, dry skin, you name it!

I love love love this. I have oily skin that’s still kind of dry underneath and this fixes both of those! It hydrated enough so it’s not dry, but soaks in so much it doesn’t leave my face oily anymore either! I hope they never discontinue this

I would 100% use this before bed in my routine though if followed up by a real moisturizer afterward, but it definitely does’t give your skin the “drink of H2O“ that it claims to.
