Overall, it looks pretty good on the skin but I feel like there are better products for moisturizer and vitamin C. Maybe it would be good mixed with a different cream. You can try it because it’s really a great price like all their other products.

This product uses the powder form of l-adoric acid, you will feel a little gritty/powdery feeling at first but it does go away quickly for me. I only use this in my night routine because I use niacinamide in my morning routine. I only feel very mild tingling and no burning. It is tolerable for me but my skin is used to actives. I use this right after I use Dr Dennis Gross extra strength daily peel so my skin has already used an active before this and still the tingle is mild for me personally. I like to use the peel before this to let this penetrate into my skin better. This works great for me. It does just what you hope a good vitamin C should. Brightens my skin and leaves it looking smooth and fresh. The price point is great too.
Excellent produit pour le prix en plus wow ! Il fait partie de ma routine du soir maintenant et je vois une amélioration de mon teint et de la texture de ma peau !
Feels gritty for the first few seconds but it goes away. My skin definitely looks brighter after using this for months!
My skin freaked out. The oily feeling makes my face feel heavy and clogged the whole day. If you suffer from rosacea you know that is not good. It also stings. Not for me, I’ll stay with Q10.

I have a a sincere routine with the cerave cream that’s super thick I use this product after using the cream and it makes like a almost greasy eraser type fillings it also smells like a broken glow stick

I would give this 5 stars, but I feel I should warn people the texture is kind of gritty, BUT if you rub it on, let it sit for 15 seconds before you put on your next product, it doesn’t mess with the application of your next product. Honestly, for the price this stuff is awesome!

I bought this approximately a month ago and it just faded my light scars a lil bit. First time it felt grainy but after that it just mind blowing no more grainy feel!!!! It just moisturize my face in the morning like an angel. I prefer to use this jn the night after moisturizer as I use this with Ordinary rosehip oil. It works magic
The first days that I used it my skin looked fine but then my skin would burn and then many bumps appeared on my skin. It just wasn’t for me.

Love this product!  After reading previous reviews about smell, gritty texture, too oily, etc... I was expecting the worst, but was willing to endure all to get the expected skin result.My experience?  No smell, no excess oil, no gritty feeling.  Yes, there is a tingling, but then again you are not supposed apply this on broken skin.  All in all, 4 uses, my pores are 1/2 the size.
Gritty and stings! Not sure who thought a gritty face product was a good idea but this is the worst Vitamin C cream I have tried

I really like this product! I have visible sun damage and dark spots and I have noticed quite a difference in evening out my skin tone since using this product- in combination with other products as well.
Love this Vitamin C! It is a bit grainy feeling but I just blend it with my moisturizer for a smoother application.
It was just okay.  My face burns when I put it on.  I need to cut it with something else.  I think there are nicer products out there.

Definitely gritty, I get why people don’t like that. But if I shake it first then mix it directly in my moisturizer it’s not problematic at all. The HA spheres/grittiness dissolve really quickly that way. Also, I think people might be using too much at once, you only need a tiny bit.But anyhow, I’ve been using this a couple weeks now and I’ve noticed a difference. My pores are clearer & look smaller. I look hydrated & glowing. Overall my skin looks more smooth & supple. I’m 33 & it seems to be making some difference on my laugh lines & 11’s.I took off one star because it IS a little gritty & messy but it’s worth it, especially since it seems to work. Also, I dont think this will be good for sensitive skin. I personally do not have sensitivity issues & I find it a little tingly. But I’ll definitely be buying this again.

review_title: definitely worth it despite the flaws
review_text: This product is great! It does feel greasy, but I mix it in with my moisturizer before going to bed, so I don’t notice it too much. By the morning, my skin is always super glowy and soft and I can really tell a difference. Sure it’s not as perfect as other Ordinary products, but it does what it’s supposed to SO well.

I’m in the early stages of using this treatment. It’s recommended to use only at Night as this stuff is potent and tingles. Press and Pat is the way to go with this treatment. This is not a lotion and a followup night moisturizer is needed. I have uneven texture skin and acne scars on my t-zone and I have instantly felt this product doing its thing and brightened my skin in the applied areas. One dot goes a long way. My product isn’t gritty but a white lotion texture. I use other products from the Ordinary line. If you’re looking to completely start over on your skin regimen I would try this potent Vitamin C treatment.

This product ina bit rough on application stings slightly when you first put it on.. that’s normal but I find this product to be light feeling slight oil feel when first on, but doesn’t last long, I haven’t broke out with zits and noticed my circles under my eyes lighter.I only put this on with my lotion at night. I wear sunscreen and lotion for the day as it’s summer

I was so excited to try this product but I’ve really disliked it. The texture is grainy and unpleasant to rub into skin. It leaves an unpleasant tingling feeling (and I do not have sensitive skin), lastly it has an unpleasant metalic scent to it. Such a deviation from the rest of their great product line.
Greasy, the squalane oil clogged my pores. Unlike other reviewers I only felt some tingling, and have not noticed a noticeable change in my acne scarring. Would not repurchase.
The texture is very grainy and it doesn’t not play well with other products but I have noticed a change in my skin tone and dark spots.

I previously used the Vitamin C Suspension in Silicone and it was awful. This one is so much better! It actually stays put, I have had no issues with peeling like I did with the silicone. It goes on so easy, just like moisturizer. My only issue is that it’s super gritty compared to the silicone based suspension. But the results are undeniable. Highly recommend

review_title: But Why Do My Hands Smell Weird?
review_text: I like this product because it really does leave my skin glowy the next morning. A little gritty but it absorbs well & the HA in it makes sure it doesn’t dry out my already dry sensitive skin. One thing I will say is that this product makes my hands STINK. It doesn’t make my face stink & the product itself doesn’t have too much of a smell but there’s something in my hand chemistry that makes this stuff reek. & the smell is hard to wash off... and if I accidentally touch my face, it’s right back. It’s bad enough that it may be a deal breaker honestly.
Love this product. Great price and works good. Did not irritate my skin and feels like it’s working. The brand is great
It’s decent. Slight but bearable stinging sensation. It’s kind of gritty like a little bit of sand got in it; so I mix it with the Ferulic acid one that they have. But it has lightened my dark spots.

I wanted to love this so much! I was so excited but was turned off especially when it arrived two weeks late. After just a few days, I noticed small, whitehead-like bumps all across my face, in places I had never broken out before. The gritty texture is also horrible and feels like a super rough microdermabrasion or physical exfoliant. Again, would have loved to love this product, but was really a flop.

Ive been using pharmaceutical-grade vitamin c products for more than a decade.  this beats most of them both in efficacy and (a serious beating) in price.  the tackiness goes away quickly if indeed it is being used correctly.  i.e.  don’t just pile it on right after using another product and allow it to sink in at least 1 minute before following with moisturizer or sunscreen.
I don’t like how it feels, kinda of like an exfoliate and stings too much.
Wonderful product.  Just like all the products I bought from the line.  Very pleased with the products and the values ​​I paid for them.

I haven’t noticed any visible improvements in my skin but I don’t use this daily--I rotate it with a few other The Ordinary products. It stings slightly and has a gritty texture upon application but both subside after a few minutes. Given the price, absolutely no complaints from me! I’m sure the concentration is also much stronger than many other serums, hence the stinging.

I’ve gone through two tubes and haven’t noticed much difference in my skin. It’s a little brighter, it’s a little softer, etc but it’s not enough to make me put up with how itchy this makes my face/neck or it’s weird smell.

review_title: Excellent product for the price point!
review_text: I have been trying to find a good vitamin c solution for a long time. Most of the serums I’ve tried made me breakout so I would quit after a few weeks. When I started using this, I hadn’t been using any vitamin or acids for awhile. First impression: it does sting a little bit. However, it’s not a painful experience or anything. I started using it a couple of times a week in the morning with a couple of drops of the brand’s resveratrol and ferulic acid serum. I’m definitely more used to it now so I have upped the frequency to a few times a week. The serum I mix it with makes my face feel a little greasy (I like to say glowy) so I stick to using it before work when I’m just doing foundation and not a full face of makeup. Overall I am really impressed and I get a lot of compliments on my skin. Also the price point really seals the deal for me. If nothing else it’s not a huge investment if you don’t like it (which is the case with many vitamin c treatments).

I had mixed feelings about this product at first, but I determined that the good outweighs the bad. When first appliedy, it’s extremely greasy and gritty; generally gross-feeling. If you have any areas of sensitive skin like on the lower edges of your face/jaw or beneath your nose, it also has the potential to burn. (Not just a mere “tingle“, but painful burn.) That said, the morning after I use this, my face is incredibly (noticeably!) soft. My skin soaks up all of my facial products and just feels really amazing.Use these tips, and give it a chance to see for yourself: 1) Do a patch test for sensitivity first, and avoid areas with particularly delicate skin. 2) Apply at night with nothing on top. (Don’t bother to use this in the morning or put makeup over it. It’ll look terrible.) 3) Put it on and don’t touch your face. (Trust me, it’ll feel gross). Don’t apply immediately before bed, or it will get your pillow all greasy. 4) In the morning, give your face a thorough cleanse and use your normal skincare/makeup products. You’ll be amazed at how soft your skin feels!

review_title: Mix this with Hyaluronic acid for glowing skin! ✨
review_text: I have dry skin and I mix this with Hyaluronic acid at night. I give it about 15 minutes to fully skin in the skin. I wake up with a beautiful, soft, radiant face. I love this!

I love this product. Price point is great and it is deff detoxifying for the face. I love the way it works and feels. Only downfall is I wish they sold a bigger bottle of it because this one lasted me a couple weeks..maybe 3? I do like a reasonable layer..not too thick and not too thin but The Origins or Fresh charcoal masks are a higher price point but last longer somehow..
Love the effect, hate the texture! Its a bit rough / grainy so I have to mix it with my moisturizer to make it bearable because I do love how much its helped with my dark spots & acne scars.

Wow. This stuff is intense.  Didn’t really understand the nature of product,  bc first time I used, it was torture.  Eventually,  I learned to mix with another serum to make it bearable.   The worst part of it tho, is this is a major magnet- every piece lint or dust in  my house gets stuck on my face.

review_title: potent and works well but use with caution
review_text: I haven’t yet used this product for a long period of time but I can say that it works. I was somewhat hesitant about the idea of a suspension because it didn’t know if the absorbic acid not being completely dissolved would make it ineffective. This product has an unmistakable sting and burn to it which tells me that the vitamin c is effective.  I want to note that this product is extremely strong, it feels more like a acid peel than a brightening serum. The granules adds to the intense exfoliating effect. If you have somewhat sensitive skin I wouldn’t leave this on overnight as it is still effective if left for a hour or 2. I used this product after using a acid treatment and retinol the night before,  yes i am stupid, i woke up this morning with peeling, raw, weeping skin. While this is my fault, It shows just how potent this product is. Definitely not your average brightening vitamin c serum that you can use without much thought.

I don’t mind the texture at all. I’m unsure if this product is doing anything. I use it only at night before bed. In the morning my skin looks nice but maybe I’m seeing what I want to see? I don’t use it daily as it’s hard to stand the tingles once it’s on my face. Not sure I would buy again.

This has a weird gritty texture. I could get over it if I liked the product otherwise but it’s kinda meh. I feel like there are so many vitamin C products to choose from now that are better. Love other things from the ordinary but this one is a let down. Someone else here mentioned putting this on their body, I will probably do the same to use it up :)

review_title: It worked, but it's not for sensitive skin
review_text: After using this on and off for 2 weeks, my skin was getting brighter. It helped with my discolored acne scars. Although, my skin always burned after using this and, because of that, I wouldn’t recommend it for sensitive skin. Otherwise, this worked well.

This stuff has really helped my uneven texture on my cheeks and forehead and has made those areas surprisingly soft. It’s a great product, especially for the price! However, the only thing I cannot get past is that it turns my fingers orange and has that fake tan smell. From what I’ve read, when vitamin C oxidizes it turns into the same active ingredient in fake tan that “tans” your skin. Even after washing my hands (after using it on my face), my fingers/nails are orange and smell weird. I do recommend it, just be warned that your fingers may turn color.

I’ve been battling uneven skin tone for years now and this was the simple solution. People have pointed out how different my skin has been and I’ve only been using this a short time. I don’t love the consistency of the product, but the product works and that’s all you can really want. It’s worth way more than what you pay!!

This is really grainy, that’s no joke. Certainly let us soak in and dry before applying anything on top of it. I am only using it now for an extra boost every 2 weeks. For me, the dose of Vitamin C is too high for daily use. When it runs out, I will likely not purchase again.

This product works super well, and the price is insanely low for how effective it is. The added HA is amazing, too--in the heat of summer I just use this under my sunscreen, without having to apply a moisturizer over.Prior to using The Ordinary, I’d gotten used to incorporating Vitamin C into my routine by mixing Philosophy’s Vitamin C powder into my moisturizer. I still think the Philosophy product is great, but it was such a hassle to take the little glass bottle and spoon with me (I even managed to crack it) when I travel. This is probably why when I switched to the Ordinary, I did not experience any stinging, but you may (I did when I first started using C at all). I don’t mind the gritty texture, it lets me know I’ve successfully applied it to my whole face. I love the high concentration as well, as I could really see the difference once I switched. My mom was so impressed when she visited me by my skin she made me order it for her! (And I think she uses too much so she just had me order her a second container, all while I haven’t finished my first)!
Been using it now over a month. No results to report. Slight tingling when in use.
This product is very gritty and doesn’t feel great on the skin. It also has a weird chemical smell. I wanted to love this product because I love the ordinary, but this was a miss for me.
Used it for over 2 months. Didn’t notice a change, it also had a weird smell to it.
yuck.. it’s like thick oil with a sheen and sticky and doesnt absorb.. kind of feels like a primer powdery but greasy at the same time

People say that the texture is gritty. But it’s like any normal cream to me tbh. And yes it does take some time to set on the skin. I’ve been using it every 2 days and OH MY GOD I have seen a difference after just one use. My face has certainly started to glow. I bought this to get rid of my hyperpigmentation problem. Let’s see how it works on that. I’ll be writing another review after some time to let you know if this really worked on my hyper-pigmented upper lips.
I really wanted to like this product but it made my face break out and had a weird chemically smell.

I am a product JUNKY, especially when it comes to skincare. I’m always on the hunt for new lotions and potions. I came across The Ordinary by happenstance, and the price certainly made me stop and research. This stuff can sometimes be slightly stingy...and the texture is a bit off putting when you first use it because it almost has a grainy texture BUT, I am actually noticing a difference in my skin! And not just ’I want to believe’ but an actual difference.I also like that this company is no frills. Simple packaging, simple products.

So this was my first The Ordinary purchase, and as a skin care junkie on a budget I love this. I apply it a couple times a week before bed, and top off with a heavier moisturizer. A lot of the reviews I saw said it can be kind of gritty but that wasn’t an issue for me, neither was any stinging and I have veerrryyy sensitive skin. I have faint lines starting on my forehead and they were completely unnoticeable after the first night of use. I have chubby cheeks too so it helped plump up my smile lines.

Honestly, this seems to be working beautifully so far. Very plumping and after using it consistently for a few weeks, I feel there is an overall improvement in my skin pigmentation and discoloration. Here’s the question however and boy would I love an answer...nearly every other person comments about the fact that this is gritty. I’ve seen you tube videos discussing the REASON for the grittyness,as well as why such is unavoidable; in order provide Vitamin C in this concentration and remain stable it needs to be in a powder form until applied and subsequently absorbed, and there is literally no way around this...but...MINE ISN’T THE SLIGHTEST BIT GRITTY???  In all other ways it’s nearly exactly as the reviews describe ...it does sting similarly to how my acids feel going on. It does pill a bit if I’m not careful when applying other things on top of it, if I rub, rather than patting things in, and so wonder what the heck is going on!!! If there is any way someone can comment back to me through my Sephora acct, I would sure appreciate it!!! It’s driving me bonkers whenever I think about it and wonder if this product is a dud or if I got something else in the wrong packaging? I don’t have any idea...  ;’)

This is an amazing product! I’m not ridiculously invested in skincare. But I do the basics. I was my face EVERY morning and night, use a serum and moisturize. And occasionally a face mask. That being said, I’ve noticed a huge difference!! I had never heard of this brand before, ran out of moisturizer and immediately went to sephora online and sorted skincare by price low to high (I mean who doesn’t?). I honestly couldn’t believe this brand- the claims, the reviews, all for ridiculously low prices?! But the claims are true. The reviews are true. My skin is evening out in its unevenness. While it did take me a minute to get used to the texture and the burning sensation, I quickly grew to love it. 10/10 will buy again, if it ever comes back in stock. Pretty sure their prices won’t stay this low forever once they realize how awesome it is and how many people will love it.!!

review_title: Girl quit playing and add it to your cart
review_text: I absolutely love this stuff its a lil gritty but if you mix it with a heavy night cream you’ll avoid it.I notice a difference literally overnight i even used it on rough patches on my knees and elbows.I’m truly summer ready no rough knees elbows or ankles, and for the price girl quit playing and it add to you cart.You’ll be glad you did. P.s. a lil goes along way and be careful it tingles at first but beauty can be pain at times

I have a lot of old dark spots from picking, so for the price, I had to try this. It does have a very gritty texture, but after massaging this into my skin for five minutes, it dissipated. It definitely burns in some spots. I waited five more minutes and applied Good Genes. I got some pillage, but so far am very pleased and eager for this to work.

review_title: There’s a Trick to This Stuff!
review_text: I love this cream. Since using it as part of my nighttime regimen, my skin has changed dramatically. I live in southern Ontario, and in the cold dry winter months my skin has the worst flaky patches that make my foundation look cheap and awkward. Since using this, my skin is smooth, bright, and moisturized, and my skin tone is evened out. I do find that it pills, and I find it difficult to “pat” into the skin. I use a small pea sized amount (you don’t need anymore than that) and I add 3 drops of The Ordinary Alpha Arbutin 2% + Hyaluronic Acid and mix in my palm, then apply it to my face; it doesn’t pill, and spreads so evenly. Highly recommend!

review_title: Great product from a great line!
review_text: This product produced visible results on me.  It does burn a bit but if you add a drop to The Ordinary Buffet serum, it alleviates any discomfort.  I had hyper-pigmentation from cysts and within one month, they were gone.  I will definitely be buying this from now on!

This product has a light watery creamy texture with bits of gritty spheres and definitely looks like a serum on the skin (that glossy oily look) for a while until it starts absorbing. It also causes a slight tingling sensation that doesn’t bother me. Because of the face glaze and tingle I use this on home lounge days (day time) and after a few hours I wipe off any residue with a hydrating toner. Since using this my face has more glow, extraction scars have healed quickly and nicely, and I’ve noticed a huge improvement on the texture and pores on my forehead. I’m ready to restock as soon as Sephora does!

review_title: PLEASE keep this stocked and BRING it to stores!
review_text: Sephora please keep this product stocked! as far as affordability it is the best vitamin c product on the market. I use it in conjunction with glycolic acid and the two together melt into my skin (goodbye grainy texture). it takes a minute for it to sink in (like literally 1 minute tops) then I’m free to apply my AM or PM moisturizer. Can even layer my foundation and concealer over top. BRING THIS BACK IN STOCK it’s ALWAYS sold out when I want to repurchase and my current tube is on its last legs.
Skin is more even and clearer. I like the little tingle.

This stuff does feel a little gritty as you put it on, but I use it in my evening routine and give it a few minutes to settle before I put on moisturizer and it’s fine. I like the effect it has on my skin and that it’s still pretty gentle.
I love this and the tingle. What I don’t like is that the “tube“ is way less then half full. It’s cheap, but awesome products. Wish online stocked them more often.

I didn’t pay close enough attention before purchasing. The grittiness of this is very off putting to me. I don’t see how this could be used in an AM skin care ruin since the mixture does not easily dissolve to a smooth finish. Can’t complain about the price, but don’t expect I’ll ever reach for this given the texture. The closest example I could give is that it feels like trying to blend an exfoliating cleanser into dry skin.

I understand why some people would find this texture uncomfortable but I do think it makes a huge difference on how much you use/ how long you wait to apply your next product. I use a small amount so it does not get overly gritty. It does sting a little bit the first couple times but now I do not notice that affect. My skin is noticeably brighter and if I make sure to apply this, wait at least 30 minutes then go in with a moisturizer, this works fine with layering products and even applying makeup later on. Of course if you don’t have that time in the AM, this is great at night :]

Of the Ordinary products I’ve tried so far, this is the only one that has been a fail for me.  It has a gritty texture so it requires some rubbing into the skin.  I wouldn’t mind this so much, but I immediately got a few small pimples (my acne is generally pretty under control so pimples are rare).  I had to discontinue use immediately so I can’t speak to it’s brightening properties.
Hydrating sinks right in just good luxury skincare period

I received this product complimentary from Influenster. Complete transparency I was a little skeptical about using the product but I was actually pleasantly surprised. This little eye cream/serum was wonderful. The applicator tip is nice and cooling which felt really good after a long day and once I had taken off my make up. I did notice that after about a week to week and a half I had less fine lines and I feel like my eyes were slightly less puffy. I can see this product lasting me a while because truly only need a small small amount of the cream/serum. Big fan of product not a big fan of the price.

I used this eye cream daily for a few weeks and I definitely de a difference! I can wait to see the results in a few months! There is no scent and the here is no sticky feeling afterwards. I would definitely recommend this product! You cannot go wrong

I was really excited to receive this product.  I haven’t noticed drastic results. However, I’ve noticed that it calmed my under eye area so it was less puffy and the fine lines were softened. The metal tip is so soothing and glides nicely on the skin. The serum is light & a little goes a long way. It absorbs nicely into the skin. I did struggle to get the serum to squeeze out. The tune needs to be a little softer.

review_title: Worth it, if you have the budget for it.
review_text: The product is overall, easy to apply and rather convenient given its design. The applicator is pretty neat but short lived, considering it’s supposed to feel nice and cool since it’s metal but it quickly warms up after finishing one eye. Prior to using this specific product, my eyes were in decent condition as I already had a product I was using prior to receiving this. Not puffy or dark, but just some little lines here and there. I stopped using my daily eye creams and just used the Dior product once in the AM and once in the PM so I can get a true review of the effects. The results were very slight for me personally- again, I don’t have a lot of wrinkles or eye issues, just some light wrinkles. I began seeing results after 2 consecutive weeks of use, the lines became more faint than they were when I first started using this product. By week 3 and 4, there was minimal change and I was okay with that. For $80, it’s a steep price - I saw similar results for a product that runs $54. The trick to these eye creams is that when you do stop using it, the lines return so it’s not a permanent solution and I saw this when I forgot to pack this during vacation to Aruba for a week. When I returned the same results came back. Overall, I would recommend if you want something luxurious. It does what it says, but only as long as you continue to use the product. Maybe I need to finish the entire bottle before permanent results, however I haven’t gotten to that point yet.

I was fortunate enough to be chosen to sample this eye serum for my honest opinion on it. I absolutely loved the tip on it. The metal felt good spreading the serum under my eyes. I felt that it definitely helped with the puffiness and bags under my eyes that I tend to suffer with daily (no matter hope much sleep I get or water I drink) but I felt it didn’t help at all with the fine lines and wrinkles I have around my eyes. I also wasn’t thrilled about how strong it is scented. It actually made my eyes water when I applied it because the smell was so strong. I’m glad I was given the opportunity to try this but I think I’ll stick with the eye serum I’ve been using that costs only a fraction of the price of this Dior serum

review_title: Great product added to my beauty routine
review_text: I received this product to try and I must say I am impressed with the results. I notice a difference around corners of eyes feeling more smooth.
It’s not terrible but I’ve used many other eye serums that deliver the same results but are half the price. I do really like the applicator of this product.

review_title: Loved! But need sale to justify price
review_text: This is beautiful from the formula to the packaging. Love the cooling metal applicator! After continued use, it left my undereye skin firm, soft and brightened, as soon as the first week!  This is a great addition to my skin routine, though I wish it didn’t require an additional eye cream. I really enjoyed using it, but I can’t see myself spending this kind of coin without a huge discount.

I received this product from Influenster to try and noticed a huge difference just a couple days after using it regularly. The applicator is unique and cooling, and the serum gets to work quickly!! My only qualm is the heavy fragrance. Thankfully it didn’t irritate my eyes or my skin, but I really wish companies would stop adding heavy perfume in makeup and skincare.

review_title: All the luxury you’re used to with Dior but this t
review_text: Typically I don’t like spending more on luxury brands for just the packaging. But this product is so much more than just a sleek design. I was fortunate to receive it complimentary for testing purposes. I love the potency of the product, leaving great results. The ingredients worked well for my fine lines and overall better eye appearance. The design of the applicator is the best I’ve seen yet! I will definitely get this product again! All the luxury you’re used to with Dior but this time for your skin!

I liked the metal applicator tip, it was nice and cooling on the eyes. The products absorbed well & didn’t feel greasy or heavy. I used this day and night on the upper part of my face, I liked its versatility for both. Some products I feel are better either only the day or night.

I’ve spent my adult life on a quest for the best eye cream. I still haven’t found it, but like this one enough to purchase another tube. I saw a slight improvement to the dark circles under my eyes and love the feeling as the cream soaks in - a bit like you’ve had a little eye lift as it tightens your skin and gives it some bounce. My only complaint is that it’s a little sticky, so I was able to use every night, but could only use on days where I didn’t need to also apply make up.

This is one of the beat eyecreams I have ever used. This is the second Dior skincare products I have tried. The packaging is luxurious, and has a nice pale pink color that I like. I have dry under eyes, and this cream kept them hydrated. The applicator to apply is a really nice treat. The cream was smooth and feels nice. I didn’t notice any scent which was a plus. The bags under my eyes seems to have gotten a little better. Yes, I would recommend.

review_title: In love with the cooling applicator
review_text: Have been using this eye serum for couple weeks I already love the instant cooling and refreshing of massaging the metallic applicator around my eyes, squeezing the proper amount can be tricky but i got use to it with time. The serum is light weighted and absorbed quickly non sticky, I didn’t use it alongside the eye cream so am not sure of it is anti-aging benefits. It is hydrating but I haven’t noticed any changes regarding the fine lines.

One of the biggest things that I suffer from is puffiness around my eyes. I don’t have a ton of fine wrinkles, but I am definitely noticing a few creases happening near my eyes. This is creamy, glides on easy and has a cooling effect.
i like it! the serum feels hydrating and the metal applicator feels very nice on the under eye area. not sure how “potent” it is as far as anti-aging, but good as a moisturizing eye cream.

I really liked this product, but I have a few qualms with it. 1. It felt moisturizing and calming on my sensitive eyes, and allowed me to layer a stronger product on top that would have irritated my eyes alone. However adding an additional product (eye serum that still needs to use an eye cream on top of it) isn’t something I see in my routine long term.2. The applicator feels great. I love the cooling sensation, but I wish it had a softer side to make it easier to use. It can be hard to squeeze out without the product getting sucked back

This eye serum is great! I love the applicator, which gives the eye area a bit of a massage. It has a nice, cooling effect as well, which feels great during application. It absorbs well and doesn’t leave residue on the skin. Only a little bit is needed at a time, so the bottle should last a long time! However, it is definitely pricey for an eye serum, depending on what you usually buy. My eyes looked more refreshed, didn’t have as much of a dark circle look, and looked like the skin around the eyes was a bit plumper. Would definitely recommend if you’re looking for a high-end eye serum to make your eye area look younger!

I really liked the applicator. It is very cool to the touch. I use this in the morning to depuff my eyes. The formula is very smooth, and easy to absorb. Howver I did not notice much difference. I would probably not buy this again, but I think the applicator it self is worth 4 stars!

I received this product complimentary through Influenster for my honest review. I have been using this product for about 2 and a half weeks now. It has a light scent that isn’t very noticeable. I love the applicator, it provides a nice cooling massage. I was also surprised to find that a little bit goes a long way! My skin feels super hydrated and less puffy after I apply. However, dark circles have always been a problem for me because I have very fair thin skin under my eyes. I have not noticed a difference in the darkness under my eyes. Overall I do really like this product and how it makes my skin feel!

I prefer to use eye serums in my nighttime routine but I ended up using this in the morning AND at night. The metal swirl application is DIVINE! The cooling effect is so refreshing and soothing, especially after waking up. I really enjoy massaging the product into my eye area. The serum is lightweight and has a very smooth consistency. It absorbs quickly into the skin. I have sensitive skin and didn’t experience any congestion issues or irritation. I’m in my thirties and I’m starting to see wrinkles. Thankfully after a few weeks of use, I’m seeing a reduction in their severity. But my undereye puffiness has seen the most improvement.

This product will be a new staple in my routine. There is something about the cool metal top that just feels refreshing when applying the serum under the eyes. I’ve only used it for a few weeks but I can tell how my puffiness and darkness went lighter under my eyes. I would definitely recommend!!! I received this product for free to try in return for my honest opinion and this is as accurate and honest as it’ll get! Absolutely love it!

It’s pricey but it works. I don’t normally go.for eye treatments but I’ve noticed a difference in brightness and some firmness since I started using this product. In love the bottle and applicator. It would be great to keep in the fridge if you have a skincare fridge in your bathroom.

This is an eye serum that helps diminish puffiness, fine lines, and dark circles. It’s very lightweight and has a light scent, but I do wish it was a cream instead so it can be more moisturizing. It applies and dries pretty easily as well. It also has an applicator tip that you can use to help massage your eye area, but I personally like using my fingers. I’ve been using this both in my morning and night routine for a couple of weeks and I have noticed very slight differences. My main concerns are fine lines and dark circles and I have noticed the area is a tiny bit more taut and just a bit brighter. I think I have to use it more to see more results, but so far I’m happy with it.
I love this applicator so much, it makes the serum feel even better on my skin! The serum is refreshing and feels so moisturizing.

This was between a 4 and 5 for me! But, I received this complimentary and want to give an honest review. The bottle is so well designed. As my photo shows, it comes with a metal like dispenser that is cool and soothing when using. It is its own depuffer and would probably be amazing if I had a small make up fridge to keep it in. I saw results too, within the first week. Less bags! It did leave a bit of a sticky residue under my eye though, so I used it at night. My only flaw for the product. But the dispenser makes up for it!

The applicator on this eye serum is my favorite part. The cooling sensation I get when I apply this serum along with the general effectiveness of the product makes it a winner. It doesn’t irritate my eyes and absorbs quickly into my dry skin skin.

Well I am a mom of toddler twins who has little time for skin routines or to care for herself I’m always tired and from health issues I either have puffy eyes dark circles or both this eye serum was amazing from the convenient dispenser to how calming the cream felt I am always a skeptic and this actually exceeded my expectations I definitely have noticed a difference in my drains and puffiness has drastically reduced and looks so much better also it was easy to apply makeup and the like after the eye serum! I will be buying this for sure I received it for free for a honest review and to be honest I can’t wait to see how I look after I finish the tube!

review_title: Excellent Eye Serum with Cooling Applicator
review_text: I have been using Dior Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum now for about a week and I am loving the results. My skin looks brighter and feels more firm after applying each morning and evening. I don’t struggle with puffiness in the mornings, but do occasionally have darker areas under my eyes and this serum helps minimize and brighten underneath my eyes. Some of my smaller fine lines have even disappeared as the serum plumps and hydrates those areas. I have enjoyed using Dior Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum because the applicator feels nice and cooling on the skin. Also unlike other products, I noticed a change in my skin after using the serum only 3 or 4 times. Although pricey, this is definitely an eye serum I will likely purchase in the future.

Love this product so far! It has an instant brightening effect! I’ve been dealing with some dark circles lately and it has definitely made them more manageable! It’s a lightweight formula with a subtle scent and you can’t beat the packaging with the applicator!

I received this complimentary of Influenster and have been using it for a few days now and I love it so far. I haven’t seen any difference in my skin but I love the applicator on the tube. My only suggestion is not to squeeze it right onto your skin because a lot can come out at once since it’s a serum. I normally put it on my finger dab it onto my skin and massage it using the tip of the tube.

Loving this serum!  I love the metal tip applicator.  It is soothing and cooling, really helps with fine lines and puffiness.  I have been using for a few days.  My eyes are a little brighter, puffiness definitely coming down.  Just be careful when applying not to squeeze the tube because the serum can come flooding out and this isn’t a product you want to waste!

I have been on a hunt for a suitable eye serum for years now. I have tried different brands but the capture total eye serum has been the most effective in my experience. I love how the surrounding skin of my eyes felt really moisturized after each use. Plus the cooling effect of the applicator which is tantamount to the effectiveness of the serum. My eye area looks so much younger and healthier.Thank you Influenster for the present !!!

review_title: Loved the applicator and the smell!
review_text: I received this product free to try from Influenster. I loved the fragrance of this serum, it wasn’t chemically it was more like a perfume which was nice. The applicator head was a nice experience and I can see its benefits. My eyes do seem brighter and more tight. My wrinkles were slightly reduced but I probably need to use it longer. Overall it was a great product!

I received these products forfree from Influenster andbrand(s) in exchange for my review. This is a very nice eye serum. Light, smooth and non-greasy. A little goes a long way. The applicator is very good. It does not pull on the skin. After my first use I noticed the skin around my brow area looked slightly firmer. And my brow line was more defined. I am very happy with this product.
I love this product so far. It has made my face feel so cool and moisturized. My under eye circles are gone!

I did receive this Dior Eye Serum for free in exchange for giving my honest review so here it is... I was so excited to try this eye serum because I love the idea behind it (I regularly use facial tools like stone or cryo-rollers, micro-needling, etc.). It is very lightly scented & I had no problems whatsoever with sensitivity or stinging which is sometimes an issue. I can’t wait to try it in the refrigerator cause I think this would intensify the applicator’s ability to de-puff the eye area via massage. My only issue was my arthritic hands had trouble squeezing the bottle which is kind of hard & rigid. This was easily remedied though by using both hands to squeeze out a tiny amount, then applying half of that dose to each eye, then using the applicator to massage the product in. I also feel like it will be impossible to get out product when it’s nearing its end because of the packaging design, but I’m not shy about cutting things open to get out every last drop & will update if I have any problems or issues later on. Eye creams last me forever but I’ve been using them religiously since I was 18, plus wearing sunscreen without fail, and I don’t have a single line or wrinkle at almost 45 to speak of! Use your eye cream & sunscreen ladies & gents... My skin is a testament to their power (I only upload untouched photos)! This is a great eye moisturizer to try & I highly recommend!

Very moisturizing and revitalizing! I received this product through Influenster to try and am so glad I was able to. This eye serum went on smoothly (the applicator is kind of unique) and appeared to diminish some of the slight wrinkles that I had around my eyes. The only con I saw was that it appeared to accentuate my dark circles on some of the nights that I put this product on, but that could also have been just a coincidence.

Dior Capture Totale Eye Serum.. It is an eye cream that feels so good when applied, its oval tip when making contact with your eyes feels fresh (a little cold) you feel so good in each application, I fell in love with this cream and its changes when applying it. .. I recommend it 100%

I was excited to receive this serum as a sample from Influenster.  I have now used it for 4 weeks and It’s amazing. I love silky fluid texture and how it glides perfect on the skin.  The applicator feels cool and really helps with puffiness.  It leaves you skin smooth and hydrated. I will definitely keep using this luxurious product.

I love trying anything eye care related. I was super excited to give this serum a try. At first glance I really liked the package a very sleek look. The applicator was one of my favorite things about this serum makes application really easy and fun.  The serum it’s self is also very good. Very moisturizing and give my eyes a soft awake look. Can’t wait to keep using it and see better results.

Definitely not worth the price. I’ve been testing this out for a few weeks 2x a day and there hasn’t been much difference. The packaging isn’t my fav, the little metal tip which is supposed to be cool/cold doesn’t stay cool/cold long enough for both eyes to really benefit from it. Like is said it’s nice but I’ll be continuing my search for the holy grail eye serum.

Was just ok. The applicator tip was nice and cooling but the moisturizing effects didn’t last long. I felt the need to follow up with eye cream on top. Not worth the high price for me. I received this product free in exchange for my honest review.

This serum has a lovely texture, smooth and luxurious, with a cooling nature on its own in addition to the cooling effect provided by the applicator. The applicator itself is convenient and perfectly shaped for the eye area, with ridges to help smoothly spread the product while gently massaging it in. After a few minutes I consistently notice a tightening of the skin under my eyes and at the edges, and it absorbs quickly and thoroughly, but I haven’t noticed the brightening effects I had hoped for. I’m very fair and experience some darkness under my eyes that is more pronounced. Over the month or so that I’ve used it, I have definitely noticed firming and lifting around my eyes. The only drawback is that dispensing enough product onto the applicator is a learning curve, but overall it seems there is less product waste than with more traditional potted eye products.

received this product complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I absolutely love this Dior Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum. First off, the delivery system is like none other. The applicator tip perfectly fits the contour of the undereye area, and the ridges in the tip combined with the cool feel is so soothing when applied. The packaging is truly elegant and I give it five stars. The Serum itself is not too heavy, but a perfect balance to provide your delicate eye area with the perfect amount of hydration without stickiness or pilling. Great product, which I highly recommend that you add to your beauty arsenal.

On the plus side, it smells nice and feels good upon application. However, I don’t see much a difference in the puffiness of my under eye area after continued used for about a month AM and PM. I wouldn’t recommend this product.

This eye serum was great for puffiness under my eyes. The applicator is a nice cool metal that feels great on the skin. It leaves a light reflecting sheen under the eye that helps with the reduced appearance of dark circles. I would not say that it helped get rid of dark circles but rather it helped with the appearance. It moisturizes wonderfully. I would purchase this product in the future.

I received this product free from Influenster in exchange for my review. II waited a bit to leave my review even though I saw results literally the same day! I love the applicator. It feels so soothing on the under eye area and the shape fits into the contour of the eye perfectly. The serum itself is creamy and silky. My first use I noticed a brightness to my under eye area. With in 3 days I noticed my fine lines were diminished. The big deal though was when I started to notice my “hanging lid skin” was tighter. Obviously nothing is going to completely get ride of the droopy “hood” but it improved the contour of my entire eye area! There is instructions on how to place the applicator and what motions to use where. I followed those and had phenomenal results. I usually only used this once a day and it wears beautifully under makeup. Definitely love this eye serum and recommend it especially for us 40+ lovelies
This is a really phenomenal eye serum, it feels weightless on, instantly seems to tighten my undereye area, and over time has reduced my eye bags and fine lines.
Not a fan. Makes my skin tacky. Did not have any changes in my skin after using twice a day for 3 weeks.

36 year old female with average fine lines, average puffiness and darkness under eyes (like not enough sleep or from drinking alcohol) and dry to normal skin, used product twice a day for at least 3 weeks Pros: lightweight, sinks into skin quickly. The metal applicator tip is nice but doesn’t stay cool after about 10 seconds of use. Noticed my fine lines weren’t as predominant but they didn’t miraculously disappear /s; didn’t expect them to, it’s a serum, folks. No noticeable change in color for the under eye area. Puffiness wasn’t as frequent but I’m thinking it has to do with the massage technique and not so much the serum itself. They recommend placing some kind of eye cream on top, which I did every time. Cons: if you don’t like fragrance in your skincare products, this is gonna be a hard pass for y’all. The tube is made of a harder plastic which makes it difficult to squeeze out the appropriate amount. I usually ended up with too much product, which is painful because of the price tag. I mention the price only because eye creams at this price point last me so much longer. Final thoughts: the results this serum gave me were visible and came quicker than other high end/designer eye products I’ve used. I’d recommend giving it a shot!

I have mixed feelings about this DiorCapture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum.  The formula itself is a milky serum that absorbs quickly and leaves my eye area feeling soft and moisturized.  It is not greasey or sticky.  I have seasonal allergies and my eye get very puffy..  I was really hoping to see a huge difference in my puffy eyes, but only noticed a slight difference.  I do feel like it did help with the fine lines at the corners though.  It comes in a tube with a textured head where the product comes out.  You have to squeeze to get it out and keep continued pressure while applying or it goes back in the tube.  The textured head feels nice and cool and is like a mini massage for the eyes.  If you have product on it it glides smoothly over the eye, but if not or you don’t have enough it pulls and tugs.   I ended up using my fingers to apply to start and then the applicator to smooth on.

I received Dior Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum Complimentary from Influenster and Dior.  I used the product for 3 full weeks.  At first use, I did need the product instructions to follow the application and massage regimen.  I immediately noticed a cooling feeling to the areas applied.  The product did not have any noticeable scent.  It was a lightweight mix between a cream and a serum.  The application regimen made sense in terms of massaging the product into the skin while helping to reduce puffiness and lift the eye area.  The serum fully absorbed into the skin and left the eye area hydrated.  I do not normally have dark under eye circles or puffiness but I do have fine lines and wrinkles.  After 3 weeks of use I can say that I have noticed some of my under eye fine lines have disappeared and my under eyes are noticeably more hydrated.  I no longer need to dab eye cream under my eyes prior to applying concealer.  Dior Capture Totale hydrates the under eye so well that the concealer applies smoothly and I am no longer concerned about my under eye fine lines appearing more prominent due to the loss of moisture due to age.  The only potential negative to this product could be the price point.  However, only a minimal amount of product is used at each application and after 3 weeks it doesn’t seem like I’ve used even close to half of the serum.  I would definitely recommend this product.  I have tried many eye creams and serums in the past and none have given me any noticeable results.  I look forward to the results from continued use of this product and will definitely purchase this product!  #Diorcapturetotale #influenster

This serum was love at first sight! First of all, I love scented products as long as they don’t have a stinky smell. This eye serum has a very fresh scent , it reminds me of the Dior Fragrance Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming. It is lightweight and absorbs into the skin right away. I am not a big fan of that massage cool tip applicator, so I am squeezing a small amount of the product into my hand and just use it from there. My skin feels hydrated and fresh and less dark circles are noticed. I highly recommend it. A great tip is to use the One Essential Eye underneath it. Life changing.

I mean, I do see less puffiness for sure! And I do notice that my eye area is more hydrated, smooth and supple!  BUT, i do not notice a difference in the fine lines or darkness. They arent too bad to begin with though so maybe that is why I am not seeing a drastic change? Also the results thus far are short lived, meaning the firmer contour wears off as the day goes on. I do feel like this is a nice hydrating eye cream, but for that price I feel like there are other things that provide more results and are more price conscious.

I have been using this product twice a day since receiving. it doesn’t creep or interfere with makeup and makes my under-eye area feel moisturized. I haven’t noticed any difference in the fine lines. I can’t speak to its efficacy on dark circles or puffiness as I do not have that but the number one thing I look for in an eye product is that it doesn’t cause me to wake up with burning from the product creeping, and this didn’t, so that’s a win. My only complaint would be the design of the packaging. I find lip products in similar packaging to be unhygienic and do not purchase them so I certainly don’t like it for my sensitive eye area. In theory I like the idea of it but wish it were part of the cap so it could be cleaned without destroying the product, and no risk of product that has touched my skin going back into the tube to mix with the rest of the product.

I have mixed feelings about this!    I love the feel once it’s on, but it was very easy to put too much on, as it then didn’t soak into the skin well.    The applicator was amazing, and being slightly cold was lovely putting on an eye cream.   It felt like it smoothed and firmed appropriately.    Overall I liked it, except for if too much got on!!!

I was lucky enough to receive a tube of this eye serum from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. At first I had some trouble applying it, you have to squeeze the tube a little to get  just enough product on the tip that it will glide around the eye area. If you squeeze too much I feel like the product gets wasted, not enough and it skips/tugs. The serum feels very light and cool and absorbs almost instantly. I used the method where you swipe towards the middle 3 times under the eye and on eyelid, then smooth eyelid towards outside and finish with brow bone massage. I still have some trouble applying just the right amount so I massage in any excess using my fingertips following the same application method. The tip is textured and shaped unlike other eye serums that have a tip or rollerball, and it is flexible. This serum doesn’t seem to moisturize on its own but definitely helps my eye cream work better. After using this for a month I give it 3 stars because I have not noticed much difference and for this price tag I expect more. The box says I would notice “more awake” eyes, what does that even mean?  I would have like to seen a more ergonomic wand and moisturizing benefits. While I greatly appreciate the freebie, I would not repurchase.

I’ve been using Dior Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum both morning and night, for almost a month and I’m loving the results. The applicator is cooling and gently massages the serum all around my eyes, immediately making my eyes feel hydrated. I do have delicate skin and thought the wonderful scent would irritate my under eyes but it did not. This product is a serum. It is recommended you apply an eye cream as well.

It works well. I’ve seen improvements since using it. It’s lightweight, and absorbs nicely. There are some things that I don’t really care for. I don’t particularly like the bottle, and the way it dispenses the product. If you hold it upside down near where you are applying the product, I feel like it dispenses too much. If you hold it right side up, you can’t really get any out. I don’t particularly like the wavy lines on the applicator. I would prefer a smooth applicator. I don’t know if the bumpiness is supposed to help with working the product into the eye area. Overall I like the product, but didn’t give it higher stars because if the packaging. I received this product free in exchange for an honest review.

I received this complimentary for my honest review in my VoxBox. Let me start with the positives. I like the formula. It feels very nice on the skin and soaks right in. It leaves my skin feeling soft and not at all sticky like some serums do. It also works well under my makeup. What I wasn’t too impressed about is the packaging and the effectiveness of the serum. The squeeze tube plus the applicator makes it really difficult to get the right amount of product out and spread around where you want to apply it. Not enough and the applicator was pulling my skin, and too much was wasteful. Also, I only used this on one eye for 3 full weeks and didn’t really see any changes in the firmness, fine lines, or darkness of my circles. The only thing this serum provided for me was very soft skin and less puffiness. I don’t think I would buy this again.

I was excited to try out this serum. I’ve been using it now for a few weeks and have notice some change but not as much as I expected (I’m sure it varies by individual). The serum in comparison to other serum that I have tried is a bit better because i have notice dark circles minimizing. However, the packaging could be better. It is a bit difficult to push out the serum from the container. I make sure to squeeze it out slowly so only the amount I need comes out. The applicator does feel nice under the eye and feels soothing. I’m not sure if I would spend the money on this product, I think I still want to finish the product before making up my mind and seeing if there is a significant difference. One thin for sure, after applying this serum my under eye does feel smooth and looks refreshed. Overall, I think it’s a good product to try out once and wait to see if there is a noticeable difference before repurchasing.

I waited a little while to use this and make sure I was getting the full effect. I absolutely love it!! Great product, the application is easy and mess free and I feel like I can actually see a visible difference. I will absolutely spurge on this product from here on out. Worth every penny!

I received this product complimentary for my honest review. The serum felt smooth and nourishing.  It also seems to work rather quickly because I noticed slight reduction in puffiness.  I will continue to use for a reduction in dark circles.   The packaging is simple and clean.  This seems to work quicker than other serums.  I’ve shared this gem with friends.

I have been using this product for almost a month and I really liked the result. The contour of my eyes looks more hydrated and healthy. When I do my makeup, I like to use a moisturizing product that helps minimize fine lines and I love this product. I received it free for the purpose of testing and writing a review about it. I highly recommend it and especially for dry and mature skin.

I’ve tried all variations of eye products to help with under eye lines, but most of all for puffiness. Nothing really seemed to work until I tried the Dior Super Potent Eye Serum. I pair it with the Dior eye cream and the products combined are all I need! I don’t have dark circles, so can’t comment on how this product helps there.I keep it in the fridge so it’s extra cooling for am and mid afternoon touch ups (feels amazing!). I love the slanted tip/applicator for smoothing, especially when it’s chilled.Highly recommend, even though the price is high, a little bit truly goes a long way!

This is my first time trying Dior skincare. I was honestly expecting an average product with a big name slapped on it. That is not at all what I got. I was in awe when I noticed results the very first use. Considering the price I was hoping I didn’t fall in love but I absolutely did. The component has a metal applicator which Dior describes as “DOUBLE-PATENTED APPLICATOR: 360 CRYO-FLEXThe wide massaging head, 7 smoothing waves and super flexible neck of Super Potent Eye Serum’s high-performance applicator are adapted to different types of eye shapes****** to reach the most delicate areas around the eyes.“ It helps evenly distribute the product with little to no waste and depuff/soothe the eye area. Some important callouts, Composed of 92%* natural-origin ingredients, Super Potent Eye Serum’s formula includes:- Biocellular longoza technology, which re-energizes the skin.- Rye extract, which stimulates the skin for visible toning and firming action.- Acetylated hyaluronic acid, which helps maintain skin hydration.The serum itself it thin, sinks in well, is very hydrating, and definitely brightens the eye area. It has an almost radiant finish. Since I’m getting older, have two children, and don’t always get enough sleep, this product has been incredible. It makes me look awake, refreshed, depuffed, and more youthful. In the month I’ve been using this serum my fine lines and wrinkles have improved. My eye contour area is more hydrated, plump, and my dark circles have improved. Nothing will take away the hollows or completely erase my dark circles but this product has been the best I’ve ever tried. I seriously can’t be without now. I love it so much. Thank you to Dior for making such a lovely product

I have been using this serum for 2 weeks now and I feel the results build. In the beginning I did not always remember to use it but now it has become a daily staple. It helps the circles around my eyes and I think I look more awake and rejuvenated after continuous use. It has a light lovely scent. It comes with an applicator and I feel this could use some work which is why I took a star off. I find myself using my fingers vs the applicator from start to finish. I would overall recommend this product and will keep using it in my every day routine

review_title: Wonderful Serum for Your Skincare Collection
review_text: This is a lovely little product! I love the applicator and how it cools and gently massages the skin under your eyes. This caused zero irritation to my very sensitive skin and was incredibly soothing. The scent is light and lovely and the serum absorbs quickly. I have deep hollows under my eyes, so I’m not sure I see a difference in my dark circles (perhaps I will see a difference with further use), but my skin is much smoother and I have fewer creases, meaning the makeup under my eyes goes on smoothly and stays that way throughout the day. Highly recommend this serum!

This is the second skincare item ive tried grom dior and it did not disapoint. The serum absorbed well and my fine lines diminished. My one complaint would be the ridges in the applicator tip. I often found traces of product caught in the ridges and so i cleaned it off and applied the additional serum with my finger so none wkuld be lost. I loved that i had no clogged pores and my skin looked fabulous. A definate repurchase.
I’m noticing a difference with my eye wrinkles. I like the difference I’m seeing

This is a nice lightweight eye serum with a pleasant scent. I’ve noticed results just from using it about a week. It takes about 10 mins to soak all the way in and dry- during that time the product does feel a tiny bit sticky but that does go away pretty quickly. It has a nice applicator to apply the product but i found it to be a bit too big to fit under my eyes easily and didn’t care for it and started to just use my pinky to apply. This product has a hefty price tag so i wouldn’t buy this just for that reason because i know alot of products that are cheaper and do the same thing. I’ve tried alot of different products and this one is definitely nice though. I received this product complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review.

I received a free sample of Dior Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum from Influenster and Dior in exchange for my honest review.I like the applicator for this product. I keep it stored upright so that the product is at the tip and ready to use. I gently squeeze the tube to dispense a tiny bit of serum, then using the applicator, dot the serum on my upper lid, brow bone and below my lower lid. Then I smooth it with the applicator which has sort of a cooling effect. I have used this product for about a week and noticed my fine lines are less noticeable and the dark circles are not as dark. The only negative is that once the product is applied and dry, it does feel a little tacky.  Overall, I like this product as it has proven to show improvements to my eye area.

I have used lots of different eye creams, this is one of my favorites. To start, the packaging and the metal applicator is awesome. It glides along your under eyes area, glides on smooth, leaves the perfect amount of product and your fingers stay clean. It was super gentle, I have extremely sensitive eyes and I have reactions to a lot of products, but not this one. It didn’t bother my eyes at all. I have used it daily for two weeks now and I have noticed less puffiness, and I feel like the fine lines below my eyes are disappearing. I can’t wait to see my results in a few months. Great product!!

I have to admit that I’m easily stress and the stress reflect in my eye... puffy eye, dark circle, etc. So getting the right eye serum to address these problems is very important to me. review_title: Cute packaging and Calming for Irritated Skin
review_text: First off, the packaging is such an experience and so aesthetically pleasing. The jar is also such a good value and it comes with an adorable gold spoon to apply the cream to your face. I deal with redness and irritation in my skin and hours after putting the cream/serum on my skin visibly calmed down and there was less redness. I definitely will be putting this on every night because it restores my skins natural moisture that I struggle with sometimes. This also brightened my dullness so I am overall pleased with this product.

The only pimples I’ve always gotten are big blind, painful pimples once every weeks on some part of my face. I started using this mask a few years ago (after trying a few other cheaper products and other brands) and the pimples have stopped. To this day, when I skip the masking by more than a week, I get a blind pimple. It doesn’t dry out my skin (I have sensitive and very dry skin). Always leaves me feeling fresh and bright skin. It has a beautiful light and natural scent. I’ve tried the cheaper tube version also by Origins - it did not work. This tub lasts me almost 4 months and is definitely worth every penny.

I have always been a fan of charcoal masks after my first - Boscia’s Luminizing Black Mask. However, I have found peel off masks to be really drying for my sry and sensitive skin. So when I got this charcoal and honey ash-off mask, I was super excited to try it. I have tried to original version without the honey in it, and found that to be a little too drying on my skin, so this reformulation with a humectant like honey had me super intrigued! And i was right - this didn’t feel tight on my skin after applying and neither did it feel too stripping after washing off. It left my skin with a natural glow and definitely brightened it as well over time (I noticed the brightening after 3 uses). The scent (a sweet honey) and texture (thick, jet black in the jar and a transluscent grey with a hint of gold/metallic colour on my face) were also added bonuses and really made me enjoy the experience of using this mask. I would, however, probably not purchase this mask at the current price point, because I don’t think it did anything too special. There are other masks in the market that do similar things at a better price point and show results faster than this one. I love other Origins products, but this one isn’t a total hit for me. Maybe it would work better on oily, acne prone skin that needs help with decongestion and shrinking of blemishes.

These are a good idea, and if they cost $2 for the 6 patches (a sample size) if you paid the $28 and it camp it came with 100 patches (minimally), I would say have at it.  But these offer nothing that a quality retinol cream doesn’t offer (and cream lasts more than 3 times and can be used on your entire face instead of limited to a couple tiny strips).  These really are just a more gimmicky version of Frownies (look them up—they are brilliant).  Frownies are low-tech and have been around more than 100 years floated by nothing but word of mouth because they work.  Save your money.  I use Frownies with cream.  Buying these Peace Out patches was an experiment, but a costly one that offered *nothing* more than what is already readily available that lasts 50-fold longer.  But some of us (case in point) need to waste our money to figure it out.

review_title: Only Saw Results in the Mornings
review_text: I’ve been using these as directed, and purchased the 12 patch kit. I’m a very young looking 41 year old with 11 lines that aren’t terribly deep. But within an hour or two, the lines are totally back to normal. I’ve been using them for weeks now and I see absolutely no difference except in the mornings.It’d be very easy for me to post a before and after photo showing that difference, but that difference just doesn’t last.

I do think this product works and I saw a difference in fine lines after using the product. The lines were definitely less visible. The only issue with this product is that I move during sleep and the sticker fell off on one of my eyes. I might have to use this product during a day instead.

I think if you’re wrinkles aren’t deep they would probably be more effective than they were for me. But to keep it up by using them constantly would be very expensive.

I will say, for being the first time trying a microneedling product, this wasn’t a bad “start” to the microneedling experience. I used these to help with smile lines, as I am a person who’s quite expressive, and have created a few lines around the mouth area over the years. The only thing I would like is for the adhesive to be stronger, because when I wake up in the morning, most of the time I find these on my pillow. Also, having more strips in a pack, even just 2 more, would be super awesome! Nonetheless, overall decent product!

review_title: Product might work but packaging is a problem
review_text: I think these might have helped with some fine lines that I’ve been getting on my face in front of my ears, but be warned about the cost and the way these are packaged!  According to the instructions you need to use these twice a week for two consecutive weeks in order to see a difference... but the box only contains 6 patches. If you want to work on more than one spot / a single wrinkle, you’ll need to buy *two packs* to have enough patches to last two weeks. Each set of three patches is on a plastic strip, enclosed in a flimsy plastic clamshell, and then in a foil pouch. If you want to do the same spot on each side of your face you’d have to open a foil pouch, use two patches, then a few days later use the remaining patch from the first pouch and open the second pouch to take a patch from there. These odd patches out that sit around waiting to be used in the clamshell packaging seem to lose their microneedle effect once the foil packet is opened. I’ve found it ranges from feeling a little less *prickly* than one from a freshly opened pouch to no needle effect at all (which is about $7 down the drain on that one patch being ineffective). Maybe you need to put it in a ziplock bag?
Practically invisible when you’re wearing it. Micro needless did not hurt at all. Seems to work better on fine wrinkles than on heavier, deeper wrinkles

I noticed slight changes after several uses. I wish there were more in the packet as I feel like I have to use them all to focus on one area. I don’t have deep wrinkles so not sure how it’d work on them, but worked for my fine lines!
Followed the instructions exactly and the patches fell off. Didn’t notice any difference. Total waste of money.

Microneedling sounds scary and painful, but these petinol patches are anything but that. this product is easy to use and gentle on sensitive skin. Leave on areas of trouble (eg around eyes or forehead) and allow the hyaluronic acid needles on the patch deliver retinol and vit C into your skin. Use weekly and you will see results shortly!
I am shocked that these actually work! Not only do they work, but I saw immediate improvement after one wear (I wear them overnight). Super impressed and hopeful the results are easily maintained.
When am I going to learn that no products work and I need to accept the signs of aging?

I love the ingredients in these patches, and I am hopeful that the delivery of retinol and peptides through these microneedling patches will be more effective than just a topical serum or lotion!
