I was doubtful that this would make a difference.  But surprisingly I have noticed a difference in my “H” wrinkles. I  am looking forward to using this more and seeing what happens.

I don’t know if I’m a genius or moron but I cut them in half. I am 34 and have the first signs of aging so they’re gentle suggestions of wrinkles and the patches were too big. Yea, it’s be nice if normally you didn’t need 3 boxes to see results but the concept is genius. Can’t wait to try to puffy eyes ones next
Great product! Easy to use and I really liked it!!!
This product worked amazingly well on my smile lines. I will definitely be buying more! This product may become a regular part of my beauty routine!

These really do work. I took before and after pics and had my friends review them to make sure it wasn’t just wishful thinking. It was startling to see what a huge difference they made. Unfortunately the results didn’t last longer than a few hours. Maybe with continued use the results will be longer lasting. It’s a good product, but I’m not sure it’s worth the price for six small patches.

I couldn’t get this sticker to stick on my skin. I could tell it penetrates when I pressed it on but it absolutely would not stay on no matter how hard or how long I pressed it on my skin. Truly a disappointment and I plan to return.

I received these as a sample, and I didn’t enjoy the experience of putting them on my face. I personally couldn’t tell any difference in my forehead wrinkles from the sample, but maybe my wrinkles are too deep!  My main complaint was the feeling of the microneedles when you applied the patch.  Just not for me!

For starters, I have some fine lines developing on my forehead that are more noticeable to me than anyone else. It felt a little weird when I put them on, but I think it’s an effective way to get the product to where it needs to be. I only needed one patch at a time, and after three patches, my lines were less noticeable and my hubby noted how my face looks smoother. It’s a little pricey in my opinion for only six patches, hence the four stars, but it definitely gets the job done if you’re looking for targeted results relatively fast. They’re very convenient as patches - less mess and hassle. I don’t think I’ll repurchase for myself but I’d recommended them to others.
Great quick fix for lines and wrinkles. I was legitimately surprised.

I was nervous to try this product, ya know tiny dissolvable needles to enhance serum absorption sounded painful. But it doesn’t hurt at all! I used it on a spot where I’ve had this red dot forever and it’s not gone but definitely smaller and more flat. The issues I have are the price for what you get. They’re small, think smallest Long bandaid in the variety pack that’s only good for childrens fingers and you get 6 of them. So not ideal for medium or large treatment areas more some of the lone rebel fine line wrinkle. Also make sure your skin is freshly washed thoroughly dried and with no moisturizer or serum in the area you’re going to put it on or it won’t stick. So if you’re a night sweater it’d be better use on a lounge around the house day.
These are amazing. I used them overnight and they make such a difference

Recently I noticed lines above my eyebrows starting to become more pronounced, so when I received this product to try it seemed like the perfect spot to give it a go. The patches are easy to apply, you can feel the little microneedles when you first apply the patch but quickly forget about them. Didn’t even notice the patches when I woke up the next morning, until I looked in the mirror. I did notice a difference in the lines though, using them as directed has helped soften their appearance.

The patches did not really show much improvement for me. I don’t think that I will use them again. They felt super prickly on my skin and when I went to pull them off, they hurt. So they really stuck to my skin, which is one good thing.

These are great!!! I have very sensitive skin and they didnt bother me.  I also noticed a difference on use one!  It defintely lessened the fine lines on my forehead, eyes and smile line.  I would defintely recommend.  I am so happy to have discovered this product via a free sample from pinchme.
A new way to fight wrinkles! These little patches really work and leave the skin smoother and looking younger.

I never thought in a million years these would work BUT I ain’t getting any younger,  so when I started to notice fine lines on my forehead,  I was excited to try these.  Let me tell you,  they don’t play around! After the first treatment,  the limes already appeared less noticeable.  After the final treatment,  I can’t really see them at all anymore! I look like I am 18 again, and I’m almost 33! I don’t know what magic wizardry is in these things,  but I am hooked!
Thank you for this. It’s a wonderful product I will definitely continue to use. As we age we need a little help and this is it. Yes please.

I received my Peace Out Skin microneedling anti wrinkle retinol patches as a deluxe free sample in my Pinchme box.  I really thought they worked well and belive that with regular use you’ll see great results! They were fun and easy to use a d I liked them enough to go purchase more
I really like this product . At first I was not sure that it would help but after a week I could tell my smile lines were getting softer.

I have searched high and low for a product like PEACE OUTMicroneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches that actually works. I am extremely pleased to report that I have found it! These patches are my new HOLY GRAIL product. After just one use I could already see a difference in the lines and wrinkles on my face. At first,  I was a little nervous about the microneedling aspect of Peace Out patches but I set that aside and tried them and I am so glad that I did. PEACE OUTMicroneedling Anti-Wrinkle Retinol Patches are extremely easy to use and are very effective.  I can’t wait to tell everyone about these amazing patches. I will definitely be purchasing them the next time am shopping for beauty products.

I received this product as a free sample from Pinch Me.  These patches are pain free and easy to use.  I was impressed with how quickly I saw results in the fine lines in my forehead - enough so to be able to justify the price if I were to purchase this item in the future.
Awesome product!! Peace Out Wrinkles is amazing. After using it for 2 weeks I could actually see a difference!

I was skeptical about how much these Peace Out Wrinkles patches would really improve the wrinkles I have starting on the top of my forehead, but I was very pleasantly surprised! I put a patch over those pesky wrinkles on my forehead before going to bed, and by the time I woke up my wrinkles were nearly undetectable! This product is amazing... I’ve never used a skincare product that has given me such noticable results that quickly. These patches seriously help to nourish and plump the skin, leaving wrinkles way less noticable and my confidence increased! They are comfortable to wear and do not cause any type of skin irritation for me. I am so impressed with this product. I am definitely going to continue to use these and I highly recommend trying them out.

These patches were easy to apply. They are slightly uncomfortable at first but that goes away as they settle in. I applied them to my crows feet and did notice some improvement in those wrinkles. My only complaint is that the package says results will be noticable after using twice per week for 2 weeks. If you want to use them around your eyes like u did, then there aren’t enough patches in the package for the entire 2 weeks; it only comes with 6. We need 8 for the full effect.
This product was super easy to use! I would definitely recommend!

I LOVE these so much!I can tell the difference in my fine lines right around the crows feet area. I love the tiny microneedles, it feels like it’s actually working into my wrinkles! The microneedles make tiny channels to allow retinol and peptides to soak into the skin properly and efficiently; that’s the best thing about em!
This product softened fine lines as expected! I appreciated the convenience and comfortability as well. I would recommend!
Say goodbye to imperfections, I wish I had known about and have also used this product ever since it hit the market! Definitely a must have for me now!
This is a great product that actually does work. Just be sure to use a sunscreen after using this product.  I would recommend this product.

I absolutely love this product! I literally saw a difference in my skin right away. These little suckers pack a huge punch and are super easy to take on the go. Peace Out has quickly climbed to the top of my travel bag and skincare routine!
I must say I am enjoying the softness of the night repair serum   I have used it for a week and my skin feels supple.  But I need to see if it works long term.
I’ve been using this product for a month now and I love it!! The skin under my eyes feels soft and looks smoother. I absolutely love the applicator. It has little to no scent. Highly recommend!!
I received this as a sample from Influenster. I tried for a week and I didn’t see any difference. It did nothing to my fine lines under the eyes. Although my eyes felt refreshing when applying it.

Helps with dryness… I received Estee Lauder’s Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix as part of Influenster’s Free Vox Box program a couple of weeks ago. I was kinda excited to try because I can tell my skin is aging; and I’ve been noticing more and more fine lines, wrinkles, and dryness around my eyes. For the past 2 weeks, I have consistently applied after washing my face before bed. Although I have noticed the skin is not as dry as with just using a moisturizer, I really don’t see a difference in lines or color. I’m going to continue to use the bottle until it’s done because it definitely has helped with the dryness aspect, but I feel like I could find a cheaper product and receive the same results. I did give it 4 stars as my honest opinion, unlike other eye repair products I’ve tried, there’s absolutely no smell and more importantly, no burning sensation. So it could just be my skin or that my lines have not developed to a point where this product would show a difference.

Thank you influenster and esteelauder for choosing me to try this eye cream for free in exchange of my review! It’s always so exciting to get chosen for a voxbox! I like that the serum absorbs into the skin quickly. It doesn’t leave a greasy mess behind. It seems to make my eyes look more vibrant after using this product.

It absorbs well and doesn’t feel too thick or too thin. I love that it is free of parabens, phthalates, sulfates, mineral oil, and synthetic fragrance. The applicator is nice and conveniently provides the right amount of product on the wand to apply. This was a sample size so it didn’t have the cooling cyro-steel wand as described but instead a plastic one. I don’t have wrinkles....(yet).....(fingers crossed) so I can’t say I saw any immediate results but the product felt great and nourishing and would be great for preventing the appearance of wrinkles.

I really like the ball tip applicator for ease of application, it allows you to put on the perfect amount of cream. I have used it now for about 3 weeks and I’m very happy with it. I have definitely seen results over the weeks. My under eyes are hydrated and smooth. I’ve also noticed tightening of my skin, helping to reduce wrinkles. I’m very happy with this eye cream!

I really enjoyed this product. It made my under eyes bright and hydrated! I also like that it isn’t sticky or super thick, it absorbs into the skin easily. I really like the tip of the applicator as well. I thought it felt nice on my skin almost like a little massage for my under eyes. It made my skin feel so hydrated and soft. I did receive this product for free in exchange for my honest review from Influenster.

This cream did not blow me away. I don’t know if it was because it was a sample and a free product but the wand barely picks up any product so I really had to dig for it.  I am not typically someone who get allergic reactions, but I found that after use my eyes watered like crazy, they didn’t hurt or get puffy, just watery!  Maybe that interferes with the results but I really did not notice much a difference. I saw a little improvement with dark circles and smoothness, but not enough for me to buy again.

The Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex is my new secret weapon at keeping my eyes looking young and rested! After using for a couple of weeks, I could really see a difference and feel a difference in the skin around my eyes. I may in my late 30s but I don’t need to look like I am. Highly recommend!

Eye cream is such an important part of skin care and I think it’s under rated. I know having 4+ steps in the morning and 4+ steps at night seems like a lot. But if you care about your skin the least you should do is moisturizer and eye cream! I love the sleek design of the Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye cream. The applicator is great, it picks up just the right amount of product. It leaves my under eyes hydrated and appear to reduce the crows feet and plump up the under eye.

I received this tester and I can’t notice much difference. It does feel nice and love the applicator since it makes it easier to apply without making a mess. The consistency is nice and hydrating, but I don’t feel is comparable to its price.

I received the Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate free to review from Influenster and I love it. I can see a huge difference in the last couple of weeks using the product. This cream does not leave my skin excessively sticky or oily.
I can’t say that I saw any difference after using this for a month. There wasn’t any noticeable difference in fine lines or dark circles.
I enjoy how bright my eyes are after using this product. I wish the sample was a bit bigger but I was able to make it last 3 weeks!

I really like this. I’ve had horrible dark under eye bags for a long time. This helped make the color less purple and helped the bags. They aren’t huge and I look like I didn’t cry all night. You know what I mean. This had a great feel when putting it on it glides lightly no pulling. Is recommended this it helps with fine eye lubes as well. I recieved a free sample from influenster and will buy full size product!
I am actually impressed with this eye cream. I have been using this nightly and I have noticed the wrinkle lines fading.

I am a 32 year old woman with dry skin and some pretty noticeable under eye darkness. I’ve been applying this nightly under my eyes and around my whole orbital eye area (like the sides and under my brow bone).Although I don’t feel any sort of “tightening“ or filling in of wrinkles, this product does improve my skin texture and elasticity. I feel more moisturized and smooth versus dehydrated. I wouldn’t say it’s going to get rid of my undereye circles, but it has noticeably improved my skin to look and feel more youthful.

I received a sample to give my honest opinion on this eye cream and I must say I loved it. The texture of cream is perfect and a little goes along way. After using for about 2 weeks I noticed a mild difference in my overall under eye appearance. I would recommend this product if you are looking for a new eye cream.

After the first use, I felt like the formula was very hydrating. It absorbed well and did not feel greasy. I noticed that using the applicator helped with some of the puffiness I was experiencing. I can’t say that I noticed any improvement in the firmness of my eye area. However, I think those types of results take longer to see. While the applicator is a great feature of this product, I find it to simultaneously be one of the biggest downsides of the product. Because you are using the applicator directly on your face, you are potentially introducing germs and bacteria back into the product. The wand also doesn’t seem to be long enough to reach the bottom of the bottle. Overall, it’s a decent product but not necessarily one I am going to run out and purchase.

Love the Cryo wand applicator! This product makes your eyes less puffy, helps with dark circles, and keeps eyes moisturized and looking fresh. Can use day or night and stays well under makeup. Estée Lauder has really been stepping their game up lately and I’ve noticed!
This has helped my bags under my eyes so much! Bags run in my family and its been so hard for me to keep them under control.  If you also have bags, run to your closest store and go buy this now!

First time to use Estee Lauder cosmetics, and I was so thrilled because I heard so many good things about their products, and YES!!! This eye cream is so great, once you apply tiny amount to my eye areas, it keeps moisture for 24 hrs! I thought it was a bit expensive to buy it by myself, but just realize such a small amount gives me a great result so the bottle will last long.

This product is so good. I have used other Estee Lauder products and I love them, however I think it is really expensive! I received this product for free to try, and I like the wand and my skin feels so smooth! I have to use it for long term to see the results but it really feels great after each use.

This is so creamy and hydrating, I should’ve tried it sooner! There’s no smell and I don’t get any breakouts in the eye area, no irritation and my under eyes feel so hydrated. I’ll be buying the full size because I don’t think I can live without this now.I didn’t notice if it helped with any under eye lines but I am only 31 trying to prevent aging so I’m gonna use it

I love this product. I received it free to try from Influenster. It is creamy, smooth, soft, and doesnt smell. I can still feel its smoothing and hydrating effects the next day. The skin around my eyes love it! I would definitely recommend!
Goes on smooth and light, feels nice and moisturizing!
This product is amazing! It’s not too heavy to cause pore congestion. Hydrates the skin well.

I received this product complimentary for my honest opinion. This product has been working it leaves under my eye looking and feeling very smooth. I’m going to continue to use the product to get a true feel of it. I can say it doesn’t have a terrible smell. It’s very smooth and has a creamy texture. Under my eyes looks very fresh and alive.

I recieved a complementary sample of this product for review purposes. I really enjoyed this product. I noticed an improvement in darkness under my eyes after using this. The liquid is smooth and just a little bit is needed. Continued use will only give better results. Simple and easy to use at night before bed.

I’m pretty happy with this products so far. Ive been using a sample size consistently for two weeks and it goes on smooth with no irritation to my sensitive skin. It also doesn’t travel into my eyes which I find a lot of creams do. The fragrance is really light which I appreciate as well because I’m pretty sensitive to smells. I don’t know that I’ve seen any miracle change yet but when o put it on my skin feels smoother and well hydrated.

This is the best of the best from Estée Lauder, this cream it’s like a miracle for your eyes I used a a campaign in a complimentary gift from influenster and the first day when I used I NOTICE THE CHANGE, my black owl eyes gone for the moment I look so radiant perfect as a eye primer as well this is a cream that you need to have it in your night desk for forever I really appreciate to Sephora#esteelauder#influenster for choose me to try this miracle of cream ! GIRLS IF YOU HAVE THE MONEY AND YOU HAVE BLACK OWLS EYES PLEASE GO AHEAD AND BUY IT YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT!

I actually really like the texture of this product and I find it to be very hydrating to my under eye area. The only issue I found with this product is that it says it should be used in the morning and at night and that makeup will be on over it. You are supposed to use this on the upper and lower eyelid, and if you try to put an eyeshadow primer over this, it becomes extremely slick and doesn’t stick. I do like it as a nighttime specific formula, although I have not noticed a reduction in fine lines or wrinkles.

I received Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate for free from Influenster & Estee Lauder. I am 44, & I have dark circles & crow’s feet (smile wrinkles). This is a small size, & I don’t remember to use every night. That being said, I haven’t seen a significant difference.  However, if I would remember to use on a regular basis, I bet that I would see a change after 3 to 6 months. This product is too high of a price point for my budget. If price doesn’t matter, then I would recommend it.
Felt nice but didn’t really see any real results from it. Very lightly scented. Has a nice slip to it. I used it as part of my nighttime routine. Soaks in nicely.
I honestly could tell a difference in my skin with this.  I received this free from Influenster and really had high hopes but it just didn’t work for me.

I received a sample for free to try. It’s a nice eye cream but it isn’t miraculous and I definitely would not shell out the cash for this. I didn’t really notice a difference between this and my normal eye cream. It has a nice consistency and isn’t greasy at all, goes on nicely and not strongly scented.

I received a sample of this eye cream. It has a very nice, balmy texture. At first I thought it was a little greasy but it quickly absorbs and leaves a nice, smooth feeling on the skin. I’ve only used it about a week but have high hopes it will be good for wrinkles and under eye circles.

I love the creamy consistency of this product and was pleased that its lasted more than 2 weeks. Product goes on with a small wand scoop so you can put on part or all of it. As a middle age woman, I can’t immediately tell if this product is helping dark spots and puffy eye area. However it is smooth, creamy, not oily, and unscented, which is right up my alley. My sensitive skin had no problems with this at anytime. I will keep using this and report back if something changes, but very happy to receive this sample.

I can’t know full results unless I use it for 30 days but I have been using it daily for 2 weeks and my eyes feel hydrated and plump and have definitely reduced the appearance of dark circles. It doesn’t smell the best though, so I wished it had a more pleasant odor.

When I first got this product I was skeptical, Lauder products were always for older women. Well I guess I am 50 so…. I really like the texture of this product and my eye area was so much more hydrated when I used it. It fit easily into my regular skincare routine and I am once again able to powder around my eyes without looking dry. The applicator is a little odd but may be better with the full size product.

This Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate has a gel-like consistency that goes on smoothly and absorbs fast. The smell is the same as in the original Advanced Night Repair Serum. I like using this eye concentrate both morning and night. It keeps my under eye hydrated and makes fine lines less visible.

I have absolutely enjoyed this product! The cool applicator makes it easy to apply and it felt very moisturizing, not greasy. I have puffy under eyes and it started working with in two days. My husband even noticed the puffiness was reducing under my eyes. I would definitely recommend this for puffy eyes.

This stuff is amazing. It helped with my puffy morning eyes when on cool with applicator. I would recommend,  very smooth and makes my skin feel so soft no greasy feeling and worked into my skin.  I received this sample free from influencer for an honest review.

I received a complimentary sample from Influenster and Estée Lauder for testing purposes. I really enjoyed this product. The eye cream had a very nice consistency that feels great on your skin. It didn’t irritate my skin at all. I wasn’t a big fan of the applicator but that won’t stop me from purchasing this product. I believe it is worth every penny. It really helped the puffiness under my eyes go away.

This product was sent totally free by influenster, and I have tried it and I feel my eyes more rested and a less married look, and the cream It is very easy to use the consistency of the cream is very soft at the time of use it feels very smooth your skin.  I recommend it.

I’m not sure I would spend the money on a full size bottle of this. I’ve been using for 2 weeks and can’t see any difference. I used nightly and in the morning if I wasn’t going to wear makeup. I have sensitive eyes and this did not bother them. I would not wear this under makeup. It’s very moisturizing, almost oily, and made my under eye cream just melt off.

This goes on smooth, its a silky consistency that feels light on the skin. There is a fresh scent that isn’t over powering. Doesn’t leave skin greasy. A little goes a long way. My sensitive skin did not have any sort of negative reaction. As with any anti aging product the true test of results is using consistently over time.I was gifted this as a sample to test.

I got this product free to try from influenster. I will say I tried it for a whole two weeks and think I see a pretty good difference in the wrinkles under my eyes. You can use it anywere you have lines. It says it is free of smell and I would say for the most part that is true. I may have a sensitive nose but I felt like I could smell just a slight smell but was not perfume at all.

I received this product as a free trial. Although I really do enjoy wearing it (it is lightweight and moisturizing), if you are looking for actual results as far as diminishing fine lines/dark circles, this may not be the product for you, as I haven’t really noticed a difference in those aspects. For the price, the refreshment it brings at night after a long day is worth it, fine lines removed or not.

This Night Repair work wonderful. I used it daily and could aee the differnce with in the week. I loved the Bottle it looked awesome and the Box is plain but the lroduct is amazing. I would recommended it to all my Beautiful friends. We all get older and our skin needs a little more love.

I received this product as a complimentary sample. Over the course of a week and using this product every day I didn’t notice any immediate changes. The product is non greasy and lightweight. I additionally like that there is no strong smell associated with this product. My under eye area did feel moisturized and very soft. I don’t have severe puffy eyes so I cannot say if it works for that but I do experience occasional dry under eye areas and this product made that area feel moisturized. I also did not notice much firming in the under eye area at this time
I love how thick and creamy this eye cream is and I love the smell of vitamin c!!!!

I can see a definite improvement in the wrinkles and dark skin under my eyes. The product is smooth and soothing to put on right before bed. The application wand took a little time to get used to, but it felt like a mini massage.

I have used this Estée Lauder product now for a few weeks. I am in my early 50’s and have some fine lines around my eyes and I definitely have seen improvement. I only have a small sample size and it will last forever. You only need a small amount. Also, I have somewhat sensitive skin and I have no irritation at all. I can’t wait to see what another few weeks will do with additional improvement.
Smooth eye cream that doesn’t leave your skin greasy. Can be used morning and night. also great for those mornings where you may wake up extra puffy.  A great compliment to my skin care routine.

I tried a sample of this cream and it was very moisturizing, perfect for overnight. I can’t tell if there’s results after only one week since I’m already using a nightly eye mask, but it feels and smells good.

I was skeptical at first but after using the product every night for 5 days I can tell a difference in the fine lines. It does reduce puffiness around the eyes but is not a cure. Regular use has show improvement in my skin. I would purchase this in the future.
I really love the formula, it’s not thick, sinks right into your skin. It smells amazing, not overpowering at all. I definitely feel likes it working .
Makes my skin feel refreshed and noticed former skin after a week of use around eyes.

This eye serum feels so nice on my dry under eyes. I love the applicator as well. I helps to hydrate and diminish puffiness, minimize  my fine lines. It is not greasy or heavy on the eyes and absorbs quickly. I use it at night before bed and wake up noticing a difference the next day. I was given this product to try but have really enjoyed it and I highly recommend.

Maybe I’m missing something but this just wasn’t it for me. I don’t mind a hefty price tag if a product delivers but for me this was no better than my usual eye cream. I used this for several weeks as I was sent it by Influenster, but no noticable difference.

I love the packaging, the consistency of the product, the applicator made it so easy to applied, non greasy blended easily into my under eye skin , it does help with depuff, brighten up the littler dark circle under my eye and my under eyes look moisturized whenever I use it.Although I received it from Influenster has a complimentary gift , as soon as I am done with it I am definitely going to purchase a bigger size for myself.

I received the Estée Lauder night repair Eye cream from Influenster I been using it for a week and I did see a difference on my eye area I feel my eyes more hydrated it’s very gentle on the eye and it feels very soft when you apply the cream I like the packaging I only been using it in the night My eyes look more healthier

review_title: Eye Matrix does a great job.
review_text: Love this product. It’s lightweight and not greasy at all. It’s the first night repair product I’ve used and will definitely look at others in the line. I have sensitive skin and found this works great on puffiness and crows feet. The dark circles under my eyes seem to be minimizing slightly although to be fair my allergies are at their peak so that is making them worse than normal. Will continue to buy and use.

I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review.  After using this product for a week in the morning and evening, I have to say it’s very hydrating.  I did notice it helped with puffiness in the AM.  I kept it in my skincare fridge so the little wand felt refreshing under my eyes.  Did notice it helped with dark circles as well but saw minimal results with firmness on my upper lids which was a little disappointing.
Este lauder has always offer great products! This is a wonderful night repair for the eyes. Love that it goes on smooth and it’s just simply great.

Mosturizing, nongreasy under eye concentrate. Not a fan of the applicator as I don’t like anything to touch my skin then go back into the container.   #EyeExperts #EsteeLauderxInfluenster #contest #complimentary @esteelauder @Influenster
Love this advanced night repair eye concentrate!! My eyes looked a million times better after using it for the first week! Highly recommend!!

It is super nice and creamy. I hate the applicator. It’s bulky, it wastes product and does not help apply the product. The product itself is nice. Definitely de puffs. I did not notice any line changes. It doesn’t have a strong smell so I appreciate that. I did get this in an influenster vox box so it was free, but I usually love stuff like this. I won’t be using it again.

I love this eye cream! Super hydrating without feeling heavy. It definitely packs a good punch and does it’s job. Firming, hydrating, non greasy. Soaks in immediately and the next morning my under eye area looks great. Definitely helps with puffiness and dark circles as well.

I received this as a sample from Influenster for free in exchange for my honest review. I liked it but I’m not sure I loved it. It actually worked well under makeup which I was worried about since it takes a little while to soak in to the skin. It definitely is hydrating without being greasy, but using it for about a week isn’t really enough to tell if it really helps with lines and wrinkles. It’s also a little pricey IMO so I’m not sure I’ll purchase it, but again, it does hydrate and it does work well under makeup which is a struggle with a lot of eye creams/serums.

I was super excited to receive this product to try. It was supposed to help all of my major issues (dark circles, dryness, puffiness) unfortunately I never saw any “results”. Feels very creamy and sinks into your skin. Yet every day my under eyes became more and more dry.

I wanted to use this for a week before I reviewed this product. I am so pleased with the results. I al always on the go and tired so my eyes are usually puffy and I have light bags. After the first couple days of using around my eyes became a lot less puffy and clearer skin!

I absolutely love this product! Ive used to use this in the past day and night and love it. review_title: Just a basic hydrating serum; does nothing else
review_text: I don’t know if I’d recommend this product tbh. It seems like such a great product when reading the claims, but when I actually put it to use, I didn’t notice any calming of my sensitization or remediation of any redness at all. It’s unfortunate because if this product actually lived up to all its claims, it could really be great! But unfortunately, I found it was pretty basic and nothing really more than a simple hydrating serum, which I definitely think you can find for a better value than this.

This serum is lightweight but not runny. It’s got a very faint smell to it, nothing overpowering or off-putting. It spreads easily and absorbs quickly into the skin. The packaging is perfect to me; it’s got a dropper lid that 1) carries just the right amount of product for application, and 2) “locks” shut, making it great for travel (no worries of spillage).From the first use, I had noticeably less redness. With continuous daily use, my redness had eased and my skin wasn’t as sensitive/reactive to touch (ie. scratching or using a facial spatula). Overtime, I’ve reduced my consistency, now using it every other day but my results have remained. It hasn’t completely eliminated my redness to the point where I’ll go au naturel BUT it has changed enough that I wear far less face makeup everyday (just a little concealer).If you’ve got mild rosacea/redness, or sensitive/irritated skin that you’re looking to target, I would definitely give this serum a try!

review_title: Really works on irritated, damaged skin!
review_text: I normally don’t swear by a “miracle“ skin product, and I am not often inspired to write reviews. I have fair, very sensitive, acne-prone combination skin, so I have to be extremely careful what I use on it. Well... This line of products truly works for troubled skin! I had been plagued for months by a wicked combination of horribly flaky-dry, red, irritated, congested skin with acne on top of that due to being outdoors a lot, camping, sweating with sunscreen and/or make-up on, wearing make-up too much, lack of sleep, etc. throughout the relentlessly hot, wet summer we had here in Virginia. I tried a bunch of different high-quality masks, exfoliators, serums, moisturizers, etc., and tried to cover it all up with make-up, which only made matters worse, and resulted in frustration. NOTHING I tried worked... even my usual go-to products....until I got samples of the Cicapair Re.Pair Serum, Cream, Camo Drops, and the Color Correcting Cream (which has SPF 30)! In only TWO days, I saw significant improvement, and immediately went to Sephora and bought the full-size Re.Pair Serum and Cream. I soon followed with purchase of the full-size Camo Drops and Color Correcting treatment. After about three weeks of unbelievably great results from these products, I had dinner with a friend who I hadn’t seen in over a month. She couldn’t believe how much my skin had improved, and how great it looked when I was wearing nothing on it but these Cicapair products, Bare Minerals Prime Time and a little under-eye concealer (IT) and blush (NARS). I now use all of these Cicapair products daily, and my skin has never been clearer, calmer, or softer. I am back to my smooth, porcelain skin, and the ruddiness/rosacea, irritation, and flakiness are GONE! Oh... bonus... the Color Correcting treatment and Camo Drops smell great! Dr. Jart’s Cicapair line of products rules!!!!

I have normal/dry and sensitive skin. I’m also very pale so any redness or darkness is really noticeable. I didn’t even know I had redness, I thought I just had pink undertones. But my skin is more even and smooth, and I don’t breakout as much. It has not affected makeup application. It absorbs very quickly and leaves the skin only slightly tacky.The tiger grass cream was way to thick and heavy for my skin, but this has been a great addition to my routine.

Going to keep it up but I will be using this. I also used the cream on the eczema in delicate areas (eyelids) and it was awesome. My skin is sensitive and fair and I am a redhead. I bought this product in a desperate, last ditch attempt to find SOMETHING, ANYTHING, that might help with my Lupus rash. I had yet another outbreak a few weeks ago and this time around it was really hanging on and refusing to calm down. Those of you that have it will understand this review on a different level than those who don’t suffer from it. My rash manifests itself in blisters that burn and itch. This time, for the first time, they migrated from my upper chest area to my face. Including my upper eyelids. It’s not just the aesthetic of having blisters all over my face that makeup will not cover, its wanting relief from the burning and stinging and itching. There is no effective medical treatment for this condition (the Lupus rash). None. So after reading many reviews I decided to try this. I figured that even if it didn’t help the rash, it might help with all of the underlying redness. Which was significant. Today is day 4 of using this morning and night after toning and under all of my regular products. Woke up this morning and rash is gone. Completely. As though it never happened. There is a faint amount of redness left on my upper eyelids but all of the blisters have disappeared. I am shook. To my core. I don’t know what witchcraft or wizardry is in this bottle but I will seriously hurt anyone that tries to take it away from me!  I have to highly recommend this product based on my experience. I am not a doctor so for those of you with Lupus rash ymmv. I also can’t speak to it’s effectiveness on acne since I’m not dealing with that.

Delicate as a lotus flower. I loved the fragrance, the texture, it leaves no residue unlike other similar products. Only downside for me is I like my moisturizer with SPF.

review_title: Great addition to my morning routine
review_text: Background info: I have combined skin (oily T zone, but dry everything else.)I am a true believer that a cream/moisturizer is actually meant to cover your liquid products and conceal the moisture, rather than provide the moisture itself. I tried this product as a stand alone product (just on toner), and I tried this product in combination with my toner, essence, serum and spf.I found this Moisturizer to work GREAT in the multiple step Korean method of skin care. It worked very well as a stand alone product as well. I liked this one better stand alone, compared to the Lotus Dream Night Cream from the same line.I think the formula is great, the smell is preferential (I am not a big fan, but it is all natural and it goes away super fast.). I like the texture because it is right in the middle. You can use a little less, or a little more depending on your skin’s needs. I also love that it does not clog my pores, as I have a major issue with pore clogging. It also worked really well as base for my foundation. I only wish this would have some spf protection as well.Side note: My foundation is a luminous finish, and this moisturizer gives you a glowing look as well. So I was worried together they will look greasy, but I am quite happy with how the compliment each other.All and all, I would highly recommend this product. Also, the 1.6 oz is a huge amount. I have been using this for a couple of weeks now, and I still feel like I have not used any yet.I received this product complimentary, to test from Influenster.

disclaimer: i’m not super great at following a daily skin routine so i don’t use this moisturizer daily. I have been using it at least 3 times a week for the last two weeks and i do love this product! it smells very light and fresh and it doesn’t bother me. i have very dry skin so i need moisturizers that pack a lot in. i’ve used products that made my skin feel dry again within an hour. however, this product gets the job done! i put it on under my makeup and it helps keep my skin feeling hydrated. i received this product complimentary from influenster for reviewing purposes, but this is a product that i absolutely will purchase!

I love this moisturizer! I use many fresh products; the moisturizer, eye cream, and night cream. All are great. The daily moisturizer has a strong scent but it absorbs nicely and creates a great canvas for makeup application. I have noticed changes in skin softness, and redness has improved.

I’ve been using this for a week and it does feel like it moisturize my skin and it’s helping a little with dark circles (it’s not that bad, also after a couple of good nights sleep they disappear tbh) But eye cream it’s important so I’ll keep using it and I recommend to put it on at night after using ice cubes, game changer

This is a great choice for a lightweight moisturizer for normal to oily skin. It is not greasy or heavy and moisturizes well. The fragrance is very pleasant, but obvious, so if you’re sensitive to fragrance you may want to try something else. It is almost a gel cream texture and very silky.

Skin care is extremely important. I’ve been using this for about a week to give a honest review. Only have to use a tiny amount, it goes a long way. It is light, doesn’t make you feel greasy. Also smells wonderful and is a great moisturizer specially in cold winter months.

review_title: Feels good, but broke me out
review_text: I really wanted to love this moisturizer, and there are a ton of things I like about it! The packaging is nice and substantial, and the moisturizer itself feels really good. It’s definitely hydrating and sat well under makeup.The only con(s) for me (and I think they’re related) are that it’s fairly heavily fragranced and it broke me out. I tried it a couple of times with a few days in between each, and every time I used it, I woke up with a zit the next day.

**I received this product complimentary**I haven’t used Fresh products before, but I don’t really like this moisturizer. It is light, and I can feel my skin actually sucking it in rather than it just sitting on top and making me look shiny. It smells  light and cucumbery, and nice. Overall I think it’s a good product. I’m happy that I received it, however the price point means I likely won’t purchase it again.
I received this complimentary from influenster! I have tried it a couple days now and I feel like my face is a lot less dry then normal. I like it a lot and would recommend!
I love this moisturizer! It has saved my dry skin through this winter , makes my face feel so soft and hydrates my skin throughout the day .

I love this moisturizer! The smell is so pleasant. It has not broke out my acne prone skin after 2 weeks of use. It absorbs super quickly and wears well under a full face of makeup. I like that this can also be used as a night cream. Highly recommend.

Let me just start by saying the smell is AMAZING. Like a spa. Very light, but so beautiful. I’m not exactly sure what Lotus smells like on its own, but this almost has a cucumber scent. Refreshing! Like most Fresh-products, the formula is a gel. I find this type of formula to be a lot more hydrating than regular moisturizers. Normally, I use (and love) the Fresh “Rose“ moisturizer, but I actually prefer this “Lotus“ version -- that’s really saying something! I find that it sits well under my foundation and has even replaced my primer! Super absorbent and not greasy. Another thing I’d like to point out is that, for the last five days I’ve been battling the flu. Around my nose is raw from blowing into tissues. Normally, like 100 percent of the time, if I apply any kind of lotion to my face while being sick, it will *sting.* Sometimes I even get an allergic reaction to the pain and my face swells up. Howeverrrrr, I did NOT have this experience with the Fresh “Lotus“ line of products. They actually have a calming, soothing effect. My boyfriend even noticed how glowing my skin is, despite having the flu.

I’ve been looking for a new moisturizer to add to my nightly routine. Fresh Lotus has a great scent and makes your skin feel so soft and smooth! A little bit goes a long way. I highly recommend this product!!

First let me say I have oily skin and this moisturizer is rich without leaving me greasy.  It feels amazing I love putting it on under my makeup it gives me such a natural glow. My makeup has been looking so good lately and it smell amazing and the packaging is beautiful

I love this product! When I first got this in the mail, I was expecting a trial sized product but when I opened it up to see it was full sized products I was amazed! I tried it the day I received it and I LOVE it. This moisturizer is so lightweight compared to other moisturizers I’ve tried. It also doesn’t have an overpowering smell which I love too!! I definitely will be using this as my everyday moisturizer from here on out.
This product rocks. The smell is great and the texture of the cream is wonderful. This moisturizer has really brought my skin back to life. I use twice a day mostly every day and it’s perfect!

I received this product complimentary to test, and I definitely like it! It’s hydrating yet not overpowering. This leaves your skin feeling fresh and moisturized without feeling great or heavy. I’ve noticed a major difference in the texture of my skin after using this. It makes my skin feel great! I would recommend.

review_title: This is an amazing day cream!
review_text: I am beyond thankful to have been able to try the Lotus Youth Preserve Moisturizer thanks to Influenster. review_title: AWFUL new formula. Bring back the old version!!!
review_text: This USED to be my absolute fave lip balm. It was the most moisturizing, had spf, and imparted a perfect pop of color. I bought it in bulk because I couldn’t stand to run out.Sadly, the new formula is awful!!! Instead of being moisturizing, it is DRYING. And, it no longer has spf. This is such an expensive chapstick. It used to be worth it, because it was literally the best thing ever. Now it is actually terrible. I am beyond disappointed :(I really hope they bring back the old formula. I won’t be buying this formulation again.

I love Fresh Sugar Lip Balms. The moisturizing feel, scent, even the taste when you lick your lips. I have a few but when they introduced new colours, I jumped at the chance to grab you. Warning, the online swatches do not match what you get with Papaya: it is neon coral on the. It is only after it wears down (20-30 minutes later) that it starts to look like it describes… a pink coral. You can’t see the brightness from my photo but it bright. I recommend the lip balm, but not this particular colour…. unless you’re looking for that 80’s neon lip.

There is no soft, velvety feel that the old one used to have that was my favorite part of the lip balm. The smell is also very reduced. I am very disappointed.
I used to love this lip treatment but the new formula they took away all the reasons I loved it. No more SPF and it is not at all hydrating.

The treatment does contain added fragrance as well as added color, which creates a pretty buildable pink-red on the lips. One note: the tube is luxe and metallic, and the top twists off (so don’t try to pull)!

I love lip products that make my lips soft and this was the perfect addition! It has a great smell to it and a beautiful color that compliments my skin tone so well! Loved peonies and can’t wait to keep using it! This was gifted by Fresh.

I was gifted by Fresh. This is my new favorite rose lip treatment for summer. It has such a pretty nourishing and buildable pigmented rose color. I really like this product. The color was def buildable, subtle at first which I appreciate. I found it very hydrating, and didn’t leave any sort of waxy or heavy feel. I will say that it didn’t last as long as some other products I’ve tried. I stopped noticing the color after a few hours. Gifted by Fresh

Fresh has gifted me and done it again with this sugar lip treatment! I absolutely love the color (peony) and it is such a beautiful and buildable color that it makes my lips look nature but better. I will absolutely continue to use this!

I received this product complimentary from Fresh. It’s a lip tint with a hint of a plum color to it and it also gives you 24 hours of hydration! This has definitely helped me with my chapped lips i use it during the day and at night before bed.

Gifted by Fresh. I love this, my lips feels so moisturized and hydrated. This is perfect for all year round give the most natural flush looking lips. Fresh never fails to impress when it comes to their lip care products. I highly recommend to try this one
Cannot live without this. Moisturizes well even through winter months and adds nice slight touch of color

I like this lip treatment. It did make my lips feel nice after and it didn’t dry for about an hour. The scent is nice and the tint is perfect. It’s not too red! My partner likes it too. I recommend if you get dry lips! Gifted by Fresh

*gifted by Fresh* this is a really nice lip balm if your looking for something basic that gives hydration and a hint of color. This gave a really nice hint of pink tint to the lips and lasted for a really long time. Even after wearing off my lips still were not dry. Also love the scent.

This was gifted to me by Fresh. This lip treatment is amazing. It makes your lips feel so soft and hydrating. Formula goes on so smooth. This lip balm has vitamin c & e with fruit oils. The color is so beautiful and buildable if you want a light,sheer cover or more coverage.

This was amazing to try as complimentary from Fresh! It was super hydrating but also gave me some great colour pay off! I definitely want to try the other colours available. This is perfect for all year round, winter for the hydration and summer against the humidity.

Gifted by Fresh- I love the buildable color of this product, I find it similar to the viral Black Honey shade from Clinique. As always the packaging is beautiful, simple and feels luxe, however the product doesn’t hydrate for as long as I would hope for a lip product of this price range.

I’ve used fresh lip products for over 10 years and love! I usually use the No color but tried the rose this time and I love the subtle color! It just looks like your natural lips and subtle color, while also nourishing and making your lips feel hydrated! Love this to put on all day instead did worrying about lipstick fading / smearing.

Upon receiving this balm complimentary from Fresh, I have Been trying out the Rosè shade for a week, and first, I found it a little drying, but I think you have to get past the first layer and then it becomes more hydrating. It builds into a light rosey color and last a few hours before it needs to be reapplied. The packaging is actually my favorite part. It’s stunning!

This lip treatment is amazing. This was gifted by Fresh. The color is so natural and i love the ingredients! This is definitely the most hydrating lip balm ive ever owned! It doesnt even feel like i have anything on when i wear it. I love it!

I was gifted by fresh to try out and give my honest review. I love fresh lip balms! This is  hydrating lip balm which has sugar from beet root and sugar cane! I love that it has such as amazing ingredients that is hydrates, softens and smoothens lips! The texture is so buttery and smooth! the colour payoff is sheer to buildable! I love the tint it provides, perfect for summer and all year round. Keeping lips healthy, supple and smooth!

Gifted by Fresh This is so cute and this shade is really perfect for me. Its stays on really nice and the packing is really nice . I’m excited to try other shades too this is a nice lip balm.I would recommend It

This was gifted to me by Fresh for my honest review. My new go to lip product! I love that this is more of a lip balm type application, but I love that I can build up the color of it as well! Keeps my lips soft and hydrated throughout the day, without feeling greasy.

I like this lip balm.  I tried it many years ago and think that the color is very pretty. I will say that I wish they brought the old formula back with SPF 15. It’s was more hydrating and pigmented than the reformed version but if you want something lightweight with buildable coverage this is great and I’ll continue to use it.*Gifted by fresh beauty

I was gifted by Fresh , I really love this lip balm , this has slight pink tint too, I received shade peony , its so pretty , definitely hydrates and moisturizes my lips through out the day , will definitely recommend to all my friends , also the packaging is different not like any lipstick

review_title: Game changer to add to your purse!
review_text: I was gifted this complimentary from Fresh, however that does not hinder my thoughts on the product itself. One of the best lip treatments that I can wear all day long. Although it may seem a little pricey, I consider it worth it since it does make such a difference in the moisture for my lips. I love that I can wear it day and night without having to use two different lip balms! Game changer.

I want to be open and honest to those reading this so I am saying I was gifted by Fresh beauty. I love fresh beauty lip products!! I have repurchase pretty much all of them this is no different. So if on the fence buy it

This Fresh lip balm is everything you could ever ask for & more!! The rose color is a little sheet but still gives your lips a pinkish tone, with some gloss! I am obsessed with this lip balm and will definitely be a new go-to for me to keep on-the-go! *gifted by Fresh

I love Fresh products and this lip treatment really reinforced my love of this brand. The shade Plum is a deep brown-purple color that makes my lips pop. It applies evenly and the texture is divine. I do feel like my lips are hydrated although I would say this formula doesn’t last quite as long as I hoped, and I needed to reapply a few times throughout the day. However my lips still felt soft after the color faded so that’s something. I’m definitely going to try other colors!Complimentary from Fresh.

This made my lips feel so moisturized throughout the day and the color gave my lips a nice rosy tint. I like to use this on days when my lips just need a little hint of color. I will be keeping this in my makeup bag as a go to lip product! #complimentaryfromfresh

Love it! It’s super moisturizing and not in a “chemically” way. It literally smells like roses and I’m glad it has a tint to it cause my lips are a bit pigmented. You can build up the color and coverage too.

I am a fan of this product, it not only brightens my under eye, but it gives it such a beautiful glow and healthy looking under eye area. I have very dry undereyes and this eye cream really refreshed, depuffed and made my under eyes look very hydrated.

I actually thought this was a rose product at first, but it’s RosÉ - even better! The scent is sweet and lovely without being too strong like a lot of rose-scented things so this made me love the product even more. The packaging is beautiful quality, heavy and nice feeling in the hand. As for the color, it’s so sheer and buildable which I really appreciate as someone who likes a more subtle lip. It has a soft pinky red “popsicle stained” look and feels more smooth and hydrating the more you apply. I would definitely try this in other shades! This product was gifted to me by Fresh.

This color is amazing! This feels super hydrating on my lips and makes them less dry and chapped while also adding a nice natural looking color - which I absolutely love!! Looks great and nourished my lips. Gifted by fresh

I love this lip balm so much! I once was given one of these as a gift from Sephora on my birthday and I have fallen in love with Fresh since then. It looks small in size but the product actually lasts a long time! Not to mention the smell and the way it makes my lips feel! Great! Gifted by Fresh

I received this product complimentary from Fresh but this is my honest opinion.This is a really nice tinted lip balm. I use lip balms daily and this one is the perfect for every day since it is also slightly tinted but still very natural looking and comfortable. The berry shade is really pretty and matches any makeup look, as well as a no-makeup makeup look. I love the nourishing ingredients like grape seed oil, castor oil and jojoba oil. Highly recommend!

Love this lip treatment! I love tinted lip balms in general and this one feels very comfortable on the lips without feeling sticky or goopy and the color is beautiful! It really softens my lips with a nice flush gifted by Fresh

When I first got this I used it in the morning and it was a little too much for my combination skin; but now it’s my staple night routine item. I read that collagen is mostly for moisturizing when applied topically so I’m not upset when I’m not seeing a ton of plumping effect (honestly I don’t believe anything that’s applied on the skin’s surface can plump lol), but man this thing nourishes the skin well. I was getting a ton of pimples along my jawline and it pretty much has stopped ever since I started using this. The scent is soft, and the product is gentle enough to be paired with most other serums and creams I have. Very happy and will continue to buy.

I’m obsessed with this product, was gifted by Algenist. I’ve been using it for two weeks now and I can definitely see a huge difference on my skin. My skin looks and feels very hydrated, I love the products on it specially collagen since I’m over my 30’s now. I highly recommend it especially if you have dry skin.

Gifted by Algenist. I am so happy that I gave a tried to Algenist Genius liquid collagen. This serum is also helping me reduce the fine wrinkles of my face. I loving every drop of it!

I was gifted by Algenist. I really enjoyed using this collagen. My skin felt smoothed and plumped. They finally came out with a pump bottle! I used the dropper version before, the dropper was harder to get the product out of the bottle.

This liquid collagen is amazing. It applies super easy, dries fast, and moisturizer can be applied on top of it (or makeup!). Within just a few days of using it i noticed my wrinkles fading away. Try it. I received this product complimentary from Algenist.

I’m super impressed with this serum! I’ve been using it twice a day for the last 10 days and I’ve already noticed my skin feeling (and looking) much more plump! I received this product complimentary from Algenist and I love it! This product is amazing! I’ve only been using it for a short time and I have definitely noticed a difference. My skin feels firmer and softer. I love the packaging. I will definitely be adding this to my daily skincare routine!

I recieved this complimentary from Algenist. I really like the texture of this collagen product..it’s a bit sticky and so I follow it up my my moisturizer. I found it to be very hydrating and gave my skin a glow. The pump was easy to use, a little comes out at a time which I like.

i love this product! it gave me a glow within and helped my skins skin tone! it is a great quality product, and didnt make my makeup pill under when using it which is a huge plus for sure. def recommend! this was “complimentary from Algenist

I received this complimentary from Algenist and This serum is great! I’ve been using it on my face and neck area and i can really see a difference in the appearance of my skin. It feels more luminous and i think it is helping with fine lines especially on my chest.

review_title: Don’t wait until it’s too late, start preventing!
review_text: I’m pushing 30 so trying this product could not have came at a better time! Algenist gifted me this serum and it was what my skin care routine was missing. My skin feels hydrated, bright and bouncy due to the collagen. I’m excited to see how it continues to help the lines I’m already seeing as I’m getting older.

I’ve been looking for a new mascara for a while now, and I LOVE this one. I was gifted by Tower 28 Beauty, and it’s been amazing. I have oily eyelids so my mascara is the first thing to run and look crazy, but so far so good. I love the applicator, and packaging.

The product is truly amazing. I got it complimentary from Algenist. I have never tried collagen before so I didn’t know what to expect and what should it do and I loved it from the first use.  It softens the skin so good. I feel like I even look younger.

It’s pricy but it’s so so good. It absorbs pretty fast into my skin and makes it supple. Also appreciate how it works well with the other products in my skincare routine (doesn’t pill etc). Gifted by Algenist.

I live the new pump bottle vs the dropper its a clean and hygienic way to use the serum. I love the collagen use for my skin and it makes my skin supple and soft. It my go to serum for am and pm skincare routine. Gifted by Algenist

This product was gifted by Algenist for my honest review. I’ve always been curious about Algenist so I was super excited to try this. This is a vegan collagen serum that adds a huge dose of hydration and helps firm the skin. The texture is a lightweight gel that absorbs effortlessly leaving my skin looking and feeling refreshed. I’ve been using this on recovery nights and my skin is absolutely loving it! Definitely a luxury item, but one that truly delivers!

I got this complimentary from Algenist. I love this Serum! I really started to notice a difference in my skin after using this for about two weeks. I used this in the morning right after toning my face. It feels really nourishing and hydrating on the skin. This serum absorbs pretty quickly, which is a big plus. My skin feels really soft. I recommend this for anymore who is looking to add extra hydration into their routine.

“All you Need“ serum is definitely a must-have! This product is a great addition to my skincare routine, and brings my skin a great feeling - more elasticity and visibly plumper. I love the pump bottle, very practical and easy to use. I love to use on my 3rd and 4th day of my skin cycling. This product was gifted by Alegnist, but I will buy it for sure and will recommend to my friends and family.

review_title: A must to have collagen serum
review_text: Amazing skincare product gifted by Algenist. My skin is sensitive. I have been using this product few days and so far loving this product. It’s definitely working on my skin. The best part is it smells so good. Highly recommended this product.

I enjoy using this super produt that is formulated to improve skin as you age! This collagen serum helps smooth wrinkles and firm skin! It hydrates and protects skin! It has  become my essential in my daily beauty routine.

review_title: I can feel my youth coming back to me thanks to th

I received this product gifted by ALGENISTI’m loving this I cannot say enough about this product; it works!! I have deep wrinkles around my mouth and I have seen a drastic change in the short time using it.I love this product. Within a week of using it my face felt so smooth. I can tell if I miss a day.

I am a 60 Yr Old Male and I participated in a trial sample and use of Genius Algenist, and WOW, was surprised and what a difference it made. I used it for 28 days in a row, twice a day. I ran out and ordered another bottle. It was on my recent trip home and some pictures with family that some family members asked me if I had gotten Botox treatments! Many commented on how much younger I looked. Great product, I will continue to use it. The refreshing feeling my skin has is a plus too.

I love this product. It was a gift from another skin care enthusiast, after I admired her skin. Within a few weeks, people were saying to me how great my skin looked, glowing and brighter. I could see myself (I look in the mirror a lot) that my skin was firmer and my lines and wrinkles were less visible, especially the “marionette lines” around my mouth and the horizontal ones on my forehead. Plus Genius Serum is light, absorbs quickly, and makes my skin feel refreshed. I used in morning and night as the second step, after cleansing.

I got this product as a sample, and it seemed OK - my skin felt nice and hydrated after using. However the smell of this is SO strong it is outrageous. It’s very perfume smelling and it lasted for hours. Would not recommend if you (or anyone who sits close to you) have even the slightest scent sensitivity.
I can’t believe this doesn’t have 5 stars!!! It made a huge difference in my skins firmness, texture, and glow! A definite must have

I love this stuff so much! Mainly use it on my retinol/hydrating nights and have seen a significant decrease in my 11’s and combined with retinol, I no longer have any dry spots. If you’re worried about the cost they have the mini’s usually in a set for a pretty good price

I’d been wanting to try this for a long, long time but had a hard time justifying the price so when I found it deeply discounted at my local Sephora during a sale, I went for it. To be honest I didn’t think I noticed too much of a difference in wrinkles or plumpness when I was using it and with the cost, I had a hard time convincing myself to pay the high price and repurchase. But in the weeks after I finished my first bottle, I saw a noticeable decline in my overall skin health. My fine lines were more noticeable and my skin was more dull than before so when I caught another sale, I decided to pick up another bottle and the improvement was noticeable.My fine lines and wrinkles are less noticeable and my skin just feels more plump and supple. I enjoy the texture, how it feels on my skin, and haven’t found the fragrance to be overwhelming. It absorbs quickly and plays well with the rest of my routine.I don’t want to love it, but I do and will probably continue to seek out good sales to keep this on my skincare shelf. I agree that the packaging with the dropper is less than ideal and needs revamping - I’ll probably try the value size with the pump next time and see if it’s better. I have a hard time recommending this just because it’s so hard to justify the price but it’s worked well for me so I’d only really  recommend it if you can afford it. It’s not a must have product but it’s a really nice to have product.

Algenist… I came her because I thought my pump was stuck or broken. Turns out that’s how it’s supposed to be. Horrible product design for a great serum. The serum is too thick to come out of the pump. It’s so hydrating, love the smell, love how it feels. But if I can’t get it out that’s a problem. Please redesign this!

This is a really nice moisturizing serum.  My skin does feel soft after i use it. However ive been using it religiously for about two months and i dont see much difference in my skin texture. If you have the money and want to try it go for it. Its a nice luxurious product. However dont save up your money just to buy this.
Like the smell and the texture, it does help to smooth my skin.
I do not write any kind of reviews but... the bottle was half full and the dropper does not work!!!!! How will I be able to tell if it works if I cannot get it out of the bottle and to my skin!!!!

My go to!!! It has a subtle perfume smell that goes away after max 20min. DO NOT LET THE COMMENTS ABOUT THE PERFUME SMELL TURN YOU AWAY. It hydrates, brightens and leaves my face so soft!! I do not have oil skin (more normal-dry) and it works amazing for me. I wash my face, apply this liquid collagen then follow up with the Algenist Genius moisturizer !

I had high hopes for this. Alas they were dashed when upon opening the bottle I noticed it was fairly highly fragranced. The dropper is problematic and doesn’t pick up any product at all, except for what clings to the outside of the dropper tube. I decided to give it a go anyway and within a minute my skin was bright red and stinging. Either the fragrance or some other ingredient is highly irritating to my skin. This is being returned.

review_title: Amazing product if you have the patience!
review_text: I have been using this product for about 7 months, and I can finally say I’m a believer. The smell is strong and the dropper is not user friendly (reasons why I marked off a star) but I can honestly say, I see a difference in my skin. It wasn’t immediate, took about 3 months for my skin to get adjusted (I have sensitive skin). Now I see true and visible change in my skin’s hydration, pigmentation, and smoothness. I use this once daily in combination with the genius collagen night cream. I had deep forehead lines that have visibly reduced. The same goes for the fine lines around my eyes. My skin looks plump and radiant. I love this serum!

This product was good, and I am about to start my second bottle.   The packaging is *NOT* bad or faulty with this product.   You just need to understand how to use it.   Simply pull the dropper out of the serum and push all the way down to push all the air out.   Then put back in the serum and release.   The serum is then easily “sucked“ back into dropper for you to then dispense on your hand or face.   Do it this way and you will have zero problems.   Am looking forward to my second bottle.

This worked wonders for my extremely dry 50+ year old skin.  I put this on in the morning, allow it to dry and then put my moisturizing sunscreen on.  This has been the only thing I’ve changed in my morning routine and my itchy dry cheeks are no longer itchy.  Moisture lasts all day long.  The only reason I didn’t give it 5 stars was due to the slight perfume scent and the price.  I wish the regular size was not so pricey.

Absolutely love this serum. I have no issue with the fragrance. Just like with any product you introduce to your routine it’s going to take a while to adjust to it and you do. I’m combo and once it’s used to it the results and worth it all! Love mixing this into my lip balms as well.
I got this as a sample and used it at night. The smell is unbelievable strong. It smells like strong and cheap perfume. So much so I had to wash it off 10 min after going to bed. Won’t use again.

review_title: Impossible to take any serum from the bottle
review_text: It’s almost impossible to grab any serum using the applicator. They need to redesign it
I had high hopes for this product, but it caused a crazy reaction on my skin after a few days. Smells great, and may have been a fluke thing!

Received some samples of this with my last purchase from Sephora. Firstly, I was impressed by the ingredient list, collagen is the first ingredient- before water! Secondly, it felt very hydrating after application and I was impressed a little bit does goes a long way. Overall, my skin did feel quite smooth after completing the trial, however, I found the product to be quite sticky and took a really long time to absorb fully into the skin. I was told you only need 1 drop at a time, but I find that goes nowhere and my skin doesn’t feel moist.  Considering the cost of $155.00 I don’t feel it was worth it. I haven’t even finished the whole pack yet and I’ve already noticed the lines under my eyes are literally disappearing!! They look so much smoother! I’ve been using 1 little pack twice a day! I will definitely be purchasing the full size!! I know it’s on the pricey side but if it works then price doesn’t matter!! Invest in your skin!!!!

I am sensitive to fragrance, this sticks with me all day and seems to attach itself to clothing as well. The fragrance so close to my eyes makes them watery and irritated, I had to stop using this product.  I am a fan of Algenist products, just not this one.

This collagen might be great and work wonderfully if you’re stupid-rich and don’t mind having to spend $115 about every 3 weeks. That’s how long the tube lasts. Seriously. I’m not convinced it really did anything anyway.

I am 52 years old and as we all know living in Michigan your skin is exposed to all kinds of elements! I have been using this product for about six months and boy what a difference! My skin is very sensitive, so When ever I tried anything it alway failed. But I can truly say this is a winner.

Purchasing my third bottle. It’s expensive but I can’t live without it. The texture of my skin has improved and I can’t give it up.

Omg!! I’m 19 and am terrified of wrinkles... this stuff makes me feel beautiful the second I wake up!!! My skin looks so rejuvenated and pretty. Completely worth the money.

it’s a shame that this has to have added fragrance because it smells awful! Happy I was able to try before purchase because I would have returned right away. For over $100 you would expect a better bottle can not afford to loose that much product because of a bottle.

I did read one review before purchasing that said if you show no sure signs of aging, not to spend your money on the product and they were probably right. While I’m 28 and am aging.... I probably won’t repurchase unless I notice significant change in my skin once I stop using it when the bottle runs out... but I doubt that will happen since i didn’t see any change when I started a few months ago. I have used a little more than a quarter of the serum so far and I can easily say that I have not only visibly noticed a difference but my skin is so much more supple and feels softer as well. I would love if Algenist could come out with this same serum in a pump style or pour out bottle as I think it would be more effective than the dropper.

Omg! My ain’t instantly looked hydrated and youthful! The bottle make is a bit harder to get the last bit out so not crazy about that out upside done over night to the little left works! A must re order!

This is the best combo ever. THIS IS BY FAR ONE OF THE BEST MOISTURIZERS OUT THERE!!! I have combination skin, and this didn’t cause any breakouts made my skin soft but not greasy and worked AMAZINGLY. The Liquid Collagen is very lightweight and I used it before the moisturizer. The Genius Sleeping Collagen is a very buttery soft cream, made with vegan plant collagen that provides intense nourishment for more hydrated, radiant skin. I’ve been using this combo every night since I got them in my VoxBox a week ago and I can say that my skin is the softest it has ever been,my pores are also smaller and my make up last longer. 10/10 recommend.

The first night I tried it I did wake up the next day with little tiny white pimples all over my forehead. I still gave it another try and decided to focus around my eyes and neck.
