(I recieved this product as a free sample from Influenster)Pros: simple ingredients, no harsh ingredients and vegan. I used it while traveling in Denver (the air was really dry) and I did make my skin feel moisturized, though I still used my regular serum and moisturizer after. Had a slight sticky residue that seemed to absorb after about 30 minutes. Smells pleasant though slightly unnatural.Cons: contains PEGS and and the 3rd ingredient is alcohol denat- YUCK!!  No reason why those ingredients should be in this product... it was slightly disappointing from a company like Belif.
Very light yet effective. Makes my skin so smooth and hydrated, but it does make my skin taste bitter... always looking forward to those kisses. So I use it when I’m alone.
Super refreshing! Lightweight and cooling to the skin. Love using this right when I wake up!
I received a sample from Influenster and I used for some time but I didn’t felt a significant difference, and plus my skin breakdown, i received this product for free for testing purposes.

I received this as a sample and I will definitely purchase again. I use it before applying make up and absolutely love how smooth it leaves my skin. My make up applies really nicely and it has a light scent.

Amazing product for the price.  I recieved this product from influenster for my honest opinion and honestly i have been loving it!  I am especially looking forward to incorporating this into my skin care for the fall as the weather get drier as does my skin. My skin drinks the product up and it preps my skin for serums to be applied
My first Belif product, and I’m impressed. Very hydrating toner! Would prefer if it came in a spray bottle.

This product is a great splash of moisture! I typically use it in the mornings when I’m too lazy to wash the sleep off my face. It’s refreshing and easy to use, though I wouldn’t say life changing in any way.
Yes! Yes! Yes! I love this toner because it’s nit super harsh. It is refreshing after a day at work, or a work out. And the price is great for the quality of the product!
I have dry acne prone skin. Using this product has helped by keeping my face feeling more fresh after all the acne medication. I definitely recommend.

A decent toner that isn’t overly hydrating and will leave skin soft. I would say this is best for oily skin due to the ingredients. I have dry skin and it didn’t do much for me hydration wise. It has a soft smell that reminds me of the beach. If you have oily skin then this toner is the one for you! I got this complimentary in a voxbox from Influenster.

I think this a beautiful hydrating Toner! It smells lovely, feels great on the skin as it dries down without being sticky. I find myself using this more like an essence than a toner. I apply a little in my hands and pat it into my skin rather than using cotton and having the product soaked up. I use it more in the AM because I use a cleansing toner at night. All around great product, I only deducted one star because I don’t remember to reach for it that often. Not a staple item for me.

I have been using this toner for about a month now, and I didn’t think a product like this would make a difference in my routine but I was totally mistaken. This hydrating toner helps to clarify skin without stripping it. I am in love with the scent (it smells similar to aqua bomb moisturizer ) and I feel like it will take me forever to go through a bottle. Definitely a permanent staple in my skincare routine.
This product feels great but I wish alcohol wasn’t one of the first ingredients. I received this product to review but doubt I will purchase it for myself. I prefer cleaner products.

I love Belif products especially the Hungarian Water Essence so I was stoked to receive this as a gift! I definitely feel the hydration when applying the toner - it feels thick and slightly sticky but I like that because it moisturizes my skin. I had been breaking out lately in my T-zone bc I hadn’t been removing my makeup entirely. The toner helps remove every last bit!

I’ve been using this toner for about 2 weeks now and am really happy with it. There is a slight mediciney smell but it’s not overwhelming. I have sensitive skin but have not experienced any burning or dry skin from using it. I do, however, feel my $6 toner gets the job done just as good if not better. I probably would not use regularly if purchasing at this price point.

review_title: Great addition to to the Aqua line
review_text: So, I’ve been using the Belif Aqua Eye Bomb cream for a couple months now so when @influenster let me know I was getting more of Belif’s Aqua Bomb products for FREE to try out and review I was thrilled; and let me tell you, they definitely have not disappointed. || My skin can be tricky because I am super oily but get a patch of eczema my glasses lay and dry spots around my mouth and chin. Well, this Aqua Bomb Toner hydrates my dry parts, removes excess oil, and feels so nice after I put it on. I’ve used other toners before but have never stuck with them them because I found them to be too drying but not this one - and combined with the Aqua Bomb Serum and Eye Cream my face has never felt better. I highly, highly, recommend all three of the products I mentioned from this Belif Aqua Bomb line.

I really love how gentle it is on my skin! I have seen such a difference in how bright my skin is and I will definitely continue to use until it is gone. I received this product free to sample from Influenster.

review_title: I really wanted to love this....
review_text: While I really enjoy the smell and the way it makes my skin feel, every time I use I wake up the next morning with a few lint little white heads. I will keep trying it to see if it’s just clearing out my skin but unfortunately my first impression is just so-so

my favorite thing about this toner is the texture- it is thicker than water while still being very light and absorbs well.  this works well in my routine as I like to layer hydrating products.  I took a star off due to the high alcohol content and I don’t care for the blueish tint.  I received this from influenster in exchange for my honest review.
love this product. I live in Wyoming and my skin gets super dry out here.

I wanted to use this for a week or so before writing a review. This is my new go to toner. My face doesn’t feel dry after using this. Some people have commented on the smell. I don’t think it is strong and dissipates moments after application.

If your looking for an extra bit of hydration to add to your routine than this is it. I switch up my toners based on how my skin is acting, and this is perfect when I want to add more hydration. I’m giving this 4 stars because this alone will not be enough to hydrate skin. When used in conjunction with a moisturizer, however,  it definitely increased moisture.

This toner has beautiful packaging and I was so excited to try it! It’s easy to use and smells great, however it doesn’t feel great on my skin and didn’t leave my skin feeling as hydrated as I thought it would. My skin burned after I put it on and it felt dry after. I used a lot more moisturizer after I normally do to make up for it and found myself quickly going back to my other toner. I was really bummed because I’ve used this line of moisturizer in the past and was hoping for a better experience.

So far I am loving this toner! I have combo skin and I have noticed a big change in my dry areas! I was a flaky mess on my chin and cheeks and my skin has definitely improved since I started using this.

review_title: Like a refreshing glass of water for your skin.
review_text: Its funny how toners always were in the very end of my beauty care list. I would always skip this step. BUT after receiving BELIF aqua bomb hydrating  toner everything changed. Its really gives your skin all the hydration you need. I feel the difference right away. Skin feels like you just gave it big glass of cold water. I live it!
So far I have really liked this product. I usually get dry skin when using to many toners. (Skin is usually oily) but this toner has not dried my face out and I’ve been using it for over a week
I love this toner! It’s SUPER hydrating and smells great. My skin feels very soft after using it !

I received this product free from Influenster and want to tell you that I really like it. I have oily combo skin. I am 65 years old and I use this after I cleanse my face every morning and every night. It feels great. There is something in it that makes my face feel velvety smooth. It’s also refreshing. I have incorporated this toner into my regime now and plan to keep it.

I have become a Belifer! This lucky, glamour loving lady got to be one of the first to test Belif’s Aquabomb Hydrating Toner, and I am in LOVE. I have always been a little lazy when it comes to toner, but after testing this, I have seen the light! After just one use my skin felt immediately refreshed and hydrated, and eight days in, my overall skin texture and clarity has improved. The product feels good, smells good, and is very effective.

so glad that I received this product to try. the toner smells great and natural. cleans off any foundation residues i may have after washing my face and I notice a reduction in my blackheads and overall increased clarity of skin!

This product is officially a part of my everyday skincare routine. So far it has not only help to hydrate my skin, leaving it with a youthful glow, but it also is clearing up my acne and dry skin patches too! I’m gonna keep it real here, I did receive this product complementary for testing. BUT I’m a believer after using it for 5 days straight with great results. I’m a forever customer now, as this product is very well priced. Especially for the quality of the product and size. It honestly feels like it’s “healing“ your skin and balancing it back out all at the same time.

I love this toner . it is very  hydrating and lightweight on the skin . my skin feels super soft and hydrated after the application . it is also super gentle . I apply it into palm of my hands and directly to my skin . I love it
I love how cooking and refreshing this toner is! Feel great even on my sensitive skin. I have been using it at night for extra hydration.

OMG! Where has this moisturizer been all my life?! I’m in my late 50’s and have very oily skin which doesn’t do well with most moisturizers. This has been a total game changer! It’s so hydrating without the heavy feeling I get from most other moisturizers I’ve tried (and there have been many). It feels great under my makeup too, and even makes my makeup look so much smoother. Best of all… my skin has never been more soft and radiant! Can’t say enough good things about it. HIGHLY RECOMMEND! Thank you FAB!
This product is great.I luv the moisture very great product. I would recommend this.

review_title: You somehow feel drier using this
review_text: One of the worst moisturizers I’ve ever used. I decided to try it as it was on sale and I typically list First Aid. I had to GLOB so much of this one to feel even slightly moisturized. It dries out so fast. I’m also not sure what’s in it ingredient wise but it would also sting my face. Was a fail for me.
This is by far my favorite moisturizer! I feels so good and smells AMAZING! It is so light and I love the way it feels cold.

I think this is my first review. This product is worth reviewing!!! My skin just drinks this!!! You actually feel it seeping into your pores. It feels cool and refreshing, and skin does not feel greasy or cakey afterwards. It’s just as if you splashed some coconut water on your face. I love first aid Beauty products!

I wanted to like this, I actually bought this twice and returned it the first time and I’m going to return it again bc of the same issue, the dryness! I wanted to give it a second try and see if I had the same issue and I did.
probably not great for people with dry skin because it definitely isn’t super hydrating, but it worked well for me since my skin is on the oily side and didn’t break me out (yet)

I was really excited to try this moisturizer. I really like First Aid Beauty’s products. The moisturizer itself feels really nice and didn’t irritate my sensitive skin. BUT the smell is so strong that I really don’t think I can use it. It gives me a headache. I think it might be the vanilla extract. The smell reminds me of cheap chapstick that you get when you’re a kid.

I have dry-combination skin and this product is amazing. I live in Florida where it’s very humid and I love this moisturizer because it absorbs right into my skin and makes it feel like nothing’s there. When I go outside I don’t have to worry about sweating off my moisturizer anymore and I love it. I feel like this moisturizer is great for people of all skin types during the day who want a good moisturizer that feels like it’s not there.

Bought this because I love FAB, and have bought a lot of their products, I swear by their Ultra Repair cream.  I was looking for a product that is light weight and moisturizes- while it is light weight this leaves my skin dry and tight. I dont have dry skin, I run on the oily side- but this really dries me out.
Smells really good, doesn’t feel oily and leaves my skin soft and really hydrated! I have the cleanser as well and they work really well together
I love the product but, it is so small and you get a little bit of it. which is a bummer

if you have oily skin you may like this product more since it dries down pretty quickly, i personally have dry skin and find it makes my skin feel quite drier around those patches that aren’t quite as oily, It does smell nice though

I love this product.  I use it in the morning under my makeup and nothing separates because there is no oil in it!  I mix it with my vitamin c serum and it stops my product from balling up.  A constant repurchase for me!

review_title: Light texture but not hydrating enough
review_text: This product is light and smells nice, but once it sets in and is dry, I don’t feel it has moisturized my skin at all. I don’t have dry in, but I need something to put on after I wash my face in the morning and night. Because my skin doesn’t feel moisterized, I end up using way more product than I want and finished this faster than any other moisturizer I’ve bought (and I’ve bought A LOT) or putting facial oil on when I wouldn’t want to. Wouldn’t recommend if you want something deeply hydrating - this is pretty light.
Bought this after breaking out in hives all over my face and being left with raw, irritated skin. My skin is very sensitive and LOVES this.
Skin feels tight and dry about a minute after application. Love the smell and the fact that it could be absorbing so fast. But I would not buy again
Fungal acne free and completely hydrates the skin! Also good for sensitive skin. Will purchase again
I was excited to try this product, but honestly I’ve had better. The texture is nice and it smells good, but my skin feels tight and dry after. I wouldn’t buy it again.

I bought this hoping it would be hydrating enough for my dry skin but it just didn’t work out. I’m giving it two stars because I did like the feel when applying it to my skin. If you have dry skin, I do not recommend buying this product.
Excellent moisturizer for sensitive skin. It feels great on the skin, smells delicious, skin feels hydrated....Not tacky or sticky! Great for sensitive, eczema skin.

This product has been recommended for dry skin. I can honestly say this is very far from the truth. My dry skin sucked this up and felt dry again in 20 min. I would probably suggest this for someone with combination to oily.
Absorbs well, but hydration does not last on dry skin. Horrible, strong smell as well. The only product from FAB that I dislike.

Fantastic! Absorbs quickly, you don’t need a lot. Doesn’t pill on your skin. Easy to apply make up on top. Great for both morning and night. It does smell like coconut (surprise) but it’s not overwhelming and is very pleasant.

I absolutely love this product. I started using it after hearing Hyram rave about it on YouTube. I have combination skin so wanted a good gel cream for my day moisturizer. This delivers in EVERY WAY and instantly absorbs into the skin. The only thing to watch is that if your skin barrier is damaged, this can burn and irritate your skin. Make sure to use on healthy skin to avoid discomfort, and maybe try the FAB Ultra Repair Cream to help repair your skin before using this if you’re having issues. I use that cream at night and this during the day.

review_title: Buy this not the tatcha water cream!
review_text: I love this cream! I have combination skin and it’s the perfect amount of moisture for my oily t zone and my drier cheeks! It doesn’t clog my pores either, which tends to happen when I change moisturizers. I switched from the tatcha water cream to this and not only is it more affordable, it works better. I’m excited to see how it works in the drier cold months but so far, I’m in love!

review_title: Solid moisturizer, not a fan of the smell
review_text: Based on Hyram’s recommendation I purchased this as a dupe to the Tatcha Water Cream. I love the Tatcha one and have repurchased several times but I wanted to have an option for a replacement as it is pricey. I like this perfectly fine. I have oily sensitive skin and it worked well for me. Personally, I’m not a fan of the smell, think it smells like robitussen/medicine. I’ll definitely use it up but not sure if I’ll repurchase.

I have eczema with a couple spots on my face prone and a bit thinned from medication over the years. I use other FAB produce with no problem. They’re light enough to not give me whiteheads but strong enough to keep my super dry skin moisturized. This coconut water cream came in a gift set and smelled so pretty I was excited to use it, but have only found that it dries me right out before the day is done. Maybe other skin types have better luck but I want to warn ppl with eczema who may also figure this will work for them since other products do.

I have very oily skin and this actually dried out my skin. No matter how much I would apply, it would leave my skin stiff and matte with absolutely no hydration. Unfortunate, because I really liked the smell and light weight consistency.

review_title: Best moisturizer for oily skin & tropical climate!
review_text: I have EXTREMELY oily skin and live in south Florida where it is pretty much hot, humid, and icky all year long. Oily skin has been an issue for me ever since I was a kid.Thanks to Hyram (YouTuber who recommends skin care products) I decided to try this moisturizer. THIS PRODUCT IS AMAZINGGG! For the type of climate I live in and my oily skin, this moisturizer works wonders. It hydrates your skin the moment you put it on and your skin takes it all in. It doesn’t leave you with a matte finish but comes pretty close which I love. Sometimes matte finishes will leave my skin oily and other moisturizers will leave my face greasy. This is the perfect balance between the two. I have tried oil control moisturizer by ole henriksen and it would leave my face greasy. I tried origins moisturizer with willow herb and also left my face greasy at the end of the day. This is the only product that has worked for me. Never going back! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS MOISTURIZER!

I really love this! I was looking for a lightweight moisturizer that wouldn’t overwhelm my combination skin, and this is it! It has the perfect amount of hydration for the dry areas on my face, and doesn’t make the oily areas any oilier. It also layers well under my SPF. The scent is quite nice; not fake or sweet-smelling. Would recommend!

This cream is very light and smells amazing. I just don’t think it hydrates my skin enough unless I use a lot of product. I liked that the product is lightweight but as someone with dry skin, I don’t recommend it because this product doesn’t moisturize much.
I’m in love with this. It feels amazing on the skin.  I have sensitive oily skin.  Over 40.  This was light weight and cooling on the skin. And the very lightest coconut scent.  A+

I like this moisturizer. It absorbs into the skin very quickly. I would recommend only if you have lean towards oily skin otherwise I don’t think it will be moisturizing enough for you. I use it as a daytime moisturizer.

I loved this moisturizer, what I was looking for was a moisturizer that didn’t make my skin feel more oily than it already is and this cream definitely solved that issue for me 100%! Honestly, my only wish was that it came in a bigger size and in a pump container instead of a jar.

If I could give this product a 0 star, I would! I have combo to oily skin and this moisturizer seems to be the perfect moisturizer for me in theory. Unfortunately, it doesn’t moisturize my skin at all. As soon as I put it on my skin, it seems to “disappear” right away. As I continued to use it for a week, my skin always feel dry and tight thru out the day. Which shocked me because I don’t have dry skin or surface dehydration at all. And what terrifies me even more is that I saw dry patches on my skin which can be physical lifted off if I scratched it. I bought this with my own money and wouldn’t buy it again.

I am obsessed with this product! A few weeks ago I identified that my skin was super dehydrated/over processed and I needed to dial back my routine and focus on hydration. I have oily and acne prone skin so I have to be very careful about the moisturizers I use. I have been so happy with my experience with the Coconut Water Cream. I use it twice a day and add two drops of The Ordinary Niacinimide in the morning. It does a great job of moisturizing my skin without being too heavy. I love the smell and the texture and it feels like such a luxurious treat when I put it on. Highly recommended!

Ouch. This moisturiser stung and caused redness immediately upon application. I was hoping it was just the actives I had used the night before, but after two more attempts I have to admit my skin just doesn’t like this cream. I have combo skin, not sensitive generally, even with the use of vitamin c, retinoids and acids. I found myself applying oils not long after to make for a lack of moisture as well. I love you FAB, but I guess you can’t win them all.

I love this product.... I have very picky skin and lots of moisturizes make my skin feel greasy. This one absorbed nicely, made my skin feel great and didn’t leave a greasy finish. Will forever buy this product!

review_title: Melts on skin, not into skin
review_text: When I first used this, I was happy with it. It melted right on my skin. Then I realized that’s the problem, it didn’t seem to penetrate. It feels like there are a lot of silicones, which I am not against, but in this case, it seems to just sit on the skin. I received this as it was part of their $91 eight piece set, so I am stuck with this full size product. At least I can now just slather it on my face and neck and not worry about how much product I am using since I don’t care for it and it as to be used up anyways.

So frickin moisturizing. My skin just soaks up Hydroboost as if it’s not enough but I only need one layer of this. My skin is EXTREMELY dry and red but this helps my skin so much to the point where I don’t care if it’s 45$. It lasts a long time too. I’ve been using this for two months and I still haven’t run out. Overall, it’s great and I definitely recommend.

This product felt amazing on the skin but I found out soon enough that it was breaking me out. Some skin types can’t handle coconut oil and others soak it up! So definitely see if you can get a trial size before purchasing:)

Love this stuff. I first tried it as a free sample a couple years ago and forgot about it. Then I stared using another first aid beauty product and it worked great. I ran out and decided to give this a try. I love it so much. It glides on my skin and absorbs nicely leaving it soft and smooth. My only issue is the size. Wish it came in a bigger size.
Love this product I got a a travel size with my order from Ipsy and love it. Makes my face smooth and don’t break out like a lot of other skin products.
this is one of my most favorite moisturizers. it is perfect for oily skin, it absorbs so nicely and smells light and fresh. it keeps my skin hydrated all day

I loveeee water creams because I can’t stand a heavy moisturizer even though I have dry skin. I am so bad about consistently using a moisturizer in the mornings but this smells sooo good that I never forget. I could bathe in this stuff. Super lightweight and dries down nicely on the skin. It also wears beautifully under makeup. Love love!

Love it. I was initially on the fence about this product. Until I incorporated a few different serums (collagen and Q10 from the Inkey List) plus hyaluronic acid. My skin texture has changed so much, it is so soft and radiant! I’ve had to use other creams if I’ve forgotten this while traveling, and I do notice a difference. This is a perfect base for makeup or to bare your skin. Plus there is this wonderful cooling experience when you initially put this on. I’ve never had any piling of products and, for me, the finishing texture is not tacky. For me - this cream is an entire experience. I’m on my second jar now and I will keep on using this from spring to fall. I live up north and I know this won’t do diddly squat when it’s - 40C (-40F for my imperial system folks!) - but that’s ok as FAB Coconut Smoothie Primer is my winter jam. Star off for packaging - I don’t like having to scoop out the product with my finger and having to continuously expose the cream to air. This product is thin enough to be in a pump or squeeze container.

I tried this on a whim on a recommendation from a coworker, and fell in love. I have dry, flaky skin on my face from years of hormonal acne and this is the only thing that helps ease the itching and actually hydrates my skin.  It has a light fragrance and despite feeling thick at first, is easily absorbed and still feels refreshing. It works well with or without makeup, and sunscreen too!!!  I just wish they had different sizes to purchase this product in as each container only lasts me about a month. I also loved the trial size one which was a tube instead of a glass jar, as it was easier to carry and get the right amount of product (no product waste).

I love this product. My skin gets very bumpy with certain moisturizers and this one does not do that at all. It makes my skin look very glowy and healthy. I don’t have extremely dry skin so it’s not to over moisturizing where it’s going to make me look oily. It’s not greasy at all. It does take a few minutes to settle into the skin but after that it works well with my makeup and I will be repurchasing

I think this is a really great moisturizer. I however have very dehydrated and dry skin and it just wasn’t quite enough for my needs. So while I think this is an excellent product, it may not meet the skin needs of those with very dry skin.
I received a sample of this and loved the way it felt on my skin. I’m considering buying a jar at some point, maybe when I finish my other moisturizers.
Loved this product got rid of my acne but it’s not as hydrating as I thought it would be
I love this product so much! The smell alone is amazing.

Best moisturizer ever. I’ve used my fair share of different brands of face moisturizers, and this one has been the best. Very light and dries quickly, yet still does the job. Will continue to repurchase.
I originally got a sample of FAB coconut water cream, and I loved it so much I bought the full size. It plumped out fine lines and made my skin feel nourished.

review_title: Made me skin dry and flaky!!
review_text: Left my skin super dry and flaky. I have combination skin that’s non-sensitive and rarely experiences dryness or irritation. I tried to exfoliate off the flakiness but that just left a stinging feeling. had to use hydrating overnight masks three nights in a row just to get my skin back to normal.
Does wonders for my combination skin type! Soothes skin and smells great!

I’m so very on the fence with this moisturizer. On the one hand the texture is amazing, it hydrates my skin beautifully and I don’t have to use a lot. But I hate tub packaging, I’m not a fan of dimethicone or it’s derivatives and I don’t like the smell. But honestly nothing hydrates and works with my skin like this one does, so I might end up buying the full size one day.

review_title: Great Day Moisturizer for Dry Skin
review_text: Great day focused moisturizer for my dry skin.Leaves me feeling hydrated, cool and refreshed during my skin care routine.

My new favorite moisturizer! Keeps my skin feeling soft, smooth and not oily or greasy ! My skin is normally very oily, dry and rosacea prone. when I put this on it feels like a nice cold drink for my skin. Cooling and calming. The non-oily finish allows you to apply as many times a day as you need - if you need a little boost.
I use this as a morning lotion because its really lightweight and doesn’t make my skin feel heavy! I had to buy again because I love the smell and the texture

I got this in last months PLAY box and I fell in love with it! I love the way my skin feels after applying, not oily or wet but it soaks into my skin and it feels weightless. Amazing product, basing this off of the sample but I am purchasing and will continue to purchase!!

My skin was peeling after a chemical burn caused by makeup wipes and dry weather. I used this product, the rewards version, and it really helped calm and smooth my skin. I typically run oily; so having dry, cracking, peeling skin is a different ballgame.

I absolutely LOVE how creamy and buttery this moisturizer feels on my skin! Not greasy at all...I got this in a sample from my Sephora play box and I’m definitely going to buy the full size..I’m squeezing the last product I have left of my sample today haha

One amazing lotion! It is so hydrating.  My face drinks it up.  It is like a gel but not sticky and it dries quickly.  I love the light coconut smell.  I got this as a trial in the Play Smart Superfoods and I had to have the full size!

review_title: Perfect day moisturizer for combo/oily skin!
review_text: I was given this moisturizer as a mini to try And ended up buying the full size of this! I take skincare very seriously and love deep hydration moisturizers but these would sometimes end up being too heavy under makeup for my combination oily skin, this is just perfect for daytime I wear the tarte Mermaid skin serum under this and this combination works like a charm for me!

Loved this!  My skin drank it up and felt amazing after application. Didn’t leave any oily feeling. And the smell is yummy!!!! I gave four stars for price point and for the unsanitary packaging. Would love it in a pump dispenser. Then the price would be well worth paying.
TOTALLY WORTH IT , so happy with this and I am going to get the full size
Love this product is very nice on the skin. I used it on winter time bc my skin get dry. Very good.
It has saved my skin!!

I have eczema on my face and I have combination skin. I’ve recently been trying a whole bunch of moisturizers and serums to find the best one and is one of my favorites for sure. Using it day and night, skin feels extremely smooth and perfect!
Lightweight summer moisturizer and it smells great. I’m on my third jar already, and would definitely recommend it. I wouldn’t use it as a heavy duty winter moisturizer for dry skin though.
I have the most sensitive skin ever and this face cream is by far the best one I have ever tried! It gives me enough moisture but doesn’t leave me greasy
Doesn’t feel greasy and smells great!
My face feels nice and hydrated after I put it in and it’s very lightweight but my issue is for some reason it’s breaking my face out. I am getting rough texture on the sides of my face.

review_title: meh, you might love it tho
review_text: love the smell love the texture love the brand. but way to light. I don’t have dry skin but I always applied this twice in a row due to it just disappearing right away. loved it enough to finish it but will not repurchase. worth a try if you don’t have dry skin what so ever. I have normal acne prone.
This product hydrates so well and it smells great.

I really wanted to love this product but it made my skin red after using it and didn’t feel hydrating. review_title: Mix Marula Facial Oil & C-Firma daily!!
review_text: After one month of using this mixed with the Marula Facial Oil after washing my face, I see huge improvements with my skin. I have combination skin. This makes my skin soft and brightens my skin. I love the way this combo works!

This might be a hot take, but I actually really like that C-Firma is now packaged so that the user can mix the product when it arrives. While the mixing process can be tedious and user-error prone, it allows the consumer to use the product at its maximum potency, meaning that we’re getting the most for our money. In the past, the C-Firma I would receive would already be a slight orange colour (meaning it had already started oxidizing and is losing potency). Now, immediately after mixing, it is clear (which is how it should be). I personally had a really positive experience mixing the serum, so thought I could share my process:1)	Plan to mix the serum at least a day before you intend to use it. I mixed it 3 days in advance.2)	Tap the container with the powder on a hard flat surface so that the powder settles at the bottom of the container. This helps to prevent powder from making its way onto the threaded part where the container joins with the dispensing head when opening to add the liquid.3)	When you open the container with the powder, do so very carefully4)	Slowly pour the liquid into the container with the powder5)	Close the container tightly before shaking – you want to make sure that it is totally and fully sealed, or you’ll end up with a leaky mess! 6)	Shake heaps. Heaps and heaps. If there is powder still at the bottom, don’t fret. You can either continue to shake, or you can leave it be for some time. That powder should dissolve on its own over time. The shaking is really only speeding up the dissolution process.7)	Occasionally shake until powder is fully dissolved8)	Let the contents settle in the fridge. Once “foam” disappears, just give it a good shake before using. Another note: this serum smells like hotdog water – this is the ferulic acid. Any good vitamin C serum is likely to have a funky smell. I have a strong sense of smell, and I find the smell dissipates after no more than an hour following application. If you can stand it, it’s worth it!

I understand the logic of having to mix the product ourselves because vitamin C is not very shelf-stable. I had never tried the original serum before they changed it, so I can’t speak to whether it’s changed. The bottle where we mix the powder and liquid had a narrow opening, so I almost spilled the liquid. I shook it for 1 minute but it still looks like powder is on the bottom. It’s now a complete liquid, it’s not a serum. I applied it after mixing and it was very sticky and tacky on my skin, which was a little disappointing considering this product is expensive. I’ve tried similarly priced vitamin C products that are not tacky or sticky at all, like YTTP. That plus the bad smell, I am not sure if I will continue to use this product even if I see brightening results.

It’s really hard to describe how it’s like but I definitely don’t like that scent.

Mixing it was a little messy also. I like that it comes separate because it probably stays fresher but the oil leaks a bit when you shake it.
can’t say enough about this product. i’ve tried many vitamin C serum‘s and this is the best one yet. gives my face the best glow!

I enjoyed this serum, and although I probably won’t repurchase it, I’m going to use it until it’s empty. I love that it’s lightweight, and it didn’t feel sticky to me as some others commented. I also love knowing that the serum is as fresh as possible - that feels very innovative. The L-ascorbic acid version of vitamin C is very active and can be irritating to any mildly sensitive skin. My skin is pretty hearty but I still felt a bit of a sting when I had sensitized areas, so I prefer a different formulation. I think if a majority of your skincare is DE and your skin isn’t sensitive, this is a good serum. *this product was reviewed free for review
I enjoy using this serum. It does make my ski brighter and a little firmer. But it’s not as life changing as I thought it would be. And it’s really pricey. But overall a good product.

I’ve been trying this serum for a few weeks now and so far it’s been pretty good to me. I really liked how I got to mix it myself. I have noticed my skin to be a bit brighter which is great. I will keep trying it and hope to see even better results!

I’ve tried some expensive serums and they always make me look like a sheet of grease and I hate it! So I was scared to try any serum at all but this was a pleasant surprise. I actually love it. It leaves my skin slightly dewy but definitely not oily. I love that I got to kinda diy and mix it up myself. A little goes such a long way and the light watery consistency of it is what my skin needs because the thicker gels and oils really don’t mix well when it comes to my combination skin and serums. I went into testing this product thinking I wouldn’t like it but I do. The only downside is that it can sting a bit but my skin isn’t usually sensitive and my tolerance for intense skincare is pretty high so I can’t speak for someone who has more sensitive skin than I do. But it only lasts maybe a couple seconds so it’s not bad at all. If you struggle finding a serum that doesn’t make you look like a glazed donut then try this one. It’s game changing.

I got this product for free to give my full honest review from influenster and drunk elephant.  Lets start with how amazing it is that if comes with two bottles so you can mix up the formula your self and you know that its super fresh. It honestly makes you feel like a mixologist super fun. The product does have a little bit of a Chemical smell I think it because of the vitamin c in it. I really enjoyed how fresh and plump my face felt after I applied it. Compared to Murad vitamin c moisturizer which dried my face out and made my extremely itchy on it. I’m not having this issue with this product so far. The only down side is the amount of product you get in the container for the price just wish it was more.

This product is literally liquid gold. It was sent to me to try and review for free by Influenster. It has brightened and toned my skin in just a week. I am so happy with the results. If you’re looking for a serum that will make your skin bright than this is the one. @sephora #gifted #complimentary #drunkelephant #shakethingsup #contest @drunkelephant

I think the concept of mixing the dual part serum is fun and allows for a fresh product to the consumer.  However, aside from the fun of mixing the powder and liquid to make the serum, I think less work for the consumer should be valued for this type of product. The serum itself goes on smooth and absorbs quickly.  It left my skin feeling tacky for a few minutes which is not preferred, but goes away after it’s fully absorbed.  The smell of the serum is almost smokey, which I disliked.  Overall, after multiple days of use I did see minor changes in my skin, but will not make this part of my skincare routine going forward as it just wasn’t right for my skin type.

Great serum!  I enjoyed mixing it together like a mad scientist and it goes on the skin nicely.  It gave me a nice glow throughout the day and wasn’t overly sticky or smelly.  I noticed some slight improvement to my skin tone and texture after a few days of use.  I think I will continue to use this and consider repurchasing for sure.
So happy with the new package update! I’m someone who likes to restock my products before I run out, so this mix-it-yourself packaging helps so i get the freshest ingredients when I open it!
I enjoy the ease of this product. However I started breaking out in little irritation bumps on my cheek after using this.

Really love this vitamin c serum! I have tried a few and this one really yields the greatest results. I have been using for about two weeks now and I knew it was working when my boyfriend said that my skin has looked amazing and glowy recently!! I call that a win! It’s easy to apply, although, I do need two pumps so I’m hoping it won’t run out too quickly. It spreads in, then gets kind of tacky, which I actually love because I can feel it there and know that it’s working. It provides an instant glow. I didn’t notice a smell like some others did, but as long as it’s working, I don’t care! I received this free for testing purposes, but I will definitely be repurchasing. Love Drunk Elephant products!

I really love this product, didn’t know what to expect when I got it in the mail but I am satisfied with the results. I got this as a part of a voxbox through Influenster and this is one of my favorite products to use. I use it after I wash my face and saw results within a few days of using it. I will now add this to my face routine as a staple must have product!

I received this product as a tester, and i actually love it! I’ve been using it for almost a week and I’ve noticed that my skin does look more radiant, even, and less textured. I’m giving this product four stars because of the strong smell.

review_title: Nice serum but the smell is not the best
review_text: I love that you freshly mix the product yourself when you are ready to use it & it was pretty easy to mix. I must say the first thing I noticed & the only negative is that it has a musk type smell that I didn’t like. However, it goes away pretty quickly & it fully absorbed into my skin within 5-10 minutes. I have been using it for a full week & it has not broken me out or irritated my sensitive skin. I must say so far I am a fan & I do like the look of my skin after application but I would have to continue using it to see the overall results.

I love the idea of the product being mixed together. It gives simple instructions for this. The serum gives me a glowy look, which I love. I wasn’t able to get a few chunks left in the serum but I’ll still use it all because it’s a good product!

I normally use the LANCOME Genefique serum but I do like to use Vitamin C occasionally to brighten my skin! This is one of the strongest vitamin c formulas in Sephora and I believe on the market! It absolutely works! You do have to mix the powder with the liquid to form the actual serum but it’s super easy! I love that so that it doesn’t easily activate and spoil! The packaging is uber unique and I love it! The product does come off a bit thick but I like something that feel like it’s gonna sink in my skin and not just dry down. You only need one pump! I would also recommend using a sunscreen. I did receive this product complimentary of Influenster and Drunk Elephant; however I would absolutely recommend this product!

Love it ! Honestly such a good serum . I think this is a vitamin c that anyone could use , or at least most skin types . It’s really smoothing and brightening , definitely one of my new faves going into my every day skincare routine . I can visibly see a difference after a couple of weeks

First to start with the smell-Im not a fan of it.However even though its tacky ,I like the serum.Using it for over a week now I can say that my skin likes it.I will see in few weeks if there are any more results.I I can say that I have used other DE products and this one didnt have that wow effect on me as the other products did.

I really like it! I’ve seen people mention the smell, but that’s normal with vitamin C products. Most of them smell like hotdog water, lol, but it doesn’t last long. You won’t smell it throughout the day, it goes away quickly. It dries faster than other vitamin c products, which is great, and it has just the right amount of tackiness. Packaging is 10/10. It’s completely covered, since vitC can’t be exposed to light. This has become part of my everyday routine! Would recommend

I’ve been really surprised by how much I love this serum! I was a little wary at first learning that I had to mix it myself, but once I read the information about how that ensures freshness and that the formula never touches the air before it’s ready to go on your face, it made a lot of sense!This is a nice thin serum that easily slides on. It stays a bit tacky on the skin for 20 mins or so, so make sure you leave time for this to soak in before moisturizing. This is typical of all serums, so no issue for me. It makes my skin look visibly brighter and plumper. It’s my first Drunk Elephant product and I’m absolutely sold! I was offered this product in exchange for an honest review by Influenster and I’m so glad I was because I will definitely buy this again.
Love the new packaging for this product! Mixing it yourself insures that the product is fresh and potent! Love using this in the mornings to brighten and energize my skin for the day!

This is something new for me. I first time trying this brand and from first application in love.  Texture is something unique! Very lightweight and tense cream will help you to brightening your skin and remove dark spots. As well as will give you such a desirable healthy look. I feel like every single cell of my face is alive and full with a magicThank for the great product!

Love this serum! I liked the original C-Firma, but I wasn’t as much a fan of the texture, especially in the warmer summer months. This is so much lighter and the mixing process is quick and easy, and you just do it the one time, after that no more mixing. The smell is definitely much less noticeable here, too, and I am so happy they kept the airless packaging. I am back in love with C-Firma!

I received this free sample from @influencer @drunkelephant. I was so surprised just by first use the way it left my face bright and hydrated. It is improving my skin texture. Definitely recommend to everyone to all. It’s in my must have list for everyday I will definitely repurchase it.

review_title: Needed a new addition to my skincare
review_text: I had been wanting a new serum lately. I was blessed to be able to receive this. It really made my skin so much better! And I don’t even have bad skin. It’s not harsh at all and it brought me to the next level

I started using vitamin c when I started trying to get pregnant. I have used this one and the one from ole Henrikson. I have to say I did notice more of a difference with this serum, but it is potent! I can’t use it too many days in a row or it will irritate my face. So if you have sensitive skin this I would recommend only using it a few times a week. This is great too since it is on the pricey side you will get more for your money. I also recommend keeping it i the fridge. It’s soothing and helps the product stay stable longer. I think this is worth a try if you can’t use retinols or salicylic acid due to pregnancy or breastfeeding. It’s a good alternative. I received this product for free to review from influenster. I have tried this product previously by purchasing with my own money however.

Can’t say I Love this but it has boosted a new glow in my skin. It’s a bit sticky when applying, so I pat it into skin instead of smoothing it on like another serum I use. I’ve noticed some breakouts since starting but nothing to make me quit using it. I’ll finish this bottle and may find something a bit better. Fine for now though.

Truly an amazing product. I struggled with skin for a long time and still so in the winter. Consistent use of this product in the AM/PM will give you beautiful results. I don’t even use moisturizer any more I only use this product to moisturize my face. It also looks beautiful when you mix a little with your foundation, rub together in your hands and apply to face and gives you a gorgeous glowy finish.

I live in a super dry climate, and am constantly looking for a face oil that with lock in moisture and give me a healthy glow. This oil is lightweight but also extremely hydrating. I apply it in the morning and give it 20-30 mins to absorb before applying my makeup, and then apply again at night. Huge fan. Will repurchase.
amazing formula but the bottle/applicator SUCKS !!!!!!!! i do have high hopes for their new oasis serum

Absolutely a great facial oil. It leaves my skin very hydrated, plump, and dewy. I apply it both at night and in the AM - I have dry skin so it absorbs easily into my skin after applying over my moisturizer. I also think it has helped a little with some redness I have, which I didn’t expect.Highly recommend - versatile, delivers, would get a fifth star if it had vitamin C active ingredient in it.

the oil itself is really good it’s just the packaging the top part of the bottle came off and everytime i screw the cap back on it just pops right off. i had way more than half left of the bottle now it’s completely empty bc it spilled through the crack of the topper. be careful with this please.

I am so surprised at how much I like this oil. It’s like the Goldilocks of face oils. Everything is “just right“. It’s really moisturizing without feeling too heavy on my skin. I run oily and normally I find oils meant for oily skin to be too light or they may be too thick and pore clogging. This is just perfect for daytime and leaves my skin nice and glowy.

review_title: Relieves dry skin and redness like a dream!
review_text: My skin was extremely dry and flaky, I have acne prone skin and this stuff worked like a dream. Got rid of redness and make my skin extremely smooth without breaking me out. I use about 5-7 drops at the end of my skincare routine and press it into my skin and then put on my moisturizer. I only use this product at night
A little goes a long way. Super hydrating and it smells amazing. The fragrance is subtle.

Love this oil. Was using the DE one previously. I thought since this one was less viscous, it wouldn’t be as moisturizing, but it’s actually MORE moisturizing. I don’t even wear moisturizer with it. The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because of the packaging. The dropper and the screw cap keep popping off and separating, so that’s been frustrating. Otherwise, this stuff is gold!
Amazing. Rarely have to exfoliate anymore and is perfect under makeup.

review_title: Oil results in brighter, more radiant skin
review_text: Love this product and highly recommend it to anyone! I have combination skin with mild acne that’s usually triggered by hormones and diet, and even the smallest blemishes leave behind red spots. I use this oil nightly - and occasionally in the morning, in lieu of moisturizer - and over time I’ve noticed a reduction in redness. Generally, my skin is brighter and more dewey (but not oilier). I’ve received many compliments about the radiance of my skin. Just purchased my second bottle.

review_title: This product is ALL Hype- Save your coins
review_text: Don’t believe the hype. This oil is a huge disappointment& a complete waste of money. I bought this product due to ingredients which I love, however, after finishing the entire bottle, it did not did not provide my skin with any long term nor short term benefits. The ONLY use I had for this product was mixing it with my matte foundation. However, for the price point I definitely recommend buying a cheaper oil than this one. Don’t believe the hype ladies. God bless!
I love, love, love this facial oil...my skin oozes with radiance. I actually love everything that YTTP has come out with!!
This has fragrance in it. Broke me out since I am sensitive towards fragrance :/ I didn’t notice that it had fragrance at first, but it does !!

The smell is so lightly fresh.. I use this as a primer, moisturizer or oil after my skincare. I have normal to dry skin but now I’d say I don’t have much dry skin anymore. Just got my second bottle, had to share! Love love love. xx

I have dry dry dry Dry Skin, which this is supposed to help, but literally it dries me out so badly. I gave it to my husband, who has super oily skin, and he loves it because it dries his oil skin out

I wanted to finish the bottle before reviewing - this is hydrating for sure and I could only use it for night time because the oil sits on top of your skin and makes you look very shiny - like, way too shiny. It helped some of my dry patches around my nose, which was good. I love oils but I did not like the feeling of this particular oil. My hands would feel a little tacky. It for sure hydrated, but the awkward face glow was a no-go for me.

I don’t know how I ever lived without this in my routine because the radiance and glow that it gives my skin is absolutely unbeatable. It is a bit pricey, but it always lasts me quite a few months and I use it twice a day. I have oily skin, so before using this, I was very against incorporating oils in my routine, but now I don’t know what I would do without it. It gives my skin that extra boost that it needs night and day. I also use it on my lips at night for deep conditioning and I wake up every morning with plump and moisturized lips. YTTP is an awesome brand as well. I love what they stand for and it makes me feel better giving money to a company that cares about their impact.

After a week of using this consistently day and night,  I noticed the differences. This oil gives my face a beautiful glow and has my skin looking so soft. The oil absorbs quickly into your skin and is not thick. Also the bottle size is much bigger than most other face oils that are the same prize! I have very dry skin so I like to use a generous amount and I feel better doing so since the bottle is bigger!
fine enough oil that is light on the skin, but the smell is weird to me.

I have dry skin for the first time in my life and this oil is perfect for it! I have been double-masking and sanitizing and sweating, so my skin is not having a good time. Used this twice and my skin is happy again! I am glowing, I am hydrated, I am living my BEST life with this!
It is ok I guess. Didn’t do much to my skin. I would choose their Dream Mask over This product.

I love face oils. This one absorbed very quickly but is still very moisturizing. I only use it at night as my last step in my routine. I do think it helped my skin regain its glow. It also smells so good!

I discovered this brand via their kit that included smaller sizes of this, the overnight mask, the day cream and night cream.  Truthfully I have not had much luck with natural brands; oddly some natural ingredients are not appreciated by my skin and create breakouts, or I see/feel no difference at all.  This was the the first natural product that caused no problems, and performed better than the more expense serums I’ve bought in the past.I used this serum and the night cream from the kit and the morning after the 2nd night my skin was noticeably softer - like - dramatically softer.  Now, at my age the only thing that is going to make a difference in lines and wrinkles is injectables, so I’m not looking for that level miracle.  But I do want something that makes my skin feel better and look better.  This did that and then some.

review_title: Okay for face but AMAZING as a cuticle oil!
review_text: Better on nails than face. This oil was okay as a facial oil, but realized it was amazing on hands/nails/cuticles. It is now my hands-down favorite cuticle oil!
Makes your skin plump and glowy. Doesn’t break out my sensitive skin

I’ve been using this product for about a month now and it’s been great but not life changing. When I apply the glow oil I immediately appear FLAWLESS. BUT, I’m disappointed that this effect only lasts for about an hour. It then fades and my skin looks dull again :( I really do enjoy it but I wish it did more

review_title: Good but not blown away like other reviews
review_text: Absorbs nicely although I prefer to mix it with my moisturizer since I have combination skin. Not as hydrating as other oils I’ve tried, but overall would recommend for anyone looking for an antioxidant boost!

LOVE this product !! I have oily skin and was looking to try an oil that would not break me out ... and this does not make me any oilier and it doesn’t break me out at all!! I was very skeptical but I love it . Soaks in very quickly and does not leave you feeling oily at all.. also helps calm any redness on my skin. Leaves me with a healthy glow !

I’ve been using the Cleanser, Power Toner, Superberry Oil, and the Moisturizer.... it’s my new favorite skincare routine! This product is perfection in a bottle! I love how it feels when I apply it, I love the glow I get after application, and I feel like it even provides a smooth base for when I apply my make up! Some people say it’s “sticky” but I follow it with the YTTP moisturizer and it hasn’t been an issue! Seriously, you have to try this!!

I got sent this by accident instead of a product I ordered and was told I could keep the product so I decided to try it out. I liked how it felt on the skin, but after about a week of using it, my T zone broke out like crazy. My forehead was terrible (full on breakout), nose and even a little on my chin. I know that this formula is not listed for oily skin, but it is for combination. I would venture to say that if you have a true combo skin type, this may not be for you. Sadly, it’s not going to work for me. I may try again in the winter when my skin is more dry or just use it on my dry sections.

review_title: Great formula, needs an adjustment on the dropper
review_text: Got this product because I really liked the herbivore hemp oil, which unfortunately made me break out, and to solve the dryness on my nose during allergy season. Is lighter than the herbivore, can use at night and in the morning, but would wait half an hour before applying makeup. Has solved the dryness around the nose, but doesn’t replace a moisturizer for my combination (closer to dry) skin. Only real gripe is the dropper! I always lose a drip or drop whenever I bring the dropper up to my hand or face, which is shame because you only need 1-3 drops each use!

I absolutely love this product. I’ve gone through 5-6 bottles and sad this is out of stock at the moment! I have combo / on the dryer side skin and this makes my face feel so supple and hydrated without looking greasy. I use it both morning and evening, and most nights when I am tired and can’t do a million steps, I just throw this on and go to bed. It’s amazing!

So many good reviews had me feeling so hopeful Maybe I’m just one of those cases of dry skin that can’t be tamed, but this oil does literally nothing for me. It doesn’t leave me any more moisturized than Trader Joe’s jojoba oil at 1/4 the price. Will be switching back to herbivore. You get what you pay for there. Stars for clean beauty and nice packaging and the thought that counts.

I love love love this product! I received the mini Youth To The People set for Christmas and this serum was the first I finished of the 5!! It smells amazing and hydrates my face ! A little goes a long wayy ! I recommend this to everyone ! A must try

I love this serum! The smell is fantastic and it gives the dewy look I love in the morning. My only con was that I felt my skin soaked it up so quickly that I couldn’t distribute it without using more than the recommended drops so to fix that I started added 3 drops to their superfood HA serum and can distribute it all evenly and combine my serums.
I am trying various oils and am impressed with this one. Easy to apply and immediately after absorption,  my skin glows.  Even after applying my moisturizer, the glow shows through.

review_title: Wake up to super soft skin!
review_text: I’ve been using this facial oil for about 1.5 months and I LOVE it. I have dry skin and use 5 drops per night after cleaning, applying serum, and moisturizer. It smells amazing and doesn’t leave my skin oily. I wake up with really soft skin that is extremely hydrated. I definitely recommend this product!

This stuff not only smells amazing and fruity, it also makes your skin glow without feeling greasy. One issue for me is that if I put any on my neck, I break out. I’m not sure why, but it works great for my face!

if you are scrolling through reviews trying to figure out if you should buy this.... the answer is yes!!! this oil is amazing, it makes your skin so soft and I love adding a drop or two with my other moisturizers or even in my foundation for a dewy look. I have very acne prone skin and I use this every morning and night and Its never clogged my pores.

I got this in the Sephora 12 days of Skincare set, and it’s going to be the only one out of the whole set that I buy the full size of. This oil is so nice! It gives my skin the prettiest glow without clogging my pores or making me feel greasy. It smells faintly of fruit, but not strong at all, and it layers GORGEOUSLY under makeup; although I find myself foregoing foundation altogether when I use this oil as my skin looks good without it! 10/10 recommend!

I live in a cold climate and have a dry, peeling, and irritated nose from the weather. I use this oil on my nose and it does an amazing job moisturizing it as I can see the skin around my nose improving the next day. I do avoid using it on my face in general as it does break me out. I would recommend this oil if you have extremely dry skin.

Honestly, I’ve tried almost everything. This has seriously changed my skin. It’s been so dry for the past couple of years...age or hormonal change after IVF. Don’t know. I’ve taken all the stuff my derm recommends. This has produced the biggest change. It feels oily for a few minutes but I put it on with my morning routine and then do other things for a few minutes and then I’m ready to do my makeup. At night I just apply and go to bed.  Bought my second bottle before I was done with the first. Great stuff!

I love this oil and I’ve tried many. it’s light enough I can use in the morning under makeup. I love the feel of it and it really hydrates with out feeling heavy. great for the winter when my skin gets super dry. definitely recommend. I’ve also tried the toner and really liked it as well. I’m so impressed with this brand I will be trying more in this line.

I like this oil - the way it feels and smells. Great for a gua sha.  I’m only knocking one star because I’m not sure it’s worth the pricetag; gua sha glides just fine with an argan oil from the local supermarket!
Wanted to love this oil because I love YTTP but it broke me out within a few weeks both of the times that I tried it.

I have only recently become a fan of facial oils and this is one of the best I’ve tried. It hydrates the skin, but doesn’t make your skin too oily because its so lightweight. The smell is sweet, fresh, and not overbearing. This layers really well under makeup. My skin feels so much healthier since I started using this.

This oil is amazing. I have a combination skin that dries out for the most part during winter and this helps me keep that glow from within look! Its not extra oily and my skin absorbs it very well, I love it!!
It’s really helped my dry skin. I noticed results almost immediately. It’s truly perfect for people sensitive to scents like myself because its scent free.
I use it after I shower at night, and I wake up to glowing skin!  No harsh smell either which is nice

I’ve been using this oil as the start of my daily morning makeup routine and it’s great! It absorbs quickly and adds just enough moisture without leaving skin oily in appearance. It hasn’t caused me to break out, and just a few drops is sufficient. No strong scent. No tingling or irritation.

review_title: A wonderful experience in a bottle
review_text: This is an excellent oil-lightweight, moisturizing. Can be mixed into foundations for that thought-after glass skin effect. It has the faintest, pleasant, perhaps fruity smell that vanishes seconds after application, leaving behind supple, gentle skin.

I don’t usually write review for products, but this oil is that good. I have super sensitive skin and most products make me break out in a rash. Not this one! It adds the hydration that I wasn’t getting from my regular skin routine. It has a very light, but pleasant scent. Will be purchasing again.

This product didn’t seem to do anything. I don’t understand the hype. It’s not super moisturizing (I have super dry skin) and didn’t make me glow like other facial oils I’ve used. It doesn’t have much of a sent and doesn’t break me out. I’ve been using it for about 4 months and will finish using the bottle, but won’t re-buy.
When you apply this oil, you see the glow right away! This oil feels so luxurious on my skin, and it soaks in super-fast! This is a new must-have.

I received a sample of this product from Sephora and once it runs out I’m going to purchase it. I noticed a difference immediately after using this product. It makes my skin bright and leaves it hydrated. I have extremely difficult skin to work with (some days dry, some oily, breakouts, cystic acne, redness, dry spots next to oily spots), so the fact that I can use this and not worry about breaking out into one of my MANY skincare issues is amazing! I put it on top of my moisturizer either before bed or before I leave the house for the day...whenever I notice my skin needs a little something extra.
Great smell. It does not leave your skin oily.

I have combination skin and I only use this with my Fenty foundation. I let it sit for 15 seconds (I need some of the oil to be on my skin because it is dry) and put on my foundation (I need a matte foundation for my oily skin). I guess you can say I use this product as a primer, which is perfect because a little goes a long way and no dry patches appear on my skin when I apply the foundation. I only use 1-2 drops per cheek.

Has helped clear my skin up and looks beautiful on the skin! Since using it my skin has also become less textured. I have oily skin so I was afraid to use it but is fast absorbing and great for looking glowy but not oily.

review_title: Love Ingredients but not for my sensitive skin
review_text: I believe that the ingredient statement is wonderful, very natural and good quality but i used it for a week and my skin started to breakout and sting. The more natural it is the more oils needed, yet I have sensitive skin so not the best product for me.
It took a while for me to see the results (about a week), but I can’t deny the fact that my skin is transformed. It’s become a holy grail in my skin care routine.

this is my favorite oil! i’ve tried many from high end to drugstore & nothing beats this one, by far. i dot my moisture on my cheeks, forehead and chin then take two drops in my palm and warm it up a little then work my moisture in. it leaves my skin so soft and glowy without the oily feeling.

LOVE this product, I first received this product in the Play Smarts box and literally the next day purchased the full size. No oil has ever left my skin feeling so soft, moisturized and luxurious. Highly recommend.
Just didn’t absorb into my skin as needed. Stayed kind of greasy and I saw no effect

Love the smell and consistency and was excited to try an oil, but after I put this on my face got red and blotchy and my eyes red and watery. I don’t have reactions to products so you may want to do a patch test first.

My holy grail skincare product. I saw results within a week: evened skin tone, brighter, glass-like skin. I’ve used oils such as Noni in the past but this product is a winner in my book. My only wish is that it came in a bigger bottle since I go through this very fast.

review_title: Love it!  Great balance and glow.

Just what my dry skin needed this summer!  Highly recommend.

I love this product. It has a dry oil feel so it soaks in quickly and leaves no oil on top of the skin which leaves a lovely lit from within glow.
I LOVE THIS SO MUCH. The smell is amazing and it works wonders for my skin.
you will be glowing after using this product!!!

Absolute must have in my skincare regime! Hydrated and gives a glow, without making my face feel greasy or oily. Love love love this, there’s a reason it’s rated so high!

Smells amazing, moisturizes, leaves a wonderful glow, and doesn’t break me out. Love this facial oil!

Because my skin was always very dry before, and now gets a little oilier, I have developed pimples. I was lucky and all through my teenage years I never had more than one or two pimples a month. It’s not oily, absorbs into the skin almost immediately, and the change was instantaneous (for me). If you’re on the fence, I would pick this up!
Recommended by a beauty advisor and I love it! Hydrated my skin so well. It felt like the oil is soaked into my skin. Will repurchase.

I love this oil!!! It smells amazing and feels even better. So lightweight yet hydrating and it feels excellent under makeup. I feel like my skin looks glowy and dewy all day under makeup and fresh and hydrated without.

I honestly love this stuff! It’s so liquidity yet hydrating  :) I am acne prone and I had this dang stubborn dry patch on my chin I couldn’t get rid of, but after using this in combination with my Clinique moisture surge it’s finally going away!! I get a nice glow and I only use 4 drops nothing more! Highly recommend for good hydration :)
normally my skin does not like oil because I’ll get acne or tiny bumps all over my face. This oil hydrated my skin and CLEARED my acne! GET YOU SOME
I love this oil. It gives you a nice glow and melts well into the skin. Can’t be without it

I’m OBSESSED with this oil! I put it on before my makeup and mix it with my moisturizer. My skin is addicted and I haven’t have as many breakouts, especially near my jawline/hormonal band. My skin is HAPPY.
My skin is so dry and this oil saves me! Light weight,hydrating and a little goes a long way!!

This oil is lovely. It smells absolutely DELICIOUS and it is incredibly moisturizing. To be honest, for my oily skin, it’s a tiny bit too heavy for every day use. But I use it a few times per week at night and it gives my skin a lovely glow and moisturizes really nice.

I really like this product. I’ve been getting over a cold, and it’s helped boost my complexion through that. It’s super light and moisturizing and has a nice fruity scent. I’d definitely recommend it!
Love this oil! It smells so good and makes your skin so glowy. I use it at night only since I have combination skin and I wake up to baby soft skin in the morning!

This product has easily become my favorite thing in my skincare routine. It makes my skin look glowy and yet not oily. It looks amazing when I’m not wearing any makeup but also is great under foundation. This product is a must-have for glowy and fresh feeling skin!

I haven’t had luck with oils in the past, cleansing or hydrating, but so far my skin has reacted well to this. I patch tested for a few days and haven’t gotten any clogged pores like I have with other oils. My skin feels super moisturized after using it!

This product is AMAZING!!  I love every YTTP product, but this one might be my new favorite! I have been skeptical about oils in the past because I have combo skin that can sometimes lean toward oily, but this product was still great!! Its light, goes on smooth, absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave an oily residue. My skin feels so hydrated!  The smell is super great and mild, so it’s not too overwhelming. My skin has honestly never felt or looked better since I started using YTTP products.  I love that the ingredients are natural and I feel like all of the products are really trustworthy.  I cannot wait to see what they come out with next! Go get this oil now!

review_title: Where has this been all my life?
review_text: I’m not usually a fan of oil based products, but I love this. As soon as you put it on, it floats effortlessly into your skin and leaves a delicate scent behind. My skin glows and doesn’t feel too heavy. It doesn’t clog my poors like other oil based products. My skin feels refreshed!
My skin is super sensistive to breakouts AND dryness and this oil is the perfect moisturizer for my specific combination skin!!
This product is AMAZING.  It makes my skin feel hydrated without feeling greasy, unlike other oils I have tried.  10/10 would recommend.

What an amazing product line! I’ve been using YTTP for 2 weeks now and my skin has been completely transformed. It’s a simple, straightforward regimen. This oil is a must have! Beautiful texture and is perfect under make up. It gives me intense hydration and a fabulous glow. Do yourself a favor and try this!

This oil is AMAZING! I recently got these two red/dark dry spots on my chin, which I have never had before. Just no…the warmth is weird and does nothing for my eyes
The worst eye cream I’ve ever had, too heavy for eye area, dries out skin

One of the most effective eye serums I have ever tried, period. Yes it does have dimethicone in it, but it didn’t give me any problems. This is a keeper and I will be buying this eye serum as long as they don’t discontinue it.

Only gave 4 stars because of the price, $50 feels so expensive for an eye cream! Though it is a pro and con because I do see a difference so it’s a personal choice to buy! Overall still I would say this is a decent product and I do recommend.

I really liked the Keihl’s Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum. It’s super hydrating. I’ve noticed reduced fine lines and slightly reduced dark circles. I’m hopeful that with continued use I will see the results I’m looking for.

I’m a mom of 4. To say I have dark circles is an understatement. This serum has helped improve them and any lines I have. I’ve tried others but none compared to this one. It’s so smooth now and my makeup looks so much better. Love it! Will definitely keep purchasing it and recommending it to everyone!

I received the Kiehl’s Powerful-Strenght Line-Reducing eye cream. As its name states, it reduces fine lines and dark circles. I habe been using this vitamin C eye cream for two months and I definitely seeing positive chances. I am loving it so far and I recommend it!

I found that the formula is fairly tacky, which isn’t great for me when applying concealer atop it during the day,  But it is long lasting at night as I can still feel it on my skin when I wash my face in the morning.  unlike most serums I have used in the past, this has a cream base, most I’ve used in comparison are more watery, which provided a lot of hydration.  I don’t necessarily think that this drastically improved my fine lines or dark circles, but I do think that it does well as an under eye moisturizer.

Ok so I’ve always been the type to use whatever eye serum I have on hand or just buy at random…because I was always in the “they’re all the same” mentality. This one…oh my gahh! I stopped using concealer under my eyes after a week of using it, and honestly even going without makeup I don’t feel self conscious about my under eyes. It’s on my must-haves for skin care list now.

Honestly I’m terrible about using eye cream twice a day but I have used this at least once a day and definitely see reduced puffiness and darkness and the fine lines under my eyes are gone!
