I’ve tried other vitamin c eye creams that felt sticky after they dried but this just left soft skin and is my favorite I have tried in a long time. Definitely keeping in my routine and planning on buying more when this runs out.

With a 2 month old, sleep is almost a luxury, but with this eye serum, you can’t even tell I’m super sleep deprived! It’s really helped with the dark circles and bags and I almost look human again! I’m really happy to have been able to try this out and I’ll definitely repurchase whenever I run out!

This product is amazing, i have been using it now for about 2 months and i can significantly see the difference in the dark circles around my eyes. I am very satisfied with this product and will definitely keep this as part of my regular routine from now on.

I am a licensed Beauty professional and product junkie for 15+ years. This eye cream has completely blown me away with my expectations for what it could do. This is amazing for all skin types and a great makeup eye primer! Skin around my eye is visibly smoother, plump, and more bright.  The thing I’m most impressed about is how it’s smoothed my fine line crows feet!

I have been using this eye serum for about a month and I love it! It’s super lightweight and I do notice a difference in my dark circles. Having children has made my dark circles more prominent and this serum helps to brighten them. I haven’t noticed any difference in lines though. Hoping I will see a difference the longer I use it

I been using it over a Month,I apply as directed, I use it at night and Day. You only need to use a little bit. My under eye area has very deep bags, and puffiness. What the serum has really done for me is decreased puffiness. My eyes would look so tired throughout the day, and since v I’ve been using this night and day for about over a month. there is almost no puffiness, even first thing in the morning. And has reduced the appearance of My deep bags. The only down side it dries out my under eyes and they start itching but otherwise it works.

I recieved Kiehls powerful strength dark circle reducing vitamin c eye serum free in exchange for my review trial and honest opinion. After using for weeks i absolutely recommend this product. Leaves my face smooth and hydrated while my dark circles have faded .
I have been using the serum for some weeks now and noticed some improvement in my dark circles. The area under my eye feels smooth and moisturised.

Kiehl’s Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum is lightweight feeling, non sticky and easily absorbed. When using this serum, I felt that it was easier on my skin than other vitamin C products. In the past, I’ve broken out in a rash with other week known products. I was very happy that my skin tolerated and enjoyed this one. I am 37 with very minimal fine lines and occasional dark, puffy under eyes. I did notice a difference that my under eye area looked more refreshed and awake within minutes of application.

I have dark eye circles, always have and haven’t found much but kiehls eye serum has made a visible difference in my dark circles. My circles aren’t completely gone but they are quite a bit lighter, so much so I dont have to use concealer under my eyes anymore.

review_title: Super hydrating, but I'm still dark
review_text: I received a free sample for this product in exchange for my honest review. I have the worst dark circles so I didn’t really expect this to help, however, being in the over-30 club, I did notice a reduction in my fine lines. My concealer seemed to go on much smoother and not crease as much with the hydrating power of this serum.

No I didn’t see a difference in my dark circle reduction, mainly because I don’t have bad dark circles, I did see a reduction in the fine lines around my eyes. I really enjoyed using this product and still have some left so I’ll finish it up before I purchase it. And has a small scent but nothing that’s recognizable when you put it on or noticeable. It doesn’t sting my eyes nor does it feel too heavy for the area. I like that it’s gentle but seems to be effective.
I love the consistency and it doesn’t have a bad smell, but it doesn’t work. I don’t really see a difference. If anything, my dark circles have gotten worse.

I love a lot of things about this product: packaging - great, easy to use pump! Consistency - fantastic, nice and creamy without being too thick or to thin. And after about 2 months of using this, I am noticing brighter under-eyes and fewer fine lines. I even used some on the back of my hands and felt like it brightened them up a bit! The only reason I don’t give this 5 stars is because it’s costly and I wonder if another product will be able to give you similar results for less.
Very powerful and I will definitely recommend this for dark circles
This serum is great. Its easy to apply on and no medication smell to it. Definitely have to be consistent for it to work.

Received a sample of this product. Noticed diminished crow’s feet within 2 weeks dark circles slightly better. But I’m a single mom and I don’t sleep a lot, so lol. Nice creamy formula didn’t bother my sensitive eyes at all. Definitely worth a try..

I like the packaging because love a good pump. Compared to other eye serums I really enjoyed the texture and ease of this; the product isn’t watery which of a lot of the ones I’ve used are but instead it’s more like a lightweight mousse texture. I used it twice a day morning/evening for 8 weeks it did help with my puffy eyes when I didn’t get enough sleep and left it hydrated the next day. The color of the product is a light orange due to the vitamin c, it doesn’t have any strong scent, and it didn’t irritate my skin; I would buy this again. I would also gift & recommend it to friends & family.
Kiehl’s Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum leaves eyes brighter and brighter. My dark circles ar noticeable gone. My skin looks younger and brighter.

I love Kiehl’s and was excited to try this generously size eye serum. There is no smell and no irritation after using for eight weeks. I like that. The texture is medium weight and didn’t feel greasy or too thin. I had hoped for more results in dark circle reduction and line diminishing. I really didn’t see any miracles there (nor did I expect them). Regarding packaging, the clear plastic top doesn’t stay seated at all. Not helpful when traveling with this product. Perhaps others will see better results, but I just found it a hydrating eye cream.

I have sensitive skin, especially near the eyes and this product is not only gentle but effective! I can visibly notice a difference in my fine lines since using the serum. I especially love that it uses known products to help with aging and fine lines. Other serums I have used have alcohol which cause irritation and drying of the skin. I would highly recommend this product.

While I didn’t notice a big difference in my dark circles, I did love how moisturizing this product was. I noticed my concealer did not cake into my fine wrinkles and it helped with “crepe“ look around my eyes. I wear fake lashes and didn’t have to worry getting this product close to my lash line and causing the glue to break down. I have very sensitive eyes and this product did not cause my eyes to water or become irritated.

Having tried Kiehl’s Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum for 8 weeks, I was disappointed with the results. I can’t really tell a difference, if at all, in my before and after pictures. I had really high hopes for it. I used it twice a day, morning and evening, so to not see noticeable results was a huge letdown for me. The serum itself had a nice consistency and didn’t really have a scent to it. Overall, I wouldn’t buy this since it didn’t seem to work for me.

Love this smooth and lightweight texture of the serum. It has a nice consistency and easy to dab evenly on the skin with the pinky finger. The serum is very gentle and I can feel the immediate effect on the under eye areas. After an intensive two months trial period of using this eye serum twice daily, I have to say that this cream is working quite efficiently and effectively in improving skin tone and texture. It’s also visibly minimizing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, especially those under eye puffiness and sagging skin. This serum is not just providing moisture for the skin but it’s enriched with vitamin C, Tri-peptides which helps reducing under eye dark circles as well as lifting, firming the skin for a more softer and smoother overall skin complexion.
I wanted to love this product. I did notice slight brightness to my dark circles, however, my skin became very tender. I experienced slight burning after each application!

Best eye cream I have ever used. It really does lighten my under eye area & I haven’t experienced any irritation. I’ve been using this product for a week & I noticed a difference within the first day.

I have circles and puffiness in the mornings, but using this makes them disappear. As another reviewer wrote, you only need to use a tiny bit. The sample packets lasted for 4-5 uses for me too. I have sensitive skin and had no problem with this. Super surprised by other people’s experiences with dryness and lack of benefit. I actually threw out a couple of eye creams I have after getting this because I figured I would never use them again, that I had finally found what worked.

how can you say this is a clean product when propylene glycol is the first ingredient? water or aloe vera should always be the first ingredient for moisture.  I am disappointed.

Disclaimer: I received this from Influenster to try. As a general rule, I love Kiehl’s products. However, this eye serum was only so-so for me. The product claims you will see results after 7 days of use, so I used it faithfully morning and night for two weeks. There is an immediate blurring/smoothing effect, as well as a slight warming sensation. However, there was no discernible difference in my dark circles (I took before/after pictures to verify!) This is a VERY silicone-heavy product. Dimethicone is the second ingredient, and there are three other silicones packed into it as well —-and that’s just the silicones I could identify. Fortunately my skin plays well with silicones, and my concealer layered smoothly over it. I will continue using this, but only in the morning under makeup for the smoothing effect.

I really enjoyed how this product just glided right into my skin and melted right into it. Made under my eyes very smooth and soft , there was a very slight change in the dark circles but nothing drastic.

review_title: A little hesitant at first BUT...
review_text: After reading a lot of mixed reviews regarding this product, I decided to give the product a chance and gave it a week before putting in my final thoughts. When I tested the product at home on my hand to understand the after feeling as there were a lot of reviews discussing this, yes there was that weird “sticky, dry” feeling to it. However, I noticed that the product does contain hyaluronic acid and hyaluronic acid does have that weird sticky feeling to it, similar to The Ordinary’s hyaluronic acid product and hyaluronic acid does tend to leave that type of weird feeling on your skin if it’s not being used properly. Hyaluronic acid and most serums in general, work best when applied to damp skin. So after going in with a toner, I apply serums right away to help with the moisture and the application process as it does apply better and more smoothly. That’s exactly what I did with this serum and it hasn’t been a problem for me since. There is no sticky residue for me when doing this. There is a strong scent of citrus to this although having sensitive skin, the scent did not break me out. Overall, I have found some improvements with my skin and it does feel a lot firmer and looks rejuvenated.

This product was really irritating to my skin! My skin puffed up and became red, itchy, dry and flaky after using this. I actually stopped using this u til my skin healed and did a pitch test with it again to confirm that this was the product that irritated my skin and to no surprise my skin reacted again in the patch test! I hope this doesn’t scar my face. Sephora won’t refund for this expensive item either. >:(

I would recommend for sure and will be using every night now to make sure my face is completely clean.

I love Drunk Elephant, so I was super excited to try a new product from their line and see how it worked for me. Not all of their products have been winners for me, but this is one I will actually probably purchase once mine runs out.The positives:- Gentle- Effective at removing makeup- Doesn’t leave any residue or tacky feeling on my skin, unlike some other “no rinse“ micellar waters- A little goes a long way- I waited a few weeks after receiving the product to see if it caused any negative interactions on my skin/between my active ingredients, and it did not. - It’s not drying at allThe negatives:- I don’t know if my other micellar waters have been too harsh, but usually, when I use them after working out, the cotton pad has a colored residue on it from removing oil and dead skin cells. There is no residue on the cotton pad unless it’s being used to remove makeup. That makes me wonder if it’s not cleansing enough to be used on its own?- Piggybacking off of that, sometimes I feel like it doesn’t do enough to dissolve oil. I have combo skin, and it works well enough overall. I think this would be best for dry to combo skin, but I’m not sure how it would fare on oily skin.

review_title: Does Nor Work for Me...Maybe I am Too Old?
review_text: I could not see much difference other than minimal sheen immediately after I put it on.  That slight sheen does not last long. It is also very light in terms of moisturizing level. I think this item may work better on people who are much younger than me (20s and 30s).
Didn’t do much for me. Went on smooth and no strong smells. Was easy to apply.

Personally I didn’t notice a huge difference when using this product. The only thing I noticed is that it gave my under eyes a slight shimmer look making them “ look” slightly brighter. I don’t feel like this did anything to actual help or correct the dark circles under my eyes. I did like that it was light weight and wasn’t sticky. I also have used other Origins product and really liked them. This one just missed the mark slightly for me. Overall I enjoy many of these product from Origins and will keep using other product from them.

Eye cream has become a step in my skincare routine, but I still feel like I haven’t hand the *one*. This one is definitely up there for me. I has a nice consistency, absorbs nicely into the skin, and it is helping with my dark circles. It’s not a drastic change, but that’s ok. I love that this contains niacinamide as it is quickly becoming a favorite ingredient of mine. I think this is definitely worth a try!

review_title: Great for a new mom with lack of sleep
review_text: Wow! What a great way to refresh your eyes. I am a new mom and I’m really on the struggle bus with sleep. I am battling with the dark circles and this stuff has helped tremendously!
I loved it, I am a person with dark circles and since I started using it I feel that it has decreased a bit, it looks better and the skin feels hydrated and fresh when I put it on

I have been enjoying this cream for approximately two weeks. The illuminating pigment helps to immediately soften my tired mom eyes while brightening them ever so slightly. I have found that the sheer cream works best if you dab a few small dots under your eye and let sit for about a minute before rubbing it in. I’m a huge fan of the subtle brightening effects because I do not wear makeup on a daily basis but want to look presentable. After applying this cream, I feel like I appear more awake and alert. I definitely recommend this product if you are looking for a light under eye cream for daytime use.

I didn’t think there was anything special about this eye cream. Nothing about my eye area looks different and I’ve used it for about two weeks. I do like that it’s not super thick, so I don’t have a hard time putting my contacts in after applying it.

So Iv been using this product for a couple weeks now and Iv noticed it does my under eyes look brighter. Normal under eye creams make my eyes water and burn but not this one. Blends in great and smells amazing. I would highly recommend if you don’t have super dark under eyes circles.

I received Ginzing eye cream as part of BzzAgent for my honest review. This eye cream is refreshing and absorbs great to be paired with makeup. And works great at night after my skincare. I woke up with no issues. This eye cream Does not burn or affect my contacts in anyway. I haven’t had any increased creasing or dryness. In fact my under eye seems smoother and more hydrated. I haven’t noticed any changes in my under eye circles yet but I will update if changes happen.

I like it...it does give a little tingly feeling when you initially apply but that means it’s working right!? It absorbs into the skin easily and a little definitely goes a long way. It did not seem to cause any extreme oiliness which is a plus. I am curious to see if this will help to brighten and depuff over time or if only when used.
great eye cream. I have darker skin and do get dark under eyes if I do t get enough sleep. this eye cream hydrates and keeps me looking refreshed.
This product is fantastic! The scent is delicate. The creamy product glides over my skin and really absorbs. I can definitely tell a difference in my under eyes!
This cream is nice and light. I hate when I can feel an eye cream after a minute or so and this absorbed nice and quick and helped to depuff my allergy eyes.

I am in love with this eye cream, it maked my under eye look hydrated and glowing. It camouflages my fine lines with the brightness and my dark circles look a litte less dark. I think this is perfect for fall and winter weather.
It works wonders on my puffy eyes and dark circles. It has a very sheer tint that would be safe to use at night if you’re worried about staining.

The tint of this matches my skin tone well, I’m African American and I have yellow undertones. The cream consistency is smooth and dense. You can see right away the formula has some shimmery, glowy elements to it. It goes on smooth, it’s not sticky or heavy and doesn’t leave any flaky residue. It’s goes on a little heavy at first but it smoothes out pretty quickly and absorbs completely. It blends into the skin to look totally natural. The subtle reflective effects of the formula give a natural, soft glowy finish. My eyes look more awake and less tired and puffy. Easy to use daily and works right away. More of quick fix than a treatment obviously but works very well for what it is.
This product works well I received this for my honest opinion

The texture on the cream is thick. I use the eye cream every night and morning around my eyes and it’s been around 2 weeks and I notice my eye puffs are still the same. It has good moisture and wrinkle prevention though. It is fragrance free which is on the positive side for me. It is also light weight. I would say for this eye cream it’s more expensive than the one I currently own. I would say to avoid this product if you have sensitive skin because it might sting your eyes.

This cream has awakened my eyes! Ginzing vitamin C eye cream by Origins is by far my favorite eye cream for the day. I only use it in the morning after a shower and waking up never felt so good! I can tell a huge difference in the mornings when I apply this to my under eyes. It’s like waking up the sun! The cream leaves my eyes looking and feeling fresh.
The GINZING™ VITAMIN C EYE CREAM TO BRIGHTEN AND DEPUFF by Origins is seriously a game-changer for my eyes, especially after nights of limited sleep! 10/10

This product was okay. It felt like it was very moisturizing but, as far as tint goes, I don’t see where it did much for my dark circles. For reference I’m usually fenty 310. My dark circles are kind of dark. I’ll probably keep using it for its moisturizing properties, though.
I received this to try, I do not have dark circles so I can not say that it helped with those. Puffiness, yes it most definitely helped with that!
This is a great product! I use is in the morning. I feel like it does a nice job moisturizing and the warm color helps to correct my dark circles.
This is so great! My eyes are less puffy and look so refreshed! Definitely recommend this product!

This is one of my favorite eye creams. I’ve had this for a little while, and I’ve felt a difference. When applying this, do not use a lot. I lightly dip my pinky finger in the container and dab under both of my eyes. The consistency is like a cream, but once it’s rubbed in, it’s like a serum because it’s so light. You’re skin feels very soft all day after using this too.
I tried this out after a night of staying up studying and it didn’t disappoint. I saw a noticeable difference where my dark circles usually are and looked much more awake.
Love this eye cream! I like to put this on when I wake up, and it helps to depuff and reduce dark eye circles. If your someone who tends to look super tired in the morning this is perfect for you!
The eye cream feels very lightweight and glides on smoothly. It feels cooling and I see some depuffing too. The vitamin c helps brighten it as well.

I am very happy with this Origins Ginzing Eye Cream, I used this for one week and I see a noticeable difference around my eyes, looks more hydrating, brights and little less puffy, It helped lighten the look of my dark circles and feels refreshing. definitely this eye cream works really well. I like  that has a lot of good ingredients ranging from Vitamin C, Niacinamide, Ginseng & Caffeine that boosts natural skin cell energy to help revive radiance. it absorbs quickly, goes on smooth and has not irritated my eyes or skin. Love it...  I highly recommend this product.

I tried this after working very long hours at a festival for a weekend, and I had really dark circles under my eyes. I used the cream under one eye and not the other so I could see how it worked. I noticed the darkness got much better, and the circle got a bit less sunken in.
Love this product! The warm tone gives a nice glow and really wakes my eyes up. It’s really smooth and leaves my underyes plumped and reduces bags

This is such a nice, lightweight and lightly tinted eye cream! I’ve been using it for a couple weeks now and I am really enjoying it. I use it in the morning and I enjoy how it hides how tired I am. I had had my eye on this eye cream for a little bit now, and when I was offered the chance to review it, I jumped on it. I plan on buying another once I’m out.

This is one of my Favorite eye creams. It has a light glimmer tint to it and has Amazing ingredients like caffeine, Panax Ginzing, and Brighting boosting Orange peel, along with illuminating minerals. This  works really well at making my tired eyes look refreshed and awake. It blends well and leaves a gorgeous slight sheen while tackling my eye puffiness.

I would say this product definitely instantly illuminates your under-eye area as soon as you put it on. It might not be the best for darker skin tone colors as it has a white-ish base to it . A little goes a long way! Will have to see about overall brightening to the under eye complexion

The cream has a light pink color, absolutely transparent when applied, odorless, easy to apply, moisturizes well, the skin really looks lighter and healthier. This cream meets all my requirements. I have no puffiness under my eyes, but I have dark circles and the skin around my eyes needs to be hydrated.Pay attention to the volume of the product. This is a very small jar. But I love just such jars, the product does not have time to deteriorate before you use it.Yes, this is a really good eye cream for me in all respects.

I liked that it brightens my eye area, but I haven’t notice it depuffing it, so that’s why I gave 3 stars. I like that it has Vitamin C and how it brightens the area, so that’s cool. I’d recommend it, maybe other people would notice the depuffing benefit, I haven’t,  but maybe others could.
My eyes looked brighter and less puffy after using!

review_title: Not seeing much difference right now.
review_text: I like the texture of the product. I can definitely see the brightening effect in the cream and I like the color as well and feel it does well blending in with my skin. I’ve been using it for a couple weeks now but honestly I don’t really see much of an effect in my skin personally. It looks pretty much the same. I’m still going to keep using it and see if that changes but at the moment I wouldn’t pay the money to get this.

I’m a little disappointed.  Not sure what this is supposed to do but it didn’t work for me.  There was no visible difference and I’ve been using the product for a week. And I only used on my right eye to see if I could notice a change. I will keep using though, maybe I have super bags and need to build up.  I’ll see if anything changes after a month.  It does feel like it should be doing something.  It tingles a bit and makes my eye water after applying but that’s about it.  Pics attached are before first time using and then after a few uses
I love this product! Helps my dark circles and keeps my under eye moisturized. I apply to all around and on top of my eyelid and makeup sits beautifully on top. Highly recommend this product.
My eyes have never felt so healthy. I love this product.It keeps my eyes brighter and less swollen and moisturized!

This eye cream is excellent! It makes my under eyes look so much lighter and less baggy. I love that the product blends out and does not look cakey under my eyes or discolored. I really like this! Thanks, BzzAgent!
Nice light formula, not to heavy. Great results too. Under eyes look brighter and calms down a bit of the puffiness in the morning.

Pros: It’s nice orangish-peach color which matches my medium-dark tan skintone. It has a nice cooling effect, gives a nice semi gloss and dries to matte. It blends well once you wear your makeup or a moisturizer, otherwise you can easily notice glossy shade on the skin. I can’t say anything on the puffiness since I don’t have that issue as of now. This product goes a long way. Cons: as of nothing, will update if there is any

I really liked Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream! After a week of using it, I noticed my eyes looked brighter and my skin was really soft around my eyes. I like the texture of the cream, it feels light and refreshing on my skin. I definitely recommend this eye cream from Origins.

This new formulation of the Ginzing eye cream goes on more smoothly than the original, but the tint of color does not appear on my skin at all. It still does a good job keeping my eye skin smooth and soft! Not much in the way of brightening, but after trying the original Ginzing eye cream, that was to be expected. Still a nice eye cream, gets the job done!

This definitely came in handy recently. Lots of crying and not wanting to look super puffy the next day. This helped. Not sure how refreshing it helped me look, but it kept my circles from lack of sleep from getting darker.
Omg this is amazing. The shade matches perfectly to my skin and it calms my dark circles.

Very impressed with Origins; They never disappoint. I always feel like I look tired around my eyes and this has really helped make an improvement both on how I look and feel. I recommend this product.

This product is amazing! Amazing smell, thick but not heavy texture but still light enough to not make you feel weighed down. The week that I used the product was full of amazing results. I could actually see how much vibrancy my face was gaining and it honestly just made my skin feel amazing. I can’t wait to see what other products are in the line and to see the long term impact of this product. I am for sure adding it to my routine moving forward.

This Ginzeng refreshing eye cream is supposed to brighten and depuff the eye, but maybe my eye bags are just that prominent! It definitely brightens due to the tint and shimery effect and my eyes feel refreshed after use. However, my eye bag is still very prominent.  I’ve only used it for about a week now, so maybe I’ll see more of the effects soon!
Love the sparkly effect it gives off, it’s super fancyyy! It has a cooling effect that helps depuff my undereye! Lives up to its claims! Will definitely repurchase!
I love it I used for a week every morning and I see to much definitely I will recommend

This product is working good for me so far. I like the scent of it. It’s not really that thick so it absorbs into my under eyes so easily. Immediately after applying you can see how it brightens underneath mostly because against my dark skin it does leave a slight cast. Not too bad through because it works great underneath make up to help brighten the eye area. As for as reducing puffiness I can say I see a slight reduction but that might only be because mine puffiness is ever so slight to began with. The biggest test would be how well this works for dark circles. Unfortunately, at this moment it hasn’t done anything towards that, which is to be expected. I’m sure a continue used of this product may result in a reduction of my dark circles. I look forward to continuing using this product and will update after a month or two of usage.
Nice brightening eye cream. Let dry before applying concealer or use for concealer-free days!

I am a lover of the Origins brand - so was excited to try this brand new eye cream. It feels super smooth when going on and absorbs well. It isn’t too heavy nor is it too light. It also smells really good (I don’t like super heavy fragrance..just the perfect hint of scent.) Overall, I really like this new eye cream!!

There’s ice cream in the shade warm has been a life-changing cream for my under eyes as well as my eyelids it feels so soothing and so smooth I like the way it feels on my skin and I have seen a huge difference after using this for two weeks straight it feels really brightening and lightning as well as I can see less wrinkles on my skin and a lot more smoother
The Ginzing Vitamin C eye cream is amazing it helped brighten my under eye and the puffiness is almost gone. The cream is so light weight and its moisturizing.

I don’t think it leaves a long lasting effect but I do notice a bit more brightness after using. It’s got a bit of shimmer which I think helps my under eye look brighter. I would recommend it if you’re thinking of taking photos and need that area to look brighter in pictures.

My age is 30+, from the outward appearance it is noticeable that there is not enough moisture.  There are mimic wrinkles.  Prone to swelling due to lack of sleep and too dense cosmetic products.I apply the cream twice a day on clean skin .  It is more convenient for me to distribute with a finger than with a sponge.  When applied to the skin, the cream becomes more liquid, like an emulsion, so it spreads easily. It is absorbed by me in about a couple of minutes, but I think that the initial condition of the skin will also play a role here. After using the cream, you can see that the skin is well nourished and moisturized.  Thanks to high-quality hydration and reflective particles, wrinkles are less noticeable. The cream does not leave a film-like feeling. Doesn’t conflict with makeup. Really reduces swelling a little.  I can’t say how it will work with the long-term problem of puffiness, but my rare puffiness around the eyes from lack of sleep eliminates 20-30 minutes after application. Let me summarize. It would seem that choosing a cream is not a particular problem - take a moisturizer and you will not go wrong, but no.  For me personally, for aging skin, just a moisturizer is often weak.  I apply it to the skin, it is absorbed, and the impression that nothing happened.  I’ll take a dense nourishing cream - in the morning, swelling under the eyes, sometimes it rolls under the foundation. Origins Ginzing cream worked well for me: it nourishes, moisturizes, reduces swelling, does not conflict with makeup, and gives a visible result. The consumption is minimal, I believe that the jar will last at least 2 months of regular use.

It took about two weeks to see a difference but it definitely helped with instant depuffing and eventual lightening. The warm tone was a great built in color corrector too, definitely worth trying out! The cream was moisturizing and smelled good. The cream lived up to what they said it would do!

Got this product as a sample tester from Sephora and so far got two uses out of the sample and I think I can squeeze out two more. I don’t normally use eye creams (moisturizer is fine on its own) but this is REALLY GOOD. The shimmer in it gives me brightness under my eyes and it sits great under makeup (no pilling etc). Definitely want a mini or full size bottle!!

Perfect moisturizer for my skin. Combination with dry cheeks and t zone can get oily. Gives a lustrous glow to my 48 Yo skin. Tend to stick to water based moisturizers as they work best for me. This moisturizer is the perfect moisturizer for my skin, not too dry, not too oily. Juussstttt right.  Kate products in general are great fir my skin type.
Made my skin look oily. Fragrance is not the best and made my skin breakout.

I really love this. I love it so much that I legit cried when I fumbled it and dumped an entire new one all over my bathroom. all over my vanity my mirror, the floor, the bathroom door. Every where. Im so sad but I love it so much I’ll buy more. It’s the best for my combo skin. My skin feels hydrated and not oily. Cleaned up off of everything pretty well too. Oops!

I mean, it moisturizes. It has a drug store feeling, but at a much steeper price. It definitely can’t be the only moisturizer in a routine, and needs a more deeply moisturizing night mask or even moisturizing primer. I can’t decide if it smells more like fruit loops or fruity pebbles. So if you like to smell like breakfast cereal this is the perfect moisturizer for you.

I have never ever written a review but I HAVE to after trying this product. I had purchased a sample kit of the Kate Somerville Exfolikate line and after about a week or so of using this moisturizer it had increased the glowiness in my complexion as well as overall brightness. It has now been a few weeks and my hyperpigmentation from acne scars have reduced and my skin is SO soft!!! Not to mention it has the most divine smell, like fruit loops! My skin has gotten to the point where I don’t even feel the need to wear any face products. MUST BUY!!!!
Looked great at first. I have dry skin and it was not good for my skin overall and made me even dryer.
I’ve tried nearly every KS moisturizer and this is my favorite hands down. So nourishing!
This is the best moisturizer by far. I am so happy with it. It makes my skin super soft, hydrated and with a dab is more than enough to cover your whole face. Love it, love it!

One of my favorite moisturizers of all time! This stuff is amazing, I typically have pretty oily skin but I like my skin to feel extremely hydrated. My skin feels so soft and plump after using it and a little goes a long way. My only downside is that it does not work well before makeup. It causes all my primers and foundations to separate/roll, so from now on I only use it at night. Other than that, amazing! Would definitely buy again!
This glow moisturizer has made my face so soft and glowly! Amazing product!
It definitely gives you a glow! I’d recommend for dry or normal skin. Probably a little to thick for oily. It smells amazing too! I had someone ask me what perfume I was wearing after I put it on.

I have completely finished this before reviewing. This lasted a long time, made my skin feel nice and hydrated.  I don’t think I noticed any long term effects.  While it was a solid product I don’t think I would repurchase. I think the price per Oz is a little high.  I bought during the 20% sale so it wasn’t quite as bad.
I’m 22 at first my skin looked glowy and dewy now it is red and severely broken out I have pimples where I have never had them before refunding asap

This is the most amazing moisturizer I’ve ever used. I’d marry it if I could. I used up my sample and can’t bring myself to spend the full $65 for a jar of this, so I’ll have to say good bye to it. Sigh.
I love the GLOW IAM HOOKED

Sadly, this makes me breakout.  Also, if you’re already doing chemical exfoliation, I don’t think you’ll reap the benefits of this, making it simply an overpriced moisturizer.  I could see how some people would love it though, it’s very hydrating and smells like Froot Loops.  :)

I have used Kate Somerville’s line for 12  years.  I love her products.  The texture, smell and the way it makes my skin feel. However, in my opinion, I think this product is best suited for women between 18 and 34 years of age.  I love the new facial scrub, as well as ExfoliKate, but this moisturizer lacks for anti-aging benefits for women 40 and up. It would be a beautiful product for young women.  I also do not agree with a massive distribution of products being reviewed in exchange for free products.  I feel the reviews are skewed and lose credibility.  I rate this product two stars for women 40 .  I believe KS has better moisturizers for women in that age range than this product.
I really loved this one. I’ve been using it for a few weeks now along with the cleanser and 2-min facial, and the combo is working really well for me! It smells really nice,

I received samples, but I can’t tell if it works or not - I couldn’t stand it, had to wash off! 1. The smell is overwhelming. 2. It’s greasy - I can’t imagine to put it in the morning and be so greasy, neither in the night - it will end up on the pillow, not absorbing at all.

I really like this moisturizer! I only use it in the morning, only because I am really bad at remembering to use it at night. I am really impressed with my results. My skin glows and feels super smooth. It also smells really good.

I’m truly obsessed with exfoliating and I love that this product has pumpkin enzymes unit.  I’ve received so many compliments on my skin since using it. It’s smells great which is a bonus.  It gives such a radiant finish without making my face feel greasy. I do wish it was it a squeeze tube instead of jar packaging but that’s not a deal breaker. I will defiantly be repurchasing. I received this for free for sampling purposes.
I absolutely love this moisturizer!! I have acne prone skin, and it didn’t break my skin out.  It made my skin soft and glowy.  Also, I loved the scent!

Got this as a sample at Sephora. I’ve been using it for a whole week and loving the glow. It have a light fragrance and is very light on my oily skin. I’ve notice a huge difference in my skin. I can actually go out with out makeup and have a beautiful glow. Love it! Highly recommended.

I’ve been using the foam cleanser, the exfoliating mask and this moisturizer from this brand and I’ve noticed some changes. It’s true that my skin glows like never before and the tone has balanced, but I don’t feel like this product is good for my oily skin. This product can be used both: during the day and at night. I applied it on my skin after the cleanser and before my makeup at mornings (sometimes without applying any makeup) and even if it doesn’t feel heavy when you apply it and the smell is awesome, my skin starts to look oily (not glowy) like 4 hours after the morning application. During the night, however, it’s such a good moisturizer. I thinks this happened because of my skin type. I’d recommend it if you have a different type of skin, and for oily skin only at night.

I ran to Sephora the other day to grab a sample of this exfoliating moisturizer. I used it that night and had no bad reactions. I have sensitive skin and this didn’t cause damage like most other similar products do.

I have been using this moisturizer for about 1 month now as part of skincare routine after receiving it complementary for testing purposes. I use it in combination with the Kate Sommerville Exfolikate Daily Face Wash and some Drunk Elephant Skincare. I must say I like this moisturizer. I love the smell and I did notice it visibly plumping the skin. I do not like using it during the day as I think it’s a little to heavy under my makeup. Instead, I am enjoying putting it on right before bed. I would repurchase this product and recommend it to a friend, especially if they suffer from dry skin.

I love this moisturizer, it has a very nice texture, I have uneven and  combination skin, so I feel like this is going to be a must in my skin routine, the smell is great! I like how my skin get a healthy glow after the application!!! I’ll totally use this with a sunscreen during the day because since is and exfoliating as well, it might make my skin sensitive, so we’ll see I usually never have that issue before but I read it on the description. I asked for a sample to try at home at my nearest Sephora and I’m testing the ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer as a part of a contest
This moisturizer is so gooood for oily acne promise skin! it helped with my acne scars so much
I waiting to use this product to see if it’s good or not! Thanks influenster

Absolutely love the texture, smell, feel. doesn’t feel heavy at all. Made my face hydrated and glowy. I can’t wait to continue to see more results. I tested this moisturizer as part of a contest and have immediately fell in love. Hands down a great moisturizer. I highly recommend.
This product is perfect! Feels light on my skin, where most moisturizers make me feel like I have a thick layer of oil sitting on top of my skin! Definitely left a glow!

A really good product! Went on so smoothly and gave me so much hydration, I only tried a little sample since I’m testing it for a contest but that one use was amazing! I need to go buy the full size product ASAP

I recently picked up a sample of Kate Somerville ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer from Sephora and i think its the best decision I’ve made! I could tell a difference in my skin instantly and so could my family and friends! I love that its made for oily, dry,combo,and normal skin types. I can definitely tell the added AHAs glycolic and lactic acids are at work. It also has pineapple, pumpkin, and papaya enzymes for exfoliation and it smells AMAZING! Its also formulated without parabens, sulfates, and phthalates which is a huge plus. I’m definitely recommending this to everyone! I’m testing Kate Somerville ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer as part of a contest.

review_title: Your skin will love you for it!
review_text: The scent is absolutely heavenly! After several days of daily use, my face is left with a natural, makeup-free glow! No need for highlight here!

The glow moisturizer is AZAMZING. How we’ll does it work? Well, this week I literally had a coworker ask me if I was pregnant because my “skin is just glowing.“ Safe to say, this stuff works! It has done wonders to even out my skin tone and my face is so soft. Tip: A little goes a long way! I started out slathering this all over my face and ended up breaking out on my forehead. So, I cut back and now use only a couple pea size drops on my face and it is incredible.
This moisturizer is so bomb!!! I got it sent to me from Influenster for free, and I been so happy with it. It really does give you a glow and feels great on the skin.
Love the product. I am very picky and always switching to what new but don’t think I would switch from this product :)
This product is amazing. I got a sample from Sophora, and it gave me a natural glow, I am all about anti aging, and this stuff works!
Loved It! The texture is great, super soft and isn’t sticky at all. It smells delicious. I prefer to use it at night, after Kate cleanser. It leaves face perfectly smooth, soft.
Gave a very nice glow. I was very pleased with the consistency. Price was a little priceier then I would gave liked

I came into Sephora to try this product out and this moisturizer is the best out there. I have super dry skin especially around my T-zone and this stuff made my skin feel so supple and radiant. I wish I had the money to purchase this because it seems so great! I am testing this product as a part of a contest.

First let me start by saying I love this product so much I have used it for 2months bc a friend recommended it to me and it worked on my skin so well and also the texture it feels so good when applying it

ExfoliKate Glow Moisturizer is a fantastic product! The texture is light and my skin soaks it up. My face feels moisturized the entire day. It smells very refreshing which helps me start my day off on the right tone. After only a few days of use, I already see and feel a difference. My skin looks so healthy and supple ... simply radiant.

review_title: Great product overshadowed by poor service.
review_text: I have oily skin, so I use this at night and even before primer or as primer before my makeup. The moisturizer is very effective and you can see a difference in skin after a fews days use.  I went to sephora for a free sample for influenster.  The sales associate was lazy and not very helpful and just plain defeated that I was asking for a sample.  I do not understand why, should she have took the time to help me try it on I probably would have enjoyed the product more.  I am VIB Rouge so I do spend money here Sephora... The only psotive about the product is the smell. Pumpkin, papaya and pineapple are the three main ingredients and and it makes me happy along with the glow it delivers.  I am reviewing this for a contest but I will prob buy full size.

review_title: Soft, smooth and supple beautiful skin!!!!
review_text: I absolutely love this product! It truly gives my skin such a soft and supple texture and appearance. Anything from Kate somerville is worth the money but this product is by far worth it and so amazing. My skin has never felt so smooth and beautiful.

I’ve noticed an overall change in the texture of my skin (softer/smoother), brighter/glowing and reduction of fine lines in my forehead and neck area. Overall, I’m thrilled that I got to try this and will continue to have this as part of my nighttime skincare routine!

I received this product complimentary from Influenster and Shani Darden. As an avid skincare user this Retinol Reform Serum is extremely good. The ultimate multi-tasker tackling fine lines and wrinkles, uneven skin tone, loss of firmness and dark spots.  The Encapsulated Retinol allows for a slow release of the product throughout the night. It also has lactic acid great for gentle exfoliate, Niacinamide to help with skin discoloration and Aloe that helps calm and soothes skin irritation that could be caused by the retinol. I have only been using this product for about 3 weeks I can definitely see a different in my skins firmness and overall health of my skin. The only reason I gave this four stars instead of five was because my skin became very dry (which it does say can happen on the label - it tells you to use by using 1-2x per week and increase as your skin can handle). I used it 1x the first week and 2x the second week, but noticed this week that my skin really needed a lot of moisture on the days after I used it and does feel a bit tighter and drier than normal. The texture is light and is easy to spread, there is no added fragrance, which is very important to me, it only has a faint scent of some lactic acid products I’ve used previously.I am very picky when it comes to skincare products, but I simply love the Retinol Reform. It is very effective and is a quality product. It is on a pricy side, but is easier to get and use than prescription retinoids.

This product is amazing. It is lightweight and wonderful for my skin. I have used other retinol products that dried my skin out. This one did not. I have used it for about 3 weeks now and can defiantly see a difference.
Not bad no scent.  Some difference around my eyes.  Caused some dryness around my nose that I need to work on to get hydrated.

review_title: I think I’ve found the holy grail retinol
review_text: So it’s been 7 days of using this serum, and I already see a difference in my skin! I was using the Drunk Elephant retinol before Shani, and almost every time it would make my skin burn. I’ve also tried Biossance for similar retinol results. Shani’s never burns and hasn’t irritated my skin at all. I’ve had these bumps on my cheek/clogged zit trapped under the skin, and since I’ve started using this retinol, the spot has improved greatly. Can’t wait to see how my skin will look in another week.

This retinol is amazing! Ive had to change my birth control a million times and with that, I broke out each time with cystic acne in a few spots. I couldn’t seem to get rid of the red scarring with any serum- retinol, vitamin c, etc. I tried a sample of this one night and woke up the next morning with the scarring and spots drastically lighter and my face just overall looked replenished. Very happy and will definitely buy the full size !

I don’t use a lot of products in general but I’m in my 40’s and figured it’s time for retinol. I started using this 8/16/20. You can see in the first pic I have residual acne scars, uneven texture, redness, just bleh all around. I took the 2nd pic 1/10/21 and there’s a noticeable improvement. The texture is smoother, tone is better, scars have faded and my skin feels softer to the touch. Less broken out too! I highly recommend this product.

This is an okay retinol but & prob good for sensitive skin. But I noticed no changes in my skin. TBCH my skin looked better when I was using honeymoon glow from the farmacy. I was hoping this would help with acne scars and texture and just give me that kind of clean glossier skin but I sort of think my skin looks worse now after a month of using this about every other day. Pretty disappointed because I read a million articles hearing this is what celebs use, but to be honest maybe they just had good skin to begin with

review_title: Longtime Retinol User & I LOVE This
review_text: I’ve been using retinol in my skincare routine for over 2 years and I know how important it is. When I started using Shani Darden, I worked my way up to applying it every other day and was careful when introducing my skin to a new product. I started with once a week, then twice a week, and now every other day. Maybe it was that, or maybe just the way it’s formulated, but I saw no irritation at all. Which is HUGE when you have skin that tends to be more sensitive like mine.As with all retinol formulas, it does take a while to work so be patient. I have been using this for over 2 months and am starting to see my skin become more supple and my acne scars are fading. The serum lasts a long time and lives up to the hype. *I received this product in partnership with Sephora + Shani Darden*

I am really loving this Retinol, Still slowly building up it up as retinol something I generally only use once a week. It also contains lactic acid, not a usual pairing but I dig it as it’s still super gentle! Retinol is one of those products I start using more in the fall/winter, so I love that both products are multi-purpose as well as effective. Plus the gentler for my dry, sensitive skin, THE BETTER! Slowly replacing my favorite Sunday Riley retional product!

This retinol is so gentle!! If you’ve had bad experience with retinol in the past, I would highly suggest looking into this one! This formula is very gentle and hydrating. I use 2 pumps in my PM routine and follow up with moisturizer and SPF (very important especially when using retinol!). I’ve been using this product 3x a week and really been loving it! I noticed a big difference with my hyperpigmentation and overall improved the appearance of my skin.

I have been using this twice a week at night and am happy to report no sensitivity, redness or irritation. It has a thick serum/gel texture that absorbs instantly. I love how it improves skin texture and fine lines, and am excited to see the improvements with longer-term use.

I have been using this twice a week at night and am happy to report no sensitivity, redness or irritation. It has a thick serum/gel texture that absorbs instantly. I love how it improves skin texture and fine lines, and am excited to see the improvements with longer-term use.

I love everything about this serum! I have used like 4 or 5 bottles of this (even with the old formula that was exclusive to her website). The types of retinol and the lactic acid create the most beautiful glow and keep my skin even and youthful. I can’t imagine using anything else!

I love everything about this serum! I have used like 4 or 5 bottles of this (even with the old formula that was exclusive to her website). The types of retinol and the lactic acid create the most beautiful glow and keep my skin even and youthful. I can’t imagine using anything else!

review_title: A staple in my skin care
review_text: I received this product in partnership with Shani Darden and this is my honest review. I started using the Retinol reform 30 days ago. I started 2-3 times a week because I’m the past retinol has been harsh on my skin. Not this one. My skin didn’t get irritated. I moved up to 4 times a week and after 30 days of using I saw significant improvement in my skin tone. A lot of my old blemishes are gone! I will continue to use.

review_title: The HYPE on this product is so real!!
review_text: I partnered with Shani Darden on a 30 day skincare challenge to test out how the Retinol Reform worked on my skin. The 30 days are up, but this product will forever be in rotation. I suffer from the leftovers of a bad case of hormonal acne (redness, scarring, uneven skintone) & after 30 days- I basically had a new set of skin. It really cleared up the scarring and redness along my jawline BIG TIME. I have always had issues with retinols in the past cause my skin is super sensitive, but my skin LOVED this gentle formula!

feels great going on with no burn or anything but unfortunately this broke me out every time I used it. every.time. made zero difference in my skin otherwise too. it’s a shame because my aging skin was prepared to fall in love with this “cult favorite.“ on to the next product!

This product is the BEST! My skin reacts so well to it. I’ve noticed a difference in the texture and even my acne scars. You have to be patient, but with consistent use it makes a difference. Can’t wait to try Shani’s other products!

I follow Shani on Instagram and when she mentioned that this was a gentle form of retinol that would not cause severe peeling and breakouts like other retinols, I ordered the mini size for trial. I have used retinol in the past and my skin was not a fan. Instant peeling, breakouts, the works... and it took forever for my skin to heal from it. Similar thing happened with this product, minus the peeling. My skin was not a fan and from the breakouts that appeared the next day after using this product, I now have acne scars left over that I am trying to heal and get rid of. I know that when you use retinol initially, your skin has a period of turnover where it becomes really bad before the acne clearing, anti-aging effects of retinol really break through, but the initial period was so bad for me that I had to stop using the product.I have sensitive combo skin and would not recommend this.

Very happy. I’ve been wanting to try Shani’s retinol reform for awhile but was reluctant because I have sensitive skin and her website has indicated not intended for sensitive skin. I’m so happy I put my uncertainty aside. I have had zero irritation since day 1. I use every other night as part of my nightly routine and it leaves my skin looking softer with reduced visible fine lines. I’m purchasing the larger size and highly recommend - especially for those with sensitive skin.

review_title: Yes it is small but it works
review_text: Ok this thing is really small. I didn’t pay attention to the size before purchasing but I am so glad that I didn’t return it because it has transformed my skin. You don’t need much and I don’t use it every day (3 times a week).  I’m hoping to purchase the bigger size when it comes back in stock.

review_title: Invest in this product! Total game changer
review_text: I’ve been using Retinol Reform for 2 yrs now and it’s an absolute game changer. My fine lines are reduced, skin texture is even, and it even helps ward off pesky zits. I’m in my early 30s and just trying everything to delay getting botox and so far so good! Definitely the most expensive product in my routine but so worth it. I think if you’re going to spend money on one thing, a retinol like this is 100% worth it.

Usually I don’t do reviews but I had to because I fell in love with this product, I have very sensitive skin and I have never used retinol before.  Let me tell you, I’ve been using this product for a week and can already see it working.  I had no reaction or dryness.  My face looks brighter and smoother, my mother noticed immediately.  I am 33 years old and she said I look like 25, my husband told me that I looked younger and he doesn’t even know that I am using this product.  I can’t wait to see what my face will look like after a month ... I’m very happy with my purchase ...

I have dry acne prone sensitive skin. I am in my early 30s. I previously tried a competitor retinol and it made my face peel and it hurt for days afterwards. I bought this with high expectations as I have the aforementioned acne, some fine lines, texture and general aging. I also purchased the oil free moisturizer (I’ll write another review separately) that planned to use in conjunction with this product the following morning to prevent peeling. I have been using this for two weeks and I experienced some purging but then this retinol is helping to remove them and my fine lines are going away fast already! My face feels plumper, which I honestly didn’t expect, and my fiancé asks me constantly if I’m wearing makeup when I’m not. I feel like my face is looking more even these days. I am excited to see what happens going forward. I also bought a lightweight sunscreen to protect my skin during the day. This is worth it!

I’m fortunate to have inherited clear skin but was looking to add a stronger daily retinol as I creep closer to 40yo. This product made my face develop deep and large acne (whiteheads) overnight. I stuck with it in case it was my face adjusting but after an entire week, I couldn’t take it anymore. After ceasing to use, my skin cleared up almost immediately. For what it’s worth, I also tried her Texture Reform and had similar results.  My face doesn’t like her cult products for some reason.

Started using this product two weeks ago and it’s been great so far. Dark spots from acne has reduced. There is no harsh effect on the skin as it was the first retinol I ever tried. Definitely loving this and can’t wait to see the results.

This is almost perfect for me. I use once a week and I still am getting a bit of dryness especially around my nose but not as bad as with other retinols or vita c serums I’ve used. On the plus side. My pores appear to be a bit smaller and the overall radiance and texture of my skin is really nice. This is helping my skin thrive during quarantine!

Started using this product two weeks ago and it’s been great so far. Dark spots from acne has reduced. There is no harsh effect on the skin as it was the first retinol I ever tried. Definitely loving this and can’t wait to see the results.

I have been following Shani for a while on instagram. When she finally hit Sephora I bought the 1 oz bottle. It has 2.2.% retinol which is less then some others on the market but it is paired with 2% lactic acid serum which is really what helps with seeing immediate results.I have acne prone skin, and acne scarring not many wrinkles but preventative measures are always nice. I started out using twice a week before bed with nothing layered underneath and now I use it every other day with another serum like Estée Lauder advanced night repair.  Shani says you can use a moisturizer on top if you need added moisture but I figured I would try without to see the results. After first use I definitely noticed a difference in the pigmentation of some of my acne scars. My pores also looked less huge. I haven’t taken before and after pictures, but every time I use the product I am happy with the results. I have read that the formula has changed since it was originally formulated but I don’t know the difference as I have only tried the version after it hit Sephora. I took off 1 star because for the price of the product I feel like there are other retinol’s on the market (like Sunday Riley that offer 6.5%) that offer more bang for your buck. Friendly reminder to always use an SPF during the day if you are using a retinol :-)

I have used this product 2 to 3 times a week for the last month, and I have noticed the fine lines in my forehead, which were prominent, have improved in appearance. I apply a moisturizer after applying, which is a must. The price tag is a bit steep for me at the moment, so I probably won’t buy it. However, I will keep it in mind as it gets the job done.

I am in love with Shani Darden skincare. I find that I am much more willing to pay for high quality skincare products than I am for makeup, and this is no different. If you do not have a good base to work with, then why bother, in my opinion. I just recently turned 30, and thought I really better start transforming my skincare routine. I already love Shani Darden products, so the Shani Darden Retinol Reform seemed like a no brainer as far as somewhere to start. I could not be more pleased with the results. I feel like my skin has a bounce and brightness to it that I frankly did not know it was missing. Looking forward to seeing continued and lasting results.

It’s hard to write a complete review only after two weeks but it shows promise. The retinol is the right color (bright yellow) if you know your retinol. The packaging is nice and the instructions are simple. As with any retinol, your skin will feel dry -- this is when you amp up your top layer of moisturizer and you should feel fine. I’ll keep using it and report back in a month or so!

This stuff is a miracle! I am 38 and suffer from acne (still SMDH) and I’m trying not to age like an old suitcase! this has SAVED my skin! It keeps my acne away and has smoothed out my texture! I love all Shani’s products... I use them all! You will not be dissatisfied with this product!

I have been using this retinol for over a year now and absolutely love it. My skin look even and glowing. The fine lines between my brows have noticeably minimized. No irritation or sensitivity even when I first started. Highly recommend!!!!
My first time trying Retinol and I’m in love with it. I’ve been using it about  a month and my skin feels so nice it’s brighter and less acne.

This is hands down my holy grail retinol product. I can never be without it so I stock up when I get the chance. It has retinol and lactic acid so is great for spot prevention and wrinkles but I mainly use it to prevent acne and reduce spots. I don’t find that I’m sensitive to it but some may be sensitive. If that’s the case, try the texture reform instead. I’m typically allergic/sensitive to prescription retinoids (differin, retin-a, tazorac, etc.) so I was pleased that I could tolerate this product.
Short of getting a prescription, this is the best retinol you can find. I’ve tried so many OTC options and this one is far and away the best. On my third bottle!

This product was amazing for me it was hydrating which is good for me since i have somewhat dry skin. It did reduce some of my dark spots which is a ++. Overall really liked the product would most likely buy again!

I have been using this product for a little over a week now and I can’t express how smooth and fine my skin looks. It has that healthy glow, and smooth appearance. This is my first time using any product from Shani Darden and honestly, this won’t be my last!!

I haven’t noticed results in the 2-3 weeks I’ve been using this, but it does go on smooth and doesn’t make my face dry or oily so I’m willing to keep using to see if I notice any differences. The one thing I didn’t like is the scent. It’s very off-putting and is the one thing that would make me not want to continue using or buy again.
Very nice lightweight formula with a mild scent (almost none existent)! After two weeks of using every other day, I notice my skin tone was noticeably more even.
Light and doesn’t irritate skin. Saw small improvements in a few weeks.

I received this product as a sample and I am so glad I did. In only 2 uses I saw my forehead wrinkles noticeably improved. I was super impressed with how well it worked in such a short amount of time. The price is something I take issue with as I don’t know if I’ll be able to keep purchasing this. I think it’s high for just a single item. With that said I can’t argue that the product delivers great results.

review_title: Looks to be working excellent for BIG pores.

This product has changed my skin so much. My wrinkles are disappearing and my pigmentation is getting much better. My new go to for skin care

review_title: Like the clear version but slightly better.

I’ve been hearing such good thinks about this lip butter and i just had to buy it, the pink sugar smells like frosting or like an iced animal cookie, 10/10 my new favorite lip balm

Not really sure why this product is so popular. I don’t hate it, but I don’t love it. I have all 4 shades & you can slightly see the difference on the lips but it doesn’t feel any different than any other lip products I own.
I have really chapped lips especially in the winter but with this it just takes the chap away it makes my lips go from looking dull to looking glassy and shiny. Absolutely recommend!

This smells amazing and definitely feels hydrating for a long time on the lips, but I don’t love the applicator as I find it’s a bit difficult to get a good wash of colour. The colour also fades very quickly. Once I finish this one I’d probably just buy the clear shade and use it over lip liners.

review_title: Makes you feel like the It girl

This feels and looks really good. Smells good too. I think it’s worth the hype. I would rebuy. I also like the packaging.

review_title: I love this stuff it’s so good and so worth it
review_text: Absolutely amazing. I wear this everyday it’s perfect shade, smell and size and it perfect for everyday!

I decided to try this after seeing on TikTok.. The formula is actual so soothing; not sticky at all. I actually prefer this over Laneige & will be buying more! I got the coral shade which gives a nice subtle red hue & will be buying more!
I love this ! Very hydrating I use it everyday and the color is just so so nice on my lip color ! I just hate that type of applicator
super moisturizing but doesn’t last very long. still overall a great product. i personally also think it’s worth the price because it gives a lot more product than you think it does

Kept putting off buying this, but finally purchased and can say this will be purchased on repeat. The smell of this is amazing! It smells like cake. This also delivers a surprising amount of color for just being a balm. Lastly, the amount of moisture this gives is insane! So moisturizing! This will be my daily go to and I love the cool, clear applicator tip. It guides on smoothly. No complaints here
I absolutely love this product, it is not sticky at all like some other ones, it smells delicious & can’t go wrong with it also being clean!
My absolute fav lip oil not sticky and lasts a long time! I highly recommend.

Love this lip balm. The vanilla scent is to die for and the formula is super hydrating and not sticky. It smells like a vanilla cake ! The color is very sheer which I like for a lip balm. It healed my dry lips and it has kipped them smooth. I recommend it even if it’s pretty pricey.
so hydrating, great scent. this is my favorite lip balm ever.
I haven’t stopped using this! It is the perfect amount of shine and it very light weight but still SO hydrating!! Buying all the colours!

One of my all time favorites. Smells amazing, like cookies. The color is a light tint, and it’s super moisturizing. My go to when I’m out and wanting a little bit of lip color and gloss, but nothing too thick.

I’ve had this for a few months, and it still has a lot of product. I use it frequently throughout the day, but I wasn’t entirely impressed at first. However, I used it before going to bed and for once, I did not wake up with dry lips, which at this point, I think I’ve had dry lips since primary school. Now, I only use it when going to bed instead of throughout the day. My lips do not look or feel dry the whole day when I use this like a sleep mask vs a lip balm throughout the day, which is better since you’re technically prolonging the product before it runs out. I also like using it on top of a lip tint, since those are very drying as well. I will be repurchasing again.

I was expecting an amazing balm after reading the reviews. It’s a nice balm, but nothing special. I like to wear lip liner and the Dior lip oil, or a lip balm (Glossier or Kopari) applied on top. This is very messy and not very hydrating.

If you’re into basic makeup that looks natural but flattering, this lip is a perfect every day. Definitely a purse staple. I love the smell, the finish, and the color, plus it isn’t a tacky balm so it feels great on the lips! Very hydrating!

The vanilla! This Summer Fridays lip balm is vanilla-scented, but like, for real. It’s made with vanillin, the organic compound found naturally in vanilla beans, so the fragrance is a rich and complex, not artificial. There’s no flavor or sweetener here, just lots of hydration and a cool clear tip so you can see exactly how much product you’re dispensing.
This caught my eye at checkout and I couldn’t pass it up— beautiful packaging and even more beautiful product.  Non-sticky, super hydrating versatile balm for anytime of day. Currently: obsessed!

This lip balm is one of my absolute favorites and will continue repurchasing. I love that it hydrates my lips and doesn’t leave them sticky. There are several different shades to pick from as well. I just prefer the clear one.

This is one of my new favorite lip balms! It really does have a melted-butter-like texture, so it applies easily into the lips. It also lasts a while on the lips of not disturbed and my lips don’t feel dry after using this. If you enjoy vanilla scents, this one is for you.  The tube also has a soft silicone applicator that curves perfectly to the lips, making it easy to not waste product.

This lip balm goes on very smooth on the lips. It’s very long lasting. It’s very nourishing and has really helped soothed my dry and cracked lips. It smells so good, wish I could eat it. I would definitely buy this again in other scents.

1st of all I super love the applicator on the lip balm. It’s a silicone texture and feels amazing on my lips. The lip balm itself is very hydrating and smells sooo delicious! Definitely my new holy grail!

I have dry lips and boy oh boy does this lip butter balm feel moisturizing! My lips feel instantly more hydrated. I love how it adds a nice bit of shine too, so I can skip the gloss. The balm is not sticky, and is easy apply with the silicone applicator. I also love the vanilla scent, it’s not too much, but just right.

Isn’t sticky or thick, just a nice balm. Highly recommend.

Where to start? This stuff is amazing. The applicator is unlike any I’ve tried before and helps it go on so smoothly. Also, I’m not typically the biggest fan of vanilla products because a lot will smell or taste wayy to artificially sweet, but this one is perfect. It has just a subtle hint of vanilla that I love!

I’m obsessed with this product! It’s a mix between a gloss and a balm. It makes your lips look so glassy and shiny but isn’t sticky at all which is a major plus! Will definitely purchase this in the future!

The perfect year round lip product 🫶🏼 my lips stay hydrated without the “tacky” feeling of other gloss products, which is huge for someone with long hair (if you know, you know). I look forward to trying other shades!

Lip lip butter balm feel so comfy on the lips. The packaging is so quality an sleek. It’s perfect for the colder months. I love that this isn’t sticky an leaves my lips plump an super soft. I can’t express how much I’m loving this.

I’ve been so excited to try this and it didn’t disappoint!! Firstly, the tip applicator was very unique it’s more pointed to fit your lips better which is great. When I compare it to another brand like Rhode’s I would choose SF’s every time. The bottle is the perfect size and doesn’t soak in quickly so you’re not having to reapply constantly. I will definitely get the colored ones now.

review_title: A Must-Have for Those Who Struggle w/ Cystic Acne!
review_text: Everything about this product is amazing, except the price. However, I find it worth the price tag because I have cystic acne, and regular lip balms break me out around my mouth. review_title: I'm definitely giving this a whirl!
review_text: This came as part of a sample, and I am 52, with very oily skin. I don’t wear very much on my skin and not so much concerned about wrinkles as I am of the dark circles and puffiness that is hereditary in my family. The images here were taken at 10:08 & 10:44 am the same morning,  in the same room. Zero edit (I hate editing). Unless it’s my imagination, I feel the crows feet appear reduced and the puffiness seems less, I do feel a slight tightening to the skin area (not sure if it’s to be used in the eye area but I did sparingly). Not sure why the complaint of scent because it’s very light. I normally use Lancome and their scent makes my eyes water; but I’m going today to purchase this.

This product has multiple uses my routine; I love it as a serum “primer” for under makeup. It’s so lightweight yet delivers a huge dose of hydration. I prefer to layer a thick cream moisturizer over top for skincare only days, and then the SPF 50 primer CT just launched. Together it’s a simple combo that keeps me looking radiant and balanced. Great product for sensitive skin in my experience. Product was received complimentary for review.

For starters, I’d actually never tried anything from Charlotte Tilbury before now. I’ve always been interested, but I had a hard time coughing up that kind of money on a brand I wasn’t familiar with. So, when I received the Charlotte Tilbury Magic Elixir, I was super stoked to get acquainted with the brand. The serum itself feels really nice on the skin. It’s not thick or tacky, and absorbs rather quickly. It also has a soft, delicate fragrance to it. Typically, I try to stay away from fragrances skincare as it’s just not necessary and has the potential to cause irritation, but the fragrance in this was non irritating and was also not overwhelmingly strong. If you’re familiar with the BareMinerals SkinLongevity Long Life Herb Serum, it is eerily similar. Like almost exact between the feel and scent. When using this serum, I just applied a few drops to my face before applying my moisturizer, and it seemed to play well with all of my other products in my skincare lineup. I used the entire bottle over the course of a month, and that was with conservatively sized amounts at each application, so it may not be a realistic product to add to your lineup if you’re budget conscious. Overall, I’m satisfied with the results this serum gave me. My skin did feel softer and less texturized. It also gave me a very healthy glow and did not irritate my skin whatsoever.

So let’s do pro’s and con’s and everything in between. The good things about this primer are that it is great at hydrating, absorbs quickly, and didn’t irritate my sensitive skin. But on the other hand I didn’t notice it do too much besides provide some temporary hydration. I used it consistently but didn’t really see much difference in my skin not to mention it sometimes pilled depending on what moisturizer I put on top. The in between would be that I seem to be greating a few breakouts recently, which normally doesn’t happen, however I don’t know if this serum is to blame or not so just beware. For the price I think there are better serums out there that’ll do more honestly. (I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest opinion.)
