I think this product will be best for those who have dry skin and don’t really have a skincare routine yet. This is a great product to add moisture to your skin and its easy to use.  I personally loved the way my makeup sits on top of this product. It helped everything just bond for a smoother finish. I also enjoyed the scent on this its like a clean scent with a hint of soft florals. Furthermore, I loved that the bottle and dropper are both made of glass. If you have oily skin or already have an attachment to your skincare routine with Vitamin C, Hyaluronic Acid and Niacinamide, then you can probably skip this one.

review_title: Real magic in a glass bottle
review_text: I have tried I swear a million products to reduce the look of my pores and I’ve found nothing, until I received this magic serum. I noticed a change with just the first use, I’ve been using it for a week now and it’s just truly Magic in a glass bottle. The applicator is easy to use and the smell is slightly musky but refreshing to me.

I received Charlotte’s Magic serum crystal elixer free from Influenster in exchange for my honest thoughts.  It comes in a beautiful glass bottle, with a nice lines design on the bottom. The applicator is unique as it’s slanted towards you. Six drops is all you need to cover your entire face, I noticed the moisture as soon as I put the first drop on my face. Once I massaged it around to cover the rest of my face I noticed the moisture feeling throughout my entire face. It dried quickly though which was nice. After just a little time I noticed my face felt like it was being slightly pulled, almost as if it had a little invisible glue feeling. I feel over time I will definitely notice firmer tighter reduced wrinkles. I look forward to this now being a part of my daily routine.

This serum definitely presents itself as luxury in a bottle. The applicator and sleek look are lovely. There is a floral scent upon application, but it fades quickly, which might be a relief to those with fragrance sensitivities. Although it does feel quite nice upon application, I woke up the morning after to clogged pores. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin and this formula just doesn’t agree with mine, unfortunately. Too bad because I otherwise enjoy a lot of Charlotte Tilbury products, but this one just wasn’t a match for me.

I’m so glad I got to try this for free in exchange for my honest review from Charlotte Tilbury and Influenster. This serum is absolutely magical! It left my face feeling moisturized and looking shiny and radiant. I definitely think this is a great thing to check out especially if you are looking for a product for anti-aging. I don’t know if I would recommend this to someone acne-prone, but otherwise this is a great product! Just apply this under your normal makeup routine or alone and you are ready to be the star that you are!

I have to admire the beautiful packaging of this serum. It comes in the beauty glass bottle. Serum feels very lightweight, hydrating  and my skin looks plump and glowing. One of the main in-house niacinimide which helps to brighten complexion. Great serum to use under moisturizer. I like the texture. It has light scent which doesn’t bother me at all.
I feel like this was a waste of money. I don’t get the hype over this
Ive tried this a couple of times now and I dont think this product is for me. It sits on my skin and slouches off the minute I touch my face. Very disappointed for the price.

This is the only serum I’ve found that I replace when I’m out. Usually I’ll branch out and try something new but this is the best! I’m on my 4th bottle now. It smells so good and I love the consistency on my face.
Not sure if it’s because I’ve been working more or what but I’m pretty sure this made me break out in acne.. I’ve never had bad acne until I used it :(( (I tried a sample)

review_title: this really is magic for middle-aged skin
review_text: I don’t know what it is about this serum, but when I apply it there’s this glow about my skin and the refined texture/plumpness is out of this world. I had previously picked up a mini with my beauty insider points, loved it so much I’m here to get a full size. It may not be very useful for young skin? I’m 50 and have good skin to start with, but this serum really takes it to the next level! Wow. Superb under makeup. I also use it under the magic cream and the magic night cream, fantastic with both. My skin looks so plump and smoothed out, and has a glow from within.

Made my skin feel tight, but didn’t have any kind of effect.  Reviews are really divided on this.  I took a chance, but agree with the “not worth the money“ camp.  Best thing about the product is the dropper.  It gets every last bit of serum due to a bend at the bottom.

This ___ ain’t ‘bout ___ and don’t do ___. That’s the long and short of it. And it doesn’t smell great, either. I have non-reactive, normal but aging skin, and it is... fine. Absolutely nothing to write home about. Superficially moisturizing. I went through a whole bottle, and yup, I can now say there are better serums to spend one’s money on, for sure.

Amazing! I received a sample of the Charlotte Tilbury serum to try. Oh my goodness. I didn’t expect this to work as well as it did. It was a surprise to see how well It smoothed my skin and made it soft IN ONE NIGHT!?! What kind of sorcery is this? Lol it was a great product and I recommend trying it. It doesn’t have a fragrance, and is the consistency of most serums-like a watery lotion. It smoothed and tightened my skin. I have acne prone oily skin and use it every other night in addition to my other skin care products.

Serums are my favorite skin care product and the one you should spend the most on in your routine. I haven’t been wearing makeup during this awful pandemic and this product has really helped keep my skin hydrated and glowing. The serum pairs very well with the magic cream or magic cream light. I highly recommend it to anyone looking to help hydrate their skin or help with the friction caused by mask wearing. This is a fragranced product but that doesn’t bother me and I had no issues with the fragrance.
Love the bottle and dropper! The pipette made application very easy. It applies absorbs quickly into the skin, without any residue making it great for layering product. I would definitely buy again.

I received this from Influenster to test and review.  Love the design of this bottle. I feel like the dropper helps me to get the perfect amount of product so I don’t waste it. Considering it’s $80, I think that’s important..I feel like I waste a ton with the air pumps. However, I have oily skin and this is a little TOO moisturizing for my skin. If you have dry skin, I think this would be a great option for you.

I received this full size product as complementary and I started using it in lieu of my usual Estée Lauder serum. I love the dropper and the bottle it comes in; it looks nice, the product stays in nice, somewhat spillage proof and you can adjust however much you want to use without directly touching with your fingers. I used it sparingly and it only lasted 2 months til I finished the whole product. I do like the fact that it is light, not sticky, and the smell is very light and pleasant. It does make my skin soft and hydrated but I think my skin gets dried after a few hours (I have dry skin). Also I did not see much improvement on wrinkle reduction or firmness of skin. I think I will stick to my good ole brown bottle serum but I do recommend it to anyone that has oily skin and wants something light.
I received this for free, and honestly is not bad but is not my favorite. I don’t like the smell and it’s a little bit sticky.

I loved the glow I got when using this serum. Even under foundation my skin had a beautiful glow that was unlike any other serum/primer I’ve used. The only downside I found with this serum is that it felt a bit tacky/sticky when I first applied it. That feeling went away after a few seconds, but I prefer when serums feel silky as opposed to sticky. Overall that will not stop me from continuing to use this product as part of my daily routine.
I really liked this serum. It wasn’t heavy and didn’t leave my skin greasy like some others have. I wasn’t a huge fan of the smell but I got used to it. It helped improve my skin texture.

The saddest thing: I spent 100 hard earned dollars for this product and after a month it did absolutely nothing for me. This is the second niacinamide-based serum that leaves my skin hanging high and dry. I guess this so called magic ingredient is not for everyone.

I tried this serum because the list of ingredients is superb. I bought the small bottle, and it did not even last me three weeks. It stinks well into the skin, a very thin liquid. I wish I would’ve bought the larger bottle. I will definitely re-purchase.

Really disappointed to report that this didn’t do anything for my skin. I used it religiously every morning for 6 weeks and noticed no differences. The packaging is stunning and looks lovely in my bathroom but that’s the only benefit.

I love it! This is literally magic serum. The minute you put it on you can feel it working. My skin feels refreshed and absolutely incredible as soon as I use it. I highly recommend it! It is worth every penny!

Ok , I have to say , I was super skeptical about this product working as claimed ! The serum reminded me of my grandmother  then I figured out why ... it smells like roses . I wasn’t crazy about that but it grew on me . So I couldn’t find the true ingredient list anywhere which concerns me.  It says 2% Replexium 5% Niacinamide & golden Vitamin C.    I quickly fell in love with how it made my face feel every time I used it ! Very Refreshing and my face felt super smooth afterwards  !    The Hydrating Moisturizer like no other !  It was not like a regular moisturizer feel ,and not even a body butter feel . It was much thicker , almost  a solid , like chapstick feel . It was quite heavenly ! A little went a long way and you could feel your skin quickly absorb it and hydrate! It plumped my skin and  this lasted a long while !     So long term use . I did notice my face looked like it had more even skin tone , plumped and hydrated . My pores were smaller and wrinkles lessened!! Looked great under my makeup! Great products!  I think people will be pleased with the results.     Thanks for the opportunity to try your Magic Serum & Moisturize r

I received a complimentary sample through influenster for my honest review! So far I’ve been using this for a month and I can already see the changes. My skin is brighter and my pores are smaller and it’s even helped to even out my skin tone and get rid of some of the redness!!

I received this to review. I’ve been using this for over a month. I’ve not noticed any significant differences in my skin at all. It is highly fragranced, so be aware if this bothers you. This product didn’t improve or harm my skin, so I feel it didn’t do any improvement but it’s good that it also didn’t negatively impact it either. For anti aging products, I’d personally look elsewhere.

review_title: Did not work for my skin
review_text: I really wanted to love this serum. I used it twice a day for about 4 weeks.  The first two weeks my skin definitely felt tighter and my pores smaller.  I felt like I even had a little glow.  However, the longer I used it, the more irritated my skin became.  I do have sensitive skin, but this product seemed to aggravate it, making my cheeks red and even causing a few bumps to appear on my cheeks.  It would probably be better suited for someone without really sensitive skin.  I did receive this product for free to sample on behalf of Influenster, but all opinions are my own.

I love this serum. It smooth out my skin and give my skin beautiful glow. I would by it again even though it is expensive but I don’t like the dropper. I don’t know if consestincy cause dropper not to pick up the product or somethingelse but it is so aanoying and difficult to get the product. All you get it air into the dropper and it takes 3-5 times to get actual product into it. This would be the only reason I would not purchase it. Wish it came with the pump bottle.

This was my first Charlotte Tilbury product and I am sold! I have been using this serum for about a month and am loving the results.  My skin is more hydrated and looks and feels firmer. It is always so hard to tell but I feel like it has helped reduce the appearance of my pores and fine lines. 4 stars only because the scent was a bit matronly. Product lasts forever. After almost two months of teice-daily use I still have half a bottle of product left! I received this complimentary in return for an honest review. #influenster #MagicSerumCrystalElixer #contest #complimentary @influenster
This is a very expensive serum that is really nothing special.  I have no notable changes after one month.  There are other better choices, although I love Charlotte Tilbury, this is not a winner. :(

I received this product complimentary for an honest review.  This serum has a very pleasant light scent similar to the magic cream.  I have been using it twice a day, a.m. and p.m.  When you first apply it it feel a little sticky but it is absorbed quickly, leaving the skin feeling very moisturized.  It works great with other products and under foundation.  I do recommend and would repurchase.
I got this as a sample and honestly I noticed differences in my skin after one use. I’m absolutely in love with this serum!!

I received this from Influenster and have been testing it for a couple weeks. It’s a good serum but no better or worse than the Lancôme i have been using for years. It feels great on my skin and is more hydrating than other serums i have used in the past but the jury is still out as to whether or not i would purchase this.

This serum has changed the texture of my skin! It’s much smoother and I see less wrinkles around my eyes. Not bad for something that o have used for only 2 weeks. So glad I got to try this through Influenster. This product is a keeper!

I received this as a free sample from Influenster. After using this for 21 days. I have found that the appearance of my pores has been reduced and it gives my skin a subtle rosy glow. I would definitely recommend.
This is amazing skin care routine serum, one of the best that i ever try, my skin look so smooth and juicy, in love with this, thank you so much influenters!!

I have very dry skin and this serum works really well for me, except I feel like it almost absorbs too well and I have to use quite a few drops to cover my face. The smell is delicious and the packaging is divine.I would prefer for the serum to be slightly more hydrating and for a higher concentration of vit c, but overall this is a good serum that firms up my face and provides a nice base for make up.I received the serum complimentary for testing purposes, this is my honest review.

I received this complimentary bottle from Influenster. If you have problematic skin as I do this is probably not for you. It is fragrant, it didn’t cause any irritation but it also just didn’t do anything for my skin. I do love the CT makeup line, she’s amazing. So I tried the serum out on my daughter who is 19. She did like it, it did give her a pretty glow. However,  the ingredient list isn’t great and is why I discouraged my daughter from continued daily use. I feel There are much better serums out there for a much better price. I would not recommend this product. @ctilburymakeup #charlottetilbury #magicserumcrystalelixir #complimentary

It is a good serum, especially like it for daytime use under my makeup as it is hydrating but not at all heavy or greasy, it all sinks in and it leaves your skin with a glowy look to it. I preferred it under my previous regularly used moisturizer than under the Charlotte Tilbury one.

I had to wait a wee bit to test this serum, since I’d just finished up a TCA peel.  I received/reviewed the Magic Cream previously, and was fairly certain I’d like the serum too.The serum texture is fantastic: substantial without being sticky or greasy.  It applies smoothly and absorbs quickly, all with a luminous finish (a step or two down shimmer wise from Future Dew). It is scented, but not cloying.  Substantively, the serum is well-rounded. It includes Vitamin C and 5% Niacinamide, along with Replexium -- a new blend of Acetyl Tetrapeptide-11 and Acetyl Tetrapeptide-9 (both Tetrapeptids eearned a rank of Best in the Paula’s Choice Ingredient Dictionary).The ingredients are pretty much guaranteed to improve skin tone. The luminous finish provides an instant glow, which is a nice bonus. I was definitely impressed that the formula didn’t irritate my post-peel skin at all.It is cruelty free too!I received this product complimentary for review.

I’m in love with the charlotte tilbury magic serum! I recieved this #complimentary for testing purposes and was wowed by the results. It instantly hydrates my 52 yr old skin and I’ve been using about 2weeks and already there is a visible difference in my fine lines and wrinkles plus a major improvement in my skin’s elasticity!!! I’ll be buying this serum. All I need to leave my house now is a clean face and my magic serum.

I have been using it morning and night.  I massage a few drops on my skin before moisturizer.  Easy to use dropper in a beautiful bottle and a little goes a long way.  Plays well with other products and makeup and leaves my skin smooth, bright and more youthful after a week of use.  Truly magic in a bottle.

review_title: Can we get a legit review? Can I get an "Amen!"
review_text: Can someone please review this product who did not receive it from Influenster? I don’t want to be “influenced“ by someone spouting off about a product with #ad after their review. Seriously, Sephora? Knock it off with these bogus reviews.

This is a beautiful serum! It leaves my skin feeling very moisturized and ready for the day or ready for the night! I cannot speak on the long term effects yet but it does feel very nice! I was given this product free from influenster in exchange for a review!

I’ve had this for a short while so it’s too early to truly see the Impact. The packaging is lovely as expected from Charlotte tilbury but the smell is not my favorite. The serum itself Is not too thick or sticky and the droplet works well. A little goes a long way and my skin feels so soft after every use, I’ve noticed a few dry patches going away. I will keep using it to see if any significant improvements happen. I also have sensitive skin and there has been no adverse effect

Recieved complimentary for testing purposes. I have only used this serum a few times but I can already see a difference in my skin tone and my face seems softer and smoother. My pores do seem to be a bit smaller and my skin is very well hydrated. I will be trying more products from Charlotte Tilbury in the future.

Ahhmazing! Seeing results in just three short days. Using nightly under my moisturizer and mornings under my makeup or sunscreen. Your just a few drops away from softer, brighter and tighter skin. It’s a part of my new Skin regiment.
Left my face felling so soft wow I’m amazed but only use it twice let see how it does later but I really like it I’m impressed
Love it!!! It goes on easily and it smells great!!! It’s my second day using it but I’m certain this is my new face serum. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes from Influenster

It left my face feeling incredibly soft. I’ve already noticed a reduction in the amount of redness i have. It smells great. I’m sold on it. I received this product complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes.

I finally received the Charlotte Tilbury magic cream and serum! As expensive as it is it is definitely worth the money. Although I can’t determine the long term results I can conclude after using it that you can instantly feel a difference. My face gets very glowy and it’s feel moisturized and hydrated. It’s like the after feeling of a high quality face mask! This is going to be a life changer! I can feel it!
Made my face extremely sticky, my eyes sting and gave me acne. For the price of this serum I’d expect better active ingredients, and performance.

Luxury experience, luxury price, bargain basement ingredients.  While not likely to hurt your skin, unless the heavy fragrance is sensitizing to your skin, wont hurt it but can easily get same serum for much less.  She has thrown every active possible in here and I am sure something will work.  I say stick to the make up.

I was happy with my usual eye cream, but decided to try this because of its best of beauty award. I gave this a good 4+ months of use to really give it a chance. I wish I had never bought it or switched. Not only did my fine lines and wrinkles get worse, but so did my dark circles. I finally gave up and went back to my Murad, and saw improvement in days. This may work for some people, but I would not personally recommend it.

Love this eye cream. It’s very soothing and great for dry eyes. The consistency is thinner than most eye creams I’ve used in the past but I really like this one. Since the skin around my eyes get very dry, I’ve used some products where it actually stings or burns when using a moisturizer and this does not do it at all. I wish this eye cream did have some sort of brightening aspect to it though.

I have been searching for a really hydrating eye cream that will minimize the appearance of my fine lines and dark circles. It did get rid of maybe like  half of the darkness under my eyes, and you know, I’m not crazy, I know it’s not just gonna snap back to the way it was when I was 16, but I wasn’t really impressed. Sadly enough, that’s about all it’s done for me. I’ve tried a few different eye creams at my ripe age of 22, (2 different it cosmetics, the farmacy one with the cherries on the packaging, many from the drugstore) and this one is extremely lackluster for the price you pay. I swear on my momma, The Daily eye cream from colourpop, ($16) is thicker and more hydrating than whatever the heck this is. To each there own, clearly a lot of people love it, but I definitely won’t be buying again.
So moisturizing! I’ve repurchased twice because I love how rich and hydrating it is.

I received this as a sample from my points. I honestly think it has made a difference in the dark circles I have and fine lines, my under eyes look smoother and lighter. I use this at night only since I don’t think it would work well with my makeup during the day just because it moves around a lot. I’m going to buy the full size once I finish this sample.

Just finished my 3rd jar of this cream and can say it’s just fantastic. Works great under make up, has brightened my under eye area noticeably. At night I use an eye oil over the top and the comb seems to be it for me. Love the texture.

It’s like my eyes get a reset every time I put this on. I don’t feel like I need to put a lot too. I’m on my way to buy a third one. Any wrinkles that I see that are starting to arise this cream smoothens it out. It’s also not too strong in scent so it doesn’t irritate my eyes. It’s not drying. It never stings my eyes. Love love this eye cream
I’ve used this for 3 weeks. It feels nice, I like the consistency of it. I like it but don’t see much difference. Think I need to add retinol. 43 yrs old

review_title: used to love it but it’s changed
review_text: Used to love this eye creamBut the formula had changed.  It used to be more rich, thicker. Now it feels like any other cream on the market. Very disappointed.

review_title: great under eye cream for hydration
review_text: so amazingly hydrating for your under eyes and love how clean this is. my under eye skin can get irritated with certain products but this one has surpassed expectations!

I got a 3ml sample to try. I finished it because I am in a “project use it up” for 2022 but I could not see myself spending money to repurchase this. I like a hydrating eye cream and this did not do it for me. I can get better from the drugstore.
Not as good as I expected.  Skin doesn’t feel essential moisturizer

I use this as my nighttime eye cream and it’s amazingly hydrating. I use tretinoin and like to apply this eye cream first to prevent the tretinoin from migrating too close to my eyes and keep my under eyes nice and hydrated through the night. It’s pretty thick, but it works for day time use under my tinted sunscreen as well. I think it helps to plump up my skin and may even be helping with the appearance of my dark circles. I will definitely repurchase this!
Life changed. I don’t really wear makeup so I can’t say if it moves makeup or anything but for ppl who don’t wear makeup I’m not joking this is worth every penny

I’m a huge eye care fanatic and was so pumped to try this! First, this little container comes PACKED with product. You definitely get your moneys worth in that regard. The texture is lovely, thick and glides on smoothly. It soaks in nicely, not tacky or drying. I can definitely tell if I skip putting this on at night! The smell isn’t overpowering either. All around win!

Received this product complimentary free from Biossance for my honest review.  I’m highly impressed how well Squalane + Marine Algae Eye Cream worked compared my other. More brighter under eye, let my skin feel much smoother.  Very gentle on skin. I recommend

I received this product complimentary from Biossance  Squalante + marine algae eye cream! I received this product last week, and i was expecting a bigger product but the product is super small. Even though the cream seems to be thick and with one layer you should be good to go. I love the texture and the little package.

I’ve been looking for a new eye cream and this one is another winner from Biossance! Love the feel of this, the texture is smooth, and it works so well! My under eye area has significantly improved and I would definitely purchase this one again!

I love this eye cream, the skin around my eyes is very sensitive and most eye creams irritate the area but this one is gentle enough for that delicate area. It’s very moisturizing and it hydrates the skin without being too heavy. It works well under makeup as well.

review_title: The most nourishing and hydrating eye cream!
review_text: I love Biossance products! I was excited to try their eye cream, and it did not disappoint. Beautifully packaged, the texture is thick, rich, silky, and creamy. Like butter for your eyes! It feels absolutely amazing!I gently pat in with my ring finger or use an eye roller to massage the product in. My eyes are very sensitive, and I have had zero irritation or blurry vision from this which is always a win.The skin around my eyes feels deeply nourished and hydrated. The hydration lasts all day. I use AM and PM. I notice this product de-puffing my morning eyes and brightening my tired, dull skin.Amazing eye cream I would definitely recommend!

This product was gifted by Biossance for free. I absolutely love this eye cream. The texture is not too heavy but moisturizing enough. It contains Squalane, which is one of my favorite moisturizer ingredients. Also it’s fragrance free.

I love this eye cream. It does exactly what it promises. I apply it the morning before applying my makeup and it reduces puffiness and fine lines. I apply it at night along with a few dots of my very moisturizing

I was recently gifted a jar of squalane + Marine Algae Eye Cream complimentary from Biossance, and it has done away with my dark bags, and my crows feet are gone! This stuff is wonderful, and I have been using it less than a week. I use it every morning and every night at bedtime.

Wow this eye cream does the job! It gets rid of eye puffiness, wrinkles and it’s very hydrating. I was using DE’s C Tango eye cream and it did nothing but irritate my eyes. Everyone needs to try out this eye cream. You won’t be disappointed! I’ve gone through one jar and I just bought another one. It’s now a permanent staple in my skincare routine.
Other than plumping up my under eyes & making them soft & smooth I haven’t seen any major changes…for these results I will def repurchase.

review_title: Smooths and Brightens my Sensitive Skin Instantly!
review_text: My skin is SUPER sensitive especially my under eyes, my skin loves ALL biossance products and this eye cream is my favorite! It glides on to ur skin and soaks in leaving no greasy residue. Smooths and brightens instantly!

I had high hopes for this product, but it not only did nothing for my under-eyes, but it ended up irritating them to the point that I woke up with my eye still red. It defintely never hydrated my skin, and I was dissapointed that it had both fragrance and dye in it. I will not use this again.
Currently almost finished with my container — I love this eye cream. It is creamy and rich without being too heavy for my eyes. I use it morning and night.

review_title: not moisturizing enough for my dry under eyes
review_text: While I generally really like Biossance products, and I read reviews on this eye cream before trying, I was rather let down with this. To be fair, I have dry under eyes, so this just didn’t cut it for me. That said, all I really expect eye cream to do is moisturize well. My under eyes were left dry and crepey using this. I’ve used plenty of other eye creams that were more moisturizing.
Feels very cooling and moisturizing. I use this as my day eye cream and find it sits nicely under my make up.
It’s a good temporary moisturizer, haven’t noticed any lasting effects yet. Feels refreshing when I put it on. Still undecided if I’ll be repurchasing.
Didn’t expect this cream to work so well for my tired puffy eyes! I’ve only had it for 3 days and it’s already helped so much! A new staple of mine for sure

I really like the line, and find this has a cooling affect for my eyes. I haven’t used it that long so can’t speak to the effectiveness of the product yet. I wish it was a bigger jar and it’s a bit expensive for such a small jar.

I got this in a set with the Biossance face cream. Do I think this is the best eye cream in the world? No. I’m mainly looking for a product that hydrates my under eyes, which this does well. I don’t find it slipping into my eyes over the course of the day or night. Normally, my eyes are sensitive to most eye creams, but I haven’t had any issues with this one. The slight tint is nice to mask some discoloration. This won’t remove the need for a concealer, but it’s a nice touch. Overall, I like it.

Used points for a trial size (5mL). I applied daily morning and night on undereyes and side creases for the past month and noticed a difference in my lines being less prominent & less dry. It doesn’t make the dark circles any lighter however. Definitely easier to apply concealer after letting product “sink in.” Gives me a more fresh and awake appearance which is great for my aging 50s skin!
After more than four months using this product I do not see any improvement. This cream doesnt seem to hydrate or help in any way. Really disappointed of the product.

review_title: Sadly did not work for my skin
review_text: I was excited to try this product based on the online reviews, however, I was sadly disappointed. Despite trying many methods of applying this thick eye cream, I found that it did not absorb into my skin effectively. As a result, after about a month of use, I started developing bumps (pimples?) around the eye area. Please note that I was not using any other eye products during this trial time. I really wanted this product to work for me, but I ended up returning it. For reference, I have oily skin.

What a waste of money.. I was so very disappointed with this product. I’m in my late 20s, so this was the perfect gentle yet effective retinol to begin with. My mom loves it. It’s great to begin using retinol with. Did not cause me to breakout or dry my skin out

Love that this retinol serum combines three retinol technologies. It applies silky and smooth on my skin. I personal LOVE the scent however if you don’t like fragrance in your skincare this may not be for you. I have not experienced irritation or dryness and have seen improvement in skin brilliance.

So before using this product I felt like makeup sat on top of my skin instead of blending into it. This has completely fixed that problem and I can noticeably feel and see a difference in the texture of my skin!
LOVE LOVE LOVE!!!!! This product is worth every penny.   You’ll notice results within a few days and I didn’t get any of the “retinol uglies” like I usually do when I switch retinol products. Buy it!

I have been loving Murad for years! This renitol does not irritate my skin or cause breakouts which is usually the case for me with any retinol products. Just as smooth and great as all their other products. A must have!

AmaZing serum that contains not only retinol but hyaluronic acid too. My skin loves this product. Beautiful packaging and nice texture too. I only use it twice a week and I like it doesn’t feel stingy.

I wanted to start using retinol products for a very long time now.   I like that it’s not harsh on my skin and does  not irritate it.  It has a lovely gel/creamy like texture.  Does not feel heavy on the skin and sinks in pretty fast.

This serum is amazing and after using it for only a few nights my skin feels a lot smoother and visibly plumper in the mornings. It goes on very smoothly and the product itself have a very mild and pleasant scent.

I adore using retinol in my routine and this one is gentle enough that does not irritate my skin but at the same time I can see visible improvements in my skin. It smooths out the texture, corrects fine lines as well. You have to be consistent with the retinol and to slowly build up if you want to see results. Don’t forget if you are sensitive use a buffer like hyaluronic acid. Make sure you use SPF. I never experienced any redness or irritation with this one. Love the pump packaging, a little bit goes a long way.

Gifted by Murad for honest reviews! I have tried their products in the past so I was excited to try this one too. I didn’t see any significant difference as of now. As I have used it for a few days only. May be will see results after some time. But I think it’s too pricey so I won’t buy it. I also didn’t like the smell.

I absolutely love this retinol serum. I have been using this serum for a while now and I already see a difference in my fine lines. I didn’t experience any irritation from it. I highly recommend this to everyone.

Oh my this is my FAVORITE PRODUCT EVER! I love most things my Murad but this takes the cake. The way my skin feels after this is amazing and it’s helped so much with fine lines. I would reach for this over and over.

Oh my this is my FAVORITE PRODUCT EVER! I love most things my Murad but this takes the cake. The way my skin feels after this is amazing and it’s helped so much with fine lines. I would reach for this over and over.

review_title: Best serum for anti aging and hyperpigmentation
review_text: This is the first time I’ve used a retinae serum and I’m glad that I got to used Murad’s retinol serum as my first one. I’m 23 so I wanted to get ahead of the aging process and take some preventive measures. I have some under eyelines and the serum has dramatically lessened the look of them. The serum has also helped to even out my skin tone around my mouth. I’ve had terrible hyperpigmentation around my mouth so this serum has given me so much confidence. I would recommend this to everyone. To be transparent this was gifted to me by Murad but all my thoughts about this product is truthful.

I received this Retinol Youth Renewal Serum complimentary from Murad Skincare. I have tried several retinol products in the past and I like how gentle, yet effective this one is. My skin really looks refreshed and younger when I use this.

Wow! I’m the biggest fan of Murad. I love trying their new products. This is my new fave retinol. I’ve quite sensitive skin but so far so good with this.  Fine lines be good! My skin looked less tired after only a week of using.

Retinol takes a while to see results, so I’m not going to speak to that since I’ve only been using it for a few weeks. This is such a hydrating formula that hasn’t caused any irritation at all, but my skin already feels softer and smoother!

I just want to start off by saying that I consider retinol to be a necessary component in my skin care routine. Be cautious when using it however because you have sensitive skin it can be irritating. Nothing that a serum or a night cream can not help with. This product is pricey but you get what you pay for in my opinion. It is definitely worth the splurge.I have already noticed that my skin is more plump and firm. I would definitely recommend. This serum was gifted by Murad, but my opinions are entirely my own.

Gifted by Murad. I really love this serum. I have sensitive dry skin and this serum helps with my skin. It doesn’t irritate my skin but helps to make it look refreshed, radiant and healthy. I use this every other day and have noticed a difference!

I have been using murad retinol youth renewal eye serum for about 7 days and I can already see how hydrated my eyes look and feel. I’ve been using on my eye lids and under eyes. I love that it has a light scent and a tinted color. Helped with fine lines
This is amazing! Made my skin look like I am 18 again! It has completely cleared my breakouts! Way better than Curology! No issues what so ever w/ this product!
I really like Murad products. I am giving this a four because for me personally, I am looking for stronger retinol and decided to go for another option. My main concern is anti-aging.

Even Using this product one time causes a lot of stripping of my skin’s protective moisture barrier. I emailed the company to ask what percentage of retinol is in this product because I haven’t found a good strategy for making use of it. They refused to disclose the percentage. I give them 1 star for a lack of transparency about something as simple as the retinol percentage. If you can’t even give basic info to your users, you don’t deserve their trust. I’ve used their face wash for ten years, but I won’t try any other products after the this.
Love love love this product! Definitely can tell a difference in smoothness.

review_title: Ah-ma-zing. Take all of my money.
review_text: Such a great serum! I’m starting to use these anti aging serums at a fairly young age because I want to take preventative measures. I’m 24. No other serum has made a difference in my tone or overall skin appearance. But this not only toned out my redness, but just made my skin look really young and bright. I can’t say enough great things.

First and foremost, does anyone the percentage of retinol in this? Now that thats out of the way, it really seemed to not do much in comparison to Drunk Elephant’s retinol, which at the moment is my favorite but is also pricey. Has a non offensive smell, and applies ok. Overall, its alright but pricey and for that I want more than alright

I am into anti aging products now that I am almost 40 and I can’t even believe that lol.  I do like this serum a lot especially for the lines that are starting to appear on my forehead.  Thank you to Bzz Agent for sending me this complimentary for review.

The Youth Renewal Serum is an ok product. It absorbs fast into your skin. Has a very light scent as well. A little really does go a long way. I’ve been using it for about a month now and I do notice a slight difference in my crows feet and laugh lines disappearing.

The Youth Renewal Serum is an ok product. It absorbs fast into your skin. Has a very light scent as well. A little really does go a long way. I’ve been using it for about a month now and I do notice a slight difference in my crows feet and laugh lines disappearing.

If your skin is sensitive to retinol, I’d recommend the night cream alone. This serum does its job, but made my skin a scaly mess for about a week. I wanted to love it but the amount of fragrance in this line is just too much. If you don’t mind fragrance in your skincare, then this product won’t bother you. I liked the eye serum and night cream much more, but I would use the serum again to prep my skin before my wedding.

I had a few facial surgeries to dig out some cyctic acne cysts and my skin is very uneven on the texture side. Color its fine but texture is just off. I was quite pleased how well this worked to even out the texture. Not perfect but enough of a difference that I noticed.

I hate you Murad for making me love this serum. Now my pocket hates you. lol. This serum is worth every penny. The entire retinol line is worth it! It really brings results with fine lines and wrinkles. I can even see a slight change in my deeper wrinkles after 3 weeks!

review_title: Gets rid of those pesky little lines! Super gentle
review_text: Wow! I’m beyond impressed with the performance of this Murad Resurgence Retinol Youth Renewal Serum and how quickly I was able to see results! This serum feels absolutely lightweight, absorbs instantly, feels refreshing on my skin, and best of all, it gives me results I’ve been waiting for when trying similar products like this one in the past. My facial skin looks and feels more plump, fine lines around my eyes have almost completely vanished and giving me a more youthful appearance again. I love it!! Excellent quality product and very gentle on my sensitive skin. I highly recommend it!

My skin is thanking me for using this product! This has to be my favorite serum to date. It is lightweight and absorbs quickly. No sticky business. It does take about two week to see results so be patient! My skin looks healthier, firmer, and smoother. Definitely recommend this product and f you are concerned with aging skin.

This serum is one of my favorites; it absorbs so quickly, doesn’t leave me feeling oily, and is lightweight on my skin! I’ve noticed that it’s already helped lighten some of my dark spots, and also helped clear up my acne! It doesn’t dry out my skin at all, either. Worth the money for sure, and I love the results!

review_title: Works like magic! I love it.
review_text: I’ve been using this serum for at least a month in conjunction with the eye serum and night cream. It works really well for my combination skin. It applies easily and doesn’t leave a greasy or sticky residue. It leaves my skin smooth and silky without looking greasy. Smell is really pleasant. To me, it smells like powder and floral. It doesn’t linger, it goes away after application which I love! I’ve noticed a huge difference from how my face looked like pre-Murad, my lines and wrinkles are fading and it looks healthier and glowing over all.I did get a slight reaction on my first application. Some part of my face itched a little but it went away after a few seconds. It never happened again and I’ve never had any other reaction since.
The serum is very light and it feels great on my skin. Will definitely make u feel as if your skin is youthful.

So far so good! Been using the Retinol Youth Renewal Eye Serum, Serum, and Night Cream together. All of the products work well together. The serum is very lightweight, absorbs quickly, and I didn’t notice a fragrance. Excited to see my results from continuous use!
Great product! I like using it before I put my face cream on. I can definitely tell a difference in my skin. Feels and looks a lot better even after just one week.
The texture is lovely w/out any heavy scents. Wears well under foundation. Absorbs quickly. Not greasy. Provides excellent hydration instantly.
Burned my skin. Returned within 3 days of purchase

So I got this product as a sample one time. I wasn’t planning on using it but once I ran out of my regular night serum I decided to try it out because I’m on a budget. And iT CHANGED MY LIFE. I immediately noticed it clearing up my skin, lightening my dark spots, and adding glow. It was crazy! I have combination skin that is prone to minor break outs and really annoying dark spots after said breakouts run their course. My skin has been clear since I’ve started using it. It stops congestion in it’s tracks! I’m so thankful for my random sample. I ended up buying the whole thing and am ready to try more Murad products. Please give this a try!

I received this product as a free sample. I really love how non greasy it is because I hate that! So far, my skin is looking more radiant, which I LOVE and it’s not giving my skin any kind of reaction which is a total plus as well. I can’t wait to see the results as I continue to use it for a longer period of time. So far so good!

review_title: I think it works, for others - not for me.
review_text: The name holds a lot of weight in the beauty industry. Murad is known for building incredible products that really work. That said, this product, I didn’t really enjoy as much. A few things come to mind as to why. First, I am 32. When I received this product as a sample, I wasn’t sure if it was going to work since it is made to renew youth. Secondly, as an African American, I wondered if the product worked well for people with melanin. I love the other Murad products I have, but this one, not too much.

I’ve received this product as a free sample and this product is so good! The packaging is pretty basic, but the product is amazing. The serum has a creamy bu light texture, smells floral, and is definitely not greasy. Once I apply it to my skin it feels cooling and absorbs quickly. It doesn’t leave an oily feeling on skin either. I’ve been using it for the last 10 days and love it so far.

I received this product as a free sample. Works amazing to fade fine lines and spots left from past breakouts without being too harsh on skin. I’ve been using for a week and have already seen a difference in my skin’s texture and can’t wait to keep using this product!

review_title: Strong retinoid product that works well!
review_text: I received this product as a free sample. This retinol serum is very strong, which means it works well and does exactly what it’s supposed to--it helps fade fine lines and acne spots. Like any retinoid, it can cause dry or irritated skin, so start slow with this one. After just using it one night I had some patches where skin was flaking off on my face. So I’d recommend using it one night, and giving it a few days to see how your skin reacts before using it again. Overall, very pleased with the product and can’t wait to see more results over time.

I received this product as a free sample, but I am already a fan after using it a few nights. My skin is definitely more smooth and feels/looks amazing when I wake up. I’m in shock of how great it is working so far. I can’t wait to see the results after a month!

I received this product as a free sample. I received this serum and immediately started getting excited about it because I saw the rave reviews. I loved that it went on smooth, it didn’t have an odor, and didn’t make my skin feel dry afterward​. I have only used this every other night, but my skin does feel smooth in the morning and has not broken me out. I am excited to see more results!

I received this product as a free sample but have been a Murad user for a long time. I have always been very impressed with these products. They are high-end and I can immediately see a difference in my skin. They smell great, work effectively and last a long time as well. I highly recommend this product if looking for fresh, healthy and vibrant skin.

Yes! Was so happy to see murad has a retinol product.  I have already acquired several of their other products and have been very happy with how it works, as well as how much product comes out when using.  I got this as a free sample after trying their other profits. I have sensitive skin and need to use this less than what is recommended, but I think that also means it works and lasts twice as long.

I could tell right off the bat that this product was super high quality. This sinks into the skin right away and doesn’t leave it feeling sticky or heavy. The packaging is straight forward and high quality. I can see that my skin is plumper and more glowy.

I received this product as a free gift from Murad and am very pleased with it thus far. The texture of the product is very smooth making it easy to spread on your skin and to apply a thin layer. It has a light pleasant scent to it and feels very luxurious. The packaging is heavy duty (in a good way) and isn’t the least bit cheap. For a retinol serum I feel as though you get quite a large amount of product. I’ve been using this nightly for about a week now, and I feel as though I can see results already - giving me younger healthier looking skin. I’m looking forward to continual use of the product as well as the results!

I received this product as a free gift from Murad and am very pleased with it thus far. The texture of the product is very smooth making it easy to spread on your skin and to apply a thin layer.
