I’m looking forward to continual use of the product as well as the results!

This is my first retinol product. I have absolutely loved it thus far! It is light and goes on easy. You can feel in soaking into your skin and you are left with a light, really smooth feeling. There is no sticky/tacky feeling after applying. The bottle is easy to use and allows you to get the perfect amount of serum for you. Since using, I have noticed a more even skin tone and a boost in radiance - which I love! I received this product as a free sample. All opinions are my own!

I received this product as a free sample. I have only used it a couple of times so far, but my skin definitely looks more radiant and my skin has been looking less flakey and rough when I put on foundation which is a major win for me in dry winter weather! I don’t have any wrinkles or lines (yet) so I can’t comment on its effectiveness there, but it’s definitely leaving me with smoother skin that is less dry and dull! The scent is soft and fades quickly which I always appreciate in skincare as I also wear perfume and don’t want to smell both mixed together. The packaging is pretty standard for a serum, a lot of plastic pieces. I would love to see Murad move to glass or another more easily recyclable material!

Feels great on the skin! It’s lightweight and great for sensitive skin. I’ve been hearing about retinol and am excited to see the results from this product! I’ve been using it for a few days now and my skin already looks more even! I received this product as a free sample.

review_title: Steadily becoming a holy grail skincare
review_text: I think I love this product!! I got the mini size to start and I actually started using it every other day immediately and I’ve had no problems. I don’t get any sensitivity or peeling like other people experience with retinol-based products. My skin’s texture feels so smooth and I can’t wait to see more long term results from using. I first cleanse with my clarisonic, put this on then follow up with Drunk Elephant face oil and I think this is has been doing wonders for my skin. A little goes a long way so barely a full pump (about a pea size or less) is literally all you should use to cover your face.
Amazing results , i been using it for a whole year . Love it!!
Great product. My skin is so soft, radiant, and smooth after using this product two or three nights per week. The puckers over my eyebrows are noticeably disappearing.
I have been using for 3 weeks.  It feels nice when I put it on, and my skin does feel hydrated.  Have not seen any major difference on my skin

I’ve only been using this for 2 or 3 weeks but I actually think it’s working! My skin seems to have fewer lines, an overall smoother look, and it’s soft - definitely feel like it’s more youthful looking. I’m using this at night, followed by a heavy night cream, and then washing with a mild cleanser and using a Cerave retinol cream during the day under make up. Not sure if it’s this combination or this specific product, but I love it!

review_title: Sebum be gone! Lovely rice polish
review_text: this is the most I’ve ever spent on a cleanser. I’ve sampled dermalogica enzyme powder and loved it. What I didn’t like was the design of the package and the scent. It has a chemical smell to it. I spent months researching other types of cleansing powders and finally decided to bite the bullet and purchase Tatcha Rice Polish. My skin is very oily and I have deep pores, which fills with oils and turns into sebum. Sounds nasty.  My pores tend to clog especially around my nose area. When I first used the polish, there was no scent and the color was lovely. It’s a mint green color. I added some water to the powder and it became a nice foam and cleansed my skin. My skin is absolutely smooth and the sebum is gone. I love it. It’s gentle enough where I can use it every day. I will try the other products.

This will always be in my skin care routine! It lathers so well, leaves my skin feeling soft and I love that it’s not too rough or gritty on my skin. Amazing on my sensitive/acne prone skin. I have this one and the blue calming one and I love both!

I remember the reason I got hooked onto this was when I purchased products from the tatcha website and they sent me samples of each kind of rice powder. I loved the gentle and classic the most and just decided to go with the classic. I have to say this cleanser is AMAZING. It’s not like your typical exfoliant, this helps get rid of dead skin with enzymes. It’s NOT like a scrub. For me personally, I am able to use this product daily after I remove my makeup and I use a very small amount to lather and cleanse with. Over the course of a few weeks I noticed my small breakouts I would get started to disappear, and people would compliment my skin frequently when I switched to this product. I love the smell, I love the results, and it’s honestly been lasting me MONTHS of use. I HIGHLY RECCOMEND you only put up the spout a tiny bit, not all the way up so you get a small amount of product dispensed. I usually get my hands wet first before pouring the product and lather with a little water before using it on my face. This is honestly my new holly grail skincare product and I can’t see myself without it. I have dry skin btw if that helps for reference!

Love the product. HATE the new packaging. A ton of powder will be lost the first few times you use it since it’s impossible to control how much comes out when the bottle is full and new.Really annoyed they change the packaging to something more tedious.
This product packaging is incredible - truly Tatcha is always setting the bar when it comes to product innovation. This brightens by skin and really just makes me glow - CHEF KISS.
This leaves my face feeling smooth and very clean. However, it can get very drying.

I have Tatcha moisturizer and absolutely love it. I decided to try this product since I love their moisturizer so much. I love this just as much as the moisturizer. Tatcha products are the best. It doesn’t take much to make a lather on face. My face feels so clean and fresh after using. I can’t wait to try more from Tatcha!

I was gifted this cleanser along with the Camellia Oul Cleanser by my mother in law, who gave me the remainder of her purchase because it didn’t work for her. I used both products as my cleansing routine in the morning and after removing makeup for three weeks, and it was like I wasn’t even washing my face at all. While I felt good and my skin felt soft after washing, I was breaking out like a teenager and having trouble managing spots that lasted for days. It seems like an extremely gentle exfoliated, which I liked, but I didn’t receive any exfoliating benefits with use. Would not recommend when I can spend a fraction of the price on drugstore products that actually work.

I first tried this as a mini. It lasted a long time & I had great results with it- so I bought the full size. It’s now a regular in my evening routine. I first use a cleansing o or balm & then follow up with this. It leaves my skin soft and healthy looking. I love a lot of Tatcha products anyway but this is by far my favorite

This stuff is life changing. I’ve never had a fantastic complexion but this is a game changer. I’ve been using it for 2 years and it has improved the texture (smoother) and tone of my face. It’s definitely a must try and a little goes a long way.

Amazing!! Tonight was my first night using it and my skin feels soft, clean and cool. I can tell it’s working deep within my pores. Normally, after I cleanse, I tone and there’s still a little makeup on the cotton swab but not after using this. Highly recommend for other combo skin folks! This entire line has made my skin radiant and is shrinking my pores.... just buy it- you will not regret it!

I’ve been testing out the Indigo one since June 2020. I’m still unsure how I feel about it in terms of wanting to continue to use this in the long run. I love the application process of this. It’s really fun and I feel good utilizing this product in my skincare routine to give myself some self-care. I especially find myself gravitating towards this product by the end of the week or just when my skin feels dirty or tired. I like the idea of using this as an exfoliator since I have drier skin, so when I used this almost every day—it was way too drying for me. I’ve been using this on and off, just like I would with a general exfoliator. After each use, my skin does feel clean BUT... it can feel a tad bit dry. I think my skin is just dry no matter what though!!The only other reason why I’m not sure I’m IN LOVE with this product is because I think it may be causing tiny break outs here and there. I feel like I notice more tiny break outs whenever I use this. But I do not get irritated skin concerns—just skeptical acne? It’s hard to say because my skin has become acne-prone ever since I got into my mid-late 20’s...Overall, I’m fond of the idea of this and the powder itself is really cool and easy to use. I just pour some onto my palm and then sprinkle some warm water. I find that warm water definitely dissolves this enzyme powder much thoroughly than cold water. I might try the purple (gentle) in the near future!

I have extremely sensitive, dry skin. I am prone to red, irritated and itchy skin so I have always steered clear of anything that scrubs or exfoliates the skin. I was given a sample of this product and it was AMAZING. extremely gentle, does not feel like abrasive or rough at all. it is well worth the money.
This may be expensive but it’s worth every penny.  Having rosacea and trying to find products that work has been challenging until I discovered this.... miracle in a jar.
The packaging is enough to make you feel like royalty.  The product inside is truly Devine.  So gentle, yet so effective.

I have the “Deep” polish and it is very gentle and non-abrasive.  I absolutely love it!  Love that it’s a powder and it develops a gente foam when rubbed onto the wet skin.  Makes my skin soooo soft and clean, without feeling stripped.  Also really really love the dispenser top!

I have very oily skin, so I bought the green colored Deep version. I already have a chemical exfoliant in my face routine, so I was looking for a physical one to use a step before it. I followed the YouTube reviews and used half a teaspoon amount of powder. I dripped some water into my hands and rubbed them together and the foam was super thick. I couldn’t feel the powdery grains anymore. I rubbed it into my face for 20 seconds then rinsed off my face. I loved that it gave me a squeaky, dull, matte face. Absolutely no shine, how I like it. Literally a smooth clean canvas. My face wasn’t stripped dry and it didn’t peel. My face was still soft, but just not shiny. I’m really happy with my purchase. This really did work on my oily skin. (Before I bought this, I wondered how the powder would be distributed. If I had to use a spoon or not to scoop it out. I should’ve known that the high quality Tatcha brand would include a sliding cover over the spout/hole. Genius! No spoon needed.)

I have had both the classic and deep versions of this polish and I cannot live without it. I have oily skin and this doesn’t strip it or make it feel tight whatsoever. It also has given my skin a natural glow without makeup over time,, which I adore. Totally worth the investment imho.

Can I just say that after 3 years of trying different products this one improved my skin like nothing ever happened. I had dark deep blackheads some hyperpigmentation and lots of deep clogged congested pores. Saved my skin in the cold Canadian winters.
This is a beautiful product! Feels amazing on my face and makes my skin looks luminous! I love this product and it is worth every penny

I have extremely sensitive skin and on top of that I use a oxygen cannula that sits on my cheeks that irritates my skin. I’ve tried just about everything I figured I’d give this a go but I was hesitant because of the price but a little goes a long way and it works magic. I don’t use it every day but rather every other day or every few days . Would definitely recommend and buy again

review_title: Long term user, a must have for me
review_text: I have used classic and deep formulas. This is a must have for me. I’ve been using this for almost a year and I have noticed my overall skin texture is smoother without feeling dry. Pores are noticeaby smoother. My cheeks are sensitive and neither formulation has irritated. Just love it.

Nice for physical exfoliation without being too harsh on the skin. I only took off a star because it can be a bit of a hassle to mix the right amount of water with the powder to make the paste, but if you don’t mind that part then it’s a great product.
I’m absolutely in love with all Tatcha products. And this makes my face feel super hydrated!
I was amazed how soft, smooth and plump my skin felyt after using this. When you lather the powder it feels so soft and gentle on the skin. I have normal-combo skin and this worked great!
Love this product! So far only have used it once but it definitely made my sensitive skin feel a lot smoother without irritation like most exfoliants

This product makes me feel more like moisturizing than exfoliating. It just sort of foams your face and gives you a really subtle exfoliation. My skin didn’t feel raw or stripped afterward and it has been looking smoother, brighter and more even ever since. Highly recommended!

I decided to try this product because I was in search of a gentle but effective exfoliator. I prefer to use this product in the shower after cleansing my face 1-3 times a week. A small dime size amount is all you need and then I just drizzle a few drops of water into my palm. The powder transforms into a nice creamy/foamy lather that leaves my face feeling squeaky clean. However sometimes it feels like it strips the skin a little too much, and I rush to tone and moisturize as soon as I jump out of the shower. I still think I would buy this again.

would have given the product five stars if they didn’t cheap out on the amount of product, the jar is only 2/3’s full and they purposely designed it so you can’t tell... it’s a not a bag of chips y’all!

I have been using this product for 6 months. Been using it as a second wash in the morning after the Glossier milky jelly cleanser. I have oily skin in the t-zone and thought the Tatcha Powder would help that. I have some discoloration and redness as well and this powder hasn’t really helped either of those. But the Tatcha Violet C mask once a week has helped the discoloration I believe.

I have sensitive skin and wanted to find a exfoliate that I could use everyday. I use the classic one and I have combination sensitive skin . I do like this product as it does not irritate my skin and does a good job at what it’s meant for . I took one star off because of the price , it does last you awhile however.
Super soft yet cleansing. Hasn’t caused any new breakouts. My skin feels super soft after I wash it.

I chose this as a free sample last time I ordered from Sephora because I had heard and read rave reviews. I have very sensitive and acne prone skin so I have trouble finding effective exfoliants which are gentle enough for my skin. This did not disappoint. I liked it so much I ordered it immediately! I like how you can control the “grittiness” depending on how much water you use. I’ve also mixed it with my Avene cleanser. Expensive, but a little goes a long way.Updated On: February 12, 2020I have now used this twice a day with my regular Avene cleanser for almost 3 weeks. My skin is super clear and soft. I really think this is worth the price tag.

I have only been using this product for three days and OMG!!. My face was instantly exfoliated, brighten, and even toned. My husband commented on how bright and clean my face looked today. I just freaken love this. I have tried many other exfoliates, and laura mercier gommage was my go too, not favorite but better than most. This is heaven! I love it! I am so glad I found you rice polish.
I have very sensitive skin. I’m usually dry but sometimes get oily in my T-zone. This got rid of all the rough/uneven texture on my skin, and my skin looks so smooth now!
10/10. My skin has never felt so soft and clean and the smell is lovely. I will repurchase this until the end of time!

I bought the indigo (blue) one because of sensitive skin (apparently the purple is for dry skin). I expected a lot more from a product I’m apparently supposed to use daily. This won’t even last the month. On top of that, while my skin feels great after use, its caused a acne breakout all over one cheek which I’ve NEVER had before. It’s going to leave me with scars. Definitely returning.

This is an incredible product. It leaves my skin so soft and is slowly improving the redness on my face. Very easy to use. I normally do not spend this much on facial products, but this is well worth it.

review_title: AMAZING-I’ve lost count of my rice polish empties!
review_text: Listen, it’s expensive. And trust me, I’ve tried to live without it, but I can’t. 6 months ago my previous powder ran out and I decided I would try and find a cheaper dupe and experiment with new products. After a carousel of different regimes my skin was bumpy with little breakouts here and there. I walked past this product and decided to buy it again and after a week my skin was clear bright and smooth again. I’m not going to claim this is a miracle product, but its the closest thing I’ve ever found to one. Together with the camellia cleansing oil it is truly the HG cleanse.

Left my skin feeling too tight. For context, I have oily, moderately acne-prone skin, and noticed in spite of this product being marketed for those with oily skin types, that my skin found it overly abrasive (and mind you, trusts saying a lot for someone’s skin who can handle tough exfoliants such as DE Sukari Baby-Facial) Even after using the Tatcha Essence product, my skin still felt uncomfortably tight and sapped of suppleness and hydration. Mind you this is after one week of use, using it only once or twice a week, both in the evening and morning. Using it strictly in the evening or morning only made no difference to the effect it had on my skin. However, I will be open to trying out the classic rice polish and the gentle version to see if either of those are suitable for my skin.

This powder is just as it says, “gentle”. This is the first Tatcha product I have ever purchased and I am instantly hooked. It feels so good when I apply it to my skin and it is very soft. I have noticed, as I apply this product, it does rub into my skin a little bit - it doesn’t stay “foamy”, but that doesn’t bother me. My skin feels clean, polished, and looks very healthy after I use this product. Will highly recommend this product!
I purchased the gentle version. It is wonderful. I use it one to two times per week and it is coarse enough to exfoliate but gentle enough to not irritate my sensitive skin. Highly recommend!

Reminded of Amore enzyme product. Bought it because it’s one of Meagan Markle’s fave product and so many good reviews. It was just okay. Didn’t see any wow effect with this. Smells and feels good though. Not mind blowing.

I’ve had this product for around a month and I feel that it is safe to say that this and a lot of Tatcha’s products will be a staple in my beauty routine. I use this every night after my Tatcha cleanser and it has been amazing. I love the way it foams and I feel like it really does help to fully cleanse my skin. The only gripe I have is that when I pour the product it gets some of the powder gets stuck in the lip and it builds up but that is not enough of a reason to not love this product.

review_title: One use and I’m a believer
review_text: Ok so I saw Jeffree Star using this on one of his recent posts raving about how it makes his foundation application flawless so I figured why not I’ll try it. It arrived today and I just used it and OMG my face became sooo silky smooth and I kid you not my pore shrunk before my eyes! And the product itself is in a lot bigger of a container than I imagined so it’s going to last a while making it well worth the price tag!
Awesome product to fight against my acne. It also is good for cleaning out my pores as well. I tend to use this product with water mixed in rather than mixing it with the cleansing oil.

I was sceptical about buying this product at first due to the price but Holy Cow! Totally worth the splurge! I love the way it feels on my face while washing, sooo silky! and my face feels so clean after! Also, major props to the dispenser top. Makes it easy to control how much product comes out and no spills! Highly recommend!

As excited as I was to use this product, I am sad that I will have to return it, as it flared up my rosacea and seborrheic dermatitis. I did a test to stop using it for a couple of weeks, and the conditions receded. It is probably great for normal skin but not for mine.

review_title: Only a little bit goes a long way!
review_text: Okay - I am literally obsessed with this cleanser. I first tried this within the Tatcha gift package and I absolutely love it. Also - just a little amount goes a long way. It foams up right away and really cleanses my face the best. I can’t say enough good things about Tatcha products. Seriously the best.
I am liking the powder formula very much.  Is it life changing no.

review_title: Does absolutely nothing and super drying
review_text: I’ve oily skin and this made my skin so DRY. I woke up EXTRA oily because of this and it looked like someone cooked bacon on my face. It also doesn’t exfoliate at all. It’s like cleaning your skin with water and foam. I’m not sure how this product has good reviews? It also caused tiny acne as well. The pH level is also very acidic. It will eventually ruin your skin.
I purchased this after receiving and loving a sample.  It takes only a very small amount to use to exfoliate.  I love it so much I just purchase a second bottle so I wouldn’t run out.

I have combo skin and have tried both the classic and the gentle polish powders. This is a nice, gentle way to exfoliate daily if you want (I only use this 2-3 times a week). I don’t notice too much difference between the classic and gentle powders, but they both leave my skin smoother and brighter albeit a little on the dry side (but its supposed to do that as it is removing dead skin cells). I took off a star because of the price (you can find similar products online that might not be as ’clean’ or SLS free) and because as pretty as the packaging looks, it’s very bulky. Would recommend if you want a gentle exfoliator and can handle the cost.

This is a great exfoliator especially for sensitive skin, it leaves my skin silky smooth and clean. I reccomend that you use a light moisturizer afterwards since it leaves the skin a little dry, but overall gets the job done a little goes a long way.

Great product, I’ve used the green one previously, but my skin got a little dry this winter and this one is perfect for it.  I can already see a different in my texture after 2 weeks of use.  Will repurchase for sure.
I love this face cleanser, it doesn’t feel like my skin is over-cleansed/dried out after rinsing the product off.

My new go to! I use the Tatcha Deep Clean every night and then this one about twice a week. I got the Calming because I deal with a lot of redness and my goodness. It really works. Not only does it make my face feel as smooth as a babies bottom, but the redness is almost completely gone every time. I would HIGHLY recommend.

I was super hesitant but excited to try this I didn’t know what to expect so I got a sample, which that little sample has lasted 3 washings so it’s worth the price. I felt immediate results my skin was soft and a little tight right after but the next day my skin was so soft and the next washing my skin was even softer and smoother. Def replace your face washes and just get this its the best thing I have tried in a while. Watch the video on the product for how to use I winged it before using it the first time and it was a little clumsy.
I just bought this product and I love it! It is a very fine foam that leaves my skin cleaned and smooth.

I loved this for about a week of use. I have extremely dry skin, so i was looking for a regimen to fix that problem. while my skin is dry, i haven’t broken out in years. probably since i was 16, and now i’m 19. over the last few days, i’ve gotten pimples in places i never used to have them; even when my skin was more acne prone. i didn’t want to believe it was the problem, but after reading some other reviews i think it may be. i’m really bummed about it.

So much more than rice!This cleanser has made my red, irritated skin so smooth and clear. It’s totally changed my perspective of what an exfoliator needs to be. Plus, using it really does feel like a ritual of self-care each day.
Just another fab Tatcha product. My skin has become so clear and smooth since using this product and others.

Can’t figure out how to change the type I bought. But I have the calming one. This stuff is SO GOOD. So worth the price. I use it as my first step in the morning, in place of a cleanser. It makes my skin softer than a baby’s bottom, helps with redness and gesture and reduces blackheads. Love this, so worth the price.
I really wanted this product to work for my skin, but it just made my face tight and dry afterwards. ):

This is such a wonderful product I fell in love after the first time I tried it!! It gently exfoliates everything and conditions my skin to look radiant! This is a must have in my daily routine. I am hooked on Tatcha!

I typically have to switch my routine up in the winter because I live in an area that gets very cold and dry. This is the first exfoliant that I can not only use every day, but it is gentle enough to get the job done without making me overly dry. I love the packaging. It is extremely easy to use, and you don’t lose product because of the design. Let’s not forget the added bonus of how soft your hands feel as well. I adore Tatcha. I will be repurchasing this if I ever manage to finish it as a little does go a long way.

I bought this YESTERDAY because my skin was peeling from a new retinol I added into my routine. My skin has never felt so smooth in years. This is such a gentle (yet abrasive enough) exfoliater. I 10/10 recommend to anyone

Got this in a sample size and have it on my list to get the full size soon.  It feels amazing! Smooth soft skin without harsh exfoliation.  Like that it’s a natural exfoliate, instead of the ’beads’ that are linked to pollution.

I use this a few times a week to exfoliate the skin and it’s not harsh or drying like other exfoliating powders I’ve used. Effective, gentle and a little goes a long way. It gives my face a polished look and my pores are more minimized after adding this to my skin care routine . Highly recommend.

My new fav!! I use this with the Tatcha Pure One Step Camellia Cleansing Oil and my skin feels so clean and smooth. The powder dissolves into a nice foamy cleanser that gently exfoliates and cleanses the skin. I have seen a dramatic difference in appearance and texture of my skin since I started using this. I would definitely recommend it.

Love, love, love Tatcha’s powder cleansers. I’ve used a couple different ones and honestly cannot tell the difference, aside from smell. I use the Deep version only because it smells more like brown rice, and I happen to quite enjoy the scent. I don’t know how many jars I’ve used up (I’ve probably exceeded ten at this point.) It’s expensive, but I love it. It’s also extremely travel friendly!
Love the way it makes my very sensitive skin feel, smooth like a baby’s behind!

I have the blue jar, which is the calming powder. I LOVE this product. It’s gentle, but still leave my skin clean and smooth. I use this in the evenings, when I need to remove the whole day from my skin. So soothing, yet refreshing. Magic! Holy grail!
Love this, however since I already use the tatcha cleanser I don’t think this product is necessary. I will continue to use
This is such a fun product to use. I’ve been using it for a month and my skin has never looked better.

I have combination, very sensitive skin and this works amazing for me. It is not an abrasive scrub at all- so do not get this if you want something with grit to it. It’s extremely gentle and is more of a deep foaming cleanser than an exfoliator but I absolutely love it! I use this as well as the deep cleanser by Tatcha and I am obsessed! Highly recommend!

This stuff is fabulous. I use it as step 2 in my nightly regimen. First, I use the Camelia oil cleanser to clear my makeup, and follow it up with this exfoliating cleanser. Used together,  I’ve noticed my skin is calmer, more even-toned, and it feels hydrated and not oily in the morning.

As an exfoliating wash, this is effective. It also does a bit of toning which is great as a sort of two in one. However, there are down sides to using this. It is *messy*. The powder has a tendency to get all over my sink when I use it. Additionally, the powder can go right up your nose if you’re not careful about inhaling while applying. So yes it works and I will definitely buy from this company again. But would I buy this specific product again? Probably not.
So good for deep cleansing

I LOVE this exfoliator. It works great on my sensitive acne-prone skin. Didn’t dry my skin out after each use but left it feeling super smooth and soft. I only use it 1-2 times a week. Such a gentle exfoliator and will definitely buy it again.
Great product! I am older and having some issues with my face breaking out. This has calmed my face and healed my blemishes overnight. It feels so good on my skin I look forward to using it everyday.

review_title: where have you been all my life?!
review_text: Repeat after me: DO NOT CHEAP OUT ON SKINCARE PRODUCTS!I have struggled for YEARS with dry, sensitive skin where I either broke out to the point that my skin was raw or I had to do serious exfoliation once a week.I took a chance with this product based on research I’ve done and I’m seriously kicking my own butt for not getting it sooner.A little goes a very long way (a common theme with this product line) and my skin is the smoothest it’s been in decades.  It’s certainly not clearing up my discoloration (not intended to do that), but I’m starting to achieve the glass skin look that’s popular now.So worth it!!
I really love this product my skin looks radiant; you do have to be extra careful not to breathe the powder in
Wonderful addition to my routine! Makes my skin super soft.

I’ve had the gentle rice enzyme powder for several months now and it does what it claims. During the winter months, I’d been in desperate need of an exfoliant and this product was recommended to me by a friend who is into all things Asian beauty. I got a kick out of my face smelling like a rice-cake while massaging the powder into my skin and once the product was rinsed off of my face, my skin was smooth and supple - ready for my moisturizer. I would recommend this product to anyone looking for a gentle yet effective exfoliant.

I have used this product multiple times, watched and read multiple people advising how you should use this product, and honestly, I’m a little confused. I decided to purchase this product because I’ve heard many people raving about how good it is. When I tried it out, however, I was confused.The instructions on Sephora and on their video say to pour a bit of powder on your damp hands to create a lather before applying to your face. Regardless of how much or little product or water I used, I didn’t really see anything? Just milky looking water.. Not sure if that’s how it’s supposed to be like.As well, after using it on my face, I honestly couldn’t see or feel a difference. Disappointing.

I am so thankful that I discovered this product! I have very sensitive skin, so finding a nice exfoliant that doesn’t leave my face completely red and burning (sometimes for days) was always a challenge. This is so gentle, and a little really goes a long way. It leaves my skin feeling very smooth, and I have noticed an improvement in my overall texture and pigmentation. I would highly recommend this to people with sensitive skin like me, no longer will my poor cheeks suffer from overly abrasive exfoliants!

WOW WOW WOW!!! After the first time I used this, my skin felt so smooth!!! I noticed the change of my skin in texture AS I WAS USING IT!!! My skin looks so supple and appears smooth as well. My skin seriously looks like I could end the routine right there. I was so shook. Like, the kind of shook you have to pinch yourself. My skin breaks out easily and it took Tatcha to help me breakup with my former skincare brand. RIP Philosophy. Yes this brand is bougie, but, they work. Nothing is ever touching my skin again.
Knocked one star for the price only. This is the best cleanser I’ve ever used. Nothing makes me face feel smoother or more cleansed without feeling stripped. It truly is the PERFECT balance.
Been using this product for years and I just love how it’s so gentle for an exfoliant. I use this every morning :)
Such an amazing product. It’s a staple in my skin care routine. My dry skin always looks so good after using the rice enzyme powder.

Received a sample, used it and it was so SMELLY. Now I’ve never used this type of product before so I was not sure what to expect, it did make my face silky smooth...but it smelled god awful. Needed to wash my face afterwards and use my rose toner to freshen up my skins smell.
Works well and leaves the skin feeling soft and clean after. I got a sample size myself.

I have been struggling to find an exfoliating treatment for years, and happened on this at my local Sephora. So far so good.  My skin looks great, and it’s not overly stressing my skin like scrubs with beads in them do.
Made my skin soft but made me breakout every time I used it. After a week I took it back.

I bought this product to help balance out all the problems I’ve been having with my skin over the past several months - uneven texture, dryness, oily t-zone and chin and breakouts. SO happy with the results! I wash my face using my Origins checks and balances wash and then sprinkle the amount of powder on my hand and just add a couple drops of water. It makes a light paste that’s easier to put on my skin and get a bit more of a exfoliating and then I add a bit more water and thoroughly wash my face in small circles. The regular powder has very fine granules in it, making it gentle but powerful at the same time. After one week of using this with the Tatcha water cream my skin look amazing. I use it when I wash my face every night and I wake up glamorous!

I gave this product three stars simply because I don’t know how I feel about it. I go back and forth. I bought the mini pack that has this and the oil that breaks down makeup. I use this powder after the oil to kind rinse off any excess makeup or oil left on my face. I like how clean my face feels afterwards, but I also immediately feel my face getting dry. The good thing is that they have a product that you can mist on your face afterwards that has a “dewy” feel and it brings my face back to life. It’s definitely one of those “hit or miss” situations with this powder. It may be that I have really dry skin, who knows. But I definitely won’t be giving up on this brand.
I love Japanese and Korean skincare! When I started using this product I saw amazing results. My skin looks more polished!
Absolutely love! Replaced my Clarisonic!

I had the full size for over a year, since I did not use it daily. I end up using more than the half in the shower to exfoliate my body since I was over this product! I am not buying exfoliating products any more but if I did I will buy this again, but the travel size since it last forever. It does leaves your skin feeling soft and moisturized.
Just fine, not as good as I thought it was. Heard from friend about it. Didn’t like much. I will buy another brand next time.
LOVE! LOVE! LOVE! Super hydrating, a little goes a long way.

I don’t understand the positive reviews on this product. The instructions say to use it *after* moisturizer. In other words, apply your regular expensive night moisturizer and then put this on top of it. Seems to be a gimmick to invent more stages  (i.e., more products) to a skincare routine. I’ve tried it with and without moisturizer. It is not as moisturizing as a typical night moisturizer and adds no noticeable benefit to other night moisturizers. I don’t get it. Invest in a quality night cream instead.

review_title: Make my skin soft and supple in the morning
review_text: I love the gel texture of this product. I used it as a last step in my night time skincare. I don’t use it every day because laziness...duh. But when I do use it at night, it needs like 3-4 minutes to dry so that it won’t be sticky on my skin and I wake up with baby soft skin. I was trying this out and comparing this with the glow recipe watermelon sleeping mask. I like glow recipe better. It just felt more luxurious than belif aqua bomb for me personally. Skincare ingredients wise, they both do the same thing, make your skin super soft and supple in the morning...
Just bought this product today and decided to give it a try. Can someone please tell me what h is this in the jar?! I am wondering how this product was even made.

Great for plumping up dry skin over night! The gel feels so soothing and it’s incredibly lightweight. The price point is great for a clean beauty item. The only thing missing is that it doesn’t have any anti-aging or oils. It’s great for a lightweight gel moisturizing mask but I  would alternate with other night creams.
I love this sleeping mask! My skin feels so plump immediately after using it. Even more so in the morning. Definitely something I use at least 4-5 times a week.
Nice, light nighttime moisturizer that doesn’t feel greasy

I’d bought this to replace my empty laniege sleeping mask and I came across an Instagramer raving about it at the time I was pregnant. So I did some research and most Korean skincare brands are very good when it comes to the type of ingredients they used for their products and this is safe to use during pregnancy. So I’d splurged and bought the product to try and I love it! The texture is bouncy and so ever moisturizing. I wake up with a moisturizered face each morning. I didn’t repurchase the product again because I it’s quite expensive and I was gifted the etude house collagen sleep mask to try so I’m using that. Maybe when it goes on sale or when there’s a 2x points event I’ll buy it again to use.
Great night cream that doesn’t transfer to your pillow. Really hydrating and soothing, will be buying this again.

review_title: I Absolutely amazing for oily/acne prone skin
review_text: I have tried other sleeping masks like from youth to the people and korres’s greek yoghurt but they are so heavy and thick for my skin. Now this product is absolutely perfect. It feels so cool on contact, soaks in perfectly, and I don’t feel like I am clogging up my pores. It hydrates perfectly. The only thing I wish it had was a spatula to scoop it out because it is kind of difficult.
LOVE IT! It is just the best! I wake up with full hydrated face and without any redness. the best
This product made my eyes burn just from it being around it, it had a strong fragrance and it also just didn’t do what it said it did, it almost dried out my skin in all honesty.

I was expecting a rich moisturizer that really made my skin feel hydrated. I put it on at night and can’t tell any real difference in the morning. I feel like it just sits on my skin. I’m disappointed.

Love this product! I’ve been using it for about 6 months and it’s heaven! It’s dry in Alberta so I wear this mask every other night and wake up with such soft skin! It’s my favorite! It takes a few uses to kick in so keep at it!

I love the other Aqua Bomb and Moisture Bomb moisturizers from Belif, so I grabbed this during the last Sephora sale to add to my nighttime routine. The ingredients looked great, thought this would be a soothing last step in my routine. Unfortunately, I find this a little irritating after a few minutes. It also dries to a tight kind of film. I hesitate to use it now after retinol or acid treatments. I’ll try to finish it up but I won’t be purchasing this again.

Amazing. Literally amazing. After I finish cleansing my face, this is the perfect overnight mask to hydrate my skin and make everything baby smooth the next morning. I found a new staple in my skincare routine !
A little goes a long way. Very hydrating. I like to use this as a base before foundation.

For someone like me who is very skeptical about new face products  this one blew me away. i have been using this for a long time and I still love this. My skin is predominantly dry and this as my last step in my skin care really plumps up my skin. I love the amount of product you get and the price is pretty ok too. I wish I had used this one earlier  and for those who are wondering, I love this more than the Laneige one.

I’m a mid-light skinned woman in her mid-30s with sensitive combination skin (a combination of acne and fine lines, lol), and I’m already a longtime user and lover of the Aquabomb moisturizer. My skin is prone to both dryness and breakouts, especially in winter or on long flights. The moisturizer has never broken me out, so when I had a transatlantic flight coming up, I thought I’d give this a try as an in-flight treatment. It worked so well, I ended up buying another! I came off the plane looking like I had never heard of jet lag! Now I take it on every trip, and use it at home on particularly cold or dry days, or just when my skin needs some extra love. Like the moisturizer, it hydrates beautifully and does not break me out. Recommend!

I’ve tried A LOT of products (creams, masks, oils)... I have combo skin, which is super sensitive. My skin is dry, but with the wrong products I will break out. The more dry my skin gets, the more red it is... then I use makeup to cover it... which often dries me even more... mix in winter weather and my skin appears to age before my eyes! I have used this for one week, and ALREADY there’s a significant difference! My significant other spontaneously commented two days in a row that I look younger! Worth the purchase, if you are on the fence... just go ahead and buy this one.I haven’t experienced any irritation like I do with the majority of products I’ve tried. I like the cooling effect I feel after washing my face in the evening. The first two nights I wasn’t sure if I noticed “improvement” in the morning, but the following evening I added just a little bit to my cheeks about 30 min after my 1st application... this was where the magic happened for me!

I was hesitant to purchase the full-size version based only upon so many good reviews, but I’m so happy I did.  I love this stuff!I’ve always been pretty terrible about moisturizing my face at night / before bed.  I don’t like the feel of thick moisturizers on my face, especially before I go to sleep, and I don’t want anything transferring to my bedding.  This stuff is perfect for me all-around.  It’s a thin, jelly-like consistency that feels really lightweight and, even not being refrigerated, it has a cooling effect.  It absorbs very quickly and doesn’t leave any or residue to transfer to clothing or bedding.I also love the way my face feels when I wash it off in the morning; my skin feels so soft and clean.  I notice my face is way more hydrated when using this and it looks better overall.   A little goes a long way with this stuff.  One swipe with my middle finger is plenty for my entire face and neck.I am becoming a very big fan of the belif product line, and this is one of my favorites.I’m surprised at how many reviewers stated they broke out after using this, but I am fortunate not to have problem skin or adverse reactions to any products I’ve used.  This product is fantastic and works well for me, especially in these winter months.  When the weather gets warmer, I may try only using this a couple nights per week rather than every night as I’m doing now.

review_title: Hands down the BEST product I own
review_text: This is, by far, honestly, the best mask I’ve ever used on my face. It is worth every penny. I have chronic redness that I’ve never been able to reduce with a product (only can ever cover it up) this definitely made a difference, and my skin has NEVER been so soft, after once use, of anything. Ever. HIGHLY Recommend. BUY THIS PRODUCT.
Perks up and plumps complexion instantly. I can feel the difference in my skin after one application. It’s also gentle and easy on my oily skin.
My new holy grail! My skin feels so soft and hydrated after one use!

Received this is my Sephora play box and I loved it! I already use the aqua bomb moisturizer, which is perfect for combination skin. During the winter my combination skin gets really dry and I saw a difference the next morning after one use. It gets absorbed quickly and you wake up with your skin feeling and looking refreshed !

I never comment on products - this is my first. I haven’t had a break out since I was a teenager. I used this product - the only change in my usual routine - and the next day, I have little white heads and bumps all over my face. Very disappointed. Would never buy (this was a sample) and wish I had read the 1 and 2 star reviews which mentioned breakouts, too.

Belif is easily my favorite skin care brand and this completed my collection (I have both moisture bomb and aqua bomb, the face mist, eye bomb) and this is just as good as the others. I can’t imagine not having this in my life. I’ve repurchased aqua bomb 3 times and I will def repurchase this. My skin has never look better. I can finally wear matte foundation and I’ve never been able to because of my dry skin issues
I have used Belif products for years and this sleeping mask is my go to moisturizer. My skin has been dry so I use it during the day as well.
Easy to use and doesn’t rub off. I feel a noticeable difference in the morning. I have just started using it, so I’m not sure if there are long term benefits.
Very hydrating. Love the texture!

I really love this sleeping mask! I typically use it in place of a moisturizer but I have used it once or twice over a face oil. It dries quickly and doesn’t leave my face feeling sticky. The next morning my face is glowing and hydrated.

I have absurdly dry skin... like if I go 24 without moisturizing I look like a lizard woman. I already use Belif’s Moisturizing Bomb, and figured I’d give this a try. I absolutely love this product! I’ve tried many moisturizers but there’s something about this product that I keep reaching for. The smell is amazing, and the finish feels great.

I have precancerous lesions on my face from years of sun exposure ( I’m 48 ). I have done a series of treatments to resurface my skin down to the layers of the lesions. After each treatment the healing process begins as scabs form and have to slough off.  I’ve used so many products over the past two years searching for one that would accelerate the healing process post treatment. This is the best one I have found. It cuts the new skin regeneration time in half and creates radiance that my lackluster skin needs afterward. I don’t use it for moisture but it is the bomb for healing and radiance !!!  And doesn’t break out my ultra sensitive skin.

The very first time I wore this I got multiple compliments from friends and family that my skin looked like it was glowing. I could never find a good moisturizer for my combo skin but this is a god send for me. Perfect to wear under makeup or just on its own— and it smells so fresh!!
This is the best moisturizer that I’ve bought it doesn’t leave my skin oily and it doesn’t give me any pimple which is a big plus for me
Super awesome smelling and lasts a long time.

review_title: Hydrating, rich and light! Love this product!
review_text: This moisturizer is crafted to absolute perfection. It’s an extraordinary combination of creamy, smooth, and rich, while leaving your skin looking radiant and feeling great. The light formula absorbs directly into the skin and doesn’t leave an oily or dewy look. This product makes my skin feel refreshed and revitalized. The price is amazing for a 50mL jar and I will definitely be purchasing this product again!
Smells amazing but not enough hydration for me. I would suggest this for someone who is very oily!

I love the smell of this product as well as other Origins GinZing products. This gel face moisturizer is great for my skin. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and doesn’t give me an oily shine like some other moisturizers do. This is a great product for people with oily and acne skin issues like myself because it allows your skin to breathe since it’s a gel moisturizer and not a heavy cream.

I absolutely love this moisturizer, it is my go to. It’s a gel formula, so it’s not too heavy or greasy. plus you can visibly see the difference it makes by lightening and evening your skin tone. Must have for anyone!!

Amazing moisture! I use this every morning and it literally wakes me right up! It absorbs nice with no oily residue and leaves your skin feeling so soft! You will  not be dissapointed in this product!
Leaves my skin so soft and it smells amazing!!
Thought it was going to be much more moisturizering then it is. Don’t see a big difference for the price.

review_title: Origins is great, this one is not
review_text: It was just there, did nothing special. Kept my skin at minimum moisturizing for survival, and nothing else. Love Origins but this product is not for me.
I have dry, overly sensitive skin and this moisturizer works wonderfully.  It goes on silky smooth, hydrates my skin and smells great doing it.

I love the scent of this! I love how it transformed my skin... so Idk why I haven’t bought this again!! The craziest part is that this isn’t even targeted towards people who have acne! and it removed all my acne! I love this it makes my skin feel awake and now my skin is not so good so I should definitely repurchase this! its been too long :(  It smells very citrus so if you don’t enjoy that scent I wouldn’t recommend it but if you can look past that get it!!!
Found this on a shopping trip with my daughter and absolutely love it.
A light moisturizer that still feels hydrating with a nice scent. I think it’s priced well and would make a good standard moisturizer for any routine. Definitely for summer.
Has a great scent, but does not help my skin, actually dried it out even more.. leaves skin feeling tight and dry even after applying a lot of product
Non-greasy but at the same time not very moisturizing. It feels really light on the skin with refreshing smell, it’s a nice day cream but definitely not enough for winter.

Looove it! I have dry skin and my skin just loves this stuff. Very lightweight but moisturizes so well! I use this both AM and PM. I wake up with supple skin! I highly recommend. Plus smells nice and citrusy!
Awesome. Super cool on my skin and not greasy or thick. A little product goes a long way and keeps my skin refreshed
Usually 1 moisturizer isn’t enough for my super dry skin, but this one is all I need even in winter!

I got this as a deluxe sample and omg... it’s AMAZING. it smells super citrus-y which is really pleasant and it wakes you up for sure lol. it’s really hydrating and it feels suuuuuper lightweight. it sinks into the skin pretty quickly but only like 80% does, so you still feel  hydrated. definitely a summer lotion, but it still does the job during the winter. once this runs out, I’m definitely buying the fill sized product. :)
Not moisturizing enough...The consistency is too gel-like. I wouldn’t even use it in the summer :(
I have very oily skin and this made a big difference.  I noticed with using this my face doesn’t get as oily throughout the day.
Helps dry patchy skin on face.  Great product for anyone that cannot use any oils.
This product smells amazing (like citrus) and goes so well on my skin.i tried it as a sample and now i’m hooked!

review_title: My skin looks visibly brighter when I use it
review_text: Nice and light, but moisturizes well and makes my skin glowy. Sometimes I mix it with a few drops of Origins youth renewal face oil. It smells great, too. It’s been my go-to for awhile.
I only have the sample and I’m in love with it. I’m going to buy the actual size of it soon. It’s working great for my oily skin and keeps my occasional pimples under control!!

I originally got this as a sample and fell in love with it so I had to buy it in a full size. My skin felt great after using it, my pores looked smaller and a lot of my redness was gone. I have really scensitive skin, a lot of products make me break out but so far my skin has done so well with this one.  I definitely recommend.

This is probably the 10th jar I repurchased.Absolutely love this moisturizer. I have very dry skin and most “super moisturizing“ creams are not moisturizing enough for me. After washing my face it always feels very dry, tight and uncomfortable and this moisturizer provides instant relief. This gel is very lightweight, smells  fresh and is fully absorbed by the skin within 2 minutes. It does not leave a heavy/greasy/sticky feeling, my face does not sweat under it and make up glides on perfectly over it!I will definitely keep buying this product.
Just picked this up, smells amazing, great feel, makes my skin glow and makes me feel amazing!

This is my all time favorite moisturizer. I have been using this for years. I have very dry skin and this smooths my skin out. I use it morning and night. I love the fresh orange smell too. Would recommend.

I have extremely dry skin, and I used this moisturizer before putting on my foundation. The moisturizer didn’t help with my dry patches. I love the citrus smell, and I like the lightweight feeling of the product. It just isn’t moisturizing enough for me.
I use this in the mornings when my face is dull and tired.. Leaves my skin feeling incredibly refreshed and smooth
My favorite part of this product is the smell! It is really refreshing in the morning. Also, unlike some moisturizers, it did not feel heavy nor did it feel like it was clogging up my pores.
Love this product! Recommended by a friend, and have been using it faithful. Smells great. Non greasy texture. Leaves your face with a glow.
I’m really enjoying this moisturizer, It does not feel heavy and the skin and has such a creamy texture. The smell is also amazing.

Smells so good! Great moisturiser which is really light, doesn’t give me breakout and not greasy. I switched to this during Spring/Summer time. Not sure if this would be heavy enough for dry winters though as I have pretty dry skin. Will share my thoughts again after using it for Winter :)
Love love love this moisturizer. It smells great and feels super light and refreshing. Definitely worth checking out! (I got this sample free for testing purposes from influenster)
I love this moisturizer! It is light but gets the job done.

I received this product for testing and review purposes, but I’ve been obsessed with all things Origins for a year now, so all of my opinions are my own and not influenced in any way. This moisturizer hydrates my skin without leaving it feeling oily. It’s extremely light weight and smells amazjng. I use it in the morning and my skin is always left feeling fresh, bright, and energized. My only complaint is that sometimes this moisturizer feels tacky, but that won’t stop me from continuing to buy this product.

I loved this product! I have oily skin, so it can be hard to find a good moisturizer that doesn’t make my skin even oiler. It felt great and it could tell that it made a difference in my skin. I received this product as a free sample

I received this package from influenster I love origins products so I was excited to try this! I have really oily skin so I tried the moisturizer at night and I loved it! I loveeee the face wash! My under eyes are pretty taught so I didn’t notice anything with robe under eye cream!

Super light drying, refreshing moisturizer! Love the gel feeling and how smooth it feels on my skin, especially great for that “zing“ in the morning. Good size too that should last at least half a year.
I was definitely sold on its scent; it is Amaziing! besides the fact that it smells delicious, it is a perfect lightweight moisturizer.

I truly love this moisturizer! I have oily skin so am generally hesitant towards moisturizers (especially in the morning before makeup) but this doesn’t make me more oily. It smells so good and feels good. I received this product for free but all opinions are my own and truthful.

I struggle to find a moisturizer that is a good balance of effective, yet lightweight for my combo skin and this did the trick!! I’m in my late 30’s with somewhat sensitive, reactive skin. I get dry patches on my forehead and on either side of my nose and this gel moisturizer has worked wonders for keeping those areas hydrated while making sure the rest of my face doesn’t feel like an oil slick! I experienced some minor tingling and redness straight after applying, but it went away fairly quickly and didn’t cause any long term issues that would deter me from using this product. Oh and it smells amazing! Very refreshing and citrusy, perfect to wake you up in the morning!! *I received this product for free for testing/review purposes.*

review_title: Great as a refresher, not a moisturizer.
review_text: Great for brightening my skin in the morning and very refreshing. Not as moisturizing as I generally need though.

One of the best moisturizers I have ever used! I usually have normal skin type but tend to get oily around my nose area and this moisturizer helps keep my skin balanced. I love it! Definitely going to repurchase!

I have been using this product for about 2 years now and I am in love with the lightweight texture.The ginzing moisturizer is perfect for normal to oily skin types. The refreshing scent not only smells amazing but it leaves a fresh feel to the skin. Even days that my skin isn’t happy with me all I need to do it apply ginzing and my skin starts to glow. Price is amazing and you definitely will be back for more! (I did received this product for free for testing from influenster and origins!) all opinions are my own and I am not being paid for this review.

This moisturizer is simply amazing. It smells wonderful, its thin and light, and non-greasy. A little goes a long way ladies!! A tiny pat can easily distribute delicious smelling goodness all over your face. It’s so lightweight you can’t even tell you’re wearing it, save for the lovely  scent emanating off of your face! Within 2 weeks of using this my dry skin was gone AND my sunburn healed completely. It really is amazing. I received this product free in exchange for my open and honest review. All opinions are my own!

Never tried any Orgins products before and after a month of daily use I can honestly say that my skin is smoother!!!  LOVE the smell.  resfreshing light citrusy scent. A little goes a long way as well.

This is a great lightweight moisturizer. But, as it’s energizing, I wonder why it doesn’t have SPF because it’s definitely supposed to be a daytime product. I have combination-oily skin and it was nice and lightweight on my skin and absorbed quickly...if it had SPF 25 at least it would get five stars! I received one to try out for testing purposes for free and am enjoying it, so it you’re looking for a good lightweight moisturizer to wake you up in the AM, try this one.
Love the scent of this but beyond that it is a great moisturizer. Very lightweight and doesn’t feel at all greasy. Perfect for under makeup. Absorbs quickly.

I absolutely loved this product. It is light, fresh and gave me just the right amount of moisture I needed. It’s perfect to put on before applying makeup b/c it isn’t too heavy. I live the energizing smell it adds as well!I received this product for free, all opinions are my own.

Overall I really like this moisturizer. It’s light weight and smells great. I have combination skin and it did just fine, no dryness/breakouts. The only thing it didn’t improve was the dry areas I have on my nose.* I received this product to test/review at no cost.

This smells AMAZING! It isn’t too thick and is perfect under makeup. I use this and then a primer and my makeup looks great all day. The days I didn’t use it I could tell a difference on a few dry patches that collects and breaks up my makeup by the end of the day.

The scent of this cream is amazing! I love how light it feels on your skin. It truly feels refreshing. I’m a night cream type of person and I would definitely purchase this. I received mine free for testing purposes but it’s definitely a keeper. No SPF in it for those who like day moisturizers.

this moisturizer is great. it smells amazing. I use it in the morning and it absorbs super quickly. great for my oily skin and my dry patches. Wish it contained an SPF (i don’t like using multiple products on my face) but I will definitely purchase again!

Moisturizer with a ZING! Left my skin soft and moisturizer without feeling heavy or greasy. Light enough to use morning and night, did not clog my pores. Did not cause or exacerbate break outs (for me). I received this product as a free sample in exchange for my unbiased review.

INCREDIBLE! I’m pretty picky about my overall skin care routine and absolutely LOVE this moisturizer from Origins! It’s soft, absorbs well into my skin and isn’t at ALL greasy! I highly recommend this product to anyone! *I received this product free for testing purposes*
I enjoyed this moisturizer. It is light and non greasy!
